title: TACET: Context-Appropriate Acoustic-Social Navigation for Quadrupeds
summary: Quadruped robots entering hospitals, care homes, and quiet offices must be context-appropriate not only in where they move but in how loudly they move: a legged robot's locomotion noise, dominated by foot-ground impacts, is itself a social variable. Prior social navigation respects human space but treats the robot as acoustically uniform, while quiet-locomotion methods reduce noise to an operator-specified, context-blind level. We present TACET, a context-appropriate acoustic-social navigation method that infers social context from the robot's egocentric view and decides both where it walks and how loudly, coupling a slow fine-tuned vision-language reasoner to a fast reactive controller through a single compact behavior token, <gait, speed, social_cost>. The same token conditions both a social costmap (where to go) and a quiet locomotion policy (how loudly to move), while a structured out-of-view memory keeps recently seen people in the reasoner's context after they leave the camera view. On a real quadruped, context-conditioned locomotion lowers locomotion noise by up to 9.3 dBA at matched speed, and across our scenarios the full method keeps personal-space compliance at 100% with low acoustic intrusion (<=2.9 dBA), jointly improving spatial and acoustic performance in the evaluated scenarios. The project page is available at https://rcilab.khu.ac.kr/tacet/.

AI.tldr: TACET：一种上下文适配的声学-社交导航方法，将慢速VLM推理器与快速反应控制器通过行为token <gait, speed, social_cost>耦合，同时决定四足机器人"往哪走"与"走多响"，在真实平台上降低撞击噪声最高9.3 dBA并保持100%个人空间合规。
AI.motivation: 进入医院、养老院和安静办公场所的四足机器人，其运动噪声（主要来自足-地撞击）本身是一种社会变量，需在"怎么走"上符合情境。已有社交导航尊重人类空间但把机器人视为声学上均匀的；静音运动方法则把噪声降到操作者指定、与情境无关的固定水平。因此需要同时兼顾空间与声学的上下文适配导航。
AI.method: 提出TACET：从机器人第一视角推断社会情境，用单个紧凑行为token <gait, speed, social_cost>将慢速微调视觉-语言推理器与快速反应式控制器耦合。该token同时条件化社交costmap（决定去哪）与静音运动策略（决定多响）；并用结构化视野外记忆，使离开相机视野的人仍保留在推理器上下文中。
AI.result: 在真实四足机器人上，情境条件化运动在相同速度下将运动噪声最多降低9.3 dBA；在所评估场景中完整方法保持100%个人空间合规，声学侵入低（≤2.9 dBA），空间与声学性能联合提升。
AI.conclusion: TACET通过单一行为token统一空间社交导航与静音运动，验证了"走哪里"与"走多响"可联合优化，为安静公共环境中四足机器人的情境化社交导航提供了可行方案。

title: GOTT: Object-centric Dexterous Manipulation with a Reusable Cross-Embodiment Primitive
summary: Foundation models and large-scale human data provide rich sources of manipulation intent, but translating this intent into multi-fingered robot behavior remains difficult. Dexterous hands still lack a reusable low-level primitive that reliably establishes contact across tasks and embodiments. We propose GOTT, a reach-acquire-move framework built around a single cross-embodiment contact-acquisition primitive. Given a robot-agnostic object trajectory and a reach specification, GOTT first brings the hand near a task-relevant contact region. The shared closed-loop primitive then establishes stable contact from this approximate initialization, and a pose-conditioned controller tracks the desired object motion. Reach specifications may come from future-aware planning, external models, or human demonstrations, while the primitive and tracking backend remain unchanged. Simulation and real-world experiments show that GOTT is able to establish robust contact across diverse objects, arm-hand platforms, and seen and unseen hand morphologies. It also consistently improves end-to-end task success over open-loop grasp execution.

AI.tldr: 提出GOTT框架，以“接触获取”这一跨本体低级原语为核心，结合reach-acquire-move流程，将操作意图转化为多指灵巧手行为。
AI.motivation: 基础模型与大规模人类数据蕴含丰富的操作意图，但将其迁移到多指机器人行为仍很困难；灵巧手缺乏一种可复用、能跨任务与跨本体可靠建立接触的低级原语。
AI.method: GOTT包含三阶段：给定与机器人无关的物体轨迹和reach规格，先将手带至任务相关接触区域附近；再通过共享的闭环接触获取原语从该近似初始化建立稳定接触；最后由位姿条件控制器跟踪期望物体运动。reach规格可来自未来感知规划、外部模型或人类演示，而原语与跟踪后端保持不变。
AI.result: 仿真与真实世界实验表明，GOTT能在多样物体、臂-手平台以及见过与未见过的手部形态上建立稳健接触，并相对开环抓取执行持续提升端到端任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 跨本体的接触获取原语可作为可复用的低级基元，将高层操作意图有效落地为灵巧操作，且对平台与手部形态具有泛化性。

title: MOSAIC-SV: Real-Time Adaptive Identification of Vessel Dynamics for the Control and Deployment of Aquatic Robots
summary: Model-based control of an aquatic robotic platform depends on a hydrodynamic model that is costly to identify and specific to the hull, payload, and conditions it was measured in. Here, we present MOSAIC-SV, a deployable real-time adaptive dynamics identification and control system that identifies a control-sufficient dynamics model from a spec-sheet engineering prior, without dedicated identification trials, and re-estimates it at every control step of a closed-loop mission while the controller plans on it. A physically admissible unscented Kalman filter re-estimates hydrodynamic, disturbance, and actuator parameters at every control step of the closed-loop mission; while a command-dependent consider projection withholds corrections the current command cannot attribute between actuator effectiveness and external force; and a model predictive path integral controller plans on the current estimate. In simulation on a CyberShip II plant, MOSAIC-SV recovers the transit performance of the calibrated model under static mismatch and transient changes, and stays within 20% of its own transit time at the unscaled prior when its inertia or damping prior is wrong by an order of magnitude. In on-water field trials on the Blue Robotics BlueBoat, a twin-thruster catamaran, MOSAIC-SV transits at least 25% faster and predicts its own motion with at least 56% less error than its frozen engineering prior, including under an unmodeled payload. The same MOSAIC-SV system concept was also feasibly deployed on a 6.3-tonne dual outboard monohull.

AI.tldr: MOSAIC-SV是一种可部署的实时自适应水动力辨识与控制框架，仅凭规格表先验即可在线估计控制足够的动力学模型，并在每个控制步重估参数，在仿真与实船试验中均优于冻结先验。
AI.motivation: 基于模型的水面/水下航行器控制依赖水动力模型，但此类模型辨识成本高，且强依赖于具体船体、载荷与测量工况，难以迁移；因此需要一个无需专门辨识试验、可从工程先验出发并在线自适应的动力学辨识与控制方案。
AI.method: MOSAIC-SV包含三部分协同：1）物理可行的无迹卡尔曼滤波器（unscented Kalman filter），在每个闭环控制步重估水动力、扰动与执行器参数；2）命令相关的consider投影（command-dependent consider projection），抑制当前指令无法在“执行器效力”与“外力”之间区分的修正量；3）模型预测路径积分控制器（model predictive path integral, MPPI），在当前位置估计上进行规划。系统从规格表工程先验出发，无需专门辨识试验，实现边规划边辨识。
AI.result: 在CyberShip II仿真平台上：静态失配与瞬态变化下，MOSAIC-SV可恢复标定模型的航行性能；当惯性或阻尼先验偏差达一个数量级时，其航行时间仍保持在不缩放先验的20%以内。在Blue Robotics BlueBoat双推进器双体船水上试验中：相比冻结工程先验，航速至少快25%，自运动预测误差至少降低56%，且包含未建模载荷情形。同一系统概念也在6.3吨双舷外机单体船上完成可行部署。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC-SV证明了无需专门辨识试验、仅凭工程先验即可在闭环任务中实时辨识并规划的水动力自适应控制范式的可行性，在仿真与多类实船上均带来显著性能与预测精度提升，并具备向大型船舶平台迁移的潜力。

title: Sparse Calibration-Based Personalization of Kernel-Based Gait Phase and Speed Estimation Using Wearable IMUs
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, The 26th International Conference on Control, Automation, and Systems (ICCAS 2026)
summary: This paper presents sparse calibration-based personalization for kernel-based gait phase and walking speed co-estimation from wearable inertial measurement units (IMUs). A 28-speed reference library was constructed from bilateral thigh and shank trajectories in a 20-subject locomotion dataset. Rather than directly applying population-average kernels, the method combines a user-specific baseline estimated from three calibration speeds with a principal-component (PC) model of baseline-centered kinematic deviations. Offline validation showed that personalized kernels reduced phase error relative to the population kernel. In a single-participant online pilot evaluation, the personalized kernels produced numerically lower mean phase and speed errors and ran in real time on embedded hardware. However, the speed effect was not significant, and pairwise phase differences did not remain significant after multiple-comparison correction. The pilot evaluation establishes wearable implementation feasibility while indicating reference-to-online dataset mismatch and the need for larger-cohort validation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于稀疏标定的个性化核方法，用于IMU步态相位与速度联合估计，验证了嵌入式实时可行性。
AI.motivation: 群体平均核难以适应个体差异，需以少量标定速度实现个性化，提升步态相位与行走速度的联合估计精度。
AI.method: 基于20名受试者双侧大腿与小腿轨迹构建28速度参考库；用三个标定速度估计用户基线，并建立以基线为中心的运动学偏差主成分（PC）模型，合成个性化核替代群体平均核。
AI.result: 离线验证中个性化核降低相位误差；单受试者在线试点中相位与速度平均误差数值更低，并在嵌入式硬件上实时运行；但速度效应不显著，多重比较校正后成对相位差异亦不显著。
AI.conclusion: 试点验证了可穿戴实现可行性，但存在参考库与在线数据集的失配，需更大规模队列验证。

title: REDIRECT: A 1% Fix for Bad Robot Habits
summary: Robots can acquire bad habits from a few defective moments in otherwise useful teleoperation. In mixed-quality robot data, normal and problematic demonstrations share most task behavior and differ only at a local action continuation. Full retraining is costly, while fine-tuning on clean data alone offers limited recovery under a small update budget. We ask whether the local difference can instead be fixed with only 1% of the full-training sample-backward budget. Using only episode-level retained/problematic labels, REDIRECT localizes the branch, assigns a coherent retained continuation to the original observations around it, and anchors shared behavior, without frame-level annotations or additional interaction. Across three randomized ManiSkill tasks and three seeds, REDIRECT raises the mean success rate from 68.2% to 90.3%, recovering 88.8% of the clean-retraining gap versus 22.1% for matched-compute fine-tuning. On a PiPER arm, it recovers 86.7-92.9% of the clean-only gap across cup insertion and towel folding. Local robot habits can therefore be repaired by spending the update budget on the behavioral difference rather than relearning shared behavior.

AI.tldr: REDIRECT 仅用 1% 的全训练反向传播预算，借助回合级保留/问题标签定位并修复机器人混合质量数据中的局部坏习惯。
AI.motivation: 机器人可从少量有缺陷的遥操作时刻中习得坏习惯；混合质量数据中正常与问题演示共享大部分行为，仅在局部动作延续处不同。全量重训代价高，而在小更新预算下仅用干净数据微调恢复有限。作者希望用极低更新预算（1% 全训练样本-反向传播预算）修复该局部差异。
AI.method: REDIRECT 仅使用回合级保留/问题标签：定位分支点，围绕该点为原始观测分配一致的保留延续，并锚定共享行为；无需帧级标注或额外交互。
AI.result: 在 3 个随机化 ManiSkill 任务、3 个随机种子下，REDIRECT 将平均成功率从 68.2% 提升至 90.3%，恢复干净重训差距的 88.8%，而等算力微调仅恢复 22.1%。在 PiPER 机械臂的杯具插入与毛巾折叠任务上，恢复干净-only 差距的 86.7–92.9%。
AI.conclusion: 局部机器人坏习惯可通过将更新预算用于行为差异而非重新学习共享行为来修复。

title: SUAVE: Unified Video-Action Models via Masked Diffusion
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) inherit strong semantic grounding from pretrained vision-language backbones but are typically optimized for predicting actions rather than future observations. They can see and act, but they do not imagine the future before acting. World action models (WAMs) built on video diffusion backbones can imagine but treat language as frozen conditioning on a continuous latent space. Unified models bring these modalities into one architecture, but they either decode autoregressively, one token at a time, or keep video continuous with an auxiliary action head. In this work, we present SUAVE, a Single vocabulary Unified Action-Video modEl in which a masked diffusion transformer generates video and actions conditioned on language, with all three modalities represented as discrete tokens in a shared sequence. Choosing which tokens to mask at inference turns the same network into a world model, a robot policy, or a video-action model. For action-free co-training, the action positions of unlabeled video are filled with mask tokens and excluded from the loss. Simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate two findings. First, a single SUAVE model predicts long-horizon video and acts as a policy, competitive with dedicated world models and specialized action policies on static and dynamic manipulation tasks. On a real robot, our model generates subgoal images and an action chunk spanning one second of motion in 1,030 ms on an RTX 5090 GPU, sustaining closed-loop control at 2.5 actions per second. Second, pretraining on robot video and co-training on human video substantially improves policy performance and zero-shot robustness to distribution shift. Together, these results show that masked diffusion is a practical and versatile foundation for unified video-action modeling.

AI.tldr: SUAVE 提出用单一离散词表下的掩码扩散 Transformer 统一建模语言、视频与动作，通过选择推理时被掩码的 token 使同一网络充当世界模型、机器人策略或视频-动作模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）擅长语义接地但只预测动作、不预测未来观测；基于视频扩散的世界动作模型（WAM）能想象未来却把语言当作冻结条件；统一模型则要么自回归逐 token 解码，要么保留连续视频并外挂动作头，均未在单一架构内真正统一三模态。
AI.method: 将语言、视频、动作全部离散化为共享序列中的 token，用掩码扩散 Transformer 在语言条件下同时生成视频与动作。推理时通过选择掩码哪些 token，使同一网络分别扮演世界模型、机器人策略或视频-动作模型；无动作视频的共训练中，将动作位置填为掩码 token 并从损失中排除。
AI.result: 单一 SUAVE 模型可预测长时程视频并作为策略，在静态与动态操作任务上与专用世界模型和专门动作策略相当。在真实机器人上，于 RTX 5090 上 1,030 ms 内生成子目标图像及覆盖约 1 秒运动的动作块，支持 2.5 次/秒的闭环控制。在机器人视频上预训练并在人类视频上共训练，显著提升策略性能与对分布偏移的零样本鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 掩码扩散是统一视频-动作建模的实用且通用的基础范式。

title: Return-to-Home Feasible Micro-Aerial Vehicle Exploration for 3D Gaussian Splatting Reconstruction
comment: IEEE/RSJ International Conference on INTELLIGENT ROBOTS & SYSTEMS 2026
summary: Micro aerial vehicles (MAVs) enable rapid indoor 3D reconstruction for inspection and time-critical situational awareness, but must operate under strict flight-time budgets and safety constraints that require explicit return-to-home (RTH) feasibility with a conservative margin. We present a topology-first active reconstruction framework that decouples high-fidelity rendering from navigation. A dense 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) map is optimized as the reconstruction target, while a lightweight Truncated Signed Distance Field (TSDF)/occupancy scaffold supports conservative collision checking and online construction of a sparse 3D Voronoi skeleton roadmap. Since directly extracting roadmaps from TSDF geometry can be unstable under noisy and incomplete online fusion, we validate nodes and edges using carved free-space consistency and dense visibility checks, which suppress behind-wall phantom structure and stabilize planning. Viewpoints are selected on the roadmap using a flight-time-budget-aware objective and a lightweight receding-horizon lookahead to improve non-myopic exploration behavior. We evaluate on photorealistic indoor simulation benchmarks (ReplicaCAD, Gibson, and HM3D), reporting reconstruction coverage/error, RTH success, and computational cost. Results demonstrate improved or competitive performance relative to recent GS-based baselines under identical flight-time budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种"拓扑优先"的主动重建框架，将高保真3D高斯泼溅渲染与导航解耦：用轻量TSDF/占据支架做保守碰撞检测与在线Voronoi骨架路网构建，并通过自由空间一致性与可见性校验稳定路网，再结合飞行时间预算目标与滚动时域前瞻选择视点，在ReplicaCAD、Gibson、HM3D上取得优于或可比于现有GS基线的表现。
AI.motivation: 微型飞行器可在室内做快速三维重建，用于巡检与时效性态势感知，但受严格飞行时间预算与安全约束限制，必须显式保证带回飞（RTH）可行并留出保守余量。现有基于高斯泼溅（GS）的主动重建方法通常将高保真渲染目标与导航规划耦合，难以同时满足时间预算与安全性要求，因此需要一个将两者解耦的框架。
AI.method: 1) 表示分层：以稠密3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）地图作为重建目标，另用轻量截断符号距离场（TSDF）/占据栅格作为导航支架，实现渲染与规划的分离。2) 路网构建：在支架上在线构建稀疏3D Voronoi骨架路网；针对从TSDF几何直接提取路网在噪声与不完整在线融合下不稳定的问题，利用已观测自由空间一致性与稠密可见性检查对节点与边进行校验，抑制"墙后幽灵结构"并稳定规划。3) 视点选择：在路网上采用飞行时间预算感知的目标函数，并引入轻量滚动时域前瞻（receding-horizon lookahead）以改善非短视探索行为。4) 评测：在ReplicaCAD、Gibson、HM3D逼真室内仿真基准上报告重建覆盖率/误差、RTH成功率与计算开销，并与近期GS基线在相同飞行时间预算下对比。
AI.result: 在ReplicaCAD、Gibson、HM3D三个逼真室内仿真基准上，报告了重建覆盖度与误差、RTH成功率及计算成本三类指标；在相同飞行时间预算下，相较近期基于高斯泼溅（GS）的基线方法取得了更优或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，将高保真3DGS重建与基于轻量TSDF/占据支架的导航规划解耦，并借助自由空间一致性与可见性校验稳定在线Voronoi路网、结合时间预算感知与滚动时域前瞻的视点选择，可在严格飞行时间预算与RTH安全约束下实现高效且可靠的室内主动三维重建，为MAV时效性巡检任务提供了可行的框架。

title: A Biomimetic Gaze Control to Restore Head-Neck Movements
summary: Powered neck exoskeletons are developed to restore head-neck motions for those with neck muscle weakness. Current methods using hand-held input devices to control these robotic systems are unintuitive or non-viable for these populations. Alternatively, the eyes coordinate with the head to accomplish many daily tasks. Therefore, movements of the eyes can be a useful signal to control the neck exoskeletons without needing to use the hands. However, previous control models lack biobehavioral basis as well as means to personalize the control behavior, causing unnatural head-neck movements. This paper presents a novel eye-tracking controller design leveraging the vestibulo-ocular reflex to emulate natural eyehead coordination. Personalization tools were also designed, consisting of sliders to allow users to adjust the parameters of this controller. Here, we present the technical design and validation of this system in human users. Compared to the previous eye-tracking model, the new controller provides natural head motions personalized to the user through more natural velocity profiles and a 24 percent average increase of accurate motion intent detection. This system provides a powerful platform for studying eye-tracking controllers in the context of personalization and preference, and ultimately restoring the lost head-neck mobility in patient populations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于前庭眼反射的个性化眼动控制颈部外骨骼控制器，通过模仿自然眼-头协调实现更自然的头颈运动，并验证其优于既有眼动控制模型。
AI.motivation: 现有动力颈部外骨骼依赖手持输入设备控制，不直观且对颈部肌肉无力人群不可行；而此前基于眼动的控制模型缺乏生物行为学依据及个性化手段，导致头颈运动不自然。
AI.method: 利用眼与头在完成日常任务中的自然协调（前庭眼反射VOR），设计新型眼动追踪控制器以模拟自然的眼-头协调；同时开发个性化工具（滑杆调节控制器参数），并进行技术设计与人体受试者验证。
AI.result: 与既有眼动模型相比，新控制器产生更自然的速度曲线，提供个性化的自然头部运动，运动意图检测准确率平均提升24%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统为研究个性化与偏好场景下的眼动控制、并最终恢复患者头颈活动能力提供了有力平台。

title: Reward-DAgger: Robot-Gated Interactive Imitation Learning with General-Purpose Progress-Based Reward Models
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have enabled generalist control policies capable of completing a wide range of tasks. However, their performance degrades when deployed in unseen environments, making it critical to detect failures and teach recovery behaviors. Existing runtime monitoring methods often require task- and policy-specific training or hyperparameter tuning, limiting cross-task deployment and introducing additional overhead during iterative policy updates. We present Reward-DAgger, a robot-gated interactive imitation learning framework that uses dense progress signals from a general-purpose reward model to determine when human intervention is needed. Our approach is agnostic to the underlying policy architecture, requires no access to policy internals, and can be applied across tasks without retuning the gating mechanism. Our results show that Reward-DAgger achieves a better failure-detection accuracy-latency tradeoff than existing runtime monitoring baselines. Across eight simulated and real-world tasks, Reward-DAgger consistently improves the downstream policy's autonomous success rate throughout interactive learning and achieves strong return on human effort, outperforming the baselines in most settings. Importantly, the same gating configuration is used across tasks without task-specific hyperparameter tuning, demonstrating transfer across tasks, environments, and policy architectures. Code and videos are available at https://liralab.usc.edu/reward-dagger.

AI.tldr: 提出 Reward-DAgger，一种机器人门控交互式模仿学习框架，利用通用奖励模型的稠密进度信号决定何时需要人工干预，无需任务/策略特定训练或超参调优。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人控制策略在未见环境中性能下降，因此检测失败并教授恢复行为很关键；但现有运行时监控方法需任务与策略特定的训练或超参调优，限制跨任务部署且在策略迭代更新时带来额外开销。
AI.method: 基于通用奖励模型的稠密进度信号构建门控机制，判断何时触发人工干预；该方法不依赖策略架构、无需访问策略内部信息，且门控机制可跨任务复用而无需重新调参。
AI.result: 在失败检测的准确率—延迟权衡上优于现有运行时监控基线；在八个仿真与真实任务中，交互学习过程中持续提升下游策略自主成功率，人工投入回报高，多数设置下优于基线；同一门控配置跨任务使用，无需任务特定超参调优。
AI.conclusion: Reward-DAgger 以通用奖励模型实现无需调参、策略无关的机器人门控交互式模仿学习，具备跨任务、跨环境和跨策略架构的迁移能力。

title: Terrain-Dependent Intra-Cycle Leg Timing for Effective Locomotion on Granular Slopes
summary: Locomotion on granular slopes such as sand dunes remains a fundamental challenge for legged robots due to reduced shear strength and gravity-induced anisotropic yielding of granular media. Using a hexapedal robot on a tiltable granular bed, we systematically measure locomotion speed together with slope-dependent normal and shear granular resistive forces. While normal penetration resistance remains nearly unchanged with inclination, shear resistance decreases substantially as slope angle increases. Guided by these measurements, we develop a simple robot-terrain interaction model that predicts anchoring timing, step length, and resulting robot speed, as functions of terrain strength and slope angle. The model reveals that slope-induced performance loss is primarily governed by delayed anchoring and increased backward slip rather than excessive sinkage. By extending the model to generalized terrain conditions, we construct failure phase diagrams that identify sinkage- and slippage-induced failure regimes, enabling quantitative risk estimation for locomotion on granular slopes. This physics-informed framework provides predictive insight into terrain-dependent failure mechanisms and offers guidance for safer and more robust robot operation on deformable inclines.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过六足机器人在可倾斜颗粒床上的实验，测量了正常与剪切颗粒阻力随坡度的变化，并建立机器人-地形相互作用模型，揭示颗粒斜坡上运动性能损失主要由锚定延迟和后滑增大导致，而非过度下陷，进而构建失效相图以量化风险。
AI.motivation: 在沙丘等颗粒斜坡上，颗粒介质剪切强度降低及重力诱导的各向异性屈服，使足式机器人运动面临根本性挑战。研究旨在从物理机制上理解坡度对运动性能的影响，并预测失效模式。
AI.method: 在可倾斜颗粒床上使用六足机器人系统测量运动速度及随坡度变化的法向与切向颗粒阻力；基于测量结果建立简化的机器人-地形相互作用模型，预测锚定时机、步长和机器人速度；并将模型推广至一般地形条件以构建失效相图。
AI.result: 法向贯入阻力随倾角几乎不变，而剪切阻力随坡角增大显著下降。模型表明坡度引起的性能损失主要源于锚定延迟和后滑增加，而非过度下陷。推广模型得到区分下陷型与滑移型失效区域的失效相图，可实现颗粒斜坡运动风险的定量估计。
AI.conclusion: 该物理知情框架为地形相关的失效机制提供了预测性认识，并为机器人在可变形斜坡上更安全、鲁棒的运动提供了指导。

title: Autoware in Construction: Gap Analysis and LiDAR Perception Toward Off-Road Autonomous Driving
comment: 2026 IROS 5th Workshop on Future of Construction, 4 pages, 5 figures
summary: Autoware is an open-source autonomous driving software platform widely adopted by researchers and industry developers. Originally developed primarily for public-road applications, including passenger vehicles, taxis, and buses, Autoware is increasingly being extended to off-road environments such as construction and agricultural sites. Construction sites, however, differ fundamentally from public roads and challenge many assumptions underlying conventional autonomous driving systems. They are characterized by unstructured terrain, airborne dust, continuously evolving site conditions, and construction-specific objects. This paper presents lessons learned from ongoing efforts to extend an Autoware-based autonomous driving system to large dump trucks operating at construction sites. We identify gaps between public-road and off-road construction applications across the sensing, mapping, localization, perception, planning, and control modules of the Autoware stack. We then discuss potential solutions for addressing these gaps, with particular emphasis on ongoing LiDAR-based perception pipeline development and findings from field testing. Finally, we propose a roadmap toward end-to-end autonomous driving for construction vehicles.

AI.tldr: 本文分享将 Autoware 开源自动驾驶平台从公共道路拓展至工地大型矿用自卸卡车的经验教训，梳理感知、建图、定位、规划与控制各模块的差距并提出解决思路与路线图。
AI.motivation: Autoware 原本面向公共道路场景（乘用车、出租车、公交车），但正被逐步扩展到建筑工地、农业等非结构化越野环境。工地与公共道路存在本质差异——非结构化地形、扬尘、持续变化的场地条件、施工专用物体，这些都对传统自动驾驶假设构成挑战，因此需要系统性地识别并解决这些差距。
AI.method: 采用经验总结与差距分析的方法：以基于 Autoware 的自动驾驶系统在大型矿用自卸卡车上的部署实践为对象，沿 Autoware 技术栈的传感、建图、定位、感知、规划与控制模块，逐项对比公共道路与非结构化工地应用之间的差异；在此基础上提出针对性解决方案，重点介绍正在开展的基于 LiDAR 的感知流水线开发及实地测试发现。
AI.result: 识别出公共道路与工地越野应用在 Autoware 各模块上的具体差距，给出了相应的潜在解决方案，并报告了 LiDAR 感知流水线的开发进展与实地测试结果；最终提出面向工程车辆端到端自动驾驶的路线图。
AI.conclusion: 将公共道路自动驾驶系统迁移至工地场景需要针对非结构化环境进行模块级适配，LiDAR 感知是关键突破口；本文的经验与路线图为建筑车辆端到端自动驾驶的后续研究提供了方向。

title: Bi-manual Stabilization of the Cervical Spine for Safe Physical Human-Robot Interaction in Rolling Maneuvers
summary: The neck, specifically the cervical spine, is a highly fragile and mobile part of the body with a high risk of catastrophic injury. Whether someone is injured on a battlefield, in a natural disaster, or in an athletic event, great care is always taken with the cervical spine when transporting, rolling, or moving the patient. In this work, we present an algorithm and adaptations for bi-manual robots to stabilize the cervical spine during rolling maneuvers. We investigate techniques to maximize grip strength within safety bounds and present a control approach for proper neck rotation. We found that with our approach, a bi-manual robot is capable of achieving human-level performance in maintaining target rotational alignments. The axial alignment for the robot with prediction was within .21 degrees of human novices.

AI.tldr: 提出双臂机器人稳定颈椎滚转操作的算法，通过安全约束内最大化抓取力与颈部旋转控制，达到接近人类新手水平，轴向对齐误差仅0.21度。
AI.motivation: 颈椎脆弱且活动度高，在战场、灾害或运动场景中搬运、翻滚、移动伤员时极易发生灾难性损伤，因此需要谨慎处理。目标是让双臂机器人辅助完成颈椎稳定操作。
AI.method: 设计用于双臂机器人在滚转操作中稳定颈椎的算法及适配方案；研究在安全边界内最大化抓取力的技术；提出实现正确颈部旋转的控制方法。
AI.result: 双臂机器人可达到人类水平的旋转对齐保持性能；带预测的机器人在轴向对齐上与人类新手相差0.21度以内。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法使双臂机器人在颈椎稳定操作中实现接近人类新手的表现，验证了机器人辅助颈椎保护操作的可行性。

title: Continual Humanoid Motion Learning
summary: Humanoid whole-body controllers can now track a diverse set of dynamic motions, but they are typically trained offline and then frozen, so teaching such a controller a new skill tends to erode the skills it already mastered. We study continual learning for humanoid whole-body motion, where a single controller must acquire skills from a sequential task stream without revisiting past data. We introduce Similarity-guided LoRA-PNN, a progressive neural network (PNN) policy that prevents catastrophic forgetting by construction while reusing knowledge across skills through lightweight low-rank adaptation. A two-level motion-similarity measure, built from dynamic time warping aggregated by optimal transport, decides which prior skill to build on and how much new capacity to allocate, yielding strong forward transfer and large efficiency gains. Across six sequentially learned skill categories, our similarity-guided LoRA policy attains the best forward transfer (0.125 vs. 0.079) and the highest average accuracy among all methods, while saving up to 94.5% of trainable parameters and 40.8% of training time. The resulting controller reaches 96.13% sim-to-sim transfer and is deployed on a physical Unitree G1. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/continual-humanoid-learning-35D3.

AI.tldr: 提出Similarity-guided LoRA-PNN，实现人形全身运动控制的持续学习，通过结构防遗忘并复用知识。
AI.motivation: 现有人形全身控制器多离线训练后冻结，学习新技能会侵蚀已掌握的技能，难以在无历史数据条件下顺序学习。
AI.method: 基于渐进神经网络（PNN）策略，结合低秩适配（LoRA）；用动态时间规整聚合最优运输构建两层运动相似度度量，决定基于哪个旧技能扩展及新容量分配。
AI.result: 六类顺序技能任务中，前向迁移最佳（0.125 vs. 0.079），平均精度最高，节省最高94.5%可训练参数与40.8%训练时间；sim-to-sim迁移达96.13%，并部署于Unitree G1实机。
AI.conclusion: 相似度引导的LoRA-PNN可在顺序任务流中高效持续学习人形全身运动技能，兼顾防遗忘、前向迁移与实机部署。

title: Humanoid Rickshaw Pulling: Whole-Body Locomotion under Coupled Wheeled Loads
summary: Humanoid robots could transport payloads substantially heavier than themselves by pulling passive wheeled vehicles instead of carrying the load. This capability, however, creates a coupled locomotion problem: the robot must maintain persistent upper-body contact while adapting to unknown, configuration-dependent forces arising from the payload, vehicle, and terrain. We present a whole-body control framework for humanoid rickshaw pulling that tracks commanded vehicle motion while preserving balance and stable grasps under uncertain load dynamics. During training, a privileged teacher exploits vehicle states, interaction forces, and load properties. Its actions and latent are distilled into a history-conditioned student that implicitly infers coupled dynamics from proprioceptive responses, followed by reinforcement-learning fine-tuning. Comparisons with \emph{No History} and \emph{Only History} baselines show that the resulting policy achieves accurate vehicle tracking while reducing vehicle oscillation, torso tilt, and actuation cost. Behavioral analysis shows that Unitree G1 propels the rickshaw and generates gait-synchronized whole-body reactions that stabilize its lateral and roll motions. Moreover, pulling redistributes joint effort and yields a lower robot-normalized cost-of-transport proxy than unloaded walking over most tested load--speed conditions. On hardware, a single policy performs starting, sustained pulling, turning, and stopping with both rigid payloads and human passengers, handling a loaded rickshaw mass of up to 115~kg without load-specific retuning. These results demonstrate robust heavy-load transportation through coordinated and persistent humanoid--vehicle interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出人形机器人拉人力车（被动轮式车辆）的全身控制框架，通过特权教师蒸馏到历史条件学生策略，实现重载运输。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人通过牵引被动轮式车辆可运输远重于自身的载荷，但这带来耦合的移动问题：机器人需保持持续的上肢接触，同时适应来自载荷、车辆与地形的未知、构型相关力。核心动机是解决这种负载动力学不确定下的全身平衡与稳定抓握控制。
AI.method: 采用全身控制框架，跟踪指令车辆运动同时保持平衡与稳定抓握。训练阶段：特权教师策略利用车辆状态、交互力与载荷属性；将其动作与隐变量蒸馏到历史条件学生策略，使其从本体感受响应中隐式推断耦合动力学，随后进行强化学习微调。设置 No History 与 Only History 基线进行对比。
AI.result: 相比基线，策略实现准确的车辆跟踪，降低车辆振荡、躯干倾斜与驱动代价。行为分析显示 Unitree G1 能推动人力车并产生步态同步的全身反应以稳定侧向与翻滚运动；牵引重新分配关节出力，在多数载荷—速度条件下机器人归一化运输代价代理指标低于空载行走。硬件上，单一策略完成起步、持续牵引、转向与停止，支持刚性载荷与真人乘客，负载人力车质量达 115 kg 无需按负载重新调参。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了通过协调且持续的人形—车辆交互，可实现鲁棒的重载运输。

title: Attention-Based Surface Representation Learning for Robot State Prediction and Open-Ended Surface Classification
summary: For ground robots operating in outdoor environments, understanding the properties of the underlying terrain is essential for ensuring reliable operation. In most perception-based studies, this problem is formulated as categorical classification with a fixed number of classes defined during training. We propose an approach that enables new surface classes to be added as trainable vectors, which can subsequently be used to address higher-level tasks. By employing a learning paradigm based on predicting the robot's next state in time and using attention blocks, we improved classification accuracy to 98.56% on the Belyaev-Kushnarev dataset and 94.8% on BorealTC.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可扩展地形分类方法，新增地表类别以可训练向量表示，基于"预测机器人下一时刻状态"的学习范式并引入注意力模块，在Belyaev-Kushnarev与BorealTC数据集上分别达到98.56%和94.8%的分类准确率。
AI.motivation: 室外地面机器人需理解地形属性以保证可靠运行。现有基于感知的研究多将地形识别建模为固定类别数的分类问题，训练后无法引入新类别，缺乏可扩展性，也难以支撑更高层任务。
AI.method: 将各地表类别表示为可训练向量，使新类别可在不重训原有框架的前提下增量加入；采用基于时间序列的"预测机器人下一状态"自监督学习范式进行特征学习，并在网络中引入注意力模块（attention blocks）以增强判别能力。
AI.result: 分类准确率在Belyaev-Kushnarev数据集上提升至98.56%，在BorealTC数据集上达到94.8%。
AI.conclusion: 可训练的类别向量表示与状态预测式学习范式相结合，可在保持分类精度的同时赋予地形分类系统可扩展性，新增地表类别亦可复用于更高层任务。

title: ROOT: Discovering Rewards for User-Specified Embodied Behaviors
summary: Reinforcement learning for embodied control remains constrained by the difficulty of reward specification. Although recent large language model (LLM)-based methods can synthesize reward functions from natural-language descriptions, they often fail to capture subtle behavioral properties that humans care about, such as natural gait, posture, and movement style. This limitation arises because many desired behaviors are easier to recognize visually than to encode in a reward function. We introduce Reward Optimization via Observable Trees (ROOT), a framework for discovering reward functions that align learned policies with user-specified embodied behaviors. Rather than relying solely on scalar training statistics, ROOT casts reward design as an observation-guided search over a persistent experiment tree that stores reward programs, trained policies, and rollout observations, together with behavioral insights distilled by a video-language model, to diagnose behavioral failures and guide subsequent reward refinements. We evaluate ROOT on seven tasks across four embodiments: simulated Hopper, HalfCheetah, Ant, Unitree Go2, and as well as the real-world Unitree Go2. ROOT produces behaviors that better align with user intent than those generated by existing LLM-based reward-generation methods, achieving up to 86.8% locomotion-completeness accuracy and improving Vid-LLM behavioral alignment from 3.56/5 to 4.14/5, a 16.5% improvement over baselines. Human evaluations further support these results, with ROOT preferred in 51-63% of pairwise comparisons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ROOT框架，将奖励函数设计转化为基于观测引导的实验树搜索，利用视频语言模型诊断行为缺陷并迭代优化奖励程序，从而让具身控制策略更符合用户描述的细微行为特征。
AI.motivation: 强化学习具身控制受限于奖励函数难以指定。现有基于LLM的奖励生成方法虽能从自然语言描述合成奖励函数，但难以捕捉人类关注的细微行为属性（如自然步态、姿态、运动风格），因为许多期望行为"视觉上易识别、却难以编码为奖励函数"。
AI.method: ROOT将奖励设计建模为观测引导的搜索过程，维护一棵持久化实验树，节点存储奖励程序、训练所得策略、 rollout观测，以及由视频语言模型（Vid-LLM）蒸馏出的行为洞察，用于诊断行为失败并指导后续奖励精炼，而非仅依赖标量训练统计。
AI.result: 在四种具身体、七项任务（仿真Hopper、HalfCheetah、Ant、Unitree Go2，以及真实Unitree Go2）上评估。ROOT相比现有LLM奖励生成方法更符合用户意图：运动完整性准确率达86.8%，Vid-LLM行为对齐分数从3.56/5提升至4.14/5（相对基线提升16.5%）；人工评估中ROOT在51-63%的成对比较中被偏好。
AI.conclusion: 通过将视觉观测与语言模型洞察引入奖励搜索闭环，ROOT有效弥补了纯标量奖励生成在细微行为对齐上的不足，并在仿真与真机任务中验证了其优越性与泛化能力。

title: Grounded in Time: A Multi-Source Dataset and Benchmark for Temporal Grounding in Robotic Manipulation
summary: Robotic manipulation often requires inferring task-relevant states from past interactions when the current observation alone is insufficient to determine the appropriate action. Despite progress in benchmarking memory-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models, application-oriented tasks requiring history-dependent semantic inference remain underrepresented. We introduce GiT (Grounded in Time), a dataset and benchmark for grounding manipulation decisions in past events across biolaboratory, household, and industrial scenarios. It includes real-robot and Universal Manipulation Interface (UMI) style demonstrations covering 18 bimanual tasks, together with simulation data and a ManiSkill-based evaluation suite covering nine tasks. Fine-grained subtask annotations and annotated counterfactual task pairs, in which similar current observations require different actions depending on prior events, support policy learning and targeted evaluation of history use. Evaluations of representative end-to-end VLA models in simulation and on selected real-world tasks reveal substantial room for improvement in history-dependent manipulation. The dataset and benchmark are available at the project page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GiT（Grounded in Time），一个面向历史依赖语义推理的机器人操作数据集与基准，涵盖生物实验室、家庭与工业场景，包含18个双臂任务（真实机器人与UMI演示）、仿真数据及基于ManiSkill的9任务评测套件，并提供细粒度子任务标注与反事实任务对，以支持策略学习与历史利用评估。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作中，仅凭当前观测往往不足以决定动作，需从过去交互中推断任务相关状态。尽管记忆增强的VLA模型基准已有进展，但面向应用、依赖历史的语义推理任务仍被覆盖不足。
AI.method: 构建GiT数据集与基准，覆盖生物实验室、家庭、工业场景；收集真实机器人与UMI风格演示，覆盖18个双臂任务；提供仿真数据及基于ManiSkill的评测套件（9个任务）；加入细粒度子任务标注，并构建反事实任务对——当前观测相似但需依据先前事件采取不同动作。
AI.result: 在仿真与部分真实任务上对代表性端到端VLA模型进行评测，结果显示在历史依赖操作上仍有显著提升空间。
AI.conclusion: GiT为历史依赖的机器人操作决策提供了标准化数据与评测平台，通过反事实设计实现针对性的历史利用评估，揭示现有VLA模型的不足并推动相关研究。

title: Real-Time Conformal-Seeded Hybrid Inverse Kinematics for Offset Redundant Manipulators
summary: This paper presents a conformal-seeded hybrid strategy for solving inverse kinematics of offset, redundant 7-DoF robot arms of the humanoid class. Analytical inverse kinematics (AIK) provides closed-form solutions with very low computational cost. However, for offset kinematic structures, the exact closed-form solution is generally unavailable, and practical AIK must rely on an approximate or simplified kinematic model. In contrast, numerical inverse kinematics (NIK) can achieve high-precision solutions on the full kinematic model. However, its convergence is highly sensitive to initialization. To overcome these limitations, we propose a two-stage hybrid inverse kinematics framework with conformal-calibrated seed selection. First, an approximate analytical model efficiently enumerates a finite set of candidate joint solutions. Second, we rank these candidates using a lightweight learned predictor of post-refinement difficulty, wrapped by split-conformal prediction into a calibrated upper bound that serves as the selection score. The best-ranked seed is then refined using a Levenberg-Marquardt solver on the full kinematic model. The proposed method combines fast candidate generation, learned seed ranking with a calibrated difficulty bound, and accurate numerical refinement, achieving real-time performance of less than 40us and a success rate of 100% in our evaluation on reachable targets. We validate the approach through large-scale stochastic simulation across the workspace and experimental demonstrations with motion planning on a humanoid robot arm. Demonstration videos are available at https://youtu.be/aeiBmw1XRbw.

AI.tldr: 提出一种结合保形校准种子选择的两阶段混合逆运动学框架，用于7自由度冗余人形机械臂，实现<40us实时性与100%可达目标成功率。
AI.motivation: 偏置冗余7-DoF机械臂上，解析逆运动学（AIK）因结构偏置无精确闭式解，只能依赖近似模型；数值逆运动学（NIK）虽在完整模型上精度高，但对初值高度敏感、收敛性差。需兼顾速度、精度与鲁棒性。
AI.method: 两阶段混合框架+保形校准种子选择：①用近似解析模型高效枚举有限候选关节解；②用轻量学习预测器评估各候选的“精修难度”，并以split-conformal预测包裹为校准上界作为选择分数；③对最优种子用Levenberg-Marquardt在完整运动学模型上精修。
AI.result: 在可达目标评测中实现<40us实时性能与100%成功率；通过覆盖工作空间的大规模随机仿真及人形机械臂运动规划实验验证。
AI.conclusion: 融合快速候选生成、带校准难度上界的学习式种子排序与精确数值精修，有效克服AIK近似误差与NIK初值敏感问题，方法在人形机械臂上具备实时性与高可靠性。

title: Asynchronous Tracking, Optical Communication and 3D Motion Capture using Event-based Sensors
summary: Inter-robot communication is a key enabling technology in cooperative robotics applications. While wireless communication is ubiquitous, simple, and effective, it has inherent limitations: the receiving robot cannot easily localise the source of an incoming signal, clock synchronisation is challenging, and signals are broadcast to all nearby devices rather than targeted recipients. Optical communication provides a complementary channel that is inherently directional and spatially localised, directly addressing these limitations. Event cameras are bio-inspired dynamic vision sensors that respond to changes in image intensity with high temporal resolution, high dynamic range, and low latency, making them well-suited as receivers for high-rate optical communication in cooperative robotic systems. In this paper, we propose the Asynchronous Tracking and Optical Communication (ATOC) system, which integrates LED smart-beacon modulation, event-based detection, optical tracking, and event-data demodulation in a single pipeline. By simultaneously tracking and demodulating multiple LED smart beacons, ATOC transforms a conventional visual marker into a robust communication channel suitable for a wide range of high-impact robotics applications. We validate ATOC in a suite of laboratory studies and two 'applications': a smart-city demonstration and a 3D motion-capture system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ATOC 系统，将 LED 智能信标调制、事件相机检测、光学跟踪与事件数据解调集成于单一流水线，实现多信标同时跟踪与解调，将视觉标记转化为鲁棒光通信信道，并通过实验室实验及智慧城市、3D 动作捕捉两项应用验证。
AI.motivation: 机器人间通信是协作机器人应用的关键使能技术。无线通信虽普遍、简单且有效，但存在固有局限：接收方难以定位信号源、时钟同步困难、信号面向所有邻近设备广播而非定向发送。光学通信作为互补信道，天生具备方向性与空间局部性，可直接弥补上述不足。
AI.method: 以事件相机（仿生动态视觉传感器，对图像强度变化响应，具备高时间分辨率、高动态范围与低延迟）作为高速光通信接收器，提出 ATOC（异步跟踪与光通信）系统，在单一流水线中集成 LED 智能信标调制、事件式检测、光学跟踪与事件数据解调，实现多 LED 智能信标的同时跟踪与解调。
AI.result: 在系列实验室研究中验证了 ATOC，并完成两项应用验证：智慧城市演示与 3D 动作捕捉系统。
AI.conclusion: ATOC 将常规视觉标记转化为鲁棒通信信道，适用于广泛的高影响力机器人应用场景。

title: TacOT: Learning Contact-Rich Dexterous Manipulation from Human Demonstrations via Tactile-Guided Optimal Transport
summary: Learning contact-rich dexterous manipulation from human demonstrations provides a scalable source of interaction data, yet transferring such skills to robots remains challenging due to unreliable human--robot correspondence. Existing human-to-robot transfer methods typically rely on visual appearance or motion similarity, which may associate similar motions with different contact states and force patterns. Tactile dynamics provide interaction-aware cues to distinguish manipulation processes with similar motions but different contact states. We introduce tactile-guided optimal transport (TacOT), a framework for human-to-robot contact-rich manipulation. TacOT leverages action--tactile dynamic time warping to identify human--robot demonstration correspondences with consistent interaction dynamics and uses these correspondences to guide soft optimal transport alignment in a shared policy representation space. This enables human demonstrations to provide contact-rich supervision for robot policy learning without requiring predefined frame-level human--robot pairing. Across four real-world dexterous manipulation tasks, TacOT improves closed-loop success rates over action-guided OT by up to 17 points on in-distribution tasks and 20 points under targeted human-to-robot out-of-distribution transfer. Further analyses show that tactile-guided correspondence selects demonstration pairs with more consistent contact dynamics and produces latent representations that better reflect interaction-state evolution. These results demonstrate that tactile dynamics provide an effective semantic signal for establishing reliable human-to-robot correspondence in contact-rich dexterous manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出TacOT框架，利用触觉动力学引导最优传输，实现无需预定义帧级配对的人到机器人接触丰富操作技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 人与机器人之间的对应关系不可靠：现有的人到机器人迁移方法多依赖视觉外观或运动相似性，可能将相似动作关联到不同的接触状态与力模式，导致迁移失败。触觉动力学可提供交互感知线索，区分动作相似但接触状态不同的操作过程。
AI.method: TacOT（tactile-guided optimal transport）框架：1）使用动作—触觉动态时间规整（action–tactile dynamic time warping）识别具有一致交互动力学的人—机器人示教对应关系；2）用这些对应关系引导共享策略表示空间中的软最优传输对齐；3）无需预定义帧级人—机器人配对，即可让人类示教为机器人策略学习提供接触丰富的监督。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界灵巧操作任务上，相比动作引导的OT，TacOT在分布内任务上闭环成功率提升最高17个百分点，在针对性的人到机器人分布外迁移下提升最高20个百分点。进一步分析表明，触觉引导的对应关系能选出接触动力学更一致的示教对，并产生更能反映交互状态演化的潜在表示。
AI.conclusion: 触觉动力学为在接触丰富的灵巧操作中建立可靠的人—机器人对应关系提供了有效的语义信号。

title: Human Behavior-Informed Crash Scenario Generation with Real-World Crash Priors for Autonomous Vehicle Safety Evaluation
summary: Reliable safety evaluation of autonomous vehicles (AVs) is essential to improving road safety, yet it depends critically on realistic simulation of rare crashes. Existing crash scenario generation methods can increase collision occurrence, but often fail to realistically reproduce how crashes evolve before impact or the distribution of crash types observed in the real world. Here, we present CrashSim, a human behavior-informed crash scenario generation framework that uses real-world crash priors to guide generative multi-agent traffic simulation for more reliable AV safety evaluation. These priors capture how real-world crashes evolve before impact and how different crash types are distributed, allowing limited crash data to guide realistic and scalable scenario generation across naturalistic driving contexts. We evaluate CrashSim against competing methods, showing that it more closely reproduces real-world pre-impact behavior, collision dynamics, collision geometry and crash-type distributions. We further use CrashSim to construct nuCrash dataset, containing over 4,000 crash and near-crash scenarios. Closed-loop evaluation of five AV planners shows that nuCrash more effectively exposes differences in planner safety capabilities than nuScenes. An LLM-assisted evaluation agent further analyzes planner failures to provide capability-level diagnoses and targeted improvement guidance. Together, CrashSim enables realistic and scalable crash generation for more informative AV safety evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出CrashSim——一种基于人类行为先验的碰撞场景生成框架，利用真实世界碰撞先验引导生成式多智能体交通仿真，生成更真实、可扩展的碰撞与近碰撞场景（nuCrash数据集，超4000个场景），用于提升自动驾驶车辆安全评估的信息量与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶车辆（AV）安全评估高度依赖对稀有碰撞的真实仿真，但现有碰撞场景生成方法虽能提高碰撞发生率，却难以真实复现碰撞发生前的演化过程以及真实世界中碰撞类型的分布。因此需要一个既能保证场景真实感、又具备可扩展性的碰撞生成框架，以支撑更可靠的AV安全评估。
AI.method: 提出CrashSim，一个人体行为先验驱动的碰撞场景生成框架：使用真实世界碰撞先验（capturing碰撞发生前的演化方式及不同碰撞类型的分布）来引导生成式多智能体交通仿真，使有限的碰撞数据能够在自然驾驶情境下指导真实且可扩展的场景生成。基于该框架构建了nuCrash数据集，包含4000多个碰撞与近碰撞场景，并对五种AV规划器进行闭环评估，同时引入LLM辅助的评估智能体分析规划器失效。
AI.result: 与对比方法相比，CrashSim能更贴近真实世界地复现碰撞前行为、碰撞动力学、碰撞几何以及碰撞类型分布。闭环评估显示，nuCrash比nuScenes更能有效区分不同AV规划器在安全能力上的差异；LLM辅助评估智能体可进一步分析规划器失效，提供能力层面的诊断与针对性的改进指导。
AI.conclusion: CrashSim实现了真实且可扩展的碰撞场景生成，为自动驾驶车辆提供更具信息量的安全评估；其评测数据集nuCrash可有效揭示规划器间的安全能力差异，并结合LLM诊断工具为规划器改进提供指引。

title: Frame-Level Temporal Alignment for Human-to-Robot Visual Adaptation
summary: Transferring visual representations pretrained on human videos to robot manipulation requires learning reliable correspondences between human and robot demonstrations. However, paired demonstrations can differ in execution rate and in the proportion of non-key frames that do not directly reflect task progress. Frames at the same relative timestamp may therefore represent different task stages, which can cause correspondence learning to fail. To address these issues, we propose Frame-Level Temporal Alignment (FLTA), a framework that uses two temporal priors to adapt visual encoders pretrained on human videos for robot manipulation. It learns shared task-progress representations without frame-level correspondence annotations, allowing frames at different relative temporal positions to match. A global progress prior combines normalized temporal positions with visual similarity to construct a soft correspondence target. A local temporal order prior penalizes backward transitions while allowing stays and varying forward rates to accommodate execution-rate differences. With ResNet-50 and ViT encoders, our method achieves relative improvements of 46.93% and 65.96%, respectively, over the best baselines in average simulation success rates and achieves higher task success rates on real-world manipulation tasks. These results also suggest that effective human-robot adaptation depends less on the number of parameters updated than on which parameters are selected. Our project page is available at https://rtx5090ultra.github.io/FLTA-Project-Page/.

AI.tldr: 提出帧级时间对齐框架FLTA，利用全局进度先验与局部时序顺序先验，在无帧级对应标注下实现人-机器人演示的软对齐，显著提升视觉编码器迁移至机器人操作的成功率。
AI.motivation: 将人类视频预训练的视觉表征迁移到机器人操作任务，需要学习人-机器人演示之间可靠的对应关系。但配对演示在执行速率以及非关键帧比例上存在差异，导致同一相对时间戳的帧可能处于不同任务阶段，从而使帧级对应学习失败。
AI.method: 提出Frame-Level Temporal Alignment（FLTA）框架，引入两种时间先验来适配人类视频预训练的视觉编码器。其一为全局进度先验，将归一化时间位置与视觉相似度结合，构造软对应目标；其二为局部时序顺序先验，惩罚时间上的倒退转移，同时允许停驻与变化的前进速率，以容忍执行速率差异。整个学习过程不需要帧级对应标注。
AI.result: 在ResNet-50和ViT编码器上，平均仿真成功率相对最优基线分别提升46.93%和65.96%；在真实世界操作任务上也取得更高的任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，有效的人-机器人适配更多取决于所选择更新的参数，而非参数更新数量；FLTA可作为无需帧级标注的通用时间对齐方案提升跨域视觉表征迁移效果。

title: AgenticTactileVLA: Contact-Guided Execution-Time Supervision for Generalizable Dexterous Manipulation without VLA Retraining
summary: Vision-language-action policies may predict a transferable manipulation strategy yet fail to realize it reliably on the encountered object: objects compatible with the same grasp differ in geometry and compliance, and visual feedback degrades under closure occlusion. AgenticTactileVLA is presented as an execution-time supervisor that shifts part of object-specific adaptation from prediction to physical interaction. A fixed VLA provides the approach and hand targets; the supervisor decides whether to remain transparent, refine finger flexion, retain or release the corrected configuration, return control to the VLA for retry, or select a compliant hand-control regime. It uses finger-position and motor-effort feedback as proprioceptive contact evidence and requires neither tactile sensors nor VLA retraining. On a Unitree G1 with a BrainCo Revo2 hand, a randomized matched-block evaluation on five objects held out from VLA training yields 61.3% completion for the base VLA, 72.0% for unconditional close-to-stall control, and 84.0% for the supervisor under a shared budget; the gain is positive on every object and persists under moderate pose perturbations. Ablations show the gain is not explained by extended closure alone, and that selective triggering reduces correction episodes by 65.7% with no detected change in completion. A retention audit shows acceptance predicts retention in 88.9% of held-out cases, while compliant objects expose conservative false rejection. A thin-walled-cup study demonstrates contextual routing to compliant control, matching an always-compliant reference. These results suggest that contact-guided execution-time adaptation can improve the object-level generalization of a fixed VLA to held-out objects by adapting physical realization without object-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgenticTactileVLA，一种执行时监督器，把物体特异的适应从预测阶段转移到物理交互阶段，在固定 VLA 基础上用本体感受接触证据改进对未见物体的抓取完成率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略虽能预测可迁移的操作策略，但在实际遇到物体时难以可靠实现：同一抓取策略对应的物体在几何与柔顺性上存在差异，且手部闭合遮挡会削弱视觉反馈。因此需要一种不依赖触觉传感器、也无需重训练 VLA 的执行时自适应机制，提升物体级泛化能力。
AI.method: 固定 VLA 提供接近与手部目标；监督器以手指位置与电机电流/力矩（motor-effort）反馈作为本体感受式接触证据，决定：保持透明、细化手指屈曲、保留或释放已修正构型、交还 VLA 重试、或切换到柔顺手部控制模式。方法无需触觉传感器，也无需重训练 VLA。在 Unitree G1 + BrainCo Revo2 手上，对 5 个未参与 VLA 训练的物体做随机匹配方块评测，并设基座 VLA、无条件闭至堵转两种对照，在共享预算下比较，另做消融、保留审计与薄壁杯情境路由研究。
AI.result: 共享预算下完成率：基座 VLA 61.3%，无条件闭至堵转 72.0%，监督器 84.0%；增益在每个物体上均为正，并在中等位姿扰动下持续。消融显示增益不能仅由延长闭合时间解释；选择性触发使修正回合减少 65.7%，未检测到完成率变化。保留审计显示接受判定在 88.9% 的留出案例中预测保留，柔顺物体暴露出偏保守的误拒绝。薄壁杯实验显示可情境化路由到柔顺控制，与始终柔顺的参考方法相当。
AI.conclusion: 接触引导的执行时自适应可在不进行物体特异重训练的情况下，通过调整物理实现方式来提升固定 VLA 对留出物体的物体级泛化能力。

title: Reachability-Guided Sequential Quadratic Programming-Guarded Model Predictive Path Integral for Safe Nonlinear Predictive Control
summary: Safe robot control often requires combining long-horizon performance optimization with hard state and input constraints, but existing approaches tend to address this tradeoff partially. Sampling-based model predictive control (MPC) methods such as model predictive path integral (MPPI) are effective in handling nonlinear and nonconvex environments, yet their finite-sample rollouts and unconstrained weighted-average update can return an unsafe control. Deterministic nonlinear MPC can explicitly incorporate constraints, but its real-time safety and performance depends strongly on warm starts and local convergence. Hamilton--Jacobi reachability (HJR) provides rigorous safety certificates, but offline value-function computation remains practical only for reduced-order models. We propose ReSQ-MPPI, a reachability-informed generation--refinement architecture that combines these complementary strengths. An HJR value function computed offline for a reduced-order model guides online MPPI sampling toward safe, promising trajectory candidates. The MPPI solution is then refined by a small number of sequential quadratic programming (SQP) iterations in a full-order MPC problem. A key observation is that the standard MPPI inference step is an unconstrained weighted least-squares problem; ReSQ-MPPI replaces it with a constrained MPC refinement that recovers the MPPI update when it is feasible and minimally modifies it otherwise. Simulations in cluttered navigation and autonomous racing environments demonstrate that ReSQ-MPPI improves safety and performance over standalone MPPI, MPC, and reachability-filtered sampling-based control baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReSQ-MPPI，用离线降阶 HJR 值函数引导 MPPI 采样，再用少量 SQP 迭代在全阶 MPC 中精化，兼顾长时域性能与硬约束安全。
AI.motivation: 机器人安全控制需同时兼顾长时域性能优化与状态/输入硬约束。现有方法各有短板：采样类 MPC（如 MPPI）能应对非线性非凸环境，但有限采样与无约束加权平均更新可能输出不安全控制；确定性非线性 MPC 可显式建模约束，但实时性与性能强依赖热启动和局部收敛；HJR 能提供严格安全证书，但离线值函数计算仅对降阶模型可行。
AI.method: 提出 ReSQ-MPPI，采用可达性引导的"生成—精化"架构：离线针对降阶模型计算 HJR 值函数，在线引导 MPPI 采样趋向安全且有潜力的轨迹候选；随后在全阶 MPC 问题中进行少量序列二次规划（SQP）迭代精化解。核心观察是标准 MPPI 推理步等价于无约束加权最小二乘问题，ReSQ-MPPI 将其替换为带约束的 MPC 精化：当 MPPI 更新可行时予以恢复，不可行时做最小修正。
AI.result: 在杂乱导航与自动驾驶竞速仿真环境中，ReSQ-MPPI 相比单独使用的 MPPI、MPC 以及基于可达性滤波的采样控制基线，在安全性与性能上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过将降阶 HJR 的安全引导、MPPI 的采样探索与全阶 MPC 的约束精化相结合，ReSQ-MPPI 有效弥合了性能优化与硬约束安全之间的差距，验证了可达性引导生成加约束精化这一架构的可行性。

title: WasserMan: Benchmark for Underwater Manipulation Policy Learning
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Underwater manipulation couples visual decisions, contact forces and a thruster-controlled floating base. We introduce WasserMan, to our knowledge the first multi-task simulation benchmark for visuomotor learning of floating-base underwater contact manipulation. It provides ten expert-solvable tasks, two vehicle-arm platforms, a bimanual configuration and underwater dynamics. Nine tasks have learned-policy evaluations. We compare ACT, diffusion policies (DP) and behavioral cloning on six tasks, with three training runs and equal sampled-window budgets. Pretrained SmolVLA adds evaluations on three tasks. In the tested settings, removing integral action can prevent completion, while changing action interfaces can reduce learned-policy success despite successful expert replay. Currents produce task-dependent changes in completion and actuation effort. Versioned tasks, demonstrations and per-episode evidence support a protocol separating expert feasibility, learned completion and execution effort.

AI.tldr: 提出 WasserMan——首个面向浮基水下接触操作视觉运动学习的多任务仿真基准，包含十个专家可解任务、两种载具-机械臂平台、双臂配置与水下动力学，并对 ACT、扩散策略、行为克隆及预训练 SmolVLA 进行评测。
AI.motivation: 水下操作同时耦合视觉决策、接触力与推进器控制的浮动基座，现有仿真基准缺乏面向此类视觉运动学习的多任务评测平台，因此需要构建专门的基准。
AI.method: 构建 WasserMan 基准，提供十个专家可解任务、两种载具-机械臂平台、双臂配置和水下动力学，其中九个任务含学习策略评测。在六个任务上以三次训练运行和相同采样窗口预算对比 ACT、扩散策略（DP）与行为克隆，并在三个任务上加入预训练 SmolVLA 评测。
AI.result: 在测试设置下，移除积分作用可能导致任务无法完成；改变动作接口即便专家回放成功，也会降低学习策略成功率；水流对完成情况和驱动代价产生任务相关的影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过任务版本化、演示数据及逐回合证据，WasserMan 支持一种将专家可行性、学习完成度与执行代价相分离的评测协议。

title: DreamFormer: Dream Imitation with a Transformer World Model for Language-Conditioned Robotic Manipulation
comment: submitted to IEEE Transactions on Cognitive and Developmental Systems (TCDS)
summary: We introduce DreamFormer, a model-based agent that acquires language-conditioned, multi-task skills by imitating expert demonstrations within the latent imagination of a learned world model. DreamFormer first learns a task-agnostic Transformer world model from unstructured play data, then acquires task-specific behaviors by optimizing an intrinsic reward that aligns agent-generated rollouts with expert demonstrations in latent space. Since the policy is trained on-policy inside imagination, it is exposed to its own errors during training, mitigating the covariate shift inherent to offline behavioral cloning. To make long-horizon imagination affordable, DreamFormer encodes a high-resolution multi-view robotic observation into a single input token, avoiding both spatial downsampling and the multi-token representations used by prior Transformer world models. On the long-horizon CALVIN benchmark, DreamFormer outperforms LUMOS, the comparable model-based agent, on single-environment evaluation (2.52 vs 2.34 average tasks completed per chain of five) while keeping imagination rollouts tractable. Against HULC, the behavior cloning baseline, it nearly doubles performance on zero-shot transfer to an unseen environment (1.30 vs 0.67), indicating that dynamics learned by the world model transfer more readily than a directly cloned policy. This is consistent with the role attributed to internal models in biological agents, where a model of environment dynamics supports behavior in situations not previously encountered.

AI.tldr: 提出DreamFormer：在世界模型潜空间想象中模仿专家演示，获得语言条件的多任务技能。
AI.motivation: 离线行为克隆存在协变量偏移，长时程想象代价高昂，先前Transformer世界模型的多token表示阻碍可负担的长时程rollout。
AI.method: 先从无结构play数据学习任务无关Transformer世界模型；再用内在奖励在潜空间对齐rollout与专家演示，在想象中在线训练策略；并将高分辨率多视角机器人观测编码为单token以避免空间下采样和多token表示。
AI.result: CALVIN基准上，单环境评估2.52 vs LUMOS 2.34（每五任务链平均完成任务数）；零样本迁移到未见环境1.30 vs HULC 0.67，接近翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型学得的动力学比直接克隆策略更易迁移，符合生物智能体内部模型支撑未遇情境行为的观点。

title: NM-LIO: Multiple LiDAR-Inertial Odometry Addressing LiDAR Measurement Noise Discrepancy
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures, 1 table. Published in the International Conference on Robot Intelligence Technology and Applications (RiTA 2024)
summary: Multiple LiDAR-inertial odometry methods have been widely applied in robotic applications owing to their enhanced accuracy and reliability. However, adopting multiple LiDAR systems can be challenging due to the discrepancies in measurement noise across different LiDARs. Existing methods have typically overlooked the noise discrepancies, which can significantly affect accuracy. In this paper, we propose Noise-aware Multiple LiDAR-Inertial Odometry (NM-LIO) that addresses the noise discrepancies. We integrate a noise model to quantify the measurement noise of each LiDAR. Additionally, we estimate the uncertainty of the residuals based on the measurement noise, allowing the measurement model to capture the noise discrepancies. Our proposed method is evaluated on a public multiple LiDAR dataset and compared with state-of-the-art methods. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can accurately estimate the odometry in various environments by accounting for the noise discrepancies.

AI.tldr: 提出NM-LIO，通过噪声建模量化各LiDAR测量噪声并估计残差不确定性，解决多LiDAR噪声差异问题。
AI.motivation: 多LiDAR-惯性里程计因精度与可靠性受青睐，但不同LiDAR测量噪声存在差异。现有方法通常忽略该噪声差异，从而显著影响定位精度。
AI.method: 引入噪声模型以量化每个LiDAR的测量噪声；基于该测量噪声估计残差的不确定性，使测量模型能够捕捉噪声差异，从而构建噪声感知的多LiDAR-惯性里程计（NM-LIO）。
AI.result: 在公开多LiDAR数据集上评估，并与当前最先进方法对比；实验结果表明，所提方法通过考虑噪声差异，能在多种环境中准确估计里程计。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模并利用多LiDAR噪声差异，可有效提升多LiDAR-惯性里程计的精度与鲁棒性。

title: Online Target-less Radar-LiDAR-Camera Extrinsic Calibration via Joint Optimization
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the International Conference on Control, Automation and Systems (ICCAS 2026)
summary: Fusing radar, LiDAR, and camera enables robust perception in diverse and adverse conditions, but the fusion performance critically depends on accurate extrinsic calibration among the three sensors. In this paper, we address the problem of online target-less extrinsic calibration for the radar-LiDAR-camera system. Existing target-less methods are mostly designed for a single sensor pair, and composing the pairwise results does not guarantee consistency across the three sensors. Moreover, the sparse and noisy radar measurements make the radar-involving pairs unreliable. To tackle these challenges, we propose a joint calibration framework that constructs residuals for each sensor pair and optimizes the extrinsics of all pairs together to minimize the overall residual. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive radar noise filter that rejects spurious radar returns using a range-dependent margin, and a correspondence accumulation strategy that aggregates sparse radar correspondences over frames. We validate our method on an in-house radar-LiDAR-camera dataset covering diverse urban environments, where it reduces calibration errors across all sensor pairs over a state-of-the-art camera-LiDAR baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向雷达-激光雷达-相机系统的在线无靶标外参联合标定框架，通过多对传感器残差联合优化、自适应雷达噪声滤波与对应累积策略，提升三传感器一致性与标定鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 雷达、激光雷达与相机融合可在多样及恶劣条件下实现鲁棒感知，但融合性能高度依赖三者之间精确的外参标定。现有无靶标方法多针对单一传感器对设计，逐对组合结果无法保证三传感器间的一致性；同时雷达测量稀疏且噪声大，导致涉及雷达的传感器对标定不可靠。
AI.method: 提出联合标定框架：为每个传感器对构建残差，并对所有传感器对的外参进行联合优化，以最小化总体残差。同时引入自适应雷达噪声滤波器，利用随距离变化的边距剔除虚假雷达回波；并设计对应累积策略，跨帧聚合稀疏的雷达对应关系。
AI.result: 在覆盖多样城市环境的自建雷达-激光雷达-相机数据集上验证，方法在相机-激光雷达先进基线基础上，降低了所有传感器对的标定误差。
AI.conclusion: 面向雷达-激光雷达-相机的在线无靶标外参标定可通过多对联合优化与雷达噪声抑制、对应累积实现一致性提升；自建数据集的实验表明该方法优于现有相机-激光雷达基线。

title: Leveraging Cost-effective Robotics for K-12 STEM Education through Water Quality Monitoring Tasks
summary: Engaging K-12 students in authentic scientific research remains a significant challenge, particularly at the intersection of environmental science and robotics. We introduce the Jar Jar ROV, a low-cost, open-source Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) platform designed for citizen science-based water quality monitoring by middle school students. This paper presents the design of the platform and the results of a large-scale deployment with over 100 students across a US state who built, programmed, and deployed the ROVs in local lakes. The educational framework yielded high student engagement in hands-on activities, with ROV construction earning a perfect average score from mentors. Scientifically, the program established a grassroots monitoring network, generating nearly eleven thousand validated measurements of temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, and turbidity. However, our evaluation identified a critical "engagement gap," with student interest declining sharply during more complex tasks such as electronics assembly and data uploading. This paper contributes both a validated, scalable model for integrating robotics into environmental education and a data-driven roadmap for future improvements. These enhancements focus on lowering technical barriers and creating a more intuitive link between data collection and scientific discovery, addressing a key challenge in empowering the next generation of citizen scientists.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍低成本开源水下机器人平台Jar Jar ROV，用于中学生开展公民科学水质监测，并在全州100余名学生中大规模部署；结果显示动手建造参与度高、产出近1.1万条验证水质数据，但电子装配与数据上传环节存在明显"参与度落差"。
AI.motivation: 让K-12学生参与真实科学研究仍是难题，尤其是环境科学与机器人学的交叉领域；同时需要低成本、可扩展的方案来推动水质监测类公民科学实践。
AI.method: 设计并开发低成本、开源的遥控潜水器（ROV）平台Jar Jar ROV，面向中学生公民科学水质监测；在一州范围内开展100余名学生参与的大规模部署，学生完成ROV的搭建、编程与本地湖泊下水作业，并由导师评分、收集与验证水质测量数据以评估教育效果与科学产出。
AI.result: 学生在动手活动中参与度高，ROV建造环节获得导师评分满分（平均分满分）；项目形成基层监测网络，产出近11,000条经校验的温度、pH、溶解氧与浊度测量数据；但评估发现关键"参与度落差"，在电子装配和数据上传等复杂任务中，学生兴趣显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究既提供了一个经验证、可扩展的将机器人学融入环境教育的模型，也给出了数据驱动的改进路线图；后续改进聚焦于降低技术门槛，并在数据采集与科学发现之间建立更直观的联系，以应对赋能下一代公民科学家的关键挑战。

title: RiskFly: Frustum-Aligned Spatio-Temporal Risk Fields for One-Stage Agile Flight in Dynamic Clutter
summary: Agile flight in unknown, cluttered, and dynamic environments requires a planner that knows where and when danger will appear, not only that a trajectory is dangerous. One-stage learning-based planners trained with differentiable privileged costs are fast and expert-free, but the only signal reaching their encoder is a scalar trajectory cost with no spatial or temporal structure, so avoidance degrades into late reactive maneuvers. We present RiskFly, a one-stage planner that predicts risk in the same space in which it acts. A dual-stream observation pairs a short depth sequence with a frustum-aligned inverted spherical range-map sequence, whose angular cells match the end-state proposals one to one. An auxiliary head regresses a frustum-aligned spatio-temporal risk field, supervised by a privileged closest-point-of-approach (CPA) target. This self-predicted field is queried differentiably along the instantiated quintic trajectory at its own arrival times, and also enters the training objective, so representation supervision and planning gradients meet in a single space. Privileged signals are discarded at deployment, and the planner runs map-free from onboard depth and proprioception. Extensive simulation and zero-shot real-world flights on resource-constrained platforms show higher success rates at comparable end-to-end latency.

AI.tldr: RiskFly：单阶段学习式规划器，在与动作同一空间预测风险，用视锥对齐的时空风险场监督编码器，实现更早避障。
AI.motivation: 未知、杂乱且动态环境中的敏捷飞行要求规划器知道危险将在何处、何时出现，而非仅判断轨迹是否危险。单阶段学习式规划器虽快且无需专家示范，但其编码器仅接收缺乏时空结构的标量轨迹代价，导致避障退化为滞后的反应式机动。
AI.method: 提出 RiskFly：双流观测将短深度序列与视锥对齐的倒置球面距离图序列配对，其角度单元与终态候选一一对应；辅助头回归视锥对齐的时空风险场，由特权最近接近点（CPA）目标监督；该自预测风险场沿实例化五次多项式轨迹按其到达时间可微查询，并进入训练目标，使表征监督与规划梯度在同一空间交汇；部署时丢弃特权信号，仅依赖机载深度与本体感知、无地图运行。
AI.result: 大量仿真及在资源受限平台上的零样本真实飞行表明，在相当的端到端时延下取得更高的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 将风险预测与动作空间对齐的单阶段规划框架可有效改善动态避障的时效性，并在真实平台上保持实时性与泛化性。

title: ForeAct3D: Policy-Grounded Future World Modeling for VLA Policies
summary: Robots need to anticipate how their actions will change the world, since manipulation success hinges on the resulting contacts and object motions. However, existing Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies that predict future observations from shared features leave the forecast decoupled from the actions the policy will actually execute, and impose no physical constraints on how the scene may evolve. We introduce ForeAct3D, a framework for policy-grounded future world modeling within VLA policies. Learnable geometric queries decode depth, semantic segmentation, and camera pose from the policy representation into current and future semantic 3D scene states, and the future queries are conditioned on the policy-generated action chunk to ground the forecast in the planned interaction. A physical-consistency closure relates the two states through background staticity and instance-level rigidity, and anchors the wrist-camera pose to end-effector kinematics. These objectives shape the shared representation used for action generation during training, and no future prediction is required at inference. Without robot pretraining, ForeAct3D achieves 98.3\% average success on LIBERO and an average task length of 3.73 on CALVIN, outperforming its base policy on every suite. Ablations show that semantic 3D supervision, physical consistency, and action conditioning each improve manipulation performance, and that action conditioning substantially improves future object localization. Real-world experiments on spatial placement, object insertion, and sequential manipulation further raise average success from 6.7\% to 37.8\% over the base policy. The project page and code are available at https://github.com/anthonytao80-crypto/ForeAct3D.

AI.tldr: 提出 ForeAct3D 框架，在 VLA 策略内部构建以策略为锚点的未来世界模型，通过语义 3D 场景状态预测与物理一致性约束塑造共享表征，提升操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 策略从共享特征预测未来观测，导致预测与策略实际执行的动作解耦，且对场景演化缺乏物理约束，难以保证操作中接触与物体运动的合理性。
AI.method: 用可学习几何查询从策略表征解码当前与未来的深度、语义分割和相机位姿，生成语义 3D 场景状态；未来查询以策略生成的动作块为条件，使预测锚定于规划交互；引入物理一致性闭合约束，包括背景静止性与实例级刚性，并将腕部相机位姿约束到末端执行器运动学；训练时这些目标塑造动作生成所用的共享表征，推理时无需未来预测。
AI.result: 无需机器人预训练，在 LIBERO 上平均成功率 98.3%，CALVIN 上平均任务长度 3.73，在所有套件上优于基策略。消融显示语义 3D 监督、物理一致性与动作条件化均提升操作性能，动作条件化显著改善未来物体定位。真实世界空间放置、物体插入与顺序操作实验将平均成功率从 6.7% 提升至 37.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将未来世界建模与策略动作显式绑定并施加物理约束，可有效提升 VLA 操作的预测质量与执行性能，且推理阶段无额外开销。

title: Exploiting Hierarchical Controller Structure in Contextual Parameter Learning for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Hierarchical control architectures are widely used to decompose complex control problems into interacting control levels and are particularly important in robotics, where planning, whole-body motion, and lower-level control must be coordinated across different levels of abstraction and time scales. Their overall closed-loop performance, however, depends strongly on parameters distributed across the hierarchy, such that tuning controllers on different levels independently may neglect relevant cross-layer interactions. We propose a contextual Bayesian optimization framework for joint parameter learning in hierarchical control systems. Rather than modeling closed-loop performance only as a scalar black-box function, we retain separate observations of task performance, realization quality, and control effort. A correlated multi-output Gaussian process models these performance components, while their known aggregation into the overall closed-loop objective is evaluated analytically. The formulation exploits three complementary consequences of hierarchical control: informative performance quantities exposed by the hierarchy, coupling between parameters of different controller levels, and variations of these relations with operating conditions. We evaluate the approach for humanoid loco-manipulation, jointly tuning a centroidal predictive controller and a whole-body controller for physical box pushing under varying box mass. The proposed method achieves the lowest mean empirical regret during both training and adaptation among the considered baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出上下文贝叶斯优化框架，用于分层控制系统的联合参数学习，仅用多输出高斯过程建模性能分量并以解析方式聚合，在人形机器人推箱任务中取得最低经验遗憾。
AI.motivation: 分层控制架构广泛用于分解复杂控制问题，在机器人中需协调规划、全身运动与底层控制等不同抽象层次和时间尺度。但其整体闭环性能高度依赖分布在各层的参数，逐层独立整定会忽略关键的跨层耦合与工况变化。
AI.method: 不把闭环性能仅视为标量黑箱函数，而是分别保留任务性能、实现质量与控制代价的观测；用相关多输出高斯过程建模这些性能分量，并对其已知的聚合关系解析地计算整体闭环目标。框架利用分层控制的三点互补特性：层级暴露的信息性性能量、不同控制器层参数间的耦合、以及这些关系随工况的变动。
AI.result: 在人形机器人运动-操作（loco-manipulation）任务上验证：联合整定质心预测控制器与全身控制器，在不同箱体质量下完成物理推箱。所提方法在训练与自适应阶段均取得相较对比基线最低的平均经验遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 将性能分量结构化建模并结合已知聚合关系，可有效利用分层结构带来的信息与跨层耦合，实现跨层参数的联合优化，并提升对工况变化的自适应能力。

title: An End-to-End Framework for Modelling Pneumatic Soft Robots Based on Differentiable Finite Element Methods
comment: Published in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Soft robots present significant modelling challenges due to their non-linearity, complex dynamics and potentially intricate geometries. These difficulties in accurate system identification and dynamics modelling limit their applications in precise robotics tasks. Prior modelling approaches typically suffer from trade-offs in accuracy, computational efficiency, or speed. The differentiable finite element method (FEM) offers a promising balance between these desiderata for soft robot modelling, and enables the use of gradients for efficient calibration and trajectory optimisation. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end differentiable FEM-based framework designed to streamline modelling and system identification for pneumatic soft robots, enabling the generation of reliable models for downstream tasks. The framework automates the conversion of computer-aided designs into voxelised tetrahedral viscoelastic FEM meshes that accurately represent the robot's geometry and actuation mechanism. By integrating easily acquired point cloud data with differentiable FEM, the framework achieves precise identification of material and dynamic actuation parameters using a minimal experimental setup. Additionally, the differentiable nature of the model facilitates trajectory optimisation by leveraging gradients from robot dynamics and contact interactions. We validate the framework by modelling a complex bellow-shaped pneumatic soft robot and demonstrate its efficacy in real-world motion planning tasks. Experimental results indicate high modelling accuracy, with a maximum positional error of less than 3 mm, and successful application in tasks such as path following and grasping.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种端到端可微分有限元（FEM）框架，用于气动软体机器人的建模与系统辨识，通过将CAD自动转换为体素化四面体黏弹性网格，并结合点云数据辨识材料与驱动参数，实现高精度建模与轨迹优化。
AI.motivation: 软体机器人因非线性、复杂动力学和复杂几何形状而建模困难，导致系统辨识与动力学建模不准确，限制了其在精密任务中的应用。现有建模方法在精度、计算效率和速度之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出端到端可微分FEM框架：自动将计算机辅助设计（CAD）转换为体素化四面体黏弹性FEM网格，以准确表征机器人几何与驱动机制；将易获取的点云数据与可微分FEM结合，在最小实验设置下精确辨识材料参数与动态驱动参数；利用机器人动力学与接触交互的梯度进行轨迹优化。
AI.result: 通过在复杂波纹管状气动软体机器人上建模验证，最大位置误差小于3 mm，建模精度高，并成功应用于路径跟随与抓取等真实运动规划任务。
AI.conclusion: 该可微分FEM框架在精度、计算效率与速度之间取得良好平衡，可自动化生成可靠模型，支持下游任务，为气动软体机器人的建模、系统辨识与轨迹优化提供了有效且实用的解决方案。

title: PerturBot: Breaking Shortcut Priors in Vision-Language-Action Models with Perturbative Training
summary: A vision--language--action (VLA) policy can complete complex tasks while ignoring the evidence that should determine its actions. An object held near the wrist camera can displace the instructed target. Language and action show the same pattern: a familiar noun can trigger the operation it was paired with in training even after the verb changes, and a gripper that closed on nothing may lift anyway. We call these dependencies modality shortcuts: regularities in successful demonstrations make visual, lexical, or motor cues sufficient to predict expert actions without the task evidence needed for the underlying decision. More demonstrations of the same kind can raise task success while leaving these shortcuts intact. We propose Perturbot which makes task-relevant evidence easier to use and shortcuts insufficient on their own: it applies task-preserving wrist-view perturbations, enriches instructions with decision-relevant captions, and adds random and failed trajectory segments relabeled with the behavior they contain. It complements scaling by changing what is scaled, and leaves inference unchanged. Moreover, we propose GroundingFscore, an offline score that diagnoses how severely a policy relies on modality shortcuts. Task success rate shows whether a policy improves, while GroundingFscore reveals whether the policy scales healthily, relying on task evidence rather than shortcuts. Together, Perturbot and GroundingFscore provide a training-and-evaluation framework for disentangling VLA decisions from shortcut priors while preserving responsiveness to task-relevant evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"模态捷径"概念，并给出Perturbot训练方法与GroundingFscore离线评估指标，用于缓解与诊断VLA策略对模态捷径的依赖。
AI.motivation: VLA策略虽能完成复杂任务，却可能忽略真正决定动作的任务证据：腕部相机近旁物体可替换被指令的目标；语言与动作也表现出同样模式——熟悉名词在动词改变后仍触发训练时配对的操作，夹爪空夹也能抬起。作者将这类由成功示范中的规律性导致视觉、词汇或运动线索足以预测专家动作、而无需任务证据的现象称为"模态捷径"。增加同类示范能提升任务成功率，却保留这些捷径，因此需要新的训练与评估手段。
AI.method: 1）Perturbot训练方法：施加保持任务不变的腕部视角扰动，使用含决策相关信息的caption丰富指令，并加入随机与失败轨迹片段并按其所含行为重新标注，使任务相关证据更易被利用、使捷径不再充分；不改变推理过程。2）GroundingFscore评估指标：离线诊断策略对模态捷径的依赖程度。
AI.result: Perturbot通过改变被缩放的示范内容来补充单纯规模扩展；GroundingFscore能够揭示策略是否健康地随规模扩展，即是否依赖任务证据而非捷径。二者结合形成训练与评估框架。
AI.conclusion: Perturbot与GroundingFscore共同提供了一个训练与评估框架，在保持对任务相关证据响应的同时，将VLA决策与捷径先验解耦；任务成功率反映是否提升，GroundingFscore反映是否健康扩展。

title: RoboIRS: Inference-Time Internal Representation Steering for Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) often degrade under out-of-distribution task variations despite retaining partial task capability. To recover such capability, we propose RoboIRS, an inference-time internal representation steering method that uses successful and failed rollouts to train linear classifiers, select outcome-relevant intervention locations, and derive task-specific steering directions without updating policy parameters. On 15 simulation tasks with a frozen $π0.5$ policy, RoboIRS improves the average success rate from 44.4% to 66.2%, outperforming alternative inference-time intervention baselines while adding little inference time. We further validate RoboIRS on real-robot manipulation using the same $π0.5$ policy and demonstrate its applicability to a world-action model Cosmos Policy, where the average success rate improves from 35.4% to 55.4%. These results show that directly steering internal robot-policy representations can improve the performance of robot policies at inference time. Project website is available at https://rollingoat.github.io/roboirs/.

AI.tldr: 提出RoboIRS，一种推理时内部表征引导方法，通过成功/失败轨迹训练线性分类器，定位结果相关干预位置并推导任务特定引导方向，无需更新策略参数，显著提升VLA与WAM模型在分布外任务上的成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型与世界-动作模型（WAMs）在分布外（OOD）任务变化下性能常显著下降，尽管仍保留部分任务能力。因此需要一种恢复该能力的方法，且希望不依赖重新训练或参数更新。
AI.method: RoboIRS在推理阶段进行内部表征引导：利用成功与失败的rollout训练线性分类器，据此选择与结果相关的干预位置，并推导任务特定的引导方向（steering directions）；整个过程中冻结策略参数，不进行任何策略更新。
AI.result: 在15个仿真任务上，使用冻结的π0.5策略，平均成功率从44.4%提升至66.2%，优于其他推理时干预基线，且额外推理时间很小。在真实机器人操作任务上以同一π0.5策略验证有效，并扩展至世界-动作模型Cosmos Policy，平均成功率从35.4%提升至55.4%。
AI.conclusion: 直接引导机器人策略的内部表征可在推理阶段有效提升策略性能，为VLA与WAM模型在分布外任务下的能力恢复提供了无需参数更新的通用方案。

title: Test-Time Training as Residual Memory for Robot Policies
summary: Memory is essential for long-horizon robotic manipulation, where successful actions may depend on past events that are no longer recoverable from the current observation. As episodes grow longer, however, retaining the full history becomes increasingly costly, creating a fundamental scalability challenge for memory-augmented policies. Existing approaches address this challenge by either storing selected past observations in a bounded memory bank or compressing interaction history into a fixed-size parametric state through Test-Time Training (TTT). Yet these formulations do not explicitly distinguish between historical information that can already be recovered from the policy's current context and information that must persist beyond it. We introduce TTT-RM, which repurposes TTT as Residual Memory, using fast weights not to generically compress history but to complement a bounded memory bank by preserving task-relevant historical information that cannot be recovered from the policy's current context. Concretely, TTT-RM learns a history decoder that reconstructs historical representations from the current observation and retrieved memory. The resulting reconstruction residual captures what this context fails to explain and serves as the learning target for TTT. The TTT slow weights are optimized against this residual target so that online fast-weight updates learn to encode complementary historical information over time. The fast-weight state is then queried to produce a residual memory representation that conditions action generation. Extensive experiments on memory-intensive simulation benchmarks and real-world tasks show that TTT-RM consistently improves across multiple memory designs, outperforms diverse baselines, and supports sustained execution on a three-minute, eight-stage stowing task.

AI.tldr: TTT-RM 将测试时训练（TTT）重新定位为"残差记忆"，用快速权重仅编码当前上下文无法恢复的任务相关历史信息，与有界记忆库互补，在记忆密集型仿真基准与真实任务上持续提升性能。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人操作中，成功动作常依赖当前观测已无法恢复的过去事件；随回合变长，保留完整历史代价过高，形成可扩展性瓶颈。现有方法或是在有界记忆库中存放挑选的过去观测，或是通过 TTT 将交互历史压入固定大小的参数状态，但都未显式区分"已可由当前上下文恢复的历史信息"与"必须持久保存于上下文之外的信息"，导致容量被冗余信息占用。
AI.method: 提出 TTT-RM：将 TTT 用作残差记忆。学习一个历史解码器，从当前观测与检索到的记忆重建历史表征；重建残差即当前上下文无法解释的部分，被作为 TTT 的学习目标。TTT 慢权重针对该残差目标优化，使在线快速权重更新逐步学会编码互补的历史信息；随后查询快速权重状态，得到残差记忆表征，用于条件化动作生成。
AI.result: 在记忆密集型仿真基准与真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，TTT-RM 在多种记忆设计下均取得一致提升，优于多种基线方法，并支持在三分钟、八阶段的收纳（stowing）任务中持续执行。
AI.conclusion: 通过让快速权重专门补偿有界记忆库无法覆盖的历史信息，TTT-RM 以残差为监督缓解了记忆增强策略的可扩展性问题，在长时程操作中兼具性能与持续执行能力。

title: Emergent Underactuation in Fully Actuated Multirotors by Minimizing a Homogeneous Allocation Cost
summary: Full actuation is commonly valued for independent position and attitude tracking. This work establishes a complementary principle: when only a position trajectory is prescribed, minimizing a positively homogeneous allocation cost selects underactuated-like behavior on a fully actuated multirotor. This cost class includes norms and power laws, including standard minimum-norm pseudoinverse allocation. We use fiberwise infimization to transport the actuator-output cost to wrench space, yielding a homogeneous infimal allocation cost. Restriction to unit zero-moment forces defines a directional landscape whose minimizing directions are independent of force magnitude. We show that aligning any fixed minimizing direction with the required world-frame force minimizes instantaneous and integrated zero-moment allocation costs. The resulting body force remains in a fixed one-dimensional subspace without transverse components. We derive an exact optimality-gap decomposition quantifying the additional cost of every other attitude trajectory and characterizing the minimum-cost class. When a disturbance or prescribed-motion change modifies the required-force direction, a fully actuated platform can immediately generate the modified force using transverse authority and reorient toward the new minimum-cost family. A structurally underactuated platform must reorient before generating that force. Thus, homogeneous allocation-cost minimization explains why optimal nominal motion can be underactuated-like, while full actuation remains valuable for disturbance rejection and transient force generation.

AI.tldr: 在全驱动多旋翼仅需跟踪位置轨迹时，最小化正齐次分配代价会自发选择类欠驱动行为；但全驱动的横向力能力在扰动抑制与瞬态力生成中仍具价值。
AI.motivation: 全驱动平台通常以独立位置与姿态跟踪能力被重视。本文提出一个互补原理：当只规定位置轨迹时，最小化正齐次分配代价会倾向选择类欠驱动行为，从而解释为何最优标称运动可能表现为欠驱动，同时澄清全驱动能力在何处仍然必要。
AI.method: 将执行器输出代价通过纤维化下确界（fiberwise infimization）传输到力旋量空间，得到齐次下确界分配代价。限制到单位零力矩力后定义方向性景观，证明其极小方向与力幅值无关。进一步将固定极小方向与世界坐标系所需力对齐，并推导精确的最优性间隙分解，用以量化其他姿态轨迹的额外代价并刻画最小代价类。
AI.result: 对齐任一固定极小方向与所需世界坐标系力可同时最小化瞬时与积分的零力矩分配代价；得到的体轴力保持在固定的一维子空间内，无横向分量。最优性间隙分解可精确量化非最优姿态轨迹的额外代价。当扰动或运动变化改变所需力方向时，全驱动平台可立即通过横向权限生成修正力并再定向至新的最小代价族，而结构欠驱动平台必须先行再定向。
AI.conclusion: 齐次分配代价最小化解释了最优标称运动为何呈类欠驱动：零力矩条件下最优力位于固定一维子空间。全驱动的价值体现在扰动抑制与瞬态力生成，因为其可即时利用横向权限响应所需力方向变化，而结构欠驱动平台存在再定向延迟。

title: Robot Learning with Visual Predicted Force
summary: Force-aware manipulation typically relies on specialized force or tactile sensors. We show that force-aware manipulation can instead be achieved through visual force prediction from the deformation of a compliant Fin Ray gripper. Our approach trains two models. First, we train a visual force estimator on calibration data and use it to annotate task demonstrations with force estimates. Second, we train an action--force proposal policy on these force-augmented demonstrations to jointly generate candidate robot actions and their associated forces. At test time, we sample candidate actions and the forces they are expected to produce, then execute the action whose predicted force is closest to a target from the demonstrations. We evaluate our approach on berry picking, empty-can grasping, in-hand reorientation, and plug insertion. Our results show that visual force prediction can guide inference-time action selection for contact-rich manipulation without requiring force or tactile sensors at deployment.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出利用柔性Fin Ray夹爪形变的视觉力预测实现力感知操作，无需部署力/触觉传感器。方法分两阶段：先用标定数据训练视觉力估计器标注示范数据，再训练动作-力联合提案策略。测试时采样候选动作及其预测力，选择预测力最接近目标的动作执行。在浆果采摘、空罐抓取、手内重定向和插梢任务上验证有效。
AI.motivation: 传统力感知操作依赖专用力传感器或触觉传感器，成本高、结构复杂且在部署时受限。作者希望摆脱这种硬件依赖，探索是否能仅凭视觉信号推断力信息，从而以更简单的方式实现接触丰富场景下的力感知操作。
AI.method: 方法分两阶段模型训练。第一，使用标定数据训练视觉力估计器，利用柔性Fin Ray夹爪的形变从视觉图像预测力，并用该估计器为任务示范数据标注力估计值。第二，在力增强的示范数据上训练动作-力提案策略，使其能联合生成候选机器人动作及对应力。测试阶段，采样候选动作及其预期产生的力，选择预测力与示范中目标力最接近的动作执行。
AI.result: 在浆果采摘、空罐抓取、手内重定向和插梢四类任务上进行评估，结果表明视觉力预测可有效指导推理阶段的动作选择，实现接触丰富的操作，且在部署时无需力传感器或触觉传感器。
AI.conclusion: 视觉力预测能够替代专用力/触觉传感器，为接触丰富操作提供力感知能力。通过柔性夹爪形变估计力、并用其引导推理时的动作选择，该方法在无传感器部署条件下仍能完成多种操作任务，为低成本、结构简单的力感知操作提供了可行途径。

title: Lie Rarely, Lie Big: Stealthy Insider Attacks on LLM Robot Teams
summary: When a team of robots delegates planning and mutual trust to LLM agents, a single compromised robot can corrupt the shared outcome. We study this threat in a grounded task: a multi-robot survey in which measurements can be verified against the physical world, but every verification costs budget that would otherwise advance the mission.
