We treat the compromised robot as a stealthy adversary in the system-theoretic sense: it is limited not by an energy bound but by the team's own detectors. We then derive two bounds. First, the probability that the adversary's reports are verified is bounded below in terms of the degrees in the communication graph and the verification budget. Second, the map error caused by any stealthy adversary is bounded above by the value of a linear program over the adversary's bias distributions; its solution is an exchange rate between stealth budget and damage: below a critical verification level the worst stealthy attack tells rare, full-magnitude lies on the records least likely to be verified, and above it the better purchase is small biases hidden in the noise. In experiments where the honest robots are LLM agents, both bounds hold at the budget the attack actually spent. The experiments also show that which records an LLM robot re-checks is unbiased, but how much it re-checks is unpredictable.

AI.tldr: 研究多机器人团队将规划与信任委托给LLM智能体时,单个被攻陷机器人可破坏集体结果。作者将攻击者建模为受团队检测器约束的隐蔽对手,推导出验证概率下界与地图误差上界,并用LLM智能体实验验证。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协作中LLM智能体承担规划与相互信任,若单个机器人被攻陷,可污染共享决策结果。该威胁需要形式化刻画,但现有工作缺乏对其在可验证物理任务中的隐蔽攻击边界的分析。
AI.method: 在"多机器人勘测"接地任务中,测量可对照物理世界验证,但每次验证消耗本可用于推进任务的预算。将受陷机器人建模为系统理论意义上的隐蔽对手:其限制不来自能量界,而来自团队自身的检测器。据此推导两个界:(1)用通信图度数与验证预算刻画对手报告被验证概率的下界;(2)将任何隐蔽对手造成的地图误差上界表示为关于对手偏差分布的线性规划值。
AI.result: 验证概率下界与地图误差上界均成立。线性规划解给出隐蔽预算与破坏之间的"汇率":低于临界验证水平时,最坏隐蔽攻击是对最不可能被验证的记录施加罕见但满幅的谎言;高于该水平时,更优策略是隐藏在噪声中的小偏差。在诚实机器人为LLM智能体的实验中,两个界在实际攻击所耗预算处均成立;且LLM机器人复核哪些记录是无偏的,但复核数量不可预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作形式化了LLM多机器人团队中受检测器约束的隐蔽攻击威胁,给出验证概率下界与误差上界,并揭示验证预算与破坏之间的交换关系。实验表明理论界在LLM智能体场景下成立,同时指出LLM复核行为的策略不可预测性。

title: DNPush: Distributed Nonparallel Pushing Force Control of Multi-Robot Systems for Object Transportation
comment: 8 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters
summary: This letter proposes DNPush, a Distributed Nonparallel Pushing force controller for cooperative object transport without inter-robot communication. Each robot uses local force measurements, a preassigned force weight, and a locally expressed desired transport direction, without requiring an object model, contact locations, a CoM estimate, or moment arm magnitudes online. DNPush regulates nonparallel force magnitudes from local force direction misalignments through a reciprocal-sine law. Under the stated contact conditions, Lyapunov analysis with LaSalle's invariance principle proves convergence to a unique rotational equilibrium, where perpendicular force contributions cancel and the net torque from normal forces is zero. Object velocity converges to the desired transport direction, and suitable contact regions exist for convex polygons. Simulations isolate the reciprocal-sine scaling mechanism, five-robot coordination, and active rotational damping. Hardware experiments with soft tactile differential-drive robots achieve a velocity direction error of 0.61 deg +/- 0.79 deg over five trials with a fixed transport direction and demonstrate object transport through waypoints with three robots.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DNPush——一种无需机器人间通信的分布式非平行推力控制器，用于协同物体运输。每个机器人仅依靠局部力测量、预设力权重和局部表达的期望运输方向，无需物体模型、接触位置、质心估计或在线力臂幅值。通过倒数正弦律将局部力的方向偏差映射为非平行推力幅值，并用Lyapunov分析与LaSalle不变性原理证明收敛到唯一旋转平衡，使物体速度收敛到期望运输方向。仿真验证机理与多机协调，实物实验速度方向误差为0.61°±0.79°。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协同运输通常依赖机器人间通信、物体模型、质心估计或已知接触几何，这些要求在实践中难以满足且降低系统鲁棒性与可扩展性。本文旨在仅利用局部力信息实现分布式、非平行推力协调，从而在无通信条件下完成物体运输。
AI.method: 提出DNPush分布式非平行推力控制器：各机器人使用局部力测量、预设力权重与局部表达的期望运输方向；通过倒数正弦律（reciprocal-sine law）根据局部力方向偏差调节非平行推力幅值。基于给定接触条件，采用Lyapunov分析与LaSalle不变性原理证明系统收敛至唯一旋转平衡，其中垂直分力相互抵消、法向力净力矩为零；并分析凸多边形存在合适接触区域的条件。通过仿真分离验证倒数正弦缩放机制、五机器人协调与主动旋转阻尼，并开展软触觉差速驱动机器人的实物实验。
AI.result: Lyapunov分析与LaSalle不变性原理证明了收敛到唯一旋转平衡，物体速度收敛到期望运输方向，并证明凸多边形存在合适的接触区域。仿真分别验证了倒数正弦缩放机制、五机器人协调与主动旋转阻尼。实物实验中，软触觉差速驱动机器人在固定运输方向下五次试验的速度方向误差为0.61°±0.79°，并实现三机器人通过路径点的物体运输。
AI.conclusion: DNPush能够在无机器人间通信、无物体模型、无接触位置与质心估计的条件下实现协同物体运输，理论上保证收敛到期望运输方向与唯一旋转平衡，并通过仿真与实物实验验证了机制有效性与实际可行性。

title: PatternDex: Learning Interaction Patterns to Guide Reinforcement Learning of Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation of Articulated Objects
comment: 8 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables. Project page: https://patterndex.github.io/PatternDex/
summary: In this paper, we develop a method that enables bimanual dexterous hands to manipulate articulated objects with a high success rate without suffering from an embodiment gap. We observe that the correlation between hand motions and object motions is dictated by the object rather than the hands and can be learned from human-object demonstrations. Based on this observation, we propose PatternDex, a method that learns this correlation and represents it as a token sequence, which we call an interaction pattern. From this pattern, PatternDex estimates the wrist motions and contact points that fit the target robot, and then trains a reinforcement learning policy that exploits these estimates as guidance. Since the guidance fits the target embodiment, the policy explores only the actions that the target robot can execute and thus achieves high success rates. PatternDex also requires only simple fine-tuning to train a new robot, since it can reuse the learned interaction pattern. We evaluate PatternDex with bimanual dexterous hands on human demonstrations from the ARCTIC dataset. PatternDex achieves, on average, a 92.8% success rate with Allegro hands, while the state-of-the-art baseline achieves 52.2%. Also, it achieves success rates above 70% with three other robot hands after fine-tuning alone. Furthermore, we verify that the learned policy transfers well to a real-world task of opening a microwave. Videos and additional results are available at https://patterndex.github.io/PatternDex/

AI.tldr: PatternDex 通过从人类演示中学习手-物交互模式（token 序列）并据此估计适配目标机器人的腕部运动与接触点，引导强化学习策略，实现双手灵巧手高成功率操作铰接物体。
AI.motivation: 双手灵巧手操作铰接物体时存在 embodiment gap（本体差异），直接迁移人类演示或训练策略成功率低；作者观察到手部运动与物体运动的相关性由物体而非手决定，且可从人-物演示中学习。
AI.method: 提出 PatternDex：从人-物演示中学习手-物运动相关性，表示为 token 序列即"交互模式"；由该模式估计适配目标机器人的腕部运动与接触点；再以这些估计作为引导训练强化学习策略，使策略仅在目标机器人可行动作空间内探索；同时可复用的交互模式使新机器人仅需简单微调。
AI.result: 在 ARCTIC 数据集的人类演示上评估：Allegro 手平均成功率 92.8%，SOTA 基线为 52.2%；经微调后在另外三种机器人手上成功率均超过 70%；学习到的策略可良好迁移至真实世界开微波炉任务。
AI.conclusion: 将手-物交互相关性抽象为可复用的交互模式，能有效缩小 embodiment gap，提升双手灵巧操作成功率并降低新本体的适配成本。

title: Flow Policies as Actions of Skill-Level World Models: Learned and Symbolic Abstractions for Long-Horizon Planning
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/flow-skill-wm
summary: Latent world models enable robots to plan by predicting the consequences of actions. Planning long tasks with control-rate actions requires many prediction steps, which enlarges the search space and accumulates error. Skill-level actions shorten these sequences, but a symbolic skill vocabulary requires domain knowledge and labeled demonstrations. We construct skill-level actions from the inputs of a flow-matching policy trained on demonstrations segmented into complete skills. The policy maps a noise seed and an observation, optionally with a code or label, to a complete skill execution, so one execution is one world-model transition. On this mechanism we propose four action abstractions with increasing task knowledge: a compressed seed, two discrete codes learned from the demonstrations, and a symbolic label. We evaluate them with a common world-model training procedure and planning framework on simulated block rearrangement tasks that require up to 14 sequential skills. The symbolic label succeeds in over 90% of the tasks that require up to six skills and degrades beyond. Without any label, an object-centric learned code matches it on single-skill tasks and retains half to three quarters of its success on tasks of two to five skills. Ablations attribute much of the label's advantage to its planner knowing which actions are applicable, rather than to the label itself. Beyond six skills the search, not the world model, limits success. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/flow-skill-wm

AI.tldr: 提出用流匹配策略构建技能级动作抽象，使一次技能执行对应一次世界模型转移，并比较三种免标注/带标注动作表示在长程规划中的表现。
AI.motivation: 控制速率下的动作序列过长会放大搜索空间并累积预测误差；技能级动作可缩短规划序列，但传统符号技能词表依赖领域知识与标注示范。
AI.method: 在分割为完整技能的示范上训练流匹配策略，将噪声种子与观测（可选加上code或label）映射为一整段技能执行；据此设计四种任务知识递增的动作抽象：压缩种子、两种从示范中学到的离散code、符号label。用统一的世界模型训练流程与规划框架进行评估。
AI.result: 在最多需14个连续技能的仿真积木重排任务中，符号label在不超过六个技能的任务上成功率超90%，之后下降；无label时，物体中心的学得code在单技能任务上与label持平，在2–5技能任务上保留其成功率的1/2到3/4。消融表明label的优势很大程度来自规划器知道哪些动作可用，而非label本身。超过六个技能后，瓶颈是搜索而非世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 技能级动作抽象可免去符号词表与标注示范，学得code可在中短程任务上接近符号label；长程任务的主要限制在于搜索效率。

title: Learning Task and Motion Plans from Real Demonstrations with Hybrid Flow Matching
comment: 9 pages, 9 figures, 1 table. Submitted to IEEE ICRA 2027. Project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning
summary: Long-horizon mobile manipulation requires a task plan and the motion that executes it. Generative planners trained on demonstration produce both in one pass, requiring neither a symbolic domain nor search. To date, however, they have relied on thousands of scripted demonstrations of fixed-base arms and executed open loop. This paper presents a hybrid flow matching planner: a single network generates the symbolic plan with masked discrete flow matching and the motion trajectory with continuous flow matching. Unlike prior generative planners, we aim to learn from a much smaller set of demonstrations and to execute the plan in closed loop. Two properties of the data compensate for the small dataset. A demonstration resumed from any of its intermediate actions is itself a demonstration, which multiplies the training samples and enables replanning after every action. Objects of the same kind are interchangeable, which turns demonstrations of one goal into demonstrations of every permuted goal. Our base implementation produces valid plans on 68% of held-out scenes; a training and generation scheme for the discrete plan raises this to 76%, and replanning after every action raises the task completion rate from 40% to 53% in a kinematic simulation. The planner matches the task completion rate of motion-only flow matching policies while additionally providing the symbolic plan, and it outperforms previous hybrid diffusion formulations on both task completion and plan validity. We validate the planner on a real mobile manipulator. Videos and project page: https://andreumatoses.github.io/research/hybrid-flow-planning

AI.tldr: 提出混合流匹配规划器，用单一网络同时生成符号计划（掩码离散流匹配）与运动轨迹（连续流匹配），在小样本演示下实现闭环长程移动操作。
AI.motivation: 长程移动操作需任务规划与运动执行，生成式规划器可一次生成二者且无需符号域与搜索，但现有方法依赖数千条固定基座机械臂脚本演示且仅开环执行，数据成本高、鲁棒性差。
AI.method: 混合流匹配规划器：单网络以掩码离散流匹配生成符号计划、连续流匹配生成运动轨迹。利用数据两性质补偿小数据集：(1) 从任一中间动作恢复的演示本身即演示，倍增样本并支持每步动作后重规划；(2) 同类物体可互换，使单一目标演示泛化为所有排列目标。并提出离散计划的训练与生成方案。
AI.result: 基础实现在68%留出场景生成有效计划，离散计划训练与生成方案提升至76%；运动学仿真中每步重规划将任务完成率从40%提升至53%。规划器达到仅运动流匹配策略的完成率并额外提供符号计划，在完成率与计划有效性上优于先前混合扩散方案，并在真实移动机械臂上验证。
AI.conclusion: 单一混合流匹配网络可仅凭少量演示同时产出符号计划与运动轨迹，并通过数据增广与闭环重规划显著提升泛化与任务完成率，在仿真与真实移动机械臂上均可行。

title: Distributed Cascade Force Control of Soft-Tactile-Based Multi-robot System for Object Transportation
comment: 6 pages, 7 figures. Published in the 2024 IEEE/SICE International Symposium on System Integration (SII)
summary: In this paper, we present a distributed cascade force control system (DCFC) for multiple robots with the aim of pushing a rigid object towards a desired moving target without their inter-robot communication. These mobile robots are equipped with 360-degree vision-based soft tactile sensors utilized to determine contact location and resultant impact force. By investigating the dynamics of moving rigid objects on the flat, we proposed a distributed cascade control. The inner loop control incorporates contact force and positioning, ensuring the robots' pushing contact and application of the desired force to the object. The outer loop control coordinates the robots to push the object in a desired direction without inter-robot communication, regardless of the unknown object mass. The stability and convergence of the system are verified using the Lyapunov stability theory. We also conducted simulation and real-word experiments to validate the performance of the proposed control method, and the experimental results showcase the successful coordination of multiple robots in pushing an object towards a moving desired direction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需机器人间通信的分布式级联力控系统（DCFC），使多机器人协作将刚性物体推向移动目标。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协作推动刚性物体时通常依赖机器人间通信，且物体质量未知，通信与建模依赖会降低系统的鲁棒性和可扩展性。
AI.method: 基于平面运动刚性物体动力学，设计分布式级联控制：内环融合接触力与位置控制，保证接触并施加期望推力；外环在无通信条件下协调各机器人朝期望方向推送，且不依赖物体质量；用李雅普诺夫稳定性理论证明稳定性和收敛性。
AI.result: 仿真与实物实验均验证了所提方法性能，多机器人成功协同将物体推向移动的期望方向。
AI.conclusion: 该分布式级联力控方案在无机器人间通信、物体质量未知的情况下可实现多机器人协调推动，具有较好的有效性与稳定性。

title: ExStereo: Lifting 2D Vision-Language-Action Models to 3D with Explicit Stereo Representations
summary: Three-dimensional perception is critical for robotic manipulation, particularly for high-precision tasks, as recovering metric depth and precise 3D object positions from monocular RGB observations is inherently ill-posed. However, many Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models rely solely on RGB observations for perception. Leveraging recent advances in foundation models for stereo matching, we introduce ExStereo, a stereo module that augments pre-trained 2D VLAs with 3D perception. ExStereo reconstructs scene geometry from stereo image pairs and renders multi-view observations as an explicit stereo representation for stereo feature extraction. The action tokens from the action expert selectively attend to the resulting stereo tokens through our proposed action-stereo cross-attention mechanism, enabling the policy to generate robot actions conditioned on 3D scene information. To learn robust 3D representations, we introduce a mid-training stage before task-specific post-training, using a self-supervised learning objective on large-scale stereo data. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two publicly available VLAs, $π_{0.5}$ and SmolVLA, and evaluate them in simulation and on a real-world bimanual PiPER platform. Across both settings, VLAs fine-tuned with ExStereo consistently outperform baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of stereo perception for robotic manipulation. Our project website is at: https://exstereo-vla.github.io/ExStereo/.

AI.tldr: ExStereo 是一个即插即用的立体感知模块，通过重建场景几何与多视角渲染为预训练 2D VLA 模型注入 3D 感知能力，在仿真与真实双臂平台上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 单目 RGB 观测恢复度量深度与精确 3D 物体位置本身是病态问题，而多数 VLA 模型仅依赖 RGB 进行感知，导致在高精度机器人操作任务中 3D 感知能力不足。
AI.method: 基于立体匹配基础模型构建 ExStereo 模块：从双目图像对重建场景几何并渲染多视角观测，形成显式立体表示以提取立体特征；通过提出的 action-stereo 交叉注意力机制，让动作专家的 action token 选择性关注立体 token，从而生成依赖 3D 场景信息的动作；并在任务后训练前引入基于大规模立体数据的自监督中期训练阶段以学习鲁棒 3D 表示。
AI.result: 在公开 VLA 模型 π0.5 与 SmolVLA 上微调，于仿真环境及真实双臂 PiPER 平台上评测，使用 ExStereo 微调的 VLA 在两个设定下均一致优于基线。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明立体感知能有效提升机器人操作的性能，验证了以显式立体表示增强 2D VLA 的可行性与通用性。

title: Tackling Sim-to-Real Mismatch Through Sampling-Based Disturbance Observers: From Analytical Models to Learned World Models
comment: 15 pages, 14 figures, 7 tables. Project website: https://sampling-based-dob.github.io/
summary: Robotic controllers increasingly rely on analytical models, simulators, cost-query interfaces, and learned world models. However, physical deployment can deviate from nominal assumptions, and additional disturbances may arise even when the model itself is accurate. In control systems, disturbance observers (DOB) are widely used to estimate such unmeasured effects from nominal models and measured feedback. Classical DOB formulations are generally built around explicit plant models. This paper develops the sampling-based disturbance observer (SDOB), extending the DOB principle to a broader range of models, including simulators and learned world models, through state-rollout or cost-query interfaces. SDOB separates two observable channels: state-effect disturbances, for which the feedback state differs from its prediction, and cost disturbances, for which the same query state receives different costs as the perceived environment changes. Diverse simulation and real-robot experiments across traditional and learned models demonstrate the effectiveness of SDOB in compensating for sim-to-real mismatch and improving control performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于采样的扰动观测器（SDOB），将扰动观测器原理从显式被控对象模型扩展到仿真器和学习世界模型，通过状态推演或代价查询接口估计扰动，从而补偿Sim-to-Real偏差并提升控制性能。
AI.motivation: 机器人控制器日益依赖解析模型、仿真器、代价查询接口和学习世界模型，但实际物理部署常偏离名义假设，即使模型本身准确也可能出现额外扰动。经典扰动观测器（DOB）虽能从名义模型与测量反馈中估计未测扰动，但其构造通常依赖显式被控对象模型，难以适用于仿真器与学习模型，因此需要扩展DOB的适用模型范围。
AI.method: 本文提出基于采样的扰动观测器（SDOB），通过状态推演或代价查询接口，将DOB原理推广到包括仿真器和学习世界模型在内的更广泛模型。SDOB区分两个可观测通道：一是状态效应扰动，即反馈状态偏离其预测值；二是代价扰动，即同一查询状态在感知环境变化时得到不同代价。
AI.result: 在传统模型与学习模型上开展的多种仿真与真实机器人实验表明，SDOB能有效补偿Sim-to-Real偏差并提升控制性能。
AI.conclusion: SDOB将扰动观测从显式模型推广至仿真器与学习世界模型，为利用非解析模型估计扰动提供了统一途径，并在仿真与真实机器人任务中验证了其对Sim-to-Real差异的补偿能力与对控制性能的提升作用。

title: GJK-CBF: Control Barrier Functions for Convex Rigid Body Collision Avoidance on SE(3)
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Demo video: https://youtu.be/eDvscHhGIj0. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible. Code will be released upon publication
summary: Collision avoidance among convex bodies is a fundamental problem in robotics. Control Barrier Functions (CBFs) provide a practical framework for real-time safety filtering due to their computational efficiency. For general convex bodies, exact separation measures, such as distance or scaling factor, are typically computed through optimization. Existing CBF formulations often obtain the required gradient via differentiable optimization (diffOpt), adding computational overhead. In contrast, we leverage the Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi (GJK) algorithm to obtain the current witness pair---the pair of points realizing the minimum distance or penetration depth---and formulate a CBF, termed GJK-CBF, whose gradient is constructed directly from the relative rigid-body motion of the witness pair, without resorting to diffOpt. This formulation applies to both 2D and 3D environments across a broad class of convex body pairs, provided that at least one in each one-to-one interaction is strictly convex. The proposed GJK-CBF is validated in various scenarios, including multi-robot position swapping in both 2D and 3D, navigation through a vertical slit in 3D, and its applicability to manipulators. The results demonstrate collision-free motion across all scenarios while reducing the conservativeness introduced by geometric approximations, particularly in narrow environments.

AI.tldr: 提出GJK-CBF：利用GJK算法的witness pair直接构造CBF梯度，无需可微优化(diffOpt)，适用于2D/3D多类凸体碰撞避免，减少几何近似保守性。
AI.motivation: 凸体间碰撞避免是机器人学基础问题。CBF因计算高效适合实时安全滤波，但一般凸体的精确分离度量（距离或缩放因子）通常需通过优化求解。现有CBF公式多依赖可微优化(diffOpt)获取所需梯度，带来额外计算开销。因此需要一种无需diffOpt、可直接构造梯度的CBF方法。
AI.method: 使用Gilbert-Johnson-Keerthi(GJK)算法获取当前witness pair（实现最小距离或穿透深度的一对点），据此构造CBF（GJK-CBF）。其梯度直接由witness pair的相对刚体运动构建，不依赖diffOpt。适用于2D和3D环境及广泛类别凸体对，前提是每一对交互中至少有一个体是严格凸的。
AI.result: 在多种场景中验证GJK-CBF：2D和3D多机器人位置互换、3D穿越垂直狭缝、以及在机械臂上的适用性。所有场景均实现无碰撞运动，并减少了几何近似引入的保守性，尤其在狭窄环境中表现突出。
AI.conclusion: GJK-CBF提供了一种无需可微优化的碰撞避免CBF构造方式，通过witness pair直接得到梯度，在2D/3D多类凸体对（至少一个严格凸）中有效，验证于多机器人换位、3D狭缝导航与机械臂，实现无碰撞并降低保守性。

title: $R^2$-WAM: Repair-and-Reject Post-Training for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) emerge as a promising foundation for policy refinement by predicting the consequences of sampled actions. However, visually plausible predictions can mislead policy refinement if they fail to reflect the input actions. To address this mismatch, we introduce $R^2$-WAM, a two-stage repair-and-reject post-training framework that first improves the consistency of predicted futures with input actions, then uses these futures to select inferior action samples for negative fine-tuning. The repair stage grounds imagination in observed robot behavior through a kinematic alignment score that measures agreement between predicted and demonstrated motion, enabling the predicted video to faithfully reflect its input actions. Using the repaired video model, the rejection stage compares imagined outcomes of sampled and demonstrated actions, selectively applying negative fine-tuning to samples whose predicted task progress falls below the demonstrated reference by a prescribed margin. Together, the two stages extend video prediction from representation learning to consequence-based policy refinement without additional environment interaction or changes to the inference procedure. $R^2$-WAM achieves 93.8% average success on RoboTwin 2.0 across clean and randomized settings. On the long-horizon real-world Fold Shirt task, it achieves 87.5% average success, compared with 0% for Fast-WAM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 $R^2$-WAM，一个"修复-拒绝"两阶段后训练框架，先通过运动学对齐分数提升世界动作模型预测视频与输入动作的一致性，再利用修复后的预测结果对任务进展不足的动作样本进行负向微调，从而把视频预测从表征学习扩展为基于后果的策略精炼。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）通过预测采样动作的后果为策略精炼提供基础，但视觉上合理的预测可能并不忠实反映输入动作，这种不匹配会误导策略精炼。因此需要在不增加环境交互、不改变推理流程的前提下，提升预测与动作的一致性并据此精炼策略。
AI.method: 提出 $R^2$-WAM 两阶段后训练框架：（1）修复阶段：引入运动学对齐分数，度量预测运动与示范运动之间的一致性，使想象结果植根于观测到的机器人行为，令预测视频忠实反映输入动作；（2）拒绝阶段：利用修复后的视频模型比较采样动作与示范动作的想象结果，对预测任务进展低于示范参考且超过预设阈值的样本施加负向微调。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 的干净与随机化设置下平均成功率达 93.8%；在长时程真实世界 Fold Shirt 任务上平均成功率 87.5%，而 Fast-WAM 为 0%。
AI.conclusion: 通过修复与拒绝两个阶段，$R^2$-WAM 将视频预测从表征学习拓展到基于后果的策略精炼，无需额外环境交互或修改推理过程，并在仿真基准与长时程真实任务上取得显著性能提升。

title: PreAct-Nav: Agentic Reasoning Before Action for Urban Navigation
summary: Urban navigation requires embodied agents to pursue long-horizon goals through local decisions based on egocentric observations. However, existing agentic navigation methods often struggle to translate distant goals into coherent local decisions in large-scale physical environments. Their reliance on linguistic reasoning over transient observations or limited history constrains anticipation of the consequences of actions and future conditions, despite the importance of such foresight for navigating long and complex urban routes. To bridge this gap, we propose PreAct-Nav, an agentic navigation framework that equips frozen policies with anticipatory reasoning for robust urban navigation. Our central idea is to anchor local decisions in persistent medium-horizon subgoals, assess the consequences of predicted actions before execution, and continually update the reasoning context using actual outcomes. At its core, a navigation memory module maintains the active subgoal and relevant experience across decisions, translating distant goals into actionable intermediate objectives. We further introduce a predictive world sandbox that uses an action-conditioned world model (AC-WM) to forecast world dynamics conditioned on candidate movements. A vision-language model (VLM) reasoner interprets these predictions under the current subgoal to retain or revise actions. After execution, real observations are used to assess outcomes, correct inconsistent assumptions, and update memory to continue or reformulate the subgoal. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that the proposed PreAct-Nav improves action selection through memory updates and visual prediction, with more pronounced gains on longer routes and routes with more turns.

AI.tldr: 提出 PreAct-Nav 智能体导航框架，通过中时域子目标锚定局部决策、预测式世界沙盒评估动作后果、并持续更新导航记忆，为冻结策略赋予前瞻推理能力，从而提升大规模城市环境长程导航表现。
AI.motivation: 城市导航要求具身智能体基于自我中心观测进行局部决策以追求长时域目标。现有方法难以将远距离目标转化为连贯的局部决策：它们依赖对瞬时观测或有限历史的语言推理，限制了对动作后果与未来状况的预判，而这类前瞻性对长且复杂的城市路线至关重要。
AI.method: 核心思想是将局部决策锚定在持久的中时域子目标上，在执行前评估预测动作的后果，并利用真实结果持续更新推理上下文。具体包含：导航记忆模块维护活跃子目标与相关经验，将远距离目标转化为可执行的中间目标；预测式世界沙盒使用动作条件世界模型（AC-WM）在候选动作条件下预测世界动态；视觉语言模型（VLM）推理器在当前子目标下解读预测结果，决定保留或修正动作；执行后用真实观测评估结果、纠正不一致假设并更新记忆，以继续或重构子目标。该框架为冻结策略赋予前瞻推理能力。
AI.result: 大量评估表明，PreAct-Nav 通过记忆更新与视觉预测改进了动作选择，且在更长路线和转弯更多的路线上增益更为显著。
AI.conclusion: 将局部决策锚定于持久的中时域子目标、结合动作条件世界模型的前瞻预测与基于真实结果的记忆更新，可有效增强冻结策略在城市长程导航中的动作选择能力，尤其适用于长距离与多转弯的复杂路线。

title: Nudge Before You Push: Physics-Aware Navigation via Tactile Probing
summary: Visually identical containers can conceal loads that require different handling decisions. We present TANav, which uses a brief nudge to measure push resistance for navigation under a site-defined handling boundary. TacPhys reads the force sequence, with optional RGB-D and kinematics, into a mass estimate for push authorization. A repeated-patrol planner weighs probe and route costs, requests a second contact when useful, and reuses observations across visits. In simulation, TacPhys approaches a resistance-only Bayes reference and reduces missed pushes from 28.7% to 5.5% relative to peak-force thresholding at comparable low-risk operating points. In repeated-patrol simulation, TANav recovers 90% of the oracle's path saving, more than halves human interventions relative to always-detour, and reduces boundary violations from 4.3% to 2.9% relative to RGB-D-only probing. On a quadruped manipulator with a Hall-array fingertip, offline zero-shot MAE is 0.28-1.07 kg on containers up to 2.82 kg. Force-rise calibration at 3 kg gives 93.5% pooled offline accuracy (86.4% on non-cube episodes); a separate raw-peak rule gives 15 of 20 correct online decisions on unseen boxes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TANav 导航框架与 TacPhys 触觉质量估计模块：通过短暂"推挤"测量容器推阻，结合力序列（可选 RGB-D 与运动学）估计质量以授权推/绕行决策，并用重复巡逻规划器权衡探测成本与路径成本。仿真中 TacPhys 接近仅阻力 Bayes 参考，误推率由峰值力阈值法的 28.7% 降至 5.5%；重复巡逻仿真中 TANav 恢复 oracle 路径节省的 90%，人工干预减半以上，越界率由 4.3% 降至 2.9%。四足机械臂加霍尔阵列指尖的离线零样本 MAE 为 0.28–1.07 kg（≤2.82 kg 容器），3 kg 力上升标定离线准确率 93.5%，在线未见过箱体 20 次决策中 15 次正确。
AI.motivation: 外观完全相同的容器可能装载不同重量的载荷，从而需要不同的搬运/让行决策。仅凭视觉无法区分，而盲目推挤又可能违反场地定义的处理边界（如载荷过重不可推），造成风险。因此需要一种低成本、在线可用的方式判断"能否推"，并在重复巡逻中智能决定何时探测、何时绕行。
AI.method: 提出 TANav 系统：(1) 用一次短暂 nudge（推挤）测量容器的推阻；(2) TacPhys 触觉模块将力时间序列（可选融合 RGB-D 与机械臂运动学）映射为质量估计，用于推挤授权；(3) 重复巡逻规划器联合优化探测成本与路径成本，必要时请求第二次接触，并在多次巡逻间复用观测结果。硬件验证采用带霍尔阵列指尖的四足机械臂平台。
AI.result: 仿真：TacPhys 性能接近仅基于阻力的贝叶斯参考；在相当的低风险工作点上，误推率由峰值力阈值法的 28.7% 降至 5.5%。重复巡逻仿真：TANav 取得 oracle 路径节省的 90%，人工干预较总是绕行减少一半以上，越界率由仅 RGB-D 探测的 4.3% 降至 2.9%。真机：对不超过 2.82 kg 的容器，离线零样本 MAE 为 0.28–1.07 kg；3 kg 下力上升标定给出 93.5% 离线汇总准确率（非立方体片段 86.4%）；独立原始峰值规则在未见箱体上实现 20 次在线决策中 15 次正确。
AI.conclusion: 通过短暂物理推挤测量推阻并结合触觉质量估计与重复巡逻规划，TANav 能在视觉不可区分的情况下有效支持推/绕行决策，在仿真与真机上均显著降低误推、越界与人工干预，同时对未见物体具备一定零样本泛化能力。

title: RobotUse: Allocating Computation, Context, and Decisions
comment: 18 pages, 10 figures, 11 tables. Project page: https://robotuse-team.github.io/
summary: Robot agents must connect their intended actions to observed outcomes while retaining the context needed to revise their choices over repeated attempts. Existing interfaces often leave these choices inside predefined tools or require agents to manage detailed execution code and its growing history. We introduce RobotUse, a robot agent harness that organizes computation, context, and decisions around specifying and revising physical actions. Agents visually select targets and poses, while the backend handles geometry, motion planning, and control. Subagents retain detailed interactions within each subgoal and return the information needed for subsequent decisions. Continual harnessing lets agents learn from execution by updating a persistent playbook. On RoboLab, RobotUse achieves 45% task success, outperforming CaP-X by 6.7 percentage points while maintaining compact decision contexts and reducing reliance on predefined action abstractions. Furthermore, we show that RobotUse learns from real-world execution despite imperfect feedback and transfers what it learns to subsequent tasks. Project page is available at https://robotuse-team.github.io/.

AI.tldr: RobotUse是一个机器人智能体运行框架，将计算、上下文与决策组织在"指定与修正物理动作"这一核心上，在RoboLab上取得45%任务成功率，较CaP-X提升6.7个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人智能体接口存在两类缺陷：一是将动作选择封装在预定义工具内部，限制了灵活性；二是要求智能体自行管理详细执行代码及其不断增长的历史记录。这导致智能体难以将意图动作与观测结果有效关联，也难以保留修正选择所需的上下文。
AI.method: 提出RobotUse框架：智能体通过视觉方式选择目标与位姿，后端负责几何、运动规划与控制；子智能体在各自子目标内保留详细交互，并仅向主流程返回后续决策所需信息；采用持续"harnessing"机制，通过更新持久化的playbook从执行中学习。
AI.result: 在RoboLab上任务成功率达45%，比CaP-X高6.7个百分点，同时保持紧凑的决策上下文并降低对预定义动作抽象的依赖；此外，在反馈不完美的真实世界执行中也能学习，并将所学迁移至后续任务。
AI.conclusion: RobotUse通过将动作指定与底层执行解耦、借助子智能体隔离上下文、并以持久playbook实现持续学习，在提升任务成功率的同时保持上下文紧凑，验证了从真实执行中学习与跨任务迁移的可行性。

title: DiVeR: Decision-Critical Verifier Learning for VLA Test-Time Scaling
summary: Scaling robot data and model capacity has improved Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, but further progress is constrained by the high cost of robotic data. Verifier-guided test-time scaling offers an efficient alternative by sampling multiple action candidates and selecting the one most likely to lead to task success at inference time. Existing classification-based verifiers learn from trajectory-level outcomes but treat all visited states equally, even though their value for candidate discrimination can vary across a trajectory. At many states, plausible actions are similar and provide limited discrimination signal, while only a sparse set of decision-critical states admits meaningfully different actions that can substantially affect downstream outcomes. To address this, we propose DiVeR, which estimates decision criticality from the dispersion of sampled action representations. DiVeR then uses this signal to reweight verifier learning toward states where action selection is most consequential, without requiring step-level annotations or additional environment interaction. Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world experiments on a Franka Research 3 robot, DiVeR consistently improves task success through more effective verifier-guided action selection, while adding negligible verifier inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出DiVeR，通过采样动作表示的离散度估计决策关键性，对验证器学习进行重加权，聚焦对动作选择最关键的稀疏状态，在LIBERO、RoboCasa和真实Franka机器人上一致提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略受益于数据与模型容量的扩展，但机器人数据成本高昂，进一步进展受限。验证器引导的测试时扩展是高效替代方案：采样多个候选动作并选出最可能成功者。现有基于分类的验证器从轨迹级结果学习，却对所有访问状态一视同仁，忽视其区分不同候选动作的价值差异——多数状态下候选动作相似、判别信号有限，仅少数稀疏的决策关键状态才存在能显著影响下游结果的差异化动作。
AI.method: DiVeR从采样动作表示的离散度（dispersion）估计决策关键性，并据此对验证器学习进行重加权，使学习偏向动作选择最具后果的状态，无需步骤级标注或额外环境交互。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、RoboCasa以及真实Franka Research 3机器人实验中，DiVeR通过更有效的验证器引导动作选择，一致地提升任务成功率，同时验证器推理开销可忽略不计。
AI.conclusion: 以动作表示离散度衡量决策关键性并重加权验证器学习，是一种无需额外标注或交互的轻量有效方案，能显著改善验证器引导的动作选择与任务成功率。

title: A Unified Dynamics Framework for Reinforcement Learning and Classical Control of a Six-DOF Pipeline-Tracking ROV in NVIDIA Isaac Sim
summary: Reinforcement learning controllers for underwater vehicles are usually trained against one physics representation and deployed against another, so reported performance does not always describe behavior outside training. This paper presents a pipeline-tracking architecture for a six-degree-of-freedom remotely operated vehicle (ROV) in which one Universal Scene Description (USD) scene supplies the real BlueROV2-Heavy mass, added-mass, damping, buoyancy, and thruster parameters to both halves of the system: a vectorized NumPy implementation of Fossen's marine-craft equations, and an interactive NVIDIA Isaac Sim deployment applying the identical equations as PhysX forces at every step. The Coriolis-centripetal term is the primary dynamics model in both branches; a controlled ablation on PPO and TRPO shows that including it does not destabilize either algorithm and modestly improves tracking, about 19 percent lower standoff RMS error for TRPO. Five reinforcement learning algorithms, PPO, soft actor-critic, TD3, DDPG, and TRPO, are trained against one environment, reward, and randomized evaluation harness through a checkpoint-compatibility layer scoring any policy with the same code. The pipeline is extended with six classical baselines, PID, sliding-mode, fuzzy logic, feedback linearization, model predictive control, and an adaptive neuro-fuzzy inference system, driven by the same guidance geometry and thruster allocation as the learned policies. Under Coriolis-enabled dynamics, PPO, TRPO, and feedback linearization reach the strongest combination of 100 percent success and competitive accuracy; PID, fuzzy control, and the neuro-fuzzy baseline also reach 100 percent success with looser tracking; DDPG and TD3 each show a specific, explainable failure mode rather than a general weakness of off-policy learning; and classical control remains a strong baseline against the best learned policies.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一套六自由度ROV管道跟踪架构，用同一USD场景向基于NumPy的Fossen方程环境与Isaac Sim/PhysX部署端提供一致的物理参数，统一评测了5种强化学习算法与6种经典控制基线。
AI.motivation: 水下航行器强化学习控制器通常在一种物理表示下训练、在另一种物理表示下部署，导致所报告性能无法真实反映训练分布之外的行为，因此需要统一动力学与评测协议以保证结果可信、可比。
AI.method: 以单一USD场景提供BlueROV2-Heavy的质量、附加质量、阻尼、浮力与推进器参数，同时驱动两个分支：向量化NumPy实现的Fossen船舶运动方程，以及Isaac Sim中每步以PhysX力形式施加相同方程的交互式部署；Coriolis-向心项是两分支的主动力学模型，并在PPO与TRPO上做受控消融；通过检查点兼容层用同一代码、环境、奖励与随机化评测框架训练并打分PPO、SAC、TD3、DDPG、TRPO；再引入PID、滑模、模糊逻辑、反馈线性化、MPC与ANFIS六种经典基线，与学习策略共用制导几何与推力分配。
AI.result: 加入Coriolis项不会破坏任一算法稳定性且略微提升跟踪性能（TRPO的站位RMS误差约降低19%）。在启用Coriolis动力学时，PPO、TRPO与反馈线性化达到100%成功率与较优精度；PID、模糊控制与神经模糊基线同样达到100%成功率但跟踪更松；DDPG与TD3各自表现出特定且可解释的失效模式，而非离策略学习的普遍缺陷；经典控制仍是对抗最优学习策略的强基线。
AI.conclusion: 统一物理参数、动力学方程与评测协议后，学习策略与经典控制可在同一基准下公平比较；Coriolis项应作为主模型保留，PPO/TRPO具备与强经典基线相当的竞争力，而DDPG/TD3的问题可归因于具体失效机制而非算法范式本身。

title: FreeLoc: Online Floorplan Localization via Diffusion-Aided Pose Refinement
comment: Accepted at the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL) 2026
summary: Floorplans provide compact and widely available geometric maps for indoor localization, but existing high-performing floorplan-based methods still convert them into dense scene-specific offline databases, tying accuracy, storage, and runtime to the sampling resolution of the discretized pose space. We present FreeLoc, an online RGB-based floorplan localization framework that treats the floorplan as a directly queryable geometric map. FreeLoc introduces an efficient online geometric querying and diffusion-aided refinement scheme, which retrieves plausible pose anchors through on-the-fly floorplan ray querying and refines them into accurate continuous pose estimates. For sequential localization, FreeLoc develops an online likelihood construction strategy that bridges single-frame localization and probabilistic temporal fusion by constructing likelihoods from coarse-sampled candidates and refined pose hypotheses, enabling histogram-filter-based temporal fusion without offline databases. Experiments demonstrate real-time online inference and state-of-the-art performance in both single-frame and sequential localization, while real-world results validate practical deployability in indoor robotic localization scenarios.

AI.tldr: FreeLoc 提出一种在线 RGB 平面图定位框架，将平面图直接作为可查询几何地图，避免构建稠密场景专用离线数据库，实现实时在线推理并在单帧和序列定位中达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有高性能的基于平面图的室内定位方法需将平面图转换为稠密的场景专用离线数据库，导致精度、存储和运行时间均受离散化位姿空间采样分辨率的制约。为摆脱这一限制，作者希望将平面图作为可直接查询的几何地图，实现无需离线数据库的在线定位。
AI.method: FreeLoc 引入高效的在线几何查询与扩散辅助细化方案：通过即时平面图射线查询（on-the-fly floorplan ray querying）检索合理的位姿锚点，并将其细化为精确的连续位姿估计。针对序列定位，提出在线似然构建策略，从粗采样候选和细化位姿假设中构建似然，衔接单帧定位与概率时序融合，从而支持基于直方图滤波的时序融合而无需离线数据库。
AI.result: 实验表明 FreeLoc 实现实时在线推理，在单帧定位和序列定位中均取得最先进（state-of-the-art）性能；真实世界实验验证了其在室内机器人定位场景中的实际可部署性。
AI.conclusion: FreeLoc 通过将平面图视为可直接查询的几何地图，并结合在线射线查询、扩散细化与在线似然构建，摆脱了对稠密离线数据库的依赖，兼顾实时性、精度与实用部署能力，为室内机器人定位提供了一种有效的在线 RGB 平面图定位方案。

title: Now You Feel It, Now You See Me: Digital-Twin-based Teleoperation Interface for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Teleoperation is becoming increasingly important for collecting high-quality demonstrations to teach robots dexterous manipulation skills. For dexterous manipulation, bare-hand tracking provides a practical way to control robotic hands and demonstrate coordinated finger movements without gloves or exoskeletons. However, this type of teleoperation faces two key feedback limitations: a lack of force feedback and visual feedback of occluded region. The absence of force feedback hinders precise and safe manipulation, as operators must infer contact force visually rather than feel them directly. Occlusion by objects or other robot parts impairs the assessment of hand positions, approach distances, and pre-grasp configurations suited to the object's shape. To address these limitations, we propose a digital-twin-based augmented reality (AR) teleoperation interface that integrates bare-hand tracking, bimanual robotic hands, and virtual representations of the robot and task objects. The interface renders tactile measurements on robot hand meshes as visuo-force feedback. Furthermore, it offers a user-controlled virtual view panel or occlusion-aware transparency rendering to provide occlusion-mitigating visual feedback. We evaluated the interface through user studies involving Task 1 and Task 2, examining how force visualization and visual assistance support demonstration collection in tasks requiring careful force regulation and manipulation under occlusion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于数字孪生的AR遥操作界面，通过裸手追踪控制双臂机器人手，并将力反馈可视化和遮挡缓解视觉反馈集成到界面中，以提升灵巧操作示教数据采集的质量。
AI.motivation: 遥操作是采集高质量机器人灵巧操作示教数据的重要手段，裸手追踪无需手套或外骨骼即可控制机器人手。但该类遥操作存在两个关键反馈缺陷：缺乏力反馈，操作者只能靠视觉推断接触力，难以精确、安全地操作；以及被物体或机器人自身遮挡区域的视觉反馈缺失，影响手部位置、接近距离和适配物体形状的预抓取姿态判断。
AI.method: 提出一种基于数字孪生的增强现实（AR）遥操作界面，集成裸手追踪、双臂机器人手以及机器人与任务物体的虚拟表示。界面将触觉测量结果渲染在机器人手网格上，作为视-力反馈；同时提供用户可控制的虚拟视角面板或遮挡感知透明化渲染，以提供缓解遮挡的视觉反馈。
AI.result: 通过包含Task 1和Task 2的用户研究对界面进行评估，考察力可视化与视觉辅助如何在需要精细力调节和遮挡条件下操作的任务中支持示教数据采集。
AI.conclusion: 该界面通过视-力反馈与遮挡缓解视觉反馈，缓解了裸手遥操作中力反馈缺失和遮挡导致视觉受限的问题，有助于在精细力调节与遮挡操作任务中支持示教数据采集。

title: PB-STDG: A Prediction-Based Short-Term Decentralized Greedy Guidance Algorithm for a Drone Road System
summary: In recent years, Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) or drones have been increasingly adopted in urban environments for applications such as parcel delivery, infrastructure inspection, emergency response, and drone light shows. A non-negligible issue is how to manage the increasing number of drones operated by different entities, to enable them to cooperatively avoid potential collisions and determine conflict-free short-term flight paths in urban airspace. This paper presents a Prediction-Based Short-Term Decentralized Greedy (PB-STDG) guidance algorithm for a structured Drone Road System (DRS). PB-STDG extends the original STDG algorithm by introducing a prediction mechanism that enables drones to anticipate the decisions of neighboring drones using additional information shared in beacon packets, aiming to address the over-conservative behavior observed in the STDG algorithm. Several simulation scenarios are conducted to evaluate and compare the proposed algorithm with STDG. The results show that PB-STDG improves traffic efficiency while maintaining a safety level comparable to that of STDG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PB-STDG算法，通过引入预测机制扩展原有STDG，使无人机能预判邻近无人机的决策，从而在结构化无人机道路系统中提升短期路径规划的交通效率，同时保持与STDG相当的安全水平。
AI.motivation: 城市环境中无人机应用日益增多，多主体运营的无人机如何协同避碰、确定无冲突的短期飞行路径成为不可忽视的问题。原有STDG算法存在过度保守的行为，导致交通效率不足。
AI.method: 提出基于预测的短期去中心化贪心算法PB-STDG，服务于结构化无人机道路系统（DRS）。该算法扩展原STDG，通过信标包中共享的额外信息引入预测机制，使无人机能够预判邻近无人机的决策，以缓解STDG的过度保守问题。
AI.result: 通过多个仿真场景对PB-STDG与STDG进行对比评估，结果表明PB-STDG在保持与STDG相当安全水平的同时，提升了交通效率。
AI.conclusion: PB-STDG通过预测机制有效改善了原STDG算法的过度保守问题，在结构化城市空域中实现了效率与安全的良好平衡。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement of Visuomotor Policies through Local Recovery Supervision
summary: Visuomotor policies can execute familiar tasks yet lack the corrective behavior needed after their own mistakes. We present a framework for recursive self-improvement through local recovery supervision. Each round audits the current policy, generates corrective demonstrations at supported failure states, and uses them to update the policy that drives the next round of collection. An offline auditor locates unresolved failures using coarse and dense temporal evidence and specifies observable repair goals. A fixed multimodal agent acts as a tool-using teacher, generating recovery actions through observation, computation, execution, and feedback. The frozen student tests whether each teacher endpoint supports further progress. If continuation fails, the system restores that endpoint and extends the demonstration. Action-level quality assessment then defines continuous training windows with aligned observations, quality weights, and validity masks. Only the student is deployed. In a preliminary LIBERO-Goal study, recovery-augmented post-training achieves 88 successful episodes out of 100 validation scenes, compared with 78 for original-data continuation from the same $π_0$ checkpoint. An earlier BC-RNN study on robomimic Can improves success from 102/130 to 112/130 using 26 local recovery segments. Both comparisons match 2,000 additional optimization steps.

AI.tldr: 提出一种通过局部恢复监督实现策略递归自我改进的框架：离线审计定位失败状态，固定多模态教师生成纠正动作，冻结学生验证端点可行性，动作级质量评估构建训练窗口，仅部署学生策略。LIBERO-Goal上88/100优于78/100，robomimic Can上112/130优于102/130。
AI.motivation: 视觉运动策略能完成熟悉任务，但自身犯错后缺乏纠正行为（恢复能力）。需要一种不依赖额外人工示教的自我改进机制，针对失败状态生成局部恢复监督。
AI.method: 递归自我改进框架，每轮：1）离线审计器用粗/密时间证据定位未解决失败并指定可观测修复目标；2）固定多模态智能体作为工具使用型教师，经观察-计算-执行-反馈生成恢复动作；3）冻结学生验证每个教师端点能否继续推进，失败则回退并延长示教；4）动作级质量评估定义带对齐观测、质量权重和有效性掩码的连续训练窗口；5）用纠正示教更新策略驱动下一轮采集，仅学生部署。
AI.result: LIBERO-Goal初步研究：恢复增强后训练100个验证场景成功88，原始数据续训为78（同一π₀检查点）。robomimic Can早期BC-RNN研究：用26个局部恢复片段将成功从102/130提升至112/130。两组对比均匹配2000额外优化步。
AI.conclusion: 局部恢复监督可在相同优化预算下有效提升策略成功率，教师-学生分离与端点验证机制保证恢复示教质量，仅部署学生保持推理成本不变。

title: VICON: Visual-Inertial-Contact based Hand-Object Tracking for Manipulation Datasets
summary: Learning dexterous manipulation benefits from human demonstration datasets that capture diverse and natural hand-object interactions. In particular, contact points and forces provide supervision on where and how strongly to interact, which cannot be fully captured by motion trajectories alone. However, methods for jointly capturing hand and object motion, contact points, and forces remain limited. Moreover, severe occlusion from hand-object interaction challenges accurate tracking of both hands and objects. To address these limitations, we present a Visual-Inertial-CONtact based hand-object tracking (VICON) framework. It holistically captures both hand and object motion along with contact information during manipulation, even under severe occlusion. First, we adopt a visual-inertial glove and an RGB-D camera for accurate hand tracking, and redesign the glove to incorporate contact sensing. Specifically, force-sensitive resistors (FSRs) are placed on the glove based on human grasp frequency to synchronously record contact states and calibrated normal forces. Second, without requiring pre-existing CAD models, we estimate object poses using RGB-D images and a mesh reconstructed from a monocular video. We propose factor-graph-based object trajectory estimation that fuses object-pose estimates weighted by visibility under hand-object occlusion, FSR measurements, and a hand-motion prior. Across 40 motion-capture sessions with five objects, VICON achieves a 2.5% failed-frame rate compared with 50.9-64.6% for the baselines, with median errors of 3.9 mm and 3.0 degrees under occlusion. Using VICON, we construct a dataset containing synchronized hand-object motion, contact points, and normal forces, and will publicly release an expanded dataset covering 10 object categories at https://github.com/VICON-dataset/dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出VICON框架，融合视觉-惯性手套与RGB-D相机，在严重遮挡下同步捕获手与物体运动及接触点/法向力，失败帧率仅2.5%，并构建公开数据集。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作学习依赖包含多样化、自然的人-物交互演示数据集。接触点与接触力对"何处、以多大强度"交互提供监督，仅靠运动轨迹无法完整获取。然而，现有方法难以同时捕获手部与物体运动、接触点及接触力，且手-物交互带来的严重遮挡使手与物体的精确跟踪困难。
AI.method: 提出视觉-惯性-接触（VICON）手-物跟踪框架。硬件上采用视觉-惯性手套与RGB-D相机实现精确手部跟踪，并重新设计手套引入接触传感：依据人类抓取频率布置力敏电阻（FSR），同步记录接触状态与标定后的法向力。物体侧无需预先CAD模型，通过RGB-D图像与单目视频重建网格估计物体位姿；并提出基于因子图的物体轨迹估计，融合按手-物遮挡下可见度加权的物体位姿估计、FSR测量值与手部运动先验。
AI.result: 在涵盖5个物体的40次动作捕捉会话中，VICON失败帧率为2.5%，而基线方法为50.9%-64.6%；遮挡条件下中位误差为3.9 mm和3.0度。基于VICON构建了包含同步手-物运动、接触点与法向力的数据集，并将在指定网址公开释放覆盖10个物体类别的扩展数据集。
AI.conclusion: VICON可在严重遮挡下整体捕获手与物体运动及接触信息，显著优于现有基线，为灵巧操作学习提供了高质量的接触-力监督数据，并承诺公开扩展数据集以促进后续研究。

title: Vela: Scaling Vision-Language-Action Models with Adaptive Action Curve Parametrization
summary: Most vision-language-action models represent future motion as fixed-rate action chunks, tying temporal resolution and prediction horizon to a fixed output budget. This pointwise representation wastes capacity on highly correlated neighboring actions, leaves temporal continuity and smoothness to be learned implicitly, and forces a tradeoff between long-horizon coverage and the local precision required for contact-rich manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce Vela, a vision-language-action foundation model that represents future robot behavior as continuous trajectories. Vela combines a compact spline-based action representation with motion-dependent temporal support and a shared action interface for heterogeneous embodiments, allowing a fixed output budget to adapt its temporal resolution across motions. We pretrain Vela on large-scale multi-embodiment robot data and evaluate it on LIBERO-X, EBench, and two real-world long-horizon tasks, egg-cake cooking and potato shredding, obtaining promising results across simulation and physical manipulation. These results highlight the potential of continuous action representations as a foundation for future embodied foundation models. Project page and more results: https://clementine24.github.io/Vela/ .

AI.tldr: Vela 提出用连续轨迹（样条基）表示机器人未来行为，替代固定的等间隔动作块，实现固定输出预算下自适应时间分辨率，并在仿真与真实长时程操作任务中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型将未来运动表示为固定速率的动作块，导致时间分辨率与预测时域被固定输出预算绑定；逐点表示在高度相关的相邻动作上浪费容量，时间连续性与平滑性需隐式学习，且长时程覆盖与接触密集操作所需的局部精度之间存在权衡。
AI.method: 提出 Vela 视觉-语言-动作基础模型：以连续轨迹表示未来机器人行为，结合紧凑的样条动作表示、运动依赖的时间支撑（运动自适应时间支持区间）以及面向异构本体的共享动作接口，使固定输出预算能够在不同运动间自适应调整时间分辨率；在大规模多本体机器人数据上预训练。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO-X、EBench 以及两个真实世界长时程任务（蛋饼烹饪、土豆切丝）上进行评测，在仿真与物理操作中均取得有前景的结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明连续动作表示有潜力成为未来具身基础模型的基础范式。

title: Safe Ergodic Control for Multi-Robot Systems via Quadratic Programming
summary: Ergodic control drives robots to spend time in each region in proportion to a spatial distribution of interest, making it well suited for dense spatiotemporal environmental monitoring. Existing safe ergodic controllers rely on offline trajectory optimization or hierarchical architectures, which limit real-time applicability and decouple the ergodicity objective from the safety constraint. This paper presents a quadratic programming (QP)-based controller that treats ergodicity and safety jointly. We first introduce a Gaussian-kernel ergodic metric that, unlike the classical indicator-based metric, is time differentiable. This allows the exponential decay of the metric to be imposed as a time-varying control barrier function (CBF) constraint, relaxed by a slack variable, alongside hard CBF constraints for region containment and inter-robot collision avoidance. We establish that the resulting QP remains feasible from any safe initial configuration and that, up to the slack term, the ergodic metric decays exponentially. Simulations show improved performance over baseline methods, and experiments with three aerial vehicles validate the work on real hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于二次规划（QP）的控制器，将遍历性与安全性联合处理，通过高斯核遍历度量与时间变化控制障碍函数（CBF）约束实现实时安全遍历控制，并在仿真与三架飞行器实验中验证。
AI.motivation: 现有安全遍历控制器依赖离线轨迹优化或分层架构，限制了实时性，并将遍历目标与安全约束解耦。本文旨在实现遍历性与安全性的联合、实时处理。
AI.method: 提出基于QP的控制器，同时处理遍历性与安全性。首先引入高斯核遍历度量，相较经典基于指示函数的度量具有时间可微性；进而将该度量的指数衰减作为时间变化的CBF约束（由松弛变量放松），与区域包含和机器人间避碰的硬CBF约束共同构成QP。
AI.result: 证明该QP在任意安全初始构型下保持可行；除松弛项外，遍历度量呈指数衰减。仿真显示性能优于基线方法，三架飞行器实验在真实硬件上验证了该方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提QP控制器实现了遍历与安全的联合实时控制，具有可行性保证与可证明的遍历收敛性，并通过仿真和实机实验得到验证。

title: CoDance: Learning Reactive and Compliant Human-Humanoid Interaction from Video
summary: Partnered human-humanoid interaction couples locomotion with continuous physical contact. A humanoid needs to coordinate with a person's motion while responding to interaction forces and maintaining stable and natural movement. We present CoDance, a framework for learning reactive and compliant human-humanoid interaction from video. We study partnered dancing as a challenging instantiation, where a humanoid coordinates its footsteps with a moving partner and maintains continuous two-hand contact. Given a single video of two human dancers, CoDance retargets their motions into a robot reference and a moving partner. We introduce a multi-link compliance augmentation that transforms the kinematic demonstration into force-aware training data by adapting the robot reference under structured forces at both hands. Policies trained on this data follow the observed partner while preserving the demonstrated locomotion style and responding compliantly to physical interaction. In simulation, the policies adapt their footsteps to changes in the partner and reproduce approximately 80% of the wrist displacement encoded by the augmented demonstrations. On a physical humanoid, CoDance enables sustained two-hand dancing with a human partner including repeated transitions between forward and backward motions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoDance框架，通过单段双人舞视频学习人形机器人与人类伙伴的反应式、柔顺交互（持续双手接触下的脚步协调）。
AI.motivation: 人-人形机器人协作交互需要将行走与持续物理接触耦合：机器人既要与人的运动协调，又要响应交互力并保持稳定自然的动作，这一联合运动与柔顺性问题具有挑战性。
AI.method: 以双人舞为挑战性实例。给定一段两名人类舞者的单目视频，CoDance将其运动重定向为机器人参考轨迹与一个移动伙伴；引入多连杆柔顺增强（multi-link compliance augmentation），在双手处以结构化外力作用调整机器人参考动作，从而把纯运动学演示转化为具备力觉感知的训练数据，再据此训练策略。
AI.result: 仿真中，策略能跟随伙伴脚步变化并将动作风格保持为演示风格，同时柔顺响应物理交互；复现了增强演示所编码腕部位移的约80%。在实体人形机器人上实现与人类伙伴持续双手共舞，包括前后向运动的反复切换。
AI.conclusion: 表明从单段视频经由柔顺增强可学习到反应式、柔顺的人-人形协作交互策略，并能迁移至真实人形机器人完成持续接触的动态任务。

title: VAMPS: Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning
summary: Learning robot policies directly on physical systems remains difficult because data collection is costly and policy exploration can be unsafe. We introduce Visual and Motor Policies from Sampling-Based Planning (VAMPS), a framework that uses Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control to train reusable policies without human demonstrations. VAMPS supports two training modes. For one-step proprioceptive policies, it operates iteratively in simulation: the policy warm-starts MPPI, and the refined trajectories provide new supervision as the policy changes. A learned terminal value improves short-horizon planning, while an Implicit Q-Learning (IQL) critic guides the policy update. Iterative refinement outperforms training once on frozen MPPI data, and we transfer the learned locomotion policy to a Unitree Go2. For visuomotor policies, VAMPS operates directly from real-robot data. MPPI uses task-specific state estimates to plan and execute trajectories while recording RGB and sensor observations on a Flexiv Rizon 10S. Action Chunking with Transformers predicts action chunks, reducing the effective prediction horizon, and is trained offline on this fixed dataset. We demonstrate visuomotor pick-and-place and force-aware whiteboard erasing. In the latter task, the policy additionally observes the measured $6$-D wrench and desired normal force. These results show that VAMPS can learn policies either in simulation followed by hardware transfer or directly from autonomously collected real-robot data.

AI.tldr: VAMPS 提出用 MPPI 控制生成数据来训练可复用策略，无需人类示教，支持仿真迭代训练与真机离线训练两种模式，并实现运动与视觉运动任务的策略学习。
AI.motivation: 直接在物理系统上学习机器人策略存在数据采集成本高、策略探索不安全的问题，且通常依赖人类示范。作者希望避免人工示教，利用采样规划控制自动产生监督信号，从而获得可复用策略。
AI.method: VAMPS 以 MPPI 控制为核心生成与精炼轨迹。其一，单步本体感知策略在仿真中迭代训练：策略为 MPPI 提供热启动，精炼后的轨迹作为新监督，学习终止价值函数改善短视界规划，并用 IQL critic 指导策略更新。其二，视觉运动策略直接在真机数据上训练：MPPI 借助任务相关状态估计规划并执行轨迹，同时记录 Flexiv Rizon 10S 上的 RGB 与传感器观测，再用 Action Chunking with Transformers 离线预测动作块以缩短有效预测视界。
AI.result: 迭代精炼优于在冻结 MPPI 数据上一次性训练；学到的运动策略成功迁移到 Unitree Go2。视觉运动方面实现了抓放与力感知白板擦除，后者策略额外观测测得的 6 维力旋量与期望法向力。
AI.conclusion: VAMPS 表明既可在仿真中学习策略再迁移至硬件，也可直接从自主采集的真机数据学习策略，为低成本、无示教的机器人策略学习提供了可行路径。

title: Optimal Control with Learned Critics under Unmodeled State Dependencies
comment: Keywords: Model Predictive Control, Model-Based Reinforcement Learning, iLQR, Value Function Approximation. Presented at 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), Austin TX, USA
summary: Model Predictive Control (MPC) provides a structured and constraint-aware mechanism for decision-making, but its reliance on optimization-friendly analytical dynamics models limits its use in tasks with contacts and other hard-to-model state dependencies. Model-free reinforcement learning avoids explicit modeling assumptions but typically requires large amounts of interaction data. We present a learning-based MPC framework that combines the data efficiency and structure of local model-based planning with learned components that compensate for incomplete dynamics and finite-horizon myopia. The method augments a nominal analytical model with a residual dynamics network that learns missing state-dependent effects from data and combines the resulting planner with a learned action-value critic that injects long-horizon MDP structure into the local iLQR optimization. To make this practical at reinforcement-learning scale, we develop a GPU-accelerated batched iLQR solver that evaluates learned dynamics and critic networks inside the optimal-control loop and solves thousands of trajectory-optimization problems in parallel. The complete system is integrated into a robotics simulator, enabling scalable model-based reinforcement learning under incomplete dynamics. Experiments on biased and incompletely modeled control tasks show that the approach improves closed-loop control performance while preserving the model-based structure needed for efficient constrained trajectory optimization.

AI.tldr: 提出一种学习型MPC框架，将解析模型与残差动力学网络结合，并用学习到的动作价值critic补偿有限时域短视，配合GPU加速批量iLQR求解器实现可扩展的基于模型强化学习。
AI.motivation: MPC依赖优化友好的解析动力学模型，难以处理接触等难以建模的状态依赖；而无模型强化学习虽避免建模假设，却需要大量交互数据。因此需要兼顾数据效率、结构化决策与建模误差补偿的方法。
AI.method: 在标称解析模型上增加残差动力学网络，从数据中学习缺失的状态依赖效应；将所得规划器与学习到的动作价值critic结合，把长时域MDP结构注入局部iLQR优化；开发GPU加速的批量iLQR求解器，在最优控制回路内评估学习到的动力学与critic网络，并并行求解数千个轨迹优化问题；整体集成到机器人仿真器中。
AI.result: 在存在偏差和建模不完整的控制任务上，该方法提升了闭环控制性能，同时保留了基于模型结构所带来的高效约束轨迹优化能力，并支持可扩展的基于模型强化学习。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过残差动力学学习与价值critic补偿，弥合了解析MPC与无模型RL的差距，在保持模型结构优势的同时提升了欠建模条件下的控制性能，并借助GPU批量iLQR实现强化学习规模的可扩展性。

title: TUCO: Curating Simulation Demonstrations for Sim-to-Real Robot Policy Co-Training
summary: Simulation demonstrations can supplement scarce real-world data for robot policy co-training. However, the value of using data curation to actively select these demonstrations for sim-to-real co-training remains underexplored. Existing curation methods also lack a unified criterion for measuring trajectory-level utility and set-level coverage from closed-loop target behavior. To address these gaps, we present the first systematic study of data curation for sim-to-real robot policy co-training and propose Trajectory-level Utility and set-level Coverage Optimization (TUCO). TUCO uses influence functions to trace how each source demonstration affects target-domain scoring rollouts. Our key insight is that these effects can be decomposed into an overall contribution to target return and variation across rollouts, providing a common closed-loop basis for measuring trajectory utility and set coverage. We further propose a performance-aligned subset optimizer that combines these measures in a unified curation objective to reduce redundancy and select complementary demonstrations. Extensive experiments on RoboMimic and OmniReset establish the value of active simulation data curation for sim-to-real policy co-training and show that TUCO achieves state-of-the-art performance across single-simulator, sim-to-sim, and sim-to-real settings.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究面向sim-to-real机器人策略协同训练的数据策展，提出TUCO方法，基于影响函数将源演示对目标域闭环行为的影响分解为回报贡献与跨轨迹变异，统一度量轨迹级效用与集合级覆盖，并通过性能对齐子集优化器选择互补演示。
AI.motivation: 仿真演示可弥补真实数据稀缺，但如何主动策展这些演示用于sim-to-real协同训练尚缺乏系统研究；现有策展方法也缺少从闭环目标行为出发、统一衡量轨迹级效用与集合级覆盖的准则。
AI.method: 提出TUCO（轨迹级效用与集合级覆盖优化）。利用影响函数追踪每条源演示对目标域评分rollout的影响；将影响分解为对目标回报的总体贡献与跨rollout的变异，作为闭环统一基础来度量轨迹效用与集合覆盖；进一步设计性能对齐的子集优化器，将两类度量纳入统一策展目标以减少冗余并挑选互补演示。
AI.result: 在RoboMimic与OmniReset上的大量实验验证了主动仿真数据策展对sim-to-real策略协同训练的价值，并显示TUCO在单仿真器、sim-to-sim以及sim-to-real设置下均达到state-of-the-art性能。
AI.conclusion: 主动的数据策展可显著提升仿真数据在sim-to-real协同训练中的价值；以闭环目标行为为基础的轨迹效用与集合覆盖统一度量，是选择互补演示的有效准则，TUCO在多类设置下均取得领先表现。

title: RMMBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Robotic Mobile Manipulation
comment: Accepted to the Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026), November 9-12, 2026, Austin, TX, USA
summary: Although the advancement of vision-language models (VLMs) has endowed robots with enhanced environmental understanding and task reasoning, a comprehensive evaluation methodology is important to advance the integration of VLMs in robotic navigation and manipulation. However, current benchmarks lack a comprehensive method to evaluate diverse robotic tasks, and evaluation metrics remain relatively constrained, making it difficult to assess the embodied capabilities of VLMs in a thorough and fine-grained manner. To address this issue, we propose RMMBench, an evaluation benchmark that requires robots to understand language instructions and perform long-horizon tasks in continuous spaces. RMMBench seamlessly integrates high- and low-level embodied tasks into a unified framework, constructing a "navigation-manipulation" task suite comprising 70 canonical task scenarios that range from localized manipulation to long-horizon composite navigation. The results reveal that leading VLMs still face major challenges in spatial localization when performing mobile manipulation tasks, and also highlight the necessity of enhancing the spatial perception capability of robots during long-horizon interactions. RMMBench can be accessed at https://mxxq-stack.github.io/rmmbench-project/

AI.tldr: 提出RMMBench评测基准，将高低层具身任务统一到"导航-操作"任务套件（70个典型场景），用于细粒度评估VLM在机器人导航与操作中的具身能力。
AI.motivation: VLM虽提升了机器人的环境理解与任务推理，但现有基准缺乏对多样化机器人任务的综合评测方法，评测指标较为受限，难以全面、细粒度地衡量VLM的具身能力。
AI.method: RMMBench要求机器人理解语言指令并在连续空间中执行长时程任务；将高层与低层具身任务无缝整合进统一框架，构建包含70个典型任务场景的"导航-操作"任务套件，覆盖从局部操作到长时程复合导航。
AI.result: 评测结果显示，主流VLM在移动操作任务中仍面临显著的空间定位挑战；同时凸显了在长时程交互中增强机器人空间感知能力的必要性。
AI.conclusion: RMMBench为VLM在机器人导航与操作中的综合、细粒度评测提供了统一框架，并揭示了空间定位与空间感知是当前VLM具身应用的关键瓶颈。

title: EvoMem-VLA: State-Evolution Memory for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
summary: Most vision-language-action (VLA) models rely on current observations and lose task-relevant evidence once it leaves view, limiting performance on long-horizon, memory-dependent tasks. Existing efforts incorporate compressed historical features or sparse visual keyframes. However, isolated snapshots can leave the policy uncertain about what changed during past interactions and which action should follow. To overcome this limitation, we propose EvoMem-VLA, which constructs state-evolution memory by explicitly encoding and retaining observed changes between historical states. These change representations preserve evidence of interaction outcomes, allowing the policy to track task progress beyond isolated snapshots. Specifically, we introduce conditional delta tokenization to encode ordered frame pairs into directional, source-conditioned delta tokens, each associated with its corresponding state evidence. A shared VLM backbone supports task-adaptive routing: normal long-horizon tasks follow a direct action route, whereas multi-stage tasks use a subtask route that generates an executable subtask as an additional input for action generation. With a single jointly trained policy for each simulation benchmark, EvoMem-VLA achieves success rates of 80.7\% on RMBench, 82.0\% on RoboMME and 83.8\% across four real-world tasks spanning two robot embodiments. These results represent substantial improvements over the previous state of the art in all three evaluation settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 EvoMem-VLA，通过显式编码历史状态间的变化构建状态演化记忆，结合条件增量分词与任务自适应路由，在长时程记忆依赖任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型依赖当前观测，任务相关证据一旦离开视野即丢失，难以胜任长时程、依赖记忆的任务。已有方法采用压缩历史特征或稀疏视觉关键帧，但孤立快照无法让策略明确过去交互中"发生了什么变化"以及"接下来该执行什么动作"。
AI.method: 提出 EvoMem-VLA，显式编码并保留历史状态间的观测变化，构建"状态演化记忆"。核心是条件增量分词（conditional delta tokenization）：将有序帧对编码为有方向的、源条件化的增量 token，每个 token 关联对应状态证据。共享 VLM 主干支持任务自适应路由：普通长时程任务走直接动作路径；多阶段任务走子任务路径，先生成可执行子任务作为动作生成的额外输入。
AI.result: 每个仿真基准使用单一联合训练策略，在 RMBench 上成功率 80.7%，RoboMME 上 82.0%，四个真实世界任务（涵盖两种机器人本体）平均 83.8%，三项评测均显著超越此前最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 以"状态变化"而非"状态快照"作为记忆单元，可更有效地支撑长时程任务的进度跟踪与决策；配合任务自适应路由，EvoMem-VLA 在仿真与真实场景中均取得领先性能。

title: Social Navigation for Tour-guide Robot
comment: 5 pages, 8 figures. Accepted at the 5th Workshop on Social Robot Navigation, IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS) 2026
summary: We propose a force-based model for social navigation of a tour-guide robot. Social forces due to various factors like obstacles, user position and heading, have been accounted for in the model. We claim that each one of these forces makes the robot more sociable to the user and we design an experimental setup for evaluation. In the experiment, the user follows an autonomous robot to a destination in a known map, while undertaking a few simple sub-tasks in the middle, which serve as distractions. For each participant, we run several rounds of the experiment, each with different forces and a shortest path, A*-search baseline model. Using per-round subjective indicators, we propose to study the effect of our force model on constructs such as: follow-ability, perceived safety, and perceived intelligence.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于导览机器人社交导航的力场模型，通过实验评估不同力（障碍物、用户位置与朝向）对跟随性、安全感和智能感知的影响。
AI.motivation: 提升导览机器人在用户跟随场景中的社交性，使导航行为更符合用户预期与体验。
AI.method: 构建包含障碍物力、用户位置力与用户朝向力的力场模型；设计实验让用户跟随自主机器人在已知地图中抵达目的地，途中完成若干子任务作为干扰；每位参与者进行多轮实验，分别使用不同力组合及A*最短路径基线模型，并采集每轮主观指标。
AI.result: 通过每轮主观指标，研究力场模型对跟随性、感知安全与感知智能等构念的影响（摘要未给出具体数值结果）。
AI.conclusion: 各社交力均有助于提升机器人对用户的社交性；所提出的实验设计可用于系统评估力场模型在社交导航构念上的作用。

title: FLEX-WAM: Flexible Block-Causal World-Action Models for Long-Horizon Imagination and Planning
summary: World--action models (WAMs) promise a unified model that predicts action-conditioned futures, generates feasible actions, and supports planning in imagination. However, existing joint video--action models often use computationally heavy, fixed-horizon backbones ill-suited to streaming inference and stable long-horizon open-loop rollouts. We introduce FLEX-WAM, a Flexible and Efficient Block-Causal World--Action Model for unified simulation and policy inference. FLEX-WAM supports variable-length contexts and non-causal prediction horizons, as well as infinite autoregressive generation frame by frame or block by block. Its block-causal, KV-cacheable architecture combines axial attention and blockwise diffusion forcing to enable efficient real-time rollout and deployment-time latency--throughput tradeoffs without retraining. Joint training can nevertheless produce plausible futures that weakly respond to commanded actions. We address this failure mode by balancing state and action flow-matching gradient contributions across the state--action diffusion-noise grid and regulating world-model sampling using Forward-Dynamics (FD) elasticity, an efficient training-time proxy for action responsiveness. Across simulated and real-world datasets, FLEX-WAM achieves superior multi-step prediction quality and latency while producing stable joint state--action rollouts for thousands of steps. As a joint action proposer and simulator within MCTS, it solves long-horizon PushT and all five OGBench Puzzle-4x4 tasks entirely in imagination. On a bimanual OpenArm-based robot, a single checkpoint jointly serves as a play policy and expected-outcome predictor, enabling real-time identification and collection of model--reality mismatches for future self-improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出 FLEX-WAM，一种块因果、可 KV 缓存的世界-动作模型，支持变长上下文、非因果预测视野与无限自回归生成，并用流匹配梯度平衡与 FD 弹性解决动作响应弱的问题，实现高效实时长程联合预测与规划。
AI.motivation: 现有联合视频-动作模型多采用计算量大的固定视野骨干网络，不适合流式推理和稳定的长程开环 rollout；同时联合训练容易产生对指令动作响应薄弱的"合理"未来预测。
AI.method: FLEX-WAM 采用块因果、可 KV 缓存的架构，结合轴向注意力与分块扩散强制（blockwise diffusion forcing），支持变长上下文、非因果预测视野及逐帧/逐块无限自回归生成，并可在不重训练情况下实现延迟-吞吐权衡。针对动作响应弱，作者在状态-动作扩散噪声网格上平衡状态与动作流匹配的梯度贡献，并用前向动力学（FD）弹性作为训练时的高效动作响应代理来调控世界模型采样。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实数据集上，FLEX-WAM 取得更优的多步预测质量与延迟表现，能产生数千步稳定的联合状态-动作 rollout；作为 MCTS 中的联合动作提议器与模拟器，完全在想象中求解长程 PushT 及全部五个 OGBench Puzzle-4x4 任务；在双臂 OpenArm 机器人上，单个 checkpoint 同时充当 play 策略与预期结果预测器，可实时识别并收集模型-现实不匹配以支持未来自我改进。
AI.conclusion: FLEX-WAM 通过块因果高效架构与动作响应调节机制，统一了想象规划与策略推理，展示了在长程规划、实时部署及真实机器人自改进闭环中的可行性与优势。

title: Robust Surgical Robotic Instrument Tracking via Sequential Multi-Cue Fusion and Sim-to-Real Self-Training
summary: Efficient and robust tracking of surgical robotic instruments is important for robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery, yet remains challenging due to the complexity of surgical scenes and the unconventional geometry of surgical instruments. Keypoint-based approaches are efficient, but their performance depends on reliable feature detection. Improving these detectors with real-world supervision is difficult because accurate real-world annotations are costly to obtain at scale. To address this limitation, we introduce a tracker-guided self-training framework that adapts a model pretrained on synthetic images to unlabeled real-world videos. Given measured robot joint states, an uncertainty-aware EKF recursively corrects the instrument pose and the observable joint angles by comparing projected model features with detected keypoints, shaft boundaries, and mask-derived cues. An RTS smoother subsequently refines the resulting trajectory, which is projected into pseudo-labels for fine-tuning the feature detector without laborious pose annotations. Experiments on real-world videos demonstrate consistent improvements from self-training across all evaluated keypoint metrics, and the resulting model outperforms prior approaches in both accuracy and runtime. The code and data will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出跟踪器引导的自训练框架，利用EKF与RTS平滑器生成伪标签，将合成数据预训练的关键点检测器适配到无标注真实手术视频，提升精度并降低运行时间。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人器械跟踪对机器人辅助微创手术至关重要，但手术场景复杂、器械几何形状特殊，任务困难。基于关键点的方法效率高，却依赖可靠的特征检测；而用真实世界监督改进检测器代价高昂，难以规模化获取精确标注。
AI.method: 跟踪器引导的自训练框架：以合成图像预训练的模型为起点，适配无标注真实视频。基于机器人关节状态测量，使用不确定性感知EKF递归校正器械位姿与可观测关节角，通过比较投影模型特征与检测到的关键点、轴边界及掩码线索实现；随后用RTS平滑器优化轨迹，并将其投影为伪标签，用于微调特征检测器，无需费力的位姿标注。
AI.result: 在真实世界视频上的实验表明，自训练在所有评估的关键点指标上均带来一致提升，所得模型在精度和运行时间上均优于已有方法。代码和数据将在论文发表后公开。
AI.conclusion: 该工作证明可利用跟踪器（EKF+RTS平滑）生成伪标签替代昂贵真实位姿标注，高效地将合成预训练检测器适配到真实手术场景，实现更准确且更快速的手术器械关键点跟踪。

title: Robust 2D Traversability Mapping for Construction AMRs via Failure-Mode-Aware Fusion of LiDAR Geometry and Monocular Semantics
comment: Extended version of a paper presented at the 5th Workshop on Future of Construction, IROS 2026
summary: Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs) on active construction sites face severe navigational challenges: geometry-based traversability mapping (e.g., LiDAR) misses visually hazardous but geometrically flat surfaces like wet mud and ponding concrete, while abrupt geometry on drivable speed-breakers and inclines produces phantom obstacles. We propose a real-time, failure-mode-aware multimodal traversability pipeline on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin, where LiDAR is the primary geometric safety estimate and monocular semantics act as a selective, class- and confidence-gated corrective signal. The representation retains distinct traversable classes, namely flat road, terrain, and rocky terrain, while flagging construction hazards. We also release a multimodal construction-site dataset from a custom AMR: four closed-loop ROS 2 sequences from two active sites (RGB, depth, LiDAR, IMU, GPS-RTK, odometry) plus 506 annotated frames across 28 semantic classes. By projecting LiDAR onto dense semantic masks, resolving sparsity via morphological in-painting, and applying failure-mode-aware fusion with Patchwork++, the system corrects complementary geometric failure modes for a local AMR costmap.

AI.tldr: 提出一种失败模式感知的多模态可通行性感知流程：LiDAR 为几何安全主估计，单目语义作为类别与置信度门控的校正信号，在 Jetson AGX Orin 上实时运行，并发布一个建筑工地多模态数据集。
AI.motivation: 建筑工地上 AMR 面临两类互补的感知失效：基于几何的可通行性建图（如 LiDAR）会漏检视觉上危险但几何平坦的表面（湿泥、积水混凝土），又把可行驶的减速带和坡道等突变几何误判为幻影障碍。单一模态无法同时解决这两类问题。
AI.method: 在 NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin 上构建实时多模态可通行性流程。以 LiDAR 作为几何安全主估计，单目语义作为选择性、受类别与置信度门控的校正信号；表示中保留平坦道路、地形、碎石地形等可通行类别并标记施工危险。将 LiDAR 投影到稠密语义掩码上，用形态学修补解决稀疏性，结合 Patchwork++ 进行失败模式感知融合，生成局部 AMR 代价地图。同时发布自研 AMR 采集的多模态工地数据集：两个活跃工地的四条 ROS 2 闭环序列（RGB、深度、LiDAR、IMU、GPS-RTK、里程计）及 28 类语义、506 帧标注。
AI.result: 系统能对互补的几何失效模式进行校正，输出用于局部 AMR 代价地图的可通行性表示；同时提供了含多传感器闭环序列与标注帧的多模态建筑工地数据集，支撑该任务的研究与评测。
AI.conclusion: 失败模式感知的多模态融合可弥补 LiDAR 几何与视觉语义各自的盲区，在边缘平台上实现实时可通行性建图，并伴随数据集发布以推动工地自主导航研究。

title: Neural Barriers: An Online Certifiable Learning-enhanced Adaptive High Order Safety Critical Control
summary: Control barrier functions are an effective model-based tool to formally certify the safety of a system. However, transferring their theoretical guarantees to real-world robotics systems requires high model fidelity. For example, payloads or wind disturbances can cause significant model perturbations to an aerial vehicle, leading to safety compromises. In this work, we propose a certifiable online learning-enhanced robust adaptive control barrier function, which adapts to disturbances using a Neural ODE and quantifies its adaptation uncertainty with conformal prediction. Our approach guarantees safety at all time under unknown time-varying model disturbances. It adopts a conservative strategy when the adaptation uncertainty is high; and efficiently adapts to reduce controller conservativeness as it receives more data. Our approach provides a provable safety guarantee with a probability bound under suitable Lipschitz smoothness assumptions on the underlying model and trajectory. These results demonstrate the potential of our method as a practical safety controller for robotics system operating under model perturbations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可认证的在线学习增强鲁棒自适应控制障碍函数，利用Neural ODE适应扰动并通过共形预测量化自适应不确定性，在未知时变模型扰动下提供带概率界的安全性保证。
AI.motivation: 控制障碍函数虽能形式化认证系统安全性，但迁移到真实机器人系统需要高模型保真度。实际中负载变化或风扰等会造成显著的模型摄动，导致安全保证失效。因此需要一种能在模型摄动下仍保持安全性的控制器。
AI.method: 提出可认证的在线学习增强鲁棒自适应控制障碍函数。使用Neural ODE进行扰动自适应，并用共形预测量化其自适应不确定性。当自适应不确定性高时采取保守策略；随着数据积累，控制器更高效地适应以降低保守性。在底层模型与轨迹满足Lipschitz光滑性假设下，提供概率有界的安全性证明。
AI.result: 在未知时变模型扰动下实现全时段安全性保证，并给出带概率边界的安全可证性；控制器保守性随数据增加而降低。论文称结果展示了该方法作为在模型摄动下运行的机器人系统实用安全控制器的潜力。
AI.conclusion: 该方法将在线学习、自适应与鲁棒控制障碍函数结合，可在模型扰动下提供可证明的概率安全保证，具备作为实际机器人安全控制器的应用潜力。

title: GR-LIO: A Local Ground-Aware LiDAR-Inertial Odometry System Using Body-to-Ground Height
summary: LiDAR-inertial odometry (LIO) is widely used for state estimation in ground-based autonomous mobile robots. However, the geometric constraints provided by the local ground surface remain largely underexploited in existing LIO systems. This paper proposes a filter-based local ground-aware LIO framework that explicitly incorporates local ground plane geometry into the state estimation process to improve both localization accuracy and computational efficiency. Specifically, a local ground plane is parameterized by the robot orientation and the body-to-ground (B-G) height and continuously propagated within the state estimation process. Based on the proposed B-G geometry model, a propagated local ground plane enables efficient and reliable ground segmentation. The segmented ground points are then incorporated into the filter update through point-to-plane geometric constraints, improving both state estimation accuracy and efficiency. Furthermore, a planar motion update is introduced to exploit the propagated local ground plane as an additional geometric constraint, effectively suppressing vertical drift and improving estimation robustness. To address the initially unknown B-G height, an efficient initialization strategy is developed, followed by an online calibration procedure for continuous refinement. The proposed system is evaluated on several public benchmark datasets and self-collected real-world datasets covering diverse operating scenarios. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms representative LIO methods in terms of both localization accuracy and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于滤波器的局部地面感知LIO框架，将局部地面平面几何显式引入状态估计，提升定位精度与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有LIO系统在陆地自主移动机器人中广泛使用，但局部地面提供的几何约束未被充分利用。
AI.method: 将局部地面平面用机器人姿态与机体-地面(B-G)高度参数化，并在状态估计中持续传播；基于B-G几何模型实现高效可靠的地面分割，将地面点以点到面约束加入滤波更新；引入平面运动更新作为额外几何约束抑制垂直漂移；针对初始未知B-G高度，设计初始化策略与在线标定持续优化。
AI.result: 在多个公开基准数据集与自采集真实场景数据集上评估，所提方法在定位精度与计算效率上均持续优于代表性LIO方法。
AI.conclusion: 显式利用局部地面平面几何可有效提升LIO的定位精度与计算效率，并增强估计鲁棒性。

title: TacGELLO: Tactile Contact Feedback for a 3D-Printed Teleoperation Leader
summary:
Passive leader arms transmit an operator's motion without returning remote contact or load cues. TacGELLO uses the existing servos of a 3D-printed leader for tactile contact feedback at the gripper trigger and current-based load cues at the arm joints. AnySkin contact detection activates a trigger position hold, while changes in follower joint current adjust leader-servo output limits to command resistance during lifting.
  Across six UR3 sessions with one operator, sent-command tracking error was 0.15--0.36$^\circ$ RMSE, with estimated trajectory lag of 82--98\,ms. Tactile onset was logged in 60 of 62 segmented TacGELLO grasp intervals. Median commanded closure after tactile or width-based contact references was 0.7--2.1\,mm with TacGELLO and 13.0--13.9\,mm with the original interface.

AI.tldr: TacGELLO 利用 3D 打印主导臂既有伺服，在夹爪触发处提供触觉接触反馈、在关节处提供基于电流的负载提示，实现被动主臂的力/触觉反馈；在 UR3 六次实验中命令跟踪误差 0.15--0.36° RMSE、轨迹滞后 82--98 ms，62 个抓取区间中 60 个记录到触觉触发，接触后闭合量中位数 0.7--2.1 mm（对比原界面 13.0--13.9 mm）。
AI.motivation: 被动式主臂只能传递操作者运动，无法回传远程接触与负载线索，导致操作者缺乏力觉/触觉信息，难以精确控制抓取与承载。
AI.method: 复用 3D 打印主导臂现有伺服：夹爪扳机处提供触觉接触反馈，臂关节处提供基于电流的负载提示；AnySkin 检测到接触时激活扳机位置保持，从动臂关节电流变化则调节主导臂伺服输出限幅，从而在抬起时产生阻力感。
AI.result: 一位操作者、六次 UR3 实验中，发送命令跟踪误差为 0.15--0.36° RMSE，估计轨迹滞后 82--98 ms；触觉触发在 62 个分割的 TacGELLO 抓取区间中记录到 60 个；基于触觉或宽度接触参考时，命令闭合量中位数为 0.7--2.1 mm（TacGELLO），原界面为 13.0--13.9 mm。
AI.conclusion: 在无需额外硬件的条件下，TacGELLO 可为被动主臂补充触觉与负载反馈，显著提升抓取闭合控制精度，并能可靠触发接触事件，验证了基于既有伺服的反馈方案可行性。

title: Building A Multi-Sensor Platform For Autonomous Driving Research: Challenges and Lessons Learned
summary: This paper reports on the challenges encountered and lessons learned during the development and deployment of a flexible multi-sensor platform for autonomous driving research. It aims to serve as a reference for researchers developing new multi-sensor systems. As the need for reliable, diverse datasets increases, novel environments and sensing configurations are essential to tackle real-world operational challenges. Consequently, many research groups create custom multi-sensory data collection platforms, where fundamental issues, such as mechanical design, sensor calibration, power management, and time synchronization, arise regardless of sensor types. We reflect on these challenges and share key insights to guide future platform designs, enhancing reproducibility and robustness in autonomous vehicle testing. We also summarize the mitigation strategies we adopted, for instance, system-wide time synchronization using GNSS timing and NTP protocols, custom calibration routines for different sensor configurations, and design practices to improve reliability and data integrity during field deployments.

AI.tldr: 本文总结了在开发与部署用于自动驾驶研究的柔性多传感器平台过程中遇到的挑战与经验教训，旨在为开发新型多传感器系统的研究者提供参考。
AI.motivation: 随着对可靠、多样化数据集需求的增长，为应对真实运行挑战，需要在新型环境和感知配置下采集数据，许多研究团队因此自建多传感器数据采集平台，但无论传感器类型如何，都会面临机械设计、传感器标定、电源管理和时间同步等基础性问题，亟需经验性参考。
AI.method: 作者基于该柔性多传感器平台的开发与现场部署实践，反思所遇到的共性挑战并提炼关键洞见；同时采取系列缓解策略，包括基于GNSS授时与NTP协议的系统级时间同步、面向不同传感器配置的定制化标定流程，以及提升可靠性与数据完整性的设计实践。
AI.result: 归纳了机械设计、传感器标定、电源管理与时间同步等方面的主要挑战，并给出了相应的缓解策略与关键经验；这些经验有助于提升自动驾驶测试的可复现性与鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 面向未来平台设计，研究者应重视这些基础性工程问题及所总结的设计实践，以增强多传感器系统在自动驾驶测试中的可复现性、鲁棒性与数据完整性。

title: Emergency Obstacle Avoidance Maneuvers in Differential-Drive Mobile Robots
summary: Emergency obstacle avoidance requires a mobile robot to brake or change its heading within the available distance. This paper investigates the dependence of maneuver performance and odometric error on approach speed for a differential-drive robot. A footprint-clearance analysis and a normalized wheel-motion index provide a kinematic description of five braking and turning maneuvers. The principal experiment comprises 540 block-randomized trials on tile, of which 539 are retained, at commanded approach speeds of 45, 55, and 65 cm/s. An overhead camera provides an independent pose reference. When encoder, gyro, and camera heading changes are evaluated over complete motion records, the mean encoder discrepancy increases by 4.7-5.1 degrees for the two reverse-spin maneuvers between the lowest and highest speeds; the arc and brake-assisted pivot change by less than 0.4 degrees. Larger encoder discrepancy is associated with lower avoidance success after adjustment for distance, speed, maneuver, day, and turn direction. Gyro discrepancies remain approximately 3 degrees for the reverse spins. Estimated reaction distances for 90% success and their uncertainty quantify the maneuver trade-offs. The results support speed-specific empirical characterization of emergency maneuvers and distinguish encoder error from recovery motion and measurement-window mismatch.

AI.tldr: 本文通过540次分块随机试验，研究差速驱动机器人在不同接近速度下五种紧急制动与转向机动的操纵性能及里程计误差，发现反旋机动编码器偏差随速度显著增大，并与避障成功率下降相关。
AI.motivation: 紧急避障要求移动机器人在可用距离内完成制动或转向，而机动性能与里程计误差可能依赖接近速度，但目前缺乏针对速度的实证刻画，因此需要系统量化不同速度下各机动的表现与误差。
AI.method: 采用足印间隙分析与归一化轮运动指标对五种制动和转向机动进行运动学描述；在瓷砖地面上开展540次分块随机试验（保留539次），指令接近速度为45、55、65 cm/s；使用编码器、陀螺仪及作为独立位姿参考的俯视相机，记录完整运动过程的航向变化并比较误差。
AI.result: 在最低与最高速度之间，两种反旋机动的编码器平均偏差增加4.7–5.1度，而弧线机动和制动辅助枢轴转偏差变化小于0.4度；陀螺仪偏差在反旋机动中约为3度；校正距离、速度、机动类型、日期和转向方向后，较大的编码器偏差与较低的避障成功率相关；并给出了90%成功率对应的估计反应距离及其不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持对紧急机动进行速度相关的经验性刻画，并将编码器误差与恢复运动及测量窗口不匹配区分开来。

title: FOCUS: Fine-Grained Open-Vocabulary Change Detection for Uncertainty-Aware Semi-Static Scenes
summary: Autonomous robots operating over long periods must keep their environmental memory up to date as the world changes between visits. In semi-static environments, an object may be replaced in place by a different but geometrically and semantically similar instance, making the identity change difficult to detect from geometry or coarse semantics alone. We present FOCUS, an uncertainty-aware framework for object-level change detection and map maintenance. We formulate semi-static memory maintenance as probabilistic inference that fuses geometric likelihood with appearance likelihood rendered from a 3D Gaussian map. A recursive three-state estimator maintains whether each mapped object is PERSISTED, REPLACED, or REMOVED. To account for imperfect 3DGS rendering, we model the rendered appearance evidence probabilistically rather than using it as a direct change score, with the model parameters automatically calibrated from a change-free replay of the initial mapping session. We evaluate our method on a new Isaac Sim warehouse benchmark with ambiguous in-place replacements and on the real-world TorWIC dataset. It improves object-level replacement F1 from 0.20 to 0.84 over a probabilistic baseline and transfers to real-world data without manual parameter retuning.

AI.tldr: 提出FOCUS框架，将半静态环境下物体级变化检测与地图维护建模为概率推断，融合几何与外观似然，用递归三状态估计器判断物体是被保留、替换还是移除。
AI.motivation: 长期运行的自主机器人需要保持环境记忆的时效性，但在半静态环境中，物体可能被几何和语义相似的实例就地替换，仅凭几何或粗粒度语义难以检测这种身份变化。
AI.method: 将半静态记忆维护形式化为概率推断，融合几何似然与由3D高斯地图渲染得到的外观似然；采用递归三状态估计器对每个地图物体维持PERSISTED/REPLACED/REMOVED状态；针对3DGS渲染的不完美，将渲染外观证据建模为概率形式而非直接变化分数，模型参数通过初始建图会话的无变化回放自动校准。
AI.result: 在包含模糊就地替换的新Isaac Sim仓库基准和真实世界TorWIC数据集上评估，物体级替换F1从概率基线的0.20提升至0.84，并可无需手动重新调参迁移到真实数据。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS通过不确定性感知的概率融合与自校准，有效解决了半静态环境中相似物体就地替换的检测难题，并具备良好的真实场景迁移能力。

title: Spacecraft Rendezvous Trajectory Generation with Modular Constraints via Diffusion Model Composition
summary: Emerging mission classes such as on-orbit servicing, satellite inspection, and active debris removal require trajectory design methods that are adaptable to a variety of mission scenarios. We present a diffusion-based trajectory generation approach for rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) that enables flexible configuration of mission constraints. First, individual energy-based diffusion models are trained to satisfy distinct constraints such as approach cone and sensor line-of-sight from a set of optimized trajectories. Then, at inference time, the learned energy models can be composed with one another, or with an analytically defined energy field, to enforce specific constraint combinations.
