We validate this framework with the composition of a learned approach cone model and a learned sensor line-of-sight model, as well as a learned approach cone model and synthetic obstacle avoidance model, both of which yield constraint satisfaction rates that are within 1 percentage point of the single-constraint models or higher. These results indicate that our compositional diffusion framework can provide a modular approach to RPO trajectory design and enable reconfiguration for new constraint combinations without requiring model retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于扩散模型的交会与接近操作（RPO）轨迹生成方法，通过分别训练满足单一约束的能量模型并在推理时组合，实现灵活配置多约束的模块化轨迹设计。
AI.motivation: 在轨服务、卫星巡检、主动碎片清除等新兴任务需要能适应多种任务场景的轨迹设计方法，而传统方法往往难以灵活应对不同约束组合。
AI.method: 首先从一组优化轨迹中训练多个基于能量的扩散模型，每个模型满足特定约束（如接近锥、传感器视线）；推理时将这些能量模型相互组合，或与分析式定义的能量场组合，以强制满足特定约束组合。
AI.result: 以学习的接近锥模型与学习的传感器视线模型的组合，以及学习的接近锥模型与合成避障模型的组合进行验证，二者的约束满足率均在单约束模型1个百分点以内或更高。
AI.conclusion: 该组合式扩散框架为RPO轨迹设计提供了模块化方法，无需重新训练模型即可针对新约束组合进行重构。

title: Bayesian Data Augmentation for DNN Retraining with Binomial Outcomes in Vision-Based UAV Landing
summary:
In GPS-denied or cluttered urban environments, vision-based landing is essential for reliable UAV missions. Real-world landing sites are often unstructured and highly variable, requiring strong generalization by the perception system. Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) trained with synthetic data augmentation offer a scalable solution for learning landing-site features across diverse vehicle and environmental states. However, computationally expensive DNN retraining, along with challenging performance validation via test flights, limits exhaustive model fine-tuning and necessitates an optimized retraining pipeline. In this work, we deploy a Bayesian data augmentation framework integrated with a photorealistic simulator featuring high-fidelity vehicle dynamics to iteratively retrain the helipad detector DNN, maximizing landing performance as the objective function.
  We validate our framework with experiments in a photorealistic simulator under different environmental conditions and vehicle states, demonstrating improved landing performance and tighter confidence intervals on predicted landing outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本文面向GPS拒止或复杂城市环境下的无人机视觉着陆，提出以贝叶斯数据增强框架结合高保真动力学仿真器，迭代重训练直升机停机坪检测DNN，以着陆性能为目标函数优化，仿真验证显示着陆性能提升且预测着陆结果的置信区间更紧。
AI.motivation: 真实着陆场地非结构化且高度多变，要求感知系统具备强泛化能力；合成数据增强虽可扩展，但DNN重训练计算昂贵、试飞验证困难，限制了穷举式微调，因此需要优化的重训练流程。
AI.method: 将贝叶斯数据增强框架与具备高保真飞行器动力学的逼真仿真器集成，对着陆平台（helipad）检测DNN进行迭代重训练，并以着陆性能作为目标函数进行最大化优化。
AI.result: 在不同环境条件与飞行器状态下的逼真仿真实验中，着陆性能得到提升，同时预测着陆结果的置信区间更紧。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够以数据驱动方式有效优化视觉着陆检测模型，在无需大量真实试飞的前提下提升着陆表现并增强结果可预测性。

title: Learning Coordinated Visuomotor Box-Pushing from Solo Demonstrations
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026)
summary: Multi-robot imitation learning, particularly in settings where visuomotor policies are deployed in a communication-free, onboard decentralised style, represents an attractive paradigm. However, its realisation remains insufficiently understood, largely due to the difficulty of collecting collective demonstrations, since a single operator cannot control many robots simultaneously. Meanwhile, unlike coupled collaborative manipulation, many coordinated tasks achieve system-wide efficiency primarily through minimising inter-robot interference. This structure motivates us to study whether data collected by a teleoperated single-robot can be leveraged for large-scale coordinated box-pushing as a testbed. We systematically investigate dataset creation strategies and lightweight policy architectures. In particular, experiments with up to 40 robots highlight the difficulty of acquiring effective coordination solely through passive observation of other operating robots, revealing a concrete bottleneck for multi-robot research.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无通信、机载去中心化的多机器人视觉运动模仿学习，以大规模协同推箱为测试平台，系统考察数据集构建策略与轻量策略架构，并验证单机器人遥操作数据能否迁移至多机器人协同。实验在多达40个机器人上进行，发现仅靠被动观察其他机器人难以学到有效协同。
AI.motivation: 多机器人模仿学习（尤其是无通信、机载去中心化的视觉运动策略部署）是有吸引力的范式，但其实现尚不充分。核心障碍在于集体演示数据难以采集：单个操作者无法同时控制多台机器人。同时，与耦合式协同操作不同，许多协同任务主要依靠最小化机器人间干扰来实现系统级效率，这一结构促使作者探究能否复用单机器人遥操作采集的数据来支撑大规模协同推箱。
AI.method: 以大规模协同推箱作为测试平台，系统研究数据集构建策略与轻量级策略架构；将单机器人遥操作采集的数据用于多机器人协同任务；开展最多40台机器人的实验，并对比包含"被动观察其他运行机器人"的数据获取方式。
AI.result: 在最多40台机器人的实验中，仅通过被动观察其他运行机器人来获取有效协同十分困难，暴露出多机器人研究中的一个具体瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 单机器人遥操作数据在大规模协同推箱中的可用性得到初步检验，但被动观察式数据难以支撑有效协同；该结果明确了多机器人协同模仿学习的关键瓶颈，并为数据集构建与轻量策略设计提供了实证参考。

title: Dataset-Free Compliant Humanoid Loco-Manipulation with Dynamic Online Posture
summary: Most humanoid loco-manipulation controllers require human motion data to learn whole-body coordination and posture, leaving policies reliant on external sources to provide this data. We present OCLO (Online-posture Compliant LOco-manipulation), a humanoid loco-manipulation system trained without human motion data and commanded only through two end-effector targets. Because these targets do not uniquely determine whole-body posture, OCLO generates pelvis height and torso orientation online using an analytic reachability prior, further refined through policy-in-the-loop sampling with a task-agnostic cost. OCLO also learns whole-body compliance by displacing end-effector references according to measured forces through a spring-damper model, encouraging the legs, waist, and pelvis to yield to external loads. In simulation, using the reachability prior leads to a 77.8% success rate in acquiring the commanded reference, a vast improvement over the 37.8% success rate accomplished without the prior. Further, refinement reduces end-effector orientation error across all evaluated tasks. The same posture module improves a pretrained SONIC controller on four of five tasks. Without compliance training, policies tend to lose balance under disturbances rather than sacrifice tracking. On a Unitree G1, OCLO maintains balance under end-effector disturbances that cause its ablations to fail and performs seven loco-manipulation tasks, including crouched walking and picking up a box from a low surface. Project website: https://oclo-humanoid.github.io/

AI.tldr: OCLO 是一种无需人体运动数据、仅由双末端执行器目标指令驱动的人形全身移动操作（loco-manipulation）系统，通过解析可达性先验在线生成骨盆高度与躯干姿态，并结合策略在环采样精化与弹簧-阻尼全身柔顺学习，在仿真和 Unitree G1 真机上实现稳定平衡与多任务操作。
AI.motivation: 现有人形移动操作控制器多依赖人体运动数据来学习全身协调与姿态，导致策略依赖外部数据源提供该信息。作者希望摆脱这一依赖，在仅有末端执行器目标（不足以唯一确定全身姿态）的欠约束输入下，仍能生成合理的全身姿态与柔顺行为。
AI.method: 提出 OCLO：仅以两个末端执行器目标为指令，无需人体运动数据。1) 用解析可达性先验在线生成骨盆高度与躯干朝向，解决末端目标无法唯一确定全身姿态的问题；2) 通过策略在环采样（policy-in-the-loop sampling）与任务无关的代价函数对该先验进行精化；3) 通过弹簧-阻尼模型，依据实测力偏移末端参考，学习全身柔顺性，使腿部、腰部与骨盆顺应外力。该姿态模块还可复用于预训练的 SONIC 控制器。
AI.result: 仿真中，使用可达性先验使指令参考获取成功率从 37.8% 提升至 77.8%；采样精化在所有评测任务上降低末端朝向误差。同一姿态模块在 5 个任务中的 4 个上提升了预训练 SONIC 控制器。无柔顺训练时，策略在扰动下更倾向于失去平衡而非牺牲跟踪精度。在 Unitree G1 真机上，OCLO 在会使消融版本失败的末端扰动下保持平衡，并完成 7 项移动操作任务，包括蹲姿行走与从低矮表面拾取箱子。
AI.conclusion: OCLO 证明了在无人运动数据、仅有末端执行器目标的情况下，通过解析可达性先验、策略在环精化与弹簧-阻尼柔顺学习，即可实现稳定、柔顺且多任务的人形移动操作，并能有效迁移到真实机器人及增强已有控制器。

title: Benchmarking Generative Trajectory Models for Active-Inference Control
comment: Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Active Inference (IWAI 2026). 16 pages, including appendix and references; 4 figures. Code: https://github.com/lyeeonardo/generative-trajectory-benchmark
summary: Learning from trajectory demonstrations offers a route to active-inference control of complex systems whose dynamics are difficult to model explicitly. We introduce generative active-inference control (GenAIF), in which one generative trajectory model learns from demonstrations and measured action interventions to supply a goal-conditioned policy distribution and a state-to-observation likelihood mapping. From this control design, we derive three model requirements: (i) useful action proposals, (ii) accurate prediction under imposed actions, and (iii) probabilistic observation evidence for belief updating and expected information gain. We benchmark diffusion, autoregressive Transformers, conditional variational autoencoders (CVAEs), and flow matching in a MuJoCo manipulation task with multiple physical conditions. Diffusion delivers the strongest control across the tested dynamics, while CVAE combines comparable short-horizon prediction with much faster inference. Correct conditioning is decisive, and trajectory reuse offers further computational savings. With the same frozen models, a hidden-dynamics experiment demonstrates prompt belief adaptation after an unannounced tilt change; subsequent instability identifies sustained inference as a remaining challenge. These findings support the use of shared generative trajectory models to connect action proposal, controlled prediction, and observation evidence within GenAIF.

AI.tldr: 提出GenAIF框架，用一个生成式轨迹模型同时提供目标条件策略分布与状态-观测似然映射，在MuJoCo操作任务中对比四种生成模型，扩散模型控制最强，CVAE推理最快。
AI.motivation: 复杂系统动力学难以显式建模，需从轨迹演示中学习主动推理控制，并明确生成式轨迹模型应满足何种模型要求。
AI.method: 提出生成式主动推理控制（GenAIF）：单一生成轨迹模型从演示与动作干预中学习，输出目标条件策略分布和状态到观测的似然映射；据此推导三项模型要求（有效动作提议、施加动作下预测准确、概率观测证据用于信念更新与期望信息增益）；在多种物理条件的MuJoCo操作任务上基准测试扩散模型、自回归Transformer、CVAE与流匹配。
AI.result: 扩散模型在测试动力学下控制性能最强；CVAE在短时域预测相当的同时推理速度显著更快；正确条件化是关键，轨迹复用可进一步节省计算。冻结模型下的隐藏动力学实验显示，倾斜突变未宣告后能快速实现提示级信念适应，但随后出现不稳定。
AI.conclusion: 共享生成式轨迹模型可将动作提议、受控预测与观测证据统一于GenAIF；持续推理仍是待解决的挑战。

title: Virtual model control for compliant reaching under uncertainties
summary: Virtual Model Control (VMC) is an approach to design a controller for force-controlled robots in complex uncertain environments. While this method was primarily investigated for legged robot locomotion in the past, it can be more generally applicable to other types of robotic systems. This paper investigates the VMC framework for reaching tasks in a force-controlled robotic arm. We propose six different approaches to designing virtual models in order to achieve reaching tasks in environments with obstacles and uncertainties. A force-controlled 8 degree-of-freedom humanoid robot was used to validate the proposed approach in the real world. We conducted three experiments to test the performance of VMC controllers in terms of predictability, sensitivity to external force, and adaptability against known and unknown obstacles. Experimental analyses show that, even though the proposed approach needs to sacrifice accuracy and trajectory optimality, it enables us to design complex reaching motions under uncertainties, in an intuitive and extendable manner.

AI.tldr: 本文研究将虚拟模型控制（VMC）从足式机器人运动推广至力控机械臂的到达任务，提出六种虚拟模型设计方法，并用8自由度力控人形机器人在真实环境中验证其可预测性、外力敏感性与障碍适应性。
AI.motivation: VMC 原本主要用于足式机器人运动控制，但在复杂不确定环境下具有更广泛的适用性。作者希望探究 VMC 框架能否用于力控机械臂的到达任务，以直观、可扩展的方式应对环境中的障碍与不确定性。
AI.method: 提出六种不同的虚拟模型设计方法，用于在含障碍与不确定性的环境中实现到达任务；采用一台力控8自由度人形机器人在真实世界中进行验证；设计三组实验，分别考察 VMC 控制器的可预测性、对外力的敏感性以及对已知和未知障碍的适应性。
AI.result: 实验分析表明，所提方法虽然需要牺牲一定的精度和轨迹最优性，但能够在不确定性条件下以直观且可扩展的方式设计复杂的到达运动。
AI.conclusion: VMC 框架可有效推广到力控机械臂的到达任务，其优势在于设计的直观性与可扩展性，而非精度或轨迹最优性，适用于复杂不确定环境下的运动生成。

title: When to Switch: Reliable Action-Chunk Extension for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models serve as unified policies for robotic manipulation, yet their expensive inference forces robots to pause between policy calls, resulting in stop-and-go execution that interrupts smooth motion and prolongs task completion. Extending the action chunk reduces policy calls and hence these pauses, but predicting farther into the future makes long-chunk execution unreliable. To understand where this unreliability arises, we analyze action errors within long chunks and find that they concentrate around transitions between manipulation subskills, growing sharply with chunk length. This suggests the importance of transition timing, i.e., when to switch subskills within a chunk. Motivated by this observation, we introduce RACE (Reliable Action-Chunk Extension), a framework that predicts the transition timing from an auxiliary one-step denoising pass and conditions action generation on it. By learning and conditioning on transition timing, RACE reduces errors at subskill transitions and enables reliable execution of longer action chunks. Across simulation benchmarks, RACE outperforms fine-tuning at the same chunk length; with 2x longer chunks, it surpasses recent state-of-the-art and efficient VLAs in success rate, and with 4x longer chunks, it remains competitive. On a real robot, RACE uses 4x longer chunks, which reduces the idle time caused by stop-and-go execution by about 5x, while achieving a higher success rate than fine-tuning with the same chunk length. Code and a real-robot demo are available at https://github.com/Seonghoon-Yu/RACE-VLA

AI.tldr: RACE通过预测子技能切换时机并以此条件化动作生成，实现可靠的长动作块执行，减少VLA模型推理停顿，在仿真与真机上提升成功率并大幅降低空闲时间。
AI.motivation: VLA模型推理开销大，机器人在策略调用间停顿，形成走走停停的执行方式，打断运动平滑性并延长任务时间；延长动作块可减少调用次数，但长块预测的未来越远，执行越不可靠。
AI.method: 分析长动作块内的动作误差，发现误差集中在操作子技能之间的切换处并随块长急剧增长；据此提出RACE框架，通过一次辅助的单步去噪过程预测切换时机，并将动作生成条件化于该时机，从而降低子技能切换处的误差。
AI.result: 在仿真基准中，RACE在同块长下优于微调；块长2倍时成功率超过近期SOTA与高效VLA，块长4倍时仍具竞争力。在真机上使用4倍长块，将走走停停导致的空闲时间减少约5倍，同时成功率高于同块长的微调。
AI.conclusion: 子技能切换时机的建模是长动作块可靠执行的关键，RACE通过预测并条件化切换时机，兼顾推理效率与执行可靠性，验证了长块VLA策略的可行性。

authors: Tommaso Van Der Meer Andrea Garulli
title: End-to-End Safe Social Navigation via Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning and Probabilistic Perception
comment: Accepted to the IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS), 2026
summary: Autonomous social navigation requires balancing efficiency, physical safety, and social compliance. Reinforcement Learning (RL) methods provide a viable and effective solution but often rely on unrealistic assumptions, such as the knowledge of humans' position and velocity. In this paper, we introduce JESSI (JAX-based E2E Safe Social Interpretable navigation), a lightweight end-to-end RL framework that maps raw LiDAR scans directly to kinematically feasible control commands. JESSI enhances safety via Dirichlet-parameterized continuous action spaces and deterministic bounding, while an integrated attention-based perception module extracts probabilistic human states for interpretable, socially aware decision-making. Through extensive simulations and real-world deployment on a differential-drive robot, we demonstrate that jointly optimizing the RL policy with a supervised perception signal in a multi-task paradigm enhances social behavior. Ultimately, JESSI is able to balance high navigation success rates and superior social behaviors compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: JESSI：一种基于JAX的端到端安全社交可解释导航框架，将原始LiDAR直接映射为运动学可行控制命令，通过Dirichlet参数化动作空间与注意力感知模块实现安全与社交合规。
AI.motivation: 自主社交导航需在效率、物理安全与社交合规间取得平衡。现有强化学习方法虽有效，但依赖不切实际的假设，如已知行人的位置与速度。作者希望去除该类假设，直接在原始感知输入上学习安全且具社交意识的导航策略。
AI.method: 提出JESSI轻量级端到端RL框架，以JAX实现，将原始LiDAR扫描直接映射为运动学可行的控制命令；采用Dirichlet参数化的连续动作空间与确定性边界约束提升安全性；集成基于注意力的感知模块，提取概率性人类状态以支持可解释、社交感知的决策；并在多任务范式中，用监督感知信号与RL策略联合优化。
AI.result: 通过大量仿真实验以及在差速驱动机器人上的真实部署，验证了联合优化RL策略与监督感知信号的多任务范式能够增强社交行为。与当前最先进基线相比，JESSI能够在高导航成功率与更优社交行为之间取得平衡。
AI.conclusion: JESSI表明，端到端RL结合Dirichlet动作参数化与注意力感知的多任务学习，可在不依赖行人位置速度先验假设的前提下，实现兼具安全性、可解释性与社交合规性的自主导航。

title: FreeSpeed: Training-Free Speed Control for Generative Robot Policies
comment: 37 pages, 21 figures, 14 tables. Project page: https://yuxuanhu9.github.io/FreeSpeed/
summary: Online control of execution speed is essential for deploying robot policies in real-world scenarios, as robots may need to speed up under time constraints or slow down to facilitate human interaction and improve safety. However, imitation-learned policies inherit the execution speed of their demonstrations, and test-time speed modification can introduce unrecoverable out-of-distribution observations, reducing task success. We observe that the directional inconsistency of action chunks reflects task-phase criticality, indicating how aggressively action step lengths can be modified while preserving task success. Based on this observation, we introduce FreeSpeed, a training-free module that post-processes action chunks from pretrained policies. FreeSpeed resamples each predicted chunk at the requested rate, then uses directional inconsistency between adjacent actions as the primary signal for rescaling. This signal adaptively determines how closely the execution speed can approach the requested speed, allowing flexible speed adjustment within the evaluated limits without compromising task success. Across three policy families and 50 simulated tasks, FreeSpeed supports online speed changes, with realized execution rates spanning 0.22x to 2.53x among settings that preserve per-task success. Across four real-world manipulation tasks, FreeSpeed achieves an average success rate of 94.0%, matching the frozen policy's 93.8%, while realizing execution rates from 0.38x to 1.97x.

AI.tldr: FreeSpeed是一个免训练模块，通过动作块的方向不一致性自适应调节执行速度，在保持任务成功率的同时实现0.22x-2.53x的在线速度调整。
AI.motivation: 机器人部署需要在线调节执行速度，但模仿学习策略继承了演示速度，测试时直接变速会引入不可恢复的分布外观测，降低任务成功率。
AI.method: 基于"动作块方向不一致性反映任务阶段关键性"的观察，FreeSpeed对预训练策略输出的动作块进行后处理：先按请求速率重采样每个预测块，再以相邻动作间的方向不一致性作为重缩放的主信号，自适应决定执行速度能多接近请求速度。
AI.result: 在3类策略家族和50个仿真任务上支持在线变速，成功率保持下的实现速率达0.22x-2.53x；在4个真实操作任务上平均成功率94.0%，与冻结策略的93.8%相当，实现速率0.38x-1.97x。
AI.conclusion: FreeSpeed无需训练即可实现灵活的速度调节，在评估范围内不牺牲任务成功率，适用于多种策略和真实操作场景。

title: The Unexpired Plan: A Free Monitor for Accelerated Diffusion Policies
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables. Project website (code and videos): https://yizhaojasper.com/unexpired-plan/
summary: Training-free acceleration of a diffusion policy is accepted when an internal similarity signal reports that the shortcut changed nothing. We price every monitor a control loop can afford in closed-loop success rather than feature distance, over $114$ accelerator configurations and four policy families: two accelerators each clear their own gate's bar and log every reuse as certified, while on one task one finishes every episode and the other none. A monitor is two designs, not one --- the statistic it reads, and what it does when that statistic fires. Published gates re-arm after every rejection, and under that response even an oracle handed every forward pass and the exact local action error loses twenty points; absorbing the same statistic costs one point, and most of its speed. What makes a response that never forgets affordable is a statistic that rarely fires, and what it must measure is deviation from the policy the accelerator replaced --- which a chunked policy has already paid for, its last plan not yet expired and free to read. Guarding every call this way cuts per-call compute by $1.55$--$3.09\times$, where any reference-requiring check at the same coverage would have to stop accelerating altogether. On three of our four families the schedule alone already holds the pre-stated $\pm2$-point margin. What the monitor is measurably worth shows in three places: on the fourth family, where it rescues the candidate selection landed on; on four configurations it did not select; and on a contact-rich fifth family, chosen where the schedule was expected to fail and run after every design choice was frozen, where no unmonitored arm at its speed holds the margin and the monitored one does.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究扩散策略（diffusion policy）的免训练加速监控机制，主张以闭环成功率而非特征距离来评价监控器，并将监控器拆解为"统计量"与"触发后响应"两个设计维度；提出一种"永不失忆"的响应配合"极少触发、衡量与所替换策略偏差"的统计量，在114种加速配置和四个策略家族上验证其加速与保真兼顾。
AI.motivation: 免训练加速（如缓存复用/捷径）只有在监控信号表明"捷径没有改变结果"时才可接受。已有门控（gate）以特征距离为准则，且多采用"每次拒绝后重置（re-arm）"的响应方式；作者指出这种响应方式代价高昂——即便是拥有全部前向传播和精确局部动作误差的"预言机"也会损失20分，因此需要重新审视监控器应以什么为目标、读什么统计量、触发后如何响应。
AI.method: 把监控器形式化为两部分：(1) 所读统计量，(2) 统计量触发后的响应行为。对比"每拒绝即重置门控（re-arm）"与"吸收/永不失忆（absorbing，一旦触发永久生效）"两种响应；提出统计量应衡量"与实际替代策略的偏差"，并利用分块（chunked）策略已付费的、尚未过期的上一份计划作为免费参考信号，实现无需额外参考前向传播的检查。在114种加速配置、四个策略家族上评测，另设接触丰富（contact-rich）的第五家族做冻结设计后的验证。
AI.result: 两种加速器各自通过其门控门槛且将所有复用记录为"已认证"，但在某任务上一个完成所有回合、另一个一个都没完成，说明成功率评价的必要性。在re-arm响应下，即使预言机也损失20分；改用吸收式响应仅损失1分，但牺牲大部分加速。以"极少触发+衡量与所替换策略偏差"的统计量守护每次调用，可将每次调用计算量降低1.55–3.09倍，而同等覆盖率下任何需要参考的检查都必须完全停止加速。四个家族中有三个仅靠调度（schedule）已满足预定的±2分容差。监控器的价值体现在三处：第四家族上挽救了候选选择所落到的位置、四个未被选中的配置，以及在接触丰富的第五家族（预期调度失效）上，同速下无监控臂无法保持容差而监控臂可以。
AI.conclusion: 监控器不是单一设计，而是"统计量+响应"的组合；以闭环成功率定价、采用"永不失忆"的响应，并用分块策略中尚未过期的上一份计划作为免费参考来度量与所替换策略的偏差，能在极少触发的前提下实现1.55–3.09倍的每调用计算节省，且不牺牲成功率；监控的收益可通过调度本身已达标与未达标两类场景得到分离与量化。

title: Demonstration-Calibrated Port-Hamiltonian Retuning for Manipulation Policies
summary: Diffusion and VLA policies for manipulation are often deployed through downstream impedance controllers. The stiffness and damping gains of these controllers affect task success, yet are commonly inherited from data collection rather than selected for the deployed policy. Although empirical gain sweeps can improve performance, they require repeated evaluation rollouts. We introduce PHRetune, an offline method that derives controller gains for a frozen policy without evaluation rollouts or gain search. Our approach learns a port-Hamiltonian model from demonstrations to estimate the effort and energy associated with the policy's predicted actions. The policy is applied to recorded demonstration observations, and its predictions are assessed against demonstration-derived effort and energy budgets. From this comparison, we derive a single gain scale in closed form, adjusting the downstream controller while preserving the policy and its action representation. The gains are fixed before evaluation, without requiring a prior manipulator model, task rewards, policy retraining, or additional runtime computation. Across LIBERO suites, PHRetune improves Diffusion Policy success by up to 9.4 percentage points, with the derived gains achieving the highest observed success rates in empirical gain sweeps. On all four real-world manipulation tasks, PHRetuned Diffusion Policy outperforms the nominal policy, alternative gain-tuning methods, and a policy-retraining baseline. The same procedure improves success with SmolVLA and OpenVLA-OFT on every task, while reducing acceleration and jerk for both VLA backbones.

AI.tldr: PHRetune是一种离线方法，通过从演示数据学习Port-Hamiltonian模型，以闭式解导出下游阻抗控制器的单一刚度/阻尼增益缩放，无需评估回滚或增益搜索即可提升冻结策略的操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略与VLA操作策略常部署于下游阻抗控制器上，其刚度与阻尼增益显著影响任务成功率，但目前增益多沿用数据采集时的设定，而非针对所部署策略进行选择。经验性增益扫描虽可提升性能，却需要反复的评估回滚，代价高昂。
AI.method: PHRetune从演示数据中学习Port-Hamiltonian模型，用以估计策略预测动作所对应的effort与能量；随后将冻结策略应用于记录的演示观测上，将其预测结果与由演示导出的effort和能量预算进行比较；据此以闭式解导出单一增益缩放系数，在保持策略及其动作表示不变的前提下调整下游控制器。增益在评估前即固定，无需先验机械臂模型、任务奖励、策略重训练或额外运行时计算。
AI.result: 在LIBERO各套件上，PHRetune将Diffusion Policy成功率最高提升9.4个百分点，且所导出增益在经验增益扫描中取得最高观测成功率。在全部四个真实世界操作任务上，PHRetuned Diffusion Policy优于标称策略、其他增益调优方法以及策略重训练基线。同一流程在每项任务上均提升SmolVLA与OpenVLA-OFT的成功率，同时降低两种VLA骨干的加速度与jerk。
AI.conclusion: PHRetune提供了一种无需评估回滚与增益搜索的离线增益导出方案，可普遍改善扩散策略与VLA策略在下游阻抗控制器上的部署性能，并提升运动平滑性。

title: Human-in-the-Loop Neuro-Symbolic Drift Anticipation for Reliable Visual SLAM
summary: This paper introduces Hybrid DeepSEE (HDS), a Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) neuro-symbolic framework for proactive drift anticipation in Visual SLAM (V-SLAM). While data-driven models offer predictive power, their "black-box" nature often yields physically inconsistent outputs in out-of-distribution (OOD) environments. To address this, HDS integrates neural drift risk estimation with symbolic constraint reasoning. By utilizing a Large Language Model (LLM) as a reasoning bridge, the framework translates qualitative human context into interpretable symbolic constraints. Building upon this architecture, we propose a superior drift anticipation framework that ensures enhanced reliability and consistency in Visual SLAM

AI.tldr: 提出HDS——一种人在回路(HITL)的神经符号框架，用于V-SLAM中的主动漂移预测，借助LLM将人类定性上下文转化为可解释的符号约束，以提升可靠性。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动模型虽有预测能力，但其"黑箱"特性在分布外(OOD)环境中常产生物理上不一致的输出。
AI.method: HDS将神经漂移风险估计与符号约束推理相结合，并以LLM作为推理桥梁，将人类定性上下文翻译为可解释的符号约束，构建人在回路(HITL)的神经符号框架。
AI.result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果；仅声明该框架可增强V-SLAM中的可靠性与一致性。
AI.conclusion: 在该架构基础上提出了一种更优的漂移预测框架，可确保Visual SLAM中更高的可靠性与一致性。

title: Bilinear Flow Policy: Distributional Extrapolation for Goal-Conditioned Visuomotor Imitation
summary: Goal-conditioned imitation learning (GCIL) with flow matching is a promising framework that can represent multimodal behaviors while adapting to diverse, user-specified goals, yet often fails when goals lie outside the demonstration support. To extrapolate to such unseen goals without collapsing multimodality - a problem we call distributional extrapolation - we introduce Bilinear Flow Policy (BFP), a generative visuomotor policy that combines transductive retrieval with a bilinear conditional flow. Given an unseen observation-goal pair, BFP retrieves an "anchor" training example and transductively reformulates the unseen pair as this familiar anchor plus a residual term. For this decomposition to guide action prediction, the residual must compactly encode how the current observation-goal pair differs from the anchor, and the anchor must be chosen so that this difference is predictive of the corresponding action distribution. BFP achieves this with pretrained visual features and a novel learned anchor-selection algorithm. The novel bilinear flow then models how the anchor and the residual jointly determine the multimodal action distribution. We prove that, for bilinear flow under suitable assumptions, action distribution error at unseen goals is bounded by the in-distribution flow-matching error up to problem-dependent factors. Across five manipulation tasks in simulation, BFP achieves 2.63x the out-of distribution success rate of a GCIL policy and 1.36x that of the strongest extrapolation-targeted baseline. On two real-world tasks, BFP improves over GCIL by 32%. Finally, our theory yields practical, pre deployment diagnostics for predicting which trained policies will extrapolate well and to which unseen goal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双线性流策略（BFP），将流匹配式目标条件模仿学习中的"分布外推"问题转化为"锚点+残差"的传导式检索与双线性条件流建模，并给出误差界与部署前诊断。
AI.motivation: 目标条件模仿学习（GCIL）结合流匹配能表示多模态行为并适应多样目标，但当目标落在演示分布支持之外时往往失败。作者将"在保持多模态性的同时外推到未见目标"定义为分布外推（distributional extrapolation），这是现有方法的核心痛点。
AI.method: 方法核心包含三部分：(1) 对未见观测-目标对，先检索一个"锚点"训练样本，将其传导式地重写为锚点加残差项，使残差紧凑编码当前对与锚点的差异；(2) 使用预训练视觉特征与一种新学习的锚点选择算法，保证残差对相应动作分布具有预测性；(3) 设计双线性流（bilinear flow）建模锚点与残差如何联合决定多模态动作分布。理论上作者证明，在适当假设下，双线性流在未见目标处的动作分布误差可由分布内流匹配误差以问题相关因子为界。
AI.result: 五个仿真操作任务中，BFP 的分布外成功率是 GCIL 策略的 2.63 倍，是最强外推专用基线的 1.36 倍；两个真实任务中相较 GCIL 提升 32%。理论还导出可实用的部署前诊断，用于预测哪些已训练策略能外推良好、以及能外推到哪些未见目标。
AI.conclusion: BFP 通过检索式分解与双线性流条件建模，在保持多模态的同时实现目标分布外推，兼具实验增益与可验证的误差界，并提供部署前诊断工具。

title: DASH: A da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid Robots as an Accessible Platform for Surgical Robotics Research
summary: Robotic minimally invasive surgery offers well-documented clinical benefits, but the cost and infrastructure requirements of purpose-built platforms limit access in rural and lower-resourced facilities. Recent work has teleoperated general-purpose robots for laparoscopic tasks and in vivo procedures, but relied on handheld instruments coupled through passive linkages rather than native robotic actuation. Instead, we adapt da Vinci Classic and Xi instruments onto general-purpose robots that can integrate in clinical workflows. We present DASH, a da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid platforms, consisting of two types of adapters that require no modification to the instruments themselves. Each adapter is compatible with many robotic platform load capacities, engages the instrument's native latch, and wirelessly identifies inserted tools to load instrument-specific kinematics and coupling matrices. Teleoperated experiments demonstrate the efficacy of DASH and its benefits for enabling research access to surgical robotic platforms.

AI.tldr: DASH 提出一种无需改装器械的达芬奇器械适配器，将经典与 Xi 系列手术器械集成到通用机器人（串联臂与人形平台）上，实现机器人原生驱动与无线器械识别，并通过遥操作实验验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 专用手术机器人平台成本高、基础设施要求高，限制了农村与资源匮乏机构的使用；已有通用机器人遥操作研究依赖手持器械加被动连杆，未实现机器人原生驱动，因此需要一种能直接驱动商用手术器械、可融入临床流程的通用方案。
AI.method: 提出 DASH（da Vinci Adapter for Serial-link and Humanoid platforms），包含两类适配器，均无需改动器械本体；适配器兼容多种机器人负载能力，可触发器械原生锁扣，并通过无线方式识别插入的器械以加载对应运动学模型与耦合矩阵，随后开展遥操作实验。
AI.result: 遥操作实验证明 DASH 的有效性，并展示了其在为手术机器人平台提供低成本研究接入方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: DASH 通过免改装适配器把达芬奇器械接入通用机器人，实现原生驱动与器械自动识别，降低手术机器人研究与使用门槛，为资源受限场景提供可行路径。

title: Dynamics-Aware Adaptive Corridors with Feasibility-Perturbed Trust-Region SQP for Certified Nonholonomic Motion Planning
summary: Optimisation-based parking planners usually impose collision constraints only at the time samples, so a vehicle corner can cut an obstacle between samples, and no executable trajectory exists until the solver converges. We present a planner for car-like vehicles with reverse gear in which every iterate of the optimisation phase satisfies the discretised dynamics exactly and keeps the whole vehicle rectangle clear of obstacles between the samples. Each time interval receives one convex corridor that holds all vehicle corners at both ends and is shrunk by a sweep margin bounding how far the corner paths leave their chords. Separating half-planes give the corridors a direction out of obstacles when the initial guess is in collision; later, heading-aligned boxes are grown from the speed, curvature and step of the current iterate and rebuilt after accepted steps. A feasibility-perturbed trust-region sequential quadratic programming method projects each step onto the dynamics by feedback and verifies it exactly; the cost decreases monotonically, and once the corridors stop changing, limit points are Karush-Kuhn-Tucker points of the corridor-constrained problem or violate a constraint qualification. On 820 benchmark cases the planner succeeds in 818 without penetration (797 from the first initial guess), none of the 7103 evaluated optimisation-phase iterates is unusable, and it succeeds in 96.5% of the cases when 99% of the initial guesses intersect an obstacle. Its maneuvers take 0.7% longer in the median than those of a similarly certified exact-collision baseline. The guarantees hold for the planning model, not for a physical vehicle.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向带倒挡的类车车辆泊车规划器，使优化阶段每次迭代都精确满足离散动力学且全程无碰撞，基于可行性扰动信赖域SQP求解，保证迭代可用与KKT收敛性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于优化的泊车规划器只在离散时间采样点施加碰撞约束，导致车辆角点可能在采样间隔内切入障碍物，且求解器收敛前不存在可执行轨迹。因此需要一种每次迭代都无碰撞、动力学可行的规划方法。
AI.method: 为每个时间区间构造一个凸走廊，包含车辆四角在区间两端的位置，并按"扫掠余量"收缩以限制角点路径偏离弦的幅度。通过分离半平面为走廊在初始猜测碰撞时指定脱离障碍的方向；随后依据当前迭代的速度、曲率和步长生长航向对齐包围盒，并在接受步后被重建。采用可行性扰动信赖域序列二次规划，通过反馈将每步投影到动力学上并精确验证。
AI.result: 代价单调下降；当走廊不再变化时，极限点是走廊约束问题的KKT点，或违反约束限定条件。在820个基准案例中，818个成功且无穿透（797个来自初始猜测），7103次评估的优化迭代全部可用；当99%初始猜测与障碍相交时仍达96.5%成功率；其机动中位数仅比同类认证的精确碰撞基线长0.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该规划器在规划模型层面提供了无碰撞与动力学可行性的保证，但不对物理车辆成立。方法在成功率与轨迹质量上表现优异，且不牺牲迭代可用性。

title: What the Guard Misses, the Robot Executes: Implied Harm in VLA Instructions
comment: Under review at the SPAIS 2026 workshop (CoRL 2026)
summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) act on instructions without being able to refuse, so screening harmful requests falls to monitors. We test whether these monitors catch ordinary robot tasks requested for harmful reasons, holding the task fixed while varying only how explicitly the intent is stated. $π_{0.5}$ completes the task at every level of explicitness, as often as for harmless controls. Text guards flag nearly every blunt request but few implied ones: up to 95% of implied-harm runs end with the task done and no flag raised, and up to 90% even after recalibrating on robot instructions. Monitoring the model's activations does not close this gap. Linear probes separate harmful from harmless instructions almost perfectly in the base language and vision-language models, but this separation weakens after robot training in two model families, most for implied harm.

AI.tldr: 该研究测试了机器人视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）的安全监控机制能否识别"任务相同但意图表述不同"的有害请求，发现现有文本与激活监控在隐含有害意图时存在严重漏检。
AI.motivation: VLA模型会无条件执行指令而无法拒绝，因此有害请求的筛查完全依赖外部监控器。然而以往研究多关注任务本身是否危险，忽略了"普通任务被赋予有害动机"这一更隐蔽的情形。作者希望检验监控器在保持任务不变、仅改变意图表述显式程度时是否仍然有效。
AI.method: 采用控制变量实验：固定机器人任务，仅改变请求中有害意图陈述的显式程度（从直白到隐含）；在π_{0.5}模型上运行这些请求，并分别使用文本守卫（含在机器人指令上重新校准的版本）以及对模型激活的线性探针进行监测，覆盖基础语言模型、视觉-语言模型及机器人训练后的多个模型家族。
AI.result: π_{0.5}在所有显式程度下都完成了任务，频率与无害对照组相当；文本守卫几乎能标记所有直白请求，但漏掉大量隐含请求——最多95%的隐含有害运行在任务完成且未被标记，即便重新校准后仍达90%；激活监控也无法弥补该缺口。线性探针在基础语言与视觉-语言模型中几乎完美区分有害与无害指令，但经机器人训练后分离能力下降，其中隐含有害情形下降最明显（出现在两个模型家族中）。
AI.conclusion: 现有文本守卫与激活监控难以拦截以隐晦方式提出的有害机器人请求，机器人训练还会削弱模型内部对有害意图的表征分离能力，凸显VLA安全监控存在系统性漏洞。

title: Transporting Unsecured Stacked Payloads with a Quadrupedal Robot via Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning
summary: Transporting unsecured payloads with legged robots over uneven terrain requires balancing locomotion performance and payload stability, since aggressive motion can destabilize the payload even when the robot remains stable. We study quadrupedal transportation of unsecured stacked boxes on an edgeless torso-mounted board without dedicated payload sensors or active carrier mechanisms. To address this trade-off, we propose Payload-Adaptive Multi-Objective Reinforcement learning for Transportation (PAMORT). PAMORT trains a multi-objective base policy conditioned on a preference vector that weights locomotion and payload-stability reward groups, then trains a weight adjuster on the frozen policy to adapt this preference online from proprioception. In simulation, PAMORT achieves comparable or better overall transportation success than a corresponding single-objective baseline across different payload configurations, including an unseen three-box stack, despite training only with two boxes. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 demonstrate zero-shot transfer to slopes and steps at or beyond the training difficulty, with mean success rates of 0.850 for PAMORT and 0.675 for the baseline across eight tasks. These results demonstrate robust unsecured-payload transportation with online adaptation of the locomotion--payload trade-off from proprioceptive information.

AI.tldr: 提出PAMORT——一种负载自适应多目标强化学习方法，实现四足机器人对未固定堆叠箱体在无传感器、无主动承载机构条件下的稳定运输。
AI.motivation: 腿足机器人搬运未固定负载时，运动性能与负载稳定性存在权衡：即使机器人自身稳定，剧烈运动也可能导致负载失稳。现有方案多依赖专用负载传感器或主动承载机构，硬件成本高且泛化性受限，因此需要在仅用本体感知的条件下在线调节这一权衡。
AI.method: 以多目标强化学习为基础，训练一个以偏好向量为条件的基策略，该偏好向量对运动奖励组与负载稳定性奖励组进行加权；随后在冻结基策略的前提下训练权重调节器，利用本体感知信息在线自适应调整偏好。实验平台为无边缘的躯干安装式平板，负载为未固定堆叠箱体，无需专用负载传感器或主动承载机构。
AI.result: 仿真中，PAMORT在不同负载配置下取得与单目标基线相当或更优的整体运输成功率，并成功泛化到训练中未出现的三箱堆叠。真机实验在Unitree Go2上实现零样本迁移至坡度与台阶（难度达到或超过训练水平），八项任务平均成功率为0.850，基线为0.675。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，仅凭本体感知信息即可在线自适应调节运动—负载权衡，实现鲁棒的未固定负载运输，且具备跨负载配置与跨地形难度的零样本泛化能力。

title: Dual-Rate Force-Image Control with Model-Based Orientation Limits for Robotic Ultrasound
summary: Robotic ultrasound couples a high-rate contact-force loop with slower, delayed image feedback, so image-guided ultrasound probe rotation can perturb contact force before the resulting image response is observed. We derive a closed-form orientation-rate limit that bounds the modeled rotation-induced estimated-force excursion over a finite horizon while accounting for disturbance rejection by the fast force loop. The limit depends on local contact stiffness, force-loop gains, a conservative rotation-to-force gain bound, the excursion budget, and the prediction horizon. We implement this model in a dual-rate controller with timestamp-based delay reconstruction and joint-torque-based force estimation, and evaluate it on a curved gelatin phantom using paired controller comparisons and component ablations. Relative to unconstrained image guidance, the proposed rate-limited controller reduced first-second root-mean-square (RMS) estimated-force error by 0.40 N while increasing cue-convergence time by 0.94 s. A fixed rate cap near the analytically predicted ceiling produced no resolvable difference in force error and converged 0.32 s faster, indicating that the principal practical value of the model is the rate-design rule rather than online prediction. Delay reconstruction had no resolvable effect at the tested latency. A single-subject popliteal scan demonstrated feasibility, although the image cue was noise-limited on heterogeneous tissue.

AI.tldr: 本文针对机器人超声中力环快、图像反馈慢且延迟的双速率特性，推导出一个闭式的姿态角速率上限，用于约束旋转引起的接触力偏移，并在曲形明胶体模与单受试腘动脉扫描中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器人超声同时运行高速接触力环与较慢、带延迟的图像反馈；图像引导下的探头旋转会在图像响应被观测到之前扰动接触力，存在力超调与安全性风险，因此需要为旋转速率设定有理论依据的约束。
AI.method: 推导一个闭式的姿态角速率上限：在有限预测时域内，约束建模的旋转引起的估计力偏移，并考虑快速力环的扰动抑制。该上限取决于局部接触刚度、力环增益、保守的旋转—力增益上界、力偏移预算与预测时域。将模型实现于双速率控制器中，采用基于时间戳的延迟重构与基于关节力矩的力估计，并在曲形明胶体模上通过成对控制器对比与组件消融进行评估。
AI.result: 相比无约束图像引导，所提速率受限控制器把首秒估计力误差的RMS降低0.40 N，但使引导线索收敛时间增加0.94 s。接近解析预测上限的固定速率上限在力误差上没有可分辨差异，且收敛快0.32 s。延迟重构在测试延迟下无可分辨影响。单受试腘动脉扫描显示可行性，但图像线索在异质组织上受噪声限制。
AI.conclusion: 模型的主要实用价值在于提供速率设计规则，而非在线预测；固定速率上限即可获得大部分收益且收敛更快，延迟重构在现有延迟水平下并非必要，单受试临床可行性得到初步验证但受组织异质性与图像噪声制约。

title: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Collision-Free Locomotion of an Underactuated Biped
summary: A bipedal robot cannot deviate from its path to avoid an obstacle without disturbing its balance, and this coupling is most severe on underactuated platforms such as the biped considered here, which has four actuated joints per leg and no hip or ankle roll. This paper presents a Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) framework in which a High-Level (HL) policy observes the robot pose, 36 raycast proximity measurements, moving-obstacle states, and a receding-horizon local goal, and outputs a body-velocity command $(v_x, v_y, ω_{yaw})$ every ten control steps, while a velocity-conditioned Low-Level (LL) policy tracks each command through PD-controlled joint targets. Both policies are trained jointly with Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). Because the converged gait is task-agnostic, it is frozen and driven by classical planners over the same command interface, yielding three controlled baselines: SAC+A*, SAC+RRT*, and SAC+APF. Across 100 evaluation trials per method in randomized PyBullet environments, the proposed method reaches the goal in 98.0% of static and 88.0% of dynamic trials, against at most 78.0% and 68.0% for the planner hybrids, with path lengths within 4% of the A* reference, and ablations confirm that each observation channel and reward term contributes materially to this performance.

AI.tldr: 提出分层强化学习框架，高层输出速度指令、低层跟踪，联合SAC训练，在欠驱动双足机器人上实现优于经典规划器混合方案的运动避障。
AI.motivation: 双足机器人避障时难以在不破坏平衡的前提下偏离路径，这种耦合在欠驱动平台上尤为严重（每条腿四个驱动关节、无髋/踝侧摆）。
AI.method: HRL框架：高层策略输入机器人位姿、36条射线近距离测量、运动障碍状态及滚动时域局部目标，每10个控制步输出机体速度指令(v_x, v_y, ω_yaw)；速度条件低层策略经PD关节目标跟踪指令；两策略用SAC联合训练；冻结任务无关的收敛步态，由A*、RRT*、APF经典规划器通过相同指令接口驱动作为基线。
AI.result: 随机PyBullet环境每方法100次试验：所提方法静态98.0%、动态88.0%到达目标，规划器混合方案最高为78.0%和68.0%；路径长度在A*参考的4%以内；消融实验证实各观测通道与奖励项均有实质贡献。
AI.conclusion: 分层强化学习可在欠驱动双足平台上有效解耦平衡与避障，显著超越经典规划器混合方案，且性能依赖多通道观测与奖励设计。

title: Mulligan: Performance-Guided Data Collection for Efficient On-Robot Learning
summary: Learning from human demonstrations is a reliable way to teach robots new tasks, but the gains from each additional demonstration shrink as the policy improves. Continued improvement can instead come from supervised deployment, where an operator places the objects and intervenes when the policy fails. We ask how to maximize improvement from a fixed budget of supervised episodes on high-precision manipulation tasks with wide ranges of object placements. We observe that failures can concentrate in a small subset of initial states, so uniform collection spends much of the operator's time on states the policy already handles. Mulligan makes the initial-state distribution a decision, starting each round's episodes at observed failures and untried states. To further improve data efficiency, we augment interactive imitation learning with a value function trained on all data, including failures that imitation discards. Across three real-world tasks evaluated on 2,550 held-out, blinded episodes and two simulated tasks, Mulligan outperforms uniform initial-state sampling at matched collection budgets, and combined with value-based action selection, HiL-IDQL+Mulligan, improves final real-task success by 10-34 percentage points. With operator interventions, the human-robot team completes 98% of collection episodes, remaining productive while the policy learns. Videos, code, and data are available at https://mulligan.page/.

AI.tldr: Mulligan 将"初始状态分布"作为可决策变量，让每轮采集从已观测失败与未尝试状态开始，并结合值函数利用失败数据，从而在固定监督部署预算下最大化机器人操作策略的改进。
AI.motivation: 机器人通过人类演示学习虽可靠，但演示边际收益递减。监督部署（操作员摆放物体并在策略失败时干预）可继续提升，但失败往往集中在少数初始状态，均匀采集会把操作员大量时间浪费在策略已能处理的状态上，数据效率低。因此需研究如何在固定监督回合预算下最大化改进，尤其针对宽范围物体摆放的高精度操作任务。
AI.method: 提出 Mulligan 方法：把初始状态分布设为决策变量，每轮回合从"已观测失败状态"和"未尝试状态"开始采样，替代均匀采样。同时将交互式模仿学习与值函数相结合，该值函数在所有数据（包括模仿学习丢弃的失败数据）上训练，以提升数据效率；再结合基于价值的动作选择（HiL-IDQL+Mulligan）。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界任务（2,550 个留出、盲测回合）和两个仿真任务上评估：在匹配采集预算下，Mulligan 优于均匀初始状态采样；与基于价值的动作选择结合后，HiL-IDQL+Mulligan 使真实任务最终成功率提升 10–34 个百分点。配合操作员干预，人机团队完成 98% 的采集回合，在策略学习过程中持续保持有效产出。
AI.conclusion: 将初始状态分布作为主动决策、并利用失败数据训练值函数，是提高监督部署数据效率、加速高精度操作策略学习的有效途径。

title: From Social Reasoning to Embodied Interaction: An Agentic Framework for Social Robots
summary: Natural face-to-face human--robot interaction requires a robot to understand an evolving social situation, decide when to engage, and express its intent through coordinated physical behavior. Yet existing approaches rarely close this loop: foundation-model agents provide increasingly capable multimodal reasoning and memory but remain largely disembodied, while expressive virtual agents do not face the physical constraints of real robots, and physical social robots typically address social reasoning and embodied expression only partially. We present ARISE, a unified framework that bridges Agentic Reasoning and Interactive Social Embodiment on the Sophia humanoid robot. ARISE integrates multimodal context understanding, long-term memory, and reactive and proactive interaction to determine when and what to communicate, and translates social intent into robot-native gestures coordinated with speech and mechanical facial expressions through streaming execution. Extensive evaluations on Sophia demonstrate strong perceived interaction quality, expressive and well-coordinated embodied behavior, and substantial latency reductions through streaming execution. These results highlight the importance of jointly reasoning about what to communicate, when to engage, and how to physically express social intent for natural interaction with humanoid robots. Project Page: https://robosocial.github.io/

AI.tldr: ARISE 是一个在 Sophia 人形机器人上统一"智能体推理"与"交互式社交具身"的框架，打通了多模态理解、长期记忆、主动/反应式交互与机器人原生手势、面部表情及流式执行的闭环，实现了自然的人机面对面交互。
AI.motivation: 自然的人机面对面交互要求机器人理解不断演变的社会情境、判断何时介入，并通过协调的身体行为表达意图。然而现有方法难以形成闭环：基础模型智能体具备多模态推理与记忆能力但缺乏具身；虚拟智能体表达丰富却不受真实机器人物理约束；物理社交机器人则往往只部分解决社交推理或具身表达问题。因此需要一种能同时处理"说什么、何时介入、如何物理表达"的统一方案。
AI.method: 提出 ARISE 统一框架，在 Sophia 人形机器人上融合智能体推理（Agentic Reasoning）与交互式社交具身（Interactive Social Embodiment）。框架集成多模态上下文理解、长期记忆以及反应式与主动式交互，以决定何时交流、交流什么；并通过流式执行，将社交意图转化为与语音及机械面部表情协调的机器人原生手势。
AI.result: 在 Sophia 上的大量评估表明：交互质量感知良好，具身行为表达丰富且协调一致，流式执行带来显著的延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果凸显了协同推理"交流什么、何时介入、如何物理表达社交意图"对于实现人形机器人自然交互的重要性。项目主页：https://robosocial.github.io/

title: A State Based Dispatch Controller for Hospital Delivery Robots with Shared Human and Infrastructure Resources
summary: Robot delivery studies can overstate transport capacity when travel to pickups and human support fall outside the modeled schedule. We formulate a location aware dispatch model that couples robot admission to transporter support and shared elevators, charging, and cleaning. The model replays 33,079 observed hospital requests; missing contents, deadlines, staffing, and completion times remain explicit scenario assumptions. Two full grids compare human dispatch, a resource aware controller, and a proximity and workload benchmark in 30 paired replications per scenario. An exploratory extension tests a simpler deadline admission rule under the same operating model. Pickup travel increases demand on a pooled elevator bank. In one high staffing case, raising assumed elevator capacity from two to four reduces human only lateness from 55.11\% to 3.18\%, exceeding the dispatch differences. Direct policy comparisons and robot coverage distinguish admission selectivity from system service. The analysis explains why a robot can pass a deadline admission test yet delay service through staff handoffs and shared facilities. Its contribution is a reproducible evaluation of coupled dispatch workflows, with a clear separation between admission, completion, and return to availability. The results are conditional comparisons, not estimates of hospital benefit or released clinical capacity.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出位置感知调度模型，将机器人准入与运送员支持及共享电梯、充电、清洁资源耦合，利用33,079条医院请求回放对比人力调度、资源感知控制器与邻近-负载基准，并通过扩展实验检验更简单的截止时间准入规则。
AI.motivation: 既有机器人配送研究常高估运输能力，因为取件行程与人工支持未被纳入建模日程。
AI.method: 位置感知调度模型，耦合机器人准入、运送员支持、共享电梯、充电与清洁；回放33,079条医院请求，在30次配对重复中于两组完整网格场景下比较三种策略。
AI.result: 取件行程增加共享电梯需求；某高配置场景下，假设电梯容量由2提升至4使纯人力延误率从55.11%降至3.18%，超过调度策略差异。
AI.conclusion: 结果说明机器人可通过截止时间准入测试却因人工交接与共享设施延误服务，贡献在于可复现地评估耦合调度流程，明确区分准入、完成与恢复可用性；结论为条件性比较，非医院收益估计。

title: How (and How Not) to Use Data Augmentation in VLA Post-Training
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop RoboPAD. Code and videos at https://bramgrooten.nl/vla-augm/
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models currently demonstrate strong performance in a wide range of real-world robotics tasks. However, they often still lack the generalization ability to handle large visual out-of-distribution shifts. Post-training of VLAs with reinforcement learning (RL) has been shown to benefit robustness, but significant room for improvement remains. In this work, we systematically study the effect of image augmentation on VLA post-training. We find that it is crucial to augment only the critic module during RL updates, while leaving the actor's input clean during both rollouts and updates. For $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 this raises out-of-distribution success on LIBERO-Plus by $7.8$ and $10.0$ points respectively, while augmenting the actor collapses training entirely. We investigate a range of augmentation types and strengths, and provide practical recommendations for improving generalization in VLA post-training.

AI.tldr: 该工作系统研究了图像增强对VLA模型RL后训练的影响，发现仅在critic端增强、actor端保持干净输入最佳，可使π₀.₅与GR00T N1.5在LIBERO-Plus上的OOD成功率分别提升7.8和10.0个点，而增强actor会导致训练完全崩溃。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在真实机器人任务中表现良好，但在大幅视觉分布外（OOD）偏移下泛化能力不足；已有研究表明RL后训练能提升鲁棒性，但仍存在较大改进空间，因此需要探索如何通过图像增强提升VLA后训练的泛化性。
AI.method: 系统研究图像增强在VLA后训练中的施加位置与方式：对比不同增强目标（critic vs. actor）、增强类型与强度，在RL更新中进行消融实验，核心做法是仅对critic模块做增强，actor在rollout与更新时均使用干净输入。
AI.result: 对π₀.₅和GR00T N1.5，仅在critic端增强可使LIBERO-Plus的OOD成功率分别提升7.8和10.0个百分点；若对actor也施加增强，则训练完全崩溃。同时给出不同增强类型与强度下的实验规律。
AI.conclusion: VLA的RL后训练中图像增强的施加位置至关重要：应仅增强critic、保持actor输入干净，并据此给出了提升VLA后训练泛化能力的实用建议。

title: Infant simulator with an embodied caregiver: Generating infant-perspective touch and vision during social interaction
summary: Early development unfolds in caregiver-infant dyads, where infants' sensorimotor streams are shaped by physical contact and face-to-face interaction. Yet developmental robotics simulators commonly model infants in isolation, limiting the study of caregiver-mediated experience. We present a caregiver-enabled extension of the Multi-Modal Infant Model (MIMo) in MuJoCo that turns MIMo into a controllable platform for replaying dyadic interaction and generating dense infant-perspective observations. The system provides (i) an articulated caregiver model compatible with MIMo morphologies, parameterized from anthropometrics and optionally resized to a recorded caregiver; (ii) a workflow to replay naturalistic caregiver-infant holding and soothing interactions; and (iii) logging and visualizing the infant's first-person multimodal experience (we show touch and vision). We showcase the tool on touch by introducing origin-aware contact logging that disambiguates self-, caregiver-, and environment-generated contact and supports aggregation into touch-rate statistics comparable to manual coding. While we showcase tactile analysis, the platform is intended more broadly as a generator of multimodal dyadic datasets (touch and egocentric vision) for modeling the development of social interaction.

AI.tldr: 本文将MIMo婴儿模型扩展为"照护者-婴儿"二元互动仿真平台（MuJoCo），实现照护者模型、自然抱持/安抚互动的回放流程，以及婴儿第一人称多模态感知（触觉、视觉）的日志记录，并提出"来源感知接触标注"以区分自体/照护者/环境接触。
AI.motivation: 早期发展发生在照护者-婴儿的二元体中，婴儿的感觉运动经验受身体接触与面对面互动塑造；但发展机器人学仿真器通常将婴儿单独建模，限制了对照护者介导经验的研究。
AI.method: 在MuJoCo中对MIMo进行"照护者启用"扩展：(1)构建与MIMo形态兼容、由人体测量参数化并可缩放至真实照护者尺寸的关节照护者模型；(2)提供回放真实照护者-婴儿抱持与安抚互动的工作流；(3)记录并可视化婴儿第一人称多模态经验，并引入来源感知接触日志以区分自触、照护者接触与环境接触，聚合为可手工编码对照的接触率统计。
AI.result: 以触觉为例展示了该工具的有效性：来源感知接触日志能消歧接触来源，并生成与人工编码可比拟的接触率统计数据；平台可生成包含触觉与自我中心视觉的多模态二元数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该平台提供了研究照护者介导经验的仿真基础设施，虽以触觉分析为示例，但更广泛定位为生成多模态二元交互数据集，用于建模社会互动的发展过程。

title: P3: Persistent Particle Planning for Constrained Diffusion Control
summary: Diffusion models provide expressive priors over trajectories, but adapting these priors to test-time constraints requires maintaining feasibility and consistency across successive control decisions. We introduce Persistent Particle Planning (P3), a sequential Monte Carlo framework for diffusion control that maintains a weighted population of candidate plans across replanning steps. At each control step, P3 shifts and partially re-noises the candidate trajectories, refines them under the latest observation, and uses constraint-aware weighting and resampling to select among alternative continuations without retraining the diffusion model. We consider denoising and replanning as one Feynman--Kac particle system and analyze it under an idealized repair. We prove that the re-noising depth controls how reliably a kept plan stays on its route, and that keeping a rare, well-separated route takes far fewer plans than rediscovering it by sampling from scratch. Experiments under multiple test-time constraint configurations show that population reuse reduces route switching and improves success without constraint violations. Because P3 refines earlier plans instead of redrawing them, it also needs fewer denoising iterations per replan. On maze-navigation tasks, it plans faster than both regenerated populations and methods that correct a single sampled plan by constrained optimization. Code and pretrained models are available at https://github.com/p3-username/p3-anon.

AI.tldr: P3将扩散控制中的去噪与重规划统一为一个Feynman-Kac粒子系统，通过跨控制步维持加权的候选轨迹粒子群，实现无需重训练的约束满足规划，减少路径切换与去噪迭代次数。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型能为轨迹提供表达力强的先验，但将其适配到测试时约束时，需要在连续控制决策间同时保持可行性与一致性；从零重采样既昂贵又易导致路径不一致。
AI.method: 提出持久粒子规划(P3)：序列蒙特卡洛框架，维护候选计划的加权种群。每个控制步对候选轨迹进行平移与部分重加噪，在最新观测下精化，并以约束感知的加权与重采样选择后续分支；将去噪与重规划视为一个Feynman-Kac粒子系统并在理想化修复假设下分析。
AI.result: 理论证明重加噪深度控制被保留计划维持原路径的可靠性，且保留一条罕见、良好分离的路径所需计划数远少于从零采样重新发现它。多种测试时约束配置下，种群复用减少路径切换，在无违规前提下提升成功率；每次重规划所需去噪迭代更少。迷宫导航任务上，规划速度优于重新生成种群的方法以及通过约束优化修正单个采样计划的方法。
AI.conclusion: P3通过复用与精化早期计划而非重绘，将测试时约束下的扩散规划转化为持久粒子推断问题，兼顾可行性、时序一致性与计算效率。

title: Recon2Servo: Robotic Ultrasound Visual Servoing via Learned Image-to-Motion Inference
summary: Ultrasound visual servoing is essential for autonomous robotic ultrasound, yet 6-DoF probe control from 2D B-mode images remains challenging due to limited and ambiguous out-of-plane motion cues. Existing methods typically rely on anatomical priors or handcrafted visual features, limiting their generalizability across imaging targets. Inspired by trackerless 3D ultrasound reconstruction, we propose Recon2Servo, a visual servoing framework that learns image-to-motion inference directly from B-mode images for 6-DoF probe control. A DINOv3 encoder with low-rank adaptation and a bidirectional relation module estimate the relative probe pose between current and target images to guide iterative closed-loop target-view alignment. The framework combines supervised relative-pose learning, reconstruction-guided closed-loop adaptation, and bounded residual pose correction to improve motion inference during servoing. Evaluations on a public dataset and an in-house dataset collected from 12 healthy volunteers using different ultrasound systems demonstrate its effectiveness in reconstructed-volume servoing. Additional real-robot demonstrations of target-view alignment and dynamic tracking on a human forearm are provided in the supplementary video: https://youtu.be/qwsOdI-GMYk.

AI.tldr: 提出Recon2Servo，一种直接从B型超声图像学习图像到运动映射的6自由度超声视觉伺服框架，无需解剖先验或手工特征，实现闭环目标视图对齐与动态跟踪。
AI.motivation: 自主机器人超声需要超声视觉伺服，但从2D B型图像实现6自由度探头控制困难，因为平面外运动线索有限且模糊。现有方法依赖解剖先验或手工视觉特征，跨成像目标的泛化性受限。
AI.method: 受无跟踪器3D超声重建启发，直接由B型图像学习图像到运动推断。采用带低秩适配的DINOv3编码器与双向关系模块，估计当前图像与目标图像之间的相对探头位姿，引导迭代闭环目标视图对齐。框架融合监督式相对位姿学习、重建引导的闭环自适应以及有界残差位姿校正。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和由12名健康志愿者、使用不同超声系统采集的自建数据集上评估，验证了其在重建体伺服中的有效性；补充视频展示了人体前臂上的目标视图对齐与动态跟踪的真实机器人演示。
AI.conclusion: Recon2Servo通过直接从B型图像学习相对位姿推断，摆脱解剖先验与手工特征依赖，提升了跨目标泛化能力，在重建体伺服、目标视图对齐与动态跟踪中均获验证。

title: MagServo: Uncertainty-Resilient Hierarchical Magnetic Servoing via Learned Latent Representations
summary: Magnetic navigation provides contact-free and line-of-sight-independent feedback for robotic systems, yet existing approaches typically rely on explicit pose estimation or direct use of raw magnetic measurements, making accurate control susceptible to modeling errors, measurement noise, and disturbances. This work presents MagServo, a hierarchical learning-based framework for robust 6-DoF magnetic servoing directly using the learned latent magnetic feature. MagServo learns uncertainty-resilient magnetic representations through masked reconstruction and captures state-dependent interaction dynamics between robot motion and latent magnetic transitions without analytical magnetic models or explicit Jacobian supervision. Based on the learned dynamics, a hierarchical controller combines nonlinear model predictive control for coarse approach with local Jacobian inversion for precise fine regulation. Extensive physical experiments demonstrate submillimeter and subdegree accuracy, achieving mean terminal errors of 0.386 mm and 0.479 degree for 6-DoF pose reaching. MagServo further outperforms a localization-based control baseline in complex trajectory tracking and maintains robust performance under unseen magnetic-source configurations without retraining. A supplementary video of the real-robot experiments is available at https://youtu.be/rZt1NUP1Mr0.

AI.tldr: MagServo：基于学习潜在磁特征与分层控制的无模型6-DoF磁伺服框架，实现亚毫米/亚度级精度。
AI.motivation: 现有磁导航方法依赖显式位姿估计或直接使用原始磁测量，控制精度易受建模误差、测量噪声与扰动影响。目标是实现无需解析磁模型与显式雅可比监督的鲁棒6-DoF磁伺服。
AI.method: 提出分层学习框架MagServo：通过掩码重建学习抗不确定性磁表示；从机器人运动与潜在磁状态转移中学习状态依赖交互动力学；基于该动力学，控制器将非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）用于粗接近，与局部雅可比反演用于精细调节相结合。
AI.result: 大量物理实验显示亚毫米与亚度精度，6-DoF位姿到达平均终端误差为0.386 mm与0.479°；在复杂轨迹跟踪中优于基于定位的控制基线；在未见磁源配置下无需重训练仍保持鲁棒性能。
AI.conclusion: MagServo验证了直接利用学习潜在磁特征进行6-DoF磁伺服的可行性，无需解析模型或显式雅可比监督，具备高精度与泛化鲁棒性，适用于复杂轨迹跟踪与未知磁源配置。

title: Do VLAs Understand and Adapt to the Objects They Handle, or Simply Replay Learned Behaviors?
summary: This paper asks whether VLA generalization is grounded in a global understanding of objects' physical properties that enables policies to adapt their motion to unseen setups, or if policies simply replay the motions they've learnt that happen to succeed in new setups. The former reflects genuine generalization; the latter reflects incidental robustness. We first examine awareness of physical properties in seven VLAs by applying linear probing and representational similarity analysis (RSA) to their activations. We find that physical properties, including mass, fragility, deformability, friction and size are less decodable than non-physical properties such as semantic category, material, sound and price in nearly every modality stream. Compared with their base VLMs, robot pre-training weakens the linear encoding of physical properties in the language stream. Neither pre-training nor downstream fine-tuning strengthens the alignment between physical-property differences and activation distances. We then ask whether the weak physical information present in these activations shapes the actions a VLA generates. In a controlled LIBERO case study, we increase the mass of an in-domain object and signal the change through language or vision. Most VLAs use similar lifting behaviour for the heavier and original-mass objects, leading to task success declines. The few exceptions change their behaviour in response to lexical or visual cues rather than to mass itself. These results suggest that VLAs encode physical properties weakly and do not reliably use them to adapt their motion.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验VLA模型的泛化究竟源于对物体物理属性的全局理解，还是对已学动作的偶然性复现。通过线性探测、RSA与LIBERO受控实验发现：VLA对物理属性的编码弱于非物理属性，且不依赖物理属性自适应调整动作。
AI.motivation: 区分"真正的泛化"（基于物理属性理解调整动作）与"偶然鲁棒性"（动作复现恰好在新场景中成功）对评估VLA能力至关重要，但此前缺乏对这一问题的系统实证检验。
AI.method: 对7个VLA模型在多种模态流上做线性探测与表征相似性分析（RSA），对比物理属性（质量、易碎性、可变形性、摩擦、大小）与非物理属性（语义类别、材质、声音、价格）的可解码性，并与基座VLM比较；在LIBERO上进行受控案例研究，增大域内物体质量并通过语言或视觉提示该变化，观察模型动作是否随之调整。
AI.result: 物理属性在几乎所有模态流中都比非物理属性更难解码；相比基座VLM，机器人预训练削弱了语言流对物理属性的线性编码；预训练与下游微调均未增强物理属性差异与激活距离的对齐。LIBERO实验中，多数VLA对更重物体与原始质量物体采用相似抬升行为，导致成功率下降；少数例外是响应词汇或视觉线索而非质量本身。
AI.conclusion: VLA模型对物理属性编码薄弱，且不能可靠地利用这些属性调整运动，其在新场景中的表现更多体现为偶然鲁棒性而非基于物理理解的真正泛化。

title: Adaptive Mean Flow for Responsive Closed-Loop Robot Control
summary: Diffusion- and flow-based robot policies have recently become widespread in robotic Imitation Learning (IL) due to their high performance and ability to model continuous and multimodal distributions. However, the iterative denoising procedure used by these models introduces significant prediction latency, hindering high-frequency closed-loop robot control and leading to jittery, unstable motion when frequent updates to the robot's action predictions are used. Therefore, it is common practice to train models to predict chunks of actions that can be executed sequentially without feedback, even when this reduces responsiveness and may mean the most recent state information is not used. In this article, we present Adaptive Mean Flow (AMF), a flow-based IL method that enables smooth and responsive, fully closed-loop robot control. AMF uses Mean Flow, which is an accelerated form of Flow Matching (FM), to minimize prediction latency. To ensure smoothness and consistency across predictions, AMF uses a corrupted version of the trajectory from the previous step when predicting new robot actions, with the signal-to-noise ratio increasing over the time parameter of the trajectory. This discourages large changes in the prediction from one step to the next, while allowing freedom to adapt the predictions for future steps. We evaluate AMF across a wide range of simulated and real robot tasks and demonstrate significantly improved performance compared with baselines. Code: https://github.com/akselva/Adaptive-mean-flow-RoboticIL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应平均流（AMF），一种基于流的模仿学习方法，通过平均流加速预测并结合上一时刻轨迹的加噪条件，实现平滑、响应式的全闭环机器人控制。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流式机器人策略性能高且能建模多模态连续分布，但迭代去噪带来显著预测延迟，阻碍高频闭环控制，并导致动作抖动与不稳定。因此常见做法是预测动作块并顺序执行而不使用反馈，但这牺牲了响应性，且可能无法利用最新状态信息。
AI.method: AMF 采用 Mean Flow（平均流，Flow Matching 的加速形式）以最小化预测延迟。为保证预测间的平滑性与一致性，在预测新动作时使用上一步轨迹的加噪（corrupted）版本作为条件，其信噪比随轨迹时间参数增加而提高，从而抑制相邻步骤间预测的大幅变化，同时保留对后续步骤的适应自由度。
AI.result: 在大量仿真与真实机器人任务上评估 AMF，相比基线方法性能显著提升。
AI.conclusion: AMF 通过加速流模型与基于上一轨迹加噪条件的正则化，实现了平滑且响应式的全闭环机器人控制，优于现有基线。代码已开源。

title: Execution-Aligned Progressive Noise for Consistent Asynchronous Replanning in Generative Robot Policies
summary: Continuous asynchronous replanning is essential for real-time generative robot policies, but independent stochastic initialization can cause mode switching and inconsistent continuation across action chunks. We propose Execution-Aligned Progressive Noise (EAPN), which introduces structured stochasticity at both inter-chunk and intra-chunk levels. Across replanning steps, EAPN propagates a shared noise trajectory and aligns it with the actual execution displacement, establishing execution-aligned inter-chunk correlation. Within each action chunk, it models temporal correlation along action time. The aligned stochastic history is further combined with committed action context to condition subsequent generation, allowing new chunks to continue from execution-consistent generative states rather than restart from independent noise. We evaluate EAPN on D3IL, Kinetix, LIBERO, and real-world manipulation tasks. EAPN improves multimodal behavior consistency on D3IL and achieves an average success rate of 88.59% on Kinetix. On LIBERO, it remains robust and maintains strong task performance even under long inference delays. Real-robot experiments further achieve 90.0% success on Object Storage and 96.7% on bimanual Cloth Folding, demonstrating reliable continuous execution under asynchronous replanning.

AI.tldr: 提出Execution-Aligned Progressive Noise (EAPN)，通过在chunk间与chunk内引入结构化随机性，解决异步重规划中独立噪声初始化导致的模式切换与动作不连续问题。
AI.motivation: 连续异步重规划对实时生成式机器人策略至关重要，但各动作chunk独立进行随机初始化会引发模式切换（mode switching）以及跨chunk动作延续不一致的问题。
AI.method: EAPN在inter-chunk与intra-chunk两个层面引入结构化随机性：在重规划步骤之间传播共享的噪声轨迹，并与实际执行位移对齐，建立execution-aligned的chunk间相关性；在每个动作chunk内部建模沿动作时间的时间相关性；并将对齐后的随机历史与已提交的动作上下文（committed action context）结合，用于条件化后续生成，使新chunk从执行一致的生成状态延续而非从独立噪声重启。
AI.result: 在D3IL、Kinetix、LIBERO及真实机器人操作任务上评估：D3IL上多模态行为一致性提升；Kinetix平均成功率88.59%；LIBERO上保持鲁棒，在长推理延迟下仍维持较强任务性能；真实机器人实验在Object Storage上达90.0%成功率，双臂Cloth Folding达96.7%。
AI.conclusion: EAPN通过执行对齐的渐进噪声机制，在异步重规划下实现可靠的连续执行，验证了跨chunk噪声相关性与执行一致性对生成式机器人策略的重要意义。

title: Propagating Elevation-Map Uncertainty Through the Contact Maximum in Closed Form
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the 2027 IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: Risk-aware planners score paths on uncertain elevation maps using the path cost's mean and standard deviation. Modeling rigid contact, however, requires computing a maximum over several uncertain cells. First-order propagation loses accuracy here by differentiating at only a single cell, while Monte Carlo sampling requires a full path evaluation per draw. We compute the moments of that contact maximum in closed form using Clark's pairwise recursion. By tracking each contact's covariance against the shared map cells, we propagate the smooth remainder using exact Gaussian quadratic-form identities. A contest-depth calibration, fitted once on two design traverses, closes the aggregate standard-deviation shortfall that remains. On 317 held-out rover path segments, scored against a Monte Carlo reference from the same belief, every pre-registered criterion was met. The corrected Clark fold cuts the median error of the mean from linearization's 2.3% to 0.19% and attains the lowest error in the conditional value at risk (CVaR) at the 90% level of every method tested. A benchmark plan costs just 5.5 microseconds on a GPU. These accuracy gains concentrate at contested contacts. While they seldom change which path is chosen on this terrain, the fold still selects the reference-best path in 98% of decisions against linearization's 93 to 96%. On a second dataset the mean transfers, though the risk number does not.

AI.tldr: 提出用 Clark 成对递归闭式计算刚性接触最大值的一阶与二阶矩，并以高斯二次型恒等式传播光滑余项，配合一次标定的修正，实现风险感知路径规划的精确均值与方差估计。
AI.motivation: 风险感知规划需要在不确定高程图上用路径代价的均值与标准差来评分，而刚性接触项是对多个不确定栅格取最大值。一阶传播只对单个栅格求导，精度不足；蒙特卡洛虽准确但每次抽样都要完整评估路径，代价过高。
AI.method: 利用 Clark 成对递归闭式计算接触最大值的矩；跟踪每个接触相对共享地图栅格的协方差，用精确高斯二次型恒等式传播光滑余项；再用一次在两个设计遍历上拟合的“contest-depth”标定，弥补聚合标准差的残余缺口。
AI.result: 在 317 条留出漫游车路径段上、以同一信念的蒙特卡洛为参照，所有预注册指标均达成：修正 Clark 折叠把均值中位误差从线性化的 2.3% 降到 0.19%，并在 90% 条件风险价值（CVaR）上取得所测方法中最低误差；GPU 上单次基准规划耗时 5.5 微秒。精度提升集中在争议接触处。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在几乎不改变该地形路径选择的情况下，仍以 98% 的决策率选出参照最优路径（线性化为 93–96%）。在第二个数据集上均值可迁移，但风险数值不可迁移。

title: Conditional Trajectory Peaks: Single-Pass Multimodal Policies over Action Chunks
summary: Multimodal imitation learning requires diverse executable futures under the same observation and consistent behavior across replanning cycles. We present Conditional Trajectory Peaks (CTP), a single-pass policy framework that jointly predicts complete action-chunk candidates, probability masses, and trajectory scales. Distribution-Aware Peak Specialization (DAPS) specializes trajectory peaks using trajectory-level posterior responsibilities and mass- and scale-modulated overlap constraints. Evidence-Gated Trajectory Belief Transport (ETBT) maintains cross-chunk consistency through geometric correspondence between exchangeable candidate sets, while allowing current policy evidence to override historical constraints. CTP achieves a coverage score of 91.40% on Push-T; success rates of 100.0%, 79.72%, and 84.44% on D3IL Avoiding, Aligning, and Sorting-2, respectively. On LIBERO, CTP achieves an average success rate of 97.25%. In real-world dual-arm experiments, CTP preserves both placement modes in a two-plate task, succeeding in all 50 trials. On bottle uprighting and pen placement into a holder, it maintains success rates comparable to $π_{0.5}$ while reducing policy inference latency from 218.24 ms to 75.80 ms. These results demonstrate that single-pass trajectory modeling can combine multimodal behavior, closed-loop consistency, and efficient inference.

AI.tldr: 提出CTP单遍策略框架，联合预测动作块候选、概率质量与轨迹尺度，并用DAPS做峰值特化、ETBT做跨块一致性，实现多模态行为、闭环一致与高效推理。
AI.motivation: 多模态模仿学习需在同一观测下具备多样的可执行未来，并在重规划周期之间保持行为一致；现有方法难以兼顾多模态性、闭环一致性与推理效率。
AI.method: CTP为单遍（single-pass）策略框架，同时预测完整动作块候选、概率质量与轨迹尺度。DAPS（分布感知峰值特化）利用轨迹级后验责任，并引入质量与尺度调制的重叠约束来特化轨迹峰值；ETBT（证据门控轨迹信念传输）通过可交换候选集之间的几何对应关系维持跨块一致性，同时允许当前策略证据覆盖历史约束。
AI.result: Push-T覆盖率91.40%；D3IL的Avoiding、Aligning、Sorting-2成功率分别为100.0%、79.72%、84.44%；LIBERO平均成功率97.25%；真实双臂实验中两盘任务保留两种放置模式且50次全成功；扶正瓶子与放笔入架任务成功率与π_{0.5}相当，推理延迟从218.24 ms降至75.80 ms。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，单遍轨迹建模能够同时实现多模态行为、闭环一致性与高效推理。

title: Radar2Plan: Benchmarking 4D Radar for End-to-End Open-Loop Ego-Trajectory Planning
summary: Adverse weather and poor illumination remain major challenges for robust ego-trajectory planning in mobile autonomy. 4D radar offers reliable sensing under adverse conditions and direct radial-velocity measurements. However, sensing robustness does not necessarily translate into robust downstream planning, while existing 4D radar benchmarks focus primarily on perception rather than trajectory planning. We present Radar2Plan, a modular benchmark for open-loop ego-trajectory planning using real-world 4D radar data. Radar2Plan connects sensor encoders, scene representations, and planning heads through common interfaces, enabling controlled comparisons between different sensor and planner configurations. Using DSERT-RoLL and MAN TruckScenes, we evaluated seven combinations of camera, 4D radar, and LiDAR in four representative planning baselines and 12 weather and illumination conditions under a unified protocol. To our knowledge, Radar2Plan is the first benchmark dedicated to evaluating real-world 4D radars for autonomous driving planning. Experiments show that 4D radar alone supports competitive ego-trajectory planning and robust performance under adverse conditions. Sensor-configuration comparisons further demonstrate its complementary value to other modalities, while revealing dependencies on sensor combination and planning architecture. The modular design also supports additional datasets, sensing modalities, and planners, providing a flexible foundation for future research on radar-based autonomous driving planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Radar2Plan，一个基于真实4D雷达数据的模块化开环自车轨迹规划基准，首次系统评估4D雷达在自动驾驶规划中的表现，并证明其在恶劣天气与光照条件下具备竞争力和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 恶劣天气与低光照是移动自主性中自车轨迹规划的鲁棒性难题。4D雷达可在恶劣条件下可靠感知并直接测量径向速度，但感知鲁棒性未必转化为规划鲁棒性，且现有4D雷达基准多聚焦感知而非轨迹规划，缺少针对规划的评测平台。
AI.method: 提出Radar2Plan模块化基准，通过通用接口连接传感器编码器、场景表示与规划头，实现不同传感器与规划器配置的可控对比；使用DSERT-RoLL与MAN TruckScenes数据集，在统一协议下评测相机、4D雷达、LiDAR的七种组合、四种代表性规划基线及12种天气与光照条件。
AI.result: 实验表明，仅使用4D雷达即可支持具有竞争力的自车轨迹规划，并在恶劣条件下保持鲁棒性能；传感器配置对比显示4D雷达对其他模态具有互补价值，同时揭示规划性能依赖于传感器组合与规划架构。
AI.conclusion: Radar2Plan是首个面向自动驾驶规划的真实4D雷达评测基准，其模块化设计可扩展至更多数据集、传感模态与规划器，为基于雷达的自动驾驶规划研究提供灵活基础。

title: I-BFM: Reward-Conditioned Robust Humanoid Interaction via Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning
summary: Behavioral foundation models (BFMs) have recently shown that a single humanoid policy can support diverse whole-body control, but extending such generality to physical interaction remains challenging. We introduce I-BFM, to our knowledge the first BFM for humanoid-object interaction. Rather than relying on task-specific policies or reference tracking, I-BFM learns a shared representation of the coupled dynamics among the humanoid, objects, and their contacts using forward-backward representations and unsupervised reinforcement learning. Given a downstream task reward, the same policy can be directly conditioned on a latent command to execute closed-loop interaction without task-specific policy optimization. To improve interaction control over different time scales, we further train the policy with both short-horizon interaction targets and longer-horizon goal targets. A single I-BFM policy performs carrying, pushing, and kicking, while also supporting goal reaching, motion tracking, stylistic control, and long-horizon task chaining. More importantly, it remains effective after large deviations from nominal execution: on Carry, I-BFM achieves 94.3% nominal success and retains 89.3% success after robot falls, compared with 1.3% for a planning-based baseline. Real-world experiments on a Unitree G1 further demonstrate diverse loco-manipulation behaviors, rapid recovery from interaction failures and external disturbances, and task chaining without task-specific retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个面向人形机器人-物体交互的行为基础模型 I-BFM，利用前向-后向表示与无监督强化学习学习人形、物体及接触耦合动力学的共享表征，单一策略无需任务特定优化即可完成抓取搬运、推、踢等交互任务并支持目标到达、运动跟踪与长程任务串联，在仿真与 Unitree G1 真机上均展现出强鲁棒性与快速恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 行为基础模型（BFMs）已证明单一人形策略可支持多样化的全身控制，但将这种通用性扩展到物理交互仍具挑战。现有方法多依赖任务特定策略或参考轨迹跟踪，难以泛化到耦合动力学复杂的物体交互场景，且在执行大幅偏离或机器人摔倒后往往失效。
AI.method: 提出 I-BFM：使用前向-后向表示与无监督强化学习，学习人形机器人、物体及其接触之间耦合动力学的共享表征；下游任务仅需给定奖励，同一策略即可直接以潜在指令为条件执行闭环交互，无需任务特定的策略优化。为改善不同时间尺度上的交互控制，同时使用短时域交互目标与长时域目标目标进行训练。
AI.result: 单一 I-BFM 策略可完成搬运（carrying）、推（pushing）、踢（kicking），并支持目标到达、运动跟踪、风格化控制及长程任务串联。在大幅偏离标准执行后仍有效：Carry 任务上达到 94.3% 的标准成功率，机器人摔倒后仍保持 89.3% 成功率，而基于规划的基线仅为 1.3%。Unitree G1 真机实验进一步展示了多样化的移动-操作行为、从交互失败与外部扰动中的快速恢复，以及无需任务特定再训练的任务串联。
AI.conclusion: I-BFM 是首个面向人形机器人-物体交互的行为基础模型，通过共享耦合动力学表征与潜指令条件化，实现了无需任务特定策略优化的通用交互控制，并在仿真与真机上验证了其多样性、鲁棒性、快速恢复与任务串联能力。

title: Robotizing Human Videos with Physically Consistent Interactions
summary: Human videos offer scalable manipulation data, but the embodiment gap between human hands and robot manipulators limits their direct use. Existing video-editing methods replace hands with rendered robots, yet inaccurate interaction reconstruction and compositing can produce inconsistent grasps and implausible robot-object occlusions. We address these failures from two complementary physical aspects: interaction geometry and scene visibility. First, an interaction-aware contact reconstruction module combines hand-object segmentation with mesh-level contact prediction to recover dense 3D contacts, then converts them into temporally stabilized grasps for parallel-jaw grippers. Second, a depth-aware compositing module uses scene and robot depth to enforce physically consistent robot-object occlusions. The resulting videos preserve the interaction structure of human demonstrations in a robot-compatible form and are co-trained with robot demonstrations. Using identical human videos and robot data, we compare against robot-only training and the original Masquerade pipeline. Across four RoboTwin tasks and two Diffusion Policy visual encoders, our method achieves the highest average success rates, with especially strong gains under out-of-distribution scene variation. Real-world deployment further shows that the proposed co-training approach improves robustness to visual distractors when the task geometry is observable, while performance on depth-sensitive grasps remains limited by the single-camera setup.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对人类视频转换为机器人操作数据时交互重建不准与遮挡合成不真实的问题，提出交互感知接触重建与深度感知合成两个模块，生成机器人可用的高质量视频并与机器人演示协同训练，在RoboTwin任务和真机部署中取得更高成功率与更强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 人类视频虽能提供可扩展的操作数据，但人手与机器人末端执行器之间存在本体差异（embodiment gap），无法直接使用。现有视频编辑方法（如Masquerade）用渲染机器人替换手部，却因交互重建不准确与合成不当，产生不一致的抓取和不合乎物理的机器人-物体遮挡。作者从交互几何与场景可见性两个互补的物理层面来解决这些失败。
AI.method: 方法包含两个模块：(1) 交互感知接触重建模块，结合手-物分割与网格级接触预测恢复稠密3D接触，并将其转换为面向平行夹爪的时序稳定抓取；(2) 深度感知合成模块，利用场景与机器人深度信息，强制实现物理一致的机器人-物体遮挡。所生成的视频在保持人类演示交互结构的同时转化为机器人兼容形式，并与机器人演示进行协同训练（co-training）。
AI.result: 在相同人类视频与机器人数据条件下，与仅用机器人数据训练及原始Masquerade流程对比：在四个RoboTwin任务、两种Diffusion Policy视觉编码器上，本方法取得最高平均成功率，且在分布外（out-of-distribution）场景变化下增益尤为显著。真机部署进一步表明，当任务几何可观测时，该协同训练方法提升了对视觉干扰物的鲁棒性；而在深度敏感的抓取任务上，性能仍受单相机设置的限制。
AI.conclusion: 通过从交互几何与场景可见性两方面修复人手-机器人视频转换中的物理不一致，可获得保留人类演示交互结构且机器人兼容的训练数据，并通过与机器人数据协同训练提升策略性能与鲁棒性。主要局限在于单相机设置下深度敏感抓取性能不足，未来可考虑多视角或深度感知增强。

title: Talk, Render, Act: Integrating Social Gesture and Digital Face with Synchronized Speech for Conversational Humanoid Robot
summary: Expressive humanoid interaction requires speech, facial animation, and body gestures to form a coherent response. However, many full-body humanoid robots produce speech and gestures without a visually expressive face, while talking-face animation and robot gesture generation are typically developed separately. We present Talk, Render, Act (TRABot), an agent-based framework comprising specialized agents for motion-atom construction, dialogue generation, motion planning, and facial animation. First, to produce natural and semantically meaningful gestures, we construct Robot-Ready Semantic Motion Atoms by segmenting long-form, G1-retargeted BEAT2 motion into units with natural gesture boundaries, human-verified communicative functions, and feasible trajectories. Second, to preserve semantic order and coordinate body motion with the spoken response, we introduce a Semantic-Conditioned Compositional Planner. Given an ordered semantic function sequence and an estimated response duration, the planner selects approved atoms to realize the longest feasible action sequence while accounting for transitions and neutral recovery. Finally, we deploy a Streaming Face-Speech-Body Integration system on a physical G1 humanoid, combining streaming dialogue audio, audio-driven facial animation, and semantically planned body motion in a unified real-time interaction loop. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that TRAbot achieves the best overall performance among all compared conditions in terms of naturalness, expressiveness, and multimodal coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRABot，一个基于智能体的框架，通过动作原子构建、对话生成、动作规划与面部动画等专用智能体，在物理G1人形机器人上实现语音、面部表情与身体手势协调一致的多模态交互。
AI.motivation: 富有表现力的人形交互需要语音、面部动画与身体手势形成连贯响应。然而，许多全身人形机器人只能产生语音与手势而缺乏视觉表现力的面部，且说话面部动画与机器人手势生成通常被分开开发，缺乏统一的多模态协同。
AI.method: TRABot包含四个专用智能体：动作原子构建、对话生成、动作规划与面部动画。1）将长时G1重定向的BEAT2动作分割为具有自然手势边界、经人工验证交际功能与可行轨迹的单元，构建"机器人就绪语义动作原子"；2）提出语义条件组合规划器，在给定有序语义功能序列与估计响应时长下，选择已批准原子以实现最长可行动作序列，并考虑过渡与中性恢复；3）在物理G1人形机器人上部署流式脸-语音-身体集成系统，将流式对话音频、音频驱动面部动画与语义规划身体动作整合为统一实时交互回路。
AI.result: 定量与定性实验表明，TRABot在自然度、表现力和多模态连贯性方面，在所有对比条件中取得最佳整体性能。
AI.conclusion: TRABot通过智能体化框架有效统一了语音、面部动画与身体手势的生成与集成，验证了语义条件组合规划与流式多模态融合在真实人形机器人交互中的有效性，为协调一致的多模态人形交互提供了可行方案。

title: Controllable and Photorealistic Pedestrian Risky Motion Generation for End-to-End Driving Safety Evaluation
summary: Evaluating end-to-end autonomous driving under rare, safety-critical vehicle-pedestrian interactions requires photorealistic, sensor-level scenarios. However, trajectory-based scenario generators cannot synthesize raw visual observations, whereas video-based approaches lack controllability. To bridge this gap, we present ControlPed, a novel framework that combines trajectory-level conflict synthesis with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) to generate photorealistic, motion-controllable safety-critical scenarios. Built upon HazardPed, a dataset derived from 10,352 traffic videos comprising 422 conflict trajectories, HD maps, and 857 annotated 3D human motions, ControlPed first generates conflict trajectories, lifts them into 3D human motion sequences via text-conditioned motion diffusion, and finally renders multi-view sensor observations using animatable 3DGS avatars. Safety evaluation in 88 rendered photorealistic scenarios reveals that seven leading end-to-end driving models suffer a severe performance drop, with their mean HDScore plunging from 88.8 to 47.4, exposing major failure modes under dangerous pedestrian behaviors. The dataset and testing benchmarks will be released to facilitate safety assessment of vehicle-pedestrian interactions.

AI.tldr: 提出ControlPed框架，将轨迹级冲突合成与3D高斯溅射（3DGS）结合，生成照片级真实、运动可控的安全关键型车-人交互场景，用于端到端自动驾驶安全评估。
AI.motivation: 评估端到端自动驾驶在罕见、安全关键的车辆-行人交互场景中的表现，需要照片级真实、传感器级的数据。然而，基于轨迹的场景生成器无法合成原始视觉观测，而基于视频的方法缺乏可控性，两者之间存在明显空白。
AI.method: ControlPed基于HazardPed数据集（源自10,352段交通视频，包含422条冲突轨迹、高清地图及857个标注的3D人体动作）：首先生成冲突轨迹，通过文本条件运动扩散将其提升为3D人体运动序列，最后利用可动画的3DGS虚拟人渲染多视角传感器观测。
AI.result: 在88个渲染出的照片级真实场景中进行安全评估，七种主流端到端驾驶模型性能严重下降，平均HDScore从88.8骤降至47.4，暴露出在危险行人行为下的主要失效模式。
AI.conclusion: ControlPed填补了轨迹级与视频级场景生成之间的空白，实现了照片级真实且运动可控的安全关键场景生成，可作为车-人交互安全评估的有效基准；数据集与测试基准将公开释放。

title: Arm-wise Compositional Generalization in Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Generalization in multi-arm collaboration can be studied as composing familiar atomic skills in new ways across arms. However, existing evaluations offer limited insight into which training and architectural choices support this ability under different coordination requirements. We introduce \textbf{ACG-Bench}, a benchmark for \emph{Arm-wise Compositional Generalization} that provides a common testbed for studying skill recomposition in dual-arm policies. It contains 23 task--condition pairs across 8 task families, with 6 in-domain conditions and 17 unseen compositions covering reordering, synchronization, their combination, and cross-task composition. All methods receive the same per-arm atomic prompts, and success requires achieving the task goal while satisfying physical milestones and specified order or timing constraints. Using $π_{0.5}$ as a common vision-language-action backbone, we compare representative data-augmentation and architectural strategies with shared source data and a common evaluation protocol. Our architectural study examines arm-token grouping, skill-specific LoRA adapters (SkillLoRA), and arm-wise attention (AWA), highlighting the complementarity of skill-conditioned parameters and attention structure. Combining these choices yields \textbf{AE-VLA}, which achieves 21.53\% generalization success in simulation, compared with 2.94\% for Single $π_{0.5}$, 3.06\% for MA-VLA, and 5.53\% for two independently controlled $π_{0.5}$ policies. On physical SO101 robots, AE-VLA reaches 39.00\% mean success across five unseen conditions, compared with 10.00\% for the strongest baseline. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing dual-arm policies that generalize beyond fixed training routines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ACG-Bench 双臂组合泛化基准，并基于 π0.5 组合 SkillLoRA 与 arm-wise attention，得到 AE-VLA，在仿真与真实 SO101 机器人上显著超越基线。
AI.motivation: 双臂协作中的泛化可视为以新方式组合熟悉的原子技能，但现有评测难以揭示在不同协调需求下何种训练与架构选择支持该能力，缺乏统一测试平台与可比协议。
AI.method: 构建 ACG-Bench，含 8 个任务族、23 个任务-条件对（6 个域内条件，17 个未见组合，涵盖重排序、同步、二者结合及跨任务组合）；所有方法使用相同的单臂原子提示，成功需满足任务目标并达成物理里程碑与顺序/时序约束。以 π0.5 为统一 VLA 骨干，在共享源数据与统一评测协议下比较数据增强与架构策略，考察 arm-token grouping、SkillLoRA、arm-wise attention（AWA）的互补性，并组合为 AE-VLA。
AI.result: 仿真中 AE-VLA 泛化成功率达 21.53%，单 π0.5 为 2.94%，MA-VLA 为 3.06%，两个独立控制的 π0.5 策略为 5.53%；真实 SO101 机器人上，AE-VLA 在 5 个未见条件下平均成功率 39.00%，最强基线为 10.00%。
AI.conclusion: 技能条件化参数与注意力结构具有互补性，本研究为设计超越固定训练流程、具备泛化能力的双臂策略提供了实证指导。

title: STC-MPM: Coupled Deformation, Progressive Damage, and Cut Formation in Soft-Tissue Cutting
summary: Cutting is a recurring operation in robotic au tomation, from food preparation to surgical tissue resection. For highly compliant targets, blade motion may deform or displace the material rather than advance the intended cut, while progressive failure changes load transfer and subsequent tool tissue interaction. A computational description must therefore connect cut formation to the evolving mechanical response, rather than specifying the incision independently of material failure. We present STC-MPM (Soft Tissue Cutting with the Material Point Method), a framework that couples finite-strain deformation, history-driven continuum damage, and configurable post-failure treatment. Damage initiates only when a tensile strain history exceeds a material threshold within the blade process zone. Progressive degradation changes stress transmission before the post-failure policy is applied, while the remaining tissue continues to deform, move, and interact with the tool.
