Numerical scalpel studies using delayed particle deactivation follow this response through insertion and withdrawal. Under identical blade motion, reducing the damage-rate limit leaves the first recorded damage time unchanged but delays and increases peak reaction force, delays particle deactivation, and increases the fixed-cohort displacement statistic at maximum insertion. The matched comparison illustrates how post-initiation failure evolution alters subsequent tool loading and recorded material motion. STC-MPM thus supports joint analysis of cut formation and accompanying tissue response without a pre-inserted cutting interface.

AI.tldr: 本文提出STC-MPM框架，将有限应变变形、历史驱动的连续损伤与可配置的失效后处理耦合，实现软组织中切割形成与力学响应的联合分析。
AI.motivation: 机器人自动化中的切割操作面对高顺应性目标时，刀片运动可能使材料变形或移位而非推进预定切割；渐进失效改变载荷传递与后续刀具-组织交互。计算描述需将切割形成与演化力学响应关联，而非独立于材料失效预先设定切口。
AI.method: STC-MPM耦合有限应变变形、历史驱动连续损伤与可配置失效后处理；仅当刀片过程区内拉伸应变历史超过材料阈值时损伤起始；渐进退化在施加失效后策略前改变应力传递，剩余组织继续变形、移动并与刀具交互；采用延迟粒子失活的数值手术刀研究跟踪插入与退出过程。
AI.result: 相同刀片运动下，降低损伤率上限使首次记录损伤时间不变，但使峰值反力延迟并增大，粒子失活延迟，最大插入处固定队列位移统计量增大。匹配对比表明损伤起始后的失效演化改变后续刀具载荷与记录的材料运动。
AI.conclusion: STC-MPM支持无需预先插入切割界面的切割形成与伴随组织响应的联合分析。

title: Towards Quadruped-Provided Localization and Active Tracking for Micro-UAVs
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Submitted version (before peer review) of a paper accepted at CLAWAR 2026, Cranfield, UK, 14 to 16 September 2026. The published version, titled "Towards Quadruped-Provided Localization and Active Tracking for Nano-UAVs", will appear in the CLAWAR 2026 proceedings (Springer, Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems)
summary: Micro unmanned aerial vehicles (micro-UAVs) are small enough to reach confined spaces that larger robots cannot access, but too small to carry the sensing and computing power required for autonomous flight. We move the localization stack entirely off the aerial platform onto a quadruped robot with a 7-degree-of-freedom (DOF) arm, which supplies the micro-UAV (27 g bare, 42 g with fiducial markers) its full 6-DOF pose. A camera at the arm's end-effector detects AprilTag fiducial markers on the drone and composes that observation with the quadruped's own self-localization to place the drone in a shared map frame, so the ground robot localizes its partner, rather than only tracking it relative to the camera. The arm acts as an actively-controlled observer, repositioning to keep the drone in view as both robots move; the drone carries only an inertial measurement unit and fuses the external pose to fly commanded setpoints. In lab flights the external pose is accurate to 12-16 mm, enough to fly the drone autonomously within 2-5 cm of motion-capture-fed control. Having the quadruped actively follow the drone reduces the tracking error from 11.0 cm to 6.9 cm by holding the camera in the close range, where the markers are most accurate.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将微型无人机定位栈完全卸载到配备7自由度机械臂的四足机器人上，由地面机器人提供无人机的全6自由度位姿，使仅携带IMU的27克无人机实现自主飞行。
AI.motivation: 微型无人机可进入狭小空间，但因体积和载荷限制无法搭载自主飞行所需的传感与计算资源，因此需要外部平台提供定位支持。
AI.method: 机械臂末端相机检测无人机上的AprilTag标记，结合四足机器人自身定位将观测映射至共享地图坐标系；机械臂作为主动观测器调整位姿保持无人机在视野内；无人机仅携带IMU并融合外部位姿跟踪设定点。
AI.result: 实验室飞行中外部位姿精度为12-16 mm，自主飞行控制精度达2-5 cm，接近动捕驱动控制水平；四足主动跟随将跟踪误差从11.0 cm降至6.9 cm。
AI.conclusion: 通过地面机器人主动观测提供外部位姿，可在不增加机载载荷的前提下实现微型无人机自主飞行，且主动跟随能显著提升定位精度。

title: AUTOPILOT An Advanced Perception, Localization and Path Planning Techniques for Autonomous Vehicles Using YOLOv7 and MiDaS
comment: Published in the 2023 International Conference on Advanced Computing Technologies and Applications (ICACTA), IEEE
summary: Self driving vehicles have emerged as a reliable technology that has the capability to transform transportation and mobility. The development of self driving cars requires significant advances in a number of areas, including perception, localization, decision making, and control. This research paper is based on the project implementation of the combination of object detection using YOLO (You Only Look Once), depth sensing using MiDaS for the localization and perception of obstacles, perspective transform, and decision making for path planning in self driving cars. The contemporary state of the technology for object detection, depth sensing, localization, and path planning evaluates the performance of the combined system through simulations and experiments. The results show that the combination of YOLO and MiDaS provides a new robust system for object detection and depth sensing. This research paper contributes to the advancement of self driving car technology and provides new and innovative approaches to the perception and localization of obstacles in the environment. Keywords: YOLO, MiDaS, perception, localization, decision making

AI.tldr: 本文实现了一个结合YOLO目标检测、MiDaS深度估计与透视变换的自动驾驶感知、定位与路径规划系统，并通过仿真与实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶技术的发展需要在感知、定位、决策与控制等多方面取得突破，而障碍物感知与定位是其中的关键环节，需要探索新的技术组合方案。
AI.method: 将YOLO用于目标检测，MiDaS用于深度感知以实现障碍物定位与感知，结合透视变换与决策算法完成路径规划，并构建集成系统进行仿真与实验评估。
AI.result: 仿真与实验结果表明，YOLO与MiDaS的结合构成了一种鲁棒的目标检测与深度感知新方案，系统整体性能得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为自动驾驶技术发展作出贡献，提出了环境障碍物感知与定位的新颖方法。

title: Encoded but Not in Control: Revealing the Grounding Gap in Vision-Language Robot Policies
summary: Instruction following is central to language-conditioned robot policies: language should determine what to do when the same scene permits multiple valid actions. Yet successful execution alone cannot establish whether a policy follows the instruction or infers the task from the scene. We study this ambiguity through scene-preserving instruction interventions, using valid target substitutions, arbitrary nouns, and unrelated sentences while holding the scene fixed. We evaluate vision-language-action (VLA) policies and world-action models (WAMs) in simulation and in real-world experiments. Our analysis addresses three questions: (a) Does task success imply instruction following? When instructions request a different visible object, all evaluated policies predominantly approach and pick up the incorrect original target associated with the scene. (b) Is this failure caused by language insensitivity? Instruction perturbations affect task performance. A layerwise action lens shows intermediate action predictions respond to these perturbations. Linear probes accurately recover instructed targets, indicating modified instructions are encoded despite rarely determining target selection. (c) Why does encoded language fail to control action? Attention analysis indicates weak instruction-token contributions to action generation. Target-token attention can remain focused on the original object, revealing a mismatch between target encoding and visual grounding. UMAP and shared non-negative matrix factorization show target information remains accessible within representations increasingly organized by scene identity. Our findings expose a grounding gap concealed by nominal success and provide a diagnostic framework. They further establish a concrete criterion for progress: policies should reliably follow valid changes in user intent, even when they conflict with scene-favored behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言条件机器人策略是否真正遵循指令，通过场景保持的指令干预实验，在仿真与真实环境中评估VLA策略与世界动作模型，发现任务成功并不等于指令遵循：策略多依赖场景先验而非指令。
AI.motivation: 语言条件机器人策略的核心在于：当同一场景允许多种有效操作时，语言应决定做什么。然而，仅凭成功执行无法判断策略是在遵循指令，还是从场景中推断任务。这种歧义使现有成功指标可能掩盖策略并未真正理解并执行指令的问题，因此需要系统的诊断方法。
AI.method: 采用场景保持的指令干预：在不改变场景的前提下，替换为有效目标、任意名词或无关句子。在仿真与真实实验中对VLA策略和世界动作模型（WAMs）进行评估，并围绕三个问题展开分析：(a) 任务成功是否意味着指令遵循；(b) 失败是否源于语言不敏感；(c) 为何被编码的语言未能控制动作。分析手段包括逐层动作透镜、线性探针、注意力分析、UMAP与共享非负矩阵分解。
AI.result: (a) 当指令要求不同可见物体时，所有被评估策略仍主要接近并抓取与场景关联的原始错误目标。(b) 指令扰动会影响任务表现，逐层动作透镜显示中间动作预测对这些扰动能作出响应，线性探针也能准确恢复被指令的目标，说明修改后的指令已被编码，但很少决定目标选择。(c) 注意力分析显示指令token对动作生成贡献微弱，目标token注意力可能持续聚焦于原始物体，暴露出目标编码与视觉接地之间的不匹配；UMAP与共享非负矩阵分解显示目标信息仍可访问，但表征日益按场景身份组织。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，表面成功掩盖了接地鸿沟（grounding gap），并提供了诊断框架。作者提出一个具体的进步标准：策略应能可靠遵循用户意图的有效变化，即使这些变化与场景偏好行为相冲突。

title: VLA-ZO: Fast Zeroth-Order Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Adapting vision-language-action (VLA) models to deployment-time distribution shifts is important for reliable robotic operation, but conventional first-order adaptation can exceed the memory budget of inference-oriented deployment platforms. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a forward-only alternative with inference-level memory, but accurate gradient estimation requires many perturbation queries, making naive ZO prohibitively slow for large VLA models. We present VLA-ZO, a framework for fast ZO adaptation that exploits the structure of VLA computation. By confining adaptation to the action side, VLA-ZO keeps the expensive vision-language prefix frozen and reuses its conditioning states across perturbation queries and optimizer steps, while schedule-aware prefetching hides state-transfer overhead. On LIBERO camera-viewpoint shifts, VLA-ZO reduces end-to-end adaptation time by 25.59$\times$ at $q=16$ and 32.54$\times$ at $q=64$ relative to baseline ZO, while improving average task success from 48.27% without adaptation to 58.17% and 63.58%, respectively. These results show that making ZO faster can make larger query budgets practical, providing a promising path toward resource-efficient VLA adaptation on deployment platforms.

AI.tldr: VLA-ZO通过将零阶自适应限制在动作侧并复用视觉-语言前缀条件状态，显著加速大规模VLA模型的部署时自适应。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在部署时面临分布偏移，需要自适应以保证可靠操作，但一阶自适应在推理型部署平台上内存超预算；零阶优化内存需求低，却因梯度估计需大量扰动查询而速度过慢。
AI.method: 将自适应限制在动作侧，冻结昂贵的视觉-语言前缀，并在扰动查询与优化器步之间复用其条件状态，同时用调度感知预取隐藏状态传输开销。
AI.result: 在LIBERO相机视角偏移任务上，q=16时端到端自适应时间相比基线ZO减少25.59倍，q=64时减少32.54倍；平均任务成功率从无自适应的48.27%提升至58.17%（q=16）和63.58%（q=64）。
AI.conclusion: 加速ZO使更大的查询预算变得可行，为部署平台上资源高效的VLA自适应提供了可行路径。

title: Future Anchored Verification and Online Recovery for World Action Models
summary: World action models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation. They act by first predicting how a task should be performed and then decoding the actions from that future. However, the remaining actions are invalid once execution drifts from the prediction. Simply replanning from the already out of distribution state rarely restores what the task still requires; existing execution monitors decide when to stop, but not what to restore. We observe that the answer is already in hand: the future the WAM predicted before acting depicts exactly the states it intended to pass through. We introduce FAVOR (Future Anchored Verification and Online Recovery), a lightweight framework that keeps these predicted frames as anchors and uses them for verification and recovery. An Anchor Verifier compares each observation with its anchor, together with the executed actions, to flag deviations that break the task. Anchor-Guided Recovery uses a vision-language model to turn the flagged anchor into a short corrective instruction. Under strengthened instruction guidance, the WAM executes this instruction to return to the intended future. It then resumes the task. FAVOR raises the task success of the base WAM from 97.85% to 98.10% on LIBERO and from 72.60% to 72.98% on LIBERO-Plus without modifying the policy.

AI.tldr: 提出FAVOR框架，将世界动作模型预测的未来帧作为锚点，用于执行偏差验证与在线恢复，在LIBERO上提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）先预测任务应如何执行，再从中解码动作。但一旦执行偏离预测轨迹，剩余动作即失效；而从已分布外的状态重新规划难以恢复任务所需。现有执行监控器只能决定何时停止，无法决定恢复什么。
AI.method: 作者观察到WAM行动前预测的未来已描绘其意图经过的状态，故提出FAVOR（Future Anchored Verification and Online Recovery）。包含：Anchor Verifier，将每次观测与其锚点及已执行动作比对，标出破坏任务的偏差；Anchor-Guided Recovery，用视觉语言模型把被标记的锚点转化为简短纠正指令，WAM在增强指令引导下执行该指令以回到预期未来，再恢复任务。该方法不修改策略。
AI.result: 在不修改策略的前提下，FAVOR将基础WAM的任务成功率从LIBERO的97.85%提升至98.10%，从LIBERO-Plus的72.60%提升至72.98%。
AI.conclusion: FAVOR表明利用WAM自身预测的未来帧作为锚点即可实现轻量级的验证与在线恢复，提升机器人操作任务的鲁棒性与成功率。

title: GAMBIT: Learning to Plan Continuous Multi-Robot Trajectories
summary: GAMBIT is an opening chess move in which a player sacrifices a piece, typically a pawn, to gain a positional advantage later in the game. Analogously, in multi-robot coordination, individual robots may need to forgo locally reward-maximising behaviours to improve overall team performance. Such self-sacrificial behaviours are difficult to capture with manually designed heuristics, particularly in dense, interaction-rich environments. Focusing on double-integrator continuous dynamics, this work studies how to learn such coordinated heuristics over motion primitives for multi-robot trajectory execution. Our framework, GAMBIT, first learns coordinated motion-primitive selection through imitation learning and subsequently fine-tunes the policy through reinforcement learning. We further introduce a safeguarded rollout mechanism with backup trajectories that guarantees collision-free execution at all times. Experiments demonstrate that GAMBIT substantially outperforms a range of baselines, including centralised motion planners and decentralised reactive planners, while exhibiting strong scalability. In particular, it coordinates over a thousand robots with planning latency below a few hundred milliseconds in continuous domains.

AI.tldr: GAMBIT框架通过模仿学习与强化学习结合，学习多机器人运动基元协调策略，并引入带备用轨迹的安全回滚机制，保证全程无碰撞，在密集交互场景中显著优于集中式与去中心化基线，可协调上千机器人、延迟仅数百毫秒。
AI.motivation: 多机器人协调中，个体需牺牲局部最优行为（类似国际象棋弃子）以提升团队整体表现，此类自我牺牲行为难以用人工启发式规则刻画，尤其在密集、交互频繁的环境中更为困难。
AI.method: 聚焦双积分器连续动力学，将多机器人轨迹执行建模为运动基元上的协调启发式学习：先通过模仿学习获得协调的运动基元选择策略，再用强化学习对该策略进行微调；同时设计带备用轨迹的安全回滚机制，确保执行过程始终无碰撞。
AI.result: 实验表明GAMBIT显著优于集中式运动规划器与去中心化反应式规划器等多类基线，且扩展性强：在连续域中协调超过一千个机器人，规划延迟低于数百毫秒。
AI.conclusion: 结合模仿学习与强化学习、并辅以安全回滚机制的运动基元级协调框架，能够有效学得自我牺牲式协同启发式，在大规模密集多机器人系统中兼顾性能、安全性与可扩展性。

title: Inspect Robots: Evaluating the Capabilities and Safety of Embodied AI
comment: Submitted to The Science of Physical AI Safety (SPAIS) Workshop at CoRL 2026
summary: General purpose language models are increasingly able to control robotic hardware. Understanding the capabilities and safety of these models when embodied is therefore increasingly important for understanding their societal impact and risks. To this end, we introduce Inspect Robots, a modular, open-source framework for developing and running evaluations of embodied agents. Inspect Robots pairs customizable, reusable abstractions for specifying physical evaluations and analyzing their results with infrastructure that automates evaluation setup, execution and termination. We demonstrate Inspect Robots by using it to evaluate the capabilities and safety of six policies based on frontier language models. Inspect Robots has seen significant early uptake, receiving nearly 100,000 downloads in the three months since its release.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Inspect Robots，一个用于对具身智能体进行评估的模块化开源框架，并利用它评估了六个基于前沿语言模型的策略的能力与安全性。
AI.motivation: 通用语言模型正越来越多地用于控制机器人硬件，因此理解这些模型具身后的能力与安全性，对于评估其社会影响和风险愈发重要。（现有工作缺乏系统化的评估工具。）
AI.method: 作者设计并实现了 Inspect Robots：它结合了可定制、可复用的抽象（用于指定物理评估并分析结果）与自动化评估流程的基础设施（自动完成评估的搭建、执行与终止）。
AI.result: 作者使用该框架对六个基于前沿语言模型的策略进行了能力与安全性评估；该框架在发布后三个月内获得近 10 万次下载，显示出较早的广泛采用。
AI.conclusion: Inspect Robots 为具身智能体的标准化评估提供了开源、模块化的基础设施，并已被社区快速采纳，有助于推动对具身语言模型能力与安全性的系统研究。

title: Dual Variational Autoencoders for Efficient Sim-to-Real Transfer in Low-Cost Robotic Navigation
comment: 30 pages, 13 figures. Published in Image and Vision Computing under a CC BY 4.0 license
summary: Vision-based autonomous navigation for low-cost robots remains a fundamental challenge, primarily due to the significant gap between simulated training environments and real-world operational conditions. Direct policy transfer from simulation is often ineffective, while training exclusively on real data is impractical. We propose a hybrid transfer learning framework that effectively bridges the sim-to-real gap by combining domain randomization with feature-level domain adaptation. Our method employs a dual convolutional variational autoencoder architecture with a shared decoder, trained on an extensive set of 45225 simulated images and a minimal set of only 4556 real-world samples. This architecture learns a compact, common latent representation space that aligns the distributions of both domains. The adaptation process is further enhanced by two complementary data augmentation techniques designed to expand the limited real-world data. Experimental evaluation demonstrates that our method achieves an average success rate of almost 91% on image classification tasks for real-world indoor navigation, significantly outperforming both simulation-only and real-world-only training. We validate these findings through a direct, real-world deployment, where the proposed policy successfully guides a low-cost robot in a reactive exploration task. Furthermore, we validate the model's efficiency through a rigorous computational estimation, confirming its suitability for resource-constrained embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4 and NVIDIA Jetson Nano. This work presents a practical solution for developing effective and efficient navigation policies for low-cost robotic systems.

AI.tldr: 提出混合迁移学习框架，结合域随机化与特征级域适应，用双卷积VAE共享解码器对齐仿真与真实域，仅需少量真实样本即实现低成本机器人室内导航，分类成功率约91%。
AI.motivation: 低成本机器人的视觉自主导航面临仿真到真实（sim-to-real）的显著域差异：纯仿真策略迁移效果差，而仅用真实数据训练又不现实，因此需要一种能有效弥合域差距的方法。
AI.method: 提出混合迁移学习框架，融合域随机化与特征级域适应。采用双卷积变分自编码器（VAE）架构并共享解码器，在45225张仿真图像与仅4556张真实样本上训练，学习紧凑的公共隐空间以对齐两域分布；并引入两种互补的数据增强技术扩充有限的真实数据。
AI.result: 在真实室内导航图像分类任务上平均成功率达约91%，显著优于仅仿真训练与仅真实训练。通过真实机器人部署，策略成功完成反应式探索任务；计算开销评估验证其适用于树莓派4与NVIDIA Jetson Nano等资源受限嵌入式平台。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为低成本机器人系统提供了一种实用、高效的导航策略开发方案，证明通过共享隐空间的特征级对齐与数据增强，可有效弥合sim-to-real差距并满足嵌入式部署需求。

title: DexForge: High-Fidelity Physics-Informed Dexterous Retargeting
summary: Human demonstrations offer rich examples of precise dexterous manipulation and a promising source of robot training data. However, high-fidelity reproduction of demonstrated motions and hand-object interactions across robot embodiments remains challenging under physical constraints. We present DexForge, a differentiable physics-grounded framework for converting human video demonstrations into high-fidelity robot trajectories. We reconstruct spherical-Gaussian object models and hand-object motion from visual observations, then build a differentiable simulator combining efficient Gaussian collision detection with existing differentiable dynamics. Based on this simulator, DexForge combines contact-aware kinematic retargeting with force-aware dynamics retargeting: robot-adapted stable contacts guide kinematic reference construction and subsequent gradient-based control refinement for precise physical motion reproduction. Experiments on 130 DexYCB and HOT3D demonstrations across seven dexterous hands show success-rate gains of approximately 35-53 percentage points over the baseline, with object position and orientation tracking errors on successful trajectories reduced by approximately 34-67% and 71-78%, respectively. Further experiments demonstrate open-loop transfer to MuJoCo and real-robot execution. Our project page is available at https://wmz1226.github.io/DexForge/

AI.tldr: DexForge 是一个基于可微物理的框架，将人类视频演示转换为高保真机器人轨迹；通过球面高斯物体重建、可微仿真、接触感知运动学重定向与力感知动力学重定向，实现灵巧操作动作的精确复现。
AI.motivation: 人类演示是灵巧操作的重要训练数据来源，但在物理约束下，跨机器人本体实现高保真的动作复现与手-物交互仍很困难。
AI.method: 从视觉观测重建球面高斯物体模型与手-物运动；构建结合高效高斯碰撞检测与可微动力学的可微仿真器；在此之上结合接触感知的运动学重定向与力感知的动力学重定向：以机器人适配的稳定接触引导运动学参考构建，并通过基于梯度的控制优化实现精确的物理运动复现。
AI.result: 在 DexYCB 与 HOT3D 的 130 个演示、七种灵巧手上，成功率较基线提升约 35-53 个百分点；成功轨迹上物体位置与姿态跟踪误差分别降低约 34-67% 与 71-78%；并验证了向 MuJoCo 的开环迁移与真机执行。
AI.conclusion: DexForge 表明可微物理仿真结合接触与力感知重定向，能有效缩小人类演示到机器人高保真灵巧操作的差距，并具备仿真到真机的迁移能力。

title: Towards Robust Prehensile Manipulation in Open-Ended Environments
comment: 3 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 7th International Workshop on Intrinsically Motivated Open-ended Learning (IMOL 2025)
summary: We propose to use Quality-Diversity (QD) algorithms to solve robotic prehensile manipulation tasks in open-ended environments. Our approach enables the efficient discovery of a wide range robust grasp configurations, which serve as reliable starting points for generating diverse prehensile manipulation trajectories on articulated objects. The resulting diversity in manipulation behaviors enhances generalization and adaptability, enabling effective deployment continuously evolving open-world settings.

AI.tldr: 提出用质量-多样性（QD）算法解决开放环境中机器人抓取式操作任务，高效发现鲁棒抓取配置并生成多样化操作轨迹。
AI.motivation: 开放、持续演化的环境要求机器人具备泛化性与适应性，而传统方法难以高效获得兼具鲁棒性和多样性的抓取配置与操作轨迹。
AI.method: 采用Quality-Diversity（QD）算法，首先高效发现大量且鲁棒的抓取配置，将其作为可靠起点，进而为关节物体（articulated objects）生成多样化的抓取式操作轨迹。
AI.result: 获得了宽广范围（wide range）的鲁棒抓取配置，并生成了多样的抓取式操作轨迹，形成多样化的操作行为。
AI.conclusion: 操作行为的多样性提升了泛化能力与适应性，使机器人能够在持续演化的开放世界环境中有效部署。

title: Visual Swarm Navigation via Deep Reinforcement Learning and Evolutionary Hybrid Design
comment: 46 pages, 21 figures. Published in Engineering Applications of Artificial Intelligence under a CC BY 4.0 license
summary: Swarm robotics presents a robust and cost-effective paradigm for advanced automation in complex, dynamic environments, such as those encountered in search and rescue or environmental monitoring. A fundamental challenge for this field is the data-driven design of decentralized controllers capable of generating emergent collective behaviors. This paper proposes a novel, AI-driven hybrid methodology for the automatic synthesis of swarm robotic controllers for autonomous visual navigation. This approach synergistically combines multi-agent reinforcement learning with neuro-evolutionary strategies, specifically leveraging implementations of the cross-entropy method and the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy to optimize a pre-trained individual navigation policy. The underlying deep architecture is engineered for low-cost, resource-constrained platforms, utilizing a compact neural network that relies exclusively on monocular camera imagery. This vision-based design emphasizes computational and energy efficiency, a critical requirement for practical swarm deployments. Experiments, performed in a high-fidelity physics simulator, demonstrate that the resulting controllers enable robust and scalable collective exploration of diverse indoor environments. The controller trained using our cross-entropy method achieves superior exploration coverage, visiting 36.20% more regions compared to the covariance matrix adaptation evolution strategy. Critically, our best vision-based policy achieves exploration performance statistically comparable to traditional methods relying on more expensive distance sensors, while delivering a significant 31.40% average reduction in energy consumption. These findings validate an effective and economically viable autonomous control system, establishing a path for deploying highly efficient collective intelligence in real-world engineering applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合多智能体强化学习与神经进化策略（CEM与CMA-ES）的混合方法，自动合成基于单目视觉的群体机器人去中心化导航控制器，在仿真中实现高效、可扩展的集体探索，性能与距离传感器方案相当且能耗降低31.40%。
AI.motivation: 群体机器人在搜索救援、环境监测等复杂动态场景中具有鲁棒、低成本优势，但如何以数据驱动方式设计能产生涌现集体行为的去中心化控制器仍是核心难题；同时实际部署要求控制器在资源受限平台上兼具计算与能效优势。
AI.method: 提出AI驱动的混合方法：将多智能体强化学习与神经进化策略协同结合，具体采用交叉熵方法（CEM）与协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（CMA-ES）优化一个预训练的单体导航策略；底层采用紧凑神经网络，仅依赖单目相机图像，面向低成本、资源受限平台设计。
AI.result: 在高保真物理仿真器中，控制器实现了对多种室内环境的鲁棒、可扩展集体探索；CEM训练的控制器探索覆盖率比CMA-ES高36.20%；最优视觉策略的探索性能与传统距离传感器方法统计上相当，同时平均能耗降低31.40%。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了一种有效且经济可行的自主控制系统，为在真实工程应用中部署高效集体智能提供了路径。

title: A Taxonomy on Collective Awareness
summary: As robotic teams tackle increasingly complex tasks in dynamic and unstructured environments, effective coordination requires agents to maintain accurate, aligned representations of their environment, teammates, and mission state. We argue that Mutual Awareness, Shared Situational Awareness, and Team Situational Awareness --- three concepts widely invoked in the multi-robot systems literature --- are not interchangeable: they form a containment hierarchy in which each type subsumes the previous in scope, and span a distribution spectrum from fully individualized understanding (MA) to fully uniform understanding (SSA), with TSA occupying a mixed position. We establish this through a two-dimensional taxonomy organized along the object of awareness and awareness distribution axes. Treating these terms as synonyms obscures the precise coordination requirements each imposes on a robotic system. A Search and Rescue case study with heterogeneous aerial and ground robots grounds each taxonomy position in concrete coordination requirements. These findings provide a conceptual foundation for principled specification, design, and comparison of collective awareness in multi-robot systems.

AI.tldr: 该文辨析多机器人系统中MA、SSA、TSA三个常被混用的概念，提出它们构成包含层级与分布谱系，并用二维分类法与搜救案例加以界定。
AI.motivation: 多机器人团队在动态非结构化环境中执行复杂任务，需要智能体对环境、队友与任务状态保持准确且对齐的表征；而文献中Mutual Awareness、Shared Situational Awareness、Team Situational Awareness常被当作同义词使用，模糊了各自对系统协调提出的具体要求。
AI.method: 提出一个二维分类框架，轴为"意识对象"（object of awareness）与"意识分布"（awareness distribution）；据此论证三者并非可互换，而是构成包含层级（每种类型在范围上涵盖前者）并跨越从完全个体化理解（MA）到完全统一理解（SSA）的分布谱系，TSA处于混合位置；并以异构空中与地面机器人的搜救（Search and Rescue）案例研究将每个分类位置对应到具体协调需求。
AI.result: 通过分类法确立了MA、SSA、TSA之间的层级与谱系关系，并借助异构空地机器人搜救案例，为每个分类位置给出具体的协调需求对应。
AI.conclusion: 三者不应被视为同义词；该区分为多机器人系统中集体意识的原则性规范、设计与比较提供了概念基础。

title: Odyssey: A Closed-Loop Benchmark for Long-Horizon Real-World Driving with Explicit Navigation Routes
summary: Closed-loop evaluation of end-to-end driving requires continuous rollouts that reveal how earlier decisions affect subsequent driving. However, existing benchmarks evaluate only short segments and fail to capture later consequences. Ambiguous directional commands also obscure the intended navigation objective. We introduce Odyssey, a closed-loop benchmark for long-horizon driving comprising 100 scenarios, each reconstructed from a 100-second nuPlan driving log to preserve the context of navigation maneuvers and traffic interactions. To provide a consistent navigation objective, Odyssey replaces directional commands with explicit standard-definition (SD) map routes that specify which roads to follow, while sensor-based planning determines local driving actions. Throughout these rollouts, diffusion-based refinement of 3DGS-rendered images reduces rendering artifacts along the ego trajectory. To assess how effectively planners follow these routes and prepare for upcoming maneuvers, we introduce SD Route Compliance and Pre-Lane Change Score. These assessments are complemented by RouteDS, which extends the Driving Score with penalties for SD-route deviations and failed lane preparation. We adapt state-of-the-art planners, including vision-language-action (VLA) models, and evaluate their navigation performance using these metrics. Odyssey highlights open questions in route representation and integration for E2E driving. Benchmark code and adapted baselines will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Odyssey——一个面向端到端自动驾驶的长时程闭环基准，包含100个从nuPlan 100秒日志重建的场景，用显式SD地图路线替代方向指令作为导航目标，并提出SD Route Compliance、Pre-Lane Change Score及RouteDS指标，评测VLA等先进规划器。
AI.motivation: 现有闭环评测仅评估短片段，无法揭示早期决策对后续驾驶的长期影响；同时模糊的方向指令掩盖了真实导航目标，导致难以判断规划器是否遵循预期路线并做好换道等机动准备。
AI.method: 构建包含100个场景的闭环基准，每个场景由100秒nuPlan驾驶日志重建，以保留导航机动与交通交互的上下文。用显式标准定义（SD）地图路线替换方向指令以给定一致导航目标，局部驾驶动作仍由传感器规划决定。对3DGS渲染图像进行基于扩散的精修以减少自车轨迹上的渲染伪影。新增SD Route Compliance与Pre-Lane Change Score指标，并扩展得到RouteDS。适配包括VLA模型在内的先进规划器进行评测。
AI.result: 使用所提指标对包括视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在内的先进规划器进行导航性能评测，Odyssey揭示了端到端驾驶在路线表示与集成方面仍存在的开放问题。
AI.conclusion: 长时程闭环评测与显式路线目标对端到端自动驾驶评测至关重要；Odyssey基准代码与适配的基线模型将公开发布，以推动路线表示与集成研究。

title: Traversability-Aware Cooperative Path Planning for Human-UGV Casualty Evacuation
summary: Heterogeneous multi-robot path planning is a well-studied problem in which agents with disparate kinematic and dynamic models must coordinate to achieve shared objectives. These formulations, however, treat all agents as robotic-their cost models are mechanical and their traversability is sensor-derived. In human-robot teaming, the human partner remains relegated to command and supervisory roles rather than being modeled as a physical co-navigator with distinct mobility constraints and dynamic energy reserves. This work investigates joint path planning for a two-agent human-UGV team in search-and-rescue casualty retrieval scenarios. We model the human agent using the Pandolf-Santee metabolic cost model with fatigue-modulated speed, and the UGV using a rolling-resistance energy model with terrain-dependent speed limits. By exploiting the complementary traversability of each agent-the human's ability to traverse dense vegetation and shallow water versus the UGV's superior speed on open terrain and roads-we optimize casualty transfer locations, termed switch points, to minimize total mission time. Evaluated across multiple synthetic 1km2 environments with procedurally generated elevation and land-cover data, the optimized strategy reduces mean mission time by 5.3% relative to a human-only baseline and by 7.0% relative to a naive human-UGV strategy without switch point optimization, while reducing human energy expenditure by 17.8% relative to baseline. Notably, the naive strategy reduces human energy expenditure by a larger margin (22.4%) but incurs a 2% increase in mission time relative to baseline, illustrating that switch point optimization is necessary to realize time savings from human-UGV teaming.

AI.tldr: 本文研究人-UGV双智能体团队在搜救伤员转运中的联合路径规划，首次将人类建模为具有代谢代价与疲劳约束的物理协同导航者，通过优化切换点实现时间与能耗的平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有多机器人路径规划将智能体均视为机器人，代价模型为机械性的、可通行性来自传感器；在人机团队中，人往往被降级为指挥与监督角色，未被建模为具有独立移动约束和动态能量储备的物理协同导航者。
AI.method: 针对双智能体人-UGV团队建立联合路径规划：人类采用Pandolf-Santee代谢代价模型并引入疲劳调制速度，UGV采用滚动阻力能量模型并设地形相关速度上限；利用两者互补可通行性（人可穿越密植被与浅水，UGV在开阔地与道路上速度更优），优化称作切换点（switch point）的伤员交接位置以最小化总任务时间。
AI.result: 在多个合成1 km²环境（高程与土地覆盖数据由程序生成）上评估：优化策略相对纯人基线平均任务时间减少5.3%，相对未优化切换点的朴素人-UGV策略减少7.0%，同时相对基线使人体能耗降低17.8%。朴素策略能耗降幅更大（22.4%），但任务时间比基线增加2%。
AI.conclusion: 切换点优化是实现人-UGV团队时间收益的必要条件；仅引入UGV而不优化交接位置虽能大幅节省人体能耗，却会牺牲任务时间，因此需在时间与能耗之间进行显式联合优化。

title: MarvisNav: Making Memory Visible on Route Choices for Zero-Shot Object Navigation
summary: When searching for an object, people choose their next move by considering both likely target locations and places already explored. The current view can cue place-associated memories, bringing target relevance and prior exploration into the same spatial context. In many zero-shot object navigation (ZSON) methods, however, vision-language models (VLMs) infer promising search areas from egocentric images, while exploration history is represented separately, e.g., as text or maps. This separation either requires an additional fusion step or leaves the correspondence between memory and route choices implicit for the VLM to recover. We instead make exploration memory directly visible on visual route choices. We propose MarvisNav, a ZSON framework that maintains a topological graph and projects candidate nodes together with their exploration states onto egocentric views as memory-bearing visual route choices. These states capture local exploration progress beyond binary visitation. By binding exploration state directly to each visual candidate, MarvisNav enables the VLM to jointly evaluate target relevance and exploration state without a separate post-hoc fusion or reranking stage. Without policy training, MarvisNav achieves state-of-the-art performance on HM3D (81.2% SR and 42.5% SPL), while remaining competitive on MP3D. It also outperforms representative VLM-based methods with far fewer VLM calls (e.g., 7.5% of WMNav). Real-robot experiments across diverse scenes further validate its practical deployability. Beyond MarvisNav, our study shows that memory representation shapes VLM decisions and ZSON performance, highlighting that effective memory use depends not only on its availability, but also on how it is represented. Code and project page will be available at \url{https://wangjincheng1998.github.io/MarvisNav/}.

AI.tldr: 提出MarvisNav框架，将探索记忆直接投影到第一视角的视觉路径选项上，无需额外融合，VLM可联合评估目标相关性与探索状态，在HM3D上达到81.2% SR和42.5% SPL。
AI.motivation: ZSON中，VLM从第一视角图像推断搜索区域，而探索历史多以文本或地图单独表示，两者的分离需要额外融合步骤，或使记忆与路线选择的对应关系对VLM而言过于隐式。研究希望让探索记忆直接在视觉路线选项上可见。
AI.method: MarvisNav维护拓扑图，将候选节点及其探索状态投影到第一视角视图上，形成带有记忆信息的视觉路径选项。探索状态捕获超越二元访问的局部探索进度，并将状态与每个视觉候选绑定，使VLM无需事后融合或重排序即可联合评估目标相关性与探索状态，且不进行策略训练。
AI.result: 在HM3D上取得81.2% SR和42.5% SPL的SOTA性能，在MP3D上保持竞争力；以远少于对比方法的VLM调用次数（如WMNav的7.5%）超越代表性VLM方法；多场景真机实验验证了实际部署可行性。
AI.conclusion: 记忆表示方式会影响VLM决策与ZSON性能，有效的记忆利用不仅取决于记忆是否可用，还取决于其如何被表示。

title: ArtifactArena: Evaluating Models by What They Build in the Physical World
summary: To evaluate the frontier, we must measure models not by what they say, but by what they can engineer and build in grounded physical environments. We introduce \textsc{ArtifactArena}, an open-ended platform where models face a physically grounded hardware-software co-design challenge: engineering fully functional robots to compete in a simulated arena. We evaluate a frontier model's zero-shot, verifier guided refinement, and open-ended physical design capabilities through three harnesses that refine their bot artifacts based on text descriptions, physics simulator feedback, and gameplay data. We benchmark these capabilities with an Elo ranking of frontier models derived from head-to-head tournaments between their artifacts. By releasing this framework and tournament infrastructure for ongoing community submissions, we establish a living, non-saturating testbed to continuously measure the expanding limits of open-ended intelligence in the physical world. Please visit \href{https://artifactarena.ai}{https://artifactarena.ai} for more information.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ArtifactArena，一个开放式、物理落地的软硬件协同设计评测平台：模型需从零工程化构建可在模拟竞技场中竞赛的功能性机器人，并通过三种 harness（零样本、验证器引导的迭代、开放式物理设计）考察前沿模型能力，并以对战产生的 Elo 排名进行基准化。
AI.motivation: 作者认为评估前沿模型不应只看其言辞，而应看其在真实物理环境中能工程化建造出什么，因此需要一个持续、不饱和、可度量开放式智能在物理世界中极限的评测平台。
AI.method: 构建 ArtifactArena 开放式平台，设置物理落地的软硬件协同设计任务：模型设计完整可用的机器人并在模拟竞技场对抗。通过三个 harness 对其 bot 产物进行迭代精炼：基于文本描述、基于物理模拟器反馈、基于对局数据。并用模型产物之间头对头锦标赛导出的 Elo 排名来基准化能力，同时开放框架与锦标赛基础设施供社区持续提交。
AI.result: 给出了基于模型产物对抗锦标赛的 Elo 排名，用以度量前沿模型在零样本、验证器引导精炼与开放式物理设计三方面的能力，并将平台与锦标赛基础设施开放。
AI.conclusion: ArtifactArena 形成一个持续运行、不易饱和的评测基准，可长期度量开放式智能在物理世界中不断扩展的能力边界。

title: SimForcing: Distilling Simulation Motion Priors into Real-Domain Robot World Models
summary: Action-conditioned robot world models must respond precisely to robot trajectories while preserving realistic visual dynamics, yet learning both from heterogeneous robot videos remains challenging. Simulation offers structured motion supervision, but appearance differences hinder direct transfer, and inaccurate simulation predictions can misguide real-video generation. We present SimForcing, a simulation-guided framework that uses simulation both as a source of transferable motion knowledge and as a controllable reference for prediction. First, we transfer motion knowledge from a simulation teacher through latent-motion distillation, aligning temporal changes in latent space to internalize motion priors while mitigating the influence of appearance differences. Second, we introduce multi-block simulation conditioning with condition dropout to exploit predicted simulation trajectories without relying excessively on their accuracy. Our simulation-conditioning classifier-free guidance scheme unifies these two ideas by balancing predictions based on internalized motion knowledge with those additionally guided by simulation latents. The jointly trained student generates both simulation conditions and real-domain videos, requiring no additional world model at inference. On Bridge, SimForcing achieves the best PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FVD among the compared methods without external embodied pretraining. Evaluation on InternData-A1 further supports its applicability across robot datasets. Moreover, using our trained world model to initialize a vision-language-action model improves LIBERO success, suggesting its utility for downstream policy learning. \url{https://github.com/Wang-Xiaodong1899/SimForcing}

AI.tldr: SimForcing：一种仿真引导的机器人世界模型框架，通过潜在运动蒸馏与多块仿真条件建模，兼顾动作响应精度与真实视觉动态，无需外部具身预训练即在Bridge上取得最优指标。
AI.motivation: 动作条件机器人世界模型需同时满足两点：对机器人轨迹精确响应、保持真实视觉动态。然而从异构机器人视频中同时学到二者很困难：仿真提供结构化运动监督，但外观差异阻碍直接迁移，且不准确的仿真预测会误导真实视频生成。
AI.method: 提出SimForcing仿真引导框架，将仿真同时作为可迁移运动知识来源与可控预测参考：(1) 通过潜空间运动蒸馏从仿真教师模型迁移运动知识，对齐潜空间中的时序变化以内化运动先验，缓解外观差异影响；(2) 引入多块仿真条件与条件dropout，利用预测的仿真轨迹而不对其精度过度依赖；(3) 提出仿真条件无分类器引导（CFG）统一上述两点，在基于内化运动知识的预测与额外由仿真潜变量引导的预测之间进行平衡。学生模型联合训练，可同时生成仿真条件与真实域视频，推理时无需额外世界模型。
AI.result: 在Bridge数据集上，SimForcing在PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS、FVD四项指标上均优于对比方法，且未使用外部具身预训练；在InternData-A1上的评估进一步验证了其跨机器人数据集的适用性；此外，用所训练的世界模型初始化视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型可提升LIBERO任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 仿真引导的运动知识蒸馏与仿真条件引导相结合，可有效提升动作条件世界模型的生成质量与动作响应能力，并可为下游策略学习提供有益初始化，具备跨数据集泛化潜力。

title: Physics Residual Dynamics and Reduced Order Whole-Body Planning for Obstacle Aware Human Robot Cloth CoTransportation
summary: Human--robot co-transportation of deformable objects requires predicting object deformation during motion, since obstacle clearance depends on both the grasp points and the unactuated interior. We present a hierarchical planning framework that combines a learned cloth model with a reduced-order whole-body model of a dual-arm mobile manipulator. A physics-residual conditional recurrent variational autoencoder (p-cRVAE) predicts the full cloth configuration from grasp-point observations by learning a residual correction to a computationally efficient linearized physics model, limiting error accumulation over 40-step planning horizon. The predicted cloth dynamics are embedded in a model predictive path integral (MPPI) planner using a reduced-order representation of a dual-arm mobile manipulator that preserves the non-holonomic base constraint and arm workspace limits. An MPC layer subsequently refines the sampled motion into smooth, executable references for whole-body control. The reduced-order formulation achieves tracking performance comparable to the full 17-DoF model while reducing computation time by approximately 80%. Across four co-transportation scenarios and two carrying speeds, the proposed framework maintains cloth-obstacle clearance where a corner-following baseline results in collisions, while whole-body refinement reduces final cloth deformation from 0.93\,m to 0.28\,m.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层规划框架，将学习到的布料模型与双臂移动机械臂的降阶全身模型结合，用于人-机器人协同搬运可变形物体，实现高效预测与规划。
AI.motivation: 人-机器人协同搬运可变形物体时，障碍通过性依赖抓取点与未驱动内部区域，需要预测运动中的物体形变。现有方法难以兼顾预测精度与计算效率，且全身模型计算代价高。
AI.method: 1) 物理残差条件循环变分自编码器（p-cRVAE）：基于抓取点观测，通过学习对高效线性化物理模型的残差修正来预测完整布料构型，抑制40步规划时域上的误差累积；2) 将预测的布料动力学嵌入基于双臂移动机械臂降阶表示的MPPI规划器，保留非完整底座约束与机械臂工作空间限制；3) 由MPC层将采样运动细化为平滑、可执行的全身控制参考。
AI.result: 降阶模型跟踪性能与完整17自由度模型相当，计算时间减少约80%；在四种协同搬运场景和两种搬运速度下，本框架保持布料-障碍间隙（角点跟踪基线发生碰撞），全身细化使最终布料形变从0.93 m降至0.28 m。
AI.conclusion: 该分层框架通过物理残差学习与降阶全身建模，兼顾布料形变预测精度与规划效率，有效提升人-机器人协同搬运可变形物体的避障能力与运输质量。

title: AffordCraft: Scalable Construction of Task-Ready Simulation Assets from Single Images
comment: 33 pages, 14 figures, 17 tables. Project page: https://affordcraft.github.io Code: https://github.com/AffordCraft/AffordCraft
summary: Robot learning in simulation depends on the objects the simulator offers. Many tasks need objects with separate parts, joints that allow the required motion, and physical properties that remain valid under contact. Existing methods recover this structure anew for every image: generative models predict parts and joints that mostly fail to settle or move in simulation, and general-purpose agents need a long session of model calls for each photograph. AffordCraft builds such an asset from a single RGB image and a task instruction by retrieval instead of generation: it locates the object and the part to operate, selects a matching entry from a library of articulated assets, and fits it to the image while keeping its parts and joints intact. Without any box or mask marking the object, AffordCraft produces a physically valid asset for 1,703 of 2,000 photographs from 31 categories. Five generative methods pass on at most 45% of the same photographs and, at the median, need 10 to 78 times our GPU time per valid asset. On 50 cluttered images, 162 of 237 annotated objects pass the same physical test after automatic detection. Growing the library from 141 to 11,372 entries needs no change to the method and raises category coverage from 46% to 100% and the share of selections with the requested label from 18% to 51%. We also build manipulation tasks from the constructed assets, both with single objects and in composed scenes; policies trained on scripted demonstrations complete both kinds of tasks from initial states unseen in training.

AI.tldr: AffordCraft 通过“检索而非生成”的方式，从单张 RGB 图像和任务指令构建物理有效的铰接式物体资产，在 2000 张照片中 1703 张成功，显著优于生成式方法和通用智能体。
AI.motivation: 仿真中的机器人学习依赖模拟器提供的物体，而许多任务需要具有独立部件、关节及在接触下保持有效物理属性的物体。现有方法对每张图像重新恢复该结构：生成模型预测的部件和关节大多无法在仿真中稳定或运动，通用智能体则需对每张照片进行长时间模型调用。因此需要一种更可靠、更高效的资产生成方法。
AI.method: AffordCraft 基于单张 RGB 图像和任务指令，通过检索构建资产而非生成：定位物体及待操作部件，从铰接式资产库中选择匹配条目，并将其拟合到图像上，同时保持其部件和关节完整。该方法无需标注物体的边界框或掩码。
AI.result: 在来自 31 个类别的 2000 张照片中，AffordCraft 为 1703 张生成物理有效资产；五种生成方法在同一批照片上通过率至多 45%，且每个有效资产的中位 GPU 时间为该方法的 10 至 78 倍。在 50 张杂乱图像中，自动检测后 237 个标注物体中有 162 个通过相同物理测试。资产库从 141 增至 11372 条目无需改动方法，类别覆盖率从 46% 提升至 100%，所选资产含请求标签的比例从 18% 提升至 51%。该方法还构建了单物体及组合场景的操作任务，基于脚本演示训练的策略能在训练中未见的初始状态下完成两类任务。
AI.conclusion: AffordCraft 通过检索式方法高效生成物理有效的铰接式资产，在成功率和计算成本上均优于生成式方法，且可通过扩充资产库无改动地提升覆盖率和标签匹配率，并支持构建可用于策略学习的操作任务。

title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
summary: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration video shows it, but fits poorly into an agent's context. The full video slows every turn, fixed keyframes lose the contact detail that decides whether a grasp holds, and what the agent needs shifts from the task's structure while planning to the frames around each contact. We introduce Recursive Video In-Context Learning (RV-ICL), a training-free method that turns a demonstration into a hierarchy the agent navigates rather than a prompt it receives. The hierarchy is built from the sub-events of the demonstration, such as grasps and releases. Its levels grow finer, from keyframes of the whole task to phases, moments and short clips, and are exposed through read-only tools. The agent reads the coarse levels before planning. During execution it re-enters the hierarchy whenever a step needs more detail and loads only the clip of its current sub-goal. One demonstration per task is enough. Built on RPent, RV-ICL raises success from 92.6% to 96.5% on LIBERO-PRO and from 86.7% to 95.8% on LIBERO-Plus.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出RV-ICL（Recursive Video In-Context Learning），一种免训练方法，将演示视频组织为可递归导航的层级结构，使LLM智能体按需读取粗粒度关键帧与细粒度接触片段，从而提升冻结VLA策略的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体通过文本记忆跨情节改进，但只能记录"做了什么"而非"如何完成"；演示视频虽能补充"如何做"，却难以嵌入智能体上下文：完整视频拖慢每次决策，固定关键帧丢失决定抓取成败的接触细节，且智能体需求随阶段变化——规划时需要任务结构，执行接触时需要接触帧。
AI.method: RV-ICL把演示视频转化为层级结构而非一次性提示。层级基于演示的子事件（如抓取、释放）构建，从全任务关键帧到阶段、时刻、短片段逐级细化，并通过只读工具暴露给智能体。智能体规划前读取粗层级；执行时在需要更多细节的步骤重新进入层级，仅加载当前子目标的片段。每任务仅需一个演示。方法构建于RPent之上，无需训练。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-PRO上成功率从92.6%提升至96.5%，在LIBERO-Plus上从86.7%提升至95.8%。
AI.conclusion: 将演示视频作为可递归导航的层级而非静态提示，能在不训练的情况下有效注入"如何完成"的知识，按需提供合适粒度的视觉上下文，显著提升冻结VLA策略在长时程操作任务上的表现。

title: InterMimicGen: Scaling Humanoid Loco-Manipulation through Self-Evolving Motion Imitation
summary: Captured human-object interactions provide rich supervision for humanoid loco-manipulation, but they are sparse, heterogeneous, and not directly executable by robots. We introduce InterMimicGen, a self-evolving motion-imitation framework in which robot motion data and a tracking policy improve each other. First, we consolidate motion-captured human-object interaction datasets and retarget them into humanoid robot references while preserving whole-body coordination and dexterous hand-object relationships. This produces a large and diverse humanoid robot reference collection for dexterous whole-body loco-manipulation. Second, we train a physics-based generalist tracker that executes these references in simulation on a humanoid with dexterous hands, covering a scale and diversity beyond prior humanoid tracking systems for loco-manipulation. Third, we close a data flywheel: each round makes small, task-preserving changes to where an interaction takes place and how the body performs it, fine-tunes the tracker on them, and keeps only the variants whose simulated execution completes the task, which seed the next round. With more iterations, these small edits compound into broader coverage around the sparse original demonstrations while preserving task semantics and motion quality. Experiments show contact-preserving retargeting across robot configurations, broad tracking with a single generalist policy, executable motions that keep growing over augmentation rounds, and transfer to real robots. InterMimicGen provides a unified path from heterogeneous human demonstrations to a continually expanding motion resource for humanoid robot learning.

AI.tldr: InterMimicGen 提出自演化动作模仿框架，通过重定向人-物交互数据、训练通用运动跟踪器，并构建数据飞轮，实现人形机器人灵巧全身移动操作的数据扩充与策略互促。
AI.motivation: 人类-物体交互数据虽富含监督信息，但稀疏、异构且无法直接被机器人执行，难以支撑人形机器人灵巧全身移动操作的学习。
AI.method: 首先整合动作捕捉的人-物交互数据集，在保持全身协调和手-物关系的前提下重定向为人形机器人参考动作；其次在仿真中训练基于物理的通用跟踪策略以执行这些参考；最后构建数据飞轮，每轮对交互位置和身体执行方式进行任务保持的小幅修改，微调跟踪器并仅保留能成功完成任务的变体作为下一轮种子。
AI.result: 实验表明：跨机器人构型保持接触的重定向、单一通用策略的广泛跟踪、随增强轮次持续增长的可执行动作，以及向真实机器人的迁移均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: InterMimicGen 提供了从异构人类演示到持续扩展的运动资源的统一路径，为人形机器人学习提供可复用、可增长的动作数据体系。

title: WAMJET: A Harness for World Action Model Acceleration
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) leverage pretrained video foundation models for robot manipulation, but their large backbones and video-action co-prediction are expensive. Although existing acceleration techniques offer many ways to reduce this cost, selecting and composing them requires substantial engineering for each model and hardware platform. To tackle this bottleneck, we present WAMJET, an agentic harness that accelerates WAM inference by equipping coding agents with reusable optimization guidance and measurement and validation tools. WAMJET follows a bottleneck-driven workflow where the agent profiles inference, modifies targeted code, validates effects, and iteratively refines the acceleration stack as bottlenecks shift, while preserving action quality. Experiments span six WAMs, three coding agents, and two GPU architectures. WAMJET achieves up to 9.95x lossless speedup over upstream implementations. Approximation and hardware-aware optimization yield additional latency reductions, with comparable success rates. The results show that WAMJET can produce effective acceleration stacks for WAM deployment.

AI.tldr: WAMJET是一个智能体框架，通过为编码智能体提供可复用的优化指导与测量验证工具，自动为世界动作模型构建加速方案，实现最高9.95倍无损加速。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）借助预训练视频基础模型进行机器人操作，但其庞大主干网络与视频-动作联合预测导致推理开销高昂。现有加速技术虽多，却需要针对每个模型和硬件平台进行大量工程化选择与组合，构成部署瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出WAMJET智能体化加速框架，为编码智能体配备可复用的优化指南以及测量与验证工具。采用瓶颈驱动的工作流：智能体先对推理进行性能剖析，再修改针对性代码，验证优化效果，并随瓶颈迁移迭代精炼加速栈，同时保持动作质量。
AI.result: 实验覆盖6个WAM、3个编码智能体与2种GPU架构。WAMJET相较上游实现取得最高9.95倍的无损加速；近似优化与硬件感知优化可进一步降低时延，且成功率相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明WAMJET能够为WAM部署生成有效的加速栈，缓解了跨模型与跨硬件手动调优的工程瓶颈。

title: Towards Safer Autonomous Driving in an Open World: A Dual-Process Approach
comment: 8 pages, 9 figures, Accepted for publication at the IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), 2026
summary: Before autonomous driving systems can be deployed on public roads, it is vital that these systems comply with safety standards, traffic rules, and social norms. Although neural networks trained on large amounts of driving data perform well in routine driving tasks, these models often struggle in novel situations that are not well-represented in the data. In this work, we propose a novel framework that combines a neural network for intuitive, learning-based planning in routine driving tasks with model predictive control for reasoning-based planning in unfamiliar situations, inspired by Dual Process Theory. A meta-cognitive component is designed to switch between the two, using a knowledge graph to reason about contextual risk based on explicit perceptual information and relevant traffic rules and social norms. Contextual risk is represented through risk fields, guiding both the switching mechanism in the meta-cognitive component and compliance with safety standards, traffic rules, and social norms in the reasoning-based planner. The effectiveness of our framework is tested in CARLA for variations of a typical out-of-distribution situations involving (emergency) vehicles running a red light. We show that the novel architecture reduces the number of collisions in the scenarios by 89% and improves compliance with the special right-of-way rules, compared to the NN-only planner.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种受双过程理论启发的自动驾驶规划框架，将神经网络规划器与基于模型预测控制的推理式规划器结合，并通过元认知组件与知识图谱实现二者切换，在CARLA中显著减少了碰撞并提升了交通规则合规性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统上路前必须满足安全标准、交通规则与社会规范。仅依赖大数据训练的神经网络在常规驾驶中表现良好，但在数据中代表性不足的新颖场景下容易失效，因此需要兼顾直觉式学习与推理式规划的能力。
AI.method: 提出融合框架：用神经网络负责常规任务的直觉式学习规划，用模型预测控制负责不熟悉场景的推理式规划；设计元认知组件，借助知识图谱基于显式感知信息与相关交通规则、社会规范推理上下文风险；风险以风险场表示，用于指导切换机制及推理式规划器对安全、规则与规范的遵守。
AI.result: 在CARLA中针对（应急）车辆闯红灯等典型分布外场景的变体进行测试，相比仅使用神经网络的规划器，该架构将碰撞数量减少89%，并提升了对特殊路权规则的遵守程度。
AI.conclusion: 结合直觉式神经网络与推理式模型预测控制、并以元认知与知识图谱驱动的风险场进行切换和约束，可有效提升自动驾驶在分布外场景中的安全性与规则合规性。

title: SelectOccFlow: Selective Spatiotemporal Aggregation for 3D Occupancy and Scene Flow Prediction
summary: Comprehensive 3D scene understanding for autonomous driving requires modeling geometry, semantics, and motion. However, camera-based occupancy and scene flow prediction are sensitive to unreliable spatial and temporal aggregation, caused by semantically incompatible image features, misaligned historical observations, and incomplete voxel structures. To address this issue, we propose SelectOccFlow, a selective spatiotemporal aggregation framework that progressively refines contextual evidence across image, temporal, and voxel domains. To obtain semantically compatible image evidence, we design Semantic-Guided Sampling (SGS) to regulate feature sampling with semantic priors. Since reliable image evidence alone cannot resolve temporal inconsistency, we then present State-Conditioned Temporal Aggregation (SCTA) to selectively retrieve historical evidence according to voxel states. To further enhance the structural completeness of voxel representations, we introduce Extent-Aware Spatial Aggregation (ESA), which exploits directional structural support to refine foreground geometry. Experiments on OpenOcc demonstrate that SelectOccFlow achieves a state-of-the-art OccScore of 44.9, improving the previous best by +4.2%. It also maintains competitive occupancy performance on Occ3D-nus and improves the mean OccScore under nuScenes-C corruptions by +11.1%, demonstrating improved robustness to visual corruptions. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/muchen1021/SelectOccFlow.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SelectOccFlow，一个选择性时空聚合框架，用于自动驾驶中的3D占据预测与场景流估计，在OpenOcc上取得44.9的SOTA OccScore。
AI.motivation: 基于相机的占据预测与场景流对空间和时间聚合的不可靠性敏感，原因包括图像特征语义不兼容、历史观测未对齐以及体素结构不完整。
AI.method: 提出SelectOccFlow框架，在图像、时间、体素三个域渐进式细化上下文证据。包含三个模块：语义引导采样（SGS）利用语义先验规范特征采样以获得语义兼容的图像证据；状态条件时间聚合（SCTA）根据体素状态选择性检索历史证据；范围感知空间聚合（ESA）利用方向性结构支撑精细化前景几何。
AI.result: 在OpenOcc上达到SOTA OccScore 44.9，较之前最佳提升+4.2%；在Occ3D-nus上保持有竞争力的占据性能；在nuScenes-C损坏下平均OccScore提升+11.1%，表明对视觉损坏的鲁棒性增强。
AI.conclusion: 通过跨图像、时间、体素域的选择性时空聚合，可有效提升3D占据与场景流预测的精度和鲁棒性。源代码将在GitHub公开。

title: A Bird's-Eye View of Iterative Reward Design
summary: Designing effective reward functions in RL typically requires substantial expertise and trial and error. Recent work automates this process with LLM-based systems that generate and iteratively improve reward code using policy feedback. However, these methods are often hard to compare because they differ in implementation details, feedback assumptions, and evaluation environments. To address this, we introduce a Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design (BIRD) that expresses existing methods in a unified configuration and evaluation space. This lets us compare algorithms directly, ablate individual design choices, and prototype new components under matched feedback conditions and policy-training budgets. Across MuJoCo, Meta-World, Assistax, and HumanoidBench, we identify a small set of simple design choices that consistently improve performance. Combining these choices yields significantly better performance than the evaluated methods from prior work. Our results highlight the strength of simple baselines and motivate further study of when additional algorithmic complexity improves iterative reward design. Code is available at https://github.com/safety-research/bird.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BIRD 基准，将现有基于 LLM 的迭代式奖励设计方法统一到同一配置与评估空间，实现直接对比、消融实验与新组件原型验证。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中设计有效奖励函数通常依赖大量专业经验与试错；近期虽有 LLM 系统通过策略反馈迭代生成并改进奖励代码，但这些方法在实现细节、反馈假设与评估环境上各不相同，难以直接比较。
AI.method: 构建 Benchmark for Iterative Reward Design（BIRD），把已有方法表达为统一的配置与评估空间，从而在匹配的反馈条件与策略训练预算下直接比较算法、消融单项设计选择并原型化新组件。
AI.result: 在 MuJoCo、Meta-World、Assistax 与 HumanoidBench 上识别出一小组能持续提升性能的简单设计选择；将这些选择组合后，性能显著优于所评估的先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显简单基线的优势，并呼吁进一步研究何时增加算法复杂度才能真正改进迭代式奖励设计。代码见 https://github.com/safety-research/bird。

title: Video2World: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Interactive World Modeling from Embodied Videos
summary: Building interactive simulators from real-world observations is a promising way to scale embodied data, but current pipelines still rely heavily on manual environment construction and calibration. We study whether frontier foundation models and coding agents can automate this process end to end. We formulate \emph{autonomous video-to-simulation} as a software engineering task in which an agent observes an embodied video, constructs the corresponding simulated environment and robot behavior, and iteratively refines the result through execution feedback. To evaluate this capability, we introduce \textbf{Video2World}, a benchmark comprising 222 reconstruction instances derived from 189 robot and human demonstration videos. Video2World measures reconstructed worlds along geometric fidelity, dynamic fidelity, and functional correctness, capturing spatial perception, physical reasoning, and executable interaction. Evaluating 9 frontier coding-agent systems reveals a sharp improvement in Task success beginning with Claude Opus 5, rising from below 5\% to over 15\%, while substantial gaps to human-assisted reconstruction remain. We further find that worlds that look better could work worse: better visual fidelity does not always lead to higher task success. This echoes the broader gap between perceptual realism and factual correctness observed in generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"自主视频到仿真"(autonomous video-to-simulation)任务,并构建 Video2World 基准(222个重建实例,源自189个机器人及人类演示视频),以评估前沿编码智能体端到端自动化构建交互式仿真环境的能力。评估9个前沿编码智能体系统显示,从 Claude Opus 5 起任务成功率由不足5%跃升至15%以上,但与人类辅助重建仍有显著差距;同时发现视觉保真度更高并不必然带来更高任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 从真实世界观测构建交互式仿真器是扩展具身数据的有效途径,但现有流程高度依赖人工环境搭建与标定,难以规模化。作者希望探究前沿基础模型与编码智能体能否端到端地自动化这一过程。
AI.method: 将自主视频到仿真形式化为一项软件工程任务:智能体观察具身视频,构建对应的仿真环境与机器人行为,并通过执行反馈迭代优化。为评估该能力,提出 Video2World 基准,包含222个重建实例(来自189个机器人及人类演示视频),从几何保真度、动态保真度与功能正确性三个维度衡量重建世界,覆盖空间感知、物理推理与可执行交互。并据此评测9个前沿编码智能体系统。
AI.result: 评测显示任务成功率在 Claude Opus 5 之后出现明显跃升,从不足5%提升至15%以上,但距人类辅助重建仍有较大差距。此外发现"看起来更好的世界未必更能用":更高的视觉保真度并不总对应更高的任务成功率,这与生成模型中感知真实性与事实正确性之间的差距相呼应。
AI.conclusion: 前沿编码智能体已能在自主视频到仿真任务上取得实质性进展,但尚无法达到人类辅助重建水平。视觉保真度与功能正确性存在解耦,未来评测与系统设计需同时关注几何、动态与功能层面的正确性,而非仅追求视觉逼真。

title: RAGrasp: Geometry-Semantic Template Retrieval and Grasp Transfer
summary: We present RAGrasp, a retrieval-augmented pipeline for planar parallel-jaw grasping from a compact set of locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D (color and depth) templates. Unlike task-specific predictors trained primarily on large public or synthetic grasp datasets, RAGrasp requires no end-to-end retraining for a new deployment.Its template memory is constructed from observations collected with the deployment camera, robot, and gripper in the target workspace, thereby aligning stored examples with the local sensing and embodiment conditions. The system uses self-supervised DINOv2 visual fea- tures together with appearance and depth cues to prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2), which isolates the query object. A two-stage geometry-semantic retrieval cascade then selects a template, and a confidence gate chooses one of two grasp- transfer estimators. The transferred grasp is refined using mask- support and silhouette-contact constraints before calibrated 2D- to-3D conversion. In real-world trials, RAGrasp achieves 20/20 successful grasps on seen objects and 19/20 on unseen objects. Within the evaluated setting, the results demonstrate deployment- specific grasp adaptation from limited local annotation and tolerance to the tested viewpoint and illumination changes.

AI.tldr: RAGrasp：基于少量本地标注RGB-D模板的检索增强平面平行夹爪抓取流水线，无需端到端重训，实机20/20（已见）与19/20（未见）成功。
AI.motivation: 现有抓取预测器多依赖大规模公开或合成数据集训练，面向新部署场景需端到端重训。作者希望利用部署现场相机、机器人、夹爪采集的少量标注模板，使样本与本地感知与本体条件对齐，实现无需重训的部署专用抓取适应。
AI.method: 构建本地采集的抓取标注RGB-D模板记忆库；用自监督DINOv2视觉特征结合外观与深度线索提示SAM2分割查询物体；采用两阶段“几何-语义”检索级联选出模板；通过置信度门控在两个抓取迁移估计器间选择；再用掩码支撑与轮廓接触约束细化迁移抓取，并进行标定后的2D到3D转换。
AI.result: 实机试验中，已见物体20/20抓取成功，未见物体19/20成功；在所评估设定下，验证了基于有限本地标注的部署专用抓取适应能力，并对测试视角与光照变化具有一定容忍度。
AI.conclusion: RAGrasp表明：以本地采集的少量标注模板配合检索增强与基础模型分割，可在不进行端到端重训的前提下实现对新部署的有效抓取迁移，并具备对视角与光照变化的鲁棒性。

title: PermVLA: Factorization Order as a Regularizer for VLA Learning
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies commonly learn action chunks through a fixed left-to-right (LTR) factorization, although the same expert trajectory distribution admits many valid chain-rule factorizations. We identify factorization order as an overlooked regularization choice and introduce causally anchored permutation (CAP), which samples action reveal orders with a tunable chronological prefix. Its auxiliary objective trains one shared policy to predict actions from different known subsets of the same expert chunk, while deployment retains deterministic LTR control. We call this conditional-set augmentation: it creates multiple conditional prediction problems from one expert chunk without adding demonstrations. This discourages reliance on the single chronological prefix used by ordinary teacher forcing. Controlled experiments show that CAP consistently outperforms standard LTR training on LIBERO and LIBERO-Plus, with the same advantage appearing in cross-dataset CALVIN evaluation. A diagnostic that measures the expected squared difference between a chunk's joint log likelihood under two reveal orders verifies that CAP training internalizes agreement across reveal orders. These findings position sampled subset-conditioned auxiliary objectives as a general recipe for constructing VLA regularizers, illustrated by an extension to diffusion action generators.

AI.tldr: 本文将动作块的自回归分解顺序视为一种被忽视的正则化手段，提出因果锚定排列（CAP）：在保留可调时间前缀的前提下采样动作揭示顺序，通过条件集合增强为同一专家动作块构造多个条件预测任务，从而降低对单一时间前缀的依赖，并在多个基准上稳定优于标准从左到右训练。
AI.motivation: 主流 VLA 策略普遍采用固定的从左到右（LTR）分解来学习动作块，但同一专家轨迹分布其实允许多种合法的链式法则分解。作者认为分解顺序是一种被忽视的正则化选择，固定 LTR 会使策略过度依赖普通 teacher forcing 中唯一的时间前缀，泛化性受限。
AI.method: 提出因果锚定排列（CAP）：采样动作揭示顺序时保留一个可调的时间先后缀（chronological prefix），使顺序采样在因果性与多样性之间可调。其辅助目标让同一共享策略在给定同一专家动作块的不同已知子集条件下预测其余动作；部署阶段仍使用确定性的 LTR 控制。该机制被称为条件集合增强（conditional-set augmentation），无需额外演示即可从一个专家块生成多个条件预测问题，并进一步扩展到扩散动作生成器。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 与 LIBERO-Plus 上的受控实验中，CAP 一致优于标准 LTR 训练；在跨数据集 CALVIN 评测中也表现出同样优势。此外，通过度量同一动作块在两种揭示顺序下联合对数似然的期望平方差这一诊断指标，验证了 CAP 训练确实内化了不同揭示顺序之间的一致性。
AI.conclusion: 采样式子集条件辅助目标可作为构建 VLA 正则化器的一般性方案，CAP 是其具体实例，并可推广至扩散动作生成器等更广泛的动作生成框架。

title: Probabilistic Pedestrian Forecasts from a Handheld Phone: World-Frame Heat Maps, Visual-Inertial Height Drift, and Evaluation without Ground Truth
summary: A pedestrian with a phone could be shown where nearby people will be in the next few seconds, if the forecast stays on the ground while the phone moves, is calibrated, and needs only a monocular camera and visual-inertial odometry (VIO). We build and evaluate such a system. People are detected, lifted onto the floor by ray-plane intersection, tracked in a gravity-aligned metric frame, and forecast as per-step probability maps by a small U-Net trained with a negative log-likelihood (NLL) loss on bird's-eye (SDD) and first-person (EgoTraj-Bench) trajectories. On handheld ADVIO recordings, vertical VIO drift and the user's own changes of level silently rescale monocular ground positions (by 87% within 90 s on one clip; on another, all tracks are lost for the last 31% of the clip); keeping the camera's height above the floor constant under a low-pass-filtered altitude avoids this, though it lags on escalators. On the SDD and EgoTraj-Bench test splits, the final forecaster lowers the NLL at 4.8 s by 1.51 and 1.37 nats relative to a fitted constant-velocity Gaussian. Lacking ground truth for people in handheld video, we score forecasts against the tracker's own later raw measurements. In an internally pre-registered evaluation on seven held-out clips, the final forecaster's NLL is lower than the benchmark-fitted baseline's at 1.2, 2.4 and 4.8 s (by 0.17, 0.23 and 0.47 nats; 95% intervals over people exclude zero), but by less than half as much as on the development clips. Exploratory analyses cut both ways: resampling clips instead of people widens the intervals to include zero at 1.2 and 2.4 s, and once both forecasters are recalibrated on the development clips the network is significantly better only at 1.2 s; but two clips run with ADVIO's reference poses favour the network much more when re-run with the phone's own poses. We discuss what such self-consistency scores can and cannot show.

AI.tldr: 本文构建并评估了一个仅依赖单目相机与视觉惯性里程计（VIO）的手持设备行人轨迹预测系统：检测行人、经射线-平面交会投影到地面、在重力对齐的度量坐标系中跟踪，并用小型U-Net以NLL损失预测概率图；同时揭示了单目地面定位的尺度漂移问题及其缓解方法。
AI.motivation: 手持手机用户有实时预知附近行人未来几秒位置的需求。实现这一目标的关键约束是：预测必须保持在地面坐标系中，而相机在移动；系统需可标定，且仅用单目相机与VIO。现有工作缺少在真实手持视频上验证此类"相机移动、地面固定"预测框架的实证研究。
AI.method: 检测行人后通过射线-平面交会提升到地面，在重力对齐的度量坐标系中跟踪；用小型U-Net以负对数似然（NLL）损失训练为逐步概率图，训练数据为鸟瞰（SDD）与第一人称（EgoTraj-Bench）轨迹。针对单目地面定位的尺度漂移，采用低通滤波的高度假设保持相机离地高度恒定。在ADVIO手持录像上进行评测，因缺少行人真值，用跟踪器自身后续原始测量作为评分基准，并做了内部预注册评估与重采样等探索性分析。
AI.result: 在ADVIO手持录像上，垂直VIO漂移和用户自身高度变化会静默地重缩放单目地面位置（某片段90秒内达87%；另一片段最后31%的轨迹全部丢失）；保持相机离地高度恒定可避免此问题，但在自动扶梯上有滞后。在SDD与EgoTraj-Bench测试集上，最终预测器在4.8秒处相较拟合的匀速高斯基线分别降低NLL 1.51和1.37 nats。在七个留出片段的预注册评估中，最终预测器在1.2、2.4、4.8秒处NLL均低于基准拟合基线（分别低0.17、0.23、0.47 nats；人的95%区间不含零），但提升幅度不足开发片段的一半。探索性分析结果双向：按片段而非按人重采样会使1.2、2.4秒区间含零；双方在开发片段重标定后网络仅在1.2秒显著更优；但两段用ADVIO参考位姿运行的片段在改用手机自身位姿后更偏向网络。
AI.conclusion: 该系统证明了在手持单目VIO条件下进行地面锚定行人预测的可行性，并指出垂直漂移导致的尺度失真是核心工程难题。然而自一致性评分（以跟踪器后续测量代替真值）的有效性有限，探索性分析显示结论对重采样单位与重标定方式敏感，因此这类评分能证明什么、不能证明什么仍需谨慎界定。

title: LightVLN: Efficient Aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation with Compact Memory and History-Guided Local Aggregation
summary: Aerial vision-and-language navigation (VLN) enables unmanned aerial vehicles to execute long-horizon natural-language instructions from visual observations in complex three-dimensional environments. However, recent aerial VLN models often rely on large-scale vision-language backbones and dense visual histories, imposing substantial computation and memory costs that hinder onboard deployment. We propose LightVLN, a lightweight history-aware aerial VLN framework that combines a compact 0.5B language backbone with compact representations of both historical and current observations. LightVLN compresses each historical frame into a single token using visual features already computed by the policy. It further introduces history- and instruction-conditioned local aggregation to reduce the current observation from 256 to 32 visual tokens while preserving navigation-relevant spatial information. With up to 16 historical frames, the policy uses at most 48 observation-derived tokens. On the public OpenFly dataset, LightVLN achieves 50.93% Test-Seen and 36.14% Test-Unseen success rates (SR), outperforming the evaluated 7B language-backbone baselines on most reported metrics. It also achieves 25.83% SR on AerialVLN-S Val-Seen. In a reconstructed unseen campus, we deploy LightVLN on a DJI M350 RTK with an external Jetson Orin NX 16 GB for closed-loop onboard-compute real-to-sim hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) evaluation, achieving 14.61 Hz model inference and 11.13 Hz end-to-end decision updates. These results demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of LightVLN for aerial navigation.

AI.tldr: LightVLN：轻量历史感知空中视觉语言导航框架，用0.5B骨干与紧凑历史/当前观测表示，实现高性能低算力并成功上机实飞。
AI.motivation: 现有空中视觉语言导航模型依赖大规模视觉语言骨干与稠密视觉历史，计算与内存开销大，难以机载部署。
AI.method: 采用0.5B紧凑语言骨干；将每帧历史压缩为单token（复用策略已算的视觉特征）；引入历史-指令条件化的局部聚合，把当前观测从256降至32个视觉token；最多16帧历史时观测相关token不超过48个。
AI.result: OpenFly：Test-Seen 50.93%、Test-Unseen 36.14% SR，多数指标优于所评测7B骨干基线；AerialVLN-S Val-Seen 25.83% SR。在重建未见校园中部署于DJI M350 RTK + Jetson Orin NX 16GB，HIL闭环实现14.61 Hz推理与11.13 Hz端到端决策。
AI.conclusion: LightVLN在性能与效率上具优势，适用于空中导航的机载部署。

title: GeoBridge-VLA: Geometry-Aware Residual Adaptation for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models encode semantic information from vision-language pretraining, but manipulation also requires precise spatial reasoning. We present GeoBridge-VLA, a two-stage method for learning geometric features from a pretrained VLA's frozen visual encoder and using them for action prediction. Stage I trains a feature bridge and geometry decoder with depth supervision. Stage II freezes these modules and trains a gated residual interface together with the action-side projections and action expert. The residual augments the existing visual tokens without adding a second image encoder or increasing the token count. Deployment requires RGB, robot state, and language, but no depth observations. Under matched evaluation conditions, GeoBridge-VLA achieves 70.9% success on LIBERO, compared with 60.0% for SmolVLA. Disabling the residual in the same trained checkpoint reduces success from 70.90% to 69.85%, with mixed effects across suites. On a physical ROBOTIS OMY robot, GeoBridge-VLA succeeds in 148 of 200 trials (74.0%) across four tasks, compared with 108 of 200 (54.0%) for SmolVLA.

AI.tldr: 提出GeoBridge-VLA两阶段方法，从冻结VLA视觉编码器中学习几何特征以增强动作预测，LIBERO成功率70.9%（对比SmolVLA 60.0%），真机200次试验成功率74.0%（对比54.0%）。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽通过视觉-语言预训练获得语义信息，但操作任务还需精确的空间推理能力，而预训练视觉编码器缺乏显式几何表征。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：阶段一在深度监督下训练特征桥接模块与几何解码器，从frozen视觉编码器提取几何特征；阶段二冻结上述模块，训练门控残差接口、动作侧投影与动作专家。残差直接增强现有视觉token，不引入第二个图像编码器、不增加token数量。
AI.result: LIBERO上70.9%成功率（SmolVLA 60.0%）；同一checkpoint禁用残差后降至69.85%，各suite效果不一；ROBOTIS OMY真机四任务200次试验成功148次（74.0%），SmolVLA为108次（54.0%）。部署仅需RGB、机器人状态与语言，无需深度观测。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量门控残差将几何特征注入预训练VLA视觉token，可在不增加编码器与token开销、部署不需深度输入的条件下显著提升操作成功率，残差贡献在整体上为正但任务间存在差异。

title: Direction-Conditioned Policies for Online Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
summary: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) learns representations that estimate goal reachability, yet its policy remains conditioned on raw goals and therefore does not directly exploit the geometry encoded by its critic. We introduce Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), a method built around a small modification to CRL: DCP selects previously visited states as waypoints during online training and conditions the policy on their direction and distance in representation space. At deployment, DCP applies the same interface directly to the final goal, requiring neither waypoint selection nor planning. Across nine navigation and manipulation tasks, DCP attains higher final success rates than CRL on seven tasks and spends more time near the goal on seven. Controlled maze experiments further show that DCP captures shortest-path geometry more accurately and that the supplied direction causally influences the actor's behavior. We identify waypoint coverage and ranking as limits to exploration, and show that learned candidate generation improves goal reaching in two controlled mazes.

AI.tldr: 提出方向条件策略（DCP），通过对CRL做小幅修改，将策略条件从原始目标改为表征空间中已访问状态的方向与距离；部署时直接作用于最终目标，无需路径点选择或规划，在多数导航与操作任务上优于CRL。
AI.motivation: 对比强化学习（CRL）学到的表征能估计目标可达性，但其策略仍以原始目标为条件，未能直接利用critic所编码的几何结构，导致表征中的几何信息未被策略充分利用。
AI.method: DCP基于对CRL的小幅修改：在线训练时选择此前访问过的状态作为路径点，并让策略以这些路径点在表征空间中的方向与距离为条件；部署阶段将同一接口直接应用于最终目标，无需路径点选择或规划。此外分析路径点覆盖与排序对探索的限制，并引入学习式候选生成。
AI.result: 在九个导航与操作任务中，DCP在七个任务上取得更高的最终成功率，并在七个任务上于目标附近停留时间更长；受控迷宫实验表明DCP更准确地捕捉最短路径几何，且所提供的方向对actor行为具有因果影响；学习式候选生成在两个受控迷宫中提升了目标到达表现。
AI.conclusion: 以表征空间中的方向与距离作为策略条件，可有效利用CRL critic的几何信息，在不增加部署期规划开销的前提下提升目标到达性能；未来需改进路径点覆盖与排序以增强探索。

title: A Safe Action Is Not Enough: Feasible-Future Decoding for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary:
A safe action is not necessarily a viable one. Under a frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policy, an action can be likely and locally admissible yet leave no policy-supported route to safe task completion. We call this the feasibility-likelihood gap: likelihood ranks the current action, whereas feasibility depends on the futures that remain after it.
  We derive the exact next-block marginal of the history-conditioned policy-environment trajectory law restricted to safe task completion. The derivation exposes a candidate-dependent feasible-future mass with two roles: its support records whether safe completion remains possible under the frozen continuation process, and its magnitude measures how much weighted safe-completion mass is preserved. Exact evaluation is impractical online, so we develop a selective finite-candidate approximation, derive conditions for recovering the best retained viable candidate, and instantiate it as an alarm-triggered, training-free reranker.
  On Safety-CHORES, VICS-G lowers mean cumulative safety cost by 1.9%-57.5% across six settings while remaining within 2.5 percentage points of policy sampling in success and 0.82 steps in mean episode length. The resulting decoder is tied to an exact policy-relative safe-completion target, yet requires neither retraining of the base policy nor online trajectory rollouts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"可行性-似然性差距"问题：在冻结VLA策略下，高似然且局部可容许的动作可能无后续安全完成路径。作者推导安全完成约束下的精确下一块边缘分布，提出选择性有限候选近似与理论恢复条件，并实现免训练、报警触发的重排序器VICS-G。Safety-CHORES上平均累积安全代价降1.9%–57.5%，成功率差距≤2.5个百分点、平均回合长度差≤0.82步。
AI.motivation: 在冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略下，安全动作未必可行：动作可能概率高且局部可容许，却切断了通往安全任务完成的后续策略支撑路径。现有方法按似然排序当前动作，忽略了"执行该动作后是否仍存在安全完成的未来"，导致安全与任务成功之间的错配。作者将此称为可行性-似然性差距，并试图在不重训练、不在线展开的前提下弥合该差距。
AI.method: 推导受限安全任务完成的历史条件策略-环境轨迹律的精确"下一块"边缘分布，揭示候选相关的可行未来质量：其支撑集刻画冻结续推过程下安全完成是否仍可能，其量值度量加权安全完成质量的保留程度。因在线精确求值不可行，提出选择性有限候选近似，给出恢复最佳保留可行候选的条件，并实例化为报警触发、免训练的重排序器VICS-G（基于冻结策略与安全约束的候选重排，无在线轨迹展开）。
AI.result: 在Safety-CHORES六个设置上，VICS-G将平均累积安全代价降低1.9%–57.5%；成功率与策略采样差距控制在2.5个百分点以内，平均回合长度差不超过0.82步。表明该方法在显著提升安全性的同时基本不牺牲任务效率。
AI.conclusion: 该解码器与精确的策略相对安全完成目标绑定，却无需重训练基础策略，也无需在线轨迹展开，提供了可解释、可部署的安全重排序机制。其核心贡献是将动作选择从单纯似然排序扩展为对"安全完成可行未来质量"的评估，弥合可行性-似然性差距。

title: When and What to Prune? Stage-Aware Visual Token Pruning for Efficient VLA
summary: Visual token pruning is an effective way to accelerate vision-language models and is especially useful for vision-language-action (VLA) inference, where many visual tokens must be processed before predicting robot actions. Existing pruning methods usually estimate which tokens can be pruned based on attention scores or feature diversity, retaining tokens that are either highly attended or visually different from others. However, most of them use fixed pruning schedules, such as pruning once at a preset layer or pruning at uniformly spaced layers. Such schedules can be risky for VLA models, because the model may not know which visual regions matter for the action in early layers. Tokens that look unimportant at first may become useful after the model combines visual observations with the language instruction. In this work, we propose SAPrune, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient VLA inference. Instead of pruning at fixed layers, SAPrune uses a small calibration set to observe how action-to-visual attention changes across layers, and chooses pruning layers only after the attention pattern becomes more reliable. At each selected layer, SAPrune applies a dual-path pruning rule: one path protects strongly attended visual tokens from pruning, while the other prevents useful surrounding context from being discarded. Experiments on LIBERO, SIMPLER, and real-world robotic tasks show that SAPrune prunes 87.5% of visual tokens and achieves up to 1.718x inference speedup while maintaining competitive task success rates.

AI.tldr: SAPrune：一种免训练的视觉token剪枝框架，通过校准集观察动作-视觉注意力随层变化，在注意力模式可靠后再选择剪枝层，并采用双路径剪枝规则，实现高效VLA推理。
AI.motivation: VLA推理需处理大量视觉token，现有剪枝方法多基于注意力分数或特征多样性，且采用固定剪枝调度（如预设层剪枝或均匀间隔层剪枝）。但在早期层模型尚不清楚哪些视觉区域对动作重要，看似不重要的token在与语言指令结合后可能变有用，固定调度对VLA模型存在风险。
AI.method: 提出SAPrune免训练视觉token剪枝框架。它不用固定层剪枝，而是用小型校准集观察动作到视觉的注意力如何跨层变化，待注意力模式更可靠后再选择剪枝层；在每个选定层应用双路径剪枝规则：一路保护强注意力的视觉token，另一路防止有用周围上下文被丢弃。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、SIMPLER及真实机器人任务上，SAPrune剪除87.5%的视觉token，实现最高1.718倍推理加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: SAPrune通过自适应选择剪枝层与双路径剪枝规则，在免训练条件下显著减少视觉token并加速VLA推理，且不牺牲任务成功率，优于固定剪枝调度的现有方法。

title: Deep Prior Learning for Embodied Perception
summary: Embodied systems need geometric perception that exploits available observations beyond images alone. Recent feed-forward 3D models incorporate geometric priors, including camera poses, intrinsics, and depth. However, handling noisy poses, preserving accurate priors, and recovering physical scale require more than simply accepting these inputs. We introduce \emph{Vision-Prior Geometry Grounded Transformer} (VPGGT), a VGGT-based framework that extends OmniVGGT for prior-aware embodied perception. We formulate sensor-motivated pose corruptions from ground-truth trajectories for training and introduce a parameter-free \emph{prior residual connection} (PRC) to mitigate \emph{prior dilution}, where predictions are less accurate than their supplied pose priors. Our noise formulation targets camera poses; supplied intrinsics and depth receive no additional corruption. We further introduce \emph{Metric Global Attention}, which conditions a global scale token on available pose and depth scales and predicts a shared metric scaling factor for the geometric outputs. Experiments across four datasets show that \emph{PRC} improves translation-direction accuracy and joint pose AUC over a matched training baseline when camera priors are provided for all views, under both exact and corrupted poses. These results support explicit prior access during refinement as a useful addition to feature-level conditioning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出VPGGT框架，通过先验残差连接（PRC）与Metric Global Attention，缓解先验稀释并恢复物理尺度，提升含噪位姿下的几何感知精度。
AI.motivation: 具身系统需要超越纯图像的几何感知，而现有前馈3D模型虽引入相机位姿、内参、深度等几何先验，却在处理含噪位姿、保留精确先验及恢复物理尺度方面存在不足，即简单接受先验输入并不足够。
AI.method: 基于VGGT并扩展OmniVGGT，构建先验感知的具身感知框架VPGGT。方法包括：依据真实轨迹构造传感器驱动的位姿扰动用于训练（仅对相机位姿加噪，内参与深度不加扰动）；引入无参数的先验残差连接（PRC）以缓解先验稀释；提出Metric Global Attention，以全局尺度token为条件，结合可用的位姿与深度尺度，预测共享的度量缩放因子。
AI.result: 在四个数据集上的实验表明，当所有视图均提供相机先验时，无论位姿精确或受扰动，PRC相较匹配的训练基线，在平移方向精度和联合位姿AUC上均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在几何细化过程中显式访问先验，作为特征层级条件化的有益补充。

title: StageVLN: Spatial and Trajectory Auxiliary Guidance for Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) policies increasingly benefit from strong semantic priors provided by large vision-language models (VLMs). However, standard action supervision does not explicitly encourage intermediate representations to preserve scene geometry, relative orientation, or global episode progress. Incorporating depth estimators, explicit maps, point clouds, or geometry foundation models at inference can provide such structure but introduces additional computation, memory overhead, and architectural dependence during deployment. We introduce StageVLN, a training framework that shapes navigation representations through privileged spatial and trajectory guidance while preserving the original inference pathway. A frozen geometry foundation model provides multi-level spatial guidance to hierarchical navigator states, while relative-heading and expert-route progress objectives provide complementary trajectory-state supervision. All auxiliary components are used only during training and removed at deployment. On R2R-CE validation-unseen, StageVLN achieves 56.3\% SR and 51.4\% SPL with a 4B-parameter backbone, without an additional geometry encoder at inference. On RxR-CE, it achieves 54.3\% SR without additional navigation training data or a geometry encoder at inference.

AI.tldr: StageVLN 是一种训练框架，通过特权空间与轨迹引导塑造导航表示，在保持推理路径不变的前提下提升 VLN 性能，无需推理时额外的几何编码器。
AI.motivation: 标准动作监督不显式鼓励中间表示保留场景几何、相对朝向或全局回合进度；而在推理阶段引入深度估计、显式地图、点云或几何基础模型虽能提供此类结构，却带来额外计算、内存开销与架构依赖。
AI.method: 利用冻结的几何基础模型为分层导航器状态提供多层级空间引导；辅以相对航向与专家路线进度目标提供轨迹状态监督。所有辅助组件仅在训练中使用，部署时移除。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE validation-unseen 上，以 4B 参数骨干实现 56.3% SR 与 51.4% SPL，推理时无额外几何编码器；在 RxR-CE 上实现 54.3% SR，且推理时无需额外导航训练数据或几何编码器。
AI.conclusion: StageVLN 证明可通过训练阶段的特权空间与轨迹引导有效注入几何与进度结构，在不改变推理路径、不增加部署开销的情况下显著提升 VLN 策略表现。

title: Beyond In-Distribution Preservation: Recovering Generalization in Quantized VLAs via Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning
summary: Post-training quantization has been shown to preserve VLA performance under standard evaluation conditions, but whether it preserves the full-precision model's robustness and generalization remains underexplored. In this study, we systematically study the robustness and generalization of post-quantized VLA policies under environmental disturbances. Empirical results show that quantized policies can become fragile to subtle environmental variations despite retaining comparable in-distribution performance. We further observe that action discrepancies are concentrated in a small subset of rollout states, while teacher guidance has opposite effects depending on discrepancy: it improves generalization at high-discrepancy states but can degrade it at low-discrepancy states. These findings reveal that effective post-quantization recovery requires selectively intervening on vulnerable states rather than globally distilling the student. We therefore propose Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q), a vulnerability-aware On-Policy Distillation (OPD) framework that selectively corrects vulnerable states encountered during quantized-student rollouts using the frozen full-precision policy as a teacher. PIVOT-Q identifies vulnerable states using discounted accumulated discrepancies over a short horizon, applies phase-balanced sparse supervision, and uses a Behavioral Anchor to prevent unnecessary changes. Experiments under seven LIBERO-Plus environmental variations demonstrate consistent recovery across multiple VLA backbones and quantization methods. Notably, PIVOT-Q consistently outperforms full-state distillation across all settings while using only 7.4% of its state-level distillation budget. Our code is available at https://github.com/ruanruan-andy/PIVOT-Q.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了后训练量化（PTQ）对 VLA 策略鲁棒性和泛化性的影响，发现量化策略在分布内性能不变的情况下对环境扰动变得脆弱，且动作差异集中在少数 rollout 状态上。据此提出 PIVOT-Q 框架，通过脆弱状态选择性的在线策略蒸馏恢复量化 VLA 策略的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明后训练量化在标准评测条件下能保持 VLA 性能，但其是否保留全精度模型的鲁棒性与泛化性尚未被充分探索。作者希望揭示量化策略在环境扰动下的脆弱性机制，并找到有效的量化后恢复方法。
AI.method: 提出 Policy-Induced Vulnerability-Oriented Tuning (PIVOT-Q)，一个脆弱性感知的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）框架：以冻结的全精度策略作为教师，在量化学生 rollout 中自适应地识别脆弱状态，采用短视界折扣累积差异度量脆弱性，施加阶段平衡的稀疏监督，并使用 Behavioral Anchor 防止不必要的改动。
AI.result: 实验发现量化策略虽保持可比的分布内性能，但对细微环境变化脆弱；动作差异集中于少数 rollout 状态；教师指导效果依差异程度而异——在高差异状态提升泛化，在低差异状态反而降低泛化。在七种 LIBERO-Plus 环境变化下，PIVOT-Q 在多种 VLA 骨干和量化方法上实现一致恢复，且在全部设置中优于全状态蒸馏，仅使用其 7.4% 的状态级蒸馏预算。
AI.conclusion: 量化后有效恢复需要选择性地干预脆弱状态，而非全局蒸馏学生模型。PIVOT-Q 通过脆弱状态定向的稀疏在线蒸馏，在显著降低蒸馏预算的同时一致提升量化 VLA 策略的鲁棒性与泛化性。

title: Controllable Road Marking Generation
summary: Lane and road markings provide critical guidance for vehicle navigation and multi-agent coordination, yet authoring them at scale remains a manual workflow that limits quantitative analysis and scenario testing. We introduce Controllable Road Marking Generation, which synthesizes a missing center-region marking layout from a drivable-area mask, optional outer-ring markings, and a textual description. Our benchmark uses deterministic, metadata-derived prompts and three output channels: lane dividers, road dividers, and pedestrian crossings.
