We develop a conditional bird's-eye-view (BEV) pipeline that combines (i) a text-conditioned latent rectified-flow DiT trained with a topology-aware auxiliary loss, (ii) Gaussian-blurred training targets that stabilize learning of thin, sparse markings, and (iii) Structured Gaussian Render (SGR), a training-free post-process that recovers crisp divider geometry by extracting polylines, fitting cubic Bézier curves, and re-rendering them as anisotropic super-Gaussian primitives. On 4,597 Argoverse~2 test tiles, our system achieves Buffered F1 of 80.8 and clDice of 50.2, compared with 38.8 and 24.6 for an adapted state-of-the-art mask-refinement baseline. On Waymo dataset, it yields 88.0 Buffered F1 and 66.2 clDice. Component ablations show complementary connectivity gains from topology-aware supervision and SGR. Text-editing experiments reveal that stronger guidance improves edit success but also increases changes to non-target structures. We see this framework as a step toward simulation-ready road-marking variation, automated map completion, and early-stage infrastructure design exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出Controllable Road Marking Generation任务与条件BEV生成管线，从可行驶区域掩码、可选外环标线和文本描述合成缺失的中心区域标线布局，在Argoverse 2与Waymo上大幅超越掩码精修基线。
AI.motivation: 车道与道路标线是车辆导航和多智能体协同的关键指引，但大规模制作仍依赖人工流程，制约了定量分析与场景测试；需要可控制、可自动化的标线生成方法以支持仿真就绪的标线变化、地图自动补全和早期基础设施设计探索。
AI.method: 提出可控道路标线生成：输入可行驶区域掩码、可选外环标线和文本描述，输出车道分隔线、道路分隔线和人行横道三个通道；基准采用确定性、由元数据推导的提示。方法为条件BEV管线，包含：(i) 文本条件潜空间rectified-flow DiT，配拓扑感知辅助损失；(ii) 高斯模糊训练目标以稳定细、稀疏标线的学习；(iii) 免训练后处理Structured Gaussian Render（SGR），通过提取折线、拟合三次Bézier曲线并以各向异性超高斯基元重渲染，恢复锐利的分隔线几何。
AI.result: 在4,597个Argoverse 2测试瓦片上，Buffered F1为80.8、clDice为50.2，对比适配后的SOTA掩码精修基线的38.8与24.6；在Waymo数据集上达88.0 Buffered F1与66.2 clDice。组件消融显示拓扑感知监督与SGR带来互补的连通性增益。文本编辑实验表明更强引导提升编辑成功率，但也增加对非目标结构的改动。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是可控制、仿真就绪的道路标线生成的重要一步，可服务于仿真就绪的标线变化、自动地图补全与早期基础设施设计探索。

title: OGAM: Connecting Systematic Testing to Runtime Assurance through Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring for VLA Policies
summary: Benchmarks expose vision-language-action (VLA) policies to few canonical instructions, while exhaustive deployment testing is impossible. We introduce Object-Grounded Attention Monitoring (OGAM), connecting systematic testing to runtime assurance: testing reveals attention divergence between successful and failed executions, and OGAM uses this signal to stop failures beyond the finite suite. We generate scene-grounded instructions through pairwise combinations of action templates and objects, and separately test meaning-preserving paraphrases. All 87 out-of-benchmark cases reveal problematic behavior across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, UniVLA, and $π_{0.5}$: none completes any of the 24 feasible instructions, while infeasible or hazardous requests also trigger behavior substitution. At each action query, we project gradient-weighted visual attention through object masks and group it by instruction role for comparison across tasks and policies. Dynamic time warping aligns this course with a successful reference despite speed differences; conformal calibration on successful episodes sets the early-stopping threshold for sustained deviations, with a nominal false-stop target of $α=0.05$. Across four policies, OGAM stops 87-100% of failed episodes at median times of 5-12s within a 20s budget, with observed false-stop rates of 3-5%, without failure-labeled training. Finite testing thus identifies attention patterns that support online intervention before failure fully unfolds.

AI.tldr: 提出OGAM方法，将系统化测试发现的注意力分歧信号用于运行时监控，在四种VLA策略上以3-5%的误停率提前终止87-100%的失败回合。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略基准测试仅覆盖少量规范指令，而穷尽式部署测试不可行，因此需要将有限的系统性测试与运行时保障机制连接起来，实现基准之外的失败预防。
AI.method: 通过动作模板与对象的成对组合生成场景化指令，并单独测试语义保持的改写指令；在每个动作查询处，将梯度加权的视觉注意力经对象掩码投影并按指令角色分组，用于跨任务与策略比较；使用动态时间规整将注意力过程与成功参考对齐以消除速度差异；在成功回合上进行保形校准，以α=0.05的标称误停目标设定持续偏离的早停阈值。
AI.result: 87个基准外案例在OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、UniVLA和π0.5上均表现异常：24条可行指令无一完成，不可行或危险请求亦触发行为替换。OGAM在四种策略上于20秒预算内以5-12秒中位时间终止87-100%的失败回合，观测误停率为3-5%，且无需失败标注训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 有限的基准测试能够识别出支持在线干预的注意力模式，使系统在失败完全展开之前即可介入，从而将系统化测试与运行时保障有效衔接。

title: Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization
summary: Diffusion policies provide expressive action distributions for continuous-control reinforcement learning. However, safety-aware online diffusion policy optimization remains underexplored, particularly methods that use predictive reachability information without an explicit dynamics model. We propose Reachability-Aware Diffusion Policy Optimization (RADPO), a model-free method that combines predictive first-hit safety estimation with cumulative-cost budget feedback. RADPO learns a discounted first-hit reachability value that captures the discounted risk of a cost event, assigns larger weight to events that occur sooner, and uses this signal to shape the reward. A separate dual-like multiplier adjusts the shaping strength according to realized episodic costs relative to a prescribed budget. The diffusion actor improves through weighted denoising regression on candidate actions scored by the reward critic. Our approach requires neither a learned dynamics model, action gradients through the critics, nor differentiation through the reverse diffusion sampler. We establish theoretical properties of the reachability value and show that accumulated reachability penalty provides a conservative surrogate for future discounted cumulative cost. Across ten continuous-control safety tasks, RADPO achieves competitive reward-cost trade-offs, with substantial reductions in constraint violations on several tasks relative to the compared baselines. Our theoretical and empirical analysis supports that combining reachability with cumulative budget feedback is a viable approach to safety-aware diffusion policies.

AI.tldr: 提出RADPO：一种无模型、安全感知的在线扩散策略优化方法，结合预测性首次命中可达性估计与累积成本预算反馈，在十个连续控制安全任务上取得竞争性奖励-成本权衡。
AI.motivation: 扩散策略能为连续控制强化学习提供表达力强的动作分布，但安全感知的在线扩散策略优化仍研究不足，尤其是无需显式动力学模型、又能利用预测性可达性信息的方法尚属空白。
AI.method: RADPO为无模型方法：学习一个折扣首次命中可达性价值，刻画成本事件的折扣风险并给较早发生的事件更大权重，据此塑形奖励；另设类似对偶变量的乘子，依据实际回合成本相对预设预算调整塑形强度；扩散actor通过加权去噪回归在由奖励critic评分的候选动作上改进。方法不需要学习动力学模型、不需要通过critic的动作梯度，也不需要穿过逆向扩散采样器的微分。
AI.result: 建立了可达性价值的理论性质，证明累积可达性惩罚是未来折扣累积成本的保守替代。在十个连续控制安全任务上，RADPO获得竞争性的奖励-成本权衡，并在若干任务上相对基线大幅降低约束违反。
AI.conclusion: 理论与实证分析表明，将可达性与累积预算反馈相结合，是构建安全感知扩散策略的可行途径。

title: EpicWorldModel: Exploration-driven Planning with Latent World Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 18 pages, 8 figures, 5 tables (11 pages main text, 4 pages appendix)
summary: Latent world models based on Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) are deterministic by design. While successful in fully observable scenarios, this paradigm breaks down when past observations and actions lead to multiple plausible future possibilities, e.g., due to occlusion. We introduce EpicWorldModel, a framework to train stochastic JEPAs for environments and tasks with inherent uncertainty under partially observability. We jointly train the EpicWorldModel predictor with its latent representation space to directly predict multiple potential future states using a flow-matching objective, when the goal-relevant scene content is absent from the conditioning history. We show that flow predictive variance, motivated by its relation to an upper bound on predictive entropy, serves as a useful exploration guidance for planning. By incorporating this uncertainty signal into Cross-Entropy Method (CEM)-based planning, our approach balances goal-reaching with exploration of uncertain regions where occluded goals are most likely to be located. We demonstrate the effectiveness of EpicWorldModel through a series of latent planning experiments with the best or on-par performance across tasks, showing up to 22% empirical improvement in success rate over LeWorldModel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EpicWorldModel，一种面向部分可观测、具内在不确定性环境的随机 JEPA 世界模型框架，通过流匹配目标联合训练预测器与隐表示空间，并能以流预测方差作为探索引导信号。
AI.motivation: 基于 JEPA 的潜在世界模型本质上是确定性的，在完全可观测场景下有效，但当历史观测与动作对应多个可能未来（如遮挡导致）时会失效，因此需要随机化的世界模型以应对固有的不确定性。
AI.method: 提出 EpicWorldModel：在条件历史中缺失目标相关场景内容时，采用流匹配（flow-matching）目标联合训练预测器与其隐表示空间，直接预测多个潜在未来状态；并以流预测方差（其与预测熵上界相关）作为探索引导，将其融入 CEM 规划以平衡目标达成与对遮挡目标可能所在不确定区域的探索。
AI.result: 在一系列潜在规划实验中取得最佳或持平性能，相较 LeWorldModel 成功率最高提升约 22%。
AI.conclusion: EpicWorldModel 通过随机化 JEPA 与基于流预测方差的探索机制，有效解决了部分可观测下的不确定性建模与规划问题，验证了不确定性信号在潜在规划中的实用价值。

title: CentriQ: Calibration-Free Quantization of Diffusion Transformers via Exact Mean Centering
comment: Code and project page will be released soon
summary: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) achieve state-of-the-art image generation, but their sampling cost limits deployment. Quantizing both weights and activations to 4 bits reduces this cost, yet existing methods fall short in one of two ways. Calibration-based methods are tied to a specific checkpoint and prompt distribution, whereas data-free Hadamard rotation, effective for LLMs, loses quality on DiTs. We show that this loss has a structural cause. Adaptive layer-norm conditioning adds a per-token mean to the activations, and at the widths of the evaluated DiTs, the Hadamard rotations used by data-free methods cannot spread this mean uniformly across coordinates. A single dominant direction therefore survives the rotation and sets the quantization range. We introduce CentriQ, a calibration-free quantizer that centers each token before rotation and restores the mean exactly through a rank-1 full-precision branch, so that per-token scales follow in closed form without data. Weights are fitted under a robust $\ell_p$ objective that tracks the dense mode of each group and discounts heavy tails. Across three DiTs, CentriQ matches the quality of calibrated SVDQuant at 4 bits, whereas calibration-free weight quantizers with plain per-token activation quantization collapse or degrade substantially. CentriQ outperforms the strongest calibration-free method reported to date at 2-bit weights. It is also the first calibration-free method to retain usable image quality at 2-bit activations.

AI.tldr: 提出CentriQ，一种免校准的扩散Transformer 4比特量化器，在4比特下达到校准方法SVDQuant的质量，并首次在2比特激活下保持可用图像质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiT）采样成本高，将权重和激活量化为4比特可降低成本。但现有方法存在缺陷：基于校准的方法依赖特定checkpoint和提示分布；而无数据的Hadamard旋转方法（对LLM有效）在DiT上质量下降。
AI.method: 作者指出质量下降有结构性原因：自适应层归一化（AdaLN）条件为激活加入每token均值，而所用DiT宽度下，无数据方法的Hadamard旋转无法将该均值均匀分散到各坐标，导致单一主导方向存留并决定量化范围。为此提出CentriQ：在旋转前对每个token中心化，并通过一个rank-1全精度分支精确恢复该均值，从而无需数据即可闭式得到每token缩放。权重在鲁棒ℓp目标下拟合，跟踪每组的密集模式并抑制重尾。
AI.result: 在三个DiT上，CentriQ在4比特下匹配校准方法SVDQuant的质量，而采用普通每token激活量化的免校准权重量化器则崩溃或显著退化。CentriQ在2比特权重下优于迄今最强的免校准方法，并且是首个在2比特激活下保持可用图像质量的免校准方法。
AI.conclusion: CentriQ通过针对AdaLN引入的每token均值做中心化与rank-1恢复，解决了免校准Hadamard旋转在DiT上失效的结构性原因，实现了免校准、高精度的DiT低比特量化，在4比特追平校准方法，并首次于2比特激活下保持可用质量。

title: KineWorld: Action-Induced Transport Fields for Embodied World Modeling
summary: Embodied world models predict the visual consequences of candidate actions before execution. However, existing action-conditioned world models often adopt uniformly weighted visual generation objectives that can be misaligned with embodied prediction needs. Even with explicit motion conditioning, these objectives can underemphasize spatially sparse changes that are critical to interaction. We propose KineWorld, a transport-aware world-modeling framework that extends robot kinematics from motion conditioning to the spatial allocation of generative supervision. Kinematic Transport Lifting (KTL) constructs renderer-derived, camera-aligned transport fields from commanded robot motion. Transport-Aware World Diffusion (TAWD) calibrates their motion support on the video-latent grid and reweights future-RGB flow matching through a normalized mixture of uniform and transport-focused distributions. We train KineWorld using ALOHA-AgileX bimanual manipulation data from RoboTwin 2.0. KineWorld achieves an EWMScore-P of 68.95 in single-view evaluation and a TWB-Score of 54.82 in multi-view evaluation. These results support a shift from appearance fitting toward action-consequence modeling for embodied decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出 KineWorld，将机器人运动学从运动条件扩展到生成监督的空间分配，通过运动传输场重加权扩散训练，提升具身世界模型的行动后果建模能力。
AI.motivation: 现有动作条件世界模型多采用均匀加权的视觉生成目标，与具身预测需求不匹配；即使引入显式运动条件，这类目标仍会低估对交互至关重要的空间稀疏变化。
AI.method: KineWorld 框架包含两个组件：Kinematic Transport Lifting（KTL）依据指令机器人运动构建渲染器导出的、相机对齐的传输场；Transport-Aware World Diffusion（TAWD）在视频潜空间网格上校准其运动支撑，并通过均匀分布与传输聚焦分布的归一化混合，对后续 RGB 的 flow matching 进行重加权。训练数据为 RoboTwin 2.0 的 ALOHA-AgileX 双臂操作数据。
AI.result: 单视角评估中 EWMScore-P 达 68.95，多视角评估中 TWB-Score 达 54.82。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明世界模型应从外观拟合转向行动后果建模，以更好服务于具身决策。

title: RealtimeWAM: One-Step Asynchronous World Action Models
comment: The code and checkpoints are available at $\href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam}{\text{this https URL}}$
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) incorporate visual representations from video generation backbones to guide action prediction. Recent efficient WAMs adopt Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architectures and compute video representations once for reuse by the action expert. However, intra-expert iteration (\ie, multi-step action denoising) and inter-expert waiting (\ie, sequential execution of the video and action experts) still limit inference efficiency. To this end, we present RealtimeWAM, an extremely efficient WAM variant with one-step action generation and asynchronous inference, addressing these two bottlenecks. To reduce intra-expert iteration, we propose Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD) to address a local-global error gap: low local consistency error alone does not guarantee accurate final actions. TACD supplements local consistency with explicit supervision from the frozen teacher's multi-step rollout endpoint, enabling accurate one-step action generation. Additionally, we propose Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP) to eliminate unnecessary expert-level waiting. It overlaps the two experts through block-wise sharing of the video KV cache, synchronizing only immediately before the corresponding action attention consumes it. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks (\eg, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus and RoboTwin) and model variants (\eg, Fast-WAM and Faster-WAM) demonstrate the superiority of RealtimeWAM. Notably, RealtimeWAM maintains near-lossless performance (\ie, $<1\%$ drop) across these benchmarks while delivering significant end-to-end speedup (\eg, $\sim25\times$ on H100). Our code and checkpoints are available via this \href{https://github.com/ModelTC/LightX2V/tree/main/examples/realtimewam}{link}.

AI.tldr: 提出 RealtimeWAM，通过教师锚定一致性蒸馏与跨专家波前流水线，实现一步动作生成与异步推理，大幅提升 WAM 效率且性能近乎无损。
AI.motivation: 现有高效 WAM 采用 MoT 架构并复用视频表示，但专家内多步动作去噪迭代与专家间顺序执行的等待，仍严重制约推理效率。
AI.method: 1) Teacher-Anchored Consistency Distillation (TACD)：以冻结教师多步 rollout 端点提供显式监督，弥补仅靠局部一致性误差无法保证最终动作准确的局部-全局误差差距，实现一步动作生成；2) Cross-Expert Wavefront Pipelining (CEWP)：通过逐块共享视频 KV cache 使两专家重叠执行，仅在动作注意力消费前同步，消除专家级等待。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、RoboTwin 等基准及 Fast-WAM、Faster-WAM 等模型变体上均表现优越；性能近乎无损（下降 <1%），端到端显著加速（H100 上约 25×）。
AI.conclusion: RealtimeWAM 同时缓解专家内迭代与专家间等待两大瓶颈，在保持近无损性能的同时实现数量级加速，验证了一步生成与异步推理组合的有效性。

title: H-JEPA: End-to-End Learning of Hierarchical World Models for Visual Planning
summary: Long-horizon planning with latent world models requires reasoning across timescales and levels of abstraction. Existing task-agnostic JEPA world models predict and plan at a single timescale or with multiple horizons in one shared latent space. We introduce H-JEPA, an end-to-end recipe for training a hierarchy of action-conditioned JEPAs in which each level predicts farther ahead in its own learned latent space. Planning proceeds top-down: the top level optimizes progress toward the goal, and each level's predictions become subgoals for the planner below it. When factors in the data evolve at separated timescales, higher levels discard fast, unpredictable detail and retain slower task-relevant state. Across four simulated navigation and manipulation environments, hierarchical planning improves over a flat JEPA; on Visual AntMaze, a three-level hierarchy raises success from 18% to 73% using less planner compute. Ablations attribute these gains to both temporal decomposition and higher-level goal representations. With inverse-dynamics supervision, the approach extends to diverse real-robot videos from DROID, where hierarchy improves offline planning fidelity at lower planner compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 H-JEPA，一种端到端训练"动作条件 JEPA 层级"的方法：每一层在各自学习的隐空间中预测更远的未来，规划自顶向下进行，上层输出作为下层的子目标。在四个仿真导航与操作环境中，分层规划优于扁平 JEPA；Visual AntMaze 上三级层级将成功率从 18% 提升到 73% 且规划计算量更少。
AI.motivation: 长时域规划需要跨时间尺度与抽象层级进行推理，而现有任务无关的 JEPA 世界模型只在单一时间尺度、或共享同一隐空间的多时域上做预测与规划，无法有效分离不同时间尺度上演化的因素，导致快速、不可预测的细节干扰慢速但任务相关的状态表征，规划效率与成功率受限。
AI.method: 提出 H-JEPA：端到端训练一组动作条件 JEPA 构成的层级结构，每一层在自身学习到的隐空间中预测更远的未来。规划采用自顶向下方式——顶层优化朝向目标的进展，每层的预测作为其下一层规划器的子目标。当数据中因素按分离的时间尺度演化时，高层丢弃快速、不可预测的细节，保留慢速、任务相关的状态。此外引入逆动力学监督，使方法可扩展到真实机器人视频。
AI.result: 在四个仿真导航与操作环境中，分层规划均优于扁平 JEPA；Visual AntMaze 上，三级层级在更少规划器计算量下将成功率从 18% 提升至 73%。消融实验表明增益同时来自时间分解与高层目标表征两方面。在 DROID 的多样化真实机器人视频上，结合逆动力学监督，层级结构在更低规划计算量下提升了离线规划保真度。
AI.conclusion: 将 JEPA 世界模型按时间尺度组织成层级、并配合自顶向下的子目标规划，能够有效实现长时域规划：既提升成功率与离线规划保真度，又降低规划计算开销，且可从仿真迁移到真实机器人视频，具有良好的通用性。

title: TAPDreamer: Transferable Adversarial Patches for World Action Models
summary: World models learn to predict how their environment will evolve, making them an important foundation for general-purpose robotic control. Yet world action models depend on camera inputs whose manipulation can corrupt the visual representations used across tasks and action policies. Existing attacks on these models optimize against the victim's actions or predicted futures and therefore require access to target-model outputs. In this paper, we propose an attack, TAPDreamer, against world action models that instead uses a public encoder alone to construct a fixed local perturbation that transfers across tasks and action architectures. TAPDreamer requires no target-policy queries. Our key insight is that interactions between patch-induced changes in attention weights and value vectors broadcast a nearly identical representation shift far beyond the patch footprint, and this shift remains stable across task observations. Guided by this insight, TAPDreamer uses six frames from one source task to maximize the global L1 distance between clean and patched encoder representations. In closed-loop evaluation, one frozen patch per benchmark, covering about 6.5% of the input, reduces FastWAM's success rate from 97.7% to 0.0% across 40 LIBERO tasks and from 90.8% to 0.0% across 50 RoboTwin tasks; matched random patches retain 81.5% and 79.2% success. The same patches reduce success to 2.1% and 0.8% on two DreamWAM configurations and to 10.0% on Motus. These results show that protecting downstream action generation alone is insufficient: defenses for world action models must also secure shared visual encoders against persistent local perturbations.

AI.tldr: 提出TAPDreamer攻击：仅需公有编码器、无需查询目标策略，用单个固定局部补丁即可跨任务、跨动作架构迁移，将世界动作模型成功率打到接近0%。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型依赖摄像头输入，视觉表征被污染会同时破坏多项任务与动作策略。已有攻击需针对受害模型的动作或预测未来进行优化，必须访问目标模型输出，实用性受限。作者希望构建一种无需目标策略查询、可跨任务与跨架构迁移的固定局部扰动攻击。
AI.method: 核心洞察：补丁在注意力权重上引起的改变与value向量交互，会把近乎相同的表征偏移广播到远超补丁范围的区域，且该偏移在不同任务观测下保持稳定。据此，TAPDreamer仅用公有编码器，取某一源任务的六帧，最大化干净与加补丁编码器表征之间的全局L1距离，从而构造固定局部补丁（约占输入6.5%），无需查询目标策略。
AI.result: 闭环评测中，每个基准仅需一个冻结补丁：FastWAM在40个LIBERO任务上成功率从97.7%降至0.0%，在50个RoboTwin任务上从90.8%降至0.0%；等面积随机补丁仍保持81.5%与79.2%。同一补丁使两种DreamWAM配置成功率降至2.1%与0.8%，使Motus降至10.0%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，仅保护下游动作生成并不充分：世界动作模型的防御必须同时保护共享视觉编码器，以抵御持久性的局部扰动。

title: HelixWorld: A Real-time Interactive Audio-Visual World Model
summary: World simulation is inherently multisensory, demanding synchronized visual and acoustic dynamics in real time. Yet prevailing interactive world models remain strictly silent, focusing exclusively on visual rendering and control while overlooking the acoustic dimension. We present HelixWorld, a real-time interactive audio-visual world model where visual scenes and camera-grounded spatial stereo sound co-evolve natively under user interaction. We curate a high-fidelity spatial audio-visual dataset with true stereo acoustics and metric camera poses, upon which we pre-train a bidirectional teacher conditioned on 6-DoF camera trajectories and user actions. To enable low-latency causal interaction, we distill the teacher into a few-step streaming student via an online trajectory distillation loss, sustaining drift-free joint audio-visual rollouts at 24 FPS on a single GPU. Furthermore, we formalize spatial-acoustic consistency and introduce HelixBench to evaluate whether synthesized sound fields faithfully track dynamic viewpoint motion. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HelixWorld matches state-of-the-art silent world models in visual fidelity and responsiveness, while significantly surpassing existing baselines in camera-aligned spatial-acoustic immersion.

AI.tldr: HelixWorld：首个实时交互式音视频世界模型，视觉与相机对齐的空间立体声原生协同演化，24FPS单卡无漂移联合推演，并提出HelixBench评测空间声学一致性。
AI.motivation: 现实世界模拟本质上是多感官的，需要视觉与声学动态实时同步。然而现有交互式世界模型均为"静音"，仅关注视觉渲染与控制，忽略了声学维度，导致沉浸感与真实感受限。
AI.method: 1) 构建高保真空间音视频数据集，含真实立体声与度量相机位姿；2) 以6-DoF相机轨迹和用户动作为条件预训练双向教师模型；3) 通过在线轨迹蒸馏损失将教师蒸馏为少步流式学生模型，实现低延迟因果交互；4) 形式化空间-声学一致性指标，并提出HelixBench基准。
AI.result: 在单GPU上以24 FPS实现无漂移的联合音视频推演；视觉保真度与响应性匹配当前最先进的静音世界模型，同时在相机对齐的空间声学沉浸感上显著超越现有基线。
AI.conclusion: HelixWorld将声学维度原生引入实时交互式世界模型，实现视觉与空间立体声的协同演化，并建立了空间声学一致性的评测范式，为多感官世界模拟提供了新方向。

title: DABACO: A Multi-Camera Dataset and Benchmark for Screen Localization and Pointing Estimation
comment: 21 pages, 5 figures, 6 tables. Dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22797835. Code and toolkit: https://domondo.github.io/dabaco-dataset-toolkit/
summary:
Screen localization and pointing estimation are key to low-cost interactive devices. Yet developing and evaluating these algorithms requires realistic data: synthetic captures cannot fully reproduce the optical distortion, rolling shutter, motion blur, and display processing of a physical acquisition, and most existing datasets provide static images rather than the video needed to assess continuous pointing. In this paper, we introduce the DABACO Dataset. Developed within the DABACO (Dispositivo Apuntador de BAjo COste, or Low-Cost Pointing Device) project, this dataset supports the development and evaluation of screen detection and camera-based pointing algorithms for embedded systems. It comprises video sequences captured with multiple low-cost camera sensors, including monochrome global-shutter and color rolling-shutter modules, on embedded platforms such as the Raspberry Pi 4B and ESP32-S3.
  We present a systematic annotation pipeline combining temporary visual watermarking, optical-flow tracking, manual verification, and marker removal. Both the original marked captures and the marker-free images, together with explicit corner annotations and modification masks, are released to support auditing and the study of potential reconstruction bias.
  In addition, we release an open-source evaluation toolkit with two reference baselines: a classical screen-detection pipeline based on edge and contour geometry, and a closed-vocabulary, off-the-shelf YOLOv8 segmentation model evaluated without dataset-specific training. Both are evaluated on a general-purpose computer using Intersection over Union, corner error, and pointing error, establishing initial reference results for future embedded implementations. Overall, DABACO addresses a gap in existing resources and is intended to support the development and evaluation of new low-cost screen-localization and pointing systems.

AI.tldr: DABACO数据集：面向低成本屏幕定位与指向估计的多传感器视频数据集，含标注流水线与开源评测工具包及两个基线。
AI.motivation: 低成本交互设备的屏幕定位与指向估计算法亟需真实数据；合成数据无法复现光学畸变、卷帘快门、运动模糊与显示处理，而现有数据集多为静态图像，无法评估连续指向。
AI.method: 构建DABACO数据集：采集单色全局快门与彩色卷帘快门等低成本相机模组（Raspberry Pi 4B、ESP32-S3）的视频序列；采用临时视觉水印、光流跟踪、人工校验与标记移除的系统化标注流水线；同步发布原始带标记与去标记图像、角点标注及修改掩码；并开源评测工具包，包含基于边缘与轮廓几何的经典屏幕检测流程，以及未经数据集微调的闭词表YOLOv8分割模型。
AI.result: 在通用计算机上以IoU、角点误差和指向误差对两个基线进行评测，给出了嵌入式实现的初始参考结果。
AI.conclusion: DABACO填补了现有资源空白，可支持低成本屏幕定位与指向系统的开发与评测，并支持对潜在重建偏差的审计与研究。

title: A Multidimensional Model for Quantifying Tonal Strength: A Continuous Framework of Analyzing Tonal Evolution Beyond Tonal-Atonal Binary Classification
summary: Tonality is a fundamental organizing principle of Western music. However, the gradual transition from common-practice tonality to atonality around the turn of the twentieth century cannot be captured by binary labels. To characterize intermediate tonal states and trace this evolution, we propose a multidimensional framework for quantifying tonal strength, grounded in tonal theory and mechanisms underlying tonal dissolution. This framework operationalizes the global statistical regularity, temporal coherence, and local perceptual alignment of tonal organization through three complementary features: pitch-class distribution uniformity, temporal stability of tonal centers, and local tonal clarity, respectively. To validate the model, we introduce two new datasets: a binary dataset comprising 196 tonal and atonal pieces, and a historical MIDI corpus of 1,561 compositions by 21 composers spanning the Baroque era to the early twentieth century. The proposed model achieves high discriminative performance on the binary classification task (F_1=0.985), and quantitatively reveals a continuous historical trajectory from established tonality through progressive weakening to eventual dissolution. Computational analysis of representative composers further confirms significant declines in tonal strength throughout the careers of late-Romantic and modernist figures. Additionally, analysis of EMOPIA dataset reveals a weak but statistically significant positive correlation between higher tonal strength values and positive emotional valence. This work establishes a unified quantitative model for analyzing tonal evolution and provides a continuous measure for future behavioral and neurophysiological investigations of the relationships among tonal organization, musical emotion, and cognition.

AI.tldr: 提出一个多维调性强度量化框架，通过音级分布均匀度、调性中心时间稳定性和局部调性清晰度三个特征刻画调性状态，在196首二分类数据集上F_1=0.985，并在1561首历史语料中揭示从调性确立到逐渐瓦解的连续演化轨迹。
AI.motivation: 西方音乐由共性实践调性向无调性的过渡是渐进过程，二元的"调性/无调性"标签无法刻画中间状态，因此需要一个连续、可量化的调性强度模型来追踪这一演化。
AI.method: 基于调性理论及调性消解机制，构建三维框架：全局统计规律用音级分布均匀度衡量，时间连贯性用调性中心的时间稳定性衡量，局部知觉一致性用局部调性清晰度衡量。验证使用两个新数据集：196首作品的二分类数据集，以及21位作曲家、跨巴洛克至20世纪初的1561首MIDI历史语料；并分析EMOPIA数据集中调性强度与情感效价的关系。
AI.result: 二分类任务F_1达0.985；量化呈现从调性确立、逐步弱化到最终瓦解的连续历史轨迹；代表性晚期浪漫派与现代主义作曲家创作生涯中调性强度显著下降；EMOPIA分析显示调性强度与正性情感效价存在弱但统计显著的正相关。
AI.conclusion: 该工作建立了分析调性演化的统一量化模型，为未来关于调性组织、音乐情感与认知关系的行为学及神经生理学研究提供了连续测量指标。

title: Kandinsky 6.0 Video: Foundation Models for Synchronized Video and Audio Generation
comment: Technical report on the open-source T2AV model. GitHub: https://github.com/kandinskylab/kandinsky-6
summary: We present Kandinsky 6.0 Video, a family of foundation diffusion models for synchronized text-to-audio-video generation, comprising Kandinsky 6.0 Video Lite (3B parameters) and Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro (29B parameters). Both models generate 5-second video clips with synchronized 44 kHz audio, including lip-sync, in text-to-audio-video (T2AV) and image-to-audio-video (I2AV) modes; a built-in super-resolution model raises the output resolution to Full-HD (1920$\times$1080). Building on the video generation capabilities of Kandinsky 5.0, Kandinsky 6.0 Video employs a dual-stream CrossDiT architecture that connects a pretrained video stream and a newly trained audio stream through bidirectional cross-attention for temporal and semantic alignment. Our continuous pretraining strategy first trains the audio stream from scratch on large-scale audio corpora and then trains both streams jointly on paired audio-video data while preserving unimodal fidelity; pretraining is followed by supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement-learning-based post-training, and distillation. In side-by-side human evaluation, Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro clearly outperforms its predecessor, Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro, and remains competitive with leading audio-video generation models, particularly in speech quality. To accelerate open research and deployment in multimedia generation, we release the code, model checkpoints, and diffusers integration under the MIT license.

AI.tldr: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 是一个支持文本/图像到音视频同步生成的基础扩散模型系列（Lite 3B 与 Pro 29B），采用双流 CrossDiT 架构和连续预训练策略，可生成 5 秒、44 kHz 同步音频的 1080p 视频，性能超越前代并具竞争力，代码与权重以 MIT 许可开源。
AI.motivation: 音视频同步生成（T2AV/I2AV）仍需兼顾画面质量与语音等音频保真度的统一模型。作者希望在前代 Kandinsky 5.0 视频生成能力基础上，扩展出同步音频生成能力，并提供可开源部署的模型族。
AI.method: 提出 Kandinsky 6.0 Video 模型族：Lite（3B）与 Pro（29B）。核心为双流 CrossDiT 架构，将预训练视频流与新训练的音频流通过双向交叉注意力连接，实现时序与语义对齐；采用连续预训练策略（先在音频语料上从零训练音频流，再在音视频配对数据上联合训练并保持单模态保真度），随后进行监督微调、基于强化学习的后训练与蒸馏；另配内置超分模型将分辨率提升至 Full-HD（1920×1080）。
AI.result: 两模型均可生成 5 秒视频及同步 44 kHz 音频（含唇形同步），支持 T2AV 与 I2AV 模式。人工并排评测中，Kandinsky 6.0 Video Pro 明显优于前代 Kandinsky 5.0 Video Pro，并与主流音视频生成模型保持竞争力，尤其在语音质量方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: Kandinsky 6.0 Video 通过双流架构与分阶段训练实现了高质量音视频同步生成，并以 MIT 许可开源代码、模型检查点及 diffusers 集成，以促进多媒体生成领域的开放研究与部署。

title: A Spatiotemporal Semantic Importance-Guided Unified Compression and Editing Framework for AI-Generated Videos
summary: AI-generated videos are rapidly increasing in volume, duration, and resolution, creating growing demands for efficient storage and transmission. Unlike natural videos captured from the physical world, AI-generated videos are samples from a learned generative distribution, where semantic structures are critical to content consistency, while many local textures and stochastic details can be plausibly regenerated. This distinction suggests that compression should preserve semantically important spatiotemporal information rather than reconstruct every pixel of a particular generative sample. Beyond reconstruction, AI-generated videos also create a practical need for prompt-based editing, where users expect to modify generated content while preserving its original spatiotemporal semantics. Motivated by these observations, we propose a unified compression and editing framework for AI-generated videos that incorporates a frozen video generator as a reusable generative prior. Within this framework, we design three spatiotemporal semantic importance-guided techniques that respectively address what to transmit, how much to transmit, and how to use the transmitted side information. First, an innovation selection method projects the latent discrepancy using spatiotemporal semantic importance, so that the selected innovations prioritize semantic invariants over replaceable generative variations. Second, a frame-adaptive bit allocation method estimates the nonuniform semantic demands of latent frames and allocates more innovations to frames requiring stronger semantic preservation. Third, a unified reconstruction and editing method continuously adjusts the influence of the transmitted side information, enabling the same compressed representation to provide strong guidance for faithful reconstruction or serve as a flexible semantic anchor for structure-preserving prompt-driven editing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向AI生成视频的统一压缩与编辑框架，将冻结的视频生成器作为可复用生成先验，并设计三种时空语义重要性引导技术，分别解决传输什么、传输多少以及如何使用传输的边信息三个问题。
AI.motivation: AI生成视频在体量、时长和分辨率上快速增长，对高效存储与传输提出更高需求。与自然视频不同，AI生成视频是学习到的生成分布的采样，其语义结构对内容一致性至关重要，而许多局部纹理与随机细节可以被合理再生成。因此压缩应保留语义重要的时空信息，而非重建某个生成样本的每个像素。此外，用户还需要基于提示的编辑功能，在修改内容的同时保持原始时空语义，这促使作者提出统一框架。
AI.method: 框架引入冻结的视频生成器作为可复用生成先验，并设计三种时空语义重要性引导技术。第一，创新选择方法（innovation selection）：利用时空语义重要性投影潜空间差异，使选中的创新优先保留语义不变量而非可替换的生成变化。第二，帧自适应比特分配方法（frame-adaptive bit allocation）：估计潜帧非均匀的语义需求，将更多创新分配给更需要语义保留的帧。第三，统一重建与编辑方法：持续调节传输边信息的影响强度，使同一压缩表示既能为忠实重建提供强引导，又可作为结构保持的提示驱动编辑的灵活语义锚点。
AI.result: 摘要未提供具体的实验数据或对比结果，主要通过框架设计与三类技术说明其对AI生成视频压缩效率与编辑灵活性的潜在提升。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种统一压缩与编辑框架，借助冻结生成先验与时空语义重要性引导，实现语义优先的传输策略和可调边信息利用，从而兼顾AI生成视频的高效压缩与结构保持的提示驱动编辑。

title: UltraDub: Towards Authentic Dubbing by Unifying Visually-Steered Flow Learning and Trajectory Guidance
summary: Visual voice cloning requires intelligible, speaker-consistent speech synchronized with visible articulation. However, sequential multimodal conditioning can disrupt previously established temporal and speaker cues, while imbalanced inference guidance can improve linguistic accuracy at the expense of lip synchronization. In this paper, we propose UltraDub, a Unifying Visually-Steered Flow learning and trajectory Guidance Dubbing framework that leverages vision in two ways: as continuous motion for multimodal context aggregation, and as structural rhythm for trajectory rectification. Specifically, we introduce the Motion-guided Dual-context Retrieving (MDR) module, which continually recalibrates linguistic and speaker-style retrieval through shared lip-motion query residuals, utilizing independent time-conditioned gates to regulate their contributions. Furthermore, we propose Rhythm-anchored Trajectory Guidance (RTG), a training-free mechanism that evaluates hierarchical multimodal corrections at a visual-only predictive midpoint, safely strengthening semantic conditioning while better preserving temporal alignment. Finally, we construct DiverseDub, a multi-scenario benchmark to evaluate video dubbing in the wild. Extensive experiments demonstrate that UltraDub achieves state-of-the-art performance across four datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出UltraDub框架，通过视觉引导的流学习与轨迹指导实现视觉语音克隆，达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 视觉语音克隆需同时满足可懂度、说话人一致性和唇形同步。但序贯多模态条件会破坏已建立的时序与说话人线索，而推理引导不平衡会在提升语言准确率时牺牲唇同步。
AI.method: 1) 统一视觉引导的流学习与轨迹指导配音框架（UltraDub），将视觉同时用作连续运动（多模态上下文聚合）与结构节律（轨迹校正）；2) 运动引导双上下文检索（MDR）模块，通过共享唇动查询残差持续重校准语言与说话人风格检索，并用独立时间条件门控调节二者贡献；3) 节律锚定轨迹指导（RTG），一种免训练机制，在纯视觉预测中点评估分层多模态校正，安全增强语义条件并更好保持时序对齐。
AI.result: 构建了多场景基准DiverseDub，用于评估真实场景视频配音；大量实验表明UltraDub在四个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: UltraDub通过双重利用视觉信息与免训练轨迹指导，有效缓解多模态条件干扰与引导失衡问题，在视觉语音克隆任务上实现领先效果。

title: Evolutionary Giant Tour for CVRP using NSE and ML Heuristic]{Evolutionary Giant Tour approach for CVRP using Node Shift Encoding and Machine Learning repair heuristic
summary: The Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP) remains a central concern in logistics research, as route optimisation under rigid capacity and fleet restrictions directly affects operational performance. Genetic Algorithms are widely used for this problem, yet their effectiveness depends heavily on the choice of solution encoding and on the mechanisms used to preserve feasibility during the search. This paper proposes a sequential framework that separates the evolutionary process from route construction. We adapt Node Shift Encoding (NSE) to the CVRP giant-tour setting and benchmark it against Path Representation and Double Chromosome. We further propose an unsupervised machine-learning repair heuristic that restores fleet feasibility after an unconstrained linear split, and compare this pipeline against fleet-constrained split taken from the literature. Computational tests on standard benchmark instances show that NSE consistently outperforms the other encodings in solution quality and feasibility. The repair heuristic restores feasibility in approximately 72\% of cases, and the Linear-Split-ML-Heuristic pipeline proves more robust than the constrained split, delivering lower costs and higher feasibility rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种将进化过程与路径构造分离的序贯框架，用于带容量约束的车辆路径问题（CVRP）：将节点移位编码（NSE）适配到巨型回路（giant-tour）设定，并与路径表示和双染色体编码进行对比；同时提出一种无监督机器学习修复启发式以恢复车队可行性，与文献中的车队约束分割方法比较。基准算例表明NSE在解质量与可行性上最优，修复启发式约72%情形可恢复可行性，Linear-Split-ML-Heuristic流程比约束分割更稳健。
AI.motivation: CVRP中严格的容量与车队限制使路径优化直接影响运营绩效，而遗传算法的有效性高度依赖解的编码方式与搜索过程中维持可行性的机制，现有方法在此方面存在明显依赖性与局限，因此需要系统比较编码策略并提出更稳健的可行性修复机制。
AI.method: 提出序贯框架，将进化搜索与路径构造解耦：1）将NSE适配到CVRP的giant-tour表示，并与Path Representation、Double Chromosome三种编码进行基准对比；2）提出无监督机器学习修复启发式，在无约束线性分割后恢复车队可行性；3）将该Linear-Split-ML-Heuristic流程与文献中车队约束分割（fleet-constrained split）进行对比，在标准基准算例上开展计算实验。
AI.result: 在标准基准算例上，NSE在解质量与可行性上一致优于其他两种编码；修复启发式约在72%的情形下成功恢复可行性；Linear-Split-ML-Heuristic流程比约束分割更稳健，获得更低成本与更高可行性率。
AI.conclusion: 编码选择对遗传算法求解CVRP的效果具有决定性影响，NSE是更优的编码方案；将无约束线性分割与无监督机器学习修复启发式结合，可获得比传统车队约束分割更稳健、成本更低且可行性更高的求解流程。

title: Distribution Matching Evolutionary Algorithms for Rare Event Sampling
summary: A novel discovery is one which is both useful and surprising: a generative model's output is a useful discovery if it has a low probability of being generated (it's surprising) and a high reward (it's useful). Global optimization can directly increase the probability of sampling high rewards but typically requires updating model weights. Such gradient based optimization is expensive and bars using capable closed-source models. Instead, modern search methods for discovery sacrifice the global target, and use evolutionary algorithms with local reward maximizing objectives, permitting the search to focus only on high probability samples. In this paper, we interpret various evolutionary algorithms as approximate Markov Chain Monte Carlo, an optimization-free method to sample from complex distributions. This interpretation allows developing Distribution Matching Evolutionary Algorithms (DME), a class of search methods which sample from a global target distribution without updating weights. Empirically, DME has a higher sample efficiency than existing methods on problems requiring many samples to find a solution.

AI.tldr: 该论文将进化算法解释为近似马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC），并提出分布匹配进化算法（DME），无需更新模型权重即可从全局目标分布采样，在需要大量样本的问题上具有更高的样本效率。
AI.motivation: 新发现应兼具"有用"（高奖励）与"令人惊讶"（低生成概率）两个特性。全局优化可直接提升高奖励样本的采样概率，但通常需要更新模型权重；这种基于梯度的优化代价高昂，且无法用于闭源能力模型。现有搜索方法为此牺牲全局目标，转而采用带有局部奖励最大化目标的进化算法，使搜索只能聚焦于高概率样本，从而削弱了"惊讶性"。
AI.method: 作者将多种进化算法统一解释为近似马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）——一种无需优化的复杂分布采样方法。基于这一解释，提出分布匹配进化算法（DME），该类搜索方法能够在不更新权重的前提下，从全局目标分布中进行采样。
AI.result: 在需要大量样本才能找到解的问题上，DME 的样本效率高于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 将进化算法视为近似 MCMC 是一种有效的理论视角，据此设计的 DME 在无需梯度更新的条件下实现了对全局目标分布的采样，并在样本效率上优于已有方法。

title: Adaptive Operator Selection in Bilevel Large Neighborhood Search for Electric Autonomous Dial-a-Ride Problem under Uncertainty
summary: The electric autonomous dial-a-ride problem (EADARP) extends the classical dial-a-ride problem by incorporating battery and charging constraints for electric vehicles. In practice, travel-time uncertainty can cause violations of time-window constraints. Large neighborhood search is effective for solving the EADARP, but its performance can depend on the choice of insertion operator during the repair phase. This paper investigates insertion-operator selection within a bilevel large neighborhood search framework for deterministic and chance-constrained variants of the EADARP. In the chance-constrained variant, arc travel times are modeled as independent normally distributed random variables, and upper time-window constraints are enforced probabilistically. We consider six selection methods, namely fixed greedy insertion, fixed regret-based insertion, random selection, a deterministic state-based rule, performance-adaptive ALNS selection, and LLM-based state-aware selection. Experimental results show comparable performance on smaller instances, while differences become more evident on larger and more constrained instances. There is no single strategy that performs best across all instances, and the relative performance of the LLM-based, rule-based, and ALNS strategies varies with the problem instance and experimental setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究电动自主需求响应式运输问题（EADARP）中，在双层大邻域搜索框架下的插入算子选择问题，比较六种选择方法在确定性与机会约束变体上的表现。结果表明小规模实例上性能相近，大规模及高约束实例上差异明显，且不存在普适最优策略。
AI.motivation: EADARP在经典需求响应式运输问题基础上加入电动车电池与充电约束；实际中行程时间不确定性会导致时间窗约束被违反。大邻域搜索虽有效，但其修复阶段的插入算子选择会影响性能，且插入算子选择本身缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 在双层大邻域搜索框架中研究插入算子选择，覆盖EADARP的确定性与机会约束两种变体。机会约束变体将弧行程时间建模为独立正态随机变量，对时间窗上界进行概率化约束。比较六种选择方法：固定贪婪插入、固定后悔值插入、随机选择、确定性状态规则、性能自适应ALNS选择、基于LLM的状态感知选择。
AI.result: 小规模实例上各方法性能相当；随着实例规模增大、约束增强，差异更为明显。没有任何单一策略在所有实例上均表现最佳，基于LLM、规则及ALNS的策略相对表现随问题实例和实验设置变化。
AI.conclusion: EADARP的插入算子选择不存在通用最优策略，其效果高度依赖问题实例与实验设置，需针对具体场景进行选择或自适应调整。

title: Chance-Constrained Bi-Objective Evolutionary Optimization for the Open-Pit Mining Operational Planning Problem
summary: Open-pit mining operational planning involves allocating limited resources while satisfying production, equipment, and ore-quality requirements. Existing approaches often assume deterministic ore grades or rely on simulation-based evaluation under uncertainty. In this paper, we propose a chance-constrained bi-objective formulation of the open-pit mining operational planning problem under uncertain ore grades. We aim to maximize ore production and minimize fleet cost while satisfying stochastic quality requirements through chance constraints. We model ore grades as independent normally distributed random variables and derive a deterministic reformulation of the two-sided chance constraints, avoiding sampling or simulation during fitness evaluation. We evaluate four multi-objective evolutionary algorithms on benchmark instances under different levels and structures of uncertainty. Our results show that NSGA-II and NSGA-III generally obtain the best feasible ore-production values, with NSGA-II requiring less computational time. GSEMO has the lowest computational cost but obtains feasible solutions less consistently and generally provides lower solution quality. We also observe that higher confidence and uncertainty levels reduce feasibility, with the effect depending on the uncertainty structure. The results highlight the importance of considering both the magnitude and structure of uncertainty in short-term open-pit operational planning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出露天矿短期作业计划的机会约束双目标优化模型，将矿石品位建模为正态随机变量，推导出双侧机会约束的确定性等价形式，避免仿真评估，并用四种多目标进化算法在基准算例上比较性能。
AI.motivation: 既有露天矿作业计划方法多假设矿石品位确定，或依赖仿真在不确定性下评估，计算代价高且难以直接处理质量约束的置信水平要求。作者希望在不确定品位下同时最大化矿石产量、最小化车队成本，并以机会约束刻画随机质量要求，从而更贴合实际决策需求。
AI.method: 将矿石品位设为相互独立的正态随机变量，构建含双侧机会约束的双目标模型（最大化矿石产量、最小化车队成本）。通过解析推导将机会约束转化为确定性等价约束，使适应度评估无需采样或仿真。在基准算例上，于不同不确定性与不确定性结构水平下，比较四种多目标进化算法（含 NSGA-II、NSGA-III、GSEMO 等）的表现。
AI.result: NSGA-II 与 NSGA-III 通常获得最佳可行矿石产量，其中 NSGA-II 计算时间更少；GSEMO 计算开销最低，但获得可行解的一致性较差、解质量普遍偏低。置信水平与不确定性水平提高会降低可行性，且影响程度取决于不确定性的结构。
AI.conclusion: 在短期露天矿作业计划中，同时考虑不确定性的幅度与结构十分关键；所提出的确定性重构方法可高效支撑多目标进化求解，NSGA-II 在解质量与效率间表现较均衡。

title: Robust Optimization of Spring Design under Variable Manufacturing Tolerances
summary:
A reliable assessment of an optimizer robustness requires tracking controlled changes in parameters to identify sources of algorithmic weakness. Such an approach was applied to the problem of designing tension/compression springs with three continuous variables describing the spring geometry.
  Three additional independent binary parameters reflect material variability, manufacturing-related geometric deviations, and an additional safety margin. Without expanding the decision space, these parameters can be combined in eight ways to generate variants that allow for direct comparison.
  In this study we distinguish between robustness effects and the dimension of the problem, which allows tracking changes in feasibility while keeping the nominal mass objective constant. Seven optimization methods and eight hybridized their variants are used for the analysis. The hybridization mechanism applies the operator selected by the prediction procedure presented in Section 3. All methods are evaluated under the same experimental conditions. Each method is run thirty times for each variant, with a maximum of 30000 function evaluations permitted per run.
  The final quality assessment takes into account the geometry of the feasibility region, search trajectories, performance variations across landscapes and the computational cost of fixed objectives. Together, these factors allow us to determine the quality of the solution, reproducibility, feasibility control, and the effectiveness of optimization.
  An interesting observation was that hybridization can mitigate cost or feasibility losses associated with a specific configuration. While it compensates for a specific weakness in the underlying mechanism, it does not provide universal resilience.

AI.tldr: 通过对拉伸/压缩弹簧设计问题引入3个独立二元参数（材料变异、制造几何偏差、安全裕度），在不扩大决策空间的前提下生成8种变体，系统比较7种优化方法及其8种杂交变体的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 可靠评估优化器鲁棒性需要追踪参数受控变化以识别算法弱点的来源。作者将这一思路应用于弹簧设计问题，区分鲁棒性效应与问题维度，以在保持名义质量目标恒定的同时追踪可行性的变化。
AI.method: 弹簧几何由3个连续变量描述，另加3个独立二元参数反映材料变异、制造相关几何偏差和附加安全裕度，组合成8种变体。对7种优化方法及其8种杂交变体，在相同实验条件下每变体运行30次，每次最多30000次函数评估。杂交机制采用第3节预测程序所选算子。
AI.result: 最终质量评估综合考虑可行域几何、搜索轨迹、跨景观的性能变化以及固定目标的计算成本，据此判定解的质量、可复现性、可行性控制与优化有效性。观察发现，杂交可缓解特定配置带来的成本或可行性损失。
AI.conclusion: 杂交能补偿底层机制的特定弱点，但不提供普遍适用（universal）的鲁棒性。

title: A Flexible and Generic Approach for Explainable Landscape Analysis and the pyXla Toolbox
comment: 40 pages, 32 figures, submitted to Evolutionary Computation Journal
summary: Landscape analysis has been successfully applied to understand complex optimisation problems, gain insights into algorithm behaviour, and automate algorithm selection and configuration. Although many landscape analysis techniques have been developed over the last decades, it remains difficult for researchers and practitioners to decide which approaches are appropriate and to implement them in practice. Some tools are available, but these are either restricted to particular problem domains (e.g., unconstrained black-box continuous optimisation), or are limited in what they model and measure. In addition, output from landscape analysis is often not easily interpretable, especially when computed landscape features do not correspond with aspects of problems that practitioners are familiar with. In this paper, we introduce a principled approach for explainable landscape analysis (XLA) with an associated Python package called pyXla. The approach is generic in that it applies to problems with different representations (continuous or combinatorial), with single or multiple objectives, with or without constraints. The extent of analysis provided by the XLA framework depends on the data available, with richer analysis offered as additional information is provided by the user. We demonstrate the explainable output produced by pyXla on a selection of hand-crafted problems with diverse landscape characteristics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出可解释景观分析(XLA)原则性方法及配套Python包pyXla，适用于连续/组合、单/多目标、有/无约束问题，分析深度随用户提供的数据丰富度灵活调整，并在多类手工问题上展示可解释输出。
AI.motivation: 景观分析虽已广泛用于理解复杂优化问题、洞察算法行为及自动化算法选择与配置，但研究者与从业者难以判断应选用何种方法并落地实现。现有工具要么局限于特定问题域（如无约束黑箱连续优化），要么在建模与度量能力上受限；且景观分析输出往往难以解释，尤其当计算出的景观特征与从业者熟悉的问题特性不对应时。
AI.method: 提出一套面向可解释景观分析(XLA)的原则性方法，并实现为Python包pyXla。该方法具有通用性：可处理不同表示形式（连续或组合）、单目标或多目标、有约束或无约束的问题。XLA框架的分析范围取决于可用数据，随着用户提供更多信息，可提供更丰富的分析。
AI.result: 在若干具有多样景观特性的手工构造问题上演示了pyXla所产生的可解释输出。
AI.conclusion: XLA与pyXla为跨问题类型的景观分析提供统一、可解释的框架，突破了现有工具在适用域与可解释性方面的限制，并可视数据丰富程度提供渐进式分析能力。

title: AdaEva: Accelerating LLM-Driven Algorithm Design with Adaptive Partial Evaluation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for automated algorithm design. However the computational cost of evaluating the generated algorithms can be excessive. We consider the common LLM-driven automated algorithm design (LLM4AD) setting in which a candidate algorithm is evaluated by aggregating its performance over a shared set of training instances. This instance-wise structure raises a natural question: must every candidate be evaluated on the entire instance set before deciding whether it remains competitive? Taking inspiration from algorithm configuration, we introduce AdaEva, a drop-in adaptive partial-evaluation framework that progressively evaluates candidates on larger subsets of the same instance pool and eliminates unpromising candidates as evidence accumulates. Importantly, AdaEva leaves the underlying LLM4AD procedure and per-instance evaluator unchanged and requires no prior knowledge about instance difficulty. We instantiate this idea using successive halving (AdaEva-S) and statistical racing (AdaEva-R), and evaluate both mechanisms across three representative LLM4AD frameworks, multiple LLM backbones, and optimization domains spanning combinatorial and continuous black-box optimization. Under matched evaluation budgets, AdaEva more reliably balances evaluation effort across candidates than fixed partial-evaluation strategies, yielding strong search efficiency and anytime performance together with improved held-out generalization across the evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: AdaEva 是一种即插即用的自适应部分评估框架，通过逐步扩大候选算法的评估实例子集并淘汰劣质候选，降低 LLM4AD 的计算成本，在多种框架和任务上提升了搜索效率与泛化性。
AI.motivation: LLM 驱动的自动算法设计（LLM4AD）中，评估生成算法的计算开销过大。由于候选算法性能是在共享训练实例集上聚合评估的，这引出核心问题：是否必须在完整实例集上评估每个候选才能判断其竞争力？作者受算法配置领域启发，寻求在保证搜索质量的同时减少评估成本。
AI.method: 提出 AdaEva，一种即插即用的自适应部分评估框架。它在同一实例池上逐步对候选算法在更大的子集上进行评估，并随着证据积累淘汰不具竞争力的候选。AdaEva 不改变底层 LLM4AD 流程和单实例评估器，也无需实例难度的先验知识。具体实例化为两种机制：逐次减半（AdaEva-S）和统计竞速（AdaEva-R）。
AI.result: 在三种代表性 LLM4AD 框架、多种 LLM 主干以及涵盖组合优化与连续黑盒优化的多个领域上进行评估。在相同评估预算下，AdaEva 相比固定部分评估策略能更可靠地在候选间平衡评估开销，带来更强的搜索效率和 anytime 性能，并改善了留出集泛化。
AI.conclusion: AdaEva 是一种通用、无需先验知识的自适应部分评估框架，可无缝集成到现有 LLM4AD 流程中，在匹配预算下显著提升搜索效率、anytime 性能和泛化能力。

authors: André C. P. L. F. de Carvalho
title: Active-DiNTS: Active Differentiable Network Topology Search
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Extends material from the first author's PhD thesis (University of Sao Paulo / La Rochelle Universite, 2024)
summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has proved to be a strong alternative to manual network design, but applying it to 3D medical image segmentation is limited by two well-known costs, large annotation budgets and multi-GPU clusters. Thus, this paper introduces Active-DiNTS (Active Differentiable Network Topology Search), an approach that embeds pool-based Active Learning (AL) into a bi-level differentiable topology search to perform architecture discovery and label curation jointly. At each query round, unlabeled MRI volumes are ranked by one of three uncertainty signals (Entropy, Variance, or Standard Deviation), and only the top-ranked volumes are sent to an oracle for annotation. The new labels feed two interlocked stages. Network weights are updated in an outer loop, while the macro/micro topology of a U-Net-style backbone is refined in an inner loop. Three AL regimes (weights-only, topology-only, joint) expose the speed-accuracy trade-off. Evaluations on the Medical Segmentation Decathlon (MSD) Task01 BrainTumour benchmark showed that Active-DiNTS surpasses DiNTS, C2FNAS, and nnU-Net in Dice, with gains of about 10 percentage points on Edema and 5 points on Non-Enhancing core, on a single GPU and using a fraction of the labeled volumes. The discovered architectures are denser and more FLOP-heavy than prior baselines, but remain competitive in trainable parameters and peak memory; the fastest search variant finishes in under 0.25 GPU-days, over 27x faster than the eight-GPU DiNTS search. Together, these results indicate that pairing differentiable NAS with active data acquisition is a practical recipe for accurate 3D segmentation under realistic constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于池的主动学习嵌入双层可微拓扑搜索，提出Active-DiNTS，实现架构发现与标注筛选联合进行，在单GPU、少量标注下于MSD脑肿瘤分割上超越DiNTS、C2FNAS与nnU-Net。
AI.motivation: NAS在3D医学图像分割中受限于两大成本：标注预算庞大与多GPU集群需求，因此需要一种在现实约束下同时降低标注与算力开销的方案。
AI.method: Active-DiNTS将池式主动学习嵌入双层可微拓扑搜索。每轮查询用Entropy、Variance或Standard Deviation三种不确定性信号对未标注MRI体积排序，仅将排名靠前的样本送交标注。新标签驱动两个互锁阶段：外层循环更新网络权重，内层循环细化U-Net式主干网络的宏/微观拓扑；并设置仅权重、仅拓扑、联合三种AL机制以揭示速度-精度权衡。
AI.result: 在MSD Task01 BrainTumour基准上，Active-DiNTS的Dice超过DiNTS、C2FNAS与nnU-Net，Edema约提升10个百分点、Non-Enhancing core约提升5个百分点，且仅用单GPU和部分标注体积。发现的架构更稠密、FLOP更高，但可训练参数与峰值显存仍具竞争力；最快搜索变体在0.25 GPU-天内完成，比八GPU的DiNTS搜索快27倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 将可微NAS与主动数据获取相结合，是在现实约束下实现高精度3D分割的实用方案。

title: MOXIE: Discovering Alternative Explanations for Biomedical Image Classifiers
summary: Segment-based explanation methods such as LIME return a single explanation for each prediction, computed from one fixed image segmentation. This hides two important facts: a prediction can be supported by many different sets of image segments, and the segmentation itself shapes which explanations can be found. We introduce MOXIE (Multi-Objective eXplanation Imaging Engine), an evolutionary framework that searches for segment subsets that preserve the classifier's confidence while keeping as little of the image as possible. Instead of one explanation, MOXIE returns a Pareto front of alternative explanations that range from compact to highly faithful. We evaluate MOXIE with NSGA-II and four segmentation methods (SLIC, Felzenszwalb, Watershed and Voronoi) on BloodMNIST and HAM10000 datasets, using the same evaluation budget as LIME. Results show that MOXIE achieves a higher hypervolume than LIME on every image. LIME's explanations often appear convincing, yet the classifier's confidence collapses when only the highlighted segments are shown. MOXIE's fronts reveal how much of the image is needed to preserve the model's confidence and which contextual regions influence it. We also find that segmentation strongly affects evaluation: methods with unequal segment sizes appear most compact when segments are counted. These results show that alternative explanations provide a more complete view of a model's decision than a single explanation.

AI.tldr: MOXIE是一个进化多目标解释框架，为每个预测返回一组从紧凑到高保真的Pareto前沿解释，而非单一解释，并揭示分割方法对解释评估的重要影响。
AI.motivation: 基于分割的解释方法（如LIME）对每个预测仅返回由单一固定图像分割计算出的一个解释，这掩盖了两个事实：同一预测可由多种不同的图像段子集支持；分割本身决定了能发现何种解释。因此需要能提供多样化替代解释的框架。
AI.method: 提出MOXIE（Multi-Objective eXplanation Imaging Engine），一个进化框架，搜索在保持分类器置信度的同时尽可能少保留图像的段子集。使用NSGA-II算法，并结合四种分割方法（SLIC、Felzenszwalb、Watershed和Voronoi），在BloodMNIST和HAM10000数据集上评估，评估预算与LIME相同。
AI.result: MOXIE在每张图像上的超体积均高于LIME。LIME的解释常看似有说服力，但当仅显示其高亮段时分类器置信度会崩溃。MOXIE的前沿揭示了保持模型置信度所需的图像比例以及哪些上下文区域对其有影响。分割方法强烈影响评估：段大小不均的方法在按段计数时显得最紧凑。
AI.conclusion: 替代解释比单一解释能提供对模型决策更完整的视角，分割方法的选择对解释评估具有显著影响。

title: AgentDiscover: Autonomous Discovery with Minimal Search Scaffolding
summary: Frameworks that use large language models for scientific discovery typically rely on a fixed, human-designed algorithm that decides what the model sees at each step, leaving the model only the role of proposer. The model knows nothing of the search beyond what it is shown. As models grow more capable, a question arises: does a search strategy chosen by a human before the run scale better than promoting the model from proposer to planner and letting it own the search? The Bitter Lesson suggests that choosing the strategy in advance is the kind of hand-designed structure that general methods eventually outscale. We introduce AgentDiscover, in which a coding agent plans the search using its context as working memory, runs experiments, and records every attempt in a database of ideas, candidates, and their relations. This database serves as the agent's long-term memory and is structured so that the selection rules of classical algorithms such as MAP-Elites and Monte Carlo tree search each reduce to a single query, which the agent is free to use, combine, or replace. A server maintains the database and steers the agent after every submission, keeping it on course over long runs. In our experiments, AgentDiscover is more cost-efficient than existing frameworks, reaching better scores at lower cost. On tasks in kernel engineering, biology, algorithm design, and mathematics, AgentDiscover outperforms prior discovery frameworks. Its programs would have placed first among human competitors in seven past AtCoder heuristic contests, and on eleven mathematical and systems optimization tasks it matches or exceeds every baseline that uses the same model. Our code is available at https://github.com/mhdfb/AgentDiscover.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AgentDiscover 框架，将科研发现中的搜索规划权从人类预设算法转移到编码智能体本身，用数据库作为长期记忆，在多个领域超越现有发现框架且成本更低。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的科研发现框架依赖固定的人工设计算法来决定模型每一步看到什么，模型仅充当"提议者"，不了解整体搜索。作者受"苦涩的教训"启发：随着模型能力增强，让模型从提议者升级为规划者、自主掌控搜索，可能比人类预设策略更具可扩展性。
AI.method: 提出 AgentDiscover：编码智能体以自身上下文为工作记忆来规划搜索、运行实验，并将每次尝试记录进一个由想法、候选及其关系构成的数据库。该数据库作为长期记忆，其结构使 MAP-Elites、蒙特卡洛树搜索等经典算法的选择规则都能归结为单次查询，智能体可自由使用、组合或替换这些规则。服务器维护数据库并在每次提交后引导智能体，保证长程运行不偏离方向。
AI.result: AgentDiscover 比现有框架更具成本效益，以更低成本达到更好分数。在核工程、生物学、算法设计与数学任务上超越此前的发现框架；其程序在七场过往 AtCoder 启发式竞赛中可位列人类选手第一；在十一个数学与系统优化任务上，匹配或超过所有使用相同模型的基线。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索规划权交给能力日益增强的模型（从提议者到规划者）优于人类预先设计的固定策略，验证了"苦涩的教训"在科研发现框架设计中的适用性。

title: Fractal Cross Product: Theory, Differentiable Implementation and Application to Medical Image Analysis
summary: The magnitude of the generalized Euclidean cross product is a Gram volume whose degree under common scaling is fixed by the integer dimension of the spanning frame. We formulate a generalized Fractal Cross Product (FCP) as a nonlinear radial deformation with a prescribed positive degree $D$, which may be non-integer. The scalar construction applies in any ambient dimension $m\geq k$, while its canonically oriented vector form requires codimension one. It recovers the classical generalized cross product exactly at $D=k$ and retains orthogonality, alternation, rotation equivariance, and $D$-homogeneity, but is generally not multilinear. For exact self-similar frame systems, the construction also obeys a scale-balance law at the similarity dimension. We derive a differentiable, dimensionless image response and a non-circular empirical accumulation exponent obtained by regressing raw angular Gram responses across patch widths. Binary64 calculations recover the finite-frame identities to roundoff, while raster experiments recover the Sierpiński-triangle value 1.5849625 at three resolutions. In five-seed medical-imaging comparisons, FCP-centered fusion increased mean area under the receiver operating characteristic curve from 0.7264 to 0.8135 and from 0.5843 to 0.6765 on the random and hospital-separated Retinal Image Database for Optic Nerve Evaluation partitions, respectively, and from 0.7403 to 0.7475 on FracAtlas. On FracAtlas, balanced accuracy increased from 0.6186 to 0.6721 and the harmonic mean of precision and sensitivity from 0.3669 to 0.4457. These results support the utility of the complete fusion framework, but do not isolate the effect of FCP from that of its complementary descriptors and fusion head.

AI.tldr: 提出广义分形叉积(FCP)：以正次数D的径向非线性变形推广经典广义叉积，保持正交性、交错性、旋转等变性与D-齐次性但一般不满足多线性；用于图像响应导出与分形维数估计，并在医学影像融合中验证性能提升。
AI.motivation: 经典广义欧氏叉积的模是Gram体积，其缩放次数由张成框架的整数维数固定，无法刻画非整数维度的分形结构。作者希望构造一种次数可非整数、且能兼容任意环境维度的叉积推广，以刻画自相似框架的标度行为并服务于图像/医学影像分析。
AI.method: 将广义叉积定义为带指定正次数D的径向非线性变形：标量构造适用于任意环境维数m≥k，取向的向量形式要求余维为一；在D=k时精确退化为经典广义叉积。对精确自相似框架系统，构造满足相似维数处的标度平衡律。进一步推导可微、无量纲的图像响应，并用跨块宽回归原始角Gram响应得到非循环的经验累积指数；采用Binary64数值验证与栅格实验。
AI.result: Binary64计算将有限框架恒等式恢复到舍入误差量级；栅格实验在三个分辨率下均恢复Sierpiński三角形维数1.5849625。五种子医学影像对比中，FCP中心融合将ROC-AUC均值在RIDONE随机与院际分离划分上分别由0.7264提至0.8135、由0.5843提至0.6765，在FracAtlas上由0.7403提至0.7475；FracAtlas上平衡准确率由0.6186提至0.6721，精确率与灵敏度的调和平均由0.3669提至0.4457。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持完整融合框架的有效性，但消融不充分：无法将增益单独归因于FCP，而非其互补描述子与融合头。FCP可作为非整数次数下保持几何对称性的叉积推广，并具备分形维数估计与图像融合的应用潜力。

title: Do Motion Tokenizers for Co-Speech Gesture Generation Encode Gesture Semantics?
summary: Discrete motion tokenizers encode motion as atomic units and are widely used for co-speech gesture generation. It remains unclear which motion properties, especially those relevant to gesture semantics, are recoverable from these codebooks. We probe a reconstruction-trained codebook using 19 co-speech gesture descriptors spanning from raw motion to abstract communicative function. Results show that geometry and handedness are readily decodable from token embeddings, while motion category is only weakly decoded despite showing systematic differences in discrete code usage. This gap between reconstruction quality and descriptor decodability suggests that reconstruction objectives alone do not guarantee that gesture semantics are captured, and that evaluating codebooks on such properties can guide the design of more semantic motion tokenizers.

AI.tldr: 本文通过19种共语手势描述符探究离散动作tokenizer的码本可从token嵌入中恢复哪些动作属性，发现几何与左右手信息易解码，而动作类别语义仅弱解码，重建质量高并不意味着语义被捕获。
AI.motivation: 离散动作tokenizer被广泛用于共语手势生成，但其码本究竟能保留哪些动作属性、尤其是与手势语义相关的属性仍不清楚；同时重建目标是否足以保证语义被编码也缺乏验证。
AI.method: 对以重建任务训练的离散动作码本进行探针（probing）分析，采用19种共语手势描述符，覆盖从原始运动学特征到抽象交际功能多个层次。
AI.result: 几何信息与左右手（handedness）可较容易地从token嵌入中解码；动作类别（motion category）虽有系统性的离散码使用差异，但解码性能仅弱。存在重建质量与描述符可解码性之间的明显差距。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠重建目标不能保证手势语义被捕获，需在语义属性上评估码本，以指导更具语义性的动作tokenizer设计。

title: LoRA Direction Extraction for Controllable Light Toggling in FLUX.1 Kontext
summary: We propose a fine-tuning method for flow-matching diffusion models aimed at realistic artificial light modeling without the need for a large training dataset. We address the task of controllable interior image editing, where the goal is to turn artificial light sources on or off while preserving the scene geometry, object placement, materials, and visual identity of the original image. To achieve this, we decompose the task into two independent formulations. We introduce the LoRA Direction Training Method, which extracts the pure direction of the LoRA adapter effect in the diffusion model flow field, and we also introduce specialized loss functions to ensure the realism of the inverse transformation. Additionally, the resulting increment map is used for more precise adjustment of the lighting color and temperature.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向流匹配扩散模型的微调方法，无需大规模数据集即可实现写实人造光建模，用于可控室内图像编辑（开关人工光源）。
AI.motivation: 真实感人造光建模通常依赖大规模训练数据，且在编辑光照时难以保持场景几何、物体布局、材质与视觉身份不变。
AI.method: 将任务分解为两个独立的公式化问题；提出LoRA方向训练方法，在扩散模型流场中提取LoRA适配器效应的纯方向；引入专门损失函数保证逆变换的真实性；并利用生成的增量图精细调整光照颜色与色温。
AI.result: 方法在无需大规模训练数据集的前提下实现可控室内光照编辑，能够在开关人工光源时保持原始场景的几何、布局、材质与视觉身份，并支持光照颜色和色温的精细调节。
AI.conclusion: LoRA方向训练结合专用损失与增量图调整，为流匹配扩散模型提供了一种数据高效、可控且真实感强的室内光照编辑方案。

title: Energy Variation in Training Modern Computer Vision Architectures
comment: International Conference on Next-Generation AI Technologies (ICNGAIT) Shanghai, China, 5 pages, 1 table
summary: The rapid growth of deep learning has substantially increased the energy consumption associated with model training, making energy efficiency an increasingly relevant design criterion. This study empirically measures the energy variation of training seven modern computer vision architectures, MobileNetV3-Small, MobileNetV3-Large, EfficientNet-B0, EfficientNet-B1, ViT-B/32, ConvNeXt-Tiny, and ViT-B/16 for the ImageNet-1k classification task, using a homogeneous 10,000-image subset (ImageNet-10k) and a uniform 40-epoch baseline configuration executed on two NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPUs at the Bioinformatics and Computational Biology Center of Colombia (BIOS). Energy was recorded directly via NVML and contrasted with the computational complexity of each model. The results show a Pearson correlation of 0.85 between floating-point operations (GFLOPs) and energy consumption in kWh, indicating that computational complexity is a strong but imperfect predictor of energy expenditure: architectures with comparable GFLOPs exhibited consumption differing by up to 3.1x due to differences in the hardware efficiency of their dominant operations. The EfficientNet variants offered the best balance between classification performance (Val Top-5 up to 97.15%) and energy efficiency (0.457-0.611 kWh), while Vision Transformers exhibited the highest relative energy consumption and lower classification performance under the evaluated configuration. These findings guide architecture selection in energy-constrained computing environments.

AI.tldr: 该论文实证测量了7种现代CV架构在ImageNet-10k上训练40个epoch的能耗，发现GFLOPs与能耗的Pearson相关系数为0.85，EfficientNet在性能与能效间平衡最佳。
AI.motivation: 深度学习快速发展显著提升了模型训练能耗，能效已成为重要的设计准则，然而计算复杂度（如GFLOPs）能否可靠预测实际能耗仍不明确，亟需实证数据指导能耗受限场景下的架构选择。
AI.method: 在哥伦比亚BIOS中心的2块NVIDIA Tesla P100 GPU上，对MobileNetV3-Small/Large、EfficientNet-B0/B1、ViT-B/32、ConvNeXt-Tiny、ViT-B/16共7种架构，采用统一的10,000张图像子集（ImageNet-10k）与40轮基线配置进行ImageNet-1k分类训练；通过NVML直接记录能耗，并与各模型的计算复杂度进行对比分析。
AI.result: GFLOPs与能耗（kWh）的Pearson相关系数为0.85，说明计算复杂度是能耗的强但非完美预测因子：GFLOPs相近的架构能耗差异最高达3.1倍，源于主导算子的硬件效率差异。EfficientNet变体在分类性能（Val Top-5最高97.15%）与能效（0.457–0.611 kWh）之间取得最佳平衡；Vision Transformer在该配置下相对能耗最高且分类性能较低。
AI.conclusion: 计算复杂度不能单独作为能耗代理指标，架构选择需结合实际实测能耗；EfficientNet类模型适用于能耗受限计算环境，相关结论可为绿色深度学习与架构选型提供依据。

title: What Do Verifiable Rewards Teach Video-Language Models About Time? A Controlled Multi-Model Study
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) has produced large reasoning gains in language models, and verifiable video benchmarks make it applicable to causal-temporal video question answering. We study what RLVR teaches video-language models about time. We fine-tune four open models (Qwen3-VL-8B/4B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Gemma-3-12B) with group relative policy optimization under three data recipes: verified (synthetic CLEVRER questions with exact answer and event-order rewards), unverified (self-supervised pretext tasks over 43,751 real web videos), and a 1:1 mixture, plus a verified+real arm that adds 4,000 verifiable questions on real video. Each cell is evaluated in-domain and on out-of-domain real video (a NExT-QA temporal stress set and an MVBench subset), with frames in order, shuffled, and absent. (1) Verified training yields large in-domain gains that shrink as base competence grows (+14 to +19 points on weaker models; +6 on the strongest). (2) Much of the gain is non-visual: accuracy with no frames rises nearly as much as with frames. (3) Verified-only training can severely degrade out-of-domain accuracy with no sign during training: Qwen3-VL-8B loses 26.7 and 25.2 points on the two real-video sets, while the mixture never significantly degrades a model trained on it. Adding real verified questions removes that loss (-2.3 points, within noise of base) and keeps a +9.3 in-domain gain, so the cause is narrow synthetic-only data, not verification. (4) No recipe induces temporal-order grounding: across 41 evaluations the ordered-versus-shuffled gap is indistinguishable from zero in 39 and marginal in two, despite an event-order reward. Verifiable rewards improve benchmark accuracy without temporal understanding. Report no-frame controls, and mix in real video to guard against out-of-domain degradation.

AI.tldr: RLVR 能显著提升视频语言模型的基准准确率，但并不带来真正的时间理解：增益大部分与视觉无关，仅用合成数据训练会严重损害域外性能，且事件顺序奖励未能诱导时间顺序接地。
AI.motivation: 可验证视频基准使 RLVR 可用于因果-时序视频问答，但尚不清楚 RLVR 究竟教给了视频语言模型关于"时间"的什么知识，需要系统区分在域增益、视觉依赖性与时间顺序接地。
AI.method: 对四个开放模型（Qwen3-VL-8B/4B、Qwen2.5-VL-7B、Gemma-3-12B）用 GRPO 微调，采用三种数据配方：verified（合成 CLEVRER 问题，含精确答案与事件顺序奖励）、unverified（43,751 个真实网络视频上的自监督 pretext 任务）、1:1 混合，并额外设置 verified+real 组（加入 4,000 条真实视频可验证问题）。每格均在域内及域外真实视频（NExT-QA 时间压力集与 MVBench 子集）上评估，帧以有序、打乱、缺失三种方式输入。
AI.result: (1) 可验证训练带来大幅域内增益，但随基座能力增强而缩小（弱模型 +14~+19 分，最强模型 +6 分）。(2) 增益相当大程度是非视觉的：无帧准确率提升幅度与有帧接近。(3) 仅用可验证合成数据训练会大幅降低域外准确率且训练中无预警：Qwen3-VL-8B 在两个真实视频集上分别损失 26.7 与 25.2 分；混合配方则从不显著退化；加入真实可验证问题后该损失消除（-2.3 分，处于基座噪声范围内）并保留 +9.3 域内增益，说明成因是狭窄的纯合成数据而非验证本身。(4) 没有任何配方诱导时间顺序接地：41 项评估中，有序与打乱差距在 39 项中与零不可区分，2 项边际，尽管存在事件顺序奖励。
AI.conclusion: 可验证奖励只提升基准准确率，并未带来时间理解。建议报告无帧对照，并混入真实视频以防域外性能退化。

title: StepCAD: Mesh-to-CAD Code Generation via LLM Policy and Geometry-Guided Search
summary: Recovering executable CAD programs from 3D meshes is challenging due to the compositional nature of CAD construction and the interaction between discrete modeling choices and continuous parameters. Many learning-based methods predict complete programs in a single pass and rely predominantly on sketch-extrude representations, limiting operation diversity and opportunities to correct geometric errors during reconstruction. We introduce StepCAD, a generative optimization approach that combines a state-conditioned CAD policy with geometry-guided search. Given an input mesh, the policy predicts construction actions conditioned on both target and intermediate geometry, and an IoU-guided tree search refines the resulting program through local edits. We also introduce ARCADE-1.5M, a large-scale dataset of 1.5M executable CAD programs spanning diverse operations, sequences with a maximum length of 150+ counted operations, and 12.5M intermediate state-action transitions. Experiments across multiple CAD reconstruction benchmarks show that StepCAD achieves state-of-the-art geometric reconstruction accuracy with consistently high validity, yielding up to 87.2% relative IoU improvement over the strongest evaluated baseline, with particularly large gains on complex shapes. Project page: https://ghadinehme.com/stepcad.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出StepCAD，一种状态条件CAD策略结合几何引导搜索的生成式优化方法，从3D网格恢复可执行CAD程序，并发布ARCADE-1.5M大规模数据集，几何重建精度达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 从3D网格恢复可执行CAD程序具有挑战性：CAD构建具有组合性，离散建模选择与连续参数相互耦合；现有学习方法多单次预测完整程序，且主要依赖sketch-extrude表示，导致操作多样性受限，且重建过程中缺乏修正几何误差的机会。
AI.method: StepCAD将状态条件CAD策略与几何引导搜索相结合。给定输入网格，策略以目标几何和中间几何为条件预测构建动作，并通过IoU引导的树搜索经局部编辑精化所得程序。同时构建ARCADE-1.5M数据集。
AI.result: 提出ARCADE-1.5M，含150万可执行CAD程序，涵盖多样操作、最长150+计操作序列及1250万中间状态-动作转移。在多个CAD重建基准上，StepCAD取得SOTA几何重建精度并保持高有效性，相较最强基线IoU相对提升最高达87.2%，复杂形状增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: StepCAD通过生成式优化与几何引导搜索有效克服单次预测和sketch-extrude表示的局限，提升重建精度与操作多样性，配合大规模数据集ARCADE-1.5M，在复杂形状CAD重建上表现出显著优势。

title: Beyond Token Accuracy: Prioritizing What Matters for Visual Reconstruction
summary: Tokens have become a unified interface for multimodal foundation models, making visual-token communication a natural paradigm for efficient image delivery. However, existing methods typically rely on static policies that cannot jointly adapt to image content and channel conditions. Moreover, their token-level utility objectives do not necessarily translate into improved image reconstruction quality. In this paper, we propose AdapToC, an adaptive, reconstruction-oriented visual-token communication framework. At the transmitter, an adaptive selector jointly models image content, channel state, and communication budget to perform instance-wise resource allocation. Rather than using a fixed token rate and protection policy, it dynamically determines how many tokens should be transmitted and assigns different protection levels according to token importance and current channel conditions. At the receiver, an adaptive MaskGIT receiver incorporates channel reliability into contextual token modeling. It distinguishes tokens with different reliability levels, preserves high-confidence observations, corrects potentially corrupted tokens, and iteratively reconstructs missing content from the received evidence and global visual context. By co-designing token quantity, unequal protection, and reliability-aware recovery for image-level reconstruction quality, AdapToC achieves a peak mean PSNR gain of 4.20 dB over the strongest static baseline under matched communication costs and state-of-the-art performance among the evaluated visual-token communication methods.

AI.tldr: 提出AdapToC，一个面向重建质量的自适应视觉Token通信框架，联合自适应选择Token数量、非等保护等级与可靠性感知的接收端恢复，在匹配通信开销下相比最强静态基线峰值PSNR增益达4.20 dB。
AI.motivation: 视觉Token已成为多模态基础模型的统一接口，视觉Token通信是高效图像传输的自然范式。但现有方法多采用静态策略，无法同时适应图像内容与信道条件；且其Token级效用目标并不必然转化为图像重建质量的提升。
AI.method: 发送端设自适应选择器，联合建模图像内容、信道状态与通信预算，进行实例级资源分配：动态决定传输Token数量，并依据Token重要性与当前信道条件分配不同保护等级（非等保护）。接收端设自适应MaskGIT接收器，将信道可靠性融入上下文Token建模，区分不同可靠性等级的Token，保留高置信观测、纠正可能受损的Token，并基于已接收证据与全局视觉上下文迭代重建缺失内容。核心在于对Token数量、非等保护与可靠性感知恢复的联合（co-design）优化。
AI.result: 在匹配通信开销条件下，相比最强静态基线峰值平均PSNR提升4.20 dB；在被评估的视觉Token通信方法中取得最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 以图像级重建质量为目标，联合自适应Token数量、非等保护与可靠性感知恢复，可显著优于静态策略与Token级效用导向的方法，验证了面向重建的视觉Token通信框架的有效性。

title: Are We Measuring Anticipation? Auditing Privileged Information in Procedural Video Evaluation
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
summary:
Benchmark scores license claims about the capabilities being evaluated. We audit the inference licensed by an evaluation protocol, rather than the predictive model alone. Using procedural action anticipation as a controlled case study, we study a broader evaluation-validity failure mode: a protocol can remain temporally causal and free of classical target leakage while still supplying a privileged intermediate representation. The failure is not merely optimistic accuracy, but a mismatch between the capability claimed and the construct actually measured.
  On Breakfast, matched recognizer-history and GT-history regimes score 30.3% and 62.3% (Delta_PH(R_BA) = +32.0, 95% Student-t interval [+24.1, +39.8]). A fixed-checkpoint 2 x 2 intervention isolates a +14.6-point test-time oracle contrast; a matched no-video provenance probe yields a +26.8-point gap; and a boundary-independent query/history control retains a +19.4-point gap. We refer to this discrepancy as a privileged-information gap, defined relative to a specified non-oracle recovery pipeline, and propose a reusable four-condition audit. Across five evaluation settings the gap is heterogeneous; a standard 50 Salads long-term-anticipation re-implementation provides cautious support beyond the audit-specific next-action construction.

AI.tldr: 该论文审计评测协议本身所"许可"的推断，提出"特权信息差距"这一评测效度失效模式：协议可保持时间因果性且无经典标签泄漏，却仍提供特权中间表示，导致所声称能力与实测构念错配；并给出可复用的四条件审计流程。
AI.motivation: 基准分数常被用来为"被评测能力"背书，但现有评测有效性讨论多聚焦于预测模型或经典标签泄漏（target leakage）。作者认为真正的风险在于协议层面：即使协议在时间上因果、无经典泄漏，仍可能通过特权中间表示（privileged intermediate representation）虚增性能，从而使"声称的能力"与"实际测量的构念"不一致。因此需要从"模型审计"转向"评测协议审计"。
AI.method: 以程序性动作预测（procedural action anticipation）为受控案例。在 Breakfast 数据集上比较匹配的 recognizer-history 与 GT-history 两种机制（30.3% vs 62.3%）。设计固定检查点的 2×2 干预以隔离测试时 oracle 对比；构建匹配的无视频溯源探针；以及边界无关的 query/history 控制。据此定义相对于特定非 oracle 恢复管线的"特权信息差距"，并提出可复用的四条件审计。另在 50 Salads 长时预测任务上做标准重实现以验证外推性。
AI.result: Breakfast 上 Delta_PH(R_BA) = +32.0（95% Student-t 区间 [+24.1, +39.8]）。固定检查点 2×2 干预隔离出 +14.6 点测试时 oracle 对比；匹配无视频溯源探针给出 +26.8 点差距；边界无关的 query/history 控制仍保留 +19.4 点差距。五个评测设置中该差距呈异质性；50 Salads 长时预测的标准重实现为审计特定 next-action 构念之外的情形提供了谨慎支持。
AI.conclusion: 评测协议的效度问题不只是精度乐观，而是能力主张与测量构念的系统性错配；"特权信息差距"可被操作化定义并借四条件审计检出。该差距在不同评测设置间异质，说明需逐协议核查；结果初步表明该失效模式不局限于特定构念，但跨任务泛化仍需更多证据。

title: Streaming Multi-Track Timeline Control for 3D Human Motion Generation
summary: Text-driven human motion generation has advanced substantially, yet most methods assume instructions are available before synthesis. Interactive applications require responding to new instructions while continuing ongoing actions, such as answering a phone while walking. Existing approaches address streaming generation or simultaneous composition without explicitly combining streaming instruction arrival with independently timed, overlapping actions. We introduce streaming multi-track timeline control and propose TimelineControl to incorporate new instructions alongside ongoing actions. Interval-aware conditioning preserves instruction timing, while causal part-structured representations and part-aware denoising coordinate concurrent actions across body regions. We also construct TimelineMotion, a dataset with overlapping instruction intervals and body-part annotations. Experiments on TimelineMotion and MTT demonstrate improved semantic alignment and temporal adherence over evaluated streaming baselines, including models retrained on the same data. Ablations and human evaluations validate our design, complemented by spatial conditioning and humanoid execution demonstrations. Our code, data and models will become publicly available.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"流式多轨时间线控制"任务与TimelineControl方法，使动作生成模型能在持续动作过程中响应新到达的指令，并构建TimelineMotion数据集，实验验证了语义对齐与时间遵循性的提升。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动人体动作生成多假设指令在合成前已完整给定，而交互式应用（如边走边接电话）需要在动作进行中响应新指令。已有工作分别处理流式生成或同步组合，但未显式将"流式指令到达"与"独立定时的重叠动作"结合，因此缺乏对多轨时间线的建模能力。
AI.method: 提出TimelineControl：1）区间感知条件（interval-aware conditioning）以保持指令的时间区间信息；2）因果部件结构化表示（causal part-structured representation）与部件感知去噪（part-aware denoising），在身体各区域上协调并发动作。同时构建TimelineMotion数据集，包含重叠的指令区间与身体部件标注。
AI.result: 在TimelineMotion与MTT上，相较所评估的流式基线（包括在同一数据上重训练的模型），语义对齐与时间遵循性均有提升；消融实验与人工评估验证了设计有效性，并补充了空间条件控制与类人执行演示。
AI.conclusion: TimelineControl实现了流式多轨时间线控制下的动作生成，兼顾指令时序与并发动作协调；代码、数据与模型将公开，为交互式动作生成提供新任务设定与基准。

title: Dynamic Time Step Prediction in Inverse Heat Dissipation for Blur-Like Image Restoration Tasks
summary: When using diffusion models to target image restoration problems, diffusion inversion is typically employed to retain relevant image information from the degraded images. Instead of inverting back to the initial time step (i.e., T), many methods invert to a pre-determined intermediate time step, in order to better preserve information from degraded source images. However, a pre-determined time step for inversion is not ideal for reconstruction, as a severely degraded image requires an earlier starting time step than a mildly degraded one. In addition, DDIM-based models corrupt the original signal by adding Gaussian noise, which can be mismatched to the nature of blur-like degradations, such as blur, haze, and low-light. To address these problems, we propose two solutions: (1) we adopt an alternative diffusion process, called the Inverse Heat Dissipation Model, that diffuses the input image by gradually blurring a data point (2) we propose to implement a time predictor to estimate the starting time step for the inversion, with the model learning to adapt to the degradation severity. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks show that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance in both quantitative and qualitative evaluations, with excellent generalization to many restoration tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对扩散模型图像复原中反演时间步固定和DDIM加噪与模糊类退化不匹配的问题，提出采用逆热耗散模型（IHDM）以实现逐渐模糊式的扩散，并引入时间预测器自适应估计反演起始时间步，从而在多个复原任务上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散模型的图像复原通常依赖扩散反演来保留退化图像中的信息。现有方法往往反演至预先设定的中间时间步以更好地保留退化源图像信息，但固定时间步并不理想：严重退化图像需要比轻微退化图像更早的起始时间步。此外，基于DDIM的模型通过添加高斯噪声来破坏原始信号，这与模糊、雾霾、低光等模糊类退化的本质不匹配。
AI.method: 作者提出两种解决方案：(1) 采用一种替代的扩散过程，称为逆热耗散模型（Inverse Heat Dissipation Model），通过逐渐模糊数据点来对输入图像进行扩散；(2) 提出时间预测器以估计反演起始时间步，使模型能够适应退化严重程度。
AI.result: 在标准基准上的大量实验表明，该方法在定量和定性评估中均达到最先进性能，并对多种复原任务具有出色的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过用逆热耗散模型替换高斯加噪扩散过程，并结合自适应的时间预测器估计反演起始时间步，可有效解决固定时间步与退化特性不匹配的问题，提升图像复原的性能与泛化性。

title: FADE: Frame-Aware Diffusion-Transformer-based Multi-Concept Erasure for Video Unlearning
summary: Text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models can reproduce copyrighted, violent, or explicit content, which motivates concept erasure: removing designated concepts from a pretrained model while preserving its behavior on everything else. Existing T2V erasure methods leave two problems open. Their frame-agnostic suppression can leave isolated frames in which an erased concept resurfaces, a frame-reactivation gap that clip-level averages obscure; and they are usually evaluated with one target concept or category at a time. We propose Frame-Aware Diffusion Erasure (FADE), a multi-concept video unlearning framework. FADE first applies a joint closed-form key/value edit that suppresses all target concepts, then trains per-concept frame-aware low-rank adapters whose strength is gated by the frame index and the denoising timestep to remove residual per-frame leakage. Each adapter is trained with the other targets' prompts as hard negatives, which keeps the concept-specific components of different adapters well separated, and a similarity-based soft router combines the adapters according to the prompt. With 16 concepts (objects, artistic styles, and nudity) erased from a single Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B backbone, FADE reduces the residual accuracy on the object benchmark to 4.9%, against 15.5% for the strongest of eight baselines, while keeping the VBench average within 0.9% of the unedited model. The ranking is unchanged under a VLM judge and a blinded human study, and the advantage over the strongest baseline carries over to prompts that combine several erased concepts, to 30 simultaneously erased celebrity identities, and to Wan2.1-T2V-14B, CogVideoX-2B, and HunyuanVideo-1.5.

AI.tldr: FADE是一个多概念视频扩散模型擦除框架，通过联合闭式KV编辑与帧感知低秩适配器，消除逐帧复发泄漏，在16个概念上大幅降低残留准确率并保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: T2V扩散模型可能生成受版权保护、暴力或露骨内容，需要概念擦除。现有T2V擦除方法存在两个问题：一是帧无关的抑制会在个别帧中残留被擦除概念，即"帧再激活差距"，被片段级平均指标掩盖；二是通常只针对单一概念或类别评估。
AI.method: FADE先应用联合闭式key/value编辑抑制所有目标概念，再训练逐概念的帧感知低秩适配器，其强度由帧索引和去噪时间步共同门控，以消除残余的逐帧泄漏。每个适配器以其他目标提示作为难负样本训练，保持不同适配器概念特化分量的分离，并用基于相似度的软路由器按提示组合适配器。
AI.result: 在单个Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B骨干上擦除16个概念（物体、艺术风格、裸露），FADE将物体基准上的残留准确率降至4.9%，而八个基线中最强者为15.5%，同时VBench均值与未编辑模型相差在0.9%以内。该排序在VLM评判和盲测人类研究中保持一致，相对于最强基线的优势也延续到多概念组合提示、30个同时擦除的名人身份，以及Wan2.1-T2V-14B、CogVideoX-2B和HunyuanVideo-1.5。
AI.conclusion: FADE有效解决了T2V概念擦除中的帧再激活差距和多概念评估问题，在大规模多概念擦除下同时实现强擦除效果与生成质量保持，并具备跨骨干模型的泛化能力。

title: Masked Privileged-Information Distillation for Multimodal Skin Lesion Classification Under Missing Clinical Metadata
