summary: Multimodal skin lesion classification combines clinical images with patient metadata to improve diagnostic accuracy. However, complete metadata available during training may be only partially accessible at deployment, and resource-constrained settings additionally require computational efficiency. We address these challenges with a privileged-information distillation framework in which a multimodal teacher trained on complete metadata supervises a 9.2x smaller student trained with randomly masked clinical fields. Clinical fields are masked as whole groups at a per-sample rate drawn from U(0,1), so one training run covers the full metadata availability range. Fusion is residual, with metadata added as a gated correction to an unconditional image base. On the PAD-UFES-20 dataset, distillation under masked training improves balanced accuracy over cross-entropy training at every availability level, by an average of +4.7 points versus +1.8 points without masking. The masked student loses only 7.8 balanced-accuracy points as metadata decreases from complete to absent, compared with 36.6 points for the same student trained on complete metadata, highlighting the role of masked training in graceful degradation beyond distillation alone. Grad-CAM visualizations further show that the masked student's attention generally remains lesion-centered as metadata is withdrawn. The resulting compact model targets point-of-care settings, where clinical metadata is often incomplete.

AI.tldr: 提出特权信息蒸馏框架：多模态教师（完整元数据）监督一个9.2倍更小的学生模型，学生训练时临床字段按U(0,1)的样本级概率整组随机掩码，从而单次训练覆盖全部元数据可用度范围。在PAD-UFES-20上，掩码训练下的蒸馏在每个可用度水平均优于交叉熵，平均提升+4.7点（无掩码时为+1.8点）；学生模型从完整到无元数据仅损失7.8点平衡准确率（完整数据训练时为36.6点），Grad-CAM显示注意力仍集中在病灶区域。
AI.motivation: 多模态皮肤病变分类融合临床图像与患者元数据可提升诊断准确率，但训练时可用的完整元数据在部署时可能仅部分可得；资源受限场景还要求计算效率。因此需要一种在元数据不完整乃至缺失时仍能稳健退化、且模型紧凑的方法。
AI.method: 采用特权信息蒸馏框架：教师为在完整元数据上训练的多模态模型，学生模型规模小9.2倍，训练时对临床字段以整组为单位、按每样本从U(0,1)采样的速率随机掩码，使一次训练即覆盖元数据可用度的完整范围。融合方式为残差式，元数据作为门控修正项叠加到无条件的图像基准分支上。
AI.result: 在PAD-UFES-20数据集上，掩码训练下的蒸馏在每个元数据可用度水平都将平衡准确率提升至交叉熵训练之上，平均提升+4.7点，而无掩码时仅+1.8点。掩码学生模型在元数据从完整降至完全缺失时仅损失7.8点平衡准确率，而同一学生在完整元数据上训练时损失达36.6点。Grad-CAM可视化显示，随元数据撤除，掩码学生的注意力总体仍集中于病灶区域。
AI.conclusion: 掩码训练不仅配合蒸馏提升各可用度下的性能，还独立带来元数据缺失时的平滑退化能力；所得紧凑模型面向临床元数据常不完整的即时检验（point-of-care）场景。

title: Verifier-Guided Synthetic Augmentation for 3D Human Shape Generation
summary: Limited training data diversity constrains generative modeling of 3D human bodies: conservative models remain close to observed examples, whereas exploratory models often violate basic body proportions. We introduce a verifier-guided augmentation framework that uses global and mode-local PCA to generate inexpensive candidates, screens them using correspondence-derived skeletal proportions and body-part geometry, and retrains a diffusion model on accepted candidates. Elastic registration provides both the modal structure used by distributed PCA and the dense anatomical correspondence needed for scalable screening without per-candidate body-model fitting. A blinded human study supports the verifier as a conservative gatekeeper, favoring verifier-accepted over rejected outputs. We evaluate full-pool verifier acceptance separately from the coverage and departure of accepted samples and combine them through EAUC. On 4,498 registered DFAUST surfaces, distributed-PCA augmentation achieves 86.32% acceptance, the highest CP-AUC (0.871), and the highest EAUC (0.752), improving EAUC by 32% over real-only and self-augmented diffusion. These results show that mode-local, verifier-guided proposals broaden diffusion generation while maintaining high agreement with calibrated body measurements.

AI.tldr: 提出验证器引导的增强框架，用全局与局部PCA生成候选，通过骨骼比例与部位几何筛选后重训扩散模型，在DFAUST上取得86.32%接受率与最高EAUC（0.752），较基线提升32%。
AI.motivation: 3D人体生成建模受限于训练数据多样性：保守模型只能贴近已见样本，探索性模型又常违反基本身体比例。需要一个既能扩展生成多样性、又能保证解剖合理性的方案。
AI.method: 采用验证器引导的增强框架：用全局PCA与模式局部（distributed/mode-local）PCA廉价地生成候选样本；借助弹性配准提供的模态结构与稠密解剖对应关系，通过对应关系推导的骨骼比例和身体部位几何进行规模化筛选（无需逐候选拟合人体模型）；最后用被接受的候选重训扩散模型。评估上将全池验证器接受率与被接受样本的覆盖度、偏离度分开衡量，并用EAUC统一整合。
AI.result: 在4,498个已配准的DFAUST表面上，分布式PCA增强达到86.32%接受率、最高CP-AUC（0.871）与最高EAUC（0.752），EAUC较仅用真实数据和自增强扩散的基线提升32%。盲测人类研究支持验证器作为保守把关者，更偏好被接受而非被拒绝的输出。
AI.conclusion: 模式局部、验证器引导的候选生成能在保持与标定身体测量高度一致的前提下，拓宽扩散模型的生成范围，说明质量把关与多样性扩展可以兼得。

title: VolS-GS: Relightable Gaussian Splatting with Volumetric Subsurface Scattering
summary: We present VolS-GS, a relightable Gaussian splatting framework that reconstructs objects from one-light-at-a-time (OLAT) captures and renders them under novel lighting and viewpoints. Relightable Gaussian Splatting methods typically model appearance independently at each primitive, which makes non-local effects difficult to represent. This limitation is particularly apparent for subsurface scattering, where light entering the object at one location can emerge at another. Rather than modeling this effect solely with a neural network or a local kernel at each primitive, we use the spatial support of the Gaussian scene as the domain of a differentiable finite-volume transport solver, so that light can propagate through the object's interior. A small network predicts scattering and absorption coefficients for each Gaussian, and the solve redistributes incident light through the resulting field. The coefficients are fit to images rather than measured, so the solve supplies a transport-shaped path for aggregating per-primitive appearance, not a measurement of the material. To keep the learned shadow and specular terms from taking over the other components, our shadow term is predicted from visibility together with the transmittances and the scattering the solve produces, and a regularizer suppresses specular highlights in regions the shadow term predicts to be unlit. Experiments on three OLAT benchmarks show that VolS-GS consistently improves relighting quality on held-out lights and views.

AI.tldr: VolS-GS是一个可重光照的高斯泼溅框架，用可微有限体积传输求解器代替逐图元的局部外观建模，从而在OLAT捕获下重建并支持新光照/新视角渲染，在三个基准上取得稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 现有可重光照高斯泼溅方法在每个图元上独立建模外观，难以表达非局部效应，尤其是次表面散射——光在一处进入物体、从另一处射出。仅靠神经网络或逐图元的局部核函数无法建模这类跨位置的光传输。
AI.method: 以高斯场景的空间支撑作为可微有限体积传输求解器的定义域，使光可在物体内部传播。小型网络为每个高斯预测散射与吸收系数，求解器据此将入射光在体内重新分布。系数由图像拟合而非实测，因此求解提供的是"传输形状"的逐图元外观聚合路径，而非材料测量。为抑制阴影与镜面项压倒其他分量，阴影项由可见性、求解产生的透射率与散射共同预测；并加入正则项，在被判为无光照区域抑制镜面高光。
AI.result: 在三个OLAT基准上的实验表明，VolS-GS在留出光照与视角的可重光照质量上均持续优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 将体积光传输引入高斯泼溅，可作为聚合逐图元外观的有效归纳偏置，显著改善次表面散射等非局部效应的重光照表现；但系数为拟合量而非真实材质参数，方法定位是传输塑形的外观聚合而非材料测量。

title: PhysMamba: Selective State Space Models as Learned Articulated Body Simulators
comment: CVPR 2026 Workshop on Physically Grounded Human Perception and Modeling -- 1st PhysHuman
summary: We introduce the first learned articulated body simulator based on a selective state space model (SSM), called PhysMamba. PhysMamba predicts next-frame full-body state from position, rotation, and joint-action history, without velocity inputs. We compare four architectures under partial- and full-observation inputs and three training protocols. The from-scratch rollout training protocol gives Mamba2 strong short- and mid-horizon accuracy under partial observation (s10 = 43 mm, 2/50 diverged), while the two-stage teacher-based rollout protocol stabilizes GRU but fails for Mamba2. With CUDA graph compilation, Mamba2 reaches 0.107 ms per frame (9,334 FPS) on an H100 GPU, within 1.1$\times$ of GRU's un-compiled throughput, adding under 1% latency to a 30 Hz HMR pipeline and enabling integration as a differentiable physics module for video-based mesh recovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PhysMamba，首个基于选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的关节体仿真器，仅用位置、旋转与关节动作历史预测下一帧全身状态，无需速度输入。通过对比四种架构与三种训练协议，发现Mamba2在部分观测下精度高、速度快（H100达9,334 FPS），可低延迟集成于30 Hz的HMR流程并作为可微物理模块。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型关节体仿真器多依赖RNN等架构且需速度输入，长时程精度与推理效率受限，且难以低开销嵌入视频人体网格恢复（HMR）流程。
AI.method: 基于选择性状态空间模型构建PhysMamba；以位置、旋转和关节动作历史为输入预测下一帧全身状态，不使用速度；在部分与全观测输入下比较四种架构，并测试三种训练协议（含从零开始的rollout训练与两阶段teacher-based rollout）；采用CUDA graph编译加速推理。
AI.result: 从零rollout训练的Mamba2在部分观测下短中期精度强（s10 = 43 mm，2/50发散）；两阶段teacher-based协议稳定GRU但对Mamba2失效；CUDA graph编译后Mamba2在H100上达0.107 ms/帧（9,334 FPS），约为GRU未编译吞吐的1.1倍内，给30 Hz HMR流程增加不足1%延迟。
AI.conclusion: PhysMamba验证了SSM在学习型关节体仿真中的可行性，兼顾精度与实时性，可作为可微物理模块集成至基于视频的网格恢复系统。

title: ClasSAE: Class-Aligned Sparse Autoencoders via Differentiable Feature-Class Affinity
summary: Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) began as an unsupervised tool for decomposing neural representations into sparse, interpretable features, and are increasingly used not only for passive analysis but also for active interventions such as unlearning, bias mitigation, and concept editing. A central challenge for these editing and steering methods is reliably matching features to target concepts; most current approaches address this by computing post-hoc scores over an already-trained, frozen dictionary. We instead introduce ClasSAE, a novel method that both automatically assigns classes to features and guides the encoder toward class-separable representations during training. Specifically, we apply a differentiable top-$k$ operator to a trainable feature--class affinity matrix with per-feature budgets, coupling the features selected for each sample to the classes they are trained to represent. Because gradients flow through the selection of active features rather than only through their magnitudes, the encoder and the affinity matrix co-adapt rather than being fit in separate stages. The result is a dictionary that is both class-separable and class-annotated, with no need for post-hoc probing. We propose three variants for enforcing sparsity within this framework, which achieve comparable overall performance with slightly different trade-offs. Using CLIP ViT-L/14 embeddings on ImageNet, we show that the learned affinity matrix agrees closely with an independently estimated post-hoc feature-class matrix computed on held-out data. The model also supports direct class prediction from the encoder and affinity matrix alone, without a separately fitted classifier, and its more class-aligned encoder yields improved separation in Targeted Probe Perturbation evaluations. https://github.com/St0pien/ClasSAE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ClasSAE，一种在训练过程中自动为特征分配类别并引导编码器学习类别可分表示的稀疏自编码器方法。
AI.motivation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）已从无监督分解神经表示的工具，扩展到主动干预任务（如去学习、偏差缓解、概念编辑）。这些编辑与引导方法的核心挑战在于可靠地将特征匹配到目标概念。现有方法多在已训练、冻结的字典上计算事后（post-hoc）分数，无法在训练中引导特征与类别的对应关系。
AI.method: 提出 ClasSAE：在可训练的特征—类别亲和矩阵上应用可微 top-k 算子，并设置逐特征预算，将每个样本选中的特征与其被训练代表的类别耦合。梯度通过活跃特征的选择而不仅通过其幅值回传，使编码器与亲和矩阵协同自适应，而非分阶段拟合。论文提出三种在该框架内施加稀疏性的变体，整体性能相当但权衡略有不同。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 上使用 CLIP ViT-L/14 嵌入，所学亲和矩阵与在留出数据上独立估计的事后特征—类别矩阵高度一致。模型可仅凭编码器与亲和矩阵进行直接类别预测，无需单独拟合分类器；其更类别对齐的编码器在 Targeted Probe Perturbation 评估中带来更好的分离度。
AI.conclusion: ClasSAE 生成一个既类别可分又带类别标注的字典，无需事后探测，为 SAE 的特征—概念匹配与主动干预提供了训练期引导的新范式。

title: Learning Subject-Specific Anatomical Representations via Manifold Expansion: Application to Accelerated Multi-Contrast MRI
summary: Clinical MRI routinely acquires multiple contrast-weighted images of the same anatomy for complementary tissue characterization. However, current accelerated MRI methods typically reconstruct each contrast independently, without fully exploiting shared anatomical information. This work aims to learn anatomical representations invariant to contrast-dependent appearance for reconstruction of accelerated multi-contrast MRI. We propose MAX (MAnifold eXpansion), a subject-specific framework that learns anatomical representations from a single fully sampled reference contrast. To address the under-constrained separation of shared anatomy and contrast-dependent components from a single image, MAX expands the multi-contrast manifold using anatomy-preserving intensity augmentations. A disentangled implicit neural representation models augmented samples using shared spatial coordinates for anatomy and spatially invariant coordinates for contrast appearance. The learned anatomical representation is then fixed, with the contrast representation adapted to the undersampled target data, followed by unrolled refinement. Theoretical analyses further provide insight into the disentangled representation learning and explain how the learned anatomical representation improves the target contrast reconstruction. At R = 8 for brain MRI and R = 6 for knee MRI, MAX achieves the highest mean PSNR and SSIM across all tasks, improving PSNR by more than 1 dB over the strongest baseline for both brain contrasts. MAX more faithfully recovers subtle anatomical and pathological structures and remains robust to inter-contrast motion, structural heterogeneity between reference and target contrasts, and measurement noise. Therefore, MAX provides a general strategy for leveraging high-quality reference scans in accelerated MRI and has the potential to be extended to other reference-assisted MRI inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 提出MAX框架，从单幅全采样参考对比图像学习解剖表示，用于加速多对比MRI重建。
AI.motivation: 临床MRI常采集同一解剖部位的多对比加权图像以互补表征组织，但现有加速MRI方法通常独立重建各对比，未充分利用共享的解剖信息。
AI.method: MAX利用解剖保持的强度增强扩展多对比流形，解决单幅图像中共享解剖与对比相关分量欠约束分离的问题；采用解耦隐式神经表示，用共享空间坐标建模解剖、空间不变坐标建模对比外观。学到的解剖表示被固定，对比表示适配欠采样目标数据，随后进行展开式精修。并给出理论分析。
AI.result: 脑MRI在R=8、膝MRI在R=6时，MAX在所有任务上取得最高平均PSNR和SSIM，两个脑对比的PSNR较最强基线提升超过1 dB；更忠实恢复细微解剖和病理结构，对对比间运动、参考与目标对比间的结构异质性和测量噪声均稳健。
AI.conclusion: MAX为加速MRI中利用高质量参考扫描提供了通用策略，并有望扩展到其他参考辅助的MRI逆问题。

title: MAGEFormer: Learning Metric-Consistent Representations for Anisotropic CT Segmentation
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have shown strong performance in volumetric segmentation, but their effectiveness on clinical CT is limited by an isotropic Euclidean lattice assumption. This conflicts with anisotropic CT acquisition, leading to two key issues: (1) a metric mismatch between voxel indices and physical anatomy, and (2) accuracy degradation from isotropic resampling. To address this, we propose MAGEFormer, a geometry-calibrated framework that embeds physical metric constraints directly into representation learning. Our method introduces Metric-Adaptive Spatial Embedding (MASE) to calibrate positional frequencies using voxel spacing, Geometry-Constrained Attention (GCA) to suppress physically implausible feature correlations, and Geometric View Voting (GVV) to reduce discretization bias during inference. We evaluate MAGEFormer on two multi-organ abdominal CT benchmarks, BTCV and FLARE 22, under a unified protocol against strong CNN and Transformer-based baselines. MAGEFormer achieves the strongest boundary accuracy among the compared methods, with 10.58 mm HD95 on BTCV and 3.40 mm HD95 on FLARE 22, and shows consistent gains in Dice under the same protocol. These results show that geometry-aware internal calibration is more effective than relying on conventional isotropic preprocessing alone for anisotropic CT segmentation.

AI.tldr: MAGEFormer 通过将物理度量约束嵌入表示学习，缓解各向异性 CT 分割中欧氏格点假设带来的度量失配与重采样精度损失问题。
AI.motivation: Vision Transformer 体数据分割性能优异，但其各向同性欧氏格点假设与临床 CT 的各向异性采集方式冲突，导致体素索引与真实解剖的度量失配，以及各向同性重采样引发的精度下降。
AI.method: 提出几何校准框架 MAGEFormer，包含三个模块：Metric-Adaptive Spatial Embedding（MASE）利用体素间距校准位置频率；Geometry-Constrained Attention（GCA）抑制物理上不合理的特征相关性；Geometric View Voting（GVV）在推理阶段降低离散化偏差。在 BTCV 与 FLARE 22 两个多器官腹部 CT 基准上按统一协议评测。
AI.result: 在两个基准上取得对比方法中最优的边界精度：BTCV 上 HD95 为 10.58 mm，FLARE 22 上为 3.40 mm，并在同一协议下 Dice 一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 对于各向异性 CT 分割，几何感知的内部校准比仅依赖传统各向同性预处理更为有效。

title: Dynamic Quadtree Tokenization and Transformer for Adaptive Mesh PDE Forecasting
summary: The quadratic attention cost of Vision Transformers (ViTs) forces a trade-off between spatial resolution and rollout horizon, particularly for fine-scale PDEs where shocks, reaction fronts, and material interfaces occupy small, evolving regions of the domain. Conventional neural surrogates also lack mechanisms to adapt resolution dynamically. We propose WAMRViT, a ViT that tokenizes inputs as balanced quadtrees using a wavelet-inspired refinement criterion, jointly encodes position and refinement level with 3D rotary positional embeddings, and regrids in cell space during inference for stable long-horizon rollouts. A multi-scale variant retains each leaf at its native source resolution and lets the model learn across resolution levels. Unlike fixed-budget adaptive-tokenization methods, WAMRViT imposes no predetermined token count and supports fully adaptive topology throughout autoregressive rollout. To our knowledge, it is the first machine-learning surrogate to natively tokenize multi-level Adaptive Mesh Refinement (AMR) data. On uniform-grid benchmarks, uniform-patch WAMRViT improves finest-level region-of-interest VRMSE over a finest-patch uniform ViT while using substantially fewer tokens. The multi-scale variant achieves the lowest first-step full-field RMSE and VRMSE on both benchmarks and improves rollout-averaged full-field and refined-region accuracy at long horizons. With parallelized regridding, its end-to-end rollout cost lies between finest-patch and approximately token-matched coarser-patch ViTs. On a complex AMR combustion problem whose finest features cannot be represented natively by the evaluated uniform-grid baselines, WAMRViT operates directly on adaptive cells and substantially reduces finest-level error at matched transformer capacity. Code: https://github.com/tonyzyl/wamrvit

AI.tldr: 提出WAMRViT，一种基于平衡四叉树与小波启发细化准则的ViT神经代理模型，原生token化多级AMR数据，无需固定token预算，支持推理期自适应重网格与长时程稳定滚动。
AI.motivation: ViT的二次注意力成本导致空间分辨率与滚动时程之间需权衡，对含激波、反应锋、材料界面等局部演化特征的精细尺度PDE尤为不利；传统神经代理缺乏动态自适应分辨率的机制，且既有自适应token化方法受固定token预算限制，无法处理多级AMR数据。
AI.method: 将输入token化为平衡四叉树，采用小波启发的细化准则；用3D旋转位置编码联合编码位置与细化层级；推理时在单元空间重网格以稳定长时程滚动。多尺度变体保留每个叶子节点的原始源分辨率，使模型跨分辨率学习。方法无预设token数量，支持自回归滚动中全程自适应拓扑。
AI.result: 均匀网格基准上，均匀patch WAMRViT以显著更少token优于最细patch均匀ViT的最细层ROI VRMSE；多尺度变体在两基准上取得最低首步全场RMSE与VRMSE，并改善长时程滚动平均的全场与细化区域精度。并行重网格下端到端滚动成本介于最细patch与近似token匹配的粗patch ViT之间。在复杂AMR燃烧问题中，均匀网格基线无法原生表示最细特征，WAMRViT直接在自适应单元上运行并在相同Transformer容量下大幅降低最细层误差。
AI.conclusion: WAMRViT是首个原生token化多级AMR数据的机器学习代理模型，通过四叉树自适应token化、3D RoPE与单元空间重网格，在精度与token效率上优于均匀网格基线，并能在均匀网格基线无法表示的复杂AMR问题上直接工作。

title: ASD-FEAT: A Multi-Modal Infant Video-Derived Dataset for Early ASD Risk Prediction
summary: Accurate early screening for Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a precursor to timely intervention, which is critical for improving cognitive and behavioral outcomes. We present ASD-FEAT (ASD - Feature Extraction And Tracking), a multimodal dataset derived from video recordings of infant-adult interaction sessions. The key contribution of ASD-FEAT is the combination of longitudinal coverage from infancy through 36 months, repeated interaction sessions, clinically validated developmental outcomes, expert frame-level behavioral annotations, and privacy-conscious multimodal feature representations. To the best of our knowledge, existing ASD behavioral datasets do not jointly provide these characteristics at comparable scale. To demonstrate the utility of ASD-FEAT, we use it to evaluate a computer-vision-based end-to-end pipeline relying on machine learning techniques to automatically identify ASD risk. ASD-FEAT integrates both expert-defined and deep-learned features, including face and eye landmarks, facial action units, gaze direction, head position, mel-spectrogram audio representations, and optical flow, to identify behavioral markers of social interaction. Our automated pipeline achieves an ASD classification accuracy of 76.2% and an Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUROC) of 0.82, compared to classifiers trained on manually labeled behaviors, which yielded 81.3% accuracy and an AUROC of 0.88. We further introduce a within-visit partner contrast: a per-visit signal contrasting examiner-directed and parent-directed social behavior which, when added to the classifier, lifts the fully automated Look Face + Smile and Look Face + Vocal configurations to Matthews correlations of 0.49 and 0.45 respectively, exceeding the human-coded single-partner baseline of 0.42.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出多模态纵向数据集 ASD-FEAT，并基于其构建自动化 ASD 风险识别流水线，分类准确率 76.2%、AUROC 0.82，引入"同次会话内对象对比"信号后性能进一步提升。
AI.motivation: 自闭症谱系障碍（ASD）的早期精准筛查是实现及时干预的前提，对改善认知与行为结局至关重要。然而现有 ASD 行为数据集无法在可比规模上同时具备纵向覆盖、重复会话、临床验证结果、专家帧级标注与隐私友好的多模态特征表示等特性，制约了自动化筛查研究。
AI.method: 构建 ASD-FEAT（ASD - Feature Extraction And Tracking）数据集，来源于婴幼儿—成人互动会话的视频记录，覆盖婴儿期至 36 个月的纵向数据、重复互动会话、临床验证的发育结局、专家帧级行为标注及隐私友好的多模态特征表示。特征融合专家定义特征与深度学习特征，包括面部与眼部关键点、面部动作单元、注视方向、头部位置、mel 频谱图音频表示及光流。基于该数据集评测端到端计算机视觉 + 机器学习流水线，并引入"同次会话内对象对比"（contrast examiner-directed 与 parent-directed 社交行为）作为每会话信号。
AI.result: 自动化流水线达到 ASD 分类准确率 76.2%、AUROC 0.82；基于人工标注行为训练的分类器为准确率 81.3%、AUROC 0.88。加入同次会话内对象对比信号后，全自动的 Look Face + Smile 与 Look Face + Vocal 配置的 Matthews 相关系数分别提升至 0.49 与 0.45，超过人工编码单对象基线 0.42。
AI.conclusion: ASD-FEAT 在规模与特性组合上优于现有 ASD 行为数据集，可有效支撑自动化 ASD 风险识别研究；同次会话内对象对比信号能显著提升全自动模型性能，甚至超越人工编码的单对象基线，表明多对象社交互动建模具有应用价值。

title: A Theory of Shape Reconstruction from Heat Conduction and Shading
summary: Shape from shading using a single image of a Lam- bertian surface is inherently ambiguous. When the light source direction is known, the surface normal estimation has a cone- ambiguity, which worsens when the source is unknown. Recently, shape from heat conduction has emerged as an approach that leverages heat transport equations to estimate the Shape Lapla- cian operator, an intrinsic measure of shape. However, deriving surface normals from the Laplacian operator encounters a local binary convex/concave ambiguity. Our contribution introduces a novel theory to resolve these local shape ambiguities (excluding a few degeneracies) without relying on priors like smoothness, by combining the cues from shading and heat conduction. Our method ensures the mathematical constraints of both shading and the Laplacian are satisfied simultaneously, even with an unknown light source. We validate our theory through simulations of complex shapes and analyze its performance in the presence of noise, as well as on a noisy single thermal video of real-world objects with complex shapes and material properties, including varying albedo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种结合明暗恢复形状（SfS）与热传导的新理论，在无需平滑等先验的条件下解决局部形状歧义，可同时满足阴影与Laplacian约束，并支持未知光源情形。
AI.motivation: 单图像Lambertian表面SfS本身存在固有歧义：光源已知时有锥形歧义，光源未知时更严重；而基于热传导估计形状Laplacian虽为内在量，但从Laplacian推导法向存在局部二值凸/凹歧义。
AI.method: 融合shading与heat conduction两类线索，构建新理论以消除局部形状歧义（排除少数退化情形）；方法在数学上同时满足shading与Laplacian约束，且不依赖光滑性等先验，并适用于未知光源。
AI.result: 通过复杂形状的仿真验证理论，并分析噪声条件下的性能；进一步在真实世界复杂形状与不同材质（含变化albedo）的单段含噪热视频上进行评估。
AI.conclusion: 结合阴影与热传导线索可有效解决局部形状歧义，避免传统先验依赖，并在仿真与真实热视频中表现出可行性。

title: Evaluating Zone-Guided Front Extraction for Glacier Calving-Front Delineation in SAR Imagery
comment: Accepted in ICMLA 2026 as short paper. 4 pages, 1 figure
summary: Automatic calving-front delineation from synthetic aperture radar imagery is challenging because the front is a thin and often ambiguous boundary between glacier ice, ocean, and surrounding rock or terrain. The CAlving Fronts and where to Find thEm (CaFFe) dataset provides both binary calving-front masks and broader semantic zone masks, making it possible to study whether zone-level supervision can support front recovery. In this paper, we compare direct front prediction with zone-guided front extraction using U-Net, DeepLabV3+, and SegFormer-B0 under the same bounding-box-cropped CaFFe setting. In the direct setting, models predict the binary calving-front mask. In the zone-guided setting, the model first predicts four semantic zone classes, and the front is then extracted from the predicted glacier-ocean boundary. We evaluate both zone-level and front-level performance, include a ground-truth-zone boundary check, and examine lightweight test-time adaptation on sensor-specific and glacier-specific subsets. The results show that zone labels contain useful front-boundary information: extracting the front from ground-truth zones gives the lowest mean distance error. However, fronts extracted from model-predicted zones remain weak, even when zone segmentation scores are moderate. Test-time adaptation also does not consistently improve zone-guided front recovery. These results indicate that zone segmentation performance should not be treated as a substitute for front-level evaluation and that effective use of zone labels may require boundary-aware training, label fusion, or explicit front supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了U-Net、DeepLabV3+和SegFormer-B0在CaFFe数据集上的冰裂锋提取，发现分区标签虽含边界信息，但由模型预测分区提取的锋线质量仍较弱，提示分区分割性能不能替代锋线级评估。
AI.motivation: 从SAR影像自动提取冰裂锋（calving front）困难，因其是冰、海洋与岩石/地形之间的细薄且模糊边界。CaFFe数据集同时提供二值锋线掩膜与更宽泛的语义分区掩膜，因此可探究分区级监督能否支持锋线恢复。
AI.method: 在同一边界框裁剪的CaFFe设置下，对比直接锋线预测与分区引导的锋线提取，模型为U-Net、DeepLabV3+、SegFormer-B0。直接设置中模型预测二值锋线掩膜；分区引导设置中先预测四类语义分区，再从预测的冰川-海洋边界提取锋线。评估包含分区级与锋线级指标、真值分区边界检查，以及面向传感器和冰川子集的轻量测试时自适应。
AI.result: 由真值分区提取锋线得到最低平均距离误差，说明分区标签包含有用的锋线边界信息；但由模型预测分区提取的锋线仍较弱，即使分区分割得分中等；测试时自适应也未稳定改善分区引导的锋线恢复。
AI.conclusion: 分区分割性能不应被视为锋线级评估的替代；欲有效利用分区标签，可能需要边界感知训练、标签融合或显式锋线监督。

title: Why Convolution Still Matters: Evaluating Inductive Biases in Cryospheric Image Classification
comment: Accepted at IEEE IGARSS 2026, 5 pages, 3 figures
summary: Recent advances in attention-based deep learning have motivated their adoption for remote sensing image classification; however, their benefits for cryospheric imagery, where surface states are dominated by fine-grained textures and class imbalance, remain unclear. In this work, we revisit a benchmark Greenland Ice Sheet image dataset, previously shown to favor convolutional neural networks (CNNs), to examine whether modern attention-based and hybrid architectures improve class-wise reliability. We conduct a controlled comparison between a classical CNN (AlexNet), a modern CNN (ConvNeXt-Tiny), a pure attention-based model (Swin-Tiny), and a hybrid convolution-attention model (CoAtNet-0) under identical training and evaluation protocols. Results show that AlexNet achieves the highest accuracy and the strongest balanced performance as measured by macro-averaged F1, while ConvNeXt-Tiny exhibits the highest macro-averaged AUC, indicating strong class separability but less consistent final decision quality. Class-wise analysis reveals that hybrid architectures improve recall for rare and structurally distinct surface classes, whereas convolutional models remain more reliable for texture-dominated categories. These findings highlight the importance of aligning architectural inductive bias with cryospheric data characteristics and suggest that increased model complexity does not necessarily translate to improved reliability for ice-sheet surface classification.

AI.tldr: 在格陵兰冰盖影像分类基准上，采用统一训练与评估协议对比AlexNet、ConvNeXt-Tiny、Swin-Tiny与CoAtNet-0，发现AlexNet的准确率与宏平均F1最优，ConvNeXt-Tiny的宏平均AUC最高，模型复杂度提升并未带来可靠性提升。
AI.motivation: 注意力深度学习在遥感图像分类中广受关注，但在冰冻圈影像中，地表状态由细粒度纹理主导且存在类别不平衡，注意力模型与混合架构是否真正提升类别级可靠性尚不明确；本文因此重新审视此前被认为更适合CNN的格陵兰冰盖基准数据集。
AI.method: 在相同的训练与评估协议下进行受控对比实验，涵盖四类架构：经典CNN（AlexNet）、现代CNN（ConvNeXt-Tiny）、纯注意力模型（Swin-Tiny）以及卷积-注意力混合模型（CoAtNet-0）；除整体指标外，还开展逐类别分析，考察各类别的召回率与可靠性。
AI.result: AlexNet取得最高准确率，并在宏平均F1上表现最佳的均衡性能；ConvNeXt-Tiny取得最高宏平均AUC，说明类别可分性强但最终决策质量一致性不足。逐类别分析显示，混合架构提升了对稀有且结构独特的地表类别的召回率，而卷积模型在纹理主导的类别上更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 架构的归纳偏置需与冰冻圈数据特征相匹配；模型复杂度增加并不必然带来冰盖表面分类可靠性的提升，稀有类别与纹理主导类别之间存在精度-召回权衡。

title: VCURF: Virtual Camera-based Uncertainty of Radiance Fields
summary: Radiance fields, implemented with either implicit (NeRF) or explicit (Gaussian Splatting) representations, are advancing the state of the art in novel view synthesis at a rapid pace. Even though the rendered views they generate are often compelling, they are not free of errors. In this paper, we propose a new approach for pixel-wise uncertainty quantification based on measuring the inconsistencies among renderings by the radiance field model in virtual cameras sampled near the target viewpoint. We named our approach VCURF for Virtual Camera-based Uncertainty of Radiance Fields. VCURF treats the radiance field model as a black box, only assuming that it is capable of rendering color and depth on demand. This property makes our approach applicable to both NeRF and GS models without any modification. Our experiments on a combination of datasets, radiance field models and baselines demonstrate VCURF's effectiveness in pixel-wise uncertainty estimation. We conclude the paper with findings that question the way view selection is tackled by the majority of the current literature.

AI.tldr: 提出VCURF方法,通过在目标视角附近的虚拟相机中测量辐射场渲染的不一致性,实现像素级不确定性量化,适用于NeRF和3D高斯散射模型。
AI.motivation: 辐射场(NeRF/Gaussian Splatting)在新视角合成上进展迅速,渲染结果虽有吸引力但仍存在误差,因此需要像素级的不确定性量化手段。
AI.method: 将辐射场模型视为黑盒,仅假设其能按需渲染颜色和深度;在目标视角附近的虚拟相机中采样并渲染,通过衡量这些渲染结果之间的不一致性来估计像素级不确定性。该方法无需修改即可用于NeRF和GS模型。
AI.result: 在多种数据集、辐射场模型和基线组合上的实验验证了VCURF在像素级不确定性估计方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: VCURF是一种通用、与模型无关的像素级不确定性估计方法;论文基于研究结果对当前多数文献中视角选择(view selection)的处理方式提出了质疑。

title: Dependable AI-Assisted Engineering: A Formal Framework for AI Participation and Assurance in Safety-Critical Workflows
summary: Generative AI can produce engineering artefacts, but generation alone does not determine whether or how those artefacts should enter safety-critical workflows. This paper develops a formal framework for assigning AI participation and assurance at the level of individual workflow units. Each unit has a participation and assurance record covering its engineering requirement, an approved operational formalization where applicable, the applicable mechanism, fallback where applicable, evidence obligations and the applicable guarantee, plus a deployment-readiness status. The framework distinguishes deterministic verification, statistically calibrated admission, authorized human judgement supported by AI advice, authorized human adjudication of AI-produced artefacts, retained deterministic tool paths and explicit non-participation; these arrangements carry different kinds of guarantee rather than levels on a common scale. The framework also separates formalization fidelity from verifier soundness, provides a staged classification and readiness procedure, and derives conditions for comparing a gated AI-assisted unit with an incumbent process under recurring-population assumptions. We instantiate and apply the framework in an executed 17-unit wing-spar structural-analysis workflow combining deterministically gated AI-generated CAD, retained deterministic computation and human judgement. The AI-generated CAD program passed all 23 deterministic checks and was admitted at the first attempt. Favourable stress magnitudes did not suffice to pass the stress criteria where the predeclared mesh-convergence evidence was insufficient; those criteria were instead referred to engineering judgement. The case demonstrates selective AI participation and explicit evidence handling at unit level; no claim is made of workflow-level dependability, certification, structural safety or productivity.

AI.tldr: 提出按工作流单元分配AI参与度与保证的正式框架，并在17单元机翼翼梁结构分析流程中实例化验证。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI可产出工程制品，但生成本身无法判定这些制品是否、如何进入安全关键工作流。需要将AI参与和保证责任下沉到工作流单元层面进行形式化刻画。
AI.method: 为每个工作流单元建立"参与—保证记录"，涵盖工程需求、获批的操作形式化、适用机制、回退方案、证据义务、适用保证及部署就绪状态。区分确定性与统计性校准准入、AI建议辅助的人类判断、人类对AI制品的裁定、保留确定性工具路径、显式不参与等安排（性质不同而非同一标尺上的等级）。分离形式化保真度与验证器可靠性，给出分阶段分类与就绪程序，并在重复总体假设下推导门控AI辅助单元与既有流程的比较条件。
AI.result: 在17单元机翼翼梁结构分析流程中实例化：AI生成CAD经确定性门控、保留确定性计算并引入人工判断。AI生成CAD程序通过全部23项确定性检查且首次即被准入；应力幅值有利但预声明网格收敛证据不足，未能通过应力准则，转交工程判断处理。
AI.conclusion: 案例展示了单元级的选择性AI参与与显式证据处理；未对工作流级可靠性、认证、结构安全性或生产率作任何主张。

title: UniBRep: Learning Unified Geometry and Topology for Image-conditioned B-Rep Generation
summary: Generating a boundary representation (B-rep) conditioned on a single image requires faithful reconstruction of geometry, valid topology, and support for complex shapes. We present UniBRep, a geometry-first framework that adapts a pretrained image-to-3D model to generate a feature mesh as a unified intermediate representation. Its surface provides a geometric scaffold, while spatially aligned learned features encode face-separation cues for topology recovery. Dual decoder branches generate the geometry and face-separation features; a geometry- and feature-guided construction pipeline then fits parametric surfaces, recovers boundary curves and connectivity, and assembles an explicit B-rep using a CAD kernel. Recovering topology from mesh regions avoids predefined architectural face-count limits, allowing face count to scale with shape complexity. On the standard DeepCAD benchmark, UniBRep produces valid B-reps for 80.49\% of inputs and reduces face Chamfer distance from 0.1096 to 0.0345 relative to CADDreamer. In a matched comparison, UniBRep also outperforms the HoLa public demo across all reported metrics. Further evaluations demonstrate scalability to high-complexity shapes beyond the standard 30-face range, generalization to objects outside the CAD training distribution, and qualitative transfer to real photographs.

AI.tldr: UniBRep：以几何为先的图像到B-rep生成框架，利用预训练图到3D模型生成特征网格作为统一中间表示，通过几何与特征引导的管线恢复参数曲面、边界曲线与拓扑，装配显式B-rep，突破预设面数限制。
AI.motivation: 由单张图像生成B-rep需同时保证几何保真、拓扑有效并支持复杂形状；既有方法受预设面数上限约束，难以适应形状复杂度变化。
AI.method: 几何为先框架，将预训练image-to-3D模型适配为生成特征网格：其表面作几何支架，空间对齐的学习特征编码面分离线索。双解码分支分别生成几何与面分离特征；随后几何与特征引导的构建管线拟合参数曲面、恢复边界曲线与连通性，并借助CAD内核装配显式B-rep。拓扑从网格区域恢复，避免预定义面数限制。
AI.result: 在DeepCAD基准上，80.49%输入生成有效B-rep，面Chamfer距离由CADDreamer的0.1096降至0.0345；与HoLa公开demo的匹配对比中各项指标均更优。进一步实验显示可扩展至超出标准30面范围的高复杂度形状，泛化到CAD训练分布外物体，并定性迁移至真实照片。
AI.conclusion: UniBRep通过特征网格统一表示与几何、特征双重引导的拓扑恢复，实现了高质量、可扩展且泛化性强的图像条件B-rep生成。

title: Scaling 3D Visual Grounding in Abdominal CT
summary: Visual grounding models can enhance radiology workflows by linking report findings to image regions. This is particularly valuable for 3D CT, where findings often occupy a tiny fraction of the volume. Training 3D grounding models requires large sets of paired phrases and regions, and building such datasets is expensive, requiring radiologists to annotate images by hand. We posit that this supervision is already created implicitly during routine reporting, as radiologists frequently place 2D annotations (e.g., distance measurement, arrows) on key images to make measurements and to support report interpretation. We introduce an automated pipeline that converts these routine clinical annotations into large-scale phrase-region supervision for 3D visual grounding. The pipeline links each annotation to the corresponding finding in the report through metadata matching, then uses a promptable 3D segmentation model to convert the 2D annotation into a volumetric mask. This produces phrase-mask-volume datasets without requiring additional radiologist annotation. Applied to a single institution's clinical picture archiving and communication system (PACS), our approach generated 105K phrase-mask-volume triplets from 59K abdominal CT exams. We also introduce two abdominal CT grounding benchmarks, LocusBench-Onc and LocusBench-ED, which comprise 240 oncology and 260 emergency-department radiologist-reviewed phrase-mask-volume triplets, respectively, with the latter spanning 13 distinct categories such as appendicitis, hematoma, and hernia. We further introduce LocusCT, a 3D visual grounding model trained on this dataset, which achieves hit rates of 0.725 on LocusBench-Onc and 0.773 on LocusBench-ED, substantially outperforming comparator models. These results show that routine PACS annotations are a scalable, previously unused source of supervision for 3D visual grounding.

AI.tldr: 将临床PACS中常规的2D标注自动转换为大规模短语-掩码-体积监督数据，构建3D CT视觉定位数据集与基准，并训练出性能显著优于对比模型的LocusCT。
AI.motivation: 3D CT视觉定位可将报告发现链接到图像区域，但训练此类模型需要大量配对的短语-区域数据，人工标注成本高昂。作者认为放射科医生在日常报告中放置的2D标注（如距离测量、箭头）已隐含提供此类监督信号，可加以利用。
AI.method: 提出自动化流程：通过元数据匹配将每个标注与报告中的对应发现关联，再利用可提示的3D分割模型把2D标注转换为体积掩码，从而无需额外放射科标注即可生成短语-掩码-体积数据集。
AI.result: 应用于单一机构PACS后，从59K腹部CT检查中生成105K短语-掩码-体积三元组。提出两个基准LocusBench-Onc（240例肿瘤）与LocusBench-ED（260例急诊，涵盖阑尾炎、血肿、疝等13类）。训练的LocusCT在LocusBench-Onc命中率0.725、LocusBench-ED命中率0.773，显著优于对比模型。
AI.conclusion: 常规PACS标注是3D视觉定位的一种可扩展且此前未被利用的监督来源。

title: Where Does the Semantic Gain Come From? A Reproduction and Extension of Semantic Knowledge-driven Contrastive Learning for Long-Tailed Recognition
summary: Semantic Knowledge-driven Contrastive Learning (SKCL) uses a language model to decide which classes are related, and pulls each image towards the prototypes of its semantic neighbours. On CIFAR-100-LT (beta = 100) it reports 54.02% top-1 accuracy, 2.01 points above Balanced Contrastive Learning (BCL), the method it builds on. The code and the class descriptions are not public. I reimplement SKCL, BCL and ConCutMix in one framework, check it against the public baseline code, and run every configuration with three seeds. The two baselines reproduce within 1.5 points, but SKCL built on BCL, as the paper describes it, ends up 0.56 points below BCL. To find out why, I add SKCL to the authors' own ConCutMix code. Trained for the paper's 300 epochs, it reaches 53.69, only 0.33 below the published number. At the same budget, however, the semantic graph adds just 0.23 points over ConCutMix, while training ConCutMix for 100 more epochs adds 1.04. Together with ConCutMix's published lead over BCL (1.15), this explains the claimed gain. A BCL model that never sees the graph already shares 41.2% of the graph's top-2 neighbours with its own most-confused classes (2.0% by chance), which shows why the graph adds so little on these benchmarks. I also test several changes to SKCL. Combining it with the CutMix branch improves it by 1.06 points, and an adaptive version of the graph improves it slightly (+0.34 and +0.28 in two codebases), although these gains are within seed noise.

AI.tldr: 复现显示SKCL的收益主要来自ConCutMix基线与更长训练，而非语义图本身。
AI.motivation: SKCL声称通过语言模型构建语义邻接图，将图像拉向语义邻居原型，从而在长尾基准上显著优于BCL；但代码与类描述未公开，需验证其真实增益来源。
AI.method: 在同一框架内复现SKCL、BCL与ConCutMix，与公开基线代码对齐，并以三个随机种子运行全部配置；进一步将SKCL嵌入作者自身的ConCutMix代码，控制训练轮数（300 vs 400）与语义图的有无进行比较。
AI.result: CIFAR-100-LT（beta=100）：复现SKCL基于BCL反而低于BCL 0.56个点；嵌入ConCutMix后300轮达53.69，仅比发表值低0.33。同预算下语义图仅带来+0.23，而ConCutMix多训100轮带来+1.04，叠加其相对BCL的1.15领先，可解释宣称增益。BCL模型未见图时已与图中top-2邻居共享41.2%的最混淆类（随机为2.0%）。改进尝试：加入CutMix分支+1.06，自适应图+0.34/+0.28，均在种子噪声内。
AI.conclusion: SKCL在长尾基准上的表观提升很大程度上源于基线选择（ConCutMix）与训练轮数差异，语义知识图的边际贡献微弱且不显著；该评测基准下语义图与模型固有混淆结构高度冗余。

title: From Sight to Foresight: Predictive Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Predicting future spatial states supports collision avoidance and timely decision-making in dynamic environments. However, existing vision-language models (VLMs) and benchmarks for spatial reasoning primarily focus on observed scenes, leaving predictive spatial reasoning beyond the observed interval underexplored. To this end, we introduce SpatialMind, a metric-scale VLM for spatial reasoning and future prediction. Its metric depth adapter anchors spatial reasoning to real-world scale, while its progressive state chain establishes current spatial states and observed dynamics as the foundation for future prediction. Given a video prefix, SpatialMind predicts distances, motion directions, and spatial relations in both observed and unseen future frames. For training and evaluation, we build a scalable data engine that grounds entity descriptions in metric geometry to generate question-answer pairs and state supervision. Using this engine, we construct the SpatialMind-30K dataset and the SpatialMind-2K benchmark, both covering driving and everyday egocentric scenes. The benchmark spans eight tasks across three levels: current-state understanding, observed-dynamics understanding, and future prediction. Experiments show that SpatialMind substantially outperforms both general and spatially specialized models on our benchmark while achieving competitive zero-shot performance on VSI-Bench, OSI-Bench, and VLM4D.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SpatialMind，一个度量尺度的视觉语言模型（VLM），用于空间推理与未来预测；并构建了 SpatialMind-30K 数据集与 SpatialMind-2K 基准，覆盖当前状态理解、观测动态理解与未来预测三个层次，实验表明其显著优于通用与空间专用模型。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 与空间推理基准主要关注已观测场景，缺乏对观测区间之外（未来帧）的预测性空间推理的探索；而预测未来空间状态对动态环境中的碰撞避免与及时决策至关重要。
AI.method: 提出 SpatialMind：度量尺度 VLM，包含度量深度适配器（metric depth adapter）将空间推理锚定到真实世界尺度，以及渐进式状态链（progressive state chain）以当前空间状态与观测动态为基础进行未来预测。给定视频前缀，模型预测已观测帧与未见未来帧中的距离、运动方向与空间关系。同时构建可扩展数据引擎，将实体描述基于度量几何生成问答对与状态监督，进而构建数据集与基准。
AI.result: 在 SpatialMind-2K 基准上，SpatialMind 显著优于通用模型与空间专用模型；在 VSI-Bench、OSI-Bench 与 VLM4D 上取得有竞争力的零样本性能。
AI.conclusion: SpatialMind 通过度量深度锚定与渐进式状态链，将空间推理从观测场景扩展到未来帧预测；配套数据引擎与基准为预测性空间推理提供了可扩展的训练与评测方案，验证了度量尺度建模在该任务上的有效性。

title: Watermarks and Fingerprints as Soft Bindings for Content Provenance: An Open-Licence Benchmark for Images, Audio and Video
comment: 59 pages. Code, recorded results and manuscript source: https://github.com/Original-Pictures/soft-bindings-benchmark (v1.0)
summary: Content-provenance standards such as C2PA let a platform recover a stripped manifest through a soft binding: an invisible watermark read from the content, or a fingerprint looked up in a registry. We benchmarked both families under one protocol, restricted to openly available models whose licences we audited, on public media, with false-match rates calibrated on held-out negatives and source-level bootstrap intervals for performance estimates. For watermarking we evaluated 25 image, 7 audio and 7 video configurations from 12 methods on perceptual quality, robustness, false positives and cost; for fingerprinting, 35 methods on registries of up to 98,985 images, partial edits and adversarial attacks. PixelSeal gave the best balance for image and video watermarks and AudioSeal for audio, but the error-correcting detector of every TrustMark variant fired on 5.9 to 15.3% of unmarked images, so a verifier should test the expected payload. Among fingerprints, copy detectors trained on non-commercial data detected up to 75.5% of transformed images at a pair-level false-match rate of $10^{-7}$ and DINOv2, the best permissively licensed method, 65.0%; near-copies in a product catalogue dominated the false matches, and no detection improvement from geometric verification was observed under a matched calibration false-binding constraint in the evaluated image pipelines. On the same attacked copies the two families failed differently: the union of watermark and fingerprint successes covered 69% of image copies; fingerprints covered more audio queries, whereas expected-key watermark verification covered more video queries. Embedding a watermark moved the ISCC code of 62.0% of images past its match threshold, and platform-dependent colour conversion changed watermark bits between x86 and ARM hosts.

AI.tldr: 该论文在同一协议下基准测试了C2PA软绑定中的水印与指纹两大家族方法，涵盖25种图像/7种音频/7种视频水印配置及35种指纹方法，并揭示了两者在鲁棒性、误报与失败模式上的差异。
AI.motivation: 内容溯源标准（如C2PA）允许平台通过软绑定（水印或指纹）恢复被剥离的清单。然而水印与指纹两类方法缺乏统一、可比的评估基准，且现有模型许可与误报校准问题未被系统审计。
AI.method: 在统一协议下，限定于经许可证审计的公开可用模型，使用公共媒体数据，在留出负样本上校准误匹配率，并用源级bootstrap区间估计性能。水印方面评估12种方法的25种图像、7种音频、7种视频配置，考察感知质量、鲁棒性、误报与成本；指纹方面评估35种方法，注册库规模达98,985张图像，并测试部分编辑与对抗攻击。
AI.result: PixelSeal在图像与视频水印上平衡最佳，AudioSeal在音频上最佳，但所有TrustMark变体的纠错检测器在5.9%–15.3%的未标记图像上误触发。指纹中，非商用数据训练的copy检测器在成对误匹配率10^-7下检出高达75.5%的变换图像，许可最宽松的DINOv2为65.0%；产品目录近副本主导误匹配，图像流程中几何验证未带来检测提升。两种方法失败模式不同：并集覆盖69%图像副本；指纹覆盖更多音频查询，期望密钥水印验证覆盖更多视频查询。嵌入水印使62.0%图像的ISCC码越过匹配阈值，平台相关色彩转换在x86与ARM主机间改变水印比特。
AI.conclusion: 水印与指纹在软绑定中互补而非替代：其成功集合与失败模式因媒体类型而异，联合使用可提升覆盖率。验证器应测试期望载荷以避免误触发，且须注意水印嵌入对内容指纹（如ISCC）的扰动及跨平台色彩转换导致的比特不一致。

title: Kepler4D: Controllable Future Video Generation via 4D Scene State Evolution
summary: Video world models aim to preserve scene structure and predict how dynamic objects evolve beyond visual observations. We present Kepler4D, a framework for future video generation through explicit 4D scene state evolution. Given a monocular video, Kepler4D constructs a shared 3D representation of background geometry, object motion histories, coarse spatial supports, and semantic context. Chain-of-Motion summarizes observed motion and uses a vision-language model to select structured speed and heading decisions and decide whether to bound object-center height from below. A deterministic rollout converts these decisions into future object trajectories for inspection and editing before synthesis. We render the evolving proxies into geometric controls for a pretrained video generator, separating coarse object motion from the synthesis of appearance and articulation. Experiments on real-world videos demonstrate that Kepler4D enables controllable object motion and plausible future rollout while preserving scene consistency.

AI.tldr: Kepler4D 通过显式 4D 场景状态演化实现可控的未來视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现有视频世界模型需在视觉观测之外保持场景结构并预测动态物体的演化。
AI.method: 从单目视频构建共享 3D 表示（背景几何、物体运动历史、粗略空间支撑、语义上下文）；Chain-of-Motion 总结观测运动并用视觉语言模型选择结构化速度与航向决策及是否约束物体中心高度；确定性 rollout 将决策转为未来轨迹，供检查与编辑；将演化代理渲染为几何控制以驱动预训练视频生成器，分离粗略运动与外观/关节合成。
AI.result: 在真实世界视频上的实验表明，Kepler4D 可实现可控的物体运动与合理的未来 rollout，同时保持场景一致性。
AI.conclusion: 显式 4D 场景状态演化是提升视频世界模型可控性与场景一致性的有效途径。

title: Diagnosis-Conditioned Spatial Gating and Decoder-Level Supervised Contrastive Learning for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation models can produce fluent text while still containing finding-level inaccuracies. Diagnosis-driven methods improve generation by conditioning on predicted findings, but these predictions do not directly modify the visual patch features provided to the decoder, and global gating applies the same modulation across spatial locations. We introduce a Position-Aware Gate (PAG) that uses predicted finding representations to modulate visual patches spatially without region supervision. We also propose a Decoder-level Supervised Contrastive Loss (DSCL) that structures decoder representations using shared positive findings rather than instance identity. On MIMIC-CXR, PAG+DSCL improves clinical efficacy (CE) F1 from 0.484 to 0.502 over a matched global-gate reference, while PAG and DSCL individually reach 0.491 and 0.495. Without additional fine-tuning, the combined model achieves 0.226 CE F1 on IU X-Ray, compared with 0.211 reported by PromptMRG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出位置感知门控(PAG)与解码器级监督对比损失(DSCL),无需区域监督即可对视觉patch进行空间调制,并利用共享阳性发现构建解码器表示,提升放射报告生成的临床准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有放射报告生成模型虽能生成流畅文本,但仍存在发现层面的不准确。诊断驱动方法通过条件于预测发现来改进生成,但这些预测并不直接修改提供给解码器的视觉patch特征,且全局门控在所有空间位置上施加相同调制,无法实现空间特异性的视觉调制。
AI.method: 提出PAG,利用预测的发现表示在无区域监督条件下对视觉patch进行空间调制;提出DSCL,基于共享阳性发现而非实例身份来构建解码器表示结构。两者结合在MIMIC-CXR上训练与评估,并在IU X-Ray上做零样本迁移测试。
AI.result: 在MIMIC-CXR上,PAG+DSCL将临床有效性(CE)F1从匹配的全局门控参照的0.484提升至0.502;单独使用PAG和DSCL分别为0.491和0.495。在无需额外微调的情况下,组合模型在IU X-Ray上达到0.226 CE F1,而PromptMRG报告为0.211。
AI.conclusion: PAG与DSCL能有效增强诊断驱动报告生成的空间调制与表示结构,在两数据集上均取得CE F1提升,且跨数据集迁移性优于对比方法。

title: Referring Multi-Object Tracking in Moving-Camera Videos via Global Motion Compensation
summary: Referring multi-object tracking (RMOT) takes a video and a language expression as input and tracks all referred objects. Many tracking requirements involve how an object moves rather than how it appears. However, in a video captured by a moving camera, a parked vehicle may appear to move, while a moving vehicle may show little displacement. Existing RMOT methods relate motion with text but do not explicitly remove camera-induced motion. In this paper, we propose extracting residual motion across frames by estimating camera motion in driver-view videos and compare motion characteristics with the query expression. We consider the motion-matching extent and integrate it with the RMOT method's prediction result through late fusion. In the evaluation, we verify the performance gain of taking the motion compensation module as a plug-in across different RMOT hosts.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对"参考多目标跟踪"（RMOT）中"如何运动"类查询，提出通过估计行车视角视频中的相机运动来提取跨帧残余运动，并将运动匹配度与RMOT预测结果晚融合，以补偿相机自身运动带来的干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有RMOT方法虽将运动与文本关联，但未显式去除相机运动引起的干扰。在移动相机拍摄的视频中，静止车辆可能看似在运动，而运动车辆位移可能很小，导致仅依赖表观或未补偿的运动信息难以准确匹配"如何运动"的查询。
AI.method: 1) 在行车视角（driver-view）视频中估计相机运动；2) 基于相机运动补偿，提取跨帧的残余运动（residual motion）；3) 将残余运动特征与查询表达式的运动特性进行比较，计算运动匹配程度；4) 通过晚融合（late fusion）将该匹配度与RMOT方法的预测结果结合；5) 作为即插即用模块嵌入不同RMOT基线。
AI.result: 在评估中，以运动补偿模块作为plug-in接入不同RMOT宿主方法后，均验证了性能增益。
AI.conclusion: 显式消除相机诱导运动、提取残余运动并与语言查询做运动匹配，是提升RMOT（尤其是运动相关查询）性能的有效且通用的策略。

title: CellSplat4D: PSF-Aware 4D Gaussian Splatting for Sparse Robotic Live-Cell Imaging
summary: A robotic microscope watching living cells cannot afford to look as often as it would like. Every volume it acquires costs photons the specimen does not get back, and time owed to other wells. What such a platform exists to produce is a record of individual cells through time: which cell is which from one volume to the next, and which cell divided into which two. Sampling sparsely breaks that record exactly where it matters, and the fault lies in the acquisition schedule rather than in the analysis software. We fill the gaps by reconstructing them, fitting a 4D Gaussian model to whatever volumes the hardware could afford. The model is a cloud of light-emitting blobs, each carrying a position, a shape and a lifetime. Being continuous in time, it renders any missing volume on demand, decoupling how often the robot analyses from how often it can afford to look. The microscope's point-spread function is measured from the data rather than inherited from acquisition metadata or left to the optimizer, because metadata inflates it and the optimizer cannot recover it at all: a wider blur around a smaller blob fits the images equally well. Each blob's lifetime is stored in frames rather than as a fraction of the recording, so that it denotes a fixed duration on any sequence. Unmeasured timesteps are supervised at coarse scale by a 3D U-Net that predicts the intermediate volume directly and estimates no motion field, since a dividing cell becomes two and no motion describes that. On two Cell Tracking Challenge sequences, a C. elegans embryo and a Chinese Hamster Ovarian (CHO), with fidelity scored per cell nucleus, our reconstruction holds the highest nucleus fidelity at every distance from an acquired frame, has the flattest decay across the gap, and best recovers focal planes it was never shown with graceful degradation across the gap.

AI.tldr: 提出用4D高斯模型重建稀疏采样的活细胞显微数据：从硬件可承受的体数据拟合光发射blob云（位置、形状、寿命），连续时间渲染任意缺失体，解耦分析与采样频率；PSF从数据测得而非元数据，寿命以帧为单位，未采样时间步用3D U-Net粗尺度监督。在两个Cell Tracking Challenge序列上取得最高细胞核保真度、最平缓的间隙衰减。
AI.motivation: 机器人显微镜观测活细胞时面临光子预算与时间分配限制，无法高频采集。稀疏采样会在细胞追踪最关键的环节（哪个细胞对应哪个、谁分裂成谁）破坏时间连续性记录，但问题根源在采集时序而非分析软件。因此需要弥补缺失数据。
AI.method: 1）用4D高斯模型（位置、形状、寿命的光发射blob云）拟合硬件采集到的体数据；2）模型时间连续，可按需渲染任意缺失体数据；3）PSF从数据测量而非依赖元数据或交给优化器（元数据会使其膨胀，优化器无法恢复）；4）blob寿命以帧为单位存储而非占总记录比例，确保固定时长语义；5）用3D U-Net在粗尺度监督未测量的时间步，直接预测中间体，不估计运动场。
AI.result: 在Cell Tracking Challenge的秀丽隐杆线虫胚胎与CHO两个序列上，按细胞核保真度评估：在距采集帧的每个距离上均保持最高细胞核保真度，跨间隙衰减最平缓，且对从未展示过的焦平面恢复效果最佳，并随间隙距离优雅退化。
AI.conclusion: 通过连续的4D高斯重建弥合稀疏采样造成的追踪断点，使机器人分析频率与可承受采样频率解耦；该方法在细胞核保真度与缺失焦面恢复上优于基线。

title: Sparse-GS2Mesh: 3D Gaussian Splatting Guided by Novel Stereo Views and 2DGS for Sparse View Surface Reconstruction}
comment: 13, pages, 7 figures, accepted to NIPS 2026 PhysWorldAI workshops
summary: Surface reconstruction under sparse-view settings remains challenging due to limited geometric cues. Volume rendering methods based on signed distance functions often produce over-smoothed surfaces, while 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), though time-efficient, suffers from incomplete geometry due to the lack of reliable depth supervision and the limitation of being optimized only from given input views. In this paper, we present Sparse-GS2Mesh, a stereo-aware framework for surface reconstruction from sparse views. While 3DGS and stereo matching have been leveraged for surface reconstruction under dense view settings, we extend them to operate effectively under sparse view conditions by first initializing 3DGS using epipolar depth priors to mitigate the 3DGS overfitting problem, followed by our three key components: (I) adaptive baseline selection, (II) fine-tuning with a stereo matching network, and (III) 2D/3D co-regularized fine-tuning. Given a warmed-up 3DGS initialized with epipolar depth, the adaptive baseline selection automatically determines a baseline to synthesize for each sparse view. We then fine-tune 3DGS by backpropagating depth-refining gradients from the stereo matching network, effectively specializing the 3DGS for stereo matching. The 2D/3D co-regularization further helps obtain stable reconstruction, addressing weak geometric cues in close stereo views. Sparse-GS2Mesh achieves a 15\% improvement over state-of-the-art methods in little-overlap settings and comparable results in large-overlap settings. Codes will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 Sparse-GS2Mesh，一种立体感知框架，通过极线深度先验初始化 3DGS 并引入自适应基线选择、立体匹配网络微调及 2D/3D 协同正则化，显著提升稀疏视角下的表面重建质量。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角下几何线索有限，表面重建困难。基于有符号距离函数的体渲染方法易产生过度平滑表面；3DGS 虽高效，但缺乏可靠深度监督且仅能从给定输入视角优化，导致几何不完整。作者旨在将 3DGS 与立体匹配扩展至稀疏视角场景以解决上述问题。
AI.method: 先用极线深度先验初始化 3DGS 以缓解过拟合，随后引入三个关键模块：(I) 自适应基线选择，为每个稀疏视角自动确定用于合成图像的基线；(II) 利用立体匹配网络进行微调，通过反向传播深度细化梯度使 3DGS 专门适配立体匹配；(III) 2D/3D 协同正则化，应对近距离立体视角中弱几何线索，获得稳定重建。
AI.result: 在低重叠设置下较当前最优方法提升约 15%，在大重叠设置下取得可比结果。代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: Sparse-GS2Mesh 通过极线深度初始化与立体感知微调及协同正则化，将 3DGS 与立体匹配有效扩展至稀疏视角，兼顾重建完整性与稳定性，在低重叠场景优势显著。

title: FlashGaze: Training-Free Multi-Scale Patch Pruning For Efficient Video Understanding
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in video understanding, yet efficiently processing long, high-resolution videos remains challenging. Such videos often contain substantial spatiotemporal redundancy, and processing redundant visual tokens can incur avoidable computational overhead. Many existing methods prune visual tokens during or after vision transformer (ViT) encoding, leaving much of the encoding cost unaddressed. Some approaches prune patches before encoding but rely on learned auxiliary networks for patch selection, incurring additional training and inference overhead. To address these limitations, we propose FlashGaze, a training-free method that reduces spatiotemporal redundancy before ViT encoding without introducing auxiliary networks. FlashGaze uses pixel-space differences as a proxy for information loss and employs Quadtree Dynamic Programming to jointly optimize patch dropping, merging, and keeping under a fixed budget. Experiments on two MLLM backbones across multiple benchmarks demonstrate substantial efficiency gains while largely preserving accuracy. On Qwen3-VL-8B, FlashGaze retains 98% of the full-input baseline accuracy on LongVideoBench while achieving up to 5.4x and 17x speedups in ViT encoding and MLLM prefill, respectively, and reducing peak GPU memory usage by a factor of 1.8. These efficiency gains enable the model to process videos with more frames and higher resolutions on the same GPU hardware, unlocking video understanding at scales previously out of reach.

AI.tldr: FlashGaze是一种免训练方法，在ViT编码前通过像素空间差异与四叉树动态规划联合优化patch的丢弃、合并与保留，降低视频时空冗余，在保持精度的同时显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型处理长时长、高分辨率视频时面临严重的时空冗余，现有方法多在ViT编码中或编码后剪枝token，无法解决大部分编码开销；而编码前剪枝的方法又依赖学习到的辅助网络，带来额外训练与推理开销。
AI.method: 提出FlashGaze，一种免训练方法：以像素空间差异作为信息损失的代理指标，采用四叉树动态规划（Quadtree Dynamic Programming）在固定预算下联合优化patch的丢弃、合并与保留，在ViT编码前即减少时空冗余，且无需引入辅助网络。
AI.result: 在两个MLLM主干、多个基准上验证，效率大幅提升且精度基本保持。在Qwen3-VL-8B上，LongVideoBench精度保留全输入基线的98%，ViT编码加速最高5.4倍，MLLM prefill加速最高17倍，峰值GPU显存降低1.8倍。
AI.conclusion: FlashGaze在同等GPU硬件上支持更多帧数、更高分辨率的视频处理，拓展了此前难以触及的视频理解规模，为高效长视频多模态理解提供了免训练、即插即用的解决方案。

title: OctMesh: A Unified Octree-Hierarchical Framework for Lossless Triangle Mesh Compression
summary: Lossless triangle mesh compression must preserve both vertex positions and connectivity. Octrees support learned point cloud geometry coding and progressive refinement, but extending them to meshes requires a compatible connectivity representation. Unlike the eight occupancy decisions of a voxel, a parent edge can develop into varied child connections, making edge refinement difficult to model with a compact prediction prior. We propose OctMesh, a learned framework that codes geometry and connectivity on a shared octree hierarchy. Its key observation is that octree pooling produces parents with either one child or two to eight children. Child edges are then grouped by their endpoint parents' types and whether the endpoints share a parent. Each candidate group contains children from just one parent or two connected parents. The resulting four categories define small, fixed-shape prediction tasks: connections uniquely determined by the parent graph are inherited without bits, while three neural predictors estimate probabilities for the remaining candidates. These probabilities guide arithmetic coding of the actual edge symbols. Binarized predictions of within-parent connections provide context for predicting connections between different parents. A graph-aware parent feature extractor combines local geometry, parent connectivity and global shape. The connectivity models use dedicated weights at coarse levels and share weights at fine levels. Residual edges and a finest-level face-selection payload complete the reconstruction. On 256 frames from eight MPEG V-DMC test sequences, OctMesh losslessly recovers the finest-level vertex-coordinate, edge and unoriented face sets at an average of 7.033 bits per face, 12.8% below V-Mesh. The same hierarchical representation supports nine levels of progressive vertex-and-edge refinement.

AI.tldr: OctMesh 提出在共享八叉树层级上联合学习编码网格几何与连通性，在 MPEG V-DMC 测试集上平均每面 7.033 比特无损压缩，比 V-Mesh 降低 12.8%，并支持 9 级渐进式顶点与边细化。
AI.motivation: 无损三角网格压缩需同时保留顶点位置与连通性。八叉树已支持学习式点云几何编码与渐进细化，但扩展到网格需要兼容的连通性表示。与体素的 8 个占据决策不同，父边可发展为多样的子连接，使得边细化难以用紧凑的预测先验建模。
AI.method: 核心观察是八叉树池化产生的父节点有 1 个子节点或 2–8 个子节点。将子边按端点父节点类型及端点是否共享父节点分组，得到四类候选，每类仅涉及一个父节点或两个相连父节点，从而定义为固定形状的小预测任务。父图唯一确定的连接无比特继承，其余三类由神经预测器估计概率并用于算术编码实际边符号。父内连接的二值化预测为跨父连接提供上下文。图感知父特征提取器融合局部几何、父连通性与全局形状。粗层使用专用权重，细层共享权重。残差边与最细层选面载荷完成重建。
AI.result: 在 8 个 MPEG V-DMC 测试序列的 256 帧上，OctMesh 无损恢复最细层顶点坐标、边与无向面集合，平均每面 7.033 比特，比 V-Mesh 低 12.8%。同一层级表示支持 9 级渐进式顶点与边细化。
AI.conclusion: OctMesh 通过共享八叉树层级与分组式连通性预测，实现了高效的联合几何-连通性学习式无损网格压缩，并提供渐进细化能力。

title: A Geometric-Transformation Feature-Adaptive Manifold Restoration Method for Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation of Remote Sensing Images
summary: The semantic information of objects in remote sensing images is typically invariant to geometric transformations from the dihedral group D4. However, SAM3-based open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) methods often exhibit inconsistent responses to different geometric transformations. To exploit this property and improve the stability of OVSS for remote sensing images, we propose a feature-adaptive manifold repair method based on dihedral-group geometric transformations. First, we introduce multi-scale harmonic-guided D4 view selection (MH-D4VS) to select complementary candidate views from a set of geometrically transformed views. Next, we propose original-view-anchored adaptive manifold repair (OAMR), which uses the original view as an anchor and reliable cross-view information to selectively repair locally unreliable visual features. Finally, we develop pixel decoder test-time adaptation (PD-TTA) for SAM3, which fine-tunes only the parameters of the GroupNorm layers online during inference, thereby enhancing the model's ability to adapt to sample-level distribution shifts. Experimental results show that the proposed method achieves an average mIoU of 55.6% across eight remote sensing semantic segmentation benchmarks and delivers consistent performance improvements under different SAM3-based inference frameworks.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对SAM3开放词汇语义分割在遥感图像中对D4几何变换响应不一致的问题，提出基于二面体群变换的特征自适应流形修复方法，包含MH-D4VS视图选择、OAMR流形修复和PD-TTA测试时适应三个模块。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像中目标的语义信息理论上对二面体群D4的几何变换应保持不变，但基于SAM3的开放词汇语义分割方法对不同几何变换的响应往往不一致，导致分割稳定性不足。论文旨在利用这一等变性性质，提升遥感图像OVSS的稳定性。
AI.method: 方法含三个组件：(1) 多尺度谐波引导的D4视图选择（MH-D4VS），从一组几何变换视图中挑选互补的候选视图；(2) 以原视图为锚的适应流形修复（OAMR），利用原视图作为锚点并借助可靠的跨视图信息，选择性地修复局部不可靠的视觉特征；(3) 面向SAM3的像素解码器测试时适应（PD-TTA），在推理时仅在线微调GroupNorm层参数，以增强模型对样本级分布偏移的适应能力。
AI.result: 在八个遥感语义分割基准上平均mIoU达到55.6%，并在不同的SAM3推理框架下均取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入D4几何变换先验、跨视图流形修复与轻量测试时适应，可有效缓解SAM3-based OVSS对几何变换响应不一致的问题，稳定提升遥感图像开放词汇语义分割性能。

title: Rethinking Long-Video Efficiency: A Joint Allocation Perspective on Frames, Pixels, and Front-End Latency
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/lohi
summary: Efficient long-video understanding with vision-language models (VLMs) is often framed as selecting informative frames or visual tokens at a fixed native resolution. We show that per-frame resolution can instead be traded for denser temporal coverage, while front-end decoding latency depends on the size of the candidate pool rather than the final token budget. An empirical study across multiple VLMs and long-video benchmarks yields three findings: dense low-resolution sampling outperforms sparse native-resolution sampling at matched token budgets; resolution-sensitive tasks benefit from selected high-resolution frames; and front-end decoding dominates wall time for hour-long videos. Motivated by these findings, we introduce LoHi, a training-free, single-pass framework that combines a dense low-resolution video stream with sparse high-resolution image frames through the VLM's native video and image pathways. LoHi-Anchor selects high-resolution frames using codec I-frame metadata, while LoHi-SemDiv uses query relevance and visual diversity over CLIP features. Across three long-video benchmarks, LoHi improves average accuracy by 10.6 percentage points over the native-resolution baseline at a matched token budget and by 5.2 percentage points over the strongest prior efficiency method. It also reduces front-end decoding latency by up to 7x on hour-long videos. Project page: https://sixundong.com/projects/lohi

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LoHi框架，通过以分辨率换时间密度，将密集低分辨率视频流与稀疏高分辨率帧相结合，在匹配token预算下显著提升长视频理解精度并降低前端解码延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有高效长视频理解方法多在固定原生分辨率下选择信息帧或视觉token，忽略了逐帧分辨率与时间覆盖密度之间的权衡，也忽视了前端解码延迟对整体墙钟时间的主导影响。论文希望通过实证研究揭示这一权衡关系，并据此设计更高效的框架。
AI.method: 论文首先跨多个VLM与长视频基准进行实证研究，得出三点结论：匹配token预算下密集低分辨率采样优于稀疏原生分辨率采样；分辨率敏感任务受益于精选高分辨率帧；前端解码主导小时级视频的墙钟时间。基于此提出LoHi——一种免训练、单遍框架，通过VLM原生的视频与图像通路，将密集低分辨率视频流与稀疏高分辨率图像帧结合。其中LoHi-Anchor利用编解码器I帧元数据选择高分辨率帧，LoHi-SemDiv则基于CLIP特征的查询相关性与视觉多样性进行选择。
AI.result: 在三个长视频基准上，LoHi在匹配token预算下相较原生分辨率基线平均准确率提升10.6个百分点，相较最强先有效率方法提升5.2个百分点；在小时级视频上前端解码延迟最多降低7倍。
AI.conclusion: 以分辨率换取更密集时间覆盖、并利用前端解码瓶颈优化候选池规模，是提升长视频VLM理解效率与精度的有效范式，LoHi以免训练单遍方式验证了该思路的可行性与显著收益。

title: Trust the View That Sees the Target: Mining Cross-View Conflicts for Reliability-Gated Disaster Damage Assessment
comment: 4 pages, 3 figures; Accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 5th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Workshop on Searching and Mining Large Collections of Geospatial Data (GeoSearch '26), held November 3-6, 2026, in Riverside, California, USA
summary: After a disaster, building damage is assessed from overhead tiles and ground-level photographs, and most methods fuse the two views symmetrically, trusting both equally for every building. This paper focuses on the samples where that assumption fails: the conflict cases, on which two independently trained single-view models disagree. We mine such cases from three paired collections (inspection photographs from the 2025 Eaton wildfire and street-view panoramas from Hurricanes Ian and Milton, each matched to very-high-resolution overhead tiles), where they make up 10-33% of the data. On these samples an oracle that simply trusts the correct view beats every fusion method we tested by 0.37-0.41 accuracy, and the gap survives longer training, calibration, and backbone changes. We recover part of it with a visibility-conditioned reliability gate: a linear model that decides which view to trust from building-visibility features, calibrated per-view confidences, and the disagreement itself. On the wildfire data the gate is the only method that significantly beats calibrated probability averaging (+0.051 on conflicts, p=0.0001) and end-to-end fusion (+0.072, p<10^-4); on the panoramic datasets it matches them. A controlled field-of-view experiment explains why: cropping panoramas toward the building doubles the benefit of fusion, whereas random crops of the same size do not. Finally, the spatial density of conflicts predicts tile-level damage without labels (Spearman r=0.615, p=0.001). Mining conflicts turns "does fusion help?" into "which view should be trusted, where, and why?".

AI.tldr: 该论文关注灾后建筑损毁评估中双视角融合的"冲突样本"（单视角模型判断不一致的样本，占10-33%），提出可见性条件可靠性门控方法，发现理想情况下信任正确视角的oracle比所有融合方法高0.37-0.41准确率。
AI.motivation: 灾后建筑损毁评估通常融合俯视航拍瓦片与地面/街景照片两种视角，现有方法大多对称融合，对每栋建筑同等信任两个视角。但这一假设在部分样本上失效（即两视角判断冲突），需要研究在这些冲突样本上"哪种视角应被信任、在何处信任、为何信任"。
AI.method: 从三个配对数据集（2025年Eaton野火的巡检照片、飓风Ian和Milton的街景全景图，各配以超高分辨率俯视瓦片）中挖掘冲突样本。提出可见性条件可靠性门控：一个线性模型，依据建筑可见性特征、各视角校准后的置信度以及视角间分歧本身来决定信任哪个视角。并开展受控视场角（FOV）实验加以验证。
AI.result: 冲突样本占数据的10-33%。简单信任正确视角的oracle比所有测试过的融合方法准确率高0.37-0.41，且该差距在更长训练、校准与骨干网络更换后依然存在。所提门控在野火数据上是唯一显著优于校准概率平均（+0.051，p=0.0001）和端到端融合（+0.072，p<10^-4）的方法；在全景数据集上与它们持平。FOV实验表明，将全景朝建筑裁剪可使融合收益翻倍，而随机裁剪无此效应。冲突的空间密度可在无标签情况下预测瓦片级损毁（Spearman r=0.615，p=0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 挖掘冲突样本将"融合是否有用"这一问题转化为"应信任哪个视角、在何处、以及为什么信任"，揭示对称融合假设的局限，并提出可见性条件门控作为部分弥补该差距的有效方案。

title: Synthetic-to-Real ViT-Based Pose Estimation of a Noncooperative UAV
summary: Remote pose estimation of noncooperative Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) from imagery is critical, as they cannot be influenced or instrumented in advance. Deep-learning-based approaches offer a promising solution; however, their development is constrained by the cost and difficulty of acquiring large-scale real-world datasets with accurate pose labels. Synthetic imagery provides an alternative, but models trained on synthetic data must overcome the synthetic-to-real domain gap to generalize to real-world imagery. This work investigates the inherent synthetic-to-real generalization capability of a Vision Transformer (ViT)-based model for monocular UAV pose estimation. The proposed approach employs a self-supervised DINOv2 backbone and is trained exclusively on labeled synthetic imagery while being evaluated on labeled real-world imagery. Pose ambiguity-aware strategies are incorporated during training and inference to address ambiguities arising from the projection of a three-dimensional target onto a two-dimensional image plane and from target symmetries. An $α$-$β$ filter is further integrated during inference to improve pose estimations. To assess the model under operational requirements, it is evaluated in terms of Mean Angular Error (MAE) and inference time, both before and after filtering, using a real-world dataset containing 77,077 labeled UAV images. Before filtering, the model achieves an MAE of $19.18^{\circ}$ and an inference time of $13.25$ ms, whereas after filtering, these values are $8.74^{\circ}$ and $13.42$ ms, respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究基于ViT的单目无人机位姿估计模型在合成数据训练、真实数据测试下的可迁移性，通过自监督DINOv2骨干、位姿歧义处理及α-β滤波，将平均角度误差从19.18°降至8.74°，推理时间约13.4 ms。
AI.motivation: 非合作无人机无法被预先改装或布设传感器，只能依赖图像进行远程位姿估计。深度学习方法虽具潜力，但获取大规模带精确位姿标签的真实数据集成本高、难度大；合成图像可替代，却需跨越合成到真实的域差异鸿沟，因此有必要考察模型的固有泛化能力。
AI.method: 采用基于自监督DINOv2骨干的Vision Transformer模型，仅在带标签的合成图像上训练，在带标签的真实图像上评估。训练与推理阶段引入位姿歧义感知策略，应对三维目标投影到二维图像平面及目标对称性导致的歧义；推理阶段额外集成α-β滤波器以改善位姿估计。
AI.result: 在包含77,077张带标签无人机图像的真实数据集上评估。滤波前平均角度误差（MAE）为19.18°，推理时间13.25 ms；滤波后MAE降至8.74°，推理时间13.42 ms。
AI.conclusion: ViT-based模型在仅用合成数据训练时具备一定的合成到真实泛化能力，结合位姿歧义感知策略与α-β滤波可显著降低角度误差且几乎不增加推理开销，满足实时性要求。

title: A differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3D Gaussian Splatting-SPH model for forward simulation and inverse analysis in solid mechanics
summary: Recent advances in generative world models have increased interest in digital models that reproduce both the appearance of real objects and their response to physical interaction. Three-dimensional reconstruction techniques, including 3D Gaussian Splatting, capture detailed surface geometry and appearance from images and videos. However, extending these representations beyond plausible animation to mechanically interpretable models for constitutive behavior, boundary conditions, and inverse parameter identification remains less explored. In this work, a differentiable Lagrangian-coupled 3DGS-smoothed particle hydrodynamics (SPH) model is proposed for forward simulation and inverse analysis of deformable solids. The observed object is first reconstructed from multi-view calibrated visual dataset as a 3DGS rendering model. An envelope-based procedure then generates an independent SPH support for the solid-mechanics model, avoiding the direct use of rendering primitives as mechanical particles. A reference-configuration Lagrangian transfer maps SPH deformation to Gaussian positions and covariances, thereby coupling the physical model and the image observation model while preserving a differentiable computational path. The SPH formulation supports linear elastic, hyperelastic, and Kelvin--Voigt viscoelastic responses, together with fixed, free, and Robin-type boundary conditions. Numerical studies validate the SPH response against finite-element results, assess accuracy and efficiency against a conventional model using Gaussian centers as surface SPH particles, and demonstrate forward simulations on beam, bridge, and liver-shaped examples. Inverse analyses further estimate constitutive and boundary parameters from rendered deformation observations, including noisy cases, demonstrating the feasibility of the proposed model for mechanics-based parameter identification from image data.

AI.tldr: 提出一种可微的拉格朗日耦合3DGS-SPH模型，用于可变形固体的正向仿真与逆向分析，实现从图像观测中进行力学参数识别。
AI.motivation: 生成式世界模型与3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）虽能从图像/视频重建几何与外观，但其表示多停留于合理动画层面，尚缺乏可进行本构行为、边界条件与逆参数识别的力学可解释模型。
AI.method: 先从多视角标定视觉数据集重建3DGS渲染模型；采用基于包络的流程生成独立的SPH力学支撑，避免直接以渲染基元作为力学粒子；通过参考构型拉格朗日传递将SPH变形映射到高斯位置与协方差，耦合物理模型与图像观测模型并保持可微计算路径。SPH格式支持线弹性、超弹性与Kelvin-Voigt黏弹性响应，以及固定、自由与Robin型边界条件。
AI.result: 数值研究以有限元结果验证SPH响应，并与以高斯中心作为表面SPH粒子的传统模型对比精度与效率；在梁、桥与肝脏形状算例上完成正向仿真；逆向分析从渲染变形观测（含噪声情形）估计本构与边界参数。
AI.conclusion: 该可微3DGS-SPH耦合模型证明了从图像数据进行基于力学的参数识别的可行性，为可变形固体的正向仿真与逆向分析提供统一框架。

title: Any-scale Object Detection using Arbitrary-scaled Images
summary: This paper proposes any-scale object detection using arbitrary-scale super-resolution for continuously rescaling object images, while general multi-scale object detection uses discretely rescaled appearance representations. However, a naive usage of super-resolution produces many false-positive detections if many super-resolution images are independently fed into an object detector. Our method suppresses these false positives by predicting scale proposal maps, each of which represents a set of pixels appropriate for each super-resolution scale.

AI.tldr: 提出任意尺度目标检测方法，利用任意尺度超分辨率连续缩放目标图像，并通过尺度建议图预测抑制超分辨率带来的误检。
AI.motivation: 通用多尺度目标检测仅使用离散缩放的外观表征，尺度覆盖有限；而直接引入超分辨率虽可实现连续尺度，却会因多张超分图像独立送入检测器而产生大量误检。
AI.method: 采用任意尺度超分辨率对手目标图像进行连续重缩放，并预测尺度建议图（scale proposal maps），每张图指示适合对应超分尺度的像素集合，以此抑制误检。
AI.result: 通过尺度建议图对超分尺度进行筛选，有效抑制了朴素使用超分辨率所导致的误检问题。
AI.conclusion: 尺度建议图是实现任意尺度目标检测、平衡连续尺度表征与检测精度的关键机制。

title: LoCoSplat: Real-Time Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting with Minimal 3D Reasoning
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) increasingly aggregates multi-view evidence with heavy learned 3D networks. We propose LoCoSplat (Local-Context Splatting), motivated by the observation that a Gaussian is a local primitive: once depth is predicted, what the 3D stage must add (scale, rotation, opacity) depends on the point cloud around each anchor, and a fixed local average of that neighbourhood is enough to supply it, no heavy network required. LoCoSplat realises exactly this average: it splats a 16-d linear projection of the point features into a fine and a coarse grid and reads both back at each anchor with a 0.14M-parameter pointwise MLP; with no learned 3D network and no dynamic sparse computation, its whole encoder runs as one fp16 CUDA graph. On RealEstate10K, LoCoSplat outperforms every prior feed-forward method on PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS at 6, 12, and 24 views, with a margin that widens as views densify (+3.3 PSNR over VolSplat, the prior voxel-aligned state of the art, at 24 views) and grows further under zero-shot transfer to ACID and fine-tuning on ScanNet. It reconstructs a 6-view scene in 33 ms on one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 GPU, the fastest of seven feed-forward methods and $4.2\times$ faster than the previous state of the art, trains $2.7\times$ faster ($5.9\times$ at 24 views), and uses $6.7\times$ less inference memory.

AI.tldr: 提出 LoCoSplat（局部上下文 Splatting），利用高斯是局部基元的特性，用固定局部平均替代重型学习式 3D 网络，实现高效前馈 3DGS。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈 3DGS 方法依赖重型学习式 3D 网络聚合多视角证据，计算与内存开销大。作者观察到高斯本质是局部基元：一旦预测出深度，3D 阶段需补充的尺度、旋转、不透明度仅依赖每个锚点周围的点云，固定的局部平均即可提供，无需重型网络。
AI.method: LoCoSplat 将点特征的 16 维线性投影 splat 到细网格与粗网格，并在每个锚点处同时读取两者，送入仅 0.14M 参数的点卷积 MLP。整个编码器不含学习的 3D 网络与动态稀疏计算，可作为单个 fp16 CUDA 图运行。
AI.result: 在 RealEstate10K 上，于 6/12/24 视角设置下在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 三项指标均超越所有先前前馈方法，且优势随视角加密而扩大（24 视角时相较体素对齐 SOTA VolSplat 提升 +3.3 PSNR）；零样本迁移至 ACID 及在 ScanNet 微调后优势进一步提升。单张 NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 上重建 6 视角场景仅需 33 ms，为七种前馈方法中最快，较此前 SOTA 快 4.2 倍，训练快 2.7 倍（24 视角时 5.9 倍），推理内存减少 6.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将高斯视为局部基元并用固定局部上下文平均替代重型 3D 网络，LoCoSplat 在精度、速度与内存上全面优于现有前馈 3DGS 方法，验证了轻量化局部聚合范式的有效性。

title: TRIM-ReID: Duplication-Aware Token Reduction and Modality-Aligned Interaction for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification
summary: Multi-modal object re-identification exploits complementary RGB, near-infrared (NIR), and thermal-infrared (TIR) observations to retrieve target objects. However, existing methods commonly employ visual encoders optimized for global image-text alignment and select tokens using learned importance scores. Such designs fail to preserve fine-grained identity cues or explicitly account for token redundancy, resulting in underrepresented local evidence and duplicated tokens that lead to noisy and costly cross-modal interaction. To address this gap, we propose TRIM-ReID, a compact framework that unifies dense feature extraction, intra-modal token reduction, and inter-modal aligned interaction. Specifically, semantically rich and spatially coherent patch features are extracted by Dense Identity Representation (DIR), which leverages DINOv3 to preserve fine-grained identity information. We then introduce Token Diversity Mining (TDM) to identify complementary local evidence and construct compact modality-specific token sets by suppressing repetitive patches while preserving informative diversity. Retained tokens are subsequently fused by Modal Relational Interaction (MRI) to enable effective information exchange across modalities, while a triangular alignment loss explicitly regularizes their joint relationships to maintain cross-modal semantic consistency under independent token selection. Extensive experiments on RGBNT201, RGBNT100, and MSVR310 demonstrate that TRIM-ReID achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 提出TRIM-ReID，用DINOv3密集特征提取+令牌多样性挖掘+模态关系交互，实现多模态目标重识别的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态重识别方法使用面向全局图文对齐的视觉编码器，并依赖学习的重要性分数选择令牌，无法保留细粒度身份线索、未显式处理令牌冗余，导致局部证据不足和令牌重复，进而造成跨模态交互噪声大、开销高。
AI.method: TRIM-ReID统一了密集特征提取、模态内令牌约简与模态间对齐交互：Dense Identity Representation(DIR)基于DINOv3提取语义丰富、空间连贯的patch特征；Token Diversity Mining(TDM)抑制重复patch、保留信息多样性以构建紧凑的模态专属令牌集；Modal Relational Interaction(MRI)融合保留令牌实现跨模态信息交换；并使用三角对齐损失显式正则化联合关系，在独立令牌选择下保持跨模态语义一致性。
AI.result: 在RGBNT201、RGBNT100和MSVR310数据集上的大量实验表明，TRIM-ReID达到了当前最优（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: TRIM-ReID通过密集身份表示、令牌多样性挖掘与模态关系交互的紧凑框架，有效解决了细粒度身份线索丢失与令牌冗余问题，提升了多模态目标重识别的精度与效率。

title: Beyond Plausibility: Verifiable Fine-Grained Image Editing on Structured Assets
summary: Fine-grained image editing requires more than producing a visually plausible result: an editor must execute the requested attribute change precisely while leaving everything else intact. However, existing benchmarks leave a critical gap between realism and verifiability: benchmarks built on realistic images typically rely on human or vision--language model judgments, while deterministic evaluation has largely focused on synthetic shape canvases, with application-oriented extensions primarily limited to charts. This makes it difficult to determine precisely how much of a requested edit was executed, where unintended changes occurred, and whether small differences between models reflect genuine editing capability or evaluator uncertainty. To bridge this gap, we present VeriEdit-Bench, a benchmark for fine-grained, instruction-faithful image editing across realistic structured assets with deterministic, four-axis evaluation. Its 1,740 cases are compiled from the source code of 153 Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) graphics, charts, web interfaces, and presentation slides. Controlled source-code edits preserve the original visual context while yielding exact target images, pixel-level edit masks, and explicit edit specifications, enabling reproducible scoring along four axes: edit fidelity, preservation, localization, and magnitude. Evaluating eleven editors, we find that even the strongest model remains far from full credit; rankings for the same recoloring operation reverse between charts and SVG graphics; and outputs with similar pixel-accuracy profiles can still differ substantially in localization and change magnitude. This decomposition yields graded, verifiable feedback and exposes model-specific capability and failure profiles that holistic scores or evaluator-dependent judgments may obscure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VeriEdit-Bench，一个基于 SVG 源码的细粒度图像编辑基准，包含 1740 个案例，支持确定性四轴评估（编辑保真度、保留性、定位、幅度），揭示现有评估在真实性与可验证性之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 细粒度图像编辑不仅要求视觉合理，更要求精确执行指定属性修改且不改变其他内容。然而现有基准存在真实性与可验证性的割裂：基于真实图像的基准依赖人工或 VLM 主观判断，而确定性评估多局限于合成图形画布，应用导向扩展基本限于图表。这导致难以精确判定编辑完成程度、意外修改位置，以及模型间差异源于能力还是评估不确定性。
AI.method: 构建 VeriEdit-Bench：从 153 个 SVG 图形（涵盖图形、图表、网页界面、演示幻灯片）的源代码编译出 1740 个案例。通过受控的源码编辑，在保留原始视觉上下文的同时生成精确目标图像、像素级编辑掩码和显式编辑规范，从而沿四个维度进行可复现评分：编辑保真度、保留性、定位和幅度。
AI.result: 评估了 11 个编辑模型：即使最强模型也远未达到满分；同一重着色操作在图表与 SVG 图形之间的排名发生反转；像素精度相似的输出在定位和变化幅度上仍可能差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 该四轴分解提供分级、可验证的反馈，揭示被整体分数或依赖评估者判断所掩盖的模型特定能力与失败模式，弥合了真实性与可验证性之间的鸿沟。

title: Detecting Defects that Matter: An Application-Driven Benchmark for Anomaly Detection in Manufacturing and Retail Logistics (VAND 4.0 Challenge)
summary: Existing Anomaly Detection benchmarks are saturated and often unrealistic. As part of the VAND 4.0 Challenge, we introduce a hidden-test, application-driven benchmark across two deployment-critical domains: industrial manufacturing and retail logistics. In the Industrial Track (MVTec AD 2), the results reveal that unsupervised anomaly segmentation remains challenging: the best regular-setting method achieves only ~57\% pixel-level $SegF_1$, indicating substantial room for improvement. Zero-shot approaches trail by ~15 $SegF_1$ points, confirming that task-specific training on normal data remains essential for precise defect localization. Robustness to distribution shifts remains a key open challenge and DINOv3-backbones clearly dominate this track. In the Retail Track (Kaputt 2), the results reveal that (1) supervised defect detection is approaching saturation for common defect types; (2) the best off-the-shelf VLM approach trails specialized models by ~28 AP, confirming that currently VLMs cannot replace fine-tuned detectors, (3) reference images did not prove helpful for top-performing approaches. Performance collapses on rare defects (spillage ~53 AP, missing units ~27 AP), where the supervised ceiling is bounded by data availability. To drive future progress in this domain, we provide a new low-prevalence retail AD dataset (Kaputt-Rare). Across both tracks, computational efficiency is assessed as a first-class metric combining performance, throughput, memory, and power consumption. We introduce a novel metric for measuring efficiency and reveal that that top-performing methods rely on heavy architectures while efficiency is largely neglected. Overall, we conclude that the community needs (a) more efficiency-aware method development, and (b) true anomaly detection approaches for rare defects and shifting conditions. https://sites.google.com/view/vand4-cvpr2026/challenge

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 VAND 4.0 挑战赛的应用驱动隐藏测试基准，覆盖工业制造（MVTec AD 2）与零售物流（Kaputt 2）两大领域，并评估性能、吞吐、内存与功耗。结果显示无监督缺陷分割仍具挑战（最佳约57% SegF1），VLM 无法替代微调检测器（差约28 AP），稀有缺陷性能显著崩塌，且高效方法普遍被忽视。
AI.motivation: 现有异常检测（AD）基准已趋于饱和且不贴近真实场景，缺乏应用驱动、隐藏测试的评测，且未将计算效率作为核心指标，导致方法发展与实际部署需求脱节。
