AI.method: 作为 VAND 4.0 挑战赛的一部分，构建跨工业制造（MVTec AD 2）与零售物流（Kaputt 2）两个部署关键领域的隐藏测试基准；在常规、零样本、分布偏移等设置下评测无监督异常分割与监督缺陷检测，并纳入现成 VLM 方法与参考图像策略；提出衡量效率的新指标，综合性能、吞吐、内存与功耗；同时发布低发生率零售异常检测数据集 Kaputt-Rare。
AI.result: 工业赛道最佳常规方法仅达约57%像素级 SegF1，零样本方法落后约15点，DINOv3 骨干明显占优，分布偏移鲁棒性仍为关键挑战；零售赛道常见缺陷的监督检测接近饱和，最佳现成 VLM 落后专用模型约28 AP，参考图像对顶尖方法无帮助，稀有缺陷性能崩塌（spillage 约53 AP、missing units 约27 AP）；效率方面顶尖方法依赖重型架构，效率被普遍忽视。
AI.conclusion: 社区需要（a）更具效率意识的方法开发，以及（b）面向稀有缺陷与条件漂移的真正异常检测方法。

title: AgroGround: Multi-Granularity Grounded Recognition in Agriculture
summary: Agricultural visual models are typically evaluated for either recognition or localization, but reliable diagnosis requires identifying what is present and localizing the evidence. Agricultural visual question answering (VQA) datasets carry rich semantic labels but rarely link them to image regions, and adding such annotations by hand is costly at scale. We introduce AgroGround, a large-scale dataset for grounded agricultural recognition: identifying plant diseases and other agricultural targets and localizing their image regions. An automated pipeline converts the labels of eight agricultural VQA datasets into annotations for disease lesions and whole objects, producing 794,850 instruction examples. Healthy images provide negative supervision for disease queries, teaching the model to return empty predictions. We fine-tune a shared vision-language model on known-target grounding instructions combined with instructions requiring both recognition and localization. We evaluate predicted identities, regions, joint correctness, and healthy-image abstention on 1,480 human-verified images disjoint from all training data. Grounding-only fine-tuning reduces recognition accuracy from 51.8\% to 29.1\%, while adding recognition-and-localization instructions raises it to 72.6\%. With images and annotations held fixed, combining the two formats raises joint accuracy from 19.2\% to 43.3\% at comparable grounding. Healthy negatives raise abstention on healthy images to 95.0\%, and reinforcement learning improves lesion-level grounding. The resulting 2B model exceeds its annotation teacher in grounding F1 on our benchmark and on the external PlantSeg test set. AgroGround establishes a benchmark for grounded agricultural recognition, measuring joint correctness of identity and localization along with abstention on healthy images. The code is available at https://github.com/AB-Abdulla/AgroGround.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了 AgroGround，一个大规模农业视觉定位识别数据集，通过自动化流程将8个农业VQA数据集的标签转化为病害病斑和整体目标的定位标注，共794,850条指令样本。实验表明，仅定位微调会降低识别准确率，而结合识别与定位指令可显著提升联合准确率，并引入健康图像负监督实现弃权。
AI.motivation: 农业视觉模型通常仅针对识别或定位单一任务评估，但可靠诊断需要同时确定"存在什么"并定位其证据区域。现有农业VQA数据集虽含丰富语义标签，却很少与图像区域关联，而人工标注此类区域在大规模上成本高昂。因此需要构建一个兼顾识别与定位的农业视觉定位识别基准。
AI.method: 提出自动化流程，将8个农业VQA数据集的标签转换为疾病病斑和整体目标的定位标注，生成794,850条指令样本，其中健康图像为疾病查询提供负监督。在共享视觉语言模型上联合微调已知目标定位指令和兼具识别与定位的指令，并在1,480张人工验证、与训练数据无交集的图像上评估预测身份、区域、联合正确性及健康图像弃权。
AI.result: 仅定位微调使识别准确率从51.8%降至29.1%；加入识别与定位指令后提升至72.6%。在图像与标注固定条件下，两种格式结合使联合准确率从19.2%提升至43.3%，同时保持相当的定位性能。健康负样本使健康图像弃权率提升至95.0%，强化学习进一步改善病斑级定位。所得2B模型在自建基准和外部PlantSeg测试集上的定位F1均超过其标注教师模型。
AI.conclusion: AgroGround 建立了一个面向农业视觉定位识别的基准，可同时衡量身份与定位的联合正确性以及健康图像上的弃权能力，验证了识别与定位联合训练及负监督的有效性。

title: Multi-Crop Leaf Disease Recognition: A Unified Benchmark and Cross-Region Study
summary: Deep learning models for crop leaf disease recognition routinely report near-perfect accuracy yet are typically trained and evaluated on a single dataset collected under controlled laboratory conditions, leaving their behavior under realistic cross-region domain shift poorly understood. We introduce MLD (Multi-crop Leaf Disease) dataset, a unified multi-region benchmark that combines six public crop-disease datasets from the USA, Asia, and Africa into a shared hierarchical taxonomy spanning 18 crops, 56 crop-disease classes (including one healthy class per crop) making 167,427 images. We define standardized single-source and pooled multi-source evaluation protocols that explicitly probe cross-region generalization. We also investigate whether exploiting the inherent crop-to-disease dependency via a hierarchical formulation (HiLeaD) that conditions disease prediction on the predicted crop improves recognition under cross-region shift. Under the HiLeaD, the model trained on PlantVillage achieves 99.07% in-domain disease F1 but collapses to 12.88% when tested on PlantDoc, exposing a severe cross-region domain gap. The model trained on the pooled MLD dataset partly recovers cross-region disease F1 from 12.88% to 39.64% on PlantDoc (HiLeaD), achieving a 26.76 percentage point improvement. The hierarchical formulation provides a consistent additional gain, ranging from 1.71 to 4.88 percentage points in disease F1 over the flat baseline under the MLD dataset indicating that progress in this area is currently limited more by data coverage and diversity than by model design.

AI.tldr: 该文提出跨区域多作物叶片病害基准MLD（18作物、56类、167,427张图），定义单源与多源池化评估协议，并检验层级建模HiLeaD；结果发现跨区域域偏移导致严重性能崩溃，多源数据比模型设计更关键。
AI.motivation: 现有作物叶片病害识别深度学习模型虽在单数据集上报告近乎完美的准确率，但训练与评估多局限于受控实验室条件下的单一数据源，其在真实跨区域域偏移下的表现尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建MLD统一多区域基准，整合来自美国、亚洲和非洲的六个公开作物病害数据集，纳入统一层级分类体系（18种作物、56个作物-病害类别，每作物含一个健康类，共167,427张图像）；定义标准化的单源与多源池化评估协议以显式检验跨区域泛化；并提出层级公式HiLeaD，将病害预测条件于预测出的作物类别，以利用作物-病害的固有依赖关系。
AI.result: 在HiLeaD下，基于PlantVillage训练的模型域内病害F1达99.07%，但在PlantDoc上骤降至12.88%，暴露严重跨区域域差距；基于池化MLD训练的模型在PlantDoc上把跨区域病害F1从12.88%恢复到39.64%，提升26.76个百分点；层级公式在MLD上相对扁平基线持续带来1.71至4.88个百分点的病害F1增益。
AI.conclusion: 当前该领域进展更多受限于数据覆盖度与多样性，而非模型设计；多源数据整合可显著缓解跨区域域偏移，层级建模提供稳定但有限的额外增益。

title: RPFQ-ViT: Rotated Phase-Frame Quantization for Extremely Low-Bit Weights in Vision Transformers
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026. Current preprint version; camera-ready revision forthcoming
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) achieve strong performance on image recognition and mobile vision applications, but their high-dimensional linear projections and attention computations still impose substantial storage and inference costs. Extremely low-bit quantization is a promising solution, yet ViTs often suffer severe accuracy degradation because conventional real-valued scalar codebooks are poorly matched to the directional geometry of Transformer projections. We present RPFQ-ViT, a Rotated Phase-Frame Quantization method that quantizes paired channels in two-dimensional phase planes, enabling low-bit codes to better preserve projection directions while recovering magnitude with lightweight scaling. RPFQ-ViT serves as a drop-in QAT replacement for nn.Linear and does not modify the standard real-valued attention, normalization, or activation computation graph. On ImageNet-1K, RPFQ-ViT-B/16 reaches 79.33% Top-1 / 94.48% Top-5 under W2/A4, Swin-T reaches 79.30% Top-1 / 94.79% Top-5 under W2/A8, and DeiT-S reaches 77.41% Top-1 / 93.11% Top-5 under W2/A8. Ablations, phase-geometry analysis, and direction-preservation metrics show that channel pairing, learnable rotation, phase-anchor learning, and residual phase refinement each improve quantization quality. We further deploy RPFQ-ViT image-classification models on native iOS and Android runtime stacks; with 2-bit packed weights, model size shrinks by roughly $5.4$-$7.1\times$ relative to FP32 and end-to-end on-device latency drops by $1.4$-$1.6\times$. All ImageNet results trained in our codebase use a matched 300-epoch recipe and are reported as mean accuracies over three independent runs. These results show that RPFQ-ViT provides a favorable trade-off among accuracy, compression, and practical mobile deployment for extremely low-bit ViTs.

AI.tldr: RPFQ-ViT：面向极低位ViT的旋转相位框架量化方法，在二维相位平面对成对通道量化，作为nn.Linear的QAT直接替换，兼顾精度、压缩与移动端部署。
AI.motivation: ViT虽在图像识别与移动视觉任务上表现优异，但高维线性投影与注意力计算带来大量存储与推理开销。极低位量化是有前景的解决途径，但传统实值标量码本与Transformer投影的方向性几何不匹配，导致严重精度下降。
AI.method: 提出RPFQ-ViT（Rotated Phase-Frame Quantization）：在二维相位平面对成对通道进行量化，使低位码更好地保持投影方向，并通过轻量缩放恢复幅度。方法作为nn.Linear的QAT直接替换，不改变标准实值注意力、归一化与激活计算图。关键组件包括通道配对、可学习旋转、相位锚点学习与残差相位细化。
AI.result: ImageNet-1K上：ViT-B/16在W2/A4达79.33% Top-1/94.48% Top-5；Swin-T在W2/A8达79.30% Top-1/94.79% Top-5；DeiT-S在W2/A8达77.41% Top-1/93.11% Top-5。消融、相位几何分析与方向保持指标显示各组件均提升量化质量。原生iOS与Android部署中，2-bit打包权重使模型尺寸缩小约5.4–7.1倍，端到端设备延迟降低1.4–1.6倍。结果均为匹配300轮配方、三次独立运行的均值。
AI.conclusion: RPFQ-ViT在精度、压缩与移动端实际部署之间提供了有利的权衡，适用于极低位ViT场景。

title: Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to convert medical images into diagnostic texts to assist in clinical decision-making and alleviate the workload of physicians. Although existing methods have made extensive progress in cross-modal interaction and the incorporation of external priors, the distribution shift of underlying representations and the undifferentiated rigid coupling of heterogeneous information cause weak visual abnormality cues to be easily diluted by massive text priors and generation inertia during decoding. To overcome this bottleneck, inspired by cognitive science, we propose a novel two-stage Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing (HSA-HER) framework. First, the model introduces an explicit homogeneous distribution constraint in the underlying latent space to effectively eliminate the cross-modal distribution shift between visual and textual features, thereby extracting purified visual features as semantic anchors that accurately align with diseases. Second, for heterogeneous clinical evidence composed of visual features, local entities, and global retrievals, we design a hierarchical expert routing mechanism guided by these disease semantic anchors. This mechanism abandons the undifferentiated rigid coupling paradigm. Specifically, it dynamically activates expert networks to perform targeted mining and semantic reconstruction on multi-source evidence, and adaptively allocates fusion weights. Extensive experiments on three mainstream benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSA-HER achieves state-of-the-art performance, accurately depicting complex imaging details and key diagnostic information.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出两阶段HSA-HER框架，通过同质语义对齐消除跨模态分布偏移，并以疾病语义锚点引导分层专家路由，实现异构临床证据的动态融合，在三个主流基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有放射报告生成方法在跨模态交互与外部先验引入上已有进展，但仍存在两个瓶颈：底层表征的分布偏移，以及异构信息的无差别刚性耦合，导致微弱的视觉异常线索在解码时容易被海量文本先验和生成惯性稀释。
AI.method: 受认知科学启发，提出两阶段HSA-HER框架。第一阶段在底层潜空间引入显式同质分布约束，消除视觉与文本特征间的跨模态分布偏移，提取纯净视觉特征作为与疾病精确对齐的语义锚点。第二阶段针对由视觉特征、局部实体和全局检索构成的异构临床证据，设计以疾病语义锚点引导的分层专家路由机制，摒弃无差别刚性耦合范式，动态激活专家网络对多源证据进行定向挖掘与语义重构，并自适应分配融合权重。
AI.result: 在三个主流基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HSA-HER取得state-of-the-art性能，能够准确刻画复杂影像细节与关键诊断信息。
AI.conclusion: 同质语义对齐与锚点引导的分层专家路由可有效缓解分布偏移与刚性耦合问题，抑制微弱视觉异常线索被文本先验稀释，为放射报告生成提供了一种有效的新范式。

title: Localization Lens for Improving Medical Vision-Language Models
comment: 10 pages, 1 figure, Medical Image Computing and Computer Assisted Intervention (MICCAI)
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in clinical tasks. However, they often struggle to understand anatomical structures and spatial positioning, which are crucial for medical reasoning. To address this, we propose a localization-aware enhancement to the Med-VLM pipeline, introducing improvements at three levels: data,architecture, and alignment. First, we introduce localization lens, a set of expert-validated representations that provide richer anatomical and positional context. However, as these representations increase input complexity, we integrate pixel shuffle within the model architecture to filter and refine representations, enhancing spatial information processing while preserving anatomical continuity. Lastly, to effectively align the localization lens representations with textual features, we incorporate decoupled contrastive loss (DCL) alongside the standard loss function. This ensures better feature discrimination and robustness, particularly in data limited medical settings. Through extensive evaluations on medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) datasets, we show that our methodology improves localization-driven performance across different Med-VLM architectures. Our analysis of localization-based questions further reveals that improvements in anatomy and spatial reasoning directly enhance the overall accuracy of Med-VQA upto 6.2%. The proposed approach is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing Med-VLM pipelines. The dataset, code, and trained models will be made publicly available at https://github.com/CVLABLUMS/localizationlens.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向医学视觉语言模型的定位感知增强方法，从数据、架构、对齐三个层面提升解剖结构与空间位置理解能力，在Med-VQA任务上最高提升6.2%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有医学视觉语言模型（Med-VLM）在临床任务中表现良好，但在理解解剖结构和空间定位方面存在不足，而这两者对医学推理至关重要。
AI.method: 在三个层面进行改进：1）数据层面引入localization lens，即一组经专家验证的表征，提供更丰富的解剖与位置上下文；2）架构层面集成pixel shuffle，用于过滤和精炼表征，在增强空间信息处理的同时保持解剖连续性；3）对齐层面引入解耦对比损失（DCL）与标准损失函数结合，提升特征判别力与鲁棒性，尤其适用于数据有限的医学场景。
AI.result: 在多个医学视觉问答（Med-VQA）数据集上的实验表明，该方法在不同Med-VLM架构上均提升了定位驱动的性能；对定位类问题的分析显示，解剖与空间推理的改进使Med-VQA整体准确率最高提升6.2%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法与模型无关，可无缝集成到现有Med-VLM流程中，并在定位相关医学推理任务上带来显著增益。所用数据集、代码与训练模型将公开。

title: EgoExo-Next:Benchmarking Vision-Language Models on Visual-Option Next-State and Cross-View Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly evaluated for egocentric and cross-view video reasoning, yet existing benchmarks largely focus on semantic event understanding, temporal relations, or correspondence between already observed views, leaving their ability to reason directly about future visual states underexplored. We introduce EgoExo-Next, a visual-option benchmark for dynamic visual-state reasoning, where models must identify how an observed action trajectory subsequently appears rather than predict only an action label or textual description. EgoExo-Next contains 2,503 human-curated four-choice questions from six public egocentric and ego--exo video sources and comprises four interconnected subtasks that evaluate egocentric next-state prediction, bidirectional ego--exo state correspondence, exocentric next-state prediction, and their composition in Ego-to-Exo Next-State. Extensive evaluation of proprietary, open-source, and spatial reasoning VLMs reveals a substantial human--model gap, with the best model achieving 43.81\% average accuracy compared with 98.55\% for humans, and the largest degradation occurring on the composed Ego-to-Exo task. These results suggest that current VLMs remain substantially limited in dynamic visual-state reasoning, particularly when temporal progression and cross-view reasoning must be composed. The benchmark is publicly available at \url{https://huggingface.co/datasets/yutongli2024/EgoExo-Next}.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EgoExo-Next基准，用于评测视觉语言模型在动态视觉状态推理（尤其是跨视角下一状态预测）上的能力，发现模型与人类存在巨大差距。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型评测基准多聚焦语义事件理解、时序关系或已观测视角间的对应关系，忽视了对未来视觉状态的直接推理能力。
AI.method: 构建EgoExo-Next视觉选项基准，包含来自6个公开第一人称及自我-他人视角视频源的2,503道人工标注四选一题目，涵盖四个相互关联的子任务：第一人称下一状态预测、双向自我-他人状态对应、第三人称下一状态预测，以及组合式的Ego-to-Exo下一状态推理。
AI.result: 对专有、开源及空间推理类视觉语言模型的广泛评测显示显著的人机差距：最佳模型平均准确率仅43.81%，而人类达98.55%；性能下降最严重的是组合式Ego-to-Exo任务。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在动态视觉状态推理方面仍存在明显局限，尤其当需要同时组合时间演进与跨视角推理时。基准已公开。

title: TAME:Topology-Aware Text-Driven Motion Editing across Heterogeneous Humanoid Skeletons
summary: Text-driven motion editing modifies an existing motion sequence according to a text instruction while preserving the content of the source motion. Existing methods are typically built for a single, fixed skeletal topology, which limits their use in animation pipelines where characters differ in joint count and skeletal hierarchy. We present Topology-Aware Motion Editor (TAME), a flow-matching transformer that edits motions on humanoid skeletons of varying topology. TAME represents motion as per-joint, per-frame tokens and models interactions among joints, across frames, and with the text instruction through skeletal, temporal, and text cross-attention layers. To make the skeletal attention follow each character's hierarchy, TAME replaces full joint attention with Topology-Constrained Skeletal Propagation (TCSP), which restricts attention to one-hop kinematic neighbors in the skeleton's adjacency matrix. We further introduce Edit-Focused Representation Alignment (EFRA), a self-distilled representation alignment strategy that aligns student features with cleaner EMA-teacher features exclusively on edit-relevant joint-time tokens, making edits faithful to the instruction. To make this setting trainable and comparable, we construct TopoMotionFix, a multi-topology extension of MotionFix with seen- and unseen-topology evaluation protocols. TAME outperforms previous methods in edit alignment and source preservation on MotionFix and reliably edits motions on unseen skeletons in TopoMotionFix.

AI.tldr: 提出拓扑感知运动编辑器TAME，用流匹配Transformer与拓扑约束注意力实现对不同骨骼拓扑人形运动的文本驱动编辑，并构建多拓扑基准TopoMotionFix。
AI.motivation: 现有文本驱动运动编辑方法通常针对单一固定骨骼拓扑，无法适应关节数量与骨骼层级不同的角色，限制了其在动画管线中的应用。
AI.method: 将运动表示为逐关节逐帧token；通过骨骼、时序与文本交叉注意力建模交互；用拓扑约束骨骼传播（TCSP）将骨骼注意力限制在邻接矩阵中的一跳运动学邻居，替代全关节注意力；引入编辑聚焦表示对齐（EFRA），仅对与编辑相关的关节-时间token做自蒸馏EMA教师对齐；构建多拓扑数据集TopoMotionFix及可见/不可见拓扑评测协议。
AI.result: 在MotionFix上，TAME在编辑对齐与源运动保持方面优于既有方法；在TopoMotionFix上可稳定地对未见过的骨骼拓扑进行运动编辑。
AI.conclusion: 通过拓扑约束注意力与编辑聚焦表示对齐，可有效实现跨骨骼拓扑的文本驱动运动编辑，并为此类任务提供了可训练、可比较的基准。

title: FASTER: Fast Adjoint Stochastic Transport for Endpoint Refinement in Reward-Guided Image Editing
summary: Reward-guided image editing at test time seeks to improve a specified reward while preserving source content and visual plausibility. Many existing approaches optimize candidates through pretrained generation processes, making repeated adjustment depend on costly large-model execution and, in some cases, backbone backpropagation. We develop a theoretical framework that jointly accounts for reward, source preservation, and pretrained-prior preferences, allowing the desired output distribution to be specified separately from the dynamics used to realize it. Based on this framework, we introduce FASTER, which trains a small network for each source and objective to perform inexpensive editing, while pretrained and reward models provide feedback on candidate outputs. By reusing each candidate and its feedback across multiple small-network updates, FASTER reduces repeated sampling and supervision queries without placing the pretrained generative backbone inside the inner optimization loop. On SD3, FASTER leads all four target metrics and several validation metrics among the evaluated methods. Compared with the evaluated baseline that optimizes controls along pretrained generation trajectories, FASTER achieves editing-time speedups of up to \({6.91\times}\) on Stable Diffusion 3 and \({24.14\times}\) on Stable Diffusion 1.5.

AI.tldr: FASTER：为每个源图与目标训练小型编辑网络，仅在外部提供奖励与先验反馈，实现无需大模型内循环的高效测试时奖励引导图像编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时奖励引导图像编辑依赖预训练生成过程优化候选，重复调整需反复执行大模型，甚至需骨干网络反向传播，代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出联合刻画奖励、源保持与预训练先验偏好的理论框架，将目标输出分布与实现动态分离；据此训练针对每个源和目标的轻量网络执行编辑，预训练模型与奖励模型仅对候选输出提供反馈，并复用候选及其反馈以多次更新小网络，将生成骨干排除在内层优化之外。
AI.result: 在SD3上，FASTER在四项目标指标及多项验证指标上领先被评估方法；相较沿预训练生成轨迹优化控制的基线，在Stable Diffusion 3上实现最高6.91倍、在Stable Diffusion 1.5上最高24.14倍的编辑加速。
AI.conclusion: FASTER在不将预训练生成骨干置于内层优化的前提下，兼顾奖励、内容保持与视觉合理性，并显著降低测试时编辑开销。

title: EagleDepth: Efficient Fine-Grained Depth Estimation via Pixel Diffusion Decoder
summary: Recovering detailed geometry from high-resolution images is critical for precise perception of the surroundings and objects. However, existing methods which use latent-space modeling and VAE reconstruction can compromise geometric details. Furthermore, decoding from latent codes introduces substantial inference overhead. To address those issues, we present EagleDepth, an efficient framework for high-resolution monocular depth estimation that combines the geometric priors of latent diffusion with fine-grained pixel-space generation. Our key idea is to retain depth-aware latent representations as guidance while generating the final depth map directly in pixel space. We train the latent and pixel components sequentially: first, we fine-tune a pretrained latent diffusion model using paired RGB--depth supervision; then, we adapt a pretrained pixel diffusion decoder, PiD, to predict depth conditioned on the learned features. Training of the pixel component starts at 1024 resolution and continues across multiple resolutions up to 4K. The latent branch processes resized, lower-resolution RGB images, while the pixel branch generates depth at the target resolution, bypassing the original VAE decoder. This design preserves learned geometric knowledge without requiring the latent backbone to operate at the output resolution. On five commonly used depth estimation datasets and the high-resolution Synth4K dataset, our framework achieves state-of-the-art depth estimation performance, with faster inference and better preservation of fine structures and object boundaries.

AI.tldr: EagleDepth：结合潜空间扩散的几何先验与像素空间精细生成，实现高效高分辨率单目深度估计。
AI.motivation: 现有高分辨率深度估计方法依赖潜空间建模与 VAE 重建，会损害几何细节；且从潜码解码引入大量推理开销。
AI.method: 保留深度感知潜表示作为引导，直接在像素空间生成深度图。顺序训练：先用 RGB–深度配对监督微调预训练潜扩散模型；再适配预训练像素扩散解码器 PiD，以学习到的特征为条件预测深度。像素分支从 1024 分辨率开始，逐步扩展到 4K。潜分支处理缩放后的低分辨率 RGB，像素分支在目标分辨率生成深度并绕过原始 VAE 解码器。
AI.result: 在五个常用深度估计数据集及高分辨率 Synth4K 数据集上达到 SOTA，推理更快，细结构与物体边界保持更好。
AI.conclusion: 该设计在保留几何知识的同时无需潜主干在输出分辨率运行，兼顾精度与效率。

title: Frozen in a Frame: The Velocity Blind Spot in JEPA World Models
comment: 32 pages, 17 figures, 12 tables. Code, model checkpoints, and project page are available via links in the paper
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) for world modeling train an encoder so a predictor maps a current embedding and action to the next frame's embedding, always from a single rendered frame. This has a structural blind spot: a renderer without motion blur draws a scene from configuration alone, so a single-frame embedding carries no velocity information, for any encoder, including the official released LeWM weights. We confirm this on official checkpoints across four real benchmarks (PushT, Reacher, Cube, TwoRoom): every linear velocity probe sits at or below chance while position probes reach R^2 about 0.95. We introduce RateIdent, a three-stage diagnostic protocol, and TI-JEPA, a lightweight fix splitting the latent into a pose code and an explicit finite-difference motion code, predicted jointly. Across three physically grounded environments, TI-JEPA gives a significant, seed-robust gain on a stop-at-goal planning task over a matched-memory baseline, e.g. 55% lower final distance on Pendulum (p=3.2x10^-10) and 64% on CartPole (p=5.1x10^-15). We reproduce this at official ViT-Tiny plus AdaLN-transformer scale, then push the same recipe onto real dm_control Reacher photographs trained from scratch, where TI-JEPA's branch separation exceeds the memory-having baseline's by roughly 38x, the paper's largest margin. Against a same-footprint recurrent RSSM-style predictor, TI-JEPA matches or beats its rollout accuracy on two of three environments, stays separately probeable for pose and motion, and wins outright on the most coupled one. A checkable formal argument and six evaluated environments show single-frame targets are the wrong object to predict when velocity matters, and a small, interpretable structural change fixes it with no privileged supervision. Code, checkpoints, and the project page are linked below the title.

AI.tldr: 本文指出单帧JEPA世界模型存在结构性盲区（单帧嵌入无法携带速度信息），提出诊断协议RateIdent与修复方案TI-JEPA（将潜变量拆分为位姿码与显式有限差分运动码联合预测），在多个环境中验证了规划与探测性能的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）用于世界建模时，仅从单一渲染帧训练编码器，使预测器将当前嵌入与动作映射到下一帧嵌入。由于无运动模糊的渲染器只依据配置渲染场景，单帧嵌入不携带速度信息，这对任何编码器（包括官方LeWM权重）都成立，构成结构性盲区。作者希望在速度至关重要的任务中修正这一缺陷，且不依赖特权监督。
AI.method: 提出三阶段诊断协议RateIdent，用于确认单帧嵌入的速度信息缺失；并提出TI-JEPA：将潜变量拆分为位姿码（pose code）与显式有限差分运动码（finite-difference motion code），二者联合预测。方法在官方ViT-Tiny加AdaLN-transformer规模上复现，并扩展到真实dm_control Reacher照片上从零训练。另设可检验的形式化论证，并与同规模循环RSSM式预测器对比。
AI.result: 在官方检查点的四个真实基准（PushT、Reacher、Cube、TwoRoom）上，所有线性速度探针处于或低于随机水平，而位置探针R^2约0.95，证实速度信息缺失。在三类物理环境中，TI-JEPA在停于目标的规划任务上相对匹配记忆基线取得显著且跨种子稳健的提升，如Pendulum末端距离降低55%（p=3.2×10^-10），CartPole降低64%（p=5.1×10^-15）。真实dm_control Reacher照片上，TI-JEPA的分支分离度超基线的约38倍，为论文最大差距。与同规模RSSM式预测器相比，TI-JEPA在三环境中两个上达到或超过其 rollout 精度，位姿与运动可分别探测，并在耦合最强的环境上胜出。
AI.conclusion: 形式化论证与六个环境评估表明，当速度至关重要时，单帧目标并非合适的预测对象；一个小巧且可解释的结构性改动即可修复该问题，且无需特权监督。代码、检查点与项目主页均附于标题下方。

title: WASP: Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs for Fetal Brain MRI-Ultrasound Learning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 21 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code: https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP
summary: Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is widely regarded as the optimal sensor for fetal brain analysis due to its superior soft-tissue contrast and anatomical detail. However, its high cost and operational burden make it invasive and difficult to obtain at scale. Ultrasound (US), in contrast, is cheap, safe, and routinely acquired, and as a result it has produced substantially larger datasets and a growing ecosystem of pretrained models. This asymmetry raises a natural question: Can we teach a US-only model to understand fetal MRI from only a limited set of examples? The standard recipe, training a foundation model on subject-to-subject paired MRI-US scans, is not viable since no such paired fetal dataset is publicly available. In this paper we address this gap with Weakly Aligned Spatiotemporal Pairs (WASP), a framework that formulates cross-modal correspondence as an entropic Optimal Transport problem driven by clinical metadata, in particular Gestational Age (GA) and diagnostic planes, enabling the fitting of a lightweight alignment module that lifts MRI representations into the US latent space, without fine-tuning the backbone. Empirically, WASP yields its largest gains when MRI is unseen by the model during pretraining (on USFM, GA estimation error drops from 21.9 to 17.4 days and standard plane classification accuracy climbs from 61.9% to 69.0%), while providing smaller, backbone-dependent refinements for backbones pretrained on both modalities (e.g., BioMedParse GA estimation error from 6.5 to 6.0 days and SAM-Med2d plane accuracy from 83.3% to 88.1%). Code is available at https://github.com/miccunifi/WASP.

AI.tldr: WASP将跨模态(MRI-US)对应关系建模为熵正则最优传输问题，利用胎龄与诊断切面等临床元数据构造弱对齐时空配对，训练轻量对齐模块把MRI表征映射到US潜空间，无需微调主干，提升了胎儿MRI相关任务表现。
AI.motivation: 胎儿MRI软组织结构对比与解剖细节优异，但成本高、操作负担重，难以大规模获取；超声廉价、安全、常规采集，已积累大规模数据与预训练模型生态。因此希望让仅基于US训练的模型在少量样本下理解胎儿MRI。然而标准做法需受试者级MRI-US配对数据训练基础模型，而公开数据集中不存在此类配对胎儿数据，故存在跨模态数据缺口。
AI.method: 提出弱对齐时空配对框架WASP，将跨模态对应关系形式化为由临床元数据（尤其胎龄GA与诊断切面）驱动的熵正则最优传输问题，据此拟合一个轻量对齐模块，将MRI表征提升/映射至US潜空间，且不微调主干网络。
AI.result: 当预训练阶段未见MRI时增益最大：在USFM上，GA估计误差由21.9天降至17.4天，标准切面分类准确率由61.9%升至69.0%；对双模态预训练主干则带来较小且依赖主干的改进，如BioMedParse的GA误差由6.5降至6.0天，SAM-Med2d切面准确率由83.3%升至88.1%。
AI.conclusion: WASP无需公开配对数据即可建立MRI与US间的跨模态对应，通过元数据驱动的弱对齐最优传输与轻量模块，有效将MRI表征迁移至US潜空间，尤其对仅US预训练主干提升显著，为低成本利用大规模US生态理解胎儿MRI提供了可行途径。代码已开源。

title: Organize Primitives into Semantic Parts: Reinforcement Reasoning for 3D Segmentation
summary: Primitive-based 3D segmentation offers a compact and explicit alternative to dense surface prediction, naturally supporting structural abstraction and boundary localization. However, geometric decomposition alone does not determine how primitives should be organized into semantic parts: a single part may span multiple primitives, while geometrically similar or touching primitives may belong to different parts. We therefore introduce RePart (Reinforcement Part Reasoning), which formulates primitive-to-part organization as a finite-horizon Markov decision process and learns semantic organization through trajectory-level reinforcement reasoning. RePart constructs a Composable Primitive Workspace from fine-grained superquadrics and applies a merge-and-stop policy whose decisions are optimized by their downstream effects on the resulting partition rather than local primitive compatibility. The inferred part identities are then mapped back to the original mesh through Boundary-Aware Surface Labeling, preserving accurate surface boundaries beyond the primitive approximation. On PartNet, RePart achieves the strongest results across all four aggregate partition metrics; on 3DCoMPaT++, it obtains the highest RI and SC without target-dataset fine-tuning. These results demonstrate that reinforcement reasoning provides an effective mechanism for organizing geometric primitives into semantic parts while retaining dense segmentation accuracy. Code is available at https://github.com/EngineeringAI-LAB/RePart.

AI.tldr: 提出RePart，将基元到语义部件的组织建模为有限时域MDP，通过轨迹级强化推理学习合并-停止策略，并结合边界感知表面标注映射回原网格，在PartNet与3DCoMPaT++上取得领先结果。
AI.motivation: 基于基元的三维分割虽紧凑且显式，但几何分解本身无法决定基元如何组织成语义部件：一个部件可能跨越多个基元，而几何相似或相邻的基元可能属于不同部件。因此需要超越局部几何兼容性的语义组织机制。
AI.method: RePart将基元到部件的组织形式化为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，通过轨迹级强化推理学习语义组织。方法从细粒度超二次曲面构建可组合基元工作区（Composable Primitive Workspace），采用合并-停止策略，其决策依据对最终分割的下游影响而非局部基元兼容性进行优化；随后通过边界感知表面标注（Boundary-Aware Surface Labeling）将推断的部件身份映射回原始网格，以保留精确表面边界。
AI.result: 在PartNet上，RePart在四项聚合分割指标上均取得最优结果；在3DCoMPaT++上，无需目标数据集微调即获得最高RI与SC。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，强化推理可有效将几何基元组织为语义部件，同时保持稠密分割精度。

title: ConEx: Human-Interpretable Saliency Maps via Concept-Aware Attribution
summary: Many visual explanation methods in computer vision highlight pixel importance but struggle to link these low-level cues to semantically meaningful concepts, limiting their interpretability and trustworthiness. We introduce Concept-based Explanations (ConEx), a novel framework that bridges saliency visualization with concept-based reasoning to provide both faithfulness and interpretability. ConEx automatically discovers class-specific concepts and represents them through concept activation vectors (CAVs), learned without manual supervision using an architecture-specific masking mechanism that reduces noise introduced by the segmentation masks to enhance concept purity. ConEx generates faithful saliency maps that reveal where each concept appears in the image and how it contributes to the prediction. To evaluate the reliability of these learned concepts, we propose two complementary metrics, Vector-Concept Match (VCM) and Concept-Class Match (CCM), that quantify concept alignment and enable direct comparison with existing methods. Extensive experiments across diverse settings demonstrate that ConEx achieves state-of-the-art performance on faithfulness, segmentation, and concept-quality benchmarks. Overall, ConEx advances the field toward truly interpretable and concept-grounded explanations in vision models.

AI.tldr: 提出Concept-based Explanations（ConEx）框架，将显著性可视化与概念推理结合，自动发现类特定概念并生成忠实、可解释的显著性图，在忠实性、分割和概念质量基准上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机视觉中的视觉解释方法多聚焦于像素重要性，难以将低层线索与语义概念关联，限制了可解释性与可信度。
AI.method: ConEx自动发现类特定概念，用概念激活向量（CAVs）表示；在无人工监督下，借助架构特定的掩码机制学习CAVs以减少分割掩码引入的噪声、提升概念纯度；生成可揭示每个概念出现位置及其对预测贡献的忠实显著性图；提出Vector-Concept Match (VCM)与Concept-Class Match (CCM)两个互补指标量化概念对齐性。
AI.result: 在多样设置下的广泛实验表明，ConEx在忠实性、分割与概念质量基准上均取得SOTA表现。
AI.conclusion: ConEx推动了视觉模型向真正可解释、以概念为基的解释方向发展。

title: Sparse-View 4D Gaussian Splatting via Spatiotemporal Priors and Generative Assistance
comment: 4 pages, 5 figures, Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Workshops (SA Workshops '26)
summary: We present a 4D Gaussian Splatting framework for the Sparse-View Track of the SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Volumetric Video Challenge, which requires dynamic scene reconstruction from only six cameras with wide baselines. To achieve robust dynamic reconstruction under such sparse views, our framework integrates three components. (1) Region-adaptive spatial priors: We use foreground masks to guide Gaussian initialization and mask voting to control densification separately for the dynamic foreground and static background. Background geometry is regularized using monocular depth aligned to metric scale. (2) Motion-consistent temporal priors: We provide supervision at intermediate times through frame interpolation and constrain projected Gaussian motion with estimated optical flow. (3) Generative assistance: We place virtual cameras in the widest angular gaps and restore their rendered images using a diffusion-based model conditioned on camera poses. The restored images are iteratively incorporated into training as pseudo-supervision. On the validation set, our framework improves full-frame PSNR from 25.60 dB for the baseline to 29.75 dB. On the official test benchmark, it achieves 30.04 dB full-frame PSNR and 27.88 dB foreground PSNR, ranking first overall in the Sparse-View Track.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向稀疏视角赛道的4D高斯泼溅框架，通过区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时间先验与生成式辅助三部分，在仅6个宽基线相机条件下实现鲁棒动态重建，验证集全帧PSNR由25.60 dB提升至29.75 dB，官方测试达30.04 dB全帧PSNR与27.88 dB前景PSNR，位列稀疏视角赛道第一。
AI.motivation: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026体积视频挑战赛稀疏视角赛道要求在仅6个宽基线相机下进行动态场景重建。极稀疏视角导致高斯初始化与稠密化缺乏约束、前景与背景几何重建不稳定、中间时刻运动缺乏监督，以及宽角度间隙区域无观测，因此需要引入空间、时间与生成式先验来提升重建鲁棒性。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：(1) 区域自适应空间先验：利用前景掩码引导高斯初始化，并用掩码投票分别控制动态前景与静态背景的稠密化，背景几何通过对齐到度量尺度的单目深度进行正则化；(2) 运动一致时间先验：通过帧插值在中间时刻提供监督，并用估计光流约束投影高斯运动；(3) 生成式辅助：在最宽角度间隙放置虚拟相机，用基于相机位姿条件的扩散模型修复其渲染图像，并将修复图像作为伪监督迭代加入训练。
AI.result: 验证集上全帧PSNR从基线的25.60 dB提升到29.75 dB；官方测试基准上达到30.04 dB全帧PSNR和27.88 dB前景PSNR，在稀疏视角赛道总排名第一。
AI.conclusion: 所提4D高斯泼溅框架通过融合区域自适应空间先验、运动一致时间先验和基于扩散模型的生成式伪监督，有效缓解了宽基线稀疏视角下的动态重建难题，在挑战赛稀疏视角赛道取得领先性能。

title: Task-Sensitive Geometry of Representation Transfer for Object Detection under Image Degradation
summary: Object detection under image degradation can benefit from clean-image supervision, but aggregate gains do not imply that transferred representation changes are uniformly useful. We study how clean task knowledge affects degraded-image representations and whether local responses to structured representation directions can be characterized geometrically. Using paired clean and Gaussian-degraded BDD100K images, we show that clean-teacher distillation improves observed detection accuracy while producing heterogeneous object-level transfer. We isolate a representation component complementary to direct clean-teacher alignment and map it into the distilled student space through an orthogonal bridge. Controlled interventions rescue 13.22% of objects lost under the distilled representation, versus 4.30% under norm-matched random perturbations, with very low harm on preserved objects. We introduce task-sensitive geometry, a gradient-derived channel-space geometry constructed from normalized detection-loss gradients. On a reserved cohort, mapped-complement orientation within this frozen geometry is positively associated with local intervention-response magnitude after controlling for intervention magnitude (partial Spearman $ρ$ = 0.242, 95% CI [0.108, 0.359]). The relationship eplicates on independent data ($ρ$ = 0.180) and with RT-DETR-L ($ρ$ = 0.227), but not for the direct clean-teacher residual family, and it weakens for large interventions. Routing rules and specialized distillation objectives based on these signals do not yield statistically reliable gains over CLEANKD. These results support a local, direction-family-dependent task-sensitive geometry while showing that converting such structure into improved global training remains an open problem.

AI.tldr: 研究用配对干净/高斯退化BDD100K图像考察干净教师蒸馏对退化图像表征的影响，发现对象级迁移具有异质性，并引入"任务敏感几何"刻画局部干预响应，但将此类结构转化为全局训练收益仍是开放问题。
AI.motivation: 干净图像监督虽能提升退化图像的目标检测，但总体增益并不意味着迁移的表征变化普遍有益；作者希望厘清干净任务知识如何影响退化图像表征，以及能否用几何方式刻画表征方向上的局部响应。
AI.method: 使用配对的干净与高斯退化BDD100K图像；观察到干净教师蒸馏提升检测精度但产生异质的对象级迁移；分离出与直接干净教师对齐互补的表征分量，并通过正交桥映射到蒸馏学生空间；引入"任务敏感几何"——由归一化检测损失梯度构建的通道空间几何；在保留队列上用偏相关分析映射互补方向与局部干预响应强度的关系，并在独立数据、RT-DETR-L及不同干预幅度下做验证与消融。
AI.result: 受控干预可挽救蒸馏表征下丢失目标的13.22%，而范数匹配随机扰动仅为4.30%，且对保留目标伤害极低；在预留队列上，映射互补方向在冻结几何中的朝向与局部干预响应强度正相关（偏Spearman ρ=0.242，95% CI [0.108, 0.359]），在独立数据（ρ=0.180）与RT-DETR-L（ρ=0.227）上可复现，但对直接干净教师残差族不成立，且在大干预下减弱；基于这些信号的路由规则与专用蒸馏目标未能在CLEANKD之上取得统计可靠增益。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持存在局部的、依赖方向族的任务敏感几何，表明表征结构可被几何刻画；但如何将这种局部结构转化为全局训练性能提升仍为待解问题。

title: FLASHSWIN: Unlocking Large Windows and Dense Tokens in Swin Vision Transformers with Memory Efficient Attention
summary: High-resolution vision backbones have long been forced to trade away local token density to afford larger receptive fields. Hierarchical Swin transformers impose this compromise because standard windowed attention materializes an $M^2\times M^2$ score matrix per window, incurring $O(M^4)$ memory as windows or token grids grow. Furthermore, Swin adds a learned relative-position bias elementwise to attention scores, requiring full materialization of the score matrix and its gradient. This keeps Swin and SwinV2 trapped in a small-window($M=8,16$), coarse-token regime with patch size $4\times4$ ($p=4$), limiting performance for fine-grained tasks. We introduce FLASHSWIN, which replaces standard windowed attention with a FlashAttention implementation that computes exact softmax attention without materializing the score matrix, reducing per-window memory from $O(M^4)$ to $O(M^2)$. This enables higher token density and larger receptive fields without inflating memory overhead. Training memory is flat across window sizes: at a $32\times32$ window, FLASHSWIN-T requires only $12.4$\,GB, unchanged from $8\times8$, compared to $70/90$\,GB for SwinV2/V1-T. However, applying FlashAttention directly to Swin creates a trade-off: bypassing the score matrix precludes Swin's additive relative-position bias, forfeiting spatial information in exchange for memory efficiency. FLASHSWIN restores position information as window-local learnable 2D RoPE, making large windows and dense token grids both affordable and accurate. At matched scale, FLASHSWIN-T outperforms Swin variants. With dense tokens and wide windows ($p=2,M=32$), the same Tiny model reaches $84.1\%$ ImageNet-1K, $44.1$ COCO box AP, and $47.28$ ADE20K mIoU---gains of $+1.3$, $+5.1$, and $+1.82$ over SwinV2-T at $M=16$, respectively. At fixed $M=32$, halving the patch size yields roughly $3\times$ larger gains in boundary quality than in mIoU.

AI.tldr: FLASHSWIN 用 FlashAttention 替换 Swin 的窗口注意力，将每窗口内存从 O(M^4) 降至 O(M^2)，并用窗口局部可学习 2D RoPE 替代相对位置偏置，从而支持大窗口与高密度 token，在分类、检测、分割任务上超越 SwinV2-T。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率视觉骨干长期被迫牺牲局部 token 密度以换取更大感受野。Swin 系列因标准窗口注意力需显式生成 M^2×M^2 的分数矩阵，内存开销为 O(M^4)，且其学习式相对位置偏置需对分数矩阵及其梯度完整实例化，导致 Swin/SwinV2 只能停留在小窗口（M=8,16）与粗 token（p=4）的范式，限制了细粒度任务性能。
AI.method: FLASHSWIN 以 FlashAttention 实现替换标准窗口注意力，在不显式实例化分数矩阵的情况下计算精确 softmax 注意力，将每窗口内存由 O(M^4) 降至 O(M^2)。由于绕过分数矩阵会排除 Swin 的加性相对位置偏置，作者改用窗口局部可学习的 2D RoPE 恢复位置信息，使大窗口与密集 token 网格同时可行且精确。
AI.result: 训练内存在不同窗口尺寸下保持平坦：32×32 窗口时 FLASHSWIN-T 仅需 12.4 GB，与 8×8 相同，而 SwinV2/V1-T 分别为 70/90 GB。同等规模下 FLASHSWIN-T 优于 Swin 变体。在密集 token 与宽窗口（p=2, M=32）下，同一 Tiny 模型达到 ImageNet-1K 84.1%、COCO box AP 44.1、ADE20K mIoU 47.28，相比 M=16 的 SwinV2-T 分别提升 +1.3、+5.1、+1.82。固定 M=32 时，patch 尺寸减半在边界质量上带来的增益约为 mIoU 增益的 3 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过将窗口注意力改为内存高效的 FlashAttention 并以窗口局部 2D RoPE 补偿位置信息，FLASHSWIN 打破了 Swin 系在小窗口、粗 token 上的内存约束，使大窗口与高密度 token 兼具可行性与准确性，在多项视觉任务上取得一致性提升，尤其对边界质量收益显著。

title: COMPASS: Comet Object Measurement Pipeline with Automated Selection and Scoring
summary:
Summary: The single-cell gel electrophoresis ('comet') assay is a widely used technique for quantifying DNA damage at the individual cell level. However, image analysis often relies on manual inspection or semi-automated software, which can be labor-intensive, difficult to reproduce, and sensitive to image quality and comet morphology. COMPASS automates comet assay image analysis by combining deep learning-based comet segmentation with damage measurement and automated comet selection. The pipeline produces standardized DNA damage measurements while offering robust detection, reducing manual effort and improving reproducibility through transparent selection and optional manual review.
  Availability and implementation: COMPASS is implemented in Python and is freely available at https://github.com/ rsinghlab/COMPASS. Installation instructions, pretrained weights, and example usage are provided in the repository.
  Contact: jack_roberts2@brown.edu, ritsingh@illinois.edu
  Supplementary information: Available onlime upon publication.

AI.tldr: COMPASS 是一个基于深度学习的开源工具，自动化单细胞凝胶电泳（彗星实验）图像分析，实现彗星分割、DNA 损伤量化与彗星自动筛选，提升效率与可重复性。
AI.motivation: 彗星实验是量化单细胞 DNA 损伤的常用技术，但其图像分析多依赖人工判读或半自动软件，存在劳动密集、可重复性差、对图像质量与彗星形态敏感等问题。
AI.method: COMPASS 将基于深度学习的彗星分割与损伤测量、彗星自动筛选相结合，构建自动化分析流程，并提供透明的筛选机制与可选人工复核。
AI.result: 该流程可输出标准化的 DNA 损伤测量结果，具备稳健的检测能力，减少人工工作量，并通过透明筛选与可选人工复核提高可重复性。
AI.conclusion: COMPASS 以 Python 实现，开源免费（https://github.com/rsinghlab/COMPASS），仓库提供安装说明、预训练权重与使用示例，便于推广应用于彗星实验的标准化分析。

title: Decouple, Purify and Unite: Semantic-Structural Prototype Learning for Federated Medical Segmentation
summary: Federated learning enables medical institutions to train a global model without sharing data, yet feature heterogeneity from diverse scanners or protocols remains challenging. Existing representation-based methods face two limitations: 1) Incomplete Contextual Representation Learning: single-layer or coupled representations overlook multi-level structural cues and entangle regional semantics with boundary details. 2) Layerwise Style and Aggregation Biases: domain-specific style discrepancies across intermediate layers degrade prototypes, while aggregation that overlooks client distribution shifts can further amplify bias. We propose FedBCS+, federated decoupled contextual alignment with style-purified aggregation. We employ Frequency-domain Style Recalibration (FSR) in prototype construction to decouple content-style representations and extract style-purified prototypes. Built upon these purified features, Decoupled Contextual Prototype Alignment (DCPA) explicitly decouples multi-level features into semantic and structural prototypes and aligns regional semantics and fine-grained anatomical structures separately. Style-purified Semantic Prototype Aggregation (S2PA) measures each client's purified prototype divergence from the global consensus and adaptively reweights aggregation toward under-represented clients to reduce consensus bias. On five heterogeneous medical segmentation benchmarks spanning histopathology, MRI, ultrasound, and colonoscopy, FedBCS+ achieves the highest mean Dice among the compared methods. A convergence analysis further characterizes how aggregation and alignment affect the optimization bound.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FedBCS+，一种联邦解耦上下文对齐与风格纯化聚合方法，用于解决医学图像分割中特征异质性带来的表示不完整与层级偏差问题，在五个异构医学分割基准上取得最高平均 Dice。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可使医疗机构在不共享数据的前提下联合训练全局模型，但来自不同扫描仪或协议的特征异质性仍是难题。现有基于表示的方法存在两大局限：1）上下文表示学习不完整——单层或耦合表示忽视多层级结构线索，并将区域语义与边界细节纠缠；2）层级风格与聚合偏差——中间层的域特定风格差异会损害原型，而忽视客户端分布偏移的聚合会进一步放大偏差。
AI.method: 提出 FedBCS+（联邦解耦上下文对齐与风格纯化聚合）。包含三部分：1）频域风格重校准（FSR），在原型构建中解耦内容-风格表示，提取风格纯化原型；2）解耦上下文原型对齐（DCPA），基于纯化特征将多层级特征显式解耦为语义原型与结构原型，分别对齐区域语义与细粒度解剖结构；3）风格纯化语义原型聚合（S2PA），度量各客户端纯化原型与全局共识的差异，自适应地向欠代表客户端重新加权聚合，以降低共识偏差。
AI.result: 在涵盖组织病理学、MRI、超声和结肠镜的五种异构医学分割基准上，FedBCS+ 在所比较方法中取得最高平均 Dice。收敛性分析进一步刻画了聚合与对齐如何影响优化界。
AI.conclusion: FedBCS+ 通过频域风格纯化、多层级解耦对齐与自适应重加权聚合，有效缓解医学联邦学习中的特征异质性、风格偏差与聚合偏差，提升异构场景下的分割性能，并给出了收敛性理论分析。

title: Knossos and Ariadne: Benchmarking and Learning Complete Diagram Topology Extraction with Vision-Language Models
summary: Structural diagrams are widely used to represent complex systems and relational information across scientific, engineering, procedural, and spatial domains. Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have become increasingly capable of recognizing diagram elements and reasoning about their content, while complete diagram topology extraction remains comparatively underexplored. In this paper, we study diagram-to-graph topology extraction: extracting all diagram entities and the complete relations among them. To enable large-scale supervised training and systematic evaluation of this task, we introduce Knossos, a benchmark of 19,200 diagrams across six diverse domains, with 245,179 nodes and 439,740 edges. Its symbolic generation process provides exact alignment between rendered diagrams and annotations of complete topology, relation types, and connector geometry. To address the modeling challenge of complete topology extraction, we also present Ariadne, a structured framework that decomposes the task into node inventory extraction and source-conditioned edge prediction. Extensive experiments show that training on Knossos substantially improves complete topology extraction in smaller open-source VLMs. Ariadne further improves over one-step extraction under matched supervision, demonstrating the additional benefit of structured decomposition. It achieves the highest average Edge F1 among the evaluated methods on Knossos, while both backbone variants also improve over their unadapted counterparts on the real-world external benchmark. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/bangwayne/knossos_Ariadne_Public.

AI.tldr: 本文提出图结构拓扑抽取任务，构建大规模基准Knossos并提供结构化框架Ariadne，通过将任务分解为节点清单抽取与源条件边预测，显著提升VLM的完整拓扑抽取能力。
AI.motivation: 结构图广泛用于表示复杂系统与关系信息，当前VLM虽能识别图元素并推理内容，但完整图拓扑抽取仍研究不足，且缺乏大规模监督训练与系统评测的数据基础。
AI.method: 构建Knossos基准，覆盖6个领域、19,200张图、245,179个节点与439,740条边，通过符号化生成保证渲染图与完整拓扑、关系类型及连接线几何标注的精确对齐；提出Ariadne框架，将任务分解为节点清单抽取和源条件边预测两个子任务。
AI.result: 在Knossos上训练可显著提升较小开源VLM的完整拓扑抽取性能；在同等监督下，Ariadne优于一步式抽取，取得评估方法中最高的平均Edge F1；其两种骨干变体在真实世界外部基准上均优于未适配版本。
AI.conclusion: 面向完整图拓扑抽取，结构化分解与大规模精确对齐基准相结合能有效提升VLM能力，Knossos与Ariadne为后续研究提供了数据与框架支持。

title: NAMVIS: Next-Scale Autoregressive Multi-View Image Synthesis
summary: Sparse-view novel view synthesis is a central problem in 3D content creation, but diffusion-based approaches remain limited by iterative denoising, making multi-view generation expensive at inference time. We introduce NAMVIS, a diffusion-free framework that reformulates multi-view image synthesis as geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression. Instead of generating target views through repeated denoising, NAMVIS predicts discrete visual tokens through a small number of coarse-to-fine scale steps, while sampling all tokens within each scale and across target views in parallel. To anchor this generation process to explicit camera geometry, we propose Multi-scale Projective Pose Encoding, which injects source and target camera transformations into both target-view self-attention and source-to-target cross-attention at every resolution. NAMVIS further combines global conditioning with dense geometry-aware cross-attention, enabling the model to preserve source-view appearance while maintaining target-view consistency. Across Objaverse, GSO, and OmniObject3D, NAMVIS outperforms diffusion-based baselines in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, while running over 3 times faster than the evaluated diffusion baselines under the same evaluation setting. These results suggest that geometry-conditioned next-scale autoregression is a promising and efficient alternative to diffusion for sparse-view multi-view synthesis. Additional qualitative results, videos, and resources are available at https://corl-team.github.io/namvis/

AI.tldr: NAMVIS提出一种无需扩散的稀疏视角新视角合成框架，将多视角图像生成重构为几何条件化的“下一尺度自回归”，通过少量由粗到细的尺度步骤预测离散视觉token，显著提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视角新视角合成是3D内容生成的核心问题，但基于扩散的方法受限于迭代去噪过程，导致多视角生成在推理阶段代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出NAMVIS框架：将多视角图像合成重构为几何条件化的下一尺度自回归，用少量由粗到细的尺度步骤预测离散视觉token，同一尺度内及跨目标视角的token并行采样。引入多尺度投影位姿编码（Multi-scale Projective Pose Encoding），在每个分辨率上将源与目标相机变换注入目标视角自注意力及源到目标交叉注意力；结合全局条件化与密集几何感知交叉注意力，保持源视角外观并维持目标视角一致性。
AI.result: 在Objaverse、GSO和OmniObject3D数据集上，NAMVIS在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标上均优于基于扩散的基线方法，且在相同评测设定下推理速度超过所评估扩散基线的3倍。
AI.conclusion: 几何条件化的下一尺度自回归是稀疏视角多视角合成中一种有前景且高效的扩散替代方案。

title: Investigating Spatiotemporal Redundancy in Video Transformer for Collision Anticipation
summary: In worker-equipment proximity monitoring, video transformers are widely used for collision anticipation and have demonstrated strong performance. However, their accuracy comes with substantial computational demands, creating a tension with the need for low-latency inference on mobile robots and the pursuit of lower-carbon computation in construction. To address this, this study investigates where computation within an established video transformer is redundant and whether that redundancy can be removed without materially degrading predictive performance. Using VideoMAEv2-Base on the Nexar Collision Prediction dataset, we first examine how collision-relevant information evolves across network depth and then investigate two complementary forms of redundancy: structured capacity redundancy in multilayer perceptrons (MLPs) and spatiotemporal redundancy in the token stream. Linear probes show that interpretable motion cues, including flow magnitude, looming, and approach versus retreat, are most accessible at intermediate layers, whereas collision-label discrimination strengthens toward the final layer. Token redundancy is axis-specific: adjacent temporal-token similarity reaches 0.970 in later layers, while spatial similarity falls to 0.297, indicating substantially greater redundancy across time than across space. Exploiting this asymmetry, temporal token merging reduces backbone computation from 356.99 to 178.50 GFLOPs and latency from 12.69 to 7.21 ms per clip, a 1.76x speedup, while mean average precision changes only from 0.7478 to 0.7443. Importance-guided retention of 50% of MLP units preserves an AUC of 0.753, compared with 0.529 under matched random retention, and reveals that pruning alters score calibration before discriminative ranking collapses. These findings establish a new pathway for pursuing faster algorithms through targeted temporal token compression and neuron pruning.

AI.tldr: 该研究以VideoMAEv2-Base在Nexar碰撞预测数据集上分析视频Transformer的冗余，发现时间维冗余远高于空间维，据此进行时间token合并与MLP单元剪枝，实现1.76倍加速且精度几乎不变。
AI.motivation: 工人-设备接近监测中，视频Transformer虽精度高但计算需求大，与移动机器人低延迟推理及建筑领域低碳计算的需求存在矛盾，需明确网络内部哪些计算冗余并可无损移除。
AI.method: 使用VideoMAEv2-Base在Nexar Collision Prediction数据集上，首先通过线性探针考察碰撞相关信息随网络深度的演化；随后研究两类冗余：MLP中的结构化容量冗余与token流中的时空冗余，并利用时间-空间冗余不对称性实施时间token合并与重要性引导的MLP单元保留。
AI.result: 线性探针显示可解释运动线索（流幅值、looming、接近/远离）在中间层最易获取，碰撞标签判别在末层增强。token冗余具有轴向特异性：后层相邻时间token相似度达0.970，空间相似度仅0.297。时间token合并使主干计算从356.99降至178.50 GFLOPs，延迟从12.69降至7.21 ms/clip（1.76倍加速），mAP仅由0.7478变为0.7443。保留50%MLP单元的AUC为0.753，随机保留仅为0.529，且剪枝先改变分数校准后判别排序才崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了视频Transformer中时间冗余显著高于空间冗余的规律，提出通过定向时间token压缩与神经元剪枝实现更快速算法的路径，在几乎不损失预测性能的前提下显著降低计算与延迟。

title: ThyCLIPNet: A BiomedCLIP-Guided Lightweight Attention-Enhanced DeepLabV3+ Framework for Robust Thyroid Nodule Segmentation
summary: Accurate thyroid ultrasound segmentation is often challenged by low contrast, speckle noise, and unclear boundaries. Although recent methods have improved segmentation accuracy, many rely on resource-intensive architectures or lack explicit integration of multiscale features with global biomedical visual guidance. In this paper, we introduce ThyCLIPNet, a lightweight semantic-guided hybrid encoder-decoder framework that integrates BiomedCLIP-derived biomedical semantic guidance into a lightweight multi-scale CNN segmentation pipeline. The encoder integrates MobileNetV2 with efficient channel attention, while atrous spatial pyramid pooling and a custom convolutional block attention module enrich bottleneck features. The decoder combines hierarchical skip connections and lightweight attention refinement with a BiomedCLIP-guided gated fusion pathway that projects vision-only global biomedical embeddings into decoder feature space and selectively integrates them through semantic-local fusion and spatial gating. To the best of our knowledge, ThyCLIPNet is among the first lightweight thyroid ultrasound segmentation frameworks to use BiomedCLIP's vision encoder alone for image-only global semantic guidance without text prompting. Experiments on TG3K, TN3K, DDTI, and PKTN achieve dice similarity coefficients of 96.22%, 87.58%, 84.73%, and 80.70%; intersection over union scores of 92.72%, 77.91%, 73.51%, and 67.64%; and 95th-percentile hausdorff distances of 3.75, 16.38, 18.23, and 10.86, respectively. ThyCLIPNet uses 8.55M parameters and 22.99G FLOPs. Overall, the results support integrating global biomedical semantic guidance with lightweight multi-scale CNN representations for robust and computationally efficient thyroid ultrasound segmentation. Source code: https://github.com/Tasnim-Jahan/ThyCLIPNet. [Abstract shortened for arXiv. See PDF for full abstract.]

AI.tldr: 该论文提出轻量级语义引导混合编解码框架 ThyCLIPNet，将 BiomedCLIP 视觉编码器提供的纯图像全局生物医学语义，融入多尺度 CNN 分割流程，在四个甲状腺超声数据集上取得高精度且仅需 8.55M 参数与 22.99G FLOPs。
AI.motivation: 甲状腺超声分割受低对比度、斑点噪声与边界模糊困扰；现有方法虽提升精度，但多依赖高资源架构，且缺乏多尺度特征与全局生物医学视觉引导的显式融合。
AI.method: ThyCLIPNet 采用轻量语义引导混合编解码结构：编码器以 MobileNetV2 结合高效通道注意力（ECA），并用空洞空间金字塔池化（ASPP）与自定义卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）增强瓶颈特征；解码器结合层级跳跃连接与轻量注意力精炼，并引入 BiomedCLIP 引导的门控融合路径，将纯视觉全局生物医学嵌入投影到解码器特征空间，通过语义-局部融合与空间门控实现选择性整合。该方法属首批仅用 BiomedCLIP 视觉编码器、无需文本提示的图像级全局语义引导的轻量甲状腺超声分割框架。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将全局生物医学语义引导与轻量多尺度 CNN 表示相结合，可实现稳健且计算高效的甲状腺超声分割。代码已开源。

title: ARISE: Adaptive Agentic Reasoning with Image-grounded Self-Evaluation for Interpretable IBD Assessment
summary: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) requires frequent imaging-based assessment, yet interpretation of modalities such as wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) and intestinal ultrasound remains heavily dependent on specialist expertise. Vision-Language Models (VLMs) demonstrate significant potential in multimodal medical image analysis, but their clinical adoption is hindered by their insufficient domain-specific reasoning, susceptibility to hallucination, scarcity of high quality training data in fine-grained diagnostics and limited interpretability. We introduce ARISE (Adaptive Agentic Reasoning with Image-grounded Self-Evaluation), an autonomous planning framework that models few-shot medical image understanding as a sequential agentic workflow. ARISE structures agent execution into a transparent 5-stage workflow: hypothesis generation, image-grounded evidence summarization, evidence-conditioned refinement, symbolic verification, and final diagnosis. We apply ARISE to IBD assessment across two independent patient cohorts: wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) images for Crohn's disease and B-mode ultrasound data for ulcerative colitis. ARISE consistently improves diagnostic performance over baseline VLMs while exposing where reasoning succeeds or fails, providing a more interpretable basis for clinical decision support and realistic deployment.

AI.tldr: ARISE是一个自主智能体推理框架，将少样本医学图像理解建模为5阶段序贯工作流（假设生成、图像证据总结、证据条件化精炼、符号验证、最终诊断），在克罗恩病WCE图像与溃疡性结肠炎超声两个独立队列上持续优于基线VLM，并提升可解释性。
AI.motivation: 炎症性肠病（IBD）需频繁影像评估，但无线胶囊内镜（WCE）与肠道超声等模态的判读高度依赖专科经验。视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态医学图像分析中潜力显著，却因领域推理不足、易产生幻觉、细粒度诊断高质量训练数据稀缺及可解释性有限而难以临床落地。
AI.method: 提出ARISE（Adaptive Agentic Reasoning with Image-grounded Self-Evaluation），将少样本医学图像理解建模为序贯智能体工作流，并组织为透明的5阶段：假设生成、图像接地证据总结、证据条件化精炼、符号验证、最终诊断。
AI.result: 在两个独立患者队列上评估IBD：克罗恩病的WCE图像与溃疡性结肠炎的B模式超声数据。ARISE在诊断性能上持续优于基线VLM，同时可揭示推理成功或失败的具体环节。
AI.conclusion: ARISE为临床决策支持与真实部署提供了更具可解释性的基础，同时保持了对基线模型的性能优势。

title: Super-Resolution in The Right Latent Space: A Frozen Vision-Foundation Substrate
summary: In an image latent space, the embeddings of high-resolution, natural, and sharp images form a manifold. Degradation of high-resolution images pushes their embeddings off this manifold. Real-world super-resolution (SR) then becomes the task of mapping the degraded embedding back onto this manifold --- not anywhere on the manifold, but to the point that preserves what the input still carries, both its semantics and pixel details. Every published method implements this mapping in a reconstruction-oriented latent space or pixel space. We claim these spaces are the wrong substrates for SR. Low-resolution and degraded images are embedded far from the manifold, making the mapping difficult and expensive. The lack of semantic information in these substrates also makes it difficult to navigate to the faithful point on the manifold, causing severe hallucination when degradation is heavy. Thus, restoring in a suitable latent space is crucial to the SR task. We show that the latent space of 23 fused layers of a frozen DINOv3-L is one such space that makes the SR task easier. Degraded images are embedded near the manifold. Moreover, this substrate contains a hierarchy of information, from pixel record to degradation robust semantics, guiding the model to find the faithful point on the manifold. On this substrate, a 415M decoder is trained under reconstruction and adversarial objectives to map the degraded embeddings back and decode to pixel space in one pass. The resulting model, RAESR, attains the best fidelity--perception trade-off among state-of-the-art adversarial and diffusion-based restorers on RealSR, DRealSR, LSDIR and DIV2K-Val, at 37 ms per 512 by 512 image on a single H20 GPU. Swapping the substrate for a VAE latent under an identical recipe loses on every metric.

AI.tldr: 该论文主张超分辨率应在合适的潜空间中进行，而非重建导向的潜空间或像素空间。作者发现冻结DINOv3-L第23层融合层的潜空间使退化图像嵌入靠近高分辨率流形，且包含从像素记录到退化鲁棒语义的层级信息。基于该基底训练415M解码器得到RAESR，在多数据集上取得最佳保真度-感知权衡，单张H20上512×512仅需37ms。相同配方下换用VAE潜空间则全面落后。
AI.motivation: 真实世界超分辨率的本质是将退化图像的嵌入映射回高分辨率图像流形上的保真点，该点需同时保留输入的语义与像素细节。然而现有方法均在重建导向的潜空间或像素空间中实现该映射，作者认为这些基底并不合适：低分辨率/退化图像在这些空间中远离流形，导致映射困难且昂贵；且这些基底缺乏语义信息，难以导航到流形上的保真点，在退化严重时会产生严重幻觉。因此，在合适的潜空间中进行恢复对SR任务至关重要。
AI.method: 作者提出将冻结DINOv3-L的23个融合层的潜空间作为SR基底。该空间使退化图像嵌入靠近流形，并包含从像素记录到退化鲁棒语义的信息层级，可引导模型找到流形上的保真点。在此基底上，训练一个415M解码器，采用重建与对抗目标，将退化嵌入映射回并在一次前向中解码到像素空间，所得模型称为RAESR。
AI.result: RAESR在RealSR、DRealSR、LSDIR和DIV2K-Val上，于当前最先进的对抗式和扩散式恢复方法中取得最佳的保真度-感知权衡。在单张H20 GPU上处理512×512图像仅需37ms。在相同配方下将基底替换为VAE潜空间，则在所有指标上均落后。
AI.conclusion: 在合适的潜空间中恢复是SR任务的关键。冻结DINOv3-L融合层潜空间因其退化嵌入靠近流形且具备语义层级，使SR任务更易完成，验证了基底选择的重要性。RAESR在该基底上实现了高效的保真度-感知平衡，且实验表明该优势源于基底本身而非训练配方。

title: Lollypop: Camera-to-Motion-Capture Calibration Verification with a Reference Target
comment: Accepted at IEEE SENSORS 2026. 4 pages, 3 figures
summary: Camera-to-motion-capture (mocap) calibration is essential for using mocap as ground truth in robotics, AR/VR, and other computer vision tasks. However, the calibration can drift after deployment, while calibration residuals and visual inspection provide limited independent verification. We present Lollypop, a fiducial-mocap reference target for independent calibration verification. The target couples an ArUco fiducial with a mocap marker constellation so the visual center and tracked centroid represent the same physical point. Given a candidate calibration, verification projects the mocap point into the image and measures its disagreement with the detected fiducial center. Experiments show sub-pixel nominal error, sensitivity to controlled extrinsic perturbations, and increasing error during an illustrative mixed-handling sequence.

AI.tldr: 提出Lollypop基准靶标，将ArUco视觉标记与动捕标记星座耦合，使视觉中心与跟踪质心对应同一物理点，用于相机-动捕标定的独立验证，实验显示亚像素级标称误差且能灵敏反映外参扰动与漂移。
AI.motivation: 相机与动捕系统的标定在部署后可能发生漂移，而仅凭标定残差与人工目视检查难以提供独立的验证手段，缺乏可靠的校验依据。
AI.method: 设计Lollypop基准靶标：将ArUco基准标记与动捕标记星座刚性耦合，使视觉中心与跟踪质心代表同一物理点。给定候选标定参数后，将动捕点投影到图像中，测量其与检测到的基准标记中心之间的偏差作为验证指标。
AI.result: 实验得到亚像素级标称误差；对外参受控扰动具有敏感性；在演示性的混合操作序列中，误差随过程逐渐增大。
AI.conclusion: Lollypop提供了一种低成本、可独立实施的相机-动捕标定验证方案，可检测标定漂移，适用于机器人、AR/VR等以动捕为真值的任务场景。

title: DriftSR: One-Step Real-World Image Super-Resolution via Distribution Drifting
summary: One-step real-world image super-resolution (Real-ISR) offers efficient inference, but recovering realistic and perceptually rich details often relies on score distillation or adversarial learning, introducing additional trainable components and making optimization more cumbersome. To this end, we propose DriftSR, a one-step Real-ISR framework that leverages pretrained diffusion priors through distribution drifting. Specifically, we perform drifting in the frozen intermediate representation space of a pretrained diffusion model, without introducing an additional task-specific feature encoder. Building on this space, we introduce Spatial Feature Drifting, which treats spatial features rather than entire images as distributional samples, enabling denser supervision for distribution alignment. To mitigate structural deviations, we further introduce Structure-Modulated Guidance, which adaptively refines drifting guidance according to local structural consistency with the LQ input. Consequently, DriftSR optimizes only the one-step generator, without auxiliary distillation branches or adversarial discriminators. Extensive experiments on three real-world benchmarks demonstrate that DriftSR delivers high-quality super-resolution reconstruction with efficient one-step inference.

AI.tldr: DriftSR：一种基于分布漂移的单步真实世界图像超分辨率框架，利用冻结的预训练扩散模型中间表征进行漂移，仅优化一步生成器，无需蒸馏分支或对抗判别器。
AI.motivation: 单步真实世界图像超分辨率（Real-ISR）推理高效，但获取逼真且感知丰富的细节通常依赖分数蒸馏或对抗学习，这会引入额外可训练组件，使优化过程更加繁琐。因此需要一种既能利用预训练扩散先验、又无需额外组件的高效单步框架。
AI.method: 提出 DriftSR，通过分布漂移利用预训练扩散先验。具体在冻结的预训练扩散模型中间表征空间中进行漂移，无需额外任务专用特征编码器。在此基础上引入空间特征漂移（Spatial Feature Drifting），将空间特征而非整张图像作为分布样本，实现更密集的分布对齐监督；并引入结构调制引导（Structure-Modulated Guidance），根据与低质量输入（LQ）的局部结构一致性自适应细化漂移引导。整个框架仅优化一步生成器。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界基准上进行了大量实验，表明 DriftSR 能实现高质量超分辨率重建，并具备高效的单步推理能力。
AI.conclusion: DriftSR 通过冻结扩散模型中间空间的分布漂移，在无需辅助蒸馏分支或对抗判别器的情况下仅优化一步生成器，实现了高质量、高效的单步真实世界图像超分辨率。

title: RSure-Agent: Reliable Use of Tool Observations for Remote Sensing Agents
comment: The demo is available at https://github.com/airs101/RSure-Agent (code will be released for further research)
summary: Remote sensing agents rely on perception, measurement, and raster analysis tools to solve Earth observation tasks. We refer to their judgments and quantitative results about ground objects as tool observations. However, these observations are subject to substantial uncertainty and may be incorrect even when the tools execute successfully. When agents accept incorrect observations, the errors can propagate through subsequent reasoning and cause task failure. We analyze 1,229 execution trajectories across three remote sensing agent benchmarks. On each benchmark, at least 88.1% of tasks depend on tool observations. Among these tasks, at least 22.7% contain incorrect observations despite successful tool execution. These errors propagate to the final answer in at least 82.0% of affected tasks on each benchmark. To address this problem, we propose RSure-Agent, a framework for verifying tool observations and limiting error propagation. We introduce a verifiable observation protocol that requires tools to return process evidence for the agent to verify their observations. We also construct a task-tool reliability prior from offline task feedback. The prior summarizes each tool configuration's past performance across task types and provides a task-specific reference for verification. Using process evidence and this prior, RSure-Agent decides whether to accept an observation, request additional evidence, or reject it. We evaluate RSure-Agent on EarthBench, ThinkGeo, TerraLogic, and CHOICE-420. Across the three agent benchmarks, RSure-Agent reduces the error propagation rate by 21.3 to 25.9 percentage points relative to the base configuration with verification and the prior disabled. On CHOICE-420, it improves overall accuracy over direct answering by 5.71 percentage points on average across 11 backbone models. On EarthBench, it reduces the tool-call ratio by 25.9% relative to Earth-Agent.

AI.tldr: 本文分析遥感智能体工具观测的可靠性问题：在三个基准上至少88.1%的任务依赖工具观测，其中至少22.7%存在错误观测，且错误在至少82.0%的受影响任务中传播至最终答案。为此提出RSure-Agent，通过可验证观测协议与任务-工具可靠性先验来验证观测、抑制错误传播。
AI.motivation: 遥感智能体依赖感知、测量与栅格分析工具完成地球观测任务，其关于地物的判断与量化结果称为工具观测。但工具即便成功执行，其观测仍可能不确定甚至错误；一旦智能体接受错误观测，错误会沿后续推理传播并导致任务失败。作者通过分析1,229条执行轨迹，量化了这一问题的普遍性与严重程度，从而提出验证与抑制错误传播的需求。
AI.method: 提出RSure-Agent框架：1）引入可验证观测协议，要求工具返回过程证据供智能体核验其观测；2）基于离线任务反馈构建任务-工具可靠性先验，汇总各工具配置在不同任务类型上的历史表现，作为面向具体任务的验证参考；3）结合过程证据与先验，决定接受观测、请求补充证据或拒绝观测。
AI.result: 在EarthBench、ThinkGeo、TerraLogic与CHOICE-420上评估。在三个智能体基准上，相较禁用验证与先验的基础配置，RSure-Agent将错误传播率降低21.3至25.9个百分点；在CHOICE-420上，跨11个骨干模型平均较直接回答提升5.71个百分点准确率；在EarthBench上，相较Earth-Agent将工具调用比例降低25.9%。
AI.conclusion: 工具观测错误在遥感智能体任务中普遍存在且易于传播，构成任务失败的重要来源。RSure-Agent通过过程证据验证与任务-工具可靠性先验，有效抑制错误传播、提升多基准准确率并减少冗余工具调用，表明对工具观测进行显式验证是提升遥感智能体可靠性的有效途径。

title: One Tile, Multiple Instances: Rethinking MIL for Sparse Diagnostic Evidence
summary: In weakly supervised Whole Slide Image (WSI) classification, feature extractors typically compress each image tile into a single global embedding. Consequently, slide-level aggregators are restricted to this coarse tile scale, concealing fine-grained sub-tile evidence from the attention mechanism. We introduce DI-MIL, a framework that decouples encoding context from instance granularity through decomposed instances. By clustering dense spatial tokens from a frozen foundation model within each tile, DI-MIL converts a single tile into multiple independently weighted instance embeddings. As a training-free post-encoding module, DI-MIL integrates seamlessly into existing pipelines without requiring re-encoding or downstream architectural modifications. We evaluate DI-MIL on cytopathology, a challenging testbed where sparse diagnostic signals are easily diluted within standard tiles. Across four datasets, three frozen foundation models, and two attention-based aggregators, DI-MIL demonstrates consistent efficacy, improving 67 of 72 metric-level comparisons, with the largest mean gains reaching 3.64 points under cytopathology-specific backbones. In a broader comparison against seven representative MIL baselines, DI-MIL paired with ACMIL achieves highest mean performance in 33 of 36 backbone-dataset-metric comparisons. Ablations show that direct smaller tiling inflates the extracted tile count by up to 43.3$\times$ with non-monotonic performance, whereas DI-MIL incurs zero additional image-extraction overhead while achieving the strongest overall results. These results establish instance construction as an orthogonal design dimension in MIL, supporting DI-MIL as a cost-efficient solution under sparse diagnostic evidence.

AI.tldr: DI-MIL通过聚类瓦片内稠密空间token,将单个瓦片分解为多个可独立加权的实例嵌入,作为免训练的后编码模块,在保持零额外图像提取开销的前提下显著提升弱监督WSI分类性能。
AI.motivation: 现有WSI分类的特征提取器将每个图像瓦片压缩为单一全局嵌入,导致滑片级聚合器被限制在粗粒度瓦片尺度上,细粒度的亚瓦片证据被注意力机制掩盖。在细胞病理学等诊断信号稀疏的场景中,这一问题尤为严重。
AI.method: DI-MIL将编码上下文与实例粒度解耦:对冻结基础模型在每个瓦片内产生的稠密空间token进行聚类,把单个瓦片转换为多个可独立加权的实例嵌入。该模块作为免训练的后编码组件,可无缝集成到现有流程中,无需重新编码或修改下游网络结构。
AI.result: 在4个数据集、3个冻结基础模型、2种基于注意力的聚合器上,DI-MIL在72项指标级对比中提升了67项,细胞病理学专用骨干上最大平均增益达3.64个百分点。与7种代表性MIL基线相比,DI-MIL+ACMIL在36项骨干-数据集-指标组合中有33项取得最高平均性能。消融显示直接采用更小瓦片会使提取瓦片数膨胀最多43.3倍且性能非单调,而DI-MIL零额外图像提取开销却获得最佳整体结果。
AI.conclusion: 实例构建是MIL中一个正交的设计维度,DI-MIL可作为诊断证据稀疏场景下的高性价比解决方案。

title: Enhancing Long-Video VLM Embeddings with Query-Aware Streaming Latent Reasoning
summary: Long-video embedding requires capturing sparse query-relevant evidence under a limited visual-token budget. Uniform sampling can miss brief events in videos spanning minutes or hours, whereas encoding more frames in a single context increases memory and computation. We introduce \textbf{Query-Aware Streaming Latent Reasoning} (QASLR), a post-training framework that accumulates evidence across clips while keeping the embedding size fixed. QASLR selects a bounded set of frames, restores their temporal order, and processes them clip by clip with a vision-language backbone. A compact set of persistent think tokens cross-attends to each clip's features, while an embed token reads out a normalized representation after every update. This design integrates evidence across multiple backbone calls without requiring all selected frames to share a single context. Training combines final contrastive learning, step-wise contrastive supervision, and final-embedding self-distillation. Intermediate supervision trains partial-video readouts for retrieval, while self-distillation regularizes them toward the final representation. Query-aware selection produces query-conditioned representations for candidate-set scoring and reranking, whereas query-independent selection enables reusable corpus indexing. Under the full training recipe, HourVideo retrieval Hit@1 increases from 54.2 to 70.7 and from 57.4 to 72.8 for 2B and 8B Qwen3-VL-Embedding backbones, respectively. Gains extend to the evaluated moment-retrieval and video-QA tasks, and the streaming head transfers to a second Qwen-family embedding backbone. These results support streaming latent aggregation as an effective approach to integrating long-video evidence into fixed-dimensional representations.

AI.tldr: 提出QASLR训练框架，通过流式潜在推理在固定嵌入维度下跨片段累积证据，显著提升长视频检索性能。
AI.motivation: 长视频嵌入需在有限视觉token预算下捕获稀疏的查询相关证据。均匀采样会遗漏数分钟至数小时视频中的简短事件，而在单一上下文中编码更多帧又会增加内存与计算开销。
AI.method: QASLR先选取有界帧集合、恢复时序，再用视觉-语言骨干逐片段处理。一组紧凑的持久think tokens对每个片段特征做交叉注意力，embed token在每次更新后读出归一化表示，从而在多次骨干调用间整合证据而无需共享同一上下文。训练结合最终对比学习、逐步对比监督与最终嵌入自蒸馏；查询相关选择生成查询条件表示用于候选评分与重排序，查询无关选择支持可复用语料索引。
AI.result: 在完整训练方案下，2B与8B Qwen3-VL-Embedding骨干的HourVideo检索Hit@1分别从54.2升至70.7、从57.4升至72.8。增益还扩展到所评估的moment-retrieval与video-QA任务，且流式头可迁移至第二个Qwen家族嵌入骨干。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将流式潜在聚合作为把长视频证据整合进固定维度表示的有效方法。

title: Reflection-Robust 6DoF Object Tracking with Light Fields
summary: Tracking the 6DoF pose of a moving rigid object is fundamental to robotics and autonomous driving, but existing trackers assume that object appearance is stable across a sequence, an assumption that breaks down on reflective surfaces whose appearance changes as they mirror the environment. We introduce a light field based reflection-robust 6DoF tracker that turns this apparent nuisance into a pose cue. Per frame, our method recovers depth robustly against reflections, back-projects it into a point cloud, and estimates surface normals. It then decomposes the object's view-dependent appearance into a diffuse albedo and the environment map it reflects, resulting in a relightable surface light field. Starting from a coarse initialization, we relight it by the recovered environment map and optimize the pose on the photometric loss. Because a moving object mirrors new parts of the scene, the environment map fills in as the sequence proceeds, sharpening this signal over time. To evaluate this approach, we introduce a light field tracking dataset re-rendered from a robotic manipulation benchmark at four controlled reflectivity levels, each paired with simulated depth that reproduces how consumer RGB-D sensors fail on shiny surfaces. Additionally, we evaluate on two captured light field sequences. Our method trails the strongest baselines on diffuse objects and is the only one that holds its accuracy on fully reflective objects, where every baseline degrades.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于光场的反射鲁棒6DoF跟踪器，将镜面反射的外观变化转化为位姿线索：逐帧恢复抗反射深度、反投影点云并估计法线，将视角相关外观分解为漫反射反照率与所反射环境贴图得到可重光照表面光场，再以重光照后的光度损失优化位姿；环境贴图随序列推进逐步补全使信号增强。并发布一个四级反射率的机器人操作光场跟踪数据集。方法在漫反射物体上略逊于最强基线，但在全反射物体上是唯一保持精度的方案。
AI.motivation: 现有6DoF跟踪器假设物体外观在序列中保持稳定，这一假设在反射表面上失效（外观随镜像环境变化）。论文将这一"干扰"转化为位姿线索，以解决高反射物体跟踪精度下降的问题。
AI.method: 1) 逐帧恢复对反射鲁棒的深度，反投影为点云并估计表面法线；2) 将视角相关外观分解为漫反射反照率与所反射的环境贴图，形成可重光照的表面光场；3) 从粗初始化出发，用恢复的环境贴图进行重光照，在光度损失上优化位姿；4) 运动物体不断镜像新场景区域，环境贴图随之补全，使跟踪信号随时间增强。
AI.result: 在漫反射物体上略逊于最强基线；在完全反射物体上是唯一保持精度的方案，而所有基线均出现精度退化。实验包括从机器人操作基准重渲染的光场跟踪数据集（四种受控反射率水平，并配以模拟消费级RGB-D传感器在光亮表面失效的深度）以及两个实拍光场序列。
AI.conclusion: 利用反射的环境贴图作为光度线索可显著提升高反射物体的6DoF跟踪鲁棒性，且信号随序列推进自我增强；同时在漫反射场景中保持竞争力。

title: PWM: Personalized World Models with Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Pretrained world models can generate diverse environments, yet users often want to explore a particular scene specified by their own video. This requires learning the scene's visual identity while retaining the quality of action-conditioned generation. We introduce Personalized World Models (PWM), a framework for customizing interactive world models from short scene videos through online reinforcement learning. In PWM, the support trajectory and its associated controls provide reward feedback on continuations sampled from the current policy. In the GRPO instantiation, group-relative optimization updates a compact LoRA adapter using a unified reward for scene appearance, visual continuity, and motion, while base-policy anchoring regularizes changes to the pretrained generation prior of a frozen Yume-5B backbone. The same adaptation procedure is applied across real and rendered environments. We also instantiate PWM with DiffusionNFT as an alternative reward-guided optimization method for learning the scene-specific adapter. We also introduce PWM-Bench, comprising 150 customization tasks across Indoor, Outdoor, and Gaming, with paired evaluation on held-out continuations. The GRPO and DiffusionNFT instantiations of PWM improve customization over native Yume in 71.3% and 65.3% of the evaluated scenes, respectively, with positive mean gains across all three domains. For the GRPO instantiation, matched SFT comparisons further demonstrate higher mean customization gains and better mean image-quality scores in every domain, while retaining frame-level visual quality close to the pretrained model.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出个性化世界模型PWM，基于短视频和在线强化学习定制交互式世界模型，在Yume-5B上以LoRA适配，并构建PWM-Bench基准。
AI.motivation: 预训练世界模型虽能生成多样环境，但用户常希望探索由其提供的特定视频所指定的场景，这要求在保留动作条件生成质量的同时学习该场景的视觉特征。现有方法难以兼顾场景个性化与生成质量。
AI.method: PWM框架：以支持轨迹及其关联控制为奖励信号，对当前策略生成的续帧进行采样评估；GRPO实例中，采用组相对优化更新紧凑的LoRA适配器，使用统一奖励（场景外观、视觉连续性、运动），并通过基策略锚定正则化冻结Yume-5B骨干的预训练生成先验；同一适配流程应用于真实与渲染环境；另以DiffusionNFT实现PWM作为替代奖励引导优化方法；并提出PWM-Bench，覆盖室内、室外、游戏三类共150个定制任务，在留出续帧上配对评估。
AI.result: PWM的GRPO与DiffusionNFT实例分别在71.3%和65.3%的评估场景中优于原生Yume，三个领域均取得正向平均增益；GRPO实例在匹配SFT对比中于各领域均获得更高的平均定制增益和更好的平均图像质量分数，同时保持接近预训练模型的帧级视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过在线强化学习与轻量适配器，PWM能够从短视频高效定制交互式世界模型，在提升场景个性化的同时保持预训练生成质量，且方法可跨真实与渲染环境及不同优化算法迁移。

title: TRACE: Time-Adaptive Residual Attention Control with Content-Style Decomposition for Training-Free Diffusion Style Transfer
summary: Reference-guided style transfer aims to preserve the semantic structure of a content image while transferring the visual appearance of a style reference. Recent diffusion-based methods achieve impressive stylization quality by exploiting strong pretrained generative priors. However, training-free approaches still face a difficult trade-off among style fidelity, content preservation, and content leakage. Direct style injection may unintentionally transfer semantic content from the style image, while fixed guidance schedules often ignore the time- and state-dependent nature of diffusion sampling. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE, a training-free diffusion style transfer framework with Time-adaptive Residual Attention Control and Content-Style Decomposition. TRACE first performs offline CLIP-based subspace analysis to separate content and style directions from paired data. During inference, it removes content-related components from the style reference and style-related components from the content reference to reduce leakage. It then injects style information through residual cross-attention and applies uncertainty-aware guidance to adapt the guidance signal at each denoising step. Experiments show that TRACE achieves a favorable trade-off between stylization and preservation. Compared with optimal-control-based baselines, TRACE substantially improves style fidelity (+17.28 CSD and +34.10 SRA). While, compared with stylization methods, it better preserves content structure (+12.80 DINO, +5.52 CLIP-I, and -8.19 LPIPS) and reduces directional semantic leakage by 29.5% in DCL. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/pixelchemy-research/TRACE.

AI.tldr: TRACE是一种无需训练的扩散风格迁移框架，通过时间自适应残差注意力控制与内容-风格分解，缓解风格保真、内容保持与内容泄漏之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有免训练扩散风格迁移方法存在两难：直接注入风格易从风格图引入语义内容（内容泄漏），而固定引导调度忽略了扩散采样中引导信号随时间与状态变化的特性，导致风格保真、内容保持与泄漏三者难以兼顾。
AI.method: TRACE先离线进行基于CLIP的子空间分析，从成对数据中分离内容方向与风格方向；推理时从风格参考中去除内容相关成分、从内容参考中去除风格相关成分以降低泄漏；再通过残差交叉注意力注入风格信息，并采用不确定性感知引导，在每一步去噪中自适应调整引导信号。
AI.result: 相比最优控制基线，风格保真度显著提升（CSD +17.28，SRA +34.10）；相比风格化方法，更好保持内容结构（DINO +12.80，CLIP-I +5.52，LPIPS -8.19），并在DCL指标上降低方向性语义泄漏29.5%。
AI.conclusion: TRACE无需训练即可在风格化与内容保持之间取得更优权衡，同时有效抑制内容泄漏，代码已开源。

title: Robust Tensor Completion via Reflective Convolution Nuclear Norm Minimization
summary: Robust tensor completion recovers multidimensional data from partial observations corrupted by sparse gross errors. Existing convolutional low-rank models typically construct translated copies using circular continuation, which introduces artificial wrap-around neighborhoods for finite nonperiodic data. We propose reflective convolution nuclear norm minimization (RCNNM), which replaces circular shifts with endpoint-nonrepeating reflection. The resulting lifting has nonuniform entry multiplicities and satisfies a weighted Gram identity that supports both the recovery analysis and the optimization method. Under random sampling and sparse corruption, we establish high-probability exact recovery of the underlying tensor and sparse errors, together with stability under bounded dense perturbations. We further develop a two-block ADMM with a closed-form entrywise tensor update, while singular-value thresholding is implemented through the smaller right Gram matrix. Experiments on synthetic tensors, BSDS color images, and CAVE multispectral images show that RCNNM consistently improves over its circular-lifting counterpart, with the clearest gains near image boundaries. In particular, average boundary-PSNR improvements reach 3.26 dB while global reconstruction quality remains competitive.

AI.tldr: 提出反射卷积核范数最小化（RCNNM），用端点不重复反射替代循环平移构造低秩模型，实现鲁棒张量补全并改善边界重建。
AI.motivation: 现有卷积低秩模型通过循环延拓构造平移副本，会为有限非周期数据引入人为的环绕邻域，在图像边界处产生失真，亟待一种更符合有限数据边界特性的卷积构造方式。
AI.method: 以端点不重复反射（reflection）替代循环移位构造 lifted 矩阵，得到非均匀元素重数并满足加权 Gram 恒等式，从而支撑恢复分析与优化算法；据此建立随机采样与稀疏误差下的高概率精确恢复理论与有界稠密扰动稳定性；设计双块 ADMM，采用闭式逐元素张量更新，并借助较小的右 Gram 矩阵实现奇异值阈值化。
AI.result: 在合成张量、BSDS 彩色图像与 CAVE 多光谱图像上，RCNNM 稳定优于循环 lifting 对应方法，边界处增益最显著，平均边界 PSNR 提升最高达 3.26 dB，同时全局重建质量保持有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 反射卷积 lifting 通过消除循环延拓的伪环绕效应，在理论与算法上均可支撑鲁棒张量补全，并显著提升边界区域的重建精度。

title: Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization for Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
summary: Preference alignment has become a standard practice for text-to-image diffusion models. Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) simplifies this process by eliminating explicit reward modeling. Its diffusion variant, Diffusion-DPO, has become a widely adopted baseline. Diffusion-DPO essentially encourages the likelihood of preferred samples while suppressing dispreferred ones. In this paper, we revisit DPO-style alignment methods for diffusion models from the perspective of the manifold hypothesis. Under this view, natural images concentrate near a low-dimensional manifold embedded in the high-dimensional ambient space, whereas DPO directly optimizes preference distributions in the full space without accounting for this geometric structure. This creates a mismatch in the optimization dynamics: it suppresses geometry-preserving tangential updates, while insufficiently restricting hazardous normal-direction updates. This mismatch gradually degrades image quality and diversity. To address this issue, we propose Anisotropic Geometry-Aware Preference Optimization (APO), which replaces the uniform Euclidean treatment of prediction errors with a geometry-aware anisotropic metric derived from the reference model. Concretely, APO adaptively strengthens regularization in directions where the reference denoising function is highly sensitive, while relaxing constraints in directions that permit safe semantic adjustment. This recalibrates preference optimization according to the local manifold geometry, and maintains the original manifold structure. Experiments show that APO achieves strong performance and an average win rate exceeding 60\% against various existing alignment methods across diverse benchmarks. It requires significantly fewer training steps than prior methods, and preserves generation diversity throughout training.

AI.tldr: 从流形假设视角重新审视扩散模型的DPO式偏好对齐，指出其在全空间优化导致切向/法向更新失配，进而提出几何感知的各向异性偏好优化APO。
AI.motivation: Diffusion-DPO已成为文本到图像扩散模型偏好对齐的常用基线，其本质上是在全空间中直接优化偏好分布，未考虑自然图像集中于低维流形的几何结构。这种忽略几何的做法造成优化动态失配：抑制了保持几何的切向更新，却未能充分约束有害的法向更新，从而逐步损害图像质量与多样性。
AI.method: 提出各向异性几何感知偏好优化（APO）。用基于参考模型的几何感知各向异性度量替代对预测误差的统一欧氏处理：在参考去噪函数高度敏感的方向上自适应加强正则化，在允许安全语义调整的方向上放松约束，使偏好优化依据局部流形几何重新校准。
AI.result: 在多个基准上对多种现有对齐方法取得平均胜率超过60%的强劲表现；所需训练步数显著少于先前方法，并在整个训练过程中保持生成多样性。
AI.conclusion: 从流形假设出发可统一解释DPO式扩散对齐的失效机制，APO通过几何感知的各向异性正则有效修正优化动态，在提升对齐效果的同时降低训练成本并维持生成多样性。

title: VisualErase: Dual-Branch Visual Trajectory Redirection for Robust Concept Erasure in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models
