summary: Concept erasure is essential for the safe deployment of text-to-image diffusion models, as they may reproduce harmful, copyrighted, or privacy-sensitive content learned from unconstrained large-scale data. Existing methods typically erase unwanted concepts while preserving general generation capability by redirecting target-related text-to-image mappings. However, recent studies show that erased models may still retain visual generative trajectories of target concepts, leaving them vulnerable to adversarial recovery attacks and revealing a fundamental gap between redirecting text-to-image mappings and truly removing visual knowledge. To bridge this gap, we propose VisualErase, a new paradigm that redirects concept-bearing visual generative trajectories toward explicitly defined concept-removed outcomes. To enable this redirection, we use structure-preserving image editing to construct content-aligned, concept-removed counterparts for source images, providing explicit visual endpoints that retain non-target content. We then derive a denoising target from each source-to-counterpart pair and use a dual-branch redirection loss to align both text-conditioned and unconditional predictions with this target, since conditional supervision alone does not explicitly constrain generation without textual guidance. To mitigate the adverse effects of concept erasure on non-target generation, we jointly optimize the redirection loss with a counterpart retention loss that matches denoising predictions from the frozen pretrained model. Across style, celebrity, and nudity erasure, VisualErase limits the maximum attack success rate over seven attacks to 0%, 8%, and 0.1%, respectively, while retaining general generation quality. These results highlight the importance of visual trajectory redirection for robust concept erasure beyond text-to-image mappings alone.

AI.tldr: 提出VisualErase新范式，通过重定向承载概念的视觉生成轨迹实现稳健的概念擦除，在风格、名人、裸露擦除任务上大幅降低攻击成功率并保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 文本到图像扩散模型可能复现从大规模无约束数据中学到的有害、受版权保护或隐私敏感内容，因此概念擦除对安全部署至关重要。现有方法主要通过重定向目标相关的文本到图像映射来擦除概念并保持通用生成能力，但近期研究表明被擦除模型仍保留目标概念的视觉生成轨迹，易受对抗恢复攻击，揭示了"重定向文本到图像映射"与"真正移除视觉知识"之间的根本差距。
AI.method: 提出VisualErase范式，将承载概念的视觉生成轨迹重定向到明确定义的"概念移除"结果：1）用结构保持的图像编辑为源图像构造内容对齐、概念移除的对应图，提供保留非目标内容的显式视觉端点；2）从每对源图-对应图导出去噪目标，采用双分支重定向损失，同时对齐文本条件与无条件预测，因仅条件监督无法显式约束无文本引导的生成；3）联合优化重定向损失与对应图保持损失（匹配冻结预训练模型的去噪预测），以缓解概念擦除对非目标生成的不利影响。
AI.result: 在风格、名人、裸露三类擦除任务上，VisualErase将七种攻击下的最大攻击成功率分别限制在0%、8%和0.1%，同时保持通用生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了视觉轨迹重定向对于超越单纯文本到图像映射的稳健概念擦除的重要性。

title: PortraitAes: Intent-Conditioned Structured Portrait Aesthetics Assessment
summary: Portrait aesthetic assessment assigns comparable scores according to how effectively human-centered images fulfill their photographic intent. These scores support data filtering, candidate selection, and preference modeling in image-generation pipelines. Existing methods typically predict a single aesthetic score or use general-purpose MLLMs without conditioning on photographic intent. This omission matters because the same blur, pose, lighting, or framing choice may serve one photographic intent but undermine another. These models thus learn context-agnostic aesthetic priors and yield inconsistent, inaccurate, misleading judgments for portraits with distinct photographic objectives. We introduce PortraitAes-Bench, an 11K-scale benchmark that decomposes this task into intent-conditioned subjudgments. Expert-authored rubrics define nine photographic intents, six first-level dimensions, and 22 secondary criteria. They support a structured pipeline for intent routing, specialist assessment, verification, and score fusion. Following this structure, we train PortraitAes with multi-task supervision. We then improve score comparability through Gaussian score calibration and within-dimension cross-image ranking. On the standard benchmark, PortraitAes achieves a Pearson correlation of 0.924 and a Spearman rank correlation of 0.934. On the hard-case set, its Pearson correlation is 0.829 and its Spearman rank correlation is 0.795. Across both sets, PortraitAes outperforms the evaluated general-purpose MLLMs and specialized aesthetic baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出意图条件化的人像美学评估基准PortraitAes-Bench与模型PortraitAes，在标准与难例集上均超越通用MLLM及专用美学基线。
AI.motivation: 现有人像美学评估方法多预测单一分数或使用未以摄影意图为条件的通用MLLM。然而同样的模糊、姿态、光照或构图选择在不同摄影意图下可能正面或负面，导致模型学到上下文无关的先验，对目标不同的人像给出不一致、不准确甚至误导的判断。
AI.method: 构建11K规模基准PortraitAes-Bench，将任务分解为意图条件下的子判断；由专家撰写评分细则，定义9种摄影意图、6个一级维度与22个二级准则，并支撑"意图路由—专家评估—验证—分数融合"的结构化流程。据此以多任务监督训练PortraitAes，再通过高斯分数校准与维度内跨图排序提升分数可比性。
AI.result: 标准基准上Pearson相关0.924、Spearman秩相关0.934；难例集上Pearson相关0.829、Spearman秩相关0.795。在两个集合上均优于所评估的通用MLLM与专用美学基线。
AI.conclusion: 以摄影意图为条件并配合结构化评估流程与分数校准，可显著提升人像美学评估的准确性与可比性。

title: EMBER-Bench: Benchmarking Cross-Event Causal Memory in Long-Horizon Embodied Tasks
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 14 tables. The first two authors contributed equally. Project page: https://zhaoalexgoat.github.io/EMBER-Bench/
summary: Lifelong physical agents must reason over extended interactions where past events continue to shape the world long after they disappear from view. Beyond recalling what happened, agents must infer how history changes the current state and constrains future actions. Yet existing embodied and video-memory benchmarks largely focus on historical retrieval and summary, leaving such history-dependent causal reasoning underexplored. We introduce EMBER-Bench, an egocentric benchmark for cross-event causal reasoning in long-horizon embodied tasks, for which we newly created the task design, video recording, and data annotation. It contains 189 household tasks and 699 QA pairs, spanning task progress, failure recovery, external interventions, and compound long-horizon tasks with distant dependencies and prerequisites, with fine-grained event and causal-chain annotations. EMBER-Bench evaluates reasoning in both directions: next-action prediction selects the next action from history, and causal traceback, given that action, identifies the historical event that makes it necessary. Input ablations that add action logs or privileged cause-and-consequence annotations to the video indicate which kind of historical information models fail to use. Among the 16 evaluated models, the highest overall accuracy is 61.2%, compared with a mean of 98.3% across two human evaluators. At paired decision points, correct traceback is not associated with correct next-action prediction. Adding action logs yields a gain of 1.6 points, whereas cause-and-consequence annotations yield an additional gain of 13.0 points on top of that. These results suggest that extracting causal information from past events and converting it into constraints on current actions remains a key difficulty for long-horizon embodied agents. Project Page: https://zhaoalexgoat.github.io/EMBER-Bench/

AI.tldr: EMBER-Bench是首个面向长时程具身任务的自我中心跨事件因果推理基准，包含189个家务任务与699个QA对，通过双向推理（下一步动作预测与因果回溯）及输入消融实验，揭示现有模型难以从历史事件中提取因果信息并转化为对当前动作的约束。
AI.motivation: 现有具身与视频记忆基准主要关注历史检索与总结，忽视了"历史如何改变当前状态并约束未来动作"这类依赖历史的因果推理，而终身物理智能体恰恰需要具备这种能力，因此该方面研究不足。
AI.method: 作者通过任务设计、视频录制与数据标注，构建了EMBLER-Bench（EMBER-Bench），涵盖任务进度、失败恢复、外部干预及具有远距离依赖和前置条件的复合长时程任务，配有细粒度事件与因果链标注。基准从两个方向评估推理：下一步动作预测（从历史中选择动作）与因果回溯（给定动作识别使其成为必要的历史事件）。此外设计输入消融实验，向视频中加入动作日志或特权因果注释，以判别模型未能利用的历史信息类型。
AI.result: 在16个被评估模型中，最高总体准确率为61.2%，而两名人类评估者平均为98.3%。在成对决策点上，正确的因果回溯与正确的下一步动作预测并不相关。加入动作日志带来1.6个百分点的提升，而进一步加入因果注释在此之上再带来13.0个百分点提升。
AI.conclusion: 从过往事件中提取因果信息并将其转化为对当前动作的约束，仍是长时程具身智能体的关键难点。

title: Look Where You Say You're Looking: Self-Grounded Attention for Visual Reasoning
summary: We introduce Self-Saliency, a method for training Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to increase the alignment between their visual attention and the image regions mentioned in their reasoning. Self-Saliency uses a grounding model to localize the objects mentioned in each reasoning step and treats the resulting areas as supervision for the model's visual attention. Previous work on steering visual attention determines target image regions based solely on the image and question. In contrast, we show that conditioning the target regions on the model's generated reasoning improves downstream performance. For proper evaluation, we build a unified, broad suite of 25 visual reasoning benchmarks, where we reproduce the results of previous methods. We find that Self-Saliency significantly outperforms both prior attention-steering methods and baselines that ground image-level text, achieving both a better average rank and a better mean score. Post-training analysis shows that the model primarily adapts its reasoning text to existing attention patterns, producing shorter steps that refer to larger regions. Nevertheless, when controlling for generated text, attention to grounded regions increases significantly across the relevant layer. Finally, we identify a consistent geometric bias in VLM visual attention toward the image border. However, our ablations show that Self-Saliency's gains cannot be explained by simply aligning attention with the center of the image, highlighting the importance of aligning visual attention with the regions mentioned in the model's reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出Self-Saliency方法，用grounding模型定位推理步骤中提到的对象，作为视觉注意力监督，提升VLM视觉注意力与推理提及区域的对齐，在25个视觉推理基准上取得更优表现。
AI.motivation: 已有视觉注意力引导方法仅依据图像和问题确定目标区域，未利用模型生成的推理内容；本文动机是证明以模型推理为条件来确定目标区域能提升下游性能。
AI.method: Self-Saliency：用grounding模型定位每个推理步骤中提到的对象，将其对应区域作为模型视觉注意力的监督信号；并构建包含25个视觉推理基准的统一评估套件，复现先前方法结果进行对比。
AI.result: Self-Saliency在平均排名和平均得分上均显著优于先前注意力引导方法及基于图像级文本grounding的基线；事后分析表明模型主要将推理文本适配到既有注意力模式，产生更短、指向更大区域的步骤，但在控制生成文本后，相关层对grounded区域的注意力显著增加；同时发现VLM视觉注意力存在朝向图像边界的几何偏置。
AI.conclusion: 将视觉注意力与模型推理中提及的区域对齐是性能提升的关键，该增益无法仅由对齐图像中心解释，凸显推理条件下区域监督的重要性。

title: Triggering Generalist Reasoning via Predictive Uncertainty for Dual-System VLA
summary: Dual-system Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models improve real-time robotic control by pairing a slow, reasoning-capable generalist with a fast specialist action expert. However, existing methods invoke the generalist at a fixed frequency, ignoring the fact that decision-making complexity varies throughout a rollout. This static strategy wastes computation in easy phases and can delay renewed reasoning when the scene changes unexpectedly. We propose TUD (Triggering generalist reasoning via predictive Uncertainty for Dual-system VLA), an adaptive inference framework that selectively skips unnecessary generalist calls. TUD measures the cross-step dispersion of action re-predictions at the upcoming chunk slot under the cached generalist context, as a predictive uncertainty signal. This signal captures how much the future action plan shifts as new observations arrive and is computed from forwards the architecture already runs, requiring neither manual phase labels nor an auxiliary uncertainty model. On VLA-Arena, it achieves a higher success rate at matched call budgets than alternative uncertainty baselines while maintaining low wall-clock overhead, and more consistently separates successful from failed rollouts. Also, TUD finds a more favorable cost-success trade-off than non-adaptive baselines, tracing an entire operating curve as a single threshold is varied, and substantially reduces VLM calls at matched success rate. The same trade-off appears in our real-robot experiments, where TUD cuts generalist calls by 75% relative to the strongest fixed-interval baseline while achieving an even higher success rate. Our results suggest that predictive uncertainty provides a practical criterion for adaptive reasoning in efficient VLA control.

AI.tldr: TUD 提出一种自适应推理框架，通过动作重预测的跨步离散度作为预测不确定性信号，动态决定是否调用双系统 VLA 中的通用推理器，从而在保持甚至提升成功率的同时大幅减少计算开销。
AI.motivation: 现有双系统 VLA 模型以固定频率调用通用推理器，忽略了决策复杂度在 rollout 过程中的变化。这种静态策略在简单阶段浪费算力，而在场景突变时又无法及时重新推理。
AI.method: TUD 在缓存的通用推理器上下文下，测量即将到来的 chunk 槽位上动作重预测的跨步离散度，将其作为预测不确定性信号。该信号反映未来动作计划随新观测到来而偏移的程度，且完全来自架构已有的前向计算，无需人工阶段标签或额外的辅助不确定性模型。
AI.result: 在 VLA-Arena 上，TUD 在匹配调用预算下成功率高于其他不确定性基线，同时保持较低的实际耗时开销，并更稳定地区分成功与失败的 rollout。相比非自适应基线，其成本-成功权衡更优，可通过调节单一阈值描绘完整工作曲线，并在匹配成功率下显著减少 VLM 调用。真实机器人实验中同样呈现该权衡：相比最强的固定间隔基线，TUD 将通用推理器调用减少 75%，且成功率更高。
AI.conclusion: 预测不确定性为高效 VLA 控制中的自适应推理提供了实用准则。

title: SPACE-CLIPv2: Decoding Local Geometry from Frozen CLIP for Monocular Depth Estimation
summary: Vision-language foundation models such as CLIP provide strong semantic representations, but their patch tokens are not directly optimized for dense metric geometry. SPACE-CLIP showed that frozen CLIP features can support monocular depth estimation through layer-group feature fusion, yet it leaves open how neighboring CLIP tokens should be combined to recover fine local structure. We present SPACE-CLIPv2, a frozen-backbone depth decoder that aggregates fixed local neighborhoods in CLIP token space. At selected decoder stages, the model samples a fixed token stencil, predicts aggregation weights, and injects the resulting response through a gated residual update. A token-space high-pass branch further preserves shallow local contrast. On NYU Depth V2, SPACE-CLIPv2 improves over a matched SPACE-CLIP baseline, while five-seed experiments consistently favor fixed over learned-offset sampling. Zero-shot iBims-1 evaluation further improves boundary and planar-geometry measures. These results support constrained local token aggregation as a practical mechanism for decoding geometry from frozen CLIP representations.

AI.tldr: SPACE-CLIPv2 提出一种冻结骨干的深度解码器，通过在 CLIP token 空间进行固定局部邻域聚合来提升单目深度估计的细节结构恢复能力。
AI.motivation: CLIP 等视觉-语言基础模型具备强语义表征，但其 patch token 并未针对稠密度量几何进行直接优化。SPACE-CLIP 虽证明冻结 CLIP 特征可经层组特征融合支持深度估计，但如何组合相邻 CLIP token 以恢复精细局部结构仍未明确。
AI.method: 在选定解码阶段采样固定 token stencil，预测聚合权重，并通过门控残差更新注入响应；另设 token 空间高通分支以保留浅层局部对比。整体保持冻结 CLIP 骨干。
AI.result: 在 NYU Depth V2 上优于匹配的 SPACE-CLIP 基线；五种子实验一致支持固定采样优于学习偏移采样；零样本 iBims-1 评估在边界与平面几何指标上进一步提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，受约束的局部 token 聚合是从冻结 CLIP 表征中解码几何信息的有效实用机制。

title: Code2Games: Enabling Coding Agents for Gaming World Generation
summary: Generating a high-quality gaming world from a natural-language game intent requires joint reasoning about scene structure, spatial layout, gameplay objectives, interactive entities, and executable gameplay logic. Existing coding agents can generate individual assets, scenes, or scripts, but often struggle to maintain consistency across these components. We propose Code2Games, an agentic framework that builds a structured gaming world upon a base Blender world generated from the same game intent. Code2Games coordinates scene analysis, gameplay planning, constrained gaming-world generation, and gaming-engine customization through a shared scene-gameplay representation with persistent element correspondence. After world generation, Code2Games adapts the generated world to Unreal Engine 5 and employs an execution-guided reconstruction process that uses compilation diagnostics, runtime feedback, and gameplay test results to resolve inconsistencies arising during engine adaptation. To systematically evaluate gaming-world generation, we introduce the GameCode4D benchmark, which comprises ten fixed game prompts spanning different levels of scene and gameplay complexity. We evaluate the generated results across four dimensions: visual quality, interactive fidelity, multimodal artifact quality, and playable-game quality. Experiments demonstrate that, compared with direct gaming-world generation by coding agents and existing baseline methods, Code2Games consistently improves the visual quality and interactive fidelity of generated gaming worlds, as well as the quality of the resulting games after engine adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出Code2Games智能体框架，从自然语言游戏意图出发构建结构化游戏世界：以Blender基础世界为起点，通过共享的场景-玩法表示协调场景分析、玩法规划、受限生成与引擎定制，并借助执行引导的重建流程适配UE5；同时发布GameCode4D基准，实验证明其在视觉质量、交互保真度及可玩游戏质量上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: 从自然语言游戏意图生成高质量游戏世界需联合推理场景结构、空间布局、玩法目标、交互实体与可执行玩法逻辑。现有编码智能体虽能生成单个资产、场景或脚本，但难以在这些组件间保持一致性与跨组件协调。
AI.method: Code2Games以同一游戏意图生成的Blender基础世界为底，采用共享的场景-玩法表示并维持元素持久对应关系，统一协调场景分析、玩法规划、约束式游戏世界生成与游戏引擎定制；世界生成后将其适配至Unreal Engine 5，并使用执行引导的重建流程，利用编译诊断、运行时反馈与玩法测试结果解决引擎适配过程中出现的不一致。
AI.result: 引入GameCode4D基准，包含十个固定游戏提示，覆盖不同场景与玩法复杂度，并从视觉质量、交互保真度、多模态产物质量与可玩游戏质量四个维度进行评估。实验表明，相比编码智能体直接生成游戏世界及现有基线方法，Code2Games在视觉质量、交互保真度及引擎适配后的游戏质量上均取得持续提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享场景-玩法表示与执行引导的引擎适配，Code2Games能有效提升从自然语言意图到可玩游戏世界的生成一致性与质量，且GameCode4D为系统性评估游戏世界生成提供了多维基准。

title: CoDG-Net: Structure-Guided Style Diffusion and Collaborative Learning to Mitigate Catastrophic Forgetting in Medical Image Domain Generalization
comment: Proceedings of the Thirty-Fifth International Joint Conference on Artificial Intelligence Main Track. Pages 1622-1630. https://doi.org/10.24963/ijcai.2026/181
summary: Domain Generalization (DG) for medical image segmentation is both highly challenging and critically important. However, existing medical DG methods largely overlook the issue of Catastrophic Forgetting (CF): \textbf{Models often sacrifice their ability to retain source-domain knowledge while pursuing cross-domain robustness.} This can directly threaten diagnostic safety in already-deployed clinical scenarios. To address this, we investigate data augmentation strategies and catastrophic forgetting for medical image DG segmentation. First, we propose a structure-guided style diffusion augmentation method. Constrained by anatomical structure consistency in the frequency domain, this method performs cross-domain diffusion on the amplitude spectrum, generating samples with more diverse and broader style coverage to better support domain generalization. Then, we design a collaborative learning network with a dual-branch interactive architecture (CoDG-Net), together with a novel learning bias-guided strategy that adaptively regulates knowledge transfer at both the layer level and the task level, thereby effectively mitigating catastrophic forgetting on the source domain. Experiments and ablation studies on single-source and multi-source medical DG benchmark datasets demonstrate that CoDG-Net not only outperforms existing state-of-the-art methods in target-domain segmentation performance, but also achieves a lower forgetting rate on the source-domain data. The code is available at: https://github.com/wangprocess/CoDG-Net.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对医学图像分割的域泛化（DG）中忽视的灾难性遗忘问题，提出结构引导的风格扩散增强方法与双分支协作学习网络CoDG-Net，在提升目标域分割性能的同时降低源域遗忘率。
AI.motivation: 现有医学域泛化方法大多忽视灾难性遗忘问题：模型在追求跨域鲁棒性时牺牲了对源域知识的保留能力，这在已部署的临床场景中会直接威胁诊断安全性。因此作者希望同时兼顾跨域泛化与源域知识保持。
AI.method: 方法包含两部分：1）结构引导的风格扩散增强方法，在频域以解剖结构一致性为约束，对幅度谱进行跨域扩散，生成风格覆盖更广、更多样的样本以支撑域泛化；2）设计双分支交互架构的协作学习网络CoDG-Net，并提出学习偏置引导策略，在层级别与任务级别自适应调控知识迁移，从而缓解源域灾难性遗忘。
AI.result: 在单源与多源医学域泛化基准数据集上的实验与消融研究表明，CoDG-Net在目标域分割性能上优于现有最先进方法，同时在源域数据上取得了更低的遗忘率。
AI.conclusion: 通过结构约束的风格扩散增强与偏置引导的协作学习，可有效缓解医学DG分割中的灾难性遗忘，实现目标域性能与源域保持能力的双重提升；代码已开源。

title: Salvation Lies Within: Eliciting Inherent Style Transfer in Step-Distilled Diffusion Models
summary: Adapting step-distilled text-to-image (T2I) models through post-training incurs additional computational costs and affects native few-step generation behavior. This motivates a complementary route beyond style-specific adaptation: drawing on the visual knowledge already encoded in step-distilled T2I models to elicit stylistic capabilities through language. Pursuing this direction requires textual guidance that captures how visual attributes jointly define a style and remain applicable as the depicted content changes. To explore this approach, we introduce StyleForge, a fully automatic, training-free framework that expresses reference styles as reusable rendering instructions. By integrating overall rendering characteristics with local color and lighting behavior, StyleForge organizes visual evidence from reference images into a coherent specification of how the target style should be expressed. The specification is then compiled into textual guidance that can be reused across content prompts, enabling frozen step-distilled T2I models to render different subjects and scenes in the reference style while retaining native few-step generation. Extensive experiments show relative gains of up to 29.47\% in generation quality scores over the strongest baseline, while Pareto analysis indicates that improved stylization is accompanied by strong adherence to the requested content.

AI.tldr: 提出StyleForge：一种全自动、免训练框架，将参考风格表达为可复用的渲染指令文本，使冻结的步数蒸馏T2I模型在保持原生少步生成能力的同时实现风格化。
AI.motivation: 通过后训练适配步数蒸馏的文本到图像（T2I）模型会带来额外计算开销，并破坏其原生少步生成行为。因此需要一条不同于风格特定适配的补充路径：利用步数蒸馏T2I模型已编码的视觉知识，通过语言来激发风格能力。该方向的关键在于获取能刻画视觉属性如何共同定义风格、且在内容变化时仍适用的文本引导。
AI.method: StyleForge为全自动、免训练框架，将参考风格表达为可复用的渲染指令。它将整体渲染特征与局部色彩、光照行为相结合，把参考图像中的视觉证据组织为对目标风格表达方式的一致规格说明，再将该规格编译为可跨内容提示复用的文本引导，从而驱动冻结的步数蒸馏T2I模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，生成质量分数相较最强基线最多取得29.47%的相对提升；Pareto分析显示风格化效果提升的同时，对请求内容的遵循度依然很强。
AI.conclusion: 以文本引导方式激发步数蒸馏T2I模型的风格能力是可行且有效的，StyleForge在不重新训练、不损害原生少步生成的前提下实现了高质量风格化，并在质量与内容一致性之间取得良好平衡。

title: CGDD-Net: Context-Guided Dynamic Detail Modeling for Retinal Vessel Segmentation
summary: Accurate retinal vessel segmentation requires features that capture vascular geometry while preserving information for fine-scale reconstruction. We propose CGDD-Net, a context-guided dynamic detail modeling network that connects adaptive feature extraction to a shared decoder pathway. Context-Guided Scale-Adaptive Deformable Encoding (CSDE) combines fixed-grid convolution with deformable local attention to capture vascular patterns at multiple spatial extents. Spatially Adaptive Multi-Kernel Gating (SAMG) selects receptive-field responses at each location. Dynamic Cross-Scale Detail Fusion (DCDF) aligns the gated intermediate features and compresses them into an eight-channel representation, which is reused at three decoder resolutions together with selected encoder skips. This design consolidates intermediate information before decoding instead of transferring each middle-stage feature through a separate direct skip. On DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, STARE, and HRF, CGDD-Net achieves AUC values of 0.9824, 0.9938, 0.9895, and 0.9874, with F1 scores of 0.8323, 0.8102, 0.8510, and 0.8157, respectively. The complete model contains 1.96 million trainable parameters. In cumulative ablations, the full model improves F1 over the internal baseline by 2.48, 0.61, and 3.49 percentage points on DRIVE, CHASE\_DB1, and STARE. Twelve directed cross-dataset experiments further characterize transfer without target-domain adaptation. The results support shared intermediate detail delivery as an effective, parameter-compact architecture for retinal vessel segmentation. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/lixincheng-xcl/CGDD-Net}.

AI.tldr: 提出 CGDD-Net，通过上下文引导的动态细节建模与共享解码路径，实现参数紧凑、精度较高的视网膜血管分割。
AI.motivation: 视网膜血管分割既需捕获血管几何结构，又需保留细尺度重建信息，传统多尺度编码与逐级直接跳跃连接难以兼顾细节传递与参数效率。
AI.method: CGDD-Net 包含三个模块：CSDE 结合固定网格卷积与可变形局部注意力，捕获多空间范围的血管模式；SAMG 在每处位置选择感受野响应；DCDF 对齐门控中间特征并压缩为八通道表示，在三个解码器分辨率上复用，并配合选定的编码器跳跃连接。
AI.result: 在 DRIVE、CHASE_DB1、STARE、HRF 上 AUC 分别为 0.9824、0.9938、0.9895、0.9874，F1 分别为 0.8323、0.8102、0.8510、0.8157；模型含 196 万可训练参数。累积消融中，完整模型相较内部基线在 DRIVE、CHASE_DB1、STARE 上 F1 分别提升 2.48、0.61、3.49 个百分点，并完成 12 组定向跨数据集迁移实验。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，共享中间细节传递是一种有效且参数紧凑的视网膜血管分割架构。

title: ReMAP: Restoring the Perceptual Cycle with Reasoning-Time Latent Visual Memory
summary: As multimodal large language models (MLLMs) reason for longer, attention to the initial visual input diminishes, weakening visual grounding. Visual memory reintroduces visual evidence during reasoning. We conduct a controlled analysis of visual memory along three axes: curation, organization, and access. We find that local evidence benefits from global context, compact latent representations balance accuracy and visual-context cost, and the utility of memory access depends on the reasoning state. Guided by these findings, we propose ReMAP (Reasoning-Time Memory-Augmented Perception), which couples two complementary latent memories: a static, question-conditioned Global memory that preserves scene and cross-image context, and a dynamic Local memory that uses this context as an anchor while selecting and re-encoding region-level evidence according to the current reasoning state. Both memories return compact latent tokens inserted into the reasoning sequence, and a reinforcement-learning access policy trained with branched rollouts decides when to continue reasoning or invoke Global or Local memory. On ten benchmark families, ReMAP outperforms prior visual-memory methods on all four multi-image benchmarks, exceeding the strongest prior results on MuirBench and MIMIC by 8.38 and 14.84 percentage points. Across four backbone families, enabling memory access improves over the same trained model with memory disabled, and on shared V*Bench, CV-Bench-2D, and MuirBench questions ReMAP reduces the visual tokens entering the reasoning sequence by 51.0-76.8% relative to the native-resolution backbone. Further analyses show that Global and Local memory form distinct yet complementary latent representations. Together, these components restore the perceptual cycle by letting the reasoning state trigger targeted visual retrieval, with the retrieved evidence guiding subsequent reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ReMAP框架，通过静态全局记忆与动态局部记忆两种互补的潜在记忆，结合强化学习访问策略，在推理时按需检索视觉证据，缓解多模态大模型长推理中视觉grounding弱化的问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在推理链变长时，对初始视觉输入的注意力逐渐衰减，导致视觉grounding能力下降。视觉记忆虽可重新引入视觉证据，但其设计维度（curation、organization、access）缺乏系统性分析。
AI.method: 沿curation、organization、access三轴对视觉记忆进行受控分析，得出局部证据需全局上下文、紧凑潜在表示可平衡精度与视觉上下文开销、记忆访问效用依赖推理状态等结论。据此提出ReMAP：由问题条件化的静态Global记忆保存场景与跨图像上下文，动态Local记忆以其为锚点按当前推理状态选取并重编码区域级证据；两者均返回紧凑潜在token插入推理序列，并用branched rollouts训练的强化学习访问策略决定继续推理或调用Global/Local记忆。
AI.result: 在十个benchmark系列上，ReMAP在四个多图像benchmark上均优于先前视觉记忆方法，MuirBench和MIMIC分别超最强基线8.38和14.84个百分点；跨四个backbone系列，启用记忆访问优于同等训练但禁用记忆的模型；在V*Bench、CV-Bench-2D和MuirBench共享问题上，进入推理序列的视觉token较原生分辨率backbone减少51.0-76.8%。
AI.conclusion: Global与Local记忆形成不同但互补的潜在表示。二者协同使推理状态触发针对性视觉检索，检索到的证据再引导后续推理，从而重建感知循环。

title: LoopMoEVR: Loop-Based Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts for Unified UHD Video Restoration
summary: Recently, unified high-definition image restoration has attracted considerable attention; however, existing models tend to excessively increase their depth in pursuit of improved generalization, which often yields only limited gains. Meanwhile, loop-based learning paradigms have drawn widespread attention due to their low parameter counts and strong regression capability, as exemplified by GPT-6 and looped Transformers. In this paper, we introduce the loop learning paradigm to address restoration tasks that require cross-domain learning. Specifically, we propose LoopMoEVR, a loop-based mixture-of-experts model capable of handling degraded ultra-high-definition (UHD) inputs. First, a degradation-conditioned low-rank loop embedding is designed to construct input-dependent stage conditions. Second, a spatio-temporal iterative adaptive normalization module, termed IterAda3DN, is developed to fuse local features with global loop context, thereby performing position-wise affine modulation. Finally, the expert branches further integrate the attention-updated local and global video states with the loop conditions to generate dedicated modulation parameters, while an input-conditioned depth predictor adaptively configures the number of loop iterations. With only approximately 0.884M trainable parameters, the proposed model uniformly handles UHD video dehazing, deraining, denoising, and low-light enhancement tasks, achieving state-of-the-art restoration performance on both public benchmarks and real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出LoopMoEVR——基于循环学习的混合专家模型，以约0.884M可训练参数统一处理UHD视频去雾、去雨、去噪与低光增强，在公开基准与真实场景取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 统一高清图像/视频复原中，现有模型为提升泛化性往往盲目加深网络深度，但收益有限；同时循环学习范式（如循环Transformer）以低参数量、强回归能力受到关注，故将循环学习引入需跨域学习的复原任务。
AI.method: 1) 退化条件化低秩循环嵌入，构建依赖输入的阶段条件；2) IterAda3DN时空迭代自适应归一化，融合局部特征与全局循环上下文，实现逐位置仿射调制；3) 专家分支将注意力更新的局部/全局视频状态与循环条件结合生成专用调制参数，并由输入条件化深度预测器自适应配置循环迭代次数。
AI.result: 仅约0.884M可训练参数，即可统一处理UHD视频去雾、去雨、去噪、低光增强，在公开基准与真实场景均达到SOTA复原性能。
AI.conclusion: 将循环学习与混合专家结合，可在极低参数预算下实现跨域UHD视频复原的统一建模与自适应迭代，为高效高清复原提供了新范式。

title: PCLM: Small-target localization with frozen CLIP via prototype contrast and local magnification
summary: Small targets occupy few patches in a vision-language encoder, so spatial features often mix object appearance with surrounding content. We propose Prototype Contrast and Local Magnification (PCLM), a support-conditioned localization method that uses a frozen CLIP encoder. Five masked support images per class define foreground and background prototypes through equally weighted regional features. Their difference provides a shared scoring direction for query patches, explicitly comparing target evidence with the demonstrated background. Nine overlapping query windows are enlarged and encoded independently to sample small targets more densely. Reprojection and coverage averaging combine their scores into a continuous localization map. The class direction occupies 2 KiB regardless of support count and transfers unchanged across datasets with mapped categories. On 5,047 small-target queries from VOC, COCO, ADE20K and Oxford-IIIT Pets, PCLM achieves higher mean pixel AP than every evaluated text-conditioned localization baseline on each dataset under our evaluation protocol. Gains over the strongest scene-dataset baselines range from 5.63 to 13.23 percentage points. At comparable measured latency, local magnification improves scene small-target AP by 4.51 to 5.68 points over whole-canvas enlargement. Factorial experiments show that prototype contrast increases the benefit of local observation, including under matched image-coordinate filtering. Support-budget experiments show that additional examples refine category estimation without increasing representation size or query-time scoring cost.

AI.tldr: 提出PCLM方法：基于冻结CLIP编码器，用少量掩码支持图像构建前景/背景原型，通过原型对比提供共享评分方向，并对九个重叠窗口局部放大编码，融合为连续定位图，实现小目标定位。
AI.motivation: 小目标在视觉-语言编码器中占据的图块极少，空间特征常将目标外观与周围背景内容混杂，导致定位困难。
AI.method: 采用冻结CLIP编码器；每类用五张掩码支持图像，以等权区域特征定义前景与背景原型，其差值给出查询图块的共享评分方向；将九个重叠查询窗口放大并独立编码以更密集采样小目标；经重投影与覆盖平均融合为连续定位图。类别方向仅占2 KiB，且可跨数据集迁移。
AI.result: 在VOC、COCO、ADE20K、Oxford-IIIT Pets的5,047个查询上，平均像素AP均高于所有评测的文本条件定位基线，相对最强场景数据集基线提升5.63–13.23个百分点；同等延迟下局部放大比整体画布放大提升4.51–5.68点；因子实验显示原型对比增强局部观测收益；支持预算实验表明增加示例可细化类别估计而不增加表示尺寸或查询时评分成本。
AI.conclusion: PCLM通过原型对比与局部放大有效提升小目标定位精度，且表示紧凑、可迁移、查询成本不随支持样本增加而增长。

title: Representation--Behavior Alignment for Explainable Weakly-Supervised Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) provide a natural way to make video anomaly detection more explainable. However, their final decisions do not always fully use the discriminative information contained in their hidden states, an issue we refer to as representation--behavior misalignment. We decompose this gap into a capacity component that measures discriminative information never aggregated into the readout position, and a directional component that measures the angular mismatch between the optimal and the native normal--abnormal axis at that position. Across multiple video anomaly detection benchmarks and MLLM backbones the directional component dominates, and residual-stream tracing shows that native-axis separability rises sharply in several mid-to-late attention layers. Because both components are governed by attention rather than MLP updates, we propose Representation--Behavior Alignment (RBA), a parameter-efficient method that adapts those layers using video-level labels alone while updating about 0.012\% of the backbone parameters. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RBA improves native-readout performance and better aligns the model's decision direction with discriminative representations, and it produces anomaly decisions and explanations through a single generative process.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别出多模态大模型在视频异常检测中的"表征-行为错位"问题，将其分解为容量与方向两个分量，发现方向分量占主导且由注意力层控制，提出参数高效的RBA方法进行对齐。
AI.motivation: MLLM可为视频异常检测提供更可解释的判断，但其最终决策并未充分利用隐藏状态中的判别信息，即存在表征-行为错位（representation–behavior misalignment），亟需诊断并解决这一差距。
AI.method: 将错位分解为两个分量：容量分量（从未被聚合到读出位置的判别信息）与方向分量（读出位置处最优正常-异常轴与原生轴之间的角度失配）；通过残差流追踪定位关键层；提出RBA（Representation–Behavior Alignment），一种仅用视频级标签、仅更新约0.012%主干参数的参数高效微调方法，针对注意力层（而非MLP）进行适配。
AI.result: 在多个视频异常检测基准和多种MLLM主干上，方向分量占主导；原生轴可分性在中后部若干注意力层显著上升；三个基准上的实验表明RBA提升了原生读出性能，并使模型决策方向与判别表征更好对齐。
AI.conclusion: 错位主要由注意力层主导的方向失配造成，通过极小参数量的注意力层适配即可有效对齐表征与行为，且异常判定与解释可由单一生成过程统一产出。

title: RoMod: Temporal Routing Modulation via Mixture-of-Experts for Video Anomaly Detection
summary: Intermediate-layer features from multimodal large language models have shown strong potential for video anomaly detection (VAD), yet the origin of their discriminative power remains unclear. We study this question using sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models, whose explicit expert structure and sparse activation make their internal computation easier to inspect. With a fully frozen backbone and no additional training, we find that anomaly-related evidence is concentrated in a small set of experts. These experts recur across layers, spontaneously specialize in different anomaly types, and together form a dynamic routing subnetwork. We further show that the output channels most strongly influenced by these experts are also the hidden dimensions that contain the most anomaly-relevant information. Routing statistics can therefore serve as an internal anomaly cue that complements semantic features.Based on these findings, we propose RoMod, an efficient VAD framework trained with only \(5\%\) of weakly labeled videos. RoMod includes a Routing-Modulated Fusion module, RoMF, and a Routing-aware Temporal Network, RoTN. RoMF uses routing signals to adaptively recalibrate hidden semantic channels. Its design also prevents the routing branch from bypassing semantic features and making predictions on its own. RoTN captures the temporal evolution of anomalies from onset to persistence and termination. Experiments on three benchmarks show that RoMod achieves state-of-the-art performance while running substantially faster than dense backbones of comparable size.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多模态大模型中MoE中间层特征的异常判别力来源，发现异常证据集中于少数专家并形成动态路由子网络，据此提出仅用5%弱标签数据训练的VAD框架RoMod。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型中间层特征在视频异常检测（VAD）中潜力巨大，但其判别力来源不明；作者借助专家结构与稀疏激活更易观察的稀疏混合专家（MoE）模型来探究这一机理。
AI.method: 在完全冻结骨干且不额外训练的条件下，定位集中承载异常证据的少数专家，分析其跨层复现、按异常类型自发专门化并构成动态路由子网络的现象，并验证受这些专家影响最大的输出通道同时是异常信息最丰富的隐藏维度。基于此提出RoMod框架，含Routing-Modulated Fusion（RoMF）模块，用路由信号自适应重校准隐藏语义通道并防止路由分支绕过语义特征独立预测；以及Routing-aware Temporal Network（RoTN），建模异常从发生到持续再到终止的时间演化。
AI.result: 仅使用5%弱标签视频训练，在三个基准上达到state-of-the-art性能，且推理速度显著快于同等规模的稠密骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: MoE中的路由统计本身可作为补充语义特征的内部异常线索，为高效VAD提供了新的机理依据与框架设计范式。

title: How Does Geometry Enter Generated Motion?
comment: 43 pages, 13 figures, including supplementary material. Project page: https://liweihan1107.github.io/samelaw/
summary: Under a fixed physical law, the visible geometry of a scene determines how motion must change. We ask how video generators realize this relationship. We fix the law and the initial state and change only the geometry drawn in the first frame, within matched families of tracks and deflectors, and compare each generated trajectory with the simulator prediction for that geometry. Paired interventions change one thing at a time: a local bump, the height of a barrier, the words of the prompt, the length of the clip. Across nine image-to-video models, geometry is preserved and shapes the motion: the speed of the ball follows the drawn undulation of a track. A physical state would carry this response forward, and here the generated motion parts from the law. The mean slope barely accelerates the ball, successive contacts fail to compose through a consistent state, an edit ahead of the ball alters its motion before it arrives, and the ball climbs over barriers higher than its release point. Two global conditions organize the global trajectory: text strongly controls the destination, while clip length strongly controls timing in the open-weight models tested. The pattern persists with photographed first frames. Current video generation thus behaves as geometry-conditioned motion synthesis whose evolution of state differs systematically from that of a fixed physical law.

AI.tldr: 在固定物理定律下，通过成对干预改变首帧几何（轨迹起伏、障碍高度、提示词、片段长度），对九个图像到视频模型进行系统测试，发现模型能保留并响应几何，但状态演化系统性地偏离物理定律：速度不随平均坡度加速、连续接触不构成一致状态、未来编辑会提前影响球的运动、球能越过高于释放点的障碍。文本强烈控制目的地，片段长度在开放权重模型中强烈控制时序。
AI.motivation: 作者想探究：在物理定律固定的条件下，可见几何本应决定运动如何变化。视频生成模型能否建立"几何→运动"这一关系，以及其内部是否维持一个可延续的物理状态，是理解当前视频生成是否真正"懂物理"的关键问题。
AI.method: 固定物理定律与初始状态，仅改变首帧中绘制的几何，在匹配的轨迹与偏转器族内（小球、轨道、障碍等）进行成对干预，每次只改变一个变量：局部凸起、障碍高度、提示词、片段长度；将各模型生成的轨迹与模拟器对该几何的预测逐一对比。涵盖九个图像到视频模型，并使用实拍首帧进行验证。
AI.result: 几何被保留并影响运动：球速跟随轨道的起伏。但一旦需要物理状态来延续响应，生成运动就偏离定律。平均坡度几乎不加速小球；连续接触无法通过一致状态组合起来；位于球前方、球尚未到达处的编辑会提前改变其运动；球会爬过高于其释放点的障碍。全局层面，文本强烈控制目的地，片段长度在开放权重模型中对时序影响显著；该模式在实拍首帧下同样存在。
AI.conclusion: 当前视频生成表现为"几何条件化的运动合成"：它能把运动与可见几何绑定，但其状态演化与固定物理定律存在系统性差异。这提示模型缺乏持续、一致的物理状态表征，仅实现了表层的几何-运动关联。

title: SemCam: Semantic Camera Motion Control for Video Generation
summary: Controlling the camera relative to a moving subject in an existing video is challenging: behaviors such as maintaining a frontal view require the camera to adapt to the subject's changing position and orientation, making the desired trajectory difficult to specify in advance. Existing camera-controlled video-to-video methods typically rely on explicit trajectories or reference motions, which do not directly express these dynamic camera--subject relationships. We introduce semantic camera motion control, a novel video-to-video task in which a reference video and a target motion label specify the desired subject-relative camera behavior without an explicit target trajectory. Our method, SemCam, learns to realize this behavior while preserving source content. It combines shared-basis low-rank adaptation with motion-conditioned modulation, while a background-consistency loss encourages fidelity in regions visible in both reference and target videos. We construct 661 paired videos covering eight semantic camera behaviors and evaluate on a separate 109-scene benchmark using subject-relative motion metrics, appearance measures, and a user study. SemCam achieves a semantic-motion success rate of 68.6%, compared with 45.3% for Vista4D, the strongest evaluated baseline, while maintaining comparable subject identity preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出语义相机运动控制（semantic camera motion control）这一视频到视频新任务，并设计方法SemCam，通过参考视频与目标运动标签指定主体相对相机行为，在保持源内容的同时实现该类运动。
AI.motivation: 在既有视频中控制相机相对运动主体具有挑战性：维持正面视角等行为要求相机适应主体不断变化的位置与朝向，难以预先给定目标轨迹。现有相机控制视频到视频方法依赖显式轨迹或参考运动，无法直接表达这种动态的相机—主体关系。
AI.method: SemCam结合共享基低秩适配（shared-basis low-rank adaptation）与运动条件调制（motion-conditioned modulation），并引入背景一致性损失，以提升参考视频与目标视频共同可见区域的保真度。任务输入为参考视频与目标运动标签，不含显式目标轨迹。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖8种语义相机行为的661对视频，并在独立的109场景基准上使用主体相对运动指标、外观指标和用户研究进行评估。SemCam语义运动成功率达68.6%，最强基线Vista4D为45.3%，同时保持相当的主体身份保持能力。
AI.conclusion: 语义相机运动控制可作为一种有效的新视频到视频任务形式，SemCam在无需显式目标轨迹的情况下显著优于现有基线，并兼顾内容保真与主体身份保持。

title: Construction and Evaluation of Machine Learning Models for Near-Real-Time Fire Detection from MTG FCI Imagery
summary: Geostationary satellite observations are important for wildfire detection and monitoring. The current study evaluates machine learning models for MTG FCI near-real-time fire detection in 1- and 2-km spatial configurations and compares them with threshold-based algorithms. The models were trained and evaluated using VIIRS fire reference data across diverse ecological regions in Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. The key results are that 1-km models significantly outperform both their 2-km variants and operational threshold products. The constructed 1-km models achieved F1 scores higher by up to 0.36 compared to baseline products. Importantly, the 1-km models detected small fires with higher probability compared to competing models. Finally, the models robustly detected fires up to 260 min earlier than baseline products. To support opensource applications, our trained models are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了用于MTG FCI近实时火点检测的机器学习模型（1km与2km空间配置），并与阈值算法进行对比，结果表明1km模型显著优于2km变体及业务阈值产品，能以更高概率探测小火并最多提前260分钟发现火情。
AI.motivation: 静止气象卫星观测对野火探测与监测具有重要意义，需评估机器学习模型在MTG FCI近实时火点检测中的表现，并与传统阈值算法进行比较，以提升探测性能。
AI.method: 构建1km和2km两种空间配置的机器学习模型，使用VIIRS火点参考数据在欧洲、非洲和中东的多样生态区进行训练与评估，并与阈值型算法（业务产品）进行对比。
AI.result: 1km模型显著优于其2km变体及业务阈值产品，F1分数最高提升0.36；1km模型对小火点的探测概率更高；并且相比基线产品可最多提前260分钟探测到火情。
AI.conclusion: 1km空间配置的机器学习模型在MTG FCI近实时火点检测中具有明显优势，且训练模型已公开以支持开源应用。

title: Recurrent Latent Visual Search for GUI Grounding
summary: GUI grounding is a critical capability for GUI agents powered by vision-language models, helping them execute user instructions by locating the corresponding elements in screenshots. Single-step grounding struggles with small elements and dense layouts, motivating multi-step visual search. However, existing approaches commonly rely on textual reasoning misaligned with visual space or costly multi-round interactions with external visual tools. To make multi-step visual search an explicit spatial process within the model, we propose ReLaViS, which performs Recurrent Latent Visual Search in a single interaction round. At each step, a spatial search head uses the hidden state to query the screenshot's visual tokens, producing a spatial search distribution that explicitly represents the search focus. This distribution then aggregates the visual tokens into latent visual evidence, which is recurrently fed back as the next input embedding to condition subsequent search. We further introduce a GUI-aware coarse-to-fine inductive bias through trajectories constructed from flat element annotations, supervising search from the global interface through intermediate element groups to the target. Built on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, ReLaViS improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy by 3.1 percentage points to 56.3% with only a 3.5% increase in inference FLOPs and outperforms the matched single-step baseline on all five benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出ReLaViS，将多步视觉搜索显式化为模型内部的循环潜在空间搜索过程，在单轮交互中完成GUI元素定位，无需外部工具或多轮交互。
AI.motivation: GUI grounding是视觉语言模型驱动的GUI agent的关键能力。单步grounding在小元素和密集布局上表现不佳，而现有多步视觉搜索方法要么依赖与视觉空间错位的文本推理，要么依赖昂贵的外部视觉工具多轮交互。
AI.method: 在每个搜索步，空间搜索头用隐藏状态查询截图的视觉token，生成显式表示搜索焦点的空间搜索分布；该分布聚合视觉token为潜在视觉证据，并循环反馈为下一步的输入嵌入以调节后续搜索。同时利用扁平元素标注构建轨迹，引入GUI感知的由粗到细归纳偏置，监督从全局界面经中间元素组到目标的搜索。
AI.result: 基于Qwen2.5-VL-7B，在ScreenSpot-Pro上将准确率提升3.1个百分点至56.3%，推理FLOPs仅增加3.5%，并在全部五个基准上超越匹配的单步基线。
AI.conclusion: ReLaViS通过将多步视觉搜索内化为模型内的循环潜在空间过程，实现了高效且显式的空间搜索，在提升GUI grounding精度的同时保持低推理开销。

title: Order Matters: Competition-Guided Query Ordering for RNN-Based Object Detection
summary: DETR-style detectors use one-to-one bipartite matching during training to assign object queries to ground-truth objects, enabling end-to-end set prediction without non-maximum suppression (NMS). However, without an explicit de-duplication procedure, multiple queries can still produce highly similar hypotheses for the same object, making training unstable and predictions less decisive. Inspired by the sequential ordering of NMS, we propose DETRNN, a plug-and-play module that turns unordered object queries into a competition-aware sequence for recurrent refinement. DETRNN builds an explicit confidence-and-similarity based order from prior predictions, then refines queries with an RNN along this order to model competition inside the decoder. This ordered recurrent refinement reduces redundant predictions, stabilizes optimization, and improves final detection accuracy. Experiments on multiple DETR-style detectors show consistent gains with comparable efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出 DETRNN，一种即插即用模块，将无序目标查询转为基于置信度与相似度的竞争感知序列，并用 RNN 依序精炼，抑制冗余预测、稳定训练并提升检测精度。
AI.motivation: DETR 类检测器通过一对一二分匹配实现端到端集合预测，无需 NMS。但缺少显式去重机制，多个查询仍可能对同一目标生成高度相似的假设，导致训练不稳定、预测不够果断。
AI.method: 受 NMS 顺序化处理启发，DETRNN 先依据先验预测构建显式的“置信度+相似度”排序，将无序查询组织为竞争感知序列；再沿该序列用 RNN 精炼查询，在解码器内部显式建模查询间竞争关系。
AI.result: 在多种 DETR 类检测器上取得一致的性能提升，且效率相当。
AI.conclusion: 有序的循环精炼可减少冗余预测、稳定优化并提升最终检测精度，是一种通用、易嵌入的改进方案。

title: Long-MDR: Long-Context Reinforcement Learning for Multimodal Deep-Research Agents
summary: The next generation of multimodal research agents must reason over long-lived research histories rather than short model completions. During a single task, an agent may repeatedly search the web, inspect visual evidence, revisit earlier hypotheses, and accumulate tens of thousands of tokens of multimodal context. Despite this trend, online RL for multimodal research agents remains largely confined to shorter contexts and interaction horizons. We push online RL training to 128k context and 75+ tool-interaction turns. To our knowledge, this is the first online multimodal deep-research RL study trained at 128k context, and the first trained with a 75 tool-turn horizon. Scaling to this regime exposes several practical limitations of conventional RL training. Early in training, weak policies make poor use of large interaction budgets, causing expensive rollouts with little reward improvement. Later, policy entropy can collapse before performance has saturated, prematurely ending useful learning. We introduce Long-MDR, a three-component training recipe designed specifically for this setting: On-Policy Distillation Warmup, Progressive Horizon Expansion, and Entropy-Triggered Rescue. Together, these techniques improve both the learning efficiency and stability of long-horizon RL, enabling continued gains in a regime where direct training is slow and costly. At a 50-turn evaluation budget, our RL-trained Long-MDR-9B ranks first on five of six benchmarks among the compared 7B-9B agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多模态深度研究智能体的长时程在线强化学习，将上下文扩展至128k、工具交互轮次提升至75+，提出Long-MDR三段式训练配方（在线策略蒸馏预热、渐进式时程扩展、熵触发救援），显著提升长时程RL的学习效率与稳定性，Long-MDR-9B在50轮评估预算下于六个基准中的五个取得同类7B-9B智能体第一。
AI.motivation: 下一代多模态研究智能体需在长时程研究历史（而非短模型输出）上进行推理，单任务中会反复检索网页、检查视觉证据、回溯假设并累积数万token的多模态上下文。然而现有在线RL训练多局限于较短上下文与交互时程，无法支撑这一场景。
AI.method: 将在线RL训练扩展至128k上下文与75+工具交互轮次，并针对该情形下暴露的两个问题（训练早期弱策略浪费大量交互预算、后期策略熵在性能饱和前坍塌）提出Long-MDR三段式配方：在线策略蒸馏预热（On-Policy Distillation Warmup）、渐进式时程扩展（Progressive Horizon Expansion）、熵触发救援（Entropy-Triggered Rescue）。
AI.result: 在50轮评估预算下，RL训练得到的Long-MDR-9B在所比较的7B-9B智能体中于六个基准中的五个排名第一；训练过程学习效率与稳定性均优于直接训练。
AI.conclusion: 该工作是目前首个在128k上下文下训练的在线多模态深度研究RL研究，也是首个采用75工具轮时程训练的研究；Long-MDR配方使长时程RL在低效高成本的区域仍能持续获得收益。

title: F$^2$ SLAM: Turning Feed-Forward Geometry into Persistent Factors for SLAM
summary: Feed-forward 3D models provide strong multi-view geometric priors, while on- line simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies mainly on local mea- surements and can accumulate drift over long sequences. Existing attempts to combine the two typically treat feed-forward predictions as an external geomet- ric state that is aligned or fused with the online estimate after the fact, which keeps broader multi-view evidence outside the optimizer that refines the SLAM state. We present F2SLAM, which instead converts feed-forward geometry di- rectly into optimization-native target-weight measurements attached to a persis- tent dense factor graph. A high-frequency stream maintains local tracking con- straints and graph connectivity, while a low-frequency stream uses wider multi- view context to selectively refresh existing measurements after a state-consistency check. Both streams constrain the same poses, inverse depths, and optional cam- era intrinsics through a single dense bundle adjustment. Experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate consistently strong trajectory estimation and improved dense reconstruction in both calibrated and uncalibrated settings. Notably, the uncalibrated configuration reduces the average ATE RMSE from 0.030 m for the strongest feed-forward baseline to 0.002 m on the Replica dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出F2SLAM，将前馈三维模型的几何先验直接转化为优化原生的目标权重测量，嵌入持久稠密因子图中，通过单一稠密光束法平差统一约束位姿、逆深度与相机内参，在标定与非标定场景下均取得更优的轨迹估计与稠密重建。
AI.motivation: 传统在线SLAM主要依赖局部测量，长序列易累积漂移；已有的前馈模型与SLAM结合方案多将前馈预测视为外部几何状态，仅在事后与在线估计对齐或融合，导致更广泛的多视图证据无法进入优化器参与状态精化。作者希望让前馈几何真正成为优化框架内部的一部分。
AI.method: F2SLAM将前馈几何直接转换为优化原生的目标权重测量，并附着于一个持久的稠密因子图上。系统采用双频流设计：高频流维持局部跟踪约束与图连通性；低频流利用更广的多视图上下文，在状态一致性检查后选择性地刷新已有测量。两条流通过单一的稠密光束法平差共同约束相同的位姿、逆深度以及可选的相机内参。
AI.result: 在多个基准上实验表明，F2SLAM在标定与非标定设置下均能持续获得较强的轨迹估计表现，并改善稠密重建质量。尤其在不标定配置下，Replica数据集上平均ATE RMSE由最强前馈基线的0.030 m降至0.002 m。
AI.conclusion: 将前馈多视图几何先验内化为优化原生测量并纳入统一稠密因子图优化，是提升在线SLAM轨迹精度与稠密重建质量的有效途径，且无需依赖预先标定的相机内参即可显著降低绝对轨迹误差。

title: PixReenact: Pixel-Conditioned Causal Video Diffusion for Streaming Head-Avatar Reenactment
summary: Streaming head-avatar reenactment aims to animate a reference image according to a live driving video, requiring robust motion transfer, long-term identity stability, and low latency. Existing methods often rely on specialized identity or motion representations, which can discard useful visual information and inherit failure modes from external extractors. In addition, many recent diffusion-based reenactment methods use offline, clip-based generation, jointly processing and denoising an entire video clip before producing its output, making continuous low-latency streaming difficult. We introduce PixReenact, a pixel-conditioned streaming reenactment framework built on causal video diffusion. PixReenact conditions directly on VAE-encoded reference and driving frames, without specialized identity or motion representations. To separate reference identity from driver motion, we train with cross-identity pseudo supervision together with corrective objectives anchored to the original reference and driving inputs. Long self-rollouts reduce autoregressive drift, while state-aware dual-teacher distillation separately addresses cold-start and steady-state generation. Across three cross-identity benchmarks and a long-horizon streaming benchmark, PixReenact demonstrates robust cross-identity reenactment, particularly under challenging conditions such as extreme viewpoints, occlusions, and pronounced facial expressions, while maintaining the reference identity over long streams. A 4-NFE rolling student continuously emits four frames per update with a mean emission latency of 239 ms.

AI.tldr: PixReenact 是一种基于因果视频扩散的像素条件流式头部化身重演框架，直接在 VAE 编码的参考帧与驱动帧上条件化，无需专门的身份或运动表示。通过跨身份伪监督、纠正目标、长自回归 rollout 以及状态感知双教师蒸馏，实现鲁棒跨身份重演与长期身份稳定，并在 4-NFE 下达到平均 239 ms 的发射延迟。
AI.motivation: 流式头部化身重演需同时满足稳健的运动迁移、长期身份稳定性和低延迟。现有方法依赖专门的身份或运动表示，会丢失有用视觉信息并继承外部提取器的失效模式；许多基于扩散的重演方法采用离线、基于片段的生成方式，对整个视频片段联合处理与去噪，难以实现连续低延迟流式生成。
AI.method: PixReenact 构建于因果视频扩散之上，直接以 VAE 编码的参考帧和驱动帧为条件，不使用专门的身份或运动表示。为分离参考身份与驱动运动，采用跨身份伪监督并结合锚定于原始参考与驱动输入的纠正目标；通过长自回归 rollout 减少自回归漂移；采用状态感知双教师蒸馏分别处理冷启动与稳态生成。推理端使用 4-NFE 滚动学生模型。
AI.result: 在三个跨身份基准和一个长时程流式基准上，PixReenact 展现出稳健的跨身份重演能力，尤其在极端视角、遮挡和明显面部表情等挑战性条件下表现突出，并能在长流中保持参考身份。4-NFE 滚动学生模型每次更新连续输出四帧，平均发射延迟为 239 ms。
AI.conclusion: PixReenact 通过像素条件化的因果视频扩散框架，摆脱对专门身份/运动表示的依赖，并借助跨身份伪监督、纠正目标、长自回归训练与状态感知双教师蒸馏，实现了兼具鲁棒性、长期身份稳定性与低延迟的流式头部化身重演。

title: ArticuTable: Generating Instance-Level Interactive Rigid-Articulated 3D Tabletop Scenes from a Single Image
summary: Embodied agents benefit from 3D environments that combine visual fidelity to real-world observations with physical interactivity. Existing single-image tabletop reconstruction methods recover plausible scene geometry but typically represent objects as monolithic rigid bodies, limiting interaction to whole-object rigid motion and precluding executable part-level articulation. Meanwhile, recovering a scene layout consistent with the input view remains challenging because a single observation may admit multiple plausible pose-scale configurations. We present ArticuTable, a single-image 3D tabletop reconstruction framework that recovers both executable part-level articulation and an input-view-consistent scene layout. For object modeling, we introduce generation-robust articulation modeling (GRAM), which combines joint fitting guided by a multimodal large language model with semantic state reasoning to recover reliable joint parameters and valid motion ranges from imperfect monolithic proxy meshes, thereby converting them into executable articulated assets. For scene layout, we introduce progressive semantic-geometric scene registration (PSGSR), which progressively narrows the pose-scale search space under complementary metric, planar, and input-view constraints and resolves orientation ambiguity through structure-aware semantic correspondences, yielding a scene layout consistent with the input view. We further contribute ArticuTable-100, a curated collection of 100 simulation-ready tabletop scenes. Extensive evaluation, including a user study, demonstrates strong performance across visual fidelity, input-view consistency, articulation quality, physical plausibility, and simulation readiness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ArticuTable，一个单图像桌面3D重建框架，可同时恢复可执行的部件级铰接与输入视图一致的场景布局，并贡献了ArticuTable-100数据集。
AI.motivation: 具身智能体需要兼具视觉保真度与物理交互性的3D环境。现有单图像桌面重建方法虽能恢复合理几何，但通常将物体表示为整体刚性体，仅支持整物体刚性运动，无法实现可执行的部件级铰接；同时，单次观测可能存在多种合理的位姿-尺度配置，导致恢复与输入视图一致的场景布局十分困难。
AI.method: 提出ArticuTable框架，包含两个核心模块：1）生成鲁棒的铰接建模（GRAM），结合由多模态大语言模型引导的关节拟合与语义状态推理，从不完美的整体代理网格中恢复可靠的关节参数与有效运动范围，将其转化为可执行的铰接资产；2）渐进式语义-几何场景配准（PSGSR），在度量、平面和输入视图约束下逐步缩小位姿-尺度搜索空间，并通过结构感知的语义对应关系解决朝向歧义。
AI.result: 构建了ArticuTable-100，包含100个可直接用于仿真的桌面场景。大量评估（含用户研究）表明，该方法在视觉保真度、输入视图一致性、铰接质量、物理合理性和仿真可用性方面均表现优异。
AI.conclusion: ArticuTable实现了单图像桌面场景中部件级铰接与输入视图一致布局的联合恢复，并发布了仿真就绪的数据集，为具身智能体的3D环境构建提供了有效方案。

title: MGPO: Manifold-Guided Diffusion Alignment for Task-Aware Dataset Distillation
summary: Diffusion-based dataset distillation (DD) suffers from a fundamental objective mismatch: likelihood-driven diffusion models prioritize density approximation over the discriminative decision boundaries required for downstream tasks. Beyond semantic mismatch, relying solely on density also leads to geometric coverage loss, where generated samples collapse into a few high-density modes and fail to cover the manifold's structural diversity. We propose Manifold-Guided Policy Optimization (MGPO), which reformulates DD as a multi-objective reinforcement learning problem and achieves Dual-Space Alignment via a pixel-space discriminative reward and a latent-space geometric reward guided by a class-wise Minimum Spanning Tree (MST). The discriminative reward enforces class separability, while the MST-based geometric reward encourages generated latents to cover a sparse geometric skeleton of each class, jointly addressing both failure modes. We further provide an idealized analysis that motivates the MST-based reward, including a Hausdorff approximation bound and a subsampling bound independent of the dataset size. The reward-modular design extends to structured tasks such as object detection and segmentation by substituting the frozen task reward model. Extensive experiments show MGPO consistently outperforms existing methods, including a +8.0% mIoU gain on segmentation under low-budget settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出流形引导策略优化（MGPO），将基于扩散的数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题，通过像素空间判别奖励与隐空间MST几何奖励的双空间对齐，同时解决语义不匹配与几何覆盖缺失两类问题。
AI.motivation: 基于扩散的数据集蒸馏存在根本性目标错配：扩散模型以似然驱动，偏向密度近似，而下游任务需要的是判别性决策边界，二者语义不一致。此外，仅依赖密度还导致几何覆盖损失，生成样本坍缩到少数高密度模式，无法覆盖流形结构多样性，即语义不匹配与几何覆盖缺失两大失效模式。
AI.method: 提出流形引导策略优化（MGPO），把数据集蒸馏重构为多目标强化学习问题，实现双空间对齐：一是像素空间的判别奖励，强化类间可分性；二是隐空间的几何奖励，由逐类最小生成树（MST）引导，促使生成隐变量覆盖每类的稀疏几何骨架。奖励模块化设计可通过替换冻结的任务奖励模型扩展到目标检测、分割等结构化任务。
AI.result: 给出理想化分析以支撑MST奖励，包括Hausdorff近似界与独立于数据集规模的子采样界。大量实验表明MGPO持续优于现有方法，在低预算分割设置下mIoU提升+8.0%。
AI.conclusion: MGPO通过判别奖励与MST几何奖励的联合优化，同时缓解语义不匹配与几何覆盖缺失，理论分析与实验均验证其有效性，并具良好任务扩展性。

title: Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting for Diffusion Sampling Acceleration
summary: We propose Hybrid-Basis Feature Forecasting (HybridFF), a training-free, plug-and-play framework for accelerating diffusion sampling. To capture local smoothness, long-range trends, and complex non-monotonic variations when modeling feature evolution, HybridFF first estimates coefficients using moving least squares (MLS) for each of multiple complementary basis families and then combines the corresponding predictors using fusion weights. In addition to the choice of basis functions, the fusion weights also play a critical role. We introduce two strategies to balance quality and speedup. HybridFF (Fixed) prioritizes efficiency with model-specific fusion weights calibrated on a small set and held constant during inference. HybridFF (Adaptive) updates the fusion weights online using branch reliability scores computed from an exponential moving average of full-step prediction errors, improving prediction fidelity and generation quality under aggressive caching while retaining substantial acceleration. Experiments across DiT-XL/2, FLUX.1-dev, SD3.5-Large, and HunyuanVideo demonstrate a favorable speedup--quality trade-off over representative single-basis forecasters and caching baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、即插即用的扩散采样加速框架HybridFF，通过多基函数预测器融合建模特征演化，兼顾加速与生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型采样计算开销大；特征在时间步间演化同时包含局部平滑、长程趋势与非单调变化，单一基函数预测器难以同时刻画，导致加速时质量下降。
AI.method: 对多个互补基函数族分别用移动最小二乘（MLS）估计系数并构建预测器，再以融合权重组合。提出两种策略：HybridFF (Fixed) 用小样本集校准的模型专属固定权重以追求效率；HybridFF (Adaptive) 基于全步预测误差的指数移动平均计算分支可靠性分数，在线更新融合权重，以提升激进缓存下的预测保真度。
AI.result: 在DiT-XL/2、FLUX.1-dev、SD3.5-Large与HunyuanVideo上，相比代表性单基函数预测器与缓存基线，取得更优的加速—质量权衡。
AI.conclusion: 多基函数融合与权重自适应机制可有效加速扩散采样，在保持生成质量的同时实现显著加速，且方法免训练、即插即用。

title: Answer with Evidence: Consistency-Aware Grounded Visual Question Answering for Roadside Traffic Scenes
summary: Roadside traffic reasoning requires every free-form textual claim to be backed by visual evidence. Existing grounded multimodal large language models (MLLMs) frequently exhibit say-point mismatch, in which the textual answer contradicts the bounding boxes the model localizes. Evaluation metrics that score answers and boxes separately leave this failure unpenalized. We trace the mismatch to the conventional answer-then-ground factorization, which commits to a numerical claim before any object is enumerated. To measure it, we build RoadSceneVQA-G, a benchmark of 34.7K question-answer pairs in which every free-form answer is linked to the set of boxes that witnesses it, and we propose the Answer-Grounding Consistency (AGC) evaluation suite. To address it, we introduce Enumerate-then-Answer (EtA), which reverses the generation order so that answer-evidence agreement becomes a property of the output structure, and Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization (ECPO), a reinforcement learning stage that uses the union of multiple rollouts as a recall teacher without ground-truth boxes. EtA raises say-point consistency from 26.6\% to 93.7\% and grounding F1 from 52.2\% to 73.0\%, and ECPO further increases F1 to 75.6\% without per-box supervision. On gRefCOCO, the same framework outperforms the strongest compared method, indicating that it transfers beyond traffic scenes. The project is available at \url{https://github.com/GuanRunwei/RoadSceneVQA-G}.

AI.tldr: 本文针对路边交通场景中多模态大模型的"说-指不一致"问题，提出RoadSceneVQA-G基准与AGC评测套件，并设计"先枚举后作答"（EtA）框架及ECPO强化学习策略，显著提升答案与视觉证据的一致性。
AI.motivation: 路边交通推理要求每条自由文本主张都有视觉证据支撑。现有多模态大模型常出现"说-指不一致"：文本答案与模型定位的边界框相矛盾。传统的评测指标将答案与边界框分开打分，无法对此类失败进行惩罚。作者将这一失配归因于"先作答后定位"的分解范式——模型在尚未枚举任何目标之前就已做出数值性判断。
AI.method: 1) 构建RoadSceneVQA-G基准，包含34.7K问答对，每个自由形式答案都关联到为其提供证据的边界框集合；2) 提出Answer-Grounding Consistency（AGC）评测套件以量化一致性；3) 提出Enumerate-then-Answer（EtA），反转生成顺序，使答案-证据一致性成为输出结构的固有属性；4) 提出Enumeration-Consistent Policy Optimization（ECPO）强化学习阶段，以多次采样的并集作为召回教师，无需真值框监督。
AI.result: EtA将说-指一致性从26.6%提升至93.7%，grounding F1从52.2%提升至73.0%；ECPO在无逐框监督下进一步将F1提升至75.6%。在gRefCOCO数据集上，该框架优于最强对比方法，表明其可迁移至交通场景之外。
AI.conclusion: 通过反转生成顺序的EtA框架与无真值框监督的ECPO策略，有效解决了多模态大模型的说-指不一致问题，在路边交通场景及通用指代任务上均取得显著提升，验证了方法的有效性与可迁移性。

title: Mobile-4DGS: Unified Static-Dynamic Real-time Mobile Gaussian Splatting
summary: Recent advances in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have achieved remarkable performance in novel view synthesis, yet deploying both static and dynamic Gaussian representations on resource-constrained mobile devices remains challenging due to heavy storage, redundant primitives, and costly per-frame computation. We present Mobile-4DGS, a unified lightweight framework for high-fidelity real-time static and dynamic Gaussian rendering on mobile platforms. For compact appearance modeling, we introduce a Monte Carlo Specular Energy Aggregator that compresses high-order radiance residuals into the first-order Spherical Harmonics (SH), together with an Attribute-Conditioned SH Enhancement module whose predicted offsets are pre-baked before inference. We further propose a Multi-View Alpha-Based Densification and Pruning strategy to suppress redundant primitives while maintaining multi-view consistency. For dynamic scenes, we develop a compact explicit 4D representation by constructing second-order Gaussian motion, learnable temporal support, and a binary static-dynamic partition, enabling continuous-time modeling without runtime deformation networks. Based on this partition, a Depth-Order Certificate selectively reuses previously committed depth orders to reduce re-projection, sorting, merging, and index-buffer updates during playback. Extensive experiments on static and dynamic scenes demonstrate that Mobile-4DGS substantially reduces storage and rendering overhead while maintaining competitive visual quality, enabling real-time 3D and 4D Gaussian Splatting on mobile devices. \textcolor{magenta}{\href{https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}{Code has been released: https://xiaobiaodu.github.io/mobile-4dgs-project/}}.

AI.tldr: 提出Mobile-4DGS统一轻量框架，实现移动端高保真实时静态与动态3D高斯渲染。
AI.motivation: 3DGS在新视角合成上性能优异，但在资源受限的移动设备上部署静态与动态高斯表示仍面临存储开销大、图元冗余、逐帧计算昂贵等挑战。
AI.method: 1) 蒙特卡洛镜面能量聚合器，将高阶辐射残差压缩至一阶球谐；2) 属性条件球谐增强模块，其预测偏移在推理前预烘焙；3) 多视角Alpha密度化与剪枝策略，抑制冗余图元并保持多视角一致性；4) 面向动态场景的紧凑显式4D表示，由二阶高斯运动、可学习时间支撑与二值静动态划分构成，无需运行时变形网络即可连续时间建模；5) 基于该划分的深度序证书，选择性复用已提交深度序以减少重投影、排序、合并与索引缓冲更新。
AI.result: 在静态与动态场景的广泛实验中，显著降低存储与渲染开销，同时保持有竞争力的视觉质量，实现移动端实时3D与4D高斯泼溅。
AI.conclusion: Mobile-4DGS为移动平台提供了一个统一的轻量级实时静/动态高斯渲染方案，兼顾紧凑表示与实时性能，代码已开源。

title: BossouChimpanzee: Long-term Chimpanzee Video Dataset
summary: We describe the BossouChimpanzee video dataset, a unique long-term visual record of wild chimpanzees at an outdoor laboratory for field experiments in Bossou, Guinea, spanning three decades (1988-2018) and comprising over 1,200 hours of continuous video recordings collected through collaborative fieldwork and research. In this paper, we outline the history and scientific contributions of the experimental paradigm and video archive, provide key statistics and details on the structure of the main video dataset, and release an initial ~74h snapshot, BossouChimpanzee70h, covering 23 identified individuals focused on chimpanzee individual and action recognition, ahead of the full video resource. This dataset represents a valuable resource for cognitive and behavioural research in ethology and a rich benchmark for training and evaluating machine learning models on audiovisual data from the wild.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍BossouChimpanzee视频数据集：源自几内亚Bossou野外实验站、跨越1988-2018年三十年的野生黑猩猩长期录像档案，累计超1200小时；论文梳理该实验范式与影像档案的历史与科学贡献，说明主数据集的结构与关键统计，并先行发布约74小时的初始快照BossouChimpanzee70h，涵盖23个已识别个体，聚焦个体识别与动作识别，面向动物行为学认知研究及野外视听数据的机器学习基准。
AI.motivation: 野生黑猩猩的长期、连续视听记录极为稀缺，现有数据多为短期、零散采集，难以支撑个体层面与行为层面的大规模、可复现研究。作者希望将三十年的野外实验录像整理为规范数据集，为动物行为学与认知科学研究提供资源，并为野外视听数据的机器学习模型训练与评测建立基准。
AI.method: 以Bossou户外实验室的野外实验为背景，通过合作式野外工作与研究，采集并整理1988至2018年间超过1200小时的连续录像；介绍该实验范式和视频档案的历史与科学贡献，给出主数据集的结构说明与关键统计；在主资源发布前，先行公开约74小时的初始快照BossouChimpanzee70h，覆盖23个已识别个体，任务设定为黑猩猩个体识别与动作识别。
AI.result: 形成跨三十年、总时长超1200小时的连续野生黑猩猩视频档案；发布初始快照约74小时，包含23个已识别的黑猩猩个体，并围绕个体识别与动作识别设定任务与基准。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集是动物行为学与认知行为研究的宝贵资源，也是野外视听数据上训练和评估机器学习模型的丰富基准；初始快照的发布为后续完整视频资源的开放使用奠定基础。

title: Revisiting Ground-Truth Synthesis from High-Speed Video: Exact Validity Conditions and an Audited Consumer Capture Corpus
summary: Motion-deblurring datasets are commonly synthesised by averaging $N$ consecutive high-frame-rate frames and labelling the result with the central frame. We show that this label is unbiased for every capture timing only when the window is odd and the frames' sample durations are equal. An even window shifts every label by a fixed fraction of the blur length, even under perfect timing. Unequal durations are subtler: their mean misalignment is zero, so dataset statistics cannot reveal them, yet when the offset cannot be read from the blur they convolve the supervision rather than adding noise to it. Auditing 51 smartphone clips recorded at a nominal 240 fps, we find 19 captured near 176 fps, a behaviour recorded only in the container's timing tables. In a controlled test the parity choice costs a fitted linear deblurring filter far more than these timing irregularities do, and interpolation labels, unlike blur labels, can be repaired with the true frame times. We provide a tool that checks both conditions without decoding, and will release the clips and their timing tables.

AI.tldr: 运动去模糊数据集合成中，以中心帧作为标签仅在奇数窗口且各帧采样时长相等时才无偏；偶数窗口会系统性偏移标签，不等时长则会把错位卷积进监督信号。作者审计51段标称240fps的手机视频，发现19段实际约176fps，并给出无需解码的检测工具。
AI.motivation: 运动去模糊数据集普遍通过平均N帧高帧率图像并以中心帧为标签来合成，但该标签的正确性依赖于窗口奇偶性与帧采样时长等隐含假设。作者希望揭示这些假设被违反时，标签偏差与监督信号污染如何产生，以及它们对去模糊模型训练的实际影响。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明中心帧标签无偏的条件为窗口长度为奇数且各帧采样时长相等；分析偶数窗口导致的固定比例偏移，以及不等时长下均值错位为零但会将错位卷积进监督信号的现象。实证审计：对51段标称240fps的智能手机视频片段，从容器时基表中读取真实帧时序。控制实验：比较窗口奇偶性选择与时间不规则性对拟合线性去模糊滤波器的影响。工具：提供一个无需解码即可检查上述两个条件的检测工具，并将公开片段及其时基表。
AI.result: 51段标称240fps的手机视频中，有19段实际采集帧率约为176fps，且该行为仅记录在容器的时基表中。控制实验显示，窗口奇偶性的选择对拟合线性去模糊滤波器造成的性能损失远大于这些时间不规则性。此外，与模糊标签不同，插值标签可以借助真实帧时刻进行修复。
AI.conclusion: 中心帧标签的无偏性并非普适，偶数窗口与不等采样时长会分别引入系统性偏移和监督信号卷积污染，且后者难以从数据集统计中察觉。由于奇偶性选择的影响大于时序不规则性，数据集构建应优先校正窗口奇偶性，并利用真实帧时刻修复插值标签；作者提供的免解码检测工具可辅助完成此类审计。

title: Kinematics-Centric Continuous Sign Language Retrieval with Gloss-Guided Boundary-Aware Alignment
summary: Sign language-text alignment remains a fundamental challenge for text-driven sign language understanding. Existing methods predominantly rely on appearance-heavy RGB representations, which entangle motion semantics with visual variations and lead to ambiguous motion-language grounding. In this paper, we reformulate sign language-text alignment in a structured kinematic space and propose a kinematics-centric framework that adopts 3D SMPL-X motion as the primary representation. By explicitly modeling the kinematic dynamics of signing in a unified motion space, our approach reduces reliance on appearance signals and yields more semantically consistent representations. To capture the compositional nature of sign language, we introduce a gloss-guided local alignment mechanism that leverages gloss temporal spans as weak supervision to decompose continuous motion into coherent segments and establish fine-grained motion-text correspondences, thereby reducing ambiguity in localizing word-level semantics in continuous signing. Furthermore, we develop a visual distillation strategy, where RGB signals serve as privileged supervision during training to provide complementary contextual cues, while being completely removed at inference time. Extensive experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art bidirectional retrieval performance on CSL-Daily and competitive results on PHOENIX-2014T. These results highlight the effectiveness of kinematic representations and explicit local grounding for sign language-text alignment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以运动学为中心的手语-文本对齐框架，采用3D SMPL-X运动表示替代RGB，结合gloss引导的局部对齐与视觉蒸馏策略，在CSL-Daily和PHOENIX-2014T上取得优异检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有手语-文本对齐方法主要依赖外观特征密集的RGB表示，将运动语义与视觉外观变化纠缠在一起，导致运动-语言对齐存在歧义。作者希望将手语-文本对齐重新定义在结构化运动学空间中，减少对外观信号的依赖，获得语义更一致的表示。
AI.method: 1) 以3D SMPL-X运动作为主要表示，在统一运动空间中显式建模手语的运动学动态；2) 提出gloss引导的局部对齐机制，利用gloss时间跨度作为弱监督，将连续运动分解为连贯片段，建立细粒度运动-文本对应，缓解连续手语中词级语义定位的歧义；3) 设计视觉蒸馏策略，训练时以RGB信号作为特权监督提供互补上下文线索，推理时完全移除。
AI.result: 在标准基准上，方法在CSL-Daily上取得最先进的双向检索性能，在PHOENIX-2014T上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果验证了运动学表示与显式局部对齐对手语-文本对齐的有效性，表明结构化运动空间能够提供更语义一致的手语表示。

title: Shadow Feature Refinement Network: Progressive Feature Refinement based on Knowledge Distillation for Effective Shadow Removal
summary: In the field of deep learning, has seen significant advancements; however, shadow removal remains a persistent challenge owing to the variable sizes and colors of shadows influenced by lighting conditions. This study proposes a novel shadow feature refinement network (SFR-Net), which leverages supervised learning, feature refinement loss, and knowledge distillation to enhance shadow removal performance. A dedicated post-processing algorithm is further introduced to restore natural color consistency in the generated shadow-free images. We evaluated our method on two public datasets: the adjusted image shadow triplet dataset (ISTD+) and the shadow removal dataset (SRD), which demonstrate strong generalization capabilities under diverse conditions. On ISTD+, our model achieved a root mean square error (RMSE) of 3.4627 and structural similarity index measure (SSIM) of 0.9382 across the entire image. On SRD, it recorded an RMSE of 4.3781 and an SSIM of 0.9341. These comprehensive results show that our approach performs competitively across both shadow and non-shadow regions while setting a promising direction for robust and perceptually natural shadow removal. Code is available at https://github.com/DongHyun99/SFRNet.

AI.tldr: 提出SFR-Net，结合监督学习、特征细化损失与知识蒸馏进行阴影去除，并引入后处理算法恢复自然色彩一致性；在ISTD+和SRD上取得竞争性性能。
AI.motivation: 深度学习虽进展显著，但阴影去除仍因光照导致的阴影尺寸与颜色多变而具挑战性，且生成的无阴影图像常存在色彩一致性不足问题。
AI.method: 提出阴影特征细化网络（SFR-Net），采用监督学习并结合特征细化损失与知识蒸馏增强阴影去除性能；额外设计后处理算法，用于恢复生成的无阴影图像的自然色彩一致性。
AI.result: 在ISTD+上全图RMSE为3.4627、SSIM为0.9382；在SRD上RMSE为4.3781、SSIM为0.9341；在两数据集上均展现出跨多样条件的强泛化能力，且在阴影与非阴影区域均表现竞争性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在阴影去除的精度与感知自然度上均具竞争力，为鲁棒且感知自然的阴影去除提供了有前景的方向；代码已开源。

title: Riemannian Shape Analysis of the Corpus Callosum in Kendall Space: Aging and Alzheimer's Disease
summary: The corpus callosum (CC) is a major white-matter structure and a well-established marker of brain aging, but most studies quantify it using scalar summaries that discard its boundary geometry. We present a Riemannian shape-space framework for analyzing age-related morphological change in the midsagittal CC, applied to the OASIS-1 cohort. Each contour is represented by $128$ landmarks and embedded into Kendall shape space, where translation, rotation, and scale are removed. We derive a multivariate geodesic regression with exact Riemannian gradients and use the fitted age-velocity field to localize age-related deformation to five anatomical sub-regions. In the cognitively normal cohort ($n = 252$), geodesic regression outperforms the Euclidean linear benchmark ($R^2 = 0.1355$ vs.\ $0.1216$). Regional energy is posterior-dominant: the Splenium carries $41.4\%$ and the Isthmus $23.8\%$ of total age-related shape change, together accounting for $\sim 65\%$ despite comprising only $\sim 35\%$ of landmarks. Signed projections confirm the ordering (Splenium $r = 0.570$; Isthmus $r = 0.473$). In contrast, age explains less than $0.5\%$ of shape variance in Alzheimer's disease ($n = 88$), indicating that the disease disrupts the healthy aging trajectory. A tangent-space classifier achieves an age-group AUC of $0.791$ from the 2D contour alone, exceeding a recent volumetric benchmark ($0.67$).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于Kendall形状空间的黎曼形状空间框架，对OASIS-1队列胼胝体正中矢状面轮廓进行测地回归，定位与年龄相关的形变并区分正常老化与阿尔茨海默病。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多使用标量摘要量化胼胝体，丢弃其边界几何信息；作者希望保留轮廓的完整几何结构，以更精确刻画与年龄相关的形态变化。
AI.method: 将每条轮廓表示为128个地标点，嵌入去除平移、旋转、尺度的Kendall形状空间；推导具有精确黎曼梯度的多元测地回归，并利用拟合的年龄速度场将形变定位到五个解剖亚区；同时构建切空间分类器。
AI.result: 在认知正常队列（n=252）中，测地回归优于欧氏线性基准（R²=0.1355 vs. 0.1216）；区域能量以后部为主，Splenium占41.4%、Isthmus占23.8%，合计约65%但仅含约35%地标；符号投影确认该排序（Splenium r=0.570，Isthmus r=0.473）；阿尔茨海默病队列（n=88）中年龄仅解释不足0.5%的形状方差；切空间分类器仅用2D轮廓即达到年龄组AUC=0.791，超过近期体积基准（0.67）。
AI.conclusion: 黎曼形状空间测地回归能有效定位胼胝体年龄相关形变，揭示后部亚区主导的老化模式，并表明阿尔茨海默病破坏健康老化轨迹；基于轮廓的分类性能优于体积基准。

title: WILLIE: A Unified Framework and Benchmark for Wound Classification, Segmentation, and Localization
comment: 21 pages, 4 figures, 9 tables. Published in Proceedings of the 11th Machine Learning for Healthcare Conference (MLHC 2026), PMLR 340:1243-1263. Code: https://github.com/Qian-Group-HRI/Willie
summary: Chronic wound management affects over 8.2 million patients in the United States and imposes substantial clinical and economic burden. Clinical wound assessment commonly involves three coupled tasks: identifying wound type, delineating wound boundaries, and localizing the wound region for measurement and monitoring. Despite this clinical coupling, existing machine learning approaches typically address wound classification, segmentation, and localization using separate models. We present WILLIE, a unified framework and benchmark for wound classification, segmentation and localization that enables systematic evaluation of multi-task wound analysis under a common protocol. WILLIE harmonizes three public wound datasets into a shared benchmark and compares unified models across three scaling configurations against 10 single-task baselines. The best model achieves 91.88% classification accuracy, 91.41% Dice, and 96.23% AP@0.5 while producing all three outputs in a single forward pass. Beyond aggregate performance, our results show that segmentation-derived localization outperforms dedicated detection baselines in this benchmark, suggesting that box-based localization may be unnecessary for spatially coherent wound targets. Our findings highlight that effective multi-task learning in healthcare imaging depends not only on shared representations, but also on task formulation, compatibility, and benchmark design.

AI.tldr: WILLIE 提出统一的伤口分类、分割与定位框架及基准，将三个公开数据集整合为共享基准，以单次前向推理同时输出三类结果，并系统比较多任务统一模型与单任务基线。
AI.motivation: 慢性伤口管理在美国影响超过 820 万患者，带来显著临床与经济负担。临床伤口评估天然涉及分类、边界勾画与区域定位三个相互耦合的任务，但现有机器学习方法通常用独立模型分别处理，缺乏统一评估协议，难以系统比较与理解任务间关系。
AI.method: WILLIE 将三个公开伤口数据集协调统一为共享基准，在统一协议下评估多任务伤口分析。它对比了三种缩放配置下的统一模型与 10 个单任务基线，模型在单次前向传播中同时完成分类、分割与定位，从而使多任务学习效果可与专用单任务模型直接比较。
AI.result: 最优模型在单次前向推理中同时输出三项结果，取得 91.88% 分类准确率、91.41% Dice 与 96.23% AP@0.5。此外，基于分割推导的定位在该基准上优于专用检测基线，表明对于空间连贯的伤口目标，基于边界框的定位可能并非必要。
AI.conclusion: 医疗影像中有效的多任务学习不仅依赖共享表示，还取决于任务形式化、任务兼容性与基准设计。WILLIE 为多任务伤口分析提供了统一框架与基准，并提示分割导出的定位可作为更优的定位范式。

title: IRSTD-Agent: Agentic Infrared Small Target Detection via Zoom-Guided Interaction Learning
summary: Infrared small-target detection plays an important role in maritime monitoring and aerial surveillance. Although multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer promising capabilities for visual understanding, existing MLLM-based approaches struggle to precisely localize infrared small targets. In this paper, we propose IRSTD-Agent, an agentic framework for infrared small target detection through dynamic visual search. The framework enables an MLLM to adaptively determine where and at what scale to inspect an image and progressively gather fine-grained visual evidence for precise target localization. Five complementary visual tools (PROPOSAL, ZOOM, DETECT, DROP and REFINE) support object candidate discovery, adaptive observation, target localization, hypothesis rejection, and target extent refinement, together enabling a coordinated search process over original-resolution images. To teach the MLLMs to conduct this search, we introduce Zoom-guided Interaction Learning, which uses annotation-derived interaction trajectories to supervise tool selection and the corresponding arguments. Through extensive experiments on WideIRSTD-Full and IRSTD-1k datasets, we demonstrate that IRSTD-Agent outperforms the evaluated vision-language models and enhances the precise localization capabilities of MLLMs in IRSTD tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 IRSTD-Agent，一个通过动态视觉搜索实现红外小目标检测的智能体框架，让多模态大模型自适应决定在何处、以何尺度检查图像并逐步收集细粒度证据，配合五种视觉工具与 Zoom-guided Interaction Learning 训练，在 WideIRSTD-Full 与 IRSTD-1k 上优于所评估的视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 红外小目标检测在海上监测与空中监视中很重要。尽管多模态大模型（MLLM）具备视觉理解潜力，但现有基于 MLLM 的方法难以精确定位红外小目标（目标尺寸小、分辨率要求高）。
AI.method: 提出 IRSTD-Agent 智能体框架，进行动态视觉搜索：使 MLLM 自适应判断检查位置与尺度，逐步积累细粒度视觉证据。设计五种互补视觉工具——PROPOSAL（候选发现）、ZOOM（自适应观测）、DETECT（目标定位）、DROP（假设剔除）、REFINE（目标范围细化），在原始分辨率图像上协同搜索。并引入 Zoom-guided Interaction Learning，用标注衍生的交互轨迹监督工具选择及其参数。
AI.result: 在 WideIRSTD-Full 与 IRSTD-1k 数据集上开展大量实验，IRSTD-Agent 优于所评估的视觉语言模型，并提升了 MLLM 在 IRSTD 任务中的精确定位能力。
AI.conclusion: 智能体式动态视觉搜索是提升 MLLM 红外小目标检测与定位能力的有效途径。

title: Learning Conditional Source Distribution via Flow Reversal for Temporal Flow Matching
summary: We introduce CNP-Flow, a flow matching framework for temporal generation that learns conditional source distributions through flow reversal. Whereas standard conditional flow matching (FM) incorporates conditioning through the vector field and draws source samples from a standard Gaussian, CNP-Flow uses a conditional noise predictor (CNP) to produce an isotropic Gaussian source for each temporal condition. The CNP is supervised by source samples obtained through flow reversal, which maps observed targets backward through a pretrained FM model. A three-stage pipeline pretrains the FM model, trains the CNP, and fine-tunes the FM model using the learned source distribution, while preserving the FM backbone architecture. Across video prediction, video interpolation, and 7-DoF Franka robot motion planning, CNP-Flow consistently improves generation quality. It also matches baseline performance with fewer function evaluations. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/cnpflow

AI.tldr: CNP-Flow 是一种基于流反转学习条件源分布的流匹配时序生成框架，在视频预测、插值和机器人运动规划任务上一致提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 标准条件流匹配（FM）仅通过向量场引入条件，源样本固定取自标准高斯分布，难以针对不同时序条件生成适配的源分布，限制了生成质量。
AI.method: 提出 CNP-Flow：使用条件噪声预测器（CNP）为每个时序条件生成各向同性高斯源。CNP 由流反转获得的源样本监督——将观测目标通过预训练 FM 模型反向映射得到源样本。采用三阶段流程：预训练 FM 模型、训练 CNP、利用学习到的源分布微调 FM 模型，同时保持 FM 主干结构不变。
AI.result: 在视频预测、视频插值及 7-DoF Franka 机器人运动规划任务上，CNP-Flow 一致提升生成质量；并在更少函数评估次数下达到基线性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习条件相关的源分布并结合流反转监督，CNP-Flow 在保持骨干架构的同时提升了时序生成质量与采样效率。

title: CleanMDM: Clean Motion Diffusion Model for Multimodal Motion Cleanup
summary: Motion capture data is rarely directly usable, as they typically exhibit missing segments, jitter, drift and contact artifacts. Traditionally, corrupted motions are cleaned by animators through the manual identification of keyframes from noisy motion, subsequent keyframe correction, and interpolation between corrected keyframes to reconstruct coherent motion. While the rise of generative motion models has made automatic cleanup feasible, most approaches operate as black box denoisers with limited controllability, making it difficult to preserve reliable segments or enforce specific user intents. Inspired by animation workflows, we present CleanMDM, a unified multimodal motion cleanup framework that formulates cleanup as masked conditional generation with plug-and-play conditions. This single model supports arbitrary combinations of noisy 3D motion, sparse 2D keyframes, sparse 3D keyframes, and text. This design enables both automatic cleanup without additional user annotation and controllable cleanup under multimodal guidance. To further improve motion realism, we incorporate the Latent Motion Quality Discriminator (LMQD) to better match kinematic distributions and reduce skating, jitter, and interpenetration artifacts, and we apply Mesh-Aware Contact Projection as a test-time optimization step to enhance contact and physical consistency. Experiments across multiple datasets demonstrate that CleanMDM consistently outperforms prior cleanup and generation baselines, and that low cost conditions (text and 2D keyframes) provide reliable controllability gains in multimodal cleanup scenarios.

AI.tldr: CleanMDM 是一个统一的多模态运动清理框架，将清理建模为带即插即用条件的掩码条件生成，支持3D运动、稀疏2D/3D关键帧与文本的任意组合，并配合LMQD与Mesh-Aware接触投影提升真实感与物理一致性，在多个数据集上优于现有基线与生成方法。
AI.motivation: 运动捕捉数据普遍存在缺失片段、抖动、漂移与接触伪影，难以直接使用。传统上依赖动画师手工从含噪运动中识别关键帧、修正并插值，成本高。生成式运动模型虽可实现自动清理，但多作为黑盒去噪器，可控性差，难以保留可靠片段或落实用户意图。
AI.method: 提出 CleanMDM 统一多模态运动清理框架，将清理形式化为带即插即用条件的掩码条件生成，单模型支持含噪3D运动、稀疏2D关键帧、稀疏3D关键帧与文本的任意组合，从而兼顾无需额外标注的自动清理与多模态引导下的可控清理。引入潜在运动质量判别器（LMQD）以更好匹配运动学分布，减少滑步、抖动与穿模伪影；并在测试时应用网格感知接触投影（Mesh-Aware Contact Projection）优化接触与物理一致性。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，CleanMDM 持续优于先前的清理方法与生成基线；低成本条件（文本与2D关键帧）在多模态清理场景中带来可靠的可控性提升。
AI.conclusion: CleanMDM 借鉴动画工作流，以掩码条件生成统一多模态运动清理，兼具自动与可控清理能力，并通过LMQD与网格感知接触投影提升真实性与物理一致性，验证了低成本条件作为有效控制信号的可行性。

title: A Strong Baseline for Evaluating Vision Encoders in Multimodal Large Language Models
