summary: Evaluating vision encoders requires metrics that reliably predict their downstream performance in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Although recent studies have shown that cross-modal metrics can better capture such performance, unimodal metrics remain the dominant choice in practice. In this work, we revisit cross-modal evaluation of vision encoders through large-scale experiments. We identify important limitations in both the experimental design and methodological formulation of prior approaches. After addressing these limitations and introducing simple improvements, we propose RAVEL, a training-free method based on cross-modal nearest-neighbor retrieval. Despite its simplicity, RAVEL achieves state-of-the-art performance across our experiments, outperforming prior methods by a substantial margin. Our results demonstrate that simple cross-modal metrics, when evaluated under a careful and comprehensive setup, can provide a strong basis for evaluating vision encoders for MLLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文重新审视视觉编码器的跨模态评估，指出既有工作在实验设计与方法构建上的缺陷，并提出免训练的跨模态最近邻检索指标RAVEL，在实验中大幅超越先前方法，达到最优表现。
AI.motivation: 评估视觉编码器需要能可靠预测其在多模态大模型（MLLM）中下游性能的指标。尽管跨模态指标被证明更能反映下游表现，实践中仍以单模态指标为主。作者希望重新检验跨模态评估的有效性并修正既有方法的问题。
AI.method: 通过大规模实验重新审视跨模态评估，识别先前方法在实验设计与方法表述上的关键局限；解决这些局限并引入简单改进后，提出RAVEL——一种基于跨模态最近邻检索的免训练方法。
AI.result: RAVEL结构简单，却在所有实验中取得最优性能，且以显著幅度超越先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 在严谨、全面的实验设置下，简单的跨模态指标可为MLLM视觉编码器评估提供强有力基础。

title: Prism: Dynamic Sparse Attention for Native 2K Joint Video-Audio Generation Model Training
summary: Natively training joint video-audio generation models at higher resolutions empowers them to learn richer visual details and sharper motion dynamics. However, full attention incurs quadratic cost and, as resolution increases, spreads attention over increasingly redundant tokens, diluting learning signals for informative content and disrupting pretrained priors. Existing sparse attention methods either target training-free acceleration or overlook the unique structure of joint video-audio data, where cross-modal interactions are inherently concentrated around sound-producing regions. To address this, we propose Prism, a dynamic sparse attention framework for natively training joint video-audio generation models at 2K. In particular, Prism organizes the token sequence into spatiotemporal macro-zones, enabling the attention structure to adapt to local content. For each zone, it estimates local information structure via video feature variance along the channel and feature norms from the audio-to-video cross-attention, jointly capturing how visual content varies directionally and how strongly audio influences each visual region. Based on these signals, Prism dynamically assigns a tailored block shape to each zone, applying finer partitioning along axes of rapid visual content variation and strong audio-visual coupling. This encourages tokens within each block to remain semantically coherent, allowing block-level features to capture both visual content and joint video-audio interaction patterns. Prism further adopts a hybrid block selection strategy to dynamically determine per-query sparsity. Experiments show that Prism achieves 2.5$\times$ training speedup compared to full attention, while surpassing it in generation quality.

AI.tldr: Prism 是一种面向 2K 分辨率联合视频-音频生成模型原生训练的**动态稀疏注意力框架**，通过时空宏区划分与内容自适应的块形状分配，在显著降低计算开销的同时超越全注意力的生成质量。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率原生训练能带来更丰富的视觉细节与更锐利的运动动态，但全注意力的计算量随分辨率呈二次增长；同时，分辨率提升会使注意力分散到大量冗余 token 上，稀释有效信息的学习信号并破坏预训练先验。现有稀疏注意力方法要么只面向免训练加速，要么忽略了联合视频-音频数据的独特结构——即跨模态交互本质上集中于发声区域。
AI.method: 提出 Prism 动态稀疏注意力框架。首先将 token 序列组织为**时空宏区（spatiotemporal macro-zones）**，使注意力结构适配局部内容。对每个区，通过视频特征沿通道的方差与音频到视频交叉注意力的特征范数，估计局部信息结构，联合刻画视觉内容的方向性变化与音频对各视觉区域的影响强度。据此为每个区**动态分配定制的块形状**，在视觉内容变化快、音视频耦合强的轴向上采用更细的划分，使块内 token 语义保持一致，块级特征能同时捕捉视觉内容与音视频交互模式。此外采用**混合块选择策略**动态确定每个 query 的稀疏度。
AI.result: 相比全注意力实现 **2.5× 训练加速**，同时在生成质量上超过全注意力。
AI.conclusion: Prism 通过内容自适应的动态稀疏注意力，有效解决了高分辨率联合视频-音频生成训练中全注意力的二次复杂度与注意力稀释问题，验证了以音视频结构先验指导稀疏模式设计的有效性，实现训练效率与生成质量的双重提升。

title: Render to Reason: Novel-View Semantic Prediction Improves Spatial Understanding in VLMs
summary: Recent works augment Vision-Language Models with geometry features from pretrained 3D models, expecting that the geometric signal will boost spatial reasoning. However, we find that simply fusing geometry features and training on standard spatial QA yields only marginal improvements on high-level multi-hop tasks. We attribute this gap to a training-signal problem: standard spatial QA can be largely answered from visual features and language priors, so the geometry pathway receives weak gradients and fails to integrate with the visual features. To provide a training signal that requires geometry, we propose \textbf{novel-view semantic rendering} as an auxiliary training task that requires the model to predict the semantic layout of an unobserved viewpoint, inspired by humans' ability to mentally simulate novel viewpoints during spatial reasoning. This task encourages joint use of both pathways: geometry provides pose-dependent visibility, while vision provides semantic content. Our auxiliary task yields consistent improvements over the geometry-augmented baseline across all three benchmarks (up to +1.6 on VSI-Bench, +2.2 on ReVSI, +2.9 on our 3D-Point-QA dataset) and our full model surpasses prior open-source methods on VSI-Bench and on ReVSI. Project page: https://yuqunw.github.io/Render2Reason/.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现视觉语言模型简单融合几何特征收益有限，并提出"新视角语义渲染"辅助训练任务，通过迫使模型联合使用几何与视觉通路，提升空间推理性能。
AI.motivation: 现有工作为视觉语言模型引入预训练3D模型的几何特征以增强空间推理，但作者发现仅简单融合几何特征并在标准空间问答上训练，对高层多跳任务提升甚微。作者将这一差距归因于"训练信号问题"：标准空间问答大多可依靠视觉特征与语言先验回答，导致几何通路获得弱梯度，无法与视觉特征有效整合。
AI.method: 作者提出"新视角语义渲染"作为辅助训练任务，要求模型预测一个未观测视角的语义布局，灵感来自人类在空间推理中心智模拟新视角的能力。该任务鼓励两条通路协同：几何提供依赖位姿的可见性，视觉提供语义内容。
AI.result: 该辅助任务在全部三个基准上相较几何增强基线取得一致提升：VSI-Bench最高+1.6、ReVSI+2.2、自建3D-Point-QA数据集+2.9；完整模型在VSI-Bench与ReVSI上超越先前开源方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过设计需要几何信息的辅助训练信号（新视角语义渲染），可有效促进几何与视觉通路的联合使用，从而显著提升视觉语言模型的高层空间推理能力，并超越现有开源方法。

title: Unmentioned Checklist Findings Change How Reinforcement Learning Appears to Improve Chest Radiograph Report Checking
comment: 40 pages, 7 figures, 17 tables (main text and references pp. 1-19; Supplementary Information as an appendix, pp. 20-40). Submitted to npj Digital Medicine. Code: https://github.com/ali-vosoughi/VerifyGRPO-Rad
summary: Automated checks of radiology reports may rely on AI-generated checklists that leave findings unmentioned. We used reinforcement learning to train a vision-language model to fill in a 12-finding checklist from a chest radiograph without seeing the sentence under test; a separate checking model judged the sentence from the checklist. On held-out patients, a rule-based check and an independent medical checker, neither used in training, measured discrimination gains (Youden index) of 12.6% and 11.8%; only the rule-based check met the prespecified false-alarm criterion. Switching to the training format, which fixes finding order and enters unmentioned findings as absent, raised the training checker's measured gain and lowered the independent checker's, a prespecified comparison that yielded 6.2% (95% interval 2.0% to 10.5%) and, post hoc on held-out patients, 7.7%. Across 8 checking models, acceptance of a label-consistent negative statement about an unmentioned finding ranged from 1.0% to 97.0%. Labels were report-derived, not radiologist-adjudicated.

AI.tldr: 用强化学习训练视觉-语言模型生成12项胸部X线检查清单，以核查放射报告；模型格式会导致未提及发现被记为阴性，造成检查模型行为与评估结果显著偏差。
AI.motivation: 自动化放射报告核查常依赖AI生成的检查清单，但清单可能遗漏发现（未提及项），影响核查可靠性，需明确清单生成方式对核查性能与评估的影响。
AI.method: 用强化学习训练视觉-语言模型，在不看被检句子的条件下，从胸片填写12项发现清单；另设独立核查模型根据清单判断句子。在留出患者上用规则核查与独立医学核查（均未参与训练）测量判别力增益（Youden指数）；并比较训练格式（固定发现顺序、未提及发现记为absent）与替代格式的影响；另评估8个核查模型对未提及发现的label-consistent阴性陈述的接受率。标签来源于报告推导，非放射科医师裁定。
AI.result: 留出患者上，规则核查与独立医学核查的Youden指数增益分别为12.6%与11.8%，仅规则核查满足预设误报标准；切换到训练格式后，训练核查模型测得增益上升、独立核查模型下降，该预设比较为6.2%（95%区间2.0%–10.5%），事后留出患者为7.7%；8个核查模型对未提及发现的label-consistent阴性陈述接受率为1.0%–97.0%。
AI.conclusion: 清单格式与未提及发现处理方式显著影响核查模型的表观性能与评估口径；将未提及项默认为absent会抬高训练同源核查指标、压低独立核查指标，且不同核查模型接受未提及阴性陈述的差异极大，使用报告推导标签可能高估临床有效性。

title: DynaMesh: Dynamic 3D Texture Generation
summary: We present DynaMesh, a dynamic texture generation method for 3D meshes. Given a textureless shape and a text prompt describing an effect, our method produces an appearance that evolves while the object's geometry remains unchanged. Previous works on dynamic 3D content generation have focused on motion, where an object's geometry and position change while keeping its appearance the same. Methods on texture generation sit on the other side of the problem, painting appearance onto a shape as a fixed surface property and not as an evolving process. Neither addresses a visual effect that propagates on a 3D object. A natural route consists of two generators: a video model that shows the effect from a single view, and an image-to-3D generator that lifts each frame to 3D. However, the latter has no notion of time, so running it per video frame produces a sequence that flickers, loses effect details, and yields a different mesh at every video frame. Our method addresses these failures by conditioning a video model on a render of the mesh and the prompt to obtain a reference video, then running a frozen image-to-3D generator on the video with two changes. The conditioning of each frame is blended over a temporal window, and low-rank adapters are fit per shape to restore the lost details. The mesh is encoded once for the whole sequence, so geometry is constant by construction, and the output is a single mesh with a texture per frame. Applied to various objects and effects, DynaMesh substantially improves over recent video-to-4D and texturing methods, and can generalize its temporal effect to different shapes never seen during training. Our project page is at https://threedle.github.io/dynamesh/.

AI.tldr: DynaMesh 是一种面向3D网格的动态纹理生成方法：给定无纹理形状和描述效果的文本提示，在几何不变的前提下生成逐帧演化的外观纹理。
AI.motivation: 现有动态3D生成工作主要处理"运动"（几何与位置变化、外观不变），而纹理生成工作将外观作为固定表面属性而非演化过程，二者都无法刻画"在3D物体上传播的视觉效果"。若采用"视频模型+逐帧image-to-3D"的两段式方案，由于后者缺乏时间概念，会逐帧产生闪烁、细节丢失且每帧网格不一致的问题。
AI.method: 以网格渲染图和文本提示为条件驱动视频模型，得到参考视频；再将冻结的图像到3D生成器应用于该视频，并做两处改动：一是将每帧的条件在时间窗口内进行混合（blending），二是针对每个形状拟合低秩适配器（low-rank adapters）以恢复丢失的细节。网格在整个序列中只编码一次，因此几何在构造上保持恒定，最终输出为单一网格加逐帧纹理。
AI.result: 在多种物体和效果上，DynaMesh 相较近期视频到4D（video-to-4D）与纹理化方法有显著提升，并能将时间效果泛化到训练中未见过的不同形状。
AI.conclusion: DynaMesh 通过"视频先验+几何固定+时间条件混合+逐形状低秩适配"的框架，实现了单一网格上逐帧演化纹理的动态效果生成，兼顾了时间一致性与细节保真，并具备跨形状泛化能力。

title: Monocular markerless biomechanics for clinically interpretable gait assessment in spinal cord injury
summary: Three-dimensional gait analysis guides rehabilitation after spinal cord injury but depends on marker-based motion capture and force plates, which few clinics have. Monocular markerless pipelines have been established in fewer healthy adult cohorts but not in neurological cohorts. We present the SCAI SCI Gait dataset, comprising 239 adult individuals with spinal cord injury with synchronized video, motion capture, and force-plate measurements, we fitted a parametric body mesh to a single sagittal-view video, driving an anthropometrically scaled OpenSim model via virtual markers. Markerless lower-body kinematics showed state-of-the-art agreement with motion-capture measurements (r = 0.68-0.90, p < 0.001, and RMSE = 4.18-6.49 degrees), and accurate kinematics-based predicted ground-reaction forces closely matched those measured by force plates (r = 0.85-0.87, p < 0.001, and RMSE = 2.13-2.19 Newton per kg). Furthermore, conditional-dependence graph analysis with Markov blankets revealed that waveform components were conditionally associated with functional independence, and speed-stratified clustering revealed distinct mechanical strategies among individuals walking at similar speeds. These findings establish the use of monocular video as a scalable approach for clinically meaningful biomechanical assessment and data-driven phenotyping in patients with spinal cord injury. Github: https://github.com/SCAI-Lab/SCAI-SCI-Gait

AI.tldr: 该研究发布SCAI SCI Gait数据集（239名脊髓损伤成人，同步视频/动捕/测力台），用单目视频拟合参数化人体网格驱动OpenSim模型，实现无标记下肢运动学与地面反作用力预测，精度接近动捕与测力台，并揭示波形成分与功能独立性的条件关联及同速下不同机械策略。
AI.motivation: 三维步态分析对脊髓损伤康复有指导价值，但依赖标记点动捕与测力台，临床普及受限；单目无标记方法此前仅在少量健康成人队列验证，尚未在神经系统疾病队列中建立。
AI.method: 构建239名脊髓损伤成人的SCAI SCI Gait数据集，含同步视频、动捕与测力台数据；将参数化人体网格拟合到单一矢状面视频，通过虚拟标记驱动按人体测量学缩放的OpenSim模型；随后进行基于条件依赖图与马尔可夫毯的分析，以及按速度分层的聚类。
AI.result: 无标记下肢运动学与动捕高度一致（r=0.68–0.90，p<0.001，RMSE=4.18–6.49°）；基于运动学预测的地面反作用力与测力台测量吻合（r=0.85–0.87，p<0.001，RMSE=2.13–2.19 N/kg）；波形成分与功能独立性存在条件关联，速度分层聚类显示相同步速个体存在不同机械策略。
AI.conclusion: 单目视频可作为可扩展手段，用于脊髓损伤患者具有临床意义的生物力学评估与数据驱动表型划分。

title: SteadySplats: Resampling of Low-Variance Gaussians for High-Fidelity Stochastic Rendering
summary: Stochastic order-independent transparency enables efficient and elegant rendering of primitive-based radiance fields like 3D Gaussian Splatting models, but remains impractical due to the inherent visible noise in the output. We propose a principled approach to minimize high-frequency noise, addressing its sources at the representation and image synthesis level. During stochastic rendering, our history-based spatial resampling scheme drastically accelerates image convergence, while temporal importance resampling ensures coherence under camera movement. During training, a color regularizer implicitly reduces the variance along view rays in the 3DGS models. With these properties, our optimized, Vulkan-based renderer effectively mitigates output noise at low and high sample counts, achieving a substantial 13~dB PSNR increase in quality over previous stochastic methods at 1 sample per pixel and quickly converging to sorted 3DGS with an average L1 error of less than $10^{-4}$.

AI.tldr: 提出一种原则性方法，从表示与图像合成两个层面抑制随机顺序无关透明渲染中的高频噪声，实现高效低噪的3DGS渲染。
AI.motivation: 随机顺序无关透明（OIT）能高效优雅地渲染3D高斯泼溅等基元式辐射场，但输出固有的可见噪声使其难以实用。
AI.method: 在随机渲染阶段，采用基于历史的空域重采样加速图像收敛，并用时间重要性重采样保证相机运动下的连贯性；在训练阶段，引入颜色正则化器隐式降低3DGS模型沿视线方向的方差；并实现基于Vulkan的优化渲染器。
AI.result: 在高、低采样数下均有效抑制噪声；相比先前随机方法在每像素1采样时PSNR提升约13 dB，并快速收敛至排序3DGS，平均L1误差小于1e-4。
AI.conclusion: 通过在表示和合成两个层面处理噪声来源，使随机OIT渲染在低采样下达到实用质量，并逼近精确排序渲染的精度。

title: Generating the Wild: Individual-Consistent Image-to-Video Generation for Wildlife
summary: Individual-level wildlife identification often suffers from data scarcity, as varying observations of the same animal under diverse poses, viewpoints, and motions are rarely available. Image-to-video (I2V) generation offers a promising way to mitigate this limitation by synthesizing additional observations from a single reference image. However, existing I2V models mainly emphasize global layout, semantics, and motion, and therefore often fail to preserve fine-grained local appearance cues that distinguish one wildlife individual from another, such as fur texture, stripe boundaries, spot configurations, and contour transitions. We observe that these identity-critical cues are closely related to high-frequency information. To address this challenge, we propose WildIcon, a high-frequency-guided I2V framework for wildlife individual consistency. Specifically, WildIcon introduces a frequency-aware identity encoding branch that extracts individual-specific high-frequency cues from the reference image. Combined with isolated foreground information, the resulting identity tokens are then injected into cross-attention blocks as identity conditioning. Building on a frozen backbone with lightweight identity adaptation, WildIcon preserves fine-grained identity cues visible in the reference image while retaining the motion controllability and semantic fidelity of the base I2V model. In addition, to support the training and evaluation of wildlife individual-consistent I2V, we construct WildlifeVid, a wildlife-centric video dataset with high-quality, temporally coherent clips and individual-level identity labels. Experiments on I2V generation and downstream animal re-identification (ReID) show that WildIcon achieves stronger individual consistency than existing baselines, and that its filtered outputs can serve as useful candidate training augmentations for downstream ReID.

AI.tldr: 提出高频引导的图像到视频生成框架 WildIcon，通过频率感知的身份编码注入高频个体线索，并结合 WildlifeVid 数据集，提升野生动物个体一致性并为下游 ReID 提供增强数据。
AI.motivation: 野生动物个体识别面临数据稀缺问题：同一动物在不同姿态、视角和运动下的观测难以获取。图像到视频（I2V）生成可缓解该问题，但现有 I2V 模型侧重全局布局、语义与运动，难以保留区分个体的细粒度局部外观线索（如毛皮纹理、条纹边界、斑点分布、轮廓过渡）。作者观察到这些身份关键线索与高频信息密切相关。
AI.method: 提出 WildIcon：1）频率感知身份编码分支，从参考图像中提取个体特定的高频线索；2）结合孤立前景信息生成身份 token，作为身份条件注入 cross-attention 模块；3）基于冻结主干网络加轻量身份适配，在保留参考图细粒度身份线索的同时维持基础 I2V 模型的运动可控性与语义保真度；4）构建 WildlifeVid 数据集，包含高质量、时序连贯的视频片段与个体级身份标注。
AI.result: 在 I2V 生成与下游动物再识别（ReID）任务上的实验表明，WildIcon 相比现有基线实现更强的个体一致性，其筛选后的输出可作为下游 ReID 的有效候选训练增强数据。
AI.conclusion: 高频引导的身份条件机制能有效弥补现有 I2V 模型在细粒度身份保持上的不足，为数据稀缺场景下的野生动物个体识别提供可行的生成式增强方案，并配套数据集支持后续研究。

title: EchoDino: A pediatric foundation model for transferable echocardiographic analysis across the lifespan
summary: Echocardiography is the most widely used cardiac imaging modality, yet interpretation demands integrating visual evidence across global anatomy, localized structures and dynamic cardiac motion. Machine-learning models have automated individual tasks, but they are typically built for a single purpose and depend on expensively labeled datasets - a barrier particularly acute in pediatric care, where data are scarce and anatomy changes with age. Here we present EchoDino, a self-supervised foundation model for echocardiography, created by adapting the DINOv3 framework to 3.7 million frames from 1.7 million unlabeled pediatric echocardiography videos. With its encoder frozen, EchoDino produces representations that capture global context, local anatomy, and dense spatial detail. We introduce Motion-biased Entropy Maximization Sampling (MEMS) to select the most informative frames for video-level analysis. Across nine pediatric and adult datasets, EchoDino outperformed strong baseline models, raising view-classification accuracy from 0.609 to 0.889 and the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve for structural-heart-disease detection from 0.811 to 0.872, while also cutting age-estimation error from 3.857 to 1.389 years, achieving the best segmentation accuracy and lowering ejection-fraction errors. By generalizing from label-free pediatric data to adult echocardiography, EchoDino offers a versatile foundation for cardiac image analysis across the lifespan.

AI.tldr: EchoDino：基于DINOv3的自监督超声心动图基础模型，用170万未标注儿科视频训练，冻结编码器即在下游任务上超越强基线，并可泛化至成人。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图解读需整合整体解剖、局部结构与动态运动信息，而现有机器学习模型多为单一用途且依赖昂贵标注数据；儿科场景数据稀缺、解剖随年龄变化，标注瓶颈尤为突出。
AI.method: 将DINOv3框架适配到370万帧、来自170万段未标注儿科超声心动图视频，进行自监督预训练；并提出运动偏置熵最大化采样（MEMS）为视频级分析挑选最具信息量的帧；下游任务使用冻结编码器提取表征。
AI.result: 在九个儿科与成人数据集上超越强基线：视图分类准确率0.609→0.889；结构性心脏病检测AUC 0.811→0.872；年龄估计误差3.857→1.389岁；分割精度最佳，射血分数误差降低。
AI.conclusion: 从不含标注的儿科数据出发可泛化至成人超声心动图，EchoDino为跨生命周期的心脏影像分析提供了通用基础模型。

title: Difference Feature Map Distillation: Transferring Inter-Sample Relational Knowledge Towards Efficient Transformer-Based Tracking
comment: Published in the 2026 IEEE Intelligent Vehicles Symposium (IV)
summary: In autonomous driving perception, visual object tracking systems must satisfy stringent latency and power constraints while remaining robust in complex and dynamic environments. Although transformer-based trackers achieve state-of-the-art accuracy, their substantial computational and memory overheads hinder deployment on real-time, resource-constrained platforms. To move toward this goal, we propose Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation (DFM-KD), a novel relational distillation framework tailored for transformer-based visual object tracking. Unlike conventional feature distillation methods that minimize point-wise discrepancies (e.g., mean squared error) between teacher and student feature representations, DFM-KD transfers knowledge through inter-sample feature differences, explicitly aligning the relational structure of the feature space. By distilling how the teacher models appearance variation and consistency across samples, rather than enforcing similarity in absolute activations, DFM-KD enables the student to better capture the structural dynamics of visual changes within a batch. As a result, the distilled model exhibits enhanced feature robustness and improved tracking performance. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DFM-KD consistently outperforms conventional feature-level distillation methods in both tracking precision and success rates.

AI.tldr: 提出DFM-KD：一种面向Transformer视觉目标跟踪的关系型知识蒸馏框架，通过蒸馏样本间特征差异来对齐特征空间的关系结构，在跟踪精度与成功率上优于传统特征级蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知中，视觉目标跟踪需在严格时延与功耗约束下保持鲁棒性。Transformer跟踪器虽精度领先，但计算与内存开销大，难以部署于实时资源受限平台，因此需要压缩/蒸馏手段。
AI.method: DFM-KD（Difference Feature Map Knowledge Distillation）关系型蒸馏框架。不同于逐点最小化师生特征差异（如MSE）的传统特征蒸馏，该方法通过样本间特征差异传递知识，显式对齐特征空间的关系结构；即蒸馏教师如何在样本间建模外观变化与一致性，而非强制绝对激活值相似，使学生捕捉批内视觉变化的结构动态。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，DFM-KD在跟踪精度与成功率两项指标上均稳定优于传统特征级蒸馏方法；蒸馏后模型特征鲁棒性增强，跟踪性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 以关系型（样本间差异）蒸馏替代逐点特征蒸馏，可更有效迁移Transformer跟踪器的特征空间结构知识，为资源受限平台上的实时视觉跟踪提供可行路径。

title: Rotated, but How Far? Diagnosing and Improving Object-Rotation Reasoning in VLMs
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can detect that an object has rotated across views, but cannot reliably tell by how much. We introduce OR-Bench, a fine-grained benchmark for object-rotation reasoning with eight tasks covering rotation detection, rotation magnitude estimation, and multi-view rotation reasoning. Across 12 VLMs, the gap is stark: the strongest models approach 100% accuracy on detection, yet even coarse magnitude estimation is near chance. When asked for exact angles, models place 91.8--100% of their predictions on just $0^\circ$, $90^\circ$, and $180^\circ$, a failure we term canonical-angle collapse. This collapse persists even without visual input. Representation probing shows that missing information is only part of the explanation. Although rotation information becomes less recoverable at finer granularity, substantial coarse-grained information remains, and a simple linear probe outperforms the models' generated answers. This suggests that VLMs underuse rotation information they already encode. We therefore propose RotationCue, a lightweight decoder that recovers coarse rotation information from the VLM's own frozen representations and feeds it back to the model as intermediate textual context. Across three VLMs, RotationCue improves every model--task combination on OR-Bench, raising macro-average accuracy by 7.9--12.6 points while preserving general capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出细粒度物体旋转推理基准 OR-Bench，揭示视觉语言模型存在“规范角度坍缩”现象，并证明模型低估了自身已编码的旋转信息；据此提出轻量解码器 RotationCue，从冻结表征中恢复粗粒度旋转信息并回馈为文本上下文，在三款 VLM 上全面提升性能。
AI.motivation: VLM 能判断物体是否发生旋转，却无法可靠估计旋转幅度。作者希望系统刻画这一缺陷的表现形式、成因（信息缺失还是信息未用），并据此提出改进方案。
AI.method: 构建 OR-Bench 基准，含八项任务，涵盖旋转检测、旋转幅度估计与多视角旋转推理，评测 12 个 VLM；进行表征探测（线性探针）分析旋转信息的可恢复性，并测试无视觉输入条件下的表现；提出 RotationCue：一个轻量解码器，从 VLM 自身冻结表征中恢复粗粒度旋转信息，作为中间文本上下文回馈模型。
AI.result: 最强模型旋转检测接近 100% 准确率，但粗粒度幅度估计接近随机水平；精确角度预测中 91.8–100% 落在 0°、90°、180°，即“规范角度坍缩”，且无视觉输入时依然存在。表征探测显示细粒度旋转信息可恢复性下降，但粗粒度信息仍大量保留，线性探针优于模型生成答案，说明 VLM 未充分利用已编码信息。RotationCue 在三个 VLM 上覆盖全部模型—任务组合均有提升，宏平均准确率提高 7.9–12.6 分，同时保持通用能力。
AI.conclusion: VLM 的旋转推理瓶颈主要不在于信息缺失，而在于对已编码旋转信息的利用不足；通过从冻结表征中提取并回馈粗粒度旋转线索，可有效缓解规范角度坍缩并显著提升旋转推理能力，且不损害通用性能。

title: T-JEPA: A Temporal Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture for Learning Better Remote Sensing Representations
summary: Earth observation (EO) data provide rich temporal supervision, yet existing remote sensing foundation models mainly exploit sequential observations through imposing predefined pairwise relations or aggregating holistic reconstruction context. We seek to further exploit the sparse and nonuniform temporal sampling inherent in EO sequences as supervisory signals. To this end, we propose T-JEPA, a temporal joint-embedding predictive architecture that learns time-gap-conditioned latent transitions. A shared single-frame encoder processes each observation, while a temporal predictor estimates the complete target latent field from a masked source latent representation and the actual elapsed time. Across multiple temporal intervals, these predictive constraints organize observed states into structured latent trajectories. Asymmetric metadata injection mitigates shortcut learning, and direct supervision across multiple temporal scales proves more effective than recursively rolling out intermediate states. In parallel, masked pixel reconstruction provides complementary supervision for preserving spatial details. Under matched pre-training data and throughput, T-JEPA achieves leading transfer performance on both static and temporal tasks. Analyses further reveal that T-JEPA learns representations with time-gap-dependent transition predictability and coherent latent dynamics, while maintaining strong cross-period consistency, representation diversity, and semantic discriminability.

AI.tldr: T-JEPA：一种时间联合嵌入预测架构，利用地球观测序列中的稀疏非均匀时间采样作为监督信号，学习时间间隔条件下的潜在状态转移。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感基础模型对时序观测的利用有限，多依赖预定义的成对关系或整体重建上下文，未能充分利用EO序列中稀疏且非均匀的时间采样所蕴含的监督信号。
AI.method: 提出T-JEPA，学习时间间隔条件下的潜在转移。共享单帧编码器处理各观测，时间预测器由掩码源潜在表示与实际流逝时间估计完整目标潜在场；通过非对称元数据注入缓解捷径学习，并在多时间尺度上进行直接监督；辅以掩码像素重建保留空间细节。
AI.result: 在匹配预训练数据与吞吐量下，T-JEPA在静态与时序任务上均取得领先的迁移性能；分析表明其表征具备随���间间隔变化的转移可预测性与连贯的潜在动力学，并保持跨周期一致性、表征多样性与语义可判别性。
AI.conclusion: 将EO序列中的时间间隔作为显式监督信号可有效组织观测状态为结构化潜在轨迹，直接跨尺度监督优于递归展开中间状态，为遥感基础模型的时间表征学习提供了有效范式。

title: HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models
summary: Long-horizon video world models require persistent memory to preserve scene consistency over extended rollouts. Softmax attention retains the full generation history through a growing KV cache, whereas recurrent linear attention compresses history into fixed-size states with substantially lower memory cost. However, we identify severe long-range forgetting in Gated DeltaNet (GDN), where information from distant but relevant scenes is progressively attenuated by subsequent state updates. To address this limitation, we propose HLA-WM, a training-free hybrid linear-attention framework that combines coarse-grained geometry-guided retrieval with fine-grained recurrent linear-state computation. HLA-WM exploits the affine structure of GDN to cache compact chunk-wise transition summaries, retrieve scene-relevant historical chunks using camera geometry, and recompose them into query-specific recurrent states. On the $60$-second SANA-WM-Bench, HLA-WM improves all six aggregate revisit-consistency and camera-control metrics of the base autoregressive generator without additional training, including a $0.74$ dB PSNR gain and a $28.5\%$ reduction in rotation error. The improvements persist after downstream refinement and generalize to MBench-A, where HLA-WM consistently improves all three revisit-consistency metrics across all four subsets and all evaluated inference modes over $547$ samples. At a $60$-second context, HLA-WM reduces historical-state memory by $12\times$ relative to full KV caching while incurring at most a $1.6\%$ reduction in inference throughput. These results demonstrate that selectively addressable recurrent memory can improve long-range scene recall while preserving the efficiency advantages of GDN. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/

AI.tldr: 提出免训练混合线性注意力框架HLA-WM，通过几何引导检索与分块循环状态重组，缓解Gated DeltaNet长程遗忘，在长时视频世界模型中兼顾场景一致性与内存效率。
AI.motivation: 长时程视频世界模型需持久记忆以维持场景一致性。Softmax注意力依赖不断增长的KV cache，内存开销大；循环线性注意力将历史压缩为固定状态、成本低，但作者发现Gated DeltaNet(GDN)存在严重长程遗忘：远处但相关的场景信息被后续状态更新逐步衰减。
AI.method: 提出HLA-WM，一种免训练的混合线性注意力框架，结合粗粒度几何引导检索与细粒度循环线性状态计算。利用GDN的仿射结构缓存紧凑的分块转移摘要，借助相机几何检索与场景相关的历史块，并将其重组为查询特定的循环状态。
AI.result: 在60秒SANA-WM-Bench上，无需额外训练即提升基础自回归生成器全部六项重访一致性与相机控制指标，包括PSNR提高0.74 dB、旋转误差降低28.5%；下游精炼后改进仍保持。在MBench-A的547个样本、四个子集和所有推理模式下，三项重访一致性指标均获提升。60秒上下文时，历史状态内存较完整KV cache减少12倍，推理吞吐损失至多1.6%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，可选择性寻址的循环记忆能够改善长程场景召回，同时保留GDN的效率优势。

title: Robust Local Optimization Done Right
summary: RANSAC scoring and local optimization (LO) impose different robustness requirements, motivating the separation of hypothesis selection from refinement. We systematically isolate the effects of robust-loss shape, incorrectly specified inlier scales, and optimization strategy on essential matrix, fundamental matrix, and homography estimation. A profile-marginal score marginalizes the nuisance inlier scale and selects an inlier partition, from which we estimate the scale that sets the LO loss width; this makes LO robust to an inlier scale specified too large, whereas one specified too small degrades selection itself. Refinement needs gradient from correspondences the seed currently rejects: optimizers that reweight from current residuals stay pinned to their seed, whereas methods with broad basins recover strongly perturbed seeds yet degrade accurate score-selected hypotheses, so basin size alone is insufficient to assess RANSAC LO. Joint half-quadratic optimization balances the two and is the most consistent strategy across model classes. An optimizer matched to the profile-marginal score, which never decreases it, does not reach the best accuracy, challenging the prescription that scoring and refinement objectives should match. Composed from these findings, our RANSAC reduces the median essential-matrix pose error of a state-of-the-art RANSAC on PhotoTourism from 2.23 degrees to 1.58 degrees with a correctly specified inlier scale and from 38 degrees to 6.2 degrees when it is grossly misspecified (128x too large).

AI.tldr: 该论文系统解耦了RANSAC中评分与局部优化(LO)的稳健性需求，揭示了稳健损失形状、内点尺度误设与优化策略对本质矩阵、基础矩阵和单应估计的影响，并提出profile-marginal评分与匹配的联合半二次优化策略，显著降低了位姿误差。
AI.motivation: RANSAC的假设选择(评分)与精细化(LO)具有不同的稳健性要求，现有方法常将二者目标混为一谈，缺乏对内点尺度误设及优化策略影响的系统分析。
AI.method: 通过profile-marginal评分边缘化冗余的内点尺度并选取内点划分，由该划分估计设定LO损失宽度的尺度；对比重加权型优化器（依赖当前残差、受制于种子）与宽吸引域方法，采用联合半二次优化平衡两者；并检验与profile-marginal评分匹配的优化器的表现。
AI.result: 在PhotoTourism数据集上，所提RANSAC将中位本质矩阵位姿误差从2.23度降至1.58度（内点尺度正确设定时），在内点尺度严重误设（过大128倍）时从38度降至6.2度；发现与评分目标匹配、且从不降低profile-marginal评分的优化器并未达到最佳精度。
AI.conclusion: 假设选择与精细化需分离考虑；LO应由评分所得内点划分设定损失宽度以容忍尺度过大，而优化需引入种子当前拒绝对应点的梯度；吸引域大小不足以评估RANSAC LO性能；联合半二次优化跨模型类别最一致；评分与精化目标匹配并非最优的必要条件。

title: A new design of a fall detection system integrating landmark identification and deep learning techniques
summary: This article introduces an innovative system that integrates landmark identification with deep learning to enhance fall detection accuracy and reliability. By utilizing advanced computer vision techniques, such as Media Pipe for spatial recognition, the system effectively differentiates between routine movements and actual falls. The integration of landmarks with a deep learning prediction algorithm minimizes false alarms, ensuring timely responses to genuine falls. Comprehensive experimentation underscores the system's versatility across various scenarios, emphasizing its potential to improve safety and independence for older adults. The training process demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy, stabilizing by the 40th cycle, while error rates decline significantly during the initial cycles. Real-time experiments, involving both male and female participants aged 8 to 50, recorded a remarkable 95% detection rate of falls, demonstrating the system's effectiveness and promising future applications in elder care and smart health monitoring environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合关键点识别与深度学习的跌倒检测系统，利用MediaPipe等计算机视觉技术区分日常动作与真实跌倒，实验显示实时检测率达95%。
AI.motivation: 提升跌倒检测的准确性与可靠性，减少误报，保障老年人及时获得救助，从而增强其安全性与生活独立性，并服务于养老照护与智能健康监测场景。
AI.method: 将关键点识别与深度学习预测算法相结合，采用MediaPipe等计算机视觉技术进行空间识别，用以区分常规动作与真实跌倒，并降低误报率；在多种场景下开展训练与实时实验。
AI.result: 训练过程中准确率稳步上升并在第40个周期趋于稳定，误差率在初始周期显著下降；实时实验中，8至50岁的男女参与者跌倒检测率达到95%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在多种场景中表现出良好的适应性与有效性，在老年人照护和智能健康监测环境具有广阔的应用前景。

title: Vision-enabled detection of safety helmet compliance in construction zones
summary: In the rapidly evolving field of construction management, worker safety remains a top priority. This paper introduces an innovative vision-based system for real-time detection of helmet compliance, specifically designed for construction sites, utilizing advanced computer vision techniques and machine learning algorithms within the YOLO (you only look once) framework. Our system leverages high-resolution video feeds from strategically positioned cameras to monitor adherence to safety regulations regarding helmet usage. By employing deep learning methodologies, the system effectively identifies individuals not wearing helmets, thereby significantly mitigating the risk of head injuries among workers. Our training and validation results revealed an impressive precision exceeding 97% at mAP@0.5 for both helmeted and non-helmeted individuals. Furthermore, our experiments demonstrate exceptional detection accuracy, demonstrating the system's resilience under varying lighting conditions and diverse worker movements. The consistent decrease in loss and improvement in metrics throughout training validates the effectiveness of the YOLOv8 model in enhancing recognition performance. The implications of this research extend beyond mere regulatory compliance, opening avenues for innovative applications in occupational safety management. This study highlights the critical role of technology in protecting lives and lays the groundwork for future advancements in smart construction environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于YOLO框架的视觉实时安全帽佩戴检测系统，mAP@0.5超过97%，可在不同光照与工人动作下准确识别未佩戴者，助力建筑工地职业安全管理。
AI.motivation: 建筑管理中工人安全是首要任务，头盔佩戴合规性监管亟待高效自动化手段，以减少头部伤害风险并提升职业安全管理水平。
AI.method: 利用部署在关键位置的高分辨率摄像头视频流，采用YOLO框架下的深度学习与机器学习算法进行实时目标检测，识别未佩戴安全帽的人员；通过训练与验证实验评估模型性能，并测试其在光照变化和多样工人动作下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在佩戴与未佩戴安全帽两类目标上，mAP@0.5精度超过97%；训练过程中损失持续下降、指标不断提升，验证了YOLOv8在识别性能上的有效性；系统在变化光照和多样动作条件下仍保持优异检测精度。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明YOLOv8可有效提升安全帽合规检测性能，意义超越法规合规本身，为职业安全管理创新应用与智能建筑环境发展奠定基础。

title: A Three-Dimensional Reverse-Projection Method for Sparse Point Cloud Completion and Its Application to High-Speed Train Nose Reconstruction
summary: Holes in LiDAR scans of environments with glass windows remain an unresolved problem in three-dimensional reconstruction. This study presents a pipeline for point cloud acquisition, filtering, completion, and surface reconstruction to address sparse sampling and missing window regions in scans of a high-speed train nose. FAST-LIVO2 provides the initial point cloud through multisensor odometry and mapping, and moving least squares (MLS) smooths the observations. We then introduce three-axis projection-based subdivision and interpolation with reverse hole boundary identification, referred to as three-axis reverse completion. The method interpolates missing regions from observations around each hole. Greedy projection triangulation, Poisson surface reconstruction, and a Marching Cubes-based pipeline generate meshes from the completed point cloud. Experiments on a proportionally scaled display model of a high-speed train nose show that the proposed method fills missing point cloud regions around the glass windows. Under the evaluation setting used in this study, greedy projection triangulation yields lower geometric distance errors than the other two reconstruction pipelines. The pipeline supports non-contact digital modeling of train nose geometry and provides a practical approach to reconstructing objects with glass windows.

AI.tldr: 提出一套点云获取-滤波-补全-曲面重建流水线，解决高速列车车头玻璃窗区域点云缺失问题，贪婪投影三角化重建误差最低。
AI.motivation: 含玻璃窗环境的LiDAR扫描存在空洞，是三维重建中尚未解决的问题；高速列车车头扫描中存在稀疏采样与玻璃窗区域点云缺失。
AI.method: FAST-LIVO2多传感器里程计与建图获取初始点云，MLS平滑观测；提出基于三轴投影的细分与插值，并结合反向空洞边界识别（三轴反向补全），从每个空洞周围观测插值缺失区域；随后用贪婪投影三角化、泊松曲面重建和基于Marching Cubes的流程生成网格。
AI.result: 在按比例缩放的列车车头展示模型实验中，所提方法成功填补玻璃窗周围缺失点云区域；在本研究评价设置下，贪婪投影三角化的几何距离误差低于另外两种重建流程。
AI.conclusion: 该流水线支持列车车头几何的非接触式数字化建模，为含玻璃窗物体的重建提供了实用方法。

title: InteractionBench: A Real-Time Interaction Benchmark for Streaming Video Systems
summary: A video assistant must speak when its instruction warrants a response and stay silent otherwise. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates this decision for the complete system of model, memory, and response controller. InteractionBench covers query responses, event triggers, and ongoing updates in 1,060 interactions over 812 videos, with 69 negative streams and 53 suites that pair counted events with look-alike near misses. It scores content accuracy, timing accuracy, and silence compliance on the video clock. Timely speech costs silence across systems. Polled Qwen3-VL-8B reaches 77.8 timing accuracy but 10.9 silence compliance. A native real-time interaction system reaches 29.2 silence compliance at 66.8 timing accuracy, yet emits on 89.9% of negative streams. No open-weight system clears a third of the near-miss suites. Fewer replies help only when chosen, as random deletion merely trades timing for silence. Offline scores miss these failures and mispredict online behavior. Adding restraint is costly, as the native system's controller adds little by itself and agentic systems add it only at about 30 s per poll.Project page: https://www.enxinsong.com/projects/interactionbench/ Code: https://github.com/Espere-1119-Song/InteractionBench Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/InteractionBench/InteractionBench

AI.tldr: 本文提出InteractionBench基准，用于评估视频助手"该说时说、不该说时沉默"的决策能力，覆盖问答、事件触发与持续更新三类任务，并对内容、时机与沉默合规性进行打分。
AI.motivation: 视频助手不仅需要正确回答，还需判断何时应当发声、何时应当保持沉默。现有离线评测无法反映这种在线交互决策的失败模式，也无法预测真实系统的行为。
AI.method: 构建InteractionBench，包含812个视频上的1,060次交互，涵盖69条负样本流和53个将计数事件与相似"近失"（near miss）配对的测试套件；在视频时钟上评估内容准确率、时机准确率与沉默合规性；对轮询式Qwen3-VL-8B、原生实时交互系统等进行对比，并分析减少回复、随机删除、额外控制模块等策略的影响。
AI.result: 轮询式Qwen3-VL-8B时机准确率77.8%但沉默合规性仅10.9%；原生实时交互系统沉默合规性29.2%、时机准确率66.8%，却在89.9%的负样本流上误发音；无开源权重系统能通过三分之一以上的近失套件；随机删除回复只是以时机换取沉默；离线分数无法预测在线行为；原生系统的控制器自身贡献有限，智能体式方案每次轮询约需30秒。
AI.conclusion: 视频助手的核心挑战在于发言与沉默的权衡，现有系统普遍缺乏"克制"能力，且离线评测严重高估其在线表现；提升沉默合规性代价高昂，需要专门的控制机制设计。

title: FairRSFM: A Biome-Aware Benchmark and Debiasing Framework for Remote Sensing Foundation Models
summary: Remote sensing foundation models (RSFMs) are commonly evaluated using aggregate metrics, which can hide systematic performance disparities across ecological regions. We introduce FairRSFM, a biome-aware benchmark for evaluating ecological group robustness in RSFMs. FairRSFM maps georeferenced samples from 14 terrestrial biome classes into six ecologically meaningful macro-groups and evaluates models under a unified frozen-backbone evaluation protocol. The benchmark covers four downstream datasets: m-EuroSAT, m-BigEarthNet, m-SA-Crop-Type, and MMEarth20K with Dynamic World label maps. Using Prithvi-EO-2.0, SatMAE, and DOFA across three random seeds, we show that aggregate performance consistently masks biome-dependent disparities across architectures and tasks. For example, Prithvi-EO-2.0 reaches 90.98% overall macro-F1 on m-EuroSAT but a mean worst-group score of only 83.72%, while m-SA-Crop-Type drops from 27.30% overall mIoU to 18.47% in the Xeric and Mineralogical group. We further evaluate Biome-Orthogonal Linear Probing (BOLP), Dynamic Biome Reweighting (DBR), and GroupDRO as complementary mitigation baselines. Their effectiveness is model- and task-dependent; for example, BOLP improves Prithvi-EO-2.0 worst-group F1@opt on m-BigEarthNet from 46.12% to 50.27% without updating the RSFM backbone. FairRSFM provides a reusable protocol for diagnosing and mitigating ecological robustness gaps in remote sensing foundation models. Code and datasets are available at: https://github.com/aminurhossain/FairRSFM.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FairRSFM，一个面向遥感基础模型的生物群系感知基准，揭示并缓解生态群体鲁棒性差距。
AI.motivation: 遥感基础模型（RSFMs）通常仅用聚合指标评估，这会掩盖不同生态区域间的系统性性能差异，缺乏对生态群体鲁棒性的诊断手段。
AI.method: FairRSFM将14类陆地生物群系的带地理坐标样本映射为6个生态宏组，在统一冻结骨干评估协议下评测。覆盖m-EuroSAT、m-BigEarthNet、m-SA-Crop-Type及带Dynamic World标签图的MMEarth20K四个下游数据集，使用Prithvi-EO-2.0、SatMAE、DOFA及三个随机种子。并提出/评估BOLP、DBR与GroupDRO三种缓解基线。
AI.result: 聚合性能一致地掩盖了跨架构与任务的生物群系依赖性差异。如Prithvi-EO-2.0在m-EuroSAT整体macro-F1达90.98%，但最差组均值仅83.72%；m-SA-Crop-Type从整体mIoU 27.30%降至Xeric and Mineralogical组18.47%。缓解方法效果依赖模型与任务，BOLP在不更新骨干情况下将Prithvi-EO-2.0在m-BigEarthNet的worst-group F1@opt从46.12%提升至50.27%。
AI.conclusion: FairRSFM为诊断与缓解遥感基础模型的生态鲁棒性差距提供了可复用协议，代码与数据集已开源。

title: Gauss-Map Variation for Image Denoising: Geometric Analysis and an Anderson--Accelerated Majorization--Minimization Method
summary: We propose a Gauss-map variation (GMV) model for image denoising that measures the spatial variation of the tangent-plane projectors of the scaled image graph. We establish an equivalent representation of the regularizer in terms of the corresponding Gauss map and, using differential geometric tools including tubular coordinates and the Frenet frame, analyze its behavior across general $C^2$ and piecewise $C^2$ boundaries. The resulting estimates provide edge- and corner-contrast preservation properties. To solve the proposed model, we introduce a bilinear decomposition involving a unit normal field and a scalar magnitude field and develop an Anderson-accelerated majorization--minimization algorithm. The normal field subproblem admits an explicit pointwise majorization--minimization update, which is combined with an Anderson acceleration. For both $L^1$ and $L^2$ data fidelity terms, we establish sufficient decrease and boundedness of the iterates and prove that the generated sequence converges to a critical point of the penalized model. Numerical experiments on synthetic and natural images demonstrate the boundary preserving capability of the proposed model and its competitive performance in removing Gaussian and impulsive noise.

AI.tldr: 提出GMV图像去噪模型，基于缩放图像图切平面投影子的空间变化，结合微分几何分析与Anderson加速MM算法，实现边界保持的去噪。
AI.motivation: 在图像去噪中，如何在去除噪声的同时有效保持边缘和角点等几何特征，是一个核心挑战；需要一种能够刻画并保持边界对比度的正则化模型及相应的高效求解算法。
AI.method: 提出Gauss-map variation (GMV)模型，度量缩放图像图切平面投影子的空间变化；用对应Gauss map给出正则子的等价表示，借助管状坐标和Frenet标架等微分几何工具分析其在一般C^2及分段C^2边界上的行为；引入由单位法向场和标量幅值场构成的双线性分解，设计Anderson加速的majorization--minimization算法，法向场子问题具有显式逐点MM更新；对L^1与L^2数据保真项证明了迭代的充分下降性、有界性及收敛到临界点。
AI.result: 理论分析给出边缘和角点对比度保持性质；算法对L^1和L^2保真项均具收敛性保证；合成与自然图像实验表明模型具有边界保持能力，并在去除高斯噪声和脉冲噪声方面具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: GMV模型通过微分几何刻画图切平面投影变化，兼具边界保持性与去噪竞争力，配合Anderson加速MM算法具有理论收敛保证，适用于高斯与脉冲噪声去除。

title: Level-of-Token Diffusion
summary: Image and video diffusion models allocate equal computation to every region, even when the intended scene calls for varying levels of detail. The spatial distribution of detail can often be anticipated before generation, indicating where computation can be reduced. We introduce Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion, a framework that turns this knowledge into an explicit multiresolution token layout (Level-of-Token layout) for adaptive and efficient generation. Tokens represent rectangular patches of varying sizes and shapes, allocating finer tokens where detail is needed and coarser tokens elsewhere. We adapt pretrained diffusion transformers to LoT layouts through a patch-wise asymmetric flow parametrization and embeddings for multiresolution tokens, preserving full-resolution flow prediction at every denoising step while processing only a reduced token sequence. LoT Diffusion enables layout-adaptive generation while preserving pretrained generative priors. We demonstrate LoT with layouts derived from semantic masks, bounding boxes, texture variance, and depth-of-field cues, as well as agentic plans. Across image and video generation, LoT offers favorable quality-efficiency tradeoffs, with significant speedups determined by the layout's token budget. Our project website is at https://georgenakayama.github.io/lotdiffusion/.

AI.tldr: LoT Diffusion 提出“Token 层级布局”实现自适应多分辨率生成，按细节需求分配粗细 Token，显著提升图像/视频扩散生成效率。
AI.motivation: 现有图像与视频扩散模型对所有区域分配相同计算量，即使场景中不同区域所需细节程度差异明显，造成计算浪费。而细节的空间分布通常可在生成前预知，因此存在按需分配计算的可能。
AI.method: 提出 Level-of-Token (LoT) Diffusion 框架，将细节分布转化为显式的多分辨率 Token 布局：Token 表示不同大小与形状的矩形块，细节区域使用细 Token，其余区域使用粗 Token。通过对预训练扩散 Transformer 进行 patch-wise 非对称 flow 参数化及多分辨率 Token 嵌入，在每步去噪中保持全分辨率 flow 预测，同时仅处理缩减后的 Token 序列。
AI.result: 在图像和视频生成任务中，LoT 在保持预训练生成先验的同时支持布局自适应生成，并实现良好的质量—效率权衡，加速幅度取决于布局的 Token 预算。布局来源于语义掩码、边界框、纹理方差、景深线索以及智能体规划等。
AI.conclusion: LoT Diffusion 通过在生成前利用可预知的细节分布构建多分辨率 Token 布局，实现了自适应且高效的扩散生成，在不牺牲生成质量的前提下显著降低计算量。

title: Imagine to Act: High-Fidelity Data Synthesis via Image Editing World Model for Scalable GUI Agent Training
summary: Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for automating complex digital workflows across diverse applications. However, training highly capable and generalizable agents fundamentally relies on massive, high-fidelity visual-action trajectories, which are notoriously difficult to acquire. While human demonstrations are unscalable, existing GUI world models rely on text descriptions or HTML rendering, discarding crucial pixel-level visual details like icons and layout styles. To address this issue, we introduce Infinite-Dreamer, a simulation-free data synthesis method powered by a pixel-level Image Editing World Model. By conceptualizing GUI transitions as image editing tasks, we leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to describe action-induced UI changes as structured delta-text. We then fine-tune an image editing backbone to controllably synthesize realistic screenshot transitions. We utilize this model to generate both single-frame visual robustness data and multi-step imaginary trajectories. To validate the effectiveness of our approach, we fine-tune the Qwen3-VL baseline solely on the synthesized data to obtain Infinite-Actor, and evaluate it on AndroidWorld, MobileWorld, and AndroidControl-Curated benchmarks. Infinite-Actor consistently outperforms the Qwen3-VL baselines across scales: Infinite-Actor-8B improves AndroidWorld Pass@1 by +4.45 and nearly doubles the MobileWorld Pass@3 success rate, while Infinite-Actor-2B improves Pass@1 by +9.05. Code is available at https://github.com/swaydy-n/Infinite-Dreamer.

AI.tldr: Infinite-Dreamer 提出一种无需仿真的 GUI 数据合成方法，利用像素级图像编辑世界模型生成高保真视觉-动作轨迹，仅用合成数据微调即可显著提升 GUI 智能体性能。
AI.motivation: 训练高能力、可泛化的 GUI 智能体依赖大规模高保真视觉-动作轨迹，但此类数据获取困难：人工示范无法扩展，现有 GUI 世界模型依赖文本描述或 HTML 渲染，丢弃了图标、布局风格等关键像素级视觉细节。
AI.method: 提出 Infinite-Dreamer：将 GUI 状态转移建模为图像编辑任务，用 VLM 将动作引起的 UI 变化描述为结构化 delta-text；基于该文本微调图像编辑骨干网络，实现可控的截图转移合成；用该模型生成单帧视觉鲁棒性数据与多步想象轨迹；仅在合成数据上微调 Qwen3-VL 得到 Infinite-Actor。
AI.result: 在 AndroidWorld、MobileWorld 与 AndroidControl-Curated 上评估：Infinite-Actor-8B 使 AndroidWorld Pass@1 提升 +4.45，MobileWorld Pass@3 成功率接近翻倍；Infinite-Actor-2B 使 Pass@1 提升 +9.05，各规模均优于 Qwen3-VL 基线。
AI.conclusion: 像素级图像编辑世界模型可有效合成高保真 GUI 轨迹数据，无需真实环境仿真或人工示范即可显著提升 GUI 智能体的性能与泛化能力，为可扩展的数据合成提供了新范式。

title: Weave Mamba Fusion: Global Cross-Scale Interaction for Lightweight Face Detection
summary: Feature pyramid methods, from FPN to BiFPN, have achieved strong performance in face detection by fusing multi-scale features. However, detecting faces under unconstrained conditions, such as small scale, occlusion, and extreme pose, remains difficult, as it requires global cross-scale dependencies that local fusion cannot model. State space models such as Mamba provide global context with linear complexity by scanning features as a sequence, and therefore offer a promising direction for this problem. Nevertheless, such a scan needs the two pyramid scales combined into a single feature map, and the way they are combined determines whether cross-scale structure is preserved. Summation collapses the two scales before the scan, so the scan has no cross-scale structure to exploit, while concatenation keeps both scales but at far higher cost. To address this, we propose \textbf{Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)}, which interleaves two adjacent pyramid scales column by column so that each step of a horizontal bidirectional SS2D scan moves from one scale to the other. With partial-channel processing and parameter-free de-weaving, WMF enables efficient cross-scale interaction while preserving feature structure. Integrating WMF into every fusion node yields \textbf{WeaveBiFPN}, the neck of our \textbf{WeaveFace} detector. On WIDER FACE, WeaveFace achieves 91.41\% mean AP with only 0.34M parameters and 1.16 GFLOPs, outperforming prior detectors under 0.5M parameters. Its largest gains are on the Hard subset, where it reaches 87.14\% AP. The code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/dohun-mat/WeaveMambaFusion}.

AI.tldr: 提出Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)与WeaveBiFPN，通过列交织相邻金字塔尺度实现高效跨尺度融合，构建WeaveFace检测器，在WIDER FACE上以0.34M参数和1.16 GFLOPs达到91.41% mAP。
AI.motivation: 特征金字塔融合方法（FPN、BiFPN）在非受限人脸检测（小尺度、遮挡、极端姿态）中难以建模全局跨尺度依赖，而局部融合无法满足需求。状态空间模型（如Mamba）能以线性复杂度提供全局上下文，但将其用于金字塔需先将两个尺度合并为单一特征图，合并方式决定跨尺度结构能否保留：求和会提前坍缩尺度，扫描无从利用跨尺度结构；拼接保留双尺度但代价过高。
AI.method: 提出Weave Mamba Fusion (WMF)，将相邻两个金字塔尺度按列逐列交织，使水平双向SS2D扫描的每一步在不同尺度间切换；结合部分通道处理与无参数de-weaving，在保留特征结构的同时实现高效跨尺度交互。将WMF集成到每个融合节点构成WeaveBiFPN，作为WeaveFace检测器的neck。
AI.result: 在WIDER FACE上，WeaveFace以仅0.34M参数和1.16 GFLOPs取得91.41%平均AP，优于0.5M参数以下的现有检测器；在Hard子集增益最大，达到87.14% AP。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过列交织方式将Mamba式状态空间扫描引入多尺度金字塔融合，可在低计算与低参数开销下有效建模跨尺度全局依赖，显著提升非受限人脸检测性能，尤其对Hard子集效果明显。

title: Certification of Real Images through Calibrated Content Authentication
summary: Generative models can synthesize high-quality inauthentic multimedia content that is already being misused at scale. We evaluate twenty deepfake detectors against ten generators released in the last four years and find accuracy decreasing over time, from near-perfect 99.5% to 76%. Adversarial perturbations further reduce every baseline detector to below 2% accuracy, effectively inverting the detector's assigned label. We argue that this unreliability reflects a fundamental ambiguity: generators can reproduce authentic content exactly (e.g., through memorization), so content alone cannot reveal the true provenance label.For this reason, content produced by a generator must admit a faithful reconstruction by that same generator, and finding such a reconstruction makes synthetic provenance plausible and authenticity plausibly deniable.We therefore propose and evaluate a detection paradigm that outputs a calibrated prediction of whether authenticity is plausibly deniable: a faithful reconstruction by any known generator establishes plausible deniability, while calibration bounds how often content from known generators fails to be reproduced. Our evaluation shows that (i) our detector can be calibrated so that at most 1% of generated content is wrongly certified, an operating point at which most baseline detectors reach near-zero recall, including the strongest with 93% accuracy; (ii) calibrating a stricter security threshold on attacked samples preserves this bound against adaptive adversaries within the evaluated bounded-perturbation attack space, whose perturbations break every baseline, but does not cover arbitrary adversarial transformations; and (iii) post-hoc verifiability is eroding, as 1,116 of 3,000 Reddit images resist reproduction by a 2022 generator, but only 55 to 79 resist reproduction by 2024 generators.

AI.tldr: 论文评估20个深度伪造检测器对10个生成器的检测能力，发现准确率从99.5%降至76%，对抗扰动可将所有基线检测器降至2%以下；作者提出"合理否认性"检测范式，通过可复现性校准实现最多1%误认证率，并揭示后验可验证性正随生成器迭代而迅速衰退。
AI.motivation: 生成模型已大规模制造高质量伪造内容并被滥用，但现有检测器面对新生成器和对抗扰动时可靠性急剧下降。作者认为这种不可靠源于根本性歧义：生成器可通过记忆化精确复现真实内容，因此单纯依赖内容无法揭示真实来源标签，需要重新定义检测目标。
AI.method: 提出"合理否认性"检测范式：若某已知生成器能对内容进行忠实重建，则合成来源可信且真实性可被合理否认。据此设计检测器，输出"真实性是否可合理否认"的校准预测；以忠实重建确立否认性，以校准约束已知生成器内容被误判为不可复现的频率，并针对有界扰动攻击样本设置更严格安全阈值。
AI.result: (i) 检测器可校准至最多1%生成内容被错误认证，此时多数基线检测器召回率趋近于零，包括准确率93%的最强基线；(ii) 在有界扰动攻击空间内，对受攻击样本采用更严格阈值仍能维持该界限以抵御自适应对手，而这些扰动可攻破所有基线，但不覆盖任意对抗变换；(iii) 后验可验证性正在衰退：3000张Reddit图像中，2022生成器有1116张无法复现，而2024生成器仅55至79张无法复现。
AI.conclusion: 内容本身无法可靠判定来源，检测应从"真假判别"转向"合理否认性"的校准预测。该方法在误认证率约束上显著优于传统检测器，并在特定攻击空间内具备鲁棒性，但无法覆盖任意对抗变换；同时生成能力快速演进正持续侵蚀后验可验证性，凸显该范式的紧迫性。

title: fMRI-TAMCL: Text-Anchored Supervised Multimodal Contrastive Learning for fMRI-Based Brain Disorder Classification
summary: Resting-state fMRI is important in the classification of brain disorders, but highly multimodal and exhibits strong multisite heterogeneity. Existing methods fuse images, BOLD-based functional connectivity, and phenotypic data modalities. Unlike other medical imaging datasets, rs-fMRI datasets rarely include a text modality, so they are generated from phenotypic data or BOLD activations. These text generation methods rely on fixed assumptions for subjects, sites, devices, and protocols, leading to poor generalization across datasets. We propose fMRI-TAMCL, a text-anchored multimodal contrastive learning framework that integrates fMRI images, sparse FC, and generated subject-specific text. Its Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation module generates BOLD activation text, while Feature-Value Serialization module generates phenotypic text. All three modalities are encoded as clustered graphs, projected onto a shared unit hypersphere space, aligned using pairwise, text-anchored supervised contrastive learning, and fused with attention. fMRI-TAMCL proves its generalization capability across five datasets outperforming 29 baselines with 78.6%-86.4% accuracy in downstream classification.

AI.tldr: 提出fMRI-TAMCL，一个以文本为锚的多模态对比学习框架，融合fMRI图像、稀疏功能连接与生成的受试者特异文本，用于脑疾病分类。
AI.motivation: 静息态fMRI（rs-fMRI）在脑疾病分类中很重要，但数据高度多模态且存在明显的多中心异质性；已有方法融合图像、基于BOLD的功能连接与表型数据。与其它医学影像数据集不同，rs-fMRI数据集很少自带文本模态，因此现有工作多从表型数据或BOLD激活生成文本，而这些生成方法依赖对受试者、中心、设备和协议的固定假设，导致跨数据集泛化能力差。
AI.method: fMRI-TAMCL包含两个文本生成模块：Subject-Adaptive Threshold Derivation模块生成BOLD激活文本，Feature-Value Serialization模块生成表型文本；将fMRI图像、稀疏FC与生成的受试者特异文本三种模态统一编码为聚类图，投影到共享的单位超球空间，采用成对的、以文本为锚的监督对比学习进行对齐，并通过注意力机制融合。
AI.result: 在五个数据集上验证泛化能力，优于29个基线方法，下游分类准确率达到78.6%–86.4%。
AI.conclusion: 文本锚定的多模态对比学习能有效缓解rs-fMRI多中心异质性与文本模态缺失问题，实现跨数据集泛化。

title: Spatial Supervision Without Attribution Optimization: Improving Post-Hoc Class Activation Maps via Box-Guided Evidence Routing
comment: 24 pages, 12 figures. Appendix included in the main PDF (pages 10-24)
summary: Post-hoc class activation maps (CAMs) are a standard tool for inspecting the evidence behind an image classifier's predictions, yet nothing in ordinary training encourages these maps to be spatially appropriate. We study whether inexpensive spatial supervision can improve a classifier's own predicted-class Grad-CAM without ever optimizing an attribution map. Box-Guided Evidence Routing (BGER) trains a lightweight gate on the final feature map under box or mask supervision and routes classification through the gated features, while Grad-CAM is computed separately at the pre-gate representation, so the evaluated map never enters the training objective. With a BCE routing loss, BGER raises MaxBoxAccV2 from $0.584$ to $0.715$ on CUB-200-2011 and from $0.757$ to $0.832$ on Stanford Dogs at comparable accuracy. Matched controls attribute most of the ResNet-50 gain to the spatial supervision reshaping the backbone rather than to routing itself: when classification bypasses the gate, most of the improvement remains, and detaching gradients through the gate leaves the ResNet-50 result nearly unchanged. The same detachment preserves most of the gain in two DenseNet-121 chest X-ray settings but removes the apparent gain on Swin-T, and directly supervising the CAM reaches stronger localization at a larger accuracy cost. Overall, spatial supervision can improve separately evaluated post-hoc CAMs, but both the mechanism and the size of the benefit depend on the architecture and the evaluation setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Box-Guided Evidence Routing (BGER)，用廉价的框/掩码空间监督训练分类器，从而在不优化归因图的前提下改善其自身预测类的Grad-CAM。
AI.motivation: 后置类激活图（CAM）是检验图像分类器预测依据的标准工具，但常规训练并不对CAM施加任何空间约束，导致其空间定位往往不合理。作者希望探究：廉价的、无需优化归因图的空间监督，能否改善分类器自身的预测类Grad-CAM。
AI.method: BGER在最终特征图上训练一个轻量gate，在框或掩码监督下通过门控特征进行分类路由，而Grad-CAM在门控前的表示上单独计算，使被评估的图从不进入训练目标。使用BCE路由损失。另设匹配对照实验：分类绕过gate、以及通过gate处梯度detach，以区分路由本身与空间监督对backbone的重塑作用；并在ResNet-50、DenseNet-121（胸片）、Swin-T等架构及直接监督CAM的设定下比较。
AI.result: 在BCE路由损失下，BGER将CUB-200-2011的MaxBoxAccV2从0.584提升至0.715，Stanford Dogs从0.757提升至0.832，准确率相当。在ResNet-50上，大部分增益来自空间监督对backbone的重塑而非路由本身：分类绕过gate时大部分提升仍保留，gate处detach梯度后结果几乎不变。同样detach在DenseNet-121胸片的两个设定中保留了大部分增益，但在Swin-T上消除表观增益；直接监督CAM可获得更强定位但准确率代价更大。
AI.conclusion: 空间监督能够改善单独评估的后置CAM，但其作用机制与收益幅度均依赖于具体架构和评估设定。

title: TasteRoute: Personalized Routing for Video Generation
summary: Rapid progress in video generation has led to a plethora of models that differ substantially in capability and generation cost. This raises a natural question: can each request be efficiently routed to an appropriate model? We find that even when the consensus of the other annotators is used as an oracle, it agrees with each annotator's own favorite only 34-55% of the time. Motivated by this observation, we introduce TasteRoute, a personalized video-generation router that selects a generator jointly based on the input request, user preferences, and available generation budget. Across text-to-video and image-to-video settings, TasteRoute is competitive with strong simple baselines on preference routing while reducing average generation cost. The cost saving increases under higher budget caps. Finally, we release TasteRoute-3k, a human-annotated dataset containing multi-model video comparisons, quality judgments, preference rankings, and user-profile signals to facilitate future research on personalized and cost-aware video routing.

AI.tldr: 论文提出TasteRoute，一个基于请求、用户偏好与预算约束的个性化视频生成路由模型，在文生视频与图生视频任务中以更低生成成本实现有竞争力的偏好路由效果。
AI.motivation: 视频生成模型在能力与生成成本上差异显著，用户偏好亦存在高度个体差异（以其他标注者共识作为oracle时，仅34-55%与个体偏好一致），因此单一模型难以高效满足所有请求，需要个性化且成本感知的路由方案。
AI.method: 构建TasteRoute模型，联合输入请求、用户偏好信号与可用生成预算进行生成器选择，覆盖文生视频与图生视频场景；同时发布TasteRoute-3k人工标注数据集，包含多模型视频对比、质量判断、偏好排序与用户画像信号。
AI.result: 在偏好路由上，TasteRoute与强简单基线相比具有竞争力，同时降低平均生成成本；预算上限越高，成本节省越明显；并公开个性化与成本感知视频路由的标注数据集。
AI.conclusion: 个性化与预算感知的视频生成路由可行且有效，用户偏好差异使个性化路由具有必要性，TasteRoute-3k为后续研究提供数据基础。

title: Fitting Vision Adapters at Frontier Scales
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment
summary: Training a small projector between a frozen vision encoder and language model is an established approach to multimodal learning. As the parameter count of language models scales dramatically, we revisit which vision capabilities this approach can add while keeping their pretrained weights fixed. Here we train a 50M parameter projector from the vision encoder of Kimi K2.6 to GLM 5.2 and 5.3, both models without native vision capabilities, and further present a reproducible recipe for training these adapters at scale. We study the following: (a) how vision capabilities of multimodal models scale as purely the language model side scales, and (b) what specific vision capabilities are able to be imbued into a pure language model at scale, and which ones remain limited. We evaluate on MMMU-Pro and BLINK, examining both overall performance and results on individual visual tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文通过在冻结的视觉编码器与纯语言模型之间训练小型投影器，研究了纯语言模型侧规模扩大时多模态视觉能力的可注入性与局限。
AI.motivation: 业界常用冻结视觉编码器加投影器的方式实现多模态，但当语言模型规模急剧增长时，尚不清楚这一范式还能为模型增添哪些视觉能力，以及哪些能力仍受限。
AI.method: 从视觉编码器（Kimi K2.6）向不具备原生视觉能力的语言模型（GLM 5.2 与 5.3）训练约 50M 参数投影器，并给出大规模训练此类适配器的可复现方案。
AI.result: 在 MMMU-Pro 与 BLINK 上评估整体表现及单项视觉任务结果，考察 (a) 视觉能力随语言模型侧规模缩放的变化，以及 (b) 大规模注入纯语言模型的具体视觉能力及其局限。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明小投影器搭配冻结编码器可在一定程度上为大规模纯语言模型赋予视觉能力，但不同视觉任务的可获得性存在差异，部分能力仍难以注入。

title: LoDEOT: Low-Dimensional and Efficient Offset Tokens for Building Footprint Extraction from Off-Nadir Imagery
summary: Instance-level roof-to-footprint offset (RFO) prediction is central to extracting building footprints from off-nadir imagery. Query-based pipelines commonly use high-dimensional instance tokens to predict signed two-dimensional RFOs. We investigate whether RFO prediction can instead use a compact offset token. Under local pinhole projection and vertical-extrusion assumptions, the idealized RFO map admits a five-parameter sufficient descriptor comprising intrinsic shape, composite amplitude, and relative geometry. This factorization provides a structural prior for a five-dimensional offset token, whose channels learn task-relevant latent representations through end-to-end training. Based on this design, we propose LoDEOT, which retains high-dimensional instance tokens for detection and segmentation but maps instance-token, concentration-gated roof, and box-mask evidence to a five-dimensional offset token followed by an independent two-dimensional readout. Known denoising-query target indices further align each supervised decoder-layer estimate with the same clean instance RFO, organizing successive predictions as target-aligned recovery under perturbed query conditions. Experiments on five real-world building datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of LoDEOT for building footprint extraction. Experiments on real-world building datasets demonstrate that a five-dimensional offset token can support accurate RFO prediction. On BONAI, LoDEOT achieves the best roof-detection bAP and bAP50 and leads all five offset-corrected footprint metrics among the evaluated end-to-end methods, with FAP50 of 54.58 and mEPE of 5.23 pixels. Its FAP50 exceeds those of the evaluated end-to-end baselines by 7.56-16.85 percentage points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LoDEOT，用五维紧凑偏移token替代高维实例token进行屋顶-足迹偏移(RFO)预测，有效提升建筑足迹提取精度。
AI.motivation: 从离轴(off-nadir)影像中提取建筑足迹的关键是实例级屋顶-足迹偏移(RFO)预测。现有基于查询的流水线通常使用高维实例token来预测带符号的二维RFO，缺乏结构化先验，token冗余且任务针对性不足。作者探究能否用紧凑的偏移token来完成RFO预测。
AI.method: 在局部针孔投影与垂直拉伸假设下，理想化RFO图存在一个五参数充分描述子（内在形状、复合幅值、相对几何），为五维偏移token提供结构先验。基于此提出LoDEOT：保留高维实例token用于检测与分割，将实例token、浓度门控(concentration-gated)屋顶证据与box-mask证据映射为五维偏移token，再经独立的二维读出层预测RFO。利用已知去噪查询目标索引，将各监督解码层的估计对齐到同一干净实例RFO，使逐层预测组织为扰动查询条件下的目标对齐恢复。
AI.result: 在五个真实建筑数据集上验证了LoDEOT的有效性。在BONAI数据集上，LoDEOT取得最优的屋顶检测bAP与bAP50，在评估的端到端方法中领先所有五项偏移校正足迹指标，FAP50达54.58、mEPE为5.23像素；其FAP50比所评估的端到端基线高出7.56-16.85个百分点。实验表明五维偏移token足以支撑精确的RFO预测。
AI.conclusion: RFO预测无需依赖高维实例token，紧凑的五维偏移token即可在结构先验引导下实现高精度预测；LoDEOT证明了该设计的有效性，并在多个真实数据集上取得领先性能。

title: End-to-End Autonomous Recursive Arborescence Deformable Flow and Non-Linear Hemodynamics for Patient-Specific Coronary Centerline Extraction
summary: Extracting patient-specific vascular trees from volumetric medical images is fundamental to computational angiography and non-invasive hemodynamic assessment. Conventional voxel segmentation models often sever delicate bifurcations, while heuristic Euclidean Minimum Spanning Trees introduce non-anatomical shortcuts. Moreover, linear Poiseuille flow neglects quadratic kinetic dissipation across arterial narrowings, underestimating ischemia. We formulate an end-to-end framework decoupling continuous geometric arborescence generation from non-linear hemodynamics. First, an autonomous 3D Ostium Landmark Localization Head with dual-sinus query channels and spherical-gated refinement eliminates centerline seeding dependency, achieving cohort mean localization error of 7.63 mm (7.43 mm LCA, 7.83 mm RCA; 71.4% <= 8.0 mm) from raw contrast context. Second, a Spatially-Grounded Deformable Step Flow Architecture queries continuous 3D feature pyramids via trilinear sampling, sequentially generating trajectories with anchor boundary enforcement (X(0) = P_start). Third, a Top-Down Recursive Arborescence State Machine detects bifurcation peaks via Tree-NMS and parameterizes predecessor parent pointers (p_k < k), guaranteeing single connected acyclic tree topology (beta_0 = 1, beta_1 = 0) with differentiable step termination. Fourth, an iterative Picard non-linear Kirchhoff solver with Young-Tsai / Gould quadratic dissipation enforces machine-precision mass conservation (residual 5.82e-11 mL/s). Across 14 development patients under standardized in-silico stenosis stress testing (Q_0 = 4.0 mL/s), linear Poiseuille flow misclassifies 75% diameter lesions as non-ischemic (FFR > 0.80) in 14/14 cases, whereas our non-linear solver captures functional ischemia (FFR = 0.5864, lesion disparity 32.89 mmHg, p = 6.10e-5) with 3.66x collateral shunting. Test set firewall isolation was maintained.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个端到端框架，将连续几何血管树生成与非线性血流动力学解耦：通过3D开口标志定位头、空间接地可变形步进流架构及自顶向下递归树状态机，实现单连通无环血管树拓扑；并用迭代Picard非线性Kirchhoff求解器（含Young-Tsai/Gould二次耗散）捕获功能性缺血。
AI.motivation: 从体医学图像提取患者特异性血管树是计算血管造影和无创血流动力学评估的基础。传统体素分割常切断细微分叉，启发式欧氏最小生成树会引入非解剖短路；同时线性Poiseuille流忽略动脉狭窄处的二次动能耗散，低估缺血。为解决这些几何与物理缺陷，作者提出将几何血管树生成与非线性血流动力学解耦的端到端框架。
AI.method: 方法包含四个模块：(1) 自主3D开口标志定位头，采用双窦查询通道与球门控细化，消除中心线播种依赖；(2) 空间接地可变形步进流架构，通过三线性采样查询连续3D特征金字塔，顺序生成轨迹并施加锚点边界约束X(0)=P_start；(3) 自顶向下递归树状态机，通过Tree-NMS检测分叉峰并参数化前驱父指针p_k<k，保证单连通无环树拓扑（beta_0=1, beta_1=0）与可微步终止；(4) 迭代Picard非线性Kirchhoff求解器，结合Young-Tsai/Gould二次耗散。
AI.result: 开口定位队列平均误差为7.63 mm（LCA 7.43 mm，RCA 7.83 mm；71.4%≤8.0 mm）。树拓扑保证beta_0=1、beta_1=0。非线性Kirchhoff求解器实现机器精度质量守恒（残差5.82e-11 mL/s）。在14例开发患者标准化在体狭窄压力测试（Q_0=4.0 mL/s）中，线性Poiseuille流在14/14例中将75%直径病变误判为非缺血（FFR>0.80），而非线性求解器捕获功能性缺血（FFR=0.5864，病变压差32.89 mmHg，p=6.10e-5），并伴3.66倍侧支分流。测试集防火墙隔离得以保持。
AI.conclusion: 该解耦框架有效克服了传统分割的拓扑断裂、EMST的非解剖短路以及线性流的缺血低估问题。非线性求解器相较线性Poiseuille流能更准确识别功能性缺血，表明在计算血管造影与无创血流动力学评估中纳入二次动能耗散至关重要。

title: Safe Image Generation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models achieve remarkable visual image generation performance, but they can still generate NSFW (Not-Safe-For-Work) contents, including violent or explicit images. Existing safety checker mechanisms are largely confined to pre-generation filtering (e.g. prompt-level text classifiers) or post-hoc moderation applied after an image is completely synthesized. However, adversarial attack methods operate over a much broader space. This imbalance highlights the need for a safety mechanism that intervenes during the generation process. We propose an in-generation safety framework that monitors the denoising trajectory and detects emerging NSFW signals from intermediate representations. Rather than merely detecting NSFW generations, our method applies reinforcement learning to generate safe images from NSFW prompts. By coupling in-generation detection with controllable steering, our approach mitigates unsafe trajectories even when NSFW signals emerge after generation has already begun. Experiments results show that our method consistently outperforms existing safe image generation methods across both standard and adversarial evaluation sets, while preserving perceptual quality and prompt fidelity. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种生成过程中的安全框架，通过监控去噪轨迹检测中间表示中的NSFW信号，并结合强化学习进行可控引导，从NSFW提示生成安全图像。
AI.motivation: 现有T2I模型仍会生成暴力或露骨等NSFW内容，而现有安全机制多局限于生成前过滤（提示级文本分类器）或图像完全合成后的后处理审核，无法应对对抗攻击所覆盖的更广泛空间，因此亟需一种在生成过程中介入的安全机制。
AI.method: 提出in-generation安全框架：监控去噪轨迹，从中间表示中检测正在浮现的NSFW信号；不仅做检测，还通过强化学习在NSFW提示下生成安全图像，将生成中检测与可控引导相耦合，从而在NSFW信号于生成开始后才出现时也能缓解不安全轨迹。
AI.result: 在标准与对抗评测集上，该方法一致优于现有安全图像生成方法，同时保持感知质量与提示保真度。
AI.conclusion: 在生成过程中进行检测与引导是应对T2I模型NSFW内容问题的有效途径，兼顾安全性与图像质量，代码将在接收后发布。

title: AstraSR: Real-World Thermal Super-Resolution with GPT-6 Astra
summary: Real-world thermal super-resolution (SR) is constrained by limited sensor resolution and the difficulty of obtaining corresponding high-resolution (HR) observations for direct model supervision. Conventional SR methods typically construct training pairs by treating captured thermal images with real-world degradations as HR references and applying predefined degradation to generate synthetic low-resolution (LR) inputs. Such a construction not only introduces a domain gap between synthetic and captured LR observations but also retains acquisition degradations in the supervision. To address this issue, we propose AstraSR, a real-world thermal SR method guided by GPT-6 Astra, a frontier multimodal generative model endowed with emergent and transformative visual capabilities. Specifically, we construct a dataset of image pairs by using captured LR thermal images to condition GPT-based HR reference. We develop a direct generative supervision strategy that learns from captured thermal inputs paired with GPT-generated HR references. Pixel, gradient, and perceptual losses jointly supervise the transfer of intensity patterns, structural boundaries, and visual details from the generated references. Qualitative comparisons with seven existing state-of-the-art real-world SR methods show continuous object contours, distinct structural boundaries, and smooth intensity transitions in the thermal scenes. These results demonstrate that AstraSR outperforms existing real-world SR methods in both thermal clarity and structural coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出AstraSR，借助GPT-6 Astra生成HR参考，实现真实世界热成像超分辨率。
AI.motivation: 真实热成像SR受限于传感器分辨率低，且难以获取对应HR观测用于直接监督。传统方法将真实退化热图当作HR参考，再施加预定义退化生成合成LR，导致合成LR与实采LR之间存在域差距，且监督信号中残留采集退化。
AI.method: 以实采LR热图作为条件，驱动GPT-6 Astra生成HR参考，构建图像对数据集；提出直接生成式监督策略，学习实采热输入与GPT生成HR参考之间的映射；采用像素损失、梯度损失和感知损失联合监督，分别迁移强度分布、结构边界和视觉细节。
AI.result: 与七种现有最先进真实世界SR方法的定性比较显示，热场景中目标轮廓连续、结构边界清晰、强度过渡平滑，在热清晰度与结构一致性上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: AstraSR通过GPT-6 Astra引导的直接生成式监督，绕开合成LR的域差距与退化残留问题，在真实世界热成像SR的清晰度与结构连贯性方面取得领先表现。

title: Every View Counts: View-Consistent Panoptic Quality for Multi-view Panoptic Segmentation
comment: 23 pages, 8 figures. Under review. Youngmin Lee and Byungha Ko contributed equally
summary: Multi-view panoptic segmentation assigns a semantic class and a scene-level instance ID to every pixel of an unordered set of images, and recent feed-forward 3D models predict these labels for the input views in a single forward pass. Their predictions, however, have been evaluated with the scene-level PQ (PQ^scene) borrowed from per-scene optimization methods, typically on rendered held-out views. PQ^scene tiles all views of a scene into a single image, so that a missed appearance or a change of ID lowers the score of the matched pair only in proportion to its area. We propose View-Consistent Panoptic Quality (VC-PQ), which extends PQ from a single image to a set of input views, counts equally every view in which an instance is visible, and penalizes a prediction that is not visible in the same views as its ground truth. A decomposition of VC-PQ attributes the score a method loses to mask accuracy, view consistency, and the matching threshold. A single additional parameter recovers the area weighting of tiling for comparison. Under a fixed evaluation protocol on ScanNet++ and ScanNetv2, recent feed-forward methods are evaluated with VC-PQ and PQ^scene, and the decomposition shows where each of them loses its score. Controlled perturbations of the ground truth show that VC-PQ responds to the number of views in which an instance is missed or changes ID, whereas PQ^scene responds to their area. The aim of this work is to make view consistency part of the evaluation of multi-view panoptic segmentation, with VC-PQ reported alongside PQ^scene.

AI.tldr: 提出VC-PQ，将全景质量从单图扩展到多视图集合，使视图一致性成为多视图全景分割的评价指标。
AI.motivation: 现有多视图全景分割的前馈3D模型评估沿用逐场景优化方法的PQ^scene，其将场景所有视图拼成单图，漏检或ID变化仅按面积比例扣分，无法反映视图层面的预测一致性。
AI.method: 提出VC-PQ，将PQ从单图扩展到输入视图集合：对实例可见的每个视图等权计数，并惩罚预测未在与真值相同的视图中可见的情况。对VC-PQ进行分解，将失分归因于掩码精度、视图一致性和匹配阈值；引入一个额外参数以恢复铺贴式的面积加权以便对比。
AI.result: 在ScanNet++和ScanNetv2的固定评估协议下，用VC-PQ和PQ^scene评估近期前馈方法，分解结果揭示各自失分来源；对真值的受控扰动表明VC-PQ对实例漏检或ID变化的视图数量敏感，而PQ^scene对面积敏感。
AI.conclusion: 应把视图一致性纳入多视图全景分割评价，VC-PQ与PQ^scene并列报告。

title: Prompt and Refinement: Asymmetric Mutual Learning for Infrared Small Target Detection with Noisy Labels
comment: The code will be released at https://github.com/fuyimin96/PAR upon acceptance
summary: Existing data-driven infrared small target detection (ISTD) methods typically require large-scale datasets with accurate pixel-level annotations for model training. However, such labor-intensive requirements are difficult to satisfy in real-world applications due to the heavy reliance on expert knowledge and the inherently weak distinctiveness of infrared small targets. Consequently, the presence of noisy labels during model training is inevitable, which can severely mislead the learning of target perception toward spurious patterns. To address this challenge, we propose Prompt and Refinement (PAR), a label-noise-robust asymmetric mutual learning paradigm for ISTD. Specifically, PAR comprises a pretrained Segment Anything Model (SAM) and an ISTD-specific detector trained from scratch, which learn collaboratively through a peer-teaching scheme. Coupled with local contrast regularity, the predictions of the two asymmetric peer models are mutually exploited as rectification cues for the supervisory masks of their counterparts. The interaction between complementary inductive biases effectively prevents the label correction process from degenerating into the self-confirmation loop of a single model, enabling progressive refinement of the annotations toward intrinsic target characteristics. In addition, the detector predictions are utilized as corrective mask prompts to facilitate task-specific adaptation of the vision foundation model. Moreover, an evidential uncertainty estimation strategy is introduced into the optimization process to further alleviate the adverse effects of noisy labels. Extensive experiments under diverse noisy label scenarios on three ISTD datasets demonstrate that PAR consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Prompt and Refinement（PAR）——一种面向红外小目标检测（ISTD）的标签噪声鲁棒非对称互学习范式，通过预训练 SAM 与从零训练的 ISTD 专用检测器相互“同侪教学”，结合局部对比度正则、掩码提示适配与证据不确定性估计，在多个含噪数据集上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有数据驱动的红外小目标检测方法依赖大规模、像素级精确标注的数据集。然而红外小目标本身辨识度弱，精确标注高度依赖专家知识，现实中难以满足，导致训练中不可避免地出现噪声标签，并严重误导模型学习虚假模式。因此需要一种对标签噪声鲁棒的 ISTD 方法。
AI.method: 提出 PAR 非对称互学习范式，由预训练 SAM 与从零训练的 ISTD 专用检测器组成，通过 peer-teaching（同侪教学）协同学习；结合局部对比度正则，将两个非对称对等模型的预测互为对方监督掩码的矫正线索；检测器预测被用作矫正性掩码提示，促进视觉基础模型的任务特定适配；并在优化中引入证据不确定性估计策略以缓解噪声标签的负面影响。
AI.result: 在三个 ISTD 数据集、多种噪声标签场景下的实验表明，PAR 持续达到最先进（state-of-the-art）性能。
AI.conclusion: 非对称对等模型间互补归纳偏置的交互可有效避免标签矫正退化为单模型的自确认循环，使标注逐步向目标内在特征收敛；PAR 为噪声标签条件下的红外小目标检测提供了一种鲁棒且有效的解决方案。

title: ReMem: Streaming Video Understanding With Long Context Retention
summary: Despite their impressive performance on a wide range of video understanding tasks, current Vision Language Models (VLMs) are predominantly designed for offline scenarios and struggle to handle online streaming videos that demand low latency response. Several studies have explored memory and token compression strategies in an attempt to adapt offline VLMs for streaming video understanding tasks. However, through our probing experiment, we identify that most existing works tend to progressively lose long context information as length of input stream increases. To address this, we propose ReMem, a novel training-free adaptation technique that enables VLMs to process streaming videos of arbitrary lengths while improving their long context information retention capability. ReMem exploits memory from two perspectives, implemented as two core components. The Streaming Context Memory (SCM) continuously compresses historical context with query-independent attention. The Retrieved Vision Memory (RVM) then retrieves the most salient, query-relevant context from memory to augment the VLM's input. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed ReMem achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across a variety of widely used benchmarks, spanning both streaming video and general long video understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出ReMem，一种免训练适配技术，通过流式上下文记忆与检索视觉记忆两组件，使VLM能处理任意长度流式视频并提升长上下文保留能力，在流式与长视频理解基准上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型主要面向离线场景，难以应对低延迟的在线流式视频。已有记忆与token压缩方法虽尝试适配，但探测实验表明其随输入流增长会逐渐丢失长上下文信息。
AI.method: ReMem为免训练适配方法，含两个组件：Streaming Context Memory（SCM）以查询无关注意力持续压缩历史上下文；Retrieved Vision Memory（RVM）从记忆中检索与查询最相关、最显著的上下文以增强VLM输入。
AI.result: 在流式视频和通用长视频理解等多类常用基准上，ReMem取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过双视角记忆机制，ReMem可在免训练条件下支持任意长度流式视频处理并改善长上下文保留，验证了记忆压缩与检索结合的有效性。

title: JLD: Perceptual Distance Through A Jacobian Lens
summary: Image compression, restoration, and generation all require a way to measure how different two images look to a person. Pixel error ignores how people see, while the most accurate perceptual distances are typically fitted to human judgments, tying them to a fixed data and resolution. For example, when image resolution is doubled, the correlation of DISTS with human scores on TID2013 drops from 0.815 to 0.717. We introduce the Jacobian Lens Distance (JLD), which derives its perceptual geometry from a frozen vision encoder rather than from human labels. JLD combines the locality of early patch features with the perceptual sensitivity captured by later encoder representations. Specifically, we use the encoder Jacobian to identify directions in the early feature space that most strongly affect the encoder output, producing a fixed metric tensor, $E[J^\top J]$, which we call the Jacobian lens. The lens is fitted only once from 100 unlabeled images, taking about 35 seconds. Locally, this construction defines a pullback metric in pixel space, giving JLD a clear geometric interpretation that can be directly analyzed on real images. Across four standard perceptual databases, JLD achieves state-of-the-art performance and consistently outperforms LPIPS, DISTS, PieAPP, and DreamSim. JLD is also robust to changes in image resolution, on TID2013, its lens-term correlation remains nearly unchanged when the resolution is doubled, decreasing only from 0.850 to 0.845. We further introduce JLD-fast, which is $4\times$ faster than LPIPS-VGG while achieving a mean correlation of 0.911. Finally, JLD naturally extends to video, reaching a correlation of 0.786 on Waterloo IVC 4K compared with 0.611 for VMAF.

AI.tldr: 提出Jacobian Lens Distance（JLD），从冻结视觉编码器的雅可比中导出感知几何，无需人类标签拟合，在多个感知数据库上达到SOTA，且分辨率鲁棒，可扩展至视频。
AI.motivation: 图像压缩、复原与生成都需要衡量两幅图像在人眼中的差异。像素误差忽略人眼感知；而最准确的感知距离通常拟合人类主观判断，因而被绑定到固定的数据和分辨率上（例如分辨率加倍时，DISTS与TID2013人类评分的相关性从0.815降到0.717）。因此需要一种不依赖人类标签、且对分辨率鲁棒的感知距离度量。
AI.method: JLD从冻结的视觉编码器而非人类标签中导出感知几何，结合早期patch特征的局部性与后期编码器表征的感知敏感性。具体用编码器雅可比识别早期特征空间中影响编码器输出最强的方向，得到固定度量张量E[JᵀJ]，即"雅可比透镜"（Jacobian lens）。该透镜仅用100张无标签图像拟合一次，约35秒。局部上，该构造在像素空间定义了拉回度量（pullback metric），使JLD具有可在真实图像上直接分析的清晰几何解释。还提出JLD-fast，比LPIPS-VGG快4倍。
AI.result: 在四个标准感知数据库上，JLD达到SOTA，持续优于LPIPS、DISTS、PieAPP和DreamSim。JLD对分辨率变化鲁棒：在TID2013上分辨率加倍时，其lens项相关性几乎不变，仅从0.850降至0.845。JLD-fast比LPIPS-VGG快4倍，平均相关性达0.911。JLD可自然扩展到视频，在Waterloo IVC 4K上相关性为0.786，而VMAF为0.611。
AI.conclusion: JLD通过从冻结视觉编码器雅可比导出的感知几何，避免了人类标签拟合带来的数据与分辨率绑定问题，实现了SOTA且分辨率鲁棒的图像/视频感知距离度量，并提供高效变体JLD-fast。

title: Label-Free Coreset Selection with Foundation Models for Efficient Annotation in Computational Pathology
summary: Computational pathology has the potential to improve clinical outcomes through a demonstrated increase in diagnostic and prognostic accuracy. However, the development and validation of deep learning algorithms still require annotated data, a costly procedure involving expert pathologists who already face critical workforce shortages. Existing coreset selection methods to optimize annotation efforts currently all rely on hyperparameters tuned on natural-image benchmarks that do not transfer to histopathology and are cumbersome to use in clinical practice. In this study, we present GCcore, a novel label-free coreset selection method that embeds every image of a dataset with any pathology foundation model and greedily selects the samples that collectively maximize the global coverage of the embedding space. The proposed method provides a lower-bound guarantee on the global coverage of the returned coreset for any coreset size, while being completely hyperparameter-free and deterministic. We demonstrate GCcore's superior performance over 14 baselines including state-of-the-art methods across 10 tasks and datasets spanning whole slide image classification, tile classification, and tissue segmentation, where it ranks first on six and within the top three on nine, while also demonstrating how existing methods can shift by up to five rank positions depending on their hyperparameter settings. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/OncoAI-ULBHUB/GCcore.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GCcore，一种无需标签、无需超参数的贪心 coreset 选择方法，通过在病理基础模型嵌入空间中最大化全局覆盖度，显著降低标注成本，并在多任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 计算病理学中深度学习算法的开发与验证依赖专家标注数据，而病理专家严重短缺；现有 coreset 选择方法依赖在自然图像基准上调优的超参数，无法迁移到组织病理学，临床使用不便。
AI.method: GCcore 是一种无需标签的 coreset 选择方法：先使用任意病理基础模型对数据集中每张图像进行嵌入，再以贪心策略选择能够共同最大化嵌入空间全局覆盖度的样本。
AI.result: GCcore 对任意 coreset 规模都提供全局覆盖度的下界保证，且完全无需超参数、具有确定性。在涵盖全切片图像分类、图块分类与组织分割的 10 个任务与数据集上，相比 14 个基线（含 state-of-the-art 方法）表现更优，其中 6 项排名第一、9 项进入前三；同时显示现有方法会因超参数设置不同而产生最多 5 个名次波动。代码已公开。
