AI.conclusion: GCcore 提供了一种免超参数、确定性强且带理论保证的 coreset 选择方案，可有效优化病理图像标注成本，并在多任务上超越现有方法，具备临床实用性。

title: From Transformation to Target State: Rethinking Query Representation for Zero-Shot Composed Image Retrieval
summary: Composed image retrieval (CIR) aims to retrieve a desired target image from a query consisting of a reference image and a modification text. This task exhibits an unusual representational asymmetry: the modification text specifies a transition from the reference state, whereas retrieval candidates depict completed target states. This creates a representation mismatch for zero-shot methods that query pretrained vision-language spaces directly with transformation-oriented language. We study this mismatch and reformulate zero-shot composed image retrieval as target-state reconstruction followed by retrieval. We instantiate this formulation with ASAP-CIR, a training-free framework that reconstructs a static target representation using a frozen multimodal large language model (MLLM). The representation combines multiple holistic descriptions with a variable set of importance-weighted atomic semantics, thereby preserving both overall target identity and fine-grained visual constraints. Retrieval then integrates holistic state alignment, atomic constraint grounding, and calibrated target-state evidence aggregation. A controlled text-only diagnostic shows that target-side static query formulations achieve more reliable retrieval than dynamic composed query formulations, particularly when source-state semantics must be suppressed or transformed. Experiments on FashionIQ, CIRR, and CIRCO further characterize the effectiveness and limitations of this representation principle, with the clearest gains on the multi-target CIRCO benchmark. These results show that how composed intent is represented before retrieval is a consequential design choice, distinct from the choice of retrieval backbone itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文将零样本组合图像检索（CIR）重新表述为"目标状态重建+检索"，提出免训练框架ASAP-CIR，用冻结的多模态大模型重建静态目标表示（整体描述+重要性加权的原子语义），并通过整体对齐、原子约束落地与校准证据聚合完成检索，在CIRCO等多目标基准上收益最明显。
AI.motivation: 组合图像检索存在表征不对称：修改文本描述的是从参考状态出发的"转换"，而检索候选是已完成的"目标状态"，二者语义层级不一致。零样本方法直接用转换导向的语言查询预训练视觉-语言空间，会产生表示错配。作者希望研究这一错配，并把问题重心从"检索骨干选择"转移到"组合意图如何被表示"这一设计选择上。
AI.method: 将零样本CIR重表述为目标状态重建后再检索，并用免训练框架ASAP-CIR实例化：利用冻结的MLLM重建静态目标表示，该表示由多个整体性描述与一组可变的、重要性加权的原子语义组成，以同时保留目标整体身份与细粒度视觉约束；检索阶段融合整体状态对齐、原子约束落地和校准的目标状态证据聚合。另设纯文本对照诊断实验，比较目标侧静态查询与动态组合查询两种表述方式。
AI.result: 纯文本诊断显示，目标侧静态查询表述比动态组合查询表述检索更可靠，尤其在需要抑制或变换源状态语义时。在FashionIQ、CIRR和CIRCO上的实验刻画了该表示原则的有效性与局限，其中在多目标的CIRCO基准上增益最为清晰。
AI.conclusion: 在检索之前如何表示组合意图是一个具有实质影响的设计选择，其重要性独立于检索骨干本身的选择；将零样本CIR视为目标状态重建问题可缓解转换语言与目标状态候选之间的表示错配。

title: Investigating Query-Insensitive Behavior in Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
summary: Spatio-temporal video grounding (STVG) aims to localize objects or events described by natural language queries in both space and time. Existing STVG models are typically trained and evaluated under the assumption that each query is relevant to the input video. In this work, we challenge this assumption by studying the behavior of state-of-the-art STVG models under irrelevant queries and missing textual input. Our experiments show that current models can still produce plausible spatio-temporal predictions even when the query is unrelated to the video or removed entirely. We further analyze HCSTVG-v2 and VidSTG to identify dataset regularities that may encourage such query-insensitive behavior. Our study highlights an underexplored limitation of STVG models and motivates negative-aware evaluation protocols and architectures that explicitly assess query relevance.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑STVG模型"查询必然相关"的假设，发现现有SOTA模型在无关查询甚至无文本输入时仍能给出看似合理的时空预测，并分析数据集规律来解释这种查询不敏感行为。
AI.motivation: 现有STVG（时空视频定位）模型普遍在"每个查询都与输入视频相关"的假设下进行训练与评估。作者认为这一假设不成立，可能掩盖模型对查询的依赖性不足问题，因此需要研究模型在无关查询与缺失文本输入下的真实行为。
AI.method: 对当前最先进的STVG模型进行扰动实验：将查询替换为与视频无关的文本，以及完全移除文本输入，观察其时空预测输出。同时在HCSTVG-v2与VidSTG两个数据集上分析数据规律（dataset regularities），以定位可能导致查询不敏感行为的偏差来源。
AI.result: 实验显示，即便查询与视频无关或文本被完全移除，现有模型仍能输出貌似合理的时空预测，表明模型对文本查询的依赖远低于预期。数据集分析进一步揭示了HCSTVG-v2与VidSTG中存在可能助长该行为的规律。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了STVG领域一个被忽视的局限性，指出需要引入"负样本感知"（negative-aware）的评估协议与模型架构，显式地判断与评估查询相关性，而非默认查询必然相关。

title: Patch-based Querying Identifies Structures of Interest in Electron Microscopy
comment: 41 pages, 20 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in Computers in Biology and Medicine
summary: Volume electron microscopy (vEM) has emerged as an essential sensing technique in biomedical research, allowing the three-dimensional imaging of biological cells and tissues at nanometer-scale resolution. The ability to generate extensive datasets has reached the limitations of downstream analysis processes, which depend significantly on the intervention of human experts for preprocessing and annotation. We propose an efficient and reliable patch-based retrieval framework based on self-supervised learning of local image descriptors to locate self-similar structures in vEM datasets. Given a few manual annotations of a given cellular structure, our method can retrieve similar structures across the EM volume. Our framework is interactive, allowing the human expert to refine the search queries and retrieve relevant image patches quickly and using little labeled data. Experiments on real-world vEM images of biological tissues demonstrate that our framework can reliably identify relevant cellular structures, generalize across different organelles and acquisition modalities, and substantially reduce the search space for downstream analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于自监督局部图像描述子的块检索框架，可在体电子显微镜数据集中定位自相似结构。
AI.motivation: 体电子显微镜（vEM）能实现纳米级分辨率的细胞与组织三维成像，但海量数据已超出下游分析能力，且高度依赖人工预处理与标注，因此亟需高效可靠的方法来降低标注负担。
AI.method: 基于自监督学习局部图像描述子的块级（patch-based）检索框架：给定少量人工标注的特定细胞结构，检索整个EM体数据中相似结构；框架具有交互性，支持专家快速精炼查询并检索相关图像块，仅需少量标注数据。
AI.result: 在真实生物组织vEM图像上的实验表明，该框架能可靠识别相关细胞结构，可跨不同细胞器与采集模态泛化，并显著缩小下游分析的搜索空间。
AI.conclusion: 该交互式自监督检索框架高效可靠，能泛化于多种细胞器与成像模态，有效减少人工干预与搜索空间，为vEM下游分析提供实用支撑。

title: Scalable Minimal-Change Learning for Controllable Image Editing
comment: 29 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Revised version with additional off-target, reward and SFT control, human evaluation, and OmniGen2 transfer results; clarified related work and experimental scope
summary: Image editing should change only the attributes specified by an instruction while preserving everything else, yet current methods often make unintended changes. We treat this minimal-change principle as an optimization objective for instruction-based editing. Latent L1 regularization is a poor proxy for output locality in modern nonlinear generators and often requires supervision unavailable at scale. We instead optimize edit outcomes with reinforcement learning. An agentic vision-language reward model audits each source image, instruction, and edited image for two failure types: unimplemented requested changes and unintended changes. A group-level rubric merges and verifies these issues to provide consistent rewards across candidate edits without per-instruction human annotations. On FLUX.1 Kontext-dev, ARRO raises average EditScore from 5.21 to 5.88 across MinEval, MagicBrush, AnyBench, and Emu-Edit. On 600 evaluation examples, it reduces off-target pixel change by 8.4% relative to the base editor. Reward and SFT controls, blinded human evaluations, and transfer to OmniGen2 provide complementary evidence. Code: https://github.com/Showwwwwwwww/ARRO

AI.tldr: 提出ARRO方法，将"最小改动"原则形式化为指令图像编辑的优化目标，用强化学习配合智能体视觉语言奖励模型进行优化，在多个基准上提升编辑质量并减少无关像素改动。
AI.motivation: 基于指令的图像编辑应只改变指令指定的属性，但现有方法常产生非预期改动；而隐空间L1正则化在现代非线性生成器中无法有效代理输出局部性，且所需监督在规模上难以获取。
AI.method: 将最小改动原则作为优化目标，改用强化学习优化编辑结果；由智能体式视觉语言奖励模型审计源图、指令与编辑图，检测两类失败（未实现请求改动、非预期改动）；再用组级评分标准合并并校验这些问题，从而在无逐指令人工标注的情况下为候选编辑提供一致奖励。
AI.result: 在FLUX.1 Kontext-dev上，ARRO将MinEval、MagicBrush、AnyBench、Emu-Edit上的平均EditScore从5.21提升至5.88；在600个评测样例上，相比基础编辑器将偏离目标的像素改动减少8.4%；奖励与SFT对照、盲审人类评估及向OmniGen2的迁移提供了补充证据。
AI.conclusion: 以强化学习结合智能体奖励模型优化编辑输出局部性是可行且有效的，能在无需逐指令人工标注的前提下提升编辑保真度并减少非预期改动，且方法具有可迁移性。

title: Casual Flash Lighting for Gaussian Splat Inverse Rendering
summary: Recovering geometry, materials, and lighting from photographs is highly ambiguous when only static illumination is available. Active-lighting setups reduce the ambiguity but require dark rooms or specialized hardware. Instead, we synergize both static and flash lighting from casual indoor capture, with the flash on or off, each from independent viewpoints. The flash residual constrains albedo and the BRDF, while static lighting captures grazing-angle specular highlights that flash misses. With a 2DGS reconstruction framing, our key contribution is a GS-anchored diffuse field: a hash-encoded MLP is queried at the rasterized 2DGS depth. As it depends only on world position, it is view consistent in 3D and allows the flash residual to drive material decomposition instead of being absorbed by alpha-blending drift across views. At the same time, we render static lighting with deferred shading such that it can also supervise material decomposition. On five synthetic and three real indoor scenes, our method outperforms six recent baselines on diffuse color, albedo and roughness material parameters, and in relighting where PSNR improves by 4.17 dB over the next-best baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种利用日常室内拍摄中同时存在的静态光照与闪光灯图像（各自独立视角）进行逆渲染的方法，核心是"以2DGS为锚的漫反射场"，在合成与真实室内场景上优于六个基线，重光照PSNR提升4.17 dB。
AI.motivation: 仅依赖静态光照进行几何、材质与光照的逆渲染存在强烈歧义；主动光照方案虽能降低歧义，却需要暗室或专用硬件，难以普及。作者希望利用随手拍摄的室内数据（闪光灯开/关，视角独立）来协同发挥两者优势，在无需特殊硬件的条件下缓解歧义。
AI.method: 以2DGS重建为框架，引入"GS锚定的漫反射场"：在光栅化得到的2DGS深度处查询哈希编码的MLP，由于该场仅依赖世界坐标，故在3D中具有视角一致性，使闪光残差能够驱动材质分解，而不会被跨视角的alpha混合漂移所吸收。同时，静态光照部分采用延迟着色渲染，从而也能对材质分解进行监督。闪光残差用于约束反照率与BRDF，静态光照则捕捉闪光灯缺失的掠射角高光。
AI.result: 在五个合成场景与三个真实室内场景上，该方法在漫反射颜色、反照率与粗糙度等材质参数上均优于六个近期基线；在重光照任务中，PSNR相比次优基线提升4.17 dB。
AI.conclusion: 通过将静态光照与闪光灯图像协同使用，并以2DGS锚定的世界坐标漫反射场保证视角一致性，可在无需暗室或专用硬件的日常室内拍摄下实现更准确的材质分解与重光照，验证了闪光残差与延迟着色静态监督相结合的有效性。

title: Representation Disentanglement for Fair Chest X-Ray Diagnosis
summary: Deep learning has advanced chest X-ray (CXR) diagnosis, yet demographic biases in learned representations may contribute to performance disparities across intersectional groups. We propose a single-encoder framework combining dual-level decorrelation with prototype-guided cross-group contrastive learning to reduce demographic dependence while accounting for within-class variation. We further propose Demographic Representation Alignment Reduction (DRAR), a new metric that quantifies the reduction in demographic structure within disease representations. The framework is evaluated on four classification tasks using 34,809 CheXpert test images across eight intersectional groups, defined by age, sex and ethnicity. Compared with empirical risk minimization (ERM), our method reduces the mean equalized-odds gap from 15.41\% to 10.86\% and the AUC gap from 5.95\% to 5.01\%. Our method achieves a DRAR of 59.04\% relative to ERM, with only a slight decrease in mean AUC. These results demonstrate that representation disentanglement can reduce demographic bias and improve intersectional fairness. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/06Yujie/Fair-Medical-Imaging}.

AI.tldr: 提出结合双层去相关与原型引导跨群体对比学习的单编码器框架，减少胸部X射线诊断中的人口统计偏差，并提出DRAR指标量化偏差削减。
AI.motivation: 深度学习在胸部X射线诊断中进展显著，但学习表征中的人口统计偏差可能导致交叉群体间的性能差异，需要在不牺牲诊断性能的前提下降低表征对人口属性的依赖。
AI.method: 单编码器框架，融合双层去相关（dual-level decorrelation）与原型引导的跨群体对比学习，兼顾类内变异；同时提出人口统计表征对齐削减指标DRAR，用于量化疾病表征中人口统计结构的减少程度。
AI.result: 基于CheXpert测试集34,809张图像、8个交叉群体（年龄、性别、族裔）、4个分类任务评估：相比ERM，均衡赔率差距均值由15.41%降至10.86%，AUC差距由5.95%降至5.01%，DRAR达59.04%（相对ERM），平均AUC仅轻微下降。
AI.conclusion: 表征解耦可有效降低人口统计偏差并提升交叉群体公平性，为医学影像公平性提供新框架与度量工具。

title: Local2Mesh: Spatially Localized Contour-to-Mesh for Left Ventricular Reconstruction from Sparse 2D Cardiac MRI
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) left ventricular (LV) reconstruction from sparse cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging remains challenging due to inter-slice misalignment and insufficient local spatial information between slices. Global aggregation of contour features may obscure local contour-to-surface relationships. We propose Local2Mesh, a spatially localized contour-to-mesh framework that deforms a template mesh to reconstruct 3D LV geometry from sparse 2D contours without 3D mesh annotations. The framework introduces geometry-aware alignment to correct inter-slice misalignment and a plane-aware Local Router that routes contour features to template vertices using vertex-to-plane distances. Local and global contour features then jointly guide graph-based template deformation for 3D LV reconstruction. Experiments on two public datasets, M\&Ms-2 and ACDC, demonstrate superior geometric reconstruction and functional estimation over existing methods. Zero-shot transfer from M\&Ms-2 to ACDC demonstrates strong cross-dataset generalization. Reconstructed meshes also improve disease classification over sparse contours, supporting their utility for downstream cardiac analysis. These results demonstrate that combining geometry-aware alignment with local contour-to-vertex modeling improves LV reconstruction from sparse 2D contours and supports downstream cardiac analysis. The code is available at \url{https://github.com/hwu918945-alt/loca2mesh}.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Local2Mesh框架，通过几何感知对齐与局部路由机制，从稀疏2D心脏磁共振轮廓重建3D左心室网格，在两个公开数据集上实现更优的几何重建与功能估计，并展现出良好的跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 从稀疏CMR图像重建3D左心室几何面临两大挑战：一是层间错位（inter-slice misalignment），二是层间局部空间信息不足。而现有的全局轮廓特征聚合方式可能掩盖局部轮廓到表面的对应关系，难以准确刻画局部几何细节。
AI.method: 提出Local2Mesh，一种空间局部化的轮廓到网格（contour-to-mesh）框架，通过变形模板网格重建3D左心室几何，且无需3D网格标注。方法包含：几何感知对齐（geometry-aware alignment）用于校正层间错位；平面感知的Local Router利用顶点到平面的距离将轮廓特征路由到模板顶点；随后局部与全局轮廓特征共同引导基于图的模板变形。
AI.result: 在M&Ms-2和ACDC两个公开数据集上，该方法在几何重建和功能估计方面均优于现有方法；从M&Ms-2到ACDC的零样本迁移表现出强跨数据集泛化能力；重建网格相比稀疏轮廓提升了疾病分类性能，支撑下游心脏分析任务。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知对齐与局部轮廓到顶点建模相结合，能够有效提升从稀疏2D轮廓重建左心室几何的质量，并支持下游心脏分析应用。

title: ROT: Rotating Hidden States towards Contextual Vectors for Hallucination Mitigation in LVLMs
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) frequently suffer from object hallucination. Existing training-free interventions primarily manipulate attention weights, which indirectly affect the deep semantics reaching the final predictive layers. In this work, we shift our focus to the hidden state vectors extracted after self-attention and residual addition. Empirical analysis reveals that hallucinated tokens do not simply over-rely on linguistic priors; instead, they exhibit an anomalous contextual deviation, showing significantly lower similarities to both textual and visual contexts in intermediate layers. Motivated by this, we propose ROT, a layer-specific, training-free framework. ROT dynamically detects semantic deviation in the middle layers and applies a norm-preserving rotation to steer the hidden states back toward the local multimodal context plane spanned by the contexts. For subsequent layers, a representational smoothing mechanism is introduced to stabilize the calibrated trajectory. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that ROT consistently reduces hallucinations across various model architectures and scales, offering an efficient, geometry-driven solution for grounded generation.

AI.tldr: 提出ROT，一种分层、免训练框架，通过在中层检测语义偏离并用保范旋转将隐状态校正回多模态上下文平面，配合表征平滑，有效缓解LVLM的物体幻觉。
AI.motivation: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）普遍存在物体幻觉。现有免训练干预方法主要操纵注意力权重，间接影响到达最终预测层的深层语义。作者转而关注自注意力与残差相加后的隐状态向量，发现幻觉token并非简单过度依赖语言先验，而是在中间层表现出异常上下文偏离，即与文本和视觉上下文的相似度都显著偏低。
AI.method: ROT是一个分层、免训练的框架。它在中间层动态检测语义偏离，并对隐状态施加保范旋转（norm-preserving rotation），将其引导回由上下文张成的局部多模态上下文平面；在后续层引入表征平滑机制，以稳定校正后的隐状态轨迹。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，ROT在不同模型架构与规模上均能持续减少幻觉，为有据生成提供了一种高效、几何驱动的解决方案。
AI.conclusion: 通过从注意力权重转向隐状态几何性质，ROT以分层、免训练、保范旋转加表征平滑的方式校正中层语义偏离，跨架构与规模有效缓解物体幻觉，是一种高效且无需训练的几何驱动方法。

title: Vision Transformer Ensembles for Panoramic Street Segmentation
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures. Code available at https://github.com/yunusserhat/palmcity_challenge . Trained models available at https://huggingface.co/yunusserhat/palmcity-eomt-dinov3-large
summary: Semantic segmentation of street panoramas can support detailed descriptions of urban environments, yet small datasets and unequal training costs make model selection difficult. This paper presents the system used for a first place submission to the PalmCity challenge in the leaderboard snapshot dated 5 October 2026. Nine pretrained segmentation systems are compared using approximately equal computation budgets. The candidates include DeepLabV3+, SegFormer, UPerNet, Mask2Former, DINOv3 with a linear decoder, and an Encoder only Mask Transformer using DINOv3. The two leading candidates are trained independently with three random seeds and longer budgets. Equal averaging of class probabilities from the three Encoder only Mask Transformer models, evaluated at three image scales with horizontal reflection, produces 60.95% mean intersection over union and 71.16% mean F1 on the 84 image public validation split. The submitted predictions receive 57.08% mean intersection over union and 67.96% mean F1 on the hidden test leaderboard. Producing all 249 test masks takes 251.49 seconds including model initialization and provenance checks on one NVIDIA RTX 5090. Peak allocated GPU memory is 2.70 GiB. The study reports all eligible models, all inference variants, class level errors, source conditions, and reproducibility checks, providing a documented challenge workflow with existing architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了PalmCity街景全景语义分割挑战赛第一名方案：在等算力预算下比较九个预训练分割系统，最终采用DINOv3编码器+掩码Transformer（Encoder-only Mask Transformer），通过三种子模型类别概率平均、三尺度与水平翻转推理，取得隐藏测试集57.08% mIoU / 67.96% mean F1。
AI.motivation: 街景全景语义分割可为城市环境提供细粒度描述，但该领域数据集规模小、训练成本不均，导致模型选择困难；同时缺乏可复现、公平比较的挑战赛工作流程。
AI.method: 在近似相等的计算预算下对比九种预训练分割系统（DeepLabV3+、SegFormer、UPerNet、Mask2Former、DINOv3+线性解码器、Encoder-only Mask Transformer（基于DINOv3）等）；对两个领先候选以三个随机种子和更长预算独立训练；推理时对三个Encoder-only Mask Transformer模型的类别概率等权平均，并在三个图像尺度上结合水平翻转进行测试。
AI.result: 公开验证集（84张）上达到60.95% mIoU与71.16% mean F1；隐藏测试榜上57.08% mIoU与67.96% mean F1；生成全部249张测试掩码耗时251.49秒（含模型初始化与来源校验），单张NVIDIA RTX 5090上峰值分配显存2.70 GiB。
AI.conclusion: 该研究完整报告了所有合格模型、全部推理变体、类别级误差、来源条件与可复现性检查，证明仅使用现有架构即可构建有据可查的挑战赛工作流程。

title: Anatomy-preserving unpaired cone-beam CT refinement for image-guided radiotherapy using pseudo-label guided diffusion
summary: Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used in image-guided radiotherapy, but scatter, beam hardening, noise, truncation, and other artifacts limit image quality and CT number accuracy. Paired CBCT and CT data are difficult to obtain clinically because of motion, anatomical changes, and acquisition mismatch. We present RefineCBCT, an unpaired CBCT refinement framework that uses pseudo-label guidance and short-step diffusion to reduce artifacts while preserving patient-specific anatomy. RefineCBCT was trained and evaluated on unpaired CBCT and planning CT data from public LUNG TCIA and PELVIC TCIA datasets and compared with representative GAN and diffusion based methods. On LUNG TCIA, it achieved the best results across all metrics, with MAE 19.411, RMSE 62.758, PSNR 30.845 dB, and SSIM 0.931. On PELVIC TCIA, it achieved the best MAE, PSNR, and SSIM, with values of 14.905, 36.671 dB, and 0.876. The refined images showed fewer streaking and shading artifacts, clearer anatomical boundaries, and improved soft tissue uniformity, with line profile and ROI analyses showing closer agreement with planning CT. These results suggest that RefineCBCT provides efficient and effective CBCT refinement under clinically realistic unpaired training conditions and may support more reliable CBCT use in image-guided radiotherapy workflows. Code is publicly available on GitHub, and the evaluated datasets are available from The Cancer Imaging Archive.

AI.tldr: 提出RefineCBCT，一种基于伪标签引导与短步扩散的非配对CBCT精修框架，在LUNG与PELVIC TCIA数据集上取得优于代表性GAN与扩散方法的指标，减少伪影并保持患者解剖细节。
AI.motivation: CBCT广泛用于图像引导放疗，但散射、射束硬化、噪声、截断等伪影限制图像质量与CT值准确性。临床中配对CBCT-CT数据因运动、解剖变化与采集不匹配而难以获取，因此需要非配对条件下的CBCT精修方法。
AI.method: RefineCBCT采用非配对精修框架，结合伪标签引导与短步扩散（short-step diffusion），在降低伪影的同时保留患者特异性解剖结构。训练与评估使用公开LUNG TCIA和PELVIC TCIA的非配对CBCT与计划CT数据，并与代表性GAN和扩散类方法对比。
AI.result: LUNG TCIA上全部指标最优：MAE 19.411，RMSE 62.758，PSNR 30.845 dB，SSIM 0.931。PELVIC TCIA上MAE、PSNR、SSIM最优，分别为14.905、36.671 dB、0.876。精修图像条纹与阴影伪影更少，解剖边界更清晰，软组织均匀性提升，线剖面与ROI分析与计划CT更一致。
AI.conclusion: RefineCBCT在临床现实的非配对训练条件下实现了高效且有效的CBCT精修，有望支持图像引导放疗流程中更可靠的CBCT应用。代码已在GitHub公开，评估数据集可从TCIA获取。

title: Benchmarking CLIP for Zero-Shot Face and Periocular Gender Estimation
comment: Accepted for publication at 25th International Conference of the Biometrics Special Interest Group, BIOSIG 2026
summary: We investigate CLIP for zero-shot gender estimation from full-face and periocular images. Three CLIP backbones are evaluated on 11,299 frontal images from Adience using image-text similarity with male/female prompts, achieving 95.54% full-face accuracy without task-specific training. For periocular, zero-shot predictions are strongly biased towards males, primarily due to a misaligned decision boundary. Threshold alignment substantially reduces this bias, reaching 85.29% accuracy. Linear SVMs trained on CLIP features provide only marginal gains, with a best periocular accuracy of 86.17%, approximately 2.8% above previous Adience results in the literature. Nevertheless, the gap with full-face performance confirms the greater difficulty of periocular gender estimation

AI.tldr: 研究评估了CLIP在整脸与眼周图像的零样本性别估计，整脸准确率95.54%，眼周因决策边界偏移存在男性偏置，阈值对齐后达85.29%，线性SVM仅带来边际提升（最佳眼周86.17%，比文献高约2.8%）。
AI.motivation: 探究CLIP在零样本条件下进行性别估计的可行性，并比较整脸与眼周（periocular）两种输入的性能差异，同时考察眼周图像上零样本预测偏置的来源及可否缓解。
AI.method: 在Adience数据集的11,299张正面图像上评估3种CLIP骨干网络，采用男/女文本提示的图像-文本相似度进行零样本预测；针对眼周的男性偏置进行阈值对齐；并训练基于CLIP特征的线性SVM作对比。
AI.result: 整脸零样本准确率达95.54%（无需任务特定训练）；眼周零样本因决策边界错位强烈偏向男性，阈值对齐后提升至85.29%；线性SVM仅在眼周带来边际增益，最佳为86.17%，约比既有Adience文献结果高2.8%。
AI.conclusion: CLIP可在无任务特定训练下实现高精度整脸性别估计，但眼周任务明显更难；眼周零样本偏置主要源于决策边界偏移，简单阈值对齐即可大幅缓解，而线性SVM的额外收益有限。

title: AnchorGen: Anchored Optimization for Customizable Generative 3D Design
summary: Engineering design often starts from a 2D sketch that fixes style and proportions, yet the subsequent 3D shape optimization relies on learned generative priors to keep the geometry valid. However, these priors are agnostic to the sketch: while they admit a valid design by correcting a drifted proposal back to its training distribution, they often correct it towards the high-density region, ignoring the specified design. We introduce \emph{AnchorGen}, a rectified-flow framework trained unconditionally on the concatenated shape and sketch latents of paired data. The learned manifold represents the joint distribution of shape-sketch pairs, so constraining the sketch component restricts the iterate to the sub-manifold of shapes consistent with a target style. Since training employs no conditioning signal, the constraint is imposed at inference: gradient descent optimizes the shape latent to minimize a differentiable drag surrogate, while constraining the sketch latent to remain close to the target sketch via a token-wise cosine penalty. A single model thereby supports design-preserving optimization, dimensionally explicit design edits, and sketch-only synthesis.

AI.tldr: 提出AnchorGen，一种基于整流流的生成框架，通过在草图与形状拼接潜变量上做无条件训练，得到形状-草图联合流形，从而在推理阶段以草图约束实现设计保持的三维形状优化、显式维度编辑与仅草图合成。
AI.motivation: 工程设计中2D草图固定了风格与比例，但后续3D形状优化所依赖的学习型生成先验与草图无关：当把漂移的候选方案纠正回训练分布时，往往将其拉向高密度区域，反而忽视了用户指定的设计意图。
AI.method: AnchorGen在成对数据的形状潜变量与草图潜变量拼接表示上以无条件下方式训练整流流（rectified flow）。所学流形建模形状-草图对的联合分布，因此约束草图分量即可把迭代限制在与目标风格一致的形状子流形上。由于训练不使用条件信号，约束在推理时施加：用梯度下降优化形状潜变量以最小化可微的阻力代理目标，同时用逐token余弦惩罚约束草图潜变量接近目标草图。
AI.result: 单个模型即可同时支持三种能力：保设计的形状优化、维度显式的设计编辑，以及仅由草图驱动的形状合成。
AI.conclusion: 将生成先验从“与草图无关的高密度纠正”转变为“草图锚定的联合流形约束”，为工程设计中的风格一致性与可编辑性提供了统一的无条件训练、推理时约束的建模范式。

title: Efficient Test-time Adaptation through Candidate Verification and Divergence Shifts
comment: Accepted for publication in Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2026
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) achieve strong zero-shot transferability but remain vulnerable to target-domain shifts at inference time. Test-time adaptation (TTA) offers a practical remedy, yet most existing VLM-TTA methods follow a prediction-side adaptation paradigm. They use test samples to adjust logits, prototypes, caches, priors, or feature statistics, often incurring additional computational overhead. In this paper, we take a different perspective and reframe VLM-TTA as candidate verification rather than prediction adjustment. We propose Test-Time Correction (TTC), a hypothesis-based correction framework guided by a simple principle: hypothesize, reconstruct, correct. Given a test feature and its top-k candidate labels, TTC treats each candidate label as a hypothesis, reconstructs the feature within the corresponding latent subspace stored in a memory bank, and measures the resulting divergence shift. This shift quantifies how much the candidate subspace and its relations to other candidates change after the hypothetical insertion of the test feature. A correct candidate hypothesis induces only a small shift, whereas an incorrect one perturbs the subspace more strongly. TTC therefore corrects the prediction by selecting the candidate with the minimum aggregated divergence shift. This training-free candidate-verification mechanism avoids iterative optimization and provides a favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off. Across five TTA settings and 15 benchmark datasets, including zero-shot classification, domain generalization, few-shot classification, base-to-novel generalization, and cross-dataset evaluation, TTC consistently improves accuracy over state-of-the-art VLM-TTA methods while achieving up to 2x speedup, over 3x lower CPU memory usage, and up to 1.4x lower GPU memory usage than the lowest-memory training-free baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出测试时校正（TTC）框架，将视觉-语言模型的测试时自适应（VLM-TTA）重构为候选验证问题，通过"假设-重建-校正"机制选择最小散度偏移的候选标签，无需训练和迭代优化，在15个数据集上超越SOTA并显著提升效率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言模型虽具备强零样本迁移能力，但在推理时面对目标域偏移仍十分脆弱。现有VLM-TTA方法多采用预测侧自适应范式，利用测试样本调整logits、原型、缓存、先验或特征统计量，不仅带来额外计算开销，且局限于修正预测本身，缺乏从候选假设验证角度的新视角。
AI.method: TTC将VLM-TTA重新表述为候选验证而非预测调整，遵循"假设、重建、校正"原则。对给定测试特征及其top-k候选标签，将每个候选标签视为一个假设，在记忆库中对应潜在子空间内重建特征，并测量由此产生的散度偏移。该偏移量化了假设性插入测试特征后，候选子空间及其与其他候选关系的变化程度：正确假设仅引起小幅偏移，错误假设扰动更强。最终选择聚合散度偏移最小的候选完成校正。整个机制无需训练、避免迭代优化。
AI.result: 在五种TTA设置和15个基准数据集上（含零样本分类、域泛化、少样本分类、基类到新类泛化、跨数据集评估），TTC一致优于当前最先进的VLM-TTA方法。效率方面，实现最高2倍加速、CPU内存占用降低3倍以上，GPU内存占用较最低内存的无训练基线最高降低1.4倍。
AI.conclusion: TTC通过将测试时自适应重新定义为基于假设的候选验证问题，提供了一种无需训练、避免迭代优化的校正机制，在准确率与效率之间取得良好权衡，并在多种TTA设置下验证了其有效性与高效性。

title: Bayesian Optimization in Sequence-to-Architecture Latent Space for Zero-Shot NAS
summary: Zero-shot Neural Architecture Search removes the prohibitive cost of traditional NAS, but its search process is typically based on the evolutionary algorithm (EA); lacking an explicit model of the objective, it often resorts to a near-random search through mutation. Bayesian Optimization offers a principled alternative by modeling the objective and aggregating information across iterations, but scales poorly to the high-dimensional, discrete, graph-structured spaces of modern NAS, restricting its use to only small networks. In this paper, we bring Bayesian Optimization to zero-shot NAS for large-scale architectures by learning a latent space via a Variational Autoencoder trained to reconstruct a novel prefix encoding of architectures and propose a proxy scalarization that combines several zero-shot proxies into a single Bayesian Optimization objective. After only 10,000 iterations of the proposed search algorithm (8 hours on a single GPU), our method found a network architecture which under the given model parameter count constraints achieves state-of-the-art results on three separate tasks -- image classification, object detection and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将贝叶斯优化引入零样本NAS，通过VAE学习架构的前缀编码隐空间，并用代理标量化方法融合多个零样本代理指标作为单一优化目标，在单GPU 8小时内搜索到的架构在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割三个任务上均达到同等参数量约束下的最优性能。
AI.motivation: 零样本NAS虽消除了传统NAS的高昂成本，但其搜索过程通常依赖进化算法；由于缺乏显式的目标模型，往往退化为近似随机的变异搜索。贝叶斯优化通过建模目标并跨迭代聚合信息提供了原理性替代方案，但难以扩展到现代NAS所需的高维、离散、图结构空间，通常只能用于小型网络。
AI.method: 通过训练一个变分自编码器（VAE）来重建架构的一种新颖"前缀编码"，从而学习一个隐空间，将贝叶斯优化引入面向大规模架构的零样本NAS；并提出一种代理标量化方法，将多个零样本代理指标组合为单一的贝叶斯优化目标。
AI.result: 在仅进行10,000次搜索迭代（单GPU上约8小时）后，所提方法找到了一个网络架构，在给定模型参数数量约束下，于图像分类、目标检测和语义分割三个独立任务上均取得当前最优（state-of-the-art）结果。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，将贝叶斯优化与学习得到的隐空间表示及多代理标量化相结合，可有效克服零样本NAS中搜索效率低与高维离散图结构空间难以扩展的问题，为大规模架构的高效零样本搜索提供了可行路径。

title: EORestore-Agent: Fidelity-Guided Agentic Restoration of Remote Sensing Images with Composite Degradations
summary: Remote sensing images often carry composite degradations, in which haze, cloud, noise, blur, low light, and low resolution coexist. Restoring them requires deciding which tool to apply, in what order, and when to stop, yet no clean reference is available at inference time to verify these decisions. All-in-one models trained on single degradations converge to a narrow PSNR band as degradations accumulate. To formulate real-world remote sensing restoration as a traceable trajectory, we present EORestore-Agent, which replaces this unmeasurable objective with reference-free, verifiable per-step decisions. A fine-tuned vision-language model reports all residual degradation types, whose tool pools are scored together, so the restoration order emerges from step-wise selection. A relative quality scorer, trained with full-reference supervision on synthetic degradation chains, predicts the changes in PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS from the current image to each candidate. A step is accepted only when no predicted change is negative and the predicted PSNR gain is positive. Otherwise, the agent keeps the current image. On a synthetic Landsat-8 benchmark with six degradation types, EORestore-Agent improves PSNR by 2.3 to 3.2 dB over the strongest retrained all-in-one baseline on composites of two to six degradations, whereas zero-shot natural-image agents fall below the degraded input in PSNR in 17 of 18 settings. Replacing the learned scorer with no-reference quality differences costs 1.1 to 4.6 dB. The remaining harmful steps are small and cluster near the acceptance threshold. Sentinel-2 examples illustrate transfer to real atmospheric degradation without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出 EORestore-Agent，将遥感图像复合退化恢复建模为可追溯的逐步决策轨迹，用无参考可验证的每步判定替代不可测的整体目标。
AI.motivation: 遥感图像常同时存在雾、云、噪声、模糊、低照度、低分辨率等复合退化，恢复时需决定用什么工具、按什么顺序、何时停止；但推理阶段没有干净参考图来验证这些决策。单退化训练的一体化模型在退化叠加时会收敛到狭窄的 PSNR 区间。
AI.method: 将真实遥感恢复形式化为可追溯轨迹；微调视觉语言模型报告所有残余退化类型，其工具池被联合打分，恢复顺序由逐步选择自然涌现；训练一个相对质量评分器（在合成退化链上以全参考监督），预测当前图像到各候选图像在 PSNR、SSIM、LPIPS 上的变化；仅当无预测变化为负且预测 PSNR 增益为正时接受该步，否则保留当前图像。
AI.result: 在含六种退化类型的合成 Landsat-8 基准上，二至六种退化复合时 PSNR 比最强重训一体化基线高 2.3–3.2 dB；零样本自然图像智能体在 18 个设置中有 17 个低于退化输入的 PSNR。用无参考质量差替换学习评分器损失 1.1–4.6 dB。剩余有害步骤幅度小且聚集在接受阈值附近。Sentinel-2 样例显示无需重训即可迁移到真实大气退化。
AI.conclusion: 以无参考、可验证的逐步决策替代不可测的整体目标，可有效应对遥感复合退化，并在不重训的情况下具备向真实场景迁移的潜力。

title: MoCAR: Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression for Continuous Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Autoregressive generation is natural for language, where predicted tokens can be directly reused as the next prediction state, but trajectory forecasting lacks such a clean token: motion is continuous, multimodal, and expressed in local coordinate frames that evolve with the predicted trajectory. We present MoCAR (Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression), a decoder-only framework that casts trajectory forecasting as next-code prediction in a coordinate-aware continuous latent space. MoCAR learns a continuous motion-code space from endpoint-normalized trajectory segments, where each code jointly captures local trajectory geometry and the reference-frame transition induced by that segment. Historical motion codes are used as a teacher-forced prefix, future codes are generated autoregressively under temporal, map, agent, and mode interactions, and predicted codes persist in latent memory while decoded endpoints update the local scene context. This enables rollout without trajectory-space re-tokenization, trajectory queries, goal candidates, or proposal-and-refinement pipelines. On Argoverse (AV) benchmarks, MoCAR achieves top-tier performance with a simple single-stage architecture, transfers strongly from AV2 to AV1 in zero-shot evaluation, and improves on turn-heavy scenarios. Ablations confirm that the learned continuous motion-code space, latent alignment, weak KL regularization, and joint tokenizer-predictor optimization are essential for stable latent autoregression.

AI.tldr: MoCAR将轨迹预测建模为坐标感知连续隐空间中的下一码预测，以单阶段解码器架构在Argoverse基准上达到顶尖性能，并支持零样本跨数据集迁移。
AI.motivation: 语言中的自回归生成可直接复用预测token作为下一状态，但轨迹预测缺乏这种干净token：运动是连续的、多模态的，且表达在随预测轨迹演化的局部坐标系中，难以直接套用离散token自回归范式。
AI.method: 提出MoCAR（Motion-code Coordinate-aware AutoRegression）解码器only框架。从端点归一化的轨迹片段学习连续运动码空间，每个码同时编码局部轨迹几何与该片段引起的参考系变换。历史运动码作为teacher-forced前缀，未来码在时间、地图、智能体与模态交互下自回归生成；预测码保留在隐记忆中，解码端点用于更新局部场景上下文。无需轨迹空间重tokenization、轨迹查询、目标候选或提议-精化流程。
AI.result: 在Argoverse（AV）基准上以简单单阶段架构取得顶尖性能；从AV2到AV1零样本迁移表现强；在转向密集场景中有所提升。消融表明连续运动码空间、隐对齐、弱KL正则与tokenizer-预测器联合优化对稳定隐自回归至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 将轨迹预测转化为坐标感知连续隐空间中的下一码预测，可行且高效，为轨迹预测提供了一种无需离散化与多阶段管线的统一自回归范式。

title: Frequency-Decoupled Diffusion Guidance for Non-Blind Image Deblurring
summary: Pretrained diffusion models provide powerful image priors for training-free posterior sampling in image restoration. To guide this sampling process, frequency-aware methods progressively incorporate measurement information across frequency bands, facilitating coarse-to-fine reconstruction. However, existing methods typically do not explicitly separate frequency activation from degradation-induced attenuation, leaving attenuation differences among inactive frequencies insufficiently modeled. In this work, we propose frequency-decoupled posterior guidance to separate frequency activation from attenuation-aware spectral regularization. Specifically, a progressive low-to-high frequency schedule determines the active measurement band, while a kernel-derived attenuation map defines a selective spectral prior over inactive components. To stabilize the sampling process, we also introduce a local trajectory regularizer that suppresses spatially irregular state-to-clean deviations. For a fixed endpoint energy, we provide a KL-regularized path-space interpretation. In practice, we construct time-dependent guidance through local energy corrections using a Tweedie plug-in approximation. Experiments on natural-image benchmarks demonstrate strong PSNR and SSIM performance across challenging non-blind deblurring settings, even at higher measurement noise levels.

AI.tldr: 提出频率解耦后验引导，将频率激活与衰减感知的频谱正则化分离，用于扩散模型的无训练图像复原，在非盲去模糊任务上取得优异PSNR/SSIM。
AI.motivation: 现有频率感知方法逐步注入测量信息以粗到细重建，但未显式区分频率激活与退化引起的衰减，导致非激活频段的衰减差异建模不足。
AI.method: 1) 频率解耦后验引导：渐进低到高频调度确定激活测量频带；2) 核导出的衰减图对非激活分量施加选择性频谱先验；3) 局部轨迹正则器抑制空间不规则的state-to-clean偏差；4) 固定端点能量下给出KL正则化路径空间解释；5) 用Tweedie插值近似进行局部能量修正构造时间相关引导。
AI.result: 在自然图像基准的多种高难度非盲去模糊设置下，即便测量噪声较高，也取得较强的PSNR与SSIM表现。
AI.conclusion: 显式分离频率激活与衰减感知频谱正则化，并辅以局部轨迹正则化，可稳定扩散后验采样并提升非盲去模糊复原质量。

title: Joint Class-Time Learning for Video Classification with Multi-Instance Partial-Label Learning
summary: Multi-instance partial-label learning (MIPL) addresses inexact supervision in both the instance and label spaces, which can be applied to video classification. However, bag-level labels do not explicitly supervise the correspondence between candidate classes and temporal evidence. We propose {\ours}, which couples label disambiguation with temporal evidence allocation through a joint class--time assignment. Occupancy-regularized spherical matching associates contextualized video features while learning nonuniform temporal mass and discouraging excessive concentration. During training, candidate-restricted inference recomputes the assignment within the candidate label set. A dual-marginal KL projection then constructs a structured teacher that incorporates momentum-refined class beliefs while preserving the proposal's temporal occupancy. A single plan-level KL objective aligns the full-space predictor with this teacher. Our analysis characterizes when candidate re-solving differs from masking and shows that, under the stated construction, the joint objective decomposes into class-marginal and class-conditional temporal supervision. We construct VCMIPL benchmarks from Breakfast, DoTA, and FineAction using model-generated candidate labels and evaluate the method across four feature representations. Extensive experimental results demonstrate that PIVOTMIPL outperforms existing MIPL algorithms in both effectiveness and efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出PIVOTMIPL方法，通过联合类别—时间分配将标签消歧与时间证据分配耦合，解决多实例偏标签学习中的对应关系缺失问题，并在新构建的VCMIPL基准上取得优于现有方法的效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 多实例偏标签学习（MIPL）同时存在实例空间与标签空间的不精确监督，可应用于视频分类；但包级标签无法显式监督候选类别与时间证据之间的对应关系，导致类别消歧与时间定位脱节。
AI.method: 提出PIVOTMIPL：(1) 占用正则化球面匹配，关联上下文化视频特征，学习非均匀时间质量并抑制过度集中；(2) 候选受限推理，在候选标签集内重新计算分配；(3) 对偶边缘KL投影，构造结构化教师，融合动量精炼的类别信念并保留提案的时间占用；(4) 单一plan级KL目标，将全空间预测器与教师对齐；并给出候选重解与掩码差异的理论分析，证明联合目标可分解为类别边缘监督与类别条件时间监督。
AI.result: 基于Breakfast、DoTA、FineAction用模型生成候选标签构建VCMIPL基准，并在四种特征表示上评测；实验表明PIVOTMIPL在效果与效率上均优于现有MIPL算法。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合类别—时间分配及教师对齐机制，PIVOTMIPL有效实现MIPL框架下的标签消歧与时间证据分配协同，验证了方法在视频分类任务中的有效性与高效性。

title: VepAgent: Bridging Causal-Transition via Tool-Augmented Reinforcement Learning for Video Event Prediction
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated remarkable potential in video understanding, yet their reliance on retrospective summarization and text-centric priors often limits their ability to bridge unobserved causal transitions when applied to Video Event Prediction (VEP). To address this, we propose VepAgent, an agentic framework that integrates causal-transition reasoning with tool-augmented reinforcement learning (RL) for robust VEP. Unlike prior methods that passively project future trajectories from historical dependencies, our approach explicitly models the logical progression from terminal observed states to future events. Specifically, we first construct futurebench-4K, a high-quality chain-of-thought dataset for supervised fine-tuning (SFT) that effectively bridges the causal-logic gap by structuring the deduction of unobserved intermediate states. Subsequently, we develop a diagnostic tool library integrating state tracking, frame retrieval, and region magnification, enabling the agent to dynamically augment reasoning with external tools to recover missing spatio-temporal evidence and resolve visual ambiguities during inference. Moreover, we propose a composite reward mechanism that jointly optimizes prediction accuracy, causal coherence, and reliable prior, compelling the agent to rely on genuine visual grounding rather than superficial textual similarities. Extensive evaluations on FutureBench and NEPBench datasets demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance, significantly outperforming larger MLLMs and validating the empirical effectiveness of our agentic, future-oriented reasoning paradigm.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VepAgent，一个将因果转移推理与工具增强强化学习相结合的智能体框架，用于视频事件预测（VEP），并构建了FutureBench-4K思维链数据集，在FutureBench和NEPBench上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）依赖回溯式摘要和以文本为中心的先验，难以在视频事件预测中跨越未观测到的因果转移，无法有效从历史依赖被动外推未来。
AI.method: 提出VepAgent智能体框架：1）构建FutureBench-4K高质量思维链数据集用于监督微调（SFT），通过结构化推导未观测中间状态弥合因果逻辑缺口；2）开发包含状态跟踪、帧检索、区域放大的诊断工具库，使智能体在推理时动态调用外部工具恢复缺失时空证据、消除视觉歧义；3）设计复合奖励机制，联合优化预测准确性、因果连贯性与可靠先验。
AI.result: 在FutureBench和NEPBench数据集上达到最先进（SOTA）性能，显著优于规模更大的MLLMs。
AI.conclusion: 验证了该智能体式、面向未来的推理范式的实证有效性，证明显式建模因果转移并结合工具增强强化学习可提升视频事件预测的鲁棒性。

title: Wiring Matters: Injection Topology and Initialization of Affordance Heads in Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Dense affordance supervision is an appealing auxiliary signal for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, yet naively co-training an affordance head can severely damage instruction following. We present a controlled study of how to wire such a head into a modern VLA on the LIBERO benchmark. Our recipe reads the backbone through a stop-gradient and re-injects an intermediate head feature into the action expert via a learned bridge. The stop-gradient is a precondition: letting affordance gradients reach the backbone drops the policy below the headless base (85.5% vs. 93.1%). With the backbone protected, a same-budget 2*2 ablation over injection topology (concatenation vs. residual) and bridge initialization (zero vs. random) shows initialization is the dominant lever. The best wiring, an actively initialized residual bridge, reaches 96.2%, matching the far more elaborate three-expert AffordanceVLA (95.8%) with under 1% extra parameters. Two probes explain the mechanism: ground-truth affordances fed as an input hurt, and inference-time zeroing shows a lazy bridge acts only as a training-time regularizer while an active bridge becomes load-bearing.

AI.tldr: 在LIBERO基准上系统研究了如何将稠密affordance监督接入现代VLA策略：冻结主干（stop-gradient）是前提，桥接初始化是主导因素，最佳配置（主动初始化的残差桥接）以不足1%额外参数达到96.2%，媲美复杂的三专家AffordanceVLA（95.8%）。
AI.motivation: 稠密affordance监督对VLA策略是有吸引力的辅助信号，但朴素地联合训练affordance头会严重损害指令跟随能力。作者希望弄清"如何正确接线"这一问题，而非简单堆叠模块。
AI.method: 在LIBERO上进行受控实验：(1) 通过stop-gradient读取主干，并借助可学习bridge将中间头特征重新注入action expert；(2) 在相同预算下做2×2消融，比较注入拓扑（拼接 vs. 残差）与桥接初始化（零初始化 vs. 随机初始化）；(3) 用两个探针分析机制——将ground-truth affordance作为输入，以及在推理时置零桥接。
AI.result: 允许affordance梯度回传主干会使策略跌至85.5%，低于无头的93.1%基线；保护主干后，初始化是主导因素。最佳接线为"主动初始化的残差桥"，达到96.2%，与三专家AffordanceVLA（95.8%）持平，额外参数不足1%。探针显示：ground-truth affordance作为输入反而有害；推理时置零表明惰性桥仅起训练期正则作用，而主动桥是承重的。
AI.conclusion: 将affordance头接入VLA的关键在于"接线方式"而非容量：stop-gradient保护主干、合理的注入拓扑与主动初始化三者结合，即可用极小开销获得SOTA级性能；桥接可从纯正则器转变为推理期承重组件。

title: Readout Blindness: VLM Scores Miss the Spatial Direction Their Frozen Encoders Retain
summary: CLIP-like vision-language models remain a cornerstone of multimodal systems, yet their scores stay near chance on directed spatial relations, such as whether one object is left of another. We call this failure readout blindness and analyze, theoretically and empirically, why deployed scores miss the direction: when scoring rules treat the subject and object symmetrically, direction cancels regardless of encoder training. Guided by this analysis, we introduce Antisymmetric Displacement Readout (ADR), which aligns caption words with image patches in the frozen features and scores each relation by the signed displacement between matched object centroids. Notably, ADR succeeds without additional training or learned parameters, thereby demonstrating that directional information remains in the frozen encoder. However, text and world priors can inflate accuracy, so we further introduce prior deflation, which measures the benefit of the image-text pairing as the grounded gain over a null that pairs each item with an unrelated image. Extensive experiments across encoder families show that ADR substantially improves over deployed scores, which remain near chance on most direction-balanced sets even for fine-tuned encoders. Compared with more complex readouts, ADR outperforms the evaluated MLLM likelihood readouts and is competitive with their chat inference at a small fraction of the computation. These results support our claim that directional information can be recovered from frozen features by an appropriate readout. Our implementation and evaluation kit will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文诊断了CLIP类视觉-语言模型在定向空间关系（如“左/右”）上接近随机水平的失败，提出“读出盲区（readout blindness）”概念，并从理论与实证说明对称打分规则会抵消方向信息；进而提出无需训练、无参数的反对称位移读出（ADR），配合“先验消减”指标，显著恢复冻结特征中的方向信息。
AI.motivation: CLIP类视觉-语言模型是多模态系统的基石，但在定向空间关系（例如一个物体是否在另一个物体左侧）上的得分接近随机水平，严重限制其空间推理能力。作者希望揭示这一失败的根源，并验证方向信息是否仍存在于冻结编码器中。
AI.method: 1）从理论上分析“读出盲区”：当打分规则对称对待主语与宾语时，方向信号无论编码器如何训练都会被抵消。2）提出反对称位移读出（ADR）：在冻结特征中将caption词与图像patch对齐，用匹配到的物体质心之间的有符号位移来为每个关系打分；无需额外训练或学习参数。3）提出先验消减（prior deflation）：以“将每个项目与无关图像配对”的null作为基线，用grounded gain衡量图文配对的真实收益，从而剥离文本与世界先验带来的虚高准确率。
AI.result: 跨多种编码器家族的实验表明：部署的读出得分在大多数方向均衡集合上接近随机水平，即便对微调编码器也是如此；而ADR大幅优于这些部署得分。与更复杂的读出方法相比，ADR优于所评估的MLLM似然读出，并在仅消耗少量计算的情况下与MLLM对话式推理具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 方向信息确实保留在冻结的编码器特征中，通过合适的读出方式即可被恢复；现有失败主要源于读出规则本身的对称性，而非编码器缺乏方向表征。

title: SPIN: Image Immunization Against Diffusion Editing via Single-Step Projection in Stochastic Neighborhoods
summary: Diffusion models have greatly advanced instruction-guided image editing, while also raising concerns about unauthorized image manipulation. Image immunization addresses this risk by adding imperceptible perturbations to an input image to disrupt subsequent edits. Since editing requests are unknown at image release, protection should remain effective beyond the instruction used to construct the perturbation. Existing immunization methods either require costly full-trajectory backpropagation or use intermediate objectives whose effects may be weakened by subsequent denoising. Meanwhile, a single inference path provides limited feedback about alternative denoising continuations. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{SPIN}, a framework for image immunization via one-step projection over local stochastic trajectory neighborhoods. Starting from an early denoising state, \textsc{SPIN} generates stochastic neighboring states under the same instruction and predicts their clean latents through one-step projection without full unrolling. We then optimize a bounded input perturbation to maximize the average deviation of these predictions from a clean-edit reference, encouraging the perturbation to disrupt multiple possible editing outcomes. Experiments on two image editors demonstrate substantial gains in protection performance, with \textsc{SPIN} outperforming compared methods across all six metrics under seen instructions and in the more challenging unseen instruction setting.

AI.tldr: 提出SPIN框架，通过局部随机轨迹邻域的单步投影实现图像免疫，在两种编辑器上六个指标均超越对比方法。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型推动指令引导图像编辑发展的同时带来未授权篡改风险，图像免疫通过添加不可感知扰动破坏后续编辑。但编辑指令在图像发布时未知，保护需对构建扰动所用指令之外的指令也有效。现有方法要么依赖代价高昂的全轨迹反传，要么使用中间目标，其效果可能被后续去噪削弱；同时单一推理路径对替代去噪延续提供的反馈有限。
AI.method: 提出SPIN框架：从早期去噪状态出发，在同一指令下生成随机邻域状态，并通过单步投影预测其干净潜变量，无需完整展开轨迹。随后优化有界输入扰动，最大化这些预测相对干净编辑参考的平均偏差，促使扰动破坏多种可能的编辑结果。
AI.result: 在两个图像编辑器上的实验表明保护性能显著提升，SPIN在已见指令下的全部六个指标上优于对比方法，在更具挑战性的未见指令设定下同样胜出。
AI.conclusion: SPIN以单步投影替代全轨迹反传，兼顾效率与泛化性，验证了面向随机轨迹邻域优化的图像免疫在已见与未见指令下均具优势。

title: BabelFake: A Multilingual Audio-Visual DeepFake Benchmark
comment: 25 pages (8 main paper + ack), 25 pages total, 8 figures, under submission
summary: Reliable and practical audio-visual DeepFake detection requires benchmarks that reflect diverse linguistic contexts and modern data synthesis pipelines for visual as well as audio manipulations. However, existing datasets predominantly contain footage of English-speakers, often include outdated manipulation types, or overlook the audio modality. Further, many datasets feature individuals who did not consent to be used in DeepFake creation. We introduce BabelFake, a multilingual audio-visual DeepFake benchmark recorded with consenting participants. BabelFake contains 399k clips (1,323 hours) from 496 individuals spanning five languages (English, German, Italian, French, Spanish). Our modular data generation pipeline pairs 11 modern video manipulation methods with 4 voice cloning engines, distinguishing visual-only (face swapping) and joint audio-visual manipulations (lip synchronization and portrait animation). By benchmarking state-of-the-art detectors, we show that detection difficulty depends on the audio-visual generation pairing, with substantial performance degradation when authentic audio is preserved. Cross-language/demographic evaluation reveals sensitivity varying across detector architectures and training data, while human evaluation reveals that perceived realism and machine-detection difficulty do not necessarily align.

AI.tldr: BabelFake：一个含同意錄製的多語言視聽 DeepFake 基準，399k 片段、1,323 小時、496 人、五種語言，配對 11 種視頻與 4 種語音克隆方法，揭示檢測難度取決於視聽生成配對。
AI.motivation: 現有 DeepFake 資料集多為英語母語者影像、操縱類型過時、忽略音頻模態，且常包含未經同意之人物，難以支撐可靠且實用的視聽檢測研究。
AI.method: 構建模塊化數據生成流水線，將 11 種現代視頻操縱方法與 4 種語音克隆引擎配對，區分純視覺操縱（換臉）與聯合視聽操縱（唇形同步、肖像動畫），並以同意參與者錄製多語言數據。
AI.result: 基準測試 SOTA 檢測器顯示：檢測難度依賴視聽生成配對，保留真實音頻時性能顯著下降；跨語言/人口統計評估顯示敏感度隨檢測器架構與訓練數據變化；人類評估顯示感知真實性與機器檢測難度並不必然一致。
AI.conclusion: BabelFake 為多語言、合規且涵蓋現代視聽操縱的 DeepFake 檢測提供了更貼近實際的基準，強調需針對視聽配對、跨語言泛化與人機感知差異改進檢測方法。

title: MeSD: Multi-Evidence Self-Distillation for VideoLLM
summary: While reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards provides reliable outcome supervision for VideoLLMs, sequence-level rewards offer limited token-level guidance. On-policy self-distillation addresses this limitation by conditioning a self-teacher on privileged information to provide dense token-level supervision. However, aggregating heterogeneous evidence within a single teacher context obscures cross-evidence agreement and conflict. A further challenge lies in determining whether teacher guidance should refine reward-based updates or provide corrective supervision for failed trajectories. To address these issues, we propose MeSD, a multi-evidence self-distillation framework for VideoLLMs. MeSD constructs three evidence-conditioned teachers with shared parameters, using the ground-truth answer as a common semantic context while separately incorporating temporal and spatial evidence. Given the same student-generated prefixes, MeSD evaluates evidence-specific preferences relative to the Answer Teacher and fuses teacher-common preferences with gated teacher-specific residuals. Furthermore, MeSD introduces Verification-Guided Optimization to classify trajectories as Success, Failure, or Indeterminate. For Success and Indeterminate trajectories, MeSD refines token-level advantage magnitudes while preserving reward-derived signs. For verified failure trajectories that contain the required evidence, MeSD applies failure-conditioned distillation, using reverse-KL correction toward the fused distribution. Experiments on multiple video benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains over reinforcement learning and self-distillation baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MeSD，一种面向VideoLLMs的多证据自蒸馏框架，通过构建三个证据条件教师并融合其偏好，结合验证引导优化，在多个视频基准上超越强化学习与自蒸馏基线。
AI.motivation: 强化学习可验证奖励虽为VideoLLMs提供可靠的结果监督，但序列级奖励缺乏token级指导；on-policy自蒸馏虽能通过特权信息提供密集token级监督，却存在两个问题：一是在单一教师上下文中聚合异构证据会掩盖证据间的一致与冲突；二是难以确定教师指导应细化基于奖励的更新，还是为失败轨迹提供纠错监督。
AI.method: MeSD构建三个共享参数、以真实答案为公共语义上下文并分别融入时间与空间证据的条件教师。对相同学生生成前缀，MeSD相对Answer Teacher评估各证据专属偏好，并将教师共同偏好与门控的教师特异残差相融合。同时引入Verification-Guided Optimization，将轨迹分为Success、Failure、Indeterminate：对Success与Indeterminate保留奖励符号并细化token级优势幅度；对已验证且包含所需证据的失败轨迹，采用反向KL校正朝融合分布进行失败条件蒸馏。
AI.result: 在多个视频基准上的实验表明，MeSD相较强化学习与自蒸馏基线取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: MeSD通过多证据条件教师融合与验证引导优化，解决了自蒸馏中证据冲突与失败轨迹监督难题，为VideoLLMs提供了更有效的token级监督。

title: Environmental sensor readings in two crop disease image datasets identify the session in which each image was taken
summary: Integrating environmental sensor data with leaf imagery is widely reported to boost crop disease classification accuracy. In this work, we reveal that these reported gains are often artifacts of dataset construction: because a single sensor reading is shared across many images collected in a single session (one farm on one date), multimodal networks can predict disease simply by memorizing session identities. Analyzing two widely used Korean datasets, the Crop Disease Diagnosis (CDD) benchmark and an AI Hub pest/disease dataset, we demonstrate that nearly all images share sensor values, with 91.9% of CDD test images having exact sensor duplicates in the training set. Remarkably, an image-free classifier given only timestamps matches or exceeds sensor-driven predictions across all seven evaluated crops, and matches the published macro-F1 of a state-of-the-art CDD fusion model. These results indicate that performance gains on standard random splits cannot be disentangled from session leakage. We propose that multimodal crop studies must evaluate on session-held-out splits and report performance against sensor-free date-time baselines to ensure genuine generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示环境传感器数据提升作物病害分类精度的报道多为数据集构造伪影：同一会话（同农场同日期）内多张图像共享同一传感器读数，导致多模态网络可通过记忆会话身份预测病害。
AI.motivation: 环境传感器与叶片图像融合被广泛认为可提升作物病害分类精度，但作者怀疑这些增益并非来自真实多模态信息，而是数据集构造（会话泄漏）导致的伪影，因此需要系统检验。
AI.method: 分析两个广泛使用的韩国数据集：作物病害诊断基准（CDD）和 AI Hub 病虫害数据集；统计图像间传感器值的重复情况与训练-测试集传感器重复率；构建仅依赖时间戳、不含图像的无图像分类器，与传感器驱动预测在七种作物上对比，并与已发表的先进 CDD 融合模型 macro-F1 对比。
AI.result: 几乎所有图像共享传感器值，CDD 测试集中 91.9% 的图像在训练集中存在完全相同的传感器重复；仅用时间戳的无图像分类器在全部七种作物上达到或超过传感器驱动预测，并匹配已发表先进 CDD 融合模型的 macro-F1。
AI.conclusion: 标准随机划分下的性能增益无法与会话泄漏解耦；多模态作物研究应使用会话留出（session-held-out）划分评估，并以无传感器日期-时间基线作为对照，以确保真实泛化能力。

title: MTOR: Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection with Multimodal Semantics and Temporal Over-Regularity
summary: The rapid evolution of video generation has narrowed the perceptual gap between authentic and synthetic videos, making generalizable AI-generated video detection increasingly challenging. Existing detectors predominantly rely on visual representations, leaving caption-derived textual semantics underexplored. Meanwhile, temporal regularity in fine-grained visual representations has received limited attention. We find that caption-derived textual representations provide complementary discriminative cues to global visual representations. Our analysis further reveals that AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and lower temporal variability, a pattern we term temporal over-regularity (TOR). Based on these findings, we propose MTOR with a multimodal branch and a TOR component. The multimodal branch integrates global visual and caption-derived textual representations, while the TOR component models temporal over-regularity at three levels: coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability. Extensive evaluations on five benchmarks covering 46 generator variants demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance against 16 representative baselines, while robustness experiments confirm strong resilience to twelve real-world video perturbations. Code and models will be released at https://github.com/hwang-cs-ime/MTOR.

AI.tldr: 提出MTOR框架，融合全局视觉与字幕文本语义，并建模视频的时序过度规则性，用于AI生成视频检测，在五个基准上取得最优整体性能。
AI.motivation: 视频生成技术快速进步缩小了真实与合成视频的感知差距，检测愈发困难。现有检测器多依赖视觉表征，忽视了字幕衍生的文本语义；同时细粒度视觉表征中的时序规律性也研究不足。
AI.method: 分析发现字幕文本表征可对全局视觉表征提供互补判别线索，且AI生成视频表现出更强的时序持续性与更低的时序变异性，即"时序过度规则性（TOR）"。据此提出MTOR，包含多模态分支与TOR组件：多模态分支整合全局视觉与字幕文本表征；TOR组件在粗粒度帧间连续性、细粒度token对应关系、帧到视频稳定性三个层面建模时序过度规则性。
AI.result: 在涵盖46种生成器变体的五个基准上评测，相对16个代表性基线取得最优整体性能；鲁棒性实验验证对十二种真实世界视频扰动具有较强韧性。
AI.conclusion: 融合字幕文本语义与多层级时序过度规则性建模，可有效提升AI生成视频检测的泛化性与鲁棒性，代码与模型将开源。

title: Multi-Task Partially Supervised Learning for Super-Resolution and Semantic Segmentation on Earth Observation data
summary: Super-resolution and semantic segmentation are known to benefit one another, especially in the Earth observation context. However, learning both tasks in a joint model often requires both task annotations, which is impractical and expensive. In this paper, we study the multi-task partially supervised learning paradigm for both tasks, where each example is assumed to have only a single-task annotation. To that end, we examine two multi-task architectural variations, the sequential and shared variants, and then propose a hybrid variant and a re-projection loss to benefit from the shared representation and enforce image quality of super-resolution when training with semantic segmentation. Experiments show favorable results compared to the SOTA sequential variant. Source code will be published at https://github.com/lhoangan/munera.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多任务部分监督学习范式：每个样本仅有单任务标注，联合进行遥感图像超分辨率与语义分割。作者比较了顺序式与共享式两种架构变体，提出混合变体及重投影损失以利用共享表示并在语义分割训练时保证超分辨率图像质量，实验优于SOTA顺序式方法。
AI.motivation: 超分辨率与语义分割相互促进，尤其在遥感场景中；但联合模型通常需要两个任务的标注，成本高且不现实。因此需要研究每个样本只有单任务标注的多任务部分监督范式。
AI.method: 分析两种多任务架构变体：顺序变体（sequential）与共享变体（shared）；在此基础上提出混合变体（hybrid），并设计重投影损失（re-projection loss），以利用共享表示并在使用语义分割训练时约束超分辨率图像质量。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，所提方法相比SOTA的顺序变体取得了更优的结果。代码将发布于 https://github.com/lhoangan/munera。
AI.conclusion: 在仅单任务标注的部分监督设定下，通过混合架构与重投影损失可有效联合超分辨率与语义分割，性能优于现有SOTA顺序式方案。

title: Harnessing Multimodal Large Language Models for Training-Free Human-Object Interaction Detection
summary: Human-object interaction (HOI) detection aims to localize human-object pairs and recognize their interactions. Traditional supervised methods perform strongly but rely on task-specific training. Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer a promising route to training-free HOI detection through their broad visual-semantic knowledge and versatile perceptual and reasoning capabilities. However, existing approaches largely invoke these capabilities through loosely coordinated inference stages. This fragmented execution restricts the role of interaction hypotheses in guiding visual exploration, leaving key participants overlooked and local ambiguities unresolved. Furthermore, propagating early semantic assumptions through subsequent visual grounding and relation prediction induces self-reinforcing semantic circularity. To resolve these challenges, we propose HarnessHOI, a training-free framework that transforms passive MLLM inference into an active interaction-centric harness. Specifically, we introduce an interaction-guided perception mechanism that projects emerging interaction hypotheses back into the visual space to discover missing participants and refine ambiguous evidence through targeted observation. Furthermore, a relation-agnostic geometric adjudication module reconciles multi-source evidence to establish a unified spatial basis for grounded interaction reasoning across multiple actions and semantic roles. Extensive experiments on HICO-DET and V-COCO demonstrate that HarnessHOI achieves state-of-the-art performance among training-free methods, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed harness for complex interaction understanding. Code will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练HOI检测框架HarnessHOI，将被动MLLM推理转为主动的以交互为核心的引导机制，解决推理碎片化与语义循环问题。
AI.motivation: 传统监督式HOI检测依赖任务特定训练；现有基于MLLM的免训练方法通过松散协调的推理阶段调用能力，导致交互假设无法有效引导视觉探索、关键参与者被忽略、局部模糊未解决，并通过早期语义假设在后续视觉定位与关系预测中传播引发自我强化的语义循环。
AI.method: 提出免训练框架HarnessHOI，包含两大部分：1）交互引导感知机制，将涌现的交互假设投影回视觉空间，以发现缺失参与者并通过针对性观察精炼模糊证据；2）关系无关的几何裁决模块，协调多源证据，为多动作与语义角色的交互推理建立统一空间基础。
AI.result: 在HICO-DET与V-COCO数据集上大量实验表明，HarnessHOI在免训练方法中达到最先进性能，验证了该引导机制对复杂交互理解的有效性。
AI.conclusion: HarnessHOI通过主动交互引导的免训练框架有效缓解推理碎片化与语义循环问题，在HOI检测上取得免训练方法中的最佳表现，代码将在发表后开源。

title: SpatialChain: A Benchmark for Auditing Spatial Reasoning Faithfulness in VLMs
comment: Accepted at the 2nd Workshop on Embodied Spatial Reasoning (ESR), NeurIPS 2026. 29 pages (8 main), 9 figures, 18 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark
summary: Thinking-enabled vision-language models (VLMs) report ever-higher accuracy on spatial benchmarks, yet final-answer scores cannot reveal whether a correct prediction reflects faithful spatial reasoning or a linguistic shortcut. We introduce SpatialChain, a dataset of 28,350 training and 899 test examples pairing spatially-oriented GQA questions with scene-graph-grounded reasoning chains, retained only when the generated answer matches the symbolic ground truth, and a two-axis evaluation combining objective chain-overlap metrics with a scene-graph-aware LLM judge that scores faithfulness and completeness independently of the final answer. Applied to nine thinking-enabled VLMs, the protocol surfaces three findings invisible to standard accuracy: (i) four of nine models achieve $\geq$79% VQA accuracy while exhibiting shortcut rates above 39%, i.e., correct answers whose reasoning the judge marks as unfaithful; (ii) chain quality significantly predicts answer correctness for seven of nine models, but the two exceptions (Claude Sonnet 4.6, InternVL3.5-8B) reveal qualitatively distinct failure modes, terse output vs. verbose-decorative reasoning, that benchmark accuracy alone conflates; (iii) SFT on SpatialChain improves Qwen3-VL-8B by +6.2 pp in-domain and reduces its shortcut rate to 22%, while a stylistic specialization effect on external benchmarks motivates replay-augmented training as mitigation. The faithfulness judge is validated against 198 human-annotated items, where judge-human agreement matches human-human agreement, and against a second judge from a different provider, which preserves the model ranking ($ρ$ = 0.88). Data, generation scripts, and evaluation code are released at https://github.com/spatialchain/SpatialChainBenchmark.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialChain 数据集与双轴评估协议，用于检测思维增强型 VLM 在空间任务中"答案正确但推理不忠实"的捷径现象。
AI.motivation: 现有空间基准仅看最终答案准确率，无法区分正确答案是来自忠实的空间推理，还是语言捷径（linguistic shortcut）。
AI.method: 构建 SpatialChain：28,350 训练 + 899 测试样本，将空间导向的 GQA 问题与场景图支撑的推理链配对，且仅在生成答案与符号真值一致时保留；评估采用双轴设计——客观的推理链重叠指标 + 场景图感知的 LLM 评判器，独立于最终答案分别打分忠实度与完整性。应用于 9 个思维增强型 VLM，并以 198 个人工标注项和另一家提供方的第二评判器进行验证。
AI.result: (i) 9 个模型中有 4 个 VQA 准确率 ≥79% 但捷径率 >39%；(ii) 9 个模型中有 7 个推理链质量显著预测答案正确性，两个例外（Claude Sonnet 4.6、InternVL3.5-8B）分别表现为输出过简与冗长装饰性推理；(iii) 在 SpatialChain 上 SFT 使 Qwen3-VL-8B 域内提升 +6.2 pp、捷径率降至 22%，但外部基准出现风格特化效应。评判器与人类一致度约等于人类间一致度，与第二评判器排序相关性 ρ=0.88。
AI.conclusion: 最终答案准确率会掩盖不忠实推理，需要显式的推理链评估；SpatialChain 可诊断捷径、提升推理忠实性，但需通过重放增强训练缓解风格特化副作用。

title: Toward Reliable Infant Pose Estimation: A Training-Dynamics Approach to Noisy Annotation Detection
summary: Spontaneous movement analysis in preterm infants relies increasingly on markerless pose estimation (PE) to derive clinically relevant motion biomarkers directly from video recordings. Training accurate infant PE models requires large sets of manually annotated keypoints, and human annotation is inherently prone to error. Noisy keypoints (i.e., keypoints mislocalized with respect to their true anatomical position) are especially problematic in this clinical setting, since they can propagate as artificial artifacts into the reconstructed joint trajectories. Building on the small-loss hypothesis and training-dynamics-based sample selection established in the noisy-label learning literature, we propose a novel framework for detecting noisy keypoint annotations. A hybrid convolutional-attention model is trained to predict the anatomical category of each keypoint from its spatial coordinates and local visual features; the resulting cross-entropy training dynamics are then used to derive per-keypoint descriptors, which are partitioned into clean and noisy subsets via unsupervised clustering. We validate the approach on NeoPose, a newly collected dataset of 65 hospitalized preterm infants, under two realistic noise scenarios (random positional perturbation and left-right swapping) across multiple noise levels. Results show that the proposed approach achieves an F1-score of up to 91.9% in noisy-keypoint detection. The framework further generalizes to the heterogeneous COCO benchmark, where filtering CE-detected noisy keypoints from the training set also yields measurable improvements (up to 7.4 AP points) in downstream pose estimation accuracy at moderate-to-high noise levels.

AI.tldr: 提出基于混合卷积-注意力模型与交叉熵训练动态的框架，无监督聚类检测早产儿姿态估计中的噪声关键点，NeoPose数据集上F1达91.9%，并泛化至COCO。
AI.motivation: 早产儿自发运动分析日益依赖无标记姿态估计（PE）从视频中提取临床运动生物标志物。训练准确的婴儿PE模型需大量人工标注关键点，而人工标注易出错。噪声关键点（偏离真实解剖位置）在此临床场景中尤为有害，会以伪影形式传播至重建的关节轨迹。
AI.method: 借鉴噪声标签学习中的小损失假设与基于训练动态的样本选择，构建噪声关键点检测框架：训练一个混合卷积-注意力模型，从关键点空间坐标与局部视觉特征预测其解剖类别；利用所得交叉熵训练动态导出关键点级描述子，再通过无监督聚类划分为干净与噪声子集。在NeoPose（65名住院早产儿）数据集上，于两种现实噪声场景（随机位置扰动与左右互换）及多噪声水平下验证。
AI.result: 噪声关键点检测F1-score最高达91.9%。框架可泛化至异构COCO基准：从训练集过滤CE检测出的噪声关键点后，在中高噪声水平下下游姿态估计精度最高提升7.4 AP。
AI.conclusion: 基于训练动态的噪声关键点检测能有效识别人工标注错误，提升婴儿及通用姿态估计的数据质量与下游精度，具备跨数据集泛化能力。

title: MaRO-GS: Mask-Robust Object-Centric Gaussian Splatting from Inconsistent Multi-view Masks
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. Project page: https://eunjikim02.github.io/marogs/
summary: We address the challenge of accurate 3D object reconstruction from multi-view images in Gaussian Splatting. Existing object-level 3DGS methods reconstruct the entire scene rather than directly optimizing the target object, even when only the target object is needed, which incurs substantial computational overhead. They also rely on 2D segmentation masks to associate Gaussians with objects, but these masks are often inconsistent across views. Such inconsistencies corrupt Gaussian optimization and produce incorrectly supervised Gaussians that degrade object reconstruction fidelity. To overcome these limitations, we propose MaRO-GS, a 3DGS framework that directly optimizes target-object Gaussians from object-masked multi-view images and remains robust to inconsistent supervision. For reliable supervision, mask-reliability view filtering excludes unreliable views. Object-supported Gaussian density control suppresses Gaussians irrelevant to the target object and prevents background densification, while Silhouette-aligned Object Loss maintains object-focused optimization. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that MaRO-GS improves PSNR, segmentation accuracy, and computational efficiency, with the largest PSNR gain of 2.05 dB on the small-object LERF-Mask dataset.

AI.tldr: MaRO-GS是一个面向目标的3D高斯泼溅框架，通过掩码可靠性视图过滤、目标支撑高斯密度控制和轮廓对齐目标损失，直接从物体掩码多视图图像优化目标高斯，在多数据集上提升PSNR、分割精度与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有物体级3DGS方法重建整个场景而非直接优化目标物体，即使只需目标物体也带来大量计算开销；同时依赖2D分割掩码关联高斯与物体，但掩码跨视图不一致，会破坏高斯优化并产生错误监督高斯，降低物体重建保真度。
AI.method: 提出MaRO-GS框架，直接用物体掩码多视图图像优化目标物体高斯，并对不一致监督保持鲁棒。关键设计包括：掩码可靠性视图过滤以排除不可靠视图；目标支撑高斯密度控制以抑制与目标无关的高斯并防止背景致密化；轮廓对齐目标损失以维持物体聚焦优化。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，MaRO-GS提升了PSNR、分割精度与计算效率，在小型物体的LERF-Mask数据集上取得最大2.05 dB的PSNR提升。
AI.conclusion: MaRO-GS通过直接优化目标物体高斯并增强对不一致掩码监督的鲁棒性，有效改善了物体级3D重建的保真度、分割质量与计算效率。

title: Topology-Informed Prompt-Conditioned Universal Segmentation of Uterine Structures from Ultrasound and MRI
summary: Multi-structure segmentation of the uterus is important for computer-assisted screening, diagnosis, and treatment planning of uterine diseases, where ultrasound and MRI provide complementary clinical information. However, developing a unified model across these modalities is challenging due to their substantially different image appearances, anatomical contexts, spatial resolutions, and label spaces. Moreover, existing datasets often define different segmentation targets, making joint learning challenging and potentially leading to negative transfer across heterogeneous tasks. To this end, we propose a Topology-informed Prompt-conditioned Universal Segmentation (TPUS) framework for segmenting multiple uterine structures across ultrasound and MRI. TPUS introduces a graph-based multi-dataset backbone comprising modality-specific stems and a modality-shared graph-based encoder-decoder to support modality-sensitive input adaptation, structural feature reasoning, and joint representation learning across heterogeneous uterine segmentation tasks. In addition, TPUS uses task-aware class prompts to condition the segmentation process for different datasets and label spaces, a dynamic convolutional adaptation module to generate task-specific output responses, and a topology-informed loss to encourage anatomically consistent predictions. Experiments on a uterine ultrasound dataset and a T2-weighted uterine myoma MRI dataset demonstrate that TPUS achieves Dice scores of 0.898 and 0.693 on the two held-out test sets, respectively, outperforming several generic and universal segmentation baselines. Source code can be accessed at https://github.com/YonghengSun1997/TPUS.

AI.tldr: 提出TPUS框架，实现超声与MRI跨模态、跨数据集的子宫多结构统一分割。
AI.motivation: 子宫多结构分割对子宫疾病的计算机辅助筛查、诊断与治疗规划具有重要意义，超声与MRI可提供互补的临床信息。但跨模态统一建模面临图像外观、解剖上下文、空间分辨率与标签空间差异大的问题；同时现有数据集分割目标不一致，联合学习易产生异构任务间的负迁移。
AI.method: TPUS包含：基于图的多数据集骨干网络，由模态特异stem与模态共享的图编码器-解码器组成，支持模态敏感输入适配、结构特征推理与异构任务的联合表征学习；任务感知类别提示（task-aware class prompts）对分割过程进行条件化以适配不同数据集与标签空间；动态卷积适配模块生成任务特定输出响应；拓扑感知损失（topology-informed loss）约束解剖一致性。
AI.result: 在子宫超声数据集与T2加权子宫肌瘤MRI数据集的留出测试集上，TPUS分别取得0.898与0.693的Dice分数，优于多种通用及统一分割基线。
AI.conclusion: TPUS通过拓扑先验与提示条件化的统一架构，有效缓解跨模态、跨数据集异构分割任务中的负迁移，实现超声与MRI子宫多结构的联合分割，性能优于现有基线。

title: NeuroCBIR: A Fast and Accurate Image Retrieval System for Whole-Brain and Region-Specific MRI
comment: Neuroimaging, Content-Based Image Retrieval, MRI, Zero-Shot Learning
summary:
Content-based image retrieval (CBIR) in neuroimaging enables the identification of structurally similar brain scans, supporting diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment planning; however, existing methods are often limited to small datasets, single brain regions, or coarse class labels, thereby restricting their clinical utility and generalizability.
  Here, we present NeuroCBIR, a framework for fast and flexible retrieval of both whole-brain and region-specific 3D T1w MRI scans. A total of 103 cortical and subcortical regions are extracted to enable both whole-brain and region-level queries.
  NeuroCBIR leverages latent representations learned by a variational autoencoder (VAE) combined with contrastive learning, producing scan-specific embeddings that capture anatomical patterns. These embeddings were evaluated for subject re-identification, zero-shot age prediction, and zero-shot multi-class pathology stratification. Re-identification performance was high across both whole-brain and brain-region levels (mean average precision across the top-5 retrieved images (mAP@5) >= 98.4%), with robust generalization across datasets and acquisition conditions. While NeuroCBIR is not trained for age prediction or pathology stratification, zero-shot evaluations for these two tasks demonstrate that the embeddings encode meaningful information for downstream tasks.
  Embedding extraction on a 4-core CPU required approximately 18.7 s per scan, whereas similarity search was effectively instantaneous (less than 0.01 s).
  NeuroCBIR is publicly available for brain MRI with more than 26,000 precomputed T1w MRI embeddings. It supports reproducible research, region-specific flexibility, and clinically meaningful personalized diagnostic support. The software is available at https://github.com/minnelab/NeuroCBIR.

AI.tldr: NeuroCBIR是一个基于VAE与对比学习的脑MRI内容检索框架，支持全脑及103个皮层/皮层下区域级3D T1w检索，在重识别任务上mAP@5≥98.4%，并具备零样本年龄预测与病理分层能力，已公开26,000+预计算嵌入。
AI.motivation: 神经影像中的内容检索（CBIR）有助于识别结构相似的脑扫描，从而支持诊断、预后与治疗规划；但现有方法多受限于小数据集、单一脑区或粗粒度类别标签，临床实用性与泛化性不足。
AI.method: 提取103个皮层与皮层下区域，支持全脑与区域级查询；利用变分自编码器（VAE）学习潜在表示并结合对比学习，生成捕获解剖模式的扫描特异性嵌入；在受试者重识别、零样本年龄预测与零样本多类病理分层任务上进行评估；测量4核CPU上的嵌入提取与相似性检索耗时。
AI.result: 重识别在全脑与区域级均表现优异（mAP@5 ≥ 98.4%），跨数据集与采集条件泛化稳健；尽管未针对年龄预测或病理分层训练，零样本评估显示嵌入编码了可用于下游任务的有效信息；4核CPU上每例扫描嵌入提取约18.7秒，相似性搜索小于0.01秒（近乎即时）。
AI.conclusion: NeuroCBIR公开可用，提供26,000+预计算T1w MRI嵌入，支持可复现研究、区域特异性灵活检索以及具有临床意义的个性化诊断支持，代码见 https://github.com/minnelab/NeuroCBIR 。

title: Harmful Content Generation in Text-to-Image Models: Capabilities and Moderation Limitations
comment: Accepted for publication in ACM Transactions on Intelligent Systems and Technology (TIST)
summary: Text-to-image generative models can produce highly realistic imagery but also raise concerns about harmful misuse. While safety mechanisms exist, systematic evaluations of their effectiveness against realistic attacks remain limited. We present a systematic evaluation of harmful content generation across five open text-to-image models using an automated pipeline that transforms legitimate news captions into unsafe prompts targeting sexually explicit content, violence/gore, harmful stereotypes, self-harm, and hate speech. We evaluate both standard models with built-in safety mechanisms and community fine-tuned variants that bypass content restrictions. A human evaluation of 1,500 generated images shows high harmful-content generation rates: 89.2% for gore-related prompts, 47.6% for sexually explicit content, 43.6% for harmful stereotypes, 46.0% for hate speech, and 34.5% for self-harm, predominantly through graphic violence. Models show substantial capability for generating violent and stereotypical content, while community fine-tuned variants are particularly vulnerable to sexually explicit prompts. Generation quality is largely preserved under harmful prompting, producing imagery of sufficient fidelity to pose risks for disinformation and abuse; FLUX.1-dev produces clearly realistic harmful images in 30.9% of cases. We further evaluate automated moderation systems and find substantial detection gaps that allow unsafe images to evade filtering. Finally, we assess synthetic image detectors and show that models trained only on benign datasets perform worse on explicit content, while more diverse training data improves detection, highlighting semantic distribution gaps in current approaches. These findings expose limitations in current generation safeguards, moderation systems, and synthetic image detection, highlighting the need for stronger defenses against misuse at scale.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了5个开源文生图模型的有害内容生成风险，通过将新闻标题改写为不安全提示进行测试。1500张图像的人评显示高有害生成率（血腥89.2%、色情47.6%等），社区微调变体更易被绕过，现有审核与合成图像检测系统存在明显缺口。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型可生成高度逼真图像，带来滥用风险；尽管已有安全机制，但对其在真实攻击下有效性的系统评估仍有限，需要量化有害内容生成、审核与检测环节的防护缺口。
AI.method: 构建自动化流水线，将合法新闻标题转化为针对色情、暴力/血腥、有害刻板印象、自残和仇恨言论的不安全提示；在5个开源文生图模型上测试，涵盖标准安全机制模型与绕过限制的社区微调变体；对1500张生成图像进行人工评估，并评估自动审核系统与合成图像检测器。
AI.result: 有害内容生成率高：血腥89.2%、色情47.6%、有害刻板印象43.6%、仇恨言论46.0%、自残34.5%（多表现为血腥暴力）；生成质量基本保持，FLUX.1-dev有30.9%为明显逼真有害图像；自动审核存在显著检测缺口；仅用良性数据训练的检测器对露骨内容表现更差，训练数据多样可提升检测。
AI.conclusion: 当前生成安全机制、审核系统和合成图像检测均存在明显局限，难以应对规模化滥用，亟需更强的防御措施。

title: A General Pipeline for Dense Illuminant Estimation via Physically Based Synthetic Data
comment: Accepted at the 34th Color and Imaging Conference (CIC 2026), hosted by the Society for Imaging Science and Technology (IS&T)
summary: Illuminant estimation is a fundamental problem in computational photography, as it enables the correction of color shifts induced by varying lighting conditions. While learning-based methods have demonstrated strong performance, their progress is hindered by the limited availability of large-scale datasets with accurate illuminant ground-truth. In this work, we propose a general and reusable pipeline to derive dense illuminant chromaticity maps from physically based 3D-rendered scenes. By repurposing an existing 3D scene collection, our approach enables the systematic generation of pixel-wise illuminant annotations under controlled lighting conditions, effectively lowering the barrier to data acquisition for learning-based illuminant estimation. Using this pipeline, we generate a large-scale synthetic set of 74,321 images, which we employ for pre-training both single- and multi-illuminant estimation models. Extensive experiments with state-of-the-art architectures show that synthetic pre-training consistently improves performance, with gains of up to 28% for single-illuminant estimation and up to 57% for multi-illuminant estimation, particularly in data-scarce regimes. These findings demonstrate that synthetic data generation pipelines offer an effective and scalable solution for the pre-training of illuminant estimation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从3D渲染场景中生成密集光源色度图的通用可复用流水线，据此构建了74,321张图像的大规模合成数据集，用于光源估计模型的预训练，单光源和多光源估计性能分别最高提升28%和57%。
AI.motivation: 光源估计（光照颜色估计）是计算摄影的基础问题，可用于校正不同光照条件引起的颜色偏移。基于学习的方法表现优异，但其发展受限于缺乏具有准确光源真值的大规模数据集，数据获取成本高、标注困难。
AI.method: 提出一种通用且可复用的数据生成流水线，通过复用现有3D场景集合，在物理渲染条件下推导出密集的逐像素光源色度图，从而系统性地生成受控光照下的像素级光源标注。利用该流水线生成74,321张图像的合成数据集，并将其用于单光源与多光源估计模型的预训练。
AI.result: 在多种当前最优架构上的大量实验表明，合成预训练能一致地提升性能：单光源估计最高提升28%，多光源估计最高提升57%，在数据稀缺的场景下提升尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 合成数据生成流水线为光源估计方法的预训练提供了有效且可扩展的解决方案，能够降低数据获取门槛，并显著提升模型性能，尤其在数据受限条件下具有重要价值。

title: BrainTRACE: Tracing Longitudinal, Multimodal, and Volumetric Evidence in Brain MRI Clinical Reasoning
summary: Brain MRI interpretation is a longitudinal clinical reasoning problem: radiologists compare serial studies, integrate information across MRI sequences, localize findings within volumetric anatomy, and translate this evidence into report-grounded assessments. Existing medical VQA and 3D imaging benchmarks capture important parts of this workflow, but often evaluate brain MRI through isolated images, static volumes, or ungrounded report-style answers, thereby obscuring failures in the evidence chain that support clinical validity. We introduce BrainTRACE, a report-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether vision-language models can trace the evidence structure required for longitudinal brain MRI interpretation. BrainTRACE contains 7,273 scored VQA instances derived from 1,778 longitudinal patients, 7,299 MRI studies, and approximately 29k co-registered 3D MRI sequence volumes. The benchmark is organized by five levels of clinical reasoning, from acquisition recognition to case-level synthesis, and by evidence demands covering longitudinal comparison, report-grounded references, multi-sequence integration, and volumetric spatial evidence. BrainTRACE supports rendered inputs compatible with standard VLM interfaces, a 3D-evidence condition, and a decomposed case-reasoning track that audits six steps in a longitudinal evidence chain. Evaluation of 20 VLM configurations shows that current systems can identify isolated visual cues but rarely compose them into grounded longitudinal interpretations. We release the benchmark specification, evaluation lists, scoring implementation, scoring rubrics, and audit-record format to support reproducible progress in brain MRI VLM evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BrainTRACE，一个以报告为依据的纵向脑MRI解读基准，用于评估视觉语言模型能否追踪临床推理所需的证据链，包含7273个VQA实例，覆盖五个推理层级与四类证据需求。
AI.motivation: 现有医学VQA与3D影像基准多通过孤立图像、静态体积或无依据的报告式答案来评估脑MRI，掩盖了支撑临床有效性的证据链中的失败。脑MRI解读本质是纵向临床推理问题，需要系列对比、跨序列整合、体部解剖定位并将证据转化为有报告依据的评估。
AI.method: BrainTRACE构建了源自1778名纵向患者、7299次MRI检查、约2.9万个共配准3D MRI序列体积的7273个评分VQA实例。基准按五个临床推理层级（从采集识别到病例级综合）组织，并按证据需求分类（纵向比较、报告依据引用、多序列整合、体积空间证据）。支持兼容标准VLM接口的渲染输入、3D证据条件，以及分解式病例推理轨迹以审计纵向证据链的六个步骤。
AI.result: 对20种VLM配置的评估显示，现有系统能识别孤立的视觉线索，但很少将其组合为有依据的纵向解读。
AI.conclusion: BrainTRACE揭示了当前VLM在纵向脑MRI证据链推理上的不足，并发布基准规范、评估列表、评分实现、评分标准与审计记录格式，以支持该领域可复现的进展。

title: FrontVeg V2: A Training-Free Software Framework for Foreground-Aware Zero-Shot Plant Trait Segmentation in High-Resolution Images of Trellised Crops
summary: FrontVeg V2 is an open-source, training-free software framework for foregroundaware zero-shot segmentation of plant traits in high-resolution images of trellised crops. The pipeline combines monocular depth estimation, automatic foreground extraction using Valley-Aware Depth Thresholding, tiled zero-shot segmentation, Graph-Based Mask Assembly, and geometry-aware fusion. This design enables plant organs and disease symptoms to be segmented while reducing detections arising from neighboring vegetation rows. The current implementation integrates Depth Anything V2 (DAV2) and SAM3 and can be used through both command-line batch processing and a Napari graphical interface. FrontVeg V2 provides a reusable framework for multi-crop, multi-trait digital phenotyping without task-specific model retraining.

AI.tldr: FrontVeg V2 是一个开源、免训练的前景感知零样本分割框架，用于高分辨率棚架作物图像中的植物性状分割，通过深度估计与多重几何融合模块降低邻行植被干扰。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率棚架作物图像中，相邻种植行的植被会引入大量误检，干扰目标植株器官与病害症状的准确分割；同时传统方法依赖任务特定的模型再训练，成本高、泛化性差，亟需一种免训练、可跨作物跨性状复用的分割方案。
AI.method: 流水线由五个环节组成：单目深度估计、基于 Valley-Aware Depth Thresholding 的自动前景提取、分块（tiled）零样本分割、基于图的掩膜组装（Graph-Based Mask Assembly）以及几何感知融合；当前实现集成 Depth Anything V2（DAV2）与 SAM3，支持命令行批量处理与 Napari 图形界面两种使用方式。
AI.result: 该设计能够在分割植物器官与病害症状的同时，减少由邻近植被行引起的检测。框架被验证为可用于多作物、多性状数字表型，无需任务特定模型再训练。
AI.conclusion: FrontVeg V2 提供了一个可复用的免训练框架，为多作物、多性状数字表型研究提供了通用的前景感知零样本分割基础。

title: Keepsake: Selective Spatial Memory for Long-Horizon Video Generation
summary: Long-horizon camera-controlled video generation relies on persistent memory to maintain scene consistency. Existing systems follow two strategies to achieve this consistency. Full-history approaches retain all generated observations, causing unbounded storage and retrieval costs. Selective-construction approaches reduce redundancy, but make one-time retention decisions that are never revisited, even as an observation's value changes with the evolving memory bank. Both strategies leave a shared question unresolved: as the generated history evolves, which stored observations should still remain in memory? Our key insight is that the value of a stored observation is not fixed, but relational: it depends on the alternatives currently available in the memory bank.
