A view supported by many geometrically and visually similar substitutes can be relinquished with little loss of coverage, whereas an observation with few viable alternatives should remain regardless of age. We introduce Keepsake, an online, training-free controller for fixed-capacity spatial memory. At each update, Keepsake constructs a pose-appearance graph over retained and newly generated observations, combining camera-pose proximity with visual similarity. A retention priority jointly captures the number of strong substitutes and the similarity of the closest alternative, allowing Keepsake to continually reassess memory value, preserve observations with little alternative support, and evict highly replaceable ones under a fixed budget. The controller modifies only the persistent-memory update; the host generator, denoising schedule, and retrieval rule remain unchanged. Across MemCam and WorldMem, Keepsake improves FVD and LPIPS under a fixed memory budget. On 180-second MemCam trajectories, it retains only 32 of 5,397 frames while reducing FVD by 35.1%.

AI.tldr: Keepsake：面向长时相机控制视频生成的在线、免训练固定容量空间记忆控制器，通过姿态-外观图与关系型保留优先级动态重估记忆价值。
AI.motivation: 长时相机控制视频生成依赖持久记忆维持场景一致性。现有方法分为两类：全历史方法保留所有观测，导致无界的存储与检索开销；选择性构建方法虽减少冗余，但只做一次性保留决策且不再重审，无法适应观测价值随记忆库演化而变化的情况。二者共同遗留的问题是：随生成历史演化，哪些已存观测仍应留在记忆中？
AI.method: 核心洞见：已存观测的价值并非固定，而是关系型的，取决于当前记忆库中可用的替代品。若某视图存在大量几何与视觉相似的替代，则可被舍弃而不显著损失覆盖度；而替代品稀少的观测无论多旧都应保留。据此提出Keepsake——在线、免训练的固定容量空间记忆控制器。每次更新时，在保留观测与新生成观测上构建姿态-外观图，融合相机姿态接近度与视觉相似度；保留优先级联合刻画强替代品数量与最近替代品的相似度，从而持续重估记忆价值、保留替代支持稀少的观测、在固定预算下淘汰高度可替代者。该控制器仅修改持久记忆更新，宿主生成器、去噪调度与检索规则保持不变。
AI.result: 在MemCam与WorldMem上，Keepsake在固定记忆预算下提升FVD与LPIPS。在180秒的MemCam轨迹上，仅保留5,397帧中的32帧，同时将FVD降低35.1%。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆价值建模为关系型（依赖当前记忆库中的替代支持）而非固定属性，使固定预算下的在线记忆管理能在极低帧保留率下仍显著提升生成一致性，且无需训练、不改变宿主生成流程，具有良好的即插即用性。

title: VGGT-Bridge: Beyond Sequential Pose Graphs via Coarse-Stride Skip Edges
summary: Feed-forward visual geometry transformers such as VGGT reconstruct dense 3D structure from images in a single forward pass, simplifying multi-view 3D reconstruction. However, their quadratic attention complexity makes them difficult to scale to long sequences with thousands of frames. Chunk-and-align frameworks address this by splitting a long sequence into overlapping chunks and stitching their local reconstructions into a pose graph. Yet existing methods connect only sequentially adjacent chunks, so small per-frame errors accumulate along the chain into large-scale drift. To move beyond sequential edges, we propose VGGT-Bridge, which adds long-range skip edges that directly constrain non-adjacent chunks without retraining. By running VGGT on sparsely sampled coarse chunks, each coarse chunk bridges distant fine chunks into a single direct constraint. We further turn VGGT's first-frame scale bias into a drift correction by feeding selected coarse chunks in reverse, and a loop-aware policy keeps this reversal compatible with existing loop closures. VGGT-Bridge reduces ATE by 28.3% on KITTI Odometry, 18.8% on Virtual KITTI, and 10.0% on Waymo Open over the SwiftVGGT baseline, achieving the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods.

AI.tldr: 提出 VGGT-Bridge，在 chunk-and-align 框架中引入长程跳跃边与非相邻块直接约束，无需重训练即缓解序列漂移，在 KITTI/Virtual KITTI/Waymo 上显著降低 ATE。
AI.motivation: 前馈视觉几何 Transformer（如 VGGT）虽能在单次前向中重建稠密 3D 结构，但二次注意力复杂度使其难以扩展到上千帧的长序列。chunk-and-align 框架通过切分重叠块并拼接局部重建来缓解，但现有方法仅连接顺序相邻块，导致逐帧小误差沿链累积形成大规模漂移。
AI.method: VGGT-Bridge 在不重训练的前提下，向 chunk-and-align 框架中加入长程跳跃边，直接约束非相邻块：通过对稀疏采样的粗粒度块运行 VGGT，使每个粗块为多个远端细粒度块建立单一直接约束；同时将 VGGT 的首帧尺度偏置转化为漂移校正，方法是反向输入选定的粗块；并提出环路感知策略，使该反向操作与既有回环闭合兼容。
AI.result: 相比 SwiftVGGT 基线，ATE 在 KITTI Odometry 上降低 28.3%，Virtual KITTI 降低 18.8%，Waymo Open 降低 10.0%，在所有 chunk-and-align 方法中达到最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入长程跳跃边与反向粗块校正，VGGT-Bridge 有效抑制了链式顺序约束带来的漂移累积，且无需重训练即可作为即插即用增强，在多个自动驾驶数据集上取得领先的位姿估计精度。

title: Analysis of SWIR Imaging Detection Performance Under Adverse Environmental Conditions for Autonomous Driving Systems
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Short-wave infrared (SWIR) imaging has emerged as a promising modality for autonomous driving, yet its practical benefits over RGB remain poorly characterized across diverse conditions. This paper presents a systematic comparative study of paired RGB and SWIR object detection on the RASMD dataset, covering four weather conditions and two real-time detection architectures, with various fine-tunings evaluated against a unified ground truth. Overall, RGB demonstrates comparable or superior performance in most scenarios, while RF-DETR exhibits greater robustness across varying conditions. Beyond aggregate metrics, we propose a sensor-dominance mining framework that combines multi-model agreement with targeted manual inspection to identify scenarios where one sensing modality provides more reliable detections using largely unannotated paired data. This analysis reveals that SWIR offers clear advantages in four safety-critical situations, including windshield glare, water droplets on the windshield, low-contrast object visibility, and long-range vehicle detection. The findings suggest that SWIR should be viewed as a complementary modality that enhances perception in rare but challenging conditions. The datasets will be available upon request, and all code and trained model weights are publicly released at https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文对RASMD数据集上成对的RGB与短波红外(SWIR)目标检测进行系统对比，并提出了传感器优势挖掘框架，发现RGB在多数场景表现相当或更优，而SWIR在四类安全关键场景中具有明确优势。
AI.motivation: SWIR成像被视为自动驾驶的潜力模态，但其在不同条件下相对RGB的实际收益尚未被充分刻画。
AI.method: 在RASMD数据集上开展成对RGB与SWIR目标检测的系统比较：覆盖四种天气条件与两种实时检测架构，采用多种微调策略并统一真值评估；同时提出传感器优势挖掘框架，结合多模型一致性与针对性人工检查，在基本无标注的配对数据中定位某一模态检测更可靠的场景。
AI.result: 总体上RGB在多数场景表现相当或更优，RF-DETR在不同条件下鲁棒性更强；SWIR在四类安全关键情形中优势明显，包括挡风玻璃眩光、挡风玻璃水滴、低对比度目标可见性以及远距离车辆检测。
AI.conclusion: SWIR应被视为互补模态，用于在稀有但困难的条件下增强感知；数据集可申请获取，代码与训练权重已开源于https://github.com/comsee-research/swir-adverse-env-analysis。

title: Multitask Conditional Generative Adversarial Network Enables Automatic Whole Knee Cartilage and Menisci Segmentation and Reliable T1\r{ho} and T2 Quantification Without High-Resolution Morphological Images
summary: Early osteoarthritis detection through quantitative MRI (qMRI) requires accurate cartilage and meniscus segmentation, traditionally necessitating time-consuming, costly 3D high-resolution Double Echo Steady-State (DESS) MRI scans. This study developed a multi-task conditional generative adversarial network (MT-cGAN) to simultaneously synthesize DESS-like images and segment tissues directly from qMRI echo images. This retrospective study evaluated 508 knee MRI volumes from 361 subjects (mean age: $40.4 \pm 12.2$ years; 179 female) across three cohorts. Ground truth segmentation masks were generated from DESS images using a pretrained model with manual correction, and $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ maps were computed from magnetization-prepared angle-modulated partitioned $k$-space spoiled gradient echo snapshots (MAPSS) echo images. MT-cGAN was trained to jointly synthesize DESS-like images and segment cartilage and meniscus directly from echo images. Model performance was evaluated using Dice score for segmentation accuracy and coefficient of variation (CV) for $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ quantification. MT-cGAN achieved the highest segmentation performance, mean Dice score 0.84 (range: 0.80--0.86) across all cartilage and meniscus compartments and significantly outperformed the state-of-the-art conditional GAN model with transfer learning (mean Dice, 0.82; $p < 0.001$, Wilcoxon signed-rank test). For relaxometry quantification, MT-cGAN demonstrated the highest consistency with the reference DESS protocol, yielding the lowest CV ($T_{1ρ}$: 1.84%, $T_2$: 1.81%). The proposed MT-cGAN accurately segmented cartilage and menisci while providing reliable $T_{1ρ}$ and $T_2$ quantification directly from echo images. By eliminating the need for separate morphological DESS scans, this workflow reduces required scan times to facilitate the clinical translation of qMRI.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出多任务条件生成对抗网络（MT-cGAN），可直接从qMRI回波图像合成类DESS图像并分割软骨与半月板，在361名受试者、508个膝关节MRI数据上取得优于现有条件GAN的分割性能，同时保持较高的T1ρ与T2定量一致性，从而省去单独的DESS形态学扫描。
AI.motivation: 早期骨关节炎的定量MRI（qMRI）检测依赖准确的软骨和半月板分割，而传统方法需要耗时且昂贵的3D高分辨率DESS扫描。研究旨在消除对单独形态学DESS扫描的依赖，简化流程并促进qMRI的临床转化。
AI.method: 开发多任务条件生成对抗网络（MT-cGAN），从qMRI回波图像中同时合成类DESS图像并分割软骨与半月板。回顾性分析三个队列共361名受试者（平均年龄40.4±12.2岁，179名女性）的508个膝关节MRI体数据；以基于DESS图像、经预训练模型生成并人工校正的分割掩膜为金标准，由MAPSS回波图像计算T1ρ与T2图。采用Dice评分评估分割精度，采用变异系数（CV）评估T1ρ和T2定量的一致性。
AI.result: MT-cGAN在所有软骨和半月板分区上取得最高分割性能，平均Dice为0.84（范围0.80–0.86），显著优于结合迁移学习的最新条件GAN模型（平均Dice 0.82，p < 0.001，Wilcoxon符号秩检验）。在弛豫定量方面，MT-cGAN与参考DESS协议一致性最高，CV最低（T1ρ：1.84%，T2：1.81%）。
AI.conclusion: MT-cGAN能够直接从回波图像准确分割软骨与半月板，并提供可靠的T1ρ和T2定量结果。通过免除单独的形态学DESS扫描，该流程缩短了所需扫描时间，有助于推动qMRI的临床转化。

title: Lens3D: Target-Conditioned Visual Foveation for Fine-Grained 3D Understanding
summary: Existing 3D large language models often overlook fine-grained attributes and less visually salient objects and parts, even when relevant evidence is present in scene videos. We introduce Lens3D to improve fine-grained object understanding through external visual assistance and knowledge transfer. Its LensUnd pipeline adopts 3D localization to select informative, complementary views for an external 2D vision-language model, supporting fine-grained object captioning, small-object grounding, and fine-grained object question answering. LensDistill transfers the resulting fine-grained knowledge to 3D LLMs through detailed caption supervision, enabling captioning from native inputs without external VLM calls. We also construct LensBench, a held-out evaluation set of 2,068 objects with three silver-standard reference descriptions per object. Experiments with Video-3D LLM and 3DRS demonstrate that LensDistill substantially improves fine-grained object captioning while preserving existing grounding and scene-level QA performance. These results establish the feasibility of transferring externally acquired fine-grained knowledge into native 3D LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Lens3D，通过外部视觉辅助与知识蒸馏提升3D大语言模型的细粒度物体理解能力，并构建了LensBench评测集。
AI.motivation: 现有3D大语言模型往往忽略细粒度属性以及视觉显著性较低的物体和部件，即便相关证据已存在于场景视频中。因此需要一种方法增强其细粒度物体理解能力。
AI.method: 提出Lens3D，包含两个模块：LensUnd利用3D定位为外部2D视觉语言模型选择信息丰富且互补的视角，支持细粒度物体描述、小物体定位和细粒度物体问答；LensDistill通过详细描述监督将获得的细粒度知识迁移到3D大语言模型，使其无需调用外部VLM即可从原生输入进行描述。同时构建LensBench评测集，包含2,068个物体，每个物体三条银标准参考描述。
AI.result: 在Video-3D LLM和3DRS上的实验表明，LensDistill显著提升了细粒度物体描述性能，同时保持了原有的定位和场景级问答性能。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了将外部获取的细粒度知识迁移到原生3D大语言模型的可行性。

title: Video Encoders Built on Image Representations
summary: The design of a video encoder determines when frames begin to interact and which frame-specific visual evidence remains accessible to the language model. Native video pathways couple neighboring frames during visual encoding, whereas image pathways preserve independently computed frame representations but incur a much larger visual-token cost when all image tokens are forwarded. We ask a basic question: whether a compact video encoder can instead be built on image representations. To answer this question, we separate three operations that are often coupled: per-frame representation, cross-frame token allocation, and temporal interaction. A frozen image encoder first produces frame-specific candidates. A question-aware selector then allocates a fixed token budget across frames using relevance, diversity, and cross-frame correspondence, after which a lightweight learned refiner reads neighboring-frame context and writes residual updates only to the retained anchors. This preserves source positions and keeps the visual output at the fixed budget. Across 13 benchmarks and three vision-language backbones, the resulting pathway matches full-image aggregate performance while using only about 28%-35% of its visual tokens. Specifically, on Qwen3-VL-8B, it achieves a 13-benchmark macro-average of 62.75 with 1,535 visual tokens, compared with 62.58 for the full Image pathway at 4,424 tokens and 59.49 for native Conv3D at 2,212 tokens. On Qwen3-VL-32B, it reaches a 13-benchmark macro-average of 66.28, compared with 66.09 for Image, while providing a 2.16x end-to-end speedup. These results show that compact video encoding does not require early temporal mixing: frame-specific evidence can be preserved first, allocated jointly, and temporally contextualized after selection.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种在冻结图像编码器之上构建紧凑视频编码路径的方法：先独立生成逐帧表示，再以问题感知方式跨帧分配固定视觉token预算，最后对保留的锚点做轻量时序精炼。在13个基准、三种VLM骨干上，仅用约28%-35%的视觉token即达到全图像路径的聚合性能，并实现最高2.16倍端到端加速。
AI.motivation: 视频编码器设计存在一个核心权衡：原生视频路径（如Conv3D）在视觉编码阶段就耦合相邻帧，而图像路径保留独立计算的帧表示，但转发全部图像token时视觉token开销极大。作者质疑是否必须通过早期时序混合才能实现紧凑视频编码，并提出核心问题：能否在图像表示之上构建紧凑的视频编码器。
AI.method: 作者将通常耦合的三个操作解耦：逐帧表示、跨帧token分配和时序交互。具体流程为：(1) 冻结的图像编码器生成帧特定的候选token；(2) 问题感知选择器依据相关性、多样性和跨帧对应关系，在帧间分配固定的token预算；(3) 轻量学习精炼器读取相邻帧上下文，仅对保留的锚点写入残差更新。该设计保持源位置不变，并使视觉输出维持固定预算。
AI.result: 在13个基准和三种视觉-语言骨干网络上，该路径仅使用全图像聚合路径约28%-35%的视觉token，却匹配其性能。在Qwen3-VL-8B上，以1,535个视觉token取得13基准宏平均62.75，优于全图像路径的62.58（4,424 token）和原生Conv3D的59.49（2,212 token）。在Qwen3-VL-32B上，宏平均达66.28，高于全图像的66.09，并提供2.16倍端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑视频编码并不需要早期时序混合：可以优先保留帧特定证据，联合进行token分配，并在选择之后再完成时序上下文化。这一解耦范式为高效视频-语言建模提供了可行且高效的替代方案。

title: Talk Like You: Imitating How You Speak in Real-Time Talking Head Generation
summary: In daily life, each person exhibits unique speaking habits, leading to subtle yet consistent lip-shape variations even when pronouncing the same word. Although recent talking head generation methods have achieved impressive visual fidelity and lip synchronization, they largely overlook user-specific customization, especially the motion patterns that characterize individual speaking habits. These habits are difficult to model and capture, as their motion patterns are highly fine-grained and often similar across individuals. As a result, many approaches produce overly uniform facial motions and fail to capture diverse, person-specific articulation patterns. To address this, we propose TalkLikeYou, an efficient framework that imitates how a target person speaks in talking head generation. Our method models habit in motion-space and achieves real-time performance through Flow Matching with only one sampling step during inference. We further adopt a two-stage imitation learning strategy to capture subtle distinctions between habits, allowing users to specify a target habit through either a preset style from the dataset or a reference video. In addition, we introduce a new metric PLAD that projects mouth motions onto representative articulation axes to evaluate imitation accuracy and generation diversity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TalkLikeYou generates high-quality talking heads in real-time and significantly improves speaking habit imitation compared with prior methods. The code is available at: https://github.com/BQ-Wang0511/TalkLikeYou

AI.tldr: 提出 TalkLikeYou 框架，在动作空间中建模说话习惯，通过单步 Flow Matching 实现实时、可定制的说话头生成，并引入 PLAD 指标评估模仿准确性与多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有说话头生成方法虽在视觉保真度和唇同步上表现优异，但忽视用户个性化需求，尤其是体现个人说话习惯的运动模式。这些习惯运动模式高度精细且个体间差异微小，难以建模与捕捉，导致生成的面部运动过于同质化，缺乏多样化的个人发音特征。
AI.method: 1) 在运动空间（motion-space）中建模说话习惯；2) 采用 Flow Matching 并仅需一次采样步实现实时推理；3) 引入两阶段模仿学习策略以捕捉习惯间的细微差异；4) 用户可通过数据集预设风格或参考视频指定目标习惯；5) 提出新指标 PLAD，将嘴部运动投影到代表性发音轴上以评估模仿准确性与生成多样性。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TalkLikeYou 能够实时生成高质量说话头，并在说话习惯模仿方面显著优于现有方法。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将个性化说话习惯引入说话头生成任务，通过运动空间建模、高效 Flow Matching 与两阶段模仿学习，实现了实时且可定制的个性化说话头生成，并提供 PLAD 指标为习惯模仿评估提供新范式。

title: Cross-dataset harmonization for robust endoscopic image analysis
summary: A significant problem in endoscopic image analysis is that the machine learning (ML) models used for this purpose usually underperform when applied on images acquired from endoscopes that are different from those used to acquire the images of their training set. The main difference of the images originating from different endoscopes is their color distributions, which depend both on the image sensors and the light sources used. Although previous studies have highlighted this challenge, to the best of our knowledge it has not been previously explicitly tackled. This study focuses on this problem and proposes very simple but impactful method. It implements a reference-based image harmonization that reduces global appearance differences between endoscopic datasets. Specifically, it extracts global color statistics from a chosen reference dataset in the CIE-Lab color space and applies a statistical channel-wise transformation to map each target image toward the appearance of the images of the reference dataset. The method is evaluated in the context of polyp detection in both flexible colonoscopy and capsule endoscopy datasets using a dataset-level cross validation protocol. The results indicate that the proposed harmonization consistently improves cross-dataset performance up to 30.7%, outperforming relevant baseline and state-of-the-art methods. The results indicate that a substantial part of the generalization gap is driven by low-level appearance variation that can be mitigated without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于参考图像的颜色协调方法，通过提取参考数据集在CIE-Lab空间的全局颜色统计量并对目标图像做通道级统计变换，缓解不同内窥镜图像间的域偏移。在结肠镜与胶囊内窥镜息肉检测任务中，跨数据集性能最高提升30.7%，优于基线及现有方法。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜图像分析中，ML模型在来自不同内窥镜的图像上表现显著下降。主要差异源于图像传感器与光源导致的颜色分布差异。虽已有研究指出该挑战，但尚未被明确解决。作者认为泛化差距的很大一部分由低层外观变化驱动，且无需重新训练即可缓解。
AI.method: 提出一种参考驱动的图像协调方法：选定参考数据集，在CIE-Lab颜色空间中提取其全局颜色统计量；对每张目标图像施加逐通道的统计变换，将其颜色分布映射至参考数据集的表观风格，从而减小全局外观差异。该方法无需重新训练模型，属预处理式域对齐。评估采用数据集级交叉验证协议，任务为柔性结肠镜与胶囊内窥镜的息肉检测。
AI.result: 在数据集级跨验证下，所提协调方法持续提升跨数据集性能，最高提升30.7%，并优于相关基线方法与现有最优方法。
AI.conclusion: 跨内窥镜泛化差距的很大一部分由低层外观（颜色统计）变化导致，可通过简单、无需重训练的参考图像协调有效缓解，为内窥镜图像分析的域偏移问题提供了简单而有效的解决方案。

title: VideoTapestry: Query-Adaptive Memory Refinement for Multi-Agent Long-Video Understanding
summary: Long-video understanding places substantial demands on memory, as answering questions often requires retrieving information distributed across extended temporal spans. Existing approaches broadly follow two paradigms: query-driven exploration, which is sensitive to localization errors, and query-independent memory construction, which may omit question-specific details. We introduce VideoTapestry, a training-free multi-agent framework that adapts a preconstructed hierarchical video memory through coarse-to-fine, query-driven refinement. The preconstructed memory organizes video content into three levels, capturing global narrative context, event-level temporal structure, and fine-grained relational evidence, respectively. To support coarse-to-fine localization and observation, we assign a specialized agent to each level, keeping retrieval and refinement within a scale-specific context. Guided by the query, these agents revisit relevant video regions and enrich layer-wise memories with targeted multimodal observations. Their refinements are assembled according to the original hierarchy into a composite query-adaptive memory, preserving global context in a compact form while retaining fine-grained evidence along query-relevant branches for final reasoning. Compared with direct GPT-5.5 inference, VideoTapestry achieves absolute accuracy gains of 17.2%, 14.9%, 9.8%, and 7.0% on LVBench, LongVideoBench (Long), Video-MME (Long), and EgoSchema, respectively, achieving the state-of-the-art results among all competitors.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练多智能体框架 VideoTapestry，通过粗到细的查询驱动方式对预构建的分层视频记忆进行适配与细化，在多个长视频理解基准上取得新的最优结果。
AI.motivation: 长视频理解对记忆需求极高，答案常需跨长时间跨度检索信息。现有两类范式各有局限：查询驱动探索易受定位误差影响；与查询无关的记忆构建可能遗漏问题特定细节。
AI.method: VideoTapestry 是免训练的多智能体框架。先预构建三层分层视频记忆，分别捕获全局叙事上下文、事件级时间结构与细粒度关系证据；为每一层分配专门的智能体，将检索与细化限制在对应尺度的上下文中。智能体在查询引导下重访相关视频区域，并以目标多模态观测丰富各层记忆；随后按原始层次组装为查询自适应的复合记忆，在紧凑保留全局上下文的同时沿查询相关分支保留细粒度证据，用于最终推理。
AI.result: 相较直接使用 GPT-5.5 推理，VideoTapestry 在 LVBench、LongVideoBench (Long)、Video-MME (Long)、EgoSchema 上分别取得 17.2%、14.9%、9.8%、7.0% 的绝对准确率提升，并在所有竞争者中达到最优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过预构建分层记忆与查询驱动的粗到细多智能体细化，VideoTapestry 在免训练条件下有效缓解了定位误差与细节遗漏的权衡问题，显著提升长视频理解精度，并取得当前最优结果。

title: ChronoWorld: Camera-Controlled Consistent 4D World Generation via Spatiotemporal Cues and Geometric Reflections
summary: While existing camera-controllable video generation models can produce visually compelling sequences, preserving intrinsic 4D spatiotemporal coherence remains challenging. To address this limitation, we propose ChronoWorld, an "Observation--State--Reflection" framework that leverages spatiotemporal causal cues and reconstruction priors to generate globally consistent, free-view 4D scenes. Given a context video, we introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that enforces multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality throughout the generation process. In addition, we develop a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline with a 4D retrieval strategy to enable dynamic self-assessment and correction of generated outputs, improving consistency and accuracy. Extensive experiments show that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in spatiotemporally consistent, cinematic-quality 4D scene generation, with strong generalization and high-fidelity geometry across diverse scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出ChronoWorld框架，通过"观测—状态—反射"机制结合时空因果线索与重建先验，实现全局一致的自由视角4D场景生成。
AI.motivation: 现有可控相机视频生成模型虽能产出视觉上吸引人的序列，但在保持内在4D时空一致性方面仍面临挑战。
AI.method: 1）提出"观察—状态—反射"(Observation-State-Reflection)框架；2）设计时空极线因果注意力机制(Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention)，在生成全程施加多视角极线约束与时间因果性；3）构建重建驱动的几何反射管线，配合4D检索策略，实现动态自评估与修正。
AI.result: 大量实验表明ChronoWorld在时空一致、电影级质量的4D场景生成上达到最先进水平，具备强泛化能力与跨场景高保真几何。
AI.conclusion: ChronoWorld有效提升了自由视角4D场景生成的时空一致性与几何精度，验证了因果约束与重建先验结合的有效性。

title: GS-Pool: Object-Level Change Detection in 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Factories, museums and surveyors photograph the same space months apart and need to know which objects changed. When each visit is reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), a direct comparison of the two reconstructions does not answer this. Training is stochastic, so two reconstructions of an unchanged space never coincide, and the second visit is often a quick re-scan with far fewer photographs. We propose GS-Pool, which takes two independently reconstructed Gaussian fields of the same space and returns the changed objects in each, together with their masks. SAM2 masks of each visit's photographs are lifted onto the Gaussians that render them and merged into an object pool, so every decision is taken once per object in 3D. We introduce a photographic carrier, the 3DGS training loss of each input reconstruction against the other visit's photographs, backpropagated to the Gaussians that rendered each pixel. We combine it with GS-Diff's geometry and colour terms and our distilled DINOv3 features. This evidence is compared with that of the objects present in both visits, which sets a change threshold for each scene. On PASLCD, GS-Pool reaches mIoU/F1 scores of 0.751/0.846 against 0.644/0.758 for GS-Diff, the strongest prior method, a gain of 17%/12%. Its mIoU is also 36%, 40% and 57% above that of O-SCD, PlenoCI and MV-3DCD, and it reaches 0.855 mIoU on CL-Splats, 33% above MV-3DCD. Each changed object is returned as a set of Gaussians with the evidence behind its decision, which an inspector can review in 3D.

AI.tldr: GS-Pool利用两次独立重建的3DGS场，将SAM2对象掩码提升至高斯并汇成对象池，结合摄影载体（跨访训练损失）、几何颜色与DINOv3特征判定变化对象，在PASLCD上mIoU/F1达0.751/0.846，超越GS-Diff等先前方法。
AI.motivation: 工厂、博物馆与测绘场景常需在数月间隔拍摄同一空间并判断哪些物体发生变化。将每次访问重建为3DGS后，直接比较两次重建无法回答该问题：训练具有随机性，未变空间的重建也不会重合；且第二次访问往往照片很少、为快速重扫。因此需要一种能处理独立重建、训练随机性与稀疏第二访照片的变化检测方法。
AI.method: 提出GS-Pool：输入同一空间两次独立重建的高斯场，输出各自变化对象及其掩码。将各次访问照片的SAM2掩码提升到渲染它们的高斯上，合并为对象池，使每个决策在3D中按对象执行一次。引入摄影载体（photographic carrier），即每个输入重建对另一次访问照片的3DGS训练损失，并反向传播到渲染各像素的高斯。将其与GS-Diff的几何与颜色项及蒸馏的DINOv3特征结合。所得证据与两次访问中均存在的对象证据比较，为每个场景设定变化阈值。
AI.result: 在PASLCD上，GS-Pool取得mIoU/F1为0.751/0.846，而最强先前方法GS-Diff为0.644/0.758，提升17%/12%。其mIoU较O-SCD、PlenoCI与MV-3DCD分别高36%、40%和57%；在CL-Splats上达0.855 mIoU，较MV-3DCD高33%。每个变化对象以一组高斯及决策证据返回，便于检查者在3D中复核。
AI.conclusion: GS-Pool通过对象级3D高斯池与跨访摄影载体证据，有效解决独立3DGS重建且第二访照片稀疏场景下的变化检测，显著超越现有方法，并提供可3D复核的决策证据。

title: Extending Dynamic World Surface Water Mapping to Sentinel-1 with AlphaEarth Embeddings
comment: 8 pages, 3 figures, 5 tables; includes 3 pages of supplementary material
summary: Dynamic World (DW) maps land use and land cover globally at 10 m from Sentinel-2 (S2) imagery, but only for cloud-free observations, which limits where and when surface water can be mapped. We use the DW water class as weak supervision for a Sentinel-1 (S1) synthetic aperture radar (SAR) model so that DW-like water maps can be produced for every S1 acquisition. Google's AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) annual embedding supplies spatial context, while S1 backscatter supplies the acquisition-time observation. On 53 globally distributed scenes with independent annotations of 3 m PlanetScope imagery acquired within 48 h of the S1 overpass, the S1-only model already reaches a pooled water intersection over union (IoU) of 0.77, comparable to 0.75 for the operational OPERA DSWx-S1 product, and adding AEF raises it to 0.85. The fused model improves on the S1-only model on 44 of 53 scenes and exceeds OPERA on 48, and on the independent S1S2-Water benchmark it reaches 0.94, compared with 0.87 for OPERA. Optical land-cover products can thus provide scalable training labels for SAR surface water mapping.

AI.tldr: 用Dynamic World光学水体类作为弱监督标签训练Sentinel-1 SAR模型，并融合AlphaEarth年度嵌入提供空间上下文，实现任意S1过境时刻的水体制图，精度超过OPERA业务产品。
AI.motivation: Dynamic World能提供全球10 m土地覆盖制图，但仅限无云观测，导致地表水在时空覆盖上存在大量缺口；而SAR不受云层影响，却缺乏大规模高质量水体标签。因此需要一种可扩展的方法，将光学产品的信息迁移到SAR水体提取中。
AI.method: 将DW水体类作为弱监督标签训练S1 SAR水体模型；以S1后向散射作为成像时刻观测，Google AlphaEarth Foundations年度嵌入作为空间上下文，构建S1-only与S1+AEF融合两种模型。在53个全球分布场景上，用S1过境48小时内获取的3 m PlanetScope独立标注进行验证，并在S1S2-Water基准上评测。
AI.result: S1-only模型汇总水体IoU为0.77，与业务化OPERA DSWx-S1的0.75相当；加入AEF后提升至0.85。融合模型在53个场景中的44个优于S1-only，在48个场景上超过OPERA；在独立S1S2-Water基准上达到0.94，OPERA为0.87。
AI.conclusion: 光学土地覆盖产品可为SAR地表水制图提供可扩展的训练标签，结合年度嵌入空间上下文可显著提升SAR水体提取精度，并在多个场景与基准上超越现有业务产品，为实现不受云层限制的全球水体制图提供了可行路径。

title: MC-Sparse: Deconstructing and Closing the Dense-Sparse Attention Gap in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Sparse attention is a primary approach to reducing the latency of diffusion transformers in long-sequence generation tasks, such as video and high-resolution 3D asset generation. However, existing methods can degrade generation quality and fidelity at high sparsity levels. Through controlled oracle comparisons, we trace this degradation to three sources: constraints imposed by token grouping, inaccurate interaction selection, and the attention contributions lost when tokens are discarded. Guided by this analysis, we propose Meta-Cached Sparse Attention (MC-Sparse), a training-free framework that selects individual key-value (KV) tokens while organizing similar queries into tile-aligned groups for efficient GPU execution. MC-Sparse caches metadata comprising query groups, KV indices selected using exact attention probabilities, and residuals between dense and sparse attention outputs, and reuses them across subsequent denoising steps. Across video and 3D generation models, MC-Sparse achieves higher fidelity to dense-attention outputs and larger denoising speedups than existing sparse-attention baselines, without visible quality degradation. Relative to dense attention, it delivers a $1.80\times$ denoising speedup on Minimax-H3-Base and a $2.32\times$ speedup on 3D asset generation, both with negligible quality loss.

AI.tldr: 本文提出免训练稀疏注意力框架MC-Sparse，通过元数据缓存（查询分组、精确注意力选择的KV索引、稠密-稀疏残差）跨去噪步复用，在视频与3D生成中实现高于基线的保真度与更大加速。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer在长序列生成（视频、高分辨率3D资产）中延迟高，稀疏注意力是主要加速手段，但高稀疏度下生成质量与保真度下降。作者通过受控的oracle对比，将退化归因于三个来源：token分组带来的约束、交互选择不准确、以及被丢弃token所损失的注意力贡献。
AI.method: 提出Meta-Cached Sparse Attention（MC-Sparse），一种免训练框架：以单个KV token为选择粒度，同时将相似查询组织为tile对齐的分组以便GPU高效执行；缓存元数据，包括查询分组、基于精确注意力概率选出的KV索引，以及稠密与稀疏注意力输出之间的残差，并在后续去噪步中复用。
AI.result: 在视频与3D生成模型上，MC-Sparse相比现有稀疏注意力基线，对稠密注意力输出的保真度更高、去噪加速更大，且无可察觉的质量下降。相对稠密注意力，在Minimax-H3-Base上实现1.80倍去噪加速，在3D资产生成上实现2.32倍加速，质量损失均可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过oracle分析定位稀疏注意力退化根源，并据此设计的细粒度KV选择加缓存复用策略，可在免训练条件下兼顾生成保真度与推理效率，为长序列扩散Transformer的稀疏注意力提供了有效方案。

title: Less Context, Better Geometry: Masked Geometric Encoder for Robust 3D Foundation Models
summary: Recent progress in 3D foundation models has enabled rapid 3D reconstruction and camera calibration by leveraging learned 3D priors from vast amount of spatial data. However, the all-to-all global attention design leads to quadratic complexity and limits long-sequence inference; unconstrained cross-view interactions also can propagate unreliable evidence from occluded or visually similar but geometrically distant views. In this paper, We introduce a Masked Geometric Encoder (MGE), which promotes the learning of robust geometric representations under incomplete cross-view context. During training, MGE strategically drops frame tokens from global attention and distills from a pretrained full-context teacher model. This allows the model to learn an intrinsically richer per-frame representation while providing sufficient intermediate supervision to avoid performance degradation. Through extensive experiments, we show that MGE leads to much stronger performance under occlusion and doppelganger views while retaining high performance on standard benchmarks. Such a richer frame representation also leads to more effective token reduction during inference. To this end, we develop a novel Anchor-Guided Adaptive token merging technique that preserves representative anchor frames while jointly merging redundant tokens from the remaining views. Compared to other efficient inference approaches, we can achieve inference speedup while consistently maintaining higher reconstruction quality, particularly in limited-view settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出掩码几何编码器（MGE），通过训练时丢弃部分帧token并蒸馏全上下文教师模型，学习鲁棒的逐帧几何表征，并结合锚点引导的自适应token合并技术实现高效推理。
AI.motivation: 现有3D基础模型依赖全对全局注意力，导致二次复杂度、限制长序列推理；且无约束的跨视图交互会传播来自遮挡视图或视觉相似但几何距离较远视图的不可靠信息。
AI.method: 提出MGE：训练时策略性地从全局注意力中丢弃帧token，并蒸馏自预训练的全上下文教师模型，以提供中间监督；同时提出锚点引导的自适应token合并技术，保留代表性锚点帧并合并其余视图中的冗余token。
AI.result: 在遮挡视图和“分身”（doppelganger）视图下性能显著增强，同时在标准基准上保持高性能；相比其他高效推理方法，在保持更高重建质量（尤其在有限视图设置下）的同时实现推理加速。
AI.conclusion: MGE学到的更丰富逐帧表征既提升鲁棒性，又利于推理时的token缩减，配合锚点引导token合并可在效率与重建质量间取得更优平衡。

title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing
summary: Sliders provide an intuitive interface for continuous image editing. In current generative approaches, however, the slider is simply a rescaling of the method's strength parameter, such as an adapter coefficient, a prompt weight, or an interpolation factor. This strength relates poorly to perceptual change. The image can partially revert as the slider moves, long stretches of the range produce no visible difference, and short intervals transform the image abruptly. Remapping the strength could fix this uneven pace, but only if the trajectory is monotone, which current methods do not enforce. We therefore distinguish the slider from the strength, and require perceptual distance from the input to grow linearly with the slider value. We introduce UniSlider, a lightweight LoRA trained on a few-step editing backbone so that its strength approximates this ideal slider. Few-step sampling lets us impose this objective in pixel space without intermediate ground truth, and the backbone's output is preserved at full strength. However, a low-rank adapter cannot make the strength fully uniform. Our slider is thus an inference-time remapping of the strength, obtained by adaptive sampling. Since training optmizes to make the trajectory monotone, this remapping closes the remaining gap without extra training or parameters. On a new benchmark of 300 continuous edits evaluating uniformity, monotonicity, edit fidelity, and identity preservation, UniSlider outperforms all prior methods and is preferred in a user study.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 UniSlider，将滑条（slider）与强度参数解耦，通过少步编辑骨干上训练的轻量 LoRA 使强度逼近"感知距离随滑条线性增长"的理想滑条，并在推理时用自适应采样做重映射，在连续编辑基准上超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式图像编辑中，滑条只是对强度参数（适配器系数、提示词权重、插值因子）的重新缩放，而该强度与感知变化关系不良：图像会部分回退、大段区间无可见差异、短区间突变。重映射强度可缓解步速不均，但前提是轨迹单调，现有方法无法保证。
AI.method: 区分"滑条"与"强度"，要求输入图像的感知距离随滑条值线性增长；训练 UniSlider——一个在少步编辑骨干上的轻量 LoRA，使强度近似该理想滑条。少步采样使其可在像素空间施加该目标而无需中间真值，且全强度下保留骨干输出。由于低秩适配器无法使强度完全均匀，滑条进一步定义为推理时对强度做自适应采样得到的重映射；因训练已优化轨迹单调性，该重映射无需额外训练或参数即可弥合剩余差距。
AI.result: 在包含 300 个连续编辑、评估均匀性、单调性、编辑保真度与身份保持的新基准上，UniSlider 优于所有先前方法，并在用户研究中更受偏好。
AI.conclusion: 将滑条从强度参数中解耦，并以"感知距离线性增长"为目标训练 LoRA、再配合推理期自适应重映射，可在不增加训练或参数的情况下实现均匀、单调的连续图像编辑体验。

title: Anatomy-aware Fine-grained Multimodal Fusion for Laryngopharyngeal Cancer T-Staging Prediction Using CT and Radiology Report
comment: Accepted by IEEE Transactions on Medical Imaging (IEEE TMI)
summary: Accurate T-staging is crucial for guiding personalized treatment strategies for laryngopharyngeal cancer. However, current clinical practice relies on invasive biopsy procedures, whereas CT-based staging remains challenging due to the complex patterns of tumor invasion. Recent computer-aided approaches face two key challenges: 1) Structural relationship modeling: existing methods underrepresent anatomically structured patterns of tumor invasion, as they either process whole CT volumes without tumor-specific anatomical constraints or rely on labor-intensive tumor segmentation. 2) Fine-grained cross-modal alignment: while radiology reports contain organ-specific invasion details, current methods that apply global feature fusion struggle to accurately align individual anatomical structures with their corresponding textual descriptions. To address these issues, we propose an anatomy-aware multimodal framework that integrates organ-level CT context and radiology reports into a unified representation for laryngopharyngeal T-staging. The framework first constructs an Anatomy-Structured Organ Graph (AOG) that captures invasion patterns between primary sites and surrounding organs, then performs Organ-Anchored Cross-Modal Alignment (OCA) so that each organ node aggregates textual evidence from the radiology report, and finally refines this graph representation by injecting organ-specific invasion cues extracted from the report via Report-Enhanced Graph-Refinement (REG), yielding a multimodal organ graph that combines spatial and textual evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves superior performance in T-staging of laryngopharyngeal cancer.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种解剖感知的多模态框架，融合器官级CT上下文与影像报告，用于喉咽癌T分期。框架依次构建解剖结构化器官图（AOG）、执行器官锚定的跨模态对齐（OCA）并通过报告增强图精化（REG）注入器官特异性侵犯线索，最终形成多模态器官图。实验表明该方法在喉咽癌T分期上性能优越。
AI.motivation: 喉咽癌精准T分期对个性化治疗决策至关重要，但临床依赖有创活检，CT分期因肿瘤侵犯模式复杂而困难。现有计算机辅助方法存在两大瓶颈：(1)结构关系建模不足——要么不加肿瘤特异性解剖约束地处理整个CT体数据，要么依赖耗时的人工肿瘤分割，无法刻画解剖结构化的侵犯模式；(2)细粒度跨模态对齐缺失——影像报告含器官特异性侵犯细节，但现有全局特征融合方法难以将单个解剖结构与对应文本描述精确对齐。
AI.method: 提出解剖感知多模态框架，将器官级CT上下文与影像报告统一表征，包含三个核心模块：(1)解剖结构化器官图（AOG）：建模原发灶与周围器官之间的侵犯模式；(2)器官锚定跨模态对齐（OCA）：使每个器官节点聚合报告中对应的文本证据；(3)报告增强图精化（REG）：利用从报告中提取的器官特异性侵犯线索精化图表示，最终得到融合空间与文本证据的多模态器官图。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，所提框架在喉咽癌T分期任务上取得了优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将器官级CT上下文与影像报告以图结构进行细粒度跨模态融合，该框架有效缓解了结构关系建模不足与跨模态对齐粗糙的问题，为喉咽癌无创、精准T分期提供了可行方案。

title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, forming dynamic contextual tokens whose function is not well understood. In this work, we introduce a framework for reading this contextual space through natural-language interrogation. We train a lightweight bottleneck network that maps intermediate contextual tokens into the input space of a frozen Large Language Model (LLM), allowing the LLM to answer questions about the emerging image directly from these hidden representations. Our reader reveals that contextual tokens encode a rich, global representation of the emerging scene: generation-specific semantics, including attributes left underspecified by the prompt, are accessible surprisingly early in denoising, while increasingly fine-grained details become readable over time. Remarkably, this information remains decodable even when the MM-DiT receives an empty prompt, showing that contextual tokens accumulate substantial image-specific information from the evolving visual representation itself. We further find that generations with more readable contextual representations tend to receive higher human-preference scores. Building on these observations, we introduce Contextual Alignment, a training technique that explicitly reinforces the visual-semantic information encoded in the contextual tokens, improving generation quality and distributional coverage. Together, our results establish contextual tokens as both an interpretable view into the internal dynamics of MM-DiTs and an effective target for improving generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过自然语言"审问"MM-DiT中间上下文token的框架，揭示其编码全局场景语义，并据此提出Contextual Alignment训练技术提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 多模态扩散Transformer（MM-DiT）在生成过程中通过多模态注意力反复更新文本token，形成动态的"上下文token"，但其功能尚不清楚。作者希望理解并利用这一上下文空间。
AI.method: 训练一个轻量瓶颈网络，将中间上下文token映射到冻结大语言模型（LLM）的输入空间，使LLM能够直接从隐藏表示中回答有关正在生成图像的问题。基于此发现，提出Contextual Alignment训练技术，显式强化上下文token中编码的视觉-语义信息。
AI.result: 上下文token编码了正在生成场景的丰富全局表示：生成特定语义（包括提示中未充分指定的属性）在去噪早期即可被读取，细节随时间逐渐可读；即使MM-DiT接收空提示，信息仍可解码，说明上下文token从演化中的视觉表示中积累了大量图像特定信息。上下文表示可读性更高的生成结果倾向获得更高的人类偏好评分。
AI.conclusion: 上下文token既为MM-DiT内部动态提供了可解释视角，也是改进生成模型的有效目标，Contextual Alignment可提升生成质量与分布覆盖度。

title: S2PD: Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion for Physically and Logically Consistent Video Generation
summary: Bidirectional video diffusion models denoise entire videos in parallel, yet when trained on effectively unlimited in-distribution data from procedural generators, continue to violate physical laws and simple symbolic rules. We introduce Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion (S2PD), which performs autoregressive diffusion at high noise before switching to parallel diffusion at low noise. The autoregressive phase provides the serial computation needed to coordinate interdependent events and produce valid state transitions while the parallel phase jointly refines the entire video and reduces sampling time relative to fully serial generation. We implement S2PD with two architectures: a pixel-space diffusion transformer trained from scratch and a pretrained video model adapted through LoRA fine-tuning with causal attention. Across games, physical simulations, and real video, S2PD follows rules more reliably than matched bidirectional baselines and generates videos with greater temporal stability and sampling efficiency than other serial methods.

AI.tldr: S2PD 提出一种"先串行后并行"的扩散采样框架：在高噪声阶段采用自回归扩散以协调相互依赖的事件，在低噪声阶段切换为并行扩散以联合精修整段视频，兼顾规则一致性与采样效率。
AI.motivation: 双向视频扩散模型虽可并行去噪整段视频，但即便在由程序化生成器提供的近乎无限的同分布数据上训练，仍会违反物理规律与简单符号规则。其根源在于并行去噪缺乏协调相互依赖事件所需的串行计算能力。
AI.method: 提出 Serial-to-Parallel Diffusion（S2PD）：在高噪声区间执行自回归扩散，提供串行计算以生成合法的状态转移；在低噪声区间切换为并行扩散，对整段视频联合精修以降低采样时间。实现上采用两种架构：(1) 从零训练的像素空间扩散 Transformer；(2) 通过 LoRA 微调并引入因果注意力的预训练视频模型。
AI.result: 在游戏、物理模拟与真实视频三类场景上，S2PD 比同等条件的双向基线更可靠地遵循规则，且相较其他串行方法具备更好的时间稳定性与采样效率。
AI.conclusion: 将自回归的串行协调能力与并行扩散的高效精修相结合，是提升视频扩散模型物理与符号规则遵循能力、同时保持采样效率的有效途径，且可兼容从零训练与预训练模型微调两种范式。

title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline
summary: Pipeline figures in ML papers must be repurposed across many canvases, including paper columns, 16:9 slides, portrait posters, 1:1 social teasers, 9:16 phone previews. Each format imposes a different aspect ratio on the same computational graph, where any silently broken connection misrepresents the method. We formulate aspect-ratio-adaptive flowchart relayout as a distinct task: given a raster flowchart and a target ratio, produce a structurally faithful, hallucination-free, editable layout. Existing methods fail characteristically: image-to-image models stretch blocks and reject extreme ratios, text-to-image agentic systems hallucinate content, and parse-then-render systems mis-route edges. We propose an agentic pipeline factored into Parse, Style, and Layout stages, each pairing a main agent with a critic that combines deterministic constraint checks with VLM visual feedback so connectivity is explicitly checked and prevented from being silently broken. Outputs are draw.io-editable mxGraph XML. On a curated benchmark of 100 flowcharts at five aspect ratios, evaluated by Gemini 3.1 Pro and validated against human judgments, our method reaches 68.6% Content Fidelity versus 11.2-41.4% for prior work. Project page: https://onefigureeverycanvas.vercel.app/

AI.tldr: 本文将"宽高比自适应流程图重排版"定义为一个独立任务：给定栅格流程图与目标宽高比，输出结构忠实、无幻觉、可编辑的布局。作者提出分解为 Parse–Style–Layout 三阶段的智能体流水线，每阶段由主智能体与批评者（确定性约束检查+VLM视觉反馈）配对，显式校验连通性，输出 draw.io 可编辑的 mxGraph XML。在100个流程图×5种宽高比的基准上，内容保真度达68.6%（先前工作为11.2%–41.4%）。
AI.motivation: ML论文中的流程图需要在论文分栏、16:9幻灯片、竖版海报、1:1社交封面、9:16手机预览等多种画布上复用，每种格式对同一计算图施加不同宽高比。已有方法存在特征性失败：图到图模型拉伸方框且无法处理极端比例，文生图智能体系统产生内容幻觉，先解析后渲染的系统错连边——任何被静默破坏的连接都会歪曲方法本身。
AI.method: 提出智能体流水线，分解为 Parse（解析）、Style（样式）、Layout（布局）三个阶段；每阶段将主智能体与批评者配对，批评者结合确定性约束检查与VLM视觉反馈，使连通性被显式检查、避免被静默破坏；最终输出 draw.io 可编辑的 mxGraph XML。
AI.result: 在100个流程图、5种宽高比的精选基准上，由 Gemini 3.1 Pro 评测并经人类判断验证，方法达到68.6%的内容保真度，而先前工作仅为11.2%–41.4%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将宽高比自适应流程图重排版形式化为独立任务，并引入带批评者校验的分阶段智能体流水线，可在保证结构忠实与无幻觉的前提下生成可编辑布局，显著优于现有图像编辑、文生图智能体及解析后再渲染等各类基线方法。

title: Least Squares for Time Series Forecasting
summary: A time-series forecast is scored on a future value of the series. A representation loss that regresses the next latent, as in LeNEPA, is a different least-squares problem on the same bottleneck. We write both programs down. The forecast program minimizes the error of a decoded latent on the coordinate that will be reported. For a scalar target and a linear decoder, every latent rank of at least one matches ordinary least squares, and an isotropy constraint is only a rescaling: after the decoder is refit, the forecast does not move. The other program fits the whole next vector at a fixed rank, then freezes the encoder and attaches a head. On a four-dimensional series whose last three coordinates are the same autoregression, that rank-1 fit puts mass $0.9998$ on the repeated coordinate and forecasts the remaining signal at the marginal variance $2.794$. The forecast program puts mass $1$ on the signal and matches the innovation variance $0.992$. Rank $2$ gives the vector fit a second direction, and the two programs agree. Iterating the fitted one-step coefficient $0.803$ raises the open-loop error from $0.992$ at one step to $2.700$ at eight steps.

AI.tldr: 论文对比时间序列预测的两种最小二乘程序：直接最小化预测误差的"forecast program"与回归下一潜变量的表征损失（如LeNEPA）。标量目标加线性解码器下，两者在秩≥1时等价，各向同性约束仅是重缩放；但多维序列下秩1向量拟合会塌缩到重复坐标上并劣化预测。
AI.motivation: 表征学习（如LeNEPA）用"回归下一潜变量"的损失来预训练时序模型，但该损失与真正的预测目标（未来某坐标的取值）并不必然是同一个优化问题，作者希望澄清两者关系及其后果。
AI.method: 将两种目标写成显式的最小二乘程序：forecast program直接最小化解码潜变量在待报告坐标上的误差；另一程序先在固定秩下拟合整个下一步向量，再冻结编码器接一个预测头。在一个四维序列（后三维为同一自回归过程）上做秩1、秩2的对比实验，并迭代一步系数做开环多步误差分析。
AI.result: 标量目标加线性解码器时，任意秩≥1的潜在表征都与普通最小二乘一致，各向同性约束仅是重缩放，解码器重拟合后预测不变。四维序列上，秩1向量拟合把0.9998的质量放到重复坐标上，剩余信号只能以边际方差2.794预测；forecast program把质量1放在信号上，匹配新息方差0.992。秩2时两者一致。迭代系数0.803使开环误差从一步0.992升到八步2.700。
AI.conclusion: 回归下一潜变量的表征损失与预测目标在标量情形下等价（秩≥1），但在多维、低秩情形会因拟合重复/无信号方向而严重偏离预测目标；预测任务应直接优化待报告坐标的误差，而非整体拟合下一向量。

title: Selective Backpropagation for Efficient Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning (FSCIL) requires models to continuously learn new classes from limited samples while retaining prior knowledge, under strict constraints on compute and memory. Existing approaches lie along a difficult trade-off: simple fine-tuning is computationally efficient but suffers from catastrophic forgetting, replay-based methods mitigate forgetting at the cost of substantial compute and memory, and exemplar-free methods often reduce forgetting by freezing most of the backbone, improving efficiency at the expense of adaptability. We propose Selective Backpropagation (SBP), a deterministic parameter budgeting framework that bridges this gap. SBP restricts gradient updates to a pre-allocated subset of network parameters, freezing past knowledge and preserving unbiased capacity for future learning, enabling rapid adaptation without costly mask optimization. We show that SBP achieves strong performance across standard FSCIL benchmarks while requiring training time close to that of naive fine-tuning and substantially lower training time than prior SOTA methods. Crucially, our experiments expose a limitation of standard FSCIL evaluation: performance on short, distribution-consistent benchmarks does not necessarily predict behavior under distribution shift or over substantially longer learning horizons. We therefore evaluate FSCIL methods in cross-domain settings and over an 80-session ImageNet-1K stream. SBP remains strong across these regimes while maintaining low training cost, providing a favorable stability-plasticity-efficiency trade-off. Our code is available at https://github.com/PaInt-Lab/sbp-main-public.

AI.tldr: 提出选择性反向传播（SBP）框架，将梯度更新限制在预分配的参数子集上，实现免掩码优化的快速适应，在FSCIL基准上兼顾性能、训练效率与稳定性-可塑性平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有FSCIL方法存在难以调和的权衡：简单微调计算高效但易发生灾难性遗忘；基于回放的方法缓解遗忘却带来巨大的计算与内存开销；无样本方法多依靠冻结大部分主干来减少遗忘，虽提升效率但牺牲了适应性。因此需要一种能在稳定性、可塑性与效率之间取得更优折中的方案。
AI.method: SBP是一种确定性的参数预算框架，通过将梯度更新限制在预先分配的网络参数子集上，冻结既有知识并为未来学习保留无偏容量，从而避免昂贵的掩码优化，实现快速适应。
AI.result: SBP在标准FSCIL基准上取得较强性能，训练时间接近朴素微调，并显著低于先前SOTA方法。实验还揭示了标准FSCIL评估的局限：短程、分布一致的基准性能无法预测分布偏移或更长学习周期下的表现。为此在跨域设置及80会话的ImageNet-1K流上评估，SBP仍保持强劲表现与低训练成本。
AI.conclusion: SBP提供了良好的稳定性-可塑性-效率权衡，并指出FSCIL评估需纳入跨域与长程会话场景；代码已开源。

title: UnAct: Gradient-Free Unlearning via Targeted Activation Intervention
summary: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of designated training data from a trained model without retraining from scratch. Retrain-free methods such as Selective Synaptic Dampening (SSD) and its label-free variant LFSSD avoid full retraining but still require backpropagation and parameter importance computed over the entire dataset. We ask: what happens when a deletion request arrives with only a few images of the class to be forgotten? To answer this question, we introduce UnAct, a gradient-free class-unlearning method that needs only forward passes over the forget images. UnAct scores late-layer units by their responses, attenuates the most responsive connections, and repeats this for up to 20 rounds using no gradients, no labels, and no retained data. On ResNet-18 trained with CIFAR-10, CIFAR-20, and CIFAR-100, UnAct is competitive with SSD and LFSSD when forgetting entire classes and, unlike them, never collapses the network when forget data is scarce. On ResNet-18, across all tested sizes, UnAct's retain accuracy stays within 2.5 points of retraining, while SSD and LFSSD, at their full-class operating points, lose up to 86 points on some classes. With five forget images on CIFAR-10, UnAct's distance to retraining is 0.21 points, against 67 for LFSSD and 90 for SSD, and re-selecting SSD's threshold at each size with an oracle does not close the gap. In preliminary transfer to ViT-B/16, UnAct's distance to retraining is 11.5 against 33.7 for SSD, and a request is 19x faster than SSD when SSD computes its importance at request time. The code is available at https://github.com/abdulmuizz0903/UnAct

AI.tldr: UnAct是一种无需梯度、标签与保留数据的类别遗忘方法，仅对遗忘图像做前向传播，通过抑制后层高响应单元实现机器遗忘，在遗忘数据稀缺时显著优于SSD与LFSSD。
AI.motivation: 现有免重训练遗忘方法（如SSD及其无标签变体LFSSD）仍需反向传播，并依赖在整个数据集上计算的参数重要性。当删除请求只提供少量目标类别图像时，这类方法性能急剧下降甚至导致网络崩溃，因此需要一种在遗忘数据稀缺场景下仍稳健的遗忘方法。
AI.method: 提出UnAct，一种无梯度的类别遗忘方法：仅对遗忘图像执行前向传播，依据后层单元对遗忘图像的响应进行打分，抑制响应最强的连接，并可重复至多20轮；整个过程不使用梯度、不使用标签、也不使用保留数据。
AI.result: 在ResNet-18上以CIFAR-10/20/100训练：遗忘整类时UnAct与SSD、LFSSD竞争力相当；遗忘数据稀缺时UnAct不会使网络崩溃。所有测试规模下UnAct的保留准确率与重训练相差不超过2.5个百分点，而SSD与LFSSD在全类操作点某些类别上损失最高达86个百分点。CIFAR-10仅5张遗忘图像时，UnAct与重训练差距为0.21个百分点，LFSSD为67、SSD为90，且用oracle在每个规模重选SSD阈值也无法弥合差距。初步迁移到ViT-B/16时，UnAct与重训练差距为11.5，SSD为33.7；当SSD在请求时计算重要性时，UnAct的请求处理速度快19倍。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖前向传播与后层响应抑制的UnAct，在遗忘数据有限的实际删除请求场景下比SSD/LFSSD更稳健、更接近重训练效果，且在ViT上具备初步可迁移性与速度优势，代码已开源。

title: Understanding Clustering in Slot Attention via Particle Dynamics
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to the DynaFront workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Studying attention through the lens of interacting particle dynamics has shown how token clustering can emerge from the underlying dynamics. We extend this perspective to slot attention, a method for object-centric image segmentation and representation learning in which learned components obscure how much of the clustering behaviour is intrinsic to the attention dynamics. We therefore introduce simplified slot attention (SSA), a parameter-free variant whose dynamics are connected to soft $k$-means clustering and which provides a straightforward mechanistic explanation for the emergence of object-centric representations. On the Pascal VOC dataset, SSA achieves performance comparable to that of slot attention, demonstrating that competitive object-centric segmentation can be achieved without learned neural-network components.

AI.tldr: 本文将"粒子交互动力学"视角引入 Slot Attention，提出无参数变体 SSA（简化 Slot Attention），其动力学与软 k-means 聚类相关联，在 Pascal VOC 上达到与 Slot Attention 相当的物体中心分割性能。
AI.motivation: 已有工作表明，从交互粒子动力学的角度可以解释 Attention 中 token 聚类的涌现。但 Slot Attention 含有大量可学习组件，掩盖了聚类行为究竟有多少源自 Attention 动力学本身的机制，因此需要去除学习组件来厘清其内在机理。
AI.method: 提出简化 Slot Attention（SSA）：一种无参数（parameter-free）的 Slot Attention 变体，去掉可学习的神经网络组件，并建立其动力学与软 k-means 聚类之间的联系，从而给出物体中心表征涌现的机制性解释。
AI.result: 在 Pascal VOC 数据集上，SSA 取得了与原始 Slot Attention 相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: 物体中心分割不需要依赖可学习的神经网络组件即可实现竞争性性能，说明聚类与物体中心表征的涌现主要归因于 Attention 的动力学本身，而非学习到的参数。

title: Learning Discriminative Geometry for Drifting Models
summary: Recently proposed Drifting Models shift iterative distribution refinement from inference to training, enabling effective one-step generation. However, their performance on complex image datasets depends strongly on the representation used to construct the drifting field: pixel-space drifting performs poorly, whereas pretrained feature spaces substantially improve sample quality for reasons that remain unclear. We trace this gap to the discriminative geometry of the representation, which determines sample weighting in kernel density estimation (KDE) and, consequently drift. We introduce persistent representation learning, which continuously learns a more discriminative representation geometry as the generator evolves across batches. We further establish a current-step gradient equivalence between the KDE ratio loss and drift regression loss under matched conditions, connecting density-ratio-based generator optimization to empirical drifting and motivating direct control of the drifting velocity. Across multiple datasets, our method learns effective discriminative representations directly from pixels and reduces FID by approximately $82-95\%$ over the original pixel-space Drifting Models, without pretrained encoders. Adapting pretrained representations and applying velocity clipping provide further gains.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对 Drifting Models 在像素空间中生成质量差的问题，指出其根源在于表示的判别性几何，并提出持续表示学习（persistent representation learning），在无需预训练编码器的情况下显著降低 FID。
AI.motivation: Drifting Models 将迭代分布精炼从推理转移到训练，从而实现有效的单步生成，但其在复杂图像数据集上的性能强烈依赖用于构建 drifting field 的表示：像素空间 drifting 表现差，而预训练特征空间能显著提升样本质量，但原因尚不明确。作者希望厘清这一差距的来源。
AI.method: 作者将性能差距归因于表示的判别性几何，它决定 KDE 中的样本加权并因此影响 drift；提出 persistent representation learning，在生成器跨批次演化时持续学习更具判别性的表示几何；并在匹配条件下建立 KDE ratio loss 与 drift regression loss 之间的当前步梯度等价关系，将基于密度比的生成器优化与经验 drifting 联系起来，从而支持对 drifting velocity 的直接控制。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上，该方法可直接从像素学习有效的判别性表示，相比原始像素空间 Drifting Models 将 FID 降低约 82–95%，且无需预训练编码器；适配预训练表示并应用 velocity clipping 可进一步带来增益。
AI.conclusion: 表示空间的判别性几何是 Drifting Models 性能的关键，持续表示学习能够从像素中直接获得有效表示并大幅提升单步生成质量；预训练表示适配与速度裁剪可作为进一步改进手段。

title: KALEIDO: Input-Space Adaptation of a Vision Model for Time-Series Forecasting Through Gated Fold Geometries
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Foundation Models for Temporal Systems (FMTS)
summary: Time-series foundation models buy zero-shot forecasting with large temporal corpora; a vision model needs none, since a natural image implicitly embeds the patterns a forecaster must model, and an ImageNet-pretrained masked autoencoder forecasts a series by inpainting a rendering of it. A rendered series is not a natural image, however, and closing that gap takes temporal-aware adaptation. We show that the rendering geometry - how the series is folded and drawn - is a controllable, mixable axis for it. Kaleido detects the dominant periods, renders a rule-generated set of fold geometries, combines the inpaintings with a convex per-position gate fit on validation only, and fuses the result with the zero-shot output at one fixed share, with no per-dataset hyperparameter beyond the baseline's published settings. Training only LayerNorm (0.05%), Kaleido lowers MSE by 13% against the published zero-shot baseline on LTSF and, frozen, by 6.6%; on GIFT-Eval it improves the baseline by 7.4% in MASE and 19.3% in CRPS.

AI.tldr: Kaleido 将时间序列通过规则生成的多种折叠几何渲染为图像，利用 ImageNet 预训练掩码自编码器做修复预测，并以凸门控融合多几何结果，仅训练 LayerNorm 即显著提升零样本预测精度。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型依赖大规模时序语料实现零样本预测，而自然图像本身隐含了预测器需要建模的模式，故仅用 ImageNet 预训练的掩码自编码器即可通过修复序列渲染图来预测。但渲染的序列并非自然图像，二者之间存在差距，需要时序感知的适配。作者提出渲染几何（序列如何折叠与绘制）是弥补该差距的可控、可混合的维度。
AI.method: Kaleido 检测主导周期，生成一组由规则设定的折叠几何，对每种几何的渲染图做修复预测，再用在验证集上拟合的逐位置凸门控组合这些修复结果，并以固定比例与零样本输出融合；除基线已公开设置外无逐数据集超参数，且仅训练 LayerNorm（占参数 0.05%）。
AI.result: 仅训练 LayerNorm 时，Kaleido 在 LTSF 上相比已发表的零样本基线将 MSE 降低 13%，冻结时降低 6.6%；在 GIFT-Eval 上相对基线 MASE 提升 7.4%，CRPS 提升 19.3%。
AI.conclusion: 渲染几何是适配视觉模型做时序预测的有效可控轴，通过多几何混合与轻量参数适配，能以极低训练成本显著超越已发表的零样本基线，验证了以视觉修复范式进行时序预测的可行性。

title: Do More Modalities Always Help? A Geometric Perspective on Missing-Modality Robustness
summary: Missing modality remains a longstanding challenge in multimodal learning. Existing methods typically address this issue through modality recovery or adaptive strategies. However, they overlook models' internal cross-modal dependencies formed during multimodal training, which later impair robustness. We systematically characterize a counterintuitive deployment-time failure mode: models trained on full modalities can underperform unimodal models when one modality is missing at inference time. This pattern appears across diverse architectures, such as fusion models, CLIP-style two-tower models, and vision-language models. We show that such degradation is closely associated with learned cross-modal dependencies in the principal parameter subspaces. Multimodal training induces structured rotations of these subspaces, particularly in cross-modal interaction layers. These rotations are associated with reduced task-aligned margins and larger task-aware representation harm under missing-modality inputs. We propose Geodesic Unlearning (GU), a lightweight parameter-editing method that leverages Grassmannian subspace geometry for structured subspace correction to improve missing-modality robustness. It rotates the principal input subspace toward a unimodal reference along a geodesic path. We prove that this correction minimizes the distance to the reference within a fixed subspace-distance budget. Experiments across architectures and datasets show that GU improves performance under missing-modality inference while preserving full-modality accuracy, outperforming strong missing-modality robustness baselines. These findings support a geometric view of deployment-time missing-modality degradation and suggest localized subspace editing as a practical route for robustness correction.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示多模态模型在缺失模态推理时的反直觉性能退化现象，并将其归因于跨模态交互层中主子空间的结构化旋转，提出基于Grassmann流形的测地卸载（GU）方法进行子空间校正，从而提升缺失模态鲁棒性且不损失全模态精度。
AI.motivation: 缺失模态是多模态学习的长期挑战。现有方法多依赖模态恢复或自适应策略，但忽略了多模态训练过程中形成的模型内部跨模态依赖，这种依赖在部署阶段反而损害鲁棒性。作者系统刻画了一个反直觉的失败模式：在全模态上训练的模型，当推理时缺失某一模态，其表现可能劣于单模态模型，该现象广泛存在于融合模型、CLIP式双塔模型及视觉-语言模型中。因此需要从几何角度理解并修正这一退化。
AI.method: 作者将退化与主子空间中习得的跨模态依赖关联，发现多模态训练会诱导这些子空间（尤其在跨模态交互层）发生结构化旋转，导致任务对齐间隔减小、缺失模态输入下任务感知表征损伤增大。据此提出测地卸载（Geodesic Unlearning, GU），一种轻量级参数编辑方法，利用Grassmann流形子空间几何进行结构化子空间校正，沿测地路径将主输入子空间旋转至单模态参考方向。理论上证明该修正在固定子空间距离预算内最小化到参考的距离。
AI.result: 在多种架构与数据集上的实验表明，GU在缺失模态推理下提升性能，同时保持全模态准确率，并优于强缺失模态鲁棒性基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持对部署阶段缺失模态退化的几何解释，并表明局部子空间编辑是鲁棒性修正的一条实用路径。

title: MedImageOSWorld: Benchmarking GUI Agents for Medical Image Consoles
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Supplementary material (8 pages) included as an ancillary file
summary: Graphical consoles offer a practical interface for medical acquisition assistance, allowing agents to work through the controls and visual feedback used by human operators. Reliable assistance requires linking on-screen anatomy to acquisition decisions that determine what image evidence becomes available next. We introduce MedImageOSWorld, a benchmark for evaluating this capability in simulated CT, MR, and ultrasound consoles. Using screenshots and mouse-and-keyboard actions, agents configure protocols, plan acquisitions, inspect the resulting images, and make corrective adjustments across seven capability levels, from console operation to feedback-driven control. Evaluation combines task-specific workflow checks with hidden anatomical ground truth to assess procedural completion and acquisition outcomes separately. A common evaluation protocol specifies episode conditions and interaction budgets, while recorded trajectories support analysis of how agents observe, act, and respond to acquisition feedback. Across eleven open-weight agents, success rates range from 3.0 to 25.0 on a 0-100 scale while workflow-progress rates reach 21.5-74.5: agents complete much of the console workflow but rarely acquire the intended anatomy. Success collapses between perception and planning, from 79-90% at the lowest three levels for the best agent to at most 12% for millimetre-level planning and 0% for closed-loop control among open-weight agents. Two proprietary agents reach success rates of about 34 and exceed the best open-weight agent mainly in acquisition quality (61 versus 42). MedImageOSWorld provides a controlled setting for studying whether general-purpose GUI agents can translate visual observations into effective medical acquisition decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MedImageOSWorld基准，用于评估通用GUI智能体在模拟CT、MR和超声控制台上完成医学采集任务的能力，涵盖七个能力层级。评估显示十一个开源权重智能体的成功率仅3.0–25.0（满分100），工作流完成率达21.5–74.5，说明智能体虽能完成大部分界面操作，但很少真正采集到目标解剖结构，能力在感知与规划之间出现明显断层。
AI.motivation: 医学采集辅助依赖将屏幕上的解剖信息与采集决策相连接，因为决策决定了后续可获得的图像证据。然而现有研究缺乏一个可控环境来检验通用GUI智能体能否把视觉观察转化为有效的医学采集决策，故需构建专门基准。
AI.method: 构建MedImageOSWorld基准，在模拟CT、MR和超声控制台上评估智能体。智能体通过截图及鼠标键盘操作配置协议、规划采集、检查图像并做纠正调整，覆盖从控制台操作到反馈驱动控制的七个能力层级。评估结合任务特定工作流检查与隐藏解剖真值，分别衡量流程完成度与采集结果；统一评估协议规定回合条件与交互预算，并记录轨迹以分析智能体的观察、行动与反馈响应方式。
AI.result: 在十一个开源权重智能体上，成功率区间为3.0–25.0（0–100分），工作流进展率为21.5–74.5。最佳智能体在最低三个层级达79–90%，但毫米级规划至多12%，闭环控制为0%。两个专有智能体成功率达约34，主要优势在采集质量（61对42）。
AI.conclusion: MedImageOSWorld为研究通用GUI智能体能否将视觉观察转化为有效医学采集决策提供了受控环境，揭示出当前智能体在感知与规划之间存在显著能力断层，尤其在毫米级规划与闭环控制环节表现薄弱。

title: VideoResearchAgent: Grounded Task Synthesis and Sim-to-Real RL for Open-Web Video Research
summary: Existing deep research agents are designed primarily for text- and image-based web sources, while video reasoning systems typically assume that relevant videos are provided in advance. We study open-web video research, where an agent must autonomously discover relevant videos, navigate their temporal content, and ground answers in visual evidence. Training such agents at scale is challenging as live video interaction is slow and unreliable, whereas fixed local simulation can induce retrieval-specific shortcuts that fail to transfer to the open web. We introduce VideoResearchAgent, a scalable training framework to address these challenges. First, we introduce controllable task synthesis pipeline to synthesize multi-hop research tasks from timestamped visual evidence while filtering text-only shortcuts. Second, we build a field-aligned local video simulator that preserves deployment-facing search and watch interactions while accelerating video search by a factor of 34.5-64.6. Third, we introduce Retrieval-Domain-Randomized GRPO (RDR-GRPO), which diversifies candidate rankings, distractors, metadata, and result structure during training to reduce overfitting to simulated retrieval. On Video-BrowseComp, the VideoResearchAgent trained using Qwen3.5-4B achieves 40.48% accuracy, comparable to Gemini-3-Flash-Preview, while reducing cumulative API-token consumption by 74.9% relative to the untrained model. Together, these results establish an accurate and efficient training recipe for open-web video research.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 VideoResearchAgent，一个面向开放网络视频研究的可扩展训练框架，通过可控任务合成、领域对齐的本地视频模拟器与检索域随机化 GRPO，训练出在 Video-BrowseComp 上准确率 40.48%、接近 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 且 API 消耗降低 74.9% 的智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有深度研究智能体主要面向文本与图像网页源，视频推理系统通常假设相关视频已预先给定，缺乏让智能体自主在开放网络中检索并理解视频的研究范式；而大规模训练此类智能体面临困境：真实视频交互缓慢且不稳定，固定本地模拟又易引入检索特化捷径，难以迁移到开放网络。
AI.method: 框架包含三部分：（1）可控任务合成流程，从带时间戳的视觉证据合成多跳研究任务，并过滤仅靠文本即可解决的捷径；（2）领域对齐的本地视频模拟器，保留部署时的搜索与观看交互接口，同时将视频搜索加速 34.5–64.6 倍；（3）Retrieval-Domain-Randomized GRPO（RDR-GRPO），在训练中随机化候选排序、干扰项、元数据与结果结构，以缓解对模拟检索分布的过拟合。
AI.result: 在 Video-BrowseComp 上，基于 Qwen3.5-4B 训练的 VideoResearchAgent 达到 40.48% 准确率，与 Gemini-3-Flash-Preview 相当，同时相对未训练模型将累计 API token 消耗降低 74.9%。
AI.conclusion: 结果共同确立了面向开放网络视频研究的准确且高效的训练方案，验证了可控合成、领域对齐模拟与检索域随机化强化学习相结合的有效性。

title: FACET: Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport in High-Fidelity Fluorescence Microscopy Synthesis
summary: Fluorescence microscopy reveals where proteins localize, but only a limited number of proteins can be imaged in the same cell; generating these images from amino-acid sequence and the cell's morphological context enables in silico localization of unimaged proteins. The two conditions, however, play asymmetric roles: morphological context is spatially aligned with the target, whereas sequence is non-spatial and must specify protein-dependent localization within it, with recurring coarse patterns shared across proteins and finer protein-specific variation. Existing generators condition on both jointly, without separating what each explains. We introduce FACET (Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport), a probabilistic generative framework that encodes this structure as an explicit inductive bias: sequence semantics are learned from what context leaves unexplained, coarse localization regularities are shared across proteins through a semantic memory, and protein-specific variation is a bounded residual around them. A variance-preserving state projection further lets FACET perform continuous stochastic transport through a pretrained diffusion predictor with minimal parameter overhead. On held-out proteins, FACET improves spatial overlap by 34.3% on the Human Protein Atlas and 14.0% on OpenCell over a backbone-matched baseline, and reduces FID by 27.2% and 46.5%, respectively, with 75% fewer network evaluations. It also substantially improves protein-association structure recovery and yields better-calibrated predictions, while detailed ablations show complementary contributions from its design choices. These results identify factorized asymmetric conditioning, rather than generator capacity alone, as a key lever for high-fidelity, efficient, and biologically meaningful cellular image synthesis.

AI.tldr: FACET 提出因子化非对称条件生成框架，通过将序列语义与形态学上下文解耦、共享粗定位规律并建模蛋白特异残差，实现高效高保真的细胞内蛋白定位预测。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微镜只能同时成像有限数量的蛋白，而由氨基酸序列和细胞形态学上下文在计算机中预测未成像蛋白的定位成为需求。但序列与形态学上下文作用并不对称：形态学上下文与目标空间对齐，序列则是非空间的，需在上下文中指定蛋白依赖的定位，且存在跨蛋白的粗粒度共同模式与更细粒度的蛋白特异变异。现有生成器将二者联合条件化，未区分各自解释的成分。
AI.method: 提出 FACET（Factorized Asymmetric Conditioning for Efficient Transport），一个概率生成框架，将此结构编码为显式归纳偏置：序列语义从上下文无法解释的部分学习；粗粒度定位规律通过语义记忆在蛋白间共享；蛋白特异变异建模为有界残差。另引入保方差状态投影，使 FACET 能借助预训练扩散预测器进行连续随机传输，参数开销极小。
AI.result: 在留出蛋白上，相比骨干匹配的基线，FACET 在 Human Protein Atlas 上空间重叠提升 34.3%，在 OpenCell 上提升 14.0%；FID 分别降低 27.2% 与 46.5%，同时网络评估次数减少 75%。此外显著改善蛋白关联结构恢复，并给出校准更好的预测；消融实验显示各设计选择具有互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，因子化非对称条件化（而非仅靠生成器容量）是实现高保真、高效且具生物学意义的细胞图像合成的关键杠杆。

title: CASE: Cost-Aware Stopping for Efficient Long-Video Agents
summary: Long-video agents can actively gather question-relevant evidence, but they typically leave a central decision implicit: when has the agent seen enough to answer? We propose CASE, a plug-in termination framework that frames this decision as policy-conditioned sequential stopping. At each causal checkpoint, CASE combines an auxiliary multiple-choice assessment of accumulated evidence with the host agent's execution state. From complete native trajectories, we construct a cost-aware target that compares answering now with stopping later along the same search path, accounting jointly for answer correctness and the full cost of continued reasoning. A lightweight Ridge regressor learns this decision gap and produces STOP/CONTINUE decisions. We evaluate three vision-language models with VideoSeek and AVP. On Video-MME, end-to-end accuracy changes by +0.67 percentage points on average while CASE reduces model-token use by 53.63%. The same frozen policies then transfer zero-shot to LongVideoBench and MLVU, with end-to-end accuracy changes of +3.38 and +4.58 points while saving 58.78% and 51.28% of model tokens, respectively. Across all agent-model-benchmark combinations, CASE attains the highest accuracy-efficiency Pareto-frontier coverage among the compared stopping methods (83.3%) at the selected operating points. Online execution preserves this favorable accuracy-efficiency trade-off and additionally reduces measured runtime by 54.1% on average. CASE provides a plug-in termination framework for long-video reasoning agents, enabling them to decide when further evidence acquisition is no longer worthwhile.

AI.tldr: 提出CASE——一个即插即用的终止框架，将长视频智能体的"何时停止取证"建模为策略条件化的序贯停止问题，在提升精度的同时大幅降低推理开销。
AI.motivation: 长视频智能体能够主动收集与问题相关的证据，但其核心决策始终是隐式的：智能体何时已经看够了、可以作答？缺乏显式的终止判据会导致过度检索与算力浪费，或过早作答而损害准确性。
AI.method: CASE将终止决策形式化为策略条件化的序贯停止。在每个因果检查点，它把对累积证据的辅助多项选择评估与宿主智能体的执行状态相结合；从完整原生轨迹中构建代价感知目标，沿同一搜索路径比较"现在作答"与"继续检索"的收益，联合考虑答案正确性与持续推理的全部代价；用轻量Ridge回归器学习该决策差距，输出STOP/CONTINUE。策略冻结，可零样本迁移。
AI.result: 在3个视觉语言模型上以VideoSeek和AVP评测：Video-MME上端到端准确率平均变化+0.67个百分点，模型token用量减少53.63%；冻结策略零样本迁移至LongVideoBench与MLVU，准确率分别变化+3.38和+4.58个百分点，token节省58.78%和51.28%。在所有智能体-模型-基准组合中，CASE在所选工作点上取得最高的精度-效率帕累托前沿覆盖率（83.3%）。在线执行保持该权衡，并平均减少54.1%的实测运行时间。
AI.conclusion: CASE为长视频推理智能体提供了即插即用的终止框架，使其能够判断进一步获取证据何时不再值得，在几乎不损失甚至提升精度的前提下显著节约token与运行时间，并具备跨基准的零样本泛化能力。

title: Universal Test-Time Training
summary: Recent Test-Time Training (TTT) architectures compress context into fast weights that are updated online and queried as memory. Existing TTT designs keep this memory private to each layer: it recurs only over time, and depth merely indexes L separate memories. We argue that memory ownership need not be tied to depth, and introduce Universal Test-Time Training (uTTT), in which all layers read and write one shared memory while retaining layer-specific backbone parameters. The shared memory thus recurs over two dimensions, time and depth, with chunks and layers as their units: a write by a deep layer in one chunk can be read by a shallow layer in the next. We instantiate this idea as uTTT-MoE and uTTT-Dense. uTTT-MoE routes each token head to a few experts in a pool shared by all layers; uTTT-Dense applies the whole shared memory at every layer without routing. In language modeling, uTTT-MoE reaches 15.5 and 27.9 RULER accuracy at 124M and 760M, 2.6 and 2.1 points above its layer-private counterpart at equal state and active compute, the highest among tested bounded-state models, with per-token loss matching or beating full attention. In novel view synthesis, sharing at fixed per-layer compute gains 0.92 dB in view-23 object PSNR in routed models and 0.76 dB in dense models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用测试时训练（uTTT），将原本各层私有、仅沿时间递归的快速权重记忆改为全层共享，使记忆沿时间与深度两个维度递归，并给出uTTT-MoE与uTTT-Dense两种实例，在语言建模和新视角合成上均优于逐层私有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有TTT架构将上下文压缩为在线更新、作为记忆查询的快速权重，但该记忆被限定为每层私有：只在时间维度上递归，深度仅索引L个独立记忆，限制了记忆的容量与跨层信息复用。
AI.method: 作者主张记忆归属不必与深度绑定，提出uTTT：所有层读写同一个共享记忆，同时保留各层特有的主干参数，使共享记忆以chunk和层为单位在时间与深度两个维度上递归——深层在某chunk的写入可被浅层在下一chunk读取。实例化为两种形式：uTTT-MoE将所有层共享的专家池中为每个token头路由到少数专家；uTTT-Dense则在每层无路由地应用整个共享记忆。
AI.result: 语言建模中，uTTT-MoE在124M和760M规模下RULER准确率分别达15.5和27.9，在相同状态与激活计算量下比逐层私有对应模型高2.6和2.1个点，为所测有界状态模型中最高，且每token损失匹配或优于全注意力。新视角合成中，在固定每层计算量下，路由模型view-23物体PSNR提升0.92 dB，稠密模型提升0.76 dB。
AI.conclusion: 记忆可跨层共享而非必须私有于深度，使记忆沿时间与深度双向递归是可行且有效的；uTTT-MoE与uTTT-Dense在等状态、等激活计算条件下均超越逐层私有基线，验证了共享记忆设计的通用性与优越性。

title: DREAM: Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-agent Debate
summary: Multi-agent debate (MAD) has emerged as an effective paradigm to improve the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) and is increasingly being extended to multimodal settings. However, existing multimodal MAD frameworks typically expose agents to the same fixed visual input, ignoring substantial variation in the visual scale needed across samples and agents. In addition, these frameworks frequently suffer from groupthink, a phenomenon where agents prematurely abandon correct deductions to conform with confident but hallucinated peer responses. To address these bottlenecks, we introduce DREAM (Dynamic Resolution Assignment For Multimodal Multi-Agent Debate), which operates via two core components: (1) Dynamic Resolution Assignment, a zero-shot probe round where agents test multiple resolutions, quantify uncertainty using Average Normalized Log-Likelihood (ANLL), and use an adaptive threshold to assign each agent to its empirically optimal resolution; (2) Uncertainty-Guided Rollback Aggregation counters groupthink by tracking each agent's uncertainty over rounds and restoring early low-uncertainty answers overridden by group pressure. On six multimodal datasets, DREAM improves the accuracy-token trade-off over multi-agent debate baselines by 1.5-3.2% accuracy without dataset-specific tuning.

AI.tldr: 提出DREAM框架，通过动态分辨率分配与不确定性引导回滚聚合，缓解多模态多智能体辩论中固定视觉输入与群体思维问题，在六个数据集上提升1.5-3.2%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态多智能体辩论（MAD）框架通常让所有智能体共享同一固定视觉输入，忽略了不同样本与不同智能体在视觉尺度需求上的显著差异；同时易出现群体思维，即智能体为迎合自信但产生幻觉的同伴回答而提前放弃正确推理。
AI.method: DREAM包含两个核心组件：（1）动态分辨率分配：通过零样本探测轮让智能体测试多种分辨率，以平均归一化对数似然（ANLL）量化不确定性，并利用自适应阈值将每个智能体分配到其经验最优分辨率；（2）不确定性引导回滚聚合：跨轮次跟踪各智能体不确定性，恢复被群体压力覆盖的早期低不确定性答案，以对抗群体思维。
AI.result: 在六个多模态数据集上，DREAM在无需数据集特定调参的情况下，相比多智能体辩论基线在准确率-令牌权衡上提升1.5-3.2%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: DREAM通过为每个智能体自适应分配视觉分辨率并结合不确定性驱动的回滚聚合，有效缓解固定视觉输入与群体思维两大瓶颈，在多个多模态任务上以更优的准确率-令牌权衡超越多智能体辩论基线。

title: Atomic Visual Entailment: Enhancing Zero-Shot Vision-Language Reasoning through Atomic Fact Decomposition and Learned Selection
summary: Visual entailment (VE) asks whether an image supports, contradicts, or leaves undecided a textual hypothesis. Strong results come from fine-tuning large vision-language models on labelled data, while zero-shot and hybrid approaches remain far behind. A VE hypothesis often bundles several visual claims, yet existing zero-shot methods reason over it as a single unit. We propose Atomic Visual Entailment (AVE), which decomposes the hypothesis into atomic facts, produces candidate predictions from both the full hypothesis and its facts using frozen vision-language models, and predicts the final label with a lightweight classifier trained only on how those candidates behave. We find that decomposition helps only when the hypothesis context is preserved: judging facts in isolation is worse than not decomposing at all. Full-hypothesis and atomic prediction make complementary errors, and learning which to trust recovers far more of that complementarity than majority voting, reaching 0.803 test accuracy on SNLI-VE without fine-tuning any vision-language model. AVE also localises the visual evidence behind its prediction without region-level supervision. These results suggest that learning which candidate prediction to trust can close much of the gap to fine-tuned systems, offering a practical alternative where fine-tuning a vision-language model directly would need more labelled data or compute than is available.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Atomic Visual Entailment (AVE)，将视觉蕴含假设分解为原子事实，在保留完整假设上下文的前提下用冻结的视觉语言模型生成候选预测，并用轻量分类器学习信任哪个候选，在SNLI-VE上无需微调即达0.803测试准确率，并可定位视觉证据。
AI.motivation: 视觉蕴含（VE）任务中强结果主要依赖对大规模视觉语言模型的微调，而零样本与混合方法性能差距明显；同时现有零样本方法把包含多重视觉断言的假设当作单一整体推理，忽略了其组合结构。作者旨在找到一种无需微调即可缩小与微调系统差距的实用方案。
AI.method: 提出AVE方法：1）将VE假设分解为原子事实；2）使用冻结的视觉语言模型分别基于完整假设和原子事实生成候选预测；3）训练一个轻量分类器，仅依据这些候选预测的行为特征预测最终标签。关键设计是保留假设上下文进行分解，而非孤立判断原子事实。
AI.result: 发现只有在保留假设上下文时分解才有帮助，孤立判断原子事实甚至不如不分解；完整假设预测与原子预测产生互补错误，学习信任策略比多数投票能恢复更多互补性；在SNLI-VE上达到0.803测试准确率，且无需微调任何视觉语言模型；AVE还能在无区域级监督下定位支持预测的视觉证据。
AI.conclusion: 学习信任哪个候选预测可大幅缩小与微调系统的差距，为缺乏标注数据或算力、无法直接微调视觉语言模型的场景提供了实用的替代方案。

title: Visual Grounding Safety in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are increasingly trained to generate structured outputs like points and bounding boxes that downstream interfaces, agents, and robots can act on, yet safety alignment of this output channel has not been systematically analyzed. We study visual grounding safety by repurposing three safety benchmarks spanning direct harm (VLSU), social bias (BBQ-V), and situational safety (Asimov-2.0) into 15,401 matched pairs of harmful requests that differ only in the requested output: a free-text answer (VQA) or a grounding (point or bounding box). Across five VLMs, models that refuse a harmful request posed as a question often comply when the same request asks for a grounding: averaged over models, grounding refusal trails VQA refusal by 31-59 percentage points, depending on the domain, and safety system prompts do not close this gap. We propose a fine-tuning approach that combines grounding-form refusals with capability grounding data and self-distilled benign data to counter over-refusal. For Qwen3-VL-8B and VisionReasoner-7B, it improves grounding refusal by 77-95 percentage points on VLSU and BBQ-V and by 64-85 points on the held-out Asimov-2.0 domain, while also improving VQA refusal, preserving grounding capability, and keeping over-refusal limited. Representation analysis shows that fine-tuning moves harmful requests toward each model's refusal direction, most strongly for grounding, while leaving benign requests near the harmless reference.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统分析了视觉语言模型（VLM）在"定位输出"（点/边界框）通道上的安全对齐缺口：同一有害请求若要求输出定位而非自由文本，模型拒答率平均下降31-59个百分点，且系统提示无法弥补；作者提出结合定位形式拒答数据、能力定位数据与自蒸馏良性数据的微调方法，在两个模型上使定位拒答率提升64-95个百分点，同时保持定位能力并控制过度拒答。
AI.motivation: VLM越来越多地被训练生成点、边界框等结构化输出，供下游界面、智能体和机器人直接执行，但这一输出通道的安全对齐尚未被系统研究。已有安全基准多针对自由文本问答（VQA）形式的请求，忽视了"同一有害意图换一种输出形式（定位）"是否会导致拒绝行为失效的问题。
AI.method: 1) 将三个安全基准（VLSU直接危害、BBQ-V社会偏见、Asimov-2.0情境安全）改造为15,401对匹配样本，每对仅在所请求输出上不同：自由文本答案（VQA）或定位（点/边界框）；2) 在5个VLM上对比两种输出形式下的拒答率，并测试安全系统提示的效果；3) 提出微调方法，混合"定位形式的拒答数据"、能力定位数据以及自蒸馏良性数据以抑制过度拒答；4) 通过表征分析考察微调对有害/良性请求表征方向的影响。
AI.result: 跨5个VLM，以问题形式提出的有害请求常被拒绝，但同一请求改为要求定位时模型却往往顺从：平均而言定位拒答率比VQA拒答率低31-59个百分点（随领域而异），安全系统提示未能弥合差距。所提微调方法在Qwen3-VL-8B和VisionReasoner-7B上，使VLSU与BBQ-V的定位拒答率提升77-95个百分点，在留出的Asimov-2.0领域提升64-85个百分点，同时提升VQA拒答率、保持定位能力，并将过度拒答控制在有限水平。表征分析显示微调将有害请求推向各模型的拒答方向（对定位最强），而良性请求仍接近无害参考。
AI.conclusion: 视觉定位构成VLM安全对齐中一个被系统性忽视的输出通道，其拒答行为显著弱于文本问答且难以通过提示修补。通过在拒答数据中显式覆盖定位输出形式，并结合能力数据与自蒸馏良性数据，可以在不大幅牺牲定位性能与可用性的前提下实质性修复该缺口，表征层面的证据进一步支持拒答方向被有效迁移。

title: From Pixels, Without Pre-training: Joint Generative and Self-Supervised Representation Learning in One Model
summary: Strong image generation models are conditioned on class labels, aligned to frozen pretrained encoders, or built on separately trained autoencoders. While effective, generation then depends on supervision or pretraining: labels must be annotated, and encoders or autoencoders pretrained for the target domain. We study joint generative and self-supervised representation learning in a single model, enabling self-conditioned generation without labels or pretrained models. This is challenging because the objectives are mismatched: contrastive learning consumes clean augmented views and favors coarse, invariant semantics, while flow matching consumes noisy images and must preserve the fine detail and spatial layout that contrastive learning discards. We propose SCION (Self-conditioned Generation on Self-supervised representation), whose core is a single pixel-space encoder conditioned on the flow timestep and an embedding. For representation learning, this conditioning embedding is a learned global vector shared across images, with the encoder's [CLS] token yielding the semantic representation trained by the contrastive loss. For generative training, the conditioning embedding is the image's own [CLS] representation, while patch tokens pass through a decoder to predict the image. To sample without a reference image at inference, we jointly learn a prior over the embedding. Gradient-norm balancing and stop-gradient mechanisms enable joint optimization in one run. SCION is self-supervised and self-contained, with no labels or pretrained models. On ImageNet 256x256, with the JiT-B recipe and no representation guidance, SCION reaches 8.92 FID, surpassing class-unconditional iREPA, which aligns to pretrained DINOv2 (46.44), and RCG, which conditions on it (14.27). With JiT-L, SCION achieves 5.89 FID without guidance and 3.47 with representation guidance, outperforming RCG with the ADM recipe (6.24).

AI.tldr: 提出 SCION，在单一模型内联合进行自监督表征学习与生成建模，实现无需标签和预训练模型的自条件生成，在 ImageNet 256×256 上取得优于依赖预训练编码器的基线方法的 FID。
AI.motivation: 现有强图像生成模型依赖类别标签、冻结的预训练编码器或单独训练的自编码器，生成过程因此受制于监督信号或预训练资源（标签需人工标注，编码器/自编码器需目标域预训练）。作者希望研究在单一模型中联合进行生成与自监督表征学习，从而摆脱标签与预训练依赖。
AI.method: 核心是单个像素空间编码器，条件于 flow 时间步与一个嵌入向量。表征学习阶段：该条件嵌入为所有图像共享的可学习全局向量，编码器的 [CLS] token 作为语义表征并用对比损失训练。生成训练阶段：条件嵌入替换为图像自身的 [CLS] 表征，patch token 经解码器重建图像。为在推理时无需参考图像采样，联合学习嵌入上的先验分布。通过梯度范数平衡与 stop-gradient 机制在一轮训练中完成联合优化。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，采用 JiT-B 配方且无表征引导时，SCION 达到 8.92 FID，优于类别无条件 iREPA（对齐预训练 DINOv2，46.44）与 RCG（以 DINOv2 为条件，14.27）。采用 JiT-L 时，无引导达 5.89 FID，加表征引导达 3.47 FID，超过使用 ADM 配方的 RCG（6.24）。
AI.conclusion: SCION 是自监督、自包含的模型，无需标签或预训练模型即可完成生成与表征的联合学习，验证了消解对比学习与 flow matching 目标冲突的可行性，并在 FID 上超越依赖预训练编码器的条件生成方法。

title: On Hyperparameter Tuning on the Test Set
summary: "Don't tune hyperparameters on the test set" is often stated in machine learning textbooks. Violating it is considered a cardinal sin that produces misleadingly optimistic results, corrupts benchmark integrity, and thus can even be interpreted as scientific fraud. Yet evidence suggests that test set hyperparameter tuning does occur in practice, making it all the more important to understand its actual consequences. So how bad is it, really? In this work we question this dogma and put it to an empirical test. We systematically study the magnitude of the performance inflation caused by tuning the hyperparameters on the test set for MNIST-1D, CIFAR-10, and three tasks from the GLUE benchmark. Our experiments show that while the effect is real and significant, it is frequently small relative to other sources of noise. In many cases, we find that tuning on the test set recovers exactly the same model as when tuning on the validation set. Most importantly, we find that the rankings of models remain essentially preserved after tuning on the test set and therefore that consistent test-set tuning may not invalidate benchmarks or model selection. Our results call for a more nuanced view of tuning hyperparameters on the test set, stimulating researchers to openly report test tuning.

AI.tldr: 本文对"在测试集上调超参数是学术不端"这一教条进行实证检验，系统量化测试集调参带来的性能膨胀幅度，发现其效应虽真实但常小于其他噪声源，且模型排序基本保持不变。
AI.motivation: 机器学习教材普遍将测试集调超参数视为严重错误，会产出虚高结果、破坏基准公正性，甚至被解读为学术造假。然而实践中确实存在此类行为，因此有必要弄清其真实后果究竟有多严重。
AI.method: 在MNIST-1D、CIFAR-10以及GLUE基准中的三个任务上，系统研究测试集调超参数所导致的性能膨胀幅度，并与验证集调参的结果进行对比，考察所选模型是否一致以及模型排序是否改变。
AI.result: 测试集调参带来的性能膨胀真实且显著，但相对于其他噪声源往往较小；在许多情况下，测试集调参得到的模型与验证集调参完全相同；模型排序在测试集调参后基本保持不变。
AI.conclusion: 一致的测试集调参未必会使基准或模型选择失效，应对该问题持更细致的看法，并鼓励研究者公开报告测试集调参行为。

title: Beyond Transport Cost: Routing Differences between Flow Matching and Optimal Transport
summary: In generative models, Optimal Transport (OT) is used to improve Flow Matching (FM) by reducing noise-data coupling cost.
