However, different noise-to-output assignments can yield nearly equal costs, raising a key question. Is cost alone sufficient to guide coupling design? We address this question by separating transport cost from routing, i.e., the destination reached by each noise sample. We show numerically how FM and OT can differ in routing while remaining close in cost. We examine its consequences in learned neural FM. Using the exact FM routing as an oracle, we further construct a routing-aware training coupling and find that it yields a directionally consistent improvement in generation over a cost-matched, cost-only counterpart. Our findings highlight what cost minimization can overlook and motivate using both cost and routing to evaluate the design of OT-based FM couplings. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑最优传输(OT)中"仅靠传输代价即可指导耦合设计"这一假设，提出应将传输代价与路由(每个噪声样本到达的目标)分离考察，并证明路由信息对基于OT的流匹配(FM)生成具有独立且一致的正向价值。
AI.motivation: OT被用于改进FM以降低噪声-数据耦合代价，但不同的噪声到输出分配可能给出几乎相同的代价，因此仅以代价为准则可能无法区分优劣耦合，需澄清代价是否足以指导耦合设计。
AI.method: 将传输代价与路由(每个噪声样本的到达目标)分离；数值上展示FM与OT在路由上差异显著而代价接近；在学习到的神经FM中，用精确FM路由作为oracle，构建路由感知的训练耦合，并与"代价匹配但仅考虑代价"的对照耦合进行比较。
AI.result: 数值实验显示FM与OT在代价相近情况下路由可明显不同；在神经FM中，路由感知耦合相比代价匹配的cost-only对照在生成质量上取得方向一致的提升。
AI.conclusion: 代价最小化会忽略路由层面的重要差异，评估与设计基于OT的FM耦合时应同时考虑代价与路由；代码将在录用后发布。

title: MEND: RL For Flow Models via Proximal Velocity Matching
summary: Reward post-training of flow models either reweights the model's own samples under a KL penalty or a frozen reference, often for thousands of updates, or backpropagates the reward and moves every sample without checking that the move is worth its size. We introduce MEND, a reinforcement learning method built on proximal velocity matching. MEND caps rewards within each prompt group, so samples that already score well receive no move. Below the cap, it proposes moves along the reward gradient and accepts one only when its capped reward gain exceeds a quadratic displacement price. The model then regresses onto the resulting velocity targets, with no KL term, frozen reference model, or advantage weights. In 100 updates, MEND outperforms Flow-GRPO (about 4k updates) on five of six evaluators at the same distance to base-model images. Under an equal-budget protocol, it surpasses ReFL and DiffusionNFT at every evaluated update across four training rewards, reaching PickScore 24.03 versus 23.92 and 23.43, respectively. A 300-update three-reward run also surpasses the five-reward DiffusionNFT model on all three rewards it trains on. MEND is general and easy to adopt: it applies to any flow backbone with a differentiable reward.

AI.tldr: MEND：基于近端速度匹配的流模型强化学习后训练方法，通过奖励上限+二次位移代价的接受准则生成速度回归目标，无需KL项、冻结参考模型或优势权重，100步即超越Flow-GRPO（约4k步）。
AI.motivation: 现有流模型奖励后训练要么在KL惩罚或冻结参考模型下重加权自身样本并需数千次更新，要么直接反向传播奖励、不加检验地移动每个样本，无法确认移动幅度是否值得。本文希望以更少更新、更可控的移动实现高效且通用的奖励对齐。
AI.method: 提出MEND，一种建立在近端速度匹配（proximal velocity matching）之上的强化学习方法：对每个prompt组内的奖励设上限，已得分良好的样本不再移动；在上限以下沿奖励梯度提出移动，仅当被截断的奖励增益超过二次位移代价时才接受；随后模型回归到由此得到的速度目标上，不使用KL项、冻结参考模型或优势权重。
AI.result: 100次更新内，在六个评测器中的五个上超越Flow-GRPO（约4k次更新），且与基座模型图像的偏移距离相同；在等预算协议下，于四个训练奖励上、每个评测更新点均超过ReFL与DiffusionNFT，PickScore达24.03（对比23.92与23.43）；300次更新的三奖励运行也在其训练的三个奖励上全面超越五奖励的DiffusionNFT模型。
AI.conclusion: MEND以奖励上限与位移代价控制的近端速度匹配替代KL/参考模型式约束，在极低更新预算下取得更优且更稳定的对齐效果，且适用于任何具备可微奖励的流骨干网络，具有良好的通用性与易用性。

title: Ultrasound Operator Guidance Using World Modeling and Retrieval Based Action Planning
summary: Ultrasound is widely used, but acquisition quality is heavily dependent on the operator's knowledge and expertise. With demand for examinations outpacing the supply of trained sonographers, operator-guidance systems aim to close this gap by instructing a less trained user how to move the probe toward a target view. In this paper, we propose a retrieval-induced latent transition model for ultrasound acquisition dynamics, formulating ultrasound operator guidance as multi-step planning and retrieval in a world model. Using a V-JEPA 2.1 backbone, observations are first encoded into a latent space where anatomically related views lie close together. We then retrieve similar views from a reference database containing encoded latent states and corresponding probe positions and orientations. Rather than learning a parametric transition function, we directly use physically executed transitions from the database to establish our nonparametric, retrieval-induced transition model that supports receding-horizon planning. At deployment, guidance is generated from the live ultrasound image feed alone, without any probe tracking hardware. Applied to carotid ultrasound, the proposed planner reaches the target view in 86% of retrospective closed-loop episodes, versus 52% and 43% for representative baselines, outperforming both on every target view, including the challenging longitudinal internal and external carotid artery views. A prospective feasibility study on unseen volunteers, run in real time on a CPU using distillation, reaches 83% target-view reachability. Because planning is driven by proximity to any encodable goal latent, the same world model can navigate back to any previously acquired, patient-specific frame, supporting reproducible longitudinal imaging for e.g. perioperative or follow-up monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出检索诱导的潜在转移世界模型，将超声操作引导建模为多步规划与检索，无需探头追踪硬件即可从实时图像生成引导，颈动脉目标视图到达率86%（基线52%/43%），前瞻性实验83%。
AI.motivation: 超声成像质量高度依赖操作者经验，而检查需求超过合格技师供给。现有操作者引导系统希望训练程度较低的用户也能将探头移动至目标视图，但获取高质量超声仍具挑战，需要一种能在无探头追踪硬件条件下实现自动引导的方案。
AI.method: 基于V-JEPA 2.1骨干将观测编码至解剖相关视图相互邻近的潜在空间；从含潜在状态及其对应探头位置/姿态的参考数据库中检索相似视图；不学习参数化转移函数，而是直接用数据库中物理执行的转移构建非参数、检索诱导的转移模型，支持滚动时域规划；部署时仅依赖实时超声图像流生成引导，无需探头追踪硬件，并通过蒸馏在CPU上实时运行。
AI.result: 在颈动脉超声上，回顾性闭环实验中达到目标视图的成功率为86%，代表性基线为52%和43%，在所有目标视图上均优于基线，包括具有挑战性的颈内、颈外动脉纵向视图；在未见志愿者上的前瞻性可行性研究，用蒸馏在CPU上实时运行，目标视图可达率为83%。
AI.conclusion: 由于规划由与任意可编码目标潜在的接近度驱动，同一世界模型可返回任何先前采集的患者特定帧，支持如围术期或随访监测中可重复的纵向成像。

title: On Impact of Loss Function on the Performance of Neural Networks in Melanoma Diagnosis
comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
summary: Melanoma is the deadliest type of skin cancer, whose early diagnosis is crucial for patients' survival. Image classification using deep learning models has shown promising results for melanoma diagnosis. However, the performance of these models on the melanoma datasets such as SIIM-ISIC melanoma classification dataset is a challenge due to the class imbalance. One of the methods to deal with this challenge is using loss function modifications. In this work, we have investigated the effect of different loss functions on the performance of deep neural networks. We trained these networks using focal loss, logit-adjusted softmax cross-entropy (CE) loss, and weighted softmax CE loss, and we report different metrics for evaluating performance and uncertainty calibration. Our results suggest that focal loss delivers a good combination of performance in terms of AUC and uncertainty calibration in terms of expected calibration error (ECE) simultaneously.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨不同损失函数对深度神经网络在黑色素瘤图像分类中的性能影响。实验比较了focal loss、logit-adjusted softmax交叉熵损失和加权softmax交叉熵损失，结果显示focal loss在AUC性能与期望校准误差（ECE）两方面均取得较好平衡。
AI.motivation: 黑色素瘤是最致命的皮肤癌，早期诊断对患者生存至关重要。基于深度学习的图像分类已展现潜力，但SIIM-ISIC等黑色素瘤数据集存在严重类别不平衡问题，影响模型性能。损失函数修改是应对该挑战的方法之一。
AI.method: 使用三种损失函数训练深度神经网络：focal loss、logit-adjusted softmax交叉熵（CE）损失、加权softmax CE损失。针对类别不平衡的黑色素瘤分类数据集，报告多种性能评估指标及不确定性校准指标。
AI.result: focal loss在AUC性能与不确定性校准（以期望校准误差ECE衡量）两方面同时表现出良好组合。
AI.conclusion: 在类别不平衡的黑色素瘤图像分类任务中，focal loss是兼顾分类性能与不确定性校准的较优损失函数选择。

title: Impact of Data Augmentation on Confidence Calibration in Melanoma Classification
comment: Presented at the 30th Conference on Medical Image Understanding and Analysis (MIUA 2026)
summary: Accurately quantifying the predictive uncertainty or improving model calibration plays an important role in medical image classification, in particular in melanoma diagnosis, where accurate uncertainty quantification can have significant implications for patient care. One of the methods for calibration improvement is data augmentation. In addition, data augmentation as a method for synthetically increasing the size of the dataset has been proven to improve the performance of models trained on imbalanced datasets. However, the impact of data augmentation, as a transformation of a part of the original data, on calibration of models trained on imbalanced datasets, in particular in melanoma classification is under-explored. We train neural networks on SIIM-ISIC 2020 melanoma classification dataset under two conditions: with and without data augmentation, and compare the differences in AUC and expected calibration error (ECE) in both scenarios. Our results shows improvements in uncertainty calibration using different augmentation methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数据增强对黑色素瘤分类中模型校准的影响，在SIIM-ISIC 2020数据集上对比有无数据增强时的AUC与ECE，发现多种增强方法能改善不确定性校准。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分类（尤其是黑色素瘤诊断）中，准确量化预测不确定性或改进模型校准对患者护理意义重大。数据增强既可用于提升校准，也能通过扩大数据集规模改善不平衡数据集上的模型性能；然而，数据增强作为对原始数据部分样本的变换，对不平衡数据集（特别是黑色素瘤分类）模型校准的影响尚缺乏深入探索。
AI.method: 在SIIM-ISIC 2020黑色素瘤分类数据集上训练神经网络，设置两种条件：使用数据增强与不使用数据增强，并采用不同的数据增强方法，比较两种情形下AUC和期望校准误差（ECE）的差异。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用不同的数据增强方法能够改善不确定性校准。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强有助于提升不平衡黑色素瘤分类任务中的模型校准效果，为医学图像分类中的不确定性量化提供了参考。

title: Loss-Invariant Projections as Passive Probes of Learned Representations
summary: Learned feature representations in neural networks often contain structure beyond that directly used by the final task output. We study this structure using $\textit{passive probes}$ that apply fixed, untrained, property-independent projections to representations as they evolve during training. We motivate this approach through the task of prediction on $S^2$ where equivalent vector and Hermitian parameterizations reveal an additional loss-invariant trace coordinate. This motivates a general construction in which fixed random projections serve as observers of learned features. Because the observer is loss-invariant and independent of the property being studied, changes in accessibility reflect changes in the representation relative to the fixed observer rather than adaptation of the observer itself. We show that ensembles of passive probes can directly reflect task-relevant information such as target alignment. Under our constructions, the accessibility of eventual difficulty evolves differently across tasks. It increases during training in the regression tasks of surface-normal estimation and image inpainting but remains near its initial level in image classification. Comparisons with learned linear probes further show that recoverability and passive accessibility can evolve differently during training. Together, these results show how passive probes can separately characterize changes in representation geometry and the accessibility of eventual task difficulty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"被动探针"（passive probes）方法，通过固定、未经训练且与属性无关的随机投影来观测训练过程中演化的特征表示，从而区分表示几何变化与任务难度可及性的变化。
AI.motivation: 神经网络中习得的特征表示常包含超出最终任务输出直接所用结构的信息。作者希望找到一种不依赖后验训练、不受探针自身适应性干扰的方式来刻画这些结构及其在训练过程中的演化。
AI.method: 以 $S^2$ 上的预测任务为例，等价的向量参数化与 Hermitian 参数化揭示出一个额外的损失不变迹坐标，由此推广出一般构造：用固定的随机投影作为学习特征的观测者。由于观测者损失不变且与被研究属性独立，可及性变化反映的是表示相对固定观测者的变化，而非观测者自身的适应。作者进一步使用被动探针集成来反映目标对齐等任务相关信息，并与学习式线性探针进行对比。
AI.result: 被动探针集成可直接反映目标对齐等任务相关信息；最终难度的可及性在不同任务中演化方式不同——在表面法向量估计与图像修复等回归任务中随训练上升，而在图像分类中基本保持在初始水平。与学习式线性探针的对比显示，可恢复性（recoverability）与被动可及性（passive accessibility）在训练中可呈现不同演化轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 被动探针能够分别刻画表示几何的变化与最终任务难度的可及性，为理解神经网络特征表示中超出任务输出的结构提供了独立且互补的分析工具。

title: LeAVJEPA: A Minimalist Architecture for Audio-Visual Self-Supervised Learning
summary: Prior audio-visual self-supervised learning methods rely on mechanisms such as EMA target encoders, prediction heads, reconstruction decoders, and contrastive losses. We introduce LeAVJEPA, the first audio-visual encoder trained under LeJEPA's collapse-free objective. A single early-fusion Vision Transformer processes audio, video, and joint audio-video inputs. Modality dropout treats a missing modality as another view of the same event, making cross-modal alignment implicit in the objective. The model aligns global embeddings with modality-specific local embeddings, and SIGReg prevents representational collapse. A controlled ablation identifies modality dropout as the key mechanism for audio-visual alignment. Despite the architectural simplicity, LeAVJEPA reaches 36.0 mAP on AudioSet-20K and 91.3% accuracy on ESC-50 under frozen evaluation. After fine-tuning, it reaches 61.1% accuracy on VGGSound, and its embeddings support zero-shot audio-visual retrieval.

AI.tldr: LeAVJEPA是首个基于LeJEPA无坍缩目标的音视频自监督编码器，用单一早期融合ViT处理音频、视频及联合输入，以模态dropout隐式实现跨模态对齐，并通过局部-全局对齐与SIGReg防坍缩，在冻结评估与微调下均取得竞争力性能。
AI.motivation: 现有音视频自监督方法依赖EMA目标编码器、预测头、重建解码器和对比损失等复杂机制，架构与训练流程繁重。作者希望以更简洁的方式实现有效的音视频表征学习与跨模态对齐。
AI.method: 提出LeAVJEPA：在LeJEPA无坍缩目标下训练的音视频编码器。采用单一早期融合ViT同时处理音频、视频和联合音视频输入；将缺失模态视为同一事件的另一视图（模态dropout）；对齐全局嵌入与模态特定的局部嵌入，并用SIGReg防止表征坍缺。通过受控消融识别关键机制。
AI.result: 冻结评估下AudioSet-20K达36.0 mAP，ESC-50达91.3%准确率；微调后VGGSound达61.1%准确率；嵌入支持零样本音视频检索。
AI.conclusion: 模态dropout是音视频对齐的关键机制。尽管架构简单，LeAVJEPA仍能达到有竞争力的效果，表明无坍缩目标结合早期融合ViT可有效支撑音视频自监督学习与零样本检索。

title: Improving Proactive AI Assistance with Hierarchical Procedural Understanding
summary: Proactive AI assistants continuously observe a user's activity and decide whether to provide new guidance or remain silent. They should provide appropriate guidance for the task, determine when to provide the next guidance based on task progress, and adjust the guidance level to the user's expertise and needs. Supporting these capabilities requires training and evaluation data that reflect procedural structure and capture how guidance should adapt to task progress and user needs. However, existing datasets either focus on detection-based proactive understanding or provide procedural guidance at a fixed granularity. Fixed-granularity guidance provides limited information about fine-grained progress and broader procedural context, making it difficult to determine completion and adapt guidance granularity. To address these limitations, we introduce the ProactiveCoach suite, comprising ProactiveCoach-Instruct for training, ProactiveCoachBench for evaluation, and fine-tuned VLMs with an adaptive guidance system. ProactiveCoach-Instruct provides hierarchically structured guidance at the phase, step, and action levels for learning task progress and procedural context. ProactiveCoachBench evaluates whether models provide appropriate guidance at the right time across different guidance levels and adapt when the requested level changes. We fine-tune pretrained VLMs on ProactiveCoach-Instruct and demonstrate its effectiveness across backbones. Compared with fixed-granularity supervision, hierarchical supervision improves overall performance across backbones by up to 9.6%p. We further build an adaptive guidance system by combining our fine-tuned model with a lightweight guidance router. Without additional fine-tuning, our system outperforms the in-context adaptation baseline by 57.1%p across four guidance-level transitions. Our project page is available at https://jinsuby.github.io/ProactiveCoach/.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ProactiveCoach 套件，包含训练数据集 ProactiveCoach-Instruct、评测基准 ProactiveCoachBench 以及带自适应引导系统的微调 VLM，通过层次化引导数据提升主动式 AI 助手在合适时机提供恰当粒度引导的能力。
AI.motivation: 主动式 AI 助手需要根据任务进展决定是否提供新引导、何时提供下一步引导，并适配用户专业水平与需求。然而现有数据集要么聚焦于检测式主动理解，要么仅以固定粒度提供流程引导。固定粒度引导无法提供细粒度进度与更广流程上下文的信息，导致难以判断任务完成情况并自适应调整引导粒度。
AI.method: 引入 ProactiveCoach 套件：ProactiveCoach-Instruct 用于训练，提供阶段（phase）、步骤（step）、动作（action）三个层级的层次化结构引导，以学习任务进度与流程上下文；ProactiveCoachBench 用于评测，考察模型能否在不同引导层级下于正确时机提供恰当引导，并在所请求层级变化时做出适配；在 ProactiveCoach-Instruct 上微调预训练 VLM。
AI.result: 在多种骨干网络上验证了方法有效性。相比固定粒度监督，层次化监督使各骨干网络整体性能最高提升 9.6 个百分点。进一步将微调模型与轻量级引导路由器结合构建自适应引导系统，无需额外微调，在四种引导层级转换上比上下文内适配基线高出 57.1 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 层次化结构引导数据能有效提升主动式助手的引导时机判断与粒度自适应能力，结合轻量路由器可构建高效的自适应引导系统，为主动式 AI 助手的训练与评测提供了新方案。项目页面：https://jinsuby.github.io/ProactiveCoach/。

title: Detecting Nighttime Anomalies from NASA Black Marble Using a Generalized Spatio-Temporally Robust Framework of Machine Leaning Ensembles
summary: Nighttime lights from NASA's Black Marble product suite capture thermal and light emission signals from anomalous events including fires, volcanic eruptions, and gas flaring. Existing detection approaches rely primarily on thermal bands, limiting sensitivity to weaker signals. We propose a novel machine learning framework that jointly models Black Marble M-band and Day/Night Band (DNB) signals to derive a generalized, spatio-temporally robust ensemble of anomaly detectors. The framework iteratively builds detectors that scale across regions, seasons, anomaly classes, and extends over land and ocean. Detection sets at varying confidence levels are derived based on relevant bands and detector agreement. The approach improves true detection rate while reducing spurious detections and results demonstrate strong generalizability with applications in natural hazard monitoring and energy extraction.

AI.tldr: 提出一种联合建模 Black Marble M 波段与 DNB 波段的机器学习框架，构建可跨区域、季节、异常类型并覆盖陆地与海洋的泛化异常检测器集成，在提升真检率的同时减少虚警。
AI.motivation: NASA Black Marble 产品可捕获火灾、火山喷发、天然气放空等异常事件的热与光辐射信号，但现有检测方法主要依赖热红外波段，对较弱信号的敏感性不足，且难以保证跨时空与跨场景的泛化能力。
AI.method: 提出一种联合建模 M 波段与昼夜波段（DNB）信号的机器学习框架，以迭代方式逐步构建异常检测器集成；集成在区域、季节、异常类别以及陆地与海洋上均可扩展。依据相关波段与检测器一致性，生成不同置信水平的检测结果集合。
AI.result: 该方法提升了真检测率并减少了虚假检测，实验表明其具有较强的泛化能力，可应用于自然灾害监测与能源开采等场景。
AI.conclusion: 融合热辐射与可见光/近红外夜间灯光信号的联合建模思路，可突破单一热波段检测的灵敏度与泛化瓶颈，为多场景夜间异常监测提供通用且时空稳健的解决方案。

title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
summary: Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings. Yet it remains unclear how accurately current models recover plotted values from real scientific figures, as existing benchmarks rely largely on synthetic charts or cover only a limited range of chart types. We introduce PlotGround, an automated pipeline for building plot digitization benchmarks from real scientific figures and their author-released source data. PlotGround maps figures to source tables, identifies reconstructable panels, and generates quantitative questions with source-grounded reference values. We use PlotGround to construct PlotGround-1k, a human-verified benchmark of 1,119 questions from 1,066 bioRxiv preprints. Across sixteen multimodal models, the best reaches 87.5% accuracy at a $\pm 5\%$ relative-error tolerance. Tightening the tolerance to $\pm 2\%$ lowers every model's accuracy by 11-24 percentage points, revealing a gap between approximate visual reading and precise quantitative recovery. PlotGround's paired figure-source structure lets us compare how accurately the same values are recovered from figures and from source tables. Providing source tables instead of figures raises a coding agent's accuracy from 90.0% to 97.4% while cutting cost by 72%.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PlotGround自动化流水线，从真实科学图表和作者源数据构建图表数字化基准，并基于此构建人类验证的PlotGround-1k（1,119题，来自1,066篇bioRxiv预印本），评测16个多模态模型的定量取值能力。
AI.motivation: 科学图表常编码了机器不可读的定量结果，准确的图表数字化对验证和复用已发表发现至关重要。但现有基准多依赖合成图表或仅覆盖有限图表类型，当前模型从真实科学图表恢复数值的准确度尚不明确。
AI.method: PlotGround：将图表映射到源数据表，识别可重建的面板，并生成以源数据为参考答案的定量问题。用该流水线构建PlotGround-1k基准，并在16个多模态模型上评测，还利用图表-源表配对结构比较同一数值从图表与源表恢复的准确度。
AI.result: 在±5%相对误差容差下，最佳模型准确率为87.5%；收紧至±2%时，所有模型准确率下降11–24个百分点。提供源表而非图表时，编码智能体准确率从90.0%升至97.4%，成本降低72%。
AI.conclusion: 当前模型在近似视觉读取与精确定量恢复之间存在明显差距；图表-源表配对结构可量化这一差距，并显示源表在准确率和成本上均优于图表输入，凸显图表数字化基准的必要性与现有模型的局限。

title: Learning Robust Personalized Prompts for LLM-Driven Sequential Recommendation
summary: LLM-driven sequential recommendation formulates next-item prediction as autoregressive generation conditioned on natural-language prompts. However, minor wording changes in semantically equivalent prompts can cause substantial performance fluctuations, undermining robustness and requiring costly manual prompt engineering. Continuous prompt learning reduces template dependence but faces two interacting challenges: shared task-level instructions lack user-specific reasoning guidance, while gradient updates can push continuous prompts outside the LLM's effective semantic space. Injecting personalized signals can further amplify this semantic drift. To address these challenges, we propose LRPRec, a learnable prompting framework that initializes continuous instruction prompts from discrete templates and introduces two complementary mechanisms. Personalized prompt injection encodes user behavior into a preference embedding and additively injects it into shared prompts, enabling parameter-efficient user-level adaptation. A semantic drift constraint regularizes the shared prompts within a trust region around their initialization anchors to preserve semantic validity during optimization. By constraining the shared component while allowing additive personalization, LRPRec decouples stability from expressiveness. Extensive experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over strong baselines while eliminating the need for manual tuning of background and task inference templates.

AI.tldr: LRPRec是一个可学习的连续提示框架，通过用户偏好注入与语义漂移约束，在保持语义有效性的同时实现个性化，缓解LLM序列推荐对提示措辞的敏感性问题。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的序列推荐依赖自然语言提示进行自回归生成，但语义等价提示的轻微措辞变化会导致性能显著波动，鲁棒性差且需昂贵的人工提示工程。连续提示学习虽减少模板依赖，却面临两个相互交织的问题：共享任务级指令缺乏用户特定推理指导；梯度更新可能将连续提示推离LLM有效语义空间，而注入个性化信号会进一步加剧语义漂移。
AI.method: 提出LRPRec框架：从离散模板初始化连续指令提示，并引入两个互补机制。(1)个性化提示注入：将用户行为编码为偏好嵌入，以加法方式注入共享提示，实现参数高效的用户级适配；(2)语义漂移约束：将共享提示正则化在初始锚点附近的信任域内，以在优化过程中保持语义有效性。通过约束共享分量同时允许加性个性化，实现稳定性与表达性的解耦。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，LRPRec相较强基线取得一致性提升，同时无需人工调优背景模板和任务推理模板。
AI.conclusion: LRPRec通过解耦稳定共享提示与个性化注入，有效应对连续提示学习中的语义漂移与用户适配难题，提升LLM序列推荐的鲁棒性与性能，并免除手动提示工程。

title: FICO: Find-Then-Compute for Corpus-Level Spreadsheet Question Answering
summary: Question answering over spreadsheet collections requires finding the correct workbook and computing over complete tables. We introduce Find-then-Compute (FiCo), which retrieves document summaries, disambiguates similar workbooks, and executes constrained Structured Query Language (SQL) over the selected full table. On DataBench (80 datasets, 1,810 questions), FiCo reaches 76.2% accuracy: 9.9 points above a strong TableRAG-style baseline on the same frozen workbook choices (66.3%) under the tracks' prespecified evaluators, and 63.4 points above prefix RAG (12.8%). On 508 MiMoTable questions, FiCo reaches 79.7%, versus 22.2% for prefix RAG. Giving the strong baseline the gold workbook raises it from 66.3% to 76.3%, exposing a 10.0-point source-selection cost under fixed compute. Despite 95.1% document recall and 98.5% executable SQL, only 81.3% of questions execute on the gold workbook. FiCo's advantage comes from integrating semantic source selection with exact, schema-grounded computation.

AI.tldr: 提出Find-then-Compute（FiCo）框架，用于电子表格问答：先检索文档摘要并消歧相似工作簿，再对选定的完整表执行受限SQL计算。在DataBench上达76.2%准确率，显著优于TableRAG式基线（66.3%）和prefix RAG（12.8%）；MiMoTable上达79.7%。
AI.motivation: 电子表格集合上的问答需同时完成两件事：定位正确的工作簿（source selection），以及在完整表上进行计算。现有RAG式方法（如prefix RAG）难以处理完整表格计算与相似工作簿区分，导致准确率低下。
AI.method: FiCo采用两阶段流程：1）Find阶段——检索文档摘要并对相似工作簿进行消歧，选出语义上正确的工作簿；2）Compute阶段——对选定完整表执行受约束的SQL查询，实现基于schema的精确计算。该方法将语义源选择与精确计算解耦但整合。
AI.result: DataBench（80数据集，1,810问题）：FiCo达76.2%，高于同冻结工作簿选择的TableRAG式基线66.3%共9.9点，高于prefix RAG 12.8%共63.4点。MiMoTable（508问题）：79.7% vs prefix RAG 22.2%。将gold workbook给予强基线可从66.3%提升至76.3%，暴露10.0点的源选择成本（固定计算量下）。文档召回95.1%，可执行SQL 98.5%，但仅81.3%问题能在gold workbook上执行。
AI.conclusion: FiCo的性能优势来源于将语义源选择与基于schema的精确计算相结合。消融显示源选择是主要瓶颈（10.0点成本），且即便给定正确工作簿，仍有约18.7%问题无法执行，提示计算与schema匹配环节存在进一步改进空间。

title: Multimodal Dual-Encoder Retrieval for Automated ICD Coding
summary: Accurate International Classification of Diseases (ICD) coding is crucial for large-scale clinical research, documentation, and billing. There are three primary problems with current ICD prediction methods: (1) They are unable to comprehend multimodal patient data because they rely on either structured EHR data or unstructured clinical notes. (2) They also struggle with scalability to a larger amount of ICD codes (9K+ codes in ICD-9), as traditional classifiers need dense output layers and often do not generalize well to long tail rare diseases. (3) They lack transparency for clinical use. To address these challenges, this research proposes a two-stage framework that first retrieves ICD codes using a multimodal dual-encoder retrieval model, where structured and unstructured patient data are integrated through gated fusion. The second stage refines the top-k retrieved candidates with an LLM-based re-ranker that provides ranked codes with clinically relevant explanations. Our experiments show that the proposed approach improves Micro-F1 and Precision over a multimodal dual-fusion classifier baseline. These improvements demonstrate that combining a gated multimodal retrieval system with LLM-based re-ranking is a practical alternative to dense multi-label classification for automated ICD coding.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段ICD编码框架：先以多模态双编码器检索结合门控融合整合结构化与文本数据，再用LLM重排器对top-k候选进行精排并给出临床解释，Micro-F1与Precision优于多模态双融合分类基线。
AI.motivation: 准确的ICD编码对大规模临床研究、文档与计费至关重要。现有方法存在三大问题：(1)仅依赖结构化EHR或非结构化临床笔记，无法理解多模态患者数据；(2)难以扩展到9K+ ICD编码规模，传统分类器需稠密输出层，对长尾罕见病泛化差；(3)缺乏临床可用所需的透明性。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：第一阶段用多模态双编码器检索模型召回ICD编码，通过门控融合(gated fusion)整合结构化与非结构化患者数据；第二阶段用基于LLM的重排器(refiner/re-ranker)对top-k候选精排，输出排序后的编码及具临床相关性的解释。
AI.result: 实验表明，所提方法在Micro-F1与Precision上优于多模态双融合分类器基线。
AI.conclusion: 将门控多模态检索系统与基于LLM的重排相结合，是替代稠密多标签分类用于自动ICD编码的可行方案，兼顾可扩展性与临床可解释性。

title: From Valid to Useful: Post-Verification Acquisition for Recursive Self-Improving Recommendation
summary:
Sequential recommenders can generate synthetic interaction sequences and retrain on the augmented corpus in a recursive self-improvement loop. To limit error accumulation, current methods verify each generated sequence remains predictive of the user's real interactions and discard those that drift away from it. Verification does not, however, determine which verified sequences should train the next model. With every verified sequence used for training, source sequences yielding more verified sequences or longer continuations have more influence, although neither quantity indicates how much those sequences will help the next model.
  We formulate the decision of which verified sequences are used to train the next model as \emph{post-verification acquisition} and introduce {\bf Disagreement-Aware Recursive Self-Improving Recommendation (DA-RSIR)}. DA-RSIR caps each source sequence's contribution and ranks its verified sequences by how much the model's predictions disagree over their augmented interactions. It uses a score derived from Bayesian Active Learning by Disagreement (BALD) and estimated with Monte Carlo (MC) dropout.
  DA-RSIR requires no extra labels, teacher model, or quality scorer. Across four datasets, three recommender models, and two metrics, it improves on the retain-all approach in all $24$ comparisons and attains the highest mean in $23$ of $24$ overall; the aggregate improvement is statistically significant on both metrics. A single DA-RSIR round exceeds the retain-all approach's best gain over five recursive rounds. These findings establish post-verification acquisition as a separate control point in recursive self-improvement, separating which sequences pass verification from which verified sequences are used to train the next model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"验证后获取"（post-verification acquisition）问题，并设计DA-RSIR方法，通过限制每条源序列的贡献、按BALD不确定性对验证通过序列排序，替代"全部保留"策略，在24组对比中全部提升推荐性能。
AI.motivation: 现有递归自改进推荐方法通过验证保证生成序列仍能预测用户真实交互，但未解决"哪些验证通过的序列应被用于训练下一模型"的问题。采用全部保留会导致：产出更多验证序列或更长续写的源序列获得更大影响，而这两种量都不能反映序列对下一模型的真实价值，从而造成影响失衡与误差累积。
AI.method: 将"哪些验证序列用于训练下一模型"形式化为 post-verification acquisition 问题，提出 DA-RSIR。方法对每条源序列的贡献设上限，并用基于 Disagreement 的贝叶斯主动学习（BALD）得分、经蒙特卡洛（MC）dropout 估计，对其验证序列按模型预测在增强交互上的分歧程度排序。无需额外标签、教师模型或质量评分器。
AI.result: 在4个数据集、3种推荐模型、2个指标下，DA-RSIR 在全部24组对比中均优于 retain-all，在23/24中取得最高均值，总体提升在两个指标上均统计显著；单轮 DA-RSIR 即超过 retain-all 五轮递归的最优增益。
AI.conclusion: 验证后获取是递归自改进中的独立控制点：验证决定哪些序列"通过"，获取决定哪些通过序列"用于训练"，二者应分开处理；按分歧度选择训练序列可显著提升递归自改进推荐的效果。

title: Query Generation with Direct Preference Optimization for Document Expansion in E-commerce Search
summary: Doc2Query, a popular document expansion technique, leverages sequence-to-sequence models to generate relevant queries, effectively addressing the "vocabulary mismatch" problem in information retrieval. However, these models often suffer from generating either hallucinations unrelated to the document or repetitive content already present in the document. Training sequence-to-sequence models to produce high-quality, novel, and relevant tokens remains a significant challenge. To address these issues, we introduce a novel approach, QGDPO, that employs direct preference optimization (DPO) to guide the generation process. We first fine-tune a base sequence-to-sequence model and subsequently utilize a relevance model to score its predictions. Based on these scores, we construct pairs of winning and losing predictions as relevance preferences for the DPO training. Furthermore, we enhance our pipeline by using the relevance model to filter out poor predictions, retaining only the most relevant generated content for indexing. QGDPO effectively eliminates 50% of irrelevant predictions comparing against Doc2Query baselines, while the relevance filter removes an additional 14.61%. This feature has been successfully deployed to production on Walmart.com for full traffic, with a substantial improvement in relevance and user engagement.

AI.tldr: 提出QGDPO，利用直接偏好优化（DPO）引导查询生成，缓解Doc2Query的幻觉与重复问题，并加入相关性过滤，已落地Walmart.com全量流量。
AI.motivation: Doc2Query等文档扩展方法用序列到序列模型生成查询以缓解检索中的“词汇不匹配”问题，但模型常产生与文档无关的幻觉或文档中已有的重复内容。如何让模型生成高质量、新颖且相关的token仍是难题。
AI.method: QGDPO：先微调基础seq2seq模型；再用相关性模型对其预测打分；根据分数构建“胜出/落败”预测对，作为相关性偏好用于DPO训练；并在流程中用相关性模型过滤低质预测，只保留最相关生成内容用于索引。
AI.result: 相比Doc2Query基线，QGDPO有效消除50%的无关预测，相关性过滤器再额外去除14.61%。该方案已在Walmart.com全量流量生产环境部署，相关性与用户参与度均有显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 将DPO引入文档扩展的查询生成并结合相关性过滤，可有效提升生成质量与检索相关性，且具备大规模生产可行性。

title: ModelLakeFishing: Efficient Retrieval over Million-Scale Model Lakes
summary: Open model lakes may contain millions of reusable models, making it costly to identify suitable models for a new dataset. We present ModelLakeFishing, a model-retrieval framework for queries specifying a target dataset, prediction task, and evaluation metric. It consolidates metadata and historical evaluations into a model-dataset-task evidence graph, learns model and query embeddings with a relation-aware graph encoder, and indexes model embeddings using Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) search. At query time, HNSW retrieves 1,000 candidates without scoring every model, after which a training-side task prior reranks candidates for the requested metric and returns the top 10. We evaluate on a lake of 3,016,439 models and 247,803 observed model-dataset performance pairs using three root-aware splits that hold test performance edges out of representation learning and retrieval. ModelLakeFishing achieves a mean eligible-query gold@10 of 0.2968, recovering the observed-best model in the top 10 for 29.68% of eligible queries and retaining 93.47% of the gold@10 of an exhaustive baseline using the same scoring and reranking procedure. Given precomputed query embeddings, retrieval and reranking take 0.747 ms median and 1.102 ms at the 95th percentile. These results demonstrate efficient retrieval over million-model lakes from sparse relational evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出 ModelLakeFishing 框架，将元数据与历史评估组织为“模型-数据集-任务”证据图，学习关系感知嵌入并用 HNSW 索引，实现百万级模型湖中面向指定数据集/任务/指标的快速模型检索。
AI.motivation: 开放模型湖可能包含数百万可复用模型，针对新数据集逐一评估或打分所有模型的成本极高，因此需要高效的模型检索方法。
AI.method: 将元数据与历史评估整合为模型-数据集-任务证据图；用关系感知图编码器学习模型与查询嵌入；用 HNSW 对模型嵌入建立索引；查询时 HNSW 先召回 1000 个候选而无需为全部模型打分，再由训练侧任务先验按目标指标重排并返回 top 10；采用三个 root-aware 划分，将测试性能边排除在表示学习与检索之外。
AI.result: 在包含 3,016,439 个模型和 247,803 个已观测模型-数据集性能对的模型湖上评估，eligible query 的平均 gold@10 为 0.2968，即在 29.68% 的 eligible query 的前 10 中找回观测最佳模型；在相同打分与重排流程下，保留 exhaustive 基线 gold@10 的 93.47%；给定预计算查询嵌入，检索与重排中位耗时 0.747 ms，95 分位耗时 1.102 ms。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在稀疏关系证据条件下，可对百万级模型湖实现高效检索，并在大幅降低计算成本的同时接近穷举基线的效果。

title: Do We Still Need Gazetteers in the Era of LLMs? Chaining Retrieval with a Spatial Neuro-Symbolic Index
summary: Geographic information retrieval (GeoIR) tasks require systems to interpret ambiguous toponyms for downstream applications. Traditionally, toponym resolution relies on gazetteers to provide an explicit index of place entities and spatial relationships. Recently, gazetteer-free approaches seek to reduce dependence on handcrafted searches: dense retrieval utilizes text encoders to capture rich context, moving beyond the limitations of lexical search. However, text encoders implicitly assume that learned representations can function as reliable spatial-semantic indexes. In this paper, we evaluate this assumption through a spatial-semantic indexing setup: given a contextualized toponym mention, we retrieve the corresponding gazetteer entity represented by text derived from a gazetteer knowledge graph. We benchmark five frozen text encoders under two retrieval strategies: brute-force nearest-neighbor retrieval over entity representations, and a neuro-symbolic hierarchical beam search that constrains retrieval (i.e. chaining the search with gazetteer hierarchy). Experimental results reveal a distinct coarse-versus-fine trade-off. Unconstrained dense retrieval frequently incurs catastrophic spatial errors. Conversely, hierarchical constraints improve coarse geographic grounding, but still yield limited benefit for fine-grained localization metrics: vanilla text encoders fail to capture the fine-scale spatial fidelity encoded in gazetteers. Our code is publicly available at: https://doi.org/10.25439/rmt.31094269

AI.tldr: 本文评估了免词典地名词解中"文本编码器可作为可靠空间-语义索引"这一假设：在五种冻结文本编码器上对比暴力最近邻检索与神经符号层次束搜索，发现存在"粗-细"权衡。
AI.motivation: 地理信息检索（GeoIR）需系统解析歧义地名以支持下游应用。传统地名解析依赖地名词典提供的显式地名实体索引与空间关系；近期免词典方法（如稠密检索）借助文本编码器捕获丰富上下文，以突破词汇检索的局限。但这些编码器隐含假设其学习到的表示可充当可靠的空间-语义索引，本文旨在检验该假设是否成立。
AI.method: 构建空间-语义索引场景：给定上下文中的地名提及，检索由地名词典知识图谱文本表示的对应词典实体。在五种冻结文本编码器上评估两种检索策略：一是对实体表示做暴力最近邻检索；二是神经符号层次束搜索，通过与地名词典层次结构链式约束检索。
AI.result: 实验结果呈现明显的"粗粒度—细粒度"权衡。无约束的稠密检索频繁产生灾难性空间错误；层次约束能改善粗粒度地理定位，但对细粒度定位指标收益仍有限——原始文本编码器无法捕获地名词典所编码的细尺度空间保真度。代码已公开：https://doi.org/10.25439/rmt.31094269
AI.conclusion: 文本编码器的隐式空间-语义索引假设在细粒度地名解析上并不成立；层次约束可作为改善粗粒度地理锚定的有效手段，但提升细粒度定位仍需超越原始文本编码器的表示能力。

title: Agentic RAG Evaluation: Budget Allocation Across Questions, Trajectories, and Reads
summary: Evaluation budgets in agentic retrieval-augmented generation span questions, search trajectories, and repeated answers. We measure allocation precision, reading efficiency, and cost boundaries using a retrieval-feedback comparison on HotpotQA and MuSiQue. At 34.14--34.39M model tokens, broader question coverage lowers standard error by 33\% versus five reads and 12.6\% versus three trajectories. Archived nested and Q-only forecasts predict these allocations within 4.0\% and 3.5\%, respectively. Depth subsets establish no clear forecasting advantage beyond the two-trajectory audit. One-read variance penalties relative to the fitted optimum at the same token budget are 0--9.9\%, with substantial Pro uncertainty. Under recorded model fees, more questions beat more trajectories at search prices of \$0--1 per 1,000 requests; question-versus-read fee rankings remain unresolved. Temperature zero cuts answer disagreement from 14.3\% to 3.4\% while comparison precision stays similar. \par\medskip\noindent\textbf{Keywords:} Agentic RAG; Evaluation budget; Generalizability theory; Repeated sampling.

AI.tldr: 该文在Agentic RAG中系统研究评估预算在"问题数、检索轨迹数、重复读取数"三个维度上的分配问题，用检索反馈对比实验衡量分配精度、读取效率与成本边界，并以通用性理论与重复抽样为框架给出可预测、可复现的预算配置建议。
AI.motivation: Agentic RAG的评估成本由问题数量、检索轨迹与重复答案共同构成，但现有工作缺乏对这些评估预算如何分配、能否被预测、以及不同分配在同等token预算下的效率差异的系统量化，因此作者希望在固定预算下识别更优的分配策略并检验其可预测性与稳健性。
AI.method: 在HotpotQA与MuSiQue上进行检索反馈对比实验，以约34.14–34.39M模型token为统一预算，比较更广的问题覆盖与五次读取、三条轨迹等配置；使用归档的嵌套预测与Q-only预测检验预算分配的可预测性；通过深度子集审计检验预测优势是否可延伸；在记录模型费用与0–1美元/千次请求的搜索价格下比较问题数与轨迹数的成本排序；并将温度设为0以考察答案分歧与比较精度的变化。
AI.result: 更广的问题覆盖相比五次读取将标准误降低33%、相比三条轨迹降低12.6%；归档嵌套预测与Q-only预测分别将分配误差控制在4.0%与3.5%以内；深度子集在两条轨迹审计之外未显示清晰的预测优势；相同token预算下单次读取相对拟合最优的方差惩罚为0–9.9%，且Pro存在较大不确定性；在记录费用下，当搜索价格为0–1美元/千次请求时，增加问题数优于增加轨迹数，而问题与读取之间的费用排序仍未确定；温度0将答案分歧从14.3%降至3.4%，比较精度基本持平。
AI.conclusion: 在Agentic RAG评估中，将有限预算优先分配给更广的问题覆盖而非更多检索轨迹或读取，能在同等token成本下获得更低的标准误；预算分配具有可预测性，但预测优势并不随深度子集稳定扩展，且成本排序受搜索价格影响。降低温度可显著减少答案不一致而不牺牲比较精度，为评估预算的稳健配置提供了实证依据。

title: SearchJev: A Fast and Calibrated System-1 Model for Search Agents
summary: Search agents repeatedly make short decisions about relevance, evidence sufficiency, and search actions. Using generative language models for these decisions introduces latency and unreliable confidence. We present SearchJev, a fast and calibrated System-1 model that separates search decisions from System-2 reasoning and generation. Given a search state and a decision schema, SearchJev directly scores legal options without autoregressive output generation. We propose Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions (SLCD) to learn decision probabilities from uncertain supervision and calibrate their confidence. In a dual-system search agent, SearchJev handles short decisions and delegates uncertain judgments to System 2, which retains planning, query generation, and answer composition. We also introduce SearchDecision-Bench, a benchmark unifying six types of search decisions for training and evaluation. On SearchDecision-Bench, SEARCHJEV improves decision quality over same-size Qwen3.5 autoregressive models, achieves 5.2-5.3 times faster decisions, and reduces average expected calibration error by 41-74%. On BrowseComp-Plus, the dual-system agents achieve a 3.7-4.7 times speedup in active search time while improving answer accuracy from 45% to up to 54%.

AI.tldr: SearchJev 是一种快速且校准良好的 System-1 模型，将搜索决策与 System-2 推理生成解耦，直接对合法选项打分而无需自回归生成，并通过 SLCD 学习与校准决策概率。
AI.motivation: 搜索智能体需频繁做出相关性、证据充分性与搜索动作等短决策，使用生成式语言模型会带来延迟高和置信度不可靠的问题。
AI.method: 提出 SearchJev：给定搜索状态和决策模式，直接对合法选项打分，不做自回归输出；提出 Soft-Label Learning for Calibrated Decisions（SLCD），从不确定监督中学习决策概率并校准置信度；在双系统搜索智能体中，SearchJev 处理短决策，将不确定判断交由 System 2 负责规划、查询生成与答案撰写；并构建 SearchDecision-Bench，统一六类搜索决策用于训练与评测。
AI.result: 在 SearchDecision-Bench 上，SearchJev 相比同规模 Qwen3.5 自回归模型提升决策质量，决策速度提升 5.2-5.3 倍，平均期望校准误差降低 41-74%；在 BrowseComp-Plus 上，双系统智能体活跃搜索时间加速 3.7-4.7 倍，答案准确率从 45% 提升至最高 54%。
AI.conclusion: 通过将搜索短决策交由快速校准的 System-1 模型处理，并与 System-2 分工协作，可在显著加速搜索的同时提升决策质量与答案准确率。

title: Quality-Aware Cross-Model Computation Reuse
summary: An intermediate result computed by one model can be reused by other models to perform their tasks. Existing work mainly focuses on practical execution, leaving a theoretical gap in optimizing reuse decisions. This optimization faces two challenges: quality uncertainty, because the effect of reuse on task quality is uncertain across models, and coupled scheduling, because tasks need to share the cost of preparing reusable results. These challenges compound each other: quality must be learned online, but the shared preparation structure makes scheduling NP-hard even with known quality, breaking the key assumption in existing methods. We formulate cross-model computation reuse as an online decision problem and develop the Quality-Aware Reuse Scheduling (QARS) algorithm to address it. For quality uncertainty, QARS learns task-dependent reuse quality from selected, possibly delayed feedback and uses optimistic estimates to guide decisions. For coupled scheduling, it jointly chooses which results to prepare and which tasks should use them, adapting scheduling accuracy to the remaining quality uncertainty. For the considered problem, our analysis separates learning and optimization error in regret and quantifies the tradeoff between scheduling accuracy and computation. Completing the quality-aware stopping rule yields $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ regret while preserving feasibility. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of QARS in optimizing cross-model reuse, reducing the combined cost of computation and quality loss by up to 18.0%, and mean regret by 63.9% over the strongest scheduling baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文将跨模型计算复用形式化为在线决策问题，提出质量感知复用调度算法QARS，在质量不确定与调度耦合下实现约 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾，实验使综合成本降18.0%、平均遗憾降63.9%。
AI.motivation: 一个模型计算的中间结果可被其他模型复用，但现有工作侧重实际执行，缺乏对复用决策优化的理论分析。该优化存在两大挑战：跨模型复用对任务质量的影响不确定（质量不确定性），以及任务需分摊可复用结果准备成本（调度耦合）。二者相互加剧：质量需在线学习，而共享准备结构使调度即使质量已知也为NP难，打破了现有方法的关键假设。
AI.method: 将跨模型计算复用建模为在线决策问题，并提出质量感知复用调度（QARS）算法。针对质量不确定性，QARS从被选中且可能延迟的反馈中学习任务相关的复用质量，并用乐观估计指导决策；针对调度耦合，联合选择准备哪些结果以及哪些任务使用这些结果，并使调度精度自适应于剩余质量不确定性。理论分析将遗憾分解为学习误差与优化误差，并刻画调度精度与计算量之间的权衡。
AI.result: 在完整实现质量感知停止规则时，算法达到 $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ 遗憾并保持可行性。实验表明QARS在跨模型复用优化上有效，相比最强调度基线，计算与质量损失的联合成本最多降低18.0%，平均遗憾降低63.9%。
AI.conclusion: QARS为跨模型计算复用的在线优化提供了理论框架与可行算法，兼顾质量学习与耦合调度，在保持可行性的同时取得次线性遗憾，并在实验中显著优于强基线。

title: Search Engines Never Say No: How Frozen Agents React When the Retrieval Tool Refuses
summary: A search tool never says no: it returns its top-k passages even when the index holds no answer, so the agent sees irrelevant text instead of a miss signal. We ask what frozen search agents do when the tool refuses instead. On an index-hole testbed (257 NQ and 300 HotpotQA questions run with and without their gold passages in a 21M-passage BM25 index), seven agents receive one of five refusal wordings. An un-announced one-sentence refusal raises abstention on unanswerable questions from 23% to 97% on average for Qwen3-8B/32B and from 28% to 57% for Claude Haiku 4.5, cutting wrong answers almost one-for-one and beating a system-prompt instruction by 51 points on average. Search-R1 ignores the refusal and fabricates retrievals; Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Opus 5.5 answer from memory (abstention +2 points) and obey a system-prompt directive instead (+16). We also found that wording matters: an explanation beats a bare token; a directive inside the observation is decisive for Haiku; a soft warning is useless. Realistic triggers, from a lightweight score-based predictor to an LLM grounding judge, fall well short of the oracle, and all land on a benefit-versus-signal-quality curve that prices any trigger by its recall at a fixed false-refusal budget: for compliant agents the bottleneck is the detector inside the tool, not the agent, and the curve tells future detector work what each point of recall is worth.

AI.tldr: 论文研究冻结的搜索智能体在检索工具"拒绝返回"（即索引无答案时返回拒答信号）时的行为。在257条NQ与300条HotpotQA的"索引空洞"测试集上，向7个智能体注入5种拒答措辞。主要发现：一句未预告的拒答可将Qwen3-8B/32B的弃答率从23%提升到97%，Claude Haiku 4.5从28%到57%，错误答案近乎一对一减少；但Search-R1会忽略拒答并编造检索结果，Claude Sonnet/Opus 5.5改为凭记忆作答。措辞影响显著，且真实触发器的效果远不及oracle，落在"收益—信号质量"曲线上。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索工具从不"说不"，即使索引中没有答案也总返回top-k段落，导致智能体看到无关文本而得不到"未命中"信号。作者想探究：如果工具主动拒绝返回，冻结的搜索智能体将如何反应，以及这种拒答信号能否有效提升弃答、减少错误答案。
AI.method: 构建"索引空洞"测试集：257个NQ问题和300个HotpotQA问题，分别在包含与其不包含gold段落的21M段落BM25索引上运行。7个搜索智能体接受5种不同的拒答措辞。此外，分别用轻量级基于分数的预测器和LLM grounding judge作为现实触发器，并与oracle对比。
AI.result: 未预告的单句拒答使不可回答问题上的弃答率显著上升：Qwen3-8B/32B从23%平均升至97%，Claude Haiku 4.5从28%升至57%，错误答案几乎一对一减少，平均比系统提示指令高51个百分点。Search-R1忽略拒答并编造检索内容；Claude Sonnet 5.5和Opus 5.5凭记忆作答（弃答仅+2个百分点），但会服从系统提示指令（+16）。措辞有影响：带解释优于裸token，观察内的指令对Haiku起决定作用，软警告无效。现实触发器（分数预测器、LLM judge）效果远逊于oracle，均落在"收益—信号质量"曲线上。
AI.conclusion: 当检索工具能发出拒答信号时，合规智能体的弃答行为大幅改善、错误答案显著减少，瓶颈在于工具内部的检测器而非智能体本身。触发器的价值可由"收益—信号质量"曲线刻画：在固定误拒预算下，每个召回率提升点都有明确收益，为未来检测器研究提供了定价依据。

title: OpticalRec: Unified Optical Vision-Language Representation for Multimodal Recommendation
summary: Recent advances in vision-language modeling have substantially improved multimodal encoding, retrieval and reasoning. Yet for multimodal recommendation, encoding rich item vision-language semantic interactions remains a long-standing bottleneck, which hampers accurate item representation learning and user-item matching. Mainstream approaches primarily adopt independent encoding of vision and language modality followed by rigid late fusion such as concatenation, inherently omitting native vision-language interactions and introducing cross-modal semantic distortion. To address this challenge, we propose OpticalRec, the first visual-space unified encoding paradigm for multimodal collaborative filtering, a fundamental recommendation setting. Instead of isolated modality-specific encoding, OpticalRec renders item textual metadata as visual glyphs, enabling native image-text interaction within the visual encoder - the perceptual encoding level. The resulting representations are further processed by the language decoder - the semantic encoding level, allowing OpticalRec to exploit the dual-attention mechanism of modern vision-language models that previous encoding methods omitted. OpticalRec's efficacy is theoretically supported by mutual information analysis and empirically demonstrated through superior performance across strong baselines and benchmarks. As a plug-and-play module, OpticalRec (1) introduces minimal cost, (2) is robust against rendered text font, color and layout, etc., and (3) integrates seamlessly into existing multimodal collaborative filtering models.

AI.tldr: 提出OpticalRec，首个面向多模态协同过滤的视觉空间统一编码范式，将物品文本元数据渲染为视觉字形，在视觉编码器中实现原生图文交互，并经语言解码器进一步处理。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态推荐方法多采用视觉与语言模态独立编码加拼接式晚期融合，遗漏了原生图文交互并引入跨模态语义失真，导致物品表示学习与用户-物品匹配不准确。
AI.method: 将物品文本元数据渲染为视觉字形，使图文交互在视觉编码器（感知编码层）内原生发生；所得表示再由语言解码器（语义编码层）处理，从而利用现代视觉语言模型的双注意力机制。
AI.result: 通过互信息分析提供理论支撑，并在多个强基线与基准上取得更优性能；作为即插即用模块，成本极低，对渲染文本的字体、颜色、布局等具有鲁棒性，且可无缝集成到现有多模态协同过滤模型中。
AI.conclusion: OpticalRec以视觉空间统一编码替代孤立模态编码与刚性晚期融合，为多模态协同过滤提供了低成本、鲁棒且通用的新范式。

title: SCOUT: Supply-Aware Cold-Start Proactive Query Suggestion for Travel Search
comment: Accepted at the CIKM 2026 Workshop on Generative, Retrieval-augmented, and Agentic Intelligence for Personalization
summary:
Generative query suggestion, powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), has become increasingly popular in search and conversational systems to reduce user friction and guide intent formulation. Existing approaches align suggestions with user preferences (e.g., clicks or conversions). This works for open-ended applications like chatbots and personal assistants, where the result space is unconstrained or historical user free-text queries are abundant.
  However, applying these methods to travel search presents two limitations. First, travel search is fundamentally constrained by physical inventory; a query (e.g., "romantic beachfront villa") may yield abundant results in Bali but few in Tokyo, so aligning with user preferences is not by itself grounded in what can be offered. Second, travel platforms traditionally rely on faceted search interfaces with no free-text queries. This creates a cold-start problem: without historical query logs there is no demand-side data for alignment, and without a seed query at request time, suggestions must be generated proactively from structured context alone.
  To address these challenges, we propose SCOUT, a bootstrapping framework for supply-aware proactive query suggestion. SCOUT overcomes the data gap by substituting missing demand-side user feedback with supply-side system feedback. It treats the search engine as a reinforcement learning environment, deriving a dense reward from the production reranker's query-listing match scores, and optimizes the policy with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). SCOUT improves inventory match rate (IMR@18) by 12.3% while preserving diversity, matching a compute-intensive best-of-8 policy at zero marginal inference cost and making supply-aware suggestion deployable on a real-time travel search path.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SCOUT，一个面向旅游搜索的供给侧感知主动式查询推荐自举框架：用系统侧反馈（reranker匹配分）替代缺失的需求侧用户偏好数据，将搜索引擎建模为强化学习环境，以GRPO优化策略。
AI.motivation: 生成式查询推荐在聊天机器人等开放域场景中依赖用户偏好（点击、转化）对齐，但旅游搜索受两方面限制：一是可供给的实体库存受限（同一查询在不同目的地结果差异巨大），仅对齐用户偏好无法保证可被满足；二是旅游平台多采用分面检索界面，缺少自由文本查询日志，导致冷启动问题——既无需求侧对齐数据，请求时也无种子查询，只能从结构化上下文主动生成建议。
AI.method: SCOUT以供给侧系统反馈替代缺失的需求侧用户反馈；将搜索引擎视为强化学习环境，从生产环境reranker的查询-房源匹配分中构造稠密奖励，并采用GRPO（组相对策略优化）训练策略模型。
AI.result: IMR@18提升12.3%，同时保持建议多样性；效果与计算密集的best-of-8策略相当，但边际推理成本为零。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT使供给侧感知的查询建议可部署于实时旅游搜索链路，为缺乏查询日志的受限库存场景提供了可行的冷启动方案。

title: Generate What You Can Trust: Content Credibility in Generative Recommenders
summary: Generative recommendation (GR) represents items with semantic IDs (i.e., discrete token sequences) and generates target item tokens as recommendations. Despite its promising results, existing methods predominantly optimize for accuracy while neglecting the credibility of the recommendations they generate. This oversight inevitably exposes users to uncredible content (e.g., fake news) with serious societal consequences, including user distrust, reputation harm to platforms, and broader social instability. To address this critical yet underexplored challenge, we propose CreGR, the first credible GR model that jointly tackles content credibility across the two core stages of GR: tokenization and generation. In the tokenization stage, we design a new credibility-aware tokenizer that explicitly encourages the model to learn discriminative tokens respectively for credible and uncredible items, thereby disentangling credibility signals at the token level. Building on this, in the generation stage, we propose a novel accuracy-preserving and credibility-oriented generator grounded in discrete diffusion. Specifically, we introduce an asymmetric masking probability reduction strategy that selectively diminishes the contribution of tokens associated with uncredible content to the generation process, while leaving tokens encoding user preference signals unaffected so as to preserve recommendation accuracy. Experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of CreGR.

AI.tldr: 提出首个可信生成式推荐模型CreGR，在分词与生成两个阶段联合处理内容可信度问题。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐方法主要优化准确率，忽视推荐内容的可信度，导致用户暴露于虚假信息等不可信内容，带来用户不信任、平台声誉受损及社会不稳定等后果。
AI.method: CreGR在分词阶段设计可信度感知分词器，学习可信与不可信物品的判别性语义ID，在token层面解耦可信度信号；在生成阶段提出基于离散扩散的准确率保持且面向可信度的生成器，采用非对称掩码概率降低策略，选择性地削弱不可信内容相关token对生成的贡献，同时不影响编码用户偏好信号的token。
AI.result: 在三个真实数据集上的实验验证了CreGR的有效性。
AI.conclusion: CreGR作为首个可信生成式推荐模型，通过在分词和生成两阶段联合建模可信度，在保持推荐准确率的同时提升推荐可信度。

title: Beyond Semantic Similarity: Performance and Costs of Agentic Retrieval for Complex Tasks
summary: Modern information systems, including many agentic workflows, use dense retrieval to explore large amounts of unstructured data. However, dense retrieval relies on surface-level semantic similarity, which is insufficient for increasingly complex search applications. Here, we investigate agentic retrieval that combines the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) with the efficient corpus exploration of retrievers in a ReAct agentic loop to solve complex retrieval tasks. In our experiments, we show that agentic retrieval is more effective than standard retrieval, improving nDCG@10 by 8.7 points using the same embedding model. Moreover, while specialized retrieval methods struggle on out-of-domain tasks, agentic retrieval is highly generalizable: the same pipeline achieves competitive results on both the ViDoRe v3 and BRIGHT leaderboards. However, this improvement comes at a cost. On average, agentic retrieval takes 107.4 seconds, compared to 0.67 seconds for standard retrieval, and consumes 764.1K input and 5.8K output tokens per query. In short, our study demonstrates the effectiveness of agentic retrieval in modern data systems and motivates future work on more cost-efficient retrieval agents for large-scale deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"智能体检索"（agentic retrieval）：在ReAct智能体循环中结合LLM推理能力与检索器的高效语料探索，以解决复杂检索任务。实验表明其效果优于标准稠密检索且泛化性强，但延迟与token开销显著更高。
AI.motivation: 现代信息系统（含众多智能体工作流）需从大规模非结构化数据中检索信息，而稠密检索依赖表层语义相似度，难以支撑日益复杂的检索应用；同时专用检索方法在跨域任务上表现不佳，缺乏泛化能力。因此需要一种兼顾推理能力与语料探索效率的检索范式。
AI.method: 提出智能体检索：将LLM的推理能力与retriever的高效语料探索相结合，在ReAct式智能体循环中迭代完成复杂检索任务。实验以相同embedding模型为控制变量，对比标准（稠密）检索，并在ViDoRe v3与BRIGHT等基准上评估效果、泛化性及成本（延迟、输入/输出token）。
AI.result: 在相同embedding模型下，智能体检索较标准检索将nDCG@10提升8.7个点；同一条pipeline在ViDoRe v3与BRIGHT榜单上均取得有竞争力的结果，表现出强泛化性，而专用检索方法在域外任务上表现不佳。代价方面：平均延迟107.4秒（标准检索为0.67秒），每查询消耗764.1K输入token与5.8K输出token。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了智能体检索在现代数据系统中的有效性，同时揭示其高昂的延迟与token成本，未来工作应聚焦于面向大规模部署的更具成本效益的检索智能体。

title: Constraint-Aware Conversational Job Recommendation in Code-Mixed Low-Resource Settings
summary: Conversational job recommendation requires jointly modeling semantic relevance, user preferences, eligibility requirements, and the noisy language used in real-world career discussions. These challenges are especially pronounced in low-resource, code-mixed settings, where strict constraint matching can incorrectly eliminate otherwise suitable jobs. We introduce JobCCC, a conversational job recommendation benchmark for Bangladesh comprising 22,410 structured job postings and 988 multi-turn career-advice dialogues derived from regional Reddit communities. Each dialogue is annotated with evolving seeker preferences and linked to a ground-truth job, and is evaluated in semantically equivalent English and Romanized Bangla--English variants. We compare sparse BM25 retrieval, multilingual dense retrieval, and their hard-constraint-filtered counterparts against Weighted Soft-Constraint-Aware Ranking (W-SCAR), our multi-criteria ranking framework that combines lexical relevance, semantic relevance, and graded utilities for experience, location, education, and salary using the Technique for Order Preference by Similarity to Ideal Solution (TOPSIS). Experiments reveal that strict filtering consistently degrades retrieval because incomplete extraction and brittle attribute matching irreversibly remove relevant jobs. W-SCAR avoids destructive pruning and achieves more balanced performance across the two language conditions, obtaining 37.37% and 38.43% Hit@10 on English and Banglish, respectively. The code and dataset are publicly available at \href{https://github.com/M-Jawad01/Conversational-Job-Recommendation-System-LLM}{GitHub} and \href{https://huggingface.co/datasets/Armans33115/JobCCC-Conversational-Job-Recommendation-Bangladesh}{Hugging Face}, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出JobCCC——一个面向孟加拉国低资源、语码混合场景的对话式求职推荐基准，包含22,410条结构化职位和988段多轮职业咨询对话，并提出了W-SCAR软约束感知排序框架，其Hit@10在英语和Banglish上分别达到37.37%和38.43%，优于硬约束过滤方法。
AI.motivation: 对话式求职推荐需同时建模语义相关性、用户偏好、资格要求以及真实职业讨论中的噪声语言，而低资源、语码混合场景下这些挑战尤为突出，严格约束匹配会错误剔除原本合适的职位，因此需要一个针对性的基准与更稳健的排序方法。
AI.method: 构建JobCCC基准：22,410条结构化职位与988段来自区域Reddit社区的多轮职业咨询对话，每段对话标注演进的求职者偏好并链接真实职位，在语义等价的英语与罗马化孟加拉语—英语（Banglish）两个变体上评测。方法上对比稀疏BM25检索、多语言稠密检索及其硬约束过滤版本，并提出W-SCAR多准则排序框架，融合词汇相关性、语义相关性以及对经验、地点、教育、薪资的梯度效用，采用TOPSIS进行排序。
AI.result: 实验表明严格过滤会持续降低检索性能，因为不完整的抽取和脆弱的属性匹配会不可逆地移除相关职位；W-SCAR避免破坏性剪枝，在两种语言条件下表现更为均衡，英语与Banglish的Hit@10分别为37.37%和38.43%。
AI.conclusion: 在低资源、语码混合的对话式求职推荐中，软约束感知的多准则排序优于硬约束过滤；JobCCC为相关研究提供了基准，代码与数据集已公开。

title: MATE: Adaptive Long- and Short-Term User Memory for LLM-Based Recommendation
summary: Large language model (LLM)-enhanced recommender systems leverage rich item semantics to support personalized recommendation. However, semantic representations alone do not determine which historical behaviors reflect persistent preferences and which mainly indicate recent interests, leaving an important aspect of user understanding unresolved. Recent advances in LLM inference show that newly available information can be used to refine the internal state during inference, thereby improving subsequent predictions. Inspired by this principle, we propose MATE (Memory Adaptation with Temporal Evidence), an adaptive user modeling framework for LLM-enhanced sequential recommendation. MATE first evaluates each newly observed interaction from two temporal perspectives: whether it is repeatedly supported by historical behaviors and whether it is consistent with recent interactions. The resulting temporal evidence controls the updates of two user-specific memories, where the long-term memory conservatively preserves persistent preferences while the short-term memory rapidly adapts to recent interests. For each recommendation, a recent-context representation dynamically determines how strongly the two memories contribute to the current user representation. During offline training, next-item prediction is jointly optimized with temporal supervision, while during online adaptation, the shared model remains fixed and only the two user memories are updated from newly observed interactions. Experiments on MovieLens-10M, Amazon Luxury Beauty, and KuaiRec show that MATE improves mean NDCG@10 over the strongest external baseline by 7.0--13.2%. Further analyses support its ability to adapt to recent interests while retaining useful information about recurring earlier preferences.

AI.tldr: 提出 MATE 框架，通过时间证据调控长/短期记忆自适应更新，提升 LLM 增强序列推荐性能。
AI.motivation: LLM 增强推荐虽利用丰富物品语义，但仅凭语义表示无法区分哪些历史行为体现持久偏好、哪些仅反映近期兴趣，用户理解存在缺口；受 LLM 推理时可利用新信息精炼内部状态的启发，需要一种时间维度的自适应用户建模方法。
AI.method: MATE 对每个新观测交互从两个时间视角评估：是否被历史行为反复支持、是否与近期交互一致；所得时间证据控制两个用户专属记忆的更新——长期记忆保守保留持久偏好，短期记忆快速适应近期兴趣。推荐时由近期上下文表示动态决定两记忆对当前用户表示的贡献强度。离线训练联合优化下一项预测与时间监督；在线自适应阶段共享模型固定，仅更新两个用户记忆。
AI.result: 在 MovieLens-10M、Amazon Luxury Beauty 和 KuaiRec 上，MATE 相比最强外部基线将平均 NDCG@10 提升 7.0–13.2%；进一步分析支持其既能适应近期兴趣，又能保留反复出现的早期偏好信息。
AI.conclusion: MATE 通过时间证据驱动的双记忆机制有效解决 LLM 增强序列推荐中的偏好区分问题，实现近期兴趣适应与长期偏好保留的平衡。

title: Beyond States: Investigating the Effects of Context on User Modeling with Feature-Conditioned Markov Models
comment: This is the author's version of the work. It is posted here for your personal use. Not for redistribution. The definitive Version of Record was published in Proceedings of the 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26), dx.doi.org/10.1145/3799682.3840602
summary: User behavior simulation is widely used to evaluate interactive information retrieval systems, but classical state-based approaches (e.g., Markov models) have limited ability to incorporate contextual information relevant for decision-making. We address this limitation by introducing a feature-conditioned Markov-style user model, in which transition probabilities are modeled as functions of positional, content-based, and interaction-derived features, enabling context-aware decision making while preserving the structural simplicity and computational efficiency of state-based models. Applying a multi-level framework that assesses predictive fit and behavioral fidelity, we analyze how different sources of contextual information contribute to realistic user simulation across multiple datasets, search settings, and feature configurations. Our results show that incorporating contextual features improves the models' ability to reproduce key aspects of real user interactions, but that their effectiveness hinges on search scenario and modeling objective. Instead of a one-size-fits-all solution, effective simulation requires task- and setting-specific feature selection. Our framework provides a practical and interpretable basis for making these choices.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种特征条件化的马尔可夫式用户模型，将转移概率建模为位置、内容与交互特征函数，在保留状态模型简洁性与效率的同时引入上下文感知；并构建多层级评估框架，验证上下文特征能提升仿真真实性，但有效性依赖搜索场景与建模目标，需任务特定的特征选择。
AI.motivation: 用户行为仿真广泛用于交互式信息检索系统评估，但经典基于状态的方法（如马尔可夫模型）难以纳入对决策有用的上下文信息。
AI.method: 提出特征条件化马尔可夫式用户模型，转移概率为位置、内容与交互衍生特征的函数；采用多层次框架评估预测拟合度与行为保真度，并在多数据集、多搜索设置与多特征配置下分析不同上下文信息来源的贡献。
AI.result: 引入上下文特征可提升模型再现真实用户交互关键方面的能力，但其效果取决于搜索场景与建模目标。
AI.conclusion: 不存在通用方案，有效仿真需要任务与场景特定的特征选择；该框架为这些选择提供了实用且可解释的依据。

title: Commercial Intent in Human-AI Conversations: A Corpus Audit and Architecture for Website Sales Agents
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, 2 tables, 21 references. Technical white paper with an aggregate corpus audit and reference architecture; text-free aggregate counts and reproducibility code included as ancillary files
summary: Conversational sales agents must distinguish questions about products from purchase commitments, preserve explicit requirements, and ground the next action in current business information. We report an aggregate census of 725,219 records in an accessible conversation table provided by Aiso and develop a reference architecture for this setting. All records have distinct non-null conversation hashes. Existing metadata labels identify 41,800 commercial records (5.76%) and 2,387 transactional records (0.33%); their union contains 44,187 records (6.09%). Within the commercial category, 54.31% are labeled English, 41.59% have recorded depth of at least two, and 13.51% have depth of at least four. Commercial-label prevalence varies from 4.87% to 6.35% across three source batches. These measurements motivate explicit separation of corpus inventory, commercial relevance, training eligibility, and observed business outcomes. The proposed architecture combines business-grounded knowledge, provenance-bearing conversation state, and a constrained next-action policy. A quality specification addresses source rights, privacy, label validation, deduplication, and training-test separation. The study is a metadata audit and technical design, not a validation of label accuracy, model training volume, or sales conversion. No raw conversation text or personal identifiers are released.

AI.tldr: 本文对Aiso提供的725,219条对话记录进行元数据普查，并据此提出对话销售智能体的参考架构，强调须将语料库存、商业相关性、训练资格与业务结果显式分离。
AI.motivation: 对话销售智能体需区分产品咨询与购买承诺、保留明确需求，并基于当前业务信息决定下一步动作，但此类系统缺乏对可用数据规模的可靠盘点与清晰的架构规范。
AI.method: 对725,219条对话记录做聚合元数据审计：核验对话哈希唯一性，统计商业记录（41,800条，5.76%）与交易记录（2,387条，0.33%）及其并集（44,187条，6.09%），分析语言分布、对话深度与批次间标签流行度差异，并设计包含业务知识、带溯源的对话状态与受限下一步动作策略的参考架构及质量规范。
AI.result: 所有记录对话哈希均为非空且唯一；商业类中54.31%标注为英语，41.59%深度≥2，13.51%深度≥4；商业标签流行度在三个来源批次间为4.87%–6.35%。
AI.conclusion: 本研究属元数据审计与技术设计，未验证标签准确性、模型训练规模或销售转化，也未发布任何原始对话文本或个人标识；其核心贡献在于量化数据现状并确立四层概念分离与质量规范。

title: SPRIG: Semantic-ID-enhanced Paths for Knowledge Graph-based Generative Recommendation
comment: Accepted as a short paper at CIKM 2026. 5 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables
summary: Recommender systems leveraging generative models often generate item identifiers directly, rather than ranking catalog items by a recommendation score. Recent work extends beyond pure sequential interaction signals by incorporating item content and structured relationships among items, with two distinct directions emerging. Semantic IDs (SIDs) enrich item representations by replacing opaque, randomly initialized embeddings with hierarchically quantized discrete codes derived from item content. Knowledge-graph (KG) path reasoning instead generates entity-relation paths that ground recommendations in structured relationships between items, attributes, and external entities, thereby enriching the relational context. These two lines have complementary limitations: SID-based models lack relational grounding, while KG-based generative recommenders still represent items as arbitrary, opaque tokens tied to large embedding tables, limiting parameter sharing and generalization. We propose SPRIG, a generative recommender that integrates content-derived SIDs into KG path reasoning. SPRIG is trained on information-rich KG paths that terminate in items represented as discrete, content-derived tokens, combining the advantages of both approaches. We evaluate SPRIG on movie and music recommendation datasets against baselines spanning sequential language models, KG-augmented methods, and SID-based approaches. Our results show that SPRIG achieves competitive performance over prior generative models while using fewer parameters and a lower compute cost. Code: https://github.com/justinhangoebl/semantic-id-knowledge-graph-recommender

AI.tldr: SPRIG是一种生成式推荐模型，将内容派生的语义ID（SID）与知识图谱（KG）路径推理相融合，在电影和音乐推荐任务上以更少参数与更低计算成本取得有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式推荐存在两条互补但各有局限的路线：SID类模型用内容派生的分层量化离散码替代随机初始化嵌入，但缺乏关系性依据；KG路径推理类模型通过实体-关系路径引入结构化关系，却仍将物品表示为与大规模嵌入表绑定的不透明token，限制了参数共享与泛化能力。二者结合可互补短板。
AI.method: 提出SPRIG生成式推荐器，将内容派生的SID嵌入KG路径推理中。模型在信息丰富的KG路径上训练，路径终点为以离散、内容派生token表示的物品，从而同时获得内容语义与结构化关系上下文。
AI.result: 在电影与音乐推荐数据集上，与序列语言模型、KG增强方法及SID类方法等基线对比，SPRIG在参数更少、计算成本更低的情况下取得了与先前生成式模型相当（有竞争力）的性能。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SPRIG验证了将内容派生语义ID与知识图谱路径推理统一于生成式推荐框架的可行性与有效性，可在降低参数与计算开销的同时保持竞争性性能，为融合内容语义与结构化关系提供了新思路。

title: Reading the Mood: Emotion-Guided Book-to-Music Recommendation via CGANs and LLMs
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at SENTIRE 2026 (ICDM 2026 Workshops)
summary: Background music that matches the mood of a text has been shown to make readers feel more immersed and improve their reading experience, motivating recommender systems that pair books with mood-matched music. In this direction, we present Sentiment Aware Generative Adversarial Network for Cross Domain Recommendation (SAGA-CDR), a two-phase cross-domain recommendation framework that personalizes music suggestions and emotionally aligns them with the book being read. In the first phase, transformer-based sentiment embeddings are constructed from user reviews and mapped across domains via a Conditional Generative Adversarial Network, whose mask-conditioned generator handles missing sentiment components and injects stochasticity for richer preference transfer. A compact rating neural network then fuses sentiment-specific interaction scores with a collaborative filtering prior to predict music ratings. In the second phase, large language models classify each book into a valence-arousal emotional quadrant, and candidate tracks are filtered to match that quadrant. Experiments on both the English Amazon and Chinese Douban datasets show that SAGA-CDR achieves the best rating prediction accuracy on Amazon (RMSE 0.98) and the lowest RMSE on Douban (0.91), with ranking performance competitive with the strongest sentiment-aware baseline, even in cross-lingual settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SAGA-CDR两阶段跨域推荐框架，将书籍与情绪匹配的音乐配对，结合情感嵌入、条件GAN与LLM情绪象限分类，实现个性化且情感对齐的音乐推荐。
AI.motivation: 贴合文本情绪的背景音乐能提升读者的沉浸感与阅读体验，因此需要能够将书籍与情绪匹配音乐配对的推荐系统。然而，跨域推荐中情感信息存在缺失与跨语言迁移问题，需要一种兼顾情感对齐与偏好迁移的方法。
AI.method: 提出SAGA-CDR两阶段跨域推荐框架。第一阶段：基于Transformer从用户评论构建情感嵌入，通过条件生成对抗网络（C-GAN）跨域映射，其掩码条件生成器处理缺失的情感成分并注入随机性以丰富偏好迁移；随后由紧凑的评分神经网络将情感交互分数与协同过滤先验融合，预测音乐评分。第二阶段：利用大语言模型将每本书分类到效价-唤醒（valence-arousal）情绪象限，并据此过滤候选曲目以匹配该象限。
AI.result: 在英文Amazon和中文豆瓣数据集上的实验表明，SAGA-CDR在Amazon上取得最佳评分预测精度（RMSE 0.98），在豆瓣上取得最低RMSE（0.91），其排序性能与最强的情感感知基线相当，且在跨语言场景下依然具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SAGA-CDR通过情感感知的跨域生成式建模与基于大语言模型的情绪象限匹配，有效实现了书籍-音乐的情感对齐个性化推荐，并在多语言数据集上验证了其在评分预测与排序方面的有效性。

title: Fine-Grained Emotion Classification from Mobile App Reviews: An Empirical Study with Large Language Models
summary: Context: Fine-grained emotion classification of mobile app reviews enables requirements engineering activities that go beyond polarity-based opinion mining, including emotionally informed issue prioritisation and feature-oriented feedback analysis. However, automatic fine-grained emotion extraction from app reviews remains understudied. Objectives: Building on a previously published annotation framework and human-labelled ground truth adapted from Plutchik's taxonomy, this paper investigates how large language models can be leveraged for automatic multi-label emotion classification under severe class imbalance. Methods: We compare encoder-only fine-tuning under multi-label and binary-ensemble formulations, decoder-only zero- and few-shot prompting across open-source and proprietary models, and a catalogue of imbalance mitigation strategies (loss reweighting, resampling, generative data augmentation), with the synthetic-review generator and prompting strategy selected via an intrinsic augmentation-utility ranking. Results: Fine-tuned encoders trail the best decoder-only few-shot prompting (macro-F1 0.642) by a wide margin at baseline (multi-label: 0.387; binary ensemble: 0.450); pairing the best multi-label encoder with generative data augmentation and positive-weighted loss closes most of this gap (+0.204) at up to three orders of magnitude lower inference latency than the decoders, with the largest gains on the rarest emotions, from undetected to gains of up to +0.501 F1. Conclusion: Large language models make fine-grained, multi-label emotion classification of app reviews feasible for requirements engineering pipelines, with modest macro-F1, and the best formulation and mitigation strategy are backbone- and formulation-dependent. We release the experimental pipeline, synthetic corpora, and fine-tuned checkpoints for replication and reuse.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索用大语言模型对移动应用评论进行细粒度多标签情感分类，并比较编码器微调与解码器提示、以及多种类别不平衡缓解策略的效果。
AI.motivation: 应用评论的细粒度情感分类可支持超越极性情感分析的需求工程活动（如情感驱动的议题优先级排序与面向特征的反馈分析），但自动细粒度情感抽取仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 基于既有标注框架与人工标注的Plutchik分类体系真值，比较三类方法：编码器多标签微调与二分类集成微调、解码器零样本与少样本提示（开源与专有模型）、以及不平衡缓解策略（损失重加权、重采样、生成式数据增强），其中合成评论生成器与提示策略通过内在增强效用排序选择。
AI.result: 微调编码器基线显著落后于最佳解码器少样本提示（macro-F1 0.642；多标签 0.387，二分类集成 0.450）；将最佳多标签编码器与生成式数据增强及正类加权损失结合可缩小大部分差距（+0.204），推理延迟低至解码器的三个数量级以下，且在稀有情感上增益最大（从未检出提升至最多 +0.501 F1）。
AI.conclusion: 大语言模型使应用评论的细粒度多标签情感分类在需求工程流程中可行，但macro-F1 仅为中等水平，最佳方案与缓解策略依赖骨干模型与任务形式；作者发布实验流程、合成语料与微调检查点以供复现和复用。

title: Periscope: Extending Frozen Language Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: A language model reads long text in one quadratic forward pass, stops at the context window, and loses accuracy with length before reaching it. We ask whether the read can be factorized when deciding over a finite set: which document is relevant, which option is supported, which passage is the evidence. Periscope, a training-free inference method, arranges the $N$ chunks of a text on a $K{\times}K$ grid with $K{=}\lceil\sqrt{N}\rceil$ and asks a frozen model the same question about $K$ local spans of consecutive chunks and $K$ strided spans that sample the whole text, reading the log-odds of every answer at one token. Each answer takes its best local and strided score, and scoring every chunk by its two spans gives an evidence map at no further cost, whose peak is the chunk behind the answer. Every probe is about $\sqrt{sc}$ tokens for a text of $s$ tokens and chunk size $c$, so a window of $W$ tokens reaches $W^{2}/c$ tokens at $s^{1.5}$ cost. The map replaces the long read. On LongBench v2, reading only the $K$ chunks the map ranks highest, 9k tokens, matches the same model's best window read across windows from 32k to 1M tokens, and on InfiniteBench, where the median context is 150k tokens, it leads the best window read by 5 points. The same map ranks BRIGHT's long-document corpora with the best NDCG@10 of six methods. Each call caches only one probe, so a 27B model reads 4.5M-token contexts on one 80GB GPU, where a single pass would need 296GB of cache. A long read then needs a GPU that holds the model, not one that holds the text.

AI.tldr: Periscope是一种免训练推理方法，将长文本分块排成K×K网格，用冻结模型对局部与跨步span提出同一问题，按最优分数聚合，实现长文本高效阅读与证据定位。
AI.motivation: 长文本语言模型在单次二次前向传播中受限于上下文窗口，且随长度增加准确率下降。作者探究：在有限集合上做决策时（如哪篇文档相关、哪个选项成立、哪段为证据），长文本阅读能否被因子化，从而避免完整长读。
AI.method: Periscope将N个块排成K×K网格（K=⌈√N⌉），对K个连续块局部span和K个跨步span询问同一问题，在单一token读取每个答案的log-odds；每个答案取其最优局部与跨步得分；再以各块的两个span打分生成证据图。每个探针约√(sc) tokens（文本s tokens、块大小c），因此W token窗口以s^1.5成本覆盖W^2/c tokens。
AI.result: 在LongBench v2上，仅读证据图排名最高的K个块（9k tokens）即可匹配同模型32k至1M窗口的最佳窗口读取；在InfiniteBench（中位上下文150k tokens）上领先最佳窗口读取5分；同一证据图在BRIGHT长文档语料上取得六种方法中最优NDCG@10。每次调用只缓存一个探针，27B模型可在单张80GB GPU上读取4.5M-token上下文，而单次完整前向需296GB缓存。
AI.conclusion: 证据图可替代长文本完整读取；长文本读取所需的是能容纳模型的GPU，而非能容纳文本的GPU。

title: Cross-Modal Contrastive Learning for the Retrieval of Immunotherapy-Associated Molecular Signatures from Histopathology
summary: Gastric Adenocarcinoma is a leading cause of cancer mortality. Although "Inflamed/Non-Inflamed" subtypes have been proposed to predict immunotherapy response, their identification relies on a costly 10-gene RNA signature. We propose a Cross-modal Contrastive Multiple Instance Learning (CCMIL) framework for cross-modal retrieval, imputing these molecular signatures directly from standard Hematoxylin & Eosin (H&E) slides. By leveraging a supervised contrastive objective, CCMIL aligns visual morphological patterns with molecular phenotypes into a shared latent space. This establishes an interpretable search-by-case retrieval engine, enabling pathologists to query a whole slide image to surface transcriptomically coherent neighbors and approximate RNA signatures without genomic sequencing at inference. Our results demonstrate that this retrieval-first approach captures the continuous phenotypic spectrum of tumor inflammation and yields clinically interpretable attention heatmaps. Furthermore, the learned representation also supports competitive downstream classification, providing a practical molecular pre-screening strategy.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出跨模态对比多实例学习(CCMIL)框架，利用标准H&E病理切片直接推断胃腺癌的分子炎症表型，无需RNA测序。
AI.motivation: 胃腺癌是癌症致死的主要原因。虽有"炎症/非炎症"亚型可预测免疫治疗反应，但其识别依赖昂贵的10基因RNA特征，成本高、难以普及，亟需低成本替代方案。
AI.method: 提出跨模态对比多实例学习(CCMIL)框架：以监督对比目标将视觉形态学模式与分子表型对齐到共享潜在空间，实现跨模态检索，从H&E切片直接推断分子特征。
AI.result: 检索优先的方法捕捉了肿瘤炎症的连续表型谱，生成临床可解释的注意力热图；所学表征支持具有竞争力的下游分类，可作为实用的分子预筛策略。
AI.conclusion: CCMIL建立了可解释的"按病例检索"引擎，使病理学家无需基因组测序即可查询全切片图像、找到转录组一致的邻近样本并近似RNA特征，为分子预筛提供了实用方案。

title: MemStrata: 95% and 90.91% Source-Aware Accuracy on LongMemEval-500 and LoCoMo-1540 with a Local Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M Reader
comment: 29 pages, 23 tables, 1 figure. Ancillary files contain per-question grades and reproducible analyses, plus explicitly labelled exports from audited follow-up reports
summary: An adequate conversational answer may differ from a short or incomplete benchmark reference. To measure adequacy against the recorded history we prefer source-aware grading, in which the judge checks the reference against the full source before assessing system-blinded answers; original reference-only grading is reported alongside. With a local Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M reader and a 24,000-token evidence ceiling, MemStrata CL1 scores 475/500 (95.0%) on LongMemEval-S and 1,400/1,540 (90.91%) on LoCoMo categories 1-4 under source-aware GPT-5.5 adjudication, against 463/500 (92.6%) and 1,205/1,540 (78.25%) under reference-only grading of the same answers. It preserves a retrieval backbone and adds nonduplicated, dated, speaker-attributed source spans. A same-reader full-history control with about 4.7 times the evidence scores 464/500 reference-only and 470/500 (94.0%) source-aware; neither difference is decisive. Keyword-only selection at the same budget scores 425, and a matched-reader Letta arm 438. On LongMemEval-M, where the packet holds about 1.6% of each history, MemStrata CL1 scores 427/500, with losses concentrated in multi-session and temporal questions. On 300 BEAM-1M questions it outscores dense retrieval, 0.738 to 0.706 (Wilcoxon p = 0.011). A same-seed replay of unchanged requests changed 1.5-2.3% of labels. On identical packets GLM 5.3 flash is non-inferior within 3 points (462 versus 463); Muse Spark 1.3 did not show non-inferiority on 269 questions. None of four pre-registered interventions met all of its registered advancement or feasibility criteria. Signed read-side artifacts support inspection but do not regenerate the private retrieval pipeline. The superiority of source-aware grading to human adjudication is not established, and development exposure, automated-judge dependence and the absence of held-out data preclude an independent-replication or leaderboard claim.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MemStrata CL1：一种基于“源感知”评判的检索增强记忆系统，在 LongMemEval 与 LoCoMo 上优于仅参考评分，但四项预注册干预均未达标，结论受限于开发暴露与自动评判依赖。
AI.motivation: 短小或不完整的基准参考答案难以衡量真实对话答案的充分性，因此需以完整对话历史（源）为参照进行源感知评分，并据此重新评估记忆系统在长对话基准上的表现与检索设计价值。
AI.method: 在保留检索骨干的基础上，MemStrata CL1 加入去重、带日期与说话人归属的源片段（span）；以本地 Qwen 3.8 27B Q4_K_M 为阅读器、证据上限 24,000 token，采用源感知 GPT-5.5 评判，并与仅参考评分并列报告；设置同阅读器全历史对照（约 4.7 倍证据）、同预算关键词选择、匹配阅读器的 Letta 对照，以及 GLM 5.3 flash、Muse Spark 1.3 等评判/模型对照，并开展同种子重放与四项预注册干预检验。
AI.result: LongMemEval-S 上 475/500（95.0%）源感知 vs 463/500（92.6%）仅参考；LoCoMo 类别 1-4 为 1,400/1,540（90.91%）vs 1,205/1,540（78.25%）。全历史对照 470/500（94.0%）源感知、464/500 仅参考，差异不具决定性；关键词选择 425，Letta 臂 438。LongMemEval-M（包约占历史 1.6%）得 427/500，损失集中于多会话与时间类问题；BEAM-1M 上 0.738 对 0.706（Wilcoxon p=0.011）。同种子重放标签变动 1.5-2.3%；GLM 5.3 flash 在相同包上非劣（462 vs 463，3 点内），Muse Spark 1.3 在 269 题上未显示非劣。四项预注册干预均未满足全部晋级或可行性标准。
AI.conclusion: 源感知评分优于仅参考评分，但相对人类裁决的优越性尚未确立；由于开发暴露、自动评判依赖及缺少留出数据，无法支持独立复现或排行榜式主张。签名读侧工件可支持检查，但不能重新生成私有检索流程。

title: Cut Binary Cross Entropy: Efficient Large-Vocabulary Loss and Gradient Kernels for Sequential Recommendation
summary:
Industrial sequential recommender systems operate over massive item catalogs (e.g., 10^5--10^7 items). Multi-label recommendation models are trained with Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE) loss over the full vocabulary, but standard BCE materializes a dense [B, N, V] logits tensor in High Bandwidth Memory (HBM), incurring prohibitive $O(BNV)$ memory and fatal Out-Of-Memory (OOM) errors. While chunked loss optimizations exist for Softmax Cross-Entropy in LLMs, large-scale multi-label BCE optimization remains unexplored across deep learning ecosystems.
  We propose CutBCE, an exact, hardware-accelerated BCE loss and gradient operator implemented in JAX and Pallas for large-vocabulary workloads. CutBCE introduces (1) an exact fused reformulation evaluating dense background loss and sparse target corrections; (2) a custom Vector-Jacobian Product (VJP) with a dedicated Pallas TPU backward kernel computing logit tiles on-chip in both passes so logits and their gradients never reside in HBM; (3) dynamic VMEM budgeting and sharding-aware collective hoisting for distributed meshes; and (4) count-based zero-overhead training metrics. On single-chip TPU v5e/v6e mini-benchmarks, CutBCE eliminates OOM errors with up to 91.9% speedup. On 8-chip TPU slice training for multi-label SASRec with 876k items (Yambda-50M), CutBCE reduces peak HBM by 65.7% (>14 GiB saved per chip) and increases training speed by 225.9% with comparable accuracy. CutBCE is open-sourced at https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/RecML/blob/main/recml/core/ops/binary_cross_entropy_ops.py.

AI.tldr: 提出CutBCE——JAX/Pallas实现的精确、硬件加速的多标签BCE损失与梯度算子，通过融合重写、定制VJP与TPU隐核，避免logits及其梯度驻留HBM，在大词表推荐场景消除OOM并显著提升速度、降低显存。
AI.motivation: 工业级序列推荐词表规模巨大（10^5–10^7项），多标签模型用全词表BCE训练时需物化稠密[B,N,V] logits张量，导致O(BNV)显存开销与致命OOM。LLM领域已有分块Softmax交叉熵优化，但大规模多标签BCE优化在深度学习生态中尚属空白。
AI.method: CutBCE包含四点设计：(1) 精确融合重写，分别计算稠密背景损失与稀疏目标修正；(2) 定制Vector-Jacobian Product（VJP）及专用Pallas TPU反向核，在前向与反向两遍均片上计算logit tile，使logits及其梯度不进入HBM；(3) 动态VMEM预算分配与分片感知的集合通信提升（collective hoisting），适配分布式mesh；(4) 基于计数的零开销训练指标。
AI.result: 单芯片TPU v5e/v6e小规模基准中，CutBCE消除OOM并取得最高91.9%加速。8芯片TPU切片上训练876k项的多标签SASRec（Yambda-50M），峰值HBM降低65.7%（每芯片节省超14 GiB），训练速度提升225.9%，精度相当。
AI.conclusion: CutBCE以精确、显存高效的算子形式解决了大词表多标签BCE的显存与效率瓶颈，兼容分布式TPU mesh且保持精度，已开源，可推广至工业级序列推荐训练。

title: PACMI: Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation for Long-Term LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents rely on long-term memory to retain and reuse information when performing tasks over long horizons. Existing methods provide limited support for handling memories that become outdated as new observations or domain evidence arrive. Such outdated memories may remain semantically relevant, continue to affect dependent records, and retain value as historical evidence. This calls for two capabilities: dependency tracking to identify downstream effects and historical preservation to retain useful past records. We propose Provenance-Aware Cascading Memory Invalidation (PACMI), a framework that represents memories and new evidence in a provenance graph with typed dependency edges. PACMI assigns records to a four-state validity lattice, propagates validity changes to dependent memories, and uses the resulting states for retrieval and stale-premise detection. We also introduce a diagnostic benchmark with 100 cases and 300 queries across five domains. The evaluation separates node, context-, and answer-level performance. PACMI achieves the highest final-answer accuracy on this benchmark, and its paired difference from the strongest baseline is significant under an exact McNemar test. The premise checker achieves perfect precision, recall, and F 1 on the controlled query distribution. Cascading propagation primarily improves memorystate correctness: removing it increases final-answer errors from 3 to 11, but the paired difference does not reach the 0.05 significance threshold. Code and data will be made publicly available.
