Across Models Under Pressure, LASR refusal prediction, immutable AgentDojo, and a prospectively protocol-frozen ST-WebAgentBench replication, joint activation-observable monitors reach AUROC 0.957 and 0.935 on the first two benchmarks, yet their locked 5%/10% detection rates are only .642/.742 and .719/.782, respectively. On AgentDojo, the secondary mean-activation rollout monitor reaches AUROC 0.922 but detects none of 38 positive semantic cases at the locked 5% operating point; thresholds intended for 10% false alarms realize 18.7-20.0% on test. Because the test misses its prospectively frozen 40-positive support gate, we label it support-insufficient. On ST-WebAgentBench, activation reaches AUROC .874, but 23 independent calibration negatives cannot identify even a 10% controller; the locked policy abstains rather than reporting its mechanical zero FPR as a success. An exploratory counterexample also lowers full AUROC while improving realized 10% utility. The fail-closed compiler caps MUP and LASR at restricted predictive value and AgentDojo and ST-Web at representation accessibility; no setting reaches alarm-policy validity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"操作有效性契约"（Operational Validity Contract），指出激活探针的AUROC与部署监控器在严格误报预算下的阈值告警决策是两个不同的估计量，并论证当前方法无法达到"告警策略有效性"。
AI.motivation: 既有激活探针虽能高AUROC预测安全相关属性，但部署中的智能体监控器需要在低误报预算下做阈值化告警决策；二者估计目标不同，导致高AUROC指标被误当成功，而实际语义单元级别的告警风险未被识别。
AI.method: 提出操作有效性契约，固定监控器的目标、可观测性、身份、时机、干预单元、比较对象、校准与成本；将风险形式化到语义请求或轨迹级别；要求置信认证阈值需足够的独立负单元、平局安全规则及向部署的迁移。在Models Under Pressure、LASR拒绝预测、AgentDojo及预注册协议冻结的ST-WebAgentBench复制上评估联合激活可观测监控器。
AI.result: 前两个基准上联合激活可观测监控器AUROC达0.957和0.935，但锁定5%/10%检测率仅.642/.742和.719/.782；AgentDojo次级均值激活rollout监控器AUROC为0.922，却在锁定5%操作点未检出38个阳性语义案例中任何一个，原定10%误报阈值实测为18.7-20.0%；ST-WebAgentBench激活AUROC为.874，但23个独立校准负单元无法识别10%控制器，锁定策略选择弃权而非报告机械零FPR为成功。探索性反例在降低完整AUROC的同时改善实际10%效用。失败关闭编译器将各设置分别限制在有限预测价值或表示可及性，无一达到告警策略有效性。
AI.conclusion: AUROC与部署所需的阈值化告警策略有效性不可混同；在严格误报预算下，现有激活监控器普遍无法通过操作有效性契约，需按语义单元风险、校准独立性与迁移性重新评估。

title: SIFT: Robust Meta-Faithfulness Verification of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Under Distribution Shift
comment: Under review as a conference paper at ICLR 2027
summary: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) faithfulness detectors are widely used to audit reasoning models, yet a detector is itself a predictor whose verdicts are treated as stable properties. We ask whether a detector is faithful to itself under distribution shift. We formalize meta-faithfulness as an invariance principle: a valid detector must return identical verdicts on traces that differ only by transformations preserving ground-truth faithfulness. We prove three results: (i) no detector using only intervention-response profiles can separate faithful from epiphenomenal mechanisms with identical signatures; (ii) any detector relying on shift-sensitive features violates invariance at a rate independent of its in-distribution accuracy; (iii) an asymptotic certified selective-risk guarantee enables confident abstention. We operationalize the principle in FaithShift, a stress-test protocol spanning ten shift axes, and propose SIFT, a hidden-state trajectory detector trained with cross-environment invariance objectives and certified abstention. Across 14,996 traces, four domains, and eight models, three findings emerge. First, transfer collapse is real: all existing detectors show gaps $\geq 0.15$ AUROC. Second, the dominant bottleneck is sampling stochasticity, not shift: over 80% of detector instability stems from random seed variation, falsifying our preregistered prediction that shift-attributable violations exceed 0.25. Third, SIFT cuts invariance violations by 64% over the best single-seed baseline, but a four-seed ensemble of any detector narrows the margin to 0.01 (indistinguishable at matched coverage, $p=0.21$), and SIFT needs a 51% abstention rate. Cross-model transfer degrades from within-family to cross-family to open-weight-to-API, partly closed by multi-model training. We offer a framework for auditing auditors: the real barrier is detector variance, not distribution shift.

AI.tldr: 本文将"检测器自身的忠实性"形式化为元忠实性不变性原则，提出FaithShift压力测试协议与SIFT检测器，经14,996条轨迹实验发现：检测器不稳定的主因是采样随机性而非分布偏移，且任一检测器的四种子集成即可抹平SIFT优势。
AI.motivation: CoT忠实性检测器被广泛用于审计推理模型，但其判决被默认当作稳定性质。作者追问：检测器在分布偏移下是否对自身忠实？即检测器能否在仅经受保持真值忠实性的变换时给出相同判决。
AI.method: 形式化元忠实性为不变性原则（保留真值忠实性的变换应产生相同判决）；证明三条理论结果；提出FaithShift十轴压力测试协议与SIFT隐状态轨迹检测器（跨环境不变性目标训练+认证弃权），在14,996条轨迹、4个领域、8个模型上验证。
AI.result: 现有检测器迁移AUROC差距≥0.15；超80%的不稳定性来自随机种子而非分布偏移，证伪了"偏移归因违规>0.25"的预注册预测；SIFT将不变性违规降低64%，但任一种子集成法把差距缩到0.01（匹配覆盖率下p=0.21不可区分），且SIFT需51%弃权率；跨模型迁移从族内到跨族再到开放权重到API逐步退化。
AI.conclusion: 审计审计者的真正障碍是检测器方差而非分布偏移；单模型方法优势在多种子集成下不显著，提示评估应控制随机性并报告弃权-覆盖率代价。

title: Stance Drift: How AI-mediated Communication Distorts Our Message
summary: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly mediate human communication, from drafting emails to summarizing scientific reports, yet whether they faithfully preserve a speaker's position remains largely untested. We model AI-mediated communication as a two-step generation-extraction pipeline: one LLM produces an argument from a specified stance, and a second LLM extracts the stance from that argument. We represent the pipeline as a probabilistic state transition over five Likert-type stance categories and define the stance preservation rate (SPR) as the average probability that the extracted stance matches the initial stance. Across 112 debate propositions, none of the nine LLMs tested exceeded an SPR of 0.7 under the default configuration. Three drift patterns accounted for most of the drift: polarization, deviation from neutrality, and flipping. Among the mitigation strategies tested, including in-context learning, multiple extraction with shuffled options, assertion, and reflection, only adding medium reasoning effort to a reflection prompt for GPT-5.4 substantially improved the SPR, to 0.775, yet polarization remained the largest pattern, with 0.119 of the transition mass. An exploratory comparison with human extraction on a single proposition suggests that drift arises at both the generation and the extraction stage. These results point to a fidelity gap in AI-mediated communication, with implications for journalism, policy deliberation, scientific communication, and other domains where opinion-laden messages pass through language models.

AI.tldr: 该研究将AI媒介传播建模为"生成-抽取"两步流程，提出立场保持率（SPR）指标，发现九种LLM在112个辩论命题上SPR均未超过0.7，立场漂移主要表现为极化、偏离中立和翻转三种模式。
AI.motivation: LLM日益充当人类传播的中介（如起草邮件、总结科学报告），但其是否忠实保留说话者立场基本未经检验，存在传播保真度的潜在缺口。
AI.method: 将AI媒介传播建模为两步"生成-抽取"流水线：第一个LLM依据指定立场生成论证，第二个LLM从该论证中抽取立场；以五级Likert立场类别上的概率状态转移表示该流程，定义SPR为抽取立场与初始立场匹配的平均概率。测试九种LLM、112个辩论命题，并比较上下文学习、打乱选项的多次抽取、断言与反思等缓解策略。
AI.result: 默认配置下无任何模型SPR超过0.7；漂移主要由极化、偏离中立、翻转三种模式构成。仅对GPT-5.4在反思提示中加入中等推理努力能显著提升SPR至0.775，但极化仍为最大漂移模式（转移质量0.119）。对单一命题的人类抽取探索性比较表明，漂移在生成与抽取两个阶段均会出现。
AI.conclusion: AI媒介传播存在保真度缺口，对新闻业、政策审议、科学传播等观点负载信息经语言模型传递的领域具有重要启示。

title: Does Neural Complexity Improve Health Misinformation Detection? A Leakage-Controlled Cross-Corpus Benchmark
comment: 18 pages, 3 tables. Reproducibility materials and source code are available from the author
summary: Increasing architectural complexity is often assumed to improve health misinformation detection, yet reported gains are difficult to interpret when studies use different corpora, preprocessing pipelines, data splits, and leakage controls. This study provides a controlled cross-corpus benchmark of five compact neural architectures (1D-CNN, LSTM, BiLSTM, CNN-LSTM, and CNN-BiLSTM), a soft-voting neural ensemble, and three classical machine-learning baselines using COVID19-FNIR and CONSTRAINT. Exact-text duplicate controls were applied before modelling; all neural systems used a common preprocessing and optimisation protocol, and neural results were repeated across three random seeds. On COVID19-FNIR, the deep ensemble achieved a mean macro-F1 of 0.9963 and ROC-AUC of 0.9994, while individual neural models ranged from 0.9945 to 0.9957 macro-F1. On CONSTRAINT, the ensemble achieved macro-F1 of 0.9272 and ROC-AUC of 0.9811, whereas a linear SVM achieved macro-F1 of 0.9574 and ROC-AUC of 0.9931. Architecture rankings changed across corpora, and simple sparse linear models remained highly competitive. The findings show that model complexity does not provide a stable performance advantage and that benchmark construction can dominate architecture choice. The study contributes a reproducible, leakage-controlled basis for evidence-driven model selection in health misinformation classification

AI.tldr: 本文对五种紧凑神经网络架构（1D-CNN、LSTM、BiLSTM、CNN-LSTM、CNN-BiLSTM）、一个软投票神经集成及三种经典机器学习基线，在COVID19-FNIR与CONSTRAINT两个语料上进行了受控的跨语料基准评测，采用统一的预处理与优化协议、精确文本去重控制及三种随机种子重复实验。结果显示，模型复杂度并未带来稳定的性能优势，且基准构建方式的影响可能超过架构选择本身。
AI.motivation: 文献中普遍假设架构复杂度提升可改善健康虚假信息检测，但由于各研究使用的语料、预处理流程、数据划分及泄漏控制各不相同，所报告的增益难以解释与比较。因此需要一个受控的跨语料基准，以厘清架构选择与基准构建各自对性能的贡献。
AI.method: 构建受控跨语料基准：选用COVID19-FNIR与CONSTRAINT两个数据集；建模前施加精确文本重复控制以抑制泄漏；所有神经模型共享统一的预处理与优化协议；神经结果在三个随机种子下重复。评测对象包括五种紧凑神经架构（1D-CNN、LSTM、BiLSTM、CNN-LSTM、CNN-BiLSTM）、一个软投票神经集成，以及三种经典机器学习基线。
AI.result: 在COVID19-FNIR上，深度集成取得平均macro-F1为0.9963、ROC-AUC为0.9994，单个神经模型macro-F1在0.9945至0.9957之间。在CONSTRAINT上，集成取得macro-F1为0.9272、ROC-AUC为0.9811，而线性SVM取得macro-F1为0.9574、ROC-AUC为0.9931。架构排序在不同语料间发生变化，简单稀疏线性模型保持高度竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 模型复杂度并不提供稳定的性能优势，基准构建方式的影响可能主导架构选择。本研究为健康虚假信息分类中基于证据的模型选择提供了一个可复现、受泄漏控制的比较基础。

title: Grounding Probes: Generator-Independent Hallucination Detection from Observer Model Hidden States
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Code and per-sample predictions: https://github.com/MRathmayr/LettuceDetect
summary: Detecting responses that retrieval-augmented generation does not ground in its context trades speed against accuracy: surface checks miss paraphrased fabrication, sampling-based methods cost extra generations. Hidden-state probes sit between the two, but every existing one reads the generating model's own activations, so a change of generator invalidates the detector and a closed-weight generator is out of reach. This paper removes that coupling. The Grounding Probe is logistic regression over the mean-pooled middle-layer hidden states of an observer language model that reads the context, question, and response in one forward pass and generates nothing, with the recipe it needs: pool over response tokens, read a middle layer, and control capacity, which closes the train-test AUROC gap from 0.087-0.202 to 0.009-0.013. Asking the observer outright, rather than reading its hidden state, costs at least +0.166 AUROC in every one of four models. Fitted on 15,090 annotated responses it reaches 0.879-0.894 AUROC on RAGTruth test across four observers, and 0.924 AUROC with 0.820 F1@0.5 averaged with a supervised span detector, 0.060 above that detector alone. One probe holds across six generators, and hold-out controls, including one in which no evaluation prompt appears in training, bound the cost of removing a generator at about 0.02 AUROC. Code, probes, and predictions are released.

AI.tldr: 提出Grounding Probe，用独立观察者模型的中间层隐藏状态做逻辑回归，检测RAG中未落地于上下文的生成，摆脱对被检测生成器权重与激活的依赖。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG忠实度检测存在速度与精度权衡：表层检查漏掉改写式捏造，采样法需额外生成；隐藏状态探针介于两者之间，但都读取生成模型自身激活，导致更换生成器即失效，且无法用于闭源权重模型。
AI.method: 用观察者语言模型一次性前向读取上下文、问题与回答且不生成内容；对回答token的中间层隐藏状态做平均池化，再以逻辑回归拟合探针。配方要点：池化回答token、读中层、控制容量。
AI.result: 15,090条标注数据训练后，在RAGTruth测试集上四观察者达0.879-0.894 AUROC；与有监督跨度检测器平均后达0.924 AUROC、0.820 F1@0.5，较单独检测器高0.060。单一探针跨六种生成器有效；容量控制将训练-测试AUROC差距从0.087-0.202降至0.009-0.013；直接询问观察者比读其隐藏状态至少低+0.166 AUROC；去除生成器依赖的代价约0.02 AUROC。
AI.conclusion: 通过将探针与生成器解耦，该方法在保持高精度与低开销的同时实现了跨生成器泛化，适用于闭源模型场景，并公开代码、探针与预测结果。

title: Extracting Persona Subspaces Through Iterative Nullspace Projection For Modulation
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can adopt distinct personas to tune their semantics, expertise, and perspective to different users and tasks. Precise control over these traits is critical to ensure safety and reliability in model behavior. Existing methods like activation steering and prompt-based persona induction reduce a persona to a single dominant direction, missing the finer, nested traits that emerge only once that dominant signal is factored out. We introduce modulation as a setting where the persona context is already embedded in the content being manipulated, requiring control methods to amplify or suppress a trait already present rather than inject it from scratch. PaSS is an inference-time control paradigm that models personas as multi-dimensional subspaces in a model's latent space without supervised contrastive examples. The persona subspaces are extracted via iterative concept erasure and applied to modulate persona-guided generation without retraining. To extract this subspace, we use Iterative Nullspace Projections (INLP) to linearly and iteratively isolate persona-specific directions. We causally evaluate six personas against diverse tasks like MATH-500, TinyAlpaca, GSM8K, and IFEval, showing that discriminative, iterative subspace extraction captures diverse traits underlying a given persona, enabling stronger and larger modulation than single-direction additive methods, while maintaining content fidelity. We further study individual peeled directions within each subspace to uncover the distinct aspects of persona behavior they encode. Overall, we show that persona subspaces offer a controllable, interpretable, and generalizable framework for modulating LLM behavior without sacrificing task performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"调制(modulation)"设定与PaSS框架，将人格建模为潜空间中的多维子空间，通过迭代零空间投影(INLP)提取人格方向，实现推理时无需重训的人格调制。
AI.motivation: 现有方法（激活引导、基于提示的人格诱导）将人格简化为单一主方向，忽略了仅在剔除主信号后才显现的、嵌套的细粒度特质；且调制设定下人格上下文已嵌入内容中，需要放大或抑制已有特质而非从零注入。因此需要能捕获多维人格特质的控制方法。
AI.method: 提出推理时控制范式PaSS：无需监督对比样本，将人格建模为模型潜空间中的多维子空间。使用迭代零空间投影(INLP)线性、迭代地剥离人格专属方向，通过迭代概念擦除提取人格子空间，并在不重训的情况下将其应用于调制人格引导的生成。因果评估六种人格，在MATH-500、TinyAlpaca、GSM8K、IFEval等任务上验证，并研究子空间内各剥离方向的独立编码作用。
AI.result: 相比单方向加性方法，判别式、迭代式子空间提取能捕获单一人格下的多样特质，实现更强、更大幅度的调制，同时保持内容保真度；各剥离方向可解释地编码人格行为的不同侧面，且任务性能不受损。
AI.conclusion: 人格子空间为调制LLM行为提供了可控、可解释且可泛化的框架，在不牺牲任务性能的前提下实现精细人格控制。

title: Steering Speech-Language Models: Training-Free Task Specialization via Contrastive Activation Addition
summary: Activation steering has proven effective for controlling the behavior of Large Language Models (LLMs) at inference time, but its application to SpeechLLMs remains new, and training-free steering approaches for such models are still largely unexplored. We propose a training-free Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) protocol that derives steering vectors for common speech tasks (e.g. transcription) in SpeechLLMs from a small number of labeled utterances. We showcase that adding these vectors in the representation space, at inference time, enforces better the targeted speech task. We further show that, when combined with prompting, these vectors yield to consistent improvement over prompting alone on most evaluated tasks such as Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) or Emotion Recognition (ER), and transfer to out-of-domain data. We additionally demonstrate the usefulness of script-normalization directions to enforce the target script of a specific language.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的对比激活加法（CAA）协议，为SpeechLLM推导语音任务（如转录）的引导向量，在推理时注入表示空间即可更好地强制目标语音任务，与提示结合后在ASR、情感识别等任务上取得一致提升，并可迁移到域外数据及实现文字系统归一化。
AI.motivation: 激活引导在LLM推理时控制行为已有效，但在SpeechLLM上仍属新领域，针对此类模型的无训练引导方法基本未被探索，因此需要一种低成本、免训练的控制手段。
AI.method: 提出免训练的对比激活加法（CAA）协议：利用少量带标注语音样本，为常见语音任务（如转录）推导引导向量；在推理时将这些向量加到表示空间中，以强化目标语音任务；并与提示（prompting）方式结合使用。
AI.result: 在表示空间加入这些向量能更好地强制目标语音任务；与提示结合后，在ASR、情感识别（ER）等多数评测任务上相较单独提示取得一致提升，并能迁移到域外数据；此外，脚本归一化方向可有效强制特定语言的文字系统。
AI.conclusion: 免训练CAA是控制SpeechLLM行为的有效途径，可作为提示的补充并具备跨域泛化能力，同时可借助方向向量实现文字系统层面的控制。

title: Understanding Errors in LLM-Based Question Answering over Imperfect Tables
summary: We investigate error discovery and handling in question answering over imperfect tables through controlled studies across three large language models (LLMs) on human-reviewed RADAR-T examples. Answering questions over these tables requires handling errors that can affect the answer. We vary row order and compare original, error-marked, and repaired tables to test whether discovery depends on where errors appear and whether providing their locations is sufficient for accurate question answering. First, reordering rows changes error discovery even when the table contents and gold answer remain unchanged. Complete discovery is higher for back than front placements and, averaged over the tested mean positions, for compact than widely spaced layouts. Second, providing verified error locations alone is insufficient for accurate QA, leaving a substantial accuracy gap between error-marked and repaired tables. Providing tables with human-reviewed repairs already applied raises code-assisted QA accuracy by 39.0-59.1 percentage points over the error-marked tables across the three systems. GBDI, a simple workflow, puts these findings into practice by combining error discovery across shuffled table views with explicit guidance for verifying and handling the reported errors. On RADAR-T, GBDI raises observed QA accuracy by 3.8-18.5 percentage points over a code-agent baseline across five systems. These results highlight the importance of both reliable error discovery and effective error handling in question answering over imperfect tables. Our anonymous repository is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/GBDI-ICLR-2027-85BD/

AI.tldr: 该论文研究不完美表格问答中的错误发现与处理，发现行序影响错误发现，而仅标注错误位置不足以提升问答准确率，需实际修复。提出GBDI工作流，在RADAR-T上较代码智能体基线提升3.8-18.5个百分点。
AI.motivation: 表格问答中错误会影响答案正确性，但错误发现是否依赖错误出现位置、以及仅提供错误位置能否满足准确问答尚不明确，需要受控实验加以厘清。
AI.method: 在三个大语言模型上对经人工审核的RADAR-T样本开展受控研究，改变行顺序，对比原始表、错误标注表与修复表；并提出GBDI工作流，融合打乱表格视图下的错误发现与对已报告错误的显式验证和处理指导。
AI.result: 行重排会改变错误发现，即使内容与标准答案不变；靠后放置的完整发现率高于靠前放置，紧凑布局平均高于分散布局。仅标注错误位置不足，错误标注表与修复表间仍有明显准确率差距；提供人工修复表使代码辅助问答准确率提升39.0-59.1个百分点。GBDI在RADAR-T上较代码智能体基线提升3.8-18.5个百分点（五个系统）。
AI.conclusion: 在不完美表格问答中，可靠的错误发现与有效的错误处理同等重要，二者缺一不可。

title: WNet: Discrete Wavelets Transform for Efficient Token Mixing
summary: In a Transformer, token mixing is the step that lets each token draw information from other tokens, and it dominates the cost of encoding long sequences. Self-attention does this mixing very well: every token weighs every other token by content, which gives strong contextual modeling. That all-pairs comparison is also why its cost grows quadratically with sequence length. We introduce WNet, a Transformer encoder that replaces self-attention with token mixing based on the discrete wavelet transform (DWT). Three attention-free mixers recombine the scales: by linear fusion, by learned gating, or by letting each token choose its scales. A hybrid adds self-attention in the last layer only. A receptive-field analysis shows that wavelet mixers built from two-tap filters, such as Haar, never relate tokens outside fixed blocks, however deep the network, even when the filters are learned. Longer filters reach the whole sequence within two layers. We pre-train every model with masked language modeling on a fixed-token subset of C4 and fine-tune on GLUE, using one controlled setup with size-matched BERT and FNet baselines and a control that cannot mix tokens. The token-gated mixer trains as fast as attention at 256 tokens and 2.7 times faster at 4,096.

AI.tldr: WNet 用离散小波变换(DWT)替代自注意力进行 token 混合，提出三种无注意力混合器，并通过感受野分析揭示两抽头滤波器（如 Haar）的混合范围受限。
AI.motivation: 自注意力的全对比较带来强上下文建模能力，但其代价随序列长度平方增长，主导了长序列编码成本。作者希望寻找更高效的 token 混合方式以在保持性能的同时降低复杂度。
AI.method: 提出 WNet，一种用基于离散小波变换的 token 混合替代自注意力的 Transformer 编码器。三种无注意力混合器重组尺度：线性融合、学习门控、以及让每个 token 选择其尺度；另有一种混合模型仅在最后一层加入自注意力。作者进行了感受野分析，并采用受控实验设置，在 C4 的固定 token 子集上用掩码语言建模预训练，在 GLUE 上微调，并与规模匹配的 BERT、FNet 基线及无法混合 token 的对照进行比较。
AI.result: 感受野分析表明，由两抽头滤波器（如 Haar）构建的小波混合器无论网络多深、滤波器是否可学习，都不会关联固定块之外的 token；而更长的滤波器可在两层内覆盖整个序列。token 门控混合器在 256 tokens 时训练速度与注意力相当，在 4,096 tokens 时快 2.7 倍。
AI.conclusion: 小波变换可作为自注意力的高效替代用于 token 混合，但两抽头滤波器的混合范围存在固有限制；更长的滤波器与门控设计可在提升长序列效率的同时扩展感受野。

title: Verb-ICL: Rethinking In-Context Learning for Structured Prediction
summary: Structured prediction tasks pose unique challenges for in-context learning (ICL): their compositional outputs require modeling fine-grained, token-level patterns that sentence-level approaches fail to capture, and their task-specific annotation conventions are human-defined artifacts that cannot be acquired through pretraining alone. We propose Verb-ICL, a selective annotation framework for ICL-based structured prediction that addresses both challenges. Verb-ICL first selects representative examples using a token-level coverage strategy that captures local semantic patterns critical for structured prediction, then generates actionable error feedback that codifies task-specific annotation guidelines and incorporates this feedback into ICL demonstrations. We evaluate Verb-ICL on six structured prediction datasets spanning information extraction and semantic parsing. Experiments with recent LLMs show that Verb-ICL consistently outperforms strong selective annotation baselines under low-resource settings and continues to provide gains as the annotation budget increases. Extended analyses demonstrate that the generated feedback is predominantly useful across a four-category quality taxonomy, generalizes as task-level guidance beyond instance-specific corrections, and improves performance regardless of the underlying selection strategy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Verb-ICL，一个面向结构化预测的ICL选择性标注框架，通过token级覆盖策略选取代表性样例并生成错误反馈以编码任务特定标注规范，在六个数据集上持续优于强基线。
AI.motivation: 结构化预测在ICL场景下存在两大挑战：其一，其组合式输出需要建模细粒度、token级的模式，句子级方法难以捕捉；其二，任务特定的标注规范（annotation conventions）属于人工定义的产物，无法仅通过预训练获得。现有选择性标注方法未能同时应对这两点。
AI.method: Verb-ICL包含两个核心组件：（1）采用token级覆盖（token-level coverage）策略选取代表性样例，以捕捉对结构化预测至关重要的局部语义模式；（2）生成可执行的错误反馈（actionable error feedback），将任务特定标注准则显式化，并将该反馈融入ICL示例中。
AI.result: 在涵盖信息抽取与语义解析的六个结构化预测数据集上，使用近期LLM的实验表明：Verb-ICL在低资源设定下一致优于强选择性标注基线，且随标注预算增加仍持续带来增益。扩展分析显示，生成的反馈在四类质量分类体系中主要为有用；其可作为任务级指导泛化，而非仅限实例级纠正；且无论底层选择策略如何，均能提升性能。
AI.conclusion: Verb-ICL通过token级样例选择与错误反馈驱动的标注规范编码，有效解决了结构化预测中ICL的细粒度模式建模与规范获取难题，具备良好的泛化性与策略无关的增益特性。

title: More Value per Key: Asymmetric Sparse Attention for Faster LLM Decoding
summary: utoregressive generation in Large Language Models (LLMs) is constrained by the memory and computational demands of attention mechanisms. Sparse attention methods mitigate this cost by selecting only high-probability entries of the attention matrix. We observe that in many such methods, this renders the probability-value multiplication negligible, shifting the bottleneck to the query-key step. Key heads can therefore be reduced to accelerate inference, while retaining more value heads preserves capacity with limited additional decoding cost. We introduce Sparse Asymmetric Group-Query Attention (SAGA), which decouples key and value head counts to exploit this principle, and pair it with approximate top-N (Atop-N) attention, a simple sparse attention method designed to study the interaction between sparsity and head-count asymmetry. We formalize the benefits of this asymmetry theoretically and validate them empirically through latency measurements and quality evaluations on models up to 1.5B parameters. Together, SAGA and Atop-N achieve end-to-end decoding speedups exceeding $2\times$ over our full-attention GQA baseline at long contexts. Models trained from scratch with SAGA nearly match the quality of comparable GQA variants on the evaluated benchmarks. To facilitate adoption, we introduce an efficient fine-tuning method that converts pretrained models to the SAGA architecture, enabling practitioners to benefit from our approach without costly retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGA（稀疏非对称分组查询注意力），解耦key与value头数以加速LLM推理，配合近似top-N稀疏注意力，在长上下文下实现超2倍解码加速且质量接近GQA基线。
AI.motivation: 自回归生成的瓶颈在于注意力机制的内存与计算开销。现有稀疏注意力仅保留注意力矩阵的高概率项后，概率与value的相乘可忽略，瓶颈转移到query-key计算，因此可削减key头数；而保留更多value头可用有限解码代价维持模型容量。
AI.method: 提出Sparse Asymmetric Group-Query Attention（SAGA），将key头数与value头数解耦以利用上述原理；并搭配近似top-N（Atop-N）稀疏注意力，用于研究稀疏性与头数非对称之间的交互。理论上形式化该非对称性的收益，并通过延迟测量与最高1.5B参数模型的质量评估进行实证验证。此外提出高效微调方法，将预训练模型转换为SAGA架构。
AI.result: 在长上下文下，SAGA与Atop-N结合相比全注意力GQA基线实现端到端解码加速超过2倍。从零训练的SAGA模型在评测基准上质量与可比的GQA变体几乎持平。配套的微调转换方法使从业者无需昂贵重训练即可采用该方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦key/value头数并结合稀疏注意力，可有效缓解注意力瓶颈、显著提升长上下文解码速度，同时保持模型质量，并可通过微调便捷迁移至现有预训练模型。

title: How Do People Challenge Racial Stereotypes Online? Counter-Story Detection Across Reddit Communities
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 28 pages, 12 figures, 24 tables. Content warning: this paper contains examples of racial stereotypes that may be upsetting or offensive. Code: https://github.com/UmaGunturi/counter_story_detection
summary: Counter-storytelling is a powerful mechanism people use to challenge dominant narratives. Unlike other forms of counterspeech that have been widely studied in computational social science, counter-storytelling has largely been overlooked. Counter-stories are difficult to detect automatically; they are relational (defined with respect to expressions of racial stereotypes) and structurally diverse (drawing on stories that describe lived experiences, witnessed events, exemplars, and hypotheticals). We introduce a first framework for detecting and characterizing counter-storytelling against racial stereotypes at scale. This includes (1) a three-dimensional taxonomy grounded in narratology and Critical Race Theory and (2) a multi-stage pipeline that identifies relational pairs of stereotypes and counter-stories in noisy Reddit discourse. Using this pipeline, we annotate 25,549 Reddit posts across 615 communities and identify 1,312 counter-stories. Our analysis shows that speaker identity and post context shape how counter-stories are told. For example, in-group writers favor first-person testimony, often adopting the role of self-reflective insiders. Our work shows how computational methods can scale qualitative approaches to identify and characterize counter-storytelling as a contextual narrative practice, with implications for content moderation, narratology, and racial discourse analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出首个大规模检测与刻画反种族刻板印象的"反叙事"（counter-storytelling）的框架，包含基于叙事学与批判种族理论的三维分类体系，以及一个在嘈杂Reddit话语中识别"刻板印象—反叙事"关系对的多阶段流水线；在615个社区的25,549条帖子中标注出1,312条反叙事，并发现说话者身份与发帖语境塑造了反叙事的讲述方式。
AI.motivation: 反叙事是挑战主流叙事的有力机制，但相较于计算社会科学中已被广泛研究的其他反言论形式，它长期被忽视。其自动检测困难：反叙事是关系性的（需相对于种族刻板印象表达来界定），且结构多样（可为亲身经历、目睹事件、范例和假设情境等故事）。因此需要首个可规模化检测与刻画反叙事的框架。
AI.method: 提出(1)一个根植于叙事学和批判种族理论的三维分类体系；(2)一个多阶段流水线，用于在嘈杂的Reddit话语中识别"刻板印象—反叙事"的关系对。基于该流水线，对615个社区的25,549条Reddit帖子进行标注，识别出1,312条反叙事，并分析说话者身份与发帖语境对反叙事讲述方式的影响。
AI.result: 共标注25,549条Reddit帖子（覆盖615个社区），识别出1,312条反叙事。分析表明说话者身份与发帖语境塑造了反叙事的讲述方式，例如内群体写作者偏好第一人称证词，常扮演自我反思的"内部人"角色。
AI.conclusion: 本工作展示了计算方法如何规模化地支撑质性研究路径，以识别和刻画作为一种语境化叙事实践的反叙事，对内容审核、叙事学和种族话语分析具有启示意义。

title: Viva La Vida: Verification and Accumulation Failures in Multi-Agent Proof Search
summary: When an agentic prover works on an open problem, there is no proof assistant to fall back on: its verifier and lemma library are ultimately language models judging model outputs. We instrumented such a system end to end and analyzed $51{,}754$ traced observations across three full runs ($186$ hours, \$$5{,}694$). We find three connected failure modes. First, the three-model verifier requires unanimity and treats parse or API failure as non-approval; in $10$ of $12$ verification events, one member returned no parseable output or an API error, making acceptance arithmetically impossible without surfacing an error. Second, when the ensemble did function, one verifier approved $3$ attempts that GPT rejected, each claiming to resolve the open problem; a single-verifier design would therefore have announced a solution three times. Third, because nothing could be approved, every review was a refutation, yet the lemma extractor mines reviews as well as proofs: $24$ of $93$ lemmas ($26\%$) were extracted from rejected arguments with their refutational context removed. Taken together, these findings show that without external verification, supervision is itself a critical trust boundary: systems must distinguish abstention from rejection, preserve useful disagreement, and preserve the provenance and polarity of information before it becomes future context.

AI.tldr: 对一个无外部证明助手的智能体证明系统进行端到端仪表化分析（51,754条追踪观测、3次完整运行、186小时、耗资5,694美元），揭示三种相互关联的失效模式：验证器联盟因票一致要求与解析/API失败被计为非批准而无法通过任何结果；联盟偶尔运作时单一验证器会误批3个被GPT否决的"解决"尝试；引理抽取器从被拒绝的论证中抽取引理却剥离反驳语境（26%）。核心结论：缺乏外部验证时，监督本身即是关键信任边界。
AI.motivation: 开放问题场景下不存在可回退的证明助手，验证器与引理库本质上都是语言模型在评判模型输出，因此监督环节的可靠性成为系统可信度的决定性因素。作者希望通过对这类系统进行端到端仪表化追踪，量化"模型监督模型"范式在真实长时运行中的失效机制。
AI.method: 对智能体证明系统进行端到端仪表化（instrumentation），在三次完整运行中采集并分析51,754条追踪观测，历时186小时、成本5,694美元；从验证事件、联盟投票行为、引理抽取来源三个层面进行统计与因果分析。
AI.result: 发现三种相互关联的失效模式：(1) 三模型验证器要求全体一致，并将解析失败或API错误视为非批准，12次验证事件中有10次至少一名成员未返回可解析输出或报错，使接受在算术上不可能实现且不显式报错；(2) 当联盟正常运作时，某单一验证器批准了3个被GPT否决的尝试，且均声称解决了开放问题，即单验证器设计会三次错误宣告"已解决"；(3) 由于没有任何结果能获批，所有评审都是反驳性的，而引理抽取器同时挖掘评审与证明，导致93条引理中24条（26%）来自被拒绝的论证，且其反驳语境被剥离。
AI.conclusion: 无外部验证时，监督本身构成关键信任边界。系统设计必须区分"弃权（abstention）"与"拒绝（rejection）"，保留有益的验证器分歧，并在信息成为未来上下文之前维护其来源（provenance）与极性（polarity），以避免错误知识被沉淀进引理库。

title: Cluster Validation Indices as Self-Supervised Objectives for Text Representation Learning
summary: Self-supervised fine-tuning refines the embedding space of a pretrained language encoder without labels. However, the commonly used approaches are computationally expensive. Specifically, contrastive learning-based methods need multiview data and in-batch negative examples, while negative-free approaches require auxiliary graphs/networks. An interesting question arises: can self-supervised fine-tuning be done without relying on either additional negatives or graph data? To answer this question, we introduce SilK (Silhouette-guided K-means), which trains on a Cluster Validation Index, an internal measure of cluster quality without using labels. SilK clusters the corpus and then regresses a simplified silhouette toward a target value. Each document is compared only against the k cluster centroids, never against other documents, so the method needs no augmentation, no negative pairs and one view per document. On BERT-base, SilK trains 1.46x faster per epoch than the fastest baseline we evaluate and uses 45.4% less peak GPU memory than the leanest one. Under frozen-encoder linear probing, SilK stays competitive with the best baselines on three downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 SilK（Silhouette-guided K-means），用聚类验证指标（轮廓系数）替代对比学习/无负样本方法，实现无需负样本、无需图数据的自监督微调，训练更快更省显存，下游任务表现与最佳基线相当。
AI.motivation: 现有自监督微调方法计算开销大：对比学习依赖多视图数据与批内负样本，无负样本方法需要辅助图或网络。作者提出能否在不依赖额外负样本或图数据的前提下完成自监督微调这一问题。
AI.method: SilK 基于聚类验证指标（Cluster Validation Index，无标签的簇质量内部度量）进行训练：先对语料聚类，再将对简化的轮廓系数（silhouette）的回归朝向目标值优化。每篇文档仅与 k 个簇质心比较，不与其它文档比较，因此无需数据增强、无需负样本对、每篇文档仅需一个视图。
AI.result: 在 BERT-base 上，SilK 每轮训练比所评估最快的基线快 1.46 倍，峰值 GPU 显存比最精简的基线少 45.4%。在冻结编码器线性探测下，SilK 在三个下游任务上保持与最佳基线相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: SilK 证明无需负样本或图数据也能进行有效的自监督微调，在效率（速度、显存）与效果（线性探测性能）之间取得了良好平衡。

title: No Hindsight for LLM Fact-Checkers: Measuring Leakage Channels in Misinformation Detection
summary: As automated fact-checking scales on social media, large language model (LLM) verdict scores can look stronger than warranted. One reason is that evaluations mix in information that was not knowable at claim time. Two channels are easy to conflate: outcomes memorized in pre-training and retrieved evidence published after the claim. Yet standard benchmarks rarely separate the two. In this study we measure both channels on AVeriTeC and QuanTemp++ by reconstructing point-in-time evidence conditions and probing for outcome information encoded in model representations. We find substantial evidence of parametric leakage, that can be hidden by the aggregate accuracy, while a simple representation bottleneck reduces this future leakage more efficiently than a mutual-information-based training penalty. We also find that allowing post-claim evidence inflates zero-shot accuracy by 6.3 points in AVeriTeC while the effect is negligible in QuanTemp++, where retrieval provides little post-claim evidence. These results show that misinformation benchmarks can overstate fact-checking performance when they do not account for what information was actually available at claim time.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示自动化事实核查评测中存在"时间信息泄漏"：既有预训练记忆的结果信息，也有事后检索证据，二者常被混淆，导致基准高估LLM核查能力。作者在AVeriTeC与QuanTemp++上重构claim时点证据条件并探测表征中的结果信息，发现参数泄漏显著且可被聚合准确率掩盖；简单表征瓶颈比互信息惩罚更有效抑制未来泄漏；允许事后证据使AVeriTeC零样本准确率虚增6.3个百分点，而QuanTemp++几乎无影响。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于社交媒体自动化事实核查，其判定分数可能比实际能力更强。核心原因是评测混入了"claim发生时不可知"的信息，形成两类易混淆的泄漏渠道：（1）预训练阶段已记忆的结果信息（参数泄漏）；（2）claim之后才发表的检索证据（事后证据）。现有基准很少将二者区分，因此无法判断模型究竟是基于当时可得信息进行推理，还是依赖了未来信息。
AI.method: 在AVeriTeC与QuanTemp++两个基准上，重构point-in-time（claim时点）证据条件，以隔离事后证据的影响；同时通过探测模型表征中编码的结果信息来测量参数泄漏；并比较两种缓解手段——基于互信息的训练惩罚与简单的表征瓶颈（representation bottleneck）——对未来泄漏的抑制效果。
AI.result: 发现存在显著的参数泄漏，且该泄漏会被聚合准确率掩盖；简单表征瓶颈在减少未来泄漏方面比互信息训练惩罚更高效；允许使用事后证据会使AVeriTeC的零样本准确率虚增6.3个百分点，而在QuanTemp++中影响可忽略，因为其检索几乎无法提供事后证据。
AI.conclusion: 当基准未考虑claim时点实际可得的信息时，虚假信息检测基准会高估事实核查性能。未来评测应显式区分并控制参数泄漏与事后证据两类渠道，以确保对LLM事实核查能力的度量真实可信。

title: A Systematic Analysis of the Predictive Power of LM Surprisal in Reading Chinese
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures. Hongao Zhu and Muxiaoqiao Xu contributed equally. Correspondence to: hai.hu@polyu.edu.hk
summary: This study analyzes the predictive power of LM-derived, token-level surprisal on Mandarin Chinese reading times. We first propose the Shortest Matching Sequence (SMS), an alignment scheme that maps between the word segmentation assumed by eye-tracking corpora and the LMs' subword tokenization, as the two tokenizations often disagree in the context of Mandarin Chinese. Then, using a suite of Chinese-Pythia models (14M-1.4B) trained on scratch with 30B tokens, we examine how well surprisal predicts first fixation duration, gaze duration, and total reading time in three paragraph-level eye-tracking corpora of Mandarin Chinese (GECO-CN, HKP, and MECO). Contrary to previous null findings, our results show that surprisal is predictive of Chinese reading times. However, whether predictive power scales with model size and the amount of training is corpus-specific: bigger models predict better in GECO-CN, whereas inverse scaling emerges in HKP and, at the largest sizes, in MECO. Subsequently, we tested one possible explanation for the inverse scaling in HKP and found that checkpoints whose surprisal remains closer to $n$-gram statistics are better predictors of reading. All in all, the predictive power of surprisal on Chinese reading time measurements is corpus-specific, which cautions against drawing scaling conclusions from a single corpus.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出最短匹配序列(SMS)对齐方案，用中文Pythia模型(14M-1.4B)考察token级surprisal对中文阅读时间的预测能力，发现surprisal确有预测力，但随模型规模的变化趋势因语料库而异。
AI.motivation: 以往研究对LM衍生的surprisal能否预测中文阅读时间多得出零结果；同时中文分词与LM子词切分常不一致，缺乏合理的对齐方法，难以可靠评估surprisal的预测效力。
AI.method: 提出最短匹配序列(SMS)对齐方案，将眼动语料库的分词与LM子词tokenization进行映射；使用从头训练、语料量30B token的中文Pythia模型套件(14M-1.4B)，在GECO-CN、HKP、MECO三个段落级中文眼动语料库上检验surprisal对首次注视时长、凝视时长和总阅读时间的预测能力，并针对HKP的反向缩放现象检验其与n-gram统计接近度的关系。
AI.result: 与以往零结果相反，surprisal能预测中文阅读时间。但预测力是否随模型规模和训练量提升呈语料库依赖性：GECO-CN中模型越大预测越好，HKP出现反向缩放，MECO在最大规模处亦出现反向缩放；surprisal更接近n-gram统计的checkpoint预测阅读效果更好。
AI.conclusion: surprisal对中文阅读时间测量的预测力具有语料库特异性，不应基于单一语料库得出缩放结论。

title: Rewrite What Matters: Adaptive Multilingual Query Rewriting for Reasoning via Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: In multilingual scenarios, queries with equivalent semantics but in different languages could guide the model into different reasoning trajectories, leading to performance disparities. To mitigate this gap, previous studies typically apply a one-size-fits-all query rewriting strategy, such as translation, which overlooks the fact that different scenarios require diverse types of semantic transformations. In this paper, we propose mRewriter-R1, an agentic multilingual query rewriting framework with reinforcement learning. Unlike single-turn rewriting, mRewriter-R1 formulates multilingual query rewriting as a multi-turn sequential decision-making process, where the model dynamically performs multi-aspect optimization through adaptive operator selection. Experimental results demonstrate that mRewriter-R1 outperforms all strong multilingual rewriting baselines on different large reasoning backbones. Further analyses show that the learned policy can adaptively decide on rewriting operators according to query characteristics, exhibiting strong generalization ability across diverse reasoning tasks, and plug-and-play compatibility with heterogeneous reasoning language models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 mRewriter-R1，一种基于强化学习的代理式多语言查询改写框架，将多语言查询改写建模为多轮序贯决策过程，通过自适应算子选择实现多方面优化。
AI.motivation: 多语言场景下，语义等价但语言不同的查询会引导模型进入不同的推理轨迹，导致性能差异。已有方法通常采用"一刀切"的改写策略（如翻译），忽略了不同场景需要不同类型的语义变换。
AI.method: 提出 mRewriter-R1 代理式多语言查询改写框架，引入强化学习。区别于单轮改写，将多语言查询改写形式化为多轮序贯决策过程，模型通过自适应算子选择动态执行多方面优化。
AI.result: 在不同大型推理骨干模型上，mRewriter-R1 均优于所有强多语言改写基线。进一步分析表明，学到的策略能根据查询特征自适应决定改写算子，在多样推理任务上具有强泛化能力，并能即插即用地兼容异构推理语言模型。
AI.conclusion: mRewriter-R1 通过强化学习驱动的多轮代理式改写，有效缓解多语言推理性能差异，并展现出良好的自适应性与泛化性。

title: Scaling Verifiable Environments for Long-horizon Work Agents
summary: Work agents operate over digital artifacts to execute professional knowledge-intensive work, requiring training environments that support long-horizon interaction and trustworthy verification. However, hand-crafted environments incur prohibitive engineering overhead that prevents environment scaling, whereas synthesis methods sacrifice workspace complexity, realism, or grounded verifiability. To bridge this gap, we introduce WorkForge, a scalable synthesis framework for constructing verifiable work-agent environments from real-world resources. Starting from expert workflows, WorkForge first identifies the resources, decisions, and deliverables required by each workflow. It then retrieves relevant real-world files and organizes them into a workspace. WorkForge inspects the workspace to extract concrete, checkable facts about its content. These factual anchors fix which task types the workspace can support and how their outcomes can be verified. Therefore, WorkForge derives each task's instructions, solution plan, and complementary programmatic and semantic verifiers directly from these factual anchors, keeping verification traceable to observable workspace evidence. Furthermore, we construct 16.7K verifiable environments across 40 professional domains, with workspaces collectively covering 60 file types. Post-training Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base improves GDPVal from 45.5 to 73.6 and APEX Score from 5.0 to 21.3, while enabling Qwen3.5-27B to achieve highly competitive performance and outperform strong competitors. Our analyses confirm the efficacy of the proposed method and reveal consistent scaling behaviors across both data volume and interaction horizons.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WorkForge——一种从真实资源出发、可扩展合成"可验证工作智能体环境"的框架，通过事实锚点将任务指令、解决方案与程序化/语义验证器绑定到可观测的工作区证据，构建了跨40个专业领域、16.7K个可验证环境，显著提升模型在 GDPVal 与 APEX 上的表现。
AI.motivation: 工作智能体需要长时程交互与可信验证的训练环境，但人工构建环境工程开销巨大、难以规模化，而现有合成方法又牺牲了工作区复杂度、真实性或可落地的可验证性，二者之间存在空白。
AI.method: WorkForge 以专家工作流为起点：先识别每个工作流所需的资源、决策与交付物；再检索真实文件并组织成工作区；随后检视工作区、抽取具体可核查的事实性锚点，由这些锚点确定工作区支持的任务类型及其验证方式；最终从事实锚点直接推导任务指令、解决方案计划以及互补的程序化与语义验证器，使验证可追溯至可观测的工作区证据。
AI.result: 构建了覆盖40个专业领域、16.7K个可验证环境，工作区合计涵盖60种文件类型。后训练使 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 的 GDPVal 从 45.5 提升至 73.6、APEX Score 从 5.0 提升至 21.3；并使 Qwen3.5-27B 取得极具竞争力的表现、超越强劲对手。分析还证实了方法有效性，并在数据量与交互时程两个维度上观察到一致的扩展行为。
AI.conclusion: WorkForge 通过事实锚点驱动的合成范式，实现了复杂真实工作区与可靠验证的统一，可规模化生成可验证工作智能体环境，并展现出良好的性能增益与跨数据规模、交互时程的扩展性。

title: From Overloaded to Guaranteed: High-Throughput Multi-SLO Enforcement for LoRA-Assisted On-Premise LLM Deployment
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become essential in privacy-sensitive sectors like hospitals and government agencies, the on-premise LLM servers offer a cost-effective and secure alternative to public cloud services. However, these resource-constrained servers struggle to guarantee heterogeneous Service Level Objectives (SLOs) when serving multiple LoRA-adapted services simultaneously. Existing serving frameworks suffer from severe SLO violations due to the computational overhead of LoRA layers and the rigid nature of batch scheduling. To address this, we propose HALO, a scheduling method tailored for LoRA-assisted on-premise LLM deployment. HALO introduces two key innovations: a spatial multiplexing strategy that overlaps Base and LoRA computations by partitioning GPU Streaming Multiprocessors (SMs), and an SLO-aware scheduler that decouples request execution based on "request-level slack." By prioritizing urgent tasks and utilizing idle budget for traffic shaping, HALO significantly mitigates resource contention. Our evaluation demonstrates that HALO minimizes SLO violations while improving throughput compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: HALO 是一种面向 LoRA 辅助的本地部署 LLM 服务的调度方法，通过空间复用与 SLO 感知调度降低 SLO 违规并提升吞吐。
AI.motivation: 本地部署 LLM 服务器在隐私敏感行业（如医院、政府机构）中具有成本效益与安全性，但在资源受限条件下同时服务多个 LoRA 适配服务时，难以保障异构 SLO。现有服务框架因 LoRA 层计算开销大、批调度机制僵化，导致严重 SLO 违规。
AI.method: HALO 提出两项关键创新：一是空间复用策略，通过划分 GPU 流多处理器（SM）实现 Base 与 LoRA 计算的重叠；二是 SLO 感知调度器，基于“请求级松弛（request-level slack）”解耦请求执行，优先处理紧急任务并利用空闲预算进行流量整形。
AI.result: 实验评估表明，与最先进基线相比，HALO 在最小化 SLO 违规的同时提升了吞吐量。
AI.conclusion: HALO 有效缓解资源竞争，适用于 LoRA 辅助的本地 LLM 部署场景，兼顾 SLO 保障与吞吐效率。

title: Building LLM Agent Systems the Deep Learning Way: From Modular Design to Architecture Search
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have revolutionized AI research and enabled exciting agent systems. To build a complex LLM agent system, most existing research relies on insights from other domains or heuristics to manually build the agent system. However, this approach often requires heavy hand-engineering and fails to fully optimize for the downstream task of interest. Inspired by the tremendous success of deep learning, we propose to construct LLM agent systems in a modular manner, similar to building a deep neural network. Our key insight is to make analogies between LLM building blocks, such as retrievals, memories, and prompting strategies, and the successful deep learning modules, such as MLPs, attention, and recurrent modules. We further design forward inference and feedback mechanisms for LLMs, where prompts in LLMs are considered as the weights in deep models, and the prompt optimization from feedback is analogous to the back-propagation algorithm. We additionally leverage a search algorithm to search for the best configuration of LLM agent systems, similar to the neural architecture search (NAS) in deep learning research. Comprehensive experimental results demonstrate that the proposed deep learning recipe for LLM agent systems is highly effective, in particular: (1) Organizing LLM modules into deep-learning-style architectures yields noticeable performance gain; (2) Automatic prompt optimization, equivalent to backpropagation, is efficient in incorporating feedback from the task of interest and achieves at least 5% performance improvement; (3) NAS equivalent algorithm works well for further optimizing the LLM agent system architecture with 11% performance gain compared with randomly designed architectures. Overall, our research demonstrates the exciting opportunity of transferring the success of deep learning to building LLM agent systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出以深度学习的方式模块化构建LLM智能体系统：将检索、记忆、提示策略等LLM模块类比为MLP、注意力、循环模块，将提示视作权重并用反馈驱动的提示优化类比反向传播，同时用搜索算法类比NAS来优化架构，实验验证了该"深度学习配方"的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体系统多依赖其他领域的洞见或启发式规则手工搭建，导致大量人工工程且难以针对下游任务充分优化。受深度学习巨大成功的启发，作者希望将深度学习的构建范式迁移到LLM智能体系统。
AI.method: 核心思路是在LLM模块与深度学习模块之间建立类比：检索、记忆、提示策略等对应MLP、注意力、循环模块。在此基础上，设计面向LLM的前向推理与反馈机制，其中提示被视为深层模型的权重，基于反馈的提示优化类比反向传播；此外引入搜索算法寻找LLM智能体系统的最优配置，类比深度学习中的神经架构搜索（NAS）。
AI.result: 实验结果证明该深度学习式配方高度有效：(1) 将LLM模块组织为深度学习风格架构可带来明显性能提升；(2) 等价于反向传播的自动提示优化能高效利用任务反馈，至少取得5%的性能提升；(3) 等价于NAS的算法可进一步优化系统架构，相比随机设计的架构获得11%的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了将深度学习成功经验迁移至LLM智能体系统构建的巨大潜力。

title: TrajLong: Co-Designing Agentic and Long-Context Supervision for Mid-Training
summary: LLM agents for coding, search, and workplace tasks increasingly rely on long-context capabilities to effectively aggregate and reason over extended interaction histories. Recent work has incorporated agent trajectories into mid-training stage, drawing on their naturally long and interaction-rich structure. Yet how to organize the information within these trajectories into effective mid-training supervision remains underexplored. In this work, we investigate the relationship between long-context and agent atomic capabilities and introduce TrajLong, a novel framework that compiles trajectories into long-context training tasks with dense supervision, targeting three representative atomic capabilities: evidence grounding, cross-evidence aggregation, and temporal state maintenance. We mid-train Qwen3-14B-Base and Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base with data compiled by TrajLong, followed by supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on 6 long-context and 12 agent benchmarks demonstrate broad performance gains, with controlled ablations showing improvements over raw and masked trajectory baselines. Capability-level analyses further reveal task-dependent associations between long-context and agent atomic capabilities. These findings suggest that the shared capability demands of long-context reasoning and agent execution provide a principled basis for designing mid-training data to develop downstream agent capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 TrajLong 框架，将 agent 轨迹编译为具有密集监督的长上下文训练任务，以开发下游 agent 原子能力。用其数据对 Qwen3-14B-Base 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base 进行 mid-training 后再做 SFT，在 6 个长上下文与 12 个 agent 基准上取得广泛性能提升。
AI.motivation: LLM agent 越来越依赖长上下文能力来聚合与推理长交互历史；已有工作将 agent 轨迹引入 mid-training，但轨迹内部信息的组织方式（如何转化为有效的 mid-training 监督）尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出 TrajLong 框架，将轨迹编译为长上下文训练任务并配以密集监督，针对三类代表性原子能力：证据定位（evidence grounding）、跨证据聚合（cross-evidence aggregation）、时序状态维护（temporal state maintenance）。以该数据对 Qwen3-14B-Base 和 Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base 进行 mid-training，随后进行监督微调（SFT）。
AI.result: 在 6 个长上下文基准和 12 个 agent 基准上取得广泛的性能提升；受控消融显示优于原始轨迹和掩码轨迹基线；能力层面的分析揭示长上下文能力与 agent 原子能力之间存在任务依赖的关联。
AI.conclusion: 长上下文推理与 agent 执行共享的能力需求，为设计 mid-training 数据以发展下游 agent 能力提供了有原则的依据。

title: IREA: Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment for Normative RAG
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong performance across various tasks, but they still struggle with questions involving ethical judgment. Previous studies have attempted to train LLMs on ethical standards, but the diversity and relativity of ethical norms make them difficult to fully internalize in model parameters. As an alternative, we introduce normative RAG, a retrieval-augmented approach that supports ethical judgment using external normative knowledge. Normative retrieval involves a distinct asymmetry between context rich narrative queries and generalized normative statements. Existing factual retrieval methods rely on query-only expansion into a document-like form, making them insufficient for resolving this asymmetry. Therefore, we propose Intermediate Representation-based Embedding Alignment (IREA), a bidirectional alignment method that maps both text types into a shared situation-behavior representation. This representation captures ethically salient contextual and behavioral information in a normalized form, reducing surface-level discrepancies and improving alignment in the embedding space. Experimental results show that IREA improves normative retrieval and downstream ethical judgment across multiple settings, demonstrating the effectiveness of bidirectional alignment for normative RAG.

AI.tldr: 本文提出规范化RAG（normative RAG）框架，并设计基于中间表示的嵌入对齐方法IREA，通过双向对齐将情境丰富的叙事查询与概括性规范文本映射到共享的"情境-行为"表示空间，缓解两类文本的嵌入不对称，提升规范检索与下游伦理判断性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在伦理判断类问题上表现欠佳；将伦理规范直接训练进模型参数难以实现，原因在于伦理标准具有多样性与相对性。因此需要借助外部规范知识进行检索增强，但规范检索存在"情境丰富的叙事查询"与"概括性规范陈述"之间的固有不对称，现有效实检索方法仅靠查询单向扩展为类文档形式，无法解决该不对称。
AI.method: 提出规范RAG，用外部规范知识支持伦理判断。针对检索不对称问题，提出基于中间表示的嵌入对齐（IREA）：一种双向对齐方法，将叙事查询与规范陈述两类文本共同映射到共享的"情境-行为"（situation-behavior）表示空间。该表示以规范化形式捕捉具有伦理显著性的情境与行为信息，减少表层表述差异，从而改善嵌入空间中的对齐效果。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，IREA在多种设置下同时提升了规范检索效果与下游伦理判断表现，验证了双向对齐对规范RAG的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 双向对齐是解决规范检索中查询-文档不对称的有效途径，IREA通过中间表示对齐为规范RAG提供了可行方案，说明以外部知识增强替代参数内化是应对伦理判断任务的一种有效思路。

title: When LLMs Sit Above Diagnostic Tools: Unrealized Complementarity in Industrial Fault Diagnosis
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as integration layers above specialized tools, but a stronger component does not necessarily produce a stronger combined system. Across five diagnostic datasets (bearing vibration, process monitoring, semiconductor equipment), we study whether an LLM can reliably use external diagnostic information; paired repeat calls separate advice effects from output instability. In all five, conflicting external information overturned initially correct LLM judgments. Among the four datasets with direct integration comparisons, none showed a consistent advantage for implicit LLM integration over the stronger standalone source. On a Tennessee Eastman confirmation set whose protocol was fixed before evaluation, unaided accuracy was 64.67%, implicit LLM-specialist integration 77.43%, and the specialist alone 83.33%. Specialist information improved the LLM by 12.8 points (95% interval 9.7 to 15.9), yet the integrated output stayed 5.9 points below the specialist (95% interval -12.0 to -0.7). A two-source selector oracle reached 92.76%, indicating complementarity that the integrated output did not fully realize. The integrated output missed 140 of 295 specialist corrections (47.5%) but lost 15 of 99 initially correct LLM judgments (15.2%). The deficit remained under prompt and specialist sensitivity analyses. Among CWRU cases solved under both evidence presentations, task-aligned physical evidence yielded lower estimates of susceptibility to incorrect advice in six of seven models (five intervals excluding zero); higher reasoning effort gave no reliable reduction in five models, and a separate four-model TEP analysis gave no clear evidence that it resolves the integration problem. Source quality and integration quality should be evaluated separately: an integration layer should be compared with its stronger standalone component, not only with the unaided LLM.

AI.tldr: 该研究检验LLM作为外部诊断信息整合层是否优于其更强独立组件，发现五组数据集中冲突信息均能推翻LLM原本正确判断，且集成输出一致性地弱于专家单独表现。
AI.motivation: LLM日益被用作专用工具之上的整合层，但更强的组件未必带来更强的组合系统，因此需要独立评估"整合质量"与"来源质量"。
AI.method: 在五个诊断数据集（轴承振动、过程监测、半导体设备）上开展配对重复调用以区分建议效应与输出不稳定性；在四个数据集上进行直接整合比较；在预先固定协议的Tennessee Eastman确认集上对比无辅助LLM、隐式LLM-专家集成与专家单独表现；并做提示词与专家敏感性分析、双源选择oracle分析、CWRU案例中任务对齐物理证据的易受影响性分析，以及四模型TEP验证与推理努力度分析。
AI.result: 五个数据集冲突外部信息均推翻LLM原正确判断；四个可比数据集中无一显示隐式LLM集成相对更强独立来源的稳定优势。TEP确认集：无辅助64.67%、集成77.43%、专家单独83.33%；专家信息使LLM提升12.8个百分点（95%区间9.7–15.9），但集成输出仍低于专家5.9个百分点（区间-12.0–-0.7）。双源选择oracle达92.76%，表明存在集成未充分实现的互补性。集成输出漏掉295项专家纠正中的140项（47.5%），却丢弃99项原正确LLM判断中的15项（15.2%）。该缺陷在提示词与专家敏感性分析下仍存在。CWRU任务对齐物理证据在七个模型中六个给出更低的错误建议易感性估计（五个区间不含零）；五个模型中提高推理努力度未带来可靠改善，四模型TEP分析亦无明确证据表明其能解决集成问题。
AI.conclusion: 来源质量与集成质量应分开评估：整合层应与其更强的独立组件比较，而非仅与无辅助LLM比较。

title: Causal Improvement Graph for Agentic Harness Optimization
summary: Agentic Harness is the runtime that constructs task context and controls execution flow, thereby shaping overall agent performance. Given a fixed model and external evaluation, automated Harness optimization seeks to improve this runtime through an iterative proposal--evaluation loop to better solve target tasks. Existing meta-harness methods mainly adopt proposer-centric discovery, in which an LLM-based proposer integrates accumulated experimental findings to determine subsequent Harness revisions. This places the burden of maintaining the evolving improvement state on the proposer as history expands and its underlying experimental logic becomes harder to discern. In this paper, we introduce the Causal Improvement Graph (CIG), a graph-governed meta-harness framework that externalizes the evolving improvement state in a persistent graph, allowing prior findings to directly govern subsequent Harness optimization through local proposer operations. CIG grows and links Evidence, Hypothesis, Intervention, and Outcome nodes to represent what was observed, how it may be explained, how to test that explanation, and what the evaluation reveals. Their structural relations preserve how the improvement state changes across iterations, allowing local proposers to build directly on relations among prior findings rather than recover them from raw history. Across various agent tasks, CIG discovers stronger Harnesses than previous meta-harness baselines and remains robust to the choice of task solver and proposer. Structural ablations further support the design of an explicit improvement state with graph-governed evolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出因果改进图（CIG），一种图治理的元Harness框架，将演化中的改进状态外化到持久图中，通过局部提议器操作让先验发现直接指导Harness优化。
AI.motivation: 现有元Harness方法采用以提议器为中心的发现模式，由基于LLM的提议器整合累积实验发现来决定后续Harness修订。随着历史扩展，提议器需承担维护演化改进状态的负担，且底层实验逻辑愈发难以辨识。
AI.method: CIG构建并连接四类节点：Evidence（观测到的内容）、Hypothesis（可能的解释）、Intervention（检验解释的方式）、Outcome（评估揭示的结果）。其结构关系保留改进状态在迭代间的变化，使局部提议器能直接基于先验发现之间的关系构建，而非从原始历史中恢复。框架通过迭代的提议—评估循环优化运行时的任务上下文构建与执行流程控制。
AI.result: 在多种智能体任务上，CIG发现的Harness强于先前的元Harness基线，且对任务求解器和提议器的选择保持稳健。结构消融实验进一步支持了显式改进状态与图治理演化的设计。
AI.conclusion: 将演化改进状态显式外化为持久图并以图治理方式演化，可有效减轻提议器的状态维护负担，实现更优且更稳健的Harness自动化优化。

title: AraYoungVoices: A Diverse L1/L2 Corpus of Arabic Child and Adolescent Speech
summary: State-of-the-art ASR systems primarily target native adult speech, leading to substantial performance gaps for children, adolescents, and L2 speakers. We introduce AraYoungVoices, a 151.72-hour Arabic read-speech corpus from 286 speakers aged 7--18, comprising AraKids (7--12) and AraTeens (13--18). The corpus includes 146 native Arabic (L1) and 140 second-language (L2) speakers, with native speakers spanning Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, and North African dialectal backgrounds and L2 speakers representing diverse linguistic backgrounds across the Americas, Asia, Africa, and Europe. We benchmark four pretrained ASR models under zero-shot and fine-tuned settings using unseen-speaker-$\&$-unseen-prompt (USUP) and unseen-speaker-$\&$-seen-prompt (USSP) evaluations. Results show that L2 speech remains substantially more challenging than L1 speech, with the largest errors observed mainly for younger L2 speakers. Age-specific fine-tuning improves the matched age group, while joint fine-tuning provides a stronger balance across populations. ASR hypotheses are also consistently closer to the standard reading prompt than to the verbatim transcription, particularly for L2 speech, suggesting partial normalization of reading deviations.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布阿拉伯语青少年朗读语音语料库AraYoungVoices（151.72小时，286名7-18岁说话人），并对四个预训练ASR模型进行零样本与微调基准测试，揭示L2语音识别显著难于L1、低龄L2说话人错误最大，以及ASR输出偏向标准朗读文本而非逐字转写的现象。
AI.motivation: 当前最先进ASR系统主要面向母语成人语音，导致儿童、青少年及二语（L2）说话人性能显著下降。针对阿拉伯语青少年群体、尤其是L2说话人的语音数据与系统评测仍然匮乏。
AI.method: 构建AraYoungVoices朗读语音语料库：151.72小时，286名7-18岁说话人，分为AraKids（7-12岁）与AraTeens（13-18岁）；含146名阿拉伯语母语（L1）与140名二语（L2）说话人，L1覆盖埃及、海湾、黎凡特、北非方言背景，L2覆盖美洲、亚洲、非洲、欧洲多种语言背景。对四个预训练ASR模型在零样本与微调设置下评测，采用未见说话人&未见提示（USUP）与未见说话人&已见提示（USSP）两种协议，并比较ASR假设与标准朗读提示及逐字转写的一致性。
AI.result: L2语音识别难度显著高于L1，最大误差主要出现在低龄L2说话人；按年龄分组微调可提升对应年龄组表现，联合微调在全体人群间取得更好的平衡；ASR假设持续更接近标准朗读提示而非逐字转写，L2语音尤为明显，提示存在对朗读偏差的部分归一化。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了面向阿拉伯语青少年及L2说话人的新基准资源，表明年龄与母语背景是ASR性能的关键影响因素；针对性微调与联合微调各有取舍，且ASR系统倾向于输出规范化的标准文本，为后续公平性与鲁棒性研究提供依据。

title: Usage-Modulated Sentiment Representations in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (main conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, including appendices
summary: Prior work suggests that sentiment can often be captured by approximately linear directions in LLM activation spaces, but a single direction may not fully capture sentiment representations. In natural communication, sentiment is shaped not only by polarity but also by usage factors, such as tone and audience adaptation. We test whether these factors systematically modulate sentiment representations beyond a shared sentiment direction. We construct a controlled paired dataset that holds event content fixed while varying sentiment polarity and usage factors, and analyze Llama, Mistral, and Gemma. We identify a shared sentiment direction, remove it, and test the residual structure through erasure and generation-time tone steering. Across models, the shared direction is robust (median cosine 0.953-0.975), yet removing it leaves 0.833-0.909 of the original positive-negative representation-difference norm. The residuals contain compact, reproducible usage-conditioned structure. Targeted erasure weakens held-out usage metrics more than random and label-shuffled controls. On Llama, outputs steered along residualized tone components are preferred in 92.8% of blind target-tone comparisons while preserving the requested sentiment polarity in 98.7% of evaluated outputs.

AI.tldr: LLM激活空间中的情感由一条共享方向与额外的语用因素（语气、受众适应）共同编码；去除共享方向后仍保留大部分表征差异，且残余结构可被定向擦除与生成时语气引导。
AI.motivation: 既有研究多认为情感可由LLM激活空间中的近似线性单一方向刻画，但自然交流中的情感不仅取决于极性，还受语气、受众适应等使用因素影响；作者据此检验这些因素是否在共享情感方向之外系统性地调制情感表征。
AI.method: 构建受控配对数据集：固定事件内容，变化情感极性与使用因素；分析Llama、Mistral、Gemma。先识别共享情感方向，再将其移除，通过擦除实验与生成时语气引导检验残余结构；并使用随机对照与标签打乱对照评估擦除的特异性。
AI.result: 共享情感方向跨模型稳健（中位余弦相似度0.953–0.975），但去除后仍保留原始正负表征差异范数的0.833–0.909；残余中含紧凑、可复现的、以使用条件为条件的结构。定向擦除对留出使用指标的削弱强于随机与标签打乱对照。在Llama上，沿残余化语气成分引导的输出在92.8%的盲测目标语气比较中更受偏好，同时在98.7%的评估输出中保持所要求的情感极性。
AI.conclusion: 情感表征不能由单一线性方向完全刻画，而是“共享极性方向+使用条件调制的残余子空间”的复合结构；该残余结构可被定位、擦除并用于生成时可控引导，且不破坏情感极性。

title: Self-Generated Feedback Destabilizes Test-Time Training: A Causal Decomposition of Long-Horizon Adaptation
summary: Test-time training (TTT) lets a model store information in its weights during inference. When the model learns from its own output, however, each update also changes the model that generates the next training example. Across 128K-token streams, retaining generated-text updates worsens prediction on independent human-written text with three TTT-E2E model configurations (labeled 125M, 760M, and 3B). The same failure occurs when Adam updates Qwen3-4B's existing weights. The same update mechanisms can improve on real text, so writing itself is not the failure. Three matched comparisons trace the causal pathway. Fixed Generation removes over 98% of the damage at 125M and 760M by using a frozen model to generate training chunks. Recorded Replay separates the loss caused by reading degraded text from the additional loss stored by updating on it. A paired one-update comparison then shows the local conflict: an update predicts its source better but new real text worse. This cost grows after Closed Loop adaptation, with a few trajectories accounting for most large failures. Finally, Settlement evaluates the candidate state on independent real text before commitment. It leaves mean endpoint gaps of 0.07 and -0.02 nats at 125M and 760M while retaining real-text adaptation. These results motivate checking prediction on independent evidence before retaining an update.

AI.tldr: 测试时训练(TTT)在推理时用自身生成文本更新权重会损害对独立人类文本的预测能力；归因于闭环自生成训练机制，通过冻结生成、记录回放与候选状态评估可消除大部分损害。
AI.motivation: 检验TTT的一个结构性隐患：模型从自身输出学习时，每次更新都会改变生成下一批训练样本的模型本身，形成闭环反馈，可能导致对独立真实文本预测能力的退化。
AI.method: 在128K token流上，对三种TTT-E2E配置(125M、760M、3B)及Qwen3-4B(Adam更新)进行对比；采用三项匹配对照：(1)Fixed Generation，用冻结模型生成训练块；(2)Recorded Replay，分离"读取退化文本"与"在退化文本上更新"两部分损失；(3)单步配对比较，观察同一次更新对源文本与新的真实文本的预测差异；并提出Settlement，在提交更新前用独立真实文本评估候选状态。
AI.result: 保留自生成文本更新会损害独立人类文本预测；固定生成在125M与760M上消除超过98%的损害；单步配对比较显示更新对源文本预测更好、对新真实文本预测更差；该代价在闭环适应后累积，少数轨迹贡献了大部分严重失败；Settlement在125M与760M上端点差距仅为0.07与-0.02 nats，同时保留真实文本适应能力。
AI.conclusion: 失败并非源于"书写"本身(相同更新机制在真实文本上可改善)，而源于闭环式自生成训练；应在保留更新前用独立证据检验其预测效果。

title: Towards cross-cultural study of folksong lyrics with machine translation
summary: Music is universally present in human societies. Ethnomusicologists have long been documenting the diverse expressions of human musicality, and comparative musicology has recently brought several studies of folksong to a more global scale. Such cross-cultural research has not been conducted on lyrics: the language barrier has so far prevented work with multi-lingual data. However, Natural Language Processing (NLP) technologies have reached a stage where this language barrier may no longer be prohibitive. Combining folksong lyrics corpora across five languages, we machine-translate them to a pivot language with a pre-trained neural topic model, and we examine the relationship between content and social function within each language, and across languages for wedding songs. As expected, human evaluation of translation results shows that non-Indo-European languages suffer from overall worse translation quality. Experiments with topic models then indicate that the content of lyrics is at best partially related to the social function of folksongs across all languages. These experiments are just first steps into cross-cultural folk musics lyrics analysis; however, they do indicate that a previously unobserved web of cross-cultural relationships beyond ethnomusicological typologies may be uncovered through the study of what people sing across the world's diverse folk musics.

AI.tldr: 本文结合五种语言的民歌歌词语料，通过机器翻译转译到枢轴语言并使用预训练神经主题模型，考察歌词内容与社会功能（尤其是婚礼歌曲）在语言内与跨语言间的关系。
AI.motivation: 民族音乐学长期记录人类音乐性的多样表达，比较音乐学已将民歌研究推向全球尺度，但跨文化研究尚未涉足歌词，主要障碍是多语言数据的语言壁垒。NLP 技术的新进展使这一壁垒可能不再不可逾越，因此作者希望首次开展跨文化民歌歌词分析，探索歌词内容与民歌社会功能之间的关系，并揭示超越既有民族音乐学类型学的跨文化关联网络。
AI.method: 整合五种语言的民歌歌词语料；使用预训练神经主题模型将歌词机器翻译到枢轴语言；对翻译结果进行人工评估；在语言内和跨语言（婚礼歌曲）层面开展主题模型实验，分析歌词内容与社会功能的关系。
AI.result: 人工评估显示，非印欧语系语言的翻译质量整体明显更差；主题模型实验表明，在所有语言中，歌词内容与民歌社会功能至多只有部分相关。
AI.conclusion: 这些实验只是跨文化民歌歌词分析的初步尝试，但结果表明，通过研究世界各地多样民歌中人们所唱的内容，可能揭示出一种此前未被观察到、超越民族音乐学类型学的跨文化关系网络。

title: How Much Do LLM-as-a-Judge Design Choices Matter? A Systematic Comparison of Prompt Designs, Rating Scales, and Models
summary: Researchers increasingly use Large Language Models as judges (LLM-as-a-judge) to evaluate model outputs. Yet there are no standards for how to design these judges. Typically, researchers choose the prompt, rating scale, and model intuitively. If these choices change the judge's verdicts, two studies can reach different conclusions about the same facts. To address this risk and to provide an empirical basis for judge designs, we evaluate 10 reasoning models across multiple designs on two tasks: a scalar rating of sentence sentiment and toxicity (over 500 items per category), as well as a binary accuracy classification of question-answer pairs (n=600). For the rating tasks, despite judges showing significant disagreements with the human ground truth, the practical size of differences is small enough to consider most judges reliable (mean absolute deviation of 0.11 points on a 1 - 7 scale); toxicity judges even outperform standard classifiers. Judges are also highly accurate on average (96.5%) for the accuracy classification task. However, design choices can produce shifts: changing the rating scale alone can shift measured bias by up to 0.93 points (rating task), and while accuracy levels are rarely impacted, design choices consistently impact judge leniency (classification task; leniency drop of 28.9 percentage points when using detailed prompts, and up to 56.1 percentage points when switching models). Counterintuitively, lower reasoning effort affects neither accuracy nor leniency. Across both tasks, model identity is the dominant source of variance. These findings suggest that while LLM judges are broadly trustworthy in aggregate, design choices can be meaningful sources of variance. Given the growing reliance on automated evaluation in LLM research, we intend this study as a methodological reference for designing more robust and replicable LLM-as-a-judge pipelines.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了10个推理模型在情感/毒性评分与问答准确性分类两类任务上的LLM-as-a-judge设计，发现评判者整体可靠，但设计选择（评分尺度、提示详细度、模型身份）会显著影响偏差与宽松度，模型身份是方差的最主要来源。
AI.motivation: LLM-as-a-judge被广泛用于评估模型输出，但提示、评分尺度、模型等设计缺少标准，多凭直觉选择。若这些选择改变评判结论，两项针对同一事实的研究可能得出不同结果。因此需要为评判设计提供实证依据，识别设计选择带来的方差风险。
AI.method: 评估10个推理模型，覆盖多种评判设计，在两类任务上进行测试：(1) 句子情感与毒性的标量评分（每类500+条目）；(2) 问答对的二分类准确性判断（n=600）。分析提示、评分尺度、模型身份与推理投入等设计因素对评判结果的影响，并与人工标准对比。
AI.result: 评分任务中，评判者与人工标准存在显著分歧但实际差异较小（1–7量表上平均绝对偏差0.11分），多数评判者可靠，毒性评判者甚至优于标准分类器；准确性分类平均准确率达96.5%。但设计选择带来偏移：仅改变评分尺度即可使测得偏差变动最高0.93分（评分任务）；分类任务中准确率很少受影响，但设计选择稳定影响评判宽松度（使用详细提示后宽松度下降28.9个百分点，切换模型后最多下降56.1个百分点）。反直觉的是，降低推理投入不影响准确率或宽松度。跨任务中模型身份是方差的主导来源。
AI.conclusion: LLM评判者在总体上具有可信度，但设计选择是显著方差来源。研究为设计更稳健、可复现的LLM-as-a-judge流程提供方法学参考，以应对LLM研究中日益增长的自动化评估依赖。

title: vMF Sentence LDA: A Spherical Topic Model over Sentence Embeddings
summary: Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) and models derived from it remain widely used topic models. LDA observes each document as a bag-of-words and models each topic by a categorical distribution over the vocabulary, so that it uses neither the internal structure of the document nor the similarity in meaning between words. Earlier work has responded to this limitation in two ways: many models have introduced embeddings, and some have assigned topics to sentences rather than to words. Their combination, a topic model that observes sentence embeddings, remains little explored. We propose vMF Sentence LDA (vSLDA), which keeps the admixture structure of LDA, observes each sentence as its L2-normalized embedding and models each topic by a von Mises-Fisher (vMF) distribution, which matches the cosine geometry of sentence embeddings. Its per-topic parameter count and per-iteration cost are linear in the embedding dimension, versus quadratic for the full-covariance Gaussian distribution in the existing model over sentence embeddings. We evaluate vSLDA where the limitation is expected to matter most, among topics that share much of their vocabulary: the topics that subdivide the one subject of a collection, and the narrow topics that result when a corpus is divided into a large number of topics. On two corpora, vSLDA attains the best mean rank against eight baselines when the fine categories within each coarse category are classified from the document-topic distributions. On the whole corpus, its advantage appears or widens as the number of topics grows. Weighting the word frequencies of each sentence by its topic posterior yields expected topic-word counts of the same form as those of LDA, so that the standard topic coherence and diversity measures apply to models that assign topics to sentences. On their product, topic quality, vSLDA leads in most within-category conditions of both corpora.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 vMF Sentence LDA（vSLDA）：保留 LDA 的混合结构，将每个句子视为 L2 归一化嵌入，并用 von Mises-Fisher（vMF）分布建模主题，以匹配句嵌入的余弦几何；参数与每轮迭代开销相对嵌入维度为线性。
AI.motivation: LDA 将文档视为词袋，按词表上的类别分布建模主题，既未利用文档内部结构，也未利用词间语义相似性。已有工作分别引入嵌入或按句子分配主题，但"以句嵌入为观测"的组合仍少有探索。
AI.method: 提出 vSLDA，保留 LDA 的混合（admixture）结构，每个句子以其 L2 归一化嵌入作为观测，主题由 vMF 分布建模以契合句嵌入的余弦几何；相较现有基于句嵌入、使用全协方差高斯分布的模型，其每主题参数量与每轮迭代代价对嵌入维度为线性（而非二次）。评估聚焦词表重叠度高的场景：同一主题细分出的子主题，以及语料划分为大量主题时产生的窄主题；此外，将句子词频按主题后验加权后，可得与 LDA 同形的期望主题-词计数，使标准主题一致性与多样性指标适用于按句分配主题的模型。
AI.result: 在两个语料上，当从文档-主题分布对每个粗类别的细类别进行分类时，vSLDA 对八个基线取得最佳平均排名；在整个语料上，其优势随主题数增加而出现或扩大。在主题质量（一致性与多样性之积）上，vSLDA 在两个语料的多数类内条件下领先。
AI.conclusion: 以句嵌入为观测、用 vMF 建模主题的 vSLDA 在词表高度重叠的细粒度/窄主题场景下优于既有方法，且保留了 LDA 的可解释评估框架，计算开销更低。

title: Small Agents with Semantic Search: Efficient Multilingual Code Localization
summary: Locating relevant files from natural-language requests is a core subtask for agents operating over code repositories. We investigate whether this task can be delegated to compact, specialized models to enable on-device search while reducing the token usage, latency, and inference cost of larger agents. We show that semantic search improves file localization, with gains in accuracy, cross-language transfer, and inference efficiency. To study this setting, we introduce a training framework for file-localization agents built around ColGREP, a local semantic search tool based on late-interaction retrieval models. Our recipe combines weighted supervised fine-tuning on teacher trajectories, assigning turn-level credit based on retrieval outcomes, with reinforcement learning on localization quality. We train three model families with fewer than two billion parameters to formulate search queries, inspect retrieved content, and identify relevant files. On localization tasks derived from SWE-bench Lite and Multi-SWE-bench Flash, ColGREP-equipped agents substantially improve over their base models and outperform corresponding GREP-based agents. In addition to improving localization accuracy, ColGREP reduces mean end-to-end trajectory latency by 44.1\% on CPU while using 29.1\% fewer tokens, and enables better generalization to programming languages unseen during fine-tuning. These results suggest that compact, tool-specialized localization agents can provide an efficient interface between natural-language requests and large codebases.

AI.tldr: 论文研究将代码仓库中的文件定位任务委托给紧凑专用模型，提出基于ColGREP（晚交互语义检索工具）的训练框架，结合加权监督微调与强化学习，训练三个小于20亿参数的模型家族，在SWE-bench Lite和Multi-SWE-bench Flash上显著提升定位精度与效率。
AI.motivation: 自然语言请求到相关文件的定位是代码仓库智能体的核心子任务。作者希望将这一任务委派给紧凑的专用模型，以实现端侧搜索，同时降低大型智能体的token消耗、延迟和推理成本。
AI.method: 引入面向文件定位智能体的训练框架，核心是ColGREP——一种基于晚交互（late-interaction）检索模型的本地语义搜索工具。训练配方结合了两部分：基于教师轨迹的加权监督微调（按检索结果分配轮级信用），以及在定位质量上的强化学习。训练了三个参数量小于20亿的模型家族，用于生成搜索查询、检视检索内容并识别相关文件。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Lite和Multi-SWE-bench Flash派生的定位任务上，配备ColGREP的智能体大幅优于其基座模型，并超越相应的基于GREP的智能体。除提升定位精度外，ColGREP在CPU上将平均端到端轨迹延迟降低44.1%，同时减少29.1%的token使用，并对微调时未见过的编程语言具有更好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，紧凑的、工具专用化的定位智能体能够在自然语言请求与大型代码库之间提供高效的接口。

title: InstMoE: Adaptive Multimodal Routing with Specialized Experts
summary: Multimodal inputs are inherently heterogeneous, not only across modalities but also in the information pathways required for effective prediction. To address this limitation, we propose InstMoE, an adaptive expert routing framework for multimodal learning. InstMoE dynamically routes each input to specialized unimodal and cross-modal experts, allowing the model to adapt its information pathways to the characteristics of the input. However, routing can be misled when modality-specific variations obscure task-relevant semantics. Such irrelevant variations may distort routing decisions, causing inputs to be assigned to inappropriate experts. We therefore introduce a Contrastive Semantic Alignment module, which encourages semantically similar inputs to share task-relevant representations while suppressing irrelevant modality-specific variations. Experiments on multimodal sentiment analysis benchmarks demonstrate that InstMoE achieves state-of-the-art performance on CMU-MOSEI and CH-SIMS v2 while using substantially fewer parameters than competitive baselines. Further analysis shows that different inputs exhibit distinct expert preferences, demonstrating that InstMoE moves beyond fixed fusion toward adaptive multimodal computation.

AI.tldr: InstMoE 提出自适应专家路由框架，为多模态输入动态分配单模态与跨模态专家，并用对比语义对齐模块抑制无关模态变化，在多模态情感分析任务上以更少参数取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 多模态输入具有内在异质性，不仅体现在模态之间，也体现在有效预测所需的信息通路上。现有方法多采用固定的融合方式，无法根据输入特性自适应地调整信息通路；同时路由决策容易被模态特有的无关变化干扰，导致专家分配错误。
AI.method: 提出 InstMoE 自适应专家路由框架，将每个输入动态路由至专门的单模态专家和跨模态专家，使模型能够依据输入特征调整信息通路。为缓解模态特有变化对路由的误导，引入对比语义对齐（Contrastive Semantic Alignment）模块，促使语义相似的输入共享任务相关表示，同时抑制无关的模态特有变化。
AI.result: 在多模态情感分析基准上，InstMoE 于 CMU-MOSEI 和 CH-SIMS v2 上达到最先进性能，且参数量显著少于竞争基线。进一步分析表明，不同输入表现出不同的专家偏好。
AI.conclusion: InstMoE 突破了固定融合范式，实现了自适应的多模态计算，在保证性能的同时提升了参数效率。

title: Belief-Trajectory Energy: Measuring the Path to a Prediction
summary: Large language models (LLMs) progressively revise their predictions across Transformer layers, yet we typically observe only the final output, discarding the trajectory through which it is formed. We introduce Belief-Trajectory Energy(BTE), a model-grounded measure that characterizes an input through the layerwise predictive revisions it induces in a model. By mapping intermediate states into a shared predictive space, BTE provides a principled measure of belief change that can be summarized as either a scalar or a structured depth profile. Theoretically, we show that local BTE corresponds to predictive revision under the Fisher-Rao geometry, while the sequence of revisions captures information beyond the initial-to-final belief change. Empirically, scalar BTE provides a model-relative signal of difficulty across diverse reasoning tasks, while richer BTE representations support human-LLM review detection and fine-grained generator attribution, reaching up to $0.998$ macro-AUROC and $95.6\%$ eight-way attribution accuracy. Further analysis shows that BTE develops throughout pretraining and is selectively reshaped by targeted training, demonstrating that the resulting measurement reflects what the scoring model has learned. Together, our results establish belief trajectories as a principled model-grounded signal and suggest a broader perspective in which learned models can themselves serve as instruments for characterizing the data they process. More demonstrations can be found at https://yingjiahao14.github.io/BTE-web/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Belief-Trajectory Energy (BTE)，一种基于模型逐层预测修正轨迹的度量，理论联系Fisher-Rao几何，能在推理难度评估、人机审核检测与生成器归因中取得优异效果。
AI.motivation: LLM在Transformer各层间逐步修正预测，但通常只观察最终输出，丢弃了信念形成的完整轨迹。作者希望利用这一被忽略的中间过程作为刻画输入数据的信号。
AI.method: 提出BTE：将中间层状态映射到共享预测空间，度量输入所引发的逐层预测修正，可表示为标量或深度剖面；理论上证明局部BTE对应Fisher-Rao几何下的预测修正，且修正序列携带超越首末信念变化的信息。
AI.result: 标量BTE在多种推理任务上提供模型相对的难度信号；结构化BTE表示支持人机审核检测与细粒度生成器归因，最高达0.998 macro-AUROC和95.6%八分类归因准确率。BTE随预训练发展，并被针对性训练选择性重塑。
AI.conclusion: 信念轨迹是一种有原则的、模型根基的信号，表明学习到的模型本身可作为刻画其所处理数据的工具。

title: Selecting Repetition Counts Across Model Scales in Data-Constrained Pretraining
summary: The repetition count that works best for a small language model may not remain best at a larger scale. We study this effect in pretraining with a finite target corpus mixed with generic data at a fixed target fraction. On Wikipedia-derived data and Proof-Pile-2, the ranking of measured repetition counts changes with model size, and a 520M Proof-Pile-2 experiment confirms that reducing repetition from sixteen to eight improves loss while using fewer training tokens. We use loss curves from several smaller models to retain a short list of promising repetition counts for evaluation at a larger scale. On PubMed and Caselaw, candidate sets fixed before target-model training retain the lowest-loss measured count on the original evaluation grids at both 200M and 520M. This supports candidate retention as a practical alternative to exact point prediction. We also relate the pruning regression to an empirical scaling model with two opposing repetition-dependent loss terms. A first-order expansion in log model size yields the linear form used by the selection rule, providing a scaling-based interpretation of the candidate-selection procedure.

AI.tldr: 小语言模型上最优的重复次数在更大规模下未必保持最优；本文提出用多个小模型损失曲线保留少量候选重复次数，再在大模型上评估，并给出基于缩放的线性选择规则。
AI.motivation: 在固定目标比例的预训练中（目标语料与通用数据混合），重复次数的最优值可能随模型规模变化。穷举每次重复次数的成本随规模上升而过高，因此需要一种低成本方法在大模型训练前筛选出有前景的重复次数候选。
AI.method: 在Wikipedia衍生数据与Proof-Pile-2上测量不同模型规模下重复次数的排名变化；利用若干较小模型的损失曲线保留一份短的候选重复次数列表，并在200M与520M规模上于PubMed、Caselaw数据上评估；将剪枝回归关联到含两个方向相反的重复依赖损失项的经验缩放模型，并对log模型规模做一阶展开得到线性形式的选择规则。
AI.result: 在Wikipedia衍生数据和Proof-Pile-2上，测得重复次数的排名随模型规模改变；520M的Proof-Pile-2实验确认将重复次数从16降至8可在使用更少训练token的情况下改善损失。在PubMed与Caselaw上，训练目标模型前固定的候选集在200M和520M两个规模、原评估网格上均保留了最低损失的实测重复次数。
AI.conclusion: 候选保留（candidate retention）是替代精确点预测的实用方案；剪枝回归可由两相反重复依赖损失项的缩放模型解释，其log模型规模一阶展开给出选择规则所用的线性形式，为候选选择流程提供了基于缩放的解释。

title: Verification Trap: Understanding Test-Time Selection Failures under False Premises in Code Generation
summary: Test-time compute has become a central way to improve code generation: systems sample multiple candidate programs and use verifier-visible evidence to select the final output. This paradigm implicitly assumes that the verifier provides a corrective signal independent from the generator. We challenge this assumption under misleading task premises. When the generator and verifier share a false premise, they become coupled through a mistaken belief: the generator produces premise-consistent shortcuts, while the verifier supplies evidence that fails to expose them. Consequently, the selector may choose a hidden-test-wrong candidate even when a hidden-test-correct program exists in the pool. We call this failure mode Verification Trap. Across three code-generation benchmarks and five code models, false premises consistently degrade first-sample correctness, reduce selector-chosen correctness after 64-sample test-time selection, and amplify recoverable mis-selection. Mechanistically, verifier-written tests inherit the premise-level blind spot, reshaping verifier-visible candidate space away from hidden-test correctness. These traces make Verification Trap predictable before hidden execution: a lightweight gold-free predictor using verifier-visible features reaches 0.846 AUROC. Our results identify decoupled evidence as a key mitigation axis: coupled scaling provides limited recovery, whereas premise-agnostic robustness auditors recover substantial oracle headroom.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示并刻画了代码生成中"验证陷阱"（Verification Trap）：当生成器与验证器共享错误任务前提时，二者通过错误信念耦合，导致测试时选择偏好隐藏测试错误的候选，即使池中存在正确程序。
AI.motivation: 测试时计算已成为提升代码生成的核心范式，系统采样多个候选程序并借助验证器可见的证据来选择最终输出。该范式隐含假设：验证器提供的纠正信号独立于生成器。作者质疑该假设在"误导性任务前提"下是否成立，即生成器与验证器可能共享同一错误信念而被耦合。
AI.method: 在三个代码生成基准与五个代码模型上系统实验，引入错误任务前提，测量其对首样本正确率、64 样本测试时选择后选择正确率的影响，并量化"可恢复的误选择"；机制上分析验证器自写测试如何继承前提级盲点；进一步训练一个轻量级、无需金标准（gold-free）的预测器，仅用验证器可见特征来预测验证陷阱。
AI.result: 错误前提一致地降低首样本正确率，降低64样本测试时选择后的选择正确率，并放大可恢复的误选择。机制上，验证器编写的测试继承了前提级盲点，使验证器可见的候选空间偏离隐藏测试正确性。无需金标准的轻量预测器利用验证器可见特征达到0.846 AUROC，可在隐藏执行前预测验证陷阱。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明"解耦证据"是关键缓解方向：耦合式扩展（coupled scaling）恢复有限，而前提无关的鲁棒性审计器（premise-agnostic robustness auditors）能恢复大量 oracle 上限空间。验证陷阱是可预测的失效模式，提示测试时选择范式的核心假设需要修正。

title: FORGE: Verification-Gated Behavioral Repair for Generative Language Models
summary: Generative large language models (LLMs) inherit undesirable behaviors from pre-training, including demographic bias and toxic generation, that often emerge only after deployment and affect a small subset of inputs. A repair should eliminate the identified defect, preserve the model's overall functionality and, ideally, provide correctness guarantees. Existing approaches address this only partially: gradient-based fine-tuning lacks per-instance guarantees and becomes unstable with few defect samples; model editing assumes explicit knowledge replacement rather than behavioral correction; and constraint-based repair is largely restricted to discriminative models with unique target outputs. We present FORGE, a framework for targeted behavioral repair of generative language models that separates defect localization, weight editing, and behavioral verification into independent stages. Its core is a repair abstraction that converts localized defective generation into explicit optimization objectives, enabling verification-oriented repair techniques to operate on autoregressive generation. FORGE is editing-mechanism agnostic: we instantiate it with (1) a constraint-based quadratic optimization method that provides per-sample repair certificates and (2) a null-space projection editor that minimizes interference with the original model distribution, both under the same localization and verification protocol. On five open-source LLMs, FORGE consistently achieves larger reductions in bias and toxicity than gradient-based fine-tuning with minor perplexity degradation. The two backends exhibit complementary performance across architectures, which a lightweight causal probe traces to where toxicity-related signals concentrate. FORGE also remains effective with only a handful of defective examples, where conventional fine-tuning often oscillates or fails to converge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FORGE框架，用于生成式语言模型的定向行为修复，将缺陷定位、权重编辑与行为验证解耦为独立阶段，并提供可验证的修复保证。
AI.motivation: 生成式大模型会从预训练中继承偏见与毒性等不良行为，且往往在部署后才显现并只影响少量输入。修复需消除缺陷、保留整体功能并尽可能提供正确性保证；现有方法（梯度微调、模型编辑、约束修复）仅能部分满足：微调缺乏逐实例保证且少样本不稳定，模型编辑假设显式知识替换而非行为纠正，约束修复多局限于具有唯一目标输出的判别模型。
AI.method: FORGE将定向行为修复拆分为缺陷定位、权重编辑与行为验证三个独立阶段。核心是一个修复抽象，将局部化后的缺陷生成转化为显式优化目标，使面向验证的修复技术可用于自回归生成。该框架对编辑机制无依赖，实例化了两种后端：(1) 基于约束的二次优化方法，提供逐样本修复证书；(2) 零空间投影编辑器，最小化对原始模型分布的干扰；两者共用相同的定位与验证协议。
