AI.result: 在五个开源LLM上，FORGE在偏见与毒性降低方面持续优于梯度微调，且困惑度退化较小。两种后端在不同架构上表现出互补性能，轻量级因果探针将其归因于毒性相关信号的集中位置。在仅有少量缺陷样本时FORGE仍然有效，而传统微调常出现震荡或不收敛。
AI.conclusion: FORGE通过解耦定位、编辑与验证，实现了对生成式语言模型的可验证定向行为修复，兼具逐样本保证、低干扰与少样本鲁棒性，且与具体编辑机制无关。

title: Inductive Claims Extraction at Scale
summary: A large part of political discourse on social media is built and expressed at a level of claims: i.e. declarative, typically single-clause statements, which convey a particular interpretation of reality and can range from factual to evaluative. Moreover, rather than occurring randomly, claims coalesce, recur in patterns, and come to be associated with different world views. When paired with structural computational tools such as Social Network Analysis, claims can be a powerful unit of analysis to study political phenomena such as echo chambers or polarisation. In this paper, we present a pipeline that uses a large language model (LLM) to inductively extract and catalogue claims from large social media corpora, and apply it to two different Twitter datasets: one relating to the 2020 US presidential election and the other to the 2022 FIFA World Cup. We comprehensively evaluate the approach by measuring the pipeline's recall and precision against manually annotated samples, run ablation studies isolating the contribution of its various components, and perform a qualitative error analysis. We discuss the value of the approach in the context of Computational Social Science research, and illustrate its capabilities by presenting the claims catalogue obtained from each dataset.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一套基于大语言模型（LLM）的流水线，从大规模社交媒体语料中归纳式抽取并编目"主张"（claims），并在2020年美国大选与2022年FIFA世界杯两个Twitter数据集上评估其有效性。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体政治话语多以"主张"为基本单位——即陈述性、通常为单句的表述，承载对现实的特定解读。这些主张并非随机出现，而是聚合成簇、反复出现，并与不同世界观相关联。结合社会网络分析等结构化计算工具，主张可作为研究回声室、极化等政治现象的强有力分析单元，但缺乏可扩展的自动抽取与编目方法。
AI.method: 构建一条利用大语言模型（LLM）从大规模社交媒体语料中归纳式抽取并编目主张的流水线，并将其应用于两个Twitter数据集：一个关于2020年美国总统选举，另一个关于2022年FIFA世界杯。
AI.result: 通过与人工标注样本对比，测量了流水线的召回率与精确率；通过消融实验隔离各组件贡献；并进行了定性错误分析。此外展示了从每个数据集获得的主张编目（claims catalogue）。
AI.conclusion: 该研究证明了所提方法在计算社会科学研究中的价值，并提供了一种可扩展的、基于LLM的主张抽取与编目工具，用于支撑回声室、极化等政治现象的实证研究。

title: When Verifiable Counts Depend on Wording: Auditing Wording Robustness in Instruction Following
summary: Verifiable instruction-following benchmarks often express each constraint through one fixed template. We test whether scores remain stable when the operational requirement is unchanged but its wording varies. We introduce WISE, a matched evaluation suite and reporting protocol instantiated on exact word count, keyword inclusion exactly once, and an inclusive 8--12 word range. Across 100 matched tasks, up to thirteen models from seven providers, and repeated generations scored over the complete visible output, wording alone produces substantial compliance shifts. In an avoidance-family panel, five avoidance and exclusion forms fall below the positive baseline, while constructional controls also shift compliance substantially: in the nine-model control panel, compliance is 54.9% for the original positive form, 48.2% for a longer positive form, 36.7% when the target appears later, and 33.8% for AVOID1. A strict JSON-structure probe shows wording sensitivity beyond counting, with a different direction of effect. Effect sizes, failure directions, weakest forms, and model rankings vary across realizations. Under the most disruptive exclusion form, the top-ranked model changes and 24.1% of strictly ordered model pairs reverse. Human validation further shows that unanimous agreement on an exact-count interpretation can coexist with substantially different model behavior. WISE supplements conventional scores with mean and worst-form compliance, wording gaps, failure profiles, and ranking stability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WISE 评测套件，检验指令遵循基准在操作要求不变、仅措辞变化时分数是否稳定，发现措辞本身即可造成显著合规率波动并影响模型排名。
AI.motivation: 现有可验证的指令遵循基准通常用固定模板表达每条约束，隐含假设“同一操作要求的不同表述应产生相近分数”。论文质疑这一假设，检验措辞变化是否会使评测结果失真。
AI.method: 构建 WISE 匹配评测套件与报告协议，覆盖精确词数、关键词恰好出现一次、8–12 词闭区间三类约束；在 100 个匹配任务、至多 13 个模型（7 家提供商）上重复生成，并对完整可见输出评分。设置回避族面板（5 种回避/排除表述与正向基线对比）及构式控制面板，另进行严格 JSON 结构探测与人类验证。
AI.result: 仅措辞变化即导致合规率大幅波动：九模型控制面板中，原正向表述合规率 54.9%，加长正向表述 48.2%，目标后置 36.7%，AVOID1 为 33.8%。严格 JSON 结构探测显示措辞敏感性超出计数类约束且效应方向不同。效应量、失败方向、最弱表述与模型排名随表述变化；在最具干扰性的排除表述下，排名第一的模型发生改变，24.1% 的严格有序模型对出现次序反转。人类验证显示，对精确计数解释的一致同意可与模型行为的显著差异并存。
AI.conclusion: 指令遵循基准的分数对约束措辞高度敏感，单一模板评测不足以保证结论稳健。WISE 建议在常规分数之外补充平均与最差表述合规率、措辞差距、失败画像与排名稳定性等指标。

title: Red-TTT: Test-Time Training for Automated Jailbreaking Large Language Models
summary: Large language models remain vulnerable to jailbreaks, and automated red teaming is the standard way to find jailbreaks in large language models at scale. Current methods either draw more samples at test time through search, rewriting, and tree expansion, or train a stronger attacker offline with reinforcement learning. Both share a limitation: once an attack on a specific target behavior begins, the attacker's weights are frozen. Any signal it gathers about the behavior stays in its context window and is discarded afterward. The attacker never adapts its proposal distribution mid-attack, so success depends almost entirely on the sampling budget, and under a budget affordable at scale, many behaviors remain unbroken. We propose Red-TTT, which updates the attacker's parameters during the attack on each behavior. At each round, the attacker samples a group of candidates, scores them against the victim's replies, and takes a policy-gradient step before drawing the next group, so what it discovers about the current victim is consolidated into weights rather than accumulated as context. We also adapt the training objective to red teaming, where success is judged by the single best sample rather than the average. Red-TTT requires only sampling access to the victim and integrates into existing attack pipelines with no other changes. Against the Best-of-N baseline, Red-TTT raises attack success rate from 55.9\% to 72.4\% on average at a budget of 120 samples, improving over the baseline in every configuration and cracking many behaviors previous method cannot. The code is available at https://github.com/SaFo-Lab/Red-TTT

AI.tldr: Red-TTT 在攻击过程中对攻击者模型进行参数更新（测试时训练），将攻击中获得的信号固化到权重中，从而在相同采样预算下显著提升越狱成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有自动化红队方法（测试时搜索/改写/树扩展，或离线强化学习训练更强攻击者）存在共同缺陷：一旦针对某一目标行为的攻击开始，攻击者权重即被冻结，攻击中获得的关于该行为的信号只存在于上下文窗口，随后被丢弃；攻击者无法在攻击中途调整其提议分布，导致成功率几乎完全依赖采样预算，而在可扩展的预算下许多行为仍无法被攻破。
AI.method: 提出 Red-TTT：在针对每个行为的攻击过程中更新攻击者参数。每轮中攻击者采样一组候选，依据受害者回复对其打分，并在抽取下一组之前执行一步策略梯度更新，使当前受害者的相关信息被合并进权重而非累积于上下文。同时将训练目标适配红队场景，即以单个最优样本而非平均表现来衡量成功。方法仅需对受害者的采样访问，可直接集成进现有攻击流程而无需其他改动。
AI.result: 在 120 次采样预算下，相比 Best-of-N 基线，Red-TTT 将平均攻击成功率从 55.9\% 提升至 72.4\%，在所有配置下均优于基线，并能攻破此前方法无法攻破的许多行为。
AI.conclusion: 攻击过程中的参数更新（测试时训练）是一种有效且即插即用的红队增强手段，可在有限采样预算下提升越狱发现能力；代码已开源。

title: RubricArmor: Adversarial Evolution Improves LLM-Based Rubric Generation
summary: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) provides interpretable rewards for aligning large language models (LLMs) by evaluating responses against query-specific evaluation criteria. To construct rubrics at scale, a straightforward approach to LLM-based rubric generation is to prompt an LLM to generate a rubric directly from the query. However, rubrics directly generated by LLMs are vulnerable to reward hacking, since omitted or underspecified criteria allow the policy to obtain high rubric rewards with low-quality responses. Existing LLM-based rubric generation methods improve the granularity and coverage of the generated criteria but do not proactively guard against reward hacking. To address this limitation, we propose RubricArmor, an adversarial framework that exposes and mitigates potential reward hacking at the rubric generation stage before it occurs in subsequent RL. Specifically, RubricArmor performs adversarial evolution, in which an attack step and a repair step alternate over multiple rounds. The attack step simulates the reward hacking of the policy by constructing adversarial responses that satisfy the current rubric but fail to properly complete the task. The repair step then revises the rubric to detect the response defects exposed by the attack step while preserving other valid criteria. Extensive experiments demonstrate that RubricArmor outperforms competitive rubric generation baselines and translates into more effective downstream rubric-based RL.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RubricArmor，一种对抗式评分标准生成框架，通过在生成阶段交替执行攻击与修复步骤，提前暴露并缓解奖励黑客问题，从而提升基于评分标准的强化学习对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 基于评分标准（rubric）的强化学习通过查询特定的评估标准为 LLM 对齐提供可解释奖励。然而直接用 LLM 从查询生成评分标准易受奖励黑客影响：遗漏或描述不清的准则会让策略以低质量回答获得高评分奖励。现有方法虽提升准则的粒度与覆盖度，但未主动防御奖励黑客。
AI.method: 提出 RubricArmor 对抗式框架，在评分标准生成阶段就暴露并缓解潜在奖励黑客。其核心为对抗演化：攻击步骤与修复步骤多轮交替。攻击步骤通过构造满足当前评分标准但未正确完成任务的对抗性回答，模拟策略的奖励黑客行为；修复步骤据此修订评分标准，使其能检测攻击暴露的回答缺陷，同时保留其他有效准则。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，RubricArmor 优于多个竞争性评分标准生成基线，并在下游基于评分标准的强化学习中转化为更有效的对齐效果。
AI.conclusion: 在评分标准生成阶段引入对抗式攻防演化，可主动预防奖励黑客，提升评分标准质量及其下游强化学习对齐性能。

title: The ÌròyìnSpeech Text Corpus: 24,905 Curated Yorùbá Sentences for Speech and Language Technology
comment: 8 pages. Data descriptor for the ÌròyìnSpeech Text Corpus, doi:10.5281/zenodo.23138464. Under review at the Journal of Open Humanities Data
summary: ÌròyìnSpeech is a 42-hour, 80-speaker Yorùbá read-speech corpus whose audio has been distributed by ELRA since 2024. This paper describes the release of its text component: 24,905 unique, hand-verified, tone-marked Yorùbá sentences (275,897 tokens; 15,687 types), curated in 2022 as recording prompts. Roughly 11,000 sentences were adapted from openly licensed news material; the remainder were written in-house to broaden coverage beyond the religious translation that dominates existing Yorùbá corpora. Every sentence was checked by hand for tone-mark accuracy, edited for read-aloud clarity and a neutral register, and localised so that non-Yorùbá personal and place names appear in Yorùbá form. Preparing the text for release surfaced systematic Unicode normalisation failures affecting more than 60% of lines (with precomposed and decomposed forms of the same letter co-occurring within single sentences) which we document and correct. The corpus supports diacritic restoration, grapheme-to-phoneme conversion, TTS front-end development and orthographic research, and serves as a validated prompt set for new recording.

AI.tldr: 本文发布ÌròyìnSpeech约鲁巴语语音语料库的文本部分，包含24,905条经人工校验、带声调标记的句子（275,897词次；15,687词型），并记录了影响超60%句行的Unicode规范化问题及其修正。
AI.motivation: 现有约鲁巴语语料库以宗教翻译文本为主，覆盖面狭窄；同时该语料库的音频部分自2024年起已由ELRA发布，但配套文本尚未公开，且文本准备过程中发现大规模Unicode规范化缺陷，亟需系统记录与修正。
AI.method: 于2022年以录音提示文本形式整理语料：约11,000句改编自开放许可新闻材料，其余为内部撰写以扩展题材覆盖；每句均经人工校验声调标记准确性，并针对朗读清晰度与中性语体进行编辑，同时对非约鲁巴语人名与地名进行本地化处理；此外，对文本进行Unicode规范化缺陷的排查与修正。
AI.result: 构建并发布24,905条唯一句子、275,897个词次、15,687个词型的文本语料；发现并文档化影响超过60%句行的系统性Unicode规范化失败问题，具体表现为同一句内同一字母的预组合形式与分解形式并存，并已完成修正。
AI.conclusion: 该文本语料可支持变音符号还原、字素到音素转换、TTS前端开发与正字法研究，并可作为经验证的录音提示集用于新语音采集。

title: Towards Unbiased On-Policy Distillation for Block Diffusion Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as an effective post-training paradigm for language models, with recent efforts extending it to block diffusion language models (BDLMs). However, existing studies focus almost exclusively on small block sizes, leaving distillation into student models with larger blocks underexplored. In this work, we investigate this regime and reveal two critical optimization biases that induce severe training instability. First, mismatched block boundaries between teacher and student cause \textbf{\textit{context misalignment}}, providing distorted supervisory signals that misguide student decoding. Second, even under aligned contexts, an \textbf{\textit{intrinsic optimization bias}} in OPD, where the student tends to rapidly absorb high-support signals while lagging on low-support updates, drives a premature confidence surge that traps weaker students in catastrophic overconfidence collapse. To resolve these, we propose \mbox{\textbf{Un-OPD}}, an unbiased on-policy distillation framework with two novelties for stabilizing BDLM training. First, Un-OPD introduces a boundary-aware step filtering strategy that eliminates context-misaligned decoding steps. Second, Un-OPD proposes moderating optimization intensity at high-support positions via a support-rebalanced confidence calibration, thereby bypassing overconfidence collapse. Beyond stability, we also introduce a rollout reuse mechanism to reduce rollout generation overhead. Extensive experiments on math reasoning and code generation benchmarks show that Un-OPD consistently stabilizes training and delivers superior performance while reducing wall-clock training time by approximately half.

AI.tldr: 针对大block规模下块扩散语言模型（BDLM）的on-policy蒸馏（OPD）中存在的两类优化偏差，提出无偏蒸馏框架Un-OPD，通过边界感知步过滤与支持度重平衡置信度校准稳定训练，并辅以rollout复用降低开销。
AI.motivation: 现有OPD研究几乎只关注小块（small block size），忽略了学生模型使用大块时的蒸馏情形。在该情形下存在两个导致训练极度不稳定的优化偏差：一是师生块边界不匹配造成"上下文错位"（context misalignment），产生扭曲的监督信号误导学生解码；二是即使上下文对齐，OPD存在"内在优化偏差"——学生快速吸收高支持度信号而滞后于低支持度更新，导致置信度过早飙升，使较弱学生陷入灾难性的过度自信崩溃。
AI.method: 提出Un-OPD，一个无偏的on-policy蒸馏框架，包含两项创新：1）边界感知步过滤（boundary-aware step filtering）策略，剔除上下文错位的解码步骤；2）支持度重平衡置信度校准（support-rebalanced confidence calibration），在高支持度位置调节优化强度，从而绕过过度自信崩溃。此外引入rollout复用机制以降低rollout生成开销。
AI.result: 在数学推理与代码生成基准上的大量实验表明，Un-OPD能持续稳定训练并取得更优性能，同时将实际训练时间（wall-clock）减少约一半。
AI.conclusion: Un-OPD有效解决了大block BDLM蒸馏中的不稳定问题，兼顾稳定性、性能与效率（训练时间减半）。

title: Harness-Search: Guiding Long-Horizon Search through Multi-Agent Coordination
summary: Long-horizon search requires agents to gather evidence across multiple steps and synthesize it into well-supported answers. The recent agent harnesses provide a natural and promising framework to support such long-running search processes. As interaction histories grow, one single agent in harnesses might get stuck and cause the policy to lose track of unresolved questions, overlook useful evidence, or terminate before sufficient support has been collected. One of promising way is to decouple three distinct responsibilities of proposing retrieval actions, updating persistent state, and deciding when to stop rather than concentrating them within a single policy. Targeted at it, we introduce Harness-Search, a multi-agent search harness to reduce the local errors propagating across subsequent exploration, evidence curation, and termination decisions. In particular, Harness-Search assigns these responsibilities to three permission-bounded authorities: a Retrieval Policy that proposes search operations, a Memory Operator that validates and commits persistent-state updates, and a Summary Auditor that accepts or rejects termination based on the sufficiency of the curated evidence. Together, these roles form a Propose-Commit-Audit loop in which actions are proposed, persistent evidence is selectively committed, and stopping decisions are subjected to an explicit sufficiency check. Across seven long-horizon search benchmarks, Harness-Search improves both retrieval and answer generation under the same policy backbone, increasing Recall by 4.60-27.92 points and Final-Answer Recall by 12.34-30.13 points over the strongest harness-based baseline on each evidence-retrieval benchmark. Moreover, trajectory-level analyses show that Harness-Search continues to accumulate useful evidence and expand evidence coverage with less redundant retrieval as the search history grows.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Harness-Search，一种多智能体搜索框架，通过将检索动作提议、状态更新提交与终止决策解耦为三个权限受限的角色，形成 Propose-Commit-Audit 循环，在长时程搜索任务中显著提升检索与答案生成性能。
AI.motivation: 长时程搜索要求智能体在多步交互中持续收集证据并综合出有支撑的答案。现有 agent harness 依赖单一策略同时承担检索提议、状态维护与终止判断，随着交互历史增长，单一策略容易陷入停滞、丢失未解决问题、忽略有用证据或过早终止，且局部错误会在后续探索中传播放大。
AI.method: 将单一策略的三项职责解耦，分配给三个权限受限的权威角色：Retrieval Policy 负责提议搜索操作；Memory Operator 负责校验并提交持久状态更新；Summary Auditor 基于已整编证据的充分性接受或拒绝终止。三者构成 Propose-Commit-Audit 循环，即动作被提议、持久证据被选择性提交、停止决策须经显式充分性检查。
AI.result: 在七个长时程搜索基准上，在相同策略主干下，Harness-Search 同时提升检索与答案生成：相较各证据检索基准中最强的 harness 基线，Recall 提升 4.60–27.92 个点，Final-Answer Recall 提升 12.34–30.13 个点。轨迹级分析表明，随着搜索历史增长，该方法持续累积有用证据、扩大证据覆盖，并减少冗余检索。
AI.conclusion: 通过角色解耦与显式充分性审计，Harness-Search 有效抑制了局部错误在探索、证据整编与终止决策间的传播，验证了多智能体权限分离在长时程搜索框架中的有效性与可扩展性。

title: The Hidden States Cookbook: A Large-Scale Ablation Study for Noise-Robust Conversational Intent Classification in Industry
summary: Conversational database interfaces face a critical challenge: users naturally embed queries in conversational noise (greetings, politeness, off-topic remarks), which degrades intent classification accuracy and wastes computational resources. Despite advances in orchestration and retrieval strategies, a fundamental question remains unanswered: which pooling strategy maximizes intent classification accuracy under realistic conversational noise in production language models? This work addresses this gap through 360 controlled experiments spanning four pooling configurations (mean, max, last-token, attention, and FFT-augmented variants) using Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct on BANKING77 and CLINC150 datasets under clean/noisy conditions with ten random seeds. Key findings reveal that attention pooling consistently outperforms alternative strategies under noisy conditions (~+2.6-2.8 F1 over the default), while mean pooling degrades performance by up to ~5 F1 points. Frequency-domain filtering does not produce consistent accuracy improvements and functions primarily as a structural variation rather than an accuracy-enhancing component. These results provide concrete, evidence-based guidance for building noise-robust conversational classifiers: attention pooling is recommended for noisy interfaces, mean pooling should be avoided, and last-token pooling is appropriate for clean-query scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文通过360组对照实验，系统比较五种池化策略在真实对话噪声下对意图分类精度的影响，发现注意力池化在噪声条件下最优，均值池化性能下降明显，频域滤波无稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 对话式数据库接口中，用户常将查询嵌入寒暄、礼貌用语与离题内容等对话噪声中，导致意图分类精度下降并浪费算力。尽管编排与检索策略已有进展，但"哪种池化策略能在真实对话噪声下最大化意图分类精度"这一基础问题仍无答案。
AI.method: 在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct上进行360组受控实验，覆盖四种池化配置（均值、最大值、末位token、注意力及FFT增强变体），在BANKING77与CLINC150数据集上，于干净/含噪两种条件、十个随机种子下评测。
AI.result: 注意力池化在噪声条件下持续优于其它策略（相对默认策略约提升2.6–2.8 F1），均值池化最多下降约5个F1点；频域滤波未带来一致的精度改进，其作用更接近结构性变体而非精度增强组件。
AI.conclusion: 为构建抗噪对话分类器提供实证指导：含噪接口推荐注意力池化，应避免均值池化，而末位token池化适用于干净查询场景。

title: Writing as a Self-Organized Critical Process
summary: We explain autocorrelation decay power laws omnipresent in texts by self-organized criticality. Specifically, we analyze the recently released KLiCKe keystroke dataset and show that not only the final texts' autocorrelations form a manifold that adheres to a power law with a finite-size scaling, but also the text revisions generate revision-size-dependent restoring dynamics toward that manifold. Thus, human writing appears to dynamically regulate semantic correlations in a text toward a critical state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用自组织临界性解释文本中普遍存在的自相关衰减幂律：基于KLiCKe击键数据集，发现文本自相关构成一个服从幂律且具有限尺寸标度的流形，而写作修订过程呈现出依赖修订规模的恢复动力学，使语义相关性被动态调控至临界状态。
AI.motivation: 文本中普遍存在自相关衰减幂律，但其成因尚缺乏统一解释。作者希望从自组织临界性（SOC）视角为这一跨文本的统计规律提供机制性说明，并借此理解人类写作过程本身的动力学性质。
AI.method: 利用新发布的KLiCKe击键数据集，追踪写作全过程（包括中间的文本修订），对最终文本的自相关结构进行分析，检验其是否形成服从幂律并具有有限尺寸标度行为的流形；随后分析修订操作是否产生依赖修订规模的恢复动力学，即文本在偏离该流形后是否被拉回。
AI.result: 最终文本的自相关并非单条曲线，而是构成一个流形，该流形遵守幂律并表现出有限尺寸标度；文本修订产生依赖修订规模的恢复动力学，指向该流形。二者共同表明写作过程在动态地把语义相关性调节至临界状态。
AI.conclusion: 文本中的自相关衰减幂律可由自组织临界性解释：人类写作是一个将语义相关性调控至临界状态的自组织过程，而非静态的语言统计巧合。

title: Dataset Signatures in Human-LLM Interactions and User Modeling
summary: Human--LLM interaction datasets shape our understanding of AI use and provide a foundation for downstream research, including training and evaluation of user models. In recent years, a growing number of datasets have sought to capture a representative picture of human--LLM interactions. But how different are the pictures these datasets provide, and what do those differences mean for research built on them? We study these questions across seven conversation datasets, spanning in-the-wild chat logs and human preference data. We begin by revisiting the dataset classification experiment of Torralba & Efros and find that neural network classifiers identify the source of a conversation from user messages alone well above chance, indicating distinctive dataset signatures. This separability persists after matching datasets on the dimensions of human-designed taxonomies, implying subtle differences that these taxonomies do not capture. We then examine the implications for user modeling: how dataset signatures propagate to the outputs of user models trained on these datasets; how dataset choice influences evaluations of user model quality and subsequent evaluations of LLM assistants paired with these user models; and how dataset classifiers can guide data selection for training user models. While each dataset is meant to capture a slice of 'real-world' interactions, our findings reveal the extent to which these slices diverge, and the consequences of those differences for research built on these foundations.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究七个对话数据集之间的"数据集签名"差异，发现神经网络仅凭用户消息即可高准确率识别对话来源，且这种可分性在按人工分类维度匹配后依然存在；这些差异会传播到用户模型输出、影响模型评估，并可用于指导数据选择。
AI.motivation: 近年来越来越多数据集试图刻画人类-LLM交互的全貌，但这些数据集所呈现的"图景"究竟有多大差异、差异对基于它们的研究意味着什么，尚不清楚。作者希望量化数据集间的差异，并揭示其对用户建模与下游评估的影响。
AI.method: 作者在七个对话数据集（涵盖真实场景聊天日志与人类偏好数据）上：(1) 复现 Torralba & Efros 的数据集分类实验，用神经网络分类器仅依据用户消息识别对话来源；(2) 在人工设计分类法的维度上对数据集进行匹配，检验可分性是否持续；(3) 分析数据集签名如何传播到用户模型输出、如何影响用户模型质量评估及后续LLM助手评估；(4) 利用数据集分类器指导用户模型训练的数据选择。
AI.result: 神经网络分类器仅凭用户消息即可显著高于随机水平地识别对话来源，表明各数据集具有独特签名；在按人工分类维度匹配数据集后，这种可分性依然存在，说明存在分类法未捕捉到的细微差异；数据集签名会传播到用户模型输出，并影响模型质量评估与后续LLM助手评估；数据集分类器可用于指导训练数据选择。
AI.conclusion: 尽管每个数据集都意在捕捉"真实世界"交互的一个切面，但这些切面之间存在显著分歧；这种分歧对建立在其之上的研究（尤其是用户建模与评估）具有实质影响，提示研究者需谨慎对待数据集的代表性与可迁移性。

title: Lend Me Your Eyes: Instruction-Aware Text Embeddings via Attention Relay
summary: Text embedding models trained with contrastive learning learn to follow task instructions from instruction-paired data, while instruction-tuned LLMs already know how to follow them. We show that this instruction-following ability can carry over from an LLM to a Transformer-based embedder without any training. We propose Attention Relay, which passes the attention weights an LLM produces to the embedder's own attention. Across six instruction-tuned LLMs from the Qwen3, Llama 3.1 and OLMo 3 families and ten widely used embedding models that differ in tokenizer, size and pooling type, Attention Relay makes nearly every combination instruction-aware. Experiments that break the method down into its parts show that the LLM's attention weights track the instruction in its later layers and come largely from instruction tuning. They also show that relaying these weights selects which content in the text matters: it makes the aspect of the text that the instruction asks about dominant in the embedding, or restores that aspect where averaging had diluted it.

AI.tldr: 提出 Attention Relay，将指令微调 LLM 的注意力权重直接传递给文本嵌入模型自身的注意力，无需任何训练即可让嵌入模型具备指令感知能力。
AI.motivation: 对比学习训练的文本嵌入模型需要依赖指令配对数据才能学会遵循任务指令，而指令微调的 LLM 本身已具备指令跟随能力。作者希望验证这种能力能否从 LLM 无训练地迁移到基于 Transformer 的嵌入模型中。
AI.method: Attention Relay：把 LLM 在推理时产生的注意力权重中继（relay）到嵌入模型自身的注意力机制中，使嵌入模型在编码时直接复用 LLM 的指令跟随注意力模式。作者在 Qwen3、Llama 3.1、OLMo 3 三个家族的六个指令微调 LLM，以及十种分词器、规模和池化方式各异的常用嵌入模型上进行组合实验，并对方法进行拆解分析。
AI.result: 几乎所有的 LLM 与嵌入模型组合都能因此获得指令感知能力。拆解实验表明：LLM 的注意力权重在其较深层中追踪指令，且主要来源于指令微调；中继这些权重能够筛选出文本中重要的内容，使指令所询问的方面在嵌入中占据主导，或在平均池化稀释后被重新恢复。
AI.conclusion: 指令跟随能力可以从指令微调 LLM 零训练地迁移到嵌入模型，注意力权重是承载这一能力的关键载体，Attention Relay 为构建指令感知嵌入提供了一种免训练的通用方案。

title: Can Prosodic Style Be Inferred from Text Alone? Evidence from Unsupervised Acoustic Clusters
summary: Much of expressive text-to-speech research rests on an untested assumption that written text carries enough information to select an appropriate prosodic style for its delivery. Text-predicted style models improve listener preference, and expressive-appropriateness evaluation presupposes that context constrains style, yet neither measures the assumption itself. This paper tests it as a falsifiable hypothesis against style labels derived from acoustics alone. For each of six speakers in a 1,200-hour conversational corpus, utterances are clustered in the spaces of five speech models, including a prosody-only control, and the cluster of held-out utterances is predicted from twelve text embedding models. Three controls are applied: utterance length is erased from the speech embeddings; accuracy is scored against the majority-class floor of unbalanced clusters rather than uniform chance; and a bag-of-words baseline measures word identity alone. Text predicts the cluster above that floor for all six speakers (+0.111 top-3 accuracy), but bag-of-words achieves three quarters of this. Sentence embeddings add only +0.026, largest for encoders not trained for sentence semantics and reversed by tree-based probes for all others. Acoustic clusters are not compact in text embedding space in any of 360 configurations. The prosody-only space weakens the association for five speakers, but not for the speaker showing it most strongly. Text thus informs these delivery clusters mainly through word choice, whether as a cue to prosody or as a marker of topic and recording situation, and reference-free style selection cannot assume more.

AI.tldr: 本文把"书面文本足以预测韵律风格"这一未经检验的假设作为可证伪命题加以检验，结论是：文本确实能预测纯声学聚类风格并超过多数类基线，但这种信息主要来自词本身，而非句子语义，因此无参考的风格选择不能依赖更多信息。
AI.motivation: 表现力TTS研究普遍默认书面文本携带足够信息来选择合适的韵律风格：文本预测风格模型能提升听者偏好，表现力恰当性评测也预设语境约束风格，但这两者都没有直接度量该假设本身。作者希望用纯声学导出的风格标签来直接检验这一前提是否成立，并厘清文本若有效，其信息究竟来自何处。
AI.method: 在一个1,200小时对话语料上，对六位说话人分别处理：用五种语音模型（含仅韵律的对照）空间对语句做聚类；再用十二种文本嵌入模型从留出语句的文本预测其聚类归属。设置三项对照：(1) 从语音嵌入中抹除语句长度信息；(2) 以不平衡聚类的多数类下限而非均匀随机作为评分基准；(3) 加入词袋基线单独度量词身份的作用。此外用树模型探针检验句子嵌入的增益，并检查声学聚类在文本嵌入空间中的紧致性。
AI.result: 文本对全部六位说话人预测聚类均显著高于多数类下限（top-3准确率+0.111）；但词袋基线就达到其中约四分之三。句子嵌入仅额外贡献+0.026，且增益最大者恰是未针对句子语义训练的编码器，而其增益对其它编码器在树模型探针下均被逆转。在全部360种配置中，声学聚类在文本嵌入空间均不紧致。仅韵律空间对五位说话人削弱了该关联，但对关联最强的那位说话人并未削弱。
AI.conclusion: 文本与这些纯声学风格聚类之间的关联主要来自词汇选择，其机制可能是词作为韵律线索，也可能是词反映主题与录音情境。因此，无参考条件下的风格选择不能假定文本提供的信息超过词汇层面。

title: What Is a Repeated Token Worth? The Scaling Geometry of Multi-Epoch Pretraining
summary: As pretraining increasingly repeats data, every run faces three questions: how many epochs to take, how that number should change with model size, and whether anything besides the epoch count matters. We answer them by pricing a repeated token against two references: one epoch on the same data, which gives its value, and fresh data at equal compute, which gives its cost. Against fresh data, the cost of repetition follows a single variable, the number of extra epochs divided by the unique tokens per parameter. Against the same data, a second epoch is worth nearly as much as a fresh one, and repeated tokens fall to half the value of fresh ones after a critical epoch count that grows with the training budget per parameter but hardly with model size. With unique data fixed, the predicted compute-optimal run grows model size and epochs together until loss stops improving, near the critical epoch count. The same variable accounts for the direction of size trends that appear to conflict: larger models tolerate fewer epochs when the corpus is fixed, from about 15 at 127M to 4 at 2B parameters, but not when unique data grow with the model. Counts alone do not determine loss: at identical counts, replaying shards consecutively raises loss by up to 0.46~bits per byte, concentrating repeats on fewer samples also raises it, lower-entropy sources degrade faster with repetition, and re-tokenizing repeats helps only under heavy repetition. These results offer an empirical guide to pretraining when unique data, rather than compute, are the binding constraint.

AI.tldr: 论文系统研究数据重复预训练中的三个核心问题：重复多少轮（Epoch）、该数量如何随模型规模变化、以及除了轮数外还有哪些因素影响损失。作者提出以"每一参数对应的唯一token数"归一化的"额外轮数"作为关键变量，给出了重复token相对新数据的价值/成本定价、临界轮数规律，以及计算最优配比、规模趋势和多种重复方式（分片连续重放、样本集中、低熵源、重新分词）对损失的经验性影响，为"唯一数据而非算力构成瓶颈"时的预训练提供指导。
AI.motivation: 随着预训练越来越多地重复使用数据（多轮训练），实践者面临三个具体疑问：应训练多少轮、该轮数如何随模型规模变化、以及除轮数之外是否还有别的因素影响结果。现有工作缺乏对重复数据在"价值/成本"上的统一度量，也未能解释不同研究关于"更大模型容忍更少轮数"的看似矛盾结论，因此需要一个以数据而非算力为约束的经验性指导框架。
AI.method: 作者以两种参照物为重复token定价：同一数据上训练一个epoch（衡量其"价值"），以及在等算力下的全新数据（衡量其"成本"）。据此提出关键归一化变量——"额外轮数除以每参数量对应的唯一token数"。通过固定唯一数据量或令唯一数据随模型增长两种设定，逐点测量重复token相对新数据的价值随轮数、训练预算每参数占比、模型规模（127M至2B）的变化，并考察分片连续重放、样本集中重复、数据源熵、以及重复数据重新分词等实现细节对loss的影响。
AI.result: 1) 相对新数据，重复的成本由单一变量决定，即额外轮数除以每参数量对应的唯一token数；2) 同一数据上第二个epoch的价值几乎与新数据相当，但超过一个"临界轮数"后重复token价值跌至新数据的一半，该临界轮数随每参数训练预算增长，却几乎不随模型规模变化；3) 在唯一数据固定时，预测的计算最优配置会让模型规模与轮数同步增长直至loss不再改善，接近该临界轮数；4) 同一变量可解释表面矛盾的规模趋势：语料固定时大模型容忍更少轮数（127M约15轮，2B约4轮），但唯一数据随模型增长时则不然；5) 轮数本身不足以决定loss——相同轮数下，连续重放分片可使loss上升最多0.46 bits/byte，把重复集中在更少样本上也会升高loss，低熵数据源随重复退化更快，而重新分词仅在重度重复时才有帮助。
AI.conclusion: 重复数据的"价值—成本"可由"额外轮数/每参数唯一token数"这一单变量刻画，模型的轮数容忍度、规模趋势与计算最优配比均可用该变量统一解释。此外，重复的"方式"（分片顺序、样本集中的程度、数据熵、是否重新分词）会独立于轮数影响loss，因此仅依据轮数无法确定损失。当唯一数据而非算力成为约束时，上述结果为预训练的数据重复策略提供了经验性指南。

title: More Than Words: Compositional Tokenization for Efficient Language Models
summary: Language models process and generate text sequentially in token units, and the tokenizer determines how much text each inference step covers. Under standard tokenization, a short English phrase such as "On the table." is usually produced as four separate predictions for the preposition (On), article (the), noun (table), and punctuation (.), where each consumes a sequence position and adds inference cost. We introduce CoBPE, a compositional tokenization approach that represents such phrases as a lexical base token (table) attached with a small set of reusable surface modifiers, composed in embedding space at input and predicted jointly at output. In controlled pretraining from scratch at 780M and 1.3B scales, CoBPE shortens sequences by 30% and improves average downstream performance by 1.2 points relative to standard BPE under matched training compute. Our results suggest that part of what is now expressed through token sequences can instead be modeled through structured representations, opening a broad design space for more token-efficient and capable language models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoBPE 组合式分词方法，将短语表示为词根 token 加可复用表层修饰符，在嵌入空间组合、输出端联合预测，在 780M 与 1.3B 规模下序列长度缩短 30%，下游平均性能提升 1.2 分。
AI.motivation: 标准分词按 token 顺序逐步预测，"On the table." 等短语被拆为介词、冠词、名词、标点四个预测，每步占用一个序列位置并增加推理成本，token 效率与表达能力受限。
AI.method: 提出 CoBPE：组合式分词，将短语表示为词汇基 token（如 table）附着少量可复用表层修饰符；输入阶段在嵌入空间进行组合，输出阶段对这些成分进行联合预测。
AI.result: 在 780M 和 1.3B 参数规模、控制变量从头预训练下，CoBPE 相对标准 BPE 在相同训练算力下将序列长度缩短约 30%，下游任务平均性能提升 1.2 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当前由 token 序列表达的部分信息可改为结构化表示建模，为更 token 高效且能力更强的语言模型开辟了广阔设计空间。

title: Automatic Speech Recognition for Low-Resource Sinhala: A Critical Review of Methods, Challenges, and Future Directions
comment: 29 pages, 1 table. Submitted to Computer Speech & Language
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) for low-resource languages remains a major challenge. Sinhala, the primary language of Sri Lanka with about 16 million speakers, illustrates the difficulty: agglutinative morphology, a 54-phoneme inventory, subject-object-verb (SOV) syntax and scarce annotated speech data limit both conventional and modern ASR systems. This paper presents the first critical review of Sinhala ASR research, tracing its development from Hidden Markov Models (HMMs) through deep neural networks to self-supervised pre-trained models such as wav2vec 2.0, XLS-R, Whisper and Massively Multilingual Speech (MMS). We compare existing Sinhala systems with related low-resource ASR work on Tamil, Malayalam and Hindi in terms of architecture, training data, word error rate (WER) and robustness to real-world acoustic conditions, and we assess self-supervised and transfer learning as responses to scarce labeled data. We show that most reported WERs are not directly comparable because they differ in corpus, data split and scoring, and that the only controlled comparison in the literature attributes an 18.1% relative WER reduction to corpus correction alone. We also discuss context-aware ASR that draws on phonological, syntactic and semantic knowledge. We identify six research gaps: (1) the lack of large annotated corpora covering multiple dialects and acoustic conditions; (2) weak contextual modeling of Sinhala morphosyntax; (3) high WER in real-world conditions; (4) the absence of standardized benchmarks; (5) the lack of parameter-efficient fine-tuning studies; and (6) the absence of annotated code-switched Sinhala-English speech resources. We outline a research agenda to address these gaps, intended as a roadmap for researchers working on Sinhala and other morphologically rich languages.

AI.tldr: 本文是首篇僧伽罗语ASR综述，梳理从HMM到自监督预训练模型的发展，对比泰米尔语等低资源语言系统，指出报告WER不可直接比较，并归纳六大研究空白与路线图。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言ASR仍是重大挑战。僧伽罗语（约1600万使用者）因黏着形态、54音位系统、SOV语序及标注语音稀缺，使传统与现代ASR系统均受限制，亟需系统性梳理研究现状并明确发展方向。
AI.method: 综述性研究：追踪僧伽罗语ASR从隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）经深度神经网络到自监督预训练模型（wav2vec 2.0、XLS-R、Whisper、MMS）的发展；在架构、训练数据、词错误率（WER）及真实声学条件鲁棒性方面，与泰米尔语、马拉雅拉姆语、印地语的同类低资源工作对比；评估自监督与迁移学习对标注数据稀缺的作用；并讨论融合音系、句法与语义知识的语境感知ASR。
AI.result: 发现多数报告的WER因语料、数据划分与评分方式不同而不可直接比较；文献中唯一的受控对比显示，仅语料修正即带来18.1%的相对WER降低。据此识别六项研究空白：(1) 缺少覆盖多方言与声学条件的大规模标注语料；(2) 对僧伽罗语形态句法的语境建模薄弱；(3) 真实场景WER偏高；(4) 缺乏标准化基准；(5) 缺少参数高效微调研究；(6) 缺少标注的僧伽罗语-英语语码转换语音资源。
AI.conclusion: 提出针对上述空白的研究议程，作为僧伽罗语及其他形态丰富语言研究者的路线图，强调语料建设、标准化评测、语境建模与参数高效微调等方向。

title: Knowing the Rules, Applying the Rules: Evaluating Language Models on Traditional Chinese Bazi
comment: 16 pages, including references and appendices. Project page: https://monsterpppp.github.io/bazi-qa-benchmark/
summary: Knowing domain rules does not guarantee applying them to a case. We study this distinction in traditional Chinese Bazi through 3,000 Chinese multiple-choice questions spanning 14 Theory and 11 Case categories. Six endpoint systems are evaluated, with primary results reported on a 2,492-item model-informed refinement. Theory accuracy exceeds Case accuracy for every system, and gaps of 16.60-29.56 percentage points remain when invalid responses are excluded. The contrast is more specific than a general case-reasoning deficit. Across six systems, Twelve Stages and Nayin reach mean accuracies of 89.10% and 88.62%, while Shensha Basics reaches 75.96%. Within Case, Luck Pillars averages 84.62%, but Career and Family Relations average only 36.98% and 38.19%. Overall rankings also conceal different category strengths. On the original 3,000 items, paired DeepSeek native/disabled comparisons associate native configurations with Theory gains of 6.53 and 12.20 points for Flash and Pro, respectively; Case changes are -3.67 and +1.27 points. These are provider-configuration associations, not isolated causal effects of reasoning. The results motivate task-specific evaluation of cultural-domain applications rather than reliance on aggregate knowledge scores. The benchmark measures agreement with a model-generated, model-verified answer key, not real-world predictive validity. Final-set results are post-selection descriptions, and incomplete provenance and expert validation constrain their interpretation.

AI.tldr: 通过3000道中文多选题区分"懂规则"与"用规则"，发现所有系统理论准确率均高于案例准确率，差距16.60–29.56个百分点，且类别间强弱不齐，提示需按任务评估文化领域应用能力。
AI.motivation: 已有评测多依赖聚合知识分数，无法区分"掌握领域规则"与"将规则应用于具体情境"的能力差异。论文以传统八字命理为文化领域测试床，检验这一区分是否真实存在且具任务特异性。
AI.method: 构建3000道中文多选题，涵盖14个 Theory（理论）与11个 Case（案例）类别；评测6个端点系统，主结果基于2492题的模型辅助精炼集。采用配对比较（如 DeepSeek 原生/关闭推理配置）与分类别准确率分析，并排除无效回答以检验差距稳健性。
AI.result: 所有系统 Theory 准确率均高于 Case，排除无效回答后差距仍为16.60–29.56个百分点。Twelve Stages 与 Nayin 平均达89.10%与88.62%，Shensha Basics 为75.96%；Case 中 Luck Pillars 平均84.62%，而 Career 与 Family Relations 仅36.98%与38.19%。总体上 DeepSeek 原生配置相对关闭推理在 Theory 上分别提升6.53（Flash）与12.20（Pro）个百分点，Case 变化为-3.67与+1.27个百分点。
AI.conclusion: "懂规则≠会用规则"的差异具有类别特异性，聚合排名会掩盖不同类别的能力结构。应针对文化领域应用开展任务特定评测；该基准衡量的是与模型生成并验证的答案键的一致性，而非现实预测效度，且最终集结果属事后筛选、来源与专家验证不完整，解释需谨慎。

title: Spend Bytes on Breadth: Precision-Count Trade-offs for Decode-Time KV Compression in Long Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Reasoning models write most of their KV cache while decoding long chains of thought (CoT), so the cache has to be compressed online under a fixed memory budget. Decode-time methods mostly decide which tokens to evict. We ask how a fixed byte budget should be split between the number of cached tokens and their precision. BreadthKV spends the bytes on more tokens at low precision, combining quantization with eviction, and picks the bit-width for each model and budget with a 60-problem end-to-end calibration, since offline attention error does not predict it reliably. On three reasoning models and four math and science benchmarks, it scores above eviction alone in 17 of 18 settings and produces shorter outputs. Much of what eviction loses comes from derailed runs, which keep reasoning until the length cap without reaching an answer. On Qwen3-8B at our tightest budget, eviction sends 91% of AIME samples to the cap and BreadthKV 40%. Under the same protocol, BreadthKV is statistically indistinguishable from a joint rate-distortion allocator (RDKV) that uses 27% more KV memory-time, and it outperforms our re-implementation of ThinKV.

AI.tldr: BreadthKV在固定KV缓存字节预算下，将预算分配给更多低精度token（量化+驱逐），并通过端到端校准选择位宽，在多数推理基准上优于单独驱逐方法。
AI.motivation: 推理模型在解码长思维链时产生大量KV缓存，需在固定内存预算下在线压缩。现有解码时方法多关注驱逐哪些token，但未系统探讨固定字节预算应如何在缓存token数量与其精度之间分配。
AI.method: BreadthKV将字节预算用于更多token的低精度存储，结合量化与驱逐；针对每个模型和预算，通过60题端到端校准选择位宽，因为离线注意力误差无法可靠预测该选择。
AI.result: 在3个推理模型和4个数学与科学基准上，BreadthKV在18个设置中的17个超过单独驱逐，且输出更短。Qwen3-8B最紧预算下，驱逐使91%的AIME样本触及长度上限，而BreadthKV为40%。相同协议下，BreadthKV与使用多27% KV内存时间的联合率失真分配器（RDKV）统计上不可区分，并优于ThinKV的复现。
AI.conclusion: 在固定字节预算下，偏向更多低精度token的分配策略优于仅驱逐方法，可减少因推理失控导致的长输出；端到端校准对位宽选择必要。BreadthKV在内存效率上具有优势。

title: MedicalHarness: A Controlled Evaluation of LLMs and Agent Harnesses on Medical Tasks
summary: LLM agents are increasingly built for medical work and scored on clinical benchmarks. Each such score, however, comes from a model running inside an agent harness, the system that controls the loop between the model and its environment. An agent's score is therefore a property of a model--harness pair. For medical agents, how much outcomes change with the harness has rarely been measured. Measuring this change, and explaining it, raises two challenges. First, a harness comparison must change nothing but the harness and be repeated across models and kinds of task. Second, comparing whole harnesses leaves their mechanisms bundled together, so it cannot show when an individual mechanism helps. To address these challenges, we present MedicalHarness, a controlled study of models and agent harnesses on medical tasks. We first build MedicalHarnessBench to evaluate agents on $107$ tasks across four domains that each test a different harness capability. Using this benchmark, we run five open-weight models under five agent harnesses, changing only the harness within a comparison, and analyze both outcomes and execution traces. To study individual mechanisms, we build MH-Lab, a controlled harness that switches off context management, planning or tool exposure one at a time within a shared execution loop. We find that the harness and its interaction with the model account for about a quarter of the outcome variance, and that no single harness is best across models and tasks. Code and data are available at https://github.com/REAL-Lab-NU/MedicalHarness.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MedicalHarness 受控研究，通过构建 MedicalHarnessBench 基准与 MH-Lab 可控执行框架，系统量化了模型—harness 配对中 harness 对医疗智能体表现的贡献。
AI.motivation: 医疗 LLM 智能体的基准分数实际上来自"模型 + harness"这一配对，但 harness 对结果的影响程度鲜有测量；现有工作还存在两点困难：harness 对比需仅改变 harness 并在多模型、多任务上重复；直接比较整套 harness 会混淆内部机制，无法判定单一机制是否有益。
AI.method: ①构建 MedicalHarnessBench，包含覆盖四类领域、各考察一种 harness 能力的 107 个任务；②在该基准上让 5 个开放权重模型 × 5 个 agent harness 运行，比较中仅更换 harness，并同时分析结果与执行轨迹；③构建 MH-Lab，一个共享执行循环中可逐一关闭上下文管理、规划或工具暴露的可控 harness，用于研究单个机制。
AI.result: harness 及其与模型的交互作用约占结果方差的四分之一；不存在在各模型与任务上普遍最优的单一 harness。
AI.conclusion: 医疗智能体评测应被视为模型—harness 配对的性质，harness 设计与模型交互显著影响结果，且需按模型和任务类型分别选择与评估 harness；单一机制的作用可通过 MH-Lab 之类的可控消融来识别。

title: CLARA: Can AI Assess Developmental Appropriateness in Children's Stories?
summary: Assessing the developmental suitability of children's narratives is important for educational recommendation and developmental literacy research, yet such assessment typically relies on subjective and difficult-to-scale human judgment. This raises an important question: Can AI systems approximate human developmental judgments of children's stories? To study this problem, we introduce CLARA, a cognitively grounded framework for developmental narrative understanding through structured annotation across cognitive (COG), language (LAN), and social-emotional (SEL) dimensions, together with a bilingual benchmark resource containing 1107 Chinese--English children's stories with normalized silver developmental references and structured developmental annotations. We evaluate CLARA through benchmark comparison, component analysis, translated bilingual consistency analysis, and blinded human evaluation with educators. Experimental results show that structured developmental annotation achieves substantially stronger alignment with developmental references and human judgments than readability-based methods and direct prompting baselines. Overall, our findings suggest that AI systems can approximate certain aspects of human developmental judgment when guided by structured developmental annotation, while also highlighting the importance of interpretability and human oversight in educational NLP.

AI.tldr: 提出CLARA认知基础的儿童叙事发展理解框架与中英双语基准资源（1107篇故事），通过结构化标注显著提升AI与人类发展性判断的对齐度。
AI.motivation: 评估儿童叙事的发展适宜性对教育推荐与发展素养研究很重要，但传统评估依赖主观且难以规模化的人工判断，因此需要探究AI系统能否逼近人类的发展性判断。
AI.method: 构建CLARA框架，在认知（COG）、语言（LAN）、社会情感（SEL）三个维度上进行结构化标注；建立含1107篇中英儿童故事、规范化银标签发展参考与结构化发展标注的双语基准资源；采用基准对比、组件分析、翻译双语一致性分析以及教育者参与的双盲人工评估进行验证。
AI.result: 结构化发展标注在与发展参考及人类判断的对齐上，明显优于基于可读性的方法和直接提示基线。
AI.conclusion: 在结构化发展标注引导下，AI系统可逼近人类发展性判断的某些方面；同时强调教育NLP中可解释性与人类监督的重要性。

title: Adaptive Utilization of Low-Rank Adaptation via Conditioned Gating
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) achieves parameter-efficient fine-tuning by constraining model updates to a low-rank subspace and has been widely used in practice. However, LoRA typically employs a shared low-rank update across tokens, which limits its ability to fully exploit the adaptation subspace for tokens from different sequences. To address this issue, we propose an adaptive utilization of Low-Rank Adaptation (U-LoRA), which employs conditioned gating to explicitly learn effective token-level utilization of the limited low-rank adaptation subspace. Specifically, U-LoRA generates utilization coefficients along low-rank directions for each token and jointly coordinates and constrains them using sequence-level contextual information, thereby inducing more consistent adaptive patterns within a sentence. To further enhance training stability, we introduce a bias-corrected exponential moving average (EMA) historical prior that calibrates utilization signals across optimization steps, suppressing noise caused by batch-to-batch fluctuations. The effectiveness of our method arises from a better utilization of the existing low-rank subspace via input-conditioned strategies, rather than from expanding the subspace. Experiments on mathematical reasoning and natural language understanding benchmarks demonstrate that U-LoRA achieves competitive performance under comparable parameter budgets when with strong LoRA baselines and recent variants.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 U-LoRA，通过条件门控为每个 token 自适应生成低秩方向利用系数，并用序列级上下文协同约束，同时引入偏差校正的 EMA 历史先验稳定训练，在不扩展低秩子空间的前提下提升 LoRA 的适配效果。
AI.motivation: LoRA 在所有 token 上共享同一低秩更新，限制了其对不同序列中不同 token 的适配子空间利用能力，无法充分发挥有限低秩子空间的表达潜力。
AI.method: U-LoRA 采用条件门控，为每个 token 沿低秩方向生成利用系数，并利用序列级上下文信息进行联合协调与约束，使句内产生更一致的自适应模式；此外引入偏差校正的 EMA 历史先验，跨优化步校准利用信号，抑制批间波动带来的噪声。
AI.result: 在数学推理与自然语言理解基准上，U-LoRA 在可比参数预算下取得了与强 LoRA 基线及近期变体相当（具有竞争力）的性能。
AI.conclusion: 方法有效性源于通过输入条件策略更好地利用既有低秩子空间，而非扩展子空间；U-LoRA 以参数高效的方式实现了更细粒度的 token 级适配。

title: Plan Canvas: Fixed Reasoning Regions for Continuous Language Flows
summary: Continuous language flows generate text by denoising all positions of a target canvas together. The natural way to add reasoning to such a model is to write a trace ahead of the answer, but the trace length changes from question to question. The answer start is therefore unknown during denoising, and the model has to decide the trace length, the place of every trace token, and the answer at the same time. We propose Plan Canvas to fix the boundary between the trace and the answer. A plan region of fixed capacity holds a compact trace, supervised padding fills its unused positions, and the answer starts at a fixed position. The fixed regions also allow separate denoising clocks for the plan and for the answer. With the trace text, backbone, and canvas length of the free-trace baseline held fixed, Plan Canvas improves accuracy on ProsQA and on Deep ProsQA, a graph benchmark with longer proofs. On Deep ProsQA, accuracy rises from 73.0\% to 87.0\%, the share of questions answered with a valid path rises from 30.8\% to 59.1\%, and the gain is largest on the longest proofs.

AI.tldr: 提出 Plan Canvas，通过固定 plan 区与答案区的边界，解决连续语言流模型中推理轨迹长度可变导致的答案起点不确定问题，在 ProsQA 与 Deep ProsQA 上均提升准确率，Deep ProsQA 从 73.0% 升至 87.0%。
AI.motivation: 连续语言流（continuous language flows）通过同时去噪目标画布的所有位置来生成文本。若引入推理，自然做法是在答案前写入一条推理轨迹（trace），但轨迹长度随问题变化，导致去噪时答案起始位置未知；模型必须同时决定轨迹长度、每个轨迹 token 的位置以及答案本身，增加了建模难度。
AI.method: 提出 Plan Canvas，将轨迹与答案之间的边界固定：设置固定容量的 plan 区域存放紧凑轨迹，用监督式 padding（supervised padding）填充未使用位置，答案从固定位置开始。固定区域还允许为 plan 与答案分别设置独立的去噪时钟（separate denoising clocks）。实验中轨迹文本、backbone 与画布长度均与 free-trace 基线保持一致以做受控对比。
AI.result: 在 ProsQA 上准确率提升；在 Deep ProsQA 上准确率由 73.0% 提升至 87.0%，以有效路径作答的问题比例由 30.8% 提升至 59.1%，且证明越长提升越明显。
AI.conclusion: 固定 trace 与 answer 边界的 Plan Canvas 设计，在不改变轨迹文本、backbone 与画布长度的前提下，显著增强了连续语言流模型的推理能力，尤其对长链条证明任务收益最大。

title: HLA: Expressive Hybrid Linear Attention via Chunk-Wise Dynamic Mixing
summary: Linear attention enables efficient long-context autoregressive decoding by compressing history into recurrent states, but this compression can make selective access to sparse and distant information difficult. Existing chunk-based extensions increase memory capacity, yet learned chunk-mixing coefficients may remain fixed with respect to input content and therefore cannot adapt historical access to each query. We introduce \emph{Hybrid Linear Attention} (HLA), a query-dependent chunk-level attention mechanism for Gated DeltaNet (GDN). HLA represents each completed chunk as an exact affine state transition and computes content-dependent routing gates from compact, self-attentively pooled representatives. Each gate interpolates the corresponding historical transition with the identity map, controlling both the chunk's additive memory and its transformation of earlier states. Effective-support regularization further encourages concentrated routing for sparse inference. We evaluate HLA under both pretrained adaptation and from-scratch training. Across Qwen3.5 models from 0.8B to 9B, HLA consistently improves over native GDN and fixed chunk mixing, with gains of up to 5.57 percentage points on LongBench-V2 and 3.97 points on RULER. In a controlled from-scratch 1.3B setting trained for 100B tokens with a 4K context, HLA also improves RULER performance from 4K to 32K, with gains increasing from 0.83 points at 4K to 4.22 points at 32K. These results demonstrate that query-dependent composition of recurrent memory improves long-context modeling and remains effective beyond the training context while using compact per-chunk affine summaries. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla/

AI.tldr: HLA 是一种查询依赖的分块级注意力机制，为 Gated DeltaNet 提供内容自适应的历史访问能力，在长上下文任务上稳定优于原生 GDN 与固定分块混合。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力将历史压缩为循环状态以实现高效长上下文自回归解码，但这种压缩使稀疏且远距离信息的定向访问变得困难。现有分块扩展虽提升了记忆容量，但其分块混合系数是学习得到且相对输入内容固定，无法针对每个查询自适应地访问历史。
AI.method: 提出混合线性注意力（HLA）：将每个已完成分块表示为精确的仿射状态转移，并基于紧凑的、经自注意力池化的代表向量计算内容相关的路由门控；每个门控将对应历史转移与恒等映射进行插值，同时控制该分块的加性记忆及其对更早状态的变换；并引入有效支撑正则化以促使路由集中、便于稀疏推理。
AI.result: 在预训练适配与从头训练两种设置下评估。Qwen3.5 0.8B–9B 上一致优于原生 GDN 和固定分块混合，LongBench-V2 提升最高 5.57 个百分点，RULER 提升 3.97 个百分点；在 1.3B、100B tokens、4K 上下文的受控从头训练中，HLA 将 RULER 在 4K 至 32K 范围内的表现提升，增益从 4K 的 0.83 个百分点增至 32K 的 4.22 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 查询依赖的循环记忆组合方式能改进长上下文建模，且在仅使用紧凑的逐分块仿射摘要的情况下，仍能在超出训练上下文时保持有效。

title: Learning to Learn a Language
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables, Code: https://github.com/cbl/prior-fitted-language-model, weights: https://huggingface.co/lennartcb/pflm1
summary: We present the Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM), a 300M-parameter byte-level transformer pretrained only on samples from a synthetic non-linguistic prior. Given a prefix of real text, it learns to predict the language in context with frozen weights, having never seen a word of any real language. Every training sequence is generated by a recurrent structural causal model drawn fresh from a distribution over such models. The model never sees the same language twice during training, so the only way to predict the continuation is to infer the language from the prefix. Samples from this prior share the statistical signatures of natural text: Zipfian frequencies, slow entropy-rate convergence, and long-range dependence. On Wikipedia in six languages, bits per byte fall from the uniform eight to between 0.9 and 2.4 at one million bytes of context. Given numerals instead of text, PFLM learns to count, to compare magnitudes, and to add approximately. It predicts deterministic sequences like Rudin-Shapiro or the prime indicator, and it compresses six non-text domains, from source code to speech, below gzip and PPMd. The model has not learned a language. It has learned to learn one.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Prior-Fitted Language Model（PFLM），一个仅用合成非语言先验预训练的3亿参数字节级Transformer。它从未见过任何真实语言，却能通过推断上下文中的"语言"来预测真实文本，在六种语言维基百科上实现0.9–2.4 bits/byte，并能计数、比较数量、近似加法及压缩多种非文本域。"它没有学会一门语言，而是学会了学习一门语言。"
AI.motivation: 探究语言建模能力是否可在完全不接触真实语言的情况下获得：即模型能否仅从合成的非语言先验中习得"从上下文推断规则系统"的元能力，从而在推理时适配任意未见语言或符号系统。这一设定也有助于区分"记住某门语言"与"学会学习一门语言"两种机制。
AI.method: 构建300M参数的字节级Transformer，预训练数据全部由递归结构因果模型（recurrent structural causal model）生成，每一条训练序列对应的生成模型都从该模型分布中重新采样，因此训练中模型从不重复见到同一"语言"。关键机制为：冻结权重下，给定真实文本前缀，只能通过从上下文中推断潜在"语言"来完成续写。合成先验样本被设计为具有自然文本的统计特征：Zipf频率分布、熵率缓慢收敛、长程依赖。评测涵盖六种语言Wikipedia的bits per byte、数值序列（计数、数量比较、近似加法）、确定性序列（Rudin-Shapiro序列、素数指示序列）以及六个非文本域（含源码、语音）的压缩率。
AI.result: 1) 在六种语言Wikipedia上，bits per byte由均匀分布的8降至0.9–2.4（上下文达一百万字节时）。2) 面对数字时学会计数、数量比较与近似加法。3) 能预测Rudin-Shapiro、素数指示等确定性序列。4) 在六个非文本域（从源码到语音）上压缩效果优于gzip与PPMd。
AI.conclusion: 语言建模的核心能力可分解为一种与具体语言无关的"推断并适配潜在生成规则"的元学习能力。PFLM并未习得任何具体语言，而是习得了"学习一门语言"的能力，说明该能力可仅由具备自然文本统计特征的合成非语言先验诱导出来。

title: Noise Out, Bias In: Targeted Bias Injection in Diffusion Language Models via Closed-Loop Activation Steering
summary: Masked diffusion language models (dLLMs) generate text by iteratively denoising masked positions, re-predicting each token multiple times before it is committed. An autoregressive decoder exposes an answer's distribution once, at the step that commits it; a dLLM exposes it at every denoising step before commitment, and we show that an adversary can exploit this. Since an answer remains open to revision over many denoising steps, an adversary with access to internal activations can watch how likely the model is to produce a chosen answer and adjust the intervention accordingly. Building on this observation, we study targeted bias injection, an attack that steers a frozen dLLM toward a demographic answer selected by the adversary. The attack uses a simple proportional-integral (PI) controller that tracks the target-answer probability during denoising and adapts the strength of a steering vector on the fly. On ambiguous BBQ questions where the correct answer is abstention, our attack raises LLaDA-8B-Instruct's preference for the targeted group from 1.8 to 16.7 percentage points, more than three times the strongest fixed-strength steering baseline, and on SocialStigmaQA it raises the selection of stigmatizing answers from 17.6% to 58.1%. Fitted to other demographic targets, the same attack shifts answers by up to 37 percentage points, and each attack takes about 40 minutes on one GPU. On the primary target, feedback is what makes the attack work: constant steering at the same average strength over the token-committing steps produces a far smaller shift while corrupting nearly three times as many outputs, and a constant strength set separately for each example still falls well short. Our findings identify the denoising trajectory as a new control channel in dLLMs and call for bias audits that examine the serving stack rather than the frozen model alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示掩码扩散语言模型（dLLM）在去噪过程中多次暴露答案分布这一特性可被利用，提出一种基于比例积分（PI）控制器的目标偏见注入攻击，能显著操纵模型输出。
AI.motivation: 自回归解码器仅在提交答案的那一步暴露答案分布，而dLLM在提交前的每个去噪步骤都暴露答案分布，且答案在多次去噪步骤中保持可修改。作者认为这一去噪轨迹构成新的控制通道，可被对手利用来动态调节干预强度。
AI.method: 提出目标偏见注入攻击：在去噪过程中追踪目标答案概率，使用比例积分（PI）控制器实时调整引导向量（steering vector）的强度，将冻结的dLLM导向对手选定的特定人群答案。
AI.result: 在BBQ歧义问题（正确答案为弃权）上，攻击将LLaDA-8B-Instruct对目标群体的偏好从1.8提升至16.7个百分点，超过最强固定强度引导基线的三倍；在SocialStigmaQA上，污名化答案选择率从17.6%升至58.1%；更换目标群体后偏移最高达37个百分点，每次攻击约耗时40分钟（单GPU）。
AI.conclusion: 反馈机制是攻击成功的关键：相同平均强度的恒定引导在提交步上仅产生远小得多的偏移且破坏近三倍的输出，逐样本设定的恒定强度也远不及。研究将去噪轨迹识别为dLLM中的新控制通道，呼吁偏见审计应考察服务栈而非仅冻结模型。

title: HuatuoGPT-3: RL-Only Domain Adaptation from Base Models
comment: Extended version of "OnePO: Direct One-stage Policy Optimization for SFT-free Domain Adaptation", accepted at ICML 2026, with additional analysis and scaling to HuatuoGPT-3
summary: Domain adaptation aims to turn a general-purpose large language model (LLM) into an expert for a target domain. While the dominant SFT+RL pipeline offers a convenient cold start, it may reduce exploration diversity and introduces additional complexity through multi-stage optimization. These limitations motivate RL-only adaptation. However, pure on-policy RL suffers from a cold-start problem, while mixed-policy RL still falls short: informative tokens in teacher outputs are learned too slowly in early training, and stale teacher outputs can hinder later improvement. We identify these two failure modes as Gradient Starvation and Teacher-Distribution Anchoring. To address them, we propose One-stage Policy Optimization (OnePO), which treats teacher outputs as transient guidance for policy improvement. OnePO combines Adaptive Objective Evolution to strengthen learning on informative low-probability teacher tokens and Teacher Retirement to discard teacher outputs once the current policy can surpass them. On medical adaptation, OnePO achieves 67.2 on HealthBench (Total) with only 20K training samples, outperforming SFT+RL and pure RL by 2.7 and 7.4 points, respectively. We further scale OnePO to produce HuatuoGPT-3, an open-source medical LLM series whose 27B variant reaches 70.1 on HealthBench (Total) and 71.4 on HealthBench Professional, surpassing frontier models such as GPT-6 Astra. Models and code are available at https://github.com/FreedomIntelligence/HuatuoGPT-3.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出One-stage Policy Optimization (OnePO)，将教师输出视为策略改进的临时引导，通过自适应目标演化（Adaptive Objective Evolution）和教师退休机制（Teacher Retirement）两个组件解决RL-only领域适应中的Gradient Starvation与Teacher-Distribution Anchoring两大失效模式，在医学领域适应中优于SFT+RL与纯RL，并据此训练出HuatuoGPT-3系列开源医学大模型。
AI.motivation: 领域适应旨在将通用大模型转变为目标领域专家。主流SFT+RL流程虽冷启动方便，但会降低探索多样性，且多阶段优化带来额外复杂度，因此研究者希望采用RL-only适应。然而纯on-policy RL存在冷启动问题，而mixed-policy RL仍不足：教师输出中的信息性token在训练早期学习过慢，且过时的教师输出会阻碍后期改进。作者将这两种失效模式分别识别为Gradient Starvation（梯度饥饿）和Teacher-Distribution Anchoring（教师分布锚定）。
AI.method: 提出One-stage Policy Optimization（OnePO），将教师输出作为策略改进的临时引导。其核心包含两个组件：Adaptive Objective Evolution，用于加强对信息性低概率教师token的学习；Teacher Retirement，在当前策略能够超越教师输出后将其丢弃。
AI.result: 在医学领域适应任务上，OnePO仅用20K训练样本即在HealthBench (Total)上达到67.2分，分别超过SFT+RL和纯RL 2.7分和7.4分。进一步扩展为HuatuoGPT-3开源医学大模型系列，其中27B版本在HealthBench (Total)上达到70.1分，在HealthBench Professional上达到71.4分，超越GPT-6 Astra等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: OnePO有效解决了RL-only领域适应中的梯度饥饿与教师分布锚定问题，实现了高效的单阶段策略优化，在医学领域适应上显著优于现有pipeline，并成功应用于HuatuoGPT-3系列模型。模型与代码已开源。

title: Can Language Models Learn to Reject Their Own Bad Reasoning Steps?
summary: Verifier-guided decoding can prevent harmful reasoning steps from contaminating subsequent generation, but typically relies on an external learned verifier. We ask whether a language model can instead reject its own bad reasoning steps. We define a prefix's recoverability as the probability that the frozen generator can complete it correctly. Diagnostics show that adjacent recoverability changes are often difficult to resolve with practical Monte Carlo budgets, while same-prefix candidates exhibit a sparse low-recoverability tail. We introduce Self-Step Rejection (SSR), which trains a lightweight LoRA acceptance gate on the generator backbone while keeping the base model frozen. SSR uses confidence-qualified first-passage supervision: steps before the first resolved crossing of a root-relative recoverability barrier are accepted, the crossing step is rejected, and unresolved steps and suffixes are excluded. Training combines pointwise classification, same-prefix pairwise learning, and group-relative policy refinement using final-answer correctness. At inference, SSR accepts candidates or resamples from the unchanged prefix under rejection budgets, without an external learned verifier. Across three reasoning models and five mathematical reasoning benchmarks, SSR improves macro-average accuracy over single-pass decoding by 5.4--10.1 points using 1.21--1.40x as many generated tokens, and achieves the highest macro-average accuracy among evaluated step-level methods. Full-solution scaling methods require 4.47--8.27x the single-pass token cost for comparable performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 Self-Step Rejection (SSR)，用轻量 LoRA 接受门控让生成模型自拒错误推理步，无需外部验证器，在五个数学推理基准上平均准确率提升 5.4–10.1 分。
AI.motivation: 现有验证器引导解码能阻止有害推理步污染后续生成，但通常依赖外部学习到的验证器，成本高且需额外训练。本文探究语言模型能否自行拒绝自身的坏推理步。
AI.method: 定义前缀"可恢复性"为冻结生成器正确补全该前缀的概率；诊断发现相邻前缀的可恢复性变化用有限蒙特卡洛预算难以分辨，而同前缀候选存在稀疏的低可恢复尾部。据此提出 SSR：在冻结骨干上训练轻量 LoRA 接受门控，使用"置信度合格的首达监督"——首次跨越根相对可恢复性阈值的步被拒绝，其前步接受，未分辨的步与后缀剔除；训练融合逐点分类、同前缀成对学习与基于最终答案正确性的组相对策略优化。推理时在拒绝预算内接受候选或从不变前缀重采样，无需外部验证器。
AI.result: 在三个推理模型与五个数学推理基准上，SSR 相比单遍解码将宏平均准确率提升 5.4–10.1 分，token 消耗仅 1.21–1.40 倍，在所评估的步级方法中宏平均准确率最高。全解缩放方法达到相近性能需 4.47–8.27 倍单遍 token 成本。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型可借助轻量自训练门控实现对自身错误推理步的拒绝，在显著低于全解缩放的成本下取得更优准确率，为无需外部验证器的推理时自校正提供了可行路径。

title: Byte Language Models: Scaling, Emergent Abstractions, and Information Allocation
summary: Tokenizer-free language models remove the inductive bias of fixed tokenizers by modeling text directly as bytes, but the resulting longer sequences substantially increase computation and eliminate explicit text abstractions. We ask whether this additional computation can be useful, and whether standard Transformers can learn the abstractions that tokenization provides. We study these questions on Transformers without specialized tokenization-related architectures. With token-superposition training and hash embeddings, byte Transformers consistently outperform subword Transformers as model size scales. We further find that byte Transformers build local text abstractions as external tokenizers: a set of segmentation-like positions are used to collect local context representations, and restricting up to $25\%$ of intermediate layers to these local representations preserves downstream performance. Finally, these learned structures induce highly non-uniform generation difficulty, with uncertainty concentrated near local structure boundaries; exploiting them for speculative decoding yields $3.4\times$ more accepted tokens than in subword Transformers.

AI.tldr: 无分词器（字节级）语言模型在规模扩展时性能可超越子词模型，并能自发学出类似分词器的局部抽象结构，可用于加速生成。
AI.motivation: 固定分词器引入了归纳偏置，字节级建模虽去除了该偏置，但序列变长导致计算量大幅增加，且失去了显式的文本抽象。作者希望探究：这部分额外计算是否有用，以及标准 Transformer 能否自行学到分词所提供的抽象。
AI.method: 在不使用专门面向分词设计的架构、仅用标准 Transformer 的前提下，采用 token-superposition 训练与哈希嵌入（hash embeddings）；分析字节模型内部的表示结构，并对中间层施加限制以检验局部表示的作用。
AI.result: 随模型规模增大，字节 Transformer 稳定优于子词 Transformer；字节模型会形成一组类分段的局部位置来聚合局部上下文表示，将最多 25% 的中间层限制为仅使用这些局部表示仍能保持下游性能；其生成难度高度不均匀，不确定性集中于局部结构边界，用于投机解码时接受 token 数比子词模型多 3.4 倍。
AI.conclusion: 额外的字节级计算并非浪费：字节 Transformer 能自发学出分词器所提供的局部抽象，且这些结构可被利用来显著提升解码效率。

title: Breaking the Tie: A Cluster-Aware Routing Framework for Large Language Models
summary: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, the emergence of various Large Language Models (LLMs) has created a rich model ecosystem. However, this also brings a key challenge: how to select the optimal model for a specific user query. LLM routing addresses this need by dynamically assigning queries to the most suitable expert in the pool of candidate models. However, existing routing frameworks often simplify this process to a standard classification task; thus, a critical vulnerability is exposed when multiple candidate models correctly answer the same query. We formalize this capability overlap as routing noise, which misleads the router with arbitrarily correct candidate models, ultimately leading to routing collapse (a severe decline in generalization ability on unseen tasks). To address this problem, we propose a novel Cluster-Aware Soft-Labeling Routing (CASLR) framework. CASLR shifts the evaluation paradigm from the success of a single query to macro-domain consensus by replacing traditional one-hot vectors with a masked softmax mechanism. Specifically, for experts who answer incorrectly, we penalize their target probability to zero; for the remaining candidates, we directly compute continuous fine-grained soft labels based on their global clustering utility scores. We then use these refined soft labels to supervise a lightweight router. Specifically, the framework not only demonstrates superior accuracy on multiple benchmarks, but also outperforms Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct by 7.80% in overall average performance. Furthermore, the extremely low routing inference latency of only 1.13s further confirms that CASLR can achieve efficient system scheduling with almost zero additional overhead, while ensuring high response quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CASLR（聚类感知软标签路由）框架，将LLM路由从单查询成功范式转变为宏观域共识，用掩码softmax替代one-hot标签来缓解“路由噪声”导致的路由崩溃问题。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM生态日益丰富，如何为特定用户查询选择最优模型成为关键挑战，LLM路由应运而生。但现有路由框架把该过程简化为标准分类任务，当多个候选模型都能正确回答同一查询时便暴露关键脆弱性：任意正确的候选模型会误导路由器。作者将此能力重叠形式化为“路由噪声”，它最终导致路由崩溃，即模型在未见任务上的泛化能力严重下降。
AI.method: 提出CASLR框架。其核心是用掩码softmax机制替代传统one-hot向量，将评估范式从单查询成功转为宏观域共识：对回答错误的专家，将其目标概率惩罚为零；对剩余候选模型，依据其全局聚类效用分数直接计算连续的细粒度软标签；再用这些精炼软标签监督一个轻量级路由器。
AI.result: 在多个基准上表现出更优准确率，整体平均性能超过Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct达7.80%。同时路由推理延迟极低，仅1.13s，证实CASLR能在几乎零额外开销下实现高效系统调度，并保证高响应质量。
AI.conclusion: CASLR通过对路由噪声的显式建模与软标签监督，有效缓解路由崩溃，兼顾准确率与调度效率，为LLM路由提供了一种高效、低开销的解决方案。

title: D-Loop: Looped Diffusion Drafting for Speculative Decoding
summary: Block diffusion accelerates speculative decoding by drafting multiple tokens in one forward pass. However, each position predicts a marginal distribution without observing earlier proposed tokens, limiting draft quality and acceptance length. We identify a concrete failure, the \emph{repetition trap}, in which neighboring positions produce redundant copies of the same token. We explain this tendency theoretically and empirically examine its association with shorter accepted drafts. Recent methods refine marginal predictions with an additional causal head or a separately trained drafter, increasing parameter storage and introducing separate training objectives. We instead propose D-Loop, which introduces \emph{intra-block causal conditioning} within the original diffusion drafter without additional model components. Inspired by semi-autoregressive generation and parameter sharing, D-Loop reuses the same backbone across looped passes. The first pass proposes a block, and the second conditions on a selected prefix to regenerate the suffix in parallel. A complementary prefix--suffix objective trains the shared drafter for both anchor-only prefix prediction and prefix-conditioned suffix prediction. Across eight math, code, and chat benchmarks, D-Loop can beat DFlash and DSpark on Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B with obvious gains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出D-Loop，通过在原扩散草稿器中引入块内因果条件机制，复用同一骨干网络进行循环推理，缓解"重复陷阱"问题，无需额外模型组件即可提升投机解码的接受长度。
AI.motivation: 块扩散投机解码虽能一次前向草拟多个token，但每个位置仅预测边缘分布而不观察已提出的前序token，导致草稿质量与接受长度受限。作者识别出一个具体失败模式——"重复陷阱"，即相邻位置生成冗余的同token副本，并在理论上解释该倾向、在实证上验证其与更短接受草稿的关联。已有方法需额外的因果头或单独训练的草稿器，增加了参数存储并引入独立的训练目标。
AI.method: D-Loop在原扩散草稿器内部引入块内因果条件，不增加模型组件。受半自回归生成与参数共享启发，同一骨干网络被循环复用：第一遍提出一个块，第二遍以选定的前缀为条件并行重生成后缀。配套设计前缀—后缀目标，使共享草稿器同时学习仅锚点的前缀预测和以前缀为条件的后缀预测。
AI.result: 在八个数学、代码与对话基准上，D-Loop在Qwen3-4B与Qwen3-8B上超过DFlash和DSpark，取得明显提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过在共享骨干上复用循环式块内因果条件，D-Loop在不增加参数与训练目标的情况下有效缓解重复陷阱，提升了块扩散投机解码的草稿质量与接受长度。

title: Differentiable Bit-Widths: Co-optimizing Pruning and Quantization via SVD for Ultra-Efficient LLM Compression
comment: Accepted to Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: SVD-based pruning and quantization have recently emerged as a promising strategy for the ultra-efficient compression of large language models. In these methods, compression is performed in two stages: components are first truncated, and the remaining ones are subsequently quantized. Although this decoupled pipeline benefits from both pruning and quantization, it requires separate optimization for each stage and fails to fully exploit their balance, which can lead to suboptimal performance under aggressive compression. To address this limitation, we propose a new LLM compression method that co-optimizes pruning and quantization in a unified framework. Our key idea is a differentiable method for learning component-wise bit-widths, allowing less important components to be assigned 0-bit precision and pruned away. Notably, our method performs favorably against two-stage baselines, even when subjected to extreme quantization settings ($1.61$ bits) designed for ultra-efficiency. Code: https://github.com/MMAI-Laboratory/DBW.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的剪枝-量化协同优化框架，通过可微的组件级位宽学习实现0-bit剪枝，在1.61比特极端量化下优于两阶段方法。
AI.motivation: SVD剪枝与量化结合的压缩方法通常采用解耦的两阶段流程（先截断、后量化），需分别优化，无法充分挖掘剪枝与量化之间的平衡，导致激进压缩下性能次优。
AI.method: 提出统一框架协同优化剪枝与量化；核心是组件级比特宽度的可微学习方法，使不重要组件可被赋予0-bit精度从而被剪除。
AI.result: 在面向超高效压缩的极端量化设置（1.61 bits）下，方法性能仍优于两阶段基线。
AI.conclusion: 将剪枝与量化纳入统一的可微优化框架，可突破解耦流水线的次优性，为LLM极端压缩提供更优方案。

title: LightMTP: Lightweight Latent Multi-Token Prediction
summary: Next-token prediction (NTP) is the standard pretraining objective for large language models, yet it provides an explicit training signal only for the immediate next token, which can lead models to exploit local patterns instead of capturing longer-range structure and ideas. Multi-token prediction (MTP) addresses this by training models to predict several future tokens. However, existing MTP methods often introduce a large number of new parameters with limited improvements in downstream performance. Latent MTP approaches address this efficiency issue by encoding future tokens into a vector representation. However, these approaches usually rely on external helper models for future token encoding. We propose LightMTP, a lightweight, i.e., parameter-efficient, latent MTP approach that bootstraps the future token representations from the model's own hidden states. Our two LightMTP variants extend supervision to more future tokens without requiring the additional computational overhead of conventional MTP nor the external supervision latent MTP normally relies on. LightMTP adds at most 1% extra parameters, retains better performance on general language modeling benchmarks, and achieves similar gains in planning, coding, and reasoning.

AI.tldr: LightMTP是一种轻量级潜在多token预测方法，利用模型自身隐藏状态生成未来token表示，仅增加≤1%参数，在通用语言建模、规划、编程和推理任务上均取得收益。
AI.motivation: 标准NTP仅对下一个token提供显式监督信号，导致模型倾向利用局部模式而非捕获长程结构与语义；现有多token预测方法参数开销大而下游提升有限，潜在MTP方法又依赖外部辅助模型编码未来token。
AI.method: 提出LightMTP，一种参数高效的潜在多token预测方法，从模型自身的隐藏状态bootstrap未来token表示，无需外部辅助模型。包含两种变体，将监督扩展至更多未来token，且不引入传统MTP的额外计算开销或外部监督。
AI.result: 最多仅增加1%参数；在通用语言建模基准上保持更优性能，并在规划、编程和推理任务上取得类似增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过复用模型自身隐藏状态实现轻量级潜在多token预测，可在极低参数开销下兼顾语言建模质量与下游任务表现。

title: TrustMI: Causally controlling how assistants trust their users
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) assistants routinely decide whether they can trust users and third parties whose competence, intentions, and integrity they cannot verify. This uncertainty matters for safety, as trusting the wrong party can lead an agent to comply with harmful requests or act on malicious instructions encountered during tool use. To study this problem, we define trust as an assistant's willingness to accept vulnerability to the actions of another party and ask whether such behavior can be causally controlled through model activations. We build 2,000 contrastive conversations spanning ability, benevolence, and integrity, where paired responses complete the same request but differ in whether the assistant trusts the user. From these pairs, we learn steering matrices while keeping the model parameters frozen and test them across six instruction-tuned models from three families, finding that steering changes trust decisions monotonically in both directions. We then ask whether this effect extends to several safety-related agent settings involving harmful requests, prompt injections, and insider threats, while using benign-task and reasoning as controls. Our findings provide evidence that trust in the user can be causally controlled along linear directions in model activations and provide a way to study how trust shapes safety-relevant behavior in language models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将"对用户的信任"定义为助手愿意接受他人行为带来的脆弱性，构建了2,000组对比对话并学习激活空间中的线性操控矩阵，在三个家族六个指令微调模型上验证信任行为可沿线性方向被因果操控，且该效应延伸至有害请求、提示注入与内部威胁等安全场景。
AI.motivation: LLM助手在日常交互中必须判断能否信任能力、意图与诚信均无法验证的用户及第三方。这种不确定性具有安全意义：错误信任可能导致智能体顺从有害请求，或在工具使用过程中执行恶意指令。然而，信任这一行为是否可被因果调控此前缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 作者将信任操作化为助手"愿意接受对他人行为的脆弱性"。围绕能力（ability）、善意（benevolence）与诚信（integrity）三个维度构建2,000组对比对话，配对回答完成同一请求但在是否信任用户上存在差异。基于这些配对样本，在冻结模型参数的前提下学习操控矩阵（steering matrices），并在来自三个家族、六个指令微调模型上进行测试；随后将操控效应迁移到涉及有害请求、提示注入与内部威胁的多种安全相关智能体场景，同时以良性任务与推理任务作为对照。
AI.result: 操控在两个方向上均能单调地改变信任决策，且该效应在六个指令微调模型上均可复现。信任操控的影响进一步延伸到有害请求、提示注入和内部威胁等安全相关设置中，而良性任务与推理对照表现稳定。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明对用户的信任可沿模型激活空间中的线性方向被因果控制，为研究信任如何塑造语言模型的安全相关行为提供了方法路径。

title: Cross-Lingual Transferability of Training Data Extraction Attacks to Recover Memorized PII
summary:
The robustness of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) protection in Large Language Models (LLMs) is a critical concern, yet the risks associated with cross-lingual data extraction remain under-explored. This study evaluates the vulnerability of English-centric and multilingual models to Training Data Extraction (TDE) attacks when prompted in non-English languages.
  We construct a multi-domain PII dataset comprising social media handles, email addresses, and phone numbers and translate the attack contexts into Italian, Spanish, French, and German. Our results show that TDE attacks against both English-centric and multilingual models transfer to different languages: the attacks are successful on translated prompts, even though only the original English prompt might have been included in the pre-training data. A web-presence check on a sample of the translations confirms that they are not available online. The share of English leaks recovered in other languages grows with the multilingual capability of the model, and it drops sharply when the original wording is lost, even without a change of language.
  This suggests that native multilingual pre-training facilitates the emergence of latent cross-linguistic bridges that simplify the retrieval of personally identifiable information (PII). We analyze the activations of multilingual large language models (LLMs) and find that different translations of the same prompt are bridged in similar representations, with the strongest alignment in the middle layers.
  Our results highlight a fundamental security gap in modern LLMs, necessitating more robust, language-agnostic sanitization strategies for future model alignment.

AI.tldr: 该研究揭示了大语言模型在跨语言场景下的训练数据提取（TDE）风险：针对英语提示的攻击可迁移至意大利语、西班牙语、法语和德语，泄露的个人身份信息（PII）随模型多语言能力增强而增多，且不同语言版本的同一提示在模型中间层激活表征上高度对齐，表明多语言预训练会形成潜在的跨语言"桥梁"，从而简化PII检索。
AI.motivation: PII保护在大语言模型中的鲁棒性是关键问题，但跨语言数据提取的风险尚未被充分探索。现有研究多以英语为中心，忽略了非英语提示可能绕过安全防护、触发对预训练数据中PII的提取，这一安全缺口亟需评估。
AI.method: 构建包含社交媒体账号、电子邮箱和电话号码的多领域PII数据集；将攻击上下文翻译为意大利语、西班牙语、法语和德语；对英语中心模型与多语言模型开展训练数据提取（TDE）攻击实验；对翻译样本进行网络存在性检查以确认其非公开可得；分析多语言LLM的激活表征，考察同一提示不同翻译版本的表征对齐情况及其层级分布。
AI.result: TDE攻击在英语中心和多语言模型上均可跨语言迁移，即使预训练数据中仅包含原始英语提示，针对翻译提示的攻击依然成功。网络存在性检查确认翻译文本未在线上公开。其他语言中恢复的英语泄露比例随模型多语言能力提升而增长；当原始措辞被改变时（即使语言不变），泄露比例急剧下降。激活分析显示同一提示的不同翻译在相似表征上形成"桥接"，且中间层对齐最强。
AI.conclusion: 原生多语言预训练会促成潜在的跨语言"桥梁"表征，从而简化PII检索，构成现代LLM的一项根本性安全缺口。未来模型对齐需要更鲁棒、语言无关的数据净化（sanitization）策略，而不能仅依赖单一语言层面的防护。

title: From Traces to Agentic Worlds: Agentic Language World Models for Interactive Environment Simulation
summary: Realistic environment replicas are increasingly valuable for training and evaluating LLM agents, yet the original systems may be inaccessible or impractical to reproduce. We explore agentic language world modeling: rather than rebuilding an executable environment, a world model agent serves as the environment for a task agent and supports faithful and stateful simulation. We instantiate this paradigm with Trace2Env, a learning-free framework for settings where the original system is unavailable but historical interaction traces remain accessible. Trace2Env reconstructs these traces into a reusable environment worldbook containing environment schemas, grounded evidence, and induced behavioral knowledge. At runtime, the world model agent actively consults the worldbook together with persistent episodic state to infer each action's observation and lasting state effects. Across nine environments, Trace2Env improves both next-observation fidelity and long-horizon interaction consistency over conventional prompt-based LWMs. In multi-turn interaction, task agent actions generated against Trace2Env remain valid more often when replayed in the real environment, indicating that its simulated dynamics better preserve the consequences of earlier actions across successive turns. These results establish agentic language world modeling as an alternative direction for building realistic environment replicas without reconstructing the original executable system.

AI.tldr: Trace2Env 提出一种免学习的“智能体语言世界模型”范式，用世界模型智能体替代可执行环境，基于历史交互轨迹构建可复用的环境世界书，实现忠实且有状态的模拟。
AI.motivation: 为训练和评估 LLM 智能体，真实环境副本很有价值，但原始系统往往无法访问或难以复现，重建可执行环境成本高。
AI.method: 不重建可执行环境，而是让世界模型智能体充当任务智能体的环境。Trace2Env 将历史交互轨迹重构为可复用的“世界书”，包含环境 schema、有据证据与归纳的行为知识；运行时世界模型智能体结合世界书与持久化情节状态，推断每个动作的观察结果与持久状态效应。
AI.result: 在九个环境中，相比传统基于提示的语言世界模型，Trace2Env 提升了下一观察保真度与长时程交互一致性；多轮交互下，针对 Trace2Env 生成的任务智能体动作在真实环境重放时有效比例更高，说明其模拟动态能更好地保持前序动作的后果。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，智能体语言世界建模是在不重建原始可执行系统的前提下构建逼真环境副本的一条可行替代方向。

title: Introducing Code-Switched Contexts to Cognitively-Inspired Bilingual Model Training
summary: During language acquisition, bilingual children are regularly exposed to code-switched input and use it as a cognitive scaffold to accelerate vocabulary growth and cross-linguistic syntactic mapping. In contrast, computational bilingual models are conventionally pretrained on interleaved monolingual corpora. While introducing synthetic code-switching during pretraining has become a promising strategy to enhance cross-lingual alignment and downstream performance, the structural and developmental parameters governing the success remain poorly understood. In this work, we investigate the efficiency of training with synthetic code-switched data across two typologically distinct language pairs by controlling two key variables: the structural location of code-switches and the dynamic switching rate across training stages. Our results show that training with code-switched data improves cross-lingual alignment for typologically close languages.

AI.tldr: 本文研究合成语码转换预训练的效率，通过控制语码转换的结构位置与训练阶段的动态转换率，发现该策略对类型学相近语言的跨语言对齐有提升作用。
AI.motivation: 双语儿童在语言习得中经常接触语码转换输入，并将其作为认知支架加速词汇增长和跨语言句法映射；而计算双语模型通常仅用交错单语语料预训练。尽管在预训练中引入合成语码转换已成为提升跨语言对齐与下游性能的潜在策略，但决定其成败的结构与发育参数仍缺乏理解。
AI.method: 作者在两组类型学差异明显的语言对上，通过控制两个关键变量来考察合成语码转换数据的训练效率：一是语码转换在结构上的位置，二是训练过程中动态变化的转换率。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，使用语码转换数据训练能够改善类型学相近语言之间的跨语言对齐。
AI.conclusion: 语码转换预训练的效果受结构与训练阶段参数影响，并且其收益在语言类型学相近的情况下更为明显；该结论为设计更有效的双语预训练策略提供了参考。

title: Cross-lingual Calibration of Pre-Generation Success Probes for Multilingual LLM Routing
summary: Pre-generation success probes estimate response correctness from a language model's hidden activations before decoding, enabling cost-aware routing. While prior work has demonstrated their utility primarily on English inputs, we study their reliability across languages along three dimensions: (1) whether they preserve the ranking of likely successes and failures (DISCRIMINATION); (2) whether they retain probabilities that match observed success frequencies (CALIBRATION); and (3) whether they produce scores comparable enough across candidate models for cost-aware multilingual routing (UTILITY). Using 3,000 MATH problems in 10 languages and 8 open-weight model configurations, we compare cross-lingual transfer from English-trained probes and equal-budget pooled multilingual probes. English-trained probes retain useful cross-lingual discrimination but become less well calibrated after transfer. Pooled multilingual supervision improves both properties and yields more reliable estimates of success. In routing experiments, the pooled router achieves a 0.7% higher test success rate while reducing modeled cost by 13.0% relative to always selecting the model with the highest average success. These results show that multilingual routing requires success estimates that remain well calibrated and comparable across languages and models.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究预生成成功探针（pre-generation success probes）在多语言场景下的可靠性，围绕区分度、校准性和路由效用三个维度，使用3000道MATH题、10种语言和8个开源模型配置，比较英语训练探针的跨语言迁移与等预算多语言池化探针。结果显示英语探针迁移后区分度仍可用但校准变差，池化多语言监督能同时改善区分度与校准性，并在路由中取得更高成功率与更低建模成本。
AI.motivation: 预生成成功探针可在解码前从语言模型隐藏激活中估计回答正确性，从而支持成本感知路由；但既有工作主要验证于英语输入，其跨语言可靠性尚不清楚。作者希望检验探针在多语言环境中是否仍能保持成功与失败的排序、概率校准以及与候选模型可比性，以支撑多语言成本感知路由。
AI.method: 使用3,000道MATH问题、10种语言和8个开源权重模型配置，从三个维度评估预生成成功探针：(1) 区分度，是否保持可能成功与失败的排序；(2) 校准性，保留的概率是否匹配观测成功频率；(3) 效用，分数是否在候选模型间足够可比以支持成本感知多语言路由。比较英语训练探针的跨语言迁移与等预算池化多语言探针。
AI.result: 英语训练探针保留了有用的跨语言区分度，但迁移后校准性下降。池化多语言监督同时改善区分度与校准性，并产生更可靠的失败/成功估计。在路由实验中，池化路由器相对始终选择平均成功率最高模型，测试成功率提高0.7%，建模成本降低13.0%。
AI.conclusion: 多语言路由要求成功估计在不同语言和不同候选模型之间保持良好校准且可比。仅依赖英语训练探针的跨语言迁移不足以保证校准性与可比性，而采用池化多语言监督可提升探针质量并带来实际路由收益。

title: Shared Stopping Decisions Change Answers in HQQ Cache Quantization
summary: Language-model systems batch questions for throughput, but unrelated questions should not change a target's answer when its input and numerical execution are fixed. We study compression of the key and value cache, which stores attention representations reused during generation. With request-local groups, Transformers' Half-Quadratic Quantization (HQQ) backend updates compression parameters separately but uses a shared average error to decide when all updates stop. Replacing only the question batched with the target changes four-bit HQQ answers in 170/384 test comparisons across two models. Replaying the other execution's update counts reproduces its complete answer and cache fingerprints in every changed pair, in both directions. Computing the stopping mean in FP32 reduces cache differences but leaves answer changes. Native HQQ also changes confirmed numerical correctness in eight arithmetic pairs. Fixed iterations and request-local stopping remove observed companion dependence under matched controls. Request-local stopping remains sensitive to synthetic padding changes at the tensor level. Fixing the original iteration budget removes this decision path without tuning. Neither repair has an established quality advantage, and natural rebatching still changes answers. Request-independence audits must cover stopping decisions as well as quantization groups.

AI.tldr: 论文发现HQQ量化后端在批处理中，压缩参数的“停止决策”使用了跨请求共享的平均误差，导致同一目标问题与不同伴随问题同批时答案改变；改为请求局部停止或固定迭代数可消除该依赖，但自然重批仍会改变答案。
AI.motivation: 语言模型系统为提升吞吐量进行批处理，但独立问题不应影响目标问题的答案。作者试图检验KV缓存压缩（HQQ）在批处理下是否满足这种请求独立性，并定位导致答案变化的机制。
