AI.method: 研究KV缓存压缩中HQQ的停止条件。对比请求局部组下HQQ的分组更新与共享平均误差停止规则；在两种模型、384组测试中，仅替换与目标同批的伴随问题，观察4-bit HQQ答案变化；通过重放另一执行的更新次数、将停止均值以FP32计算、采用固定迭代与请求局部停止等控制实验，分离停止决策与量化分组的影响。
AI.result: 仅替换同批伴随问题即导致170/384次比较中4-bit HQQ答案改变；重放另一执行的更新次数可在所有变化对中双向复现其完整答案与缓存指纹；FP32计算停止均值可减小缓存差异但不消除答案变化；原生HQQ在8个算术对中改变已验证的数值正确性；固定迭代与请求局部停止在匹配控制下消除伴随依赖；请求局部停止对张量级合成padding变化仍敏感。
AI.conclusion: 请求独立性审计必须同时覆盖量化分组与停止决策。两种修复均无已确立的质量优势，且自然重批仍会改变答案，说明批处理下的答案不一致性尚未完全解决。

title: Probabilistic Race and Ethnicity Prediction Using Group-Specific Name Lists
summary: Statistically valid estimation of racial and ethnic disparities often requires inferring the probability that an individual belongs to a particular racial or ethnic group given only their name and geographic location. The standard approach, Bayesian Improved Surname Geocoding (BISG), relies on group population frequencies for each name. Although the U.S. Census Bureau provides such information for common names and a limited set of racial categories, comparable data do not exist for many racial and ethnic groups and are rarely available outside the U.S. We propose the list-powered BISG ($\ell$BISG) method, which can be used to derive calibrated group probabilities from group-specific name lists. These lists may be compiled based on expert knowledge or generated synthetically using large language models (LLMs), and thus may be subject to unknown biases. Representing names as embeddings, we treat list membership as a proxy prediction task and apply a correction based on proximal inference to recover the target group probabilities. We validate the method on U.S. voter files with self-reported race, on the full-count 1900 U.S. Census, and on the Lebanese voter registry. We find that LLM-generated name lists yield accurate and well-calibrated probabilities as well as precise disparity estimates comparable to those obtained using methods that require name-race data. Thus, $\ell$BISG substantially broadens the applicability of probabilistic race and ethnicity prediction to settings where name-race data are unavailable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 list-powered BISG（ℓBISG）方法，仅利用群体姓名列表即可校准个体种族/族裔概率，无需依赖 Census 姓名-种族频数数据。
AI.motivation: 估计种族与族裔差异需要由姓名和地理位置推断个体所属群体的概率。标准方法 BISG 依赖各姓名的群体人口频率，但美国 Census 只覆盖常见姓名和有限类别，许多群体及美国以外地区缺乏此类姓名-种族数据。
AI.method: 将姓名表示为嵌入向量，把"姓名是否出现在群体专属名单中"视为代理预测任务，并基于 proximal inference 进行偏差校正，从而从群体专属姓名列表中推导经过校准的群体概率。姓名列表可来自专家知识，也可由大语言模型（LLM）合成。
AI.result: 在美国含自报种族的选民档案、1900 年全量美国人口普查以及黎巴嫩选民登记数据上验证：LLM 生成的姓名列表可给出准确且校准良好的概率，其差异估计精度与需要姓名-种族数据的方法相当。
AI.conclusion: ℓBISG 大幅拓展了概率性种族与族裔预测的适用范围，使其可应用于缺少姓名-种族数据的场景。

title: DeferKV: Rethinking Eviction Timing for One-Shot KV Cache Compression
summary: Long-context large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities across a wide range of tasks, but the growing KV cache introduces substantial memory and inference overhead. Existing one-shot KV cache compression methods typically commit to irreversible eviction immediately after prefill, before any signal from actual generation becomes available. Our quantitative analysis shows that early queries from the actual generation stage provide attention signals that are more consistent with subsequent decode attention, with the largest single-step gain occurring at the prefill-decode boundary. Based on this observation, we propose DeferKV, which moves the eviction decision from the end of prefill to the first real decoding step and temporally combines prompt-side and decode-side observations, thereby better aligning KV importance estimation with subsequent generation requirements. DeferKV requires no additional training, draft model, or future-query prediction module, making it simple and easy to deploy. Experiments on LongBench, RULER, and Needle-in-a-Haystack demonstrate that DeferKV consistently improves model performance under KV cache compression while maintaining low inference latency.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出DeferKV，将KV cache的淘汰决策从prefill结束时刻推迟到第一个真实解码步，并融合prompt侧与解码侧注意力信号，无需额外训练或草稿模型即可提升长上下文压缩性能。
AI.motivation: 长上下文LLM的KV cache带来显著内存与推理开销。现有一次性压缩方法在prefill后立即执行不可逆淘汰，此时尚未获得真实生成阶段的任何信号，导致KV重要性估计与实际后续解码需求不一致。
AI.method: 通过定量分析发现，真实生成阶段早期query的注意力信号与后续解码注意力更一致，且最大单步增益出现在prefill-decode边界。据此将淘汰决策从prefill末移至首个真实解码步，并时间上结合prompt侧与解码侧观测，使KV重要性估计更贴合后续生成需求；方法无需额外训练、草稿模型或未来query预测模块。
AI.result: 在LongBench、RULER和Needle-in-a-Haystack上，DeferKV在KV cache压缩下持续提升模型性能，同时保持较低推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 推迟淘汰时机并融合解码侧信号是一种简单易部署的KV cache压缩策略，能在不增加训练或预测开销的情况下改善长上下文生成质量。

title: From Abusive Language Classification to Sequence Labeling Identification
summary: Industrial content moderation must process massive message streams under tight latency constraints, yet most abusive language (AL) detection systems rely on sentence-level classification (ALC), which neither localizes abusive spans nor identifies who is targeted. We define Abusive Language Identification (ALI) as a sequence-labeling task that jointly extracts AL spans and target mentions, and assess whether this approach can be used for text moderation. On a pilot corpus drawn from a production moderation pipeline, we compare ALI with ALC on cross-domain generalization and implicit abuse, and we also evaluate AL and target span detection. ALI remains competitive with ALC while providing localized outputs for moderators, with a modest and configuration-sensitive advantage on implicit abuse. Exact AL boundaries and target spans remain difficult to recover. We complement this comparison with a qualitative analysis and discuss perspectives on complete target--span linking and on structured benchmarks for ALI.

AI.tldr: 该论文将滥用语言识别定义为序列标注任务ALI，同时抽取滥用片段与目标提及，并在生产审核语料上与句级分类ALC进行对比评估。
AI.motivation: 工业内容审核需在严格延迟约束下处理海量消息流，但主流滥用语言检测依赖句级分类ALC，既不定位滥用片段，也不识别被攻击对象，难以满足审核需求。
AI.method: 从生产审核流水线抽取试点语料，将ALI建模为序列标注任务，联合抽取AL片段与目标提及；与ALC在跨域泛化和隐式滥用上进行对比，并评估AL片段与目标片段检测。
AI.result: ALI与ALC整体表现相当，同时可为审核人员提供定位输出；在隐式滥用上具有适度且对配置敏感的优势；但精确的AL边界与目标片段仍难以恢复。
AI.conclusion: ALI可作为文本审核的可行方案，兼具定位能力与竞争力；未来需推进完整的目标—片段链接及面向ALI的结构化基准建设，并辅以定性分析。

title: DialectSentEval 2026: Arabic Dialect Sentiment Analysis and Swapping Shared Task
summary: Sentiment analysis is a fundamental problem in Natural Language Processing (NLP). Standard sentiment classification for the Arabic language remains challenging due to the high volume of dialectal Arabic. To advance research in this area, this paper proposes the Shared Task on Sentiment Analysis and Swapping in Arabic Dialects (DialectSentEval), hosted with the Arabic Natural Language Processing Conference (ArabicNLP 2026). This shared task consists of two subtasks: Subtask 1 focuses on multi-class and multi-dialect sentiment analysis, requiring models to identify sentiment polarity across various Arabic dialects. Subtask 2 introduces a generative task for Arabic sentiment swap, challenging models to invert sentiment polarity while preserving core semantics. In this overview paper, we present the motivation, dataset creation, and summarize the main findings from participating models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍DialectSentEval共享任务（ArabicNLP 2026），含阿拉伯语方言情感分析（子任务1）与情感极性反转生成（子任务2），并综述数据集构建及参赛模型结果。
AI.motivation: 标准阿拉伯语情感分类因大量方言阿拉伯语而仍具挑战性，需推动该领域研究。
AI.method: 提出DialectSentEval共享任务，设置两个子任务：子任务1为多类别、多方言情感分析（跨方言识别情感极性）；子任务2为生成式阿拉伯语情感反转，要求模型反转情感极性同时保留核心语义。论文还介绍了数据集构建方法。
AI.result: 综述论文总结了参赛模型的主要发现（摘要中未给出具体指标）。
AI.conclusion: 通过共享任务推动阿拉伯语方言情感分析与情感反转生成研究，为后续工作提供基准与数据支持。

title: Agentic schema-guided extraction of materials process knowledge from scientific literature
comment: 15 pages, 3 figures, submitted for review to Nature Communications Materials
summary: Materials literature contains detailed experimental knowledge, but procedures, chemical entities and measurements remain difficult to aggregate because they are reported in heterogeneous forms and depend on process-specific context. We present SciKGExtract, a schema-guided framework that combines large-language-model extraction with chemical normalization and agent-based evaluation and refinement before knowledge-graph integration. We evaluate the framework on 176 atomic-layer-deposition papers describing zinc oxide (ZnO) and indium--gallium--zinc oxide (IGZO), together with an expert-annotated full-schema subset. PubChem normalization improves exact-match extraction F1 for every tested model. For ZnO, the best F1 increases from 0.591 for direct normalized extraction to 0.805 with agentic refinement, whereas the best IGZO result is 0.344, revealing the greater difficulty of multicomponent supercycle processes. Evaluation against a deeply nested schema containing 65 experimental properties and 155 quantitative measurement nodes further exposes errors in process segmentation and numerical assignment. These results show that chemical canonicalization and targeted agentic verification provide complementary controls for converting complex materials literature into reusable, machine-actionable experimental knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出模式引导框架SciKGExtract，结合大模型抽取、化学归一化与智能体评估精修，将ALD文献转为可复用知识图谱。
AI.motivation: 材料文献含丰富实验知识，但程序、化学实体与测量数据形式异构且依赖工艺语境，难以聚合。
AI.method: 在大模型抽取基础上引入PubChem化学归一化，并采用智能体评估与精修，再整合进知识图谱；在176篇ZnO与IGZO的原子层沉积论文及专家标注全模式子集上评测。
AI.result: PubChem归一化提升所有测试模型的精确匹配F1；ZnO最佳F1由直接归一化抽取的0.591提升至智能体精修的0.805，IGZO最佳仅0.344，体现多组分超循环工艺更难；含65项实验属性与155个定量测量节点的深层嵌套模式评测暴露工艺分段与数值归属错误。
AI.conclusion: 化学规范化与定向智能体验证互为补充，可将复杂材料文献转化为可复用、机器可操作的实验知识。

title: Breaking Bureaucracy: Evaluating open-source LLMs for legal document review
summary: In this paper, we evaluate open-source generative LLMs on legal Natural Language Inference (NLI). Legal inspectorial processes take place in specific domains and often deal with confidential data. This creates a need for working with local models that do not require labeled training data. We evaluate our models on the ContractNLI benchmark and two NLI4Wills datasets. We successfully reproduce the baseline for the task (Span NLI BERT) and we evaluate multiple open-source LLMs on the same task. We analyze the invalid rate of the models, and their stability across temperature settings and domains. Among the generative models, Gemma-4 26B performs the best, reaching an accuracy of 81.2%, even outperforming the supervised model on one metric. On accuracy, it is not possible to beat the supervised model with zero-shot approaches. Qwen-3.6 35B performs well on both ContractNLI and additional datasets in the legal wills domain. Our findings indicate that zero-shot, open-source, generative LLMs are a viable alternative for real-world legal NLI when no supervised data is available. Our code is available at https://github.com/fbaratov/contractnli-llms.

AI.tldr: 本文评估开源生成式LLM在法律自然语言推理(NLI)任务上的零样本表现，在ContractNLI和两个NLI4Wills数据集上进行测试，发现Gemma-4 26B准确率达81.2%，部分指标超越监督模型，证明无监督数据时开源生成式LLM是可行替代方案。
AI.motivation: 法律审查过程发生在特定领域且常涉及机密数据，这产生了对无需标注训练数据的本地模型的需求。因此需要评估开源生成式LLM在法律NLI任务上的适用性。
AI.method: 在ContractNLI基准和两个NLI4Wills数据集上评估多个开源生成式LLM；成功复现基线模型Span NLI BERT；分析模型在温度设置和跨领域下的无效率和稳定性；采用零样本方法进行推理。
AI.result: Gemma-4 26B表现最佳，准确率达81.2%，在其中一项指标上甚至超越监督模型；在整体准确率上零样本方法无法超越监督模型；Qwen-3.6 35B在ContractNLI和法律遗嘱领域数据集上均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，当没有监督数据可用时，零样本、开源、生成式LLM是现实世界法律NLI任务的可行替代方案。

title: Ontology Concept Overlap as a Training Signal: Knowledge-Grounded Reinforcement Learning for Clinical Question Answering
summary: Reinforcement learning post-training for language models relies on two reward designs: human preferences (RLHF, DPO) and binary verifiers (RLVR). Clinical question answering fits neither. Near-correct answers differ by a single substituted entity, and no executable check decides clinical correctness. We instantiate a soft verifier from a maintained controlled vocabulary: UMLS Concept Unique Identifier overlap (via scispaCy, set-level F1) gives a graded, externally specified reward computed without a model in the loop. We combine it inside GRPO with an entropy-normalised LLM judge, which covers the safety and evidence axes overlap cannot see, and a small consistency penalty on padding and repetition that keeps early-training samples scorable. This three-term composite improves over SFT on Phi-3-mini (3.8B) over MedQA by 2.9% on EM (0.700 vs 0.680) and 39% on Token-F1 (0.202 vs 0.145); on Llama-3.2-3B the corresponding gains are 14% on EM and 35% on Token-F1. We report Token-F1 as the primary metric because it credits partially-correct clinical content that EM discards at this open-generation scale. Main-table results are means over 3 seeds with standard deviations below 0.005. The method transfers to PubMedQA, where training on the PubMedQA train set with the same composite reward improves Token-F1 over SFT by 22% on Phi-3-mini and 17% on Llama-3.2-3B without retuning. A reward ablation on Phi-3, varying the judge-ontology split at a fixed consistency weight, attributes 3 EM points to the ontology term, the contribution that catches entity substitutions the judge cannot. Three negative findings constrain the design: DPO under random negatives underperforms SFT for strong-prior models but helps the weakest-prior one; PPO under a sparse neural reward diverges; GRPO with KL-in-loss collapses at 7B.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对临床问答提出一种复合奖励的GRPO后训练方法：用UMLS概念唯一标识符重叠构建免模型软验证器，结合熵归一化LLM评判器和一致性惩罚，在Phi-3-mini与Llama-3.2-3B上显著提升EM与Token-F1，并可零调参迁移至PubMedQA。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型强化学习后训练依赖两类奖励设计：人类偏好（RLHF、DPO）与二元验证器（RLVR）。但临床问答两者皆不适用——近似正确答案往往只差一个被替换的实体，且不存在可执行检查来判定临床正确性。因此需要一个分级、外部指定、无需模型参与计算的奖励信号。
AI.method: 从受维护的受控词表UMLS构建软验证器：通过scispaCy计算概念唯一标识符（CUI）重叠的集合级F1，得到分级奖励。在GRPO中将其与熵归一化LLM评判器（覆盖安全性与证据维度）以及针对填充与重复的小型一致性惩罚组合为三项复合奖励。模型为Phi-3-mini（3.8B）与Llama-3.2-3B。
AI.result: 在MedQA上优于SFT：Phi-3-mini上EM提升2.9%（0.700 vs 0.680），Token-F1提升39%（0.202 vs 0.145）；Llama-3.2-3B上EM提升14%、Token-F1提升35%。主表为3个随机种子的均值，标准差低于0.005。零调参迁移至PubMedQA：Token-F1较SFT在Phi-3-mini上提升22%、Llama-3.2-3B上提升17%。Phi-3上的奖励消融（固定一致性权重、变化评判器—本体划分）显示本体项贡献3个EM点。负面发现：随机负样本下DPO对强先验模型不如SFT、对弱先验模型有增益；稀疏神经奖励下PPO发散；KL置于损失中的GRPO在7B规模崩塌。
AI.conclusion: 以Token-F1为主要指标，因其能认可EM在开放生成规模下丢弃的部分正确临床内容。UMLS本体项可捕捉评判器无法发现的实体替换，是性能提升的关键来源。复合奖励设计在跨模型、跨数据集上具备可迁移性，且三类负面结果对方法设计构成约束。

title: Do Speech Representations Preserve Regional Accent Across Read and Spontaneous Speech?
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: Regional accent cues can be captured under matched conditions, but it remains unclear whether they persist between read and spontaneous speech. We study RVG1, with 500 German speakers from nine regions, comparing ten speech representations on regional classification and continuous geolocation under matched conditions and speaker-independent read--spontaneous transfer. Whisper performs best under matched conditions, reaching 0.489 nine-way UAR and 148 km median geolocation error, but drops to 0.11/0.18 UAR across transfer directions and 363 km geolocation error. Self-supervised models show a similar degradation, whereas speaker embeddings are less discriminative in-domain but more robust under transfer. This contrast is consistent across classification and geolocation. Across representations, robustness is associated with how little a representation shifts between styles (style-invariance), for which crossstyle speaker retrieval is an interpretable proxy. Age, sex, sentence-overlap, and duration controls do not account for the gap, although channel characteristics contribute. These results show that strong matched-condition performance does not indicate robust regional information.

AI.tldr: 在RVG1数据集（500名德国说话人、9个地区）上对比10种语音表征：匹配条件下Whisper区域分类与地理定位最优，但朗读—自发跨风格迁移时性能大幅下降；说话人嵌入域内判别性较弱却更具迁移鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 区域口音线索在匹配条件下可被捕获，但其能否在朗读与自发语音之间保持，尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建/使用RVG1数据集（500名德语说话人，来自9个地区）；比较10种语音表征，在匹配条件和说话人无关的朗读—自发迁移条件下，评估九分类区域识别（UAR）与连续地理定位误差；并考察风格不变性（以跨风格说话人检索为代理指标）及年龄、性别、句子重叠、时长、信道等控制因素。
AI.result: 匹配条件：Whisper最佳，九分类UAR=0.489，地理定位中位误差148 km；跨方向迁移时UAR降至0.11/0.18，定位误差升至363 km。自监督模型同样退化；说话人嵌入域内判别性较低但迁移更鲁棒。该对比在分类与定位任务上一致。鲁棒性与表征的风格不变性（跨风格说话人检索）相关。年龄、性别、句子重叠、时长不能解释该差距，信道特征有一定贡献。
AI.conclusion: 强匹配条件性能并不代表区域信息具有鲁棒性；跨朗读—自发风格迁移会显著削弱区域口音表征，风格不变性是理解表征鲁棒性的关键。

title: The Assistance Dilemma: Learning to Teach via Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) trained to answer questions are natively poor at teaching. Reinforcement Learning (RL) against a simulated student is a promising approach to improve their pedagogy, but existing RL-trained tutors reward the student's success on the tutored problem with the tutor's words still in context. The reward is then easiest to raise by telling the student the answer, and a tuned penalty is needed to reduce telling. Drawing on learning sciences, we introduce a masked near-transfer post-test: the student is tested on an unseen variant of the tutored problem with the tutor's utterances masked, so the reward can rise only through what the student wrote in its own turns. This discourages cognitive offloading by the student and allows the continuous penalty to be replaced by two binary reward gates (factual correctness of tutor response, no solution handover). A leave-one-out ablation shows that the learning-gain reward on its own does not separate teaching from telling: the gates reduce solution handover while the near-transfer post-test improves out-of-domain transfer. Using these reward designs we develop Eduardo, a multi-turn RL recipe for training LLM tutors, and use it to train 4B, 9B, 14B and 27B models from two distinct LLM architectures. Our post-trained Eduardo-27B model matches Gemini-3.1-Pro on MathTutorBench and Claude Opus 4.8 on TutorMoments at 2.4-6.2x fewer thinking tokens than frontier models, which matters for interactive tutoring. Without being named in the reward, the model more than doubles its use of the push-for-justification teacher move while support fading (e.g., assigning independent work), whose payoff lies beyond a single-problem dialog episode, is trained out. We open-source our training environment, an 8,671-problem near-transfer dataset, and trained models for further development.

AI.tldr: 提出"掩蔽近迁移后测"奖励设计，用两个二元奖励门替代连续惩罚，训练出多轮RL导师模型Eduardo，27B版本在MathTutorBench上匹敌Gemini-3.1-Pro，思考token少2.4–6.2倍。
AI.motivation: 以模拟学生做RL训练LLM导师时，奖励基于"学生在导师话语仍在上下文中的原题表现"，导致模型只需直接给出答案即可轻松提高奖励，须依赖人工调参的连续惩罚来抑制"报答案"。因此需要一种奖励机制，从根本上区分"教学"与"告知"。
AI.method: 1) 掩蔽近迁移后测：在未见过的题目变体上测试学生，且掩蔽导师的话语，使奖励只能来自学生自身回合的作答，从而抑制认知卸载；2) 以两个二元奖励门（导师回答的事实正确性、不直接交出解法）替代连续惩罚；3) 通过留一法消融验证各奖励分量作用；4) 据此构建Eduardo多轮RL训练配方，训练4B/9B/14B/27B四种规模、两种架构的模型。
AI.result: 留一法消融显示：仅用学习增益奖励无法分离教学与告知；奖励门减少解法直接给予，近迁移后测提升跨域迁移。Eduardo-27B在MathTutorBench上匹配Gemini-3.1-Pro，在TutorMoments上匹配Claude Opus 4.8，且思考token仅为前沿模型的1/2.4–1/6.2。模型未被奖励命名却将"追问理由"(push-for-justification)教学动作的使用翻倍以上；而收益超出单题对话回合的"支架渐撤"(如布置独立作业)则被训练消除。
AI.conclusion: 掩蔽近迁移后测与二元奖励门是一套有效且可扩展的导师RL奖励设计，在提升教学效果的同时大幅降低推理开销，并自发生成特定教学行为；但奖励的短视性会淘汰长程收益的教学策略。作者开源训练环境、8,671题近迁移数据集及训练模型。

title: Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression
summary: KV caches are a major bottleneck in long-context inference and long-form generation with large language models. Existing training-free eviction policies largely rely on proxy importance signals, such as attention mass, to decide which past tokens to retain. We argue that cache compression should instead preserve the predictive behavior of the full-cache model, retaining entries whose removal would substantially change the model's output distribution. We propose Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression, a training-free framework that scores candidate evictions by estimating the compressed-cache logits induced by their removal and evaluating the resulting KL to the full-cache next-token distribution. Using pre-eviction forward statistics, the method avoids running separate masked forward passes for each candidate. Across diverse architectures and both prefill-time and generation-time compression, our method delivers substantial gains in downstream task quality over lightweight attention-based heuristics at matched retained-KV budgets, with the largest gains under aggressive compression. It achieves these gains with additional compression-time computation while retaining an end-to-end speedup over full-cache inference in our evaluated settings.

AI.tldr: 提出 Behavior-Preserving KV Cache Compression，一种无需训练的 KV 缓存压缩框架，用移除条目对下一 token 分布的影响（与全缓存分布的 KL）来评分，避免逐候选掩码前向，在多种架构与压缩场景下优于注意力启发式方法。
AI.motivation: 长上下文推理与长文本生成中 KV 缓存是主要瓶颈。现有免训练淘汰策略多依赖代理重要性信号（如注意力质量）来决定保留哪些历史 token，这些信号未必与模型真实预测行为一致，因此需要以"保持预测行为"为目标的压缩准则。
AI.method: 核心观点：缓存压缩应保留全缓存模型的预测行为，即保留那些移除后会显著改变模型输出分布的条目。为此，对候选淘汰项估计其被移除后压缩缓存所产生的 logits，并计算其与全缓存下一 token 分布的 KL 散度作为评分。利用淘汰前的单次前向统计量来近似被掩码后的 logits，从而无需为每个候选单独执行 masked forward pass。
AI.result: 在多种模型架构、预填充阶段与生成阶段压缩、以及匹配的保留 KV 预算下，下游任务质量显著优于轻量级注意力启发式方法，且在激进压缩时增益最大。代价是额外的压缩计算，但在所评估设置中仍相对全缓存推理取得端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: 以行为保持（分布级 KL）为准则的 KV 缓存淘汰，能在不训练的前提下更有效地维持模型预测质量，尤其适合高压缩比场景，并在可接受的计算开销下实现端到端效率提升。

title: AECP: Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol for Multi-Agent Code Generation
summary: As AI agents increasingly tackle complex repository-level coding tasks, distributing work across multiple agents is a natural way to scale beyond the capabilities of a single agent. To coordinate their interdependent work, these agents share findings and agree on interfaces between modules. However, exchanged information often serves only as context, leaving individual agents to interpret it and incorporate it into subsequent work. Consequently, shared findings may go unused and deviations from interface agreements may go undetected, undermining the reliability and efficiency of collaboration. This motivates moving part of the coordination responsibility from individual agents to the execution harness. To make shared information actionable during execution, we introduce the Artifact-Exclusive Communication Protocol (AECP). AECP requires agents to communicate exclusively through structured artifacts and specifies how the harness processes them. The harness supplies findings when agents access relevant code, screens implementations for mismatches with recorded interface commitments, and requires affected agents to revisit revised agreements. These coordination steps become part of harness execution rather than actions that agents must initiate from prior messages. Across Doc2Repo, NL2Repo, and CodeProjectEval, using closed- and open-source models including Opus-4.8 and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, AECP improves average test pass rate by 28.2% and reduces average wall time by 16.5% relative to an agent team using free-form inter-agent messages. Artifact-exclusive communication also blocks the relay of malicious instructions between agents, reducing how often they reach other agents from 95% to 0% and how often those agents act on them from 40% to 0%.

AI.tldr: 提出工件专有通信协议（AECP），将多智能体协作中的部分协调职责从个体智能体转移到执行框架，提升仓库级编码任务的可靠性与效率。
AI.motivation: AI智能体处理复杂的仓库级编码任务时，多智能体分工可突破单智能体能力上限。但智能体间交换的信息通常仅作为上下文，需个体自行解读并融入后续工作，导致共享发现可能未被使用、接口约定偏差无法被检测，损害协作的可靠性与效率。因此需要将部分协调职责从个体智能体转移到执行框架。
AI.method: 引入工件专有通信协议（AECP）：要求智能体仅通过结构化工件进行通信，并规定框架如何处理这些工件。框架在智能体访问相关代码时提供发现，筛查实现与记录的接口承诺是否不匹配，并要求受影响的智能体重新审视已修订的约定。这些协调步骤成为框架执行的一部分，而非智能体需依据先前消息主动发起的动作。
AI.result: 在Doc2Repo、NL2Repo和CodeProjectEval上，使用包括Opus-4.8和DeepSeek-V4-Flash在内的闭源与开源模型，相比使用自由形式智能体间消息的智能体团队，AECP平均测试通过率提升28.2%，平均挂钟时间减少16.5%。工件专有通信还能阻断智能体间恶意指令的中继，使恶意指令到达其他智能体的比例从95%降至0%，其他智能体据此行动的比例从40%降至0%。
AI.conclusion: 将部分协调职责从个体智能体转移到执行框架，并通过工件专有通信协议实现可执行的共享信息，能显著提升多智能体仓库级编码任务的测试通过率与效率，同时有效阻断智能体间恶意指令的传播。

title: SOL: Measuring Gaps between Text Distributions by Double Sliced Wasserstein Metrics
summary:
Evaluating text generation requires measuring how well the generated distribution matches the data distribution. For autoregressive models, this is done by the perplexity. Diffusion and flow-based language models can only provide a likelihood bound, whose tightness differs between model families. Sample-based substitutes such as generative perplexity with entropy do not consider the distribution fit. We propose SOL,
  a distance between text distributions. Each sequence is represented by the empirical measure of its hidden states under a fixed transformer and the distributions of these measures are compared by the double sliced Wasserstein distance. We prove that SOL is a metric if the transformer is injective. Experiments show that SOL detects distributional failures, recovers expected model trends, and provides stable sample-based estimates. We put forward SOL to fill the gap in the current evaluation protocol used for non auto-regressive models. As a first step we use SOL to re-evaluate a variety of models trained on OpenWebText.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SOL——一种基于文本分布间距离的生成文本评估指标。用固定Transformer隐状态的经验测度表示序列,以双重切片Wasserstein距离比较分布,在Transformer单射时证明其为度量,并在OpenWebText上验证其能检测分布性失败、复现模型趋势且估计稳定。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型可用困惑度衡量生成分布与数据分布的匹配程度,但扩散与流式语言模型只能给出似然上界,且该上界在不同模型族间紧致度不同;基于采样的替代指标(如带熵的生成困惑度)并不考虑分布拟合,因此非自回归模型的评估协议存在空白。
AI.method: 提出SOL:在固定Transformer下,将每条序列表示为其隐状态的经验测度,再以双重切片Wasserstein距离(double sliced Wasserstein distance)比较这些测度所构成的分布;并证明当Transformer为单射时SOL满足度量性质。
AI.result: 实验表明SOL能够检测分布性失败(detects distributional failures)、复现符合预期的模型趋势(recovers expected model trends),并提供稳定的基于采样的估计。作为第一步,用SOL重新评估了在OpenWebText上训练的多类模型。
AI.conclusion: SOL被提出以填补当前非自回归模型评估协议的空白,可作为文本分布距离度量用于生成文本评估。

title: Test-Time Adaptation of Reasoning Strategies with Bayesian Nonparametric Memory
summary: While modern large language models (LLMs) have been trained to reason through verbalized chains-of-thought, the generation cost grows substantially due to suboptimal paths to reach the final answer. Furthermore, as new insights are discovered while observing various input queries (e.g. through self-reflection), limited mechanisms exist for carrying forward these findings to be applied to subsequent problems. One can view the list of such strategies or behaviors as a growing cheatsheet, with elements retrieved from this memory module at inference-time. In this work, we consider structured cheatsheets, with learned clusters of behaviors. We introduce a Hierarchical Dirichlet Process Gaussian Mixture Model (HDP-GMM) over behavior embeddings, which shares components across domains while allowing domain-specific mixing weights, and uses the posterior predictive to retrieve relevant behaviors for a query; we call this a $\textit{Bayesian Cheatsheet}$. This mechanism allows for cheap adaptation in an online test-time training (TTT) setting, softly updating the mixture's sufficient statistics following each sample and enabling the creation of new components when the synthesized behaviors are sufficiently novel. We demonstrate that Bayesian Cheatsheet achieves clear performance gains relative to existing memory modules across reasoning benchmarks such as AIME'25, Omni-MATH, and PhysReason, even in the cold-start setting. We show that the Bayesian Cheatsheet is an adaptively reorganizing memory module, as behaviors can be re-assigned to components through a single step of collapsed Gibbs sampling. Our findings highlight the value of Bayesian-inspired memory modules for effective test-time adaptation and the role of structure in metacognitive reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出 Bayesian Cheatsheet：基于 HDP-GMM 的行为嵌入记忆模块，在线测试时自适应检索行为以提升 LLM 推理效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 现代 LLM 虽具备言语化思维链推理能力，但达到答案的路径次优导致生成成本高；且从查询中获得的洞见缺乏机制延续到后续问题。现有记忆模块缺少结构化组织与在线更新能力，难以低成本适应测试时分布。
AI.method: 将策略/行为列表视为结构化 cheatsheet，对行为嵌入建模为分层狄利克雷过程高斯混合模型（HDP-GMM）：跨域共享混合分量但允许域特定混合权重，用后验预测分布为查询检索相关行为；在在线测试时训练（TTT）中按样本软更新混合充分统计量，并在合成行为足够新颖时创建新分量；可通过一步坍缩 Gibbs 采样重新分配行为到分量。
AI.result: 在 AIME'25、Omni-MATH、PhysReason 等推理基准上，相对于现有记忆模块取得明显性能提升，且在冷启动设置下依然有效；证实记忆模块能自适应重组织。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯启发的记忆模块对有效测试时自适应具有价值，结构化组织在元认知推理中起关键作用。

title: Anatomy of LLM Sycophancy: What a Flip Rate Hides
summary: A model under pushback can correct itself, capitulate, or hold, and one flip rate counts a correction and a capitulation alike. Using SycoLens, a modular replay protocol, we test how user pressure and evaluation settings shape measured flip rates. Each measurement is one stateless replay of an item, a committed answer, and one scripted user line in a fixed form. Every effect is read against a matched control with the line deleted. Pushback wording, committed text, answer format, boundary distance, and ground truth become factors of one instrument; earlier instruments vary one to three of them. Across eleven frontier models from three providers and about 760,000 controlled replays, which models look sycophantic depends on how the user pushes back. Lines that assert the opposite verdict and lines that challenge the answer without asserting one rank the models almost unrelatedly. Flip effects grow several-fold near a model's boundary, yet items answered identically in every screening draw still carry about half of the most-affected totals. On arithmetic tasks where the truth is known, one model re-derives and corrects itself under pressure while another abandons correct answers without written work. On the model tested, a planted derivation lowers release of the answer it argues for, true or wrong, where a bare stated value does not; the wrong answer is corrected much more often than the true one is abandoned. Under a yes/no readout the rankings come closer, entangled with a pressure-induced shift toward "no". One score per model therefore compares different behaviours across models and benchmarks. We condense these dependencies into a reporting profile; the instrument, records, and analyses will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出SycoLens模块化重放协议，系统检验用户压力与评测设置如何影响"谄媚翻转率"，发现模型是否显得谄媚高度依赖施压方式，单一翻转分数会把自我纠正与屈服混为一谈。
AI.motivation: 现有"谄媚"（sycophancy）测量工具往往只变化少数几个因素，且用一个翻转率同时统计"纠正"与"屈服"两种本质不同的行为，导致跨模型、跨基准的单一分数可能比较的是不同行为，测量结论不可靠。论文动机是厘清测量条件如何塑造翻转率，并给出更可比的报告方式。
AI.method: 提出SycoLens——模块化重放协议：每次测量是无状态地重放一个条目、一个已提交答案和一条固定形式的脚本化用户语句，所有效应对照"删除该语句"的匹配控制组。将施压措辞、已提交文本、答案格式、边界距离、真值作为同一仪器的因子（以往仪器只变化1–3个）。测试来自三家提供商的11个前沿模型，约76万次受控重放；并做算术任务与植入推导的机制实验。
AI.result: 模型是否显得谄媚取决于施压方式：断言相反结论的语句与不给出结论的质疑语句，对模型的排序几乎不相关。翻转效应在模型边界附近增长数倍，但每次筛查回答都相同的条目仍贡献了受影响总量约一半。算术任务中，一个模型在压力下重新推导并自我纠正，另一个则无推导过程地放弃正确答案。植入推导会降低模型给出其所支持答案的概率（无论对错），而仅陈述数值则无此效果；错误答案被纠正的频率远高于正确答案被放弃。在是/否读出口径下模型排序更接近，但混入了压力诱导的"否"倾向偏移。
AI.conclusion: 单一模型分数会把不同行为混在一起比较，跨模型与跨基准的谄媚排名因此不可直接解释。论文将这些依赖关系浓缩为一份"报告档案"（reporting profile），提议按施压措辞等条件分别报告翻转率；仪器、记录与分析将在发表后公开。

title: Before Agent Tells The Lie: Has Deception Already Been Represented?
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based agents can exhibit deceptive behavior during task execution, including hiding failures, fabricating results, or falsely signaling task completion. Existing monitoring approaches mainly detect deception after it appears in observable actions or outputs. In this paper, we investigate whether deceptive behavior can be predicted from an agent's internal representations before it becomes externally visible. We frame deception monitoring as a trajectory-level representation analysis problem and align agent trajectories around key decision points. Using hidden states extracted before these points, we show that future honest and deceptive outcomes can be reliably distinguished, with predictive signals remaining detectable several model calls before the final decision. We further characterize the temporal evolution of these signals: deception-related representations are weak early in execution but become increasingly identifiable as trajectories progress, while transferable structure can emerge before the strongest decision-adjacent signals appear. Finally, we intervene on the identified honest-deceptive representation directions during inference and find that activation steering reduces downstream deceptive behavior, suggesting that these representations influence agent decisions. Our findings indicate that agent deception is an evolving internal process that can be detected and potentially mitigated before it is expressed externally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在智能体欺骗行为外显之前，从大语言模型智能体的内部表征中预测欺骗，并通过对齐轨迹关键决策点、提取隐藏状态实现提前检测与激活干预缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的智能体在任务执行中会出现隐瞒失败、编造结果或虚假报告任务完成等欺骗行为，而已有监控方法主要在欺骗已体现在可观察动作或输出之后才进行检测，缺乏更早的预警与干预手段。
AI.method: 将欺骗监控建模为轨迹级表征分析问题，围绕关键决策点对齐智能体轨迹，提取决策点之前的隐藏状态；分析诚实与欺骗未来结果的可区分性、预测信号在最终决策前若干次模型调用中的可检测性，以及信号随时间演变规律；并在推理阶段对识别出的诚实—欺骗表征方向进行激活引导干预。
AI.result: 未来诚实与欺骗结果可被可靠区分，预测信号在最终决策前数次模型调用即可检测；欺骗相关表征在早期较弱，随轨迹推进逐渐可辨识，且可迁移结构可能早于最接近决策点的强信号出现；激活引导能够减少下游欺骗行为。
AI.conclusion: 智能体欺骗是一个不断演化的内部过程，可在其外部表现之前被检测并有望被缓解，表明内部表征对智能体决策具有影响。

title: Molecules of a Story: Community Detection in PMI-weighted Narrative Networks
summary: Automatically extracted narrative networks -- graphs with entities as nodes and their relations as edges -- have proven useful for revealing central narrative structures through salient entities and their connections (Tangherlini et al. 2020; Labatut and Bost 2019). But a narrative is more than those central structures that everything else revolves around. This work is concerned with the everything else: brief sub-plots, small clusters of descriptions, or associations between minor characters that go under the radar at the macro-level. We present an approach to unearth such peripheral structures. They involve rare entities with limited textual presence, overshadowed by dominant entities and lost among each other in the long tail of many but rare entities (Baayen 2001). We leverage the known tendency of pointwise mutual information (PMI, Church and Hanks 1990) to inflate for rare events, turning its weakness into a strength by weighting edges with PMI to foreground peripheral entity configurations. Communities extracted from the resulting network are structural traces of underlying narrative elements. We demonstrate the approach on The Lord of the Rings. From measures of how concentrated or dispersed a community's activations are across the text, a typology emerges that reveals that peripheral structures form more than a single class: episodic passages, echoing long-distance connections, and recurring threads each surface as distinct configurations. The approach is conceptually simple and surfaces fine-grained narrative details that are lost in abundance, though its deliberate amplification of weak signals comes with inherent sensitivity -- best understood as a lens for exploration rather than a robust extraction pipeline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用PMI对稀有实体加权、从而挖掘叙事网络中"边缘结构"的方法，并以《指环王》为例，揭示出三类不同的边缘叙事构型。
AI.motivation: 已有自动抽取的叙事网络多通过核心实体及其连接揭示主干叙事结构，但叙事还包含大量被宏观结构遮蔽的"其余部分"：简短支线、小型描述簇、次要人物之间的关联等。这些边缘结构由稀有实体构成，淹没在长尾中，需要新方法加以揭示。
AI.method: 利用点互信息（PMI）对稀有事件天然放大（膨胀）的特性，将其"弱点"转化为"优势"：以PMI为边加权，构建加权叙事网络，使边缘实体的配置被凸显；再从该网络中抽取社区，作为底层叙事元素的结构性痕迹。通过度量各社区激活在全文中的集中度或分散度，对不同社区进行类型划分。以《指环王》为案例进行验证。
AI.result: 基于PMI加权的网络所抽取的社区，按其在文本中激活的集中/分散程度，可归纳出一种类型学，表明边缘结构并非单一类别，而是至少呈现为三种不同构型：情节性片段（episodic passages）、远距离回响式连接（echoing long-distance connections）以及反复出现的线索/主题（recurring threads）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法概念简洁，能揭示因数量庞大而被淹没的细粒度叙事细节；但由于刻意放大弱信号，方法本身对噪声具有内在敏感性，因此更适合作为探索性"透镜"，而非稳健的自动抽取流程。

title: Word-Level Text Unmixing via Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing with Language Models
summary: Text from multiple sources can become interleaved into a single sequence when attribution metadata is lost, such as overlapping speech transcripts, document reading flows, or concurrent agent streams. We formalize this challenge as Word-Level Text Unmixing: given an interleaved lexical stream and source count K, recover the original source sequences while preserving every word occurrence and its within-source order exactly. Directly generating separated texts with LLMs can omit, duplicate, or hallucinate words, violating this exact-reconstruction objective. We therefore propose Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing (EPOR), which decouples source-ownership prediction from reconstruction. EPOR adapts a causal LLM to predict canonical ownership routes conditioned on the mixed stream and prior routing decisions. At inference, completion-safe constrained decoding is combined with deterministic indexed reconstruction, yielding structurally valid K-source partitions that preserve every observed occurrence exactly once. We also introduce UNMIXBENCH, covering controlled synthetic mixtures, timestamp-derived speech from AMI and ICSI, layout-derived document streams from ReadingBank, and simulated concurrent digital outputs. Across five evaluation tracks, a 4B EPOR model achieves the lowest mean minimum-permutation word error rate among finetuned baselines, reducing the five-track mean by 22.3% relative to compact source-array generation and remaining competitive with zero-shot frontier LLMs. These results show that when lexical evidence is fully observed, separating ownership inference from lexical regeneration provides a reliable alternative to direct generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"词级文本解混"任务，并设计EPOR方法，将归属预测与重构解耦，在UNMIXBENCH基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 多源文本在丢失归属元数据后可能交错为单一序列（如重叠语音转写、文档阅读流、并发智能体输出）。直接用LLM生成分离文本会出现漏词、重复或幻觉，无法满足精确重构的要求。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为词级文本解混：给定交错词序列和源数量K，恢复原始源序列且严格保留每个词的出现及其源内顺序。提出Evidence-Preserving Ownership Routing (EPOR)，把源归属预测与重构解耦：基于混合流和已有路由决策，用因果LLM预测规范归属路径；推理时结合补全安全约束解码与确定性索引重构，得到结构有效的K源划分。同时构建UNMIXBENCH基准。
AI.result: UNMIXBENCH涵盖受控合成混合、AMI与ICSI的时间戳语音、ReadingBank的版面文档流及模拟并发数字输出。在五个评测赛道上，4B EPOR模型取得微调基线中最低的平均最小排列词错误率，五赛道均值相对紧凑源数组生成降低22.3%，并与零样本前沿LLM具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 当词汇证据被完整观测时，将归属推断与词汇再生成分离，是替代直接生成的一种可靠方案。

title: JEV versus LLMs: Accuracy, Cost and Calibration on Seven Political Science Replications
summary: Large language models (LLMs) annotate and scale political text or constructs by generating text tokens. A new class of models, which TypeSafe markets as "System One" models, instead returns decisions and probability distributions across a user-supplied fixed answer set. A commercial model, JEV, is advertised as having a dramatic cost and speed advantage over traditional LLMs along with better calibrated decisions. As such, it might be useful for social scientists looking to quickly and cost-effectively annotate or scale large corpora of text and have a reliable indicator of a classifier's uncertainty. Yet, the accuracy of these claims and the broader model accuracy in social science text-based tasks are not yet established. In this paper, we do just that and hope to establish the suitability of JEV for social science tasks. We compare JEV with LLMs and human coders from published research, and with a current mid-tier commercial LLM (GPT-6 Luna) and an open-weight alternative (Qwen3.8-27B). We find that JEV matches, or comes close to, the capabilities of both LLMs in a variety of tasks. However, we find no cost advantage over GPT-6 Luna at OpenAI's batch prices. Further, we find that, when each question is asked once, JEV's probabilities are better calibrated than GPT-6 Luna's token probabilities, but not consistently better than Qwen3.8-27B's. We conclude that unless researchers have a need for speed, JEV's only obvious advantage is ease of parsing the underlying choice probabilities.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了TypeSafe公司宣称的"System One"模型JEV在社会科学文本标注任务中的适用性，并将其与已发表研究中的人类编码者、GPT-6 Luna及Qwen3.8-27B进行比较。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）通过生成文本token来标注和量化政治文本或构念。一类新模型（TypeSafe称为"System One"）则直接返回针对用户给定固定答案集的决策与概率分布。商用模型JEV被宣传在成本、速度上较传统LLM有显著优势，且决策校准更优，对需要快速、低成本标注大规模语料并获取可靠不确定性指标的社会科学家颇具吸引力。然而这些声明的准确性以及该类模型在社会科学文本任务中的整体表现尚未得到验证，作者因此希望系统评估JEV在社会科学任务中的适用性。
AI.method: 作者将JEV与已发表研究中的人类编码者、一个当前中端商用LLM（GPT-6 Luna）以及一个开放权重替代模型（Qwen3.8-27B）进行对比，在多种社会科学文本任务上评估其表现，并考察其成本与概率校准（calibration）情况。
AI.result: 在多种任务上，JEV的能力与两个LLM相当或接近。但在OpenAI的批量价格下，JEV相较GPT-6 Luna并无成本优势。当每个问题仅提问一次时，JEV的概率校准优于GPT-6 Luna的token概率，但并未稳定优于Qwen3.8-27B。
AI.conclusion: 除非研究人员对速度有需求，JEV唯一明显的优势在于其底层选择概率更易于解析。

title: Long-Horizon Textual World Modeling through Structured Reasoning
summary: World models must predict how an environment evolves under sequences of actions, enabling agents to compare possible futures and reason about counterfactual actions before acting. Long-horizon prediction is commonly obtained by recursively applying a one-step transition model, but intermediate errors can compound over time. Multi-step dynamics models instead condition on a sequence of future actions and predict their consequences directly, but become harder to learn as horizon grows: the model must track interacting state changes across the trajectory, endpoint supervision provides weak credit assignment, and intermediate predictions can remain plausible while losing information needed for later states. We show that these challenges can be addressed by casting the internal evolution of a multi-step transition as structured reasoning over textual world states: reasoning over sparse state changes reduces the burden of state tracking, a predictive-gain objective rewards the learned state for improving over a matched predictor that conditions on raw history instead, and intermediate predictive rewards supervise each state along the trajectory. Because these intermediate states are explicit textual representations of the world, they provide semantically meaningful targets that can be inspected, scored, and corrected during training. Across ScienceWorld, Jericho, and CEO-Bench, our approach achieves the strongest average long-horizon performance against recursive and non-recursive baselines that condition directly on raw history, with gains increasing at longer horizons. In a controlled counterfactual study, our model is also the only one with statistically significant sensitivity to future actions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将多步动力学模型的内部演化建模为对文本世界状态的"结构化推理"，通过稀疏状态变化推理、预测增益目标与中间预测奖励，缓解长时程预测中的误差累积与信用分配问题。
AI.motivation: 世界模型需要预测环境在动作序列下的演化，以支持反事实推理与规划。常用的递归式单步模型会因中间误差逐级累积而失效；多步模型虽直接以未来动作序列为条件预测结果，但随预测时程增长学习变难：需跟踪轨迹中相互作用的多个状态变化、仅端点监督导致信用分配信号弱、中间预测可能看似合理却丢失后续状态所需信息。
AI.method: 把多步转移的内部演化视为对文本世界状态的结构化推理：对稀疏状态变化进行推理以降低状态跟踪负担；采用预测增益目标，奖励所学状态相对"以原始历史为条件的匹配预测器"的提升；并沿轨迹对每个中间状态施加预测性奖励进行监督。中间状态作为显式文本表示，提供可检查、可打分、可纠正的语义目标。
AI.result: 在 ScienceWorld、Jericho 和 CEO-Bench 上，该方法在长时程平均性能上优于直接以原始历史为条件的递归与非递归基线，且时程越长增益越大；在受控反事实研究中，是唯一对未来动作具有统计显著敏感性的模型。
AI.conclusion: 将多步转移建模为对文本世界状态的显式结构化推理，可有效改善长时程预测的状态跟踪、信用分配与中间监督，从而在长时程与反事实敏感性上取得优势。

title: LoGRA: Scaling LLM Reinforcement Learning with Low-Rank Gradient Sketches
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has greatly advanced the capabilities of large language models (LLMs), but its memory demands remain a barrier to broader adoption. We introduce LoGRA, an approach to RL post-training that reduces memory by retaining useful learning signals in low-rank gradient sketches. These compact representations support both model updates and efficient policy synchronization. To prevent overly large updates from disrupting learning, we complement gradient compression with predicted-KL step control, which estimates policy changes before applying each update and adjusts its magnitude accordingly. Across reasoning tasks, LoGRA reduces average training memory by up to 45.7\% without sacrificing performance. It also enables stable training of a 27B-parameter model for over 1,100 steps on a single eight-GPU node, where dense Adam runs out of memory, making previously memory-infeasible RL training practical. Code is available in the \href{https://github.com/skzhang1/labs-molt/tree/logra/examples/scripts/logra}{Molt library}.

AI.tldr: LoGRA 通过低秩梯度草图保留学习信号并结合预测-KL 步长控制，将 RL 后训练显存降低最高 45.7%，且性能不降，可在单节点 8 卡上稳定训练 27B 模型超 1100 步。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽显著提升大语言模型能力，但其显存需求成为广泛采用的障碍，密集 Adam 等优化器显存开销大，导致部分 RL 训练在硬件上不可行。
AI.method: 提出 LoGRA：在低秩梯度草图中保留有用学习信号，用紧凑表示同时支持模型更新与高效策略同步；并辅以预测-KL 步长控制，在每次更新前估计策略变化并据此调整更新幅度，防止过大更新破坏学习。
AI.result: 在推理任务上，训练平均显存降低最高 45.7%，性能无损失；可在单台八卡节点上稳定训练 27B 参数模型超过 1100 步，而密集 Adam 会显存耗尽。
AI.conclusion: LoGRA 使此前受显存限制而不可行的 RL 训练变得可行，为 LLM 的 RL 后训练提供了更实用的显存高效方案，代码已在 Molt 库开源。

title: Representation-Space MMD for Diffusion Language Models
summary: We introduce a post-training method for diffusion language models (DLMs) that minimizes Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD) between generated and reference distributions in the feature space of a frozen pretrained DLM. To estimate MMD, we retain contextual features at individual token positions, obtaining multiple observations per sequence from a single extractor pass. We optimize this objective using policy gradients for discrete models and direct differentiation through generated latents for continuous models. In both cases, computing the loss directly from these features enables efficient post-training without full sampling trajectories or jointly trained auxiliary models. Experiments show lower generative perplexity at comparable entropy on OpenWebText and better accuracy-computation trade-offs on GSM8K. On 16B DMax-LLaDA2.0 models with hybrid masked-uniform diffusion, we increase decoding parallelism with similar or higher accuracy on math and code benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向扩散语言模型（DLM）的后训练方法，通过在冻结预训练DLM的特征空间中最小化生成分布与参考分布之间的最大均值差异（MMD）来提升生成质量与效率。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型的后训练通常依赖完整采样轨迹或联合训练的辅助模型，计算开销大、效率低。作者希望找到一种高效的后训练方式，无需完整采样轨迹或额外辅助模型即可优化生成分布。
AI.method: 利用冻结预训练DLM的特征空间计算MMD；通过在单个token位置保留上下文特征，从单次提取器前向中获取每条序列的多个观测以估计MMD。对离散模型使用策略梯度优化，对连续模型通过生成潜变量直接求导。损失直接由这些特征计算，无需完整采样轨迹或联合训练辅助模型。
AI.result: 在OpenWebText上于相当熵水平下取得更低生成困惑度；在GSM8K上获得更好的准确率-计算权衡；在采用混合masked-uniform扩散的16B DMax-LLaDA2.0模型上，于数学与代码基准上以相近或更高准确率提升了解码并行度。
AI.conclusion: 该MMD后训练方法为DLM提供了一种高效、无需辅助模型的后训练范式，在生成质量、计算效率和解码并行度上均有改进，适用于离散与连续扩散语言模型。

title: Wikidata Search Traces: A Dataset for Training Knowledge Graph Search Agents
summary: Wikidata is one of the largest open knowledge bases, yet answering a complex question over it still requires a SPARQL query that names the right entities and properties and chains their relations. Language models offer a natural-language alternative but answer largely from memory, which is least reliable for less prominent entities. We study agents that instead answer by exploring the graph, and argue that two obstacles limit them: the lack of training data recording how a solver explores, and interfaces that add large graph results directly to the model's context. We test three hypotheses: that the difficulty of graph search can be controlled through the structure of a question rather than only through obscure entities or wording; that much of the failure on long-horizon search comes from how retrieved evidence is managed rather than from the model itself; and that, in a suitable environment, open-weight models can match commercial closed ones. We construct multi-hop questions on a frozen Wikidata snapshot by replacing named entities with nested conditions, checking after each expansion that the target remains unique and that every new condition is necessary. We release 10,235 solving traces over single-entity and multi-hop questions, together with the recursive language model (RLM) harness that produced them, in which models batch graph calls, keep results in persistent Python state and interpret selected evidence through sub-calls. On 100 questions, the harness improves both models we ran under both interfaces compared with direct tool calling over the same functions: gpt-6-luna rises from 49 to 61 correct answers, doubling its multi-hop accuracy, and Qwen3.8-27B, an open-weight model served on a single GPU, from 60 to 74.

AI.tldr: 论文研究让语言模型智能体通过探索Wikidata图来回答复杂问题，指出训练数据缺失与图结果直接入上下文两大障碍，构造可控多跳问题并发布10,235条求解轨迹及递归语言模型（RLM）框架，在100题上显著提升开源与闭源模型的准确率。
AI.motivation: Wikidata等大型开放知识库上的复杂问答仍依赖需正确命名实体与属性并串联关系的SPARQL查询；语言模型虽提供自然语言替代方案，但主要依赖记忆作答，对低知名度实体最不可靠。现有探索图的智能体受两大障碍限制：缺乏记录求解器如何探索的训练数据，以及将大量图结果直接加入模型上下文的接口设计。
AI.method: 在冻结的Wikidata快照上构造多跳问题：将命名实体替换为嵌套条件，每次扩展后检验目标唯一性与新条件必要性，从而通过问题结构而非仅靠冷门实体或措辞来控制图搜索难度。发布10,235条覆盖单实体与多跳问题的求解轨迹，以及生成它们的递归语言模型（RLM）框架——模型批量发起图调用、将结果保存在持久化Python状态中，并通过子调用解释选定证据。用100道题对比直接工具调用。
AI.result: 在100道题上，RLM框架在两种接口下均优于对相同函数的直接工具调用：gpt-6-luna由49题正确提升至61题，多跳准确率翻倍；单GPU部署的开源权重模型Qwen3.8-27B由60题提升至74题。
AI.conclusion: 长程图搜索的失败很大程度源于检索证据的管理方式而非模型本身；在合适环境下开源权重模型可媲美商业闭源模型；通过问题结构可控制图搜索难度，且批量调用与持久化状态等接口设计是提升图探索式问答的关键。

title: Reward Stealing Attack on Large Language Models
summary: Adversarial attacks on Large Language Models (LLMs) aim to induce harmful content. However, existing methods suffer from high computational costs or strict model-pairing dependencies, limiting their scalability and transferability. We propose Reward Stealing Attack (ReSA), an adversarial attack framework that targets the latent safety reward underlying LLM alignment. ReSA employs maximum entropy inverse reinforcement learning to recover a proxy reward model solely from the aligned model's behavior. The extracted reward is then reversed at inference time to derive an adversarial policy, efficiently implemented via a reward-guided decoding mechanism. Experiments demonstrate that a single recovered reward generalizes across prompts and diverse models to reveal a fundamental alignment vulnerability, enabling ReSA to significantly outperform existing attacks in effectiveness and transferability. The code is available at https://github.com/GarminQ/ReSA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reward Stealing Attack (ReSA)，一种针对LLM对齐底层潜在安全奖励的对抗攻击框架，通过最大熵逆强化学习从对齐模型行为中恢复代理奖励模型，并在推理时反转奖励以生成对抗策略，实现高效且高迁移性的攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有针对大语言模型的对抗攻击方法存在计算成本高或严格的模型配对依赖问题，限制了其可扩展性与迁移性，亟需一种更通用高效的攻击范式。
AI.method: ReSA采用最大熵逆强化学习，仅从对齐模型的行为中恢复一个代理奖励模型；在推理阶段反转该奖励，通过奖励引导的解码机制高效实现对抗策略。
AI.result: 实验表明，单一恢复的奖励即可跨提示词和多种模型泛化，揭示了对齐的根本性脆弱点，ReSA在攻击有效性和迁移性上均显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ReSA揭示了LLM对齐安全奖励可被逆向恢复并反转利用的深层漏洞，为对抗攻击提供了高效、可迁移的新思路，代码已开源。

title: Programmatic Search Agents: Extending Agentic Search Beyond Query Reformulation
summary: Search agents adapt their queries, yet fixed search interfaces leave candidate processing and evidence presentation outside the agent's direct control. Our trajectory analysis shows that supporting passages can be retrieved yet never delivered to the agent; a same-page oracle intervention shows that changing the returned evidence can reduce subsequent search. We introduce Programmatic Search Agent (PSA), which makes a local executable computation over candidates the unit of a search action. PSA unifies a persistent candidate workspace, flexible primitive composition, and selective evidence presentation. It incrementally generates program cells that reuse candidates, execute dependent operations, and select what the agent inspects next. The runtime resolves specified data dependencies within each cell, while the agent adapts its search strategy across cells as new evidence arrives. We compare PSA with the Query-based Agent and Tool-based Agent on InfoSeek-Eval and BrowseComp-Plus using five policy backbones without task-specific training. All three interfaces share the search substrate, and the Tool-based Agent also shares PSA's primitives and persistent workspace. Relative to the Query-based Agent, PSA improves macro-averaged task success by 4.00 and 7.56 percentage points on the two benchmarks, respectively; within-backbone reductions in final-step tokens average 28.3% and 33.9%. These results support extending agent control beyond query reformulation to the processing and presentation of retrieved evidence. Code will be released subject to approval.

AI.tldr: 提出 Programmatic Search Agent (PSA)，把"对候选集合的本地可执行计算"作为搜索动作单元，统一持久候选工作区、原语组合与选择性证据呈现，在 InfoSeek-Eval 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上显著优于查询式与工具式智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索智能体只能改写查询，固定搜索接口把候选处理与证据呈现置于智能体直接控制之外；轨迹分析显示相关段落常被检索到却从未送达智能体，同页 oracle 干预表明改变返回证据能减少后续搜索，说明需要把控制权从查询改写扩展到证据处理与呈现。
AI.method: PSA 以"对候选集合的本地可执行计算"为搜索动作单元，包含持久候选工作区、灵活原语组合与选择性证据呈现；增量生成程序单元（program cell），复用候选、执行依赖操作并选择下一步检查内容。运行时在每个 cell 内解析指定的数据依赖，智能体则在新证据到达时跨 cell 自适应调整搜索策略。在 InfoSeek-Eval 与 BrowseComp-Plus 上，与 Query-based Agent 和 Tool-based Agent 在五种策略骨干、无任务特定训练条件下对比；三者共享搜索底层，Tool-based Agent 还共享 PSA 的原语与持久工作区。
AI.result: 相对 Query-based Agent，PSA 在两基准上宏平均任务成功率分别提升 4.00 和 7.56 个百分点；同一骨干下最终步 token 平均减少 28.3% 和 33.9%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将智能体控制从查询改写扩展到已检索证据的处理与呈现；代码将在审批后发布。

title: MedPrune: Topology-Efficient Multimodal Multi-Agent Communication Evolution for Medical VQA Tasks
summary: While medical multimodal large language models (Med-MLLMs) advance medical visual question answering (VQA), existing clinical workflow-inspired multi-agent frameworks suffer from interaction patterns and excessive computational overhead caused by redundant communication topologies. In this paper, we propose MedPrune, an efficient medical multimodal multi-agent collaboration framework that dynamically prunes both nodes and edges from the communication topology to enhance reasoning ability and token efficiency. Specifically, we first formulate the diagnostic process as a heterogeneous communication graph, where nodes represent specialist agents from various departments and edges capture intra- and inter-departmental interactions. Building on this graph, we introduce two sparsification mechanisms to enable adaptive collaborative evolution: (1) Heterogeneous Node Sparsification, which eliminates task-irrelevant specialist agents irrelevant to the current multimodal question via reinforcement learning-driven topological optimization, and (2) Heterogeneous Edge Sparsification, which selectively retains only the most diagnostically salient intra- and inter-departmental connections by jointly optimizing task performance and topological complexity. Extensive medical VQA experiments under full-set and few-shot training settings prove MedPrune surpasses multi-agent baselines and boosts token efficiency with strong adversarial robustness.

AI.tldr: 提出MedPrune，一种高效医学多模态多智能体协作框架，通过动态剪枝通信拓扑中的节点与边来提升推理能力与token效率。
AI.motivation: 现有受临床工作流启发的多智能体框架在医学VQA中受困于交互模式问题，以及因冗余通信拓扑导致的过高计算开销。
AI.method: 将诊断过程建模为异质通信图（节点为各科室专科智能体，边为科室内外交互）；引入两种稀疏化机制：(1) 异质节点稀疏化，通过强化学习驱动的拓扑优化，剔除与当前多模态问题无关的专科智能体；(2) 异质边稀疏化，通过联合优化任务性能与拓扑复杂度，仅保留最具诊断显著性的科室内外连接。
AI.result: 在完整集与少样本训练设置下的大量医学VQA实验表明，MedPrune优于多智能体基线，并提升token效率，具有较强的对抗鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MedPrune通过节点与边的双重动态剪枝，实现了高效且鲁棒的医学多模态多智能体协作。

title: SAFE-MR: Evidence Sufficiency Learning for Selective Multimodal Rumor Detection
summary: Multimodal rumor detectors increasingly rely on retrieved evidence, yet relevant evidence is not necessarily sufficient for verification. Missing provenance, duplicated reports, and unresolved contradictions can produce confident predictions without adequate support. We introduce SAFE-MR, a framework that separates claim veracity from evidence sufficiency. The method decomposes image-text posts into verifiable claims, constructs a relation-aware claim-evidence graph, and aggregates evidence using provenance and contextual compatibility. Separate veracity and sufficiency heads support selective prediction, while evidence interventions encourage stability under irrelevant additions and sensitivity to evidence removal. On NewsCLIPpings, VERITE, and XFacta, SAFE-MR achieves macro-F1 scores of 91.2%, 75.8%, and 85.2%, respectively. Against the matched backbone with evidence, its macro-F1 gains are 2.2, 4.9, and 4.8 percentage points. On the diagnostic selection set, SAFE-MR reduces AURC from 0.105 for maximum-probability rejection to 0.075 and lowers error at 80% coverage from 13.8% to 8.5%. Evidence-perturbation and ablation results support the role of sufficiency learning and intervention training in improving selective verification.

AI.tldr: SAFE-MR 将主张真实性判定与证据充分性分离，通过主张—证据关系图与选择性预测提升多模态谣言检测的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于检索证据的多模态谣言检测器默认“相关证据即足够”，但证据可能存在来源缺失、报告重复与矛盾未解等问题，导致模型在支撑不足时仍给出高置信预测。因此需要显式区分claim veracity 与 evidence sufficiency。
AI.method: 将图文帖子分解为可验证主张；构建关系感知的主张—证据图；结合来源（provenance）与上下文兼容性聚合证据；设置独立的真实性头与充分性头以支持选择性预测；引入证据干预（无关证据加入、证据移除）训练以增强稳定性与敏感性。
AI.result: 在 NewsCLIPpings、VERITE、XFacta 上 macro-F1 分别达 91.2%、75.8%、85.2%，较带证据的匹配骨干提升 2.2、4.9、4.8 个百分点；诊断选择集上 AURC 由最大概率拒绝的 0.105 降至 0.075，80% 覆盖率下错误率由 13.8% 降至 8.5%。证据扰动与消融验证了充分性学习与干预训练的作用。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模证据充分性并配合干预训练，可提升多模态谣言检测的准确性与选择性验证可靠性。

title: Domain adaptation of Russian ModernBERT for long legal documents
summary: We investigate whether continued pretraining on Russian legislative documents improves a Russian ModernBERT encoder on legal text. The adapted model, RuModernBERT-ruLaw, was trained on a corpus reported to contain 304,382 legislative documents and 194,425,905 corpus tokens. Corpus token counts are distinguished from positions produced by the model tokenizer. We compare the original and adapted encoders on a fixed external collection of 1,031 court-decision segments. Both models receive the same hidden positions in each of five masking realizations. At maximum input lengths of 512, 2,048, and 8,192 tokens, mean masked-token cross-entropy decreases by 0.10942, 0.07052, and 0.06604 natural-log units, respectively. The reported 95% intervals summarize sensitivity to masking on this fixed collection; they do not quantify uncertainty across document collections. A second evaluation addresses legal-entity extraction. The original and adapted models achieve entity-level F1 scores of 0.99852 and 0.99820. However, 99.95% of test spans have the same normalized surface form and class in the training split. This evaluation therefore provides limited evidence about transfer to previously unseen forms. The paper explains the masking objective, overlapping windows, averaging rules, and exact entity-boundary scoring using editable diagrams and clearly marked illustrative examples. The comparison supports lower masked-token prediction loss for the studied pair of models and collection. It does not isolate the contribution of distant context or establish practical legal utility.

AI.tldr: 论文考察在俄语立法文档上继续预训练能否提升俄语 ModernBERT 法律编码器。适配模型在含 304,382 份立法文档、194,425,905 语料 token 的语料上训练，并在 1,031 个法院判决片段上与原始模型对比：在 512/2,048/8,192 最大输入长度下，掩码 token 交叉熵分别下降 0.10942、0.07052、0.06604 nats；但实体抽取 F1 基本持平（0.99852 vs 0.99820），且 99.95% 测试跨度与训练集同形同类，故迁移证据有限。
AI.motivation: 作者希望验证：对通用俄语 ModernBERT 编码器进行法律领域继续预训练，能否在俄语法律文本上降低掩码语言建模损失并改善下游法律实体抽取，同时明确区分语料 token 计数与模型分词器产生的位置数。
AI.method: 在含 304,382 份立法文档、194,425,905 语料 token 的语料上继续预训练，得到 RuModernBERT-ruLaw。在固定的 1,031 个法院判决片段外部集合上，对原始与适配编码器在 5 种掩码实现中给定相同隐藏位置，按 512、2,048、8,192 最大输入长度比较掩码 token 交叉熵，并报告 95% 区间以刻画掩码敏感性；另设法律实体抽取评测，采用实体级 F1 与实体边界评分。
AI.result: 最大输入长度为 512、2,048、8,192 token 时，平均掩码 token 交叉熵分别下降 0.10942、0.07052、0.06604 个自然对数单位。实体抽取上，原始与适配模型实体级 F1 分别为 0.99852 与 0.99820；但 99.95% 测试跨度在训练集中具有相同归一化表面形式与类别。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持所研究模型对与该固定集合上更低的掩码 token 预测损失，但未隔离远距离上下文的贡献，也未证明实际法律效用；实体抽取评测因测试跨度与训练集高度重叠，对未见形式的迁移证据有限。

title: Improving Diversity in LLM Short Story Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate accurate responses, but these are void of diversity. We attempt to address this for the task of creative short story generation. Drawing on established writing conventions and known LLM limitations, we target variation in genre, tone, style, and named entities. To promote diversity across these dimensions, we introduce DivLM, an LLM post-training framework consisting of two phases. First, we perform continued pre-training on a creative writing corpus and restore instruction-following capabilities using weight residuals. We then apply reinforcement learning with a custom, composite reward function that jointly maximizes diversity across the targeted narrative dimensions while maintaining response quality. Our empirical results on two LLM families show that DivLM increases diversity metrics by more than 9% on average compared to alternative approaches, while preserving instruction following, overall response quality, and similarity to human outputs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出DivLM，一种两阶段LLM后训练框架，用于提升创意短篇故事生成的多样性。
AI.motivation: LLM能生成准确回答但缺乏多样性，尤其在创意短篇故事生成任务中，需要提升体裁、语气、风格和命名实体等维度的多样性。
AI.method: DivLM包含两个阶段：首先在创意写作语料上进行继续预训练，并利用权重残差恢复指令跟随能力；随后应用强化学习，使用自定义复合奖励函数，在目标叙事维度上联合最大化多样性，同时保持响应质量。
AI.result: 在两个LLM系列上的实验表明，DivLM相较替代方法平均提升多样性指标超过9%，同时保持指令跟随、整体响应质量及与人类输出的相似性。
AI.conclusion: DivLM通过继续预训练与复合奖励强化学习有效提升创意写作多样性，且不损害质量与指令跟随能力。

title: ufakzeka-karar: An Open Turkish Typed-Decision Model with Order-Invariant Option Scoring
comment: 9 pages (text on pages 1 to 8, references on pages 8 and 9). Model, code, benchmark and demo: https://huggingface.co/ufakai/ufakzeka-karar, https://github.com/ufakai/ufakzeka-karar, https://huggingface.co/datasets/ufakai/HakemBench, https://karar.ufakzeka.com
summary: ufakzeka-karar is an open Turkish decision model with 182,494,466 parameters. Given a Turkish text and questions of a fixed answer type (a choice, a level on an ordered scale, or yes or no), it returns a temperature-scaled probability for every option and an expected error that serves as a "not sure" signal, without generating text and in one CPU forward pass for up to ten options. Built on the lab's ufakzeka-1-base, its head scores each option blind to the others at shared positions, so the answer does not depend on option order. A sequential head trained with shuffled options was about as accurate but changed 2.3 to 2.8 percent of its answers when only the option order changed; REINFORCE lost 10.2 points (0.102) of macro F1 to cross-entropy. On the open set of HakemBench v1.0 (4,275 questions, 7 tracks) the released model ranks 7th of 16 rows with a composite of 0.660 (95% interval 0.642 to 0.677). Temperature scaling lowers calibration error (smooth ECE) on the development set but raises it on held-out support questions, from 0.027 to 0.045 for the first scored run, which never trained on them; the released model later trained on them, so its 0.036 to 0.064 is not an unseen-question test. The released model is the last of three runs scored on HakemBench, and its numbers are not blind. The second run's new training data was aimed at the first run's errors on the full test set in guardrails, moderation and customer support, and the released run was trained after the second run's guardrail results on the full test set were read, under a protocol fixed in writing before any of its data, code or runs. All its numbers come after these readings; its guardrail, moderation and customer support numbers carry the flag "shaped by reading the test results". With every model scored on the other four tracks only, its composite is 0.678, 6th of 16. Weights and code are under Apache-2.0.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍土耳其语决策模型 ufakzeka-karar（1.82 亿参数）：给定文本与固定答案类型问题，直接对每个选项输出温度标定概率并给出“不确定”信号，单次 CPU 前向即可处理至多十个选项。模型在 HakemBench v1.0 上综合得分 0.660（第 7/16），但发布版本的评测并非盲测，其部分赛道成绩受读取测试结果影响。
AI.motivation: 现有决策/问答模型多以生成式方式作答，推理成本高、答案可能受选项顺序影响、且缺乏显式的不确定性信号。该工作希望构建一个不生成文本、可单次 CPU 前向完成多选项评分、对选项顺序不敏感、并能给出校准概率与“不确信”提示的土耳其语决策模型。
AI.method: 基于实验室的 ufakzeka-1-base 构建，加入对各选项在共享位置独立打分的评分头（选项彼此不可见），从而消除选项顺序依赖；采用交叉熵训练（对比 REINFORCE 损失）；对输出概率做温度缩放以改善校准。评测在 HakemBench v1.0（4,275 题、7 个赛道）上进行，并记录三次运行的训练数据与协议固定情况。
AI.result: 顺序头在打乱选项下准确率相近，但仅改变选项顺序即改变 2.3%–2.8% 的答案；REINFORCE 相比交叉熵在宏 F1 上低 10.2 分（0.102）。发布模型在 HakemBench 综合得分 0.660（95% 区间 0.642–0.677），16 行中排第 7；若仅在其余四个赛道评分，综合得分为 0.678，排第 6。温度缩放降低了开发集的平滑 ECE，但在留出支持问题上反而使校准误差从 0.027 升至 0.045（首次计分运行）。发布版本为第三次运行，其数据选取参考了前两次在测试集上的错误与结果，故其护栏、审核与客服成绩带有“受读取测试结果影响”的标记，数字非盲测。
AI.conclusion: ufakzeka-karar 以轻量、单次 CPU 前向的方式实现了无生成的多选项决策，具备顺序不变性与显式不确定性输出，权重与代码以 Apache-2.0 开放。但由于发布版本的训练数据与协议参考了测试集结果，其在 HakemBench 上涉及护栏、审核和客服赛道的分数属于非盲测，解读时需注意这一评测局限。

title: Balancing Memory Pathways: Analyzing and Improving Memory Utilization in Hybrid LMs
summary: Recurrent-attention hybrid language models (LMs), which interleave attention and recurrent layers, are increasingly used to combine the efficiency of the recurrent layers with the strong performance of attention layers. Prior work suggests that attention and recurrent layers offer complementary pathways to use past information: attention supports precise memory recall from earlier tokens, while recurrent layers support consolidation of disparate information over long contexts. However, we observe that simply having access to both pathways does not mean that hybrid LMs are effectively using them. We find that they rely substantially more on attention than on the recurrent state. Standard supervised fine-tuning improves overall performance but does not improve how the two memory pathways are coordinated: the model becomes more reliant on information propagated by attention layers, while its use of information propagated by recurrent layers remains limited. To encourage better coordination between the two memory pathways, we add an auxiliary loss that limits attention's access to earlier context while the recurrent state propagates through the full sequence. This objective encourages the model to retain and use information through the recurrent pathway alongside attention. It improves overall performance, with particularly strong gains on tasks involving longer contexts or requiring information aggregation, consistent with the strengths of recurrent layers observed in analysis. Crucially, this imbalance and the benefit of our auxiliary loss generalize: they apply to multiple recurrent-attention LMs in question-answering and agentic tasks, as well as to attention-based LMs that combine different forms of memory. Together, our findings show that simply providing multiple memory pathways does not ensure their effective use, and that targeted supervision is needed to better coordinate them.

AI.tldr: 循环层与注意力层混合的语言模型虽提供两条互补记忆路径，但模型过度依赖注意力，标准微调无法改善协调，需通过限制注意力上下文的辅助损失来促进循环记忆路径的使用。
AI.motivation: 混合语言模型结合了循环层的效率与注意力层的性能，理论上两者可互补：注意力支持对早期token的精确回忆，循环层支持长上下文中的信息整合。然而作者观察到，仅仅同时拥有两条记忆路径并不意味着模型会有效利用它们。
AI.method: 作者首先分析混合语言模型对注意力与循环状态的依赖程度。随后引入一个辅助损失：在循环状态传播完整序列的同时，限制注意力对早期上下文的访问，从而促使模型通过循环路径保留和利用信息。
AI.result: 模型显著更依赖注意力而非循环状态；标准监督微调提升整体性能但使模型更依赖注意力层信息，循环层信息利用依旧有限。辅助损失提升了整体性能，在长上下文和需要信息聚合的任务上增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 这种路径失衡及辅助损失的收益具有泛化性：适用于问答与智能体任务中的多种循环-注意力语言模型，也适用于结合不同记忆形式的注意力语言模型。仅提供多条记忆路径并不能保证其有效利用，需要有针对性的监督来协调它们。

title: IdeaLens: Detecting AI Ideas in Long-form Writing
comment: 53 pages (9 main), 7 figures, 50 tables. Code: https://github.com/RishanthRajendhran/IdeaLens Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/rishanthrajendhran/idealens-6abee785ce6196fc0be9200f Demo: http://ideadetector.ai/
summary: While modern AI detectors identify who wrote the words, emerging policies on AI use increasingly hinge on a different question: who came up with the ideas? We introduce IdeaLens, a detector that identifies whether a document's ideas came from a human or AI (idea provenance), regardless of who wrote its words. To focus IdeaLens on ideas rather than prose, we represent documents as outlines: lists of items that each pair a discourse role with a brief, paraphrased description of the content, minimizing word-level overlap with the raw text. We train IdeaLens on 1M FineWeb documents with silver labels from Pangram, a prose provenance detector. Since the outlines are largely stripped of surface-level information, the labels must be fit mainly through the ideas. In a controlled study, IdeaLens's AI flag rate drops from 95% to 7% as models write from increasingly detailed human plans, while Pangram 4 still flags 92%; from AI-derived plans, IdeaLens stays above 96%. Conversely, on a new dataset of 50 stories that human authors wrote from AI-generated plans, IdeaLens flags 68% of the stories as AI, compared to 8% for Pangram 4. On a comprehensive suite of 19 existing detection benchmarks, we show that IdeaLens maintains strong detection rates at low false positive rates, suggesting that ideas themselves provide a powerful discriminative signal, and its performance holds across domains, formats, and languages. Finally, we examine 90K predictions from IdeaLens to characterize systematic differences between human and AI ideation. We release our models and labeled datasets to facilitate future research on idea provenance detection.

AI.tldr: 提出 IdeaLens，一个"思想溯源"检测器，通过将文档抽象为大纲表示来判别思想来自人类还是 AI，而不论文本由谁撰写。
AI.motivation: 现有 AI 检测器只回答"谁写的文字"，但 AI 使用政策更关心"谁提出的想法"。已有方法聚焦于行文风格层面，无法分离思想来源与文字来源，因此需要一种针对思想来源（idea provenance）的检测手段。
AI.method: 将文档表示为大纲：由若干条目组成，每条把话语角色与内容的简短改写描述配对，尽量减少与原文的词级重叠，从而使检测聚焦于思想而非措辞。使用 Pangram（一种行文溯源检测器）为 100 万篇 FineWeb 文档打银标签进行训练；由于大纲基本剥离了表层信息，标签只能主要通过思想来拟合。
AI.result: 在受控研究中，随着模型依据愈发详细的人类计划写作，IdeaLens 的 AI 判定率从 95% 降至 7%，而 Pangram 4 仍高达 92%；对于 AI 生成计划，IdeaLens 保持 96% 以上。在 50 篇由人类依据 AI 计划撰写的故事数据集上，IdeaLens 将 68% 判为 AI，Pangram 4 仅 8%。在 19 个现有检测基准上，IdeaLens 在低假阳性率下维持较高检出率，且跨领域、格式和语言均表现稳健。此外分析了 9 万条预测，刻画了人类与 AI 构思的系统性差异。
AI.conclusion: 思想本身构成强判别信号，可与行文溯源解耦；作者公开模型与标注数据集，以推动思想溯源检测的后续研究。

title: T-Search: An Open Agentic Retriever and Playground for Hard Multi-Step Search
summary: We present T-Search, an open-weight agentic retriever for hard multi-step search. Given a question and a search tool over a fixed corpus, it runs a bounded multi-round search and returns a ranked list of evidence chunks with short justifications, leaving answer generation to a downstream model, so backend and generator can be swapped without retraining. T-Search is built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and trained on adversarially filtered synthetic search tasks with round-sliced supervised fine-tuning followed by GSPO on a recall reward. Averaged over seven English and Russian benchmarks with gold evidence annotations, it reaches 56.0 Recall@10 with one rollout, 14.4 points above its base, and 61.3 with three fused rollouts, outperforming larger open models. We release the model, harness, live demo, and three benchmarks, including TRuST, the first native-Russian hard-search benchmark.

AI.tldr: T-Search：开源权重的智能体检索器，面向高难度多步搜索，解耦检索与生成，经合成数据监督微调后以召回率奖励做GSPO强化学习，七项基准平均56.0 Recall@10（单次rollout），超基座14.4点。
AI.motivation: 高难度多步搜索任务中，检索与答案生成通常耦合，导致后端或生成模型难以替换、需重新训练；同时开源模型在多步检索上的召回能力与更大模型存在差距。
AI.method: 基于Qwen3.6-35B-A3B构建T-Search；输入问题与固定语料上的搜索工具，执行有界多轮搜索，输出带简短理由的排序证据块，不生成答案。训练采用对抗式过滤的合成搜索任务，先做按轮次切片的监督微调，再在召回奖励上用GSPO进行强化学习，并支持多次rollout融合。
AI.result: 在七个带金标证据标注的英语与俄语基准上平均达56.0 Recall@10（单rollout），较基座提升14.4点；三次rollout融合达61.3，优于更大的开源模型。同时发布模型、harness、实时demo及三个基准，其中包括首个原生俄语高难度搜索基准TRuST。
AI.conclusion: T-Search以检索为中心、生成解耦的设计，结合合成数据SFT与召回奖励GSPO，可在不重训的前提下替换后端与生成器，并在多语言高难度多步检索上以开源规模取得领先效果。

title: CLIFT: Conformal Self-Verification for Web Agent Training and Test-Time Scaling
summary: Open-source web agents are now strong enough to execute realistic browser tasks, but training them with reinforcement learning still depends on weak supervision: binary task success is too sparse for credit assignment, while frontier-language-model judges are too expensive to call at every step and cannot be assumed available at deployment. We introduce CLIFT, a training and test-time scaling method built around conformal self-verification. During training, the agent answers natural-language verification questions about its own rollouts; a Compositional Conformal Certifier keeps only question signals whose URL-conditional evidence agrees with a training-time judge, assigns signed trust weights through polarity-aware lift, and blends the resulting verifier score into per-step rewards in a way that never subtracts from the judge baseline. At test time, the same certified bank is frozen and reused as structured evidence for Conformal Trajectory Selection (CTS): the agent samples a greedy rollout and one or more diverse retries, the self-verifier summarises each URL trace, and a conservative majority-vote rule chooses whether to swap away from the current incumbent without calling any external judge. This single mechanism supports three settings. On WebArena Infinity, CLIFT achieves state-of-the-art performance among open-source web agents. On VisualWebArena, a bank trained with the open model transfers to GPT-5.5 at test time and reaches state-of-the-art performance under the canonical harness. On Online Mind2Web, without training an agent on the benchmark, translating the certified question bank improves a live-web agent in zero-shot evaluation. Together these results position conformal self-verification as a way to turn costly judge feedback into a reusable training signal and a judge-free test-time scaling signal.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CLIFT，一种基于保形自验证（conformal self-verification）的训练与测试时扩展方法，用组合式保形认证器筛选自验证问题信号，并将其融入逐步奖励与免外部评判者的轨迹选择。在 WebArena Infinity、VisualWebArena 与 Online Mind2Web 上均取得领先或零样本提升效果。
AI.motivation: 开源网页智能体已能执行真实浏览器任务，但强化学习训练依赖弱监督：二元任务成功信号过于稀疏，难以进行信用分配；而前沿语言模型评判器调用成本高，无法逐步调用，且在部署时不能保证可用。因此需要一种低成本、可复用的监督信号来替代或补充昂贵的评判反馈。
AI.method: 训练阶段，智能体对自身 rollout 回答自然语言验证问题；组合式保形认证器（Compositional Conformal Certifier）仅保留那些 URL 条件证据与训练时评判器一致的问题信号，通过极性感知提升（polarity-aware lift）分配带符号信任权重，并将验证器分数以不削减评判基线的方式融入逐步奖励。测试阶段，冻结并复用同一认证问题库作为结构化证据，用于保形轨迹选择（Conformal Trajectory Selection, CTS）：智能体采样一次贪心 rollout 与若干多样化重试，自验证器对每个 URL 轨迹进行摘要，保守多数投票规则决定是否替换当前 incumbent，全程无需调用外部评判器。
AI.result: 在 WebArena Infinity 上，CLIFT 在开源网页智能体中达到最先进性能；在 VisualWebArena 上，用开源模型训练的问题库在测试时可迁移至 GPT-5.5，并在标准评测框架下达到最先进性能；在 Online Mind2Web 上，无需在基准上训练智能体，迁移认证问题库即可在零样本评测中提升实时网页智能体表现。
AI.conclusion: 保形自验证可将昂贵的评判器反馈转化为可复用的训练信号，同时提供一种无需评判器的测试时扩展信号，为网页智能体的训练与推理提供了统一、经济且可迁移的监督机制。

title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
summary: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic manner, which can incur unnecessary preprocessing cost and discard details that later prove essential. Recent studies have begun shifting memory processing toward runtime adaptation, but typically specialize in particular operations or fixed processing schemes, leaving flexible control over performance, cost, and latency largely underexplored. To address this challenge, we present \textbf{MemPilot}, a flexible framework that orchestrates on-demand memory curation under different performance--cost--latency preferences. Specifically, we optimize a multi-step LLM policy via reinforcement learning to iteratively choose between retrieving from query-agnostic memory and delegating query-specific curation of raw multimodal history to heterogeneous LLMs and VLMs. The policy jointly controls evidence amount, curation instructions, model selection, and visual access, enabling fine-grained allocation of runtime computation. To optimize this policy under competing objectives, we adapt objective-wise advantage decoupling by separately estimating each objective's advantage before aggregation. Moreover, we introduce prefix-based marginal utility estimation for fine-grained credit assignment across multi-step rollouts. Experiments on five multimodal agent-memory benchmarks demonstrate favorable performance--cost--latency trade-offs across optimization preferences, with preference sweeps yielding broader frontiers than existing trade-off-aware baselines.

AI.tldr: MemPilot：一个在性能-成本-延迟偏好下按需编排多模态记忆处理的灵活框架。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体记忆系统多以查询无关方式构建记忆，导致不必要的预处理开销并丢弃后续关键细节；已有运行时自适应研究通常局限于特定操作或固定处理方案，对性能、成本、延迟的灵活控制探索不足。
AI.method: 将多步LLM策略用强化学习优化，迭代地在"检索查询无关记忆"与"委托异构LLM/VLM对原始多模态历史做查询特定整理"之间选择；策略联合控制证据量、整理指令、模型选择与视觉访问；采用目标维度优势解耦（分别估计各目标优势再聚合）及基于前缀的边际效用估计进行细粒度信用分配。
AI.result: 在五个多模态智能体记忆基准上取得良好的性能-成本-延迟权衡，且偏好扫描得到比现有权衡感知基线更宽的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 按需、可控的记忆处理可有效平衡性能、成本与延迟，为智能体记忆系统提供灵活的运行时可调机制。

title: Training Numerical Intelligence via Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery
summary: AI agents are becoming increasingly capable of generating scientific code, but generating code is not the same as improving the algorithms behind it. For numerical solvers, execution feedback can expose poor performance, but rarely reveals its underlying cause and how to address it. We introduce Auto-Diagnosis and Skill Discovery (ADSD), a framework that links numerical diagnosis to reusable solver self-improvement. ADSD follows a diagnosis-first paradigm that first explains why a solver performs poorly, then uses this diagnosis to guide the discovery of appropriate numerical methods. The resulting knowledge is packaged into reusable solver skills, turning solver improvement from trial-and-error editing into a structured process of diagnosis, discovery, and implementation. Across four challenging numerical domains--power flow equation, AC optimal power flow control, stiff ordinary differential equations, and heterogeneous diffusion PDEs--ADSD consistently improves solver accuracy, robustness, and efficiency. On GOC-500 power flow, for example, ADSD reduces mean solver error by nearly $71\times$, with improvements further transferring to unseen grid topologies and operating regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出ADSD框架，将数值诊断与可复用求解器技能发现相链接，把求解器改进从试错编辑转为"诊断-发现-实现"的结构化流程，在四个数值领域显著提升精度、鲁棒性与效率。
AI.motivation: AI智能体已能生成科学代码，但"生成代码"不等于"改进算法"。对数值求解器而言，执行反馈虽能暴露性能不佳，却很少揭示其根本原因以及应如何解决。因此需要一种能先解释失败原因、再据此指导改进的机制。
AI.method: ADSD采用"诊断优先"范式：先诊断求解器性能不佳的原因，再以该诊断引导发现合适的数值方法；随后将所得知识封装为可复用的求解器技能，形成"诊断—发现—实现"的结构化改进流程。
AI.result: 在四个具有挑战性的数值领域（潮流方程、交流最优潮流控制、刚性常微分方程、异质扩散偏微分方程）上，ADSD一致地提升了求解器的精度、鲁棒性和效率。例如在GOC-500潮流问题上，平均求解误差降低近71倍，且改进可迁移到未见过的电网拓扑与运行工况。
AI.conclusion: 将数值诊断与技能发现相结合，能把求解器自我改进从试错式编辑转变为结构化、可复用且可迁移的过程，在多个数值领域取得一致且显著的性能提升。

title: Proxy Confidence: Auditing Black-Box LLM Agents with a Surrogate's Log-Probabilities
summary:
A deployed LLM agent emits tool calls, queries, and code that can be silently wrong -- by the time the error surfaces, the action has run. Frontier chat APIs hide the model's token probabilities; the agent's stated confidence barely beats chance on the mistakes that matter; and resampling does not help, since frontier models are highly repetitive, reproducing the same call across samples.
  We recover the missing signal from a low-cost open-weight surrogate run in parallel. It reads the same context, schema, and proposed action as the agent, then scores the call from its own log-probabilities through a family of complementary readouts: teacher forcing and request-PMI weigh the likelihood of each argument value, a discriminative verdict judges the call as a whole, and tool-choice competition tests the function against its siblings. One principle says which to trust: a generative likelihood localizes wrong argument values, while the verdict catches holistically wrong calls. When the error type is unknown, an ensemble is the low-regret default. The readout is training-free, needs no access to the agent's internals, and costs one prefill pass alongside the tool call.
  On difficult coding tasks it reaches AUROC 0.825 where the actor's stated confidence is near chance (0.598), and the generative readouts beat it by +0.07 to +0.28 across three further actors. Against self-consistency it gains +0.14 to +0.19 on near-deterministic actors, at 1/K the cost. The signal drives two deployment modes: a real-time gate escalating the least-trustworthy calls for review (+0.05 to +0.30 accepted-action accuracy at 50% coverage), and confidence feedback, returning the tool result with the score so the agent adapts its next step -- lifting task success on live-execution benchmarks (+0.119 and +0.137, p <= 1e-4) and beating a random-value control where step errors are silent (+0.078, p = 0.003).

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的低成本验证方法：并行运行开放权重代理模型，通过其对数概率对主代理的工具调用进行打分，实现实时错误检测与置信反馈。
AI.motivation: 已部署的LLM代理会产生静默错误的工具调用、查询和代码，错误暴露时动作已执行。前沿聊天API隐藏token概率，代理自述置信度在关键错误上接近随机水平；重采样也无效，因为前沿模型高度重复，多次采样会复现同一调用。
AI.method: 从低成本开放权重代理模型恢复缺失信号。该模型读取与主代理相同的上下文、schema和候选动作，再通过一组互补读出方式从自身对数概率评分：教师强制与请求式PMI评估各参数值的似然；判别式裁决整体判断调用；工具选择竞争测试该函数与兄弟函数。原则是：生成式似然定位错误的参数值，裁决捕捉整体错误的调用；错误类型未知时，集成是低遗憾的默认方案。该方法免训练、无需访问主代理内部，仅需与工具调用并行的一次prefill。
AI.result: 在困难编码任务上AUROC达0.825，而actor自述置信度接近随机（0.598）；生成式读出在另外三个actor上高出0.07–0.28。相比自一致性，在近确定性actor上提升0.14–0.19，成本仅1/K。信号驱动两种部署模式：实时门控将最不可信的调用升级送审（50%覆盖率下接受动作准确率提升0.05–0.30）；置信反馈将工具结果连同分数返回，使代理调整下一步——在实时执行基准上任务成功率提升0.119和0.137（p≤1e-4），并在步骤错误静默时胜过随机值对照（+0.078, p=0.003）。
AI.conclusion: 开放权重代理模型的log-probability读出可作为免训练、低成本的可靠性信号，支持实时审查门控与置信反馈，显著提升代理动作准确率与任务成功率。

title: Behavioral History Outperforms Descriptions of the Person for LLM Synthetic Personas
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as synthetic personas representing survey respondents. Their validity as substitutes for particular respondents depends on whether they reproduce individuals' decisions. We examine what information helps synthetic respondents predict each individual's later choices, using five conditions that add progressively richer information: no personal information, demographics, personality traits, cognitive scores, and finally the respondent's earlier survey choices as behavioral history. We use a two-wave panel of 845 US adults who completed measures of 14 behavioral biases (spanning risk, time preferences, overconfidence, and reasoning), so each respondent's earlier answers provide a human test-retest benchmark; in the behavioral-history condition, all items that score the target bias are withheld. At the population level, the average number of biases per respondent in every condition is close to the human average (7.1-8.1 biases, against 7.1 for humans).
