In this work, we propose EchoChat, a unified framework that reformulates empathetic spoken dialogue as a structured cognitive reasoning process integrating perception, mental-state reasoning, and response generation. To support this paradigm, we first construct EchoDialogue-400K, an acoustically rich dataset for multi-stage empathetic supervision. During the SFT stage, we strengthen acoustic grounding through proposed Acoustic-Anchored Attention (AAA). During the RL stage, we further introduce a novel stage-aware optimization objective with Step-Decomposed Credit Assignment (SDCA) to localize reasoning errors and mitigate cascaded error propagation. In addition, we introduce EchoEval, an expert-annotated benchmark for multi-dimensional empathy evaluation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that EchoChat achieves state-of-the-art performance in perception, reasoning, and response alignment. Project page: https://github.com/dingdongwang/EchoChat

AI.tldr: 该论文提出EchoChat框架，将共情语音对话重构为“感知-心理状态推理-响应生成”的结构化认知推理过程，并配套构建EchoDialogue-400K数据集与EchoEval评测基准，通过Acoustic-Anchored Attention与Step-Decomposed Credit Assignment缓解多阶段推理中的级联错误，实现感知、推理与响应对齐的SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有SpeechLLM将共情简化为输入到响应的直接映射，导致“表面温暖”却情感空洞的交互；同时共情依赖多阶段强依赖流程，任一中间步骤出错都会级联传播，而现有训练范式缺乏精确定位并改进此类错误的能力。
AI.method: 提出EchoChat统一框架：将共情语音对话建模为感知、心理状态推理与响应生成的结构化认知推理；构建声学信息丰富的多阶段共情监督数据集EchoDialogue-400K；SFT阶段引入Acoustic-Anchored Attention (AAA)强化声学接地；RL阶段提出阶段感知优化目标与Step-Decomposed Credit Assignment (SDCA)以定位推理错误、抑制级联传播；并构建专家标注的多维共情评测基准EchoEval。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，EchoChat在感知、推理和响应对齐方面均达到最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了将共情语音对话显式建模为多阶段认知推理过程的有效性，并借助声学锚定注意力、阶段分解信用分配及配套数据与评测基准，显著提升SpeechLLM的共情对话质量。

title: TS-SP: Learning Speaker-Preserving Representations in Audio Large Language Models
summary: Audio large language models (ALLMs) can understand speech content, yet their ability to use speaker identity for verification remains limited. We propose TS-SP (Two-Stage Speaker Preservation), a parameter-efficient framework for learning speaker-preserving representations and making them accessible to an ALLM's language-model component. We instantiate and evaluate TS-SP on Qwen2.5-Omni-7B. First, we adapt the audio encoder with speaker identity supervision. We then freeze the adapted encoder and train the language model to compare speakers. Both stages use low-rank adaptation (LoRA), keeping the pretrained base weights fixed. On Vox1-O, TS-SP reduces the equal error rate (EER) from 7.01\% for the Paired Loss Adaptation Baseline to 4.37\%. EER remains within 4.31--4.79\% under unseen prompts. Cross-domain evaluation on CN-Celeb yields a similar EER to the baseline, but lower accuracy at the native decision threshold. These findings support two-stage adaptation for improving speaker verification on the evaluated backbone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TS-SP两阶段说话人保持框架，通过LoRA分别适配音频编码器与语言模型，使ALLM具备说话人验证能力。
AI.motivation: 音频大语言模型能理解语音内容，但利用说话人身份进行验证的能力仍然有限，需要一种参数高效的方法将说话人表征注入语言模型组件。
AI.method: 提出TS-SP（两阶段说话人保持）框架：第一阶段用说话人身份监督适配音频编码器；第二阶段冻结适配后的编码器，训练语言模型进行说话人比对。两阶段均采用低秩适配（LoRA），保持预训练基础权重固定。在Qwen2.5-Omni-7B上进行实例化与评估。
AI.result: 在Vox1-O上，TS-SP将等错误率（EER）从Paired Loss Adaptation基线的7.01%降至4.37%；在未见提示下EER保持在4.31–4.79%之间。跨域评估（CN-Celeb）EER与基线相近，但在原生决策阈值下准确率较低。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果支持采用两阶段适配来提升所评估骨干模型上的说话人验证性能。

title: Tracing a Sparse Emotion-Control Circuit in LLM-Based Text-to-Speech
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 15 pages, 4 figures
summary: LLM-based text-to-speech (TTS) models can generate emotionally expressive speech, but how reference emotion is routed through the model and realized in decoded speech remains unclear. We introduce two emotion-sensitive metrics for matched neutral and emotional syntheses---a codec trajectory score and a late residual direction score---and use them to score activation-patching interventions. Under controlled matched-reference conditions, this analysis identifies a sparse source-to-readout component-level circuit: 23--27 attention heads and MLPs per emotion, roughly 5% of the components considered, recover or suppress 74--88% of the late emotion-readout shift on held-out cases. The circuit combines a shared component backbone with emotion-specific components; cross-emotion activation swaps reduce the target readout in 47 of 48 cases. In decoded speech, the same intervention produces consistent changes in pitch, energy, and spectral brightness over 24 matched pairs per emotion. A readout-matched residual-direction baseline produces only 17--27% of the intervention's pitch effect, showing that internal readout movement alone does not explain the decoded acoustic changes. These results trace a compact causal route from reference-derived prefix information to emotion-relevant properties of generated speech.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对基于LLM的TTS模型，提出两种情感敏感指标（codec轨迹分数与晚期残差方向分数），并通过激活修补定位出一个稀疏的"源到读出"组件级因果回路：每种情感约23–27个注意力头与MLP（约占5%组件）可恢复或抑制74–88%的晚期情感读出偏移，且该干预在解码语音中引起一致的音高、能量与频谱亮度变化。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的TTS模型虽能生成情感丰富的语音，但参考情感如何在模型中传递并最终体现在解码语音中仍不清楚，缺乏对情感路由机制的因果性理解。
AI.method: 构建匹配的中性与情感合成对，提出两个情感敏感指标——codec轨迹分数与晚期残差方向分数；用其对激活修补干预进行评分，在受控匹配参考条件下识别源到读出的组件级回路，并进行跨情感激活交换与解码语音声学分析。
AI.result: 识别出稀疏回路：每种情感23–27个注意力头与MLP（约5%组件）可恢复或抑制74–88%的晚期情感读出偏移；回路由共享骨干与情感特异组件构成；48例中47例跨情感激活交换降低目标读出；解码语音中每情感24对匹配样本均出现音高、能量、频谱亮度的一致变化；读出匹配的残差方向基线仅产生17–27%的音高效应。
AI.conclusion: 研究刻画了一条从参考派生前缀信息到生成语音情感相关属性的紧凑因果路径，表明解码声学变化不能仅由内部读出移动解释。

title: NeuMark-Native: Robust Text-to-Speech-Native Watermarking Through Full Utilization of Neural Audio Codec Latent Space
summary: Speech watermarking offers proactive traceability for synthetic speech, yet most existing models operate only after text-to-speech (TTS) synthesis by adding a watermark perturbation to the generated waveform. This post-hoc design leaves watermarking as an external step that can be omitted or bypassed and restricts the watermark to a shallow waveform representation. We propose NeuMark-Native, a TTS-native watermarking framework for neural codec-based synthesis. It embeds payload information into every generated codec-latent layer before waveform decoding, improving watermark persistence under downstream digital signal processing (DSP) and neural codec resynthesis. NeuMark-Native keeps the pretrained TTS model and the neural codec frozen, while optimizing only the watermark modules on generated codec tokens. Experiments on two corpora under 11 DSP attacks and 9 neural-codec attacks demonstrate robust watermark detection while preserving naturalness, intelligibility, and speech quality close to synthetic speech.

AI.tldr: 提出NeuMark-Native，一种TTS原生水印框架，在神经编解码器的隐层中嵌入水印，冻结TTS与编解码器仅训练水印模块，在11种DSP与9种神经编解码攻击下实现鲁棒检测且保持语音自然度。
AI.motivation: 现有语音水印多为后处理式（post-hoc）：在TTS生成波形后再叠加扰动，导致水印是可被省略或绕过的外部步骤，且仅停留在浅层波形表示上。作者希望将水印嵌入到合成流程内部，以提升水印的持久性与不可绕过性。
AI.method: 提出NeuMark-Native：面向基于神经编解码器的TTS合成，在波形解码前将载荷信息嵌入每一层生成的编解码隐层（codec-latent layer）中。训练时保持预训练TTS模型与神经编解码器冻结，仅优化作用于生成编解码token的水印模块。
AI.result: 在两个语料库上进行评测，涵盖11种DSP攻击与9种神经编解码重合成攻击，均能实现鲁棒的水印检测；同时自然度、可懂度与语音质量接近原始合成语音。
AI.conclusion: 将水印内嵌于TTS编解码隐层是一种可行的原生水印方案，在保持冻结大模型的前提下仅训练轻量水印模块，即可兼顾鲁棒性与语音质量。

title: Task-Aware Joint Pruning and Distillation for Efficient Audio Deepfake Detection
summary: Advances in speech synthesis have made deepfake speeches increasingly convincing, posing growing threats to security. While self-supervised learning (SSL) based detectors achieve state-of-the-art performance, their computational demands (typically 300M+ parameters) prevent deployment on resource-constrained devices. Existing compression methods, designed mainly for content-centric tasks, struggle to maintain competitive performance when directly adapted to deepfake detection. We propose a Task-Aware Joint Pruning and Distillation framework that combines cross-domain knowledge distillation with movement-guided structured pruning to transfer forgery-discriminative knowledge and preserve critical structures under aggressive compression. Our framework reduces the model to 31.9M parameters with 6.3$\times$ FLOPs reduction, with an average performance drop of only 1.30\% across multiple datasets compared to the uncompressed baseline, demonstrating strong potential for on-device deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务感知的剪枝与蒸馏联合框架，在保持深度伪造语音检测性能的同时将模型压缩至31.9M参数、FLOPs降低6.3倍。
AI.motivation: 基于自监督学习（SSL）的深度伪造语音检测器性能领先，但参数量通常超过300M，难以部署在资源受限设备上；现有压缩方法面向内容中心任务设计，直接迁移到伪造检测任务时性能明显下降。
AI.method: 提出Task-Aware Joint Pruning and Distillation框架，将跨域知识蒸馏与运动引导（movement-guided）结构化剪枝相结合，以迁移伪造判别知识并在激进压缩下保留关键结构。
AI.result: 模型压缩至31.9M参数，FLOPs减少6.3倍；在多个数据集上相较未压缩基线平均性能仅下降1.30%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架在显著压缩模型规模与计算量的同时基本保持检测性能，展现出了在端侧设备部署的潜力。

title: SheetSage2: Coherent Lead-Sheet Transcription with Synthetic Supervision
summary: Transcribing music into a human-readable score requires a coherent understanding of rhythm, harmony, melody, and form. Two obstacles limit this goal: annotated recordings are scarce, and accurate local predictions can still produce inconsistent musical sequences. We present SheetSage2, a unified music transcription framework that combines synthetic data, task-specific structured decoding, and autoregressive distillation. Automatically annotated MIDI, rendered into audio, provides scalable supervision across music understanding tasks. Task-specific structured decoders integrate complementary musical cues and their temporal dependencies to produce musically coherent scores. Autoregressive distillation further retains transcription accuracy without task-specific dynamic programming at inference. Across eight benchmark collections, a single SheetSage2-AR model exceeds the listed prior systems on 12 of 15 benchmark--metric pairs in our evaluation, substantially improving over SheetSage1 and surpassing task-specific models on several benchmarks. Model weights and inference code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: SheetSage2是一个统一音乐转录框架，通过合成数据、任务特定结构化解码和自回归蒸馏，在15个基准指标对中的12个上超越已有系统。
AI.motivation: 音乐转录需要连贯理解节奏、和声、旋律与曲式，但面临两大障碍：带标注的录音稀缺，且准确的局部预测仍可能生成不一致的音乐序列。
AI.method: 方法包含三部分：(1) 将自动标注的MIDI渲染为音频，提供跨音乐理解任务的可扩展监督；(2) 任务特定结构化解码器整合互补音乐线索及其时间依赖以产生连贯乐谱；(3) 自回归蒸馏在推理时无需任务特定动态规划即可保持转录精度。
AI.result: 在八个基准集合中，单一SheetSage2-AR模型在评估的15个基准-指标对中有12个超过所列先前系统，显著优于SheetSage1，并在多个基准上超过任务特定模型。模型权重与推理代码已公开。
AI.conclusion: SheetSage2作为统一转录框架，有效缓解了数据稀缺与序列不一致问题，在多数基准上取得领先性能。

title: SEA-LM: Egocentric Spatial Audio Understanding for Wearable Microphone Arrays
summary: Embodied, ego-centric intelligence fundamentally requires the ability to comprehend spatial audio within complex environments. While large audio-language models excel at mono-channel reasoning, they lack spatial awareness, discarding critical spatial cues that enable sound localization and that can improve the disentanglement of overlapping sound sources. To address this, we present SEA-LM, a Spatial Audio Understanding model. First, we introduce FOACODER, a layout-flexible spatial audio encoder trained on source localization and ego-centric voice activity detection objectives to encode First Order Ambisonics derived from variable-count, variable-position smart-glasses arrays via beamforming. We train a Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM) to understand these spatial audio embeddings through a two-stage curriculum spanning six tasks, including sound localization and spatially selective transcription in settings with multiple speakers and overlapping sounds. To prevent the transcription outputs from dominating the next token prediction loss and overwhelming the direction predictions, we introduce a Spatio-temporal Weighted Cross-Entropy Loss. On our evaluation set, SEA-LM achieves lower azimuth and elevation MAE, higher temporal IoU, lower external-source hallucination and missing-source rates, and lower WER on most transcription tasks than compared baselines, while remaining robust across 1,211 smart-glasses array configurations with 4 to 9 microphones.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SEA-LM空间音频理解模型，包含布局灵活的空间音频编码器FOACODER与两阶段课程训练的多模态大模型，实现声源定位与空间选择性转录。
AI.motivation: 具身、自我中心智能需要理解复杂环境中的空间音频，但现有大型音频-语言模型仅擅长单声道推理，缺乏空间感知，丢弃了用于声源定位和分离重叠声源的关键空间线索。
AI.method: 1) 提出FOACODER：布局灵活的空间音频编码器，以声源定位和自我中心语音活动检测为目标，通过波束成形对来自数量与位置可变智能眼镜阵列的一阶Ambisonics进行编码；2) 训练MLLM理解这些空间音频嵌入，采用覆盖六项任务的两阶段课程；3) 提出时空加权交叉熵损失，防止转录输出主导下一token预测损失、压制方向预测。
AI.result: 在评测集上，相比基线，SEA-LM取得更低的方位角与俯仰角MAE、更高的时间IoU、更低的外部声源幻觉率与漏检率，且在多数转录任务上WER更低；并在4至9个麦克风的1211种智能眼镜阵列配置下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: SEA-LM通过空间音频编码与课程式多任务训练，赋予多模态大模型空间感知能力，在定位、转录及阵列配置鲁棒性上优于基线。

title: AudioGAR: Bridging Reconstruction and Generation in Latent Audio Generative Models
summary: Latent audio generative models are typically trained in two stages: an audio codec is learned first, followed by a latent generative model. This decomposition leads to a decoder train-generation mismatch: the codec decoder is trained on encoder-induced latents but deployed on generator-produced latents at inference time. Across diverse datasets and latent generative models, we observe clear reconstruction-generation gaps under both FD and FAD, showing that strong reconstruction quality does not necessarily translate into strong end-to-end generation quality. A natural remedy is to adapt the decoder on generation-produced latents, but generated latents lack correspondence with source audio and therefore cannot directly provide the paired supervision used for decoder fine-tuning. We introduce \textbf{AudioGAR}, which constructs intermediate latents by perturbing encoder latents and denoising them through the frozen latent diffusion model. These latents form a trajectory from reconstruction toward generation, with lower-noise latents retaining source correspondence and supporting paired decoder fine-tuning. We fine-tune only the codec decoder on these latents, while keeping the codec encoder and latent generative model frozen. When applied to AudioX, AudioGAR substantially improves generative performance. It requires only 1.5\% of the original training audio hours and 0.26\% of the original training cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AudioGAR，通过在编码器潜变量上施加扰动并经冻结的潜扩散模型去噪，构造介于重建与生成之间的中间潜变量轨迹，仅微调解码器以缓解两阶段训练导致的解码器训练-生成失配问题，在仅用1.5%训练时长和0.26%成本下显著提升 AudioX 的生成性能。
AI.motivation: 潜音频生成模型通常采用两阶段训练：先学习音频编解码器，再训练潜生成模型。这种分解带来解码器的训练-生成失配：解码器在编码器产生的潜变量上训练，却在推理时接收生成器产生的潜变量。在多种数据集和潜生成模型上，FD 与 FAD 指标均显示明显的重建-生成差距，说明良好的重建质量不一定带来良好的端到端生成质量。直接的自然补救方法是在生成潜变量上微调解码器，但生成潜变量与源音频缺乏对应关系，无法提供微调所需的成对监督。
AI.method: 提出 AudioGAR：对编码器潜变量进行扰动，再通过冻结的潜扩散模型去噪，从而构造中间潜变量。这些潜变量构成从重建到生成的轨迹，其中低噪声潜变量保留源对应关系，可支持成对解码器微调。方法仅微调编解码器的解码器，冻结编解码器编码器和潜生成模型。
AI.result: 在 AudioX 上应用 AudioGAR 后，生成性能大幅提升；仅需原始训练音频时长的 1.5% 和原始训练成本的 0.26%。
AI.conclusion: AudioGAR 有效缓解了解码器的训练-生成失配，通过构造带源对应关系的中间潜变量轨迹实现高效的解码器微调，以极低的数据与计算代价显著提升端到端生成质量，为两阶段潜音频生成模型的解码器适配提供了实用方案。

title: Relational Synthesis: Structure-Mediated Concatenative Synthesis for Foley and Retrieval-Augmented Audio Generation
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 1 table. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Audio demo: https://smoothken.github.io/relational_synth_demo/. This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: We ask: given a retrieved source audio $S$ and a separate reference audio $R$, can we synthesize novel audio $Y$ out of this pair $(S,R)$ such that $Y$ remains acoustically consistent with $S$, while not persistently copying segments of $S$ or $R$? The first clause is a well-known goal in Foley audio production, and the second is a well-known issue in neural RAG when $S$ and $R$ are naively injected into neural generators. We show that both clauses can be addressed simultaneously using a method we coin relational synthesis, a variation of concatenative synthesis where target cost is replaced by a relational Gromov-like structural cost. Rather than imitating the content of $R$, relational synthesis exploits it from the "other side of the hill": it transfers the temporal structure and directed amplitude motion of $R$ to reorganize and concatenate the grains of $S$ in a novel manner that protects $S$'s acoustic information. Our experiments show that relational synthesis integrates naturally with neural RAG and produces Foley audio that performs well on metrics measuring temporal agreement, acoustic fidelity, and leakage persistence, while maintaining distribution-level quality and text alignment.

AI.tldr: 提出"关系合成"(relational synthesis)，一种拼接合成的变体，用类似Gromov的结构代价替代目标代价，将参考音频R的时间结构与方向性振幅运动迁移到源音频S的颗粒重组上，在保持S声学一致性的同时避免持续复制S或R的片段，并可自然集成到神经RAG中生成Foley音频。
AI.motivation: 给定检索源音频S与独立参考音频R，希望合成新音频Y，使其在声学上与S保持一致，同时不持续复制S或R的片段。前者是Foley音频制作的常见目标，后者是神经RAG中朴素注入S和R时常见的泄漏问题。论文希望同时满足这两个诉求。
AI.method: 提出关系合成（relational synthesis），是拼接合成（concatenative synthesis）的一种变体：将传统拼接合成中的目标代价（target cost）替换为一种关系式、类似Gromov的结构代价（relational Gromov-like structural cost）。该方法不模仿R的内容，而是从"山的另一侧"利用R——将其时间结构与方向性振幅运动迁移过来，用于以新颖方式重组与拼接S的颗粒（grains），从而保护S的声学信息。
AI.result: 实验表明，关系合成能与神经RAG自然结合，生成的Foley音频在衡量时间一致性、声学保真度与泄漏持续性（leakage persistence）的指标上表现良好，同时保持分布级别的质量与文本对齐。
AI.conclusion: 通过用关系式结构代价替代目标代价，关系合成可同时解决声学一致性与片段泄漏两个问题，为Foley音频生成与神经RAG集成提供了一种兼顾时间结构迁移、声学保真与低泄漏的有效方案。

title: A Comprehensive Objective Evaluation of Modern Text-to-Speech for Turkish Using Speech Quality Assessment Models
comment: Accepted at 28th International Conference on Speech and Computer (SPECOM 2026). Published in Lecture Notes in Computer Science
summary: Modern text-to-speech (TTS) systems can clone a target speaker from a short reference clip or be fine-tuned on a target voice, yet their behaviour on morphologically rich, lower-resource languages such as Turkish remain under-characterised. We present a systematic benchmark of four contemporary systems (Chatterbox, CosyVoice, OmniVoice, and VoxCPM2) evaluated across fine-tuned and zero-shot configurations, contrasted with a conventional VITS baseline and anchored to natural gold speech. Each configuration is scored with eighteen complementary objective metrics spanning learned naturalness predictors (UTMOS v2, DNSMOS-Pro, SCOREQ, WhisQA, AudioBox-PQ, NatScore, SpeechLMScore), intelligibility and signal-quality estimators (SQUIM PESQ/SI-SDR/STOI, Brouhaha), speaker similarity, distributional fidelity (TTSDS) and low-level acoustic descriptors. We further analyse how quality varies with utterance length and quantify long-form temporal consistency through speaker-identity and naturalness drift over chunked utterances. We release our evaluation code to support reproducible TTS evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文对四种现代TTS系统（Chatterbox、CosyVoice、OmniVoice、VoxCPM2）在土耳其语上进行了系统性基准测试，覆盖微调与零样本配置，并以VITS和自然语音为基线，采用18项客观指标评估，同时分析话语长度影响与长文本时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 现代TTS可从短参考音频克隆说话人或微调目标语音，但它们在形态丰富、资源较少的语言（如土耳其语）上的表现仍缺乏充分表征，因此需要系统性的评测。
AI.method: 构建涵盖四种当代系统（Chatterbox、CosyVoice、OmniVoice、VoxCPM2）的基准，分别在微调与零样本配置下评测，并与VITS基线及自然录音对比；使用18项互补客观指标，包括自然度预测器、可懂度与信号质量估计、说话人相似度、分布保真度（TTSDS）及低层声学描述符；并分析质量随话语长度的变化及分块话语上的说话人身份与自然度漂移。
AI.result: 对每种配置给出18项客观指标得分，揭示了不同系统在自然度、可懂度、说话人相似度与分布保真度上的差异，并量化了质量随话语长度的变化趋势以及长文本的时序一致性（说话人身份与自然度漂移）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为土耳其语等形态丰富、低资源语言的TTS提供了系统性基准与多维度评测框架，并公开评估代码以支持可复现的TTS评测。

title: Smorph: Playable Sound Morphing with Diffusion Models
summary: Sound morphing, generating intermediate sounds that transition from one sonic identity to another, can be a powerful tool for musical sound design. Existing diffusion-based morphing approaches entangle temporal structure and timbral identity, offering no mechanism to hold one fixed while transforming the other. We present smorph, a training-free guidance framework that preserves how a sound behaves over time while transforming what the sound is, allowing users to morph, for instance from brass to strings at a fixed pitch. We demonstrate across three morphing modes: prompt-to-prompt, audio-to-prompt, and audio-to-audio. Evaluations across diverse datasets show that smorph effectively produces smooth morph trajectories while substantially improving temporal-structure and source preservation over baselines, albeit with more conservative target-ward transformation in some settings. In an exploratory case study, musicians found smorph trajectories to be expressive and playable, suggesting structural anchoring can serve as a productive constraint for instrumental interaction.

AI.tldr: smorph：一种免训练引导框架，在声音变形中保持时间结构不变、仅改变音色身份。
AI.motivation: 现有基于扩散的声音变形方法将时间结构与音色身份纠缠，无法在变换其中一项时固定另一项，限制了音乐音色设计的可控性。
AI.method: 提出免训练引导框架 smorph，通过结构性锚定在变形过程中保留声音的时间行为（如固定音高），支持 prompt-to-prompt、audio-to-prompt、audio-to-audio 三种变形模式。
AI.result: 在多数据集评估中，smorph 生成平滑的变形轨迹，时间结构与源声音保持显著优于基线，但部分设置下向目标方向的变换较为保守；探索性案例中音乐人认为其轨迹富有表现力且可演奏。
AI.conclusion: 结构锚定可作为乐器交互的有效约束，为音乐声音设计提供更可控的变形工具。

title: AuraSE: Low-Hallucination Generative Speech Enhancement via Multimodal Flow Matching and Inference Policy Optimization
summary: Generative speech enhancement models can produce cleaner and more natural-sounding speech than conventional discriminative approaches, but may hallucinate by changing speech content or speaker identity, even with transcript conditioning. We present AuraSE, a flow-matching framework that addresses hallucination through complementary modality and inference designs. First, a double-stream-to-single-stream multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) allows transcript and acoustic representations to interact while preserving a dedicated pathway for the degraded input. Second, we find that the best decoder configuration, governed by guidance scale, sampling temperature, and step count, varies substantially across utterances. This observation motivates Inference Policy Optimization (IPO), an online, on-policy preference optimization method. IPO generates multiple candidates from the current model under different inference configurations, ranks them with a multi-objective reward, and learns from their relative preferences. AuraSE-IPO ranks first on 11 of 12 metrics across the synthetic test sets and obtains the highest DNSMOS and blind-listening scores among the evaluated systems on the real DNS blind test set. At deployment, it uses a fixed $10$-step ODE decoder without classifier-free guidance (CFG) or per-utterance configuration search.

AI.tldr: 提出 AuraSE，一种基于流匹配的生成式语音增强框架，通过多模态 DiT 架构与推理策略优化（IPO）抑制幻觉，在合成与真实测试集上取得领先性能，且部署时仅需固定 10 步 ODE 解码。
AI.motivation: 生成式语音增强虽能产生更干净自然的语音，但即使有转写文本条件，仍可能产生幻觉，改变语音内容或说话人身份，因此需要新的架构与推理设计来抑制幻觉。
AI.method: 1) 采用双流到单流的多模态 Diffusion Transformer（MMDiT），让转写与声学表示交互，同时为退化输入保留专用通路；2) 提出 Inference Policy Optimization（IPO），一种在线同策略偏好优化方法，从当前模型在不同推理配置下生成多个候选，用多目标奖励排序并学习其相对偏好，以应对不同话语最优解码配置差异大的问题。
AI.result: AuraSE-IPO 在合成测试集的 12 项指标中 11 项排名第一；在真实 DNS 盲测集上获得所评估系统中最高的 DNSMOS 与盲听分数。
AI.conclusion: AuraSE 通过多模态架构与推理策略优化有效缓解生成式语音增强的幻觉问题，且部署时使用固定的 10 步 ODE 解码器，无需 CFG 或逐话语配置搜索。

title: Revisiting Label-Free Speaker Embedding Enhancement with vMF Profile Likelihood
summary: Embedding enhancement improves speaker verification under acoustic mismatch without modifying a frozen backbone. Recent work has established a practical label-free setting for this task, but often adopts increasingly structured formulations. Here, the clean target is directly observed during training, making enhancement a matching problem on the unit hypersphere. We model the clean target with a von Mises--Fisher (vMF) likelihood and profile out a sample-wise concentration parameter, yielding a simple closed-form objective with adaptive weighting. Across VoxCeleb1, VoxSRC23, CN-Celeb, VOiCES, and VC-Mix, the proposed method largely preserves the baseline and gives clearer gains on challenging mismatch sets. It also remains stable under a broad single-view recipe, where a recent diffusion baseline becomes less reliable in controlled comparisons. These results suggest that effective label-free embedding enhancement in this setting does not require a highly structured formulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种简洁的无标签说话人嵌入增强方法：将干净目标建模为von Mises–Fisher (vMF)似然，通过解析消去样本级浓度参数，得到带自适应权重的闭式目标函数，无需改动冻结的主干网络。
AI.motivation: 在声学失配条件下提升说话人验证性能，通常需要嵌入增强；现有工作虽已建立实用的无标签设置，但往往采用日益复杂的结构化建模。作者认为该任务中干净目标在训练时可直接观测，因而增强本质上只是单位超球面上的匹配问题，过于复杂的结构并非必要。
AI.method: 在无标签设置下，将干净目标建模为von Mises–Fisher (vMF) 似然，并解析消去（profile out）样本级浓度参数κ，从而得到一个简单的闭式目标函数，该目标自带自适应权重；主干网络保持冻结，仅对嵌入进行增强。
AI.result: 在VoxCeleb1、VoxSRC23、CN-Celeb、VOiCES和VC-Mix上，该方法基本保持基线性能，并在具有挑战性的失配集上取得更明显的提升；在广义单视图（single-view）训练配方下依然稳定，而近期扩散（diffusion）基线在受控比较中可靠性下降。
AI.conclusion: 在该无标签嵌入增强场景下，有效方法并不依赖高度结构化的建模；简洁的vMF似然闭式目标即可实现稳健且具竞争力的性能。

title: On the Tightness and Computational Tractability of Higher-Dimensional Confidence Sequences
summary: Modern sequential monitoring problems often involve multiple metrics, where we monitor several data streams simultaneously and may act once the evidence is strong enough. Confidence sequences (CSs) are a natural tool for such continuous monitoring. However, for bounded vector means, existing multivariate CSs are either tight but computationally intractable, or fast to compute but conservative. To address this, we study three lifts of one-dimensional betting-based CSs to higher dimensions: a weighted Bonferroni region, an equivalent max-wealth form, and a portfolio region. The portfolio is typically much tighter, especially in higher dimensions, but its boundary and properties such as volume are not available in closed form. To make this tighter construction usable, we propose tractable outer approximations of the portfolio region that preserve statistical validity: a bounding box, an $\ell_p$-ellipsoid, and their intersection. We prove set relations among all constructions and show empirically that these approximations (i) achieve regions close to the intractable portfolio, (ii) substantially outperform existing tractable multivariate CSs, and (iii) enable practical use cases such as multi-metric A/B testing and model comparison.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究有界向量均值的多元置信序列（CS）构造问题，提出三种将一维基于投注的CS提升到高维的方法，并给出可计算的外近似，以兼顾紧致性与统计有效性。
AI.motivation: 现代序贯监测常需同时监测多条数据流，置信序列是连续监测的自然工具。但针对有界向量均值，现有多元CS要么紧致但计算不可行，要么计算快但过于保守，因此需要构造既紧致又可计算的多元置信序列。
AI.method: 将一维基于投注（betting-based）的CS以三种方式推广到高维：加权Bonferroni区域、等价的max-wealth形式，以及组合（portfolio）区域；针对组合区域边界与体积无闭式表达的问题，提出保持统计有效性的可计算外近似：边界框、$\ell_p$椭球及其交集，并证明各构造之间的集合包含关系。
AI.result: 理论上证明了各构造之间的集合关系；实验表明所提近似（i）能得到接近不可计算组合区域的区域，（ii）显著优于现有可计算的多元CS，（iii）支持多指标A/B测试与模型比较等实际应用。
AI.conclusion: 通过组合区域的可计算外近似，可在保持统计有效性的同时获得接近最优的紧致性，为多元序贯监测提供了实用且高效的置信序列方案。

title: Targeted Active Learning for Preference-Based Treatment Effects on Multivariate Outcomes
summary: Treatment efficacy is traditionally demonstrated on the basis of a single primary outcome. However, clinical decision-making usually requires consideration of multiple outcomes, balancing expected benefits against potential risks. The relative value assigned to these outcomes varies substantially from one patient to another. Given a preference rule over outcome profiles, treatment effects and optimal policies can be defined and estimated. Such a rule is rarely available in practice: it must itself be estimated from pairwise comparisons of outcome profiles, which are costly to collect from clinical experts. We propose an active learning framework that selects which comparisons to query. Standard criteria maximize the information gained on the preference rule itself. We instead target the quantities of interest, and select the query that most reduces uncertainty on the treatment effect and on the optimal policy induced by the learned rule. Under a Gaussian process model of the preference rule, we derive a closed-form approximation of this criterion. On semi-synthetic data built from a Parkinson's disease cohort with 13 clinical outcomes, our criterion achieves lower treatment effect estimation error and lower policy regret than existing criteria at equal query budget.

AI.tldr: 提出一种主动学习框架，用于在偏好规则未知时高效选取成对比较查询，以降低疗效估计误差与最优策略遗憾。
AI.motivation: 传统疗效评价依赖单一主要结局，但临床决策需平衡多结局的获益与风险，且患者对各结局的相对偏好差异很大。在偏好规则下可定义并估计疗效与最优策略，然而该规则在实践中通常未知，需通过临床专家的成对结局剖面比较来估计，而这类数据采集成本高昂。
AI.method: 构建主动学习框架以选择查询哪些成对比较。不同于标准准则（最大化偏好规则本身的信息增益），本文直接针对感兴趣的量，选择能最大程度降低"疗效"与"由所学规则诱导的最优策略"不确定性的查询；在偏好规则的高斯过程模型下，推导出该准则的闭式近似。
AI.result: 在半合成数据（基于含13个临床结局的帕金森病队列构建）上，在相同查询预算下，该准则比现有准则取得更低的疗效估计误差和更低的策略遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 以目标量为导向的主动查询准则优于以偏好规则信息量最大化为目标的传统准则，能在有限专家标注预算下更有效地支持多结局临床决策。

title: Probability flow ODEs in score-based and reflected diffusion models
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Workshop: AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary:
Probability-flow ordinary differential equations (PF-ODEs) are widely used as deterministic samplers for score-based diffusion models. Their usual justification is that the Fokker--Planck equation of a diffusion can be rewritten as a continuity equation driven by the score function of the forward diffusion. This identity does not, however, guarantee that the resulting velocity field generates a well-posed flow. We provide theoretical insights into the design of such deterministic samplers for generative models based on diffusions and reflected diffusions. We identify sufficient conditions for a regular Lagrangian PF-ODE flow to exist; reverse sampling and invertibility require two-sided divergence control. For learned scores, sampler stability is controlled by an unweighted velocity error, exposing a mismatch with density-weighted score matching and motivating architectural control of Jacobians, divergence, growth, and compression. Under the manifold hypothesis, positive-time regularization justifies an early-stopped PF-ODE while constants deteriorate near the data endpoint; an explicit sphere example shows that the exact deterministic flow becomes singular as the noise level vanishes even though the diffusion marginals remain well defined.
  These theoretical insights translate into concrete design principles for stable, invertible, and constraint-preserving diffusion samplers. We illustrate the practical relevance of these design principles using controlled numerical experiments.

AI.tldr: 该文从理论上研究基于得分扩散模型的确定性采样器（PF-ODE），指出仅凭Fokker–Planck方程改写为连续性方程并不保证速度场生成适定流，并给出稳定性、可逆性与约束保持的设计原则。
AI.motivation: 概率流常微分方程（PF-ODE）被广泛用作得分扩散模型的确定性采样器，其常见依据是扩散的Fokker–Planck方程可改写为由前向扩散得分函数驱动的连续性方程。但该恒等式并不保证所得速度场能生成适定的流；此外，学习到的得分与密度加权得分匹配之间存在不匹配，且流形假设下噪声水平趋零时流的适定性存在问题。
AI.method: 作者针对基于扩散与反射扩散的生成模型，对确定性采样器的设计进行理论分析：识别正则拉格朗日PF-ODE流存在的充分条件；论证反向采样与可逆性需要双向散度控制；分析学习得分下采样器稳定性由无权重速度误差控制，与密度加权得分匹配存在错配，并据此提出对雅可比、散度、增长与压缩的架构控制；在流形假设下讨论正时间正则化对提前停止PF-ODE的合理性，并给出球面上的显式例子。
AI.result: 研究表明：正则拉格朗日PF-ODE流存在需要满足特定充分条件；反向采样与可逆性依赖于双向散度控制；对于学习到的得分，采样器稳定性受无权重速度误差支配，与密度加权得分匹配不匹配；在流形假设下，正时间正则化支持提前停止的PF-ODE，而常数在数据端点附近会退化；显式球面例子表明即使扩散边缘分布保持良定义，精确确定性流在噪声水平趋于零时会变得奇异。
AI.conclusion: 这些理论洞见转化为稳定、可逆且保持约束的扩散采样器的具体设计原则，并通过受控数值实验说明了这些设计原则的实际相关性。

title: Latent Score-Based Bayesian Cramér-Rao Bound Estimation for High-Dimensional Imaging Systems
summary: We propose a data-driven framework for estimating the Bayesian Cramér-Rao bound (CRB) in high-dimensional imaging systems with complex, analytically intractable priors. Direct CRB computation is challenging in this setting due to the need to model the prior score and to form and invert the Bayesian Fisher information matrix in very high dimensions. To address these issues, we first reformulate the inverse problem in the latent space of a pre-trained variational autoencoder, thereby dramatically reducing the dimensionality of the bound estimation problem while preserving the spatial structure of the images. The Bayesian CRB is formed in this latent space and mapped back to the native parameter space using a change-of-variables formula. Second, to learn the latent prior score, we introduce a new sliced score matching objective defined in a Bochner space endowed with an $H^1(Ω)$ Sobolev norm in space. This "Bochner-space sliced score matching" objective is consistent with standard sliced score matching, but penalizes errors in the spatial gradients of the score, suppressing high-frequency artifacts that otherwise contaminate the resulting CRB estimates. We validate the approach on a stylized quantitative photoacoustic computed tomography (qPACT) breast imaging problem with over one million unknown parameters, using a foundation-model autoencoder derived from Stable Diffusion. The proposed method yields stable, artifact-free Bayesian CRB estimates that reflect the highly non-Gaussian structure of the learned prior and reveal the substantial impact of the prior on the relative performance of competing qPACT design schemes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种数据驱动框架，可在潜空间中估计高维成像系统的贝叶斯Cramér-Rao界（CRB），并通过Bochner空间切片分数匹配抑制空间高频伪影，在百万参数级qPACT问题上得到稳定、无伪影的CRB估计。
AI.motivation: 高维成像系统中先验复杂且解析不可解，直接计算贝叶斯CRB需要建模先验分数并在超高维下构造与求逆贝叶斯Fisher信息矩阵，计算上不可行。
AI.method: 1) 将反问题重述到预训练变分自编码器的潜空间，以保留图像空间结构并大幅降维，在潜空间构造贝叶斯CRB后通过变量替换公式映射回原始参数空间；2) 提出"Bochner空间切片分数匹配"目标，在赋以空间H^1(Ω) Sobolev范数的Bochner空间中学习潜先验分数，该目标与标准切片分数匹配一致，但对分数空间梯度的误差施加惩罚。
AI.result: 在一个含超过一百万未知参数量、风格化的定量光声计算断层成像（qPACT）乳腺成像问题上，使用由Stable Diffusion衍生的基础模型自编码器进行验证，方法给出了稳定、无伪影的贝叶斯CRB估计，反映了所学先验的高度非高斯结构，并揭示先验对竞争性qPACT设计方案相对性能的显著影响。
AI.conclusion: 通过在潜空间进行CRB估计并引入Bochner空间切片分数匹配，可在解析先验不可解的超高维成像问题中高效、稳定地计算贝叶斯CRB，且能刻画非高斯先验对系统设计比较的影响。

title: Adaptive Partitioning Schemes for Optimistic Optimization
summary: Applications such as engineering design often require us to optimize a black-box function, i.e., a system whose inner processing is not analytically known and whose gradients are not available. Practitioners often have a fixed budget for the number of function evaluations and the performance of an optimization algorithm is measured by its simple regret. In this paper, we study the class of "Optimistic Optimization" algorithms for black-box optimization that use a partitioning scheme for the domain. We develop algorithms that learn a good partitioning scheme and use flexible surrogate models such as neural networks in the optimization procedure. For multi-index functions on an $m$-dimensional subspace within $d$ dimensions, our algorithm attains $\tilde{O}(n^{-β/ d})$ regret, where $β= 1 + \frac{d-m}{2m-1}$, as opposed to $\tilde{O}(n^{-1/d})$ for SequOOL, a state-of-the-art optimistic optimization algorithm. We use our approach to improve the quality of Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) of the OPT-1.3B model, achieving $\sim10\%$ improvement in performance relative to the best possible unquantized model.

AI.tldr: 本文研究黑盒函数优化中的"乐观优化"算法类，提出能够学习良好划分方案并使用神经网络等灵活代理模型的算法，在$m$维子空间上的多指标函数取得$\tilde{O}(n^{-\beta/d})$遗憾，优于现有方法的$\tilde{O}(n^{-1/d})$，并应用于AWQ量化提升10%性能。
AI.motivation: 工程设计等应用常需优化黑盒函数，其内部处理无法解析表达且梯度不可用。实践者通常有固定的函数评估预算，算法性能以简单遗憾衡量。现有乐观优化算法（如SequOOL）的划分方案固定，遗憾率为$\tilde{O}(n^{-1/d})$，对具有低维结构的函数利用不足，需要学习更好的划分方案与更灵活的代理模型来提升效率。
AI.method: 在基于域划分的乐观优化算法框架下，开发能够学习良好划分方案的算法，并采用神经网络等灵活代理模型参与优化过程。针对$d$维空间中$m$维子空间上的多指标函数，设计适配低维结构的划分与代理建模策略。
AI.result: 对于$d$维空间中$m$维子空间上的多指标函数，算法达到$\tilde{O}(n^{-\beta/d})$遗憾，其中$\beta=1+\frac{d-m}{2m-1}$，而现有最优的SequOOL仅为$\tilde{O}(n^{-1/d})$。将该方法用于改进OPT-1.3B模型的AWQ激活感知权重量化，相比最佳未量化模型性能提升约10%。
AI.conclusion: 通过学习划分方案并结合灵活代理模型，乐观优化算法可显著改善黑盒优化遗憾率，在低维子空间结构下超越现有最优方法，并在大模型量化的实际任务中验证了有效性。

title: Mitigating Over-squashing without Rewiring: A Sheaf Effective Resistance Perspective
summary: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) often struggle to capture long-range dependencies due to over-squashing -- a phenomenon in which the repeated compression of node embeddings into finite-size messages causes representations to collapse. Over-squashing is most often diagnosed as a property of the graph topology, with effective resistance serving as a principled measure of the bottleneck. We provide a complementary view on the matter: building on cellular sheaves, we introduce sheaf effective resistance, a generalization of effective resistance that depends on the sheaf attached to the graph, and we prove that for flat vector bundles, the over-squashing sensitivity in the Jacobian sense is upper bounded by a quantity related to the sheaf effective resistance between the nodes. The bottleneck thus need not lie in the graph itself: it can be relocated, and reduced, by adjusting the sheaf. We instantiate this idea in FlatNSD, a simple message-passing variant of Neural Sheaf Diffusion, and show that it implicitly learns to modulate total sheaf effective resistance, performing well on benchmarks designed to stress over-squashing without altering the original graph topology.

AI.tldr: 本文从层束(cellular sheaves)视角重新审视GNN中的过挤压(over-squashing)问题，提出层束有效电阻(sheaf effective resistance)并证明其可上界Jacobian意义下的过挤压敏感性，进而提出FlatNSD模型，在不改变图拓扑的前提下通过调整层束来缓解过挤压。
AI.motivation: GNN常因过挤压而难以捕捉长程依赖：节点嵌入被反复压缩为有限大小的消息导致表示坍缩。过挤压通常被诊断为图拓扑的固有属性，有效电阻作为瓶颈的原则性度量。作者希望提供一个互补视角：瓶颈未必源于图本身，而可能通过调整附加在图上的层束来迁移和减小。
AI.method: 基于cellular sheaves引入sheaf effective resistance——有效电阻的推广，其取值依赖于附加于图的层束。对flat vector bundles，证明Jacobian意义下的过挤压敏感性被两节点间sheaf effective resistance所关联的量上界。据此实例化FlatNSD：一种Neural Sheaf Diffusion的简单消息传递变体，隐式学习调制总sheaf effective resistance。
AI.result: FlatNSD在专门用于施压过挤压的基准测试上表现良好，且无需改变原始图拓扑；理论表明过挤压瓶颈可通过调整层束被迁移并降低。
AI.conclusion: 过挤压并非仅由图拓扑决定，而可由层束结构调节。sheaf effective resistance为量化过挤压提供了新工具，FlatNSD验证了通过隐式调制层束电阻缓解过挤压的可行性，为超越拓扑改造的GNN设计提供了理论支撑。

title: Risk-Calibrated Proposal Transport for Finite-Particle Diffusion Steering
comment: Earlier version accepted at NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics (STODY)
summary: Inference-time steering combines pretrained diffusion experts or rewards without retraining by changing the dynamics that transport noise to data. Feynman-Kac correction compensates for proposal mismatch through importance-weighted sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), whose finite-particle behavior depends on the proposal. Variance-controlling guidance (VCG) improves that proposal by fitting a linear drift correction to minimize empirical log-weight-rate variance. Although its population optimum cannot worsen residual variance, finite-particle VCG can nearly eliminate its fitting residual while increasing residual risk on new states by orders of magnitude. The resulting update can degrade unweighted generation or accelerate particle collapse. We show that the centered Feynman-Kac rate is the normalized transport residual and that expected out-of-fit benefit is exactly population headroom minus coefficient-estimation penalty. Under regularity assumptions, a Wasserstein analysis bounds the unweighted proposal's terminal error using this residual. These results motivate Risk-Calibrated Proposal Transport (RCPT), which uses deletion leave-one-out residuals to calibrate the retained fraction of the VCG update, adding no model calls and only small linear-algebra overhead. Experiments on 2D checker distributions, scaffold decoration, molecular property optimization, and class-conditional CIFAR-10 generation demonstrate recovery from harmful fitted updates. Across molecular and image domains, RCPT mitigates harmful fitted updates and improves a broad range of terminal metrics relative to uncalibrated VCG.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示有限粒子方差的VCG在拟合残差趋零的同时会使新状态上的风险激增，进而提出用删除式留一残差校准保留比例的RCPT方法，在不增加模型调用的情况下恢复有害的拟合更新并提升终端指标。
AI.motivation: 推理期引导（inference-time steering）无需重训练即可组合预训练扩散专家或奖励，只需改变将噪声输运到数据的动力学。Feynman-Kac校正通过重要性加权的SMC补偿提议失配，但其有限粒子行为依赖提议质量。VCG通过拟合线性漂移校正来最小化经验对数权重率方差以改进提议，但存在总体最优与有限粒子实际表现之间的严重背离，即可能"拟合残差几近消除却使新状态上的残余风险增加数个数量级"，导致无权重生成质量下降或粒子坍缩。因此需要诊断该误差来源并加以校准。
AI.method: 作者首先给出理论刻画：中心化Feynman-Kac率等于归一化的输运残差；预期的样本外收益恰等于总体headroom减去系数估计惩罚。在正则性假设下，用Wasserstein分析以该残差界定无权重提议的终端误差。基于此提出Risk-Calibrated Proposal Transport (RCPT)：利用删除式留一（deletion leave-one-out）残差校准VCG更新中保留的比例，不额外增加模型调用，仅带来少量线性代数开销。
AI.result: 在2D checker分布、scaffold decoration、分子性质优化以及类别条件CIFAR-10生成上的实验表明，RCPT能够从有害的拟合更新中恢复。在分子与图像领域，RCPT缓解了有害的拟合更新，并在广泛的终端指标上相对于未校准的VCG取得改进。
AI.conclusion: RCPT通过风险校准的提议输运，有效解决了有限粒子VCG的过拟合风险问题，在不增加模型调用成本的前提下实现了更稳健的推理期引导，适用于分子与图像等多类生成任务。

title: Local Fisher Information Enables Sparse Causal Discovery
summary: Sparse causal discovery calls for methods that exploit graph structure without estimating high-dimensional densities. We introduce Fisher Information Completion Search (FiCS), a source-first algorithm for additive noise models that uses one local Fisher score for both ordering and parent selection. Under regularity and nonconstant-parent conditions, we prove that a node's local Fisher information equals the noise Fisher information exactly when the conditioning set contains all parents, provided that it contains no descendants. This Fisher parent completion identifies the parent set as the unique minimal Fisher completion. With a maximum conditioning set size $q$ at least the maximum indegree $d$, population FiCS queries marginals of at most $q+1$ variables and recovers the true directed acyclic graph under a positive ordering margin. Bounded conditioning also has a population advantage: reducing $q$ toward $d$ cannot decrease, and can strictly increase, the ordering margin. A growing non-Gaussian family separates local Fisher selection from conditional-variance and leaf-first Fisher ordering. For the regularized kernel Stein estimator, we establish high-dimensional DAG consistency under $q\{1+\log(p/q)\}+\log p=o(n)$, uniform Fisher separation, local approximation, and compatible ridge and parent penalty parameters. Experiments show the strongest gains when $n$ is small relative to $p$, quantify the effect of the conditioning size, and demonstrate competitive reference-graph recovery on three real-data benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Fisher信息补全搜索（FiCS），一种面向加性噪声模型的"源优先"因果发现算法，用单一局部Fisher得分同时完成节点排序与父节点选择，并在理论上证明其可识别性与高维一致性。
AI.motivation: 稀疏因果发现需要利用图结构而不必估计高维密度；现有方法或依赖条件方差、或采用叶优先的Fisher排序，难以在稀疏、高维、小样本场景下同时高效地完成排序与父集选择。
AI.method: FiCS基于加性噪声模型：在正则性与父节点非常数条件下，证明当条件集包含全部父节点且不含后代时，节点的局部Fisher信息恰等于噪声Fisher信息，从而将父集识别为唯一的最小Fisher补全；用最大条件集大小q（≥最大入度d）进行源优先查询，种群层面仅需至多q+1个变量的边际分布，并采用带正则的核Stein估计量实现。
AI.result: 理论上：在正排序间隔下可恢复真实DAG；减小q趋近d不会降低、且可严格提升排序间隔；构造递增非高斯族将局部Fisher选择与条件方差法、叶优先Fisher排序区分开；对正则化核Stein估计量，在q{1+log(p/q)}+log p=o(n)、一致Fisher分离、局部近似及相容岭与父惩罚参数下证明高维DAG一致性。实验：n相对p较小时增益最强，量化了条件集大小的影响，并在三个真实数据基准上取得有竞争力的参考图恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: FiCS以Fisher信息补全统一了排序与父集选择，兼具理论可识别性、高维一致性与实证竞争力，尤其适合小样本高维稀疏因果发现问题。

title: Gaussian Flow Dynamics: Simulation-Free Neural SDE Learning Beyond One-Time Marginals
summary: Simulation-free training of latent Stochastic Differential Equations (SDEs) relies on a variational posterior process whose one-time marginals are tractable, typically Gaussian. Such marginals, however, do not determine the underlying dynamics: many processes share the same marginals while differing in their temporal structure, and existing parameterizations fix this structure implicitly, which restricts the posterior family and biases the learned model. We introduce Gaussian flow dynamics, which construct stochastic processes directly from smoothly evolving Gaussian marginals while making the marginal-preserving, or gauge, degrees of freedom explicit and parameterizable. The construction admits state-dependent diffusion coefficients and recovers every linear SDE with additive noise and a non-degenerate Gaussian initial distribution. Building on it, we propose Gauge Matching, a simulation-free method for latent SDE learning that combines Gaussian flow dynamics with the SDE Matching objective. Gauge Matching costs at most quadratically in the latent dimension per step, like SDE Matching, but learns the temporal structure of the posterior beyond its one-time marginals. It comes within a nat of Helmholtz-SDE, which computes the gauge from the prior Jacobian at cubic cost, on the linear benchmark where the exact posterior is known, matches it on nonlinear systems, and applies where Helmholtz-SDE does not, to state-dependent noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Gaussian flow dynamics，将高斯边缘分布之间的规范（gauge）自由度显式参数化，并据此构建无模拟训练方法 Gauge Matching，用于潜在 SDE 学习，能够刻画后验的时间结构且保持二次复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在 SDE 的无模拟训练依赖单时刻边缘可解的后验过程，通常为高斯。然而单时刻边缘无法唯一确定动态过程，多过程可共享相同边缘却在时间结构上不同。已有参数化方法隐式固定了该结构，限制了后验族并引入偏差。
AI.method: 提出 Gaussian flow dynamics，从平滑演化的高斯边缘直接构造随机过程，并将保持边缘的规范自由度显式化、可参数化；该构造支持状态依赖扩散系数，且涵盖所有具有加性噪声与非退化高斯初始分布的线性 SDE。基于此提出 Gauge Matching：将 Gaussian flow dynamics 与 SDE Matching 目标结合，实现无模拟的潜在 SDE 学习。
AI.result: Gauge Matching 每步代价至多与潜维度呈二次关系（与 SDE Matching 相同），但能学习单时刻边缘之外的后验时间结构。在精确后验已知的线性基准上，其性能与以三次代价从先验雅可比计算规范的 Helmholtz-SDE 相差不到一个 nat；在非线性系统上与之相当；并可用于 Helmholtz-SDE 无法处理的状态依赖噪声场景。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式参数化规范自由度，Gauge Matching 在保持二次复杂度与无模拟训练优势的同时，扩展了可学习的后验族并覆盖状态依赖噪声，为潜在 SDE 学习提供了更灵活且高效的方案。

title: Gradient-Free Sampling from Generative Models via Stochastic Bounded Extremum Seeking
summary: We introduce a sampling approach for energy- and score-based generative models that requires no gradient evaluations of the model. Replacing the drift term that would normally contain the score $\nabla_\mathbf{x} \log p_θ(\bf{x})$ with a high-frequency dithered cosine of the model's \textit{value}, $\sqrt{αω}\,\cos(ωt + k \log p_θ(\bf{x}))$, produces, in the high-frequency averaging limit, Langevin Markov chain Monte Carlo for energy-based models and the reverse-time SDE of score-based diffusion. We prove that trajectories of the dithered Itô SDE converge to those of the target SDE, driven by the same Brownian motion, uniformly on compact time intervals in probability, by an averaging argument that extends bounded extremum seeking (ES) to Itô processes, with an explicit $O(ω^{-1/2})$ mean-square rate under global bounds. The approach is not confined to smooth targets: it extends to $C^{1,1}$ energies with discontinuous curvature (without ellipticity requirement) and to Sobolev energies whose Hessians exist only off measure zero sets; for Lipschitz energies with gradient kinks the averaged limit remains well posed; the Krylov-Röckner integrability class is the boundary of provability. The approach provides a hard \textit{a priori} bound on the per-step update rate and applies to explicitly time-varying targets on finite horizons. Gradient-free pixel-space sampling is not competitive with well-tuned backpropagation-based samplers at practical evaluation budgets; the regime where the approach offers an advantage is latent-space sampling when the model is a black box and the target drifts in time. We demonstrate latent-space tracking for time-varying images on CelebA-HQ ($256{\times}256$) from limited 1D projection measurements and latent-space EBM sampling on CIFAR-10.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需计算模型梯度的采样方法：用高频抖动的模型值余弦项替代漂移项中的score，在高频平均极限下等价于EBM的Langevin MCMC与score-based扩散的反向SDE，并给出收敛性理论与O(ω^{-1/2})均方速率。
AI.motivation: 传统能量/得分生成模型采样依赖对score ∇_x log p_θ(x)的梯度求值，成本高且在模型为黑盒或目标随时间漂移时难以适用，因此需要一种无梯度的采样方案。
AI.method: 将原本含score的漂移项替换为模型值的高频抖动余弦 √(αω)cos(ωt + k log p_θ(x))，构造抖动的Itô SDE；通过将极值搜索（ES）推广到Itô过程的平均化论证，证明其轨迹在高频平均极限下收敛到目标SDE，并拓展到C^{1,1}能量、Sobolev能量、Lipschitz能量等非光滑情形。
AI.result: 证明抖动Itô SDE轨迹在同一布朗运动驱动下依概率在紧时间区间上一致收敛到目标SDE，并给出全局界下显式O(ω^{-1/2})均方速率；方法在像素空间采样不优于调优的反向传播采样器，但在黑盒模型的潜空间采样与目标时变场景有优势，并在CelebA-HQ 256×256时变图像跟踪与CIFAR-10潜空间EBM采样上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 该无梯度采样框架在理论上覆盖广泛的目标类（至Krylov-Röckner可积类的可证边界），提供每步更新率的先验硬上界，适用于有限时域上显式时变目标；实际优势主要体现在黑盒模型潜空间采样与目标随时间漂移的情形。

title: Hypergraph Representation Learning with Hyperlink Random Effects
summary: Hypergraphs record multi-way interactions among entities. Extracting information from the combinatorial structure underlying observed multi-way interactions is a central task in many real-world problems. Existing methods face several limitations. First, many deep architectures for hypergraphs do not explicitly exploit the potential low-rank structure, which can sacrifice parsimony and interpretability in the learned representations. Second, many low-rank-based methods operate on tensor representations, which typically require hyperlinks to have uniform sizes and thus limit their applicability to general hypergraphs with non-uniform hyperlink sizes. Third, many methods ignore the fact that hyperlinks often arise from heterogeneous mechanisms. For example, medical symptoms may co-occur in the profiles of patients with very different conditions, and such heterogeneity should be incorporated into the learning process. In this work, we develop a general framework for hypergraph representation learning using hyperlink random effects while exploiting the low-rank structure in hypergraphs. The proposed framework accommodates latent heterogeneity in hyperlink formation while preserving entity interaction patterns. We establish identifiability of the model parameters and theoretical guarantees of representation-level recovery under this framework. The framework allows flexible specifications for the hyperlink random effects; in this paper, we study three choices: categorical, Gaussian mixture, and score-based effects, and develop corresponding estimation algorithms. Through simulation studies, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in recovering latent structure and capturing heterogeneous interaction patterns. Empirical studies on real-world hypergraph datasets further illustrate the practical utility of our approach.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于超边随机效应的超图表示学习通用框架，在利用超图低秩结构的同时建模超边形成的异质性，兼容非均匀超边，并给出参数可识别性与表示级恢复的理论保证；针对类型、高斯混合与得分型三类随机效应开发估计算法，仿真与真实数据实验验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 超图刻画实体间的多元交互，从多元交互的组合结构中提取信息是众多现实问题的核心任务。现有方法存在三方面局限：(1) 许多深度超图架构未显式利用潜在低秩结构，牺牲了表示的简约性与可解释性；(2) 许多低秩方法基于张量表示，通常要求超边尺寸统一，难以适用于非均匀超边的一般超图；(3) 许多方法忽略了超边往往源自异质机制（如医疗症状可在病情差异很大的患者档案中共现），这种异质性应被纳入学习过程。
AI.method: 提出一个利用超边随机效应并挖掘超图低秩结构的通用超图表示学习框架：该框架在保持实体交互模式的同时容纳超边形成中的潜在异质性；允许对超边随机效应进行灵活设定，本文研究了分类（categorical）、高斯混合（Gaussian mixture）与得分型（score-based）三种选择，并分别开发相应的估计算法。
AI.result: 建立了该框架下模型参数的可识别性以及表示级恢复（representation-level recovery）的理论保证；仿真研究证明所提方法在恢复潜在结构和捕捉异质交互模式方面的有效性；在真实超图数据集上的实证研究进一步说明方法的实际效用。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过将超边随机效应与低秩结构结合，统一刻画了一般非均匀超图上的异质交互，兼具理论保证与实用性能，为超图表示学习提供了一种通用且可扩展的建模范式。

title: Exact Fast Batch Simulation for Tabular Reinforcement Learning
summary: Simulation is a fundamental computational primitive in reinforcement learning (RL), yet conventional simulation explicitly generates individual trajectories even when downstream procedures use only aggregate statistics. To address this, we develop an exact fast-simulation framework for finite-horizon tabular Markov decision processes. Our framework has two complementary modes. In direct batch simulation, a batch is represented by its aggregate Markov flow. With sufficient parallel simulation resources, this flow can be obtained by trajectory aggregation; when such simulation is unavailable or costly but the initial state and transition distributions are directly accessible, we instead generate an identically distributed flow through forward Markov-flow sampling without materializing individual trajectories. The latter reduces the simulator-side computational dependence on batch size $m$ from $O(m)$ to $O(1)$. In adaptive batch simulation, when batch length is determined by a data-dependent condition, exact multivariate-hypergeometric splitting recursively refines a candidate Markov flow while preserving the conditional law, reducing the cost dependence on $m$ from $O(m)$ to $O(\log m)$. Together, these modes accelerate simulation by keeping trajectories aggregated whenever possible and refining flows only when required to locate data-dependent boundaries. The framework applies broadly across simulator-based, offline, and online batch or stage-based RL, as illustrated with representative algorithms from each setting.

AI.tldr: 提出有限时域表格MDP的精确快速仿真框架，含直接批量仿真与自适应批量仿真两种模式，将仿真对批量规模的依赖从O(m)降至O(1)或O(log m)。
AI.motivation: 传统仿真即使下游只使用聚合统计量，仍显式生成单条轨迹，造成计算冗余。作者希望避免在仅需聚合统计时物化个体轨迹，降低仿真代价。
AI.method: 针对有限时域表格MDP：直接批量仿真中，用聚合马尔可夫流表示一个batch；若有并行资源则通过轨迹聚合获得该流，否则在初始状态与转移分布可直接访问时，通过前向马尔可夫流采样生成同分布流而不物化个体轨迹。自适应批量仿真中，当批量长度由数据依赖条件决定时，用精确多元超几何分裂递归细化候选马尔可夫流，同时保持条件分布。
AI.result: 直接批量仿真将模拟器侧对批量大小m的计算依赖从O(m)降至O(1)；自适应批量仿真通过多元超几何分裂将依赖从O(m)降至O(log m)。
AI.conclusion: 该框架尽可能保持轨迹聚合、仅在定位数据依赖边界时细化流，从而加速仿真，并广泛适用于基于模拟器、离线、在线的批量或分阶段RL，文中以各设置的代表性算法作了说明。

title: Variance-Aware Fine-Grained Gap-Dependent Bounds for Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: We study model-free online reinforcement learning (RL) for episodic tabular Markov decision processes, focusing on both gap-dependent regret and policy switching cost. While fine-grained gap-dependent analysis has been established for model-free RL algorithms using Hoeffding-type exploration bonuses, such results for model-free algorithms with variance-based exploration bonuses remain unknown, despite their superior worst-case and coarse-grained gap-dependent guarantees. In this paper, we resolve this open problem by establishing the first fine-grained gap-dependent regret upper bound for UCB-Bernstein+, a refined UCB-Bernstein algorithm, in variance-aware model-free online RL. Moreover, by integrating a stage-wise policy update design into our fine-grained framework and using refined variance-based bonuses, we achieve the best-known gap-dependent local switching cost to date. In addition, our analysis yields improved worst-case guarantees for both regret and local switching cost over the original UCB-Bernstein algorithm. Numerical experiments further demonstrate that UCB-Bernstein+ achieves favorable empirical performance in both regret and local switching cost.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无模型在线强化学习中的间隙依赖遗憾与策略切换成本，针对基于方差探索奖励的算法给出了首个细粒度间隙依赖遗憾上界，并实现了目前最优的间隙依赖局部切换成本。
AI.motivation: 基于Hoeffding型探索奖励的无模型RL算法已有细粒度间隙依赖分析，但基于方差探索奖励的算法（其最坏情况与粗粒度间隙依赖保证更优）尚缺乏此类分析，该问题仍待解决。
AI.method: 提出精化算法UCB-Bernstein+，建立方差感知无模型在线RL中首个细粒度间隙依赖遗憾上界；并将分阶段策略更新设计融入细粒度框架，结合精化方差型奖励实现改进。
AI.result: 获得了目前最优的间隙依赖局部切换成本，且在遗憾与局部切换成本的最坏情况保证上均优于原始UCB-Bernstein算法；数值实验验证了UCB-Bernstein+在遗憾和局部切换成本上的良好经验表现。
AI.conclusion: UCB-Bernstein+在理论与实验上均取得优势，填补了方差型探索奖励算法细粒度间隙依赖分析的空白。

title: A Statistical Inference Framework for PMI Estimation and SGNS Word Embeddings
summary:
Pointwise Mutual Information (PMI) is a core measure of testing word association, and Skip-gram with Negative Sampling (SGNS) is essentially a method that implicitly factorizes a shifted PMI matrix. However, a systematic and well-rounded characterization of finite-sample uncertainty in PMI estimation remains absent and imperative to venture into.
  We provide a statistical framework for PMI estimation and its connection to SGNS. We prove consistency, asymptotic unbiasedness, and asymptotic normality of the empirical PMI estimator, derive its variance via the Delta method, and, applying stochastic approximation theory, obtain a variance decomposition for SGNS-based PMI estimation that separates data variance from optimization variance.
  Simulation experiments validate the Delta method approximation. Real-data experiments on the Brown Corpus (d = 100) reveal that SGNS systematically deviates from the theoretical relationship PMI + log K. The empirical relationship shows an attenuated PMI coefficient, an amplified log K effect, and a positive intercept, indicating systematic bias. Word analogy validation confirms the models are effective.
  The failure to validate the variance decomposition under low-dimensional conditions does not diminish its theoretical value; rather, it identifies the unbiasedness assumption as the key bottleneck and clarifies the gap between asymptotic theory and practice, providing implications for both practice and theory.

AI.tldr: 该文为PMI估计与SGNS的联系提供统计框架：证明经验PMI估计的相合性、渐近无偏性与渐近正态性，用Delta方法推导方差，并借助随机逼近理论给出SGNS-PMI估计的方差分解（数据方差+优化方差）。模拟验证Delta近似，Brown语料实验显示SGNS系统性偏离PMI+logK的理论关系。
AI.motivation: PMI是词关联度量的核心，SGNS本质上隐式分解了平移后的PMI矩阵；但PMI估计在有限样本下的不确定性缺乏系统、完整的刻画，这一空白亟需填补。
AI.method: 建立PMI估计的统计框架并刻画其与SGNS的联系；证明经验PMI估计的相合性、渐近无偏性与渐近正态性；用Delta方法推导其方差；应用随机逼近理论得到SGNS-PMI估计的方差分解，将数据方差与优化方差分离。
AI.result: 模拟实验验证了Delta方法的近似效果。Brown语料（d=100）真实数据实验表明SGNS系统性地偏离理论关系PMI+logK：经验关系呈现衰减的PMI系数、放大的logK效应与正截距，说明存在系统性偏差。词类比验证显示模型有效。低维条件下方差分解未能得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 低维条件下方差分解验证失败并不削弱其理论价值，反而指认无偏性假设是关键瓶颈，厘清了渐近理论与实际之间的差距，对实践与理论均有启示。

title: Taylor Representations for Model-Free RL in Networked MDPs
summary: In Networked Markov Decision Processes, transition dynamics are often unknown and the state--action space grows rapidly with the number of agents. In this setting, Taylor representations naturally approximate $Q$-functions, but a naive order-$n$ expansion over $N$ agents requires $Θ(N^n)$ coefficients. We justify these expansions under smooth expected future local rewards with controlled derivatives. Under this condition, finite-speed information propagation and discounting imply that local-critic Taylor coefficients decay exponentially with the graph distance to the farthest agent involved. Discarding distant-agent coefficients and marginalizing then yield scalable local Taylor representations with a bound controlled by graph locality. Building on these representations, we propose a scalable model-free actor--critic algorithm, establishing finite-sample critic and near-stationarity guarantees for a linear LSTD critic. We then introduce a more expressive neural TD parameterization. Unlike prior constructive spectral methods, our approach covers settings without access to a known local dynamics map, such as hidden switched linear--quadratic regulation. Across three control benchmarks, our method matches or outperforms spectral baselines while scaling efficiently to large graphs.

AI.tldr: 本文研究网络化马尔可夫决策过程（Networked MDP）中未知动态、状态-动作空间随智能体数量激增的问题，利用Taylor表示逼近Q函数，并通过局部化与边缘化获得可扩展的局部Taylor表示，进而提出可扩展的无模型actor-critic算法，并给出有限样本与近平稳性保证。
AI.motivation: 网络化MDP中转移动态通常未知，且状态-动作空间随智能体数量快速增长。Taylor表示可自然逼近Q函数，但N个智能体上的朴素n阶展开需要Θ(N^n)个系数，规模难以承受，因此需要一种可扩展的表示与算法。
AI.method: 在平滑期望未来局部奖励且导数受控的条件下，论证Taylor展开的合理性；利用有限速度信息传播与折扣导致局部critic的Taylor系数随到最远相关智能体的图距离指数衰减；据此丢弃远距离智能体系数并进行边缘化，得到由图局部性控制误差界的局部Taylor表示。基于该表示提出可扩展无模型actor-critic算法，对线性LSTD critic给出有限样本与近平稳性保证；进一步引入更具表达力的神经TD参数化。
AI.result: 理论方面，建立了线性LSTD critic的有限样本与近平稳性保证；方法方面，在无需已知局部动态映射的设置下（如隐藏切换线性-二次调节）仍然适用。在三个控制基准上，该方法匹配或优于谱基线，并能高效扩展到大规模图。
AI.conclusion: 通过图局部性驱动的Taylor系数截断与边缘化，可获得可扩展的局部Taylor表示与无模型actor-critic算法，兼具理论保证与对大规模网络的扩展性，并较已有构造性谱方法适用范围更广。

title: G-CARB: Graph-Localized Conformal Agent Risk Budget for Compositional Harm
comment: SLMs for Agentic Systems, Paris, France, 2026
summary: Small language model (SLM) agents need safety controls that track consequences across tool calls with little monitoring overhead. A private read, for example, becomes a leak when a later action sends that data outside the system. We introduce CARB (Conformal Agent Risk Budget), which calibrates when to stop an agent using a ledger of harm incurred before stopping. Under exchangeable episodes, standard conformal risk control bounds this declared loss in expectation over calibration and a future episode. G-CARB selects scorer evidence along observable dependencies from private sources to outgoing actions. The ledger still covers the entire executed history, and computing the gate score requires no additional language-model inference. On AgentDojo replay with two 14B backbones, G-CARB roughly halves scorer-input records at intermediate risk budgets while improving autonomous task completion relative to full-prefix scoring; random context of the same size achieves similar gains. Controlled examples show how retaining the relevant dependency can further avoid stopping benign work.

AI.tldr: 提出 CARB/G-CARB：用共形风险控制校准 SLM agent 的停止时机，以"停止前累计危害账本"为损失；G-CARB 沿可观测依赖选择性选取评分证据，在不增加额外 LM 推理的前提下降低监控开销。
AI.motivation: SLM agent 需在低监控开销下追踪跨工具调用累积的安全后果；单次私有读取在后续外发动作中才构成泄露，需有可校准的"何时停止"机制。
AI.method: CARB（Conformal Agent Risk Budget）：以停止前累计危害账本作为声明损失，在可交换 episode 假设下用标准共形风险控制给出期望损失上界。G-CARB：在私有源到外发动作的可观测依赖上选取 scorer 证据，账本仍覆盖完整执行历史，门控分数无需额外 LM 推理；并对比全前缀评分与同规模随机上下文。
AI.result: 在 AgentDojo 回放、两种 14B 骨干上，G-CARB 在中等风险预算下将 scorer 输入记录约减半，同时相较全前缀评分提升自主任务完成率；同规模随机上下文取得相近增益。受控示例显示保留相关依赖可进一步避免误停良性工作。
AI.conclusion: 共形风险预算可为 SLM agent 提供低开销、可统计校准的停止控制；沿依赖选取证据在减半评分输入的条件下改善完成率，但类似增益也来自上下文规模缩减本身，依赖选择的价值主要体现在避免误停。

title: Moment-Accurate Gaussian Mixtures for Constant-Step Stochastic Approximation
summary: Local Gaussian models of constant-step learning predict output variability and expected losses, but weak convergence alone does not justify these moment predictions. We establish moment-accurate Gaussian mixtures by matching stationary energy with local Ornstein--Uhlenbeck limits, ruling out quadratic tail mass invisible to weak convergence. For step size $a$, the second-order Wasserstein error is $o(\sqrt a)$, uniformly over invariant laws, using each law's actual root weights. The assumptions combine confinement, descent, finitely many hyperbolic equilibria and root continuity with finite-variance innovations. The result yields observable covariances, expected objective gaps and first-order mean shifts, while allowing singular covariances, compatible saddles and weights without a limit. For additive noise given by a fixed invertible transform of independent standardized Student $t_3$ coordinates, symmetry gives an order-sharp $\sqrt a$ smooth-test bound. Numerical transport calculations demonstrate the value of root-specific covariances; controlled SGD studies assess observable predictions across step sizes, batch sizes and model geometries.

AI.tldr: 该文通过将平稳能量与局部Ornstein–Uhlenbeck极限匹配，建立了矩精确的高斯混合刻画，证明二阶Wasserstein误差为o(√a)，并给出可观测的协方差、目标间隙与一阶均值偏移。
AI.motivation: 常数步长学习的局部高斯模型能预测输出变异性和期望损失，但仅有弱收敛不足以保证这些矩预测的有效性。作者旨在排除弱收敛无法检测的二次尾部质量，使矩层面的预测具有严格依据。
AI.method: 通过匹配平稳能量与局部Ornstein–Uhlenbeck极限，构建矩精确的高斯混合；在约束性、下降性、有限多个双曲平衡点、根连续性及有限方差扰动等假设下分析；利用各不变律的实际根权重，控制二阶Wasserstein误差；并针对独立标准化Student t3坐标的固定可逆变换加性噪声，利用对称性推导光滑检验界。
AI.result: 对步长a，二阶Wasserstein误差在不变律上一致为o(√a)，且允许奇异协方差、相容鞍点以及无极限的权重；结果给出可观测协方差、期望目标间隙和一阶均值偏移。在t3噪声情形下，对称性给出阶数最优的√a光滑检验界。数值输运计算展示了根特定协方差的价值，受控SGD实验在不同步长、批大小与模型几何下验证了可观测预测。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为常数步长学习的局部高斯矩预测提供了严格的矩精确基础，克服了弱收敛的局限，并在理论与数值上验证了根特定协方差等可观测预测的有效性。

title: Gaussian Limits for SGD Without Stationary Moments
summary: Temporal dependence can separate the Gaussian approximation of stochastic gradient descent from its stationary moments. For unmodified least-squares SGD, we construct a design with standard Gaussian marginals whose stationary error has every positive moment infinite. Independent observations with the same marginals instead give finite stationary variance. Both regimes retain a Gaussian small-step limit. Our general theory establishes pathwise contraction from a finite second design moment, then uses score cancellation and localization to obtain stationary Gaussian and Ornstein--Uhlenbeck limits. Independent Gaussian regression errors yield an exact conditional Gaussian law and total-variation convergence under the same design integrability. Stronger design conditions identify a positive first-order total-variation constant and a deterministic covariance correction with $o(a)$ error. A scalar coverage expansion translates this correction into its inference consequence. Experiments examine distributional error, coverage, and calibration with dependent scores. Together, these results establish precise probability-law approximation beyond moment-based stationary analysis.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示时间相依性使SGD的高斯近似与其平稳矩产生分离：在标准高斯边缘的设计下，未修正最小二乘SGD的平稳误差各正阶矩均为无穷，而独立同边缘观测却给出有限平稳方差。
AI.motivation: 以往对随机梯度下降平稳行为的研究多停留在矩层面（如平稳方差），忽略了概率律近似与时间相依结构之间的差异。本文旨在说明仅靠平稳矩分析不足以刻画SGD的分布极限，需要更精细的概率律近似理论。
AI.method: 在有限二阶设计矩下建立路径wise收缩，结合score cancellation与localization得到平稳高斯极限与Ornstein–Uhlenbeck极限；对独立高斯回归误差给出精确条件高斯律与全变差收敛，并在更强设计条件下识别正的一阶全变差常数与确定性协方差修正（误差o(a)）；通过标量覆盖展开将修正转化为推断后果。
AI.result: 构造的设计中平稳误差所有正阶矩无穷，而独立同边缘观测平稳方差有限；两情形均保留高斯小步长极限。独立高斯回归误差在相同设计可积性下实现全变差收敛；更强条件下得到正的一阶全变差常数与o(a)协方差修正，并给出覆盖率的推断影响。实验考察了相依score下的分布误差、覆盖率与校准。
AI.conclusion: 结果确立了超越基于矩的平稳分析的概率律精确近似框架，表明时间相依性会成为高斯近似与平稳矩分离的关键因素。

title: Two-Sample Testing via Path-based Inference
summary: Modern deep generative models are primarily studied for their ability to generate realistic samples, yet the generative dynamics they learn can also serve as objects of statistical inference. We develop this idea for two-sample testing, the problem of deciding whether the same distribution generated two finite datasets. Using stochastic interpolants, we connect both distributions to a shared Gaussian bottleneck, so that each half of the resulting path is a Gaussian channel acting on a single population. We prove that the null hypothesis holds if and only if the population denoiser, or equivalently, the velocity fields of the two halves, coincide at any single noise level, which amounts to a reflection symmetry of the path about the bottleneck. Deviations from this symmetry yield a continuum of two-sample witnesses, which we estimate via held-out regression risks on learned denoisers and velocities and aggregate along the path; under an information-theoretic weighting, the aggregated discrepancy equals the Jeffreys divergence between the noise-smoothed distributions. Calibrating the resulting statistics by permutation yields tests that are valid in finite samples for any trained networks and consistent when the fields are learned accurately. On a synthetic benchmark and three image benchmarks, the proposed tests improve power over the strongest baseline by up to 33 percentage points at an equal total sample budget, with the best choice of regression representation and path weighting depending on the data modality. These results show that generative paths provide a principled representation for statistical testing, extending stochastic-interpolant models beyond generation.

AI.tldr: 该论文将随机插值（stochastic interpolants）生成动力学用于两样本检验：把两个分布经共享高斯瓶颈相连，利用路径关于瓶颈的反射对称性构造检验统计量，并通过置换校准得到有限样本有效、学习准确时一致的检验。
AI.motivation: 现代深度生成模型通常只被用于生成逼真样本，但其学到的生成动力学本身也可作为统计推断的对象。作者希望把这一视角用于两样本检验（判断两组有限数据是否来自同一分布），从而把随机插值模型从“生成”拓展到“统计检验”。
AI.method: 借助随机插值把两个分布连接到同一高斯瓶颈，使路径的每一半成为作用于单一总体的高斯信道。证明原假设成立当且仅当总体去噪器（等价地，两半的速度场）在任一噪声水平上重合，即路径关于瓶颈具有反射对称性。偏离对称性给出一族两样本见证量（witnesses），通过学习到的去噪器与速度场的留出回归风险进行估计并沿路径聚合；在信息论加权下，聚合差异等于噪声平滑分布间的 Jeffreys 散度。最终统计量用置换法校准。
AI.result: 所得检验对任意训练网络在有限样本下有效，当场学习准确时具有一致性。在合成的基准以及三个图像基准上，在相同总样本预算下，相比最强基线将检验功效最高提升 33 个百分点；最佳回归表示与路径加权方式取决于数据模态。
AI.conclusion: 生成路径为统计检验提供了有原则的表示，把随机插值模型的应用从生成扩展到统计检验；检验的有效性与功效得到理论与实验支持，且实现细节需按数据模态选择。

title: Retrieval-Based In-Context Learning: A Domain Adaptation Framework
summary: In-context retrieval (ICR) is a retrieval-based form of in-context learning (ICL) in which demonstrations are retrieved from a source database based on similarity to the query, rather than sampled independently. In this work, we formulate ICR as a type of domain adaptation problem, where the source distribution $P$ of the database may differ from the target distribution $Q$ of the test query-label pair. We investigate the performance of ICR under a flexible class of distributional shifts that substantially extends prior work \citep{li2024fine,guo2025retrieval}, and establish theoretical guarantees that quantify the benefits and pitfalls of this learning paradigm. Our theory is verified by experiments on synthetic and language tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文将上下文检索（ICR）建模为域适应问题，在扩展的分布偏移设定下理论分析其收益与风险，并通过合成与语言任务实验验证。
AI.motivation: ICR从数据库按相似度检索演示，性能受源分布P与目标分布Q差异影响；已有工作对分布偏移的刻画较窄，需在更灵活、更一般的偏移类下理解ICR的收益与陷阱。
AI.method: 将ICR形式化为域适应问题：源分布P为演示数据库分布，目标分布Q为测试查询-标签对分布；在比既有工作（Li 2024、Guo 2025）更广泛的灵活分布偏移类下建立理论保证，量化该学习范式的优势与不足；并用合成任务与语言任务实验验证理论。
AI.result: 建立了在扩展分布偏移类下ICR的理论保证，刻画了其收益与陷阱；实验（合成任务与语言任务）与理论预测一致。
AI.conclusion: ICR可视为域适应问题，其有效性依赖源-目标分布关系；所提理论在更一般的偏移下给出收益与风险的量化边界，并经实验验证。

title: Isotropic Gaussian Processes Improve Vanilla Bayesian Optimization in High Dimensions
summary: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization (BO) often fits Gaussian process (GP) surrogates from far fewer observations than input dimensions. Modern Vanilla BO can perform well in this regime with dimension-aware priors, initialization, and acquisition optimization, but it typically retains automatic relevance determination (ARD), fitting one lengthscale per input coordinate. We study this modeling choice and propose Iso-BO, a controlled modification that replaces the ARD GP with an isotropic GP using one shared lengthscale while keeping the surrounding BO pipeline matched. For radial kernels, we show that the marginal log likelihood (MLL) depends on the inverse-squared ARD lengthscales only through weighted pairwise distances among the observed inputs. The current design can therefore leave some ARD directions exactly invisible or only weakly constrained by the MLL. Iso-BO removes coordinatewise reweighting and fits a single shared scale instead. Lengthscale-fitting and predictive-density diagnostics show that this finite-data effect appears in practice, including when the data-generating process is anisotropic. Across GP-prior, synthetic, and real-world benchmarks, Iso-BO often improves over matched modern Vanilla BO and remains competitive with the included high-dimensional BO baselines under the tested budgets. Stress tests also show the expected boundary wherein sufficiently strong, learnable anisotropy can favor the more flexible ARD model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Iso-BO：在高维贝叶斯优化中将常用的 ARD 高斯过程代理替换为共享单一长度尺度的各向同性 GP，并保持其余 BO 流程不变；实验表明其在有限数据下常优于匹配的现代 Vanilla BO，并与高维 BO 基线相当，但在强可学习各向异性下 ARD 仍更优。
AI.motivation: 高维 BO 中观测数远少于输入维度，现代 Vanilla BO 依靠维度感知先验、初始化与采集函数优化已表现良好，但仍默认保留 ARD（每个坐标一个长度尺度）。作者质疑这一建模选择在有限数据下的合理性：参数过多可能导致部分方向不可辨识或弱约束，从而损害长度尺度拟合与预测。
AI.method: 提出 Iso-BO：用各向同性 GP（单一共享长度尺度）替换 ARD GP，其余 BO 组件（先验、初始化、采集优化、预算）保持一致。理论分析针对径向核，证明边际对数似然（MLL）仅通过观测输入间的加权成对距离依赖逆平方 ARD 长度尺度，因此在当前设计下部分 ARD 方向可能对 MLL 完全不可见或仅被弱约束。Iso-BO 去除坐标级重加权，仅拟合单一尺度。辅以长度尺度拟合与预测密度诊断。
AI.result: 长度尺度拟合与预测密度诊断显示该有限数据效应在实际中出现，即使数据生成过程为各向异性时亦然。在 GP 先验、合成与真实基准上，Iso-BO 常优于匹配的现代 Vanilla BO，并在所测预算下与纳入的高维 BO 基线保持竞争力。压力测试揭示预期边界：当各向异性足够强且可学习时，更灵活的 ARD 模型更受青睐。
AI.conclusion: 在高维有限数据 BO 中，保留 ARD 未必有益；采用共享长度尺度的各向同性 GP 可作为简单、受控的改进，通常提升或匹配性能。但当各向异性强且可被数据充分学习时，ARD 的灵活性仍具价值，因此模型选择应视各向异性强度与数据量而定。

title: On the Sequentially Semiseparable Structure of SDE-Induced Kernels and Efficient Algorithms for Kernel-Based Estimation Problems
summary: We study kernel functions induced by a linear time-invariant (LTI) stochastic differential equation (SDE), an approach that embeds prior knowledge about the function to be estimated directly into the state-space description of the SDE. This kernel-design perspective is relevant across the many settings where kernels play a central role, including kernel methods in statistics, Gaussian process (GP) regression in machine learning, and kernel-based regularization methods in system identification. The resulting class of SDE-induced kernels includes several kernels of practical interest, such as Matérn kernels with half-integer smoothness, spline kernels, and related kernels used in system identification. In contrast to existing linear-time GP regression methods for these kernels, which are typically based on Kalman filtering and Rauch--Tung--Striebel smoothing on the latent state, we work directly with the SSS representation of the observed covariance matrix. This yields linear-complexity recursive algorithms for the matrix operations required in GP regression, including factorization, linear solves, log determinants, posterior covariance, log-marginal-likelihood gradients, and posterior sampling; the same generator-level recursions extend, with only minor modifications, to the analogous computations in kernel-based regularization methods for system identification. Compared with previous uses of SSS representations in GP regression, we derive efficient recursive algorithms for analytic marginal-likelihood gradients in three application-relevant cases, and we develop new recursions for posterior computations and Matheron-type sampling. Numerical experiments verify the accuracy of the proposed recursions and illustrate posterior inference and sampling for representative SDE-induced kernels.

AI.tldr: 本文研究由线性时不变随机微分方程（LTI SDE）诱导的核函数，直接从观测协方差矩阵的SSS表示出发，给出线性复杂度的递归算法用于GP回归中的矩阵运算与超参数梯度，并扩展到系统辨识的核正则化方法。
AI.motivation: 由LTI SDE诱导的核可把关于待估函数的先验知识直接嵌入状态空间描述，涵盖Matérn核、样条核及系统辨识常用核等，应用广泛。现有针对这类核的线性时间GP回归多依赖隐状态上的Kalman滤波与RTS平滑，计算路径不够直接，且解析梯度、后验计算与采样方面缺少统一高效算法，因此需要从协方差矩阵的SSS表示出发构造更直接的递归方案。
AI.method: 将SDE诱导核纳入一个统一核设计框架，并直接处理观测协方差矩阵的SSS（state-space / semiseparable）表示，而非在隐状态上做Kalman滤波与Rauch–Tung–Striebel平滑；在该表示上推导线性复杂度的递归算法，覆盖分解、线性求解、对数行列式、后验协方差、对数边缘似然梯度与后验采样；随后仅作小幅修改，将同一生成元层面的递归推广到系统辨识中的核正则化方法；并针对三种应用相关情形给出解析边缘似然梯度的有效递归，同时提出后验计算与Matheron型采样的新递归。
AI.result: 所提递归算法在分解、线性求解、对数行列式、后验协方差、对数边缘似然梯度与后验采样等操作上均达到线性复杂度；相比此前SSS在GP回归中的使用，本文在三种应用情形下给出了解析边缘似然梯度的有效递归，并发展了后验计算与Matheron型采样的新递归；数值实验验证了递归的准确性，并对代表性SDE诱导核展示了后验推断与采样效果。
AI.conclusion: 从观测协方差矩阵SSS表示出发，可为LTI SDE诱导核提供统一的线性复杂度递归算法，并自然延伸到系统辨识的核正则化；该框架涵盖Matérn（半整数光滑度）、样条及相关核，兼顾精度与效率，为GP回归和核正则化中的矩阵运算、梯度计算与后验采样提供了实用工具。

title: Finite-Sample Distribution Theory and Efficient Large-Scale Inference for Online Quantile Regression
summary: This paper studies online quantile regression for large-scale and streaming data using Stochastic SubGradient Descent (SSGD) with constant learning rates. Classical offline inference for quantile regression is computationally and memory intensive. Existing works of online inference for quantile regression provide only asymptotic guarantees and typically require sub-exponential tail conditions for distribution theory. To bridge these gaps, we introduce new techniques to prove a quenched central limit theorem (CLT) and finite-sample Gaussian approximation for SSGD under a finite-moment assumption. We further show that Ruppert-Polyak averaging with a constant learning rate has a non-vanishing bias and fails to satisfy CLT centering at the population target. Hence we propose suffix averaging to address this issue and establish its finite-sample Gaussian approximation. Based on these results, we provide an efficient online inference method for quantile regression that avoids covariance estimation. Numerical experiments show that our method achieves desirable empirical coverage rates and competitive performance compared to other inference methods. We also apply our approach to U.S. wage data to demonstrate its practical effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文研究恒定学习率随机次梯度下降（SSGD）下大规模流式数据的分位数回归在线推断，证明有限矩假设下的淬火中心极限定理与有限样本高斯逼近，提出后缀平均以消除Ruppert-Polyak平均的非消失偏差，并给出免协方差估计的高效在线推断方法。
AI.motivation: 经典离线分位数回归推断计算与内存开销大；既有在线推断工作仅给渐近保证，且分布理论通常要求次指数尾条件。本文旨在放宽矩条件并给出有限样本保证。
AI.method: 在恒定学习率SSGD框架下，引入新技术证明淬火中心极限定理与有限样本高斯逼近；分析Ruppert-Polyak平均的偏差性质，提出后缀平均（suffix averaging）方案，并建立其有限样本高斯逼近；据此构造免协方差估计的在线推断方法。
AI.result: 在有限矩假设下获得SSGD的淬火CLT与有限样本高斯逼近；证明恒定学习率下Ruppert-Polyak平均存在非消失偏差、无法以总体目标为中心满足CLT；后缀平均可解决该问题。数值实验显示理想经验覆盖率与有竞争力的性能，并在美国工资数据上验证实用性。
AI.conclusion: 后缀平均结合恒定学习率SSGD可实现高效、免协方差估计的在线分位数回归推断，在更弱矩条件下具备有限样本理论保证，兼具理论严谨性与实际有效性。

title: Reconstruction-Aware Distribution Matching for Inverse Problems with Unpaired Data
summary: Recovering the forward operator of an imaging system from unpaired data avoids both calibration hardware and the clean/degraded pairs that supervision requires-pairs that, for a real lens, are often impossible to acquire. Existing unpaired approaches that explicitly estimate the forward operator by distribution matching evaluate a candidate only through the measurements it generates, whose distribution should match that of the real ones. Components suppressed by the operator are barely present in the degraded images, and therefore barely constrain the operator under such a criterion. Yet inversion precisely tries to recover them. As a result, two operators that are nearly indistinguishable as forward models can invert very differently. We address this by adding a comparison on the clean side: real degraded images, once restored, should be distributed like clean ones. Restorations are computed by a differentiable plug-and-play algorithm parameterized by the operator being learned. On spatially varying PSF calibration and blind super-resolution, the method recovers more accurate operators than degraded-side matching alone, and closes much of the gap to restoration with the true operator.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种从非配对数据中恢复成像系统前向算子的方法，通过在"干净侧"增加分布对比（即真实退化图像经恢复后应服从干净图像分布），解决了仅依赖退化侧分布匹配时对算子约束不足的问题，并在空间变化PSF标定与盲超分辨任务上取得更准确的算子恢复。
AI.motivation: 现有从非配对数据估计前向算子的方法仅通过生成测量值的分布是否匹配真实退化图像来评估候选算子（退化侧匹配），无需标定硬件和成对数据。但被算子抑制的分量在退化图像中几乎不出现，因此在该准则下几乎无法约束算子；而逆问题恰恰要恢复这些分量。这导致两个作为前向模型几乎无法区分的算子，其逆过程却可能差异极大。
AI.method: 在退化侧匹配的基础上引入干净侧的比较：真实退化图像经恢复后，其分布应与干净图像分布一致。恢复图像由以被学习算子为参数的可微即插即用（plug-and-play）算法计算，从而使算子可通过该恢复结果的分布进行端到端优化。
AI.result: 在空间变化PSF标定和盲超分辨任务上，该方法恢复的算子比仅用退化侧匹配更准确，并大幅缩小了与使用真实算子进行恢复之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 补充干净侧的分布约束能有效弥补退化侧匹配对算子约束的不足，提升非配对条件下前向算子的估计精度，使逆问题的恢复性能更接近使用真实算子的水平。

title: Latent Similarity Gaussian Processes: A Theory-Grounded Approach to Personalized Suicide-Risk Forecasting for Clinical Decision-Support
summary: Forecasting suicide risk is difficult due to the high heterogeneity of patients and the low base rate of suicide-related events (SREs). We present Latent Similarity Gaussian Processes (LSGPs), which embed patients in a continuous latent space to jointly model similarity and forecast risk. By selectively drawing information from latent peers, LSGPs better capture individualized risk trajectories, generalizing nomothetic (pooled), idiographic (per-patient), and hierarchical frameworks. Our contributions are: (1) an identifiable two-channel Similarity Kernel; (2) proof that the standard model-fitting algorithm, mean-field variational inference, collapses LSGPs to nomothetic models, along with a fix; and (3) empirical results on intensive longitudinal suicide data showing LSGPs outperform nomothetic, idiographic, and hierarchical models for next-week risk forecasting, with the largest gains in forecasting first-occurrence SREs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出隐相似性高斯过程（LSGPs），将患者嵌入连续隐空间以联合建模相似性并预测自杀风险，在强化纵向数据上优于常模、个体及分层模型。
AI.motivation: 自杀风险预测困难，源于患者高度异质性以及自杀相关事件（SREs）的低基础发生率。现有常模（汇总）、个体（单患者）和分层框架难以兼顾个体化风险轨迹刻画与信息共享。
AI.method: 提出LSGPs：将患者嵌入连续隐空间，通过选择性从"隐同伴"中抽取信息，联合建模相似性与风险预测；设计可识别的双通道Similarity Kernel；并证明标准拟合算法（平均场变分推断）会使LSGPs坍缩为常模模型，同时给出修正方案。
AI.result: 在强化纵向自杀数据上，LSGPs在下周风险预测中优于常模、个体和分层模型，且在预测首次发生的SREs时增益最大。
AI.conclusion: LSGPs通过隐空间相似性建模统一并泛化了常模、个体与分层框架，为高度异质、低基础率的自杀风险预测提供了更有效的个体化建模途径。

title: On the Comparison of Optimizers for Imbalanced Learning
summary: Data imbalance is pervasive in machine learning, from rare words and anomalies to underrepresented patterns in heterogeneous or cross-tabulated data. We study idealized optimizers geometries in continuous time to model small-step training in deep learning. We assume that the source of imbalance is unobserved: the optimizer has only access to the aggregate training loss ignoring the exact contributions of the majority and minority groups. In this setting, we characterize a region where majority losses are optimized regardless of the admissible minority structure. We derive explicit equations of this zone and bounds on the time needed to leave it. These bounds exhibit a milder dependence on minority amplitude for sign, spectral, and Newton descent than for Euclidean gradient descent. Experiments with AdamW and Muon suggest similar advantages over SGD across language, tabular, and image tasks.

AI.tldr: 该论文在连续时间理想化优化器几何框架下研究数据不平衡问题，假设优化器只能访问忽略多数/少数群体贡献的聚合损失，刻画了多数损失被优先优化的区域及其离开时间界，发现在时间界对少数群体幅度的依赖性上，sign、spectral 与 Newton 下降比欧氏梯度下降更温和，实验上 AdamW 和 Muon 相比 SGD 具有类似优势。
AI.motivation: 数据不平衡在机器学习中普遍存在，涵盖稀有词、异常以及异构或交叉表中的欠代表模式。论文旨在通过连续时间理想化优化器几何来建模深度学习的小步长训练，研究在少数群体结构不可观测、只能获得聚合训练损失的情形下，优化行为如何受不平衡影响。
AI.method: 采用连续时间下的理想化优化器几何方法建模小步长训练；假设不平衡来源不可观测，优化器仅能访问聚合训练损失，忽略多数与少数群体的确切贡献；在此设定下刻画多数损失被优化而不受可允许少数群体结构影响的区域，并推导该区域的显式方程以及离开该区域所需时间的界；比较 sign、spectral、Newton 下降与欧氏梯度下降的时间界对少数群体幅度的依赖；并在语言、表格和图像任务上以 AdamW 和 Muon 对比 SGD 进行实验验证。
AI.result: 推导出多数损失优先后区域的显式方程及离开该区域所需时间的界；这些界在少数群体幅度上的依赖性对于 sign、spectral 和 Newton 下降比欧氏梯度下降更温和；AdamW 和 Muon 在语言、表格与图像任务上的实验表明其相比 SGD 具有类似优势。
AI.conclusion: 在不可观测不平衡的聚合损失设定下，可以通过理想化优化器几何刻画多数损失主导区域及其逃逸时间，且具有更优几何特性的优化器（如 sign、spectral、Newton 类及 AdamW、Muon）在少数群体幅度影响上表现出比欧氏梯度下降和 SGD 更温和的依赖性。

title: Valid Stopping in Adaptive Generator-Verifier Loops
summary: Numerous agentic workflows are based on a generator-verifier loop: a generator proposes candidates, a cheap verifier scores them, and the workflow terminates when a proposal is verified as good enough. The verifier typically proxies a more costly ground-truth oracle, and as the generator searches adaptively against it, false acceptances may accumulate. Proposals can pass the proxy but fail under the costlier ground-truth check. We study when to stop these loops while controlling the false discovery rate of the accepted proposals. Our construction introduces tools of independent interest in distribution-free statistical testing and conformal risk control, including analysis of $e$-values constructed through index betting and a novel conformal risk control procedure for non-monotone losses. We validate the approach in synthetic settings and on a protein-design benchmark.

AI.tldr: 研究生成器-验证器循环中的停止准则，通过无分布统计检验与保形风险控制，在控制假发现率的前提下决定何时终止搜索。
