Its task contracts, candidate interfaces and scoring rules support comparison across native selectors and language-model adapters. Code and aggregate results are available at https://github.com/VictorYXL/JevGraphBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GraphDecide —— 一个模型无关的基准，用于诊断 System One 式模型（如 Jev）在图理解与决策任务上的真实能力，覆盖 14 种模型-接口配置，揭示邻接识别准确并不等于结构正确、图-文联合输入并不必然提升预测、可行构造不等于高质量解三大关键区别。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被广泛用于图理解与决策，而 Jev 等 System One 模型采用从给定选项中直接选择的方式；但这类模型在图相关任务上的能力仍不明确，缺乏系统、可比较的诊断手段。
AI.method: 提出模型无关基准 GraphDecide，由三部分构成：结构化任务画像（structural task profiles）、配对的图-文输入对比（matched graph-text input contrasts）与启发式提议控制（heuristic-proposal controls）。在 14 种模型-接口配置上评估 Jev 及同类选择式模型与语言模型基线；通过任务契约、候选接口与评分规则，支持原生选择器与语言模型适配器的横向比较。
AI.result: Jev 的结果体现了该基准的核心区分：邻接识别准确并不能保证更广泛的结构正确性；图-文联合输入并不能稳定提升预测；可行构造并不代表高解质量。
AI.conclusion: GraphDecide 为 System One 类图决策模型提供了可诊断、可比较的评测框架，表明选择式模型在图任务上存在"局部正确但整体不足"的局限，代码与聚合结果已开源。

title: Capability-Driven Self-Evolution of Agent Memory
summary: Memory self-evolution uses task feedback to iteratively improve executable memory programs that store and retrieve information from past interactions. Existing approaches typically adopt holistic evolution, deriving revision directions from mixed feedback and judging progress by overall performance. This can obscure optimization directions and hide capability-specific gains offset by regressions elsewhere, leaving promising directions underexplored. We introduce capability-driven evolution, which extends search guidance from overall performance to individual capability dimensions, preserving promising revisions and expanding exploration beyond the boundaries of holistic evolution. We propose PrisMem, which uses dependency-aware capability selection to prioritize targets with potential cross-capability benefits and history-guided diagnosis to refine capability specialists. Trace-guided integration compares evaluated programs on paired differential cases, using their behavioral differences to consolidate complementary gains into a unified memory program. Experiments show that PrisMem outperforms the strongest baselines by 10.54 and 7.83 percentage points on BEAM-1M and LongMemEval-M, respectively, demonstrating its effectiveness on million-token histories.

AI.tldr: 本文提出能力驱动进化（capability-driven evolution）范式与 PrisMem 系统，将记忆自进化的搜索引导从整体性能扩展到能力维度，通过依赖感知的能力选择、历史引导诊断与轨迹引导整合三项技术，在百万 token 长历史任务上显著超越最强基线。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆自进化方法采用"整体进化"（holistic evolution）：修订方向由混合反馈导出，进度以整体性能判定。这会导致优化方向被掩盖，且某些能力的收益可能被其他能力的退化所抵消而被隐藏，使有潜力的方向未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出能力驱动进化，把搜索引导从整体性能扩展到单个能力维度，保留有潜力的修订并突破整体进化的搜索边界。具体系统 PrisMem 包含三部分：(1) 依赖感知的能力选择，优先选择具有潜在跨能力收益的目标；(2) 历史引导诊断，用于改进能力专家（capability specialists）；(3) 轨迹引导整合，在配对差分案例上比较已评估程序，利用其行为差异把互补收益整合为统一的记忆程序。
AI.result: 在 BEAM-1M 与 LongMemEval-M 上分别比最强基线高出 10.54 与 7.83 个百分点，验证了其在百万 token 历史规模下的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将搜索引导细化到能力维度可有效避免整体进化中收益相互抵消的问题，PrisMem 在长历史记忆任务上取得了显著且一致的性能提升。

title: CVIF: A Criticality-Driven Visual Intervention Framework for Geometric Diagram Understanding in MLLMs
summary: Despite significant progress in visual tasks by Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), geometric diagram understanding remains challenging due to the presence of sparse visual cues and ambiguous symbol-primitive associations. MLLMs may therefore rely on textual priors, producing interpretations that conflict with visual evidence. We introduce the training-free Criticality-Driven Visual Intervention Framework (CVIF), an inference-time method that localizes critical layers and executes visual interventions during the transition from evidence aggregation to semantic decoding. At these layers, a Geometry-Constrained Local Relation Reconstruction (GCLR) module selects and weights vertex-centered visual evidence, while an Adaptive Visual Steering Operator (AVSO) redistributes attention mass toward the selected tokens. Experiments on PGPS9K and PGDP5K show that CVIF raises Overall F1 from 77.85 to 85.58 and from 75.23 to 82.84, respectively, establishing a novel inference-time visual intervention paradigm.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练的临界性驱动视觉干预框架CVIF，通过定位关键层并施加视觉干预，缓解MLLM在几何图理解中对文本先验的依赖，在PGPS9K和PGDP5K上显著提升Overall F1。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型在视觉任务上进展显著，但几何图理解仍受限于稀疏视觉线索与模糊的"符号—基元"关联，模型易依赖文本先验，导致解释与视觉证据相冲突。
AI.method: 提出免训练的CVIF推理时方法：定位从证据聚合向语义解码过渡的关键层；在该层使用几何约束局部关系重构（GCLR）模块选择并加权以顶点为中心的视觉证据；再用自适应视觉引导算子（AVSO）将注意力质量重新分配至所选token。
AI.result: 在PGPS9K上Overall F1由77.85提升至85.58；在PGDP5K上由75.23提升至82.84。
AI.conclusion: CVIF确立了推理时视觉干预的新范式，无需训练即可有效纠正几何图理解中的文本先验偏差，为MLLM几何推理提供可行路径。

title: From Benchmark to Bench: Can Agents Survive Real-World Drug Discovery?
summary: Agentic systems increasingly coordinate molecular-design tools, but it is unclear which layer of the stack limits outcomes on real projects. We developed MAGI, an open modular agent that authors objectives, launches and monitors optimization, interprets structure--activity relationships, and revises its strategy accordingly. MAGI generates molecules either directly through the LLM or by delegating to REINVENT 4, with scoring services interchangeable behind a common contract. We tested it across nine retrospective lead-optimization campaigns from three pharmaceutical companies, replayed under fixed temporal cutoffs. Both routes produced valid structures: LLM proposals stayed closer to local chemistry and reached comparable or higher primary activity in fewer operations, whereas REINVENT explored broader chemical space. Whether a campaign met its objective depended on the predictive models, not on the generation route: attainment followed model accuracy on the chemistry proposed, dropping once that chemistry moved outside the model's applicability domain. Separately, a blinded evaluation asked whether the MAGI's output could pass as expert work: chemists were not able to discriminate agentic proposals from held-out compounds, and judged the SAR reasoning broadly plausible yet incomplete. Together, these results position MAGI as a coordination layer pluggable into existing computational chemistry workflows. The ceiling on real projects, however, remains currently set by scorer applicability rather than by tool orchestration.

AI.tldr: MAGI是一个开源模块化智能体，可自主撰写优化目标、启动并监控优化过程、解析构效关系并调整策略，生成分子时既可调用LLM直接产出，也可委托REINVENT 4，评分服务通过统一契约互换。在3家药企的9个回顾性先导优化项目中（固定时间截断回放），两条生成路线均能得到有效结构：LLM提案更贴近局部化学空间，以更少操作达到相当或更高的主活性；REINVENT探索空间更广。项目达成目标与否取决于预测模型而非生成路线，命中率随模型在所用化学空间上的精度变化，一旦化学结构超出模型适用域即下降。盲评中化学家无法区分智能体提案与留出化合物，认为SAR推理大体合理但不完整。结论：MAGI是现有计算化学工作流的协调层，真实项目的上限目前由评分器适用域而非工具编排决定。
AI.motivation: 智能体系统日益用于协调分子设计工具，但在真实项目中究竟是堆栈的哪一层限制了最终效果尚不明确；需要区分"工具编排"与"评分/预测模型"各自的贡献。
AI.method: 开发开源模块化智能体MAGI：自主撰写目标、启动与监控优化、解释构效关系并据此修正策略；生成端支持LLM直出或委托REINVENT 4，评分服务在统一契约下可替换。在3家药企的9个回顾性先导优化项目中按固定时间截断进行回放评测；另开展盲评，由化学家判别智能体提案与留出化合物并评价SAR推理。
AI.result: 两条生成路线均产出有效结构；LLM提案更贴近局部化学并达到相当或更高主活性且操作更少，REINVENT探索化学空间更广。项目达标取决于预测模型而非生成路线：命中率随模型对所提化学的精度变化，化学超出模型适用域后下降。盲评中化学家无法区分智能体提案与留出化合物，认为SAR推理大体合理但不完整。
AI.conclusion: MAGI作为可插拔于现有计算化学工作流的协调层具有实用性；真实项目的性能上限当前由评分器适用域而非工具编排决定。

title: Multimodal Safety Evaluation Should Measure Controllability Beyond Classification
summary: VLM safety is commonly evaluated through input- and output-level classification. Such classification is necessary, but it does not reveal whether a safety state is accessible or controllable inside the model. We argue that multimodal safety evaluation should therefore report a \emph{controllability profile} alongside behavioral classification, separating representation-level detectability, cross-modal specificity, intervention sensitivity, and benign-preserving selectivity. Using implicit toxicity as a stress case, we instantiate this profile on LlavaGuard and Qwen3.5 with sparse feature decompositions. LlavaGuard admits localized handles with a narrow benign-preserving intervention range and modest downstream safety gains, whereas Qwen3.5 supports strong representation-level readout but no comparable selective-control regime under the tested operators. These results show that internal readout and controllability can diverge. Future multimodal safety benchmarks should therefore report not only behavioral safety metrics, but also whether safety-relevant internal signals can be intervention-tested and controlled within a validated operating range.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多模态安全评估应超越输入/输出分类，额外报告"可控性剖面"，并在 LlavaGuard 与 Qwen3.5 上以隐性毒性为压力测试案例进行了实例化验证。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 安全评估多依赖输入级与输出级分类，这类分类虽必要，却无法揭示模型内部的安全状态是否可访问、可控；内部可读性与可控性可能存在分歧，因此需要新的评估维度。
AI.method: 提出"可控性剖面"（controllability profile），将其分解为四个维度：表示层可检测性、跨模态特异性、干预敏感性、良性保持选择性。以隐性毒性为压力案例，在 LlavaGuard 与 Qwen3.5 上使用稀疏特征分解实例化该剖面。
AI.result: LlavaGuard 存在局部化控制手柄，但良性保持干预区间较窄，下游安全增益有限；Qwen3.5 具备较强的表示层读出能力，但在所测试算子下没有相当的选择性控制机制。
AI.conclusion: 内部读出与可控性可以彼此分离。未来的多模态安全基准除行为安全指标外，还应报告安全相关内部信号能否被干预测试并在经验证的操作区间内受控。

title: Normality Constraint Learning: Adapting Foundation Models for Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) achieve strong generalization by learning to reconstruct or forecast broad temporal patterns from large-scale time series during pre-training. Yet this strength can become a weakness for anomaly detection: TSFMs may model rare anomalous patterns as effectively as normal ones, allowing anomalies to be accurately reconstructed or forecasted and thus diminishing their reconstruction/forecasting error-based anomaly scores. This paper proposes $\underline{\textbf{N}}$$\textbf{ormality}$ $\underline{\textbf{C}}$$\textbf{onstraint}$ $\underline{\textbf{L}}$$\textbf{earning}$ ($\textbf{NCL}$), a lightweight plug-and-play framework that adapts pre-trained TSFMs for accurate anomaly detection without modifying their pre-trained parameters. Our key insight is to constrain the broad pattern space of TSFMs to the normal structure of a target time series, preventing their broad modeling capability from obscuring abnormal deviations. Specifically, NCL constructs a compact normality subspace from a few normal patch features and adaptively steers each patch feature toward normality within this subspace, guided by contrastive constraints that form compact and discriminative normality manifolds. The calibrated features are aggregated to reinforce normal components and fused with the original TSFM output, amplifying the discrepancy between normal and abnormal observations for the reconstruction/forecasting error-based anomaly scoring. Extensive experiments across diverse TSFM families and benchmarks show that NCL consistently improves anomaly detection performance, providing a generalizable framework for adapting TSFMs to anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NCL（Normality Constraint Learning），一种轻量即插即用框架，在不修改预训练参数的前提下，将时序基础模型（TSFM）的宽泛模式建模能力约束到目标序列的正常结构上，从而放大异常与正常的重建/预测误差差异，提升异常检测性能。
AI.motivation: TSFM 在大规模时序上预训练后具备强泛化能力，能重建或预测广泛的时序模式。但这恰恰成为异常检测的弱点：模型可能把稀有异常模式也建模得和正常模式一样好，使异常被准确重建/预测，导致基于重建或预测误差的异常分数被削弱，难以区分异常。因此需要一种方法将 TSFM 的宽泛模式空间约束到目标序列的正常结构，避免其强建模能力"掩盖"异常偏离。
AI.method: NCL 是一个轻量、即插即用的框架，且不修改 TSFM 的预训练参数。核心做法：1）用少量正常 patch 特征构建紧凑的"正常性子空间"（normality subspace）；2）在对比约束引导下，自适应地将每个 patch 特征朝该子空间内的正常方向校准（steer toward normality），形成紧凑且具判别性的正常性流形；3）将校准后的特征进行聚合以强化正常成分，并与原始 TSFM 输出融合；4）利用融合结果进行基于重建/预测误差的异常打分，放大正常与异常观测之间的差异。
AI.result: 在多种 TSFM 家族和多个基准上开展的大量实验表明，NCL 能持续提升异常检测性能，为将 TSFM 适配到异常检测任务提供了一个可泛化的框架。
AI.conclusion: NCL 通过正常性约束与对比学习，把 TSFM 的宽泛建模能力收敛到目标序列的正常结构上，在不改动预训练参数的情况下放大异常偏差，从而持续提升异常检测效果，具备良好的通用性和即插即用性。

title: AgentPrivArena: Evaluating and Auditing Real-world AI Agent Privacy
summary: The rapid advancement of LLM agents has enabled systems to autonomously perform complex tasks through external tools, but their growing access to personal data introduces significant privacy risks. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate LLM agent privacy through simulated trajectories and outcome-based metrics, limiting their ability to capture privacy risks arising during multi-step agent execution. In this work, we introduce AgentPrivArena, a framework for evaluating privacy risks in realistic LLM agent workflows. AgentPrivArena integrates authentic MCP tools and self-hosted services within a reproducible execution environment. We further propose trajectory-level privacy metrics that quantify unnecessary information access beyond final response leakage. Building on this framework, we introduce AgentPrivAudit, a runtime auditing approach for monitoring privacy violations during agent execution. Extensive experiments on state-of-the-art LLM agents reveal substantial privacy risks overlooked by existing evaluation paradigms, highlighting the importance of trajectory-level auditing for trustworthy agent deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 AgentPrivArena 评测框架与 AgentPrivAudit 运行时审计方法，从轨迹层面评估 LLM 智能体工作流中的隐私风险。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体借助外部工具自主执行复杂任务，对个人数据的访问日益增加，带来显著隐私风险。现有基准多基于模拟轨迹与结果导向指标，难以刻画多步执行过程中出现的隐私风险。
AI.method: 构建 AgentPrivArena 框架，在可复现执行环境内集成真实 MCP 工具与自托管服务；提出轨迹级隐私度量，量化超越最终回复泄露之外的不必要信息访问；并基于该框架提出 AgentPrivAudit 运行时审计方法，在执行过程中监测隐私违规行为。
AI.result: 在先进 LLM 智能体上的大量实验显示，现有评测范式忽视了可观的隐私风险，验证了轨迹级审计的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 轨迹级审计对可信智能体部署至关重要，AgentPrivArena 与 AgentPrivAudit 为真实工作流下的隐私风险评测与运行时监控提供了有效手段。

title: GPlaceRL: An Open-Source Graph Reinforcement Learning Framework for Detailed Placement
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as a promising approach for placement optimization, particularly when combined with graph neural networks (GNNs) that capture circuit connectivity. However, most learning-based placement approaches focus on floorplanning, macro placement, or global placement, while detailed placement refinement remains relatively unexplored. In this paper, we present GPlaceRL, an open-source graph reinforcement learning framework for detailed placement refinement. GPlaceRL represents legalized placements as graphs and provides a modular environment for studying graph encoders, policy architectures, reward formulations, and local placement actions. To demonstrate the capabilities of GPlaceRL, we conduct a systematic evaluation of proximal policy optimization (PPO) policies with graph attention network (GAT) encoders in a per-design optimization setting. Across five placement benchmarks, the best greedy evaluation results achieve HPWL improvements ranging from $3.27\%$ to $32.87\%$. The results highlight the importance of compact GAT architectures and flexible local action spaces for placement optimization. Overall, GPlaceRL provides a reproducible and extensible framework for systematic research on RL-based detailed placement refinement.

AI.tldr: GPlaceRL：一个开源的图强化学习框架，用于详细布局优化（detailed placement refinement），将合法化布局建模为图，提供模块化环境研究图编码器、策略架构、奖励设计与局部布局动作。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型布局方法多集中于布局规划、宏单元布局和全局布局，而详细布局优化（detailed placement refinement）研究相对匮乏，且缺少可复现、可扩展的系统性研究平台。
AI.method: 提出GPlaceRL框架，将合法化布局表示为图，构建模块化环境；采用图注意力网络（GAT）作为编码器、近端策略优化（PPO）作为策略，在按设计（per-design）优化设定下系统评估图编码器、策略架构、奖励形式与局部布局动作。
AI.result: 在五个布局基准测试中，最佳贪心评估结果实现HPWL改进，范围为3.27%至32.87%；结果表明紧凑的GAT架构与灵活的局部动作空间对布局优化至关重要。
AI.conclusion: GPlaceRL为基于RL的详细布局优化研究提供了一个可复现、可扩展的框架，支持系统化的后续研究。

title: polyview: A Python package for multi-view machine learning
summary: Multi-view learning jointly exploits multiple complementary representations of the same data and has become increasingly important in machine learning. However, the Python ecosystem lacks actively maintained, unified tooling for end-to-end multi-view workflows. In this paper, we present polyview, a Python package that provides tools for multi-view embedding, clustering, fusion, and view augmentation, as well as for handling incomplete views, all compatible with scikit-learn. The library offers a unified interface for composing heterogeneous multi-view workflows, including seamless transitions between multi-view and single-view stages. It is built around a core set of classes and utilities that enable composition of different methods and straightforward implementation of new ones. We illustrate the package on five real multi-view datasets and compare its components based on canonical correlation analysis with those of two established libraries. polyview aims to be both a practical toolkit for benchmarking and prototyping multi-view methods and a foundation for future research and development in this area.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍 polyview，一个与 scikit-learn 兼容的 Python 多视图学习工具包，涵盖多视图嵌入、聚类、融合、视图增强及不完整视图处理，支持端到端工作流。
AI.motivation: 多视图学习通过联合利用同一数据的多个互补表示，在机器学习中日益重要；但 Python 生态缺乏活跃维护、统一的多视图端到端工具。
AI.method: polyview 提供多视图嵌入、聚类、融合与视图增强工具，并支持不完整视图处理，保持 scikit-learn 兼容。其核心类与实用程序支持异构多视图工作流的统一接口组合，包括多视图与单视图阶段间的无缝切换，便于方法组合与新方法实现。
AI.result: 在五个真实多视图数据集上展示了该包，并将基于 CCA（典型相关分析）的组件与两个已有库进行了对比。
AI.conclusion: polyview 既可作为多视图方法基准测试与原型开发的实用工具包，也可作为该领域未来研究开发的基础。

title: You Changed Your Mind, The Model Didn't: Demystifying Intent in Multi-Turn Dialogue
summary: When a large language model handles a multi-turn task and a user proposes a change but ultimately rejects it, the model should continue as if nothing changed. We find a surprising failure: merely mentioning a rejected change can derail task execution, even when the user's final intent remains unchanged. To systematically study language model behavior under evolving user intent, we introduce Intent-Eval, a controlled benchmark spanning tool actions, code, databases, and mathematics. Across diverse tasks, models are vulnerable to both rejected proposals and superseded requirements, consistent with mentioned-as-in-effect confusion: conversational content is treated as active requirements even after it has been rejected or replaced. Accuracy degradation can deepen or persist as interaction continues, highlighting the need to distinguish what has been mentioned from what remains in effect. Building on this insight, we propose Intent-OPSD, a decision-conditioned on-policy self-distillation framework with Teacher and Student initialized from the same model. The frozen Teacher provides active-intent supervision from the complete task matching the user's decision, training the Student on the full dialogue to follow active requirements reflecting user intent.

AI.tldr: 论文发现大语言模型在多轮任务中会把"已被否决/被替代"的对话内容误当作仍然生效的需求（mentioned-as-in-effect confusion），并提出 Intent-Eval 基准与 Intent-OPSD 自蒸馏方法来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 多轮任务中用户可能先提出某个变更、但最终拒绝它。理想情况下模型应"当作什么都没发生"继续原任务。但论文发现一个令人意外的失败模式：仅仅"提及"一个被拒绝的变更就会干扰任务执行，即使用户最终意图并未改变。现有工作缺乏对"演化中的用户意图"下模型行为的系统研究，且模型难以区分"被提及过的内容"与"仍然生效的需求"。
AI.method: 1) 提出 Intent-Eval：一个受控基准，覆盖工具调用（tool actions）、代码、数据库、数学等任务，用于系统评测用户意图演化场景下模型的表现。2) 基于"mentioned-as-in-effect confusion"这一诊断，提出 Intent-OPSD：一种决策条件（decision-conditioned）的在线策略自蒸馏（on-policy self-distillation）框架。Teacher 与 Student 由同一模型初始化，Teacher 冻结，依据与用户决策相匹配的完整任务提供"活跃意图"监督；Student 则在完整对话上训练，学习遵循反映用户真实意图的"活跃需求"。
AI.result: 跨多种任务，模型对"被拒绝的提议"和"被替代的需求"都存在脆弱性，表现为准确性下降，且该下降会随交互持续而加深或长期存在。这与 mentioned-as-in-effect confusion 一致：对话内容即使已被否决或替换，仍被当作活跃需求处理。
AI.conclusion: 模型必须学会区分"什么被提及过"与"什么仍然生效"。Intent-Eval 揭示了这一系统性缺陷，而 Intent-OPSD 通过决策条件的在线自蒸馏，用与用户最终决策对齐的活跃意图信号指导学习，为提升演化意图下的任务执行鲁棒性提供了可行方向。

title: ANT: A Multi-Granularity Network Traffic Dataset and Benchmark for Agents Behavior Auditing
summary: The growing adoption of large language model (LLM) agents creates a need for network administrators and security teams to audit agent behavior within organizational networks without inspecting private user content. Network traffic offers an observable source of evidence, but how much it reveals about agent tasks and operations remains unclear. Existing traffic datasets lack the joint task and stage annotations needed to evaluate this question. We introduce ANT (Agent Network Traffic), a dataset providing agent behavior information at risk, scenario, and behavior primitive granularities alongside network traffic. ANT contains 3,114 execution episodes across 20 tasks and five scenarios, comprising 276,417 bidirectional flows and 40,049 behavior primitive segments organized into 47 macro groups. We establish a benchmark for agent risk identification, scenario recognition, and behavior primitive classification using 13 representative traffic analysis baselines. The results show that existing methods recover useful but uneven behavioral signals. They struggle to identify risk when malicious workflows resemble benign tasks and to distinguish scenarios with similar traffic patterns. Primitive classification is more reliable for frequent macro groups and those with distinctive traffic patterns than for rare or semantically similar groups. ANT provides a common basis for developing more precise auditing and forensic analysis of agent behavior from network traffic. Our data and code are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ant-main-suite-7BC0/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ANT数据集，为LLM代理的网络流量提供风险、场景和行为原语三级标注，并基于13个流量分析基线建立基准。
AI.motivation: LLM代理在组织网络中被广泛采用，网络管理员需在不检查用户私有内容的前提下审计代理行为。网络流量是可观测的证据来源，但其对代理任务与操作的揭示程度尚不明确，且现有流量数据集缺乏任务与阶段的联合标注，无法支撑该问题的评估。
AI.method: 构建ANT（Agent Network Traffic）数据集，在风险、场景和行为原语三种粒度上同步提供代理行为信息与网络流量。数据集包含5个场景、20个任务下的3,114个执行片段，276,417条双向流，以及归入47个宏组的40,049个行为原语片段。基于13个代表性流量分析基线，建立代理风险识别、场景识别与行为原语分类基准。
AI.result: 现有方法能恢复部分有用但不均衡的行为信号：当恶意工作流与良性任务相似时难以识别风险，对流量模式相近的场景难以区分；原语分类在出现频繁、流量模式独特的宏组上更可靠，对稀有或语义相近的宏组表现较差。
AI.conclusion: ANT为基于网络流量开展更精细的代理行为审计与取证分析提供了统一基础，数据与代码已开源。

title: Proof-Grounded Patient-Specific Clinical Explanations from Knowledge-Graph Reasoning
summary: Clinical decision-support outputs can lack an au- ditable link between patient observations, encoded knowledge, conclusions, and recommendations. We present the CKG Clinical Explanation Engine, a downstream layer for a frozen, training-free clinical knowledge-graph reasoner that converts patient inference states and disease knowledge into typed facts, explicit rule-application traces, provenance-linked conclusions, and policy-licensed recommendations. The design separates measurement availability, representation completeness, and disease-specific activation; consequently, observed zero-activation evience is not treated as missing and partial representation is distinct from unobserved evidence. Optional language generation is restricted to symbolically licensed content. Across five usable workbooks (6,720 patients; 20,160 patient-disease traces; 1,021,440 feature-evidence rows), IG-range validity and knowledge provenance were 100%, numerical cross-sheet fidelity was 100% (120,960/120,960), and exported logical/report trace completeness was 100% (20,160/20,160). Availability representation consistency was 99.7028% (1,018,404/1,021,440); all 3,036 disagreements were confined to three systematic feature-cohort patterns. The corpus contained 86,783 observed zero-activation and 139,949 observed partially represented instances. A separate seeded 25-patient end-to-end audit completed without execution failure and passed all pre-specified trace, licensing, provenance, and state-consistency checks. These results establish structural and implementation auditability, not clinical correctness or utility.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出CKG临床解释引擎，为冻结、免训练的临床知识图谱推理器提供可审计的下游解释层，输出类型化事实、显式规则应用轨迹、带溯源的结论及策略许可的建议，并对五个工作簿进行结构性与实现层面的审计。
AI.motivation: 临床决策支持系统的输出往往缺乏从患者观测、编码知识、结论到建议之间的可审计关联，导致推理过程不透明、无法追溯证据与知识来源，也难以区分"未观测证据"与"缺失证据"。因此需要构建一个能够生成可审计、可溯源解释的下游组件。
AI.method: 设计CKG临床解释引擎，将患者推理状态与疾病知识转换为类型化事实、显式规则应用轨迹、溯源关联结论和策略许可建议；在设计上分离测量可用性、表示完备性与疾病特异性激活，使观测到的零激活不被视为缺失、部分表示与未观测证据相区分；可选语言生成仅限符号许可内容。在五个可用工作簿（6,720名患者、20,160条患者-疾病轨迹、1,021,440行特征-证据）上评估，并进行25名患者的种子端到端审计。
AI.result: IG范围有效性与知识溯源均为100%，数值跨表保真度为100%（120,960/120,960），导出的逻辑/报告轨迹完整性为100%（20,160/20,160）；可用性表示一致性为99.7028%（1,018,404/1,021,440），全部3,036处不一致集中于三种系统性特征-队列模式。语料库包含86,783个观测到的零激活和139,949个观测到的部分表示实例。25名患者的端到端审计无执行失败，通过了全部预设的轨迹、许可、溯源与状态一致性检查。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了结构与实现层面的可审计性，但并未证明临床正确性或临床效用，后续需进一步开展临床验证。

title: Signature-Based Feature Learning for Human Activity Recognition: A Reproducible Machine Learning Study of Representation, Depth, and Model Choice
summary: Human activity recognition (HAR) relies on transforming sensor signals into informative representations for classification. Although deep learning and handcrafted features are widely used, the role of representation itself is often not systematically isolated. Signature transforms provide a mathematically grounded way to encode temporal order and cross-channel interactions, but their value for HAR under a fully reproducible and leakage-aware framework remains unclear. To evaluate whether signature-based feature learning improves HAR performance compared with raw-signal baselines, and to assess the effects of embedding strategy, truncation depth, model choice, and sensor configuration. Experiments were conducted on the UCI HAR dataset using a fully reproducible pipeline with the original train--test split preserved and subject-disjoint validation to prevent leakage. Three representations were compared: raw flattened signals, time-augmented paths, and lead--lag transformed paths. Signature features were computed at multiple truncation depths and evaluated using multilayer perceptron (MLP) and Random Forest (RF) classifiers under identical preprocessing and validation procedures. A prior K-means-based feature reduction study was also reproduced for comparison. Signature-based representations improved performance when paired with RF models, the best configuration was time-augmented six-channel signatures at depth 6 using entropy-based RF achieving 0.858 accuracy and 0.859 macro F1, outperforming the strongest raw baseline (0.816 accuracy). Lead--lag representations were competitive at moderate depths but did not surpass the best time-augmented models. MLP models did not exceed raw baselines. Signature-based feature learning can improve HAR, but its benefit depends on alignment between representation design and classifier choice.

AI.tldr: 该研究在人脸活动识别(UCI HAR)上系统评估签名变换特征表示，主张"表示设计需与分类器匹配"，最佳配置为时间增广六通道签名(depth 6)+熵随机森林，达0.858准确率/0.859宏F1，超过最强原始基线(0.816)。
AI.motivation: 深度学习与手工特征在HAR中广泛使用，但"表示本身"的作用常未被系统性隔离评估；签名变换能数学化编码时序顺序与跨通道交互，其在HAR中于完全可复现、防泄漏框架下的价值仍不明确。研究旨在检验签名特征学习是否优于原始信号基线，并考察嵌入策略、截断深度、模型选择与传感器配置的影响。
AI.method: 在UCI HAR数据集上构建完全可复现流程：保留原始训练-测试划分，并采用受试者不重叠(subject-disjoint)验证以防止泄漏。比较三种表示：原始展平信号、时间增广路径、lead-lag变换路径；在多个截断深度计算签名特征，在相同预处理与验证下用MLP与随机森林(RF)评估，并复现先前的K-means特征降维研究作对照。
AI.result: 签名表示与RF结合时性能提升：最佳配置为时间增广六通道签名、深度6、基于熵的RF，取得0.858准确率与0.859宏F1，优于最强原始基线(0.816)。Lead-lag表示在中等深度有竞争力但未超越最佳时间增广模型；MLP未超过原始基线。
AI.conclusion: 签名特征学习可改善HAR性能，但其收益取决于表示设计与分类器选择之间的匹配程度。

title: HERA: Harness-Environment Co-Evolution for Reliable Agentic Abstention
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly capable of acting in complex tool-use environments, yet they often fail to recognize when tasks are infeasible and no valid solution exists. Recent work has formalized this reliability gap as the problem of agentic abstention, and existing approaches typically optimize a model or agent harness against a fixed set of tasks, leading to limited generalization to unseen failure modes. We introduce HERA, a framework for harness-environment co-evolution for agentic abstention. HERA consists of (i) a pipeline to automatically construct verifiable pairs of feasible and infeasible tasks by applying controlled environment mutations that transform solvable tasks into cases requiring abstention, and (ii) a co-evolution procedure in which performance failures on previous tasks are used to drive harness adaptation and generate new execution environments and tasks geared towards previous weaknesses. On held-out evaluation tasks, an evolved harness from HERA improves abstention accuracy from 61.7% to 83.3% while improving feasible-task completion from 68.3% to 76.7%, achieving the highest abstention and feasible-task completion among the compared methods. The resulting best harness transfers across 19 other LLMs, improving abstention accuracy by 15.3 percentage points on average without any model-specific optimization, and enabling smaller models to match the performance of more powerful models at an estimated 85% lower cost.

AI.tldr: HERA 提出一种“harness-环境协同演化”框架，通过自动构造可验证的可解/不可解任务对，并利用失败驱动的环境生成与 harness 自适应，提升 LLM 智能体的“拒答（abstention）”能力，在留出任务上显著优于对比方法，且具备跨模型迁移性。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在复杂工具使用环境中能力增强，但常无法识别任务本身不可行、不存在有效解的情况，形成可靠性缺口（agentic abstention）。现有方法通常在固定任务集上优化模型或 agent harness，导致对未见失败模式的泛化能力有限。
AI.method: HERA 包含两部分：(i) 任务构造流水线：对可解任务施加受控环境变异，自动生成成对的可解任务与不可解任务（需要拒答），并保证可验证性；(ii) 协同演化过程：根据先前任务上的性能失败驱动 harness 自适应，并生成针对既往弱点的新的执行环境与任务，形成 harness 与环境共同演化。
AI.result: 在留出评估任务上，HERA 演化出的 harness 将拒答准确率从 61.7% 提升至 83.3%，同时将可解任务完成率从 68.3% 提升至 76.7%，在对比方法中同时取得最高的拒答准确率与可解任务完成率。最佳 harness 可迁移至 19 个其他 LLM，在无需任何模型特定优化的情况下平均提升拒答准确率 15.3 个百分点，并使较小模型以约 85% 更低成本达到更强模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: HERA 通过 harness-环境协同演化有效缓解 agentic abstention 的泛化瓶颈：无需模型特定优化即可提升拒答与可解任务完成表现，并具备跨模型迁移与降本潜力，为提升 LLM 智能体在工具使用环境中的可靠性提供了可扩展路径。

title: DGA-Muon: Decoupled Geometry-Aligned Adaptive Scaling for Muon
summary: While NorMuon has achieved strong empirical performance in large-scale pretraining by enhancing Muon with row-wise adaptive scaling, its underlying adaptive mechanism remains poorly understood. In this work, we provide the first systematic analysis of NorMuon's adaptivity, revealing that it originates primarily from orthogonalization-induced geometry rather than genuine optimization-relevant information. Under exact orthogonalization, the adaptive scaling factors degenerate into a single global scalar for square and wide matrices, while for tall matrices their variation arises from the non-uniform distribution of row energy after orthogonalization. Under approximate orthogonalization, the orthogonality residual introduces additional variation into the scaling factors, leading to the \textit{Orthogonalization--Adaptivity Paradox}: more accurate orthogonalization weakens adaptivity. We further show that NorMuon's rigid row-wise scaling is geometrically misaligned with the one-sided orthogonal structure of tall matrices. Based on the analysis of these limitations, we propose two core design principles that a desirable adaptive mechanism for Muon should satisfy. First, adaptive scaling should be decoupled from orthogonalization, with the scaling factors computed directly from raw gradients. Second, adaptive scaling should be aligned with the shape-dependent orthogonal structure of the polar factor, using row-wise scaling for wide matrices and column-wise scaling for tall matrices. By incorporating several other design considerations, including sum-based second-moment estimates, bias correction, and adaptive clipping of scaling factors, we obtain the Decoupled Geometry-Aligned Muon (DGA-Muon) optimizer. We establish convergence guarantees for DGA-Muon and empirically validate both our theoretical characterization of NorMuon's scaling degeneration and the superiority of DGA-Muon over NorMuon.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统分析 NorMuon 的自适应性机制，指出其自适应变化主要源于正交化诱导的几何效应而非真正的优化信息，并提出解耦且几何对齐的 DGA-Muon 优化器。
AI.motivation: NorMuon 在大规模预训练中表现强劲，其在 Muon 基础上引入逐行自适应缩放，但其自适应机制的本质缺乏理论理解，因此需要系统性分析以揭示其局限并指导更优设计。
AI.method: 在精确正交化下分析缩放因子的退化行为：方阵与宽矩阵退化为全局标量，高矩阵的变异性来自正交化后行能量的非均匀分布；在近似正交化下分析正交性残差带来的额外变化，揭示"正交化—自适应悖论"。据此提出两条设计原则：自适应缩放与正交化解耦、直接由原始梯度计算；缩放方向与极分解因子的形状相关正交结构对齐。结合平方二阶矩估计、偏差校正与自适应裁剪，构建 DGA-Muon，并给出收敛性保证。
AI.result: 理论上刻画了 NorMuon 缩放因子的退化现象及"更精确正交化反而削弱自适应性"的悖论，并指出其刚性逐行缩放与高矩阵单侧正交结构在几何上不匹配；实验验证了理论刻画，并显示 DGA-Muon 优于 NorMuon。
AI.conclusion: NorMuon 的自适应主要来自正交化几何而非优化相关信息；理想的自适应机制应与正交化解耦且形状对齐，DGA-Muon 在理论与经验上均验证了该设计原则的有效性。

title: The Review Lottery: Calibrating an Observational Estimator of Peer-Review Noise (ICLR 2017-2025)
summary: How much of a conference accept/reject decision would change if the same paper were reviewed by a different set of reviewers? Running a second independent program committee is the gold standard for answering this, but it is prohibitively expensive: done only twice (NeurIPS 2014 and 2021). We build an observational estimator of this quantity from public review data alone, calibrate it twice, and apply it to nine years of ICLR (2017-2025; 36,113 papers, 134,912 reviews). The estimator decomposes scores with a Bayesian ordered-probit model into paper quality and reviewer noise, maps scores to decisions with a logistic model, and simulates two independent committees (posterior draws B=1,000; committee sizes k=2,3,4). Estimated disagreement rates are 23-30% at k=2 and 18-24% at k=4; 30-50% of accepted papers would be rejected. External calibration: at the NeurIPS 2021 reviewer-count caliber (k=3), the simulated 2021 disagreement rate is 23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%] vs. reported 23.0% (bias +0.3pp); accept precision and committee correlation agree within 5pp and 0.04. Internal calibration: on 18,740 papers with 4+ reviews, random model-free 2+2 reviewer splits agree with the k=2 simulation within 1pp in 2018 and 2021-2025. Longitudinally, we find no robust time trend in reviewer noise over 2017-2025. The high accepted-paper flip rates of 2020 and 2021 have distinct mechanisms: the 2020 four-point scale compressed scores (23.7% of papers had zero within-paper variance), and a counterfactual shows coarsening the scale raises disagreement by about 7pp; 2021 instead combined the lowest signal-to-noise ratio in the sample with the most threshold-crowded acceptances. For the LLM era, a 2023 breakpoint test on within-paper score variance finds no break, but the design has almost no power, and no post-2022 review text or confidence data exist, so no LLM attribution is attempted.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一种仅依赖公开评审数据的观测估计器，用于量化“若同一批论文由另一组评审人评审，会议接收/拒稿决定会有多大变化”，并在ICLR 2017-2025九年数据（36,113篇论文、134,912条评审）上应用。估计器用贝叶斯有序probit模型将评分分解为论文质量与评审人噪声，用logistic模型将评分映射为决定，并模拟两个独立委员会。估计结果显示k=2时分歧率为23-30%，k=4时为18-24%，30-50%的接收论文会被拒。外部校准（NeurIPS 2021，k=3）模拟分歧率23.3%对比实际23.0%（偏差+0.3pp）；接受精度与委员会相关性分别在5pp与0.04以内一致。纵向看评审人噪声无稳健时间趋势；2020与2021的高翻转率机制不同；未对LLM影响做归因。
AI.motivation: 回答“同一篇论文若由不同评审人组评审，会议决定会改变多少”这一问题，金标准是运行第二个独立程序委员会，但成本极高，迄今仅两次（NeurIPS 2014与2021）。因此需要一种低成本、可复用的观测估计方法，并检验其可靠性。
AI.method: 仅使用公开评审数据构建观测估计器：以贝叶斯有序probit模型将评分分解为论文质量与评审人噪声；以logistic模型将评分映射为决定；模拟两个独立委员会（后验抽样B=1,000，委员会规模k=2,3,4）。进行外部校准（对照NeurIPS 2021评审人数口径k=3）与内部校准（对18,740篇含4条以上评审的论文做随机无模型2+2评审人拆分，与k=2模拟比较）。应用于ICLR 2017-2025九年数据。
AI.result: 估计分歧率在k=2时为23-30%，k=4时为18-24%；30-50%的接收论文会被拒。外部校准：k=3下模拟2021分歧率23.3% [21.7%, 25.0%]，对比报告值23.0%（偏差+0.3pp）；接受精度与委员会相关性分别在5pp与0.04以内一致。内部校准：2018年及2021-2025年k=2模拟与随机2+2拆分的差异在1pp以内。纵向未发现2017-2025年评审人噪声的稳健时间趋势。2020与2021高接收翻转率机制不同：2020四点量表压缩评分（23.7%论文组内方差为零），反事实显示量表粗化使分歧增加约7pp；2021则是样本中最低信噪比叠加最拥挤的接收阈值。2023年组内评分方差断点检验未发现断点，但设计功效极低，且2022年后无评审文本或信心数据，故未做LLM归因。
AI.conclusion: 公开评审数据可用于估计会议决定对评审人组的敏感性，估计器经双重校准后表现良好，表明同伴评审决定存在相当高的偶然性；不同年份高翻转率的成因各异；当前数据与设计无法识别LLM对评审噪声的影响，相关归因被明确回避。

title: Can Agent Harnesses and Inference Engines Hear Each Other? The HEAR Protocol for Agentic LLM Serving
comment: Jiaqi Zhao, Haodong Chen, and Jitai Hao contributed equally
summary:
LLM agents increasingly execute complex workflows involving multi-turn reasoning, tool use, and parallel agents. Efficient serving requires decisions that span two layers with complementary information: the agent harness understands workflow dependencies, context lifecycles, and execution objectives, whereas the inference engine observes request queues, KV-cache state, resource pressure, and execution capabilities. Existing interfaces do not systematically connect these views, limiting workflow-aware execution.
  HEAR, a bidirectional Harness--Engine Pairing protocol for agentic LLM serving. HEAR standardizes how the harness communicates workflow intent and execution requirements and how the engine returns runtime state, capabilities, and outcomes. By separating protocol semantics from optimization policies, HEAR supports diverse coordination strategies without changing workflow or model semantics. We instantiate HEAR for online cache-aware runtime coordination and workload-aware execution-mode selection for agent roles.
  Across four conversational and research-agent benchmarks under memory-constrained, concurrent serving, HEAR achieves a $1.61\times$ batch speedup and reduces median time-to-first-token by $2.23\times$ on SCBench. Mooncake shows that workflow intent and live engine state provide complementary benefits across load regimes. On BrowseComp-Plus and DeepResearchBench, workload-specific configurations yield $1.23\times$ and $2.45\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively, without observed task-quality degradation. These results establish HEAR as a reusable coordination substrate for efficient agentic LLM serving.

AI.tldr: HEAR 是一种连接智能体编排层（harness）与推理引擎的双向配对协议，通过标准化工作流意图与运行时状态的交换，实现工作流感知的高效 LLM 服务。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体需执行多轮推理、工具调用与并行协作等复杂工作流。高效服务需要跨越两层的协同决策：编排层掌握工作流依赖、上下文生命周期与执行目标，而推理引擎掌握请求队列、KV-cache 状态、资源压力与执行能力。现有接口未系统性地打通这两种视角，制约了工作流感知的执行。
AI.method: 提出 HEAR——面向智能体化 LLM 服务的双向编排层-引擎配对协议。该协议标准化了编排层如何传达工作流意图与执行需求，以及引擎如何返回运行时状态、能力与执行结果。通过将协议语义与优化策略解耦，HEAR 可在不改变工作流或模型语义的前提下支持多种协同策略。具体实例化了两类应用：在线缓存感知的运行时协调，以及面向智能体角色的负载感知执行模式选择。
AI.result: 在内存受限的并发服务场景下，于四个对话与科研智能体基准上评测：在 SCBench 上实现 1.61× 批处理加速，中位首 token 时延降低 2.23×；Mooncake 表明工作流意图与实时引擎状态在不同负载区间提供互补收益；在 BrowseComp-Plus 与 DeepResearchBench 上，负载特定配置分别带来 1.23× 与 2.45× 端到端加速，且未观察到任务质量下降。
AI.conclusion: HEAR 可作为可复用的协同基础层，支撑高效的智能体化 LLM 服务。

title: FREA: A Multi-Source Expert Benchmark for Reaction Feasibility Verification
summary: As generative models and AI agents propose chemical reactions at a scale beyond expert review, feasibility verifiers decide which proposals enter synthesis planning. But do their decisions agree with chemists across different kinds of candidates? We introduce FREA, a benchmark of 751 reactions labeled by expert chemists under an explicit feasibility criterion, drawn from retrosynthesis model proposals, zero-yield experimental records, edits by large language models (LLMs), and five negative candidate generation methods. Our evaluation finds that no verifier leads across all sources: LLMs given only the criterion are competitive with dedicated verifiers, while forward models perform best on retrosynthesis proposals but reject most feasible edits of recorded reactions at the evaluated operating points. Looking beyond aggregate scores, both forward models perform below chance when separating infeasible alternative disconnections from feasible generated candidates. To study whether negative supervision addresses these weaknesses, we also release a corpus of over 14 million recorded reactions and generated negative candidates. In matched training comparisons, adding a mixture of generated negatives to forward training raises mean AUROC across sources, but these gains do not extend to retrosynthesis proposals. Varying the generation method further shows that the largest gain on generated candidates coincides with worse proposal screening. These findings motivate evaluating verifiers against experts across sources and designing negatives for transfer to model proposals.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FREA基准（751个由专家化学家按统一可行性标准标注的反应），系统评估化学反应可行性验证器在多种候选来源上的表现。结果显示没有验证器在所有来源上占优：LLM仅凭标准即具竞争力，前向模型在逆合成提案上最佳但在编辑反应上大量误拒，且在区分"不可行替代断键"与"可行生成候选"时低于随机水平。作者还发布超1400万条反应及生成负例语料，发现加入生成负例可提升平均AUROC但难以迁移到逆合成提案，且不同负例生成方法存在"生成候选增益越大、提案筛选越差"的权衡。
AI.motivation: 随着生成模型与AI智能体以超越专家审查的规模提出化学反应，可行性验证器成为决定哪些提案能进入合成规划的关键环节。然而，现有验证器是否在不同类型候选上与化学家的判断一致尚不清楚，且评测往往只看聚合分数，忽视了按候选来源划分的差异。论文动机在于建立专家标注的基准并跨来源评估验证器，揭示其系统性弱点，并探究负例监督能否弥补这些缺陷。
AI.method: 构建FREA基准，包含751个反应，由专家化学家依据明确的可行性标准进行标注，候选来源涵盖逆合成模型提案、零产率实验记录、LLM编辑生成的反应以及五种负例候选生成方法。在此基准上评估专用验证器、仅给标准的大语言模型与前向模型等多类验证器。此外发布超过1400万条记录反应与生成负例的语料，用于匹配训练比较；通过向正向训练中混入生成负例，并在不同负例生成方法间变化，考察其对各来源AUROC及提案筛选的影响。
AI.result: 评估发现没有单一验证器在所有来源上领先：仅给出标准的大语言模型与专用验证器表现相当；前向模型在逆合成提案上表现最佳，但在所评估的操作点上拒绝了大多数已记录反应的可行编辑。进一步分析显示，前向模型在区分不可行替代断键与可行生成候选时表现低于随机水平。匹配训练比较表明，向正向训练中加入生成负例的混合可提升跨来源平均AUROC，但该增益不延伸至逆合成提案；改变负例生成方法后发现，在生成候选上增益最大时，提案筛选反而更差。
AI.conclusion: 验证器的可信度高度依赖候选来源，聚合分数会掩盖系统性偏差，因此必须针对不同来源与专家判断进行评测。负例监督能带来部分收益，但难以自动迁移到模型提案的筛选，需专门设计可迁移的负例。作者据此呼吁以跨来源的专家对齐为标准来评估与设计可行性验证器。

title: Collective intelligence through aggregation
comment: This is a preprint of a paper published in Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B (2026) 381 (1948): 20240454
summary: Suppose a committee, expert panel, or other group is making judgments on some issues, where these may be not just yes/no-questions, such as whether a defendant is guilty, but also variables with many possible values, such as macroeconomic or meteorological variables or travel directions. Furthermore, there may be interconnections between different issues, as in the case of economic or climate variables. How can the group arrive at "intelligent" collective judgments, based on the group members' individual judgments? We investigate three challenges raised by this judgment-aggregation problem. First, reasonable methods of aggregation (such as defining the collective judgment for each issue as the average or median judgment) can produce inconsistent collective judgments. Secondly, many methods of aggregation are manipulable by strategic voting. Finally, not all methods of aggregation are conducive to tracking the truth on the issues in question. We prove new impossibility or possibility theorems on all three challenges, identifying what it takes to produce collective judgments in a consistent, non-manipulable, and truth-tracking manner and thereby to achieve collective intelligence through aggregation. Overall, the median method, though imperfect, performs reasonably well. We also note the relevance of our analysis for non-human group decisions.

AI.tldr: 该文研究广义判断聚合问题：当议题取多值且相互关联时，群体如何基于个体判断形成"智能"的集体判断。作者针对一致性、策略防操纵性与真值追踪三大挑战，证明了一系列新的不可能性与可能性定理，并指出中位数方法虽有缺陷但总体表现良好，同时讨论了该分析对非人类群体决策的适用性。
AI.motivation: 传统的判断聚合研究多聚焦于二元（是/否）议题，而现实中委员会或专家组的判断常涉及多值变量（如宏观经济变量、气象变量、行进方向），且议题之间存在相互关联（如经济或气候变量）。在此类更一般的设定下，如何由个体判断得到"智能"的集体判断，存在一致性、可操纵性与真值追踪三方面的挑战，亟需理论刻画。
AI.method: 采用社会选择理论/判断聚合的形式化方法，将议题推广至多值且相互关联的情形，针对三大挑战分别构造并证明新的不可能性定理与可能性定理，以刻画实现一致性、非操纵性与真值追踪所需的条件，并对中位数等具体聚合规则进行比较分析。
AI.result: 在一致性、策略防操纵性与真值追踪三个维度上均得到新的不可能性或可能性定理，明确了满足这三项要求的聚合所需条件；比较分析表明，中位数方法虽不完美，但在这些维度上表现相对良好。
AI.conclusion: 通过聚合实现集体智能，需要在一致性、非操纵性与真值追踪之间进行权衡，相关定理给出了可行与不可行的边界；中位数方法是较为稳健的选择。分析结论亦可推广至非人类的群体决策场景。

title: Conditional Rank Allocation for Taxonomy-Aware Medical Language Model Adaptation
summary: Medical question answering spans specialties and clinical operations that may benefit from different adaptation directions. We propose ARBOR, a parameter-efficient method that selects rank-one components from a shared low-rank basis for each question. An additive gate combines question representations, specialty tags, operation tags, and their interaction; a learned coefficient scales the adapter residual. An illustrative separation under orthogonal, equiprobable subtasks shows how conditional selection can avoid an approximation floor faced by a fixed update with the same active rank. This result motivates the design without asserting a corresponding bound for medical corpora. On Qwen3-8B across CMB, CMExam, MedQA, and MedMCQA, five-seed experiments yield 69.69% mean accuracy across benchmarks, exceeding LoRA r16 and MoELoRA by 1.26 and 1.30 percentage points, respectively. The reported advantage over LoRA r16 increases from 0.08 to 1.94 points as training expands from one to seven specialties. Tag perturbations and atom masking support the usefulness of clinical routing, while atom clusters align with the supplied specialty labels (adjusted Rand index 0.62). Calibration, transfer, and measured costs further characterize the method. These findings support structured conditional adaptation for medical QA, while leaving clinical safety and broader deployment untested.

AI.tldr: ARBOR是一种参数高效方法，通过从共享低秩基中为每个问题选择秩一组件，实现结构化条件适配，用于医学问答。
AI.motivation: 医学问答跨专业与临床操作，可能受益于不同的适配方向；需要一种能针对每个问题进行条件化、参数高效的适配方法。
AI.method: ARBOR从共享低秩基中为每个问题选择秩一组件；采用加性门控融合问题表示、专业标签、操作标签及其交互，并用学习到的系数缩放适配器残差。理论上在正交等概率子任务下展示了条件选择可避免固定更新面临的近似下限。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B上，跨CMB、CMExam、MedQA、MedMCQA五种子实验平均准确率69.69%，较LoRA r16和MoELoRA分别高1.26和1.30个百分点；随训练专业从1增至7，相较LoRA r16的优势从0.08升至1.94点；标签扰动和原子掩码支持临床路由有效性，原子聚类与专业标签对齐（调整Rand指数0.62）。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持面向医学问答的结构化条件适配，但临床安全性与更广泛部署尚未验证。

title: Back to the Future: Rethinking EDA Infrastructure for Agentic Systems in Chip Design Verification
comment: 40th NeurIPS'26 Workshop AI for Chip Design
summary: The unprecedented computational scale of modern artificial intelligence depends on complex, multi-billion-transistor Systems-on-Chip, yet the workflows that verify these chips remain stubbornly manual. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) have made rapid inroads into Electronic Design Automation (EDA), approximately 74.6% of existing studies target static Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code generation, leaving post-simulation verification and interactive waveform debugging largely untouched. We introduce Back-to-the-Future (BTTF), an end-to-end agentic framework that closes this infrastructural gap. BTTF distills massive, unstructured simulation dumps into a normalized relational SQLite database and couples it with a collaborative multi-agent orchestration engine that translates natural-language verification queries into schema-aware SQL while correlating signal anomalies with versioned RTL repositories. Across a 150-query benchmark, BTTF attains 95.33% execution accuracy, charting a practical path toward autonomous EDA verification.

AI.tldr: BTTF：面向芯片仿真验证的端到端多智能体框架，将仿真数据规范化为SQLite并用多智能体生成SQL，150条查询基准达95.33%执行准确率。
AI.motivation: 现代AI依赖数十亿晶体管规模的SoC，但其验证流程仍高度依赖人工。LLM虽已进入EDA领域，但约74.6%的研究集中在静态RTL代码生成，后仿真验证与交互式波形调试几乎未被覆盖，形成了基础设施空白。
AI.method: 提出Back-to-the-Future（BTTF）端到端智能体框架：将大规模非结构化仿真转储数据蒸馏、规范化为关系型SQLite数据库；配合协作式多智能体编排引擎，将自然语言验证查询翻译为模式感知（schema-aware）的SQL，并将信号异常与带版本管理的RTL仓库进行关联。
AI.result: 在包含150条查询的基准测试中，BTTF取得95.33%的执行准确率。
AI.conclusion: BTTF填补了LLM在EDA中后仿真验证与波形调试环节的空白，为自主化EDA验证提供了一条切实可行的技术路径。

title: TasteVal: Measuring the Experimental Research Taste of AI Systems Against Human Experts
summary: We introduce TasteVal, a benchmark to evaluate the experimental research taste of frontier models. We define research taste as the ability to pick interesting problems to solve, design experiments, and interpret experimental results. TasteVal measures the experimental component of research taste; given a fixed research problem, we measure how well a model iteratively designs experiments and draws conclusions from their outcomes. We operationalize experimental research taste as compute efficiency; a Researcher who reaches the same score as an expert human using half the serial experimental compute has twice the experimental taste. Experimental taste thus acts as a multiplier on experimental compute, making it a key input to forecasts of AI progress. TasteVal consists of 8 novel, challenging, open-ended tasks representative of frontier AI R&D. To isolate taste from coding ability, the model under evaluation acts as a Researcher that iteratively designs experiments while a fixed Coder agent implements them and reports their results. The Researcher executes until either the 40 H100 hour or 120 wall-clock hour budgets are exhausted. We recruit 24 human experts, at least 2 per task, and take the best expert attempt per task as the expert baseline. We evaluate 20 models released between 2023 and 2026. The best-performing model, Opus 5.5, exceeds our expert baseline, with a compute multiplier of 2.3x (95% CI 1.15-4.37), at roughly 1/30 of our baseliners' average per-run cost. On TasteVal, the compute multiplier of frontier models has doubled approximately every 3.0 months since December 2025 (95% CI 1.7-5.0), up from every 14 months between 2023 and December 2025. Measured by final normalized performance, frontier models show no trend break, doubling every 14.6 months. To keep TasteVal uncontaminated, we do not release the tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 TasteVal 基准，用"计算效率"量化前沿模型的实验性研究品味（实验品味≈计算乘数），含 8 个未公开的开放任务，评测 2023–2026 年 20 个模型。
AI.motivation: "研究品味"（选有趣问题、设计实验、解读结果）是影响 AI 进展预测的关键变量，但缺乏可度量的基准。作者希望把其中"实验设计"部分操作化为可比较的定量指标，并作为预测 AI 进展的输入。
AI.method: 将实验品味定义为计算效率：达到与人类专家相同得分所用串行实验算力越少，品味越高，故品味视为实验算力的乘数。为剥离编码能力，采用 Researcher–Coder 分离架构：被测模型作 Researcher 迭代设计实验，固定的 Coder 代理负责实现并回报结果，直到 40 H100 小时或 120 墙钟小时预算耗尽。任务为 8 个新颖、有挑战、开放式的代表性前沿 AI 研发任务；招募 24 名人类专家（每任务≥2 名），取每任务最佳专家尝试作为基线。
AI.result: 评测 20 个 2023–2026 年发布的模型。最优模型 Opus 5.5 超过专家基线，计算乘数 2.3x（95% CI 1.15–4.37），单次运行平均成本约为基线者的 1/30。按计算乘数衡量，2025 年 12 月以来前沿模型约每 3.0 个月翻倍（95% CI 1.7–5.0），此前 2023 至 2025 年 12 月为约每 14 个月翻倍；而按最终归一化性能衡量，则未出现趋势拐点，翻倍周期为 14.6 个月。
AI.conclusion: TasteVal 提供了可量化的实验研究品味基准，显示该能力（计算效率维度）近期加速明显，且与性能维度趋势不同。为防止污染，任务不予公开。

title: BiasFlow: Geometric Monitoring and Backbone Regularization for Spurious Feature Reliance
summary: Worst-group accuracy (WGA) evaluates a trained predictor but does not characterize how its frozen backbone behaves when a new head is learned. We introduce BiasFlow, a hook-based toolkit for monitoring class-attribute centroid alignment (IBMI), within-class centroid separation (W-IBMI), and feature-projection sensitivity. IBMI is confounded by class-attribute correlation and is not a measure of causal feature reliance. We pair these diagnostics with BiasFlow Regularization (BFR), a supervised, composable class-conditional centroid-alignment penalty. W-IBMI verifies the quantity BFR optimizes; it is scale dependent and does not independently establish attribute removal. Across the reported small-scale benchmarks, adding BFR improves or preserves mean WGA, with gains up to +26.0 pp on UrbanCars. The principal independent stress test freezes CelebA-Std backbones and trains fresh heads on biased data: BFR+GroupDRO improves WGA from 40.7% to 64.1%, while Male probe accuracy decreases from 92.5% to 72.2%. Attribute information remains recoverable, and cross-task results are mixed. A controlled synthetic-watermark ImageNet experiment additionally improves watermark-shift accuracy by +23.0 pp under matched training. These results support evaluating centroid geometry and resistance to biased head retraining alongside WGA, within the tested protocols.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BiasFlow 工具包与 BFR 正则化方法，通过类-属性质心对齐（IBMI）等诊断指标监测模型偏差，并在小规模基准与冻结骨干的压力测试中验证其可提升最差组准确率（WGA），同时指出属性信息仍可恢复。
AI.motivation: WGA 仅评估训练完成的预测器，无法刻画冻结骨干在新分类头学习下的行为；且 IBMI 受类-属性相关性混淆，不能作为因果特征依赖的度量，因此需要补充质心几何与抗偏置重训练的评估视角。
AI.method: 提出基于 hook 的 BiasFlow 工具包，监测类-属性质心对齐（IBMI）、类内质心分离（W-IBMI）及特征投影敏感性；并设计 BiasFlow Regularization（BFR），一种有监督、可组合的类条件质心对齐惩罚项。
AI.result: 小规模基准上 BFR 提升或保持平均 WGA，UrbanCars 增益达 +26.0 pp；冻结 CelebA-Std 骨干、在偏置数据上训练新头时，BFR+GroupDRO 将 WGA 从 40.7% 提升至 64.1%，而 Male 探针准确率从 92.5% 降至 72.2%；合成水印 ImageNet 实验在匹配训练下提升水印偏移准确率 +23.0 pp；属性信息仍可恢复，跨任务结果不一。
AI.conclusion: 在测试协议范围内，除 WGA 外，应同时评估质心几何与对偏置头部重训练的抵抗性；但这些诊断指标存在尺度依赖等局限，不能独立证明属性已被移除。

title: Orchestrating Specialized Agents for Trustworthy Enterprise RAG
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) shows promise for enterprise knowledge work, yet it often underperforms in high-stakes decision settings that require deep synthesis, strict traceability, and recovery from underspecified prompts. One-pass retrieval-and-write pipelines frequently yield shallow summaries, inconsistent grounding, and weak mechanisms for completeness verification. We introduce ADORE (Adaptive Deep Orchestration for Research in Enterprise), an agentic framework that replaces linear retrieval with iterative, user-steered investigation coordinated by a central orchestrator and a set of specialized agents. ADORE's key insight is that a structured Memory Bank (a curated evidence store with explicit claim-evidence linkage and section-level admissible evidence) enables traceable report generation and systematic checks for evidence completeness. Our contributions are threefold: (1) Memory-locked synthesis - report generation is constrained to a structured Memory Bank (Claim-Evidence Graph) with section-level admissible evidence, enabling traceable claims and grounded citations; (2) Evidence-coverage-guided execution - a retrieval-reflection loop audits section-level evidence coverage to trigger targeted follow-up retrieval and terminates via an evidence-driven stopping criterion; (3) Section-packed long-context grounding - section-level packing, pruning, and citation-preserving compression make long-form synthesis feasible under context limits. Across our evaluation suite, ADORE ranks first on DeepResearch Bench (52.65) and achieves the highest head-to-head preference win rate on DeepConsult (77.2%) against commercial systems.

AI.tldr: ADORE是一个面向企业知识工作的智能体式RAG框架，用迭代式、用户引导的调研流程替代线性检索，并借助结构化记忆库实现可溯源、可验证的长文本报告生成。
AI.motivation: 高风险决策场景下的企业知识工作对深度综合、严格可溯源性与欠明确提示词的恢复能力要求很高，而现有的一次性检索—撰写式RAG流水线往往产生浅层摘要、依据不一致、缺乏完整性校验机制。
AI.method: ADORE以中央编排器协调多个专用智能体，将线性检索替换为迭代式、用户引导的调研。核心为结构化记忆库（Memory Bank）：包含显式的主张—证据链接与章节级可采纳证据。三项机制：(1) Memory-locked synthesis，报告生成被约束在记忆库（Claim-Evidence Graph）内，支持可溯源主张与有据引用；(2) Evidence-coverage-guided execution，通过检索—反思循环审计章节级证据覆盖度，触发定向补充检索，并以证据驱动的停止准则终止；(3) Section-packed long-context grounding，通过章节级打包、剪枝与保留引用的压缩，使长文本综合在上下文限制下可行。
AI.result: 在评测套件中，ADORE在DeepResearch Bench上排名第一（52.65），并在DeepConsult上取得对商业系统最高的两两偏好胜率（77.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 以结构化记忆库为中心的智能体编排，能够有效提升企业级RAG在高风险决策场景中的可溯源性、证据完整性与长文本综合能力，并优于现有商业系统。

title: Retrieval-Centric Deep Learning in Growing Nonparametric Neural Networks
summary: We investigate a general-purpose layer for deep learning that, instead of compressing arbitrary-size training data into fixed-size weight matrices, stores a new pair of key-value representations for every data point during training, and retrieves and recombines these representations through an attention mechanism at inference time - resulting in a growing neural net (NN). While Irie et al. (arXiv:2202.05798) have put forward this perspective from the classic duality expressing any linear layer in a deep NN trained by gradient descent as linear attention (LA) over the training data points, replacing LA by more powerful attention functions, as they suggest, turns out to be non-trivial: we show that naively applying learning rules from the LA case to advanced kernels does not lead to principled optimization. Here we fill this gap and develop functional gradient-based learning rules for kernelized attention layers, based on radial basis function (RBF) and softmax-like kernels - establishing the principled "retrieval-centric deep learning" (RCDL) paradigm. Empirically, we demonstrate the promising performance and learning-efficiency of RCDL on image classification and synthetic teacher-student learning tasks. Moreover, we show that replacing LA in the dual form of NNs by advanced LA variants, namely MesaNet/DeltaNet, yields a formal connection to recently proposed optimizers for conventional fixed-size NNs, offering a novel perspective on deep learning optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文为核化注意力层建立基于函数梯度的学习规则，提出"以检索为中心"的深度学习范式（RCDL），并揭示其与主流优化器的形式联系。
AI.motivation: 传统深度网络将任意规模的训练数据压缩为固定尺寸权重矩阵。基于线性层与线性注意力（LA）的经典对偶性，可将线性层视为对训练样本的线性注意力，从而得到"随数据增长的神经网络"。但直接将LA的学习规则套用到更强的注意力核上并非原则性优化，存在理论空白。
AI.method: 针对径向基函数（RBF）和类softmax核的核化注意力层，推导基于函数梯度的学习规则，构建RCDL范式；在图像分类与合成师生学习任务上验证；并将NN对偶形式中的LA替换为MesaNet/DeltaNet等高级变体。
AI.result: RCDL在图像分类和师生学习任务上展现出良好的性能与学习效率；将LA替换为MesaNet/DeltaNet后，与近期面向常规固定尺寸NN的优化器建立形式联系。
AI.conclusion: RCDL为核化注意力提供原则性优化框架，弥补了LA到高级核的优化断层，并为深度学习优化提供了新的理论视角。

title: DUET: Co-Evolving Solver and Grader Agents
summary: Agentic workflows are increasingly used across domains such as technology, finance, and enterprise operations. As these agents become more widely deployed, continually improving them becomes increasingly important. This raises an immediate challenge: How should the agent evolve? This evolution requires effective evaluation that can assess outcomes and provide useful feedback for optimization. As the agent evolves, its behaviors and failure modes may also change, making a fixed evaluator increasingly inadequate. Another fundamental question: How should we evaluate an evolving agent? These two challenges are inherently coupled; changes in agent behavior can expose limitations of the current evaluator, while a stronger evaluator provides more informative feedback for improving the agent. Motivated by this interaction, we introduce DUET, a framework that jointly optimizes a solver agent and a grader agent to improve both. DUET iteratively selects training tasks, executes them with the solver, evaluates the resulting outcomes with the grader, and uses a tool-using update module to revise the solver and the grader, alternating between the two across rounds. By updating the grader within the optimization loop, DUET turns evaluation from a fixed source of feedback into a first-class optimization objective that adapts alongside the solver. Experiments across four agent benchmarks show that DUET improves both solver and grader performance and consistently outperforms baselines that optimize the solver with a fixed grader.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DUET 框架，通过在同一优化循环中联合优化求解器智能体（solver）与评分器智能体（grader），实现二者的协同进化，在四个智能体基准上同时提升了两者性能。
AI.motivation: 智能体工作流在技术、金融、企业运营等领域广泛部署，持续改进智能体至关重要。但智能体演化面临两个相互耦合的挑战：一是如何让智能体有效演化，需要可评估结果并提供优化反馈的评估机制；二是智能体行为与失败模式随演化而变化，固定评估器逐渐失效，因此还需回答如何评估一个不断演化的智能体。二者本质耦合：行为变化会暴露评估器局限，而更强的评估器又能为改进智能体提供更有信息量的反馈。
AI.method: DUET 将求解器与评分器视为共同优化对象：迭代地选取训练任务，用 solver 执行任务，用 grader 评估结果，再通过一个可调用工具的更新模块（tool-using update module）对 solver 与 grader 进行修订，并在多轮之间交替更新二者。核心在于把 grader 纳入优化循环，使评估从固定的反馈来源转变为一等的优化目标，与 solver 同步自适应。
AI.result: 在四个智能体基准上的实验表明，DUET 同时提升了 solver 与 grader 的性能，并持续优于使用固定 grader 优化 solver 的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将评估器与求解器联合、交替优化，能够打破“固定评估器—演化智能体”失配的瓶颈，形成评估与改进相互促进的正循环，为持续进化的智能体提供更有效的优化范式。

title: Robust blind unmixing: A geometric approach to overcoming basis variation
summary: Signal separation problems are common in science. A prominent example of this occurs during the use of diffraction or spectroscopy to identify the individual components of a mixture by measuring it. In the simplest case, the measured signal is a linear combination of basis patterns corresponding to the constituent parts. The unmixing problem is to infer all or some of these basis patterns and abundances of components from measurements of distinct mixtures. One of the core challenges of this task is the variation of the basis from mixture to mixture due to noise and the exact physics of the measurement process. This is usually addressed with tailored model-based and parametric methods that are then limited in use to specific application domains by the nature of the assumptions made. We propose a novel geometric approach to unmixing problems which views the generation of data during measurement through a metric space lens, thereby shifting the focus from parametrised models to a general relationship between basis transformations and the corresponding geometry. We take advantage of the optimal transport distances to capture commonly occurring basis variations, and use minimisation of in-class variance of candidate solutions to drive the optimisation. We pay special attention to the one-dimensional case due to its practical importance and availability of efficient distance and transport map routines. The effectiveness of our approach is demonstrated on a range of unmixing tasks using random Gaussian mixture models, simulated powder X-ray diffraction, and laboratory hyperspectral imaging datasets.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于度量空间与最优传输距离的几何化信号解混方法，通过最小化类内方差驱动优化，在一维情形下重点实现，并在高斯混合、X射线粉末衍射与高光谱成像数据上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 信号分离（解混）广泛存在于衍射与光谱测量中：测量信号通常是各组分基模式的线性组合，需从不同混合样本的测量中推断基模式及组分丰度。核心难点在于基模式会因噪声与测量物理过程而在不同混合样本间发生变化；现有方法多依赖定制的模型化、参数化手段，因假设限制而难以跨应用领域通用。
AI.method: 提出一种新的几何化解混视角：以度量空间视角看待测量数据的生成过程，将关注点从参数化模型转向基变换与相应几何之间的通用关系。采用最优传输距离刻画常见的基模式变化，并以候选解类内方差的最小化作为优化驱动。特别关注具有实际重要性且存在高效距离与传输映射算法的一维情形。
AI.result: 在多种解混任务上验证了方法的有效性，包括随机高斯混合模型、模拟粉末X射线衍射数据以及实验室高光谱成像数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该方法摆脱了特定领域的参数化假设，以几何与最优传输为核心构建更通用的解混框架，并在合成与真实类数据上展现出良好效果。

title: Dual-Scale Relational Graph Transformers for Ecosystem-Aware Fraud Detection
comment: This paper has been accepted at the Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (GDDL) workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Account takeover (ATO) fraud is a growing threat to digital banking, requiring effective detection while minimizing friction for legitimate customers. Production systems predominantly rely on tabular models that score sessions in isolation, discarding the relational structure of the underlying interaction network. Although graph-based models exploit relationships among sessions and network entities, they primarily reason over local neighborhoods and therefore capture only part of the problem: fraud risk depends jointly on the local relational structure surrounding a session and the evolving global state of the fraud ecosystem. We present HERMES (HEterogeneous Relational Micro--macro graph transformer Encoder for high-risk Sessions), a dual-scale architecture that jointly models these complementary scales of information. Micro-GT captures local heterogeneous graph structure through structured, relation-aware attention over a temporally safe session neighborhood. Complementing this local representation, Macro-GT models ecosystem-level context using non-anticipative climate tokens that summarize fraud dynamics, platform shifts, and infrastructure reuse, together with adaptive class prototypes that track representative fraud and benign session patterns over time. Evaluated on more than 130 million high-risk transaction sessions from a leading U.S. financial institution, HERMES consistently outperforms production and strong graph-based baselines, achieving a 44.44% relative reduction in customer friction and a 24.66% relative improvement in fraud recall over the production system. Ablation and temporal-stability analyses further demonstrate complementary gains from local relational modeling and global ecosystem context across changing fraud regimes.

AI.tldr: HERMES是一种双尺度异构图Transformer编码器，联合建模会话局部关系结构与欺诈生态全局状态，在1.3亿+高风险交易会话上显著优于生产系统与图基线。
AI.motivation: 数字银行中账户接管（ATO）欺诈检测需在降低合法客户摩擦的同时提升检测效果。生产系统多依赖表格模型，逐会话独立打分，丢弃了交互网络的关系结构；现有图模型虽利用关系，但主要局限于局部邻域推理，忽略了欺诈风险同时取决于会话局部关系结构与欺诈生态的演进全局状态这一事实。
AI.method: 提出HERMES双尺度架构：Micro-GT通过结构化、关系感知的注意力机制，在时间安全的会话邻域上捕捉局部异构图结构；Macro-GT通过非预期的"气候"token（汇总欺诈动态、平台变化、基础设施复用）建模生态级上下文，并结合自适应类原型随时间跟踪代表性欺诈与良性会话模式。
AI.result: 在美国某头部金融机构超过1.3亿高风险交易会话上评估，HERMES持续优于生产系统及强图基线：客户摩擦相对降低44.44%，欺诈召回相对提升24.66%。消融与时间稳定性分析进一步证明局部关系建模与全局生态上下文在不同欺诈态势下具有互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模局部关系结构与全局生态上下文的双尺度设计对ATO欺诈检测有效且稳定，可在显著降低客户摩擦的同时提升召回，具备生产级部署价值。

title: FTD-GNO: Memory-Efficient Graph Neural Operators through Functional Tensor Decomposition of the Kernel
summary: Graph Neural Operators (GNOs) provide flexible surrogate models for learning solution operators of partial differential equations (PDEs). However, standard GNOs typically parameterize the integral kernel with a monolithic neural network and evaluate kernel interactions over graph edges, leading to substantial computational and memory overhead at high resolutions or with large neighborhoods. To address these limitations, we propose Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator (FTD-GNO), a memory-efficient GNO framework that decouples the high-dimensional continuous integral kernel into low-dimensional mode-wise functions. By instantiating the kernel with classical tensor decomposition formats, including CP, Tensor-Train, and Tucker decompositions, FTD-GNO enables algebraic reconstruction of the integral operator without explicitly materializing full edge-wise kernel tensors. This factorized formulation reduces the memory footprint of kernel evaluation and aggregation while retaining the continuous operator-learning structure of GNOs. Theoretical complexity analysis shows that FTD-GNO substantially lowers parameter and activation-memory costs associated with high-dimensional kernel construction. Experiments show lower peak memory than the corresponding unfactorized graph-integral baselines, with shorter recorded training times. Fourier-graph experiments further demonstrate that FTD can improve the efficiency of a graph-integral layer within a hybrid operator and has good scalability.

AI.tldr: 提出FTD-GNO框架，将GNO的连续积分核解耦为低维模态函数，通过CP/TT/Tucker张量分解避免显式物化边核张量，显著降低参数量与激活内存。
AI.motivation: 标准图神经算子（GNO）用单一神经网络参数化积分核并在图边上计算核交互，导致高分辨率或大邻域下计算与内存开销巨大。为此需要一种能在保留连续算子学习结构的同时降低核构造与聚合成本的方法。
AI.method: 提出Functional Tensor Decomposition Graph Neural Operator（FTD-GNO），将高维连续积分核解耦为低维模态函数；以经典张量分解格式（CP、Tensor-Train、Tucker）实例化核，实现对积分算子的代数重构，无需显式materialize完整的边核张量。该因子化形式在保留GNO连续算子学习结构的前提下，降低核评估与聚合的内存占用。
AI.result: 理论复杂度分析表明，FTD-GNO大幅降低高维核构造相关的参数与激活内存成本。实验显示其峰值内存低于对应的未因子化图积分基线，训练时间更短；Fourier-graph实验进一步表明FTD能提升混合算子中图积分层的效率，并具有良好可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: FTD-GNO通过张量分解因子化积分核，在不牺牲连续算子学习结构的情况下实现了内存高效的图神经算子，兼具更低峰值内存、更短训练时间和良好可扩展性，为高分辨率PDE代理建模提供了有前景的方向。

title: What to Preserve in Recursive Computation: A Local Predictive Sufficiency Principle
summary: Recursive computation repeatedly compresses or reuses intermediate states, creating a simple tension: information that must remain useful across longer recursive paths is also exposed to more opportunities for loss before reaching the final prediction. Existing reconstruction or local-prediction objectives provide tractable supervision, but do not ensure that the retained information remains sufficient for subsequent recursive computation. We identify local predictive sufficiency with recursive predictive closure: controlling local predictive deficiencies at individual interfaces controls the resulting discrepancy at the root. We then turn this principle into a tractable training procedure. Starting from a variational characterization, we derive finite predictive tests and an empirical predictive deficiency that measures predictive value retained across compression. Its predictive sensitivities define margin-relaxed half-space constraints on parameter updates, and we project the host optimizer's proposed update onto their intersection only when predictive preservation would otherwise be violated. Across temporal graphs, language memory, vision-language-action control, and recursive self-improvement, the method matches or improves the corresponding host models under matched compression budgets, with larger gains under heavier recursive or memory demands, while better preserving predictive information across successive transformations. Crucially, the same task-agnostic predictive-preservation principle is instantiated across all four settings through host-compatible interventions while keeping the endpoint task, backbone, and evaluation protocol fixed. These results establish predictive preservation at recursive interfaces as a general training principle for recursive compression.

AI.tldr: 提出"递归预测闭包"原则，并据此设计可训练的预测保持约束，用于递归压缩类模型的训练。
AI.motivation: 递归计算反复压缩或复用中间状态，导致需在较长递归路径上保持有用的信息更易在最终预测前丢失。现有重构或局部预测目标虽可提供监督，却不能保证保留下来的信息对后续递归计算仍然充分。
AI.method: 从变分刻画出发，推导有限预测检验与"经验预测缺陷"来度量压缩后保留的预测价值；其预测敏感度定义一组边际松弛的半空间约束，仅当预测保持将被违反时，把宿主优化器提出的更新投影到这些约束的交集上。该方法为任务无关原则，通过宿主兼容的干预实例化，保持端点任务、骨干与评测协议不变。
AI.result: 在时间图、语言记忆、视觉-语言-动作控制与递归自我改进四类场景中，在匹配压缩预算下方法达到或超过对应宿主模型，且在递归或记忆需求更重时增益更大，同时更好地在连续变换间保持预测信息。
AI.conclusion: 将递归接口处的预测保持确立为递归压缩的一般性训练原则。

title: Specific Algorithmic Interpretability of Neural Networks: A Case Study on Textures
summary: We develop a principled framework for constructing neural networks whose specific parameter realizations admit an explicit algorithmic interpretation. Existing algorithm-inspired architectures can explain the computational structure of a network, yet after standard training the learned parameters need not retain a clear relation to the motivating algorithm. We address this gap as follows. First, we model each data point as a sample of a class-dependent stochastic process and assume that statistics of this process can be estimated from a single sample and these statistics are sufficient to distinguish the classes. We then construct a neural network whose initial parameters exactly implement an algorithm for estimating these statistics, making the network fully interpretable. To account for mismatch between the idealized model and real data, we fine-tune this network while controlling its deviation from the algorithmic initialization. The trained network hence roughly retains the interpretation of the initial network. A PAC-Bayesian analysis yields a uniform generalization bound whose complexity term scales with the fine-tuning radius, providing a statistical motivation for our approach. We instantiate the framework for texture classification using the scattering transform to estimate the discriminative statistics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个构造"参数实现可解释算法"的神经网络框架：以类条件随机过程的统计量作为判别依据，用算法初始化网络参数，并在微调时约束偏离初始化的幅度，从而在保持算法解释性的同时适配真实数据，并用PAC-Bayes给出泛化界。
AI.motivation: 现有"算法启发式"架构虽能刻画网络的计算结构，但标准训练后学到的参数未必与所启发的算法保持清晰对应关系，导致可解释性在训练后丢失。作者希望填补这一缺口：让网络的参数实现本身具备显式的算法解释，并在训练后仍大致保留该解释。此外，需要为这种"带偏离约束的微调"提供统计理论依据。
AI.method: 1) 将每个数据点建模为类别相关的随机过程的一次采样，并假设该过程统计量可由单样本估计且足以区分类别；2) 构造一个神经网络，其初始参数精确实现估计这些统计量的算法，使网络完全可解释；3) 为应对理想化模型与真实数据的失配，在微调时控制参数相对算法初始化的偏离（微调半径）；4) 通过PAC-Bayes分析推导一致泛化界，其复杂度项随微调半径缩放；5) 以散射变换（scattering transform）估计判别性统计量，将该框架实例化于纹理分类任务。
AI.result: 作者提出了一个通用框架，并给出了PAC-Bayes泛化界，其复杂度项随微调半径变化，从而为该方法提供统计动机；同时给出了纹理分类的实例化方案（基于散射变换）。摘要层面未报告具体的实验数值或性能对比结果。
AI.conclusion: 通过"算法初始化+受限微调"的设计，网络在训练后仍大致保留对初始算法的解释，兼顾可解释性与对真实数据的适应性；PAC-Bayes界进一步表明控制微调半径可约束复杂度，为该框架提供了理论支撑。该思路可推广到其他可建模为类条件随机过程的判别任务。

title: MaDeL: Manifold-Decomposed Feature Losses for Generative Modeling
summary: Generative models are often trained with isotropic objectives such as mean-squared error. For data concentrated near a low-dimensional manifold, however, such losses conflate displacement along the manifold, which may represent valid variation, with displacement away from it, which produces invalid samples. This mismatch is especially problematic in sparse, highly constrained domains, where ambient-space regression can encourage off-manifold interpolation. We ask whether a generative objective can distinguish manifold-parallel variation from manifold-orthogonal deviation directly from data, without explicitly estimating the manifold. We introduce a manifold-decomposed feature loss (MaDeL) that learns complementary representations from corrupted observations: one is trained to recover the clean sample, while the other is trained to recover the corruption. We show that, under a feature bottleneck, their Jacobians align with the tangent and normal spaces, exactly for linear manifolds and locally for smooth manifolds. Together, these representations define an anisotropic objective that separately measures intrinsic variation and off-manifold deviation. Across synthetic, Earth and climate science, and torsion-angle benchmarks, MaDeL improves support recovery and average angular $W_1$ under single-step sampling; on protein backbones, it reduces steric clashes across one- and few-step sampling budgets.

AI.tldr: 提出流形分解特征损失(MaDeL),通过两个互补表示分别捕获流形切向变化与法向偏离,构成各向异性目标,在稀疏高约束域中改善生成质量。
AI.motivation: 常用各向同性目标(如均方误差)在数据集中于低维流形附近时,无法区分沿流形的位移(有效变化)与离开流形的位移(无效样本),导致离流形插值,这一问题在稀疏、高约束域尤为严重。作者希望无需显式估计流形,直接从数据中区分这两类变化。
AI.method: 提出流形分解特征损失(MaDeL):从受扰观测学习两个互补表示,一个用于恢复干净样本,另一个用于恢复扰动;在特征瓶颈下证明二者雅可比分别对齐切空间与法空间(线性流形精确成立,光滑流形局部成立),据此定义分别度量内在变化与离流形偏离的各向异性目标。
AI.result: 在合成、地球与气候科学、扭转角基准上,MaDeL在单步采样下提升了支撑恢复与平均角度W1;在蛋白质骨架上,于单步与少步采样预算下减少空间位阻冲突。
AI.conclusion: MaDeL为流形结构生成建模提供了无需显式流形估计的分解式目标,在稀疏高约束域中优于各向同性损失。

title: COSMOS: Soft Mechanism Mixtures with Verifiable Routing for Long-Horizon PDE Forecasting
summary:
Neural operators offer an efficient alternative to classical PDE solvers, but most learn a monolithic map per equation family and discretization. Real systems are compositional: transport, diffusion, wave, and reaction processes can act simultaneously. Existing mixture-of-experts operators typically use sparse top-$K$ routing, although concurrent physics is naturally a blend rather than a discrete choice.
  We propose COSMOS (Cooperative Operator Specialists with Mechanism-level Operator Soft-routing), a soft mechanism-mixture neural operator. Four process-biased specialists remain active at every step and are continuously mixed by a learned gate, with their features fused by a small network. Specialists share a coarse latent grid, while a zero-initialized full-resolution residual restores detail lost through the bottleneck. We also introduce an operator-splitting compositional benchmark with known mixture weights $w^\star$ per trajectory.
  Against family-tuned FNO under 20-step rollouts, an initial 3-seed evaluation suggested gains on diffusion--reaction, parity on Navier--Stokes, and weaker shallow-water performance. An 11-seed audit showed that the diffusion--reaction gain was unstable, motivating caution in small-seed rollout comparisons and precluding a reliable accuracy-win claim on these families. Ablations show that uniform routing or removing the specialist mixture substantially degrades stable-regime rollouts. On the labeled benchmark, dense soft routing yields $2.2\times$ lower error than hard top-1 routing at identical fusion; using generator weights $w^\star$ at inference further lowers rollout error to $0.034$, diagnosing limitations of the learned gate. However, routing labels do not align with the specialists' intended mechanisms: COSMOS supports compositional accuracy, not mechanism identity.

AI.tldr: 提出软机制混合神经算子 COSMOS，四类物理过程专家常激活并由学习门控连续混合，配零初始化全分辨率残差；同时提出带已知混合权重的算子分裂组合基准。基准上软路由显著优于硬 top-1，但跨族精度优势不稳定，且路由标签与专家机制身份不对齐。
AI.motivation: 多数神经算子针对单一方程族与离散化学习整体映射，而真实系统具有组合性（输运、扩散、波动、反应可同时发生）。现有专家混合算子多用稀疏 top-K 路由，把并行物理视为离散选择，与物理叠加的本质不符。
AI.method: COSMOS 含四个过程偏置专家，每步均激活，由学习门控连续混合，特征经小网络融合；专家共享粗潜网格，零初始化全分辨率残差补偿瓶颈细节损失。另构建算子分裂组合基准，每条轨迹具已知混合权重 w*。
AI.result: 相对族调优 FNO、20 步滚出：初评 3 种子在扩散-反应上增益、Navier-Stokes 上持平、浅水上偏弱；11 种子复核显示扩散-反应增益不稳定，无法确证精度优势。消融显示均匀路由或移除专家混合显著降低稳定区滚出。基准上密软路由误差比硬 top-1 低 2.2 倍；推理用 w* 可将滚出误差降至 0.034，揭示学习门控局限。路由标签与专家预期机制不对齐。
AI.conclusion: COSMOS 支持组合精度而非机制身份；小种子滚出比较需谨慎，学习门控在机制分配上存在局限。

title: Target-free Latent Safety Alignment
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain highly vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that induce harmful behaviors and circumvent safety alignment. To defend against such attacks, adversarial training paradigms have been proposed to first simulate failure modes and then train the model to correct them, yielding promising improvements in safety alignment. However, these methods typically construct adversarial samples either by encouraging fixed harmful target completions or by performing targeted activation ablation derived from fixed benign--harmful data pairs. As a result, the generated adversarial samples tend to induce homogeneous harmful behaviors that poorly reflect the diversity of behaviors elicited by real-world jailbreak attacks. This behavior-level narrowness fundamentally limits their robustness. To address this issue, we propose a target-free adversarial training framework that generates adversarial samples in an unsupervised manner. By amplifying and diversifying behavior-level shifts in the model's latent space, our approach produces semantically diverse adversarial samples that induce a wide range of harmful behaviors. This expanded behavioral coverage exposes more diverse failure modes and thereby improves safety alignment. To quantify this effect, we use semantic entropy as an output-level measure of adversarial behavioral diversity. Empirically, our method elicits diverse harmful behaviors in the target model, substantially mitigating behavioral narrowness and improving robustness to jailbreak attacks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无目标（target-free）的对抗训练框架，通过在潜空间中放大并多样化行为层面的偏移，以无监督方式生成语义多样的对抗样本，从而缓解现有对抗训练方法的"行为狭窄性"问题，提升模型对越狱攻击的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型仍易受越狱攻击，现有对抗训练方法通过模拟失败模式再纠正来提升安全对齐。但这些方法构造对抗样本时，或依赖固定的有害目标补全，或基于固定的良性—有害数据对进行定向激活消融，导致生成的对抗样本诱发的有害行为高度同质，无法反映真实越狱攻击中行为的多样性；这种行为层面的狭窄性从根本上限制了其鲁棒性。
AI.method: 作者提出无目标对抗训练框架，以无监督方式生成对抗样本：在模型潜空间中放大并多样化行为层面的偏移，从而产生语义多样、能诱发多种有害行为的对抗样本。为量化该效应，采用语义熵作为对抗行为多样性的输出层度量指标。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法能在目标模型中诱发多样的有害行为，显著缓解行为狭窄性问题，并提升对越狱攻击的鲁棒性；语义熵作为度量有效刻画了对抗行为多样性。
AI.conclusion: 通过无监督、无目标地扩展对抗样本的行为覆盖范围，可暴露更多样的失败模式，进而改善安全对齐，为对抗训练提供了一条提升越狱鲁棒性的新思路。

title: Weight Decay and Neuron Condensation: A Three-Stage Analysis of Two-Layer ReLU Networks
summary: Weight decay is widely used as a regularization technique in neural network training, yet its role in neuron condensation (parameter direction alignment) remains unclear. Starting from a parameter initialization in the neural tangent kernel regime, we characterize training dynamics under weight decay through three stages: rapid fitting, amplitude compression, and neuron condensation. Using a two-layer ReLU network, we analyze a residual correlation field that governs both neuron amplitudes and directions. During rapid fitting, the residual approaches a quasi-static equilibrium maintained by weight decay while the tangent kernel remains nearly unchanged. In the early stage of amplitude compression, kernel decay amplifies the residual correlation field, whose isolated attracting extrema provide candidates for condensation directions. As neuron amplitudes stabilize, we bound the drift of attracting extrema and demonstrate contraction of neuron directions around them, leading to neuron condensation. This staged analysis provides a dynamical understanding of how weight decay promotes a condensed representation, beyond reducing parameter norms.

AI.tldr: 该论文从NTK初始化出发，将权重衰减下的训练动力学刻画为快速拟合、幅度压缩和神经元凝聚三个阶段，借助残差相关场揭示权重衰减如何驱动神经元方向对齐（凝聚）。
AI.motivation: 权重衰减虽被广泛用作正则化手段，但其在神经元凝聚（参数方向对齐）中的作用尚不清楚。论文旨在超越"仅减小参数范数"的解释，给出权重衰减促进凝聚表示的动力学理解。
AI.method: 从神经正切核（NTK）体制下的参数初始化出发，采用两层ReLU网络，分析与神经元幅度和方向同时相关的残差相关场；分三阶段分析训练动力学：快速拟合、幅度压缩、神经元凝聚。
AI.result: 快速拟合阶段残差接近由权重衰减维持的准静态平衡，且切核近似不变；幅度压缩早期核衰减放大残差相关场，其孤立吸引极值提供凝聚方向候选；随着神经元幅度稳定，论文给出吸引极值漂移的上界，并证明神经元方向向其收缩，导致神经元凝聚。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段分析提供了权重衰减促进凝聚表示（而非仅缩减参数范数）的动力学解释。

title: Only Project Once: Projection-Adaptive Loss for Exact Constraint Satisfaction
summary: Precise constraint satisfaction is a prerequisite to deploying learned models in many areas, motivating methods that repair raw neural predictions with a repair procedure. Current methods unroll multiple repair steps in training and softly penalize constraint violations that remain after the unroll. This is compute- and memory-intensive, lacks robustness when the repair fails to converge, and surrenders most of the constraint satisfaction work to the repair. Our central finding is that, contrary to common practice, a single detached projection step suffices in training. We accomplish this with a Projection-Adaptive Loss (PAL), which uses the constraint residual after this single step to adaptively weigh constraint penalties on the raw prediction. In experiments, PAL is the only method that retains virtually perfect feasibility on extremely nonlinear constraints, and matches or outperforms current methods on synthetic and engineering benchmarks. Because it only requires a single detached projection step, PAL trains 2.5x faster than the canonical repair-based method (DC3) on its own ACOPF benchmark. PAL can also be trained when constraints are expensive to evaluate (e.g., via neural surrogates), a setting where current unrolled methods are memory-intractable.

AI.tldr: 提出Projection-Adaptive Loss（PAL），证明训练中仅需单个detached投影步即可实现精确约束满足，训练更快且可行性更强。
AI.motivation: 在诸多领域部署学习模型需精确满足约束，现有方法在训练中展开多个修复步骤并软性惩罚剩余违反，导致计算与内存开销大、修复不收敛时缺乏鲁棒性，且把大部分约束满足工作交给修复过程。
AI.method: PAL利用单个detached投影步后的约束残差，自适应地为原始预测上的约束惩罚加权，从而在训练中仅需一次投影即可完成约束满足。
AI.result: 在实验中，PAL是唯一在高度非线性约束下仍保持近乎完美可行性的方法，在合成与工程基准上匹配或超越现有方法；因其仅需单个detached投影步，在ACOPF基准上训练速度比DC3快2.5倍，并可在约束评估昂贵（如神经代理）时训练，而现有展开方法内存不可行。
AI.conclusion: 与常见做法相反，训练中单个detached投影步已足够，PAL在可行性、效率与适用范围上均优于现有修复式方法。

title: Policy as Data: Replay-Based Policy Dual Averaging via Advantage Regression
summary: Actor-critic methods reuse past experience to improve sample efficiency. However, historical data are typically regarded as off-policy samples for the current policy-improvement update. This work introduces Regularized Dual Averaging Actor Critic (RDA2C), which assigns a distinct role to replay. In regularized dual averaging, the subsequent policy is determined by accumulated policy-improvement feedback, so historical advantage estimates contribute directly to the actor objective rather than solely to the most recent update. RDA2C stores state-action samples with critic-estimated advantage labels, fits a dual score model $Z_θ$ to the aggregated dataset, and derives the current policy from the accumulated score model using the entropy mirror map. In this way, replay defines an empirical dual objective from which the policy is computed.
