To analyze RDA2C, we establish a finite-time value-gap decomposition, separating the regularized dual-averaging term from errors due to stale-replay supervised fitting, critic bias, finite-buffer variance, and replay coverage, and stating the assumptions under which each error is bounded. RDA2C accepts advantage labels from any critic. With GAE labels, RDA2C outperforms PPO on six of eight MuJoCo tasks and eight of twelve Atari games. RDA2C also outperforms AAPDA, the closest dual-averaging baseline, on six of eight MuJoCo tasks. With twin-$Q$ labels, RDA2C matches SAC at matched batch size and update frequency.

AI.tldr: 提出RDA2C，将经验回放重新定义为累积对偶目标的构建过程，使历史优势估计直接贡献于actor目标，并给出有限时间值差分解与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 传统actor-critic方法将历史数据视为针对当前策略改进更新的off-policy样本，仅用于最近一次更新，回放数据的价值未被充分利用。本文希望赋予回放数据以独特角色，提升样本效率与稳定性。
AI.method: RDA2C基于正则化对偶平均：存储带critic估计优势标签的状态-动作样本，拟合对偶得分模型$Z_\theta$到聚合数据集，通过熵镜像映射从累积得分模型导出当前策略，使回放定义经验对偶目标。方法兼容任意critic的优势标签（GAE、twin-$Q$等）。
AI.result: 建立有限时间值差分解，将正则化对偶平均项与陈旧回放监督拟合误差、critic偏差、有限缓冲方差、回放覆盖误差分离，并给出各误差有界的假设。使用GAE标签时，在8个MuJoCo任务中的6个和12个Atari游戏中的8个上优于PPO；在8个MuJoCo任务中的6个上优于AAPDA；使用twin-$Q$标签时，在匹配批量与更新频率下与SAC相当。
AI.conclusion: RDA2C通过将回放整合进累积对偶目标，超越了将历史数据仅视为off-policy样本的常规做法，兼具理论保证与跨任务、跨critic标签的良好性能，验证了以回放定义对偶目标这一视角的有效性。

title: EasyClassifier: Honest, Reproducible Machine-Learning Classification for Researchers Who Do Not Program
summary: Machine-learning classification is now used across medicine, the social sciences, economics, education and engineering, very often by researchers who do not program. Two errors recur in such work: preprocessing learned on all rows before cross-validation (data leakage), and reporting the cross-validation score of the classifier that won a comparison (selection bias). Both make published scores optimistic. We present EasyClassifier, an open-source Python package that guides a user from a CSV or Excel file to a finished analysis through a sequence of plain-language, multiple-choice questions, with no code. It makes the correct procedure the default rather than an option: every preprocessing step is learned inside each training fold; the selected classifier receives a separate final score from nested cross-validation (up to 2,000 rows), or an untouched 20% test set; classifiers run with fixed default parameters and fixed random seeds; and every run writes a report with a ready-to-adapt Methods paragraph, the references to cite, and figures prepared for publication. On ten public datasets from seven fields and a random-label control, split in half so that one half served as an untouched external test, the common practice overstated balanced accuracy by 2.9 percentage points on average (up to 9.9 on small data), whereas the score EasyClassifier reports had a mean signed bias of +0.7 points and a mean absolute error of 2.3 points (one-sided Wilcoxon p = 3.2 x 10^{-4}, 30 runs). On random labels it reported 48.8% balanced accuracy against a chance level of 50%. EasyClassifier is available under the MIT license from PyPI (pip install easyclassifier), GitHub, and Zenodo.

AI.tldr: EasyClassifier 是一个无需编程的 Python 开源工具，通过多选问答引导用户完成分类分析，并以"内嵌预处理 + 嵌套交叉验证/独立测试集"的方式默认规避数据泄漏与选择偏差。
AI.motivation: 机器学习分类在医学、社会科学、经济学、教育、工程等领域被大量非编程背景研究者使用，其中两类错误反复出现：交叉验证前在全样本上学习预处理（数据泄漏），以及报告比较中获胜分类器的交叉验证分数（选择偏差），导致已发表分数普遍偏乐观。作者希望把正确流程变为默认设置而非可选项。
AI.method: 提出 EasyClassifier：开源 Python 包，用户从 CSV/Excel 文件出发，通过一系列通俗语言多选问题完成分析，全程无需写代码。其默认流程包括：每个预处理步骤均在每个训练折内部学习；入选分类器由嵌套交叉验证（最多 2,000 行）或未触碰的 20% 测试集给出单独最终分数；分类器使用固定默认参数与固定随机种子；每次运行自动生成报告，含可直接改写的 Methods 段落、应引用文献和出版级图
AI.result: 在来自 7 个领域的 10 个公开数据集及一个随机标签对照上，数据各分一半、其中一半作为未触碰外部测试集：常见做法平均高估平衡准确率 2.9 个百分点（小数据上最高达 9.9）；而 EasyClassifier 报告的分数平均有符号偏差 +0.7 个百分点、平均绝对误差 2.3 个百分点（单侧 Wilcoxon p = 3.2 × 10^{-4}，30 次运行）。在随机标签上，其报告的平衡准确率为 48.8%，而随机水平为 50%。
AI.conclusion: EasyClassifier 通过将正确流程设为默认，有效抑制数据泄漏与选择偏差，报告的分数偏差更小、更接近真实泛化性能，随机标签下接近随机水平。该工具以 MIT 许可证发布于 PyPI（pip install easyclassifier）、GitHub 和 Zenodo。

title: Separating Decision Time from Decision Quality in the Real-Time Gap of Distilled Deciders: Evidence from a Game and a Conveyor Simulator
comment: 80 pages including supplementary material. Submitted to Knowledge-Based Systems
summary: Real-time agents are often evaluated with the world paused, or with decision time rounded to whole ticks (tick conversion). Tick conversion predicts almost no loss for a learned decider whose hit accuracy falls by 14.8 percentage points (pp) on the same games in asynchronous play. We instead split the decider's gap to a zero-latency teacher into time and quality components. In ViZDoom, we train a small decider by imitating a scripted teacher, run the game on wall-clock time, and add a control in which the teacher waits for a call to the decider's server before deciding. On a Windows host, three preregistered studies put the time component at 6.5-8.7 pp and the quality component at 6.3-8.6 pp. On a Linux host that skips 0.08-0.09% of ticks, the time component disappeared (-0.1 pp; paired 95% bootstrap interval [-0.4, 0.0]) while the quality component remained (5.6 pp [3.7, 7.5]). Retraining on teacher-labelled states from the decider's own play (DAgger) improved it on new games on both hosts (2.6 pp [0.4, 4.9] and 3.1 pp [1.1, 5.2]), a preregistered partial success. Imposing one delay schedule on every arm in live play left a quality component of 5.8 pp [4.0, 7.5] on 100 new games, and retraining cut the decider's disagreement with the teacher on its own states from 22.7% to 14.9%. In a conveyor simulator with a 400 ms deadline, delay past it erased the quality component. A latency-matched control whose delays match the decider's shows which remedy to try.

AI.tldr: 将实时决策器相对零延迟教师的表现差距拆分为时间与控制质量两部分，发现在Windows上二者各占约6.5-8.7pp与6.3-8.6pp；在几乎不丢tick的Linux上时间成分消失而质量成分保留；DAgger重训练可部分改善，延迟匹配对照可指示应采取的补救措施。
AI.motivation: 实时智能体常在被暂停的世界中评估，或把决策时间取整到整tick（tick conversion）。但tick conversion几乎预测不出损失：同一决策器在异步实时游玩时命中率实际下降14.8个百分点。作者希望厘清这一被评估方法掩盖的性能差距究竟来自哪些成分，以及哪些补救措施有效。
AI.method: 在ViZDoom中，让小型决策器模仿脚本教师，按墙钟时间运行游戏，并加入"教师等待决策器服务器调用后才决策"的对照。将决策器与零延迟教师的差距分解为时间成分和决策质量成分；在Windows与Linux两种主机上开展三项预注册研究；用DAgger在决策器自身游玩状态上重训练；施加统一延迟调度并在传送带模拟器中用400 ms截止时间测试；设置与被测决策器延迟匹配的latency-matched对照。
AI.result: Windows主机上时间成分为6.5-8.7pp，质量成分为6.3-8.6pp。Linux主机仅跳过0.08-0.09%的tick时，时间成分消失（-0.1pp，配对95% bootstrap区间[-0.4, 0.0]），质量成分仍为5.6pp[3.7, 7.5]。DAgger在两种主机的新游戏上均有改善（2.6pp[0.4, 4.9]与3.1pp[1.1, 5.2]），属预注册的部分成功。在100个新游戏上统一施加延迟后仍残留5.8pp[4.0, 7.5]的质量成分，重训练将决策器在自身状态上与教师的分歧从22.7%降至14.9%。在400 ms截止时间的传送带模拟器中，超过截止的延迟抹除了质量成分。
AI.conclusion: 实时评估中tick conversion会掩盖真实性能损失，把差距拆分为时间与质量成分可揭示其来源；时间成分取决于主机tick丢失情况，质量成分更稳健且可由DAgger部分缓解；延迟匹配对照能帮助判断该采用哪种补救措施。

title: PIT-GCL: Protein Interaction using Topological Graph Contrastive Learning
summary: Protein binding prediction is central to target identification, therapeutic binder design, and large scale screening, yet remains challenging because binding depends on sequence, three dimensional geometry, and global structural organization. Recent folding models such as AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2 have substantially improved structure prediction, but their confidence outputs (pLDDT, pTM, ipTM) are not specifically designed for binary binding prediction, and dedicated structure aware predictors often require bound complex structures that are unavailable at screening scale. We introduce PIT-GCL, a dual tower structure aware framework that encodes each protein independently from its amino acid sequence, Cα point cloud, and a global persistent homology descriptor. Each tower combines residue ESM-2 embeddings with a topological summary computed from the H0 and H1 persistence landscapes of a Vietoris-Rips filtration, and processes the resulting tokens with a structure aware Transformer in which pairwise Cα distances enter as a learned attention bias. A bidirectional cross attention module then performs latent space soft docking between the two per-protein representations, and the model is trained with a combined binary cross entropy and NT-Xent contrastive objective. On three binary interaction prediction benchmarks, general PPI on PPIRef, TCRpMHC binding on STAG, and whole chain pairs on PPB-Affinity, PIT-GCL outperforms representative sequence based, structure aware, and task specific baselines on general PPI under our evaluation, and is the only method above chance on PPB-Affinity; on TCR-pMHC it leads at a fixed decision threshold but is outranked by a task specific sequence model. Because each protein is encoded independently in the first phase, its representation can be precomputed and reused across candidate pairs, which is convenient for large scale screening.

AI.tldr: PIT-GCL是一个双塔结构感知框架，独立编码蛋白质序列、Cα点云与持续同调拓扑描述符，通过结构感知Transformer和双向交叉注意力实现潜在空间软对接，以BCE+NT-Xent联合训练，在PPI与PPB-Affinity基准上优于基线且支持大规模筛选。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质结合预测对靶点识别、治疗性结合剂设计和规模化筛选至关重要，但结合取决于序列、三维几何和全局结构组织，难度大。AlphaFold3、Boltz-2等折叠模型的置信度输出（pLDDT、pTM、ipTM）并非专为二分类结合预测设计，而专门的结构感知预测器通常需要结合态复合物结构，在筛选规模上难以获得。
AI.method: 提出PIT-GCL双塔结构感知框架：每个蛋白质塔从氨基酸序列、Cα点云和全局持续同调描述符独立编码；将残基ESM-2嵌入与由Vietoris-Rips滤流的H0、H1持续景观计算的拓扑摘要结合，输入结构感知Transformer，其中成对Cα距离作为学习到的注意力偏置；随后用双向交叉注意力模块在两个单蛋白表示间进行潜在空间软对接；训练目标为二分类交叉熵与NT-Xent对比损失的组合。
AI.result: 在三个二分类相互作用预测基准上评估：PPIRef上的通用PPI、STAG上的TCR-pMHC结合、PPB-Affinity上的全链对。在本文评估下，PIT-GCL在通用PPI上优于代表性序列类、结构感知类及任务专用基线；在PPB-Affinity上是唯一超过随机水平的方法；在TCR-pMHC上于固定决策阈值下领先，但被任务专用序列模型超越。
AI.conclusion: 由于第一阶段每个蛋白质独立编码，其表示可预计算并在候选对之间复用，便于大规模筛选。拓扑与结构感知结合的双塔设计在通用PPI和全链对任务上表现突出，但在特定任务上任务专用模型仍具竞争力。

title: Greedy Local Learning for Language Model Pretraining: Gaps and Objective Design
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Collaborative, Open, and Decentralized Training of Foundation Models (CODEC-FM). 13 pages, 3 figures, 8 tables
summary: Greedy block-wise local learning splits a network into gradient-isolated blocks trained by local auxiliary losses, deleting the backward pass between blocks: inter-stage communication becomes forward-only and every block can step its optimizer independently, properties directly relevant to decentralized model-parallel training. Local learning is competitive with end-to-end backpropagation on image classification, and on small Transformers it is known to trade a worse best loss for parallel speedup. How this loss gap behaves in autoregressive language model (LM) pretraining at larger scale, and which auxiliary designs reduce it, has not been measured. We present a token-budget-matched empirical study at 125M and 400M parameters with $K \in \{1,2,4\}$ blocks at Chinchilla-optimal budgets, factorizing the auxiliary design into network architecture and training objective. We observe: (i) the gap to end-to-end training more than doubles from $K=2$ to $K=4$, but at $K=4$ shrinks from 125M to 400M; (ii) replacing an MLP auxiliary with a Transformer-based one is a strong network-side intervention, recovering 22-41% of the gap; (iii) a multi-token-prediction (MTP) auxiliary objective helps at the first block boundary, whereas adding it at deeper boundaries hurts, and restricting it to the first block yields the best $K=4$ configuration ($+0.062$ vs. $+0.075$ nats at 400M); and (iv) deployment-style per-block execution reduces activation memory by up to $2.2\times$. We frame these results as an empirically grounded method direction rather than a finalized method: local objectives should apply future-predictive pressure selectively across boundaries while resisting shortcuts that bypass predictive content.

AI.tldr: 本文在125M与400M参数、K∈{1,2,4}个梯度隔离块、Chinchilla最优token预算下，系统研究了贪心分块局部学习在自回归语言模型预训练中的损失差距，并拆分辅助设计为架构与目标两方面，给出了可操作的方法方向。
AI.motivation: 贪心分块局部学习通过将网络切分为梯度隔离的块、以局部辅助损失独立训练，使块间通信变为纯前向、各块可独立推进优化器，天然契合去中心化模型并行训练。已有工作显示其在图像分类上可与端到端反向传播竞争，在小型Transformer上以更差的最优损失换取并行加速，但在更大规模自回归语言模型预训练中该损失差距如何变化、何种辅助设计能缩小差距，尚缺乏测量。
AI.method: 开展token预算对齐的实证研究：模型规模125M与400M，块数K∈{1,2,4}，训练预算为Chinchilla最优；将辅助设计分解为网络架构（如MLP辅助 vs. Transformer辅助）与训练目标（如多token预测MTP辅助）两个维度进行对照实验，并测量部署式逐块执行下的激活内存占用。
AI.result: (i) 与端到端训练的损失差距从K=2到K=4增加一倍以上，但在K=4时从125M到400M有所缩小；(ii) 用基于Transformer的辅助模块替换MLP辅助是强有力的网络侧干预，可回收22%–41%的差距；(iii) MTP辅助目标在第一个块边界有效，而在更深的边界加入反而有害，仅限第一块使用时取得最佳K=4配置（400M下+0.062 vs. +0.075 nats）；(iv) 部署式逐块执行可将激活内存降低至多2.2倍。
AI.conclusion: 本文将结果定位为有实证支撑的方法方向而非最终方法：局部目标应选择性地在块边界施加未来预测压力，同时抑制绕过预测性内容的捷径。

title: ResOPD: Tail Residualization for Sparse On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on self-generated trajectories, but transmitting dense teacher distributions across long reasoning traces creates prohibitive communication and memory bottlenecks. Practical systems therefore rely on sparse teacher interfaces, typically transmitting either the sampled-token score or a small Top-$k$ distribution. However, this sparse setting faces a fundamental dilemma: sampled-token estimators are unbiased but suffer from severe gradient variance, whereas directly optimizing Top-$k$ objectives introduces systematic bias. To improve this trade-off, we propose ResOPD (On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization), which provides unbiased full-vocabulary reverse KL gradient estimation under on-policy sampling, with substantial variance reduction under the same sparse payload in the evaluated settings. ResOPD aggregates the unobserved vocabulary into an observable coarse tail event, computes its exact aggregate gradient, and samples only the fine-grained within-tail residual, which requires no additional teacher queries or forward passes. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ResOPD substantially reduces gradient variance, stabilizes online training dynamics, and improves downstream performance across the evaluated settings. These results establish ResOPD as an efficient, plug-and-play variance reduction primitive for sparse on-policy distillation.

AI.tldr: ResOPD通过尾部残差化，在稀疏教师接口下实现无偏的全词表反向KL梯度估计，并显著降低方差。
AI.motivation: 同策略蒸馏（OPD）中，跨长推理轨迹传输稠密教师分布会造成严重的通信与内存瓶颈，因此实际系统采用稀疏教师接口（采样token得分或小Top-k分布）。但该稀疏设定存在根本性两难：采样token估计器无偏却梯度方差极大，直接优化Top-k目标则引入系统偏差。论文旨在改善这一权衡。
AI.method: 提出ResOPD（On-Policy Distillation with Tail Residualization）。其核心是将未观测词表聚合为一个可观测的粗粒度尾部事件，计算其精确的聚合梯度，并仅对尾部内部的细粒度残差进行采样；该过程无需额外的教师查询或前向传播。
AI.result: 在同策略采样下提供无偏的全词表反向KL梯度估计，在相同稀疏载荷下实现了显著的方差降低；实验表明其大幅降低梯度方差、稳定在线训练动态，并在所评估设定中提升下游性能。
AI.conclusion: ResOPD是一种高效、即插即用的稀疏同策略蒸馏方差缩减基元。

title: SFlexRCA: Lightweight, Scalable, and Flexible Root Cause Analysis for IIoT Edge Systems
summary: Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) systems generate high-dimensional sensor telemetry from interconnected components, where faults can propagate across the system. To address these challenges, we propose SFlexRCA (Scalable and Flexible Root Cause Analysis), a topology-free RCA framework designed for resource-constrained IIoT environments. SFlexRCA transforms multivariate telemetry into compact orthogonal representations and applies shared lightweight linear modeling, avoiding explicit graph construction, message passing, and per-variable or lag-specific parameter growth. We evaluate SFlexRCA on three publicly available IIoT datasets, BATADAL, SWaT, and WADI, spanning different numbers of monitored variables, temporal characteristics, and training-data regimes. SFlexRCA is compared with 10 statistical, causal, and non-causal baselines in terms of RCA accuracy, training efficiency, inference latency, and memory consumption. In addition, inference efficiency and memory consumption are evaluated on Raspberry Pi 3 and Raspberry Pi 5, while energy consumption is additionally measured on Raspberry Pi 5. We further investigate temporalcontext sensitivity, architectural and loss components, and alternative representations. Notably, SFlexRCA maintains strong localization performance on BATADAL despite its limited normal-operation training data, while its compact shared architecture avoids the parameter growth associated with causal and graph-based approaches. Its lightweight shared architecture further enables efficient deployment on resource-constrained IIoT edge devices. The SFlexRCA code is available at https://github.com/theamrzaki/RootCause- Analysis-Correlation-Attentive-Modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出无拓扑依赖的工业物联网根因分析框架SFlexRCA，通过正交化多变量遥测与轻量共享线性建模实现高效RCA，并在三个公开数据集及树莓派边缘设备上验证其精度与效率优势。
AI.motivation: IIoT系统产生高维传感器遥测数据，故障可在互联组件间传播，给根因定位带来挑战；同时工业现场边缘设备资源受限，传统因果或图神经网络方法依赖显式图构建、消息传递，且参数量随变量数与滞后阶数增长，难以满足可扩展性与部署效率需求。
AI.method: SFlexRCA将多变量遥测转换为紧凑的正交表示，并采用共享的轻量线性建模，避免显式图构建、消息传递以及按变量或滞后特定参数增长，从而构建无拓扑依赖、可扩展且灵活的根因分析框架。
AI.result: 在BATADAL、SWaT和WADI三个公开IIoT数据集上，与10种统计、因果及非因果基线方法比较RCA精度、训练效率、推理延迟与内存占用；在Raspberry Pi 3和Raspberry Pi 5上评估推理效率与内存消耗，并在Pi 5上测量能耗。SFlexRCA在BATADAL正常训练数据有限情况下仍保持较强定位性能，其紧凑共享架构避免了因果与图方法中的参数膨胀，并可在资源受限边缘设备上高效部署。
AI.conclusion: SFlexRCA是一种适用于资源受限IIoT环境的高效根因分析框架，兼顾定位精度与部署效率，代码已开源。

title: ScopeSAE: Model-Scope Feature Discovery with Interpretable Layer Selection
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are a central tool in mechanistic interpretability. However, existing SAEs are primarily trained per layer. The modeling subspace is therefore fixed by layer identity, independent of which token-layer states actually drive each prediction. We argue that this constraint contributes to several limitations observed in layer-wise SAEs, including low feature utilization, high dictionary redundancy, and features that lack direct behavioral grounding. In this paper, we propose ScopeSAE, which selects the modeling subspace per token by attributing each prediction to its most influential token-layer state via normalized gradient-based attribution, and learns features over the resulting prediction-relevant subspace. Empirically, ScopeSAE yields an effect we term reconstruction-better-than-original. Written-back reconstructions of the SAE produce lower next-token cross-entropy than the original activations, an outcome that, to our knowledge, has not previously been reported for SAEs. Through interventional analyses and a KL fine-tuning counter-experiment, we show that this effect is attributable to ScopeSAE's prediction-relevant subspace itself rather than to architectural changes. ScopeSAE further improves effective feature count, interpretability, utilization, and dictionary redundancy over existing layer-based baselines, suggesting that choosing the SAE modeling subspace by predictive relevance leads to more useful and behaviorally meaningful features.

AI.tldr: 提出 ScopeSAE，按 token 通过归一化梯度归因选择与预测最相关的 token-层状态作为建模子空间来训练稀疏自编码器，从而缓解逐层 SAE 的特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺乏行为依据等问题，并首次报告了"重建优于原始"的现象。
AI.motivation: 现有 SAE 主要按层训练，建模子空间由层身份固定，与实际驱动每个预测的 token-层状态无关。作者认为这一约束导致了逐层 SAE 的若干局限：特征利用率低、字典冗余高、特征缺乏直接的行为依据。
AI.method: 提出 ScopeSAE：对每个预测，通过归一化梯度归因将其归因到最具影响力的 token-层状态，从而为每个 token 选择建模子空间，并在该"预测相关子空间"上学习特征（而非按层固定子空间）。
AI.result: 观察到"重建优于原始"（reconstruction-better-than-original）效应：SAE 重建写回后产生的下一 token 交叉熵低于原始激活，据作者所知此前未在 SAE 中报道过。通过干预分析和 KL 微调对照实验，证明该效应源自 ScopeSAE 的预测相关子空间本身，而非架构改动。相比逐层基线，ScopeSAE 在有效特征数、可解释性、利用率和字典冗余上均有改善。
AI.conclusion: 按预测相关性选择 SAE 建模子空间可得到更有用、更具行为意义的特征，说明子空间选择方式是 SAE 质量的关键因素。

title: Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery
summary: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.

AI.tldr: 该论文探究潜隐学习（subliminal learning）为何需要大量载体样本，提出将潜隐向量蒸馏视为带噪线性逆问题，发现软监督（KL）比硬监督（NLL）样本效率高得多，并解释了其机理。
AI.motivation: 已发表的潜隐学习演示通常需要数万个载体样本，才能让学生模型从语义无关数据中继承教师的行为特质。作者希望弄清这种数据需求量从何而来，并找到降低样本需求的方法。
AI.method: 构建“潜隐引导”测试平台：教师特质为已知残差流向量 Δ_T，直接以参数恢复程度衡量迁移。在相同载体前缀下，比较 token 级硬 NLL 监督与全分布软 KL 监督。理论分析将引导向量蒸馏建模为带噪线性逆问题，指出局部载体任务通过 Fisher 矩阵 F 映射特质，梯度指向 FΔ_T 而非 Δ_T，梯度下降扮演 F 的逐步减弱阻尼逆。
AI.result: 初始化时两目标梯度近乎共线且与 Δ_T 对齐差；迭代优化后二者分化：软监督仅用数百载体即可近乎精确恢复 Δ_T，硬监督即使数万样本仍远低于此。Qwen2.5-7B 与 Gemma-2-9B 实验验证四项预测：初始梯度的 Fisher 畸变、按从陡到平方向的恢复顺序、随数据规模移动的最优深度，以及从固定提示池重采样补全与新增提示同样有效。
AI.conclusion: 在此设定下，大载体数据集的主要作用并非揭示特质，而是抑制被 Fisher 逆放大后的标签噪声。软监督通过恢复低曲率方向实现高样本效率，为潜隐学习的数据效率问题提供了机理解释。

title: TSAE: Structured Sparse Autoencoders for Interpreting Time-Series Forecasting Models
summary: Time-series forecasting informs critical decisions in energy dispatch, industrial operations, and environmental monitoring; understanding the patterns models rely on is essential for assessing reliability and identifying failures. Input attribution identifies important variables and time segments but offers limited insight into internal features, while standard sparse autoencoder (SAE) objectives do not directly constrain cross-variable structure or temporal continuity. We introduce TSAE, a structured sparse autoencoder for forecasting representations that decomposes hidden states into individually inspectable features. TSAE organizes cross-variable structure through shared and variable-routed private dictionaries, separates feature detection from magnitude estimation with gated encoding, and constrains neighboring sparse-code changes according to raw-segment similarity. These mechanisms support analysis of variable context, activation strength, and temporal evolution. Forecast-consistency fine-tuning further improves preservation of the frozen forecaster's outputs. The accompanying TSEVAL protocol separately audits fidelity, feature coherence, and physical calibration to ground feature interpretation. In three-seed experiments with frozen PatchTST on ETTh1, ETTh2, and ETTm1, TSAE achieves the lowest hidden-state reconstruction error, normalized forecast-reconstruction error (NFRE), and feature transition rate among five SAEs at comparable per-token activity. NFRE decreases by 4.3-26.4% relative to the next-best mean. Dataset-dependent tradeoffs in selectivity, physical correlation, and calibration show that fidelity and temporal-stability gains require independent semantic validation to support feature interpretation.

AI.tldr: 提出 TSAE 结构化稀疏自编码器，将预测模型隐状态分解为可解释特征，并配 TSEVAL 评估协议，在 ETT 数据集上取得更低重构误差与特征切换率。
AI.motivation: 时间序列预测广泛用于能源调度、工业运营与环境监测，需理解模型依赖的模式以评估可靠性。输入归因只能识别重要变量与时间段，难以解释内部特征；标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）目标未直接约束跨变量结构与时序连续性。
AI.method: TSAE 将隐状态分解为可逐一检视的特征：通过共享字典与变量路由的私有字典组织跨变量结构；以门控编码分离特征检测与幅度估计；依据原始片段相似性约束相邻稀疏编码的变化。另采用预测一致性微调，保持冻结预测器输出；并设计 TSEVAL 协议，分别审计保真度、特征一致性与物理校准。
AI.result: 在冻结 PatchTST、ETTh1/ETTh2/ETTm1 三数据集、三种子实验中，TSAE 在可比单 token 活跃度下，于五种 SAE 中取得最低隐状态重构误差、归一化预测重构误差（NFRE）与特征切换率；NFRE 相比次优均值下降 4.3%–26.4%。选择性、物理相关性与校准存在数据集相关权衡。
AI.conclusion: TSAE 在保真度与时序稳定性上优于基线 SAE，但其特征语义解释仍需独立验证，因为保真度提升不必然对应物理或语义正确性。

title: D-DOIT: Training-free Adaptation of Discrete Diffusion via Doob's h-Transform
summary: We propose D-DOIT (Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation), a training-free and efficient adaptation method for discrete diffusion models with generic rewards. D-DOIT formulates adaptation as sampling from a reward-tilted target distribution and realizes this transport through Doob's h-transform of the discrete diffusion reverse kernel, using only reward values rather than reward gradients. Unlike continuous diffusion, masked discrete diffusion samples categorical token-reveal transitions rather than continuous state updates. D-DOIT derives the corresponding discrete Doob's h-transform, which guides sampling by reweighting reverse transition probabilities instead of adding a drift correction. To make this transformation practical, D-DOIT avoids expensive future rollouts. At each guided step, D-DOIT samples candidate next states, uses the model prediction head to complete each candidate into a clean sequence, evaluates each completion with the reward oracle, and resamples the next state with probabilities proportional to the rewards. An optional late-stage best-of-K refinement further improves sample quality by branching trajectories only near the end of denoising, avoiding the $K$-fold cost over the full trajectory. Empirically, across regulatory DNA design and protein inverse folding benchmarks, D-DOIT outperforms training-free guidance baselines. It improves enhancer activity and cell-type specificity while preserving sequence naturalness, and achieves the highest success rate in protein inverse folding.

AI.tldr: D-DOIT是一种面向离散扩散模型的免训练适配方法，通过离散Doob h-变换将采样子引导至奖励倾斜分布，仅用奖励值而非梯度，并结合候选完成与重采样及末期best-of-K精修，在调控DNA设计和蛋白质逆折叠任务上优于免训练引导基线。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散模型（尤其是掩码式）在生成中难以适配通用奖励：连续扩散的引导方法依赖梯度或连续漂移修正，不适用于分类式token揭示转移；同时基于未来轨迹展开的引导代价高昂。因此需要一种免训练、高效且只需奖励值的通用适配方法。
AI.method: 提出D-DOIT（Discrete Doob-Oriented Inference-time Transformation），将适配形式化为从奖励倾斜目标分布中采样，并通过离散扩散反向核的Doob h-变换实现该传输。方法推导了对应的离散Doob h-变换，通过重加权反向转移概率（而非添加漂移修正）来引导采样。为避免昂贵的未来展开，在每个引导步采样候选下一状态，用模型预测头将各候选补全为干净序列，用奖励oracle评估各补全结果，并按与奖励成正比的概率重采样下一状态。另可选末期best-of-K精修，仅在去噪后段分支轨迹以提升质量，避免全轨迹K倍开销。
AI.result: 在调控DNA设计与蛋白质逆折叠基准上，D-DOIT优于免训练引导基线：在保持序列自然性的同时提升增强子活性和细胞类型特异性，并在蛋白质逆折叠中取得最高成功率。
AI.conclusion: D-DOIT为离散扩散模型提供了一种免训练、仅依赖奖励值的通用奖励引导框架，其核心是通过离散Doob h-变换重加权反向转移概率，并借助候选补全重采样与末期best-of-K精修实现高效实用化，实验验证了其在生物序列设计任务上的有效性。

title: A Graph-Based Inspection and Intervention Tool for Assessing Mechanistic Learning in PINNs
comment: This is a developmental work which was submitted to NeurIPS workshops. Useful feedback was obtained and an improved version is being developed
summary: We ask whether physically meaningful correspondences discovered inside a trained scientific model remain meaningful outside the conditions under which they were discovered. We introduce GIIT (Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool), which represents governing physics as a computational physics dependency graph, maps graph nodes to internal network components via sensitivity- and trend-based discovery, and tests the resulting mapping under targeted intervention. Evaluating on temporal extrapolation out-of-distribution (OOD) regimes of increasing severity, we find that temporal extrapolation is associated with layer-wise correspondence drift and reduced functional correspondence. Specifically, while the model achieves low physics residual in-distribution (1.915 x 10-4 on full ID and 1.01 x 10-4 on an ID sub-window t in [0.5, 0.8]), the functional mapping changes even before leaving the training domain, and the shift continues as the evaluation window extends beyond the training domain: residual error increases from 2.81 x 10-2 on the boundary-crossing window (t in [0.5, 1.5]) to 3.30 x 10-1 on severe OOD (t in [1, 2]), accompanied by a systematic leftward shift of internal layer mappings, where the average winner layer index drops from 5.71 (ID) to 3.00 (ID sub-window) down to 2.29 (severe OOD). Only 2 of 7 physical nodes maintain stable layer assignments across the boundary-crossing window, and only 1 of 7 under severe extrapolation, revealing potential internal functional correspondence changes before severe degradation in conventional output metrics. Additional results for linear oscillatory systems are further detailed in the appendix.

AI.tldr: 提出GIIT工具，用计算物理依赖图检验科学模型内部物理对应关系在时空外推OOD下的稳定性，发现层映射漂移与功能对应退化先于输出指标显著恶化。
AI.motivation: 探究在训练条件内发现的物理有意义对应关系，在训练条件之外是否仍然成立，即模型内部学到的物理结构在外推分布下能否保持功能一致性。
AI.method: GIIT（Graph-based Inspection and Intervention Tool）：将支配物理表示为计算物理依赖图，通过敏感性与趋势发现把图节点映射到网络内部组件，并在定向干预下检验该映射；在递增严重程度的时序外推OOD区间上评估。
AI.result: ID下物理残差极低（全ID 1.915×10⁻⁴，ID子窗口t∈[0.5,0.8]为1.01×10⁻⁴），但功能映射在离开训练域前已改变；残差随外推窗口增大从跨界窗口(t∈[0.5,1.5])的2.81×10⁻²升至严重OOD(t∈[1,2])的3.30×10⁻¹，伴随内部层映射系统性左移，平均获胜层索引从5.71(ID)降至3.00(ID子窗口)再到2.29(严重OOD)；仅7个物理节点中2个在跨界窗口保持稳定层分配，严重外推下仅1个。
AI.conclusion: 时序外推与逐层对应漂移和功能对应性下降相关；内部功能对应变化可在传统输出指标严重退化之前被探测到，提示仅凭残差等输出指标不足以确认模型物理对应关系的可靠性。

title: Software World Models: From Consequence Prediction to Decision Value
summary: A coding agent may safely modify one repository while silently breaking downstream services, libraries, or datastores that depend on it. Exhaustively running integration tests after every agent action is impractical, so the agent must predict these failures before executing them. Existing software world models predict the agent's own observations, while static change-impact analysis only identifies where a change may propagate. We instead introduce the Software World Model (SWM), which models the broader system affected by a code change and predicts its blast set: the components that the change will break. SWM follows three stages: explore, learn, and act. Explore executes candidate changes from restored system states, prioritizing regions where observed failures contradict the dependency graph. Learn fine-tunes a language model on these execution outcomes to predict downstream breakage. Act converts sampled predictions into per-consumer break probabilities for change ranking, proactive migration, and deciding when another execution is worth its cost. On held-out synthetic systems, SWM improves blast-set F1 from 0.431 for static reachability to $0.571\pm0.037$, more than halves ranking regret, and improves migration return at all nine evaluation checkpoints. The two methods are complementary: reachability is stronger on dependencies represented in the graph, while SWM recovers failures caused by couplings the graph misses. Experiments on held-out real libraries further show that predicting structured failure outcomes, rather than only scalar risk, is important for downstream decision quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出软件世界模型（SWM），通过"探索—学习—行动"三阶段预测代码变更的"爆炸集"（将被变更破坏的组件），在合成系统上优于静态可达性分析，并能支撑变更排序与主动迁移决策。
AI.motivation: 编码代理在修改某个仓库时，可能悄无声息地破坏依赖它的下游服务、库或数据存储。每次动作后都跑集成测试不现实，因此代理必须在执行前预测这类失败。现有软件世界模型只预测代理自身的观测，静态变更影响分析只识别变更可能传播的范围，二者都未直接预测"会破坏什么"。
AI.method: SWM 分三阶段：探索（Explore）——从恢复的系统状态出发执行候选变更，优先探索观测到的失败与依赖图相矛盾的区域；学习（Learn）——在这些执行结果上微调语言模型以预测下游破坏；行动（Act）——将采样预测转化为每个消费者的破坏概率，用于变更排序、主动迁移以及判断是否值得再执行一次。
AI.result: 在留出的合成系统上，SWM 将爆炸集 F1 从静态可达性的 0.431 提升到 0.571±0.037，排序遗憾（ranking regret）降低一半以上，并在全部九个评估检查点上提升迁移收益。两种方法互补：可达性在图中已表示的依赖上更强，SWM 能恢复图遗漏的耦合导致的失败。真实库实验进一步表明，预测结构化的失败结果（而非仅标量风险）对下游决策质量很重要。
AI.conclusion: SWM 把变更影响预测从"传播范围"推进到"破坏集合"，通过学习执行结果捕捉依赖图之外的隐性耦合，为变更排序、主动迁移和测试成本权衡提供可操作的概率预测；与静态可达性分析互补而非替代。

title: TempoBridge: Source-Conditioned Flow Matching with Optimal Transport Couplings for Single-Cell Population Transitions
summary: Destructive single-cell measurements provide unpaired population snapshots rather than observations of the same cells across conditions. Local cell states and transition requests may also be insufficient to distinguish responses across source populations. We introduce TempoBridge, a common source-conditioned transport formulation for temporal, genetic, and chemical population transitions. Source cells initialize latent transport and provide a fixed empirical population summary. The velocity field receives this summary alongside the evolving cell state, flow time, and a structured transition descriptor. Minibatch optimal transport (OT) supplies couplings only for conditional flow-matching training paths; inference requires neither target expression nor OT computation. On held-out donors, TempoBridge achieves an Energy distance of 0.129 versus 0.144 for scGen. Genetic mean-expression $L_2$ error is 2.261 versus 3.156 for scGPT-scratch under Seen 2/2. On held-out compounds, condition-averaged drug-effect correlation is 0.598 versus 0.561 for the CellFlow adapter. Temporal ablations show higher mean distributional error after removing source context, replacing optimal transport with random pairing, or replacing flow matching with static residual regression. Together, these results demonstrate the predictive utility of a common source-conditioned transport formulation across held-out donors, gene combinations, and compounds.

AI.tldr: TempoBridge：一种源条件化共同传输框架，用于时序、遗传与化学扰动下的单细胞群体预测。
AI.motivation: 破坏性单细胞测序只能得到非配对的群体快照，无法追踪同一细胞在条件间的变化；局部细胞状态与转移请求不足以区分不同源群体的响应差异。
AI.method: 提出共同源条件化传输（common source-conditioned transport）表述。源细胞初始化潜空间传输并提供固定的经验群体摘要；速度场同时接收该摘要、演化中的细胞状态、流时间及结构化转移描述符。小批量最优传输（OT）仅用于构造条件流匹配的训练路径，推断阶段无需目标表达数据或OT计算。
AI.result: 留出供体上Energy距离0.129（scGen 0.144）；遗传平均表达L2误差2.261（scGPT-scratch 3.156，Seen 2/2）；留出化合物上条件平均药效相关性0.598（CellFlow适配器0.561）。时序消融显示：移除源上下文、以随机配对替代OT、或以静态残差回归替代流匹配，都会提高平均分布误差。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明该源条件化共同传输表述在留出供体、基因组合与化合物上均具有预测实用性。

title: EDISCO: Equivariant DIScrete Diffusion for Euclidean Combinatorial Optimization
comment: 45 pages, 8 figures, 18 tables, accepted to NeurIPS 2026
summary: Euclidean combinatorial optimization problems (ECOPs), such as the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP) and Capacitated Vehicle Routing Problem (CVRP), possess inherent symmetries under the two-dimensional Euclidean group E(2), including rotations, reflections, and translations. Existing learning-based methods, including recent diffusion-based methods, rely on data augmentation or regularization to approximate E(2)-equivariance. This paper presents EDISCO, the first discrete diffusion model for ECOPs with exact E(2)-invariant generative distributions over node-index solutions. EDISCO introduces an E(2)-equivariant edge-score network coupled with a categorical continuous-time Markov chain over discrete edge variables, and exact posterior sampling provides efficient multi-step inference. This design gives EDISCO a local geometric inductive bias: edge neighborhoods with the same relative geometry and combinatorial context are represented consistently regardless of absolute position or orientation, making learning more efficient and inference more robust than non-equivariant methods. EDISCO outperforms previous learning-based state-of-the-art solvers on synthetic TSP from 100 to 10000 nodes and CVRP from 50 to 2000 customers, while using only 33-50% of the training instances. Trained only on uniform synthetic data, EDISCO also outperforms competing learning-based baselines under spatial distribution shift and CVRP constraint-tightness shift. Code is available at https://github.com/ValleyC/EDISCO.

AI.tldr: EDISCO 是首个具备精确 E(2) 不变生成分布的离散扩散模型，用于欧氏组合优化问题，在 TSP 与 CVRP 上以更少训练数据超越现有学习型求解器。
AI.motivation: TSP、CVRP 等欧氏组合优化问题在二维欧氏群 E(2)（旋转、反射、平移）下具有内在对称性，但现有学习方法（含扩散方法）仅通过数据增强或正则化近似 E(2) 等变性，未真正利用该对称性，导致学习效率与推理鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: 提出 EDISCO：在离散边变量上构建分类连续时间马尔可夫链，并设计 E(2) 等变的边评分网络，使节点索引解的生成分布精确满足 E(2) 不变性；通过精确后验采样实现高效多步推理，形成局部几何归纳偏置——相对几何与组合上下文相同的边邻域表征一致，与绝对位置和朝向无关。
AI.result: 在合成 TSP（100–10000 节点）与 CVRP（50–2000 客户）上优于此前学习型最优求解器，且仅使用 33–50% 的训练实例；仅用均匀合成数据训练时，在空间分布偏移与 CVRP 约束紧度偏移下仍优于竞争的学习型基线。
AI.conclusion: 精确 E(2) 不变性为欧氏组合优化提供了更强的归纳偏置，使模型在数据效率、求解质量和分布/约束偏移下的鲁棒性上均优于非等变方法；代码已开源。

title: Operational Abstractions of Neural Network Concepts via Topological Representations
summary: Concept-based methods provide a semantic level for interpreting and manipulating learned representations, but existing editing approaches are typically specialized to particular interventions and do not provide a common and editable representation of concept organization. To achieve this, we introduce Topological Concept Representations (TCR), a post-hoc operational abstraction that jointly characterizes the concepts encoded in a learned representation and their relationships. TCR constructs an intermediate concept space from concept recoverability and interaction scores, and compactly encodes its organization through topology. Interventions are expressed through modifications of this abstraction that are propagated back to the underlying learned representation. This allows different concept-level operations to share the same optimization framework and separates the desired concept organization from the mechanism to achieve it. We establish stability and reparameterization-invariance properties of TCR and its connections to existing concept-editing formulations. We use TCR to disentangle concepts as a preprocessing step for existing erasure methods, improving worst-group accuracy by 21.89 on average at comparable concept leakage. We further use TCR to transfer concepts from teacher to student models, improving concept recoverability by up to 5.54 while also improving or maintaining competitive test top-1 accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拓扑概念表示（TCR），一种事后可操作的抽象，联合刻画学习表示中的概念及其关系，并统一概念级编辑操作，在下游解耦与概念迁移任务中取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有基于概念的方法虽能提供语义层面的表示解释与操作，但编辑方法通常针对特定干预专门设计，缺乏一个通用且可编辑的概念组织表示，导致不同概念级操作难以共享优化框架。
AI.method: TCR基于概念可恢复性与交互分数构建中间概念空间，并通过拓扑结构紧凑编码其组织；干预通过修改该抽象并回传至底层学习表示实现。该方法将期望的概念组织与实现机制分离，使不同概念级操作共享同一优化框架。
AI.result: TCR具备稳定性与重参数化不变性，并与现有概念编辑公式建立联系。用于概念解耦预处理现有擦除方法时，在概念泄漏相当的情况下最差组准确率平均提升21.89；用于教师到学生的概念迁移时，概念可恢复性最高提升5.54，同时保持或提升竞争性测试top-1准确率。
AI.conclusion: TCR提供了一种通用、可编辑的概念组织抽象，统一了概念级编辑操作，并在概念解耦与跨模型概念迁移任务中验证了其有效性与通用性。

title: E$^2$-OPSD: Taming Entropy Overshoot in On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides dense token-level supervision without a second model: one network acts as teacher with the reference solution and as student with only the problem. We identify a specific failure mode of this recipe. During training, student token entropy rises past the teacher's and remains elevated, a pattern we call entropy overshoot. We trace it to both sides of distillation. The reference-conditioned teacher is confident along its answer-directed reasoning path, but this confidence transfers poorly to student-generated prefixes, making its supervision overly tied to answer-specific cues rather than reusable reasoning patterns; meanwhile, the forward KL used by OPSD continually diffuses the student's predictive distribution without pulling it back. We introduce E$^2$-OPSD to address both causes. Exemplar-guided teaching replaces the current answer with a retrieved solved neighboring problem, providing transferable reasoning guidance without revealing the destination and better matching student-reachable states. Entropy-aware distillation uses the student-teacher entropy gap to determine the direction and strength of each token's correction. E$^2$-OPSD improves math reasoning by up to 4.3 points in mean@16 over OPSD, while out-of-domain evaluations show gains over the corresponding base models of up to 4.9 points in mean@16 and 5.5 points in pass@8. Despite these gains, E$^2$-OPSD remains simple, requiring no additional forward passes or networks.

AI.tldr: 该论文识别了在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）中的"熵超调"失效模式，并提出E²-OPSD，通过示例引导教学与熵感知蒸馏加以修正，在数学推理上显著提升且不增加额外前向或网络。
AI.motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）无需第二个模型即可提供密集的token级监督，但存在特定失效模式：训练中学生token熵超过教师并持续偏高（熵超调）。作者旨在揭示其成因并加以修正。
AI.method: 从蒸馏双方追溯成因：参考条件教师在其答案导向的推理路径上自信，但该自信难以迁移到学生生成的prefix，导致监督过度依赖答案特定线索而非可复用推理模式；同时OPSD使用的前向KL持续扩散学生预测分布而缺乏拉回机制。据此提出E²-OPSD：(1) 示例引导教学，用检索到的已解邻近问题替代当前答案，提供可迁移的推理引导而不泄露目的地，更好匹配学生可达状态；(2) 熵感知蒸馏，利用学生-教师熵差决定每个token纠正的方向与强度。
AI.result: E²-OPSD在数学推理上相比OPSD将mean@16最多提升4.3分；在域外评估中，相比对应基模型mean@16最多提升4.9分，pass@8最多提升5.5分。
AI.conclusion: E²-OPSD有效缓解熵超调问题，在不增加额外前向传播或网络的前提下，同时提升域内与域外推理性能，方法保持简洁。

title: LogSig-SSM: Time-Series Modelling with Multi-Scale Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 2 figures, 15 tables
summary: Time-series data are often sampled irregularly at high frequencies and exhibit long-range dependencies, which makes long-horizon modelling difficult. Continuous-time models such as neural controlled differential equations (NCDEs) and neural rough differential equations (NRDEs) can handle irregular sampling, but they scale poorly to long sequences. Selective state-space models (SSMs) such as Mamba scale linearly with sequence length, but they provide limited recurrent mixing across hidden dimensions within a single block. We propose LogSig-SSM (Log-Signature Compression for State-Space Models), which first compresses long multivariate time series into a shorter sequence of tokens using multi-scale windowed log-signatures, and then processes these tokens with a selective SSM backbone. LogSig-SSM is scalable and robust to irregular sampling, combining log-signature tokens that capture higher-order cross-channel interactions with a selective SSM that models long-range dependencies. The model also admits a continuous-time interpretation as an NCDE/NRDE-style system driven by a log-signature-based input, in which selectivity induces an input-dependent rescaling of the latent dynamics. Across four benchmarks, namely long-sequence classification on UEA, high-frequency physiological regression on PPG-DaLiA, multivariate weather forecasting, and irregularly sampled clinical prediction on PhysioNet Sepsis, LogSig-SSM outperforms or matches strong SSM and continuous-time baselines while training up to $30\times$ faster and using up to $37\times$ less GPU memory than Mamba on the longest sequences.

AI.tldr: 提出 LogSig-SSM：用多尺度窗口对数签名将长多元时间序列压缩为短 token 序列，再以选择性 SSM 建模，兼具可扩展性与不规则采样鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 高频不规则采样的时间序列存在长程依赖，长时程建模困难。连续时间模型（NCDE/NRDE）能处理不规则采样但难以扩展到长序列；选择性 SSM（如 Mamba）随序列长度线性扩展，但单块内隐维度的循环混合有限，表达能力受限。
AI.method: LogSig-SSM 采用两阶段设计：先用多尺度窗口对数签名（windowed log-signatures）将长多元序列压缩为较短的 token 序列，捕捉高阶跨通道交互；再用选择性 SSM 主干处理这些 token 以建模长程依赖。该模型可解释为由对数签名驱动输入的 NCDE/NRDE 式连续时间系统，其中选择性对应潜动力学的输入相关重缩放。
AI.result: 在四个基准上——UEA 长序列分类、PPG-DaLiA 高频生理回归、多元天气预测、PhysioNet Sepsis 不规则临床预测——LogSig-SSM 优于或持平强 SSM 与连续时间基线，且在最长序列上训练速度最高提升 30 倍，GPU 显存占用较 Mamba 减少最高 37 倍。
AI.conclusion: 对数签名压缩与选择性 SSM 的结合为长序列、不规则采样时间序列建模提供了高效且鲁棒的方案，在精度与计算/显存效率上均具优势。

title: Discrete Action Matching: Learning Stochastic Dynamics from Samples via State Graphs
summary: Learning population dynamics from unpaired temporal marginals is an ill-posed inverse problem that requires structural assumptions on the underlying dynamics. We introduce $\textit{Discrete Action Matching}$ (DAM), a finite-state counterpart of Action Matching based on discrete Wasserstein geometry. For a prescribed marginal path and transport geometry, we derive an action-minimization objective for its canonical minimum-kinetic-energy current. Our key observation is that the density dependence of the discrete action reduces to neighboring density ratios. Along an empirical interpolation of the snapshots, DAM first estimates these ratios and then learns an action potential. The learned fields also define a graph-supported Markov sampler. Experiments on controlled synthetic dynamics and real mouse gastrulation data evaluate marginal reconstruction and interpolation. Additional experiments approximate numerical surface-transport paths from paired samples.

AI.tldr: 提出离散作用匹配（DAM），在有限状态离散 Wasserstein 几何下，从非配对时间边际快照学习群体动力学，并给出图支撑的 Markov 采样器。
AI.motivation: 从非配对的时间边际分布学习群体动力学是病态逆问题，需对底层动力学施加结构假设；现有连续空间方法难以直接适配有限状态（图/离散）情形。
AI.method: 以离散 Wasserstein 几何为基础构造 Action Matching 的有限状态对应物。对给定边际路径与输运几何，推导其规范最小动能流（minimum-kinetic-energy current）的作用最小化目标。关键观察：离散作用对密度的依赖可归结为相邻密度比。在快照的经验插值路径上，DAM 先估计这些相邻密度比，再学习作用势（action potential），所得场同时定义图支撑的 Markov 采样器。
AI.result: 在受控合成动力学与真实小鼠原肠胚（gastrulation）数据上评估边际重构与插值；额外实验用配对样本近似数值曲面输运路径。
AI.conclusion: DAM 将 Action Matching 推广到离散状态，通过相邻密度比简化密度依赖，实现无需配对数据的边际重构、插值与采样，适用于图结构和真实生物数据。

title: Best-of-$N$ Guidance for Test-time Diffusion Alignment
summary: Diffusion models achieve strong generative performance but often struggle to align generated samples with human preferences measured by a reward model. A simple yet effective algorithm for test-time alignment is Best-of-$N$ (BoN) sampling, which draws $N$ i.i.d. samples from a pre-trained diffusion model and outputs the single highest-reward sample. Despite its empirical success, BoN makes limited use of reward information, as it is incorporated only at the final selection stage without influencing the reverse diffusion trajectory during sampling. Consequently, BoN sampling does not improve the average alignment of generated samples and is primarily suited to single-output settings. We propose Best-of-$N$ Guidance (BoNG), a novel method that integrates the principle of BoN sampling directly into the reverse diffusion process. BoNG performs online BoN selection over denoising particles and adjusts the reverse diffusion process to steer the particle population toward higher-reward regions during generation. Specifically, by introducing an asymmetric guidance interaction among denoising particles, BoNG uses the current BoN particle as a guidance signal to the rest of the particle population. This particle-level interaction reshapes the sampling process toward higher-reward regions, enabling BoNG to improve not only the final best sample beyond Vanilla BoN sampling, but also the average quality of generated samples. Over 36 empirical comparisons, BoNG achieves the best performance in 29 cases, ranking first in 80.56% of the comparisons against SMC and Vanilla BoN sampling. BoNG also supports multi-output capability, achieving 1.3$\times$ ImageReward score of the latest sample-based guidance method with a 1.6$\times$ speedup. We release the code at https://github.com/aailab-kaist/BoNG.

AI.tldr: 提出BoNG方法，将Best-of-N采样思想融入扩散模型逆向去噪过程，通过粒子间非对称引导交互提升对齐效果与平均样本质量，支持多输出。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成性能强，但与人类偏好（由奖励模型衡量）对齐不足。Best-of-N（BoN）采样虽简单有效，但仅在最终选择阶段利用奖励信息，不影响逆向扩散轨迹，因此无法提升生成样本的平均对齐度，且主要用于单输出场景。
AI.method: 提出Best-of-N Guidance（BoNG），将BoN原理直接整合进逆向扩散过程。方法在去噪粒子上执行在线BoN选择，通过引入去噪粒子间的非对称引导交互，利用当前BoN粒子作为引导信号作用于其余粒子群，从而在生成过程中将粒子群导向高奖励区域，重塑采样过程。
AI.result: 在36项实证比较中，BoNG在29项取得最佳表现，对阵SMC与Vanilla BoN时80.56%排名第一。不仅最终最佳样本优于Vanilla BoN，生成样本平均质量也得到提升。支持多输出，实现最新样本引导方法1.3倍ImageReward分数，并带来1.6倍加速。
AI.conclusion: BoNG通过在逆向扩散中引入粒子级非对称引导交互，克服了BoN仅用最终选择、无法提升平均对齐度的局限，在单输出与多输出场景下均取得领先性能，并兼顾效率，代码已开源。

title: Bayesian Entropy-based Reordering for Calibrated Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) generate sequences by iteratively replacing masked tokens with model predictions. At each denoising step, the decoder chooses which positions are sufficiently confident to commit. Existing decoding methods typically rely on softmax confidence, which can be miscalibrated. We introduce BayesER (BAYESian Entropy-based Reordering), a post-hoc Bayesian decoding framework that uses predictive uncertainty to guide token commitment. In BayesER, we construct a lightweight approximate posterior centered at the pretrained checkpoint, similar to Laplace-LoRA but without training LoRA adapters. We average predictions over posterior samples and use predictive entropy to prioritize reliable positions. We examine how posterior predictions affect position ordering and token selection across benchmarks spanning code generation, mathematical reasoning, planning, and molecular generation. We show that BayesER reduces sequence-level calibration error while preserving or improving accuracy relative to common decoding schemes, including confidence-threshold decoding. Additionally, a posterior fitted on one code-generation dataset reduces calibration error on another without refitting, suggesting that Bayesian uncertainty may provide a transferable signal for more reliable MDLM decoding.

AI.tldr: 提出BayesER，一种基于贝叶斯后验熵的后处理解码框架，通过预测不确定性指导MDLM的token提交顺序，在多个基准上降低校准误差并保持或提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 掩码扩散语言模型（MDLM）在每步去噪中需判断哪些位置足够"自信"可以提交，而现有方法依赖softmax置信度，该置信度可能存在校准偏差（miscalibrated），导致位置排序与token选择不可靠。
AI.method: 引入BayesER（BAYESian Entropy-based Reordering）：构建以预训练检查点为中心的轻量近似后验，类似Laplace-LoRA但无需训练LoRA适配器；对后验采样的预测取平均，并用预测熵对可靠位置进行优先排序；研究后验预测对位置排序和token选择的影响。
AI.result: 在代码生成、数学推理、规划、分子生成等基准上，与常见解码方案（含置信度阈值解码）相比，BayesER降低了序列级校准误差，同时保持或提升准确率；且在一个代码生成数据集上拟合的后验可在另一数据集上无需重新拟合即降低校准误差。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯不确定性可为更可靠的MDLM解码提供可迁移的信号，且后验预测能改善位置排序与token选择的可靠性。

title: EMG-GPT: Predictive Pretraining on Residual-Quantized EMG Tokens for Hand Pose Estimation
summary: Surface electromyography (sEMG) is a low-power, cost-effective biosignal for hand-pose estimation and gesture classification. In this work, we examine whether self-supervised pretraining on sEMG can yield transferable representations for continuous hand-pose estimation. We introduce EMG-GPT, a causal transformer-based model that operates on discrete sEMG representations from a frozen residual vector quantization (RVQ) tokenizer and learns temporal dynamics through depth-autoregressive future-code prediction. The model combines within-frame integration with causal temporal modeling while preserving the geometry of the pretrained codebook. EMG-GPT shows competitive results in both Regression and Tracking tasks, supporting EMG-only pretraining as a viable approach for learning transferable sEMG representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EMG-GPT，一种基于因果 Transformer 的自监督模型，在冻结的 RVQ 离散表征上通过深度自回归未来码预测学习时序动态，实现可迁移的 sEMG 连续手势姿态估计。
AI.motivation: 表面肌电（sEMG）是一种低功耗、低成本的生物信号，可用于手势姿态估计与手势分类。作者希望验证：对 sEMG 进行自监督预训练，能否获得可用于连续手势姿态估计的可迁移表征。
AI.method: EMG-GPT 采用因果 Transformer 架构，输入为冻结的残差向量量化（RVQ）分词器产生的离散 sEMG 表征；通过深度自回归的未来码预测学习时序动态；模型将帧内整合与因果时序建模相结合，同时保持预训练码本的几何结构。
AI.result: 在回归（Regression）与跟踪（Tracking）两类任务上均取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持仅使用 EMG 进行预训练是一种学习可迁移 sEMG 表征的可行途径。

title: Pythia: Toward Foundation World Models for Multimodal Time Series
summary: Time-series foundation models offer a unified approach to forecasting across heterogeneous domains. Textual context and auxiliary observations provide complementary information about temporal dynamics, yet reusable multimodal predictive representations remain underexplored. We introduce Pythia, a foundation world model that learns context-conditioned latent dynamics across datasets through a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A stop-gradient numerical reference guides contextual corrections to predicted future states. A separate probabilistic decoder then adapts to the frozen predictive representation and observed history, decoupling world-model pretraining from observation-space forecasting. On MUSE, Pythia-Tiny's normalized mean absolute scaled error (MASE) and weighted sum quantile loss (WSQL) are 0.6879 and 0.4269, reducing errors by 6.26% and 5.00% relative to the strongest model evaluated in the published MUSE leaderboard. Through a series of controlled experiments, we investigate how to design a time-series world model through shared pretraining and how joint-embedding predictive learning can incorporate multimodal information. The results support separating predictive representation learning from probabilistic readout and show complementary contributions from entity descriptions, events, and covariates.

AI.tldr: 提出时间序列基础世界模型 Pythia，基于联合嵌入预测架构学习跨数据集的上下文条件潜在动态，在 MUSE 上 MASE 和 WSQL 分别较最强基线降低 6.26% 和 5.00%。
AI.motivation: 文本上下文与辅助观测能提供时间动态的互补信息，但可复用的多模态预测表征仍缺乏探索；同时预测表征学习与观测空间预测的耦合限制了世界模型预训练的可迁移性。
AI.method: 采用联合嵌入预测架构进行共享预训练，学习上下文条件的潜在动态；用带停止梯度的数值参考引导对预测未来状态的上下文修正；以独立的概率解码器适配冻结的预测表征与观测历史，从而解耦世界模型预训练与观测空间预测。
AI.result: 在 MUSE 上，Pythia-Tiny 的 MASE 为 0.6879、WSQL 为 0.4269，相对公开榜单最强模型分别降低 6.26% 和 5.00%；控制实验表明实体描述、事件和协变量均有互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持将预测表征学习与概率读出分离，并证明联合嵌入预测学习可有效融合多模态信息，为时间序列世界模型的设计提供可行路径。

title: Green-Routed Neural Operators:\\Physics Determines Where the Network Reads
summary: We identify a mismatch between the physical role of transport fields in many PDEs and their usual role in neural operators: PDEs use them to select read coordinates, whereas neural operators typically treat them only as input values. We address this mismatch with the Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO), which uses the governing equation to determine where latent features are sampled. A parameter-free equation adapter evaluates the diagnostic relation and constructs a departure map whose values are the read coordinates. A multiscale encoder-decoder combines centered and routed reads of latent features to learn the complete finite-time update. Across five two- and three-dimensional PDE systems, GRNO achieves the lowest mean final relative $L^2$ error on four under 40-step autoregressive evaluation and remains competitive on Keller-Segel. Fixed-weight route interventions reveal strong dependence on direction and spatial alignment in four systems, with weak dependence in Keller-Segel. In independently trained ablations, GRNO achieves lower mean errors than variants that supply the transport field only as an input feature, substitute a learned displacement for the equation-specified route, or apply the route with a spatial misalignment, across all five systems. It also substantially outperforms directly advecting the physical state and learning the remaining update, indicating that equation-specified read coordinates provide an effective structural prior for long-horizon PDE forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Green-Routed Neural Operator (GRNO)，通过用控制方程确定潜在特征的读取坐标，弥合输运场在 PDE 与神经算子中角色不一致的问题，在多个 PDE 系统上取得更低误差。
AI.motivation: 在许多 PDE 中，输运场（transport fields）的物理作用是"选择读取坐标"，而神经算子通常仅将其当作普通输入值。作者识别出这一角色错配，并希望以此为切入点改进神经算子对 PDE 的建模。
AI.method: GRNO 包含：(1) 无参数方程适配器，评估诊断关系并构造 departure map，其值即为读取坐标；(2) 多尺度编码器-解码器，结合居中读取与路由读取的潜在特征，学习完整的有限时间更新。作者还设置了固定权重路由干预实验和独立训练的消融实验（如仅将输运场作为输入特征、用学习位移替代方程指定路由、空间错位应用路由）。
AI.result: 在五个二维与三维 PDE 系统上，GRNO 在 40 步自回归评估中有四个系统取得最低平均最终相对 L² 误差，在 Keller-Segel 上保持竞争力。固定权重路由干预显示四个系统对路由方向和空间对齐有强依赖，Keller-Segel 依赖较弱。消融实验中 GRNO 在所有五个系统上均优于对照变体，并显著优于直接平流物理状态再学习剩余更新的方法。
AI.conclusion: 方程指定的读取坐标为长时程 PDE 预测提供了有效的结构先验，表明将输运场的物理角色显式编码进神经算子架构能提升长期预测性能。

title: On Semi-Markov Suboptimality in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
summary: Hierarchical reinforcement learning uses temporally extended subtasks for exploration, yet committing to their execution can restrict both deployment and policy learning. We identify and separate the resulting execution and policy suboptimality. Task and execution trees distinguish reward objectives from policy choices and decision interruption. A Unified Value Function for HRL and a four-stage Generalized Hierarchical Bellman Equation then support a common analysis of both losses. Under bounded rewards and uniform termination, we establish hierarchical policy and execution improvement results. With the remaining node policies fixed, task-subtree compatibility and node-policy optimality under the original execution mode establish when Markov execution is optimal. The resulting decomposition leads to independent execution choices for behavior, targets, and deployment. We instantiate this principle through execution improvement and one-stage or two-stage policy improvement at arbitrary hierarchy depth. Option-based and goal-conditioned experiments demonstrate complementary gains from changing execution and changing the learning target. Controlled stochastic environments show how these gains depend on stochastic transition strength and spatial structure. This framework makes execution design an explicit component of hierarchical policy optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出任务树与执行树的分解框架，区分HRL中的执行次优性与策略次优性，并通过统一价值函数与四阶段广义分层贝尔曼方程分析两类损失。
AI.motivation: 分层强化学习利用时间扩展的子任务进行探索，但强制承诺执行这些子任务会同时限制策略部署与策略学习。作者希望识别并分离由此产生的"执行次优性"与"策略次优性"两类问题。
AI.method: 提出任务树与执行树以区分奖励目标、策略选择与决策中断；引入面向HRL的统一价值函数和四阶段广义分层贝尔曼方程，对两类损失进行统一分析；在有界奖励与一致终止假设下建立分层策略与执行改进结果；通过执行改进与任意层级深度的一阶段或两阶段策略改进实例化该原则。
AI.result: 在固定其余节点策略时，任务子树兼容性与原执行模式下的节点策略最优性可刻画马尔可夫执行何时最优；Option-based与目标条件实验显示改变执行与改变学习目标带来互补收益；受控随机环境表明收益依赖于随机转移强度与空间结构。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使执行设计成为分层策略优化的显式组成部分，并将执行选择独立分解为行为、目标与部署三方面。

title: Reflections and Fragments: Securing LLMs Against Sequential Mosaic Attacks
summary: Self-play red-teaming improves language-model safety by pitting attacker and defender roles against each other in a zero-sum game. However, real adversaries increasingly use mosaic attacks: multi-turn sequences whose individual fragments are innocuous in isolation yet assemble into a harmful payload. We develop a theory of mosaic defense that characterizes what is required to prevent such attacks without sacrificing helpfulness. We first show that no fixed bounded window of recent prompts is sufficient in general: safety-relevant information may occur arbitrarily far back in the interaction. We formalize a watchman, an online state mechanism that carries this information forward, and show that under explicit assumptions it enables zero-failure defense with positive benign helpfulness. Under stronger conditions, it is also optimal among zero-failure defenders. An exact watchman may nevertheless require exponentially many states, while exact maliciousness detection can require exponentially many queries in an unstructured black-box model. These state and query lower bounds do not by themselves imply hard learning: the construction underlying the state lower bound is efficiently learnable from labeled examples, whereas certifying worst-case safety can require substantially more information under restricted access. We also show that self-play equilibrium alone does not certify usefulness, motivating a constrained formulation that maximizes worst-case benign helpfulness among zero-failure defenders. Empirically, training role-specific attacker and defender LoRA adapters over frozen LLMs via multi-turn self-play strengthens both roles: attackers become more effective at eliciting harmful responses, while defenders become more robust to attack, with improvements also observed on unseen attack objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了"拼图攻击"（mosaic attack）防御理论：证明固定窗口防御不足，形式化"watchman"在线状态机制可在零失败前提下保持有益性，并给出状态/查询下界与自博弈训练验证。
AI.motivation: 自博弈红队通过攻防零和博弈提升模型安全，但真实对手采用拼图攻击：多轮对话中每个片段单独无害，组合后构成有害载荷。现有防御理论未刻画防御此类攻击所需的必要条件，也未说明如何在零失败与保持有用性之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1) 理论建模：证明任何固定有界窗口的近期提示在一般情况下都不充分，因安全相关信息可能出现在任意久远的交互历史中；2) 形式化 watchman——一种在线状态机制，向前携带安全相关信息；3) 在显式假设下分析其零失败防御与正的有益帮助性，并在更强条件下证明其在零失败防御者中的最优性；4) 给出精确 watchman 所需状态数与无结构黑盒模型下恶意性检测查询数的指数下界，并讨论其与可学习性的区别；5) 提出约束式表述：在零失败防御者中最大化最坏情况有益帮助性；6) 实证：在冻结 LLM 上经多轮自博弈训练角色专用的攻击者与防御者 LoRA 适配器。
AI.result: 理论上：固定窗口防御不足；watchman 在显式假设下可实现零失败防御且正有益帮助性，更强条件下为最优；精确 watchman 可能需要指数级状态，精确恶意检测在无结构黑盒下可能需指数级查询；但状态下界所用构造可由标注样本高效学习，而受限访问下认证最坏情况安全性可能需要更多信息；自博弈均衡本身不能认证有用性。实证：多轮自博弈使攻击者更易诱导有害回复、防御者对攻击更鲁棒，并在未见攻击目标上也有提升。
AI.conclusion: 防御拼图攻击需要超越固定窗口的在线状态机制（watchman），其在严格条件下可兼顾零失败与有益性；其代价可能为指数级状态或查询，但这种下界不等同于学习困难。自博弈均衡不足以保证有用性，应采用在零失败防御者中最大化最坏情况有益帮助性的约束式目标；基于冻结 LLM 的角色专用 LoRA 多轮自博弈训练可同时强化攻防双方并泛化到未见目标。

title: Rethinking Tabular Foundation Models On Data Streams
summary: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) outperform established machine learning models on tabular benchmarks through in-context learning. Building on this success, interest is growing in applying them to data streams, where data arrive continuously and evolve over time. On a stream, a TFM adapts by updating its context rather than its parameters, so its accuracy and cost depend on which examples it keeps and how often it rebuilds its context. We therefore present a systematic study of TFMs on data streams, covering memory management, computational cost, and stream-specific challenges such as concept drift and delayed labels. We find that TFMs achieve the highest predictive performance and that simply retaining the most recent examples is as effective as existing memory management techniques. They also recover faster than streaming learners after drift and keep the highest accuracy under label delay. This accuracy, however, comes at a high serving cost, since a nearly unchanged context is re-encoded at every prediction. These results point to architectural efficiency as the way forward for in-context stream learning.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了表格基础模型（TFMs）在数据流上的表现，涵盖内存管理、计算成本及概念漂移与标签延迟等挑战。结果显示TFMs预测性能最高，保留最近样本即足够，漂移后恢复更快，但每次预测都重新编码上下文导致服务成本高昂，指向架构效率为未来方向。
AI.motivation: TFMs凭借上下文学习在表格基准上超越传统机器学习模型，兴趣逐渐转向将其应用于数据流场景（数据持续到达并随时间演化），但对其在流上的适应机制、内存与成本权衡缺乏系统认识。
AI.method: 对TFMs在数据流上的表现进行系统性研究，覆盖内存管理策略、计算成本评估，以及概念漂移和延迟标签等流特有挑战；TFMs通过更新上下文而非参数进行适应，故考察其保留哪些样本及重建上下文的频率。
AI.result: TFMs取得最高预测性能；简单保留最近样本与现有内存管理技术效果相当；漂移后比流式学习器恢复更快；在标签延迟下保持最高准确率；但服务成本高，因每次预测都需对几乎不变的上下文重新编码。
AI.conclusion: TFMs在流式场景中精度占优但服务开销大，架构效率是上下文流式学习的前进方向。

title: Distributed Subliminal Learning: Replacing Model Updates with Random-Carrier Outputs
comment: Accepted to the Collaborative, Open, and DECentralized training of Foundation Models workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Collaborative learning typically exchanges model parameters: federated clients communicate updates, while independently adapted foundation models are combined by exchanging adapters or checkpoints. This makes communication scale with model size and requires local specializations to be reconciled in weight space, where interference is common. We ask whether knowledge can instead be shared through model behavior on task-unrelated inputs. We introduce Distributed Subliminal Learning (DSL), a collaborative learning primitive in which participants adapt a common model locally, probe it with task-unrelated inputs, and transmit only the resulting carrier outputs. A coordinator pools these outputs and distills them into a shared model. The primitive supports one-shot foundation-model composition through carrier completions and iterative federated learning through carrier logits, without transmitting model updates or requiring task-related proxy data. In LLM composition, compared with LoRA averaging, DSL achieves higher preference retention (94.56% vs. 87.76%) and a larger GSM8K gain over the base model (22.0 vs. 0.6 points), while reducing upload by 30.6-49.0$\times$. In federated classification, DSL reaches 96.83% on MNIST with 8.9$\times$ less uplink than FedAvg and provides lower-communication operating points on CIFAR-10 and Tiny ImageNet. These results establish random-carrier outputs as a practical communication primitive for knowledge sharing across distinct collaborative learning paradigms.

AI.tldr: 提出分布式潜隐学习（DSL）：不交换模型参数或适配器，仅通过任务无关输入上的行为输出（载体输出）传递知识，经协调者池化并蒸馏成共享模型，在LLM组合与联邦学习中均提升性能并大幅降低通信量。
AI.motivation: 传统协作学习（联邦学习传参数更新、基础模型通过交换适配器/检查点组合）的通信量随模型规模增长，且局部特化需在权重空间对齐，易产生干扰。作者追问：能否改为通过模型在任务无关输入上的行为来共享知识，从而规避权重空间融合问题。
AI.method: DSL 作为协作学习原语：参与者先本地适配一个公共模型，再用任务无关输入探测该模型，仅传输由此产生的载体输出；由协调者汇聚这些输出并蒸馏回共享模型。该原语支持两种形态——借助载体补全的一次性基础模型组合，以及借助载体 logits 的迭代联邦学习，全程不传输模型更新，也不需要任务相关的代理数据。
AI.result: LLM 组合任务中，DSL 相比 LoRA 平均取得更高的偏好保留率（94.56% vs. 87.76%），GSM8K 相对基座提升更大（22.0 vs. 0.6 分），上传量减少 30.6–49.0 倍。联邦分类中，DSL 在 MNIST 达 96.83%，上行通信比 FedAvg 少 8.9 倍，并在 CIFAR-10 与 Tiny ImageNet 上提供更低通信量的工作点。
AI.conclusion: 随机载体输出可作为跨不同协作学习范式进行知识共享的实用通信原语，为以行为而非权重为媒介的协作学习提供了可行路径。

title: Does Explainability Survive Data Drift?
summary: Model performance monitoring is a standard practice in machine learning deployments. Detection performance is tracked continuously, and model decay is expected as the relationship between the feature and target variables degrades, a phenomenon known as concept drift. Explanation fidelity, however, is rarely monitored with the same discipline, even in domains such as financial systems, healthcare, and other regulated environments where explanations are required for governance purposes. This paper investigates whether explanations can decay under data drift, even when the feature-target relationship remains stable, and whether explanations produced before drift occurs remain faithful to the decisions of the model that replaces them. Using the IEEE-CIS Transaction Fraud Detection dataset, we find statistically significant covariate shift but no statistically significant evidence of concept drift under the implemented conditional-drift tests, thereby providing an empirical setting in which input distributional change can be studied separately from detectable changes in the feature-target relationship. Local explanations are generated with ExIFFI and evaluated at three levels: path validity, structural behaviour, and fidelity under controlled intervention. Results show that while prior explanations retain substantial decision relevance to a retrained model, they are consistently less faithful than newly generated explanations, with no evidence of a systematically widening gap across the evaluated windows. The study shows that explanation fidelity requires its own monitoring, that structural stability of explanations does not guarantee functional fidelity, and that explanations should be treated as artifacts tied to the model that produced them.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究数据漂移下解释保真度的衰减问题：在IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集上确认存在协变量偏移但无可检测的概念漂移，用ExIFFI生成局部解释并从路径有效性、结构行为、干预下保真度三层面评估，发现旧解释对重训模型仍有决策相关性但保真度持续低于新解释，且差距未系统性扩大。
AI.motivation: 模型性能监控已是机器学习部署的标准实践，概念漂移导致的模型衰减被持续跟踪；但解释保真度很少受到同等严格的监控，而在金融、医疗等受监管领域，解释是治理所需。因此需要研究：当特征-目标关系保持稳定、仅输入分布变化时，解释是否也会衰减；漂移前生成的解释对替代模型是否仍然忠实。
AI.method: 使用IEEE-CIS交易欺诈检测数据集，通过条件漂移检验分离输入分布变化与特征-目标关系变化（发现显著协变量偏移但无显著概念漂移）；用ExIFFI生成局部解释，并在三个层面评估：路径有效性（path validity）、结构行为（structural behaviour）、以及受控干预下的保真度（fidelity under controlled intervention）。
AI.result: 先前生成的解释对重训模型仍保留相当的决策相关性，但保真度一致地低于新生成的解释；在评估的各个时间窗口内，未发现两者差距系统性扩大（no evidence of a systematically widening gap）。
AI.conclusion: 解释保真度需要独立的监控机制；解释的结构稳定性并不能保证其功能保真度；解释应被视为与其生成模型绑定的产物（artifacts），而非可跨模型沿用的通用说明。

title: No Concept Escapes the Audit: Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models
summary: Text-to-image diffusion models can generate prohibited content, which motivates concept erasure through machine unlearning. Most erasure methods intervene at the text interface, through prompt modification or localized updates to text-conditioning weights, and they are evaluated by what the model outputs for given prompts. Such evaluation cannot see what the network still encodes. Latent-space auditing, which bypasses text conditioning and probes the denoising network directly, shows that erased concepts remain recoverable from internal representations. We find that this also holds for methods built to be robust against adversarial prompts, and that the problem grows with the number of erased concepts. We propose Auditing-Aware Unlearning for Verifiable Concept Erasure in Diffusion Models (AVCE), a framework that grounds erasure in the model's latent representations. AVCE audits the embedding neighborhood of each concept and condenses the discovered vulnerable directions into an anchor at the weakest geometric point. It edits cross-attention and self-attention projections in closed form at this anchor, then fine-tunes the two pathways with pathway-level auditing losses, using orthogonal gradient projection to consolidate multiple concepts. Experiments on SD v1.5, SDXL, and Flux 1.0 across object, explicit-content, and artistic-style unlearning show that AVCE reduces attack success rates by 5.07x and improves auditing scores by 3.84x over the strongest baseline, while preserving competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: 提出AVCE框架，通过在潜空间审计并定位概念嵌入邻域的最弱几何锚点，结合闭式编辑与正交梯度投影微调，实现可验证的概念擦除。
AI.motivation: 现有文本到图像扩散模型的概念擦除多干预文本接口，仅以给定提示的输出评估效果，无法察觉网络内部仍编码的禁止概念。潜空间审计显示被擦除概念仍可从内部表征恢复，且该问题随擦除概念数量增加而加剧，即使对抗鲁棒方法也存在。
AI.method: AVCE框架：审计每个概念的嵌入邻域，将发现的脆弱方向凝练为最弱几何点处的锚点；在该锚点上以闭式解编辑交叉注意力与自注意力投影；随后用路径级审计损失微调两条通路，并采用正交梯度投影整合多概念擦除。
AI.result: 在SD v1.5、SDXL、Flux 1.0上针对物体、显式内容、艺术风格三类擦除任务，AVCE相比最强基线将攻击成功率降低5.07倍，审计得分提升3.84倍，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 将擦除根植于模型潜表征、以审计为导向的定位与编辑，可实现更可验证的概念擦除，兼顾鲁棒性与生成质量。

title: BeliefGraph-JEPA: Structured Latent World Models for Action-Conditioned Time Series
summary: Action-conditioned time-series forecasting requires accounting for how future actions and exogenous forcings influence multiple targets through partially observed effects with different delays and persistence. Direct conditioning leaves the evolution and target-specific influence of these effects implicit in the predictor, while static relational graphs specify connections without tracking evolving effects. This motivates representing future-driver influence through structured latent states that evolve over the forecast horizon and route information to individual targets. We introduce BeliefGraph-JEPA, a structured latent world model that factorizes driver influence into typed latent-effect states. These states are rolled forward under future drivers and routed through a graph to target-specific nodes, forming the predictive base of a joint-embedding predictive architecture. A capacity-controlled residual supplements this base with direct driver information. On four multi-target clinical, agricultural, environmental, and industrial systems, the framework outperforms a range of pretrained and supervised known-future-covariate baselines. Matched controls isolate latent dynamics, future rollout, graph routing, and residual capacity; future rollout and graph-first residual routing improve forecasting across all four systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 BeliefGraph-JEPA，一种结构化潜在世界模型，将未来驱动因素影响分解为带类型的潜在效应状态，经图路由至各目标节点，形成联合嵌入预测架构的预测基，并用容量受限残差补充直接驱动信息。
AI.motivation: 动作条件时间序列预测需刻画未来动作与外生强迫经由部分可观测、不同延迟与持续性的效应影响多目标，但直接条件化使效应演化与目标特异性影响隐含于预测器中，静态关系图又无法跟踪演化效应，因此需要以结构化潜在状态表示未来驱动影响。
AI.method: 将驱动因素影响分解为带类型的潜在效应状态；在未来驱动下滚动前推，并通过图路由到目标特异性节点，作为联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）的预测基；再用容量受控的残差补充直接驱动信息。
AI.result: 在临床、农业、环境与工业四类多目标系统上，优于多种预训练与有监督的已知未来协变量基线；匹配对照实验分离出潜在动力学、未来前推、图路由与残差容量，其中未来前推与图优先残差路由在全部四类系统上提升预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化潜在效应状态配合未来前推与图路由能有效刻画未来驱动对多目标的延迟与持续性影响，残差机制在补充直接驱动信息的同时通过容量控制保持预测基主导，带来跨领域一致的性能提升。

title: Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping for Off-Policy Subgoal Value Learning
summary: Off-policy hierarchical reinforcement learning must estimate the values of high-level decisions while the low-level policy changes. HIRO adapts replay data through subgoal relabeling, but after a label change, the value update targets the relabeled subgoal instead of the subgoal the high-level policy originally needed to update. We propose Hierarchical Time-aware Bootstrapping (HTB), which evaluates specified subgoals under the current low-level policy while retaining accumulated task rewards. Remaining execution time distinguishes subgoal continuation from a new high-level decision. Together with primitive-action conditioning, it enables off-policy Bellman updates based on the stationary environment transition law. HTB combines these one-step updates with multi-step suffix returns and truncated relabeling, reducing dependence on intermediate value estimates. A shared value component supports learning across actions, while nonnegative residuals constrain upward corrections relative to that component. At a fixed mixture weight of 0.95, HTB achieves 32.8% AntFall success versus 9.6% for matched local HIRO over five paired seeds at 10M environment steps. Ablations identify contributions from recursive continuation and mixed supervision; fixed-policy tests show more accurate predictions for actions whose returns were excluded from fitting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出层级时间感知自举（HTB），通过对指定子目标在当前低层策略下进行离策略贝尔曼更新、结合多步后缀回报与截断重标记，显著提升层级强化学习性能。
AI.motivation: 离策略层级强化学习需要在低层策略不断变化时估计高层决策的价值。HIRO 虽通过子目标重标记适配回放数据，但重标记后价值更新的目标是被重标记的子目标，而非高层策略原本需要更新的子目标，导致更新目标不一致，影响学习效果。
AI.method: HTB 在当前低层策略下评估指定子目标，同时保留累积的任务奖励；用剩余执行时间区分“子目标延续”与“新的高层决策”，并结合原始动作条件，使离策略贝尔曼更新基于平稳的环境转移规律。方法将单步更新与多步后缀回报及截断重标记相结合以减少对中间价值估计的依赖；采用共享价值组件支持跨动作学习，并用非负残差约束相对于该组件的向上修正。消融实验验证递归延续与混合监督的贡献。
AI.result: 在混合权重固定为 0.95、10M 环境步、五对配对种子条件下，HTB 在 AntFall 任务上的成功率为 32.8%，而匹配的局部 HIRO 仅为 9.6%。消融实验识别出递归延续与混合监督的贡献；固定策略测试表明，对被排除在拟合之外的动作回报，HTB 的预测更准确。
AI.conclusion: HTB 通过时间感知的子目标评估与平稳环境转移下的离策略自举，解决了 HIRO 子目标重标记带来的价值更新目标不一致问题，在稀疏奖励的层级任务上显著优于基线，并验证了各组件的作用。

title: Population Scaling or Data Dilution? Dynamics of Local Topology Evolution in Decentralized Learning
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures. Accepted as a poster at DynaFront @ NeurIPS 2026
summary: Scaling decentralized learning changes not only the number of clients $N$, but also the dynamics of information propagation and consensus. We argue that the effect of increasing $N$ cannot be understood in isolation, because data allocation, topology-dependent mixing, and communication capacity may change simultaneously. We study these coupled effects on CIFAR-10 with $N\in\{10,50,100,200\}$, comparing a degree-two Ring, a Static Random graph, and Local-First Heuristic Evolution (LFHE), a locally adaptive topology process based on friend-of-friend discovery. The Ring provides an analytically transparent failure mode: its Metropolis spectral gap decays as $Θ(N^{-2})$, implying progressively slower contraction of model disagreement as the population grows. Experiments show that holding the nominal local dataset size fixed substantially reduces the apparent population penalty observed when a fixed total dataset is divided among more clients. The remaining degradation depends strongly on communication structure: Ring enters a high-disagreement regime, whereas Static Random and LFHE remain close to consensus. Increasing LFHE's degree threshold further improves accuracy and consensus, but at a substantially higher model-transmission cost. These results show that decentralized scaling is governed by coupled learning and communication dynamics, rather than by the number of clients alone.

AI.tldr: 去中心化学习的扩展性不只取决于客户端数量N，还取决于数据分配、拓扑混合与通信容量三者的耦合效应；在CIFAR-10上比较Ring、Static Random与LFHE拓扑，发现固定本地数据规模可显著减弱“人口惩罚”，而剩余退化主要受通信结构支配。
AI.motivation: 已有研究常将去中心化学习的扩展性问题简单归因于客户端数量N的增加，但作者认为这种理解不充分：当N增大时，数据分配方式、依赖拓扑的混合过程以及通信容量会同时发生变化，因此孤立地考察N会掩盖真实的耦合机制，需要系统研究这些因素的联合作用。
AI.method: 在CIFAR-10上设置N∈{10,50,100,200}，对比三种拓扑：度为2的Ring、Static Random图以及基于“朋友的朋友”发现的局部自适应拓扑演化过程LFHE；通过Metropolis谱隙进行理论分析，并在实验中分别控制固定本地数据集规模与固定总数据集两种条件，同时考察LFHE度阈值与模型传输开销。
AI.result: Ring的Metropolis谱隙按Θ(N^{-2})衰减，意味着随群体扩大模型分歧的收缩越来越慢，形成解析上清晰的失效模式。实验表明，保持名义本地数据集规模固定时，固定总数据被更多客户端瓜分所观察到的“人口惩罚”显著减弱。剩余性能退化强依赖通信结构：Ring进入高分歧状态，而Static Random与LFHE接近共识。提高LFHE的度阈值可进一步改善精度与共识，但模型传输成本大幅上升。
AI.conclusion: 去中心化学习的扩展性由学习动态与通信动态的耦合共同决定，而非仅由客户端数量N决定；数据分配、拓扑混合与通信开销需被协同考虑。

title: LiFT: Loop Flow Transformers
summary: We introduce Loop Flow Transformers (LiFT), a family of looped generative models that scales computation by repeatedly applying a shared Diffusion Transformer (DiT) core, with only light changes to the standard architecture. Rather than asking every recurrent step for the final prediction, LiFT trains each step with a single regression target: a point on a straight path from the model's initial estimate to the flow-matching target. Because we index these targets by a continuous depth coordinate, a trained model can loop far beyond its training depth with no retraining, early exits, or other modifications. In our experiments, these longer rollouts improve generation, so inference computation can grow without adding parameters. On ImageNet at 256x256, LiFT-L/2 achieves an FID 3.34 points lower than our dense DiT-XL/2 baseline while using approximately 60% fewer parameters, 32% fewer training FLOPs, and 52% fewer inference FLOPs.

AI.tldr: 提出 Loop Flow Transformers (LiFT)，一种循环生成模型：重复应用共享的 DiT 核心，以连续深度坐标索引回归目标，使模型可在训练深度之外持续循环而无需重训练，从而在不增加参数的情况下扩展推理计算并提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 在生成模型中，提升效果通常依赖增加参数量或训练/推理计算量。作者希望探索一种方式：通过循环复用同一 DiT 核心来扩展计算，使推理计算可以增长而不增加参数，同时避免早期退出或其他架构改动。
AI.method: LiFT 对标准 Diffusion Transformer 架构仅做轻微改动，构建由共享 DiT 核心重复迭代的循环生成模型。关键设计是：不要求每个循环步直接给出最终预测，而是为每步设置单一回归目标——位于模型初始估计与 flow-matching 目标之间直线路径上的一个点；这些目标由连续深度坐标索引，因此训练后的模型可以循环远超训练深度而无需重训练、早期退出或其他修改。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 256×256 上，LiFT-L/2 相比稠密 DiT-XL/2 基线 FID 降低 3.34 点，同时参数减少约 60%、训练 FLOPs 减少 32%、推理 FLOPs 减少 52%。更长的循环展开（rollout）可提升生成质量，实现推理计算随需求增长而无需增加参数。
AI.conclusion: LiFT 表明通过循环共享 DiT 核心并结合连续深度坐标的逐步回归目标，可在显著降低参数与计算成本的同时提升生成性能，并支持在推理阶段按需扩展循环步数而无需重训练。

title: Soft Strategy Selection for Batch-Mode Active Learning
summary: Real-world deployment of active learning typically forces practitioners to choose an acquisition strategy before any data is labeled. This is a daunting task: strategy performance varies widely across settings (e.g. datasets, surrogate models) and cannot be assessed without deployment. Existing strategy selection methods explore one strategy from a portfolio at each round and identify the optimal one using bandit feedback or model retraining. Many acquisition rounds are therefore spent exploring strategies rather than collecting the most informative data. Such overhead is a major barrier to AL-driven design of high-throughput experiments, such as genetic perturbation screens and directed evolution, where AL runs consist of only a few rounds with large batch sizes. This regime permits a natural alternative: acquiring data using multiple AL strategies within a single batch. We refer to this as soft strategy selection and introduce FractAL, a method specifically designed for this task. FractAL infers a per-strategy reward using influence-function-based data attribution, which requires no additional retraining, and then computes budget shares for each strategy in the portfolio using online mirror descent. We benchmark FractAL across 7 setups spanning classification, regression, and genetic perturbation effect prediction. The results highlight that strategy selection is a hard problem: every existing method performs worse than random sampling on at least one setup. FractAL, however, matches or outperforms every baseline, including random sampling, on all 7 setups. Its allocations concentrate budget on the strongest strategies in the portfolio while pruning the weakest. FractAL is therefore a reliable choice for real-world deployments, where the optimal strategy is unknown in advance, an important step towards making AL practical for high-throughput experiments and modern scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FractAL，一种"软策略选择"方法：在单批次内按预算份额混合多种主动学习策略采集数据，利用影响函数数据归因估计各策略收益，并通过在线镜像下降分配预算份额，无需额外重训练。在7个任务上，FractAL 匹配或超越所有基线（含随机采样），而现有策略选择方法至少在1个任务上劣于随机采样。
AI.motivation: 真实场景中，从业者必须在标注任何数据前选定采集策略，但策略性能在数据集、代理模型等设置间差异巨大且无法在部署前评估。现有策略选择方法每轮只探索一个策略，借助bandit反馈或模型重训练确定最优策略，导致大量轮次被用于探索而非采集最有信息量的数据。这一开销在高通量实验（如基因扰动筛选、定向进化）中尤为严重，因为此类主动学习仅含少数几轮且批量很大。
AI.method: 提出"软策略选择"：在单个批次内同时使用多个主动学习策略采集数据。具体方法 FractAL：1）基于影响函数（influence function）的数据归因推断每个策略的奖励，无需额外重训练；2）使用在线镜像下降（online mirror descent）计算组合中各策略的预算份额。该设定天然适配少轮次、大批量的高通量实验场景。
AI.result: 在涵盖分类、回归和基因扰动效应预测的7个设置上进行基准测试。结果显示策略选择本身是难题：每种现有方法至少在1个设置上表现劣于随机采样。FractAL 在全部7个设置上匹配或优于包括随机采样在内的所有基线；其预算分配集中于组合中最强的策略，并剪除最弱的策略。
AI.conclusion: FractAL 是面向真实部署的可靠选择——在最优策略未知时可稳定工作，是推动主动学习走向高通量实验与现代科学发现实际应用的重要一步。

title: What Does an Observability Foundation Model Know?
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS Main Conference '26. 25 pages
summary: A linear probe can show that a label is recoverable from a model's hidden states, but not whether that goes beyond what the input already reveals, or whether the model uses it. We audit Toto, an observability forecasting foundation model, on the Benchmark of Observability Metrics (BOOM) across five series-disjoint resplits, comparing linear probes on its frozen residual stream with models that read the raw input window and with Toto's architecture stripped of its trained configuration. Short-vs-medium cadence and metric type are more linearly recoverable from Toto's residuals than from the strongest raw-window model in every resplit (macro-F1 0.766 vs. 0.633 and 0.545 vs. 0.498). Domain is nearly tied, and series cardinality is recovered far better from the raw window. MOMENT-base shows related cadence, metric-type, and domain readouts. Recoverability is not use: exchanging Toto's residuals with those of high-burst donors moves a future-burstiness readout as intended but does not make forecasts consistently burstier than a randomized donor. A BOOM-trained coordination probe has negative zero-shot R^2 on the tested external benchmarks. We report each label against its strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 该论文对可观测性预测基础模型 Toto 进行探针审计：在 BOOM 基准的五个序列不相交重划分上比较冻结残差流线性探针、原始输入窗口模型及剥离训练配置的 Toto 架构。结论是残差中确实线性可恢复短/中节奏和指标类型等标签，但"可恢复"不等于"被使用"，因果替换实验与外部零样本协调探针均表明探针结论不能直接解释为模型行为。
AI.motivation: 线性探针只能说明标签可从隐藏状态中恢复，无法判断这些信息是否超出输入本身已提供的内容，也无法证明模型实际使用了该信息。因此需要一套审计框架，将"可恢复性"与"实际使用"明确区分开来，避免把探针结果误读为模型能力或行为证据。
