AI.method: 以观测性预测基础模型 Toto 为对象，在 Benchmark of Observability Metrics（BOOM）的五个序列不相交重划分上进行审计。设置三类对照：(1) 对冻结残差流做线性探针；(2) 仅读取原始输入窗口的模型作为强基线；(3) 剥离训练配置的 Toto 架构。每个标签均与其最强基线对比，并额外在与 Toto 不同的 MOMENT-base 上做同类读出以考察普适性。进一步通过将 Toto 残差替换为高突发供体残差，检验可恢复性是否转化为因果使用；并训练 BOOM 协调探针，在外部基准上评估零样本 R²。
AI.result: 短/中节奏与指标类型在 Toto 残差中的线性可恢复性在全部五个重划分中均优于最强原始窗口模型（macro-F1 分别为 0.766 对 0.633 和 0.545 对 0.498）。领域标签几乎持平，序列基数则从原始窗口恢复得远好于从残差恢复。MOMENT-base 呈现相关的节奏、指标类型和领域读出。因果替换实验中，用高突发供体残差替换 Toto 残差虽按预期改变了未来突发性读出，但并未使预测结果比随机供体更持续地偏突发。BOOM 训练的协调探针在测试的外部基准上零样本 R² 为负。
AI.conclusion: 可恢复性不等于使用。线性探针的优越性能只能说明标签信息在残差流中线性可分，不能证明模型在下游预测中实际依赖该信息；因果替换不产生一致的预测行为改变，且跨域协调探针零样本性能为负。因此模型审计应同时报告每个标签相对其最强基线的结果，并将探针可恢复性与因果使用证据分开陈述。

title: When the Cross-Silo Federation Goes Offline: Continual Learning for Site Onboarding with Limited Unlabeled Data
comment: Accepted to the Continual Learning for Enterprise AI Agents (CLEA) workshop at NeurIPS 2026. 9 pages, 1 figure, plus appendix
summary: An organization often holds too little labeled data to train a model that generalizes, and the records that would supply the rest sit with organizations that cannot release them. Cross-silo federated learning offers a way through, since participants exchange model parameters rather than records, but it ordinarily settles two aspects of the arrangement in advance, the participating sites and the classes the model can predict, and deployment can breach both. A new site joins after training, once the established sites have finished their engagement and gone offline, and its records arrive unlabeled, mixing conditions the model already recognizes with conditions no participant has observed. We present an autonomous three-stage procedure that expands the model entirely at the joining site: reconstruction experts screen for novelty, clustering separates the flagged records into candidate conditions, and class means describe the old classes, all inside one shared representation. Those classes were learned from records that never leave their owners, so the usual defenses against forgetting are unavailable, and the procedure supplies the evidence they would have carried from either of two dissimilar sources, prototypes held by the federation or records held by the joining site. On a real industrial condition-monitoring dataset, run end to end with no label consulted, either source holds old-class accuracy at 0.868 or above with forgetting at most 0.063, and the two differ by 0.021, so a configuration can be chosen by the disclosure it permits rather than the accuracy it delivers. Both keep old- and new-class accuracy in balance where every alternative we measure gives up one for the other, and both retain more of the old classes than distillation- and regularization-based baselines. The balance still holds with only 6 labeled records per arriving condition and 3 retained per old class.

AI.tldr: 提出一种在加入站点本地自主执行的三阶段方法，用于跨孤岛联邦学习中的事后新站点接入与未标注新类发现，无需原始数据即可缓解遗忘。
AI.motivation: 组织常缺乏足量标注数据训练可泛化模型，而拥有数据的机构无法共享记录；跨孤岛联邦学习虽以参数交换替代数据共享，但通常预设参与站点与可预测类别，部署时二者均可能被打破：新站点在既有站点完成训练并下线后加入，其记录无标注，且混合了已知条件与所有参与者均未观测的新条件。
AI.method: 提出自主三阶段流程，全部在加入站点完成模型扩展：重构专家筛查新颖样本；聚类将标记记录分离为候选类别；类均值在共享表示内刻画旧类。由于旧类学自不离开所有者的记录，常规防遗忘手段不可用，因此流程提供两类异源证据：联邦持有的原型，或加入站点持有的记录，以替代其本应携带的旧类信息。
AI.result: 在真实工业状态监测数据集上端到端运行且不查询任何标签：两种证据来源下旧类准确率均≥0.868，遗忘≤0.063，二者相差0.021，因此可按允许的披露程度而非精度来配置。两者均保持新旧类准确率平衡，而所测所有替代方法都以一方换另一方；且比基于蒸馏和正则化的基线保留更多旧类。在每新增条件仅6条标注记录、每旧类仅保留3条时平衡仍成立。
AI.conclusion: 该工作使联邦模型可在新站点离线加入场景下自主扩展，通过原型或本地记录的异源证据实现新旧类平衡并抑制遗忘，为按披露约束选择配置提供了可行路径。

title: An LLM-in-the-loop RL Framework for Bioinformatics Feature Selection
summary: High-dimensional bioinformatics data, characterized by a large number of features relative to the number of samples, pose major challenges such as the ``curse of dimensionality,'' leading to overfitting, high computational cost, and poor generalization. Traditional feature selection methods often suffer from limited scalability and adaptability in such domains. We propose an LLM-in-the-loop reinforcement learning (RL) framework for bioinformatics feature selection, where the RL agent formulates feature selection as a sequential decision-making task, while the large language model (LLM) enhances the process in two ways: (1) guiding exploration through domain-informed advice, and (2) providing hybrid rewards that integrate data-driven performance with knowledge-driven evaluation. The LLM also produces explanations to improve interpretability for human experts without altering the RL policy update. Experiments on diverse bioinformatics datasets show that the LLM-in-the-loop framework outperforms baselines, achieves stable performance across downstream models, and converges faster than pure RL.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM-in-the-loop强化学习框架用于生物信息学特征选择，LLM提供领域探索引导与混合奖励，实验表明其优于基线、跨下游模型稳定且收敛更快。
AI.motivation: 高维生物信息学数据存在特征数远多于样本数的问题，引发"维度灾难"，导致过拟合、计算开销大和泛化差；传统特征选择方法在此类场景中可扩展性与适应性不足。
AI.method: 将特征选择建模为强化学习的序贯决策任务；在RL循环中引入LLM，通过两种方式增强：(1)以领域知识建议引导探索；(2)提供融合数据驱动性能与知识驱动评估的混合奖励；LLM同时生成解释以提升可解释性，但不改变RL策略更新。
AI.result: 在多种生物信息学数据集上，该框架优于基线方法，在不同下游模型上性能稳定，且比纯RL收敛更快。
AI.conclusion: LLM-in-the-loop RL框架可有效缓解高维生物信息学特征选择中的可扩展性与适应性问题，兼顾性能、稳定性、收敛效率与可解释性。

title: Your Unlearning Gives You Away: Identifying Erased Concepts in Diffusion Models
summary: Existing attacks on unlearned diffusion models assume that the erased concepts are known in advance and focus on recovering them. In practice, however, model providers may not disclose which concepts have been removed, and even with access to the original base model, an adversary may still lack a clear target to attack. In this paper, we aim to answer the following critical but overlooked questions: which concepts have been erased from the model, and how many have been erased in total? To this end, we present Tracer, a framework that rapidly and accurately identifies erased concepts and estimates their number. Tracer efficiently identifies erased concepts without generating and classifying images. By combining lightweight spectral analysis of weight footprints, it enables efficient search over large candidate vocabularies. To distinguish multiple erased concepts, we introduce a footprint coverage objective that guides sequential discovery. Tracer estimates the number of erased concepts by detecting a sharp decline in candidate confidence as the selected concepts account for the erasure footprint, without requiring labeled examples for calibration. The framework requires only lightweight linear algebra and limited forward probes, with no prior knowledge of the unlearning algorithm. Experiments across text-to-image and text-to-video backbones and diverse unlearning methods demonstrate that Tracer identifies erased concepts and estimates their number in seconds, achieving 150 to 137,000 times and 133 to 20,000 times speedups over MIA and brute-force search on image and video models, respectively, with substantially higher identification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Tracer 框架，可在不知晓被删除概念的前提下，快速识别扩散模型中已被擦除的概念并估计其数量。
AI.motivation: 现有针对未学习（unlearned）扩散模型的攻击假定被擦除概念已知，仅关注恢复它们；但实际中模型提供方未必披露删除内容，即使有原始基座模型，攻击者也缺乏明确目标。因此需要回答"哪些概念被擦除、共擦除了多少"这一被忽视的问题。
AI.method: Tracer 无需生成并分类图像即可识别被擦除概念：结合权重足迹的轻量谱分析，实现大规模候选词表的高效搜索；引入足迹覆盖（footprint coverage）目标引导顺序发现以区分多个被擦除概念；通过检测候选置信度在所选概念覆盖擦除足迹时出现的急剧下降来估计数量，无需标注样本校准。仅需轻量线性代数与有限前向探测，不依赖对未学习算法的先验知识。
AI.result: 在多种文本到图像与文本到视频骨干网络及多种未学习方法上，Tracer 可在数秒内识别被擦除概念并估计其数量，在图像与视频模型上分别较 MIA 与暴力搜索实现 150~137,000 倍和 133~20,000 倍加速，且识别准确率显著更高。
AI.conclusion: Tracer 首次系统性地解决"哪些概念被擦除及擦除总数"的问题，兼具高效率与高准确率，且不依赖未学习算法先验，适用于文本到图像和文本到视频等多种场景。

title: CIPHER-MoE: Balancing Efficiency and Routing Fidelity in Trillion-Scale MoE Training
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) has been widely adopted in recent large language model (LLM) architectures. However, scaling up MoE in LLM training introduces system-level challenges on training, where non-uniform token routing can lead to highly imbalanced workloads across experts and devices, further destabilizing the training process. With trillion-scale LLMs, imbalanced expert workloads further amplify the resource cost of MoE training, resulting in degraded training efficiency and hardware utilization for underloaded experts, while hot experts require additional resources to accommodate excessive workloads. Recent studies address imbalanced MoE training through intricate parallelism strategies or resource reallocation. However, these system-level approaches often introduce additional resource requirements and considerable orchestration complexity, which become increasingly difficult to afford when training trillion-parameter LLMs under constrained computational resources. This work introduces CIPHER-MoE, which mitigates MoE workload imbalance while keeping the router's token-side Top-K selection unchanged. CIPHER-MoE applies affinity-aware Expert-to-Token filtering with explicit capacity control to reduce hotspot expert workloads without additional hardware resources or complex runtime design. The proposed method has been evaluated on large-scale MoE models, including DeepSeek-V4-Pro, showing up to 64.9 percentage points Top-1 expert workload reduction and 1.10$\times$-1.94$\times$ training acceleration, while preserving the training quality. The source code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CIPHER-MoE，通过亲和度感知的专家-令牌过滤与显式容量控制，在不改变路由器 Top-K 选择的前提下缓解 MoE 训练中专家负载不均衡问题，实现最高 64.9 个百分点的 Top-1 专家负载下降和 1.10×–1.94× 训练加速，且不损失训练质量。
AI.motivation: MoE 在 LLM 中被广泛采用，但训练时非均匀的令牌路由会导致专家与设备间负载高度不均衡。在万亿参数规模下，这种不均衡会放大资源开销：冷门专家硬件利用率低，热点专家则需额外资源，从而降低训练效率与稳定性。已有的并行策略或资源重分配方案会引入额外资源需求和复杂的运行时编排，在算力受限条件下难以承受。
AI.method: CIPHER-MoE 保持路由器的令牌侧 Top-K 选择不变，转而采用亲和度感知的 Expert-to-Token 过滤机制，并配合显式容量控制，在不增加硬件资源、不引入复杂运行时设计的情况下削减热点专家的负载。
AI.result: 在包括 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 在内的大规模 MoE 模型上评测，Top-1 专家负载最高降低 64.9 个百分点，训练加速达 1.10×–1.94×，同时保持训练质量。源代码即将发布。
AI.conclusion: CIPHER-MoE 以算法层面的轻量过滤与容量控制替代复杂的系统级负载均衡方案，在资源受限场景下有效缓解 MoE 训练负载不均衡，兼顾效率与质量，具备面向万亿参数 LLM 训练的实用性。

title: CACFG: Curvature-Aware Classifier-Free Guidance and Optimal Control
summary: Diffusion models generate samples by learning to reverse a fixed corruption process, and classifier-free guidance (CFG) is the standard mechanism for conditioning this process on a desired class or prompt. CFG can be applied at varying guidance strengths, and while higher strengths improve image quality and conditional alignment, too high a guidance strength can degrade image quality and diversity. Furthermore, CFG violates principled diffusion sampling dynamics, and existing explanations for why it works despite the violation disagree on the underlying theory or do not extend to deterministic samplers used in practice. We address both these issues. We first frame CFG sampling as a continuous-time optimal control problem, treating the sampling trajectory as a sequence of controls chosen to maximise the probability of the desired condition. Solving the resulting Hamilton--Jacobi--Bellman equation shows that CFG is recovered under specific path costs when using an unconstrained control set. We argue this lack of constraint is responsible for CFG's failure at high guidance strengths, since it permits the sampling path to move arbitrarily far from the current image estimate. To fix this, we propose curvature-aware CFG (CACFG), which constrains the control set to a hypersphere informed by the Gaussian regularisation used when training variational autoencoders. We show that the control inputs produced by CFG sampling routinely violate this bound, and that across diffusion models, datasets, and guidance schedules, CACFG achieves superior generative quality at mid-to-high guidance strengths with a less severe quality-diversity tradeoff than regular CFG.

AI.tldr: 本文将无分类器引导(CFG)采样重构为连续时间最优控制问题，求解HJB方程说明CFG在无约束控制集下等价于特定路径代价，并指出缺乏约束导致高引导强度失效；提出基于曲率感知的CACFG，将控制集约束于受VAE高斯正则启发的超球面内，在多种模型与数据集上实现更优的生成质量-多样性权衡。
AI.motivation: CFG虽提升图像质量与条件对齐，但过高引导强度会损害质量与多样性，且违背扩散采样动力学。现有解释在其理论基础上存在分歧，也难以推广到实际使用的确定性采样器，因此需要统一的理论框架并解决高引导强度下的性能退化问题。
AI.method: 将CFG采样建模为连续时间最优控制问题，把采样轨迹视为最大化目标条件概率的控制序列；求解相应的Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman方程，证明在无约束控制集与特定路径代价下可导出CFG。基于此，提出曲率感知CFG(CACFG)，将控制集约束于一个由VAE训练时高斯正则化启发的超球面内。
AI.result: 分析表明CFG采样产生的控制输入经常违反该超球面约束，而无约束允许采样路径任意偏离当前图像估计。跨多种扩散模型、数据集与引导调度，CACFG在中高引导强度下取得更优生成质量，且质量-多样性权衡的退化比常规CFG更轻微。
AI.conclusion: 无约束控制集是CFG高引导强度失效的根源；通过曲率感知的球面约束控制集，CACFG在保持理论一致性的同时改善了生成质量与多样性权衡，为扩散采样引导机制提供了新解释与更优的替代方案。

title: CCQ: A Multi-State Child Care Quality Dataset to Support AI for Children's Health Research
comment: 29 pages, 8 figures, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/GAIN-Lab/CCQ ; Code: https://github.com/Veeeeeee7/CCQ
summary: High-quality child care in early life is a critical determinant of children's growth and development. Research on child care quality has been constrained by fragmented, non-research-friendly, and privacy-bound datasets. We present CCQ (Child Care Quality), a large-scale, de-identified dataset for applied data science research at the intersection of AI and early childhood health. CCQ integrates 59,372 child care provider records across 12 U.S. states, covering diverse provider types as well as data schemas. To ensure research utility while protecting privacy, we implement an automated, LLM-based curation pipeline that anonymizes, cleans, and standardizes raw state records into two complementary releases: a cleaned textual release and a fully preprocessed tabular release. We also benchmark traditional machine learning models, tabular foundation models, and language models on quality rating prediction and important features analytics. Within a state, tabular classifiers on the preprocessed tables perform best. Across states, zero-shot transfer is near chance, but modest target-state supervision recovers most of the within-state performance, and pretraining on other states benefits finetuned language models. We release both datasets with all code to accelerate AI-driven research on child care quality and ultimately improve children's health and development.

AI.tldr: CCQ：整合12个美国州、59,372条儿童照护提供者记录的大规模去标识化数据集，含LLM自动化整理流程与文本/表格双版本发布，并给出质量评级预测与特征分析的基准结果。
AI.motivation: 高质量儿童早期照护是儿童生长发育的关键决定因素，但相关研究受限于数据集碎片化、不利于研究使用以及隐私约束，缺乏可支撑AI与早期儿童健康交叉研究的规模化数据资源。
AI.method: 构建CCQ数据集：整合12个州的59,372条儿童照护提供者记录，涵盖多样提供者类型与数据模式；设计基于LLM的自动化整理流水线，对原始州级记录进行匿名化、清洗与标准化，输出清洗文本版与完全预处理表格版两个互补版本；在质量评级预测与重要特征分析任务上，对传统机器学习模型、表格基础模型和语言模型进行基准评测。
AI.result: 州内场景下，基于预处理表格的表格分类器表现最佳；跨州场景下零样本迁移接近随机水平，但少量目标州监督即可恢复大部分州内性能，且在其它州预训练对微调语言模型有增益。
AI.conclusion: CCQ连同全部代码一并发布，为儿童照护质量的AI驱动研究提供可复用基础设施，进而推动儿童健康与发展改善。

title: Non-invasive Seizure Detection Using Wearable Wrist-worn Accelerometry and Deep Learning
summary: Seizure monitoring and detection are crucial for reducing the morbidity and mortality associated with seizures. Current epilepsy care, often involving expensive video-electroencephalography (VEEG) monitoring, requires specialized expertise and is limited to in-hospital settings, and intrusive in nature. Seizure diaries, on the other hand, suffer from unreliability due to under-reporting, leading to incorrect therapeutic decisions. Wearable non-invasive seizure detection may offer a more tolerable and feasible solution for long-term ambulatory monitoring. This study explores a wearable remote monitoring system utilizing a single wrist-worn accelerometer device and capable of detecting multiple types of seizures, including shorter duration events. We enrolled 79 patients under video-electroencephalography monitoring to wear accelerometer devices and collect data. Concurrent VEEG recordings were reviewed by board-certified epileptologists to produce annotations, including seizure onset, offset, and seizure type. Using this data, we constructed a deep neural network based on the time-series ResNet architecture, which could discriminate among seizure and non-seizure events. Our proposed approach achieved a seizure detection sensitivity of 95.65% and an overall false alarm rate of 0.15/24 hours during the evaluation, which spanned 5576 hours of total recording. Additionally, it resulted in an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC-ROC) of 0.98 and an area under the precision-re call curve (AUC-PRC) of 0.67 when averaged over 20 patients who experienced 46 convulsive seizures. These promising results suggest that the proposed seizure detection system can be effectively used for long-term ambulatory seizure monitoring. Future steps include validating our findings in larger datasets and assessing the utility of detection for additional seizure types.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出基于单腕部加速度计的可穿戴癫痫发作检测系统，采用时间序列ResNet深度神经网络，在5576小时记录中实现95.65%灵敏度与0.15次/24小时误报率。
AI.motivation: 现有癫痫护理依赖昂贵的视频脑电图（VEEG）监测，需专业人员和住院环境，且具有侵入性；而癫痫日记因漏报导致可靠性差，影响治疗决策。因此需要一种耐受性好、可行的长期动态癫痫监测方案。
AI.method: 纳入79名在VEEG监测下的患者佩戴加速度计设备采集数据，由认证癫痫专科医师审阅同步VEEG生成发作起始、结束及类型标注；基于这些数据构建时间序列ResNet架构的深度神经网络，区分癫痫发作与非发作事件。
AI.result: 癫痫检测灵敏度达95.65%，总体误报率为0.15次/24小时（评估涵盖5576小时总记录）；在经历46次惊厥性发作的20名患者上平均，AUC-ROC为0.98，AUC-PRC为0.67。
AI.conclusion: 该系统可有效用于长期动态癫痫监测。未来工作包括在更大数据集上验证结果，并评估其对其他发作类型的检测效用。

title: ThunderSyncRL: Lossless Acceleration of Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Language models are moving beyond generating answers to pursuing long-horizon goals in interactive environments. Post-training these agents requires long, heterogeneous trajectories, and synchronous systems leave learner engines idle until rollout and verification finish. To squeeze out these pipeline bubbles, asynchronous training overlaps rollout and learning across updates, but comes at the cost of policy staleness. We introduce ThunderSyncRL, which starts gradient computation as soon as all required inputs are fixed, without policy staleness. For group relative policy optimization (GRPO), ThunderSyncRL computes each trajectory's score gradient as soon as the reward for that trajectory arrives, without waiting for the group. For on-policy distillation (OPD), it computes gradients for each completed agentic turn's teacher-scored actions while tool calls run in the sandbox. We prove that gradient streaming produces the same GRPO and OPD updates as batch-synchronous training, without changing either objective. On SWE-bench Verified and Terminal Bench 4.0, we train models to the same performance up to $1.9 \times$ faster than synchronous training. With zero policy staleness, ThunderSyncRL also outperforms asynchronous training at a fixed budget by up to $2.47$ percentage points.

AI.tldr: ThunderSyncRL：无策略陈旧的梯度流式训练框架
AI.motivation: 语言模型正从生成答案转向在交互环境中追求长时程目标，其训练需要长且异构的轨迹。同步系统会让学习引擎空等rollout与验证完成，而异步训练虽能重叠rollout与学习却引入策略陈旧问题。
AI.method: 提出ThunderSyncRL：在所有必需输入固定后立即开始梯度计算，且不产生策略陈旧。对GRPO，每条轨迹的奖励到达后立即计算其得分梯度，无需等待整组；对OPD，在沙箱中工具调用执行期间，即对已完成的每个agentic轮次中经教师打分的动作计算梯度。
AI.result: 证明梯度流式产生的GRPO与OPD更新与批同步训练完全相同，且不改变目标函数。在SWE-bench Verified与Terminal Bench 4.0上，达到相同性能的训练速度最多快1.9倍；在零策略陈旧下，固定预算时比异步训练高出最多2.47个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ThunderSyncRL通过梯度流式实现无策略陈旧的重叠计算，既保证与同步训练等价的更新，又显著提升训练效率与效果，为长时程交互智能体的后训练提供高效方案。

title: Physics-Informed but Not Physics-Consistent: Error Geometry and Subspace Projection for Neural AC Power Flow
summary: Recent neural power-flow solvers, including emerging foundation models, achieve accurate voltage predictions, yet such accuracy does not necessarily imply physically consistent solutions. Even small complex voltage errors can yield large AC power-balance residuals. We study this accuracy-consistency gap across PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA on realistic 2224-bus Great Britain network (GBnetwork) scenarios, with cross-grid evaluation of GridSFM over 31 systems. Using a singular value decomposition (SVD) basis fitted to training AC power-flow solutions, we find that neural prediction errors contain substantial components outside the dominant solution subspace. To address this mismatch, calibrated solution-subspace projection (CSP) suppresses off-subspace prediction components after train-only bias calibration, reducing Mean PB by 67.0%, 37.8%, 40.5%, and 68.9% for PIGNN-GC, GridSFM, gridfm-graphkit, and LUMINA, respectively, relative to calibrated predictions, while improving voltage-magnitude accuracy in all four models. These results identify output-error geometry as an important factor in physics-consistent neural AC power flow. Code: https://github.com/Kimchangheon/neural-acpf-error-geometry

AI.tldr: 神经潮流求解器（含基础模型）电压预测准确，但物理一致性不足；本文在GBnetwork等场景用SVD子空间分析误差几何，提出CSP方法抑制子空间外分量，显著降低功率平衡残差。
AI.motivation: 近期神经潮流求解器（包括新兴基础模型）能实现准确的电压预测，但这种准确性并不必然意味着解满足物理一致性。即使很小的复数电压误差，也可能导致较大的交流功率平衡残差，即存在"准确性—一致性鸿沟"，需要加以刻画和弥合。
AI.method: 在真实2224节点英国电网（GBnetwork）场景上，对PIGNN-GC、GridSFM、gridfm-graphkit和LUMINA进行对比研究，并对GridSFM在31个系统上做跨电网评估。基于训练集交流潮流解拟合奇异值分解（SVD）基，分析神经预测误差在解子空间内外的分布；进而提出校准解子空间投影（CSP）：先仅使用训练集进行偏差校准，再抑制预测中位于主导解子空间之外的分量。
AI.result: 神经预测误差包含大量位于主导解子空间之外的分量，说明误差几何与物理不一致性密切相关。CSP在偏差校准预测的基础上，使PIGNN-GC、GridSFM、gridfm-graphkit和LUMINA的平均功率平衡残差（Mean PB）分别降低67.0%、37.8%、40.5%和68.9%，同时在四个模型上均改善了电压幅值精度。
AI.conclusion: 输出误差的几何结构是影响物理一致神经交流潮流的关键因素；通过CSP抑制子空间外误差分量，可在不牺牲（甚至提升）电压精度的前提下显著改善潮流解的物理一致性。代码已开源。

title: Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation for RL-Improved Reasoning Teachers
summary: Reinforcement learning can substantially improve a reasoning teacher, but it is unclear which of those improvements survive when the teacher supervises a smaller on-policy student. We study this question in mathematical reasoning by comparing teacher lineages before and after GRPO, multiple student scales, direct GRPO, and several on-policy distillation objectives. The central finding is that transfer is structured rather than scalar: teacher strength alone does not make dense distillation competitive, while an RL-improved teacher creates useful but metric-dependent student gains. This motivates Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD), which screens training problems by the joint sampled success of the student and teacher, routes acquisition problems to gated forward KL, routes consolidation problems to gated reverse KL, and adds an entropy brake to protect sampled coverage. Across the main comparison, TS-OPD is the strongest student objective for macro average correctness with the GRPO-improved teacher, while pass@K remains more mixed. Ablations show that the gains come from routing and token gating rather than skipping problems. These results support a transfer-aware view of OPD: stronger teachers help when the supervision direction and token budget match the student's observed ability, not merely because the teacher endpoint is stronger.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Transfer-Stratified On-Policy Distillation (TS-OPD)，按学生与教师的联合采样成功率筛选训练问题并分流监督目标，配合熵刹车，使学生模型在数学推理上取得最佳宏平均正确率。
AI.motivation: RL 能显著提升推理教师模型，但教师改进能否在监督更小的 on-policy 学生时保留尚不明确；孤立地看"教师强度"并不能预测蒸馏收益，说明知识迁移具有结构性而非标量性，需要一个迁移感知的 on-policy 蒸馏框架。
AI.method: 在数学推理任务上，对比 GRPO 前后教师谱系、多个学生规模、直接 GRPO 及多种 on-policy 蒸馏目标；据此提出 TS-OPD：按学生与教师的联合采样成功率对训练问题分层，将"习得"问题路由至门控前向 KL，将"巩固"问题路由至门控反向 KL，并加入熵刹车以保护采样覆盖度。
AI.result: 在主对比中，配合 GRPO 改进教师的 TS-OPD 是宏平均正确率最强的学生目标，而 pass@K 表现较为混杂；消融实验表明增益来自路由与 token 门控，而非跳过部分问题。
AI.conclusion: 支持迁移感知的 OPD 观点：更强的教师只有在监督方向与 token 预算匹配学生实际能力时才有效，收益并非仅源于教师端点更强。

title: Adaptive Expert Guidance for Efficient On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
summary: With massively parallel simulation, on-policy Reinforcement Learning methods such as PPO have become standard in many domains. However, learning from scratch is sample-inefficient and fails to exploit the potential existence of a suboptimal expert, such as a heuristic, a model-based controller, or a policy trained on a related task. Such an expert is often available and can guide early training, but its sub-optimality limits final performance. The challenge then becomes balancing expert guidance against learning from rewards. Existing methods set the expert's influence through a blending weight, a schedule, or an evaluation-driven curriculum. Alternatively, they adapt it with additional learned components such as critics over expert actions or auxiliary agents. However, none optimizes it using the same on-policy objective as the policy itself. We propose a method in which the learner and the expert alternate control within each training episode, and the expert's share of control is a single learnable parameter optimized jointly with the policy. The learner benefits from the expert early in training, but its share of control declines as the learner becomes more competent, until eventually vanishing completely. This leaves the learner acting alone and better than the suboptimal expert. We evaluate our method on 34 tasks across two benchmarks, spanning discrete and continuous action spaces, using both learned and model-based experts. Our method improves sample efficiency over guided and unguided baselines while requiring minimal hyperparameter variation. The expert's share decays to zero as the learner improves, vanishing when the expert is no longer useful.

AI.tldr: 提出一种方法：在每次训练回合中学习器与专家交替控制，专家的控制占比作为一个可学习参数与策略联合优化；占比随学习器变强而衰减至零，最终学习器独立行动并超越次优专家。在34个任务、两个基准上验证，提升了样本效率且超参数调整极少。
AI.motivation: 从零开始的大规模并行on-policy强化学习（如PPO）样本效率低，无法利用潜在的次优专家（启发式、基于模型的控制器或相关任务上训练的策略）。此类专家常可获得并能引导早期训练，但其次优性会限制最终性能，因此需要平衡专家引导与奖励学习。
AI.method: 学习器与专家在每个训练回合内交替控制，专家的控制占比被设为单个可学习参数，与策略使用同一on-policy目标联合优化。学习器早期受益于专家引导，随着能力提升其控制占比逐渐下降直至完全消失，最终独立行动。
AI.result: 在两个基准的34个任务上评测，涵盖离散与连续动作空间，使用学习型与基于模型的专家。相比有引导和无引导基线，方法提升了样本效率，且超参数变化需求极小；专家控制占比随学习器进步衰减至零。
AI.conclusion: 通过将专家控制占比作为可学习参数并用与策略相同的on-policy目标联合优化，可自动实现从专家引导到独立学习的平滑过渡，专家不再有用时其占比自然消失，学习器最终超越次优专家。

title: MercerFlow: Flow Matching in a Kernel-Induced Latent Space for Probabilistic Forecasting
summary: Recent work has shown that probabilistic flow matching for time series forecasting benefits from a data-matched prior. The resulting prior introduces local correlations, which a sequential architecture usually absorbs: a recurrent neural network (RNN), a structured state-space model (S4), or a Transformer. However, such a backbone costs GPU memory and time per epoch. A cheaper alternative is MLP-based latent-space flow matching: embed the time series via an invertible map to a single latent vector and learn the flow there, so a tabular MLP can treat the series as a set of features. The relationship between the prior and the choice of linear latent map is understudied in conditional flow matching (CFM) forecasting, yet we found it strongly affects performance. Fixed transforms such as Fourier or discrete cosine (DCT) are only well-conditioned for Ornstein--Uhlenbeck priors, while a principal-component (PCA) map fit to the data is a strong but training-set-dependent reference sensitive to train--test shift. Instead, we propose to use the Mercer eigenbasis of the prior kernel: it diagonalises the centred covariance exactly, decouples from training data, and adapts to non-stationary and periodic priors. On five GluonTS benchmarks (ETTh1, ETTh2, Weather, Electricity, Traffic) under a shared protocol with TSFlow, the resulting MLP matches or beats it on CRPS at about $4.7\times$ less training memory and $3.5\times$--$4.4\times$ less time per epoch.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究条件流匹配（CFM）时间序列预测中"先验分布"与"线性潜映射"的匹配关系，提出使用先验核的 Mercer 特征基作为潜映射，使 MLP 骨干在五个 GluonTS 基准上以更低显存和时间达到或超越 TSFlow 的 CRPS。
AI.motivation: 概率流匹配预测依赖数据匹配先验，该先验引入局部相关性，通常需 RNN、S4 或 Transformer 等序列骨干来吸收，但这类骨干每 epoch 的显存与时间开销高。改用 MLP + 可逆潜映射更廉价，但先验与线性潜映射选择之间的关系在 CFM 预测中缺乏研究，且实验发现该关系对性能影响很大。现有方案各有缺陷：Fourier/DCT 等固定变换仅对 Ornstein-Uhlenbeck 先验良态；PCA 映射虽强但依赖训练集，对训练-测试漂移敏感。
AI.method: 提出以先验核的 Mercer 特征基作为线性潜映射：该基能精确对角化中心化协方差，不依赖训练数据，并可适应非平稳与周期先验。将时间序列经该可逆映射嵌入为单一潜向量，再由表格型 MLP 把序列当作特征集合学习流，从而用 MLP 替代序列骨干。
AI.result: 在五个 GluonTS 基准（ETTh1、ETTh2、Weather、Electricity、Traffic）上，与 TSFlow 采用统一协议对比，所得 MLP 在 CRPS 上达到或优于 TSFlow，同时训练显存约为其 1/4.7，每 epoch 时间约为其 1/3.5–1/4.4。
AI.conclusion: 潜映射的选择对 CFM 预测性能至关重要；先验核的 Mercer 特征基提供了一个既精确对角化协方差、又免于训练集依赖、还能适应非平稳与周期先验的映射方案，使轻量 MLP 在精度与效率上同时受益，为低成本概率时间序列预测提供了有效路径。

title: Boosting Transferable Adversarial Attacks against Deep Reinforcement Learning
summary: Most adversarial attacks on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) assume white-box access to the victim policy, which rarely holds in practice. This paper studies transfer-based black-box attacks on DRL: the attacker crafts observation perturbations on a white-box surrogate agent and feeds them to an unknown victim. We formulate the attack as return minimization under a per-step perturbation budget. We first show that transplanting transferable image-classification attacks (FGSM, MI-FGSM, and NI-FGSM) with a per-step objective yields perturbations that transfer but are no stronger than random noise of the same budget. We then propose a trajectory-level attack that optimizes a sequence of perturbations over a receding horizon through a differentiable model of the environment and a temperature-smoothed surrogate policy, with the same optimizers. On CartPole-v1 with ten DQN and DDQN agents and 100 surrogate--victim pairs, the trajectory-level attack outperforms per-step attacks and random noise in the white-box, cross-model, and cross-algorithm settings.

AI.tldr: 本文将深度强化学习的迁移黑盒攻击建模为逐步扰动预算下的回报最小化问题，发现逐帧迁移的对抗样本攻击并不强于随机噪声；提出在滚动时域上优化扰动序列的轨迹级攻击，并在CartPole-v1上验证其优于逐帧攻击与随机噪声。
AI.motivation: 现有DRL对抗攻击多假设白盒访问受害者策略，这在现实中很少成立，因此需要研究更实际的基于迁移的黑盒攻击。
AI.method: 将攻击形式化为逐步扰动预算下的回报最小化；先把图像分类的可迁移攻击（FGSM、MI-FGSM、NI-FGSM）以逐帧目标迁移到DRL；再提出轨迹级攻击，借助可微环境模型与温度平滑的替代策略，在滚动时域上优化一段扰动序列，并使用相同的优化器。
AI.result: 在CartPole-v1上使用十个DQN与DDQN智能体、100对替代-受害者组合，轨迹级攻击在白盒、跨模型与跨算法设置下均优于逐帧攻击和随机噪声；而逐帧迁移攻击虽有迁移性，但不强于同预算的随机噪声。
AI.conclusion: 逐帧迁移图像分类攻击不足以构成有效DRL黑盒攻击，需在轨迹层面优化扰动序列；轨迹级方法能显著提升迁移攻击效果。

title: On the Geometry of Multimodal Saturation: Riemannian VICReg
comment: 17 pages, 6 figures. Accepted to the Proceedings Track of the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps)
summary: In self-supervised learning, a third modality should improve, or at least preserve, performance. Across nine image-text-tabular datasets, we show that it instead harms performance: the trimodal model underperforms its own best bimodal subset in 55.6% of paired runs under VICReg. The same failure occurs in 51.1% of paired runs under SimSiam. We call this failure multimodal saturation. We propose that the failure lies in the alignment geometry. Riemannian VICReg (R-VICReg) generalizes classical VICReg: it aligns views by squared geodesic distance on learnable negative-curvature product factors and recovers VICReg exactly as curvature vanishes. Over the same 45 paired runs, R-VICReg raises the probability that the third modality helps from 44.4% to 64.4%, with gains concentrated where VICReg saturates.

AI.tldr: 在多模态自监督学习中，增加第三模态本应提升或至少保持性能，但实验发现它反而损害性能（多模态饱和），作者提出通过黎曼几何对齐（R-VICReg）来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 常识认为第三模态应提升或至少保持自监督学习性能，但作者在九个图文表数据集上观察到相反现象，即三模态模型常常不如其最佳双模态子集，这一"多模态饱和"现象需要解释与解决。作者将原因归因于对齐几何结构。
AI.method: 提出 Riemannian VICReg（R-VICReg），将经典 VICReg 推广为在可学习的负曲率乘积因子上以测地距离平方对齐视图，当曲率趋于零时可精确还原为 VICReg。
AI.result: 在 55.6% 的配对运行中（VICReg）和 51.1% 的配对运行中（SimSiam），三模态模型劣于其最佳双模态子集。在同一批 45 组配对运行中，R-VICReg 将第三模态带来增益的概率从 44.4% 提升至 64.4%，且增益集中在 VICReg 发生饱和的区域。
AI.conclusion: 多模态饱和是自监督学习中的真实失败模式，其根源在于对齐几何；通过对齐几何的黎曼推广可有效提高第三模态带来增益的概率。

title: Machine learning for journal entry testing: A type-aware evaluation of anomaly detectors under a review budget
summary: Journal entry anomaly detectors are commonly evaluated on the full population with ROC-AUC, precision and recall, ignoring the review budget and which anomaly types are found. We propose a type-aware evaluation combining per-type recall, fair-share type recall (FSR), which caps each type's credit at its budget share, type coverage and first-hit rank. We evaluate nine unsupervised detectors, a supervised reference and feedback-driven Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection (DeepSAD) on four real client ledgers with injected typed anomalies and a public synthetic ledger. On the largest client ledger, principal component analysis (PCA), an autoencoder (AE) and a variational autoencoder (VAE) each place on average 98 anomalies among the first 100 postings, but at least 95.8 belong to one type. FSR instead favours a nearest-neighbour (kNN) detector and changes the top-ranked detector on three of four client ledgers. Representation also matters: one-hot encoding exposes unseen accounts, whereas frequency encoding leaves unseen contra accounts largely undetected. On the public ledger, the Histogram-Based Outlier Score (HBOS) and Empirical Cumulative Distribution-Based Outlier Detection (ECOD) reach all eight markings within 1,386 entries, whereas kNN, the hit leader at 1,000 entries, first reaches cross-linked clearing at rank 4,641, and the supervised row-level reference misses this marking within 1,000 entries. There, the adaptive DeepSAD review protocol raises mean hits per 100 reviews from 40.0 to 68.3 but type coverage only from 2.7 to 3.0. These findings show that high hit rates can conceal systematic blind spots and suggest that feedback can reinforce existing detection patterns without broadening anomaly coverage.

AI.tldr: 提出类型感知的异常检测评估框架（按类型召回率、FSR、类型覆盖率、首命中排名），在四个真实客户账本与一个公开合成账本上评估九种无监督检测器、一个监督参考及DeepSAD。结果显示高命中率往往掩盖系统性盲点，PCA/AE/VAE命中的异常高度集中于单一类型，FSR会改变最佳检测器排名。
AI.motivation: 传统日记账异常检测采用全样本ROC-AUC、精确率与召回率评估，忽略了审查预算约束与具体被发现的异常类型。这导致评估结果无法反映检测器在实际有限审查资源下的类型覆盖能力，也无法揭示其对特定异常类型的系统性盲点，因此需要一套类型感知的评估方法。
AI.method: 提出类型感知评估体系，包括：按类型召回率（per-type recall）、公平份额类型召回率（FSR，将每类贡献上限设为其预算份额）、类型覆盖率（type coverage）与首命中排名（first-hit rank）。评估对象为九种无监督检测器、一个监督行级参考以及反馈驱动的深度半监督异常检测（DeepSAD）。数据集为四个真实客户账本（注入带类型标注的异常）和一个公开合成账本。同时比较one-hot与频率编码等不同表示方式对未见账户/对方账户检测的影响。
AI.result: 在最大客户账本上，PCA、AE、VAE平均能在前100条入账中命中98个异常，但其中至少95.8个属于同一类型；FSR则更偏好kNN检测器，并在四个客户账本中的三个上改变了排名第一的检测器。表示方式影响显著：one-hot编码能暴露未见账户，频率编码则使未见对方账户大量漏检。在公开账本上，HBOS与ECOD在1,386条记录内覆盖全部八种标记；而kNN虽在1,000条时命中数领先，却直到第4,641位才首次发现交叉清算标记，监督行级参考在1,000条内亦遗漏该标记。DeepSAD审查协议将每100次审查的平均命中数从40.0提升至68.3，但类型覆盖率仅从2.7升至3.0。
AI.conclusion: 高命中率可能掩盖系统性检测盲点，仅凭整体指标会误判检测器优劣；类型感知评估（如FSR）能揭示类型集中问题并改变检测器排名。反馈驱动的自适应审查可提升命中效率，却可能强化既有检测模式而不扩大异常类型覆盖，因此评估应纳入类型维度并关注审查预算约束。

title: Anlu: Enabling In-Context Time Series Anomaly Detection in Foundation Models via Counterfactual Supervision
summary: Whether a time-series pattern is anomalous often depends on the operating regime of the monitored process. A missing event can signal a fault in one regime and be routine in another, and the query alone may not reveal which regime applies. We study in-context learning (ICL) for time series anomaly detection (TSAD) through reference-conditioned detection, where a reference record provides evidence about expected behavior and model parameters remain fixed at inference. Supplying the reference is not enough: when training anomalies are recognizable from the query alone, the detector can fit its targets while ignoring the reference. We therefore introduce counterfactual supervision, which pairs one query with two references that support different normal rules and labels the query under each. At positions where the two labels disagree, no detector that ignores the reference can fit both targets. Anlu learns from this supervision by adding a reference memory and zero-initialized gated adapters to a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM) pretrained for anomaly detection. On the 350 TSB-AD-U evaluation sequences, Anlu raises the mean VUS-PR of the frozen TSFM from 0.542 to 0.607. Replacing the reference with zeros lowers Anlu's score to 0.499.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究参考条件化的时间序列异常检测，提出反事实监督与Anlu方法，让冻结的TSFM能真正依赖参考记录进行检测。
AI.motivation: 时间序列模式是否异常取决于被监测过程的运行状态（regime）。同一缺失事件在一种状态下可能是故障，在另一种状态下却是常规行为，而仅凭查询本身可能无法判断适用哪种状态。因此需要引入参考记录来提供期望行为的证据。然而仅提供参考还不够：当训练异常仅凭查询即可识别时，检测器可能忽略参考而直接拟合目标。
AI.method: 提出反事实监督（counterfactual supervision）：为同一查询配对两条支持不同正常规则的参考，并分别在每种参考下标注该查询。在两条标签不一致的位置上，任何忽略参考的检测器都无法同时拟合这两个目标。Anlu在此基础上，向一个为异常检测预训练的冻结时间序列基础模型（TSFM）中添加参考记忆（reference memory）和零初始化的门控适配器（gated adapters）来学习该监督信号。
AI.result: 在350条TSB-AD-U评估序列上，Anlu将冻结TSFM的平均VUS-PR从0.542提升至0.607；将参考替换为零后，Anlu的得分降至0.499。
AI.conclusion: 反事实监督能有效迫使检测器真正利用参考信息，Anlu在冻结TSFM基础上显著提升了参考条件化的时间序列异常检测性能，且性能确实依赖于所提供参考的有效性。

title: SO(3)-RoPE for Spherical Transformers
comment: Accepted at the Neurips Workshop 2026: Representations for the Physical Sciences
summary: Spherical data arise in many scientific applications. Often spherical transformers disregard the geometry of the underlying spherical domain, causing distortions and coordinate singularities near the poles. We introduce SO(3)-RoPE, a relative positional embedding that incorporates spherical geometry into transformer attention through unitary SO(3) representations. Our formulation is SO(3)-equivariant and compatible with FlashAttention, retaining efficiency of vanilla transformers. On shallow water dynamics prediction over a rotating sphere, our SO3ViT outperforms an S2Transformer baseline with lower errors and reduced runtime.

AI.tldr: 提出SO(3)-RoPE相对位置编码，将球面几何通过SO(3)酉表示融入Transformer注意力，实现SO(3)等变且兼容FlashAttention。在旋转球面浅水动力学预测中，SO3ViT优于S2Transformer基线。
AI.motivation: 球面数据广泛存在于科学应用中，但现有球面Transformer往往忽略球面域的内在几何，导致极区附近的畸变与坐标奇异性。
AI.method: 提出SO(3)-RoPE，一种相对位置编码方法，借助SO(3)酉表示将球面几何引入Transformer注意力机制；该编码具有SO(3)等变性，并与FlashAttention兼容，从而保留原始Transformer的计算效率。
AI.result: 在旋转球面上的浅水动力学预测任务中，SO3ViT相较S2Transformer基线误差更低，且运行时间更短。
AI.conclusion: 将球面几何以SO(3)等变位置编码形式融入注意力，可在保持高效的同时提升球面动力学预测的精度与速度。

title: Few-Shot Prototype Head Adaptation for On-Device ECG Personalization on PSoC~6
summary: Wearable and bedside electrocardiogram (ECG) monitors must adapt to patient-specific morphology to maintain arrhythmia detection accuracy across users, yet personalization is typically performed offline and cannot account for individual physiology, electrode placement, or recording drift. On-device adaptation by backpropagation is expensive for microcontroller-class medical devices because it requires an optimizer state, repeated backward passes through convolutional layers, and labeled arrhythmic beats that may not be available at deployment time. This letter proposes prototype-only head adaptation as a compact personalization primitive for TinyML ECG systems. A one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1-D CNN; 1,314 parameters and 72.6k multiply-accumulate operations per beat) is trained offline on the MIT-BIH Arrhythmia Database under an inter-patient protocol, frozen as a feature extractor, and exported to a PSoC 6 microcontroller. Patient-specific adaptation then reduces to computing closed-form class means in a 32-dimensional embedding space, requiring no convolutional backward pass, no iterative optimization, and only one forward pass per support beat. Prototype adaptation improves inter-patient macro-F1 from 0.635/0.639/0.646 to 0.731/0.771/0.797 at 1/5/10-shot, outperforming linear stochastic-gradient-descent (SGD) head fine-tuning at every shot count for the target tiny backbone. On-device replay over 18 one-shot episodes on a PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F matches the host macro-F1 for the prototype head (0.798), with 11.39 ms per beat, 5.2 KB flash, and 22.2 KB SRAM. A restricted variant that updates only the normal-class prototype from passively buffered sinus beats yields a consistent +0.05 macro-F1 gain, reducing the annotation burden during initial

AI.tldr: 提出"仅原型头部自适应"作为TinyML心电系统的轻量个性化方法：冻结1-D CNN特征提取器，仅在32维嵌入空间用闭式类均值实现患者自适应，无需卷积反向传播与迭代优化，在PSoC 6上实现片上实时推理。
AI.motivation: 可穿戴与床旁ECG监测需适配患者个体形态以维持心律失常检测精度，但现有个人化多为离线进行，无法应对个体生理差异、电极放置与记录漂移；而在微控制器级医疗设备上做反向传播自适应代价过高——需要优化器状态、反复的卷积层反向传播，以及部署时未必可得的带标签异常心搏。
AI.method: 训练一个1-D CNN（1,314参数，每心搏72.6k MAC），在MIT-BIH心律失常数据库上以inter-patient协议离线训练后冻结为特征提取器，部署至PSoC 6。患者自适应仅需在32维嵌入空间中计算闭式类均值，每个支持样本只需一次前向传播，无卷积反向传播、无迭代优化。对比基线为线性SGD头部微调。另设受限变体：仅利用被动缓冲的窦性心搏更新正常类原型。
AI.result: 原型自适应将inter-patient macro-F1从0.635/0.639/0.646提升至0.731/0.771/0.797（1/5/10-shot），在各shot数下均优于线性SGD头部微调。PSoC 6 Cortex-M4F上18个one-shot回合的片上复现达到与主机一致的macro-F1（0.798），每心搏11.39 ms，占用5.2 KB flash、22.2 KB SRAM。仅更新正常类原型的受限变体稳定获得+0.05 macro-F1增益，降低初始标注负担。
AI.conclusion: 仅原型头部自适应为TinyML ECG系统提供了一种紧凑、免反向传播、低标注需求的患者个性化原语，可在资源受限微控制器上片上实时运行并保持与主机相当的精度，其中正常类原型更新变体进一步降低了部署期标注负担。

title: Ramp Metering Control via Hybrid State Deep Reinforcement Learning in Partially Observable Connected Vehicle Environments
summary: Freeway on-ramp merges are major sources of congestion, causing significant economic and environmental costs. While Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) offers a promising solution for ramp metering, existing approaches rely primarily on aggregated macroscopic data. Connected vehicles (CVs) provide vehicle-level observations that can complement aggregate traffic measurements, but their limited penetration produces incomplete microscopic information. This paper proposes a hybrid observation representation combining macroscopic traffic measurements with a two-channel grid encoding observed CV presence and speed. A Dueling Double Deep Q-Network processes these inputs to select ramp-metering green durations. The controller is trained under varying traffic demands and CV penetration rates and evaluated against ALINEA and macroscopic-only DRL variants in SUMO. Across 50 matched evaluation scenarios, the hybrid controller under partial CV visibility reduces the reported total travel time by 11.4 % and mean spillback duration by 84.9 % relative to ALINEA. Evaluating the same trained policy with full CV visibility yields a further travel-time reduction of approximately 1.6 %. Analysis across penetration rates suggests that the performance gap decreases as microscopic observations become more complete. These results support the use of complementary macroscopic and sparse microscopic observations for learning-based ramp metering. The source code implementation of the model is available at: https://github.com/youcefMehamlia/Multimodal-DRL-RMC

AI.tldr: 提出宏观交通测量与双通道CV网格编码(存在性+速度)的混合观测表示，用Dueling Double DQN学习匝道控制绿灯时长，在SUMO中于CV低渗透率下显著优于ALINEA。
AI.motivation: 高速公路入口匝道汇入是拥堵主要来源，造成显著经济与环境成本。现有DRL匝道控制方法主要依赖宏观聚合数据；而网联车(CV)可提供车辆级观测以补充宏观测量，但其渗透率有限导致微观信息不完整。因此需要一种能同时利用宏观与稀疏微观观测的表示方法。
AI.method: 构建混合观测表示：宏观交通测量 + 双通道网格编码（分别编码观测到的CV存在性与速度）。采用Dueling Double Deep Q-Network处理该输入，输出匝道控制的绿灯时长。在不同交通需求和CV渗透率下训练控制器，并在SUMO中与ALINEA及仅宏观输入的DRL变体进行对比评估。
AI.result: 在50个匹配评估场景中，部分CV可见性下混合控制器相比ALINEA将报告的总行程时间降低11.4%，平均排队溢出持续时间降低84.9%。以完全CV可见性评估同一训练策略时，行程时间进一步降低约1.6%。跨渗透率分析表明，随着微观观测趋于完整，性能差距逐渐缩小。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在基于学习的匝道控制中联合使用互补的宏观观测与稀疏微观观测；随着CV渗透率提升，混合表示相对优势减小。源代码已开源。

title: Scaling Down the Scaling Laws: Parameter Efficiency and Compute-Optimal Training in Resource-Constrained Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved substantial performance gains through increases in model size, training data, and computational resources. However, traditional scaling approaches produce diminishing returns, rising financial and environmental costs, and barriers to participation for researchers operating outside large industrial laboratories. This review examines the evolution of LLM scaling theory from empirical scaling laws to compute-optimal training, with particular emphasis on parameter efficiency, token utilization, data efficiency, and resource-constrained environments. Foundational work on scaling laws is synthesized alongside later research on compute-optimal training, data pruning, efficient architectures, quantization, low-rank adaptation, and edge-oriented optimization. The literature indicates a shift from scale maximization toward more deliberate allocation of parameters, tokens, compute, and hardware resources. At the same time, important empirical, theoretical, and methodological gaps remain regarding whether scaling principles established on enterprise-grade infrastructure generalize to smaller models and constrained computing environments. This review organizes these developments into a unified framework for resource-efficient LLM training and argues that future progress should evaluate efficiency not solely through model performance, but through the relationship among performance, parameter count, computational cost, token allocation, and hardware constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文综述大语言模型缩放理论的演进，从经验缩放律到计算最优训练，聚焦参数效率、词元利用、数据效率与资源受限环境，并提出资源高效训练的统一框架。
AI.motivation: 传统依靠增大模型规模、训练数据和算力的缩放路径出现收益递减，且带来高昂的财务与环境成本，使大型工业实验室之外的研究者难以参与，因此需要重新审视并转向资源高效的缩放范式。
AI.method: 文献综述方法：整合早期缩放律基础研究与后续计算最优训练、数据剪枝、高效架构、量化、低秩适配及面向边缘设备的优化等研究，系统梳理并组织为统一框架。
AI.result: 文献显示研究重心正从"规模最大化"转向对参数、词元、算力与硬件资源的审慎配置；同时指出在"企业级基础设施上建立的缩放原则能否推广到更小模型与受限计算环境"方面仍存在经验、理论与方法上的空白。
AI.conclusion: 未来进展不应仅以模型性能衡量效率，而应综合考察性能、参数量、计算成本、词元分配与硬件约束之间的关系，为资源高效的大语言模型训练提供统一评价视角。

title: ARO: Aligned Representation learning for multi-Omics data
comment: Proceedings of the ICML 2026 3rd Workshop on Multi-modal Foundation Models and Large Language Models for Life Sciences, Seoul, Korea
summary: The high cost of functional molecular assays, and prevalence of missing modalities and unmatched samples in computational biology, create significant barriers to comprehensive multi-omic profiling, essential for capturing and reasoning over molecules, cells, tissues, and organisms. This work proposes a model that learns meaningful representations from multi-omics cancer data supporting the reconstruction of missing and unpaired modalities. Contrary to increasingly complex, larger models, e.g. Foundation Models (FMs), ARO prioritizes practical applicability in limited or incomplete data settings. ARO optimally reconstructs missing modalities (MSE of $0.15$ on the validation and test data in the Unmasked settings), with its learned latent embeddings enabling a downstream cancer classification task. Our findings indicate that analyzing diverse molecular layers as a single integrated system offers a reliable and cost-efficient approach, reducing dependence on large-scale experimental testing, while still supporting multi-omic exploration in limited data settings.

AI.tldr: 提出ARO模型，从多组学癌症数据中学习有效表征并重建缺失/未配对模态，在有限数据场景下实现高效癌症分类。
AI.motivation: 功能分子检测成本高、缺失模态与未配对样本普遍存在，阻碍了全面的多组学分析。现有方法（如基础模型FMs）越来越复杂庞大，不适合数据有限或不完整的实际场景。
AI.method: ARO模型从多组学癌症数据中学习有意义的表征，支持缺失与未配对模态的重建；与日益复杂的大型模型（如FMs）不同，ARO优先考虑有限或不完整数据场景下的实用性；将不同分子层作为单一集成系统分析。
AI.result: 在Unmasked设置下，ARO对缺失模态的重建达到最优效果（验证集和测试集MSE均为0.15）；其学习到的潜在嵌入可支持下游癌症分类任务。
AI.conclusion: 将多样分子层作为单一集成系统分析，是一种可靠且成本高效的方法，可减少对大规模实验检测的依赖，同时仍支持有限数据下的多组学探索。

title: A Physics-Guided Transformer Framework for Electromigration Analysis in Multi-Segment Interconnects
summary: As technology scales to smaller nodes, increasing current densities make electromigration (EM) one of the dominant reliability challenges in on-chip interconnects. Accurate transient stress analysis is needed to identify wires susceptible to EM degradation, but applying physics-based solvers across many interconnects remains computationally expensive. This paper proposes a physics-guided transformer framework for fast EM stress prediction in multi-segment interconnect lines. The framework converts each line into geometry- and DC-aware segment tokens and uses transformer attention to capture line-level context. A lightweight query decoder then predicts stress at selected locations and time instants. The model is trained with an objective that combines normalized supervised regression, linewise relative-$L_2$ loss, and physics-guided continuity and terminal-flux terms. Experiments on IBM power grid benchmarks show that the proposed model achieves relative-$L_2$ error below 8\% and reaches up to 2459.68$\times$ speedup compared with the matrix exponential~solver.

AI.tldr: 提出物理引导Transformer框架，实现多段互连线的快速电迁移应力预测。
AI.motivation: 工艺微缩使电流密度上升，电迁移成为片上互连主要可靠性问题；需精确瞬态应力分析识别易退化导线，但基于物理的求解器在大批量互连线上的计算成本过高。
AI.method: 将每条互连线转化为几何与DC感知的分段token，用Transformer注意力捕获线级上下文；轻量级查询解码器预测选定位置与时刻的应力；训练目标结合归一化监督回归、线级相对L2损失及物理引导的连续性与端通量项。
AI.result: 在IBM电网基准上相对L2误差低于8%，相比矩阵指数求解器最高取得2459.68倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 该物理引导Transformer在保持高精度的同时大幅提升电迁移应力分析效率，适用于大规模互连线的快速可靠性评估。

title: Latent Flow Matching for Molecular Graph Generation
summary: Modern graph generative models typically operate directly in the discrete graph space, explicitly generating node and edge variables, which can become costly as graphs grow. In this paper, we perform generation explicitly on latent representations of entire graphs obtained from a pretrained Variational Autoencoder with high reconstruction fidelity. The generated representations, obtained through flow matching, are then decoded only at the final step. Across molecular benchmarks of increasing size, our approach achieves strong validity and FCD while offering a favorable quality-efficiency trade-off compared with state-of-the-art explicit graph generative models. One of the main advantages of this formulation is that the graph representation only needs to be learned once, after which the same one can be reused across multiple generative objectives without retraining. We demonstrate generation guided by molecular properties and further introduce validity-aware generation though a classifier learned directly in latent space. All code will be made available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在预训练VAE的图潜在表示上进行流匹配生成，仅在最后一步解码，实现质量与效率的平衡，并支持属性引导与有效性感知生成。
AI.motivation: 主流图生成模型直接在离散图空间生成节点和边，随图规模增大成本迅速上升；作者希望借助高质量的图潜在表示来规避显式离散生成的开销。
AI.method: 先用高重构保真度的预训练Variational Autoencoder学习整图潜在表示，再在该连续潜在空间上使用flow matching进行生成，生成结果仅在最后一步解码为图。由于表示只需学习一次，可复用于多种生成目标；并引入在潜在空间直接学习的分类器，实现分子属性引导生成与有效性感知生成。
AI.result: 在规模递增的分子基准上取得较强的validity与FCD，相比最先进的显式图生成模型具有更优的质量-效率权衡；并展示了属性引导生成与latent space classifier支持的有效性感知生成。
AI.conclusion: 在整图潜在空间进行流匹配生成可有效提升图生成的效率与可复用性，避免重复训练表示，并为属性控制与有效性约束提供统一框架；代码将在接收后公开。

title: Differentially Private Mixing of Public Datasets Improves Private Learning
summary: Many machine learning applications involve sensitive data and therefore require training under differential privacy (DP). However, DP training often degrades model utility. In some cases, first pre-training the model on "public" data before finetuning with DP on the sensitive data can reduce the drop in utility. However, the success of this depends on how relevant the selected public dataset is to the sensitive data. We introduce the first pipeline that privately learns the mixture of several public datasets to pretrain on for a given sensitive downstream task. Our key insight is that we can privately find the best mixture of multiple public datasets by privately learning a low-dimensional linear model. We tested our method on the NIH dataset for X-ray classification and the ENRON email dataset for language modeling. Applying our method to find tailored mixtures of X-ray datasets to pretrain on for diseases in the NIH ChestX-ray14 dataset, we improved macro AUC by up to 0.037 across privacy budgets compared to the baselines, with gains as large as +22.8% relative AUC on Cardiomegaly at $ε=1$. For DP training on the ENRON dataset, pre-training on our mixture of The Common Pile (a collection of public-domain text datasets) decreased test perplexity by 16% relative to the baseline mixtures.

AI.tldr: 提出首个在差分隐私(DP)下为敏感下游任务私下学习多公共数据集混合比例以进行预训练的pipeline，核心是用隐私保护的"低维线性模型"来学习最佳混合权重。在NIH胸部X-ray分类与ENRON邮件语言建模任务上均优于基线。
AI.motivation: DP训练通常会损害模型效用。在敏感数据上用DP微调前，先在"公共"数据上预训练可缓解效用下降，但效果取决于公共数据集与敏感数据的相关性。因此需要一个能针对给定敏感任务挑选合适公共数据（及其混合比例）的方法，同时不泄露敏感数据的隐私。
AI.method: 首个可在隐私约束下学习多个公共数据集混合比例的pipeline：核心思路是将"寻找最佳混合比例"这一任务转化为私下学习一个低维线性模型，从而在满足DP的前提下确定各公共数据集的权重，用于DP微调前的预训练。
AI.result: 在NIH ChestX-ray14的X-ray分类任务上，用该方法为各疾病寻找定制化的X-ray公共数据集混合进行预训练，相比基线在各隐私预算下macro AUC最高提升0.037，在ε=1时Cardiomegaly上相对AUC提升高达+22.8%。在ENRON邮件数据集的DP训练中，用基于The Common Pile（公共领域文本数据集集合）的混合预训练，使测试困惑度相对基线混合下降16%。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，在差分隐私训练中，通过隐私保护地学习公共数据集的混合比例进行预训练，能显著提升模型效用，优于既有基线，适用于图像分类与语言建模等多类任务。

title: Closing the Context Gap: Activation Alignment for Tabular In-Context Learning
summary: Tabular foundation models perform in-context learning (ICL) by conditioning predictions on labeled training examples provided as context. Unlike traditional models that separate training from inference, these models must process all training examples in every forward pass, making each prediction expensive. Restricting the number of training examples reduces this cost but substantially degrades performance. Instead of discarding context, we propose activation alignment, a method that leverages the full context to teach a model how to behave when seeing only a subset. This is achieved by training a lightweight linear transformation on synthetic unlabeled data to map the intermediate activations of a data-constrained "student" (using partial context) toward those of a full-context "teacher" (using all data). Training the aligner requires no GPU and converges in seconds to minutes on commodity hardware. We evaluate on 38 classification datasets from the TabArena benchmark using the leading two tabular foundation models, TabPFN-3 and TabFM. Across all context budgets, the aligned student yields broad, statistically significant improvements over the unaligned baseline for both models. In low-data regimes, alignment recovers nearly half of the teacher's predictive advantage. The method provides a practical, low-overhead approach to achieving the inference speed of compact contexts while closing a significant fraction of the performance gap to the full-context teacher.

AI.tldr: 提出"激活对齐"方法：用全上下文的教师模型引导仅用部分上下文的轻量学生模型，在无需GPU、秒至分钟训练对齐器的条件下，显著提升受限上下文下的表格基础模型性能。
AI.motivation: 表格基础模型依赖上下文学习，每次预测都需处理全部训练样本，推理代价高；而直接减少上下文样本数虽降低成本，却会大幅损害性能。因此需要一种在不放弃全上下文信息的前提下降低推理开销的方案。
AI.method: 激活对齐：在合成无标签数据上训练一个轻量线性变换，将数据受限的"学生"（使用部分上下文）的中间激活映射到使用全部数据的"教师"的中间激活，从而把全上下文的行为"教"给用小子集推理的模型。对齐器训练无需GPU，在普通硬件上数秒至数分钟即可收敛。
AI.result: 在TabArena的38个分类数据集上，用TabPFN-3与TabFM两个领先表格基础模型评估：在所有上下文预算下，对齐后的学生模型相对未对齐基线均有广泛且统计显著的提升；在低数据量场景，对齐可挽回教师模型约一半的预测优势。
AI.conclusion: 该方法以极低开销实现紧凑上下文的推理速度，同时缩小了与全上下文教师模型之间相当一部分的性能差距，是一种实用且低成本的方案。

title: BRANCH-MoE: Balance-Aware Tree Routing for Large Embedding Models
summary: Mixture-of-experts (MoE) layers increase model capacity without a proportional increase in per-example computation. However, conventional flat routers can yield imbalanced expert utilization and treat experts as an unstructured collection, whose indices carry no topological meaning. We introduce {\bf BRANCH-MoE}, a routing architecture that places \(E\) experts at the leaves of a binary decision tree of depth \(\log_2 E\). At each internal node the branching probability is centered on the arrival-weighted mean score of the traffic reaching that node. This mean is estimated using an exponential moving average, which promotes utilization of both child subtrees without an auxiliary load-balancing loss. We show that this moving-average estimate admits an explicit noise-lag trade-off. We prove that for linear node maps and log-concave arrival distributions, this mechanism prevents routing-mass collapse. We further establish that, under a frozen router, an expert's execution frequency controls its stochastic-gradient convergence rate, and that confident decisions near the root bound cross-device communication when experts are assigned to devices by tree prefix. We evaluate BRANCH-MoE against Switch softmax, DeepSeek-V3 dynamic-bias, Skywork logit-normalized, and deterministic hash routing on Criteo click-through-rate prediction, Forest Covertype, HIGGS, and YearPredictionMSD, using \(E=16\), top-\(4\) routing, and five random seeds. Our results show that hierarchical routing can preserve task quality and balanced utilization while inducing a topology that supports localized expert co-activation and reduced communication.

AI.tldr: 提出 BRANCH-MoE，将专家置于深度 log2 E 的二叉决策树叶子节点，用指数移动平均估计分支概率中心，无需辅助负载均衡损失，实现层级化路由。
AI.motivation: 传统扁平路由器易导致专家利用率不均衡，且将专家视为无拓扑含义的无结构集合。
AI.method: E 个专家置于深度 log2 E 的二叉决策树叶子；内部节点分支概率以到达该节点流量的到达加权平均分为中心，用指数移动平均估计；理论上分析噪声-滞后权衡、路由质量崩塌防止（线性节点映射与对数凹到达分布）、专家执行频率对随机梯度收敛速度的影响，以及按树前缀分配设备时根附近置信决策对跨设备通信的约束；在 Criteo、Forest Covertype、HIGGS、YearPredictionMSD 上以 E=16、top-4、五个随机种子对比 Switch softmax、DeepSeek-V3 动态偏置、Skywork logit 归一化与确定性哈希路由。
AI.result: 层级路由在保持任务质量与均衡利用率的同时，诱导出支持局部专家共激活并减少通信的拓扑结构。
AI.conclusion: BRANCH-MoE 通过决策树层级路由机制，无需辅助均衡损失即可兼顾专家利用率与任务质量，并带来通信优化潜力。

title: MatrixFormer: A Foundation Model for Matrix Completion
summary: Matrix completion underlies problems from tabular imputation to causal inference, yet existing tabular foundation models treat it as entry-by-entry prediction, repeating context for every target and discarding the matrix's two-dimensional structure. We introduce MatrixFormer, a pre-trained matrix-native transformer that predicts a full distribution for every missing entry in a single forward pass. MatrixFormer is trained entirely on synthetic low-rank and latent-factor matrices under diverse missingness patterns. Applied zero-shot and with the same model weights, MatrixFormer achieves competitive performance on causal inference panel-data tasks, language-model benchmark-score completion, tabular imputation, and recommendation systems matrix completion. These results position MatrixFormer as a general-purpose foundation model for matrix completion.

AI.tldr: MatrixFormer 是一种矩阵原生预训练 Transformer，单次前向即可为每个缺失条目预测完整分布，并在零样本条件下于因果推断、表格插补、推荐系统等多类矩阵补全任务上取得有竞争力的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有表格基础模型将矩阵补全视为逐条目预测，需为每个目标重复上下文，且忽略了矩阵的二维结构，效率低且信息利用不足。
AI.method: 提出矩阵原生 Transformer（MatrixFormer），完全基于合成的低秩与潜在因子矩阵，并在多样缺失模式上预训练；单次前向即可输出每个缺失条目的完整分布。
AI.result: 以相同权重、零样本方式应用时，在因果推断面板数据任务、语言模型基准分数补全、表格插补和推荐系统矩阵补全上均达到有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: MatrixFormer 可作为矩阵补全的通用基础模型。

title: Sharpen Without Search: On-Policy Distillation of Sequence-Level Power Distribution
summary: A language model can give a correct answer more probability than any single incorrect answer and still usually sample an incorrect one, because the incorrect answers together hold more probability. The power distribution raises each complete answer's probability to a power above one and renormalizes, shifting probability toward answers the model finds most likely (sharpening). Sampling from it improves reasoning without changing parameters, but needs many scored candidates per query. We show that a model can instead be trained to produce such answers in one generation. On-policy power distillation (OPPD) runs a sequential Monte Carlo sampler in which the model being trained generates candidates and a frozen teacher's power distribution weights them; the same probabilities weight each answer in a maximum-likelihood update. Training raises single-generation accuracy by up to 23.0 points on MATH500 and 27.3 on GSM8K over the untrained model at the same temperature, and one generation scores 2.4 and 3.5 points above published power sampling with 64 candidates, recovering 94 percent of the gain that 16 candidates give the untrained model. For context, against GRPO trained with verified rewards from the same checkpoint and budget, OPPD scores 3.8, 4.0 and 5.4 points higher on MATH500, GSM8K and AIME using no reference answers; the two are complementary, and OPPD applied after GRPO adds up to 9.3 points. Trained only on mathematics, OPPD raises HumanEval accuracy by up to 5.3 points. One loss coefficient moves the sharpening exponent the model absorbs between 1.19 and 2.02, against 1.14 for ordinary on-policy distillation, and it rises mostly on the model's own answers. Gains hold across model families and sizes, including a model already trained with verified rewards, where lowering the temperature gives nothing and OPPD adds 4.4 points on MATH500. Code: https://github.com/ArminAzizi98/OPPD.

AI.tldr: OPPD 通过同策略幂蒸馏把幂采样（power sampling）的锐化效果蒸馏进单次生成，无需参考答案即可显著提升推理准确率，且与 GRPO 互补。
AI.motivation: 语言模型虽然给正确答案的单项概率高于任何单个错误答案，但所有错误答案的概率之和更大，因此通常仍采样出错误答案。幂分布（power distribution）通过对概率取大于 1 的幂并重归一化实现"锐化"，可提升推理能力且不改参数，但采样时需对每个查询评分大量候选，代价高昂。作者希望让模型一次生成即可产出这种被锐化的答案。
AI.method: 提出 On-policy Power Distillation (OPPD)：运行序列蒙特卡洛采样器，由正在训练的模型生成候选，用冻结教师的幂分布对其加权；同一组概率既用于加权候选，也作为极大似然更新中每个答案的权重，从而把幂锐化行为蒸馏进学生模型的单次生成。仅需一个损失系数即可控制模型吸收的锐化指数。
AI.result: 相比同温度下未训练模型，单次生成准确率在 MATH500 上最高提升 23.0 分、GSM8K 上 27.3 分；单次生成比已发表的 64 候选幂采样高 2.4 和 3.5 分，并恢复未训练模型用 16 候选所获增益的 94%。与同检查点、同预算、使用可验证奖励的 GRPO 相比，OPPD 不使用参考答案即在 MATH500、GSM8K、AIME 上分别高 3.8、4.0、5.4 分，且二者互补，OPPD 在 GRPO 之后应用可再增最多 9.3 分。仅在数学上训练，HumanEval 准确率提升最多 5.3 分。损失系数可将吸收的锐化指数在 1.19–2.02 间调节，而普通同策略蒸馏为 1.14，且提升主要发生在模型自身答案上。增益跨模型族和规模成立，包括已用可验证奖励训练的模型（该模型降温无效，而 OPPD 在 MATH500 上加 4.4 分）。
AI.conclusion: 幂采样的锐化收益可以被蒸馏为模型的单次生成能力，OPPD 在不使用参考答案、不改变推理时采样规模的情况下大幅提升推理准确率，并与可验证奖励强化学习（GRPO）互补叠加，且在不同模型族、规模和训练阶段上具有泛化性。

title: Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors
summary: Large longitudinal cohorts often contain wrist accelerometry without optical heart-rate sensing, motivating recovery of cardiac information from motion signals already collected during sleep. We present SeqSmoother, a transformer-based temporal corrector for sleep heart rate (HR) estimation from wrist accelerometry. SeqSmoother combines spectral descriptors with an intermediate Nightbeat-derived frequency anchor and a physics-motivated sub-harmonic feature designed to identify harmonic frequency lock-on. All inference-time features are derived from wrist accelerometry, while ECG is used only to construct reference HR labels and training-label quality weights. We evaluate SeqSmoother using 13 participant-disjoint held-out folds and compare it with the official Nightbeat implementation under a matched 60-s window and 15-s step protocol. Across all out-of-fold predictions, SeqSmoother achieved a participant-macro MAE of 1.60 bpm. On Nightbeat-retained matched intervals, Nightbeat achieved lower absolute error than SeqSmoother (0.615 versus 1.091 bpm), while SeqSmoother provided estimates over a larger portion of the eligible recording; Nightbeat produced final estimates for 72.85% of the SeqSmoother-eligible out-of-fold grid. Separately, the proposed sub-harmonic ratio achieved an AUROC of 0.972 for identifying reference-defined harmonic lock-on candidates. These findings reveal an accuracy-availability trade-off between learned temporal modeling and quality-gated signal processing while providing empirical support for a physics-informed approach to identifying frequency-tracking failures in accelerometer-based sleep HR estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SeqSmoother，一种基于Transformer的时序校正器，仅用腕部加速度计信号（含频谱描述子、Nightbeat频率锚点和物理启发的次谐波特征）估计睡眠心率，与官方Nightbeat对比，揭示了"精度-可用性"权衡。
AI.motivation: 大型纵向队列常采集腕部加速度计数据但缺少光学心率传感，因此希望从睡眠期间已采集的运动信号中恢复心脏信息，而无需额外传感器。
AI.method: SeqSmoother为Transformer时序校正器，输入融合频谱描述子、Nightbeat导出的中间频率锚点及用于识别谐波频率锁定的物理启发次谐波特征；所有推理特征均来自腕部加速度计，ECG仅用于构建参考HR标签和训练标签质量权重。采用13个被试不重叠的留出折，在60秒窗、15秒步长协议下与官方Nightbeat实现对比。
AI.result: 全部折外预测的被试宏平均MAE为1.60 bpm；在Nightbeat保留的匹配区间上，Nightbeat绝对误差更低（0.615 vs 1.091 bpm），但SeqSmoother覆盖更大比例的有效记录——Nightbeat仅在SeqSmoother可用的折外网格的72.85%上给出最终估计。次谐波比率识别参考定义的谐波锁定候选AUROC达0.972。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了学习型时序建模与质量门控信号处理之间的精度-可用性权衡，并为基于加速度计的睡眠HR估计中识别频率跟踪失败提供了物理信息方法的实证支持。

title: Bayes-Sufficient Compression Is Not Enough: How Does Communication Help Multi-Agent Systems?
summary: Multi-agent LLM systems pair a sender with broad context and an executor with a limited local view. We study when a short message improves the executor's next decision, when raw context is preferable, and when a stronger sender helps. Our framework, \emph{receiver-relative bounded coordination}, expresses message utility as receiver gain minus protocol tax. Compression beats raw context when tax savings exceed losses from omitted information and decoder mismatch. Even \emph{Bayes-sufficient} compression can fail when a bounded executor cannot use its surface form. A three-stage decomposition separates externalization, absorption, and \emph{action closure}, explaining how errors remain after the correct content reaches the receiver. Under a single-crossing condition, sender upgrades help above a receiver-burden threshold. Across six benchmarks, the same Qwen protocol raises ContextBench joint accuracy from $0.633$ to $0.775$ but lowers ToolSandbox from $0.889$ to $0.653$. Fixed-message replay reveals closure failures despite correct artifact recovery. These results guide an inference-time selector that improves the accuracy-cost frontier on the evaluated communication regimes.

AI.tldr: 提出"接收方相对有界协调"框架，将消息效用表达为接收方增益减协议税，解释多智能体LLM系统中短消息与原始上下文的取舍条件、发送方升级的有效阈值及误差残留机制，并据此设计推理时选择器改善精度-成本前沿。
AI.motivation: 多智能体LLM系统中，发送方拥有全局上下文，执行方仅有局部视野。现有研究缺乏对"何时短消息优于原始上下文""何时更强发送方有帮助""为何正确内容到达后仍有错误"的统一理论解释。
AI.method: 提出 receiver-relative bounded coordination 框架，将消息效用分解为接收方增益与协议税之差；采用三阶段分解（外化、吸收、动作闭合）刻画误差路径；在单交叉条件下分析发送方升级的收益阈值；并在六个基准上进行实验，包括固定消息重放实验与推理时选择器设计。
AI.result: 压缩优于原始上下文的条件是税费节省超过信息省略与解码器不匹配带来的损失；即使 Bayes-sufficient 压缩也可能因有界执行方无法利用其表层形式而失败。同一Qwen协议将ContextBench联合准确率从0.633提升至0.775，却将ToolSandbox从0.889降至0.653；固定消息重放揭示出在正确工件恢复情况下仍存在闭合失败。
AI.conclusion: 消息效用取决于接收方增益与协议税的权衡；发送方升级仅在接收方负担阈值以上有效；误差可源于动作闭合而非内容传递。据此外化的推理时选择器在评估的通信区间内改善了精度-成本前沿。

title: Memory-State Critic for Asymmetric Actor-Critic with Application to Vision-Based Pursuit-Evasion
comment: Accepted at the 19th European Workshop on Reinforcement Learning (EWRL 2026), Lille, France. Non-archival workshop
summary: In partially observable Markov decision processes, the optimal policy generally depends on the history of observations and past actions. Asymmetric actor-critic methods have become popular to learn such policies when additional information, such as the true state of the environment, is available during training. The critic, which is not needed at execution, is given access to the state. A critic conditioned on the state alone is generally ill-defined and yields biased policy gradients. Conditioning on the state and the history, the history-state critic restores both. In this paper, we show that conditioning the critic on the state and the policy's own memory, i.e., the internal representation of the history through which the policy selects its actions, is already well-defined and gives unbiased policy gradients, removing the need for a second recurrent approximator of the history. We call it the memory state critic. It follows that a critic based on the policy's memory need not backpropagate its loss into that memory, even though the memory is a lossy encoding of the history. We evaluate the memory-state critic in a vision-based pursuit-evasion environment between two quadrotors across two arena types. The pursuer is the learning agent, and the evader is sampled per episode from a fixed pool of heuristic behaviours. The results show that the memory-state critic outperforms the history-state critic and converges faster. In addition to being unbiased compared to the state-only critic, it maintains a slight edge in the wall arena, where the actor's history carries information that the privileged state alone does not.

AI.tldr: 提出"记忆状态评论家"(memory-state critic)：仅以环境状态与策略自身记忆(内部历史表征)为条件，即可得到良定义且无偏的策略梯度，无需再引入第二个循环网络近似历史。
AI.motivation: 部分可观测MDP中最优策略依赖观测与动作历史；非对称actor-critic在训练期可利用真实状态，但仅以状态为条件的评论家通常病态且导致策略梯度有偏。已有做法需额外用循环网络同时以状态和历史为条件(history-state critic)，计算开销大、结构冗余，因此需要更简洁且理论正确的评论家设计。
AI.method: 理论分析表明：以状态与策略自身记忆(策略据此选择动作的历史内部表征)作为评论家条件，其定义良好并给出无偏策略梯度，故无需第二个循环近似器；由此推论，基于策略记忆的评论家无需将该损失反传进入该记忆，即便记忆是历史的损失性编码。在四旋翼视觉追逃环境中验证：两机、两类竞技场，追者为学习智能体，逃者每回合从固定启发式行为池中采样。
AI.result: memory-state critic优于history-state critic且收敛更快；相比state-only critic保持无偏优势，并在wall竞技场中略有领先——该场景下actor的历史携带了特权状态所不具备的信息。
AI.conclusion: 以策略记忆为条件的评论家在理论上是良定义且无偏的，可省去第二个循环历史的近似网络及对记忆的反传，兼具效率与性能，在视觉部分可观测任务中优于现有非对称actor-critic方案。

title: Where Does Jagged Competence Come From?
summary: Capable systems often show jagged competence: low average error alongside failures on particular inputs. We ask where it comes from in a task built from two known layers. A lower layer A computes five per-slot sums from records; an upper layer B uses the slot-1 sum and a mode carried over from earlier boards to predict the next board's category, so B cannot be computed from the current A alone: B is a strict extension of A. We train small recurrent networks on B and measure, against exact ground truth, what they acquire of A. The central finding is that learning B gives the network a jagged version of A, measured through probe readability and supervised outputs. It is readable where B needs it (slot 1, 97-98% by a linear probe) and becomes less readable where B does not (the other slots, 5-10%); category misreads concentrate near the slot-1 cutoffs; and when A is trained explicitly it comes out only approximately right. The networks show jagged competence in B: natural KL below $3\times10^{-4}$ bits coexists with a maximum law TV of about 0.25 on constructed histories. Matched experiments show that even a good A is not enough: connecting a learned A to B cuts misreads 1.3 to 17-fold, the same exact A gives fewer misreads as one-hot inputs (0-2) than as numerical inputs (10-317), one B update makes an exact A inexact unless the B gradient is blocked, and exact A still leaves some B failures. In this task, uneven acquisition, access and preservation of the lower theory explain part of the jagged competence of a network that learns the theory built on it; some failures remain unexplained. Whether the same holds in larger systems is a test to run.

AI.tldr: 在两层任务中训练小循环网络：学习上层理论B会得到下层理论A的"锯齿状"版本——A仅在B需要处（slot 1）可读，其余槽位可读性显著下降；即使给定精确A也不足够，B仍有失败。
AI.motivation: 本文试图解释"锯齿状能力"（jagged competence）的来源：为什么系统平均误差低却在特定输入上失败。作者构建一个两层任务，其中上层B是下层A的严格扩展（B无法仅从当前A算出，需借助上下文传递的mode），从而考察网络在学习基于A的B时究竟习得了什么A。
AI.method: 构建分层任务：下层A从记录计算5个逐槽求和；上层B利用slot-1求和与来自先前board的mode预测下一board类别，故B是A的严格扩展。训练小型循环网络学习B，用精确ground truth对照，通过线性探针可读性与有监督输出测量其对A的习得。设置匹配实验：将学习到的A接入B、以one-hot与数值输入对比、单次B更新对精确A的影响，以及冻结B梯度。
AI.result: 学习B使网络获得"锯齿状"A：slot 1处可读性97-98%，其余槽位仅5-10%；类别误读集中在slot-1截断点附近；显式训练A也只能近似正确。B上表现为锯齿状能力：自然KL低于3×10⁻⁴ bit，同时构造历史上最大law TV约0.25。匹配实验：接入学习到的A使误读降低1.3至17倍；同一精确A以one-hot输入（0-2次误读）优于数值输入（10-317）；单次B更新会使精确A变为不精确，除非阻断B梯度；精确A仍残留部分B失败。
AI.conclusion: 在该任务中，下层理论的不均匀获取、访问与保持，部分解释了学习其上层理论的网络为何呈锯齿状能力，但仍有部分失败未被解释。作者提出该机制是否适用于更大系统是待验证的测试方向。

title: LLM-enhanced spatio-temporal learning for grid-level docked bike sharing demand prediction
comment: Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE 29th International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC)
summary: Short-term bike-sharing demand forecasting is complicated by spatial-temporal non-stationarity and the practical difficulty of incorporating unstructured external text into numerical pipelines. Conventional approaches rely on historical flow sequences and fixed graph structures, thereby constraining their accuracy when anomalous social events perturb normal travel patterns. We propose a forecasting framework in which a Large Language Model (LLM) drives a semantic shockwave mechanism that converts free-form urban text, such as municipal event schedules, local news, and transit bulletins, into quantified spatial-temporal perturbation fields. The LLM extracts three physically interpretable parameters per event (intensity, spatial reach, and temporal lag), from which Gaussian decay fields are constructed and injected into a Zero-Inflated Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Graph Convolutional Network (ZI-ASTGCN). To handle the pronounced sparsity of grid-level measurements, the model couples a dual-branch output head with a multi-task zero-inflated loss that jointly trains a gating probability and a conditional flow intensity. Experiments on the operational Barcelona Bicing dataset show that ZI-ASTGCN outperforms established neural baselines, with particularly strong gains during high-demand periods, validating the utility of physics-grounded semantic signals in spatial-temporal mobility forecasting.

AI.tldr: 提出LLM驱动的语义冲击波机制，将非结构化城市文本转化为量化时空扰动场，注入ZI-ASTGCN进行共享单车需求预测。
AI.motivation: 短期共享单车需求预测受时空非平稳性困扰，且难以将非结构化外部文本融入数值化流程。传统方法依赖历史流量序列与固定图结构，当异常社会事件扰动正常出行模式时精度受限。
AI.method: 用大语言模型驱动"语义冲击波"机制，将市政事件日程、本地新闻、交通公告等自由文本转化为量化时空扰动场；LLM为每个事件提取三个具物理可解释性的参数（强度、空间影响范围、时间滞后），据此构建高斯衰减场并注入零膨胀自适应时空图卷积网络（ZI-ASTGCN）。针对网格级测量高稀疏性，采用双分支输出头与多任务零膨胀损失，联合训练门控概率与条件流量强度。
AI.result: 在巴塞罗那Bicing实际运营数据集上，ZI-ASTGCN优于既有神经基线，在高需求时段增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 物理基础的语义信号在时空出行预测中具有实用价值。

title: KVE-KD: Key Visual Evidence-Guided Knowledge Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Knowledge distillation is crucial for deploying vision-language models on resource-constrained devices. However, existing methods typically impose uniform supervision across visual tokens or rely on static token selection, which confuses task-relevant cues with background noise and degrades cross-modal reasoning. To address this limitation, we propose Key Visual Evidence-guided Knowledge Distillation (KVE-KD), a framework that dynamically focuses feature distillation on task-relevant visual tokens identified by the teacher model. Specifically, KVE-KD appoints the final pre-generation textual token as a unified semantic anchor and identifies the target cross-modal fusion layer by analyzing changes in the anchor representation through iterative visual-token contribution removal. Within this layer, KVE-KD ranks visual tokens via the anchor-conditioned attention distribution and selects the most informative visual tokens as key visual evidence with normalized entropy. The key visual evidence subsequently guides focused visual feature distillation, making the student align closely with the teacher's task-relevant visual representations while suppressing irrelevant background information. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate that KVE-KD outperforms state-of-the-art cross-modal distillation methods, with particularly pronounced gains on tasks requiring complex reasoning and fine-grained visual understanding. Importantly, these improvements are achieved without introducing any inference-time overhead. The source code is available at https://github.com/zhangjianbin07/KVE-KD.

AI.tldr: 提出KVE-KD框架，利用教师模型定位任务相关视觉token并进行聚焦式特征蒸馏，在六个基准上优于现有跨模态蒸馏方法且无推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型知识蒸馏方法对视觉token施加统一监督或采用静态token选择，难以区分任务相关线索与背景噪声，导致跨模态推理性能下降，因此需要动态聚焦于任务相关的视觉token。
AI.method: KVE-KD将最终预生成文本token作为统一语义锚点，通过迭代移除视觉token贡献分析锚点表示变化以确定目标跨模态融合层；在该层内利用锚点条件注意力分布对视觉token排序，并基于归一化熵选出信息量最大的关键视觉证据；随后由关键视觉证据引导聚焦式视觉特征蒸馏。
AI.result: 在六个基准上的大量实验表明，KVE-KD优于当前最先进的跨模态蒸馏方法，在需要复杂推理和细粒度视觉理解的任务上提升尤为显著，且不引入任何推理时开销。
AI.conclusion: KVE-KD通过动态识别任务相关视觉token并引导聚焦蒸馏，有效抑制背景噪声干扰，提升学生模型的跨模态推理能力，兼具性能与部署效率优势。

title: BAT-NO: A Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator for Crashworthiness Prediction of Vehicle Components
summary: High-fidelity finite-element simulations provide accurate crashworthiness predictions, but their cost limits iterative design exploration. Deep learning surrogates can reduce this cost, but many component-level models are developed under a single prescribed boundary condition, limiting generalisation to boundary variations. This work proposes a Boundary-Condition-Aware Transformer Neural Operator (BAT-NO) for autoregressive prediction of transient displacement fields and scalar crashworthiness responses under variations in geometry and boundary conditions. A B-pillar simulation framework evaluates generalisation across variations in geometry, impact position and velocity, and support stiffness. BAT-NO combines recurrent mesh processing with latent-grid Fourier operator processing. Boundary-condition information is transferred to the latent grid through a hybrid local--global mechanism. Slice-based attention models interactions among physically related regions, while direct boundary-to-grid projection preserves local spatial structure. Across the validation sets for the shape-only, shape-and-loading, and shape-loading-boundary cases, BAT-NO achieves the lowest mean final-step mean nodal Euclidean displacement error among the evaluated baselines. In the most challenging case, it reduces the mean error by 32.6% relative to the second-best model. Hyperparameter tuning reduces the validation error from 0.451 to 0.269 mm, with a comparable error of 0.267 mm on 300 unseen test simulations sampled within the investigated design space. An attention-based scalar decoder jointly predicts six response trajectories with a mean relative error of 2.46%. Most derived crashworthiness indicators have median errors below 3%. These results show that explicit local and global boundary-condition representations improve crashworthiness prediction over expanded component-level design spaces.

AI.tldr: 本文提出边界条件感知的Transformer神经算子（BAT-NO），用于在几何与边界条件变化下自回归预测瞬态位移场和碰撞性标量响应，在B柱仿真中最具挑战的案例上较次优模型降低32.6%平均误差。
AI.motivation: 高保真有限元仿真虽能提供准确的碰撞性预测，但计算成本高，限制了迭代式设计探索；而现有深度学习代理模型多在单一预设边界条件下开发，泛化能力受限于边界条件变化。
AI.method: 提出BAT-NO，融合循环网格处理与潜在网格傅里叶算子处理；通过混合局部-全局机制将边界条件信息传递至潜在网格，其中切片注意力建模物理相关区域间的交互，直接边界到网格投影保留局部空间结构；并配备基于注意力的标量解码器联合预测多条响应轨迹。
AI.result: 在仅形状、形状与载荷、形状-载荷-边界三类验证集上，BAT-NO均取得最低的末步平均节点欧氏位移误差；最具挑战案例中较次优模型降低32.6%；超参调优将验证误差从0.451 mm降至0.269 mm，300个未见测试仿真误差为0.267 mm；标量解码器预测六条响应轨迹的平均相对误差为2.46%，多数派生碰撞性指标中位误差低于3%。
AI.conclusion: 显式的局部与全局边界条件表示能够提升在扩展的部件级设计空间中的碰撞性预测精度。

title: Reinforcement Learning on the Discrete Composition Channel of a Crystal Generator: Validated Gains and Reward Hacking
comment: 26 pages, 4 figures, 12 tables. Code: https://github.com/paprakash/OMatGRPO. Models and structures: https://huggingface.co/paprakash/OMatGRPO
summary: Inverse materials design is a long-standing goal of computational materials discovery. Generative models for crystalline materials are typically trained to match the distribution of a structure database, while nothing in their training objective points them at specific design goals such as targeted properties. We use group-relative policy optimization (GRPO) to align a generative model based on stochastic interpolants and discrete flow matching with general black-box reward functions through reinforcement learning. Atom types are generated by a discrete flow and the policy gradient of our generalization of GRPO directly acts on the likelihoods of the atom-type transitions, which differentiates our work from previous reinforcement-learning approaches for diffusion and flow-based generative models of crystalline materials. We introduce a reward function that raises the yield of metastable, unique and novel structures (mSUN) from 13.4% for the pretrained model to 45.5% for the reinforced model, as evaluated by a community benchmark. Our reward also improves the performance of a reinforcement learning framework for crystalline materials based on latent denoising diffusion models. At the same time, we find that directly reinforcing atom-type transition likelihoods enables reward exploitation that has to be prevented with explicit guards. The same analysis also exposes a gap in the community metric. Single-element structures in distinct packings are counted as metastable, unique and novel materials and inflate mSUN without yielding any new compounds. A stability claim is only as good as its reference hull. We report every result split by the number of reference phases behind it and argue that benchmarks should do the same.

AI.tldr: 本文用GRPO强化学习对齐基于随机插值与离散流匹配的晶体生成模型，直接对原子类型转变似然做策略梯度，将mSUN产率从13.4%提升至45.5%，并揭示了奖励利用风险与基准指标的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 晶体材料生成模型通常只被训练去匹配结构数据库的分布，其训练目标并不指向特定设计目标（如目标性质），因此逆材料设计长期难以实现。作者希望通过强化学习将黑盒奖励函数引入生成模型，实现面向设计目标的材料生成。
AI.method: 采用组相对策略优化（GRPO）对齐基于随机插值和离散流匹配的生成模型；原子类型由离散流生成，GRPO的策略梯度（作者对其进行了推广）直接作用于原子类型转变的似然，区别于以往面向扩散/流模型生成晶体材料的强化学习方法。同时引入提升亚稳、独特、新颖结构（mSUN）产率的奖励函数。
AI.result: 奖励函数将mSUN产率从预训练模型的13.4%提升到强化模型的45.5%（依据社区基准评测）；该奖励也提升了基于潜空间去噪扩散模型的晶体材料强化学习框架的表现。同时发现直接强化原子类型转变似然会导致奖励利用（reward exploitation），需显式防护机制加以阻止。
AI.conclusion: 分析暴露出社区指标存在缺陷：不同堆积方式的单元素结构被计为亚稳、独特、新颖材料，虚增mSUN却未产生新化合物；稳定性结论的可靠性取决于参考凸包的质量。作者建议所有结果按参考相数量拆分报告，并呼吁基准也采用同样做法。

title: COVER: Learning to Accept More in Selective Sleep Staging
comment: 20 pages, 3 figures; code and frozen-result reproduction: https://github.com/Kevin11Kaikai/COVER-Selective-Sleep-Staging
summary: Traditional sleep-staging methods apply the same model to every EEG epoch. Such uniform deployment expends computation on epochs that a smaller model could handle reliably, motivating cascades in which a primary classifier accepts its reliable predictions and defers the remainder to a more capable model. In this paper, we study the first stage of such a cascade: maximizing the coverage of fixed primary predictions subject to a prescribed accepted-risk target.
