We propose COVER (COVerage-oriented Error Ranking), which integrates two key innovations: (i) auxiliary-informed primary-error learning, which replaces maximum softmax probability (MSP) with a learned error score while preserving the primary labels, and (ii) fixed-scale scorer refinement, which builds on this score to directly maximize coverage under an empirical accepted-risk constraint rather than error-prediction accuracy over all epochs. We evaluate COVER on Sleep-EDF-20 at a 5% accepted-risk target, with subjects held out from all fitting and selection. Auxiliary-informed error learning raises mean subject coverage from 31.5% for MSP to 48.8% at similar subject-equal risk. At equal acceptance volume, with MSP accepting the same number of epochs as the learned scorer in each subject (20,639 in total), errors fall from 1,467 to 867. Fixed-scale refinement then adds 1.7 percentage points of coverage over its initialization in nested development, and COVER attains the highest mean coverage among eight evaluated scorers, 50.4% at 4.5% subject-equal risk, above the selective-ranking baseline SELE (49.3%) and the probability-fusion comparator DuoF (43.6%). To the best of our knowledge, this is the first work to combine auxiliary-informed primary-error learning with fixed-scale coverage refinement for selective sleep staging, offering a basis for reliability-aware allocation of computation in cascaded sleep staging.

AI.tldr: 提出COVER方法，用于睡眠分期级联模型第一阶段的覆盖率最大化选择，在5%风险目标下将受试者平均覆盖率从MSP的31.5%提升至50.4%。
AI.motivation: 传统睡眠分期对每个EEG epoch采用统一模型，计算开销浪费在易处理的epoch上；级联架构中主分类器需在限定风险下尽可能多地接受可靠预测，而现有基于最大softmax概率(MSP)的选择方法覆盖率偏低。
AI.method: COVER包含两项创新：(i) 辅助信息引导的主错误学习，用学习到的误差分数替代MSP，同时保留主标签；(ii) 固定尺度评分器精修，在经验可接受风险约束下直接最大化覆盖率，而非优化全体epoch的误差预测准确率。评估采用受试者留出（subject held-out）设置。
AI.result: 在Sleep-EDF-20、5%风险目标下，误差学习将平均受试者覆盖率从MSP的31.5%提升至48.8%（风险相当）；相同接受量（共20,639个epoch）下错误数由1,467降至867。固定尺度精修在嵌套开发中额外增加1.7个百分点覆盖率。COVER在八种评分器中覆盖率最高（50.4%，4.5%受试者等价风险），优于SELE(49.3%)与DuoF(43.6%)。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次将辅助信息引导的主错误学习与固定尺度覆盖率精修结合用于选择性睡眠分期，为级联睡眠分期中可靠性感知的计算分配提供了基础。

title: TreeWalker: Partial Evaluation for Grouped Tree-Ensemble Inference
comment: 23 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. Code and data: https://github.com/Shopify/treewalker
summary:
Many inference workloads evaluate a trained tree ensemble on row groups that share feature values: discrete-time survival models expand each patient into $G$ time steps, click-through-rate models score every item in a search session, and scenario analyses vary a few inputs while holding the rest fixed. Standard inference treats each row independently and repeats the shared work $G$ times.
  We present TreeWalker, which applies partial evaluation to grouped inference: constant features are static, varying features dynamic. It walks each tree once per group, partitions a row bitmask at varying splits, and skips empty subtrees. Training is unchanged: TreeWalker reads standard LightGBM and XGBoost models.
  We prove a structural work decomposition: per-tree work splits into the constant-projected subtree size $|T_c|$, $G$ leaf writes, and a predicate-mask provisioning cost $Q$. For the trace evaluator, per-row work approaches a $(d_v+1)/(d+1)$ fraction of a row-independent walk as $G \to \infty$.
  On Intel, TreeWalker is 2.5-3.2$\times$ faster than a row-independent traversal at the reference configuration ($T=500$, $L=8$) and 6.8-7.8$\times$ faster at $G=128$ on the survival datasets, with larger gains on Arm. On a scenario-analysis benchmark it is faster in all 16 configurations on both architectures. For f64 models, outputs match treelite's GTIL up to summation order; for f32 models, f64 accumulation is closer to a Kahan-compensated reference than native f32 on 99.98% of rows and never farther.

AI.tldr: TreeWalker 通过对分组推断进行部分求值（常量特征静态、变化特征动态），每组每棵树只遍历一次，显著加速树集成模型推断且不改变训练。
AI.motivation: 许多推断负载在共享特征值的行组上评估已训练的树集成（如生存模型将患者扩展为 G 个时间步、CTR 模型对同一会话所有物品打分、情景分析固定大部分输入），标准推断逐行独立处理导致共享工作被重复 G 次，效率低。
AI.method: 提出 TreeWalker：将常量特征视为静态、变化特征视为动态，对分组推断做部分求值；每组每棵树遍历一次，在变化分裂处对行位掩码进行分区并跳过空子树；训练不变，可直接读取标准 LightGBM 与 XGBoost 模型。
AI.result: 证明结构性工作分解：每棵树工作分为常量投影子树大小 |T_c|、G 次叶写入与谓词掩码供给成本 Q；trace 评估器在 G→∞ 时每行工作趋近行独立遍历的 (d_v+1)/(d+1)。Intel 上在参考配置（T=500, L=8）比行独立遍历快 2.5–3.2×，生存数据集 G=128 时快 6.8–7.8×，Arm 上增益更大；情景分析基准的 16 种配置在两种架构上均更快。f64 模型输出与 treelite GTIL 在求和顺序内一致；f32 模型下 f64 累加在 99.98% 行上比原生 f32 更接近 Kahan 补偿参考且从不更差。
AI.conclusion: TreeWalker 利用分组共享特征的结构实现部分求值，在大幅加速树集成推断的同时保持训练不变与输出精度，适用于生存分析、CTR 与情景分析等分组推断场景。

title: DePICT: Decision-Preserving Interface for Constrained Downstream Tasks
summary: A constrained optimization problem may involve a parameter in its objective and active constraints, yet the final decision may remain insensitive to small changes in that parameter. This raises a fundamental question: which inputs does a decision making system truly depend on? Building on this question, we introduce DePICT, a procedure for constructing decision preserving interfaces by ranking context directions according to the optimizer's solution sensitivity and aggregating them across an operating regime. We study this problem in a high dimensional setting where primitive context parameterizes a constrained task and the downstream agent observes only a selected subset of context directions. For locally regular constrained programs, we derive a Karush Kuhn Tucker (KKT) based characterization of when a context direction is optimizer relevant. Our analysis shows that appearing in the active optimization problem does not necessarily imply that a variable affects the final decision. Some context directions can alter the KKT conditions while leaving the optimal solution unchanged because their effect is absorbed by the dual variables. DePICT is designed to remove exactly these directions. In a controlled diagnosis, it recovers the decision relevant interface exactly and reduces linear predictor regret to 0.009, compared with 0.475 for the strongest competing baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DePICT框架，通过基于KKT条件的优化器解灵敏度排序并聚合上下文方向，构建决策保持接口，剔除仅影响对偶变量而不改变最优解的方向；受控实验中精确恢复决策相关接口，线性预测器遗憾降至0.009（最强基线为0.475）。
AI.motivation: 约束优化问题的目标与活跃约束常含参数，但最终决策对小参数变化可能并不敏感，因此需要回答"决策系统真正依赖哪些输入"。当原始上下文仅被下游代理观测到部分方向时，需识别并保留真正影响最优解的上下文方向，剔除冗余方向以构建决策保持接口。
AI.method: 面向高维设定：原始上下文参数化一个约束任务，下游代理仅观测选定的上下文方向子集。针对局部正则的约束程序，基于KKT条件给出"上下文方向与优化器相关"的刻画；按优化器解灵敏度对上下文方向排序，并在一个运行区间内聚合，构造决策保持接口DePICT，专门剔除那些改变KKT条件却不改变最优解（效应被对偶变量吸收）的方向。
AI.result: 分析表明，方向出现在活跃优化问题中并不意味着它影响最终决策；部分方向可通过影响对偶变量吸收其效应而保持最优解不变。受控诊断实验中，DePICT精确恢复决策相关接口，线性预测器遗憾降至0.009，而最强竞争基线为0.475。
AI.conclusion: 并非所有出现在活跃优化问题中的上下文变量都影响最终决策；基于KKT的灵敏度排序与跨运行区间聚合可有效识别决策相关方向，构建决策保持接口，显著优于现有基线。

title: Synthesizing Physics Formulae with Transformers
summary: Finding a compact formula that fits a set of input-output pairs and predicts outputs on unseen inputs is a fundamental problem in science. Symbolic regression automates the search for such formulae: search-based methods explore the space of possible formulae directly, while transformers pre-trained on synthetic data produce formulae of comparable quality substantially faster. Existing transformers, however, are prone to overfitting --- they find formulae that fit the training data well but do not extrapolate to input ranges unseen during training. We address this by shaping the set of formulae used to train a transformer, and show that the resulting formulae extrapolate substantially better. Fine-tuning the transformer on data with noise-corrupted target values further makes the synthesized formulae robust to noise in the observations. On SRBench and LLM-SRBench our transformer synthesizes a formula in about ten seconds and extrapolates better than all evaluated methods at a comparable budget. Search-based methods surpass our accuracy only when given one to three orders of magnitude more time.

AI.tldr: 通过塑造训练用公式集合，提升符号回归Transformer的外推性能，并在SRBench和LLM-SRBench上以约十秒的速度超越同类方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的符号回归模型容易过拟合：找到的公式在训练数据上拟合良好，却无法外推到训练时未见过的输入范围，这限制了其实际应用价值。
AI.method: 形塑（shaping）用于训练Transformer的公式集合，使生成的公式外推性能更好；进一步用噪声污染目标值的数据对Transformer进行微调，提升合成公式对观测噪声的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在SRBench和LLM-SRBench上，该Transformer约十秒即可合成一个公式，在可比预算下外推性能优于所有评测方法；基于搜索的方法只有在给定多出一到三个数量级的时间时，才能超过其精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过控制训练公式分布并进行噪声微调，可显著改善符号回归Transformer的外推能力和抗噪性，兼顾高速度与高精度。

authors: Abu Sa-Adat Mohamed Moon-Im Al Ahsan
title: One-Step Curvature Probes Miss the Fitting Operator: Retained Capacity and Terminal Null-Space Correction for Continual Learning
summary: A one-step curvature probe evaluates an initial direction, whereas continual learners are judged after reaching comparable new-task fit. In an overparameterized linearization, projected gradient descent converges to $Δ_P=PJ^\top(JPJ^\top)^{-1}r$, and its squared-displacement inflation is exactly the reciprocal of the retained fitting capacity $c_P(r)$. More generally, the terminal old-task quadratic ratio factorizes as $1/[c_P(r)G_{\rm end}(P,r)]$, where $G_{\rm end}$ compares curvature along endpoint directions. In the rank-one case, $G_{\rm end}$ equals the one-step probe gain; for multiple outputs, the two gains can differ. The terminal quadratic also separates into a curvature-optimal fitting floor and an algorithm-dependent null-space excess, motivating terminal null-space correction, which preserves linearized new-task outputs on its Jacobian batch. Controlled checks validate the local quadratic and show that projection can greatly reduce matched-norm curvature while barely changing terminal forgetting. Across common-threshold configurations, projection yields the larger signed old-task loss change in 73/99 matched pairs, retained fitting capacity falls with rank, and fixed-rank comparisons separate terminal forgetting even when probe gain is approximately matched. On Permuted MNIST and Split CIFAR-100, terminal correction decreases signed old-task loss in 166/180 method--dataset--seed pairs under the all-seed intention-to-correct analysis; because acceptance and outcome reporting use the same held-out split, this result is descriptive and test-conditioned. Overall, terminal cost depends jointly on retained fitting capacity, endpoint-direction curvature, and the null-space component selected by optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用"终端"（而非单步）视角刻画持续学习中的遗忘：在过参数化线性化下，投影梯度下降的位移膨胀恰为保留拟合容量 $c_P(r)$ 的倒数，并进一步分解为曲率最优拟合下界与零空间超额，据此提出终端零空间校正。
AI.motivation: 单步曲率探针（one-step curvature probe）只评估初始方向，而持续学习者的表现是在达到可比的新任务拟合之后才被评判，二者判据不一致，导致探针指标与实际终端遗忘可能脱节。作者希望建立以终端状态为中心的遗忘理论，解释何时探针增益能代表真实遗忘、何时不能。
AI.method: 在过参数化线性化框架下分析投影梯度下降的收敛解 $Δ_P=PJ^\top(JPJ^\top)^{-1}r$；推导旧任务二次型比值的终端分解 $1/[c_P(r)G_{\rm end}(P,r)]$；区分秩一情形（$G_{\rm end}$ 等于单步探针增益）与多输出情形（两增益可分离）；将终端二次型分解为曲率最优拟合下界与算法相关的零空间超额，并据此设计终端零空间校正，使其在 Jacobian 批次上保持线性化新任务输出。随后用受控实验、常见阈值配置配对比较，以及 Permuted MNIST 与 Split CIFAR-100 实验进行验证。
AI.result: 受控检验验证了局部二次近似，并显示投影可大幅降低匹配范数下的曲率，却几乎不改变终端遗忘。在常见阈值配置的 99 对匹配中，投影在 73 对中产生更大的带符号旧任务损失变化；保留拟合容量随秩下降；固定秩比较可在探针增益近似匹配时仍区分终端遗忘。在 Permuted MNIST 与 Split CIFAR-100 上，终端校正在 166/180 个"方法–数据集–随机种子"三元组中降低带符号旧任务损失；但因接受判定与结果报告使用同一留出划分，该结果属描述性且以测试条件为条件。
AI.conclusion: 终端代价并非由单步曲率单独决定，而是联合取决于三个因素：保留拟合容量 $c_P(r)$、终端方向曲率 $G_{\rm end}(P,r)$、以及优化所选择的零空间分量。这为持续学习遗忘提供了比单步探针更完整的理论刻画，并支持终端零空间校正作为实用干预手段。

title: Probabilistic Algorithms for Ising Machines from Optimization to Generative AI
summary: Ising machines have emerged as promising hardware accelerators for intractable optimization and sampling problems, yet their practical impact increasingly hinges on the co-design of algorithms and hardware, where algorithmic demands shape new architectures and new hardware capabilities inspire entirely new algorithms. In this Review, we survey probabilistic algorithms designed for portability across diverse Ising platforms, advocating a top-down perspective that prioritizes principled methods with provable guarantees. We cover foundational methods such as simulated annealing and parallel tempering, including two-dimensional extensions that natively encode hard constraints, and examine approaches that expand the scale of solvable problems from cluster mean-field methods to variational samplers. We highlight the Probabilistic Approximate Optimization Algorithm (PAOA), a classical analog of QAOA that emerged directly from probabilistic hardware development, and explore how generative AI and Ising machines might reinforce each other: learned models propose global moves to accelerate optimization, while probabilistic techniques improve inference in large language models. Much as quantum computing has seen algorithms co-evolve with hardware, probabilistic and Ising computing stand at a similar inflection point. We outline a co-design framework for accelerating the capabilities and adoption of next-generation Ising machines.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述从算法-硬件协同设计视角梳理面向多种Ising平台的概率算法，主张自上而下、具备可证明保证的方法论，并展望Ising机器与生成式AI的双向赋能。
AI.motivation: Ising机器的实际影响力日益取决于算法与硬件的协同设计：算法需求塑造新架构，新硬件能力又启发出全新算法。作者希望为下一代Ising机器的能力提升与推广应用提供统一的协同设计框架。
AI.method: 采用综述与自上而下（top-down）的分析视角，强调可跨平台移植、有原则且具可证明保证的概率算法。涵盖模拟退火、并行回火及原生编码硬约束的二维扩展；从团簇平均场到变分采样器扩展可解问题规模；重点讨论由概率硬件发展直接催生的PAOA（QAOA的经典类比）；并探讨生成式AI与Ising机器的相互增强机制。
AI.result: 系统归纳了面向Ising平台的可移植概率算法谱系及其可证明保证，指出PAOA作为概率硬件直接衍生的经典算法，并阐明生成式AI可通过学习全局移动加速优化、而概率技术可改善大语言模型推理的双向关系。
AI.conclusion: 正如量子计算中算法与硬件共同演化，概率计算与Ising计算正处于相似的转折点；作者提出一个协同设计框架，以加速下一代Ising机器能力的提升与其实际采纳。

title: Learning Latent Protein Languages for Autoregressive Generation
summary: Autoregressive transformers remain comparatively weak for protein sequence and structure generation. We study the role of target representation: amino acid tokens encode residue identities without explicit contextual semantics, while backbone coordinates require a discrete representation in our framework. We introduce two learned latent protein languages. Protein Latent Language (PLL) maps sequences to a 4,096-state contextual alphabet built on a frozen ESM-2 encoder, with one token per residue. Structure Latent Language (SLL) adapts GCP-VQVAE Lite with auxiliary sequence and confidence supervision while retaining decoding to backbone coordinates. We separately pretrain autoregressive transformer models on PLL and SLL tokens using next-token prediction, yielding PLLM and SLLM. Under matched downstream sequence training, PLLM has a fitted compute-scaling exponent of 0.038 versus 0.020 for the amino acid autoregressive model. In unconditional sequence generation, PLLM reduces the fraction of samples below a heuristic 1.5-bit residue-composition entropy threshold by 54% relative to the amino acid model across sampling temperatures. For sequence-to-structure prediction, replacing the original GCP-VQVAE Lite tokenizer with SLL reduces best validation perplexity by 34% under matched training. For long proteins, latent-token sampling is approximately 1,000 times faster than MSA-based AlphaFold2 in our measurements. In backbone generation, SLLM compares favorably with other generative models on diversity and novelty. We also observe early signs that using SLLM's internal token confidence for inference-time sampling can improve sequence-to-structure prediction quality beyond a single decoded sample. These results position learned latent protein languages as a promising substrate for autoregressive transformer scaling and inference-time sampling in protein generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种学习型蛋白质隐语言（PLL与SLL），分别将序列和结构映射为离散隐token，并预训练自回归Transformer（PLLM、SLLM），在序列生成、序列到结构预测与骨架生成上均优于氨基酸token基线。
AI.motivation: 自回归Transformer在蛋白质序列与结构生成上表现相对较弱。作者认为关键在于目标表示：氨基酸token仅编码残基身份而缺乏显式上下文语义，而骨架坐标又需要离散化表示。
AI.method: 构建两种隐语言：PLL基于冻结ESM-2编码器将序列映射为每残基一个token的4096状态上下文词表；SLL改编GCP-VQVAE Lite，加入序列与置信度辅助监督，并保留到骨架坐标的解码。分别用下一token预测预训练自回归Transformer，得到PLLM与SLLM。
AI.result: 匹配下游序列训练下，PLLM的计算缩放指数为0.038，氨基酸模型为0.020；无条件序列生成中，低于1.5比特残基组成熵阈值的样本比例较氨基酸模型降低54%。序列到结构预测中，用SLL替换原GCP-VQVAE Lite分词器使最佳验证困惑度降低34%。对长蛋白，隐token采样比基于MSA的AlphaFold2快约1000倍。骨架生成中SLLM在多样性与新颖性上具竞争力，并观察到用SLLM内部token置信度做推理时采样可提升预测质量。
AI.conclusion: 学习型隐蛋白质语言可作为自回归Transformer扩展与推理时采样的有前景的表示基础。

title: $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$ Regret and Polylogarithmic Constraint Violation for COCO
summary: We study constrained online convex optimization with adversarial convex losses and constraints ($\mathsf{COCO}$). At each round \(t\in[T]\), a learner selects \(x_t\) from a \(d\)-dimensional convex decision set \(\mathcal X\), after which an adaptive adversary reveals a convex cost function \(f_t\) and constraint function \(g_t\). Consequently, the learner incurs cost \(f_t(x_t)\) and constraint violation \(\max\{0,g_t(x_t)\}\), and aims to simultaneously minimize regret and cumulative constraint violation ($\mathsf{CCV}$) over the entire horizon. Existing algorithms achieve \(O(\sqrt{T})\) regret and \(\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})\) $\mathsf{CCV}$. We show that an online policy can achieve \(O(\sqrt{T\log T})\) regret and \(O(\log^2 T)\) $\mathsf{CCV}$, reducing the $\mathsf{CCV}$ from polynomial to polylogarithmic while retaining near-optimal regret. Our approach combines continuous Hedge with elimination on shrinking feasible sets. The key observation is that whenever the mean of the Hedge distribution violates a constraint, Grünbaum's inequality guarantees that a constant fraction of the Hedge probability mass is eliminated. We use an adaptive learning-rate schedule and a potential function coupling the surviving volume with the learning rate to convert this probability-mass reduction into a bound of \(O(\log^2 T)\) on the $\mathsf{CCV}$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带约束的在线凸优化（COCO），提出一种基于连续Hedge与收缩可行集上淘汰策略的算法，实现 O(√(T log T)) 悔恨与 O(log²T) 累积约束违反（CCV），将CCV从多项式级降到多对数级，同时保持近最优悔恨。
AI.motivation: 现有COCO算法只能达到 O(√T) 悔恨与 Õ(√T) 的CCV，约束违反随T呈多项式增长，约束满足程度不够理想。作者希望在保持悔恨近最优的前提下，显著降低累积约束违反。
AI.method: 方法结合连续Hedge与在收缩可行集上的淘汰机制。关键观察是：当Hedge分布的均值违反某约束时，Grünbaum不等式保证被淘汰的Hedge概率质量为常数比例。采用自适应学习率调度，并构造将存活体积与学习率耦合的势函数，将概率质量下降转化为对CCV的界定。
AI.result: 所提在线策略达到 O(√(T log T)) 悔恨和 O(log²T) 的CCV，在保持近最优悔恨的同时，把CCV从多项式量级降至多对数量级。
AI.conclusion: 通过在收缩可行集上结合连续Hedge、淘汰机制、Grünbaum不等式与耦合势函数，可显著改善COCO中的约束违反，实现多项式到多对数级的CCV降低，同时维持近最优悔恨。

title: LD-EnFF: Latent-Dynamics Ensemble Flow Filtering for Data Assimilation with Sparse Observations
summary: Data assimilation combines model forecasts with noisy, incomplete observations to estimate the evolving state of a dynamical system. Existing methods face two compounding challenges: high-dimensional nonlinear dynamics make repeated forward simulation computationally expensive, while sparse observations provide limited direct information about the full state. To address these challenges, we propose the Latent-Dynamics Ensemble Flow Filter (LD-EnFF), a sequential Bayesian filtering framework that performs both forecast propagation and filtering updates in a compact latent space. LD-EnFF combines a latent dynamics surrogate for ensemble propagation with a variational autoencoder (VAE)-based observation model that evaluates a state-dependent observation likelihood in latent space. At each assimilation step, an ensemble filtering update based on flow matching uses the forecast ensemble and this likelihood to generate posterior samples, jointly updating latent states and uncertain parameters. This design avoids repeated full-state simulation during forecasting and full-field reconstruction during likelihood evaluation. LD-EnFF substantially outperforms a broad range of data assimilation algorithms on benchmarks spanning Kolmogorov flow, tsunami propagation, and atmospheric modeling, all featuring complex dynamics and sparse, noisy observations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出隐动力学集合流滤波器（LD-EnFF），在紧凑的隐空间中同时完成预报传播与滤波更新，以应对高维非线性动力学的数据同化难题。
AI.motivation: 现有数据同化方法面临两重叠加挑战：一是高维非线性动力学使得反复前向模拟的计算开销巨大；二是稀疏观测对全状态提供的直接信息有限。
AI.method: LD-EnFF 是一个序贯贝叶斯滤波框架，将预报传播与滤波更新均放在隐空间中进行。它结合隐动力学代理模型进行集合传播，并采用基于变分自编码器（VAE）的观测模型在隐空间评估状态相关的观测似然；每个同化步通过基于流匹配（flow matching）的集合滤波更新，利用预报集合与似然生成后验样本，联合更新隐状态与不确定参数。该设计避免了预报时的反复全状态模拟与似然评估时的全场重构。
AI.result: 在涵盖 Kolmogorov 流、海啸传播和大气建模等具有复杂动力学及稀疏含噪观测的基准上，LD-EnFF 显著优于多种数据同化算法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将预报与更新统一到隐空间，LD-EnFF 有效缓解了计算成本与观测稀疏性两大难题，并在多类复杂动力学任务上取得优越性能。

title: Protecting Sensitive Data in Image Synthesis via PAC-Private Adaptation for Diffusion Models
summary: Synthetic data are increasingly used as an alternative to sharing sensitive records. However, synthetic data generation does not guarantee privacy, as diffusion models trained or adapted on sensitive data remain susceptible to reconstruction attacks. Moreover, while approaches that use differential privacy (DP), such as DP-SGD, achieve provably private diffusion model training, the repeated gradient clipping and noise injection they require result in significant utility loss. An important limitation of DP-based privacy is that, although it has a provable relationship to reconstruction privacy (RP), that relationship is indirect. RP is defined in terms of limiting how much an adversary's posterior distribution over sensitive data differs from the prior, whereas DP provides guarantees by bounding the sensitivity of outputs to changes in individual records. This indirection is an important source of the utility loss. To address this, we propose a PAC-private diffusion model adaptation to achieve reconstruction privacy. Since PAC-privacy is defined directly with respect to posterior advantage over the prior, it directly implicates RP. To obtain scalable PAC privatization in high dimensions, we first learn a compact data-dependent diffusion model component using LoRA or Textual Inversion, and then calibrate anisotropic Gaussian noise from the covariance of repeated mechanism outputs. Unlike DP-SGD, our method perturbs the learned component only once after optimization, thereby avoiding privacy composition across gradient updates. We evaluate the framework on few-shot concept personalization and full-dataset image synthesis, and show that the proposed approach better preserves subject identity, generation quality, and downstream classification accuracy than DP while achieving the same reconstruction privacy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于PAC隐私的扩散模型适配方法，直接面向重建隐私（RP），通过在优化后对紧凑数据相关组件（LoRA或Textual Inversion）仅加一次各向异性高斯噪声，避免了DP-SGD的梯度组合隐私开销，在相同重建隐私下优于DP基线。
AI.motivation: 合成数据被广泛用于替代敏感记录共享，但基于敏感数据训练或适配的扩散模型仍易受重建攻击。DP-SGD虽能提供可证明的隐私保证，却因反复梯度裁剪与噪声注入造成显著效用损失；其根本原因在于DP与重建隐私（RP）之间的关系是间接的——DP通过限制输出对单条记录变化的敏感度来保证隐私，而RP直接关注攻击者后验分布与先验的差异。这种间接性是效用损失的重要来源。
AI.method: 提出PAC隐私的扩散模型适配框架以实现重建隐私。由于PAC隐私直接以后验相对先验的优势定义，与RP直接相关。为实现高维可扩展的PAC私有化：首先用LoRA或Textual Inversion学习紧凑的数据相关扩散模型组件；然后根据重复机制输出的协方差校准各向异性高斯噪声。与DP-SGD不同，该方法在优化后仅对学习组件扰动一次，从而避免跨梯度更新的隐私组合。
AI.result: 在少样本概念个性化和全数据集图像合成任务上进行评估，结果表明：在达到相同重建隐私水平的前提下，所提方法在保持主体身份、生成质量和下游分类准确率方面均优于DP方法。
AI.conclusion: 以PAC隐私直接刻画重建隐私，并在优化后一次性注入校准的各向异性噪声，可在不牺牲隐私保证的情况下显著缓解DP-SGD的效用损失，为敏感数据扩散模型适配提供了更优的隐私-效用权衡。

authors: A. M. C. M. van Gils
title: On architectural choices for interpretability and thermodynamic consistency in Physically Recurrent Neural Networks in the low-data regime
summary: In this paper, we unravel the effect of different decoder architectures on the interpretability of the latent space of the Physically Recurrent Neural Network. Particular emphasis is given to a new weight normalization constraint, which acts as a regularization technique and enables robust training in the low-data regime. A brief visual exploration illustrates how these changes impact the latent space and how the fictitious stress can align with the true state of the RVE without explicit training. Reaping the benefits of a meaningful latent space, a case study illustrates how information from the microscopic level can be retrieved and incorporated into a multi-task approach that does not require extra parameters or larger training sets. Another key contribution shows that a specific architectural choice can naturally lead to a thermodynamically consistent formulation. By enforcing an adjoint encoder-decoder structure with positive scalar contributions, this modification ensures energy consistency across scales and non-negative dissipation, leading to even lower training requirements. This alternative completes the study on interpretability, inductive bias, and thermodynamic consistency, and demonstrates that data efficiency can be improved with careful architectural choices rooted in the underlying physics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究不同解码器架构对物理循环神经网络（Physically Recurrent Neural Network）潜空间可解释性的影响，提出一种新的权重归一化约束以提升低数据下的训练鲁棒性，并通过共轭编码器-解码器结构实现热力学一致性，从而改善数据效率。
AI.motivation: 提升物理神经网络潜空间的可解释性，并解决低数据条件下的训练鲁棒性与数据效率问题，同时保证跨尺度能量一致性与非负耗散。
AI.method: 研究不同解码器架构对潜空间的影响；引入新的权重归一化约束作为正则化手段；采用多任务方法在不增加参数或训练集的情况下引入微观信息；构建具有正标量贡献的共轭编码器-解码器结构以强制热力学一致性。
AI.result: 新的权重归一化约束实现了低数据条件下的稳健训练；可视化显示伪应力可在无显式训练时与RVE真实状态对齐；多任务方法有效利用潜空间信息；共轭结构确保跨尺度能量一致与非负耗散，并进一步降低训练需求。
AI.conclusion: 通过植根于底层物理的架构设计，可同时提升潜空间可解释性、归纳偏置与热力学一致性，并显著改善数据效率。

title: Articulatory Entrainment and Coordination Complexity in Spontaneous Autistic and Non-autistic Dialogue
comment: Accepted to be published in Interspeech 2026
summary: Articulatory entrainment, the adaptation of vocal tract coordination to facilitate interaction remains underexplored in spontaneous dialogue, particularly among autistic speakers. Many prior studies have utilized task-based, phoneme-level analyses with invasive measurement techniques. Here, we introduce a speaker-independent framework to quantify articulatory entrainment in spontaneous dyadic conversations among autistic and non-autistic adults using acoustic-to-articulatory inversion and coordination complexity metrics. We examine temporal changes in articulatory coordination across interaction. Non-autistic dyads exhibit increasing coordination complexity and stronger entrainment over time, autistic dyads show moderate effects, and mixed dyads demonstrate the least alignment. Greater articulatory entrainment correlates with higher self-reported conversational success, indicating increase in coordination complexity as a marker of effective social interaction.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种说话人无关的框架，结合声学到发音反演与协调复杂度指标，在自闭症与非自闭症成人的自发双人对话中量化发音同步，发现非自闭症配对同步随互动增强，自闭症配对效应中等，混合配对最弱，且同步程度与自评对话成功度正相关。
AI.motivation: 发音同步（articulatory entrainment）指为促进互动而调整声道协调，但在自发对话中研究不足，尤其是自闭症说话者。既有研究多依赖任务导向、音素层面的分析与侵入式测量，缺乏生态效度和说话人无关的量化手段。
AI.method: 构建说话人无关框架：对自闭症与非自闭症成人的自发双人对话，采用声学到发音反演（acoustic-to-articulatory inversion）获取发音运动，并以协调复杂度指标度量发音协调；考察互动过程中发音协调的时间变化，比较非自闭症配对、自闭症配对与混合配对。
AI.result: 非自闭症配对的协调复杂度随互动时间上升，同步更强；自闭症配对呈现中等效应；混合配对对齐程度最低。发音同步程度越高，自评对话成功度越高。
AI.conclusion: 协调复杂度的提升可作为有效社会互动的标记；该框架为自发对话中的发音同步研究提供了非侵入、说话人无关的量化途径。

title: Pareto-Dominant Clarification: Post-Training Coding LLMs via PPO-Lagrangian Budget Constraints
comment: Accepted to the LMP Workshop at EMNLP 2026. 17 pages, 8 figures, 1 table. Abhinav Rajput and Acey Vogelstein contributed equally. Code: https://github.com/Abhinav0710rajput/coding_llms_cmdp
summary: Coding agents operating under ambiguous instructions or user prompts must decide whether to ask clarifying questions or attempt a solution directly. While clarification from the user may improve the correctness of the agent's solution, each back-and-forth interaction incurs user and system costs, forming an explicit accuracy vs. efficiency tradeoff. Existing works study clarification behavior but do not train policies under enforceable clarification budgets; penalty-based approaches typically require separate coefficient tuning swept across all clarification budget levels. We formulate clarification as a Constrained Markov Decision Process (CMDP) and post-train Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct with PPO-Lagrangian to optimize coding accuracy, subject to an expected question-budget constraint. Evaluated on HumanEvalComm with a GPT-4o-mini oracle simulator, the resulting policies reveal that untuned clarification behavior is Pareto-inefficient: budget-constrained policies can simultaneously achieve higher accuracy and lower clarification rates than the baseline model. Across budget levels, we observe a log-shaped Pareto frontier with diminishing returns to additional clarification. Gains arise not from simply asking more questions overall, but from improved question targeting and better code generation under ambiguity. Without explicit supervision, trained policies learn to allocate clarification budget non-uniformly, asking more frequently on tougher (multi-degradation) tasks. These results suggest that unconstrained interactive LLM systems may systematically use clarification inefficiently.

AI.tldr: 本文将澄清提问建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)，用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练，在期望提问预算约束下优化代码正确率，发现无约束澄清行为是帕累托低效的。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体在指令模糊时需决定是提问澄清还是直接作答。澄清虽能提升正确率，但每次交互都带来用户与系统成本，形成准确率与效率的显式权衡。现有研究虽考察澄清行为，却未在可强制执行的澄清预算下训练策略；基于惩罚的方法通常需为各预算水平单独调参。
AI.method: 将澄清问题形式化为约束马尔可夫决策过程(CMDP)，在期望提问预算约束下，使用PPO-Lagrangian对Qwen2.5-Coder-7B-Instruct进行后训练，以优化编码正确率。评测在HumanEvalComm上进行，并使用GPT-4o-mini作为oracle模拟器。
AI.result: 所得策略表明未调优的澄清行为是帕累托低效的：受预算约束的策略可同时取得更高准确率和更低澄清率。跨预算水平呈现对数形帕累托前沿，额外澄清的边际收益递减。增益并非来自提问更多，而源于提问定位更准及模糊条件下代码生成更好。无需显式监督，训练策略即可非均匀分配预算，在更难的多重退化任务上更频繁提问。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，缺乏约束的交互式LLM系统可能系统性地低效使用澄清提问，凸显在可执行预算约束下训练澄清策略的必要性。

title: Beyond Masked Sparsity: SNACK Enables Truly Sparse Neural Networks on GPU
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 23 pages, 9 figures. Code: https://github.com/JafarBadour/Snack-SNN
summary: Deep neural networks continue to grow in parameter count, driving up training and inference cost on GPUs. Sparse neural networks and Dynamic Sparse Training (DST) promise to reduce these costs, but most implementations rely on binary masks over dense tensors and recover little of the theoretical compute, memory, or energy savings. We propose SNACK, a truly sparse GPU layer that stores and computes only non-zero connections. SNACK exposes a simple PyTorch API for restructuring connections and backpropagating gradients entirely in the sparse paradigm, and ships SNACK-COO, a custom COO-format SpMM CUDA kernel with a batch-to-Streaming-Multiprocessor mapping tuned for the small-batch, high-sparsity regime typical of large-model training and single-stream inference. At the kernel level, SNACK is up to 7x faster than the masked dense baseline (Dense+Mask) and competitive with cuSPARSE, Sputnik, and FlashSparse at 95% sparsity. At 90% sparsity, a single SNACK layer accelerates training by 8x and 3.7x, and inference by 4x and 2x, over Dense+Mask and fully dense layers, respectively, while using 72% less memory than dense and substantially less energy. End-to-end, SNACK reduces GPT-2 peak training memory by up to 40% and graph-style inference latency by 4.8x over Dense+Mask at 99% sparsity.

AI.tldr: SNACK 是一种真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储和计算非零连接，并配套稀疏 COO 格式的 SpMM CUDA 内核，在大模型训练与单流推理场景下显著提升速度、降低内存与能耗。
AI.motivation: 深层神经网络参数量持续增长，推高了 GPU 上的训练与推理成本。稀疏神经网络和动态稀疏训练（DST）虽能降低成本，但多数实现依赖稠密张量上的二值掩码，几乎无法获得理论上的计算、内存或能耗收益。
AI.method: 提出 SNACK，一种真正稀疏的 GPU 层，仅存储和计算非零连接；提供简洁的 PyTorch API，用于在稀疏范式下重构连接并反向传播梯度；并设计了 SNACK-COO，一种自定义 COO 格式 SpMM CUDA 内核，采用面向小批量、高稀疏场景（大模型训练与单流推理）的 batch 到 SM 映射。
AI.result: 内核层面，在 95% 稀疏度下，SNACK 比掩码稠密基线（Dense+Mask）快达 7 倍，并与 cuSPARSE、Sputnik、FlashSparse 相当。90% 稀疏度下，单个 SNACK 层相比 Dense+Mask 和全稠密层，训练加速 8 倍和 3.7 倍，推理加速 4 倍和 2 倍，同时比稠密少用 72% 内存且能耗显著更低。端到端，在 99% 稀疏度下，SNACK 将 GPT-2 峰值训练内存降低最多 40%，图式推理延迟相比 Dense+Mask 降低 4.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: SNACK 通过在 GPU 上以真正稀疏方式存储与计算非零连接，并结合专用 SpMM 内核，切实兑现了稀疏化在速度、内存和能耗上的收益，适用于大模型训练与推理。

title: Progressive Multi-Ancestor Bit-Depth Distillation
summary: Model compression strategies are widely employed to reduce memory footprint and network complexity, particularly for devices with constrained computational, memory, and energy resources. Prior works that rely on simultaneous conversion from floating-point high-precision (FP32) to integer low-precision (INT4) representations and distillation into smaller models suffer from unstable training and drastic degradation of prediction performance. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework, known as \textbf{P}rogressive \textbf{M}ulti-\textbf{A}ncestor \textbf{B}it-depth \textbf{D}istillation (PMABD), that progressively compresses the network while transferring knowledge through a growing pool of higher-precision ancestor teachers. PMABD generates a sequence of intermediate teachers that each learn from all higher-precision ancestors and jointly supervise the final target student. This multi-ancestor, multi-stage design stabilizes ultra-low-bit quantization by lowering quantization noise profiles across training and ensuring stable quantization. Experiments on CIFAR-10/100 with ResNet-20/32/18, and Tiny-ImageNet with MobileNetV2 show that PMABD outperforms state-of-the-art compression frameworks, results in 1.06$\%$ increase in performance of W2A2 (ResNet-18/CIFAR-100) student model. We show that a saturation-based stopping criterion contributes to improve the performance of our final student.

AI.tldr: 提出PMABD统一框架，通过多祖先、多阶段渐进式比特深度蒸馏，稳定超低比特量化训练，在多个数据集上超越现有压缩框架。
AI.motivation: 现有方法同时进行FP32到INT4的转换与蒸馏会导致训练不稳定和预测性能大幅下降，需解决超低比特量化的不稳定问题。
AI.method: PMABD生成一系列中间教师模型，每个教师从所有更高精度祖先学习，并共同监督最终目标学生；采用多祖先、多阶段设计降低量化噪声，并有基于饱和度的停止准则。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10/100（ResNet-20/32/18）和Tiny-ImageNet（MobileNetV2）上实验，性能优于SOTA压缩框架，W2A2（ResNet-18/CIFAR-100）学生模型性能提升1.06%。
AI.conclusion: PMABD能稳定超低比特量化训练，提升压缩模型性能，饱和度停止准则有助于进一步改进最终学生模型。

title: Physics is the Best Teacher: Consistency Learning for Time-Invariant Operators of Chaotic Dynamics
comment: 23 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Accepted for the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Accelerating the prediction of long-term behavior in chaotic systems is crucial in scientific computing. However, existing methods rely on numerical solvers or autoregressive models that advance one small step at a time, which makes long horizons expensive. We instead view this problem as learning the system's time-invariant evolution operator, which jumps the state across a large time span in a single evaluation. To this end, we derive the consistency equations a time-invariant operator must satisfy, with differential and compositional objectives in physical time. These equations also connect the learned operator to the physics-prescribed instant dynamics, enabling physics embedding in consistency learning. Across five chaotic systems, we find that physics-distilled consistency makes both short-term trajectories and long-term statistics more accurate. The learned operator survives temporal extrapolation and requires one-tenth as many evaluations as autoregressive rollout, offering an efficient route to long-term simulation of chaotic dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文将混沌系统长期行为预测建模为学习时间不变的演化算子，通过推导其必须满足的一致性方程（含物理时间上的微分与复合目标），实现单次跨越长时间跨度的状态跳跃，并在5个混沌系统上验证了精度与效率优势。
AI.motivation: 混沌系统的长期行为预测在科学计算中至关重要，但现有方法（数值求解器或自回归模型）每次只能推进一小步，导致长时程预测计算代价高昂。作者希望突破逐步推进的范式，寻找一种能在单次评估中跨越长时间跨度的方法。
AI.method: 作者将问题重构为学习系统的时间不变演化算子，使其一次评估即可跨越长时间跨度。为此推导该时间不变算子必须满足的一致性方程，包含物理时间上的一致微分目标与复合目标；这些方程同时将学习到的算子与物理规定的瞬时动力学相连接，从而支持在一致性学习中嵌入物理信息（physics embedding/physics distillation）。
AI.result: 在5个混沌系统上，物理蒸馏的一致性学习使短期轨迹与长期统计量都更加准确；学习到的算子能够经受时间外推（temporal extrapolation），且所需评估次数仅为自回归展开的十分之一。
AI.conclusion: 将混沌系统长时程预测视为学习时间不变演化算子并施加一致性约束，是一种兼顾精度与效率的长期仿真途径，可显著降低评估成本并保持对短时轨迹和长时统计的准确性，并具备时间外推能力。

title: Sharp Convergence and Sample Complexity of Policy Mirror Descent for Average-Reward MDPs
summary: Policy mirror descent (PMD) has a mature finite-time theory in discounted Markov decision processes (MDPs), but less is known in the average-reward setting, a more natural objective for many control applications. We give a finite-time, finite-sample analysis of PMD in ergodic average-reward MDPs built around a single master recursion that governs convergence for any critic, without external regularization. Its specializations yield linear rates for exact, inexact-tabular, and linear function approximation (LFA) updates, with a superlinear regime for exact PMD. We complement these convergence results with end-to-end sample complexities of order $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ in both tabular ($|S||A|$-dependent) and LFA ($d$-dependent) settings. Our LFA sample complexity sharpens the prior best $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^5$ mixing dependence to $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3$, and matching information-theoretic lower bounds establish that the critic's $t_{\mathrm{mix}}^3/\varepsilon^2$ sample complexity is unimprovable in both settings.

AI.tldr: 本文围绕一个统一的主递归（master recursion），对遍历平均奖励MDP中的策略镜像下降（PMD）给出有限时间、有限样本分析，无需外部正则化。
AI.motivation: PMD在折扣MDP中已有成熟的有限时间理论，但在平均奖励设定下研究不足，而平均奖励更契合许多控制应用。
AI.method: 构建一个支配任意critic收敛性的主递归，其特化形式覆盖精确更新、非精确表格更新与线性函数逼近（LFA）更新。
AI.result: 获得精确、非精确表格与LFA更新的线性收敛率，精确PMD呈现超线性收敛；表格与LFA的端到端样本复杂度均为 t_mix^3/ε^2，将LFA原有最优 t_mix^5 改进为 t_mix^3，并通过匹配的信息论下界证明该critic样本复杂度不可改进。
AI.conclusion: 为遍历平均奖励MDP中的PMD建立了紧致的有限样本理论，统一了多种critic情形并给出最优混合时间依赖。

title: Dynamic Harness Search: Building Multi-Agent Systems Per-Query via Prediction
summary: Agent harnesses specify the roles, instructions, tools, and communication structure used to solve a task, and the right harness depends on the query. Because the value of each design choice is observable only through execution, tailoring a harness to each query has required either executing alternatives at inference time or costly manual design. We introduce SHIFT, which moves execution out of the per-query search loop. A local LLM architect learns a policy over harness-building actions from search, and a value function that predicts, from measured executions, a utility balancing accuracy against execution cost. For each query, Monte Carlo tree search uses these predictions to construct a harness. Across 9,193 tasks in six benchmarks, from math to document and general-assistant tasks, with a Gemini 3.5 Flash executor, SHIFT attains the highest mean accuracy, about 80%, outperforming 17 baselines that span prompting, prompt optimization, and workflow search, and exceeding the strongest baseline by 7.2 percentage points. A cheaper mode of SHIFT also attains a higher mean accuracy than every baseline while using 32% fewer execution tokens than the strongest baseline. We further show that choosing structure, instructions, and tools jointly beats choosing only instructions or only tools by up to 9.1 percentage points, and that learned value selection identifies more accurate harnesses with lower execution cost from candidate pools.

AI.tldr: SHIFT 将执行从逐查询搜索循环中移出，通过本地 LLM 架构师学习 harness 构建策略与效用价值函数，并用 MCTS 为每个查询构建 harness，在 9,193 个任务上取得最高平均准确率（约 80%），超过最强基线 7.2 个百分点。
AI.motivation: Agent harness 的合理设计依赖于具体查询，而各设计选择的价值只有在执行中才能体现。现有做法要么在推理时对备选方案逐一执行，要么依赖昂贵的人工设计，因此需要一种更高效的方式为每个查询定制 harness。
AI.method: SHIFT 把执行移出逐查询搜索循环：先由本地 LLM 架构师通过搜索学习 harness 构建动作上的策略，并学习一个价值函数，从已测得的执行结果预测兼顾准确率与执行成本的效用；随后对每个查询使用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS），基于这些预测构建 harness。
AI.result: 在六个基准、9,193 个任务（涵盖数学、文档与通用助手任务）上，以 Gemini 3.5 Flash 作为执行器，SHIFT 取得最高平均准确率约 80%，优于涵盖提示工程、提示优化与工作流搜索的 17 个基线，比最强基线高出 7.2 个百分点。其低成本模式准确率仍高于所有基线，同时比最强基线少用 32% 的执行 token。联合选择结构、指令与工具比仅选指令或仅选工具最高提升 9.1 个百分点；学习到的价值选择能从候选池中选出更准确且执行成本更低的 harness。
AI.conclusion: 通过将执行移出逐查询搜索并以学习的价值函数指导 MCTS 构建 harness，SHIFT 在不牺牲甚至提升准确率的同时降低了执行成本，并证明结构、指令与工具的联合决策以及基于学习的价值选择对提升 agent 性能具有显著价值。

title: Ideal Paths for Approximating Logistic Gradient Descent Trajectories at Large Initialization
summary: Modern training on a new task often starts from a previously trained model rather than from scratch, raising the question of how this initialization affects the subsequent training trajectory. Classical implicit-bias results characterize the direction selected by prolonged training, but this direction alone does not provide information regarding the intermediate behavior. We address this question through a geometric approximation of full-batch logistic gradient descent (GD) trajectories on strictly linearly separable data, with large initialization of scale $R$ motivated by prior training. From any limiting normalized initial position, we use minimum-norm projection rules to construct a unique continuous ideal path consisting of finitely many linear segments. The path has two stages: negative-margin correction followed by minimum-margin growth. We prove that, after an explicit two-stage time reparameterization, the fixed-step GD trajectory divided by $R$ converges uniformly to this path on every fixed parameter interval as $R\to\infty$. Further, our quantitative error bounds account for initialization perturbations and the transition between stages. This approximation provides asymptotic formulas for peak evaluation loss and cumulative training loss. In particular, peak evaluation loss can grow linearly in $R$ even when both endpoint losses tend to zero. The cumulative losses in the correction and margin-growth stages, normalized by $R^2$ and $R$, respectively, converge to explicit limits. Experiments on controlled geometries and fixed image features complement our theoretical results.

AI.tldr: 本文研究大尺度初始化下全批量逻辑回归梯度下降轨迹的几何近似，构造唯一的连续理想路径并证明轨迹收敛，进而给出峰值评估损失与累积训练损失的渐近公式。
AI.motivation: 现代训练常从预训练模型初始化而非从头开始，因此需要理解初始化如何影响后续训练轨迹。经典隐式偏置结果只刻画长期训练所选方向，无法提供中间过程的行为信息。作者由此提出刻画大初始化下中间训练动力学的目标。
AI.method: 针对严格线性可分数据上的全批量逻辑梯度下降（GD），考虑规模为 $R$ 的大初始化。对任意极限归一化初始位置，利用最小范数投影规则构造由有限个线性段组成的唯一连续理想路径，该路径分为负间隔修正与最小间隔增长两个阶段。随后通过显式两阶段时间重参数化，证明固定步长 GD 轨迹除以 $R$ 在任意固定参数区间上随 $R\to\infty$ 一致收敛到该路径，并给出涵盖初始化扰动与阶段过渡的定量误差界。
AI.result: 该近似给出峰值评估损失与累积训练损失的渐近公式。特别地，即使两端损失都趋于零，峰值评估损失仍可随 $R$ 线性增长；修正阶段与间隔增长阶段的累积损失分别按 $R^2$ 与 $R$ 归一化后收敛到显式极限。在受控几何与固定图像特征上的实验与理论结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 大初始化下的逻辑回归 GD 轨迹可由一条两阶段线性分段理想路径一致逼近，从而定量刻画中间训练行为；峰值评估损失在大初始化下可线性放大，累积损失具有分阶段的显式标度律，为预训练初始化效应提供了理论解释。

title: You May Be Running the Wrong Inception Crop
summary: A decade after its inception, Inception crop has become the standard crop-based data augmentation method for training deep vision models. Not only is its practice of uniformly sampling crop scale and aspect ratio widely adopted, but also its lower and upper bounds, with the scale lower bound being the sole exception that is sometimes tuned. It is therefore surprising that the standard implementation in the TensorFlow / JAX ecosystem samples crop scale with probability density function $f(A) \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{A}}$ unlike the PyTorch counterpart, which follows the original description. Motivated by this discovery, we train 522 ViT-S/16 models on the ImageNet-1k dataset with various training budgets and crop scale distributions. We reach $78.78\pm0.09$ top-1 val. accuracy with 90 epochs of training budget and find that 1. Higher training budget requires stronger augmentation; 2. Lower tail of the distribution of the crop scale determines the augmentation strength of Inception crop; 3. Models trained with higher training budget exhibit sparser saliency, regardless of the crop scale distribution or weight decay. Based on 2. we revisit the performance of Beta crop, whose softer cutoff allows it to optimize model performance across training budgets with less compromise. We replicate 1. and 3. with Scion optimizer in addition to AdamW, suggesting that the results may be general.

AI.tldr: 本文发现TensorFlow/JAX生态中Inception crop的裁剪尺度采样分布与PyTorch不一致，通过522次ViT-S/16训练实验揭示裁剪尺度分布下尾决定增强强度，并据此重新评估Beta crop在跨训练预算下的优势。
AI.motivation: Inception crop已成为深度视觉模型训练的标准化数据增强方法，其均匀采样裁剪尺度的做法被广泛采用，但作者发现TensorFlow/JAX生态的标准实现使用f(A) ∝ 1/√A的概率密度采样裁剪尺度，与PyTorch遵循原始描述的实现不同，这一差异促使作者系统研究裁剪尺度分布对训练的影响。
AI.method: 在ImageNet-1k数据集上训练522个ViT-S/16模型，覆盖多种训练预算与裁剪尺度分布；同时使用AdamW和Scion优化器进行验证；基于"分布下尾决定增强强度"的发现重新评估Beta crop的性能。
AI.result: 在90个epoch训练预算下达到78.78±0.09的top-1验证准确率；发现：1) 更高训练预算需要更强的增强；2) 裁剪尺度分布的下尾决定Inception crop的增强强度；3) 更高训练预算下模型呈现更稀疏的显著性，与裁剪尺度分布和权重衰减无关。
AI.conclusion: 裁剪尺度分布的下尾是决定Inception crop增强强度的关键因素；Beta crop因其更软的截断可在不同训练预算下以更少折衷优化模型性能；在Scion优化器上复现了结论1和3，表明结果可能具有普适性。

title: PaLoRA: Paced Low-Rank Adaptation for Continual Learning
summary: LoRA-based continual learning methods mitigate catastrophic forgetting through various mechanisms, yet nearly all complement these with small learning rates as a heuristic to restrict gradient scaling magnitude. Such fixed heuristics lack theoretical guidance on how the strength of this restriction should evolve as tasks accumulate. We reveal that even under directional constraints such as nullspace projection, finite-precision updates inevitably leak into the subspace of accumulated prior knowledge along multiple directions. While small learning rates attenuate such leakage, they cannot prevent the accumulated forgetting from intensifying as the effective rank of historical knowledge grows. We show that the optimal magnitude restriction should adaptively increase with this effective rank to balance stability and plasticity, i.e., preservation of previous knowledge and acquisition of new task information. Under an anisotropic leakage model, we derive a pacing law $s^*=\sqrt{R/c}$ that characterizes the optimal scaling of gradient steps, i.e., the magnitude restriction itself, where $R$ is the effective rank of past updates. Based on this insight, we propose PaLoRA, which compresses historical knowledge via adaptive SVD truncation, projects gradients onto the nullspace of prior tasks, and applies rank-aware adaptive pacing. Experiments demonstrate consistent improvements over prior methods, with particularly strong performance in long-horizon settings, achieving substantial gains of 4% accuracy on challenging 50-task ImageNet-A and ImageNet-R benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示LoRA持续学习中固定小学习率抑制遗忘的局限，指出在有限精度下梯度更新会沿多个方向泄漏到历史知识子空间；由此提出最优幅度限制应随历史有效秩自适应增大，并推导出节奏律 s*=√(R/c)，进而提出PaLoRA方法，在长序列任务上显著优于已有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LoRA的持续学习方法虽通过零空间投影等方向性约束缓解灾难性遗忘，但几乎都辅以固定小学习率作为启发式手段来限制梯度缩放幅度。这类固定启发式缺乏理论指导：随着任务不断累积，这种限制强度应如何演化并无依据。作者希望从理论上阐明幅度限制的最优演化规律，以在稳定性（保留旧知识）与可塑性（获取新任务信息）之间取得平衡。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：指出即便在零空间投影等方向性约束下，有限精度更新仍会沿多个方向泄漏到已积累先验知识的子空间；小学习率虽可减弱泄漏，但无法阻止随着历史知识有效秩增长而累积的遗忘加剧。2) 建模：在各向异性泄漏模型下推导出最优梯度步长缩放（即幅度限制）的节奏律 s*=√(R/c)，其中R为历史更新的有效秩，表明最优幅度限制应随有效秩自适应增大。3) 方法PaLoRA：通过自适应SVD截断压缩历史知识，将梯度投影到先前任务的零空间，并施加秩感知的自适应节奏控制。
AI.result: 实验显示PaLoRA相较先前方法取得一致提升，在长序列（long-horizon）设定下表现尤为突出：在具有挑战性的50任务ImageNet-A与ImageNet-R基准上取得约4%的准确率显著增益。
AI.conclusion: 该工作从理论与实证两方面表明，LoRA持续学习中的梯度幅度限制不应固定不变，而应随历史知识有效秩自适应增长；所提节奏律s*=√(R/c)与PaLoRA方法有效平衡了稳定性与可塑性，尤其适用于任务数量多、长序列的持续学习场景。

title: Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition for Operator Learning
summary: Fourier Neural Operators (FNOs) offer an efficient paradigm for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). However, FNOs rely on a fixed Fourier basis and hard frequency truncation, which inherently limit their ability to model non-periodic, localized, and fine-scale solution structures. We propose the Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition Neural Operator (SAFDNO), a spectral neural operator that replaces predefined Fourier modes with an adaptive Takenaka-Malmquist (TM) orthonormal system derived from the theory of Stochastic Adaptive Fourier Decomposition (SAFD). Instead of performing an expensive greedy pole search in classical SAFD, SAFDNO amortizes stochastic pole selection through a neural pole predictor and constructs the adaptive TM system directly from latent features. The resulting operator performs learned filtering on coefficients of analytic branches in the Hardy space with respect to the input-adaptive TM system, preserving the global receptive field of spectral operators while providing a more flexible representation than using fixed spectral bases. Across nine PDE benchmark problems, SAFDNO achieves the best performance on all six regular-grid problems among strong neural operator baselines, with especially notable gains on Darcy, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes, where fixed Fourier modes are often less effective at modeling localized oscillations, sharp transitions, and multiscale structures. SAFDNO also exhibits stronger zero-shot super-resolution performance and shows less performance degradation when deployed on finer discretizations. These results suggest that the input-adaptive TM system provides a promising alternative to fixed spectral representations for neural operator learning.

AI.tldr: 提出SAFDNO，用自适应Takenaka-Malmquist正交系统替代固定Fourier基，在多个PDE基准上取得更优性能与零样本超分辨能力。
AI.motivation: FNO依赖固定Fourier基与硬频率截断，难以建模非周期、局部化及精细尺度的解结构。
AI.method: 以随机自适应Fourier分解（SAFD）理论中的TM正交系统替代预定义Fourier模态；用神经极点预测器摊销随机极点选择，避免经典SAFD的贪心极点搜索；由隐特征直接构造自适应TM系统；在Hardy空间对解析分支系数做可学习滤波，保留谱算子的全局感受野并提升表示灵活性。
AI.result: 在九个PDE基准中，六个规则网格问题全部取得最优；在Darcy、Burgers、Navier-Stokes上提升尤为显著；零样本超分辨表现更强，迁移到更细离散时性能退化更小。
AI.conclusion: 输入自适应的TM系统可作为固定谱表示的有力替代方案，用于神经算子学习。

title: Optimizer Geometry Sets the Pace: Spectral Learning Dynamics in Matrix Factorization
summary: Recent successes of matrix- and curvature-based optimizers have renewed interest in how update geometry shapes learning. These methods normalize or precondition updates, changing how different components progress during training. In deep matrix factorization, the geometry that slows gradient descent (GD) favors low-rank solutions by delaying the emergence of small singular modes. This raises the question of what remains of that spectral bias when normalization or curvature correction weakens or removes the slowdown. We study how optimizer geometry and depth jointly govern this behavior through a common framework for singular mode dynamics. Under explicit balance and alignment assumptions, we derive birth, saturation, and decay laws for Euclidean GD, coordinate-wise updates of SignGD and an instantaneous Adam approximation, spectral updates of Muon and cumulative Shampoo, and a block curvature model of K-FAC. The resulting picture is not a simple ordering from stronger to weaker low-rank bias. To highlight, SignGD and ideal Muon eliminate the divergent birth barrier and drive unsupported modes to zero in finite time. Cumulative Shampoo initially retains GD's depth-dependent barrier, then accumulated gradients produce a catch-up phase while making previously active modes increasingly persistent. Undamped K-FAC cancels the factorization-induced slowdown while preserving the ordering of the target singular values, whereas positive damping introduces a spectral threshold below which the slow GD phase laws reappear. These results give normalization, accumulated state, damping, and depth a direct interpretation as controls determining when modes emerge, persist, and disappear during training.

AI.tldr: 该文通过统一的奇异模式动力学框架，分析不同优化器（GD、SignGD、Adam、Muon、Shampoo、K-FAC）的更新几何与网络深度如何共同决定深度矩阵分解中的低秩谱偏置。
AI.motivation: 矩阵型与曲率型优化器的成功引发了对"更新几何如何塑造学习过程"的关注。已有研究表明，拖慢梯度下降的几何结构通过延迟小奇异模式的涌现而偏好低秩解，但当归一化或曲率校正削弱或消除这种减慢效应时，该谱偏置会如何变化尚不清楚。
AI.method: 作者建立了一个统一的奇异模式动力学分析框架，在显式平衡与对齐假设下，推导了多种优化器的"诞生律、饱和律与衰减律"：欧氏GD、SignGD与瞬时Adam近似的逐坐标更新、Muon与累积Shampoo的谱更新，以及K-FAC的分块曲率模型。
AI.result: 结果并非简单的"低秩偏置由强到弱"排序。SignGD与理想Muon消除了发散的诞生势垒，使无支撑模式在有限时间内归零；累积Shampoo最初保留GD与深度相关的势垒，随后累积梯度产生追赶阶段，同时使已激活模式愈发持久；无阻尼K-FAC抵消了分解诱导的减慢但保留了目标奇异值的次序，而正阻尼引入一个谱阈值，低于该阈值的模式重新出现慢速GD相律。
AI.conclusion: 归一化、累积状态、阻尼与深度可被直接解释为控制模式在训练中何时涌现、持续与消失的调节变量。

title: A Hand-Checkable Proof That Two Hidden ReLU Layers Compute the Maximum of Six Numbers
summary: Exactly computing the maximum function is a standard test case for studying depth in ReLU networks. Two hidden layers are known to suffice for up to twelve inputs through computer-assisted constructions. For six real inputs, we give an explicit hexagon identity whose local structure yields a self-contained analytical proof of this depth bound. The identity was found by computer-assisted search; we prove it through explicit cancellations that can be checked entirely by hand, without executing a verification program. The identity also yields an explicit network with hidden widths $17$ and $41$, zero biases, and rational weights.

AI.tldr: 该论文为六个实数输入的 ReLU 网络计算最大值函数给出了一个显式的“六边形恒等式”，并借此得到该函数可由两个隐藏层实现的解析证明。
AI.motivation: 计算最大值函数是研究 ReLU 网络深度的标准测试问题。虽然已知最多十二个输入时两个隐藏层即可实现，但此前结果主要依赖计算机辅助构造，缺乏自包含的解析证明。作者希望为六个实数输入的情形提供可手工检验的解析证明。
AI.method: 通过计算机辅助搜索发现一个“六边形恒等式”，其局部结构提供了一个简洁的解析证明。作者通过显式抵消来证明该恒等式，整个过程完全可手工验证，无需运行验证程序。
AI.result: 该恒等式为六个实数输入的最大值函数的双层 ReLU 实现提供了自包含解析证明，并给出了一个显式网络：隐藏层宽度分别为 17 和 41，偏置为零，权重为有理数。
AI.conclusion: 作者给出了六个实数输入下最大值函数可用两个隐藏层实现的显式解析证明，且所得网络参数为有理数、零偏置，验证过程无需计算机程序。

title: Cross-Trait Transfer in Subliminal Learning
comment: 38 pages, including references and appendices. Code: https://github.com/PeterXingyuZhao/cross-trait-transfer
summary: Subliminal learning is a phenomenon where a student language model acquires a teacher model's behavioral traits by training on semantically unrelated outputs. It is a subtle statistical phenomenon as trait transmission relies on weak statistical patterns in the generated data. To understand trait transmission between teacher-student pairs, we study cross-trait transfer: how data generated under one teacher trait changes the student's preferences of other traits. To this end, we introduce a directed trait-transfer matrix that quantifies these effects using log-probability gains for student answers. We find that the trait-transfer matrix reveals clusters of related traits, with students sometimes developing preferences for traits similar, but not identical, to the teacher's trait. Such cross-trait structure can be partially captured by output distribution metrics and representation-based metrics. Further, we analyze trait development and interaction: learning dynamics shows a progression from broad shared shifts toward more trait-specific transfer, and multi-trait experiments suggest that opposed traits can enhance such differentiation. Together, our findings reveal salient statistical structures over trait transfer and competition, thus providing a broader view of how hidden preferences are transmitted in subliminal learning.

AI.tldr: 本文研究"潜意识学习"中的跨特质迁移：学生模型在语义无关数据上训练后，会获得教师的特质行为。作者提出有向特质迁移矩阵，用对数概率增益量化特质间影响，揭示特质聚类结构、学习动态与多特质竞争机制。
AI.motivation: 潜意识学习中特质传递依赖生成数据中的弱统计模式，机制隐晦。以往研究多关注单一特质从师到生的直接传递，缺乏对"一个特质的数据如何影响学生其他特质偏好"这一跨特质交互的系统理解。
AI.method: 引入有向特质迁移矩阵，以学生回答的对数概率增益为度量，量化在某一教师特质下生成的数据对学生其他特质偏好的影响；并通过输出分布指标与表征类指标尝试解释该结构，同时分析学习动态与多特质实验。
AI.result: 迁移矩阵呈现相关特质的聚类结构，学生有时会偏好与教师特质相似但不完全相同的特质；该跨特质结构可被输出分布指标和表征指标部分刻画；学习动态表现为从广泛的共享偏移逐步走向特质特异性迁移，且对立特质可增强这种分化。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了特质迁移与竞争背后的显著统计结构，为理解潜意识学习中隐藏偏好的传递提供了更全面的视角。

title: Adaptive Bregman Alternating Projections for Feasible Gromov-Wasserstein Learning
summary: The Gromov-Wasserstein (GW) problem compares structured distributions without requiring a shared feature space or known correspondences, but its nonconvex objective and coupled marginal constraints make computation challenging. Bregman alternating projected gradient (BAPG) uses inexpensive alternating row and column updates, yet its fixed-penalty relaxation leaves a persistent feasibility gap. We propose Adaptive KL-BAPG (A-KL-BAPG), which combines a finite fixed-penalty burn-in with a guarded increasing-penalty phase. At each tail iteration, the method reuses BAPG's alternating updates and backtracks a delayed-power step until a Sinkhorn-inspired projective-diameter safeguard is satisfied. We prove finite termination of the backtracking at each iteration and show that the feasibility gap vanishes asymptotically. We further establish a best-iterate $O(1/\log N)$ bound for the weighted squared corrected residual and, under a support regularity condition, the existence of a stationary accumulation point for the original GW problem. This distinguishes A-KL-BAPG from fixed-penalty BAPG, whose stationarity guarantees are given for the relaxed problem. Experiments show that A-KL-BAPG achieves a favorable balance of accuracy, objective value, feasibility, and stationarity relative to BAPG variants, projection-based methods, and task-specific baselines. For synthetic and real graph alignment problems, it closely matches the accuracy and objective value of fixed-penalty KL-BAPG while reducing the marginal feasibility gap by 62-99% and the projected stationarity residual by 28-98%. Heterogeneous domain adaptation experiments show a similar pattern: A-KL-BAPG maintains comparable target accuracy and objective values while achieving better feasibility and stationarity than fixed-penalty KL-BAPG.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应KL-BAPG（A-KL-BAPG）算法，通过固定罚burn-in结合带防护的递增罚阶段，使Gromov-Wasserstein问题的可行性间隙渐近消失并获得原问题的稳定点保证。
AI.motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein问题目标非凸且带耦合边缘约束，计算困难；Bregman交替投影梯度（BAPG）虽更新廉价，但固定罚松弛存在持续可行性间隙，且其稳定点保证仅针对松弛问题而非原始GW问题。
AI.method: A-KL-BAPG采用有限固定罚burn-in加带防护的递增罚阶段；尾部迭代复用BAPG交替更新，并回溯延迟幂步，直到满足受Sinkhorn启发的投影直径防护条件。
AI.result: 证明每次迭代回溯有限终止、可行性间隙渐近消失；得到加权平方校正残差的最佳迭代O(1/log N)界，并在支撑正则条件下证明原GW问题存在稳定聚点。实验显示在保持精度与目标值的同时，图对齐任务将边缘可行性间隙降低62-99%、投影稳定残差降低28-98%，异构域适应也呈现类似优势。
AI.conclusion: A-KL-BAPG在精度、目标值、可行性与稳定性之间取得更优平衡，优于BAPG变体、投影类方法及任务专用基线，并首次为原GW问题提供稳定点保证。

title: Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning: Enhancing Agent Security against Prompt Injection Attacks from Failure Experience
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in tool-augmented environments, but their reliance on external inputs makes them highly vulnerable to prompt injection attacks that can hijack task objectives. Existing safety alignment methods rely on static expert trajectories or preference optimization, limiting their ability to generalize to adaptive attack patterns. In this work, we propose Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning (SRFT), a training framework that enables agents to improve robustness by learning from their own failure experiences under adversarial conditions. Instead of passively imitating expert behaviors, SRFT exposes the agent to compromised trajectories constructed via injected attacks, and leverages an expert model to generate structured self-reflection reasoning that contrasts unsafe and optimal actions. This reflective supervision teaches the agent to identify malicious instructions, reason about their consequences, and maintain alignment with the original user intent. We instantiate this framework in SR-Agent, built on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-8B, and evaluate it on both static and adaptive prompt injection benchmarks. Experimental results show that SRFT substantially reduces attack success rates while preserving task performance, and demonstrates strong generalization under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that learning from failure via self-reflection is a promising direction for building robust and secure LLM agents. Our code is released at https://github.com/Eden-Wang1710/srft-repo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自反思微调（SRFT）框架，让LLM智能体从自身在对抗条件下的失败经验中学习，以提升对提示注入攻击的鲁棒性，并实例化为SR-Agent，在静态与自适应注入基准上显著降低攻击成功率且保持任务性能。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体日益部署于工具增强环境，对外部输入的依赖使其易受提示注入攻击而被劫持任务目标。现有安全对齐方法依赖静态专家轨迹或偏好优化，难以泛化到自适应攻击模式。
AI.method: 提出Self-Reflection Fine-Tuning（SRFT）：不被动模仿专家行为，而是让智能体暴露于注入攻击构造的受损轨迹中，并借助专家模型生成结构化自反思推理，对比不安全动作与最优动作。这种反思监督教会智能体识别恶意指令、推理其后果并保持与原始用户意图对齐。基于Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct与Qwen3-8B实例化为SR-Agent。
AI.result: 在静态与自适应提示注入基准上评估，SRFT大幅降低攻击成功率，同时保持任务性能，并在自适应攻击下展现强泛化能力。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 通过自反思从失败中学习，是构建鲁棒且安全的LLM智能体的一个有前景的方向。

title: Integrated Imputation-Classification for Supervised Learning with Missing Data
summary: We study supervised classification problems with missing feature values. Existing approaches often decouple imputation from classification, producing imputations that may be plausible but uninformative for prediction. Instead, we propose the Integrated Imputation and Classification Network (IICN), which jointly trains an imputer and an ${(n{+}1)}$-classdiscriminator adversarially with a single class supervised classification objective, where the discriminator learns to distinguish among the $n$ true classes and an additional ``imputed" class. We prove that at the global optimum, the imputer and discriminator together implement marginalization over missing coordinates and yield a Bayes-optimal classifier. We evaluate IICN on FashionMNIST, CIFAR-10, and tabular datasets with naturally occurring missingness. IICN outperforms classical impute-then-classify pipelines and recent generative baselines, showing strong robustness and accuracy in challenging settings.

AI.tldr: 提出IICN网络，将插补器与(n+1)类判别器对抗式联合训练，用单一分类目标同时完成缺失值插补与分类，并证明其全局最优解等价于对缺失坐标的边缘化，从而得到贝叶斯最优分类器。
AI.motivation: 现有缺失特征分类方法常将插补与分类解耦，插补结果虽合理但对预测未必有信息量，导致分类性能次优。
AI.method: IICN将插补器与一个(n+1)类判别器以对抗方式联合训练，判别器需区分n个真实类别和一个额外的"插补"类，整个框架由单一类别监督分类目标驱动。
AI.result: 在FashionMNIST、CIFAR-10以及具有自然缺失的表格数据集上，IICN优于传统"先插补后分类"流程和近期生成式基线，在困难设置下表现出强鲁棒性与高准确率。
AI.conclusion: 理论上证明在全局最优时插补器与判别器共同实现对缺失坐标的边缘化并给出贝叶斯最优分类器；实验验证了该联合对抗学习框架的有效性与鲁棒性。

title: Do RUL explanations hold up? Faithfulness and stability of attributions on C-MAPSS
summary: Deep remaining-useful-life (RUL) models on NASA C-MAPSS are now routine, and so are heatmaps that colour sensors and timesteps. A heatmap that looks mechanical is not the same as an explanation an engineer can act on. We train three standard architectures - a 1D CNN, an LSTM, and a small Transformer encoder - on the official FD001 and FD003 splits with the piecewise RUL cap of 125 cycles and the official PHM08 asymmetric score. We then attach three attribution maps (Integrated Gradients, occlusion, last-layer attention) and evaluate them with the checks the XAI-for-PdM literature still under-reports: deletion/insertion faithfulness, Spearman stability under sensor-scale noise, agreement across training seeds, and cosine consistency inside RUL bins. Prediction error is a prerequisite, not the claim. The headline is which explanation method moves the RUL output when its top cells are removed, and which map survives a 5% input perturbation. Integrated Gradients and occlusion are similarly faithful on the LSTM; Transformer attention is cheap and temporally smooth but weakly faithful. All three maps are almost unchanged under 5% input noise, yet IG/occlusion agree only moderately across two LSTM seeds - stability to sensor jitter is not the same as stability to retraining. A secondary tabular check on the AI4I 2020 failure dataset shows the same deletion pattern for tree importances. We recommend occlusion or IG for any C-MAPSS-style report that will be read by a maintenance engineer, and we treat raw attention weights as a visualisation only.

AI.tldr: 在 C-MAPSS FD001/FD003 上训练 1D CNN、LSTM 与小型 Transformer，对比 IG、遮挡、注意力三类归因图的忠实性、噪声稳定性、跨种子一致性与 RUL 分箱内余弦一致性，主张工程报告用遮挡或 IG，注意力仅作可视化。
AI.motivation: 现有深度 RUL 研究普遍以传感器-时间步热力图充当解释，但"看似机械"的热力图并不等于工程师可据以行动的说明；XAI-for-PdM 文献对删除/插入忠实性、噪声稳定性、跨种子一致性等检验仍报告不足。
AI.method: 在官方 FD001、FD003 划分上，采用分段 RUL 上限 125 与 PHM08 非对称评分，训练三种标准架构（1D CNN、LSTM、小型 Transformer 编码器）；为每者附加三种归因图（Integrated Gradients、遮挡、末层注意力），并按四类检验评估：删除/插入忠实性、传感器尺度噪声下的 Spearman 稳定性、跨训练种子一致性、RUL 分箱内余弦一致性。另在 AI4I 2020 失效数据集上对树模型重要性做表格化二次验证。
AI.result: 预测误差作为前提而非主张。核心发现是各解释方法在移除其 top 单元时对 RUL 输出的推动程度不同，以及哪种图能经受 5% 输入扰动。在 LSTM 上 IG 与遮挡忠实性相当；Transformer 注意力代价低、时间上平滑但忠实性弱。三种图在 5% 输入噪声下几乎不变，而 IG/遮挡在两个 LSTM 种子间仅中等一致——对传感器抖动的稳定性不等于对重训练的稳定性。AI4I 2020 的树重要性呈现相同的删除模式。
AI.conclusion: 建议任何面向维护工程师的 C-MAPSS 风格报告采用遮挡或 IG；原始注意力权重仅作为可视化处理，不视为解释依据。

title: Modeling Deletion Requests in Machine Unlearning
summary: Machine unlearning is seen as a promising approach to enable users to exercise the "right to erasure" in the context of AI models. We ask how users might influence the behavior of models when exercising this right. We define two types of behaviors that users might adopt when requesting the deletion of their data: adaptivity and collectivity. Drawing connections between the goals of users in this context and results in stochastic optimization, we demonstrate theoretical gaps between the potential effects of groups of users who do and do not display these behaviors. We then show how techniques from data valuation might be used to design deletion requesters that can significantly alter model behavior in realistic settings. In experiments on computer vision tasks, we demonstrate the differential effects of different models of user behavior and attempt to isolate the impacts of adaptivity and collectivity.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨用户在行使AI模型"被遗忘权"时可能采取的行为（自适应性与集体性）如何影响模型行为，并从随机优化的角度揭示不同行为群体对模型影响的理论差距。
AI.motivation: 机器遗忘被视为在AI模型情境下实现用户"被遗忘权"的有前景的方法。作者关注的动机是：当用户行使删除权时，他们可能如何影响模型的行为，即用户行为方式对删除效果的影响尚未被充分研究。
AI.method: 作者定义了用户在请求删除自身数据时可能采取的两种行为类型——自适应性与集体性；将用户目标与随机优化中的结果建立联系，从理论上比较展现与不展现这些行为的用户群体的潜在影响差距；并展示如何利用数据估值技术来设计能够显著改变模型行为的删除请求者；最后在计算机视觉任务上开展实验。
AI.result: 研究揭示了体现与不体现自适应性和集体性的用户群体在潜在影响上存在理论差距；表明数据估值技术可用于设计显著改变模型行为的删除请求者；在计算机视觉任务实验中观察到不同用户行为模型带来的差异性效果，并尝试分离自适应性与集体性各自的影响。
AI.conclusion: 用户可以通过特定行为策略（尤其借助数据估值技术设计的删除请求）显著影响模型行为，自适应性与集体性行为对模型产生可区分的影响，这为理解"被遗忘权"下的用户行为效应提供了理论与实证依据。

title: S$^3$N: A Spherical Spiral Scanning Network for Weather Forecasting
summary: Machine learning-based weather prediction (MLWP) has achieved strong performance in global weather forecasting. Recent Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelation (HEALPix)-based methods use the HEALPix (HP) grid to avoid area distortion near the poles of conventional latitude-longitude (LL) grids. However, existing HP-based approaches often use pointwise mapping methods and process HP pixels within separate base faces or local windows. Consequently, the mapping may introduce reconstruction errors and cross-face communication depends on handcrafted boundary handling or shifted windows. We propose the Spherical Spiral Scanning Network (S$^3$N) to address both limitations. First, L2Proj provides a bidirectional method for mapping atmospheric fields between the LL and HP grids through an $L^2$ projection of their continuous finite-element representations. Second, the Attention-Guided Quad-Spiral State-Space Scanning (AQSS) block uses cross-latitude attention to guide selective state-space updates along four global pole-to-pole spiral paths. This design enables continuous information propagation across HP base-face boundaries without additional boundary-processing mechanisms. Experiments show that S$^3$N achieves better results at 4-, 7-, and 10-day lead times, and exhibits slower error growth in long-range forecasting.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出球形螺旋扫描网络（S$^3$N），解决HEALPix网格机器学习天气预报中映射误差与跨面通信依赖手工处理的问题。
AI.motivation: 基于HEALPix（HP）网格的机器学习天气预报方法可避免传统经纬（LL）网格在极区附近的面积畸变，但现有HP方法多采用逐点映射，并在独立基面或局部窗口内处理HP像素，导致两个问题：映射引入重构误差；跨面信息传播依赖手工边界处理或移位窗口。
AI.method: 提出S$^3$N，包含两个核心组件：1）L2Proj——通过连续有限元表示的$L^2$投影，实现大气场在LL网格与HP网格之间的双向映射；2）注意力引导四重螺旋状态空间扫描（AQSS）模块——利用跨纬度注意力引导选择性状态空间更新，沿四条全球极到极螺旋路径进行扫描，无需额外边界处理机制即可实现跨HP基面边界的连续信息传播。
AI.result: 实验表明，S$^3$N在4天、7天和10天预报时效上均取得更优结果，并在长程预报中表现出更慢的误差增长。
AI.conclusion: S$^3$N通过L2Proj提升网格映射精度、通过AQSS实现无缝跨面信息传播，验证了其在全球天气预报中的有效性及长程预报的稳定性。

title: Checkable NTK Positivity and Finite-Width Gradient Descent for Scalar- and Vector-Valued PINNs with Strong-Form, Weak-Form, and Nonlocal Linear Constraints
summary: We give checkable positive-definiteness criteria for the limiting neural tangent kernel (NTK) and high-probability finite-width gradient-descent guarantees for scalar- or vector-valued physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) with linear constraints. The constraints may be strong-form differential rows of any fixed finite order, including coupled systems, with any linear initial or boundary conditions; weak-form residual and boundary functionals; or finite-measure nonlocal observations such as integral, nonlocal-diffusion, and Dirac-data rows, all in any dimension. For each class, positive definiteness of the limiting NTK is equivalent to a rank condition on a finite coefficient, functional, or moment matrix of the fixed design: a certificate computed before training that detects structural zero modes. The model hypotheses are those of an ordinary two-layer PINN, a smooth nonpolynomial activation with bounded symmetric initialization, and are met by standard choices such as $\tanh$ with uniform initialization. Given a certificate, explicit width and step-size conditions ensure, with high probability, that the empirical NTK retains at least half the limiting gap and that full-batch gradient descent decreases the training loss geometrically at every iteration. Controlled experiments check the certificates and the finite-width mechanism.

AI.tldr: 该文为带线性约束的PINN（标量/向量输出）给出了极限NTK正定性的可检验判据，以及有限宽度下梯度下降的高概率收敛保证。
AI.motivation: PINN训练常面临结构零模导致的退化问题，而现有理论缺乏对一般线性约束（强/弱形式、非局部观测等）下NTK正定性及有限宽度收敛性的统一可检验刻画。
AI.method: 针对任意维度下各类线性约束（强形式微分行、初边值条件、弱形式残差与边界泛函、有限测度非局部观测如积分/非局部扩散/Dirac数据行），证明极限NTK正定等价于固定设计的有限系数/泛函/矩矩阵的秩条件，并给出训练前可计算的证书；在两层PINN、光滑非多项式激活、有界对称初始化假设下，推导显式宽度与步长条件。
AI.result: 给定证书后，高概率下经验NTK至少保留极限间隙的一半，且全批量梯度下降每次迭代几何式降低训练损失；受控实验验证了证书与有限宽度机制。
AI.conclusion: 结构零模可由训练前的有限维秩证书检测，且在适当宽度与步长下，约束PINN的梯度下降具有几何收敛的高概率保证，覆盖标准选择如tanh与均匀初始化。

title: CEENs: Causality-enforced evolutional networks for solving time-dependent partial differential equations
summary: Despite the growing popularity of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), their applicability in the long-time integration of partial differential equations (PDEs) remains constrained. We argue that this problem stems from the lack of consideration of temporal causality in the original PINN formulation, resulting in a bias towards satisfying governing equations at later times before learning the initial condition and hence leading to erroneous solutions. To this end, we propose a novel method that seamlessly integrates temporal causality into the training process. Drawing inspiration from classical numerical methods where the temporal causality is reflected, we divide the time domain into nonoverlapping subintervals, assign a unique neural network to each subinterval, and construct a loss function founded on the integral form of PDEs within these subintervals. The proposed networks undergo sequential training, beginning with the initial time step. Our method demonstrates significant improvement in accuracy for long-time simulations of various PDE problems where the original PINN method fails while it requires less computational cost and memory compared to the PINN method. A parallelization algorithm is provided to further enhance the computational efficiency, showing a significant speedup for solving time-dependent PDEs.

AI.tldr: 本文针对PINN在偏微分方程长时间积分中精度不足的问题，指出根源在于原公式缺乏时间因果性，提出将时间域划分为不重叠子区间、每段独立网络并基于积分形式构造损失、按时间顺序训练的方法，显著提升了长时间模拟精度并降低计算与内存开销，且支持并行加速。
AI.motivation: 物理信息神经网络（PINNs）日益流行，但在偏微分方程（PDEs）的长时间积分中适用性受限。作者认为该问题源于原始PINN公式未考虑时间因果性，导致训练偏向先满足较晚时刻的控制方程而忽略初始条件，从而产生错误解。
AI.method: 借鉴经典数值方法中体现时间因果性的思路，将时间域划分为互不重叠的子区间，为每个子区间分配一个独立的神经网络，并基于PDE在这些子区间上的积分形式构造损失函数；网络按时间顺序从初始时间步开始依次训练。此外提供并行化算法以提升计算效率。
AI.result: 在多个PDE问题的长时间模拟中，该方法相较原始PINN精度显著提升（原始PINN失败的情形下仍有效），同时所需计算成本和内存更少；并行化算法进一步提升了求解时间相关PDE的效率，取得显著加速。
AI.conclusion: 将时间因果性显式融入PINN训练（子区间划分+积分形式损失+顺序训练）可有效解决长时间积分失效问题，兼顾精度、计算与内存效率，并具备并行加速潜力。

title: Measuring Effective Data Resolution in Guided Diffusion Posteriors
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on AI for Stochastic Dynamics
summary: Guided diffusion samplers are increasingly used to reconstruct physical fields from sparse observations, but standard diagnostics do not say how much of the reconstruction was actually determined by the data. We introduce effective data resolution for black-box generative posteriors: a comparison between the resolution warranted by the inverse problem, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{ref}}$, and the resolution realised by the sampler, $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$. A perturbation estimator measures $\mathrm{dof}_{\mathrm{samp}}$ and the spatial map $R(x,x)$ from sampler queries alone. We validate the estimator against exact references and use it to study guided diffusion. The resulting measurements show that guidance weight can strongly alter apparent information transfer, that mean, spread and resolution are not jointly corrected by one weight even with an exact prior and score, and that resolution fidelity does not follow reliably from the apparent principledness of a guidance rule.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"有效数据分辨率"指标,通过比较逆问题应有的自由度(dof_ref)与采样器实际实现的自由度(dof_samp),量化黑箱生成后验中数据对重建的贡献。
AI.motivation: 引导扩散采样器被广泛用于从稀疏观测重建物理场,但标准诊断方法无法说明重建结果中有多少实际由数据决定。作者希望提供一个能衡量"数据信息实际传递量"的度量。
AI.method: 提出有效数据分辨率概念,即对比逆问题所应保证的分辨率dof_ref与采样器实现的分辨率dof_samp;设计扰动估计器,仅依赖对采样器的查询即可测量dof_samp及空间图R(x,x);并用精确参考解验证该估计器,进而研究引导扩散。
AI.result: 估计器与精确参考解一致。测量表明:引导权重可显著改变表观信息传递;即便先验与分数函数精确,均值、离散度与分辨率也无法由单一权重同时校正;分辨率的保真度不能可靠地由引导规则看似合理与否推断出来。
AI.conclusion: 有效数据分辨率为评估生成式逆问题中的信息传递提供了可操作诊断工具,揭示引导扩散在信息传递方面的局限性,提示不能仅凭引导规则的理论优雅性判断其重建质量。

title: LocusRL: Diagnosing LLM Reward and Policy Interventions in Competitive Games
summary:
Large language models can intervene in reinforcement learning through both reward design and action selection, yet aggregate performance offers an incomplete account of what these interventions actually do. Similar returns can conceal different learning mechanisms, while plausible rewards can induce undesirable behavior. We introduce LocusRL, a diagnostic framework that connects controlled reward-policy comparisons with audits of reward judgments, signal delivery, optimization objectives, and executed actions. The framework traces performance differences to testable explanations and checks targeted corrections through executable rules and counterfactual replay.
  Across two evaluation batches covering ten Connect Four training seeds, we uncover seed-dependent reversals in intervention effects and show how tracing actual updates changes their interpretation: historical Qwen training operates through reward-weighted teacher-action likelihood. A separate matched three-seed reward-direction experiment distinguishes sensitivity to a learning signal from its usefulness. With terminal rewards held fixed, a sign-reversed dense oracle yields a 2.8% aggregate win rate, compared with 57.2% for terminal-only training and 46.7% for the positive dense oracle. Thus, a reward can strongly influence learning without improving performance. At the decision level, counterfactual replay verifies a winning correction to a diagnosed action error. Complementary experiments in Leduc and reward-validation studies in Goofspiel extend the analysis to imperfect-information settings, revealing how reference-label definitions and validation-data exposure affect intervention assessment.
  Together, these findings show why evaluating LLM interventions requires tracing how their outputs become learning signals and actions. LocusRL turns aggregate outcomes into actionable diagnoses and verifiable corrections.

AI.tldr: LocusRL是一个诊断框架，通过将受控的奖励-策略对比与对奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标和执行动作的审计相连接，追踪LLM介入强化学习时的实际学习机制，而非仅依赖聚合性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可通过奖励设计和动作选择介入强化学习，但聚合性能无法完整反映这些介入的实际作用：相似回报可能掩盖不同的学习机制，而看似合理的奖励可能诱发不良行为，因此需要能追溯介入机制并验证修正的诊断方法。
AI.method: LocusRL连接受控的奖励-策略比较与四类审计：奖励判断、信号传递、优化目标、执行动作；将性能差异追溯到可检验的解释，并通过可执行规则与反事实回放检验针对性修正。实验涵盖十四个Connect Four训练种子的两个评测批次、匹配的三种子奖励方向实验，以及在Leduc和Goofspiel上的互补与奖励验证研究。
AI.result: 发现介入效果存在种子依赖的反转；追溯实际更新表明历史Qwen训练通过奖励加权的教师动作似然进行。奖励方向实验中，固定终端奖励，符号反转的稠密预言机聚合胜率仅2.8%，而仅终端训练为57.2%、正向稠密预言机为46.7%，说明奖励可强烈影响学习却不提升性能。决策层面，反事实回放验证了对已诊断动作错误的获胜修正。Leduc与Goofspiel实验进一步表明参考标签定义和验证数据暴露会影响介入评估。
AI.conclusion: 评估LLM介入需追踪其输出如何转化为学习信号与动作；LocusRL将聚合结果转化为可操作的诊断与可验证的修正。

title: One-Step Generation via Riemannian Wasserstein Gradient Flows
summary: Recently, Drifting Models and Wasserstein Gradient Flows have attracted substantial attention because they move iterative distributional refinement to training and amortize it into a generator, enabling fast inference. However, existing formulations have been developed largely for continuous Euclidean domains, such as image spaces, where particles admit unconstrained additive updates. On constrained spaces, these updates can leave the valid domain or ignore its geometry, making them unsuitable targets for training. Recent work has adapted updates to these spaces, but has focused on particular fields or offered limited empirical comparison. We derive and compare several geometry-aware fields within a common training framework for one-step generators. We test the method on data with different structures and obtain competitive one-step results in each setting. The best-performing field varies by task, showing why the choice of objective matters in practice.

AI.tldr: 本文将漂移模型与Wasserstein梯度流统一到一步生成器训练框架中，推导并对比多种几何感知漂移场。在不同结构数据上均取得有竞争力的一步生成结果，且最佳场依赖任务，说明目标函数选择的重要性。
AI.motivation: 现有漂移模型和Wasserstein梯度流主要在连续欧氏域（如图像空间）上构建，粒子可采用无约束加性更新。但在约束空间上，加性更新会跳出有效域或忽略几何结构，不适合作为训练目标。已有的约束空间适配工作仅针对特定流形或缺乏充分实验比较。
AI.method: 在统一的单步生成器训练框架下，推导并比较多种几何感知的漂移场（geometry-aware fields），使其更新尊重约束空间的几何与边界。
AI.result: 在具有不同结构的数据上进行测试，各设定均获得有竞争力的一步生成结果；性能最佳的漂移场因任务而异。
AI.conclusion: 几何感知漂移场的选取对实际性能有显著影响，实践中需根据任务选择合适的目标函数。

title: BARQ: Balanced Codebook Refinement for Low-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: As large language models (LLMs) grow in parameter count, model storage and parameter memory traffic have become major bottlenecks to efficient deployment. Codebook-based weight quantization reduces these costs, but imbalanced nearest-codeword assignments during fitting can leave some codewords insufficiently updated, limiting effective codebook utilization. To address this limitation, we propose Balanced Assignment Refinement for Quantization (BARQ), which improves quantization quality through balanced fitting of existing codebooks. Specifically, we first compute joint soft assignments between weight blocks and codewords through entropically regularized optimal transport with uniform marginals and curvature-weighted reconstruction costs, ensuring equal positive fitting mass for every codeword in the exact solution. We then refine the codewords through an assignment-weighted barycentric update, which we prove minimizes the fitting objective for fixed assignments. For finite Sinkhorn iterations, the implemented update retains this optimality provided all codeword masses exceed the denominator floor. Finally, we discard the soft assignments and use the refined codebook for standard hard nearest-codeword encoding, with our analysis establishing sufficient conditions for reducing hard-quantization distortion and evaluation loss. Across multiple LLMs, BARQ achieves lower perplexity and higher mean zero-shot accuracy than the evaluated baselines at comparable bit budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/chenhangcuisg-code/BARQ.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BARQ方法，通过平衡的码字分配精炼来改进基于码本的权重量化质量。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型参数量增长，模型存储和参数内存流量成为高效部署的主要瓶颈。基于码本的权重量化能降低这些开销，但拟合过程中最近码字分配不平衡，导致部分码字更新不足，限制了码本的有效利用率。
AI.method: 首先通过熵正则化的最优传输计算权重块与码字之间的联合软分配，采用均匀边缘分布和曲率加权重建代价，确保精确解中每个码字具有相等的正拟合质量；随后通过分配加权的重心更新精炼码字，并证明其在固定分配下最小化拟合目标；在有限Sinkhorn迭代下，只要所有码字质量超过分母下限，该更新仍保持最优性；最后丢弃软分配，用精炼后的码本进行标准硬最近码字编码。
AI.result: 在多个大语言模型上，BARQ在可比比特预算下实现了比评估基线更低的困惑度和更高的平均零样本准确率。
AI.conclusion: BARQ通过平衡拟合现有码本改善量化质量，分析确立了降低硬量化失真和评估损失的充分条件，代码已开源。

title: LoRA's Second Descent Extends Beyond Parameter Parity
summary: Double descent has sparked considerable interest, with recent work relating it to the data, the model and the learning configuration. Practical fine-tuning commonly involves training a small adapter on top of frozen pretrained weights, as in low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The adapter's rank is the hyperparameter that sets its capacity, yet how this rank relates to double descent has not been well explored. We quantify this relation under label noise on four vision backbones and a 7B language model with a module-matched rank sweep (MMRS), which extends past full rank and compares every rank with dense fine-tuning of the same modules, paired by seed. On DeiT-Tiny, risk is lowest at rank one and rises sharply as the adapter becomes able to fit the noisy labels, forming an interpolation cliff. Past the peak, risk falls again, but every tested post-peak rank that still saves parameters remains above dense risk. Rank-one LoRA outperforms dense fine-tuning on three of the four vision backbones, consistent with strong regularization at small rank. LoRA thus exhibits a second descent, but matches dense risk only after losing its parameter advantage, first on DeiT-Tiny at four times dense's projection weights. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lora-second-descent-C7B5.

AI.tldr: 本文通过模块匹配秩扫描（MMRS）系统研究了LoRA适配器秩与双下降现象的关系，发现LoRA存在第二次下降，但仅在失去参数优势后才与稠密微调风险持平。
AI.motivation: 微调常采用冻结预训练权重上训练小型适配器（如LoRA），其秩决定容量，但秩与双下降的关系尚未被充分探究。
AI.method: 在四个视觉骨干网络和一个7B语言模型上引入标签噪声，采用模块匹配秩扫描（MMRS）：扫描超过全秩的范围，并按随机种子配对，将每个秩与相同模块的稠密微调进行比较。
AI.result: 在DeiT-Tiny上，风险在秩为1时最低，随适配器拟合噪声标签而急剧上升，形成插值悬崖；峰值后风险再次下降，但所有仍节省参数的后峰值秩风险都高于稠密微调。秩为1的LoRA在四个视觉骨干中的三个上优于稠密微调，体现小秩强正则化。LoRA在DeiT-Tiny上需达到稠密投影权重四倍时才在风险上持平。
AI.conclusion: LoRA呈现第二次下降，但仅在丧失参数优势后才与稠密微调风险持平；秩为1时正则化优势明显。

title: Length Generalization Needs Proper Regularization
summary: Length generalization is the ability of sequential models to perform well on context lengths unseen during training. In this work, we show that the challenge of achieving length generalization is related not only to architectural choices such as positional encoding and the attention mechanism but also to the training procedure itself.
