We study how regularization affects length generalization and find that weight decay can hinder extrapolation. In contrast, dropout improves extrapolation when its placement within the architecture is reconsidered. In that regard, we show that the standard placement of dropout before layer normalization introduces a systematic distributional mismatch, and that applying dropout just before the linear projection resolves this issue. For example, a modified SmolLM3 with sliding window attention, continually pre-trained with dropout, can extrapolate perfectly to 64$\times$ on Needle-in-a-Haystack and far beyond the pre-training context size on RULER and HELMET. Mamba2 also benefits from dropout, suggesting an architecture-agnostic nature of the problem. We further propose Variance-Preserving Affine Dropout (VPAD), a new dropout strategy that substantially reduces the resulting pre-activation variance mismatch, leading to further extrapolation improvements in transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文指出长度泛化不仅取决于架构（位置编码、注意力），还取决于训练过程本身：权重衰减会妨碍外推，而重新设计dropout位置（放在线性投影前而非层归一化前）可改善外推；作者提出VPAD（方差保持仿射Dropout）进一步降低预激活方差失配，在SmolLM3、Mamba2等模型上实现显著的长度外推提升。
AI.motivation: 先前对长度泛化的研究主要聚焦于架构因素（如位置编码与注意力机制），而忽视了训练过程的作用。本文旨在探究正则化等训练手段如何影响序列模型的长度外推能力，并解释其内在机制。
AI.method: 1）系统研究正则化对长度泛化的影响，发现权重衰减抑制外推，而dropout在调整放置位置后可增强外推；2）分析得出标准做法（dropout置于层归一化之前）会引入系统性的分布失配，将其改为置于线性投影之前可消除该问题；3）提出方差保持仿射Dropout（VPAD），一种降低预激活方差失配的新型dropout策略。
AI.result: 采用修改版dropout的SmolLM3（结合滑动窗口注意力）经持续预训练后，在Needle-in-a-Haystack上可完美外推至64倍长度，并在RULER与HELMET上远超预训练上下文长度；Mamba2同样受益于dropout，表明该问题与架构无关；VPAD可显著减小预激活方差失配，在Transformer上带来进一步的外推提升。
AI.conclusion: 长度泛化是训练过程与架构共同作用的结果；正则化策略（尤其是dropout的放置位置与方差特性）是关键影响因素，且该规律具有架构无关性。通过重新设计dropout（置于线性投影前）及提出VPAD，可有效缓解分布失配并大幅提升长度外推性能。

title: Proximal Causal Learning under Unmeasured Confounding
summary: Estimating treatment effects from observational data typically relies on the No Unmeasured Confounding Assumption (NUCA), which rarely holds in practice. Proximal causal learning (PCL) addresses unmeasured confounding via proxy variables, yet existing methods require the proxy variables to be pre-specified. Thus, we propose PCL-U, a framework that learns proxy variables directly from observed covariates. PCL-U uses neural encoders to decompose covariates into treatment-inducing, outcome-inducing, and shared proxies, guided by minimax mutual information objectives, and obtains causal estimates through a practical moment-based risk function. Experiments on benchmarks show that PCL-U matches or outperforms existing baselines. Besides, there are two types of synthetic datasets with varying dimensions and confounding strengths that illustrate that our method maintains stable estimation accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PCL-U框架，直接从观测协变量中学习代理变量，以解决近端因果学习中代理变量需预先指定的问题。
AI.motivation: 从观测数据估计处理效应通常依赖无未测混杂假设（NUCA），而该假设在实际中很少成立。近端因果学习（PCL）通过代理变量处理未测混杂，但现有方法要求代理变量预先指定，限制了适用性。
AI.method: PCL-U使用神经编码器将协变量分解为处理诱导代理、结果诱导代理和共享代理，并由极小极大互信息目标进行引导，再通过实用的基于矩的风险函数获得因果估计。
AI.result: 在基准实验中，PCL-U达到或超过现有基线；在两类不同维度和混杂强度的合成数据集上，方法保持稳定的估计精度。
AI.conclusion: PCL-U能够自动从观测协变量中学习代理变量，缓解了PCL对预指定代理的依赖，并在多类数据上展现出竞争性且稳定的因果效应估计性能。

title: PhaseGate: Phase-Aware CPU Retrieval Scheduling for On-Device LLMs on Unified Memory
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints
summary: On-device assistants run GPU-based LLM inference alongside CPU retrieval on unified-memory systems. Under a saturated local-retrieval workload, four concurrent retrieval workers raise 95th-percentile (p95) decode latency by 60-61% on two M4 systems, whereas prefill latency rises by only 5.7-6.9%. We study LLM phase as an admission signal for independent CPU retrieval under controlled LLM workloads. PHASEGATE calibrates separate concurrency limits for prefill and decode, selecting four and one on our base-M4 configuration. Under a backlogged queue, it achieves 2.0 times the aggregate retrieval throughput of the best tested feasible fixed policy, with both p95 LLM latency metrics within 1.25 times their no-retrieval baselines in all seven held-out runs. A phase-blind control, TimeGate, uses the same two limits on a calibration-derived schedule without observing LLM phase. It achieves similar retrieval throughput but violates the output-token latency limit in every run. M2 and M2 Pro Mac minis reproduce the policy ordering, while output-length sweeps show that the advantage narrows as decode occupies more of each request.

AI.tldr: PHASEGATE 利用 LLM 推理阶段（prefill/decode）作为 CPU 检索并发的准入信号，为两阶段分别标定并发上限（基座 M4 上 prefill=4、decode=1）；在积压负载下取得最优可行固定策略 2.0 倍的聚合检索吞吐，且七个留出运行中 p95 LLM 延迟均不超过无检索基线的 1.25 倍。
AI.motivation: 端侧助手在统一内存系统上同时运行 GPU 的 LLM 推理与 CPU 检索。饱和的本地检索负载会显著恶化解码延迟（p95 上升 60–61%），而对预填充延迟影响很小（5.7–6.9%）。这种阶段间的不对称敏感性说明需要按推理阶段区分检索并发，以避免解码阶段被检索干扰。
AI.method: 提出 PHASEGATE：以 LLM 所处阶段作为 CPU 检索的准入信号，在受控 LLM 负载下标定出 prefill 与 decode 各自的并发上限（基座 M4 配置下分别为 4 与 1）。并设置阶段盲（phase-blind）对照 TimeGate：使用相同的两个并发上限，但按标定得到的调度而非观测 LLM 阶段来切换，从而隔离“阶段感知”这一因素的贡献。通过 M2、M2 Pro Mac mini 复现实验，并做输出长度扫描。
AI.result: 积压队列下，PHASEGATE 的聚合检索吞吐为最优可行固定策略的 2.0 倍，且全部七个留出运行的 p95 LLM 延迟指标均在无检索基线的 1.25 倍以内。阶段盲对照 TimeGate 检索吞吐相近，但在每一次运行中都违反了输出 token 延迟约束。M2 与 M2 Pro Mac mini 复现了策略排序；输出长度扫描显示，随解码在每次请求中占比增加，PHASEGATE 的优势收窄。
AI.conclusion: LLM 推理阶段是有效的检索准入信号：按 prefill/decode 分别限制检索并发，可在不显著牺牲 LLM 延迟的前提下大幅提升检索吞吐；优势来源于阶段感知而非单纯的双阈值调度，且在解码占比升高时减弱。

title: TMAML: Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning for Cold-Start Time Series Forecasting
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures, Accepted at Neurips 2026 TS-LIMITS Workshop
summary: Cold-start forecasting, the task of forecasting a time series with little to no historical data, is a common challenge. Addressing it requires approaches that learn quickly from few datapoints and leverage information from related series, typically through static covariates, to generalize well to unseen series. While some global forecasting models can generate cold-start predictions by leveraging information shared across multiple series, they are not optimized for out-of-train-set generalization or adaptation from short histories. In this work, we formulate cold-start forecasting as a few-window learning problem and introduce Temporal Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning (TMAML), which tailors the model-agnostic meta-learning algorithm, originally developed for few-shot adaptation of neural networks, to deep time series forecasting. TMAML constructs meta-tasks as temporally consistent support-query windows and pairs them with a temporal meta-training and meta-testing procedure, yielding forecasting models that are explicitly optimized for cold-start forecasting. We instantiate TMAML on the Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT) and present an initial empirical analysis of forecast accuracy and calibration across three cold-start scenarios: TMAML consistently outperforms or matches a standard ERM-trained TFT, yields better-calibrated forecasts than naive on two of the three scenarios, but does not consistently outperform naive on probabilistic forecast accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文将冷启动预测形式化为少窗口学习问题，提出时序模型无关元学习（TMAML），在TFT上实例化并在三种冷启动场景中验证，精度匹配或超过ERM训练基线，校准性部分更优。
AI.motivation: 冷启动预测（历史数据极少甚至无）需要能从少量数据点快速学习并借助相关序列（通常通过静态协变量）泛化到未见序列的方法。现有全局预测模型虽能利用跨序列共享信息生成冷启动预测，但并未针对训练集外泛化或从短历史中自适应进行优化。
AI.method: 将冷启动预测形式化为few-window learning问题；把最初用于神经网络少样本自适应的模型无关元学习（MAML）改造为面向深度时序预测的TMAML。TMAML以时序一致的支持-查询窗口构造元任务，并配套时序元训练与元测试流程，从而显式优化冷启动预测能力。在Temporal Fusion Transformer（TFT）上实例化TMAML。
AI.result: 在三种冷启动场景下进行初步实证分析（预测精度与校准）：TMAML一致地优于或持平标准ERM训练的TFT；在三个场景中的两个上比naive方法校准更好；但在概率预测精度上未能一致优于naive方法。
AI.conclusion: TMAML为冷启动时序预测提供了显式的元学习优化框架，在点精度上有效并对校准有部分改善，但概率预测精度仍存在提升空间，尚需更充分的实证验证。

title: DiffGate: Difficulty-Gated Teacher Guidance for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) has emerged as a widely used paradigm for post-training large language models, reducing the train--test mismatch of conventional distillation by supervising the student on its own generated trajectories. However, existing OPD objectives remain largely token-local and outcome-agnostic, optimizing teacher--student agreement at each prefix despite reasoning quality being determined at the trajectory level. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR), particularly Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), provides complementary outcome-level supervision but suffers from sparse rewards and coarse credit assignment. We show that OPD and RLVR exhibit complementary blind spots: teacher signals provide dense local guidance but are weakly aligned with rollout correctness, whereas group-relative rewards capture task success but provide coarse token-level credit and vanish on all-failure groups. We introduce DiffGate, an outcome-gated objective that combines GRPO with selective, bounded teacher guidance. Teacher supervision is applied only to failed trajectories, scaled by group difficulty, and smoothly bounded to prevent extreme teacher--student discrepancies from dominating optimization. The verifier therefore determines \emph{which trajectories} receive teacher guidance, while the teacher provides dense token-level update directions within those trajectories. Across Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B students, DiffGate improves code avg@8 over matched GRPO by $+1.7$ and $+1.8$ points and pass@8 by $+1.6$ and $+5.7$ points, respectively. On mathematics, avg@8 remains within $0.5$ points of GRPO while pass@8 improves by $+1.1$ and $+3.9$ points. Overall, DiffGate improves pass@8 across all four model--domain settings, demonstrating improved solution coverage under our evaluation protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DiffGate，一种结果门控（outcome-gated）目标函数，将 GRPO 与选择性、有界的教师指导相结合：仅对失败轨迹施加教师监督，并按组难度缩放、平滑有界，从而在密集 token 级指导与结果级奖励之间取长补短。
AI.motivation: 1) 现有 on-policy distillation (OPD) 目标大多是 token-local 且 outcome-agnostic，只在每个前缀上优化师生一致性，而推理质量本质上是轨迹级判定的；2) RLVR（尤其 GRPO）提供结果级监督，但奖励稀疏、信用分配粗糙；3) 二者存在互补盲区——教师信号密集但与 rollout 正确性弱对齐，组相对奖励能捕捉任务成功但 token 级信用粗且在全失败组中消失。因此需要一种将两者优势结合、规避各自盲区的目标。
AI.method: DiffGate：将 GRPO 与选择性、有界教师指导结合的结果门控目标。教师监督仅施加于失败轨迹，按组难度缩放，并做平滑有界处理以防极端师生差异主导优化。即由 verifier 决定哪些轨迹接收教师指导，教师在这些轨迹内部提供密集的 token 级更新方向。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-0.6B 和 Qwen3-1.7B 学生模型上：代码任务中 avg@8 相比匹配的 GRPO 分别提升 +1.7 和 +1.8 分，pass@8 分别提升 +1.6 和 +5.7 分；数学任务中 avg@8 与 GRPO 相差在 0.5 分以内，pass@8 分别提升 +1.1 和 +3.9 分。总体而言，DiffGate 在全部四个模型—领域设置中均提升了 pass@8。
AI.conclusion: DiffGate 通过结果门控的选择性教师指导，有效融合 OPD 的密集局部信号与 RLVR 的结果级监督，在四个模型—领域设置下均提升 pass@8，表明在本文评测协议下解覆盖度得到改善。

title: Asymptotically Optimal Best Arm Identification with Fixed-Budget under Differential Privacy
summary: Best arm identification under differential privacy is a pure-exploration problem in which both statistical efficiency and privacy protection must be achieved simultaneously. We study fixed-budget best arm identification for bandits under pure $ε$-differential privacy, where the learner must recommend an arm after a prescribed sampling budget while protecting the full transcript. We prove that the optimal exponential decay rate of the error probability is upper bounded by an instance-dependent privacy-aware transportation exponent that differs from the analogous quantity used to characterize the stopping time in fixed-confidence analysis by Jourdan and Azize [2025]. Guided by this exponent, we propose AO-Pri-BAI, an adaptive algorithm that maintains private running estimates through Laplace-tree mechanisms and learns a sampling design through a min--max interaction between hard alternatives and arm allocations. We prove that AO-Pri-BAI satisfies pure $ε$-differential privacy. We also establish that the exponent of the failure probability of AO-Pri-BAI matches the privacy-aware benchmark. Numerical studies show that even in the non-asymptotic setting, AO-Pri-BAI outperforms benchmark algorithms on various instances, complementing the theoretical analyses.

AI.tldr: 本文研究纯ε-差分隐私下的固定预算最优臂辨识（BAI）问题，给出误差概率最优指数衰减率的上界（隐私感知传输指数），并提出达到该基准的自适应算法AO-Pri-BAI。
AI.motivation: 差分隐私BAI需同时兼顾统计效率与隐私保护。现有工作（如Jourdan和Azize [2025]）在固定置信度设定下用传输指数刻画停止时间，但固定预算下的误差概率最优指数衰减率尚不明确，且缺乏能匹配该下界的算法。
AI.method: 作者首先证明误差概率的最优指数衰减率被一个实例相关的"隐私感知传输指数"上界所约束，该指数不同于固定置信度分析中的对应量。据此提出自适应算法AO-Pri-BAI：通过Laplace树机制维护私有运行估计，并在困难备择与臂分配之间进行min-max交互来学习采样设计。
AI.result: 理论上证明AO-Pri-BAI满足纯ε-差分隐私，且其失败概率指数与隐私感知基准相匹配（达到最优）。数值实验表明，即使在非渐近情形下，AO-Pri-BAI在多种实例上均优于基准算法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为差分隐私固定预算BAI建立了匹配的下界与算法界，AO-Pri-BAI在理论与实验上均验证了隐私约束下最优指数衰减率的可达性。

title: Anticipating the Consequences of Curriculum Decisions with Large Language Models
summary: Automatic curriculum learning can improve the effectiveness of reinforcement learning by selecting the training experiences presented to the agent over time. Predicting the consequences of such decisions can, however, be difficult. We analyze automatic curriculum learning as a sequential decision-making problem, highlighting a gap between the quantities that determine the value of curriculum decisions and the information captured by local learning signals commonly used to guide them. We then investigate whether Large Language Models (LLMs) can exploit richer information about the learning problem to better anticipate the consequences of curriculum decisions. We introduce a method that combines online learning-progress estimates with LLM-informed estimates of (i) the potential downstream benefits of learning on each task and (ii) whether direct training on a task is currently likely to produce progress. We evaluate the approach on a custom benchmark of 256 textual goals in Craftax under different curriculum objectives. We observe the strongest gains when optimizing for individual target tasks. When optimizing across the full task set, the benefits vary across learners with different mechanisms for cross-task transfer, ranging from modest improvements in learning speed to larger gains that persist through the end of training.

AI.tldr: 本文将自动课程学习建模为序贯决策问题，指出局部学习信号与课程决策价值所需信息之间存在鸿沟，并提出结合在线学习进度估计与LLM估计（下游收益、当前直接训练有效性）的方法，在Craftax的256个文本目标基准上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 自动课程学习通过选择呈现给智能体的训练经验来提升强化学习效果，但预测课程决策的后果较为困难。决定课程决策价值的量（如下游收益）与常用于指导课程的局部学习信号之间存在信息缺口，作者希望利用LLM所掌握的关于学习问题的丰富信息来弥补这一缺口。
AI.method: 将自动课程学习形式化为序贯决策问题；提出一种方法，把在线学习进度估计与LLM提供的两类估计相结合：(i) 在每个任务上学习的潜在下游收益，(ii) 当前直接训练某任务是否可能产生进度。在Craftax中构建包含256个文本目标的自定义基准，并在不同课程目标下评估。
AI.result: 在优化单个目标任务时取得最强增益；在针对全部任务集优化时，收益因学习者跨任务迁移机制不同而存在差异，从学习速度的适度提升，到持续到训练结束的更大增益不等。
AI.conclusion: LLM所提供的关于学习问题的额外信息可帮助更好地预测课程决策的后果，从而改进自动课程学习；其效果依赖于课程目标与学习者的跨任务迁移机制。

title: Backward-Consistent Diffusion Sampling for Sparsely Observed PDE Inverse Problems
summary: Recovering Partial Differential Equation (PDE) coefficient fields from extremely sparse observations is a severely ill-posed inverse problem for which generative machine learning methods (e.g., diffusion models) have become a leading way to encode the prior. Recent state-of-the-art diffusion solvers lift these priors to function spaces, finding a physics-consistent reconstruction in the output space of the diffusion denoiser. We prove that, in a discontinuous PDE setting, output space methods can result in failure to appropriately minimize the unobserved error with the correct coefficient field. Consequently, we propose Function space Backward-Consistent Sampling (FunBCS), an input space optimization approach for solving PDE problems which aims to find the best input such that the denoiser reconstruction is physics-consistent. We then prove that FunBCS appropriately minimizes the unobserved error, unlike output space optimization methods. Per our theoretical analysis, we also provide insights on how to dynamically allocate the number of input space optimization steps used throughout the sampling process. Our evaluations, across four PDE inverse problems (including the discontinuous Darcy flow), demonstrate that FunBCS reduces the reconstruction error by $27$-$64\%$ while running $1.4$-$2.1\times$ faster when compared to the current state-of-the-art.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对极度稀疏观测下PDE系数场反演的严重病态问题，证明现有输出空间扩散求解器在不连续PDE情形下无法正确最小化未观测误差，进而提出输入空间优化方法FunBCS并给出理论保证与动态步数分配策略。
AI.motivation: 从极度稀疏观测中恢复PDE系数场是严重病态逆问题，需依赖生成式先验（如扩散模型）。当前最先进的扩散求解器将先验提升到函数空间，并在去噪器输出空间中寻找物理一致重建。但在不连续PDE设定下，这类输出空间方法可能无法针对正确系数场最小化未观测误差，存在原理性缺陷。
AI.method: 提出函数空间反向一致采样（FunBCS），一种输入空间优化方法：不再优化去噪器输出，而是寻找最优输入，使去噪器重建结果满足物理一致性。同时从理论上分析未观测误差，证明FunBCS能正确最小化未观测误差，而输出空间方法不能，并据此给出采样过程中输入空间优化步数的动态分配策略。
AI.result: 在四个PDE逆问题（含不连续Darcy流）上评估，FunBCS相比当前最先进方法将重建误差降低27%–64%，同时运行速度提升1.4–2.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 在含不连续系数的PDE反演中，输入空间优化（FunBCS）在理论上比输出空间优化更正确地最小化未观测误差，并在实验上同时实现更高精度与更快速度，为扩散先验求解PDE逆问题提供了更优范式及步数分配指导。

title: The Numerical Linear Algebra of Large Language Models
summary:
Numerical Linear Algebra (NLA) has consistently played a vital role in advancing science by providing tools to solve fundamental problems encountered in scientific and engineering applications. Over the decades, it has continually evolved to meet the demands driven by successive waves of scientific discovery. For instance, during the 1950s and 1960s, substantial efforts were devoted to developing methods for solving eigenvalue problems that emerged from the rapidly growing field of aerodynamics. This led to the discovery of the LR and QR algorithms. Later the attention turned to the solution of sparse linear systems that were common in applications like computational aerodynamics. Today we are experiencing yet another wave of major scientific advancement and NLA is once more at the heart of its development. This Machine Learning (ML) wave is proving to be utterly disruptive in science and engineering. Many tools in ML particularly Large Language Models (LLMs) are grounded in matrix and tensor methods. As we are approaching Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), it is clear that matrix methods will be called to play an even more significant role. For the numerical linear practitioner the speed of the current change makes it particularly challenging to adapt.
  This is a survey article that centers on machine learning techniques, with a particular focus on large language models. It has two main objectives. The first is to clarify the core concepts behind Large Language Models in a manner accessible to specialists in numerical methods. The second is to examine the key Numerical Linear Algebra concepts employed by LLM techniques, while also highlighting several significant recent contributions of NLA to the field.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇综述，旨在向数值方法专家阐释大语言模型（LLM）的核心概念，并系统梳理LLM技术所依赖的数值线性代数（NLA）关键概念，同时介绍NLA在该领域近期的若干重要贡献。
AI.motivation: 数值线性代数（NLA）历史上始终随科学发现浪潮演进（如空气动力学推动特征值算法、稀疏线性系统求解）。当前机器学习（ML）浪潮带来颠覆性变革，大语言模型（LLM）等工具均建立在矩阵与张量方法之上，且随着迈向通用人工智能（AGI），矩阵方法的作用将更加突出。然而当前变化速度之快，使数值线性代数从业者难以适应，因此需要一篇架起NLA与LLM之间桥梁的综述。
AI.method: 采用综述（survey）方式，围绕机器学习技术、特别是大语言模型展开：一是以数值方法专家可理解的方式澄清LLM背后的核心概念；二是剖析LLM技术所使用的关键NLA概念，并归纳NLA近期在该领域的重要成果。
AI.result: 论文以综述形式界定了LLM的核心概念，并系统梳理了LLM方法所依赖的NLA关键概念，同时列举了NLA在LLM领域近期的多项重要贡献。
AI.conclusion: NLA在科学进步中始终扮演关键角色，正处于ML/LLM浪潮的核心。面向AGI的发展，矩阵方法将发挥更重要的作用。本综述为数值线性代数研究者理解并参与LLM研究提供了概念框架与NLA视角的切入点。

title: Revisiting the Generalization of Neural Graph Edit Distance Models
summary: Neural approaches to Graph Edit Distance (GED) have achieved strong results under standard within-dataset evaluation, but much less is known about how well these models transfer across graph collections. We conduct a systematic study of this problem using exact GED supervision across diverse graph datasets and a broad set of representative learning-based methods. Our results reveal a pronounced gap between within-collection performance and cross-collection transfer. Models that perform well on their training collections often lose this advantage when evaluated on structurally different data. Training on multiple source collections substantially improves zero-shot transfer and provides a better starting point when limited supervision is available for a new target collection. Further analysis shows that transfer behavior varies with the source--target direction and the structural characteristics of the collections involved. These findings suggest that conventional within-collection evaluation provides only a partial view of the generalization behavior of neural GED models and motivate broader evaluation across heterogeneous graph collections.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统考察了神经图编辑距离（GED）模型的跨图集迁移能力，发现集合内性能与跨集合迁移之间存在显著差距，多源训练可显著改善零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 神经GED方法在标准集合内评估下表现优异，但其跨图集迁移能力尚不清楚，现有评估可能只反映泛化行为的部分图景。
AI.method: 在多个多样化图数据集上，以精确GED监督为基础，对一组具代表性的学习方法进行系统的跨集合迁移研究，并分析多源训练与源—目标方向、结构特征的影响。
AI.result: 集合内性能与跨集合迁移存在明显差距；在训练集合上表现良好的模型迁移到结构不同的数据时优势常消失；多源训练显著提升零样本迁移，并为新目标集合的少监督学习提供更好起点；迁移行为随源—目标方向及集合结构特征而变化。
AI.conclusion: 传统集合内评估仅提供神经GED模型泛化行为的片面视角，需在异构图集合上进行更广泛的评估。

title: Gated Target Propagation for Compositional Generalization in Continual Learning
summary: Continual learning is typically framed as acquiring new knowledge without catastrophically forgetting previous tasks. However, a flexible continual learner should also be able to reuse and recombine previously acquired knowledge to rapidly solve novel task compositions. We introduce Gated Target Propagation (GaTaP), a continual learning algorithm in which task-specific gating variables---learned through a closed-form inner loop update---selectively suppress or enhance network modules. Network parameters are learned in a slower timescale outer loop, using the same local difference target propagation error signal as is used for adapting gating variables. We provide tractable experiments on class-incremental learning scenarios for both multilayer perceptron and convolutional network architectures. We show strong performance retention on previously learned tasks, as well as compositional generalization to unseen tasks, achieved through few-shot gain adaptation at inference. We analyze learned gating patterns and find that related tasks exhibit similar gating patterns, suggesting that inferred gates capture meaningful, reusable task structure. Overall, GaTaP provides a powerful framework for jointly ameliorating catastrophic forgetting and enabling few-shot compositional generalization in neural network models.

AI.tldr: GaTaP通过可快速适配的门控变量选择性调制网络模块，使持续学习模型既能抑制灾难性遗忘，又能对小样本新任务组合实现快速泛化。
AI.motivation: 传统持续学习主要关注在不遗忘旧任务的前提下获取新知识，但灵活的持续学习者还应能复用并重组已有知识，以快速求解新的任务组合。现有方法在兼顾抗遗忘与组合泛化方面仍不足。
AI.method: 提出Gated Target Propagation（GaTaP）：任务特定的门控变量通过闭式内环更新学习，用于选择性抑制或增强网络模块；网络参数在外环以更慢的时间尺度学习，内环与外环共享同一局部差分目标传播（difference target propagation）误差信号。推理时通过小样本门控增益适配实现新任务的组合泛化。
AI.result: 在多层感知机和卷积网络的类增量学习场景中进行了可处理实验。结果显示对已学任务具有强的性能保持能力，并通过对推理阶段的门控增益进行小样本适配，实现对未见任务组合的组合泛化。对学习到的门控模式分析表明，相关任务呈现相似的门控模式，说明推断出的门控捕捉到有意义且可复用的任务结构。
AI.conclusion: GaTaP为同时缓解灾难性遗忘并在神经网络模型中实现小样本组合泛化提供了一个有力框架。

title: Pareto-Improving Adversarial Attacks with Primal-Dual Regularization
summary: Transferable adversarial attacks are arguably the most practical black-box threat model. Under the same perturbation budget, stronger transfer attacks attain higher attack success rate (ASR), yet their imperceptibility also tends to degrade. Under such a fixed-budget protocol, transferability and imperceptibility therefore appear to trade off against each other. We argue that this conflict is an artifact of fixed-budget evaluation, not an intrinsic trade-off. When attacks are compared on the ASR--imperceptibility Pareto frontier obtained by sweeping $ε$, stronger transfer attacks already attain better imperceptibility at matched ASR than weaker ones. To exploit this latent advantage, we introduce the stealthy transfer attack ST, a plug-in primal-dual wrapper that adds an $L_\infty$ saturation regularizer to the standard constrained objective and resolves it through a two-step primal-dual update: a projected primal step on the perturbation coupled with an $L_1$-ball projection on a dual variable that absorbs the regularizer through Fenchel duality, requiring no auxiliary models or handcrafted perceptual priors. Empirically, ST extends the Pareto frontier across different base attacks and additional surrogate architectures. At $ε{=}16/255$, average imperceptibility gains over each base attack are $17\%$ on LPIPS and $14\%$ on NIQE while ASR is preserved or improved. At matched high-ASR levels, the strongest ST variants further Pareto-dominate dedicated stealth-oriented transfer attacks, confirming that the latent imperceptibility advantage of strong transfer attacks can be unlocked by a primal-dual optimization wrapper without sacrificing transferability. Code will be made available at \url{https://github.com/AndssY/ST}.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ST（Stealthy Transfer Attack），一种即插即用的原对偶（primal-dual）优化包装器，通过在标准约束目标中加入L∞饱和正则项，提升强迁移对抗攻击在固定扰动预算下的不可感知性，扩展ASR-不可感知性Pareto前沿。
AI.motivation: 在固定扰动预算的评价协议下，更强的迁移攻击通常攻击成功率（ASR）更高，但其不可感知性往往下降，因此迁移性与不可感知性看似存在权衡。作者认为这一冲突是固定预算评价带来的假象，而非内在权衡：若在扫描ε得到的ASR-不可感知性Pareto前沿上比较，强迁移攻击在匹配ASR时已具备更好的不可感知性，这一潜在优势尚未被利用。
AI.method: 提出ST（Stealthy Transfer Attack），一种即插即用的原对偶包装器：在标准约束目标上加入L∞饱和正则项，并通过两步原对偶更新求解——对扰动执行投影原步（primal step），同时利用Fenchel对偶将正则项吸收到对偶变量上，对偶变量执行L1球投影。该方法无需辅助模型或手工设计的感知先验。
AI.result: ST在不同基攻击和额外代理架构上扩展了Pareto前沿。在ε=16/255时，相较于各基攻击，LPIPS平均改善17%、NIQEE平均改善14%，同时ASR保持或提升。在匹配的高ASR水平上，最强的ST变体进一步Pareto支配专门的隐蔽导向迁移攻击。
AI.conclusion: 强迁移攻击潜在的不可感知性优势可通过原对偶优化包装器被释放，且不牺牲迁移性，说明迁移性与不可感知性之间的冲突可由固定预算评价协议解释而非本质权衡。

title: Path Laplacian Encodings for Directed Graphs
summary: Directed graphs naturally model many real-world systems in which interactions are asymmetric, such as citation networks, web graphs, and information-flow networks. However, graph learning methods commonly rely on message passing with symmetrized graph representations or positional encodings that only partially exploit edge directionality. We introduce PathLapPE, a novel spectral positional encoding (PE) derived from the path Laplacian on directed graphs. PathLapPE provides node- and edge-level features that encode directional higher-order structure and can be incorporated into standard graph learning architectures. Empirical results on node- and graph-level benchmark tasks show that PathLapPE yields consistent improvements across several architectures, especially when combined with direction-aware message passing. Compared with magnetic Laplacian positional encodings, a widely studied spectral positional encoding for directed graphs, PathLapPE does not require additional fine-tuning of directionality hyperparameters while offering competitive runtime and performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 PathLapPE——基于有向图路径拉普拉斯算子的谱位置编码，可同时提供节点级与边级特征以刻画有向高阶结构。
AI.motivation: 有向图广泛存在于引文网络、网页图和信息流网络等非对称交互系统中，但主流图学习方法常通过对称化表示的消息传递或仅部分利用边方向的位置编码来处理，方向性信息利用不充分。
AI.method: PathLapPE 从有向图上的路径拉普拉斯（path Laplacian）中导出谱位置编码，生成节点级与边级特征以编码有向高阶结构，并可插入标准图学习架构，与方向感知的消息传递结合使用。
AI.result: 在节点级与图级基准任务上，PathLapPE 在多种架构中取得一致提升，尤其是与方向感知消息传递结合时效果更佳；与磁拉普拉斯位置编码相比，无需额外调优方向性超参数，且运行时间与性能具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PathLapPE 为有向图提供了一种高效且易于集成的谱位置编码方案，在保持竞争性开销的同时更好地利用方向性高阶结构，优于需调参的磁拉普拉斯编码。

title: Low-Fidelity FDM Spectral Guidance for Neural Eigenvalue Solvers
summary: Operator eigenvalue problems appear throughout science. Classical methods usually discretize the operator into a matrix and then solve the resulting matrix eigenvalue problem. This works well in low dimensions, but fine grids quickly become expensive in both memory and computation as the dimension grows. Neural network based solvers avoid storing these large grids, but recent state of the art neural methods can require hundreds of thousands of training steps and may struggle to find the desired eigenvalues. We show that the two approaches can help each other. A coarse finite difference method (FDM) calculation acts as a cheap numerical model of the operator spectrum. We use the approximate eigenvalues as fixed shifts during the training of the neural solver, as they only need to locate the relevant part of the spectrum. We also introduce Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network (SIPMNN), a more stable training procedure for higher-dimensional problems. Across five test problems at $d=10$, the combined approach is more accurate overall than the tested fully neural alternatives while using eight to ten times fewer iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将粗网格有限差分法（FDM）与神经网络特征求解器结合，用FDM得到的近似特征值作为固定位移（shift）指导神经网络训练，并提出更稳定的SIPMNN训练流程，在d=10的五个测试问题上以更少迭代获得更高精度。
AI.motivation: 算子特征值问题广泛存在于科学中。经典方法将算子离散为矩阵后求解，低维有效，但随维度增长，细网格在内存和计算上迅速变得昂贵。基于神经网络的求解器避免了存储大网格，但现有先进神经方法常需数十万次训练迭代，且难以找到期望的特征值。作者希望结合两类方法的优势。
AI.method: 1）用粗网格有限差分法（FDM）计算，作为算子谱的廉价数值模型；2）将FDM得到的近似特征值作为训练神经网络求解器时的固定位移（fixed shifts），因为神经网络只需定位谱的相关部分；3）提出Stabilized Inverse Power Method Neural Network（SIPMNN），一种针对高维问题更稳定的训练流程。
AI.result: 在d=10的五个测试问题上，该组合方法整体上比所测试的纯神经网络替代方案更精确，同时使用的迭代次数减少八到十倍。
AI.conclusion: 粗网格FDM与神经网络求解器可以相互促进：FDM提供廉价的谱先验信息作为固定位移，提升神经求解器的精度并大幅降低训练迭代成本；SIPMNN进一步增强了高维问题的训练稳定性。

title: Score-Calibrated Flow for Sampling from Unnormalized Densities with Applications to Generative Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for online reinforcement learning (RL), enabling multimodal behaviors and improved performance. However, training these policies remains challenging: the critic specifies the desired policy as an unnormalized Boltzmann density but does not provide direct samples from it. Many existing methods rely on importance sampling to construct training signals, which can suffer from high variance, increasing computational cost and destabilizing training. We propose Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF), a simple and efficient algorithm for training generative models to sample from unnormalized densities without importance sampling or backpropagation through the sampling trajectory. We learn the desired flow by enforcing self-consistency, bypassing target posterior mean estimation. By jointly exploiting the prescribed target score and the structure of flow matching, we establish these self-consistency requirements as score-calibrated optimality conditions, first for the terminal density and then for the trainable velocity field. We prove that their unique solutions are, respectively, the target density and the ideal flow model that conditional flow matching (CFM) would recover if target samples were available. We formulate the velocity condition as a fixed-point equation and exploit its conditional-expectation structure to construct a stop-gradient objective for enforcing it. The resulting training procedure retains the scalable sample-interpolate-regress structure of CFM despite the absence of target samples, using endpoints generated by the current flow. For online RL, the critic gradient supplies the target score at the generated actions, yielding a direct approach to actor training. Experiments on RL benchmarks demonstrate that SCF matches or improves upon state-of-the-art generative-policy baselines, while substantially reducing training time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Score-Calibrated Flow (SCF)，一种用于生成模型从非归一化密度采样的简单高效算法，无需重要性采样或对采样轨迹反向传播，用于在线强化学习的生成式策略训练。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型为在线RL提供了表达力强的策略类，可实现多模态行为并提升性能。但训练这些策略仍具挑战：critic将期望策略指定为非归一化Boltzmann密度，却不直接提供其采样。现有方法多依赖重要性采样构造训练信号，导致高方差、计算开销大、训练不稳定。
AI.method: SCF通过强制自一致性学习目标流，绕过目标后验均值估计。联合利用给定的目标score与flow matching结构，将自一致性要求确立为score-calibrated最优性条件：先针对终端密度，再针对可训练的velocity field。证明其唯一解分别为目标密度以及若有目标样本时CFM会恢复的理想流模型。将velocity条件表述为不动点方程，利用其条件期望结构构造stop-gradient目标来强制满足它。训练过程在缺少目标样本的情况下仍保留CFM可扩展的sample-interpolate-regress结构，用当前流生成的端点。在在线RL中，critic梯度在生成动作处提供目标score，形成直接的actor训练方法。
AI.result: 在RL基准上的实验表明，SCF达到或优于最先进的生成式策略基线，同时显著减少训练时间。
AI.conclusion: SCF为从非归一化密度训练生成式策略提供了一种无需重要性采样、无需轨迹反向传播的高效算法，通过score-calibrated最优性条件与自一致性不动点目标实现，兼顾性能与训练效率，适用于在线强化学习。

title: Localized Operator Learning with Adaptive Partition-of-Unity Mixture-of-Expert Networks
summary: Operator learning methods such as DeepONets and FNOs often struggle with PDE families featuring sharp interfaces, heterogeneous coefficients, and localized multiscale structures. We introduce a partition-of-unity (POU) mixture-of-experts framework for localized operator learning, in which geometry-aware gating networks produce smooth spatial partitions which blend the contributions of local expert networks. Our main contribution is HiRefPOU, a residual-style hierarchical POU architecture for DeepONets that organizes localized representations through nested parent-child partitions while preserving global continuity. We also show that the same POU principle can be incorporated into Fourier Neural Operators to introduce spatial adaptivity without modifying the underlying spectral layers. On heterogeneous Darcy and reaction-diffusion benchmarks, HiRefPOU achieves substantially lower error than global DeepONet and static POU-MoE baselines, while the broader operator-learning experiments show that the benefits of localization depend on the PDE structure and the chosen neural-operator backbone. The learned partitions are interpretable and align with interfaces and regions of rapid solution variation. These results show that explicit geometric localization can improve both accuracy and interpretability in neural operator learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于单位分解（POU）的专家混合框架用于局部化算子学习，核心是面向DeepONet的残差式分层POU架构HiRefPOU，在异构Darcy与反应扩散基准上显著优于全局DeepONet和静态POU-MoE基线，且学到的分片具有可解释性。
AI.motivation: DeepONet、FNO等算子学习方法在处理具有尖锐界面、异构系数和局部多尺度结构的PDE族时表现不佳，缺乏显式的空间局部性与几何感知能力，导致精度受限且表示不可解释。
AI.method: 提出POU专家混合（POU-MoE）框架：由几何感知门控网络生成平滑空间分片，并混合局部专家网络的输出。核心贡献为HiRefPOU——面向DeepONet的残差式分层POU架构，通过嵌套父子分片组织局部表示并保持全局连续性；同时将该POU原则嵌入FNO，在不改动谱层的前提下引入空间自适应性。
AI.result: 在异构Darcy和反应扩散基准上，HiRefPOU的误差显著低于全局DeepONet与静态POU-MoE基线；更广泛的算子学习实验表明局部化的收益取决于PDE结构与所选神经算子骨干。学到的分片可解释，并与界面及解快速变化区域对齐。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何局部化可同时提升神经算子学习的精度与可解释性，但局部化的有效性依赖于问题结构与骨干网络选择，需针对性设计。

title: FoSeRL: Formal Sequential Robustness Certification for Reinforcement Learning Policies
summary: Even a few action perturbations can substantially degrade the performance of a deployed decision policy. Certifying the resulting return loss is challenging in stochastic environments, where returns vary even without an attack. We introduce FoSeRL, a framework for certifying deployed RL policies against precommitted, temporally sparse action attacks. The deployed policy is unchanged, with no smoothing or retraining. Certification requires a resettable simulator supporting shared randomness and independent one-step successor queries, but no analytical dynamics model. FoSeRL certifies that an attacked episode loses no more than a prescribed amount of return relative to the same episode unattacked, with at least a target probability and at a user-specified confidence level. Both runs share the initial state and randomness, so the measured loss reflects the attack, not the episode; carrying the running return gap as a state coordinate makes it the terminal value, reducing trajectory-level certification to terminal safety. Time-dependent barrier conditions on the augmented state bound the terminal failure probability: satisfied exactly, they certify every admissible precommitted attack; learned from sampled trajectories and verified on held-out data, they certify the same guarantee under a specified attack-episode setting. Across six stochastic continuous-control environments and three RL policy families (TD3, SAC, and PPO), FoSeRL certifies non-trivial cardinality--magnitude robustness frontiers, achieves substantially larger certified budgets than policy smoothing, and reveals marked robustness differences among policies with comparable nominal performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 FoSeRL 框架，用于在随机环境中对已部署的强化学习策略抵御预设、时间稀疏动作攻击的回报损失进行认证，无需平滑或重训练，可将轨迹级认证归约为终端安全性问题。
AI.motivation: 即使少量动作扰动也会显著降低已部署决策策略的性能，而在随机环境中回报本身存在波动，因此认证由此产生的回报损失非常具有挑战性。
AI.method: FoSeRL 保持已部署策略不变（不进行平滑或重训练），要求可重置模拟器支持共享随机性与独立单步后继查询，但不依赖解析动力学模型。它让受攻击回合与未受攻击回合共享初始状态与随机性，从而测得损失反映攻击而非回合波动；通过将运行回报差作为状态坐标，把轨迹级认证归约为终端安全性问题，并用增广状态上的时变障碍条件限制终端失败概率，可精确满足或从采样轨迹学习并在留出数据上验证。
AI.result: 在六个随机连续控制环境和三类 RL 策略族（TD3、SAC、PPO）上，FoSeRL 认证出非平凡的基数—幅度鲁棒性前沿，获得比策略平滑显著更大的认证预算，并揭示出标称性能相近的策略之间存在明显鲁棒性差异。
AI.conclusion: FoSeRL 为随机环境下抵御时间稀疏预承诺动作攻击的已部署 RL 策略提供了一种有效认证框架，可在保持策略不变的前提下给出具有目标概率与置信度的回报损失保证。

title: Variance-Optimal Control Variates for Learning with Black-box Feedback
summary: Modern models increasingly learn through black-box oracles such as humans, optimization solvers, and external tools that provide feedback without exposing their internal mechanisms. A common remedy is to learn an (action-)value function as a control variate. In this paper, we first observe that even an exact action-value function can be arbitrarily far from variance-optimal. We show that this gap arises because the value function minimizes the noise in each action's own gradient term, while an action can still affect the rest of the gradient estimator through shared parameters. A simple unbiased correction, at no extra oracle cost, can still reduce its variance by an arbitrarily large factor. Motivated by this, we then prove that the residual variance can be decomposed exactly by actions with no cross terms. This decomposition yields a closed-form variance-minimizing correction for neural-network parameters, which can be computed by a simple projection. Empirically, our correction consistently reduces the variance left by the value function and improves learning across all tasks. The source code for all experiments is available at https://github.com/Zihao-Kevin/black_box_opt.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现精确的动作价值函数作为控制变量并非方差最优，原因在于它只最小化每个动作自身梯度项的噪声；作者提出无偏校正与基于投影的闭式方差最小化校正，在无额外oracle成本下大幅降低方差并改善学习。
AI.motivation: 现代模型常通过黑盒oracle（如人类、优化求解器、外部工具）学习，这类oracle只给反馈不暴露内部机制。常用手段是学习（动作）价值函数作为控制变量来降方差，但本文指出这种做法存在根本性缺陷：即使价值函数完全精确，也未必方差最优，因此有必要重新审视并改进控制变量的设计。
AI.method: 首先给出反例与理论分析，说明价值函数只最小化各动作自身梯度项的噪声，而动作仍可通过共享参数影响梯度估计器的其余部分，故与方差最优存在任意大的差距；随后提出一种无偏校正，在不增加oracle调用成本的前提下可将方差不限倍数地降低。进一步证明残差方差可按动作精确分解且无交叉项，据此为神经网络参数导出闭式的方差最小化校正，可通过一个简单投影计算得到。
AI.result: 理论层面：证明精确动作价值函数可任意远离方差最优，并给出残差方差的精确、无交叉项的动作分解，以及闭式的方差最小化校正。实验层面：所提校正在所有任务上一致地降低价值函数留下的残差方差，并改善学习效果；代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 价值函数作为控制变量并非方差最优，其偏差源于共享参数带来的跨动作耦合；通过残差方差的无交叉项分解与投影求解的闭式校正，可在不增加oracle成本的情况下显著降方差并提升学习表现，为黑盒oracle场景下的梯度估计提供了更优且实用的方案。

title: Repeated-Measure Leakage, Distribution Shift, and Reliability under Partial Observation in Patient World Models
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Selected for oral presentation at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on World Models for High-Stakes Health (WMHS) Replication Package: https://doi.org/10.17605/OSF.IO/AUZVR
summary: Patient world models are increasingly proposed for longitudinal prediction, intervention-aware reasoning, and clinical-trial simulation. Causal or clinical intervention validity is distinct from predictive generalization and reliability; before making stronger claims, the underlying predictive state should generalize across patients, survive realistic shifts and missing observations, and expose failure through meaningful reliability signals. We evaluate these prerequisites in a deliberately narrow setting: short-horizon digital-biomarker forecasting from PhysioNet GaitPDB, comprising 165 participants, 306 recordings, and 51,129 context-future pairs. Using persistence, ridge, MLP, GRU, Transformer, and a compact JEPA-style predictor, we build an evaluation ladder that progressively removes raw temporal overlap, same-recording familiarity, and same-patient familiarity before testing unseen-patient generalization. For GRU, NMSE rises from 0.1227 under random-window splitting to 0.1393 after eliminating raw train-test overlap and to 0.1961 under patient holdout. Among 54 participants with repeated recordings, exposure to a different recording from the same patient improves GRU NMSE from 0.2177 to 0.1556, while a recording-excluded identity hypothesis is not supported at the participant level. Under participant-held-out evaluation, MLP and Transformer are statistically indistinguishable. Study shift, a four-times-longer prediction gap, and partial observation further degrade performance; under 50% temporal masking, Transformer NMSE rises to 0.611 while MC-dropout predictive variance falls. We do not claim a longitudinal or intervention-aware simulator. Instead, the results support a prerequisite evaluation stack of patient separation, repeated-measure controls, shift, missingness, and uncertainty validation before stronger patient-world-model claims are trusted.

AI.tldr: 本文在PhysioNet GaitPDB短程数字生物标志物预测任务上构建了一套评估阶梯，逐层剥离时间重叠、同记录与同患者熟悉度，系统检验患者世界模型在跨患者泛化、分布漂移、缺失观测和不确定性可靠性方面的前提条件，并未主张纵向或干预感知模拟能力。
AI.motivation: 患者世界模型被越来越多地用于纵向预测、干预感知推理和临床试验仿真，但其因果或临床干预有效性不等同于预测泛化性与可靠性。在提出更强主张之前，底层预测状态必须能跨患者泛化、在真实漂移与缺失观测下保持稳健，并通过有意义的可靠性信号暴露失效。作者旨在系统检验这些前提条件。
AI.method: 采用刻意收窄的设定：基于PhysioNet GaitPDB的短程数字生物标志物预测，涵盖165名参与者、306条记录和51,129个上下文-未来对。比较持久性、岭回归、MLP、GRU、Transformer及紧凑JEPA式预测器，构建逐步移除原始时间重叠、同记录熟悉度和同患者熟悉度的评估阶梯，最后测试未见患者泛化；并进一步考察研究漂移、四倍预测间隔和部分观测的影响，以及50%时间掩码下MC-dropout预测方差的可靠性表现。
AI.result: GRU的NMSE在随机窗口划分下为0.1227，消除原始训练-测试重叠后升至0.1393，患者留出时升至0.1961。在54名有重复记录的参与者中，暴露于同一患者的不同记录使GRU NMSE从0.2177改善至0.1556，而排除记录的身份假设在参与者层面未获支持。参与者留出评估下，MLP与Transformer统计上不可区分。研究漂移、四倍更长预测间隔和部分观测进一步降低性能；50%时间掩码下Transformer NMSE升至0.611，而MC-dropout预测方差反而下降。
AI.conclusion: 作者不声称构建了纵向或干预感知模拟器。结果支持一套前提评估栈，即患者分离、重复测量控制、漂移、缺失性和不确定性验证，认为在信任更强的患者世界模型主张之前应先通过该评估栈。

title: DASH: Fast, Valid Counterfactuals for Deep Networks via Batched Directional Search
summary: Counterfactual explanations are most useful when they can be generated with low latency, remain close to the factual input, and satisfy input-domain, categorical, and actionability constraints. Achieving these objectives simultaneously is challenging for deep neural networks. Heuristic methods are often fast but may return invalid counterfactuals, whereas exact methods can certify global proximity but may not finish within practical time limits. We introduce DASH, a batched heuristic search method for finding close, valid, and actionable counterfactuals for deep neural networks under $\ell_1$, $\ell_2$, and $\ell_\infty$ objectives. DASH uses directional Lipschitz bounds and local affine models to generate anchors, then ranks and expands promising regions with batched network evaluations. We compare DASH against nine prior heuristic methods and time-limited exact mixed-integer baselines on four tabular datasets, with network depths from 2 to 32, and evaluate scalability on PBMC3k. Across 9,000 tabular query-norm cases, DASH returns a valid counterfactual within $5\%$ of the best heuristic-observed valid distance in $94.6\%$ of cases, with a median CPU search runtime of $0.061$ s. PGD-bisect, the baseline with the highest pooled within-$5\%$ coverage, meets this criterion in $41.1\%$ of cases, with a median runtime of $0.298$ s. These results show that the proposed search maintains high valid proximity across norms while keeping its search runtime practical.

AI.tldr: DASH：一种面向深度神经网络的批量启发式搜索方法，在ℓ1、ℓ2、ℓ∞目标下生成低延迟、接近原样本且满足域、类别与可操作性约束的反事实解释。
AI.motivation: 反事实解释需同时满足低延迟、贴近原始输入，并满足输入域、类别与可操作性约束；但深度神经网络中同时实现这些目标困难。启发式方法快但可能返回无效反事实，精确方法可证明全局邻近性但实际耗时过长。
AI.method: DASH采用方向性Lipschitz界与局部仿射模型生成锚点，并通过批量网络评估对潜在区域进行排序与扩展，在ℓ1、ℓ2、ℓ∞目标下搜索反事实。
AI.result: 在四个表格数据集、网络深度2至32上，与九种启发式方法和限时精确混合整数基线比较；在9,000个表格查询-范数案例中，DASH在94.6%的案例中返回距最佳启发式有效距离5%以内的有效反事实，CPU搜索中位运行时间0.061秒；PGD-bisect的同类覆盖率为41.1%，中位运行时间0.298秒；并在PBMC3k上评估可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: 所提搜索在多种范数下保持较高的有效邻近性，同时搜索运行时间实用。

title: TIMBRE: Teaching Time Series Forecasters to Read, Remember, and Reconcile
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/stephen-guan-researcher/TIMBRE ; Checkpoints: https://huggingface.co/XinyuGuan/TIMBRE
summary: Event-informed forecasting requires translating reports and historical responses into changes to a numerical forecast. We propose TIMBRE (Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence), which combines source-aware representation, state-conditioned response transfer, and reliability-guided fusion before a frozen forecast head. A separate readout adjusts interval widths while preserving the median. In a single-seed, one-epoch development study of 13 tasks, TIMBRE improves MAE over ordinary fusion on eight tasks but over native Chronos-2 on only two. Disabling response transfer in the trained model reduces BTC and AULF MAE by 47.04% and 6.81%, respectively. These findings identify sensitivity to learned response transfer rather than a general forecasting advantage. Missing development-set scores and the absence of retrained ablations limit attribution to individual evidence mechanisms.

AI.tldr: TIMBRE 通过源感知表示、状态条件响应迁移与可靠性引导融合，将事件报告映射为对冻结预测头的数值修正，但单种子单轮实验显示其优势有限且主要来自响应迁移模块的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 事件驱动预测需要把文本报告与历史响应转化为数值预测的调整，现有方法缺乏对该转化机制细粒度归因的检验。
AI.method: 提出 TIMBRE（Temporal Integration of Memory-Based Responses and Evidence），包含三部分：源感知表示（source-aware representation）、状态条件响应迁移（state-conditioned response transfer）、可靠性引导融合（reliability-guided fusion），其输出接入冻结的预测头；另设独立读出层在保持中位数的同时调整区间宽度。
AI.result: 在13个任务的单种子、单轮开发性研究中，TIMBRE 在8个任务上较普通融合改善 MAE，但仅在2个任务上优于原生 Chronos-2。在已训练模型中禁用响应迁移后，BTC 与 AULF 的 MAE 分别下降47.04%和6.81%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明模型对所学响应迁移机制高度敏感，而非具备通用预测优势；开发集评分缺失与未做重训练消融限制了各证据模块的归因结论。

title: Multi-Agent Spectrum Sharing
summary: This project explores how multiple cognitive radars can learn to share limited wireless spectrum with other radio users without interfering with one another. Using machine learning (ML), each device independently decides where and how widely to transmit within a fixed 100 MHz band. The system analyzes real or simulated signal activity to detect which parts of the spectrum are currently in use and which are open. Based on this information, the devices adapt their transmission choices to avoid crowded frequencies while making efficient use of available space. The goal is to develop a flexible, scalable approach to spectrum sharing that could support future wireless communication systems. Experimental results using both over-the-air software-defined radio (SDR) recordings and simulated environments demonstrate that the proposed meta-learning approach consistently balances competing objectives better than conventional reinforcement learning (RL) methods in multi-agent spectrum-sharing scenarios. Across five multi-agent benchmark environments, our proposed method achieved the highest average reward among the primary baseline algorithms while simultaneously maintaining low collision rates and stable transmission behavior.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多认知雷达在固定100 MHz频段内共享频谱的问题，提出基于元学习（meta-learning）的多智能体频谱共享方法，让设备自主判断频谱占用并调整发射策略。在SDR实测与仿真环境中，该方法在五个多智能体基准环境下取得最高平均奖励，同时保持低碰撞率与稳定发射行为，优于传统强化学习方法。
AI.motivation: 无线频谱资源有限且多用户共存，认知雷达与其他无线电用户之间易产生干扰。需要一种灵活、可扩展的频谱共享方案，使各设备在避免干扰的同时高效利用可用频谱，以支撑未来无线通信系统。
AI.method: 采用机器学习方法，每个设备在固定100 MHz频带内独立决策发射位置与带宽；系统分析真实或仿真信号活动，识别频谱中被占用与空闲的部分，据此自适应调整发射选择以规避拥塞频段并高效利用空闲空间；核心为面向多智能体频谱共享的元学习（meta-learning）方法。
AI.result: 在五种多智能体基准环境中，所提方法在主要基线算法中取得最高平均奖励，同时保持低碰撞率和稳定的发射行为；在基于软件定义无线电（SDR）的空中实测记录与仿真环境中均得到验证。
AI.conclusion: 所提元学习方法在多智能体频谱共享场景下，能持续比传统强化学习更好地平衡相互竞争的目标，为灵活、可扩展的未来无线通信频谱共享提供了可行途径。

title: GRAM: Correcting Frozen Time-Series Foundation Models via Graph-Retrieved Amplitude Memory
summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) enable zero-shot forecasting through large-scale cross-domain pretraining, while retrieval augmentation further improves their performance by leveraging historical information. However, existing methods typically correct TSFM forecasts using the ground-truth futures of similar historical windows, which contain both predictive components already captured by the foundation model and sample-specific random fluctuation that is difficult to transfer. In contrast, recurring systematic model bias within prediction errors more directly characterizes the failure modes of a frozen TSFM and therefore provides more valuable correction signals. Effectively exploiting such model bias, however, poses two challenges: prediction errors at different numerical levels are difficult to compare due to scale differences, and the recurring bias must be extracted from prediction errors contaminated by random fluctuation. To address these challenges, we propose GRAM, a general retrieval-augmented framework for frozen TSFMs. GRAM first introduces an Amplitude Memory Module (AMM) that scales prediction errors by amplitude and aggregates them into retrievable prototypes. It then employs a Prototype Graph Module (PGM) to model relations among prototypes to aggregate consistent bias information while suppressing random fluctuation. During online forecasting, GRAM retrieves and expands prototypes relevant to the current query and generates per-horizon corrections to refine the original TSFM forecast. Experiments across multiple datasets and foundation models demonstrate consistent forecasting improvements.

AI.tldr: GRAM 提出一种面向冻结时序基础模型的通用检索增强框架，通过幅度记忆模块与原型图模块提取并利用模型系统性偏差，实现对预测结果的逐期修正，在多个数据集与基础模型上取得一致的预测性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有时序基础模型（TSFM）结合检索增强时，通常用相似历史窗口的真实未来值来修正预测，但这些真实未来值既包含基础模型已捕捉的预测成分，又包含难以迁移的样本特有随机波动，修正信号质量不高。相比之下，预测误差中反复出现的系统性模型偏差更能刻画冻结 TSFM 的失效模式，是更有价值的修正信号。然而利用该偏差存在两个挑战：不同数值水平下的预测误差因尺度差异难以比较；反复性偏差需从被随机波动污染的预测误差中提取。
AI.method: GRAM 是一个面向冻结 TSFM 的通用检索增强框架。首先引入幅度记忆模块（AMM），按幅度对预测误差进行缩放，并将其聚合成可检索的原型；随后采用原型图模块（PGM）建模原型之间的关系，在聚合一致性偏差信息的同时抑制随机波动。在线预测阶段，GRAM 检索与当前查询相关的原型并进行扩展，生成逐预测步（per-horizon）的修正量以精化原始 TSFM 预测。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和多种基础模型上的实验表明，GRAM 能够带来一致的预测性能提升。
AI.conclusion: GRAM 通过挖掘和利用冻结 TSFM 预测误差中的系统性偏差，而非依赖历史真实未来值，为时序基础模型的检索增强提供了一种通用且有效的修正范式，验证了模型偏差作为修正信号的可行性与优越性。

title: Which Preferences to Train On? End-to-End Multi-Objective Alignment with an Adversarial Preference Distribution
summary: Aligning large language models (LLMs) with human values is important for safe, efficient, and beneficial AI deployment. However, human values are multifaceted: helpfulness, harmlessness and humor trade off against one another, and different users want different trade-offs. Multi-objective alignment (MOA) addresses this by training a policy that can provide any point of the Pareto front, but existing methods either train one model per preference, interpolate a few separately aligned experts post hoc, or train a single conditioned model without considering which preferences it should be trained on. Since the hard regions of the preference simplex depend on the objectives at hand, existing methods leave them under-trained and do not get the most out of a single model. Therefore, we propose MAESTRO (Multi-objective Alignment via End-to-end STeering and Robust Optimization), which formulates MOA as a minimax problem over preference distributions and trains a single prompt-conditioned policy end-to-end with RL against an adversarial preference distribution: a Dirichlet distribution updated by online mirror descent toward the preferences the current policy serves worst, rather than on a fixed one. On HH-RLHF, BeaverTails and a summarization task, with up to three objectives, MAESTRO attains the best Pareto front on most tasks in a single training run, at the lowest training cost among the compared methods. The largest margins appear in the hard regions that a fixed preference distribution leaves under-trained, confirming that a single prompt-conditioned model is capable of covering the objective trade-offs on its own.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MAESTRO，将多目标对齐（MOA）建模为偏好分布上的极小极大问题，用在线镜像下降更新的对抗性Dirichlet分布端到端训练单一提示条件策略，一次训练即可覆盖帕累托前沿。
AI.motivation: 人类价值（有用性、无害性、幽默性）相互权衡且因人而异，MOA需提供帕累托前沿任意点的策略；但现有方法要么每个偏好训练一个模型，要么事后插值少数专家，要么训练单一条件模型却忽略偏好分布的选择，导致偏好单纯形上的困难区域训练不足，单模型潜力未被充分利用。
AI.method: MAESTRO将MOA形式化为偏好分布上的极小极大问题，端到端地用强化学习训练单一提示条件策略，对抗一个由在线镜像下降（OMD）更新的Dirichlet偏好分布，该分布不断向当前策略表现最差的偏好移动，而非固定分布。
AI.result: 在HH-RLHF、BeaverTails及一个摘要任务上（最多三个目标），MAESTRO仅一次训练即在多数任务上取得最佳帕累托前沿，且训练成本在对比方法中最低；最大优势出现在固定偏好分布下训练不足的困难区域。
AI.conclusion: 结果证实单一提示条件模型自身即可覆盖各目标间的权衡，验证了针对困难偏好区域自适应采样在提升MOA效率与效果上的有效性。

title: Your Temporal Link Predictor Is Blind to Who Is Active: A Missing Factor That Transfers Across Models
summary: An interaction has two parts: someone decides to act, and then chooses whom to act on. Temporal link prediction has concentrated on the second, and we show that it is blind to the first by construction: a standard negative keeps the real source and swaps the destination, and we prove that this cancels the source's activity exactly from the optimal score, so no model trained and evaluated this way is ever rewarded for learning it. Under the harder historical and inductive negatives, whose sources differ, the same factor becomes the dominant signal. We model it with Source Node Activity Modeling (SNAM), a self-exciting event intensity fitted by an exact point-process likelihood to decayed interaction counts the history states already contain; it has fewer than 20 parameters. On their own, never looking at the destination, these parameters beat DyGFormer and TPNet on four of five datasets under historical negatives. Added to the frozen scores of TPNet, TGN, DyGFormer and DSRD, four models of different design, without retraining anything, they raise AP on almost every backbone-dataset pair in both settings, by up to 25 points. Our full model ranks first overall against eleven baselines on 13 datasets and three protocols, and on million-event streams trains an epoch 9-100x faster than TPNet and DyGFormer. We conclude that source activity is a blind spot of temporal link prediction, and a cheap, transferable one to close. Code is available at https://github.com/Erutaner/Your-Temporal-Link-Predictor-Is-Blind-to-Who-Is-Active.

AI.tldr: 本文指出时序链路预测忽视了交互中的"谁发起"（源节点活跃度）这一信号，原因是标准负采样构造会从最优得分中精确抵消源活跃度；作者提出用少于20个参数的SNAM建模源活跃度，作为通用插件显著提升多种骨干模型性能。
AI.motivation: 交互包含两部分：谁决定行动、以及选择对谁行动。时序链路预测研究几乎只关注后者（目的地选择），而忽略了前者（源节点活跃度）。作者希望证明这种忽视并非数据中不存在该信号，而是当前训练与评估协议（尤其标准负采样）在构造上使模型无法获得学习该信号的奖励，从而构成一个系统性盲点。
AI.method: 1) 理论分析：标准负采样保持真实源、仅替换目的地，证明该构造会从最优得分中精确抵消源活跃度因子；而历史负采样与归纳负采样的源不同，该因子转为主导信号。2) 提出SNAM（Source Node Activity Modeling）：一种自激励事件强度模型，通过精确的点过程似然拟合历史已包含的衰减交互计数，参数少于20个。3) 将该强度作为可迁移模块，独立使用或叠加到TPNet、TGN、DyGFormer、DSRD等冻结得分的骨干模型上，无需重训练。
AI.result: 独立使用时（完全不看目的地），SNAM在历史负采样下于5个数据集中的4个上超过DyGFormer和TPNet。叠加到四种不同设计的冻结骨干（TPNet、TGN、DyGFormer、DSRD）后，在两种设置下几乎所有骨干-数据集组合上提升AP，最高提升25个点。完整模型在13个数据集、3种协议下对11个基线总体排名第一；在百万事件流上单轮训练比TPNet和DyGFormer快9-100倍。
AI.conclusion: 源节点活跃度是时序链路预测的一个盲点，其成因在于负采样协议的结构性抵消，而非信号缺失；该盲点可通过一个低成本（<20参数）、可迁移的点过程模块有效弥补，并带来跨骨干、跨数据集的稳定增益，代码已开源。

title: Prompt Dominance and Asymmetric Verifier Costs: Empirical Ablations of GRPO at 1B Scale on GSM8K
comment: 12 pages, 8 figures. Code, run records, and figure scripts: https://github.com/Helios-YQH/llm-from-scratch
summary: This paper studies GRPO at 1B scale from both directions: what estimator choices do to the learning signal, and what a degraded reward signal does to what is learned. We train OLMo-2-0425-1B on GSM8K with a from-scratch implementation and measure both sides in controlled sweeps, including a verifier-quality experiment that degrades the training reward and the test-time selector identically. Four results stand out. The prompt is the first-order decision: the zero-shot prompt leaves the base model at 0.08% (its outputs are degenerate continuations, not wrong answers), so almost no group carries a gradient, and training succeeds because the 3-shot prompt reaches 18.3%. At this scale the estimator variants sit within seed noise, with Dr. GRPO ahead on both seeds. In the off-policy regime, clipping is the whole story: training on data without a clipped ratio loses 4-6 points relative to the on-policy reference, while GRPO-style clipping and GSPO recover the loss entirely. Finally, the same weak verifier is far cheaper in RL than in test-time selection: a 10%-flip verifier leaves RL's attainable gain intact (91% and 106% retained across two seeds) where selection retains 57%, and a format-only verifier leaves RL with 16-30% of its gain and selection with essentially nothing. Flip noise acts as an affine transform on the expected reward, and the group-normalized advantage with Adam's rescaling removes it exactly; the residual is a second-order variance effect that the matched-step comparison at a 30% flip rate tests.

AI.tldr: 本文在1B规模上研究GRPO：考察估计器选择对学习信号的影响，以及退化的奖励信号对学习结果的影响。核心发现是提示词是首要决定性因素，估计器变体差异在种子噪声内，离策略场景下裁剪机制至关重要，且弱验证器在RL中的代价远低于测试时选择。
AI.motivation: 理解GRPO在小规模（1B）下的行为机制，特别是估计器选择如何影响学习信号，以及退化的奖励信号如何影响学习内容，从而厘清RL训练中关键因素与次要因素。
AI.method: 使用从零实现的GRPO在OLMo-2-0425-1B上针对GSM8K进行训练，进行受控扫描实验，包括一个验证器质量实验：对训练奖励和测试时选择器施加相同的退化。对比不同提示词（零样本vs 3-shot）、估计器变体、离策略裁剪策略，以及不同验证器噪声（10%翻转、格式-only）对RL增益与选择器增益的影响。
AI.result: 1) 提示词是一阶决策：零样本提示下基座模型仅0.08%（输出为退化续写而非错误答案），几乎无组携带梯度；3-shot提示达18.3%训练才成功。2) 该规模下估计器变体在种子噪声内，Dr. GRPO在两个种子上均领先。3) 离策略场景中裁剪是全部关键：无裁剪比率训练比同策略参考损失4-6分，而GRPO式裁剪和GSPO完全恢复损失。4) 同一弱验证器在RL中代价远低于测试时选择：10%翻转验证器下RL保留91%和106%增益（两种子），选择仅保留57%；格式-only验证器下RL保留16-30%增益，选择几乎为零。翻转噪声对期望奖励是仿射变换，组归一化优势配合Adam重缩放可精确消除；残差是二阶方差效应，由30%翻转率下的匹配步数比较检验。
AI.conclusion: 在1B规模上，GRPO训练中提示词设计是首要决定因素，估计器变体影响微小；离策略下裁剪机制是核心；RL对弱验证器鲁棒性显著优于测试时选择，且翻转噪声可通过组归一化优势与Adam重缩放精确消除。

title: Billion-Scale Thumbnail Optimization for Uncurated Short-Form Videos via Multi-Armed Bandits
summary: This paper introduces a real-time thumbnail optimization system deployed at a global $O(B)$ scale on a major short-form video platform. Unlike traditional long-form content, where custom thumbnails are heavily curated by creators, a considerable fraction of short-form videos are published without human-selected artwork. To address this uncurated corpus, we present a fully automated, end-to-end framework that replaces static default frames with dynamic, data-driven selections across billions of videos. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first published work demonstrating an online Multi-Armed Bandit framework successfully deployed at an $O(B)$ scale for uncurated short-form video discovery. Our solution pairs a multi-stage candidate generation pipeline with a low-latency serving infrastructure. By initializing the exploration framework with image-specific priors derived from a deep visual quality model, the system minimizes exploration costs and dynamically serves optimal thumbnails at serving time. Global deployment demonstrates statistically significant improvements in core user discovery and engagement metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并部署了一套面向大规模无人工封面短视频的实时缩略图优化系统，首次验证了在线多臂老虎机（MAB）框架在数十亿（O(B)）量级短视频发现场景中的成功应用，通过多阶段候选生成、低延迟服务以及基于深度视觉质量模型先验的探索初始化，实现了全局用户发现与互动指标的显著提升。
AI.motivation: 传统长视频中缩略图多由创作者精心挑选，而短视频平台上有相当比例的视频在发布时缺乏人工选定的封面，形成大量“无策展”内容。这类视频通常只能使用静态的默认帧，无法有效吸引用户点击与发现，因此需要一个全自动、数据驱动的方案来替代静态默认帧，提升短视频的发现与参与度。
AI.method: 方法上，系统采用端到端全自动框架：1）多阶段候选生成流水线（multi-stage candidate generation pipeline）产生候选缩略图；2）低延迟在线服务基础设施在请求时动态选择并返回最优缩略图；3）使用在线多臂老虎机（MAB）框架进行动态探索与利用；4）利用深度视觉质量模型生成的图像级先验（image-specific priors）对探索框架进行初始化，以最小化探索成本。整个系统在O(B)规模（数十亿视频）上实时运行。
AI.result: 在全球范围部署后，该系统在核心用户发现和互动指标上取得了统计显著的提升；同时，通过先验初始化有效降低了探索成本，验证了在线MAB框架在O(B)量级无策展短视频场景中的可行性与有效性。
AI.conclusion: 本文是首个公开报道的、在O(B)规模无策展短视频发现中成功部署在线多臂老虎机框架的工作。其结论表明：结合深度视觉质量先验的在线探索框架、多阶段候选生成与低延迟服务，可以在大规模无人工封面短视频场景中自动优化缩略图，并带来可观的用户发现与参与收益。

title: Learning under Localized Minority Imbalance
summary: Class-imbalance methods implicitly assume that the minority class is uniformly undersampled relative to the majority class. However, in many real-world settings, minority instances may be disproportionately under-observed in certain regions of the feature space. For example, small businesses that go bankrupt may disappear from records, while those that survive remain visible, making bankruptcy appear less common among small firms than it actually is. This gives rise to localized minority imbalance (LMI), a challenge that is often overlooked and extends beyond general class-count imbalance. We show that under LMI, existing imbalance mitigation techniques can fit observation-induced biases in the training data and generalize poorly to under-observed regions of the true minority distribution. To address this, we propose a tree-based stratified approach that recursively partitions the feature space with the goal of reducing within-stratum LMI distortion. For each resulting stratum, we pair its majority instances with the full observed minority set and train a base classifier to create an ensemble. Extensive experiments over benchmark tabular datasets simulated with LMI show that our stratified ensembling approach outperforms popular and state-of-the-art imbalance mitigation techniques. We also introduce a gold-standard evaluation protocol that uses unbiased test sets, and demonstrate that conventional hold-out evaluation from the same LMI-biased data can substantially mislead performance. Overall, our results highlight that the cause of imbalance is as important as the correction method.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出“局部少数类不平衡（LMI）”概念，并设计基于树的递归分层集成方法，以缓解特征空间局部观测偏差导致的泛化问题。
AI.motivation: 传统类别不平衡方法默认少数类相对多数类是均匀欠采样的，但现实中少数实例在某些特征空间区域可能被不成比例地少观测，形成局部少数类不平衡（LMI）。例如小企业破产后从记录中消失，导致破产在小企业中看似更少见。这种观测诱导偏差易被现有方法拟合，并损害对真实少数分布的欠观测区域的泛化。
AI.method: 提出一种基于树的分层方法，递归划分特征空间，以降低层内LMI失真；在每个分层中，将该层多数类实例与完整观测到的少数类集合配对，训练基分类器并构建集成模型。
AI.result: 在模拟LMI的基准表格数据集上，分层集成方法优于常用及最先进的类别不平衡缓解技术。同时提出使用无偏测试集的金标准评估协议，并证明基于同一LMI偏差数据的常规留出评估会严重误导性能判断。
AI.conclusion: 不平衡的成因与校正方法同等重要；只关注类别计数不平衡而忽视局部观测偏差，可能导致模型拟合数据观测偏差并产生误导性评估。

title: Bridging the EHR Divide: Asymmetric Contrastive Learning for Cross-National Medical Representation Transfer
summary: Cross-system transfer of longitudinal Electronic Health Record (EHR) representations is challenging because clinical coding, patient populations, and healthcare workflows differ substantially across institutions and countries. We introduce Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning (Asymmetric SupCon), a task-specific pre-training objective motivated by the heterogeneity of negative clinical outcomes. The objective clusters patients sharing a target positive outcome without explicitly attracting negative trajectories toward one another. We pre-train temporal Transformer encoders on longitudinal records from 3.98 million patients in the Taiwanese National Health Insurance Research Database (NHIRD) and transfer them to two U.S. EHR datasets, MIMIC-IV and EHRSHOT. A hybrid semantic mapping pipeline combining direct mappings with embedding-based retrieval enables transfer across heterogeneous clinical vocabularies. On MIMIC-IV, NHIRD pre-training consistently improves over random initialization while substantially narrowing the performance gap to task-specific in-domain pre-training. On EHRSHOT, the transferred models show particularly strong few-shot performance for incident disease prediction. A controlled objective ablation shows that Asymmetric SupCon achieves the best AUPRC on three of four evaluated tasks and is 0.003 AUPRC below Standard SupCon on the fourth. These results support asymmetric contrastive pre-training as an effective approach for task-specific cross-national EHR representation transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon.

AI.tldr: 提出 Asymmetric SupCon 预训练目标，实现跨系统纵向 EHR 表征迁移。
AI.motivation: 跨机构、跨国家的 EHR 表征迁移受临床编码、患者群体和医疗流程差异影响，难度较大。作者基于阴性临床结局的异质性提出任务特定的预训练目标。
AI.method: 提出 Asymmetric Supervised Contrastive Learning（Asymmetric SupCon），仅将共享目标阳性结局的患者聚类，而不显式拉近阴性轨迹。基于时间 Transformer 编码器，在台湾 NHIRD 的 398 万患者纵向记录上预训练，并迁移至 MIMIC-IV 与 EHRSHOT。采用结合直接映射与嵌入检索的混合语义映射流程以跨异质临床词表迁移。
AI.result: 在 MIMIC-IV 上，NHIRD 预训练持续优于随机初始化，并显著缩小与任务特定域内预训练的差距。在 EHRSHOT 上，迁移模型在 incident disease prediction 的 few-shot 表现尤为突出。消融实验显示，Asymmetric SupCon 在四项任务的四项中三项取得最佳 AUPRC，第四项仅低于 Standard SupCon 0.003 AUPRC。
AI.conclusion: 非对称对比预训练是任务特定跨国家 EHR 表征迁移的有效方法。代码已开源于 https://github.com/qingYzhang/Asymmetric_SupCon。

title: How Should Teachers Be Prepared? RL on Student-Induced States for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) improves the reasoning capabilities of small language models through token-level teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. Yet can teachers that excel at solving problems independently also guide student reasoning effectively? Prior work shows that when student prefixes follow reasoning paths that differ from the teacher's own or contain errors, teachers can be less accurate when continuing from these prefixes than when solving problems independently. To this end, we propose Prep-OPD, which uses reinforcement learning (RL) before distillation to train the teacher to adapt to the student's existing reasoning state and correct course when errors arise. Training optimizes teacher continuations from fixed student prefixes using final-answer correctness as the reward. The prepared teacher then trains the student through trajectory guidance and token-level supervision. We evaluate Prep-OPD on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks, using Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 as the teacher and Qwen3-0.6B and Qwen3-1.7B as students. With the 4B teacher and 1.7B student, Prep-OPD improves average accuracy over standard OPD and the strongest baseline, Relay-OPD, by 8.28 and 2.30 percentage points, respectively. Controlled experiments further show that teacher RL conditioned on student-generated prefixes yields higher student accuracy than problem-start teacher RL with and without handoff on Qwen3-1.7B. Reusing the same prepared teacher also improves Qwen3-0.6B.

AI.tldr: 提出 Prep-OPD：在蒸馏前先用 RL 训练教师，使其适应学生已有推理状态并纠错，从而提升小模型推理能力。
AI.motivation: 在 on-policy distillation 中，教师虽擅长独立解题，但当学生前缀偏离教师自身推理路径或含错误时，教师续写的准确性下降，指导效果受限。
AI.method: 用 RL 对教师进行"预备"训练：以学生生成的固定前缀为条件，用最终答案正确性作为奖励优化教师续写；再用该预备教师通过轨迹引导与 token 级监督蒸馏学生。
AI.result: 在 8 个数学推理基准上，以 Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 为教师、Qwen3-1.7B 为学生，平均准确率较标准 OPD 与最强基线 Relay-OPD 分别提升 8.28 和 2.30 个百分点；消融显示基于学生前缀的教师 RL 优于从问题起点训练的教师 RL（含/不含 handoff）；同一预备教师可复用于 Qwen3-0.6B。
AI.conclusion: 教师的独立解题能力不等于指导能力；通过面向学生前缀的 RL 预备，可显著增强 on-policy distillation 的教师适应性与学生推理表现，且具备跨学生规模的可复用性。

title: Trinity: One Differentiable Physics for Training, Refining and Scoring Generative Floorplanners
comment: Shih-Ying Yeh and Tzu-Sian Wang contributed equally. 85 pages, 65 figures, 67 tables. Project page: https://kohaku-lab.github.io/Trinity/ Code: https://github.com/Kohaku-Lab/Trinity Models: https://huggingface.co/KBlueLeaf/Trinity
summary: Floorplanning arranges the blocks of a chip and decides their shapes under objectives that press blocks together, short wirelength and a small outline, and constraints that hold them apart, non-overlap, clusters, MIB shapes and boundary blocks. Recent diffusion placers train on reference layouts alone and leave this coupled system to guidance, post-hoc loops and a legalizer, reporting only the endpoint, which hides what the generator contributes. We re-implement four of them under one recipe on FloorSet, score raw, refined and legalized layouts on one scale, and propose Trinity, a flow-matching floorplanner whose six differentiable functions for the constraints and objectives are its training loss term, the energy of a closed-form refiner after sampling and the base of a soft cost for every stage. The network thus learns the correction prior placers apply in their samplers, and sampling needs no guidance. Stage by stage, the training term lowers a plain transformer's raw soft cost by 26% and matters most at short budgets, the shared refiner decides more of the final cost than the generator and matches a ported placer's loop in 16 to 660 times fewer steps, Trinity's refined soft cost is 36% below the best ported pipeline, the soft cost ranks settings as the contest's hard cost does, and on the FloorSet val set the pipeline reaches a mean hard cost of 1.014 in 1.63 s per case.

AI.tldr: 该文在FloorSet上统一复现四个扩散布局器，并提出Trinity——一种流匹配布局器，将六项可微约束/目标函数同时用作训练损失、采样后闭式精修器的能量以及各阶段软代价的基础，无需引导即可采样。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散布局器仅用参考布局训练，把耦合的约束-目标系统交给引导、事后循环和合法化处理，且只报告终点结果，掩盖了生成器本身的贡献；缺少统一尺度下对原始、精修、合法化布局的分阶段评估。
AI.method: 在FloorSet上以同一配方复现四个扩散布局器；在同一尺度上评估原始、精修与合法化布局；提出Trinity流匹配布局器，其六个可微函数（约束与目标）分别作为训练损失项、采样后闭式精修器的能量、以及每个阶段的软代价基础，使网络学到采样器中修正先验，采样无需引导。
AI.result: 训练损失项将普通Transformer的原始软代价降低26%，在短预算下作用最大；共享精修器对最终代价的影响大于生成器，以16至660倍更少步数匹配移植布局器的循环；Trinity精修后软代价比最佳移植流程低36%；软代价对设置的排序与竞赛硬代价一致；在FloorSet验证集上流程平均硬代价1.014，每例耗时1.63秒。
AI.conclusion: 统一可微约束-目标框架下的流匹配布局器可显著优于复现的扩散流程，精修器是关键贡献者，软代价可作为硬代价的有效代理指标。

title: MAGIC: Topology-Aware Analytic Graph Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Graph few-shot class-incremental learning (GFSCIL) requires a model to continually recognize emerging classes from only a few labeled nodes while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Beyond the catastrophic forgetting inherited from conventional graph continual learning, GFSCIL presents two distinctive challenges: extremely limited novel-class supervision causes severe overfitting, while cross-session edges---edges connecting newly arriving nodes with historical nodes---alter historical propagation neighborhoods and thereby induce representation drift. We propose MAGIC, a replay-free GFSCIL framework that combines a frozen graph representation backbone (e.g., an intrinsically parameter-free backbone such as SGC or a pretrained graph foundation model) with closed-form analytic continual learning. To alleviate novel-session overfitting, MAGIC learns a topological prior from the base graph that can characterize both homophilous and heterophilous relations, and injects this prior through Potts Markov random field inference to refine supervision for novel classes. To mitigate representation drift, MAGIC transfers previous predictions from the old representations of affected historical nodes to their updated representations through drift-aware analytic distillation. Experiments across five datasets and eight baselines demonstrate the effectiveness of MAGIC. Under the 5-shot setting, MAGIC improves Mean Accuracy and Final Accuracy by 5.48 percentage points and 9.33 percentage points on average, and reduces Performance Drop by 10.78 percentage points on average compared with the best baselines. MAGIC also shows clear advantages under the 1- and 3-shot settings, with larger gains as the number of supports increases. Moreover, MAGIC requires substantially less training time.

AI.tldr: 提出免回放的图少样本类增量学习框架MAGIC，结合冻结图表示骨干与闭式解析持续学习，通过拓扑先验注入和漂移感知解析蒸馏，缓解新类过拟合与表示漂移，在五个数据集上显著优于八个基线且训练更省时。
AI.motivation: 图少样本类增量学习（GFSCIL）除传统图持续学习中的灾难性遗忘外，还面临两个特有挑战：新类监督极少导致严重过拟合；跨会话边（新节点连接历史节点）改变历史传播邻域，引发表示漂移。现有方法难以同时应对这两点。
AI.method: MAGIC为免回放框架：1）冻结图表示骨干（如无参数的SGC或预训练图基础模型）配合闭式解析持续学习；2）从基图学习可刻画同质与异质关系的拓扑先验，经Potts马尔可夫随机场推断注入，以精炼新类监督，缓解过拟合；3）通过漂移感知解析蒸馏，将受影响历史节点在旧表示上的预测迁移到其更新后表示，缓解表示漂移。
AI.result: 在五个数据集、八个基线上验证有效。5-shot设置下，平均Mean Accuracy与Final Accuracy分别提升5.48和9.33个百分点，Performance Drop平均降低10.78个百分点；1-shot与3-shot下同样占优，且随支持样本数增加增益更大；训练时间显著更少。
AI.conclusion: MAGIC以冻结骨干+闭式解析持续学习为核心，通过拓扑先验与漂移感知蒸馏协同解决GFSCIL的过拟合与表示漂移问题，兼具精度与效率优势。

title: Hamiltonian Metric Learning and Energy-Based Training: A Dissipative Geometric Framework for Optimization
summary: Optimization in machine learning is usually expressed through iterative rules that update model parameters using information from the loss landscape. In this work, we study an alternative viewpoint in which parameter optimization is treated as the evolution of a dissipative dynamical system. The model parameters are regarded as generalized coordinates, the loss acts as a potential energy, and a positive-definite metric defines the local kinetic geometry of parameter space. Starting from a variational formulation, we derive the corresponding Hamiltonian dynamics, the geometric force generated by a position-dependent metric, and a metric-compatible Rayleigh dissipation law. The resulting continuous system satisfies a monotonic energy-dissipation relation, while its discrete form allows the influence of curvature on the optimization trajectory to be studied directly. We illustrate the framework using a controlled CIFAR-10 image-reconstruction problem for which the optimum is known analytically. With the image Hessian used as the metric, the curvature dependence of the quadratic modal dynamics is removed. We then reparameterize the same image as a matrix product state, producing a genuinely position-dependent metric and a nonzero geometric force. Poincaré return maps provide a complementary phase-space view of the resulting contraction dynamics. These examples establish HAMLET as a geometric, energy-based framework for studying optimization as dissipative motion in parameter space. On a five-seed MNIST MLP benchmark, HAMLET attains the highest mean test accuracy (97.95\%) and the lowest mean test negative log-likelihood (0.0696) among the three evaluated optimizers.

AI.tldr: 本文将参数优化重新表述为耗散动力系统的演化，提出几何、能量驱动的框架 HAMLET，并用可控图像重建与 MNIST 基准验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 机器学习优化通常以迭代更新规则的形式表述，缺乏从动力学与几何角度对优化轨迹的统一理解。本文希望以耗散 dynamical system 的视角刻画参数优化，从而显式研究曲率、几何力与能量耗散对优化路径的影响。
AI.method: 将模型参数视为广义坐标，损失作为势能，正定度规定义参数空间的局部动能几何；从变分表述出发，推导对应的 Hamiltonian 动力学、由位置相关度规产生的几何力，以及度规相容的 Rayleigh 耗散律，并给出满足单调能量耗散关系的连续系统及其离散形式。实验上采用最优解已知的可控 CIFAR-10 图像重建问题，分别以图像 Hessian 和矩阵乘积态重参数化作为度规，并借助 Poincaré 返回映射分析相空间收缩动力学。
AI.result: 以图像 Hessian 为度规时，二次模态动力学的曲率依赖性被消除；将同一图像重参数化为矩阵乘积态后，得到真正位置相关的度规与非零几何力，Poincaré 返回映射提供了收缩动力学的相空间视角。在五种子 MNIST MLP 基准上，HAMLET 在三个对比优化器中取得最高平均测试准确率（97.95%）与最低平均测试负对数似然（0.0696）。
AI.conclusion: 这些例子确立了 HAMLET 作为一个几何、能量驱动的框架，可将优化研究为参数空间中的耗散运动，并为分析曲率对优化轨迹的作用提供了统一视角。

title: Priced Guidance: Can Language Models Generate Future Research Ideas?
summary: We evaluate language models' capability to generate novel research ideas through the lens of compression. We aim to lower-bound the potentially tiny probability that a language model generates the essence of a future research idea without any hints. Rather than estimate this probability through expensive repeated sampling, our Priced Guidance framework measures the compression cost: how many additional bits of information are needed to guide the model to recover the target idea. We prove that if the model can recover the target idea with at most K bits of guidance in expectation, then it can generate the idea without any guidance with probability at least $2^{-K}$. In our framework, the language model, called the generator, can pose a sequence of multiple-choice questions and specify a probability distribution over possible answers. A guide, which is a language model with access to the target idea, selects answers. If a selected answer has prior probability p, the generator pays $-\log_2 p$ bits. The generator aims to produce an idea that matches the essence of the target idea with minimal cumulative cost. This cumulative cost equals, up to an additive constant, the number of bits of information sent by the guide. Using this methodology, we evaluate five generator LLMs (Opus 5, Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, GPT-5.6 Sol, and GLM 5.3) on the core ideas in 87 recent high-quality deep learning papers and we use LLM as judge to determine whether the generated idea matches the target in terms of the central research object and defining mechanism. Fable 5.1 achieves the lowest median compression cost at 69.9 bits, substantially lower than gzip's median of 5,712 bits for losslessly compressing the summary of the target idea. A uniform ensemble of Fable 5.1, Opus 5, and Astra further reduces the median compression cost to 55.8 bits and improves the generation probability lower bound by 18,000 times.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"价格化引导"(Priced Guidance)框架，用压缩代价衡量语言模型生成未来研究想法的能力，并给出无提示生成概率的下界。
AI.motivation: 直接通过昂贵重复采样来估计语言模型无提示生成某一未来研究想法的极小概率不可行。作者转而用压缩视角，将"生成新想法"转化为"引导恢复目标想法所需的信息量"这一可度量的量。
AI.method: 生成器模型连续提出多项选择题并对答案指定概率分布，持有目标想法的引导模型选择答案；若所选答案先验概率为 p，则支付 -log₂ p 比特。生成器目标是以最小累计代价生成与目标想法本质匹配的想法，累计代价即引导所发送的信息比特数。作者证明：若模型能以期望至多 K 比特引导恢复目标想法，则无引导生成该想法的概率至少为 2^{-K}。在 87 篇近期高质量深度学习论文的核心想法上评测五个生成器 LLM，并用 LLM 作为评判者判断生成想法是否在核心研究对象与定义机制上匹配目标。
AI.result: Fable 5.1 取得最低中位压缩代价 69.9 比特，远低于 gzip 无损压缩目标想法摘要的中位 5,712 比特。Fable 5.1、Opus 5 与 Astra 的均匀集成进一步将中位压缩代价降至 55.8 比特，使生成概率下界提升约 18,000 倍。
AI.conclusion: 压缩代价可作为评估语言模型生成新颖研究想法能力的有效指标；通过集成多个生成器模型可显著降低所需引导信息量并大幅提高无提示生成目标想法的概率下界。

title: What Will Post-Training Fix? Per-Problem Gains Are Shared Across Independent RL Runs, and Existing Checkpoints Predict Them Better Than A Priori Signals
summary: Data selection, curricula and the evaluation of post-training recipes all assume that we can tell, before training, which problems a model will improve on. We test this assumption directly. For two base models, DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B and Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, we evaluate eighteen post-training runs on up to 1532 competition math problems with many samples per problem, and compare signals available before training against a noise ceiling derived from the agreement between disjoint subsets of runs. Three findings hold on both base models. What post-training fixes is shared: independent runs agree on which rarely solved problems improve, with a noise ceiling of about 0.9, yet the two base models agree with each other only at rho=0.25 - the shared component belongs to the base model, not to the problem. A priori signals capture a minority of it: base pass rate, the likelihood of a correct solution, a larger model's pass rate and their combinations explain only 0.30 and 0.24 of the explainable variance in gains. Existing checkpoints are the better predictor: the per-problem gains of a single checkpoint from another family predict a new run better than every a priori signal, alone or combined (0.52 vs. 0.33 and 0.34 vs. 0.17 against the combined signals). The conclusions hold on problems from 2025-2026 competitions and when the baselines on the two sides of every comparison are estimated independently. We propose the noise ceiling as a standard companion to per-problem signals.

AI.tldr: 该论文直接检验了"训练前即可预判模型将在哪些问题上提升"这一被数据选择、课程学习和后训练配方评估普遍依赖的假设。作者在两个基座模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B 与 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B）上，对多达1532道竞赛数学题进行18次后训练，并以不相交运行子集间的一致性构建"噪声天花板"作为解释上限。结论有三：提升的可预测部分主要属于基座模型而非问题本身；先验信号仅能解释少数可解释方差；跨家族已有检查点的逐题增益是最好的预测器。
AI.motivation: 数据选择、课程学习与后训练配方评估都默认：训练前就能判断模型会在哪些问题上取得提升。然而这一默认假设缺乏直接验证。作者希望检验该假设是否成立，并明确"可预测性"的上限在哪里，从而为逐题信号的使用提供基准。
AI.method: 在两个基座模型（DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B、Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B）上进行18次后训练运行，在最多1532道竞赛数学题上、每题多个采样。构造"噪声天花板"：以不相交运行子集之间的一致性作为可解释方差的上限。将训练前可得的先验信号（基座通过率、正确解似然、更大模型的通过率及其组合）与噪声天花板对比，同时评估其他家族检查点的逐题增益作为预测器。并在2025–2026年竞赛题上、以及每次比较两侧基线独立估计的条件下做稳健性检验。
AI.result: 三项发现在两个基座模型上都成立：(1) 后训练所修复的问题是"共享"的——独立运行对哪些罕见被解出问题的提升高度一致，噪声天花板约0.9；但两个基座模型之间的一致性仅 rho=0.25，说明共享成分属于基座模型而非问题本身。(2) 先验信号只能捕获其中少数——基座通过率、正确解似然、更大模型通过率及其组合分别只解释0.30和0.24的可解释方差。(3) 已有检查点是更好的预测器——来自另一家族的单个检查点的逐题增益优于所有先验信号（单独或组合），达到0.52 vs. 0.33、0.34 vs. 0.17。结论在2025–2026竞赛题及基线独立估计下依然成立。
AI.conclusion: "训练前可预判模型在哪些问题上提升"的假设只部分成立：提升的可预测部分主要由基座模型性质决定，而非问题固有属性；先验信号解释力有限，而跨家族已有检查点的逐题增益是更强的预测器。作者建议将"噪声天花板"作为逐题信号的标准配套报告指标。

title: How Long, Not How Close: A Learned Temporal Metric for Planning in Latent World Models
summary: Latent world models plan by rolling a frozen predictor forward under candidate action sequences and ranking the candidates by the latent distance between their imagined end state and the goal. However, this ranking breaks down when the goal lies several plans away, because the latent distance measures how closely an end state resembles the goal rather than how far it remains from reaching it. To address this, we propose TEMPO, a temporal-distance planning objective that leaves the world model untouched, learns only from the demonstrations already used to train it, and adds negligible cost to the planner's search. TEMPO learns a small map of the frozen latent in which the distance between two states of an episode reflects the number of environment steps between them, and blends this distance into the planner's cost. It requires no rewards, policies or success labels and, being a cost rather than a model, applies to frozen world models with one latent vector per state that plan by a latent distance. We evaluate TEMPO on eleven simulated environments (e.g., maze navigation, tabletop pushing, robotic arm control and three-dimensional manipulation) with the LeWM and PLDM planners. With a small MLP that adds at most 0.3% to a plan's arithmetic, TEMPO improves both planners at every goal distance, including the one-plan setting of their evaluations, raises LeWM from 36% to 99% on TwoRoom three plans from the goal, and remains competitive on a broad range of 2D and 3D navigation, reaching and manipulation tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出TEMPO，一种时间距离规划目标，在冻结世界模型上学习状态间步数距离并融入规划代价，显著提升远距离目标规划成功率。
AI.motivation: 潜在世界模型通过在候选动作序列下滚动冻结预测器，并以想象末端状态与目标之间的潜在距离对候选排序来规划。但当目标需要多步规划才能到达时，这种排序失效：潜在距离衡量的是末端状态与目标的相似程度，而非距离达成目标还有多远。因此需要一种能反映"还需多少步"的规划目标。
AI.method: 提出TEMPO：一种时间距离规划目标。它不修改世界模型，仅利用训练世界模型时已用的演示数据学习；在冻结的潜在空间中学习一张小型映射，使同一回合内两状态间的距离反映二者之间的环境步数，并将该距离融入规划器代价。无需奖励、策略或成功标签；作为代价而非模型，适用于每个状态一个潜在向量、以潜在距离规划的冻结世界模型，且几乎不增加搜索开销。
AI.result: 在十一个仿真环境（迷宫导航、桌面推动、机械臂控制、三维操作等）上，用LeWM和PLDM规划器评估。以小型MLP实现，仅增加计划算术量至多0.3%，TEMPO在所有目标距离上均提升两个规划器，包括其评测中的单步设定；在TwoRoom距离目标三步时，将LeWM从36%提升至99%，并在广泛的2D/3D导航、到达与操作任务上保持竞争力。
