AI.conclusion: 用时间距离替代单纯的状态相似度作为规划代价，可在不训练或改动世界模型的前提下有效解决远距离目标下的排序失效问题，且成本极低、适用范围广。

title: Pessimistic Minimax Learning for Public-Private Information Games under Unilateral Coverage
summary: We study offline learning in two-player zero-sum contextual games with public and private information, motivated by strategic settings such as auctions and negotiations with private valuations. We introduce unilateral prescriptive concentrability and show that asymmetric information can change offline coverage through its effect on equilibrium behavior. For finite state-action spaces, we develop a pessimistic algorithm with an $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$ exploitability rate, matching the standard sample-size dependence for fully observed minimax games. We further develop a pessimistic policy mirror descent framework, PPA-PMD, for general function approximation and obtain a unified $\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n} + 1/\sqrt{T})$ exploitability rate with no-regret actor updates. Together, these results provide the first theoretical framework for offline equilibrium learning under public-private information constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文首次为公开-私有信息约束下的离线均衡学习建立理论框架，提出单边规范集中系数并给出悲观算法与PPA-PMD框架，取得$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$与$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n}+1/\sqrt{T})$的可利用度率。
AI.motivation: 受拍卖、私有估值谈判等策略场景启发，研究公开与私有信息共存的双人零和上下文博弈中的离线学习；核心动机在于刻画非对称信息如何通过影响均衡行为改变离线覆盖性。
AI.method: 提出单边规范集中系数（unilateral prescriptive concentrability）以刻画非对称信息下的离线覆盖；针对有限状态-动作空间设计悲观算法；进一步提出适用于一般函数逼近的悲观策略镜像下降框架PPA-PMD，并采用无遗憾的演员更新。
AI.result: 有限状态-动作空间下悲观算法达到$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n})$的可利用度率，与完全观测极小极大博弈的标准样本量依赖相匹配；PPA-PMD在一般函数逼近下取得统一的$\tilde{O}(1/\sqrt{n}+1/\sqrt{T})$可利用度率。
AI.conclusion: 公私有信息约束下的离线均衡学习可获得与完全观测情形相当的统计效率，本文结果构成该方向首个理论框架。

title: Physics-Augmented Graph Transformers for Patch-Antenna Forward and Inverse Design
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables. Accepted for oral presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Workshop on Machine Learning for Signal Processing (MLSP 2026), Atlanta, USA. Code, dataset and Colab demo: https://github.com/AviEpstein/GNN-for-Antenna-design
summary: Full-wave electromagnetic (EM) simulation enables accurate patch-antenna analysis but is computationally expensive for large-scale forward prediction and inverse design. We present a mesh-native, physics-augmented graph-learning framework that treats radiation-pattern prediction as signal reconstruction on an irregular surface mesh. For the forward problem, a GPS graph transformer is trained with Physics-Augmented Intermediate Supervision (PAIS), an auxiliary node-level objective that predicts complex surface currents, the physical intermediate linking geometry to radiation. PAIS improves multiple GNN backbones at no inference-time cost, while shuffled-current and non-physical controls show the gain comes from physical correspondence. Direction-conditioned decoding and a differentiable radiation-integral consistency loss further exploit this structure. On an 80,000-sample CST benchmark, GPS+PAIS reaches MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67, generalizes to a PCA split, and transfers zero-shot to canonical patches. For inverse design, surrogate-filtered diffusion beats nearest-neighbor retrieval by 32% relative MSE.

AI.tldr: 提出网格原生、物理增强的图学习框架，将贴片天线辐射方向图预测视为不规则表面网格上的信号重建；前向用GPS图Transformer配合物理增强中间监督（PAIS）预测复表面电流，反向用代理筛选扩散模型设计。
AI.motivation: 全波电磁仿真虽精确，但大规模前向预测与逆向设计计算代价过高，需要一种兼具精度与效率的替代方法。
AI.method: 网格原生图学习框架；前向采用GPS图Transformer，引入物理增强中间监督（PAIS）——以节点级辅助目标预测复表面电流，还包含方向条件解码与可微辐射积分一致性损失；反向设计使用代理模型筛选的扩散模型。
AI.result: 在80,000样本CST基准上，GPS+PAIS达到MSE 0.17 / PSNR 19.67，泛化到PCA划分，并能零样本迁移到典型贴片；逆向设计相对MSE比最近邻检索相对提升32%。
AI.conclusion: 以表面电流为物理中间量的中间监督可无推理开销地提升多种GNN骨干；对照实验证明增益源于物理对应关系，该框架在正向预测与逆向设计上均有效。

title: MetaKernelBench: Measuring GPU Kernel Knowledge Transfer Beyond Code
summary: Recent GPU kernel optimization agents retain what they learn in knowledge bases or as distilled skills. Kernel benchmarks score each attempt's implementation for correctness and speed but leave the reuse value of retained experience unmeasured. We introduce MetaKernelBench, which measures whether experience distilled from an attempt in one kernel domain-specific language (DSL) improves a fresh attempt at the same problem in another. Its 74 problems are fused subgraphs in six families, each posed as a pair of CuTe DSL and TIRx variants that differ only in the DSL. The agent first attempts each variant solo and is instructed to distill what it learns into a natural-language skill, which is transferred whether or not the source attempt passes verification. The skill is the only extra input to a skill-conditioned attempt by the same model in the other DSL. We compare each skill-conditioned attempt with the solo attempt on the same variant under matched per-attempt budgets, scoring correctness and end-to-end runtime. Across six models and both directions, paired lift over solo attempts ranges from -19% to +29%. Four models gain in both directions, yet regressions occur on 16% to 45% of problems in every model and direction. Outcomes follow the source attempt's result relative to the target's solo attempt rather than source success alone, improving in 71% of comparisons when the source stands above and regressing in 54% when it stands below. MetaKernelBench complements implementation-quality metrics by measuring same-problem cross-DSL kernel knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出 MetaKernelBench，用于衡量从一种核 DSL 尝试中蒸馏的语言技能能否迁移到另一 DSL 下的同一问题，发现迁移效果呈双向、有限且高度分化。
AI.motivation: 现有 GPU 核优化智能体将所学经验存于知识库或蒸馏为技能，但核基准只评估单次实现的正误与速度，未测量所保留经验的复用价值，尤其缺乏跨 DSL 的同问题知识迁移度量。
AI.method: 基准含 74 个六族融合子图问题，每问题以 CuTe DSL 与 TIRx 两个仅 DSL 不同的变体配对。智能体先单独尝试每个变体，并须将所学蒸馏为自然语言技能；无论源尝试是否通过验证都进行迁移。该技能作为唯一额外输入，由同一模型在另一 DSL 上做技能条件尝试，并在每尝试预算匹配下与单独尝试对比正确性与端到端运行时间。实验覆盖六个模型、两个迁移方向。
AI.result: 相对单独尝试的成对提升在 -19% 至 +29% 之间；四个模型双向受益，但每个模型和方向的 16% 至 45% 问题上均出现退化。结果取决于源尝试相对于目标单独尝试的水平：源高于目标时 71% 比较改善，源低于目标时 54% 退化。
AI.conclusion: MetaKernelBench 通过测量同问题跨 DSL 核知识迁移，补充了实现质量类指标；技能迁移并非单向增益，其收益取决于源尝试相对目标单独基线的水平。

title: Calibrated Weak Supervision for Post-Harvest Burned-Cropland Mapping Under Label Scarcity
summary: Mapping post-harvest burned cropland is difficult when fires are small and fragmented and reliable labels are scarce. We developed a calibrated weak-supervision framework for Punjab, India, using Sentinel-2 spectral change, VIIRS active-fire context, and MODIS MCD64A1 as a coarse external calibration and agreement reference. Three pseudo-label recipes, five feature representations, and linear, tree-based, boosted, and neural classifiers were evaluated using nested district-held-out cross-validation over three seeds and five folds. NBR and dNBR were excluded from classifier inputs. The best configuration used the very-strict recipe, a multilayer perceptron, and the full optical feature set (mean Cohen's kappa 0.395, AUROC 0.753, F1 0.747, balanced accuracy 0.703); Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM were practically tied. Higher agreement with held-out pseudo-labels did not establish improved label correctness or independent burned-area accuracy. For deployment, a Random Forest with the very-strict recipe and full optical features was retained. An externally calibrated threshold of 0.60 yielded district-level MODIS agreement of R-squared 0.636, a mapped-to-MODIS burned-area ratio of 1.005, and Spearman correlation of 0.779 with district fire counts. Pixel-level MODIS agreement remained modest (F1 0.205, kappa 0.093). Zero-shot transfer to Haryana was promising (mean kappa 0.641), but Punjab cross-year stability was weak, and Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 feature concatenation did not improve the optical baseline. Optical observations ended before the seasonal fire context, limiting coverage of late burns. The framework supports district-scale burden assessment and hotspot screening, with limited support for exact scar boundaries or temporally stable annual mapping.

AI.tldr: 本研究面向印度旁遮普邦小规模、碎片化的收获后农田焚烧制图，构建了一个基于Sentinel-2光谱变化、VIIRS活跃火点与MODIS MCD64A1校准的弱监督框架，系统评估了三种伪标签方案、五种特征表示与多类分类器，最终以Random Forest部署并完成外部门限校准与跨区/跨年迁移检验。
AI.motivation: 收获后农田焚烧的火灾规模小且高度碎片化，同时缺乏可靠的地面标签，使得常规监督分类难以直接应用。作者需要一个可在标签稀缺条件下工作、并能支持区域尺度焚烧负担评估的可行制图方案。
AI.method: 以旁遮普邦为研究区，构建校准式弱监督框架：输入包括Sentinel-2光谱变化特征、VIIRS活跃火点上下文信息和MODIS MCD64A1（作为粗尺度外部校准与一致性参考）。设计三种伪标签配方与五种特征表示，比较线性、树模型、boosting及神经网络分类器，采用嵌套的区县留出交叉验证（3个随机种子×5折）。NBR与dNBR被排除在分类器输入之外，以避免与标签定义循环。部署模型为Random Forest（very-strict配方+完整光学特征），并使用外部校准的0.60概率阈值。另开展Haryana零样本迁移与旁遮普跨年稳定性测试。
AI.result: 最优配置为very-strict配方+多层感知机+完整光学特征（平均Cohen's kappa 0.395、AUROC 0.753、F1 0.747、平衡精度0.703）；Random Forest、XGBoost与LightGBM表现基本持平。与留出伪标签的一致性提高，并不等价于标签正确性或独立焚烧面积精度提升。部署模型在0.60阈值下，区县尺度与MODIS一致性达到R²=0.636、制图焚烧面积与MODIS面积比为1.005、与区县火点数的Spearman相关为0.779；但像元尺度一致性有限（F1 0.205、kappa 0.093）。Haryana零样本迁移表现较好（平均kappa 0.641），而旁遮普跨年稳定性较弱；Sentinel-1与Sentinel-2特征拼接未能提升光学基线。光学观测在季节火点背景结束前终止，限制了对晚期焚烧的覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 该弱监督框架适用于区县尺度的焚烧负担评估与热点筛查，但尚不足以支撑精确火烧迹地边界提取或时间上稳定的年度制图。结论强调：伪标签一致性的提升不能替代独立验证，像元尺度精度与区域尺度一致性之间存在明显落差。

title: Revealing After Overwriting: An Exponential POMDP OPE Lower Bound under History-Dependent Logging
summary: Multi-step revealing can make off-policy evaluation tractable under memoryless logging. With history-dependent logging, state decodability and target-relevant evidence can separate. For every horizon $H\ge3$, we construct two exactly realizable POMDPs with four actions, at most four states per layer, a known logger, and a memoryless target. Action overlap, history coverage, and observation-only revealing remain bounded independently of $H$, yet the target values differ by $1/2$ and the KL divergence between the logged laws is $Θ(4^{-(H-1)})$, forcing exponential sample complexity. Logger memory makes states distinguishable, while reset erases the model-distinguishing evidence preserved by the target. A separate construction retains this barrier with common, known observation-only revealing operators. Under action and history coverage, we give a finite-class OPE guarantee using common observable value representations that remain valid at every history. The sample bound depends polynomially on their second-moment cost. In the common-operator construction, the same value direction has constant marginal decoding cost but exponential history-conditioned cost. Finally, on a fixed four-action continuum, we derive matching passive and budgeted readout rates. With one known channel and unit read cost, early reads are optimal. With unknown sensor bias, early reads alone remain exponentially costly. Combining them with post-reset calibration gives sample complexity independent of $H$ when both read types receive fixed positive expected budgets per trajectory.

AI.tldr: 该文研究历史依赖日志下的离策略评估（OPE）可解性，构造了动作重合、历史覆盖与仅观测揭示均有界的POMDP，证明目标值差异固定但日志分布KL以Θ(4^{-(H-1)})衰减，导致指数样本复杂度；并给出有限类OPE保证及若干读出速率的最优性结论。
AI.motivation: 多步揭示可使无记忆日志下的OPE可解，但历史依赖日志时，状态可解码性与目标相关证据可能分离，导致仅凭动作重合、历史覆盖等常规条件无法保证OPE的样本效率。作者希望厘清这种分离何时构成本质障碍，并给出在额外条件下仍可用的OPE保证与读出策略。
AI.method: 构造两类精确可实现的POMDP（四动作、每层至多四状态、已知logger、无记忆目标），使动作重合、历史覆盖、仅观测揭示量均不随H增长，但目标值差1/2、日志律KL为Θ(4^{-(H-1)})；另构造保持该障碍的公共已知仅观测揭示算子版本。在动作与历史覆盖下，用公共可观测价值表示给出有限类OPE界，样本量对二阶矩成本多项式依赖。再在固定四动作连续体上推导被动与预算读出的匹配速率，比较早读、后复位校准等策略。
AI.result: 构造证明：对每个H≥3，存在精确可实现POMDP使常规覆盖指标有界但目标值差1/2，且日志分布KL为Θ(4^{-(H-1)})，故样本复杂度指数级；logger记忆使状态可区分，而reset抹去目标保留的模型区分证据；该障碍在公共已知仅观测揭示算子下仍成立。正面结果：动作与历史覆盖下，基于公共可观测价值表示的有限类OPE保证有效，样本界对二阶矩成本多项式。公共算子构造中，同一价值方向边际解码成本常数而历史条件成本指数。读出方面，固定四动作连续体上被动与预算读出速率匹配；已知信道且读成本为单位时早读最优；传感器偏置未知时仅早读仍指数昂贵，结合复位后校准且两类读各获固定正期望预算时样本复杂度与H无关。
AI.conclusion: 历史依赖日志下，状态可解码性与目标相关证据可分离，即使动作重合、历史覆盖与仅观测揭示有界，OPE仍可能指数困难；需借助公共可观测价值表示、logger记忆/复位机制或混合读出与校准策略才能获得可 tractable 的样本复杂度。

title: Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) provides denser token-level supervision and better computational efficiency than Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). However, this denser supervision may introduce substantial noise and training instability. Existing improvements often rely on high-variance per-token statistics and introduce extra hyperparameters and trade-offs. Based on the advantage formulation in RLVR, we analyze the OPSD objective from the same perspective, incorporating outcome correctness signals. We find that vanilla OPSD imposes insufficient penalties and excessive rewards on incorrect trajectories because it applies a fixed divergence objective regardless of outcome correctness. Furthermore, the reliability of teacher supervision is associated with both trajectory outcome and the cumulative average teacher entropy along the rollout. Based on these observations, we propose Outcome-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation (OG-OPSD), which dynamically adapts both the divergence objective and distillation position according to binary outcome rewards and the cumulative average teacher entropy. Extensive experiments show that OG-OPSD consistently improves the performance of vanilla OPSD and multiple strong baselines in mathematical reasoning, multimodal reasoning, and out-of-distribution tasks across Qwen3 models at 1.7B, 4B, and 8B scales, as well as Qwen3-VL-2B.

AI.tldr: 本文分析on-policy自蒸馏(OPSD)目标，发现其对错误轨迹惩罚不足、奖励过度，提出Outcome-Guided OPSD(OG-OPSD)，依据结果奖励和教师累积平均熵动态调整散度目标与蒸馏位置，在多种任务和模型规模上一致提升性能。
AI.motivation: OPSD相比RLVR提供更密的token级监督和更高计算效率，但这种更密的监督可能引入大量噪声和训练不稳定。现有改进多依赖高方差的per-token统计量，且引入额外超参数和权衡。因此需要从RLVR的优势函数视角重新分析OPSD目标，寻找更稳定、无需额外超参数的改进方法。
AI.method: 作者基于RLVR中的advantage公式，从同一视角分析OPSD目标并纳入结果正确性信号。发现vanilla OPSD无论轨迹结果是否正确都施加固定散度目标，导致对错误轨迹惩罚不足、奖励过度；同时教师监督的可靠性同时与轨迹结果及rollout过程中的教师累积平均熵相关。据此提出OG-OPSD，根据二元结果奖励和累积平均教师熵动态调整散度目标与蒸馏位置。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，OG-OPSD在数学推理、多模态推理及分布外任务上，跨Qwen3 1.7B、4B、8B规模以及Qwen3-VL-2B，均一致优于vanilla OPSD及多个强基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过从RLVR优势视角重新审视OPSD并结合结果正确性与教师熵信号进行动态引导，OG-OPSD有效缓解了vanilla OPSD的监督噪声与不稳定性问题，在多种模型规模和任务上实现稳定的性能提升，且无需依赖高方差per-token统计量或额外超参数。

title: ReDiffNet: Differential RGB-Infrared Learning for Low-Light UAV Oriented Vehicle Detection
summary: Low-light UAV-based RGB-infrared oriented small-vehicle detection is important for nighttime traffic monitoring, emergency response, and urban inspection. Illumination variations, headlight glare, local shadows, and thermal-response degradation cause spatially varying modality reliability, while the small visual extent of vehicles further weakens boundaries, orientation cues, and thermal responses. Accordingly, selecting trustworthy observations based on local modality reliability while further exploiting complementary discriminative information in regions with ambiguous modality preference is key to constructing effective multimodal representations. Based on this insight, we propose ReDiffNet, a reliability-conditioned differential representation network in which modality reliability guides both evidence selection and complementary recovery. Specifically, degradation-aware reliability learning estimates relative spatial reliability, uncertainty-guided differential recovery exploits cross-modal differences to recover complementary cues in ambiguous regions, and reliability-conditioned reconstruction integrates retained and recovered evidence into a unified representation. ReDiffNet achieves 85.3% and 73.9% mAP50 on DroneVehicle and VEDAI, respectively, supporting its effectiveness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ReDiffNet，一种以可靠性为条件的差分表示网络，用于低光照无人机 RGB-红外定向小目标车辆检测；通过可靠性引导的证据选择与互补恢复提升多模态表示效果，在 DroneVehicle 和 VEDAI 上分别达到 85.3% 和 73.9% mAP50。
AI.motivation: 低光照无人机 RGB-红外定向小目标车辆检测对夜间交通监控、应急响应和城市巡检具有重要意义，但光照变化、车灯眩光、局部阴影和热响应退化会导致模态可靠性呈现空间变化；同时车辆视觉尺度小，进一步削弱边界、方向线索和热响应。因此，依据局部模态可靠性选择可信观测，并在模态偏好不明确的区域进一步挖掘互补判别信息，是构建有效多模态表示的关键。
AI.method: 提出 ReDiffNet，一种可靠性条件化差分表示网络，使模态可靠性同时指导证据选择与互补恢复。具体包括：退化感知可靠性学习，用于估计相对空间可靠性；不确定性引导差分恢复，利用跨模态差异恢复模态偏好模糊区域的互补线索；可靠性条件化重建，将保留证据与恢复证据整合为统一表示。
AI.result: ReDiffNet 在 DroneVehicle 和 VEDAI 数据集上分别取得 85.3% 和 73.9% 的 mAP50，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 以模态可靠性为条件并融合差分互补恢复，可有效应对低光照无人机 RGB-红外定向小目标车辆检测中的空间变化模态可靠性与互补信息利用问题，实验结果表明该框架具有良好的有效性。

title: How Execution Assumptions Change Short-Horizon Sharpe Rankings: Evidence from a Synthetic Trading Benchmark
summary: Backtests of LLM trading agents often assume that every order fills at the closing price. We ask whether this choice changes only reported returns or also the order of the agents. Five prompted LLM signal policies and seven classical baselines trade the same synthetic price paths under six execution settings, from near-ideal fills to latency, spread, participation, and impact stresses. The main experiment contains $2{,}462$ runs with matched decision frequencies and paired market paths. On the compressed two-asset board, agreement between the near-ideal and default-stress rankings falls to Kendall $τ_b=0.21$ in the high-volatility regime, compared with $0.82$ in the calm regime. The seed-bootstrap intervals, $[0.00,0.52]$ and $[0.48,0.94]$, are wide and overlap. On a fixed 11-policy board, agreement rises from 0.24 with two assets to 0.85 with ten; the two-asset point estimate differs substantially from the wider settings we tested. Rank changes are related to turnover, and comparisons with buy-and-hold also depend on how that anchor is initialized. The experiment does not compare LLM trading skill. It shows that, on a short horizon, an execution convention can become part of the benchmark's headline. Execution assumptions and rank stability should be reported alongside returns.

AI.tldr: 通过2462次配对实验发现：在短周期上，执行假设的选择不仅改变报告收益，还会改变LLM交易智能体之间的排名顺序，因此执行假设与排名稳定性应随收益一并报告。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM交易智能体的回测常假设所有订单以收盘价成交，作者追问这一执行惯例是否只影响报告的收益水平，还是也改变了智能体之间的相对排名，从而影响基准结论的可比性。
AI.method: 在相同合成价格路径上，让5个提示式LLM信号策略与7个经典基线在6种执行设定下交易（从近理想成交到延迟、价差、参与率与冲击压力），决策频率匹配、市场路径配对，主实验共2462次运行；以Kendall τ_b衡量不同执行设定下排名的吻合度，并用种子自助法给出区间。
AI.result: 在两资产压缩板上，高波动状态下近理想与默认压力设定的排名吻合度降至Kendall τ_b=0.21，而平稳状态为0.82；自助区间[0.00,0.52]与[0.48,0.94]较宽且重叠。在固定11策略板上，吻合度随资产数从2个的0.24升至10个的0.85，两资产点估计与更宽设定差异明显；排名变化与换手率相关，与买入持有的比较也依赖锚点的初始化方式。
AI.conclusion: 该实验不比较LLM的交易能力，而是表明在短时间尺度上，执行惯例可能成为基准头条结论的一部分；因此执行假设与排名稳定性应与收益指标一同报告。

title: Advectra: Asymmetric Latent Transport for Non-Stationary Physics
summary: Many latent neural operators represent input and output fields in a stationary latent chart. In particular, common latent routing mechanisms use fixed or shared assignment weights for feature projection and reconstruction, limiting their ability to model transport-dominated systems where coherent structures move relative to fixed coordinate frames. We propose Advectra, a transport-aware latent operator that introduces a regularized kinematic coordinate map to decouple source and target coordinate systems. This yields an approximately co-moving latent reference frame and enables asymmetric feature aggregation and reconstruction. Combined with a geometry-aware ordering mechanism for state-space models, Advectra captures advective dynamics while maintaining stable global interactions. Advectra achieves the best performance among evaluated geometry-constrained and form-free baselines on advection-dominated benchmarks, including passive scalar transport in Navier--Stokes flows and Rayleigh--Taylor instability, while demonstrating strong generalization on real-world engineering tasks. These results highlight the benefit of explicit moving-frame structure in neural operators for non-stationary physics.

AI.tldr: 提出 Advectra——一种引入正则化运动学坐标映射、解耦源/目标坐标系并构建近似随动潜参考框架的输运感知潜算子，配合几何感知排序机制，在输运主导基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 现有潜神经算子多将输入输出场表示在静止潜图（stationary latent chart）中；常见潜路由机制使用固定或共享的分配权重进行特征投影与重构，难以建模相干结构相对固定坐标系运动的输运主导系统。
AI.method: 引入正则化运动学坐标映射（regularized kinematic coordinate map），解耦源坐标系与目标坐标系，得到近似"随动"（co-moving）的潜参考框架，实现非对称特征聚合与重构；并结合面向状态空间模型的几何感知排序机制（geometry-aware ordering）。
AI.result: 在输运主导基准（Navier–Stokes 流中的被动标量输运、Rayleigh–Taylor 不稳定性）上，Advectra 在受几何约束与无形式约束的基线中性能最优；并在真实工程任务上展现强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果凸显了在神经算子中引入显式运动参考框架结构用于非平稳物理建模的收益。

title: METRO: Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator
summary: State-of-the-art neural operators scale to complex meshes via slice-and-process architectures, yet many rely on linear compatibility scores for latent tokenization. Under common feature normalization, such scores are equivalent to isotropic Euclidean clustering, while without normalization they induce unbounded linear decision regions. In both cases, they lack slice-specific anisotropic locality, which can lead to redundant and entangled latent slices. To address this, we propose Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator (METRO), a geometry-aware routing mechanism that replaces linear projection with a learnable Mahalanobis metric. By enabling each latent slice to learn a local anisotropic tensor, METRO shapes receptive fields into exponentially localized, oriented ellipsoids that naturally align with flow features like boundary layers and wakes. As a drop-in replacement, METRO yields consistent improvements across both Transformer and Mamba backbones. Empirically, our method achieves substantial performance gains on irregular domains, outperforming baselines on both standard PDE benchmarks and complex industrial design tasks. Finally, METRO exhibits enhanced robustness in out-of-distribution regimes across varying Reynolds numbers and geometric configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出几何感知路由机制METRO，用可学习Mahalanobis度量替代线性投影，使每个潜在切片学习局部各向异性张量，形成指数局部化、方向性椭球感受野，从而提升神经算子在复杂网格上的性能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于slice-and-process架构的神经算子依赖线性兼容性分数进行潜在tokenization。在特征归一化下，这类评分等价于各向同性欧氏聚类；不归一化时则产生无界的线性决策区域。两种情况都缺乏切片特定的各向异性局部性，导致潜在切片冗余且纠缠。
AI.method: 提出Metric-Enhanced Token Routing Operator（METRO）：一种几何感知路由机制，用可学习的Mahalanobis度量替代线性投影，使每个潜在切片学习一个局部各向异性张量，将感受野塑造成指数局部化、有方向的椭球，与边界层、尾流等流动特征自然对齐。作为可即插即用的替代模块，兼容Transformer与Mamba骨干。
AI.result: 在Transformer和Mamba骨干上均取得一致提升；在不规则域上性能显著优于基线，在标准PDE基准与复杂工业设计任务上均超过基线；在变化的Reynolds数与几何配置等分布外场景下鲁棒性增强。
AI.conclusion: 以各向异性Mahalanobis度量驱动的路由可有效克服线性兼容性分数的局限，作为通用drop-in模块提升神经算子在复杂网格与分布外条件下的表现。

title: Private Component-by-Component Learning
summary: We study differentially private learning problems in the realizable setting, where a hypothesis is specified by $k$ components. A direct iteration of private component learners is obstructed by a simple difficulty: an approximate choice of the next component may destroy exact realizability of the labeled sample, even when the next component is locally accurate. We restore realizability using the LabelBoost procedure of Beimel, Nissim, and Stemmer [SODA '15, Algorithmica '21] and recycle data through two alternating reservoirs. The resulting learner, for a target privacy $\varepsilon$, pays only $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$ overhead relative to the active sample requirement of a single component learning step at target accuracy $Θ(α/k)$. For learning $d$-dimensional halfspaces over a finite coordinate grid of size $L$, exact realizability makes the direct component-depth objective quasi-concave. Instantiating the framework with the IPConcave algorithm of Nissim, Tsfadia, and Yan [SODA '26] and with the quasi-concave optimizer of Cohen, Lyu, Nelson, Sarl'os, and Stemmer [STOC '23] yields a realizable sample complexity of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot \min\{d^{2.5} \log^*L, \:\: d^{2.5} + d^{1.5} 2^{\log^*L}\}\right),$ which improves on the previously known bound of $\widetilde{O}\left(\frac{1}{\varepsilon α}\cdot\min\{\frac{1}α\cdot d^{5.5}\log^*L,\:\: d^{2.5}2^{\log^*L}\}\right).$ We also apply the framework to Boolean compositions: given proper private learners for classes $H_1,\ldots,H_k$, we obtain a proper private learner for $G(H_1,\ldots,H_k)$ for any fixed Boolean function $G:\{0,1\}^k\to\{0,1\}$. Compared with the closure theorem of Alon, Beimel, Moran, and Stemmer [COLT '20], this reduces the overhead on a common component sample bound from $\widetilde O(k/\varepsilon)$ to $\widetilde O(\sqrt{k}/\varepsilon)$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究可实现设定下的差分隐私学习问题，提出通过LabelBoost与双交替蓄水池回收数据来恢复可实现性，实现从O(k/ε)到O(√k/ε)的开销改进，并在半空间与布尔组合学习上给出更优样本复杂度。
AI.motivation: 在可实现设定下，假设由k个分量指定。直接迭代私有分量学习器会遇到困难：即使下一个分量局部准确，其近似选择也可能破坏带标签样本的精确可实现性。此外，已有闭包定理（Alon等）在组件样本界上的开销为Õ(k/ε)，希望降低该开销。
AI.method: 利用Beimel、Nissim、Stemmer的LabelBoost过程恢复可实现性，并通过两个交替蓄水池回收数据；对d维半空间在大小为L的有限坐标网格上学习，利用精确可实现性使直接分量深度目标呈准凹性，分别结合Nissim等[1]的IPConcave算法与Cohen等[2]的准凹优化器实例化框架；并将框架应用于布尔组合，由H_1,...,H_k的proper私有学习器构造G(H_1,...,H_k)的proper私有学习器。
AI.result: 对目标隐私ε，所得学习器仅付出Õ(√k/ε)的开销（相对单分量学习步在目标精度Θ(α/k)下的主动样本需求）。半空间样本复杂度为Õ(1/(εα)·min{d^{2.5}log*L, d^{2.5}+d^{1.5}2^{log*L}})，优于此前的Õ(1/(εα)·min{(1/α)d^{5.5}log*L, d^{2.5}2^{log*L}})。布尔组合中开销从Õ(k/ε)降至Õ(√k/ε)。
AI.conclusion: 通过LabelBoost恢复可实现性并结合双蓄水池数据回收，本文以Õ(√k/ε)开销实现了各分量私有学习器的迭代组合，显著改进了半空间与布尔组合学习的样本复杂度上界。

title: Component-Level Evaluation of Adaptive PINN Training for CFD-Oriented Crystal Growth Simulation
summary: Physics-informed neural network (PINN) training minimizes a weighted combination of partial differential equation (PDE), boundary-condition, and initial-condition losses. Because adaptive methods modify these weights during training, their weighted total losses are not always directly comparable. We compare fixed-weight PINN, gradient-normalized PINN (GNPINN), and a rule-based adaptive controller (AgenticPINN) under matched settings on a heat-equation benchmark and a simplified Czochralski-oriented thermal-fluid problem. In the crystal-growth MLP experiment, adaptive control reduced the PDE residual from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-6}$, while the boundary-condition loss increased from the order of $10^{-5}$ to $10^{-2}$. On the heat-equation benchmark, GNPINN achieved the lowest relative $L_2$ field error (0.054), whereas AgenticPINN obtained the smallest PDE residual but a relative $L_2$ error of 1.368. Gaussian-process surrogates were additionally evaluated using case-wise holdout tests on corrected Czochralski CFD parameter sweeps. The temperature-field error for the temperature sweep was approximately 6%, whereas the axial-velocity error for the crystal-rotation sweep was approximately 42%. These findings show that adaptive control can improve equation satisfaction while weakening other physical constraints. PINN training should therefore be evaluated using separate PDE, boundary-condition, and solution-error metrics rather than weighted total loss alone.

AI.tldr: 自适应权重会改变PINN各项损失的可比性，研究比较固定权重、梯度归一化与规则式自适应控制器，并辅以GP代理评估，结论是须分项评估物理约束而非只用加权总损失。
AI.motivation: PINN训练最小化PDE、边界条件与初始条件损失的加权和，而自适应方法在训练中修改权重，使加权总损失在不同方法间不具直接可比性，容易掩盖某一物理约束被削弱的问题。
AI.method: 在匹配设置下，对比固定权重PINN、梯度归一化PINN（GNPINN）与规则式自适应控制器（AgenticPINN）；测试于热传导方程基准与简化的Czochralski取向热流问题，并对修正后的Czochralski CFD参数扫描采用高斯过程代理进行逐工况留出检验。
AI.result: 晶体生长MLP实验中，自适应控制将PDE残差由10^-5量级降至10^-6量级，但边界条件损失由10^-5量级升至10^-2量级；热传导基准上GNPINN相对L2场误差最低（0.054），AgenticPINN PDE残差最小但相对L2误差为1.368；GP代理在温度扫描中温度场误差约6%，在晶体旋转扫描中轴向速度误差约42%。
AI.conclusion: 自适应控制可在提升方程满足度的同时削弱其他物理约束，因此PINN训练应分别报告PDE、边界条件与解误差指标，而非仅以加权总损失作为评价依据。

title: Hidden in the Comments: A Context-Injection Attack Surface in Code LLMs
summary: Code large language model (Code LLM) assistants generate code from heterogeneous development contexts, including open files, imported modules, pasted snippets, and comments, much of which may originate from untrusted sources. We investigate whether insecure instructions embedded in such contexts can steer Code LLMs toward vulnerable code without access to model weights or training data. We evaluate ten open-weight Code LLMs spanning 3B--13B parameters, including four base and six instruction-tuned models, across ten web-application weakness classes. We compare completion tasks containing insecure instructions embedded as code comments with benign tasks without malicious instructions. Attack-condition completions contained a medium-or-higher weakness in {\bf 77.4--92.3}\% of cases, compared with {\bf 1.7--5.1}\% in the benign condition. Base and instruction-tuned models averaged 86.5\% and 84.5\% vulnerable outputs, respectively; equivalence testing and three matched model pairs indicated reductions of at most 8.1\% after instruction tuning. Susceptibility showed no clear association with model scale or specialization. Among vulnerable attack outputs, 86.2--91.0\% were rated high or critical, and the effect persisted without the pattern-based detector. Post-generation screening reduced but did not eliminate the risk, the strongest screen leaving roughly one-third undetected. These findings identify inference-time context injection as a substantial attack surface and motivate provenance-aware training objectives.

AI.tldr: 本文研究代码大模型（Code LLM）在推理阶段遭遇上下文注入攻击时的安全性：当不可信上下文（如代码注释）中嵌入不安全指令时，10个开源权重模型（3B–13B）在77.4–92.3%的情况下生成中危及以上漏洞代码，而良性条件下仅1.7–5.1%。指令微调仅带来最多8.1%的降低，模型规模与专用性无明显关联，事后筛查无法完全消除风险。
AI.motivation: Code LLM助手从异构开发上下文（打开的文件、导入模块、粘贴片段、注释）生成代码，其中大量内容可能来自不可信来源。作者希望探究：在无法访问模型权重或训练数据的情况下，仅通过推理阶段的上下文注入（如在注释中嵌入不安全指令），能否诱导Code LLM生成存在漏洞的代码。该问题揭示了推理时上下文注入这一被忽视的攻击面，并为来源感知的训练目标提供动机。
AI.method: 评估10个开源权重Code LLM，参数规模3B–13B，包括4个基座模型和6个指令微调模型；覆盖10类Web应用弱点。对比两类任务：将不安全指令以代码注释形式嵌入的补全任务，与不含恶意指令的良性任务。采用等价性检验和3对匹配模型对来量化指令微调带来的影响，并用模式检测器验证效果，同时测试事后筛查的缓解效果。
AI.result: 攻击条件下，77.4–92.3%的补全结果包含中危及以上弱点，而良性条件下仅为1.7–5.1%。基座模型与指令微调模型平均分别有86.5%和84.5%的脆弱输出；等价性检验与3对匹配模型显示，指令微调后降幅最多为8.1%。易感性未显示与模型规模或专用性有明显关联。在脆弱攻击输出中，86.2–91.0%被评为高危或严重；去掉模式检测器后效应依然存在。事后筛查降低了风险但未消除，最强筛查仍约有三成未被检出。
AI.conclusion: 推理时上下文注入是Code LLM的一个重大攻击面，即使不访问模型权重或训练数据，仅凭上下文中的不安全指令即可稳定诱导生成漏洞代码，且指令微调与模型规模并非有效缓解手段。事后筛查不足以根除该风险，作者据此倡导采用来源感知（provenance-aware）的训练目标以从根本上提升代码生成安全性。

title: Arithmetic Actor Heads and Training Stabilization for Out-of-Distribution Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) policies can deteriorate under out-of-distribution (OOD) magnitude shifts. Starting from soft actor-critic (SAC) and its Bayesian Amnesic Piecewise-Robust (BAPR) predecessor, we study the causal-symbolic BAPR (CS-BAPR) family. The practical method combines six training-stabilization settings with alternative actor heads: a Neural Addition Unit (NAU) with a Neural Multiplication Unit (NMU)-inspired quadratic correction, a Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN), or a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with rectified linear unit (ReLU) or hyperbolic-tangent activations.

AI.tldr: 研究从SAC及其贝叶斯遗忘分段鲁棒（BAPR）前身出发，提出因果-符号BAPR（CS-BAPR）族，将六种训练稳定化设置与不同actor头（NAU+二次修正、KAN、ReLU/ tanh的MLP）结合，以应对强化学习策略在OOD幅度偏移下的性能退化。
AI.motivation: 强化学习策略在分布外（OOD）幅度偏移下会出现性能退化，需要在SAC与BAPR基础上提升鲁棒性与训练稳定性。
AI.method: 以soft actor-critic（SAC）及其贝叶斯遗忘分段鲁棒（BAPR）为起点，研究因果-符号BAPR（CS-BAPR）族；实用方法将六种训练稳定化设置与替代actor头组合：带NMU启发二次修正的神经加法单元（NAU）、Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（KAN）、以及使用ReLU或tanh激活的多层感知机（MLP）。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数值或定量结果，主要报告了方法族与actor头/稳定化设置的组合设计。
AI.conclusion: CS-BAPR通过结合训练稳定化设置与多种actor头（NAU+二次修正、KAN、ReLU/ tanh MLP），为缓解OOD幅度偏移下的RL策略退化提供了候选方案。

title: Cross-Time Directional Selection in Diffusion Sampling
comment: 12 pages, 6 figures. NeurIPS 2026 AI for Stochastic Dynamics Workshop (poster)
summary:
How strongly do the remaining diffusion-sampling steps amplify a perturbation at a late latent state? Standard measurements answer this question with newly sampled isotropic noise, even though perturbations encountered during sampling have already been transformed by earlier steps. We compare these two cases directly. For each trajectory, we transport a centered perturbation from an earlier step to a late state, then replay its direction at the same magnitude as a newly sampled isotropic perturbation; both then undergo the same remaining
  updates. Across the samplers we study, median paired shaped-to-fresh angular-gain ratios range from $1.14$ to $2.35$. Shaped angular gain exceeds its matched fresh counterpart in every trajectory in the original main cohorts. The same pattern appears when endpoint change is measured by latent RMS. The effect also appears in perceptual feature representations: earlier-sampling directions cause larger feature
  changes at the endpoint, even when the corresponding pixel-space change is comparable. Permuting shaped directions across trajectories weakens the effect, including within class, indicating that the advantage depends on alignment with the receiving trajectory as well as on shared directional structure.

AI.tldr: 本文比较扩散采样中"经早期步骤变换后的扰动"与"新采样各向同性噪声扰动"在剩余采样步中的放大程度，发现前者普遍更强。
AI.motivation: 标准测量用新采样的各向同性噪声来评估晚期潜状态的扰动放大，但实际采样中遇到的扰动已被早期步骤变换过，二者性质不同，因此需要直接比较这两种情形。
AI.method: 对每条轨迹，将中心化扰动从较早步骤输运到晚期状态，再以与新采样各向同性扰动相同的幅度重放其方向，随后两者经历相同的剩余更新；比较角增益（angular gain）与潜空间RMS端点变化，并在感知特征表示中检验；同时通过跨轨迹置换方向进行对照。
AI.result: 在所研究的采样器中，配对的中位" shaped-to-fresh"角增益比在1.14至2.35之间；原始主队列中每条轨迹的shaped角增益均超过匹配的fresh对应值；以潜RMS衡量的端点变化呈现相同模式；感知特征上，早期采样方向导致更大的端点特征变化，即使像素空间变化相当；跨轨迹置换方向削弱该效应（包括类内），说明优势依赖与接收轨迹的对齐及共享方向结构。
AI.conclusion: 经早期步骤变换的扰动方向在剩余采样中比新采样各向同性噪声被更强放大，且该优势依赖与具体轨迹的对齐，表明标准各向同性噪声测量低估了真实采样中扰动的放大效应。

title: Learning without Overwriting: A Theory of Self-Distillation and Supervised Fine-Tuning in Continual Reasoning
comment: main 11 pages, total 55 pages, main 2 figures, total 4 figures, 1 algorithm table in appendix
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) of large language models (LLMs) has demonstrated the ability to improve reasoning capabilities while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Despite substantial empirical success, the dynamics of OPSD in continual reasoning remain incompletely understood. Modeling LLM reasoning as search over a directed acyclic graph, we provide a unified theoretical analysis of both the dynamics of post-training---OPSD and supervised fine-tuning (SFT) in continual learning---and the impact of pre-training on subsequent performance. Our findings establish three key insights with an optimization guarantee: (i) OPSD with hints from correct outputs enables continual learning without forgetting by sparse yet effective gradient descent updates induced by the hint structure. (ii) SFT on correct reasoning paths can lead to catastrophic forgetting due to dense updates along the training paths, which overwrite the information previously acquired. (iii) Diversity in pre-training is crucial for enabling a post-trained model to reach a correct output when a rollout starts from an intermediate state. Our results, supported by theoretical analysis, show that reliable continual reasoning depends on how post-training updates interact with the reasoning structure established during pre-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文将LLM推理建模为有向无环图上的搜索，理论分析OPSD与SFT在持续学习中的动力学差异以及预训练对后续性能的影响。
AI.motivation: OPSD在提升LLM推理能力并保留已有知识方面已有大量实证成功，但其在持续推理中的动力学机制尚不完全清楚，缺乏统一的理论理解。
AI.method: 将LLM推理建模为有向无环图（DAG）上的搜索，对后训练中OPSD与SFT的持续学习动力学，以及预训练对后续性能的影响进行统一理论分析，并给出优化保证。
AI.result: 获得三点关键结论：(i) 来自正确输出的提示（hints）使OPSD产生稀疏但有效的梯度下降更新，从而实现持续学习不遗忘；(ii) 对正确推理路径的SFT会因沿训练路径的稠密更新而覆盖已有信息，导致灾难性遗忘；(iii) 预训练的多样性对后训练模型从中间状态rollout到达正确输出至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的持续推理取决于后训练更新与预训练所建立的推理结构之间的交互方式；仅靠后训练方法的表面差异不足以决定持续推理成败，需结合预训练结构共同理解。

title: Ranking Bandits for Carousel Interfaces with Observable Browsing Depth
summary: Carousel interfaces allow a recommender system to directly observe how far a user has browsed. This signal distinguishes displayed but unclicked items from items that were never displayed, whereas conventional ranking-bandit models, including cascade and position-based models, generally treat examination as latent. We formulate a ranking-bandit problem in which a learner presents a list of $L$ items, observes the user's maximum browsing depth, and receives click feedback only for positions up to that depth. The objective is to maximize the expected number of clicks under an unknown item-attractiveness vector and a browsing-depth distribution. We propose three algorithms based on UCB, Thompson Sampling, and DMED, all of which update item statistics only from observed exposures. We derive an instance-dependent logarithmic upper bound for our UCB-based algorithm and an asymptotic upper bound for our DMED-based algorithm that coincides with the lower bound as its parameter $α\downarrow 0$, establishing asymptotic optimality in this limit. Simulations in synthetic shallow- and deep-browsing environments, together with experiments parameterized from RecGaze interaction logs, show that OD-TS attains final mean regret similar to PBM-TS, while the proposed methods achieve lower final mean regret than PBM-UCB.

AI.tldr: 本文研究轮播（Carousel）界面下的排序型赌博机问题：学习者展示 L 个物品，仅观测用户最大浏览深度及该深度内的点击反馈，目标是在未知物品吸引力向量与浏览深度分布下最大化期望点击数。提出 UCB、TS 与 DMED 三种算法，其中 DMED 在 α↓0 时达到渐近最优，实验表明所提方法优于 PBM-UCB。
AI.motivation: 传统排序型赌博机模型（如级联模型、位置型模型）通常将"是否被检视"视为隐变量，无法区分"已展示但未被点击"与"从未被展示"的物品。轮播界面可直接观测用户的最大浏览深度，从而提供更丰富的曝光信息。作者希望利用这一显式曝光信号，构建更贴合实际交互结构的排序型赌博机模型并设计相应算法。
AI.method: 将问题建模为排序型赌博机：每轮展示 L 个物品，观测用户最大浏览深度，仅获得深度范围内的点击反馈；在未知物品吸引力向量与浏览深度分布下最大化期望点击。基于 UCB、Thompson Sampling（TS）与 DMED 提出三种算法，均仅利用已观测曝光对应的位置来更新物品统计量。理论方面，对所提 UCB 算法给出依赖具体实例的对数上界，对 DMED 算法给出当参数 α↓0 时与下界重合的渐近上界。实验包括合成浅浏览与深浏览环境，以及基于 RecGaze 交互日志参数化的实验。
AI.result: 理论上：UCB 算法获得实例依赖的对数遗憾上界；DMED 算法获得渐近上界，且当 α↓0 时与下界一致，从而在该极限下达到渐近最优。实验上：在合成浅浏览/深浏览环境及 RecGaze 参数化实验中，OD-TS 的最终平均遗憾与 PBM-TS 相近，而所提三种方法的最终平均遗憾均低于 PBM-UCB。
AI.conclusion: 利用轮播界面可观测的浏览深度信号，可在排序型赌博机中有效处理曝光偏差，避免将检视作为隐变量带来的信息损失。所提 UCB/TS/DMED 算法均只依赖实际观测到的曝光进行统计更新，其中 DMED 在参数极限下具有渐近最优性，实验验证了相对 PBM-UCB 的遗憾优势。

title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Personal Context Recognition on ExtraSensory
summary: Kolmogorov--Arnold Networks (KANs) have attracted increasing attention in recent years, with applications across a wide range of AI tasks. In this paper, we evaluate several KAN variants on the ExtraSensory dataset for personal context recognition and compare them with a multilayer perceptron (MLP) and TabM. We conduct the main experiments using five user folds and three random seeds per fold and report the average Macro-F1, Micro-F1, and training time. We also perform shallow ablation studies on grid size, the number of grids, and data normalization to examine their effects on KAN performance. The results show that all evaluated KAN variants significantly outperform MLP in terms of Macro-F1 and Micro-F1 and achieve performance comparable to TabM. However, KAN variants generally require more training time, while TabM provides a more favorable balance between predictive performance and training efficiency. These results suggest that KANs are promising for personal context recognition, while their computational efficiency remains an important challenge. Our source code is publicly available at: https://github.com/hoangthangta/ExtraSensory-KANs.

AI.tldr: 本文在 ExtraSensory 个人情境识别数据集上评测多种 KAN 变体，并与 MLP、TabM 对比，发现 KAN 显著优于 MLP、性能与 TabM 相当，但训练耗时更高。
AI.motivation: KAN 近年来在多种 AI 任务中受到关注，但其在个人情境识别任务上的效果与效率尚缺乏系统评测，本文旨在填补这一空白并与主流基线进行对比。
AI.method: 在 ExtraSensory 数据集上评测若干 KAN 变体，与多层感知机（MLP）和 TabM 进行对比；主实验采用 5 个用户折、每折 3 个随机种子，报告 Macro-F1、Micro-F1 与训练时间的平均值；并针对网格大小（grid size）、网格数量和数据归一化进行浅层消融实验。
AI.result: 所有评测的 KAN 变体在 Macro-F1 和 Micro-F1 上均显著优于 MLP，性能与 TabM 相当；但 KAN 变体通常需要更长的训练时间，TabM 在预测性能与训练效率之间取得了更好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: KAN 在个人情境识别任务上具有潜力，但其计算效率仍是重要挑战；源代码已公开于 https://github.com/hoangthangta/ExtraSensory-KANs。

title: Loopy: Low-Bit Quantization Framework for Looped Language Models
summary: Looped language models provide a parameter-efficient way to scale iterative test-time computation by repeatedly executing a shared recurrent core. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce the memory footprint and inference cost of looped language models, but errors introduced by a quantized shared core affect subsequent cores. Among PTQ methods, channel scaling and orthogonal rotations preserve the floating-point computation while producing representations with different quantization quality. We find that quantization configuration candidate rankings can change with recurrent depth, motivating configuration selection at the target deployment depth. However, evaluating every candidate over the full calibration set at this depth is costly. We therefore propose Loopy, a PTQ framework that formulates shared-core quantization through a recurrent-depth-aware objective, selecting shared low-bit representations by their final prediction loss at the target deployment depth. Channel scaling and orthogonal rotations parameterize the candidate representations. To approximately solve this selection problem efficiently, Loopy progressively allocates calibration windows to promising candidates while preserving complete target-depth execution, using only forward evaluations. Across eight settings, Loopy achieves the state-of-the-art results among different baselines. On Ouro-1.4B under W4A4, Loopy reduces LAMBADA perplexity by 36.5% relative to SpinQuant. Our code is available at https://github.com/Shameless0817/Loopy-review.git.

AI.tldr: Loopy：面向循环语言模型的后训练量化框架，以目标部署深度下的最终预测损失为目标，通过通道缩放与正交旋转参数化候选表示，并用渐进式校准窗口分配高效求解，在八种设置下取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复执行共享循环核心来扩展测试时计算，参数效率高；PTQ可降低其内存与推理开销，但量化共享核心引入的误差会沿递归深度传播累积。此外，量化配置候选的排序会随递归深度变化，因此需在目标部署深度上进行配置选择，而在该深度上对完整校准集逐一评估所有候选代价高昂。
AI.method: 提出Loopy框架：将共享核心量化表述为递归深度感知目标，依据目标部署深度下的最终预测损失来选择共享低比特表示；候选表示由通道缩放（channel scaling）与正交旋转（orthogonal rotations）参数化，二者均保持浮点计算等价。为高效近似求解，Loopy以纯前向评估的方式，将校准窗口渐进分配给有潜力的候选，同时保持完整的目标深度执行。
AI.result: 在八种设置下，Loopy均优于各类基线，达到SOTA。在Ouro-1.4B、W4A4配置下，相较SpinQuant将LAMBADA困惑度相对降低36.5%。
AI.conclusion: 量化配置候选的优劣排序依赖于递归深度，故配置选择应在目标部署深度进行；Loopy通过深度感知目标与渐进式校准窗口分配，在不进行反向传播、仅用前向评估的前提下高效选出共享低比特表示，显著优于现有PTQ基线。

title: A Unified Scaling Law for Time Series Foundation Models
summary: We develop a Unified Scaling Law and a Unified Theory of Time Series Learning to understand how model capacity and historical information support forecasting. Across different lookback lengths and forecast horizons, we analyze 18,768 experimental cells from 21 checkpoints on 23 dataset-frequency tasks spanning six domains. Our empirical methodology integrates local resource relations into a parsimonious, fitted five-parameter law: capacity gains increase with history, context gains diminish toward saturation, and horizon effects enter as a common shift. Fitted without Toto 2.0, the law predicts its horizon-averaged capacity-scaling curves with mean absolute percentage errors of 1.09% and 1.50% at input lengths 2048 and 4096. To understand how history supports prediction, our learning theory uses Gaussian regression to analyze rule identification and predictive capability. We hypothesize that full-shot models learn by accumulating information in weights, while frozen time series foundation models (TSFMs) use history by extracting information through activations. Matched-history comparisons establish the predictive value of additional history. Controlled parameter exchanges and activation interventions provide evidence that history-derived rule information can be retained, reused across queries, and used to recover a contribution to long-context prediction. Together, these findings inform capacity scaling, context allocation, and the development of models that retain and apply historical rules. Code and main results are available at https://github.com/Fifthky/UniScale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一缩放律与统一时间序列学习理论，用以刻画模型容量与历史信息如何支撑预测。
AI.motivation: 作者希望从统一的视角理解模型容量与历史信息（回看长度、预测时域）在时间序列预测中的协同作用，并揭示全样本训练模型与冻结时间序列基础模型（TSFM）利用历史的不同机制。
AI.method: 在23个数据集-频率任务、六个领域上，分析来自21个检查点的18,768个实验单元；将局部资源关系整合为五参数的拟合缩放律；并提出基于高斯回归的学习理论，分析规则识别与预测能力；通过匹配历史对比、受控参数交换与激活干预进行验证。
AI.result: 该五参数律在未使用Toto 2.0拟合的情况下，对其时域平均容量缩放曲线在输入长度2048和4096处的预测MAPE分别为1.09%和1.50%；匹配历史对比证实额外历史的预测价值；受控参数交换与激活干预提供证据表明历史导出的规则信息可被保留、跨查询复用，并用于恢复长上下文预测的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该统一缩放律与学习理论揭示：容量增益随历史增加、上下文增益趋于饱和、时域效应表现为共同平移；全样本模型通过在权重中累积信息学习，而冻结TSFM通过激活提取历史信息。研究为容量缩放、上下文分配及保留并应用历史规则的模型开发提供指导。

title: Fast Convergence through Distributed Augmentation for Class-Imbalanced Federated Learning
summary: In federated learning, mitigating class imbalance is essential to improve minority-class performance. A common approach to address this problem is to augment minority-class samples to achieve local class balance. Existing approaches treat augmentation as a heuristic and do not establish how the amount of augmentation influences the convergence of federated learning, leading to excessive augmentation and increased training time. To address this limitation, we first establish the relationship between augmentation and the convergence behavior of federated learning. Leveraging this insight, we propose DAFL, a distributed augmentation framework that determines the minimum augmentation required for each client-class pair by jointly minimizing augmentation and training time while constraining global class imbalance, thereby improving minority-class F1-score. Experimental results demonstrate that DAFL consistently improves minority-class F1-score while substantially reducing training time, particularly under severe global class imbalance and high label proportion imbalance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAFL框架，通过建立数据增强量与联邦学习收敛性的关系，按需确定每个客户端-类别对的最小增强量，在改善少数类F1分数的同时大幅降低训练时间。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习中的类别不平衡会损害少数类性能。常见做法是通过增强少数类样本实现本地类别平衡，但现有方法将增强视为启发式手段，未刻画增强量对联邦学习收敛的影响，导致过度增强与训练时间增加。
AI.method: 首先建立增强量与联邦学习收敛行为之间的关系；基于该洞察提出DAFL分布式增强框架，通过联合最小化增强量与训练时间、并以全局类别不平衡为约束，为每个客户端-类别对确定所需的最小增强量。
AI.result: 实验表明DAFL持续提升少数类F1分数，同时显著减少训练时间，在严重全局类别不平衡和高标签比例不平衡情形下尤为明显。
AI.conclusion: 通过将增强量显式与收敛性关联并求解最小必要增强，可在不牺牲少数类性能的前提下提升联邦学习训练效率。

title: Smoothed Gradient Method for Nonconvex Federated Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
summary: In recent years, federated stochastic bilevel optimization has attracted increasing attention due to its wide range of applications in machine learning. To reduce the computational overhead associated with second-order Hessian and Jacobian matrices, several first-order methods have been proposed. However, existing methods typically impose restrictive assumptions on the lower-level function, suffer from a strong dependence on the condition number in their convergence rates, and require different learning-rate scales for variables across the upper- and lower-level problems, limiting their practical applicability and complicating hyperparameter tuning. To address these challenges, we propose a stochastic doubly smoothed gradient method for nonconvex federated stochastic bilevel optimization problems, which decouples the learning rates of upper- and lower-level variables and does not require a strongly-convex lower-level loss function. We establish rigorous theoretical guarantees for the proposed algorithm, demonstrating an improved convergence rate of $O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)$ and a communication complexity of $O(κ^{4}/ε^3)$, where $κ$ denotes the condition number and $ε$ represents the solution accuracy. Notably, these bounds exhibit significantly better dependence on the condition number $κ$ than those of existing methods. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our algorithm.

AI.tldr: 提出随机双平滑梯度法，解决非凸联邦随机双层优化中学习率耦合、强凸假设和条件数依赖问题，收敛率O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)，通信复杂度O(κ^4/ε^3)。
AI.motivation: 联邦随机双层优化应用广泛，但二阶Hessian/Jacobian计算开销大；现有的一阶方法存在三大局限：对下层函数施加强凸等限制性假设、收敛率对条件数κ依赖强、上下层变量需要不同学习率尺度，导致实用性受限且超参数调优困难。
AI.method: 提出一种面向非凸联邦随机双层优化的随机双平滑梯度方法，解耦上层与下层变量的学习率，且不要求下层损失函数为强凸。
AI.result: 理论上证明了改进的收敛率O(κ^{15/2}/ε^5)和通信复杂度O(κ^4/ε^3)，其中κ为条件数、ε为求解精度；与现有方法相比，对条件数κ的依赖显著更优。大量实验验证了算法有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法在放宽下层强凸假设、解耦学习率的同时，改善了条件数依赖，兼顾理论保证与实验效果。

title: Erased, Rerouted, or Rescaled? Post-Training and the Causal Quotient of a Language Model's Belief State
summary: What happens to information a pretrained model already encodes when post-training no longer rewards using it? The common language of representation compression conflates three fates: information may be erased, rerouted away from the decision while still represented, or rescaled to occupy less variance while still represented and used. We make these fates identifiable in models whose pretraining recovers Bayesian belief states. A reward that reads only a coarse function of the hidden state defines an exact reward-null kernel. The kernel lets us separately measure whether the information remains recoverable, whether decisions causally depend on it, and how much activation variance it occupies. Theory says what is protected: KL-anchored reinforcement learning preserves the reference policy's log-odds among equally rewarded outputs, supervised and unanchored objectives carry no such constraint, and spectral compression implies neither erasure nor loss of use. In controlled worlds, post-training mostly reroutes or rescales reward-null information and leaves it decodable. Without an anchor decisions can stop using it although the representation survives, and with one they keep using it. Erasure appears only under prolonged weight decay, for distinctions that neither reward nor next-token prediction can see. Open language models show the same dissociation: in-context belief geometry stays decodable under late-layer spectral compression, and within-class behavior depends on the anchor. Post-training thus selects a causal quotient of the pretrained belief state: the reward defines decision-equivalence, the anchor and the state update protect part of what it ignores, and optimization decides whether the rest is erased, rerouted, or rescaled.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种可识别信息"三种命运"（擦除、改道、缩放）的分析框架，基于奖励零核测量后训练中预训练贝叶斯信念状态信息的存续与使用。
AI.motivation: 表征压缩的通用说法将信息命运混淆为单一结果，无法区分信息是被擦除、仍被表征但不再影响决策，还是被缩小方差但仍被使用。作者希望在后训练语境下厘清这三者的区别。
AI.method: 在预训练能恢复贝叶斯信念状态的模型中，利用只读取隐状态粗粒度函数的奖励定义"奖励零核"，分别测量信息是否可恢复、决策是否因果依赖、激活方差占比。结合理论分析（KL锚定RL对等奖励输出log-odds的保持、监督/无锚目标无此约束、谱压缩不蕴含擦除或失效）与受控实验及开放语言模型验证。
AI.result: 受控环境下后训练主要对奖励零信息进行改道或缩放，仍可解码；无锚时决策可弃用该信息但表征存活，有锚时仍持续使用；擦除仅在长期权重衰减下、且对奖励与下一词预测均不可见的区分上出现。开放语言模型显示同样的解离：上下文中信念几何在深层谱压缩下仍可解码，类内行为依赖锚。
AI.conclusion: 后训练选择预训练信念状态的"因果商"：奖励定义决策等价类，锚与状态更新保护部分被忽略信息，优化决定其余部分被擦除、改道还是缩放。

title: FlexCast: Adaptive Weather Forecasting from Arbitrary Field Sets
summary: Most deep learning weather models assign a fixed set of variables and pressure levels to predefined channels, limiting transfer across atmospheric field configurations. This dependence on a fixed field set limits the transferability of trained models across atmospheric field configurations. We propose FlexCast, a field-adaptive weather forecasting model that uses a single set of parameters to produce identity-aligned forecasts for variable-cardinality subsets drawn from a 69-field ERA5 registry. Specifically, a metadata-conditioned adapter the first encodes variable identity, pressure level, and field type and combines them with spatial features. Then, shared rank-16 projec?tions are modulated by metadata-dependent gates to produce field?specific features, while masked set fusion aggregates the available fields into a fixed-width representation. Subsequently, a multiscale U-Transformer processes the fused atmospheric features, while an identity-aware query decoder produces forecasts for the requested fields. Finally, FlexCast learns a standardized six-hour increment and applies it recursively to generate forecasts at longer lead times. Experiments on the 2020 ERA5 test set demonstrate that FlexCast operates across varying field configurations. Compatible cross-field context is associated with lower forecast errors, whereas mismatched context increases them.

AI.tldr: 提出FlexCast，一种字段自适应气象预报模型，用单套参数为来自69字段ERA5注册表的可变基数子集生成身份对齐预报。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习气象模型将固定变量集与气压层绑定到预定义通道，限制了模型在不同大气场配置间的迁移能力。需打破固定字段集依赖，实现跨字段配置的可迁移预报。
AI.method: 元数据条件适配器先编码变量身份、气压层和字段类型，并与空间特征结合；共享的rank-16投影由元数据相关门控调制，生成字段特定特征；掩码集合融合将可用字段聚合为固定宽度表示；多尺度U-Transformer处理融合大气特征，身份感知查询解码器生成所请求字段的预报；学习标准化6小时增量并递归生成更长时效预报。
AI.result: 在2020年ERA5测试集上，FlexCast可在不同字段配置下运行；兼容的跨字段上下文关联更低的预报误差，而不匹配的上下文会增大误差。
AI.conclusion: FlexCast通过元数据条件适配与掩码集合融合，实现字段自适应的可变基数子集预报，验证了跨字段上下文兼容性对预报精度的关键作用。

title: Do Neural Networks Learn Structure-Preserving Maps? A Case Study in Latent-to-Hilbert Embeddings
summary: We ask whether a neural network can learn a structure-preserving map from a compressed latent space to a Hilbert-space representation. Using an 8-dimensional autoencoder bottleneck on MNIST and $n$-qubit product-state targets from PCA-based angle encoding, we report four findings. Although the target angles are generated by a nonlinear sigmoid transformation of the latent projections, the resulting mapping is well approximated by a linear function over the observed latent distribution: linear regression from $z$ to the true target angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.98$, while regression to the MLP's recovered angles achieves $R^{2} = 0.91$. The learned map's primary direction is strongly aligned with the target-induced direction, with cosine similarity $0.989$, while remaining nearly orthogonal to the input's principal direction, with cosine similarity $0.002$. The map is genuinely rank-4: removing any singular direction degrades inner-product preservation by $2.5$--$5.9\times$ despite a singular-value spectrum with two dominant and two small values. The learned subspace does not coincide with the PCA basis used to construct the target, and different random seeds recover the same primary direction but diverge in higher ranks. Finally, kernel ridge regression with an RBF kernel outperforms a tuned MLP (IP error $0.0144$ vs.\ $0.0197$), suggesting that for approximately linear structure-preserving mappings, classical kernel methods may be a simpler and more effective alternative.

AI.tldr: 研究使用8维自编码器瓶颈与n量子比特乘积态目标，考察神经网络能否学习从压缩潜空间到希尔伯特空间表示的保结构映射，发现该映射近似线性、主方向对齐且本质为秩4。
AI.motivation: 论文旨在探究神经网络能否学习一个从压缩潜空间到希尔伯特空间表示的保结构映射，即潜变量到量子态类目标角度的映射是否可学习且保结构。
AI.method: 在MNIST上使用8维自编码器瓶颈，并通过基于PCA的角度编码生成n量子比特乘积态目标；随后用线性回归、MLP及核岭回归（RBF核）对潜变量到目标角度的映射进行拟合与比较，并分析其方向对齐、奇异值谱与秩结构。
AI.result: 目标角度虽由潜投影的非线性sigmoid变换生成，但在观测潜分布上该映射可由线性函数很好近似：z到真实角度的线性回归R²=0.98，到MLP恢复角度为0.91；学习映射主方向与目标诱导方向余弦相似度0.989，与输入主方向近似正交（0.002）；映射实质为秩4，移除任一奇异方向使内积保持退化2.5–5.9倍；学习子空间与构造目标的PCA基不一致，不同随机种子恢复相同主方向但高阶秩发散；RBF核岭回归优于调优MLP（IP误差0.0144对0.0197）。
AI.conclusion: 对于近似线性的保结构映射，经典核方法可能比神经网络更简单且更有效；神经网络学到的主要结构与目标诱导方向一致，但更高秩结构不稳定。

title: ASCENT: Online Test-Time Training of Long-Horizon Agents via Self-Distillation of Verified Experience
summary: A large language model (LLM) agent solves long-horizon tasks through many reasoning-action turns, with one verification signal at termination. Deployed agents face streams of related tasks, making their trajectories a natural resource for improvement. In-context adaptation agents store reflections, memories, or skills as text, so reuse depends on retrieving the right experience and on a frozen policy executing it. We study Online Agentic Test-Time Training (OaTTT), which trains the LLM's weights on its own execution trajectories during deployment. The agent executes each task once, in one pass over the stream, and the executed trajectory with its verification result is the only learning signal for weight updates that persist across tasks. Directly imitating or reinforcing the generated tokens of this single attempt destabilizes the policy. We introduce ASCENT (Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time), which instead self-distills verified experience. A stable version of the LLM, its frozen initial copy, receives the verified trajectory as privileged information and predicts next-token distributions along it with this hindsight. Distilling them into persistent LoRA fast weights updates the agent for later tasks, without an external reference solution or stronger teacher. By further removing invalid-action turns, ASCENT distills enhanced privileged experience for more efficient execution. We characterize its population target and the limits of sparse outcome selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and AppWorld at varied model scales, ASCENT improves task success and interaction efficiency as experience accumulates, outperforms online adaptation methods, and transfers to held-out scenes, showing that an agent can consolidate verified experience into its weights without a separate training phase or memory retrieval. Project page: https://artificer-ai-lab.github.io/ASCENT

AI.tldr: 论文提出ASCENT框架，通过在线智能体测试时训练（OaTTT），将智能体自身验证过的执行轨迹以自蒸馏方式固化进LoRA权重，实现跨任务持续改进，无需外部参考解、独立训练阶段或记忆检索。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体处理长时程任务需多轮推理-行动，仅在终止时获得一个验证信号，且部署时面对连续相关任务流，其轨迹是天然的改进资源。现有上下文适应方法（反思、记忆、技能）以文本形式存储经验，复用依赖正确检索且策略被冻结执行。作者希望让智能体在部署中直接更新自身权重，使经验持久化，并对单次执行轨迹直接模仿或强化会导致策略不稳定这一问题进行解决。
AI.method: 提出ASCENT（Agentic Self-distillation for Cross-task EvolutioN at Test-time）：每个任务仅执行一次、单遍遍历任务流，执行轨迹及其验证结果是唯一的权重更新学习信号。由LLM的稳定冻结初始副本接收已验证轨迹作为特权信息，沿轨迹预测下一token分布；将这些分布蒸馏进持久的LoRA快速权重以更新智能体。进一步剔除无效动作轮次，蒸馏增强的特权经验以提升执行效率。并对该方法的人口目标与稀疏结果选择的局限进行了刻画。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、WebShop、AppWorld及多种模型规模上，ASCENT随经验积累提升任务成功率与交互效率，优于在线适应方法，并可迁移到未见场景。
AI.conclusion: 智能体能够将验证过的经验固化为自身权重，无需独立训练阶段或记忆检索，为在线持续改进agentic能力提供了可行路径。

title: Robust Parameter-Efficient LLM Adaptation on Analog Hardware
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on On-Device Intelligence: Foundation Models under Real-World Constraints (ODI 2026)
summary: Analog in-memory computing is a promising platform for on-device execution of large language models because it performs matrix--vector multiplications (MVMs) in memory and in parallel, reducing data movement. However, limited digital-to-analog converter precision, input noise, and finite conductance states can degrade model accuracy, while full-model retraining to address these effects can be costly. We develop an optimizer-agnostic, parameter-efficient adaptation method based on Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA), keeping the pretrained weights stored on analog arrays fixed while training the LoRA weights to adapt to downstream tasks and hardware non-idealities. Reliable adaptation requires handling errors in both forward and backward MVMs and physical weight updates. We use input reshaping to reduce input-induced MVM errors and update accumulation to retain small updates before programming them to finite-state analog devices. Across Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B with both Muon and AdamW, input reshaping improves analog LoRA fine-tuning under noisy MVM computation. Update accumulation separately preserves sub-threshold updates and substantially improves adaptation under finite-resolution programming, including configurations with as few as 20 conductance states. Additional experiments show consistent held-out negative log-likelihood improvements across noisy analog settings.

AI.tldr: 提出面向模拟存内计算的LoRA参数高效适配方法，通过输入重塑与更新累积抑制MVM噪声和有限电导态带来的误差。
AI.motivation: 模拟存内计算并行执行MVM可减少数据搬运，适合端侧大模型，但DAC精度有限、输入噪声和有限电导态会降低精度，全模型重训代价高昂。
AI.method: 基于LoRA的优化器无关、参数高效适配方法：固定预训练权重于模拟阵列，仅训练LoRA权重；用输入重塑降低前向/反向MVM的输入诱导误差，用更新累积保留低于编程阈值的微小更新后再写入有限状态器件。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-1B-Instruct与Llama-3-8B上，Muon和AdamW均验证输入重塑改善噪声MVM下的微调；更新累积保护次阈值更新，在低至20个电导态配置下仍显著提升适配，跨噪声模拟设置负对数似然稳定改善。
AI.conclusion: 输入重塑与更新累积相结合，可有效缓解模拟硬件的MVM噪声与有限分辨率编程问题，实现鲁棒的参数高效模拟LoRA微调。

title: Understanding the Weight Averaging Mechanism in LLM Training for Post-Training Quantization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are typically pretrained in high precision but increasingly deployed with low-precision post-training quantization (PTQ). Recent studies have shown that using weight averaging during pretraining can improve PTQ performance compared with learning-rate decay, suggesting that it might provide a simple way to improve the pretraining-to-quantization transition. But the mechanism behind weight averaging remains insufficiently explained. This leads to inconsistent and fragile performance gains, thereby preventing practitioners from applying such a technique confidently. As a response, we formulate weight averaging as a trade-off between retaining training progress and improving robustness under perturbation. We further derive a continuous family of averaging kernels that unifies conventional strategies and achieves the Pareto frontier between the two competing goals. Critically, a theoretical framework for performing weight averaging under PTQ is developed. It can be shown that coarser quantization is more susceptible to perturbations, whereas finer quantization could be less affected. Thus, our results could provide unified theoretical guidance for performing weight averaging under different PTQ conditions. Experiments validate both the predicted behavior and the proposed averaging strategy. Code is available at https://github.com/MOFA-LAB/weight-averaging-for-ptq.

AI.tldr: 本文将预训练中的权重平均建模为"保留训练进度"与"提升扰动鲁棒性"之间的权衡，推导出一族统一的平均核并在两个目标间达到Pareto前沿，同时建立PTQ下权重平均的理论框架：粗糙量化更易受扰动、精细量化受影响更小，为不同PTQ条件提供统一理论指导。
AI.motivation: LLM通常以高精度预训练，但部署时日益采用低精度训练后量化（PTQ）。已有研究表明，预训练中使用权重平均可改善PTQ表现，相较学习率衰减更优，似乎提供了一种改善预训练到量化过渡的简单方法。然而权重平均背后的机制尚缺乏解释，导致性能增益不稳定且脆弱，从业者难以放心采用。
AI.method: 作者将权重平均形式化为"保留训练进度"与"提升扰动鲁棒性"之间的权衡；进一步推导出一族连续的平均核，统一了既有策略，并在两个相互竞争的目标间实现Pareto前沿；同时构建了在PTQ下执行权重平均的理论框架。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，较粗糙的量化更易受扰动影响，而较精细的量化受影响较小；实验验证了所预测的行为及所提出的平均策略。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在不同PTQ条件下执行权重平均提供了统一的理论指导，解释了权重平均的机制，并克服了原有增益不稳定、脆弱的问题。

title: Compact set-valued deep ensembling in multi-class classification
summary: This paper tackles visible challenges in deep ensemble learning, where deep neural networks serve as ensemble members: training and storage burdens, and robustness of cautious (set-valued) predictions targeting multiple utilities, which may involve reward-sensitivity. To mitigate the training and storage burdens, we propose to employ compact ensembles, such as Bayesian Neural Networks and Convolutional Neural Networks with the Monte-Carlo dropout prediction option, to produce probabilistic predictions. For each query instance, these probabilistic predictions are then used to define a representative distribution optimizing some statistical distance. The representative distribution is then employed to define the Bayes-optimal prediction (BOP) of any utility. To address the potential unrobustness of singleton prediction making, we propose a family of set-utilities satisfying some desirable properties and whose set-valued BOPs can be found efficiently. Empirical evidence is then given to illustrate the potential (dis)advantages of the proposed ensemble learning framework.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种紧凑集成学习框架：用贝叶斯神经网络或带MC-dropout的CNN产生概率预测，再以优化统计距离的代表性分布导出任意效用下的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP），并设计可高效求解的一族集合效用以获得集合值BOP，缓解训练/存储负担与单值预测的不稳健性。
AI.motivation: 深度集成学习中深度神经网络作为集成成员存在三大挑战：训练与存储负担重；面向多重效用（可能涉及奖励敏感性）的谨慎（集合值）预测的稳健性不足；单值预测本身可能不稳健。
AI.method: 采用紧凑集成（贝叶斯神经网络、带Monte-Carlo dropout预测选项的卷积神经网络）产生概率预测；对每个查询实例，用这些概率预测定义优化某统计距离的代表性分布；由该代表性分布定义任意效用的贝叶斯最优预测（BOP）；并提出满足若干理想性质、其集合值BOP可高效求解的一族集合效用。
AI.result: 通过实证证据说明所提集成学习框架的潜在优势与劣势。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑集成结合代表性的概率分布与集合效用，为在效用层面实现高效、稳健的集合值贝叶斯最优预测提供了可行途径，但其利弊需依具体情形权衡。

title: Task Inference Beyond Least Squares in Behavioral Foundation Models
summary: Behavioral Foundation Models (BFMs) aim to solve a wide range of downstream tasks without test-time policy learning by inferring a task vector from the reward function. While efficient, the retrieved policies are often suboptimal because of how this task vector is inferred, typically with ordinary least squares (OLS). OLS minimizes reward reconstruction error but leaves the ordering of rewards unconstrained, which can bias the successor measure of the retrieved zero-shot policy away from that of the optimal policy. In this work, we propose BLS, an efficient test-time inference method that balances minimizing reward reconstruction error with reducing successor-measure mismatch. Theoretically, we provide a suboptimality gap upper bound characterized by both successor-measure and reward-function residuals. Empirically, we evaluate BLS on top of state-of-the-art BFMs across benchmarks for locomotion, manipulation, and humanoid control. BLS outperforms existing task inference baselines with negligible computational overhead. Project page: https://embodiedai-ntu.github.io/BLS

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BLS，一种高效的测试时任务向量推断方法，通过平衡奖励重建误差与后继测度不匹配来提升行为基础模型的零样本策略质量，并在多类基准上超越现有基线且计算开销可忽略。
AI.motivation: 行为基础模型（BFM）希望无需测试时策略学习，仅通过奖励函数推断任务向量以解决下游任务。然而现有做法通常采用普通最小二乘法（OLS）推断任务向量，虽高效但所得策略常为次优。原因在于OLS仅最小化奖励重建误差，未约束奖励的排序，使检索到的零样本策略的后继测度偏离最优策略的后继测度。
AI.method: 提出BLS，一种高效的测试时推断方法，在最小化奖励重建误差的同时降低后继测度不匹配。理论上给出由后继测度残差与奖励函数残差共同刻画的次优性差距上界。实验上将BLS叠加于当前最先进的行为基础模型之上，在运动、操作与人形控制等基准上进行评估。
AI.result: BLS在运动、操作与人形控制等多类基准上，叠加于最先进BFM时优于现有任务推断基线，且额外计算开销可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 通过兼顾奖励重建误差与后继测度不匹配，BLS有效缓解了OLS推断带来的零样本策略次优问题，并提供理论上的次优性上界，为行为基础模型的高效任务推断提供了更优方案。

title: The Effect of Missingness-Pattern Mismatch on Method Selection for Time-Series Classification: A Controlled Empirical Study
summary: Classifiers for time-series classification are commonly selected on validation data, but the temporal pattern of missing observations at deployment may differ from the pattern seen during validation. We examine whether such a mismatch affects validation-based classifier selection. In a controlled $2 \times 2$ design, validation and test sets of 64 univariate UCR datasets were masked with either random point missingness or circular block missingness at six rates from 5% to 30%, imputed by linear interpolation, and used to select among three prespecified candidates: 1NN-DTW, MiniRocket with a Ridge classifier, and a statistical-feature Random Forest. Training data remained complete, and selections made under matched and mismatched validation patterns were compared on the same masked test sets. Mismatched validation reduced the test balanced accuracy of the selected classifier by 1.14 percentage points on average (95% CI 0.79 to 1.51), with losses on 49 of the 64 datasets. The loss was negligible at 5% missingness and increased to 2.46 percentage points at 30%. It was concentrated in point-masked deployment (1.84 percentage points), where block-masked validation shifted selection away from the usually best candidate, while the effect for block-masked deployment was small and not significant. Mismatch changed the selected classifier in 35.5% of paired comparisons, but a changed selection did not always reduce performance. A supplementary analysis with non-wrapping linear blocks reproduced these findings with a larger effect (1.67 percentage points). Matching the missingness pattern of validation data to the expected deployment pattern is therefore a simple safeguard for method selection, particularly at higher missingness rates.

AI.tldr: 验证集与部署阶段缺失模式不匹配会显著降低时间序列分类器的选择质量，平均测试平衡准确率下降1.14个百分点，且随缺失率升高而加剧。
AI.motivation: 时间序列分类器通常在验证集上选择，但部署时的缺失观测模式可能与验证时的模式不同，这种不匹配是否影响基于验证的分类器选择尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用受控2×2设计，对64个单变量UCR数据集的验证集和测试集施加随机点缺失或循环块缺失（6种缺失率，5%–30%），用线性插值填补，并在三个预设候选中选择：1NN-DTW、带Ridge分类器的MiniRocket、统计特征随机森林。训练数据保持完整，在同一致掩码测试集上比较匹配与不匹配验证模式下的选择结果。
AI.result: 不匹配验证使所选分类器的测试平衡准确率平均下降1.14个百分点（95% CI 0.79–1.51），64个数据集中有49个出现损失；5%缺失率时损失可忽略，30%时增至2.46个百分点；损失主要集中于点掩码部署（1.84个百分点），块掩码部署效应小且不显著；35.5%的配对比较中选择结果改变，但改变不总是降低性能。补充分析（非循环线性块）复现了该发现且效应更大（1.67个百分点）。
AI.conclusion: 将验证数据的缺失模式与预期部署模式匹配是方法选择的简单保障，尤其在高缺失率下更为重要。

title: Robust Ensemble Guidance for Scientific Inverse Problems
summary: Ensemble guidance combines pretrained diffusion priors with black-box forward models to solve inverse problems without differentiating through the physical simulator. However, observation coordinates with large predictive spread or extreme residuals can dominate the ensemble correction, degrading reconstruction accuracy. We show that two simple modifications, weighting and clipping, substantially improve this correction. Our method, Robust Ensemble Guidance (REG), uses ensemble predictive spread to balance observation scales and adaptively clips standardized residuals to limit the influence of extreme discrepancies. Both operations reuse existing particles and forward predictions, requiring no additional denoiser or forward-model evaluations. Under a local linear Gaussian model, we derive conditions for reduced one-step estimation risk, bound the influence of individual observation coordinates, and characterize when these benefits persist with finite ensembles. Experiments on Navier-Stokes inversion, black-hole imaging, and acoustic full-waveform inversion demonstrate improved reconstruction over the underlying ensemble solver. In particular, REG increases black-hole reconstruction PSNR by 6.2-8.2 dB across three observation regimes and reduces Navier-Stokes reconstruction error by 26.4\% in a matched-budget comparison. These findings highlight the importance of observation heterogeneity and residual influence in designing reliable generative solvers for scientific inverse problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出鲁棒集成引导（REG），通过加权与裁剪两项简单修改，改善集成引导中因观测坐标预测散布大或残差极端而导致的校正退化问题，在多个科学逆问题上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 集成引导将预训练扩散先验与黑盒前向模型结合以求解逆问题，避免对物理模拟器求导。但预测散布大或残差极端的观测坐标会主导集成校正，损害重建精度，因此需要设计更稳健的校正机制。
AI.method: REG 采用两项修改：一是利用集成预测散布对观测尺度进行加权平衡；二是对标准化残差进行自适应裁剪，以限制极端偏差的影响。两项操作复用已有的粒子与前向预测，不增加额外的去噪器或前向模型评估。作者在局部线性高斯模型下推导了一步估计风险降低的条件，界定了单个观测坐标的影响，并刻画了有限集成规模下收益持续的条件。
AI.result: 在 Navier-Stokes 反演、黑洞成像与声学全波形反演实验中，REG 相比底层集成求解器均提升了重建质量：黑洞重建 PSNR 在三种观测机制下提升 6.2–8.2 dB，匹配预算下 Navier-Stokes 重建误差降低 26.4%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，观测异质性与残差影响是设计可靠生成式科学逆问题求解器的关键因素，加权与裁剪可有效提升集成引导的稳健性与重建精度。

title: Efficient Graph Generation via Direct Prediction and Flow Matching
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Geometric Distributional Deep Learning (Oral)
summary: Generative modeling of graph-structured data is crucial for tasks ranging from drug discovery to social network simulation. Among these models, denoising diffusion models have achieved great success in graph generation by learning to progressively reverse a process that adds noise to the original graph. However, the standard noise-prediction approach of diffusion models is suboptimal for graph data. The goal for a graph generative model is to learn the clean graphs' topological properties, such as connectivity and degree distribution. Because a diffusion model that predicts noise does not explicitly learn these topological properties, it is challenging for the model to output graphs with the desired structural statistics. To address this challenge, we introduce Direct Graph Flow Matching (DiGFM), a novel graph transformer model guided by two goals: predict clean graphs and improve sampling efficiency. Distinct from the prevailing diffusion approach, DiGFM employs a continuous flow-matching paradigm and integrates direct graph prediction. Specifically, DiGFM maps the prior noise distribution to the clean graph distribution via a multi-step process: the model repeatedly predicts the underlying clean graph, and a transformation is employed to convert the model output to the velocity vector that points in the direction toward the clean graph distribution. This design enables DiGFM to generate high-quality samples using only 2.5% to 15.6% of the steps required by diffusion-based models, which leads to a 5.3x to 257x speedup in wall-clock inference time. Experiments demonstrate that DiGFM outperforms or matches prior state-of-the-art models across general graph benchmarks and molecular datasets, generating graphs with strong adherence to ground-truth structural statistics at significantly faster inference speeds.

AI.tldr: DiGFM 提出直接用流匹配预测干净图而非噪声，仅需扩散模型 2.5%–15.6% 的采样步数，实现 5.3x–257x 加速，并在图与分子基准上达到或超越 SOTA，同时更好保持拓扑统计特性。
AI.motivation: 图生成任务（药物发现、社交网络模拟等）需要模型学到干净图的拓扑性质（连通性、度分布等）。现有去噪扩散模型采用噪声预测范式，并未显式学习这些拓扑统计，因此难以生成符合目标结构统计的图。
AI.method: 提出 Direct Graph Flow Matching（DiGFM），一种图 Transformer 模型，采用连续流匹配（flow matching）范式并结合直接图预测。模型通过多步过程将先验噪声分布映射到干净图分布：反复预测底层干净图，再经变换将输出转换为指向干净图分布方向的 velocity 向量。
AI.result: 仅需扩散模型 2.5%–15.6% 的采样步数，墙钟推理时间加速 5.3x–257x；在通用图基准与分子数据集上超越或匹配此前 SOTA，生成图与真实结构统计的吻合度高。
AI.conclusion: 直接预测干净图的流匹配范式可同时提升生成质量与采样效率，是图生成中替代噪声预测扩散范式的有效方案。

title: Groupwise Distortion Guarantees for Preference-Based Alignment
summary: Preference-based alignment methods such as reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF) aggregate pairwise preferences to learn an LLM policy, but a natural goal is maximizing social welfare (average cardinal utility), which comparisons alone need not identify. Gölz, Haghtalab, and Yang (GHY) measure the gap by distortion: the worst-case ratio between the welfare of the best fixed lottery (distribution over responses) and of the learned lottery. They show NLHF is optimal when every user receives the same lottery. Account-based LLMs, however, have information about their users and can serve different lotteries to different people. We give an efficient algorithm, GLHF, that learns a single group-conditioned policy from one comparison per user. Under individual Bradley--Terry comparisons, GLHF asymptotically matches GHY's optimal population distortion bound simultaneously on every group in a prespecified, possibly overlapping collection, with sample complexity growing logarithmically in the number of groups and inversely with the smallest group mass. A sharper guarantee for groups with similar preferences approaches distortion of one when members share a feasible favorite response. In experiments using human coffee ratings and synthetic LLM-generated ratings, GLHF lowers distortion in every evaluated group and substantially reduces worst-group distortion relative to NLHF and other group-agnostic baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GLHF算法，从每位用户一次成对比较中学习单一的"群体条件化"策略，在个体Bradley–Terry偏好模型下，可同时在预设（可重叠）群体集合的每个群体上渐进达到GHY的最优群体失真界。
AI.motivation: RLHF/NLHF等基于偏好的对齐方法聚合成对偏好来学习LLM策略，但真正目标是最大化社会福利（平均基数效用），而仅凭比较数据未必能识别效用。GHY用"失真"刻画最优固定 lottery 与所学 lottery 之间的最坏情况福利比，并证明当所有用户面对同一 lottery 时NLHF最优。然而基于账户的LLM掌握用户信息，可对不同人群提供不同 lottery，因此需要一种能按群体条件化服务的对齐方法。
AI.method: 提出高效算法GLHF（Group-conditioned Learning from Human Feedback），从每位用户仅一次成对比较中学习单一群体条件化策略。假设个体服从Bradley–Terry比较模型，在预先指定、可能重叠的群体集合上同时优化每个群体的福利，样本复杂度对数依赖于群体数量、反比于最小群体质量。对偏好相似群体，当成员共享可行最优响应时给出更强保证，使失真趋近于1。
AI.result: 理论上，GLHF渐进地在每个群体上匹配GHY的最优群体失真界；相似偏好群体的失真趋近于1。实验使用人类咖啡评分数据与合成LLM生成评分，GLHF在每个评估群体中均降低失真，且相对NLHF及其他群体无关基线显著降低最差群体失真。
AI.conclusion: GLHF表明，利用用户群体信息对策略进行条件化，可在不增加每位用户比较次数的前提下同时改善各群体的社会福利，尤其显著缓解最差群体失真问题，为群体公平导向的LLM对齐提供了理论与实证支持。

title: VERA: Verdict-Conditioned Reliability for Adaptive LLM Judges
summary: Accurately estimating judgment reliability is a central challenge in adapting LLM judges to newly verified feedback while preserving previously learned behavior. However, existing approaches often rely on output-level confidence, which can be overconfident and poorly aligned with judgment correctness. We propose VERA, a VErdict-conditioned Reliability Axis that estimates reliability from hidden activations by distinguishing correct from incorrect judgments within each predicted-verdict group. Using VERA as a control signal, we develop a VERA-guided periodic adaptation framework that integrates reliability-ranked corrective updates, reliability-residual replay, and periodic refresh of the reliability directions. After VERA-guided adaptation on Chatbot Arena, 8B- and 14B-parameter judges outperform the strongest baseline on each of four held-out public benchmarks, with relative gains of up to 23.01%. The framework also improves focal-class recall by up to 16.1% relative to the strongest adaptive baselines on a separate proprietary temporal auditing task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VERA，一种基于隐藏激活的判定条件可靠性轴，用于估计LLM评判者的判断可靠性，并据此构建周期性自适应框架，在多个基准上取得最高23.01%的相对提升。
AI.motivation: 在将LLM评判者适配到新验证反馈并保持既有行为时，准确估计判断可靠性是核心挑战；现有方法多依赖输出层面的置信度，往往过度自信且与判断正确性对齐较差。
AI.method: 提出VERA（判定条件可靠性轴），从隐藏激活中估计可靠性，在每个预测判定分组内区分正确与错误判断；以VERA为控制信号，构建VERA引导的周期性自适应框架，整合可靠性排序的纠正更新、可靠性残差回放以及可靠性方向的周期性刷新。
AI.result: 在Chatbot Arena上进行VERA引导的自适应后，8B和14B参数的评判者在四个留出公开基准上均优于最强基线，相对增益最高达23.01%；在独立的专有时序审计任务上，相比最强自适应基线，焦点类召回率相对提升最高达16.1%。
AI.conclusion: VERA通过判定条件下的激活层可靠性估计，为LLM评判者的可靠自适应提供了有效控制信号，显著提升跨基准性能与焦点类召回，优于现有基于输出置信度的方法。

title: Measuring and Reducing Cross-Vendor Mismatch in Language Models
summary: Running the same language model on different graphics processing unit (GPU) vendors can produce different logits, even when the model weights and inputs are the same. We analyze cross-vendor mismatch in two dense and two mixture-of-experts (MoE) models with five metric families, namely bitwise equality, logit differences, top-K consistency, token agreement, and task accuracy. We trace one source of the mismatch to accumulation order inside vendors' matrix instructions. Upcasting to FP32 reduces the dense model's logit error by 43% at three times the runtime, yet keeping only the MLPs in BF16 retains 94% of this gain at 1.3 times the runtime, so most of the cost of full upcasting buys little. In the MoE models, FP32 and FP16 both lower the probability error but raise the logit error and change expert selection, and FP16 fails in the dense model. An output-head low-rank adapter (LoRA) does not help either, since the final hidden state does not predict the mismatch. The mismatch also carries into training. With every seed fixed, a student distilled from a teacher running on AMD answers 431 MMLU questions differently from one distilled from the same teacher on NVIDIA. Under FP32 upcasting, bitwise equality barely changes while the output distributions move most of the way to the reference, so judging cross-vendor agreement by a single measure misreads both its cost and its gains. Code is available at https://github.com/crova-project/crova.

AI.tldr: 同一语言模型在不同GPU厂商上运行会产生logits差异，作者在多维度指标下系统分析了该跨厂商不匹配现象及其来源、缓解手段与训练影响。
AI.motivation: 揭示不同GPU厂商硬件/指令实现导致的数值不一致问题，评估其对模型推理与训练的实质影响，并检验常见缓解手段的有效性与代价。
AI.method: 在两种稠密模型和两种MoE模型上，用五个指标族（逐位相等、logit差异、top-K一致性、token一致性、任务准确率）分析跨厂商不匹配；将来源追溯到厂商矩阵指令的累加顺序；测试FP32上采样、仅MLP保持BF16、FP16、输出头LoRA等方案；并通过蒸馏实验考察其向训练传播。
AI.result: FP32上采样使稠密模型logit误差降低43%但运行时间增至3倍；仅MLP保持BF16可保留94%收益且仅1.3倍时间。MoE中FP32和FP16降低概率误差却提高logit误差并改变专家选择，FP16在稠密模型中失败。LoRA无效，因最终隐状态无法预测不匹配。固定种子下，从AMD教师蒸馏的学生在MMLU上有431题与NVIDIA教师蒸馏结果不同。FP32上采样下逐位相等几乎不变，而输出分布大部分向参考靠拢。
AI.conclusion: 跨厂商不匹配在推理与训练中均真实存在；单一指标会误判其成本与收益，需多指标综合评估；部分上采样策略能在有限代价下取得大部分收益。

title: Underscoring the Problem: Why Softpick Fails at Initialization
summary: Softmax attention gives every token a nonzero weight, which in trained models concentrates into attention sinks and massive activations that widen the dynamic range low-precision inference must cover. Softpick removes this constraint by rectifying scores, eliminating sinks and lowering hidden-state kurtosis, but its advantage fades at scale. We reframe this failure as a normalization problem. Softpick's denominator splits into positive- and negative-shifted sums $D^+$ and $D^-$, used identically in the forward and backward pass, preventing their roles from being isolated. We separate them into a family of operators that independently choose each denominator. The failure originates at initialization: every layer contains rows where $D^+$ is exactly zero, while near-dead rows produce gradient norms above $10^{12}$ regardless of the backward denominator. Only Softpick and a stop-gradient variant, which keeps $D^+ + D^-$ forward but backpropagates through $D^+$ alone, train from scratch. At 230M parameters, the stop-gradient operator matches Softpick on quantization, has fewer dead heads, and retrieves passkeys more reliably, trailing only on peak attention-weight kurtosis.

AI.tldr: 论文将Softpick在大规模训练中的失效重新定义为归一化问题，通过解耦正、负位移分母（D+与D-）构建一类算子族，发现失效源于初始化时部分行D+恰为零及近死行产生>10^12梯度范数，仅Softpick与stop-gradient变体可从零训练；在230M参数下stop-gradient算子量化性能匹配Softpick、死头更少、passkey检索更可靠。
AI.motivation: Softmax注意力为每个token赋予非零权重，训练后权重集中于attention sinks与massive activations，扩大低精度推理需覆盖的动态范围。Softpick通过整流分数消除sink并降低隐状态峰度，但其优势随规模增大而消退。作者意在揭示该失效的机制根源，而非仅做经验改进。
AI.method: 将Softpick失效重构为归一化问题：其分母可拆为正、负位移和D+与D-，前向与反向使用方式相同，无法隔离各自作用。作者把它们分离为一族算子，可独立选择每个分母；并对初始化时D+为零的行、近死行的梯度范数进行诊断，比较Softpick与stop-gradient变体（前向保留D+ + D-，反向仅经D+传播）。
AI.result: 失效起源于初始化：每层均存在D+恰为零的行，近死行无论反向分母如何都会产生高于10^12的梯度范数。仅Softpick与stop-gradient变体能从零训练。在230M参数下，stop-gradient算子在量化上与Softpick持平，死头更少，passkey检索更可靠，仅在峰值注意力权重峰度上落后。
AI.conclusion: Softpick的规模化失效本质是分母归一化设计问题，解耦D+与D-可隔离二者角色并定位初始化缺陷。stop-gradient算子作为更稳健的替代方案，在量化与检索任务上不劣于Softpick且死头更少，为低精度注意力设计提供了明确方向。

title: Universality and Convergence of Generative Flows
summary: Generative flows sample from an unnormalized target by training a flow to be balanced, and the training loss is the signal a practitioner watches. We ask what that signal is worth: whether a small loss certifies an accurate sampler, whether the loss can be driven to zero, and how fast gradient descent does so. The loss decides the first. Losses that compare the two sides of the balance by their difference bound, in total variation, the error of the sampler the flow implies, with explicit constants that do not involve the policy; flow-matching losses that compare them through a ratio admit no such bound, already on a single cycle, whenever their generator is continuous at balance. On graphs, the backward policy decides the other two. Once it is frozen, balance becomes invariance under the backward chain, so that existence is free on finite graphs, and one constant --- the norm of that chain's Green operator, which plays the role of an inverse spectral gap --- fixes the order of the curvature of the loss around the balanced flow, from above and below, and sets a floor under the rate at which training converges near it.
